我当时正在拿着手机点外卖，YY不仅电话call我，还发了好几条信息；啥事儿啊?这么急?不慌不忙打开对话框一瞅，艾玛，好贵的票!!!全场抢购均1块1块1块(快闪瞎我钛合金狗眼，啥也不说了，赶紧下单

美滋滋的等外卖，还和YY炫耀下抢到了。心想这泼天富贵的馅饼也是轮到我啃了！

因为很开心，都没午休，拿着手机刷短视频，哦吼吼，短剧里的一些男女主也很帅气貌美啊，WTH哭的人心都要碎了，CTX演绎油腻霸总让人get不到油，嘿嘿帅的人咋都好看👀(也许心情嗨，看啥都更美好，全都加了层滤镜，嘻嘻……

title: What exactly is a Divine Construct! / Divine Construct とはいったい何なの！
body:
[![🔥Escalation Conflicts: Prepare For Battle](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXkPYkczkwGhrpdRMksk1BdHrQ2ptDrmfJjyih5iiadb6/image.png)](https://peakd.com/splinterlands/@splinterlands/escalation-conflicts-prepare-for-battle)

### [ENGLISH]

**The Escalation Conflict information has finally been revealed!** This was the thing I was most curious about! I noticed the announcement right before work (the info gets released really early in the morning here in Japan, so I didn’t have time to read the details 😭), and I spent the whole time wondering what kind of information had been revealed.

So let’s go over the parts that caught my attention!

![ESCALATION CONFLICTS](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP8Ep5ZbAcMtmbe3q2LZQfPpMYwzs4mrHdVzfzCSnmJVE/image.png)

**First of all! The thing that surprised me most — there are only SIX of them!!**

At the end of my previous article, I wrote, “If there are 9 Conflicts, this is going to continue into next year, isn’t it?” But apparently there are only six! And just as expected, they were all summoners!

One for each element, making six cards total. Yeah, honestly, I figured there was no way they’d skip summoners. And sure enough, the Conflict cards turned out to be summoners after all.

And the first one is this card.

![MEREDROOL](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcguSjtppVgAGnspGpDunQP6Q11wTYFg6gMcs21svCxYm/image.png)

![STATS](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY7XuCyNfwCZyLLvUKPrcWQQoHHDKrbsSZhKXou4xD2S4/image.png)

The first shocking thing is that I couldn’t even tell what the tribe buff was supposed to be. What is this? There’s only a single Bloodline Dominion icon, but no actual ability listed?

What exactly is this thing?

After reading carefully, I noticed it says:

**『Bloodline Dominion: Divine Construct units can be summoned from any element.』**

So basically:

“You can summon Divine Construct units regardless of element.”

But then another mystery appeared.

What exactly ARE Divine Construct units? 🤔

---

When you don’t know something, the answer is always Discord.

If I searched “Divine Construct,” surely I’d figure it out.

![Discord01](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcRUuNVPYkZAs6YJPHeGUoSWtj47mhVDaHPdv6QZKX9JK/image.png)

Hmm... so there really is something called Divine Construct? Are fiends considered Divine Constructs?

Wait, what exactly were fiends again? In this context, are they referring to a Chaos Legion tribe?

![Discord02](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbP1MFwoQghCfH22ygYyTRdZFMaaT4AdAe8x9vbwDubEf/image.png)

Divine Constructs deal damage to Elanor? Wait, what was Elanor again? A card name? A damage card? Did something change?

![Discord03](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYVjY184fVen27zvuc5YpGX3KEwW8KckDkwFkEYLxJFjs/image.png)

Fiends became Divine Constructs?

OH WAIT, THAT’S IT!!

![ELANOR BRAVEFOOT](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYc4PQ24xReP16XUu8m5NR57TRm3zLWh5cs8M25ctEWE1/image.png)

This card! The one where each Fiend card gives +1 stats!

You’re right! It changed to Divine Construct!

---

So, mystery solved.

Apparently this summoner can summon units from the Fiend tribe. It doesn’t grant additional abilities, but honestly, this already seems pretty strong.

![Bloodline: fiend](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZkseftEhJzsF8hhbahstBkAAby4LyEebXahnQMPtFN5W/image.png)

When searching for Fiends, the lineup looks like this. Aren’t there actually a lot of strong cards here? Especially GRAMEL THE HUNGERGRAMEL and ARCANE SKINWALKER — those are recently popular shapeshifters.

Ughhhhh... even my worst enemy BARASHKUKOR is here!

Seriously, I’m terrible against BARASHKUKOR. Just recently, my HELHEIM DEMON got instantly deleted by that thing and I lost the match.

And the granted abilities are Reckless x2.

This is another one of those “looks like a downside ability but actually has interesting applications” kinds of abilities.

The first thing that came to mind was placing it next to Painforge units to boost their attack power. With this, you no longer need to worry about triggering Painforge conditions.

Another use would be sniping low-HP enemy backliners. Depending on the situation, that could lead to some pretty interesting strategies.

A lot of powerful buffers and attackers have low Health and get deleted immediately if targeted. Especially low-cost magic attackers — there are tons of fragile ones.

Finally, looking at the mana cost, it’s only 3, which is impressively low. That’s great because fewer rulesets will restrict its usage due to cost limitations. Of course, since it’s a Legendary card, there will still be times when it becomes unusable because of Fallen Legends.

But Fire already has the extremely popular Hanv.

https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/cards_by_level/conclave/Hanv_lv2.png

The cost is lower, but the abilities are more average. The summonable tribe is excellent, but there’s no tribe buff.

So maybe you use it only in rulesets where HANV can’t be played due to mana restrictions? But then again, FITHE BLADESTONE is also really strong...

Hmm...

How should I even evaluate MEREDROOL?

It feels like they removed the tribe buff in exchange for reducing the mana cost to 3.

Still, the summonable tribe itself is clearly powerful.

If enough copies flood the market, maybe the price will actually become affordable?

And if the summoners from other elements follow the same design philosophy, does that mean they also won’t have tribe buffs?

I honestly have no idea how to evaluate this card...

---

If you are thinking of getting started, take a look at the BATTLE before you sign up.

[![BATTLE URL](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdFyv4Ep3buivhRL15L1YbU3DUKEKHTDSbKxQcwQUsuyC/image.png)](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_0f9afb5257750511d55dee2d9383fb52?ref=sakurakko)


![Separator.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sakurakko/23zSQpURqMgpo5FuaQVKT1UG8Dxmivcj6ZFG4XD7GLXtN5UkPKZi5j2byDtJpSdMjqZaU.png)



### [日本語]

**エスカレーション の コンフリクト 情報がでましたね！** めっちゃ気になっていたやつ！出勤前に気が付いて（日本では情報の公開時間が早朝になるので詳細に読む時間が無かったんですよ😭）いったいどんな情報なのか凄い気になってたんですよ。

早速気になったところを書いてみましょう！

![ESCALATION CONFLICTS](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP8Ep5ZbAcMtmbe3q2LZQfPpMYwzs4mrHdVzfzCSnmJVE/image.png)

**まず！気になったのは！6つしかない！！**

前回の最後に「コンフリクトが9個あったら来年になっちゃうよね？」って書いたんだけど6つになってた！そしてやっぱりサモナーが6つだった！

各エレメントで1つずつで6枚。そうだよね、流石に サモナーが無い事なんてないよね って思ってたけど、やっぱり コンフリクト のカードはサモナーでしたね。

そしてその1枚目がコレ。

![MEREDROOL](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcguSjtppVgAGnspGpDunQP6Q11wTYFg6gMcs21svCxYm/image.png)

![STATS](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY7XuCyNfwCZyLLvUKPrcWQQoHHDKrbsSZhKXou4xD2S4/image.png)

まずびっくりするのは種族バフが何かわからないこと。なんだこれ？Bloodline Dominion のマークが一個だけでアビリティが無い？

なんだこれは？

じっくり内容を確認してみたら **『Bloodline Dominion: Divine Construct units can be summoned from any element.』** って書いてある。

つまり 「Divine Construct ユニットをエレメントに関係なく召喚できる。」 とあるわけですがさらにここで謎が。

Divine Construct ユニットとはなんぞや？🤔

---

分からないときは Discord ですよ。\

で検索してみれば何かわかるはず。

![Discord01](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcRUuNVPYkZAs6YJPHeGUoSWtj47mhVDaHPdv6QZKX9JK/image.png)

ふむふむ。なんか Divine Construct ってのがある？fiends は Divine Construct ?

fiends ってなんだっけ？この文脈だと カオスレギオン の種族か？

![Discord02](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbP1MFwoQghCfH22ygYyTRdZFMaaT4AdAe8x9vbwDubEf/image.png)

 Divine Construct は elanor にダメージを与える？elanor ってなんだっけ？カード名？ダメージを与えるカード？なんか変わった？

![Discord03](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYVjY184fVen27zvuc5YpGX3KEwW8KckDkwFkEYLxJFjs/image.png)

fiends は Divine Construct に変わった？あ、あああ！あれか！

![ELANOR BRAVEFOOT](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYc4PQ24xReP16XUu8m5NR57TRm3zLWh5cs8M25ctEWE1/image.png)

これだ！種族：fiends のカード1枚でステータスが+1されるやつ！

ほんまや！ Divine Construct になっとるやん！

---

ということで、解決しました。

種族：fiend を呼び出せるらしい。呼び出せるだけでアビリティの付与はないけれど、これはかなり強そう。

![Bloodline: fiend](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZkseftEhJzsF8hhbahstBkAAby4LyEebXahnQMPtFN5W/image.png)

fiend で検索するとこんな感じです。結構強いカードが多くない？特に GRAMEL THE HUNGERGRAMEL とか ARCANE SKINWALKER なんて最近人気の シェイプシフター だし。

うあぁぁぁ、私の天敵 BARASHKUKOR もいるじゃないか！

いやホンマ、BARASHKUKOR 苦手なんです。こないだもコイツに HELHEIM DEMON が瞬殺されて負けたし。

そして、付与できるアビリティは Reckless x 2 。これもデメリットアビリティのようでなかなか使いどころを考えさせられるアビリティです。

最初に思いつくのは Painforge 持ちのユニットの前後につけて攻撃力アップに使う事。これがあれば Painforge の発動条件に悩まなくていいね。

そしてもう一つは相手の低HPの後衛を倒すこと。これは条件にもよるけど面白い使い方になるんじゃない？

優秀なバッファーやアタッカーには Health が低くて狙われるとすぐ倒されるユニットも多いのです。特にコストの低い魔法攻撃ユニットに多いね。

最後にコストを見ると3とかなり低め。これはコストによる使用制限を受けないので使用できないルールが少なくなっていいね。とはいえ、レジェンダリーカードなので Fallen Legends の影響で使用できなくなったりすることもあるけれど。

しかし、Fireのサモナーには 大人気の Hanv があるわけですよ。

https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/cards_by_level/conclave/Hanv_lv2.png

コストが下がったけどアビリティは並み、呼び出せる種族は優秀だけど種族バフはない。コストの関係で HANV が使用できないルールで使う？でも、FITHE BLADESTONE も優秀だしなぁ。

うーん... MEREDROOL はどう評価すべきなのか。

種族バフが無くなった代わりにコストが3になったという感じなんだけど、呼び出せる種族については優秀なわけだし。

マーケットに流れる枚数が多ければ意外と値段も下がるのか？他のエレメントのサモナーに関しても同じような能力だとすれば種族バフはつかない？

これはどう評価すべきなのか。わからん...


---

以下の画像をは紹介リンク付きBATTLE URLを含みます。
これから始めようと思っているなら、バトルを見てから登録してみてね。

[![BATTLE URL](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdFyv4Ep3buivhRL15L1YbU3DUKEKHTDSbKxQcwQUsuyC/image.png)](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_0f9afb5257750511d55dee2d9383fb52?ref=sakurakko)

title: Beauty and black . La serie que me ha cambiado la perspectiva sobre las personas
body:
ESPANISH 🇪🇦 
Empecé a ver Beauty in Black pensando que sería otra serie más de drama y lujo, pero terminé enganchándome muchísimo a la historia. La serie mezcla perfectamente el mundo de la riqueza, la belleza y el poder con la parte más oscura y triste de la vida de muchas personas.
Lo que más me llamó la atención fue el personaje de Kimmie, porque desde el principio se nota que es una muchacha que ha sufrido demasiado y que solo intenta sobrevivir como puede. Mientras veía la serie, muchas veces sentí impotencia por todas las cosas malas que le pasan, pero también admiré su fuerza para seguir adelante aunque la vida no le haya dado nada fácil.
También me impactó mucho cómo la serie muestra a las familias ricas que aparentan tener una vida perfecta, llena de dinero, empresas y lujos, pero por dentro están llenos de secretos, manipulación y problemas. Me hizo pensar en cómo muchas veces las apariencias engañan completamente.
La serie tiene muchísimo drama, traiciones, romances complicados y momentos que de verdad te dejan sorprendido. Hubo capítulos donde terminé diciendo “no puede ser” porque siempre aparece un secreto nuevo o algo inesperado sucede.
Otra cosa que me gustó mucho fue la estética de la serie: los vestidos, las mansiones, las fiestas y todo ese ambiente elegante mezclado con escenas más duras y oscuras. Ese contraste hace que la historia se sienta todavía más intensa.
En general, sentí que Beauty in Black no habla solo de belleza o dinero, sino también de supervivencia, dolor y de cómo algunas personas luchan por encontrar un lugar mejor en medio de un mundo bastante cruel.
![MV5BYWU5MmRjZjAtYjA3ZC00YjBkLWFiNGMtYTNhNmZlYzhlM2NkXkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_FMjpg_UX1000_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/diazktty/23tbRm8Xx19FPHnn5jaBX5uWrAXE5XRpi3FPXjuBxoZfitGZKHP942T3ZetW6vA9tW8ks.jpg)


ENGLISH 🇬🇧
I started watching Beauty in Black thinking it would be just another drama full of luxury and rich people problems, but I ended up getting completely hooked on the story. The series perfectly mixes beauty, power, money, and the darker side of people’s lives.
What caught my attention the most was Kimmie’s character, because from the very beginning you can tell she has suffered a lot and is simply trying to survive the best way she can. While watching the series, I felt frustrated many times because of everything she goes through, but I also admired how strong she was despite how unfair life had been to her.
I was also really shocked by the way the show portrays wealthy families. From the outside they seem perfect, successful, elegant, and powerful, but behind all the luxury there are secrets, manipulation, lies, and so many hidden problems. It made me think about how appearances can fool people completely.
The series is full of intense drama, betrayals, complicated relationships, and moments that genuinely leave you surprised. There were episodes where I literally said, “there’s no way,” because every time you think things cannot get crazier, another secret comes out.
Another thing I really loved was the visual style of the show: the dresses, the mansions, the parties, and that glamorous atmosphere mixed with darker and more emotional scenes. That contrast makes the story feel even more powerful.
Overall, I felt like Beauty in Black is not only about beauty or money, but also about survival, pain, and the struggle to find a better life in a world that can sometimes be very cruel.
![beauty-in-black-temporada-2-netflix-parte-1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/diazktty/23wqeQvAMqn9v5t85W8VLnaDM7R8LEkP8pJkMgFhwjV47cTYKKtmrSc8zqSK9WS7XnrEg.jpg)
Gracias a mi esposo, @valderalazaro, por ser mi apoyo incondicional en cada etapa de mi vida, incluso en las más difíciles.
A @bradleyarrow y a su esposa @cathyarrow, por formar parte de mi familia y por ser personas tan maravillosas.
Y a todos los seguidores de HIVE , gracias por estar, por leer y por acompañar cada historia. Los invito a seguir apoyando la comunidad BBH, para que juntos podamos seguir ayudando a quienes más lo necesitan.

And to all the HIVE followers, thank you for being there, for reading, and for supporting every story. I invite you all to continue supporting the BBH community, so together we can keep helping those in need.

title: Quinteto Contrapunto [Esp-Eng]
body: > Presentamos la trayectoria del **Quinteto Contrapunto**, los pioneros que elevaron la música tradicional venezolana a las salas de concierto mediante la perfección de la polifonía vocal.

> We present the trajectory of **Quinteto Contrapunto**, the pioneers who elevated traditional Venezuelan music to concert halls through the perfection of vocal polyphony. -----
[English version below!](#english-version)
----- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/musicavenezuela/AKSd1LgqJHJdCPVi8YYykijx1iwsBiuP4a9Dsv5YerZqgtDrqoiRbg2NPFpQ8Xc.png) # Quinteto Contrapunto: Los pilares de la polifonía popular

> Fundado en 1962, el **Quinteto Contrapunto** marcó un antes y un después en la historia musical de Venezuela. La agrupación nació de la visión de **Rafael Suárez**, quien durante sus estudios académicos en Italia comenzó a desarrollar arreglos a dos voces sobre temas tradicionales. A su regreso al país, la propuesta se amplió a una estructura de cinco voces típicas: bajo, barítono, tenor, soprano y mezzosoprano. Los integrantes fundadores, **Morella Muñoz**, **Aída Navarro**, **Jesús Sevillano**, **Domingo Mendoza** y el propio **Rafael Suárez**, conformaron un ensamble cuya calidad técnica e interpretativa se convirtió en el estándar de excelencia nacional. El Quinteto Contrapunto fue la primera agrupación en abordar el repertorio popular con la metodología y el rigor de la música académica. Este enfoque generó un impacto inmediato: por primera vez en la nación, una expresión musical de raíz tradicional obtenía la misma aceptación tanto de los músicos de conservatorio como de los sectores populares. A los pocos meses de su fundación, ya habían consolidado su primera producción discográfica y realizado giras por gran parte de la geografía nacional, convirtiéndose en un fenómeno de masas que despertó un renovado interés por las raíces culturales en un público joven y diverso. La trascendencia de este quinteto radica en haber establecido una referencia obligada para la música venezolana. Su trabajo de rescate y sofisticación de las manifestaciones autóctonas sirvió de guía para todos los grupos vocales e instrumentales que surgieron posteriormente. No se puede entender la evolución del movimiento coral y de los ensambles de raíz en Venezuela sin el estudio de las armonizaciones de Rafael Suárez, cuya capacidad técnica permitió que géneros como el merengue, el vals y el joropo se proyectaran con éxito en escenarios internacionales de alta exigencia. Tras el fallecimiento de su director y creador, y luego de diversas etapas de actividad, el nombre del **Quinteto Contrapunto** permanece como la institución pionera de la polifonía popular. Su legado no es solo un catálogo de grabaciones memorables, sino una escuela de pensamiento que demostró que nuestra identidad sonora posee una riqueza capaz de dialogar con lo universal. Hoy, el Quinteto sigue siendo el espejo donde se miran quienes buscan honrar la tradición desde la excelencia, reafirmándose como la piedra angular del canto venezolano contemporáneo. -----

> ### Quinteto Contrapunto: The Pillars of Popular Polyphony Founded in 1962, **Quinteto Contrapunto** marked a turning point in the musical history of Venezuela. The group was born from the vision of **Rafael Suárez**, who during his academic studies in Italy began to develop two-voice arrangements of traditional themes. Upon his return to the country, the proposal was expanded to a structure of five typical voices: bass, baritone, tenor, soprano, and mezzo-soprano. The founding members—**Morella Muñoz**, **Aída Navarro**, **Jesús Sevillano**, **Domingo Mendoza**, and **Rafael Suárez** himself—formed an ensemble whose technical and interpretive quality became the national standard of excellence. Quinteto Contrapunto was the first group to approach the popular repertoire with the methodology and rigor of academic music. This approach had an immediate impact: for the first time in the nation, a traditional root musical expression gained equal acceptance from both conservatory musicians and popular sectors. Within a few months of its founding, they had already consolidated their first record production and toured much of the national geography, becoming a mass phenomenon that awakened a renewed interest in cultural roots among a young and diverse audience. The significance of this quintet lies in having established an essential reference for Venezuelan music. Their work in rescuing and sophisticating indigenous expressions served as a guide for all vocal and instrumental groups that emerged later. The evolution of the choral movement and root ensembles in Venezuela cannot be understood without studying the harmonizations of Rafael Suárez, whose technical ability allowed genres such as merengue, waltz, and joropo to be successfully projected onto demanding international stages. Following the death of its director and creator, and after various stages of activity, the name **Quinteto Contrapunto** remains the pioneering institution of popular polyphony. Their legacy is not just a catalog of memorable recordings, but a school of thought that proved our sonic identity possesses a richness capable of engaging with the universal. Today, the Quinteto remains the mirror in which those seeking to honor tradition through excellence look, reaffirming itself as the cornerstone of contemporary Venezuelan song. #

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUnxETvgZJmeG5YfWAwqrxTgVhfsFpvGtT3MZepuLmpp4/img_2455.jpg)


細心的朋友應該不難發現, 由4月起, 我中斷了這6年以來堅持的習慣: 日更! 因為最近實在身心太疲累, 所以精神狀態太差了, 加上太多太多事情要處理, 所以已無精力像過往6年一樣日更了. 不過我還是會盡我能力去分享日常啦.至於最近發生甚麼事, 明天再講, 明天才是最合適的時機哈.

今天劇透一下, 上個月我正式踏入了41歲, 假設能活到80, 大概今年的生日就是正式送別了自己的前半生, 後半生, 希望一切都好起來. 家人身體健康就好. 我老婆知道最近我的狀態差到不能再差, 所以她跟三三說起我生日, 三三也義無反顧把LSJ拉下水, 要他下廚做飯給我吃, 幫我慶生.

然後, 在生日前, 我自己處理了一些人生中比較大的決策, 當時就只是盡力去做, 能不能得到自己想到的結果? 天知道 ! 盡了力就是了, 然後, 就在生日的前一天, 我確認那件事辦成了. 算是自己給自己一份最好的禮物. 另一方面, 湘在前一天也去了體檢, 她的體檢結果非常靚, 算是她送我最好的禮物, 也是送她自己的禮物.

到生日當天, 我如常上班, 幸好可以準時下班, 然後飛奔回深圳, 之後還得坐地鐵過去會合湘她們呢. 這家阿楝跟李芳還有屁孩都一起陪我, 算很熱鬧了. 去到三三家, LSJ正在忙於做飯, 幸苦我的LSJ寶寶了哈. 因為我是主角, 所以完全不用幫手, 我就坐在沙發上, 跟李芳吹吹水. 坐等開吃.

他們都準備了我最愛吃的東西, 海鮮, 牛仔骨, 蠟腸, 生蠔, 牛雜是我們上樓之前加的菜, 但我一樣愛吃, 耶! 其實呢, 我就真的打算過去吃個飯, 讓阿楝跟LSJ喝下酒就好. 說到喝酒, 阿楝跟LSJ好樣的, 兩個人都可以一下子喝了好幾罐了. 未開始吃飯已經在喝, 吃完飯還繼續喝.

後面我才知道我們的大美女文熙也會來, 之後他們居然拿了生日蛋糕出來. 哎…我去…不早說有蛋糕, 知道有蛋糕我留一些菜給文熙她們, 順便留著戰鬥力精蛋糕去. 在我完全不知情有蛋糕的情況底下, 我已完全吃不下任何東西了, 加上, 阿楝玩骰子太菜, 一直輸LSJ, 我居然幫他頂了三杯酒, 頭暈到不行, 肚也很脹, 有點尷尬.

但他們那麼有心幫我準備蛋糕, 我不能掃興, 好歹吃一塊. 結果, 真的只能吃一塊, 然後就撐到不行, 加上三杯酒的影響, 我還是進睡房躺一下, 回一下魂. 等我回魂之後, 時候不早, 要先回家囉. 今年這個生日, 確實有特別的意義.

2026.5.14

title: Un día diferente [Esp/Eng]
body:
>  ![363402.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23y8oWXnTVxeoY1DhLQxyfbzhAKDRXBoazJ8ZcpDWHXThfZvp2LgRwiw2SwMK74GqMoau.jpg) Hola, ¿qué tal, amigos? ¿Cómo están? Espero que muy bien; yo por aquí descansando. La verdad es que tuve un día bastante largo y agotador, porque tenía mucho trabajo y me costó un poco organizar todo lo que tenía pendiente; casi que ni tuve tiempo de hacer una pausa que en los trabajos de oficina siempre es necesaria. Pero ni siquiera medio tiempo para eso. Oiga, quería compartirles un rato bastante especial que tuve el día de ayer debido a que me reuní con unos primos que tenía muchísimo tiempo que no veía y todo ocurrió de la nada; realmente era algo que no tenía planificado y que se dio de la mejor manera.
Hi there, how are you all? I hope you’re doing well; I’m just taking it easy here. To be honest, I’ve had quite a long and tiring day, because I had a lot of work on and found it a bit of a struggle to sort through everything I had pending; I barely had time to take a break, which is always necessary in an office job. But I didn’t even have half a moment for that. Listen, I wanted to share a rather special moment I had yesterday, as I met up with some cousins I hadn’t seen in ages, and it all happened out of the blue; it really wasn’t something I’d planned, but it turned out perfectly.
![20260510_165512.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/EpvhW8iJgxZFRNVVkUguMUQ1Xuk4VhmjqBueuLu8kjBDvuxZzzC3C8RUSxm4iBnkwTv.jpg) ![20260510_165424.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23rz2x3Kq1iJ3SHFHy6Eyi9JRpKmb7iD8Xpya82huEJ7jxLuJHYk21ASgm9QDstf8kKTZ.jpg) ![20260510_165507.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/Eqaz5EhP127w7Rap12Qwyn8ztfALkQihsbyiC3i9fP7Ly81dRHAEHjrEp4PF2R6Uuzv.jpg) ![20260510_165420.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/242hWMATudsfEgnWPjHxvHJsCu3RkZLQdVPbyMiuWX7s39Hg38Ljzai2WZxweaAbEFxtS.jpg) Mi hermana quería salir un rato a despejar la mente e igualmente mi cuñado, así que no sabían para dónde ir y, como no nos veíamos con nuestros primos desde hace mucho tiempo y tampoco habíamos celebrado el Día de las Madres, decidimos invitarlos un rato a la playa. Bueno, realmente yo no, porque yo me encontraba trabajando y de casualidad llegué justamente en el momento y mi hermana me preguntó que si quería ir y aproveché de irme con ellos para distraerme un rato. Estuvimos bastante tiempo en la playa, en realidad, porque incluso nos vinimos de noche, y estaba siendo un supermegafrío. Menos mal que en el caso de Jade tenía su suéter, pero mi sobrina se estaba bañando en la playa y, aunque se salió temprano, es como si el frío no le afectara, ni a ella ni a mi sobrino; ellos como si nada; en cambio, yo muriéndome.
My sister wanted to go out for a bit to clear her head, and so did my brother-in-law, so they weren’t sure where to go. As we hadn’t seen our cousins for ages and hadn’t celebrated Mother’s Day either, we decided to invite them to the beach for a while. Well, not me, actually, because I was working and just happened to arrive at that very moment, and my sister asked me if I wanted to go, so I took the opportunity to go with them to take my mind off things for a bit. We actually spent quite a long time at the beach, because we even stayed until nightfall, and it was freezing cold. Luckily, Jade had her jumper on, but my niece was swimming in the sea and, although she got out early, it was as if the cold didn’t affect her or my nephew at all; they were completely unfazed, whereas I was freezing to death.
![20260510_170252.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/2458NZbss9UV9xCxKHmjd99zQNRmjGrzDvq3Z7KgCXhPctTgvJk6WJVT8YHm2RaFw9nUa.jpg) ![20260510_174735.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23yd3VyDxMhuCLcywNVxExHti3hmcrtEBMrSustWXsYS9XzRoX9dbUrfTugrdVordKRp1.jpg) ![20260510_174736.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23yTeqafDHnNdA94qN4b1C9F448WmeY13DczYqH6wzLVRkiKka83ryRoRWP9FG5J5YFUM.jpg) ![20260510_173824.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23ywpnHAqDjHwyEzxCwSbMjfPszXPvqfjcwharo1wZNw2zLEHdJRxG268P3LoJSuEYjLQ.jpg) ![20260510_174129.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/EqL7iYJeVR7v6HCgLF5aLDwzrqyHfbxMfVWmNYA54yzF1EjYqw1KNrfhyrwjKiAVchj.jpg) ![20260510_180931.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23zkpGwacJU1TaxQjFkVHvoqHMQnJDJXvyuMLGQQQCvC3jp29X12Uwe2gZo3Zb5scJ7ik.jpg) Yo creo que los últimos han salido en la playa; fuimos nosotros porque de verdad que se hizo bastante tarde, pero también teníamos tiempo que no nos veíamos, así que fue un rato bastante, pero bastante bonito, conversando y compartiendo un rato en familia, aunque también me dio mucha gracia porque en la playa había bastante peso globo y mi sobrina andaba corriendo como si le fueran a hacer algo porque se va en ella, pasan corriente, jajajajaja. ¡Saludos!
I think the last ones went out onto the beach; we went because it really did get quite late, but we hadn’t seen each other for a while either, so it was quite a long, but really lovely, time chatting and spending some family time together, although I also found it really funny because there were quite a few inflatable toys on the beach and my niece was running around as if they were going to do something to her because she gets carried away, they’re a bit of a handful, hahahaha. Cheers!
![20260510_175717.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/244oUwwUUuEzqSho35tw9qn83CCCXKj79FyUrwhMkpqvYRAtsUscT6iH1WvHVVaeJpLHZ.jpg) ![20260510_175355.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/245Hj2bJBXnTGxmi1HfUWZUWe63iaoDYKiVze4Gr6D1n26eDABNUmJ7qTJtLktKu9LcFh.jpg) ![20260510_181903.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/EqFs3EKqBqwvNA8mm8b1JtAQY2ifhjv2HSWg9KSgetWPdMrYvbq1Vbmq9K4xg3dj1gC.jpg) ![20260510_183734.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/EqL8LtP4UihYZZV21v3qmDnRats8MPV5P8tR3PXFe1Jv5tLh2vMZPvTf1bhQfVK3E7H.jpg)
https://images.hive.blog/DQmPp3w4d7XKqyHe7ehy2vRmWfJDa3A7FvafWG3WpoLJcc5/11.png

title: Vibrant banana, cacao, and coffee drink with a creamy yogurt base [Eng/Esp]
body:
Yesterday I was craving something thick, filling, and naturally sweet to drink. I remembered I had some frozen bananas, so I used those and a few other ingredients to make a delicious drink. I didn’t take any photos or anything, but today I wanted to make it again, and this time I did document the process. 

>Ayer tuve un antojo de beber algo viscoso, saciante y naturalmente dulce. Recordé que tenía algo de banana congelada y junto a otros ingredientes preparé una deliciosa bebida, no tomé fotos ni nada, pero hoy quise repetirla y esta vez si dejé las pruebas. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeM7jUFaADtgQytm6K6tRB2MiNycZ4XWuvW49aW2imDEH/1778718762151.jpg)

I ate the banana I had in the freezer yesterday, but I bought another one today. I sliced it into thin pieces so it would freeze faster, so I can treat myself to this delicious snack again this afternoon. I mean, bananas, yogurt, and chocolate are just an irresistible combination—join me in making it 😉

>La banana que tenía en el congelador la consumí ayer, pero hoy compré nuevamente. Las rebané en partes delgadas para que se congelara más rápido y así volver a darme este delicioso gusto para la merienda de la tarde. Es que banana, yogur y chocolate es una mezcla realmente irresistible, acompáñame en su preparación 😉

----------------------------------
-------------------------------------------------------

# Ingredients for 2 small glasses: 

- 2 frozen bananas.
- 3/4 cup plain yogurt.
- 1 heaping tablespoon cocoa powder.
- 1/2 teaspoon instant coffee.
- 2 teaspoons of sugar.

># Ingredientes para 2 vasos pequeños: 
>
>- 2 bananas congeladas.
>- 3/4 tazas de yogur natural.
>- 1 cucharada colmada de cacao en polvo.
>- 1/2 cucharadita de café soluble.
>- 2 cucharaditas de azúcar.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcW3XheD3nj55mpnS1fZzzSq8DANg1PdK5nP14pxWF4HS/1778718708709.jpg)

----------------------------------
-------------------------------------------------------

# Preparation // Preparación: 

This drink is very easy to make—as long as you have a blender, just blend all the ingredients until they’re well combined.

In this case, I blended the yogurt and banana first so that the rest of the ingredients would mix in more effectively.

>La preparación de esta bebida en muy sencilla, siempre que tengamos una licuadora, simplemente mezclaremos todos los ingredientes hasta integrarlos bien. 
>
>En este caso, licué primero el yogur con la banana para que luego el resto de ingredientes se unieran a la mezcla de una manera más eficaz.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR9mJeCnvKzP6yAFWdRiPr4bt2U373WVnX592Rm6zn6o6/1778718708909.jpg) | ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbK3hCDr1iu2Tdp66Pq2o6u8hMgQtpzw8a3XsUysxjEx6/1778718709082.jpg)
-|-

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmatCmeQtsrFq7RkF6EmeuwRQDq1RNz5aZqftXqxYPLZCH/1778718709226.jpg) | ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfJ2Ukv6QBEnPDduHiA9WkzCj82fRReANEQT4GMyRcc7Z/1778718709679.jpg)
-|-

After mixing in the yogurt and banana, I added the rest of the ingredients. The touch of instant coffee really brings out the flavor of the cocoa.

At first, I thought the drink would be naturally sweet, but I added a little sugar to make it even more delicious for my taste buds 😋 

>Integrados el yogur y la banana, agregué el resto de ingredientes. El toque de café soluble realza el sabor del cacao.
>
>Al principio pensé en que la bebida fuese naturalmente dulce, sin embargo, añadí un poquito de azúcar para darle un mayor gusto a mis papilas gustativas 😋 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYaKk819sd1hfNcUx5AYTkxjg2R7BoZDenRF4XjTnPjRT/1778718736133.jpg) | ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcngZA55rHkvZgzmTpACaZgCA9UWqskyvEgR72W8Pve1K/1778718736266.jpg) | ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWXreDEJ7ZKzXJ8ZQJaLuavUipq5mbcvvxTNPTVCpZbWL/1778718736437.jpg) 
-|-|-

Once everything was blended, it was time to serve.

I added a little yogurt on top to give it a unique twist and sprinkled some cocoa powder over it because, for me, you can never have too much chocolate 🤤

>Con todo bien licuado, llegó la hora de servir.
>
>Agregué un poco de yogur por encima para darle un toque diferente y espolvoreé con cacao porque el chocolate para mí nunca es demasiado 🤤

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcCnAFVXC92S2Mq4QAta8gNnaRehP9MG3enzWdEiDedoE/1778718736595.jpg) | ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT8GMaN4gmj123pdhRdGifWreLSQjMKzEVpz8jL7BKhqK/1778718736723.jpg) | ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS56njY2sK3FjxEmNR9fp4SwfoTz2sc5p9bVbp2J88JYx/1778718761990.jpg)

title: The school for robotic machines
body:
> At first glance it looks like just another factory full of silently working robotic arms, but what's happening inside that building in Massachusetts may be one of the most ambitious attempts ever made to teach machines to learn like humans.


The startup Tutor Intelligence created something it calls DF1, a kind of kindergarten for robots, it is 100 bimanual manipulators working at the same time, observing, making mistakes, repeating movements and being designed by remote human operators distributed between Mexico and the Philippines.


The idea behind this is simple but gigantic, if the bear robots want to live in the real world, they need to learn in the real world, according to Josh Grustin, founder of the company, the big problem of the modern industry is that there is no internet of physical experiences for machines, while text artificial intelligences learned by reading billions of pages, robos still do not have a Wikipedia of human movement, so Tutor decided to build it manually and perhaps that is precisely where this project becomes interesting.


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=W_9EM4mW_Uc&t=6s
https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmcM9vDyChXWWfaBhnqxXD5scZn7pnHcZrWiwyZ8HMwmbX/separador%201.png

> Instead of relying solely on digital simulations, the company put its robberies to deal with real objects, real packaging and real situations. At first, the Sony robots were clumsy, even when handling sponges or bags of chips, but after a few weeks of supervised training they began to evolve quickly.


The company's logic is almost biological. 100 robos learning simultaneously creates a kind of accelerated collective intelligence, a rare error that would take 8 hours to appear in a single robot can be identified in just 5 minutes within DF1 and that completely changes the speed of robotic evolution.


Tutor Intelligence received 34,0000 in investments and is already collaborating with companies such as Nvidia, Amazon Web Services and M Robotics, the ultimate goal is not to create just a specialized robot, but a general-purpose robotic intelligence capable of continuously learning while working.


https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmcM9vDyChXWWfaBhnqxXD5scZn7pnHcZrWiwyZ8HMwmbX/separador%201.png

title: The Museum of Sacred Art and History of Maracaibo. |  El Museo de Arte Sacro e Historia de Maracaibo.
body:
>

**Gratos saludos tengan todos mi queridísimos viajeros de todas partes del mundo, en esta oportunidad quiero compartirle todo el interior de los ornamentos históricos y religiosos que poseen el museo de Obispo Lasso de Maracaibo.**

**A warm greeting to all my dear travellers from all over the world. On this occasion, I would like to share with you everything there is to know about the historical and religious artefacts housed in the Obispo Lasso Museum in Maracaibo.**

El museo de artesacro en la ciudad de Maracaibo, situado justamente al final de la calle Carabobo, en el casco histórico de la ciudad, nos brinda un espacio de gran talla religiosa, así como también de ornamento sagrado y toda la indumentaria del sacro es grandioso ver cómo en su interior, se encuentra tanta historia de gran valor y uno de ellos es la silla en donde se sentó San Juan Pablo II, cuando vino a visitar nuestra ciudad de Maracaibo justamente en el año 1985, ¿cuándo este fue? A celebrar la misa justamente en la ciudad universitaria podemos ver cómo se encuentran estas 2 sillas papales que se las profundizaré a continuación.

>The Museum of Sacred Art in the city of Maracaibo, situated right at the end of Carabobo Street in the city’s historic centre, offers us a space of great religious significance, as well as sacred artefacts and liturgical vestments; it is truly magnificent to see how, within its walls, there is so much history of great value, and one of these is the chair where Saint John Paul II sat when he came to visit our city of Maracaibo in 1985. When was that? To celebrate Mass in the university district, we can see these two papal chairs, which I will discuss in more detail below.


![Collage de Fotos horizontal  Vision board  saturado amarillo_20260513_212443_0000.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZo9mffn3dQEdJaWXMoSEZFJJmqAN2CW6qPga8Cx61pdm/Collage%20de%20Fotos%20horizontal%20%20Vision%20board%20%20saturado%20amarillo_20260513_212443_0000.png)


---

Al llegar al museo de arte sacro, la encargada que es la directora Egle Ahumada, nos dio el recorrido explicandonos explícitamente cada uno de los lugares y lo que poseía ahora bien, el primer lugar en donde entramos es un gran cuarto en donde se conserva muchas vestimentas sagradas albas, estolas, entre otros. Pero lo más resaltante de este es que su interior posee la silla. ¿En dónde estuvo sentado San Juan Pablo II justamente en su única visita a la ciudad de Maracaibo en 1985.

>On arriving at the museum of sacred art, the curator who is the director, Egle Ahumada—gave us a tour, explaining in detail each of the rooms and what they contained. The first room we entered was a large hall where many sacred vestments alb, stoles, and others are kept. But the most striking feature of this room is the chair inside it – the very chair where Saint John Paul II sat during his only visit to the city of Maracaibo in 1985.

Cabe destacar que podemos encontrar en el museo de artesacro 2 sillas papales, una de ellas se encuentra ubicada en otra sala puesto que era la primera silla que iba ser utilizada por San Juan Pablo II, pero él se negó a usarla, porque era muy lujosa entonces, decidió por una segunda opción una silla menos grande y más modesta que está la que podemos encontrar justamente metida en un vitirinal a cada lado de esto podemos ver el escudo del Vaticano, así como cada una de las vestimentas sagradas ornamentales que utilizó San Juan Pablo II en ese día.

>It is worth noting that the Museum of Sacred Art houses two papal chairs; one of them is located in another room, as it was the first chair intended for use by Saint John Paul II, but he refused to use it because it was too luxurious at the time; he opted instead for a second choice a smaller, more modest chair which is the one we can see displayed in a glass case. On either side of this, we can see the Vatican coat of arms, as well as each of the sacred ceremonial vestments worn by Saint John Paul II on that day.


![20251217_104820.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXewWTeQb44rfeFxmEVMRZVHqD9fQomAaXR4FmREp7DuG/20251217_104820.jpg)

![20251217_101707.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdd53aVw7ZibxekMssupy64AYT1x5XLNG4yc3wvbQTcpR/20251217_101707.jpg)

![20251217_101754.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmehhWn4jtQAGfbBu1zthsrJhbEm2UYugPVLtAnpUd5f1q/20251217_101754.jpg)

---

Ahora bien, luego pasamos a una sala bastante interesante que llamó mi atención en particular, y esta tiene una copia exacta de el antiguo altar de la catedral de Maracaibo, justamente, así era en los años anteriores del siglo pasado este altar bastante elegante con una arquitectura hermosa e imponente, es este espacio posee detalles interesantes y de gran interés, puesto que la cruz que está justamente a su lado derecho era la misma que se encontraba en el altar de la antigua iglesia de San Felipe Neri, la cual es una joya arquitectónica que ha sido abandonada, y está justamente situada en el medio del famoso callejón de los Pobres, en la ciudad de Maracaibo esta iglesia fue abandonada, en 1970 es triste y lamentable, puesto que la arquitectura es bastante imponente neoclásica, algunos de sus tesoros de esta iglesia se encuentran en este espacio.

>Now, we then moved on to a rather interesting room that particularly caught my eye, and this one contains an exact replica of the old altar from Maracaibo Cathedral; indeed, this is how it looked in the early years of the last century: a rather elegant altar with beautiful and imposing architecture. This space features some fascinating details, as the cross situated just to its right was the very same one that stood on the altar of the old Church of San Felipe Neri, an architectural gem that has been abandoned, and is situated right in the middle of the famous Callejón de los Pobres in the city of Maracaibo. This church was abandoned in 1970, which is sad and regrettable, given that the architecture is quite imposing and neoclassical; some of the church’s treasures are housed in this space.

![20251217_103002.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfPZbUoFmd4RofjNbGB2M1mKAcqtnv65vx8mLG59Ku9mp/20251217_103002.jpg)

![20251217_102938.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdjhCTNXBhPW6nmD6FzXVfKUfumzfSzfVHaxTJEWKNb3L/20251217_102938.jpg)

Así como también podemos ver diversas imágenes religiosas, se encuentra en la imagen de San Bienaventurado, así como también una imagen tributo a Los Ángeles, la imagen que se robó toda mi protagonismo es la imagen de Jesús crucificado, la cual pertenecía a la iglesia San Felipe, esta se ve que es de madera de policromí y que incluso fue elaborado por un artista, este tipo de Jesús se coloca en lugares o conventos de iglesia bastante antiguos, son esculturas religiosas de gran valor histórico, también esta la hermosa Imágen de María Inmaculada Concepción que se ve que el tiempo ya ha pasado en el tiempo.

>As well as various religious images, such as the statue of Saint Blessed and a tribute to the Angels, the image that really caught my eye was that of the crucified Jesus, which belonged to the Church of San Felipe. It is clearly made of polychrome wood and was crafted by an artist; This type of Jesus is usually found in very old churches or convents; they are religious sculptures of great historical value. There is also the beautiful image of the Immaculate Conception of Mary, which clearly shows the passage of time.


![20251217_102958.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmT4eQtBNSMvWArgC8PTjYraLTi8LYrQbgDb8WRXLgXSF7/20251217_102958.jpg)

---

Pasamos luego a otro salón que este posee ornamentos bastante importantes en los que podemos encontrar reliquias en primer grado de sacerdotes importantes de Roma, así como también, podemos encontrar diferentes tipos de manuscritos o libros lesionarios que estos son guiados para conducir la santa eucaristía y las distintas celebraciones de la iglesia católica, ahora bien, también hay piezas bastante importantes que han sido conservadas a lo largo de la historia? ¿Cómo lo es? los candeleros que estos eran usados para iluminar las celebraciones en los cuales se colocaban las velas con los aceites.

>We then move on to another room which contains some rather significant artefacts, including first-class relics of important Roman priests, as well as various types of manuscripts and liturgical books used to guide the celebration of the Holy Eucharist and the various ceremonies of the Catholic Church. Furthermore, there are also some very important pieces that have been preserved throughout history. Such as the candlesticks that were used to light the celebrations, in which candles filled with oil were placed.

También puede encontrar copones corporales, calices, custodias, muchos ornamentos sagrados  a lo largo de la historia estos tienden hacer bastante diferentes cabe destacar que ellos se resguarda el cuerpo de Cristo en donde también se toman las hostias para consagrar o las que ya están consagradas.

>You can also find chalices, patens, monstrances and many other sacred vessels; throughout history, these have tended to vary considerably. It is worth noting that they are used to hold the Body of Christ, and are where the hosts are taken to be consecrated or where the already consecrated hosts are kept.

![20251217_102358.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYhfqMVqYb8LQZajEpK9oeCMhsKmrSiNNYwJ3gPb5vuc5/20251217_102358.jpg)

![20251217_102344.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbGCisRcrAPJLYCA1TtTfRgGLCYxZ2rKsninYe4X6YaBp/20251217_102344.jpg)

---

Una de las piezas importantes que poseen una sola área es un pesebre por qué te muestra la obra magnífica de la redención en el cual llegó nuestro señor Jesucristo, cabe destaca que cada una de las piezas que posee del pesebre, son piezas de acabado en español de bastante calidad y alto costo, pero nos manifestaba la directora que justamente hace algunos años en pandemia, el museo fue saqueado y se robaron la sagrada imagen de el Niño Jesús y de San José es por eso que podemos ver que estos son de otro material y totalmente blancos.

>One of the most significant pieces in this section is a nativity scene, as it depicts the magnificent work of redemption through which our Lord Jesus Christ came into the world. It is worth noting that each of the pieces in the nativity scene is a high-quality, expensive Spanish style carving, However, the director told us that just a few years ago, during the pandemic, the museum was ransacked and the sacred images of the Baby Jesus and Saint Joseph were stolen; that is why we can see that these are made of a different material and are completely white.

![20251217_102736.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbrc5V9Q37KzmZSsSRsHb81BTXRa37JwrEQUwm18UhKVn/20251217_102736.jpg)

---

Pasamos a otro salón en donde se encuentran bastantes elementos e importantes para la iglesia así como también imágenes religiosas, en las que podemos observar al sacerdote Aarón así como también a  Melquisedec, muy conocido por todos como un importante rey y sacerdote, así como también podemos ver disversos tipos de florero, isabelino de porcelana, estos eran inspirados en la época para expresar ángeles y querubines, pero está en particular, podemos ver qué tiene aspecto de diferentes flores, como también en la parte del centro, se encuentra la Virgen de la Caridad del Cobre, estas casullas, que podemos encontrar en esta oportunidad, cabe destacar que pesan un alrededor de más de 30 kg y bordadas en hilo de oro, mitras elegantes preciosas también podemos encontrar.

>We move on to another room containing a number of items of great significance to the church, as well as religious images, amongst which we can see the priest Aaron and also Melchizedek, widely known as an important king and priest; we can also see various types of vases, including Elizabethan porcelain ones, which were inspired by the period to depict angels and cherubs, but this one in particular features designs resembling different flowers; in the centre stands the Virgin of Charity of El Cobre. The chasubles on display here are worth noting: they weigh over 30 kg and are embroidered with gold thread, and we can also find elegant, exquisite mitres.


![20251217_101820.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNzXwLQ9hz1ZCiBNr6SQe8fJicRbig7uygsaPdKsvST5d/20251217_101820.jpg)

![20251217_102019.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQ8FuAUeofESbM4F9Y7LDfBmVjvVCqU69RDjEQC6yv3Gw/20251217_102019.jpg)

![20251217_102025.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfG9sia9DdwT7DwExgSZuN5NGcdYKw3n9PH2naD2riAy2/20251217_102025.jpg)

![20251217_102031.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbgf2Gw6CKBCx7xxU6svE1FxKk9V19xQWE4mQ2pTsomRV/20251217_102031.jpg)

---

Ya casi para finalizar el recorrido, estuvimos en un área en donde se encuentra pura vestimenta del monseñor roba Pérez, este hombre fue bastante influyente para nuestra iglesia Maracaibo, puesto que él fue el que logró constituir la provincia de Maracaibo cómo arquidiócesis de Maracaibo, en el cual pudiéramos ser una iglesia mucho más amplia y estructurada que se desprende de la diócesis, así como también fue un hombre muy influyente en la ciudad, logró fundar muchas iglesias a él debemos el esparcimiento de la fe de nuestra ciudad podemos encontrar sus ornamentos sagrados utilizados por el en vida.

>Towards the end of the tour, we found ourselves in an area displaying Monsignor Roba Pérez’s vestments; this man was a highly influential figure in our church in Maracaibo, as he was the one who succeeded in establishing the province of Maracaibo as the Archdiocese of Maracaibo, allowing us to become a much larger and more structured church separate from the diocese. He was also a very influential figure in the city, founding many churches; we owe the spread of the faith in our city to him. Here we can see the sacred vestments he used during his lifetime.

![20251217_101942.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZnPVKbXj5T3eAKCTNKCardNMwgbLa72yEZ4MwpYVd8MF/20251217_101942.jpg)


![20251217_101929.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeMhX19mDa8ARUBbZcK5K4G495bu9CsYFiiyHdCar1Pto/20251217_101929.jpg)

![20251217_101925.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXEoyV6Crsjg8MbL6f8ie4sBM7RfTqMcEwT3UiugNDg3C/20251217_101925.jpg)

---

Por último, hay una escultura de la sagrada imagen del papa león 13 cabe destacar, que él fue el que aprobó las misas de gallo las famosas misas que se realizan a las 5:00 de la mañana para poder prepararnos para el nacimiento de Jesús, estas se celebran en muchos países de todas partes del mundo,  todos los países se tienen sus particularidades específicas pero en nuestro país, las hacemos justamente a medianoche y sirve para realizar una novenario al nacimiento del Niño Jesús a este gran, santo padre le debemos estas hermosas tradiciones de las misas de aguinaldo.

>Finally, there is a sculpture of the sacred image of Pope Leo XIII. It is worth noting that he was the one who approved the Midnight Masses the famous services held at 5:00 am to prepare us for the birth of Jesus. These are celebrated in many countries all over the world; every country has its own specific customs, but in our country, we hold them precisely at midnight, and they serve as a novena to mark the birth of the Baby Jesus. We owe these beautiful traditions of the Christmas Masses to this great, holy father.

![20251217_102119.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQzw2ZpUJN43BaHCsorQQN2Z1wwahthEhKoiAQfUAs1AL/20251217_102119.jpg)

![20251217_102113.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbhdxqXm5rCDFDhGdnQJivKbNeUJ9VvccajcDDiS3jLDz/20251217_102113.jpg)

![20251217_102134.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWN6EhGZtn49G3kYfNEHDQ2X4Hj7wzu1aLEhCAYBSQtrr/20251217_102134.jpg)

![20251217_102201.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYJkmUQGGWgSM4i16g22BU88mnKscrGW343YzEE6N6BkP/20251217_102201.jpg)

![20251217_102212.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVmVLBsRi5kqCAVLnLoDxM7rudwYYK1C95nkf9jSSjKRw/20251217_102212.jpg)

![20251217_102209.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZSpEUSpT5soW5YfL7XpkXgMuNqvniCDPzbGLYzrY6VEE/20251217_102209.jpg)

![20251217_102238.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQuXuYKWKW4q4qhnpNCbVNdFJGkpEkWzhn6MXWnBJQgxn/20251217_102238.jpg)

![20251217_102246.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeGTPBfPnhzKPZ3H2cVuN73WCHZ5igvuXZfUkcyMjhp7a/20251217_102246.jpg)

---

Fue fascinante este recorrido mis queridos viajeros de todo el mundo, espero que le haya gustado este museo de artesacro me despido hasta una próxima oportunidad para seguirle mostrando lugares fascinantes hasta pronto.

>This tour has been fascinating, my dear travellers from all over the world. I hope you enjoyed this museum of sacred art. I’ll say goodbye for now and look forward to showing you more fascinating places next time see you soon.

![20251217_104445.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQeDAZu9vaWcD6dfbNiBhwZj2XpDp5GfdSnAVwQ39pKsa/20251217_104445.jpg)

title: Challenge #04883-M135: Divine Real Estate
body:
![ryan-hutton-Jztmx9yqjBw-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/internutter/23tv4Uz9bJ1chW2SLAz6WB4oMgbi1XhbxdtgYiyND3eoCzZuTwpSTZLLX4A5UdAuhvWxZ.jpg)

> An older god. One who had been old when the world was new. From before even the time of the dragons, before the elves came into existence, whispered gently, and not unkindly, to Wraithvine. \

-- Anon Guest

In the beginning, the legends say, there were Dragons. The Great Gold and Great Silver Dragon swam forever in the sea of the Endless Beyond, which was known as Nu. The Great Dragons swam and played, and soon needed a place to bear their first clutch, but Nu was dark and empty...

They are host to all things made and known, now, but they are still there, in the darkness between the stars. The sky at night is their temple, and few sacrifice or pray to them. Yet they are there. Waiting.

Technically speaking, Nu is everywhere. They visit the worlds they hold gently, and only when the sun cannot be seen.

It was on such a night that Nu spoke to Wraithvine. There was no fire. No moons showed in the sky. Just the stars that freckled Nu's endless being.

_You are a legend,_ the eternal darkness said. _Worshipped like a god. Why choose to walk the mortal plane on feet of flesh. You could be everywhere. Move the world through the power of your followers._

\
said Wraithvine to the darkness between the stars. Lilbit woke from her huddle to stretch, and settle anew into Wraithvine's lap. \

_You deserve a gift, all the same,_ said Nu. _Know this. Should any force destroy you, We shall take you to be a fellow deity in the Plane of Boons. You and everything you treasure. It is your realm, so it is fitting._

\

_Most become reckless when they have the adoration of a deity, assured they will have a place ready for them. Most are wrong._

\

_I have seen all of eternity, and you are the first to have that attitude._

\

body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![IP6pabPYvRRbv5kR_IMG_20260512_125151.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/evahe/images/IP6pabPYvRRbv5kR_IMG_20260512_125151/IP6pabPYvRRbv5kR_IMG_20260512_125151.webp)

![DAshPsIATVeNRA2v_IMG_20260512_125255.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/evahe/images/DAshPsIATVeNRA2v_IMG_20260512_125255/DAshPsIATVeNRA2v_IMG_20260512_125255.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

最近心心念念的想去广州的那个黄沙水产交易市场，就是有点远！我好想吃美味的海鲜啊，哪里的海鲜好划算的，再附近找个店加工一下可以了！最后还是想自己做吧，自己买了一包一百克的调料包，再买了一斤鲜活的跳跳虾🦐。

本来想炒避风塘炒花蟹的，就是不划算，而且处理起来也麻烦，吃的时候呢麻烦！各半斤虾蟹也可以的，下次再试试吧，这次来一个简单版本的虾！其实我觉得应该跟油焖大虾差不多的，这个我们已经做的很熟练了，再改良一下炒成避风塘可以啦哈哈哈！

我就按照网上的版本把虾剪须，开背去虾线！然后热锅后，再下虾，油炸到变成红色，虾壳变脆就捞起来！

不用洗锅，放一点儿花生油，把洋葱丝炒半熟后再把避风塘的调料包倒进去，用慢小火炒香炒热，最后倒入大虾！开大火翻炒十几秒，关火后再焖二分钟比较入味了！

第一次做没翻车，而且辣度可以，挺辣的不用再加干辣椒了哈哈！挺好吃的，没想到那么惹味，很好下饭啊！有点儿像去三亚吃的香辣炒虾一样，又辣又很好吃！

---

For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@evahe/2ct2nm)

title: Freewrite || Caring for Your Vehicle for Daily Commutes
body:
![PSX_20260514_081732.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmb73EQqn3RgJAbg6cxNwn7yFEU86fDRMNCSeVU6tB7QcL/PSX_20260514_081732.jpg)
![hive dividers-04.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdvc788wxsBSQHY3z21o3wSTU7hqRnyYc2JFEn2pEYSev/hive%20dividers-04.png)
A bright morning is the perfect time to do a little maintenance on your beloved vehicle. Amidst the hustle and bustle of daily life, a motorcycle is not just a means of transportation, but also a loyal companion that accompanies you on your journey from morning to evening. Therefore, keeping it in top condition is crucial.

Today, I took the time to change my motorcycle's oil to ensure its performance remains comfortable. The atmosphere of the small roadside repair shop felt quite peaceful. The morning sunlight slowly streamed in from the highway, while the occasional sound of passing vehicles could be heard. Simple activities like this often bring a sense of satisfaction, knowing that a well-maintained vehicle will last longer and be more comfortable to drive.

I believe that regular vehicle maintenance can prevent unwanted breakdowns while traveling. Furthermore, timely oil changes also help the engine run smoothly and fuel efficiently. While seemingly simple, these small gestures make a big difference in supporting a busy daily routine.

For me, moments like this also provide an opportunity to take a break from the routine. Sitting back and watching the motorcycle maintenance process creates a different atmosphere and makes the mind feel more relaxed. Sometimes happiness comes from the simple things we do in our daily lives.

May this motorcycle continue to run smoothly, accompanying you on every journey and activity to come.

title: The Title Race
body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmczMS6W8X4U4PQJvTMmxLRXW6qWw9vndteYB3V4RVCfWX/1778721623840.jpg)

ယနေ့ မနက် ၁ နာရီခွဲမှာ EPL Round 31 ပွဲကျန် ဖြစ်သည့် Man City vs Crystal Palace ပွဲစဉ် ကစားသွားခဲ့၏။ အိမ်ရှင် City က ၃-၀ ဖြင့် ဂိုးပြတ် အနိုင်ရသွားခဲ့၏။ ဘောလုံးပိုင်ဆိုင်ခွင့် အသာ၊ ဂိုးပေါက် ချိန်းခြောက်မှု အသာဖြင့် ကစားသွားခဲ့၏။ ပွဲကျန် ၁ ပွဲ ကစားပြီးပြီမို့ Arsenal နဲ့ ပွဲ အရေအတွက်လည်း တူသွားခဲ့ပြီ ဖြစ်၏။ Arsenal က ၇၉ မှတ်ဖြင့် အဆင့် ၁၊ Man City က ၇၇ မှတ်ဖြင့် အဆင့် ၂ နေရာမှာ ရပ်တည်နေ၏။ Everton နဲ့ ပွဲစဉ်သာ သရေမကျခဲ့ရင် City တို့ Arsenal နဲ့ အမှတ်တူနေမည် ဖြစ်၏။ 

အဆိုပါ ပွဲစဉ်တုန်းက City တို့ ရှုံးပြီလို့ ထင်မှတ်ခဲ့ရ၏။ ပွဲပြီးခါနီး နောက်ဆုံး မိနစ်အရောက်မှာမှ ချေပဂိုး ပြန်လည်လို့ သွင်းယူနိုင်ခဲ့ခြင်း ဖြစ်၏။ အဆင့် ၁ က Arsenal အနေဖြင့်လည်း West Ham နဲ့ ပွဲစဉ်မှာသာ သရေကျသွားခဲ့ရင် City နဲ့ အမှတ်တူသွားမည် ဖြစ်၏။ West Ham ၏ နောက်ဆုံး မိနစ် ချေပဂိုး VAR ကြည့်ပြီး ပယ်ဖျက် လိုက်သဖြင့် Arsenal တို့ အသာရသွားသည်ဟု ပြောလို့ရ၏။ အဆိုပါ ချေပဂိုး ကိစ္စက အငြင်းပွားစရာ များလှ၏။ တန်းဆင်းဇုန် ဖိအား ရှိနေသည့် West Ham အဖို့ နစ်နာလှ၏။

ကံကောင်းချင်တော့ အဆင့် ၁၇ က Tottenham က Leeds နဲ့ သရေကျသွားခဲ့သည်မို့ West Ham တို့ အနေဖြင့် မျှော်လင့်ချက်တွေ ရှင်သန်နေသေး၏။ Tottenham က ၃၈ မှတ်၊ West Ham က ၃၆ မှတ်ဖြင့် ၂ မှတ်ကွာ အနေအထားမှာ ရှိနေ၏။ ချန်ပီယံ တိုက်ပွဲလိုပဲ တန်းဆင်းဇုန် တိုက်ပွဲကလည်း အခြေအနေ ပုံစံချင်း တူနေခဲ့၏။ ဒီအချိန်မှာ ခြေစွမ်းအပြင် ကံတရားကလည်း စကားပြောလာခဲ့ပြီ ဖြစ်၏။ ဥပမာဆို မနေ့က Al Nassr ပွဲလိုပေါ့။


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc5M65fy86KKS6Qj7DUsfEZEgrs5XuXwjg4fPbpf4D8q4/1778721623856.jpg)


နိုင်ရင် Al Nassr တို့ ရာသီ သိမ်းဖို့ ၁ ပွဲ အလိုမှာတင် ဖလားရယူနိုင်ပြီ ဖြစ်၏။ Al Nassr တို့ ၁-၀ ဖြင့် နိုင်နေ၏။ ပွဲပြီးဖို့ စက္ကန့်ပိုင်းလေးသာ ကျန်တော့၏။ တာဝန် ရှိသူတွေက ဖလားပေးဖို့ ပြင်နေကြပြီ။ ပရိတ်သတ်တွေကလည်း အောင်ပွဲခံနေကြပြီ။ အဲ့မှာ Al Hilal အသင်း လက်ပစ်ဘော ဂိုးထဲ ပစ်ထည့်၏။ တဖက် တိုက်စစ်မှူး တယောက်မှ မရှိနေသည့် ဘောလုံးကို မိမိ နောက်တန်းလူနှင့်အပြိုင် ဂိုးသမားက ထွက်ဖမ်း ပုတ်ထုတ်၏။ အဲ့မှာ မသေမသပ်ဖြစ်ပြီး ဂိုးဝင်သွားခဲ့၏။ 

ဂိုးသမား အမှားဟု ဆိုလို့ရ၏။ အန္တရာယ် ရှိနေသည့် အနေအထားမျိုး မဟုတ်ဘဲ ထွက်ဆွဲဖမ်းခြင်း ဖြစ်၏။ မိမိ နောက်တန်း ကစားသမားလည်း ရှိနေတာပဲ။ သူ့သူ ခေါင်းတိုက် ရှင်းလိုက်ရင် ပြီးနေပြီ မလိုအပ်ဘဲ ထွက်ပုတ်ရာကနေ ဂိုး ပြန်ပေးလိုက်ရ၏။ သရေကြပြီး စောစီး ဖလားကိုင်ရမဲ့ အခြေအနေကနေ နောက်ဆုံးပွဲစဉ်အထိ ကစားပြီးမှသာ ဖလားယူနိုင်တော့မည် ဖြစ်၏။ ထို့ကြောင့် ကံတရားကလည်း အရေးကြီးတယ်ဟု ပြောရခြင်း ဖြစ်လေ၏။ 

EPL ချန်ပီယံက Arsenal လား၊ City လား။
EPL မှာ ရှင်သန် ကျန်ရစ်မှာ Tottenham လား၊ West Ham လား။

title: My Actifit Report Card: May 14 2026
body:
![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g09022d650b8cfe3d346375d31f47566deffba269cdf312974d8b360106c707a0237e96dcef20b7d3e5fbf1292674946f2ae230e74e11bff56cb854c3725971bd_640.jpg)
Hoy fue un día increíble para caminar por la ciudad. Empecé mi ruta temprano, cuando el sol apenas comenzaba a asomarse y la temperatura era perfecta. Al caminar por el parque, vi a un grupo de personas haciendo yoga al aire libre; sus risas y energía positiva realmente iluminaban el ambiente. Más adelante, conocí a un anciano que estaba sentado en un banco, alimentando a las palomas. Me contó que solía ser profesor de historia y que cada paloma que venía a su lado tenía una historia que contar. Fue fascinante escuchar cómo recordaba acontecimientos históricos y cómo la ciudad ha cambiado a lo largo de los años. Además, pasé por una pequeña feria de artistas locales donde vendían pinturas y artesanías. Me detuve a hablar con una joven artista que creaba hermosos retratos de la vida urbana. Me explicó su proceso creativo y cómo se inspira en las personas que ve a diario. En general, fue una caminata enriquecedora llena de encuentros inesperados y recuerdos que atesoraré. La ciudad siempre tiene algo nuevo que ofrecer si uno tiene los ojos bien abiertos. _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@titusfrost/actifit-titusfrost-20231229t015511428z)_

title: Przygotowania do Nocy Muzeów
body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWEBQANaiXmAc4aanziFEX3AhXszpRU23U6w9LhVfQbNx/dfuns_2026_05_14_0117596a4504ec1a07.jpg)

Już w piątek po raz piąty Muzeum Fuszerki i Złodziejstwa przyłączy się samowolnie do krakowskiej Nocy Muzeów. Biorąc pod uwagę rozwój KBK może to być największa edycja. Nie ma co do tego pewności, ale przygotować się na to trzeba. 

Generalnie planowane są 4 stanowiska.

1. Odprawa wizowa w przedsionku: będzie tu @szmulkberg, który będzie wydawał wizy, które będą zawierały grę z zadaniami, za które będzie można dostać rycary.
2. Główna sala: tutaj (czekając na wejście do muzeum) będzie można wykonać zadania lub wymienić PLN na rycary (przez terminal) i nabyć pamiątki z KBK (zrobiłem specjalnie na tę okazję magnesy z kluczami i pierogami).
3. Muzeum: oprowadzanie trwa jakieś 10 minut i może w nim brać udział 6-8 osób.
4. Szafa: tutaj po oprowadzaniu ludzie będą mogli sobie siąść i co godzinę będzie quiz dotyczący fuszerki i złodziejstwa.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWsEWmQGstTepZeBQZ6J4thJGzFnRixmRfYA7T1tWr5fY/google.jpg)

@wayward-dreams jak zwykle wrzucił info na Google, ale niestety Googlowi się to nie spodobało. 

Info już wrzucił [PIK](https://pik.krakow.pl/noc-muzeow-w-muzeum-fuszerki-i-zlodziejstwa/). Na ten moment MFiZ jest na samej górze listy wydarzeń.

W tamtym roku najwięcej osób przyszło z Facebooka, więc i w tym prawdopodobnie będzie to główne źródło informacji. Zwłaszcza, że algorytmy same podsuwają ludziom nasze wydarzenia. Trzeba im jednak pomóc, więc planuję zrobić jeszcze call to action i zachęcić ludzi do polubienia i skomentowania wpisu z 11 maja.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTSfuhFEswGbMruvsUejGea2AgeDU94az7Ysiny2h7RhW/noc_call.jpg)

>UWAGA! UWAGA! Jest szansa na frekwencyjny rekord w Muzeum Fuszerki i Złodziejstwa. Potrzebujemy jednak Waszej pomocy. W tamtym roku było bardzo blisko (dzięki Waszym lajkom udało się dobić do 190 odwiedzin). Jak możecie pomóc?  Po pierwsze, polajkować (poserduszkować) post z 11 maja ogłaszający wydarzenie.  Po drugie, skomentować go.  Po trzecie, kliknąć zainteresowanie lub udział. Ubiegły rok pokazał, że to REALNIE POMAGA w dotarciu do sporej liczby osób. Z góry wielkie dzięki!

title: I Discover the Room of Requirement and Meet the House-Elf Deek in Hogwarts Legacy
body:
![1.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23swc1NuMLaRikevgfzCcRLnW5H8sF6JLYkY6jED85dEV4QFmbyPEeNMdzjGZpA62NvRN.gif)

Hey gamers, welcome back to another adventure in Hogwarts Legacy! Continuing right from where we left off last time — Professor Weasley had just told me to go ahead and explore the Room of Requirement on my own, find my way through it, and discover whatever was waiting at the end. No guidance, no quest marker holding my hand the whole way. Just me, my spells, and an enormous labyrinth of magical junk stretching out in every direction. And honestly? That's exactly how an adventure in a place like this should feel. So off I went.

**Exploring the Room and Its Puzzles**

![0423 (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23tbFAxwDBo9C4YNp47vWyQAcBPinXAaXRX5N9JECYnJ82pPwxQVtyNSXJ5eyUT6zvjC7.jpg)

With Professor Weasley happily distracted by her old school bag somewhere behind me, I pushed forward through the corridors and the first thing I did was hit Revelio. Always hit Revelio in a new space in this game — it highlights interactable objects, hidden chests, and points of interest that you would absolutely walk right past otherwise. And sure enough, the Room of Requirement rewarded that habit immediately. There are collectible notes hidden throughout the space that give you little glimpses into the history of the room and the students who used it before you — a fireplace note sitting on the floor near an old hearth, a bathtub note on a table near some stacked furniture. Small details, but the kind that make the world feel genuinely layered.

![0423 (1)(2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23swgSiCWX9p88aqv8dVzpFmoPr1hrZQtaRB25KktNde89zKmgW8gSo7REduEZ4bNqyax.jpg)

The puzzles woven into the exploration section are not complicated but they're consistently satisfying to figure out. The room basically turns into a practical exam for every utility spell you've learned up to this point. There's a crate with a handle that you need to pull toward you with Accio, then use Levioso to levitate it high enough to create a climbable platform, then do a running jump to reach a higher ledge where a large chest is sitting and waiting to be looted. You slide back down, clear the next chair obstacle with Evanesco, collect the Moonstone that pops out, and keep moving. The loop feels natural and never forced — the game just places things in your path and trusts you to figure out the solution using what you already know.

Further along there are sections where you need to crouch through low crawl spaces that only open up after clearing furniture with Evanesco, which means managing the order of operations — clear, crouch, explore, then continue. There are also bags hanging high on the walls that require you to look up, cast Levioso to float them down within reach, and then Accio to pull them the rest of the way. One of these bags has a golden snitch inside it — a nice little Easter egg that fans of the books and films will get a kick out of — and you can hear it buzzing and fluttering around a corner before you even see it. Little touches like that are everywhere in this game and they never get old.

**Meeting the House-Elf Deek**

![0423 (1)(1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23swe13mWvEc8jinr2n4xmYVv6jtXLgZH7Pt4xTJrhEK1L6NQmViU1hWzqorKn5xG4F5F.jpg)

After working through the full length of the room's winding corridors, clearing obstacles, looting chests, and generally making the most of having the space to myself, I finally reached the far end of the room. And waiting there, standing quietly among the last of the accumulated clutter, was a house-elf. Small, large-eyed, wearing a neat little pillow case in the fashion of Hogwarts house-elves, and looking at me with the kind of earnest attentiveness that only house-elves seem to manage. This is Deek.

Deek introduces himself and immediately you can tell he's one of the more endearing characters in the game. He's gentle, polite, clearly very dedicated to his work, and genuinely invested in helping you get the most out of this space. He's been in the Room of Requirement for a long time, keeping it in order, maintaining it, waiting for the right student to come along and take proper ownership of it. And now that student is apparently you. The conversation with him is warm and a little funny in a quiet way — he's so earnest about everything and so clearly happy to finally have someone to look after and assist. He tells you that the room is yours now, that he will help you manage it and develop it over time, and that together you'll be able to make it into something truly useful.

![0423 (1)(4).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23swdrt2HKpFS9XHS5nfaegbqFZsFuzTM8yY5saahCj8eyppX5DJuCmWFAaruSeKV4AHR.jpg)

What's great about Deek is that he doesn't just exist as a functional NPC who unlocks game systems. He has genuine personality and he'll be a recurring presence in the room going forward, tied especially to the magical beast content that opens up later in the game. But even at this first meeting, before any of that gets introduced, he already feels like a character worth getting to know rather than just a menu prompt with a face.

**The Room of Requirement Transforms**

![0423 (1)(3).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23swcDP1rM6g68PvbMM6j7qAY6KyqfCkF8uobv1z7jb3zacVuisRiLLWm5pqQMDWGjcHx.jpg)

And then it happens. The moment you properly meet Deek and the game registers that you've completed the exploration section, the Room of Requirement transforms. This is honestly one of the most visually spectacular moments in all of Hogwarts Legacy. All of the centuries of accumulated clutter — the towers of chairs, the stacked crates, the dusty furniture, the hanging lanterns, the mountains of forgotten objects — all of it dissolves away in an instant. The whole space reconstitutes itself, the walls and floor and ceiling reshaping and restructuring, the lighting shifting and settling, and when it's done what stands before you is a clean, open, beautiful personal space that belongs entirely to you.

![0423 (1)(5).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23tvCSFFEsbLoiwm64mqa2eztjNsjR1MmxVdDK9xYgBRUA4qgaU93v2NKJBaJB7UDsrLF.jpg)

It's genuinely breathtaking the first time you see it. One moment you're standing in a chaotic attic the size of a cathedral and the next you're in your own private room inside Hogwarts that no professor, no prefect, and no other student can access unless you specifically bring them there. The architecture that's revealed once the clutter is gone is gorgeous — high stone ceilings, warm ambient light, open floor space in every direction, and this sense of possibility hanging in the air like the room itself is waiting to see what you'll do with it. Professor Weasley arrives just as the transformation completes and even she takes a moment to appreciate what the room has become, which says something given that she's clearly been here before.

**Learning the Conjuring Spell**

![0423 (1)(8).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23sweHQiViAv4mYBtcWJUSTe6HruXexRj1wkCTeZHqnUco2SVEA2WoELNvGkj5i25u9bZ.jpg)

With the room now transformed and Deek officially introduced, Professor Weasley gets down to business and teaches you the next major skill tied to this space — the Conjuring Spell. This is the spell that lets you literally create objects out of thin air and place them inside the Room of Requirement. The spell minigame for this one is similar in difficulty to Evanesco — three button prompts to hit during the wand movement trace — so take your time reading what's coming and don't rush the motion or you'll break the trace.

Once you've got the Conjuring Spell unlocked, Weasley has you practice it immediately by conjuring two specific stations. First a Potions Station, which goes into the Potions tab of the Conjuration menu — you pick whichever aesthetic style you prefer since they all function identically — and place it somewhere in the room. Then a Potting Table from the Herbology tab, same deal. Both require Moonstone to conjure, which is why all that Evanesco work you did clearing furniture earlier was building up your reserves. It's a well designed loop — the game made you earn the currency through exploration before asking you to spend it, which makes the conjuring feel earned rather than just handed to you.

![0423 (1)(11).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23u5bKF4Xn4v5wzCNM6jC1KMDy3UU7Sfv97nPjwwNuQHEu7GFfz2NNHvFm7Uc5eJireqx.jpg)

What makes the Conjuring Spell so significant beyond just placing tables is what it represents for the Room of Requirement going forward. Every station you'll ever need — potions brewing, plant growing, gear crafting, beast care — all of it gets conjured and placed by you. The room becomes a reflection of your own priorities and playstyle over time. If you focus heavily on combat, you load it up with upgrade stations. If you're into herbology and potion brewing, you build it out that way. It's genuinely your space in a way that very few game environments actually achieve.

**Mission Complete — Next Up, Professor Fig**

![0423 (1)(12).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23tvVd2ZhkszTiQFRShhQUrtG9ysxkUyvMMCH6TQqdQw33MSPg89QXGciL8e2q2Ut6iss.jpg)

With the Potions Station and the Potting Table placed and the room officially yours, the quest wraps up and 260 XP drops into your total. It's a satisfying completion because this wasn't just a mission with a combat payoff or a story reveal — it was the unlocking of an entirely new dimension of the game. The Room of Requirement is going to be a place you come back to constantly from here on out, and every time you return it'll be a little more developed, a little more personalized, and a little more useful. Deek will be there every time, ready to help, and the Interior Decorating side quest also unlocks after completing this mission which opens up even more customization options including the Altering Spell.

So gamers, the Room of Requirement was absolutely worth the wait and everything this space offers is going to keep paying off for a long time. Next up on the main story agenda — we finally reunite with Professor Fig. The book, the missing pages, everything we've been building toward in the main quest comes back into focus. That reunion is going to be a big one. See you in the next post gamers!

body.title: 极少数人，主宰了信息流：一篇文章帮你理清很多现象困惑
body.body:
以前在农村，一个村里出现个傻子这是很平常的事情，但如果有一天你上网，发现很多傻子的时候，你就会不淡定了，甚至会不自信的怀疑，是不是自己出了问题？

我以前都认为，这就是互联网上一些平台借助大数据算法，将很多极端的内容经常推送给用户的原因，但是背后究竟做到了程度，反倒没有太深入去思考。

直到昨天我看到一篇文章，读完后恍然大悟，也解开了许多我之前的困惑。

这篇文章《The Noisy Room --- A Story About Common Confusion》 中文翻译为：《一个关于常见困惑的故事》，如下图，


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rivalhw/23tw9trKS5KwS2z86ysVQZc3qfwJTn5QNQVaCKyjwAp6DtpNhhswiRHPCX3F8sbNQXmGF.png)


第一个问题是：

>你认为社交媒体用户中有多少比例的人发布严重有害的内容？

我选择大约30%

实际根据调查，结果只有3.1%，如下图，


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rivalhw/EocDmyqHFqtCRG4vkBydqwR9NDLDSaKUhkE7t2Pufj6QtkqMocYxbkNf3YGGFK5jLfD.png)

可见，多数时候，我们看到很多负面的极端的内容，愿没有我们想象中的那么多，而这背后的原因，其实就是互联网平台将这些极端的内容推送给了我们，让我们感觉极端的言论似乎看起来很多，也如同前面我们提到的，“将傻子集中起来”，让人误以为傻子变得很多了。


实际上现实的真相是：

>大多数人保持沉默

这中间，包括我们中的大多数人，很多时候都是保持沉默的。

>少数聒噪者自以为是多数派

在网上活跃的少数人，往往在心里会认为自己是多数派，主导意见，而现实是，同上边，大多数人都沉默，不说话并不代表同意这些观点。

至于为什么大多数人保持沉默？其中一个原因，**觉得自己寡不敌众。因此保持沉默。**

我看到一个极端的言论，本想发表下评论或看法，但看到评论里很多相反的意见，便犹豫了，最后甚至取消了已经写好的评论。


这篇文章里提到关于如何化解误解？

>多项研究表明，当以公开的方式纠正误解时，敌意就会下降。

也提到另一个很有意思的观点，

>每个人都抱怨政治中的金钱问题，但只要自己支持的候选人收到巨额捐款，他们就立刻噤声。

这个观点也印证了那句话，既得利益者往往不会愿意打破现有的格局，或者说会变相阻碍任何人去打破现有的格局。


现在我们仔细想下，经常在媒体上看到一些极端的报道和言论，会让我们下意识地以为发生了严重混乱甚至趋于崩溃的可能，但实际上呢，这么多年过去了，太阳依旧每天从东方升起，西边落下。天始终不会塌下来，相信会塌下来的都被证明是杞人忧天。过度的相信那些言论，会混淆我们的耳目，干扰我们明辨是非。如同你不会相信，这世界都为都是傻子一样，如果真的那么多，无非是有人刻意这么做故意让你相信罢了。

倘若这样去想，下次再看到类似事情时，以此类推，就不会觉得天下似乎要大乱了。


最后，再说一个真相，

>极少数人，却主宰了信息流。一直以来都是如此。

[The Noisy Room : A Story About Common Confusion 一个关于常见困惑的故事](https://thenoisyroom.com/)

body.title: A Beautiful Visitor: The Common Evening Brown
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmReXYx5feQ5jpk9nX9x9QNaDipsCFZubMkRVbjirqQbpq/1778679681109.png)

Hello everyone! 🌷🌸
‎
‎This is my very first post here in the Discovery-it community, and I’m so happy to share a little moment from my home with you all. 
‎
‎Hope you enjoy reading this, and I hope I get noticed and curated too! Haha.
‎
‎Last night, we had a special visitor flying inside our house. 
‎
‎It was a medium-sized butterfly and brown in color. 
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVSV6YXEJfCtCtyGKwwpHM5tjp8nhXWjbuSk5XwJCAzUb/1778679732893.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQyRvZLZU25oHTXRHNbDC8yuL2eAjZwCKEs6YMGdVtQUa/1778679733048.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeUzne66849txS137oWTdUcuV7nRwuHuWwtQ8JME8qUDX/1778679733201.jpg)
‎
‎To be honest, I am actually afraid of most insects..
‎
‎I get nervous when I see cockroaches, beetles, or grasshoppers. 
‎
‎But when it comes to butterflies, I never feel scared of them. They look so gentle and fragile, that one wrong move of their wings, it might hurt or break easily. 
‎
‎They seem so delicate, like they are made of thin silk.
‎
‎I don’t know if this is true or just my observation.. whenever a butterfly enters your home, it usually means it does not have much time left to live, and it will die soon. 
‎
‎Have you ever noticed this too? Haha. 
‎
‎It always makes me feel a little sad, but at the same time, I feel fortunate that they chose to visit us before they go.
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY9PXHYED9tGrgtDyR4uu8NsxugAeZZhHtFgVa2VSAM7G/1778679777197.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVDDg2XGc7tiKqFdegcqXQTARm5pFR8KiSuDnMJAHs5Fi/1778679777334.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYdBkEiAQKjsuGz4xaTXknyDwpqvgS9z63QjRJZDSPWEA/1778679777477.jpg)
‎
‎Well, I was curious what kind this was, so I checked using Google Lens. 
‎
‎It turns out this one is called the **Common Evening Brown.** 
‎
‎Before, I also shared photos of a very large butterfly I found here, but sadly that one was already dead.
‎
‎So, I hope this brings a little joy to your day.  
‎
‎Thanks for reading my first share here! 🦋✨
‎
‎Until my next nature observation...
‎
‎**Thanks for the visit! Have a lovely day. Buh-bye. 💗🌸**
‎
‎*All images used in this post are my own unless stated otherwise.*
‎

body.title: Adulting | Fiction | The Inkwell Writing Prompt #32
body.body: # Adulting | Fiction | @shentrading\n\n*A short story for The Inkwell Writing Prompt #32: \

*

---

The first time I moved money across a blockchain, I was shaking.

Not the dramatic kind of shaking you see in movies — just the quiet trembling of someone who had spent three years watching from the sidelines. Reading forums. Paper trading. Learning the vocabulary of a world that felt like it belonged to other people: the ones who actually *did* things.

My father had asked me once what \

meant. I'd given him a ten-minute answer and he'd nodded politely, the way you nod when someone explains a magic trick that doesn't interest you. Afterward I realized: I couldn't explain it because I hadn't done it. I'd only ever described it.

Adulting, I'd learned, is the gap between knowing and doing.

The transaction was small. Twenty HIVE. Worth maybe twelve dollars at the time. But it was *mine* — earned from two weeks of posting market analysis and receiving upvotes from strangers who found the data useful. I hadn't sold anything, hadn't borrowed anything, hadn't asked anyone for it. A blockchain had done the accounting and I had done the work.

I powered it up into Hive Power.

That's when the feeling shifted. It wasn't just twelve dollars anymore. It was a decision about time: to lock value into a system, to commit to staying, to build something that compounds. My father had explained this to me when I was eight, about savings accounts, about interest, about planting trees you won't sit under yourself.

I'd rolled my eyes at eight. At twenty-seven, staring at a wallet balance that now read 20 HP, I understood him completely.

---

There's a moment in every person's financial life — I don't think it arrives at the same age for everyone — when you stop seeing money as something that happens to you and start seeing it as something you decide. It's not about amounts. My twenty HIVE wouldn't change anyone's life. But the act of choosing what to do with it, of understanding *why* I was doing it, of making a plan and executing it without anyone's permission or help:

That was the adulting part.

---

My father called last Sunday. He asked how the \

was going.

I told him I'd earned money writing, staked it for passive returns, and built a small but real position in a network I believed in.

He said: \

I said yes.

He laughed — the warm kind, the kind I hadn't heard since I was eight and finally understood why the tortoise won.

---
