body.title: Disillusioned Future
body.body:
>I’m just so hurt that this is the future I find myself in. When I was much younger, I had a very different picture in my head. I don’t even know if it was me being naïve or just hopeful, but I genuinely believed things would be better by now. That adulthood would feel like arrival, like you work hard, you grow up, and eventually you step into some form of stability where life starts to make sense. I really thought we would have made significant progress as a nation.
There was no other version of the future I could properly imagine. In my mind, things were always going forward, always improving. It didn’t occur to me that you could “grow up” and still be stuck in the same cycles, not even stuck but regress, and still be struggling with the same basic pressures, still trying to survive more than you are actually living.
Even now after i came back from my masters, i’m here, and I feel disappointed in the country I’m in, and honestly in the world in general. What hits me the hardest is this, nothing right now even feels like it is being done in a way that guarantees a better future and that thought is scary, because it means we are not just dealing with present problems, we are actively shaping tomorrow with the same habits, or even worse habits and the same systems, the same neglect and then people will act surprised in 10 or 15 years when things look the same or worse.
A lot of us Nigerians grew up believing adulthood would come with stability, at least it looked like that in our childhood not this survival mode. Back then, there was this promise in our heads that by this age, things would have “aligned.” That life would have opened up. I actually used to think I’d be rich at this stage of life. Lol!! I was certain about it in that childlike way where doubt doesn’t exist yet.
Sometimes I’m disappointed in myself, most of the time, I’m angry at the systems and the people who keep reinforcing them. Especially those in power who seem more interested in preserving their own advantage than building anything meaningful for the future and looking at the incoming elections It feels like some people are not just occupying positions of power, but actively training the next generation of their own influence, securing continuity for a system that has not served the majority well.
Still, I write this not because I have answers, but because I can’t pretend I don’t see it anymore. I can’t keep acting like this frustration doesn’t exist in me. It does.

body.title: What kind of society are we becoming?
body.body: <center>[Everday Health](https://www.everydayhealth.com/emotional-health/all-about-laziness-what-causes-it-and-what-to-do-about-it/)</center>\nThe world has changed. Therefore, the essential demands of a society have also changed along with it. These are self-complementary and interdependent \

. Considering the technological age we are experiencing, we have countless benefits around us, which are even capable of optimizing our time well (in different ways) in relation to practically everything we can imagine. However, to what extent is convenience beneficial? In fact, how are we taking advantage of a time optimization that needs to favor us within the game?\nIf today, everything has the effective potential to reach us much more easily... What will \

society before that can even happen in a biologically natural way? Practicality brings time optimization, but it works against our interests by making us relaxed human beings regarding health issues, for example (and here I am referring not only to physical health... but also to mental health). A new way of living may be emerging... And laziness, once a cardinal sin, could become a destructive vice.\nSome movies have already addressed this theme (including animated movies), and although the reflections have been somewhat superficial (bringing a lighter, but still reflective context), it is very interesting to see how there is a gradual concern about the type of society we are becoming. Disregarding extremist views and meaningless rhetorical opinions, we need to rethink the way we live in a highly technological society, which is finding in the practicality of actions a kind of distortion in relation to the way human evolution has evolved.\nEvery day we are faced with some kind of technological advancement. This is not necessarily a bad thing, but in a less \

way, it is necessary to understand that every evolution has two sides. If on the one hand we have the chances to draw up plans and execute ideas with more agility and fewer chances of errors... On the other hand, we become \
of a manipulation that seems to be out of our control (which becomes ironic, considering the fact that we are the ones making this kind of evolution happen). This is a \

that deserves urgent discussion.
---
<center>**¿En qué tipo de sociedad nos estamos convirtiendo?**</center>
El mundo ha cambiado. Por lo tanto, las necesidades esenciales de una sociedad también han cambiado con él. Se trata de \

autocomplementarias e interdependientes. En la era tecnológica que vivimos, contamos con innumerables ventajas a nuestro alrededor, capaces incluso de optimizar nuestro tiempo (de diversas maneras) en relación con prácticamente todo lo que podamos imaginar. Sin embargo, ¿hasta qué punto es beneficiosa la comodidad? De hecho, ¿cómo aprovechamos una optimización del tiempo que debería favorecernos en el juego?\nSi hoy en día todo tiene el potencial efectivo de llegar a nosotros con mucha más facilidad... ¿Qué nos \

antes de que esto ocurra de forma biológicamente natural? La practicidad conlleva la optimización del tiempo, pero actúa en contra de nuestros intereses al hacernos personas relajadas en lo que respecta a la salud, por ejemplo (y aquí me refiero no solo a la salud física, sino también a la mental). Puede que esté surgiendo una nueva forma de vida... Y la pereza, antes un pecado capital, podría convertirse en un vicio destructivo.\nAlgunas películas ya han abordado este tema (incluidas las de animación), y aunque las reflexiones han sido algo superficiales (aportando un contexto más ligero, pero aun así reflexivo), resulta muy interesante observar cómo crece gradualmente la preocupación por el tipo de sociedad en la que nos estamos convirtiendo. Dejando de lado las posturas extremistas y las opiniones retóricas vacías, necesitamos repensar nuestra forma de vida en una sociedad altamente tecnológica, que encuentra en la practicidad de las acciones una especie de distorsión con respecto a la evolución humana.\nCada día nos enfrentamos a algún avance tecnológico. Esto no es necesariamente malo, pero, en un sentido menos \

, es necesario comprender que toda evolución tiene dos caras. Si bien, por un lado, tenemos la oportunidad de elaborar planes y ejecutar ideas con mayor agilidad y menos margen de error, por otro, nos convertimos en \
de una manipulación que parece estar fuera de nuestro control (lo cual resulta irónico, considerando que somos nosotros quienes impulsamos este tipo de evolución). Esta es una \

que merece un debate urgente. ---
**Que tipo de sociedade nós estamos nos tornando?**
O mundo mudou. Sendo assim, as demandas essenciais de uma sociedade também mudaram junto com ele. Essas são “unidades” auto complementares, e interdependentes. Considerando a era tecnológica que nós estamos vivenciando, nós temos inúmeros benefícios ao nosso redor, que são inclusive capazes de otimizar bem o nosso tempo (de diferentes formas) em relação a praticamente tudo o que nós podemos imaginar. No entanto, até onde a comodidade é benéfica? De fato, como nós estamos tirando vantagem de uma otimização de tempo que precisa nos favorecer dentro do jogo? Se hoje, tudo tem um efetivo potencial de chegar até nós com muito mais facilidade... O que vai nos “impedir” de nos tornarmos uma sociedade “adoecida” antes mesmo que isso possa acontecer de uma maneira biologicamente natural? A praticidade traz otimização de tempo, mas joga contra os nossos interesses por nos tornar seres humanos relaxados quanto a questão de saúde, por exemplo (e aqui eu me refiro não apenas a saúde física... mas também a saúde mental). Um novo modo de viver pode estar emergindo... E a preguiça como pecado capital pode se tornar um vício destrutivo. Alguns filmes já trataram dessa temática (incluindo filmes animados), e ainda que as reflexões tenham sido um tanto quanto superficiais (trazendo um contexto mais leve, mas ainda reflexivo), é muito interessante perceber como há uma preocupação gradual sobre o tipo de sociedade que nós estamos nos tornando. Desconsiderando as visões extremistas e opiniões retóricas sem sentido, precisamos repensar o modo de viver em meio a uma sociedade bastante tecnológica, que está encontrando na praticidade das ações uma espécie de deturpação em relação ao modo de evolução humano. Todo dia estamos diante de algum tipo de avanço dentro da tecnologia. Isso não é necessariamente algo ruim, mas de uma maneira menos “poética”, é preciso entender que toda evolução tem dois lados. Se por um lado temos as chances de traçar planos e executar ideias com mais agilidade e menos chances de erros... Por outro, nos tornamos “reféns” de uma manipulação que parece estar fora do nosso controle (o que se torna irônico, considerando o fato de que somos nós que estamos fazendo esse tipo de evolução acontecer). Esse é um “paradoxo” que merece uma discussão urgente. Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@wiseagent/what-kind-of-society-are-we-becoming-3pt)

body.title: A Short Travel Exploration at San Jose Aqua Farm In Lugait, Misamis Oriental Mindanao Philippines
body.body: >\nFor today's travel blog of mine is quite challenging since the place I went was in abandoned hatchery farm here in the Province of Misamis Oriental. This site was completely abandoned many years already and it is covered with lots of wild grass and tall trees. San Jose Aqua Farm is one of the hatchery here in Lugait, Misamis Oriental it produced lots of prawns and fish that day but now, the hatchery was completely shutdown leaving lots of abandoned structures built at the place. Small wooden boats are very usable that day specially when personels are went to the sea just to check the big main pipes use to get lots of sea water. But now, those small wooden boats are also abandoned and slowly destroyed placing near at the abandoned structure.\n</div class=\

>

### Laboratory Structure:
![IMG_20260514_062023.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSgUQBXBgCkSQ8rSDgsQca1u4bGichdUfvCsCm3ACK9LR/IMG_20260514_062023.jpg)
</center>
This is the laboratory structure built inside of the site, it is made of solid concrete including walls, floors and even rooftop. They built this in this kind of design so strong winds cannot destroyed the structure that is why concrete rooftop is very important and perfect to built. This structure was built 25 years already. Broken glass windows and rusty metals that supported the ceilings so it wont broke. A few cracks at walls shows because of the strong earthquakes happens here.

### Sleeping Quarters:
![IMG_20260514_061610.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcKyLsHcm1oeLpmzy4mjjwYK7XnNCXNPsi25C63gEyZ2G/IMG_20260514_061610.jpg)
</center>
This is the sleeping quarters of the workers here that time, it is made of light materials like plywoods, lumbers and plainsheets. It is built near at the laboratory and served as a guard house to all facilities. 

### A Very Old Concrete Stairs:

![IMG_20260514_061751.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPrGry9zBgqMgiJkXo7y2w5qwwg1Nf2ndnbbPQxXhZAVS/IMG_20260514_061751.jpg)
</center>
This very old concrete stair case leads down to the shore. It took almost 5 minutes of walking from this stairs and it contains 100 staircases. Because of many years abandoned, the structure are now covered with wild grass and small tree plants. Here in the site, there are two concrete stair case built but the other one is now completely covered with wild grass and cannot be accessible anymore. 

### The Main Canal:
![IMG_20260514_061929.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTZKFQSv6fJMKbuZ8EDS2ah4NjaT1N2XFwqM2F8rd9jof/IMG_20260514_061929.jpg)
</center>
The draining water from the concrete fish tanks are all flows down here in this big canal. It is made of solid concrete including the sidings and flooring of the place. It leads down to the big and deep safety tank. There is also few concrete post used to build fence are at the place near at the canal but it was not completely built. Near at the big canal are lots of fish tanks made of concrete and it contains and built in different kinds of depth and sizes depends on what kind of prawns they produced that time. 

### Concreted Fish Tanks:
![IMG_20260514_061402.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPEp8JBDttmWfDQrtBv3ZwRKbm4WstEDJGP5wkSkoMMJP/IMG_20260514_061402.jpg)
</center>

![IMG_20260514_061200.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVaXiNMrs98q4NAG9cYWUmzK9H9JmhPPvbDmGb4ihp5pd/IMG_20260514_061200.jpg)
</center>

![IMG_20260514_062206.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWn3hEyBG5ZJbjkPDwQq2D6Pho1A9LRUUnBLNYo38mMCm/IMG_20260514_062206.jpg)
</center>

![IMG_20260514_062303.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfFMC9JVZKGcdv8iWW7gTt7158dbU947djtLdoMdtPDhF/IMG_20260514_062303.jpg)
</center>
This are the fish tanks built here at the abandoned hatchery. Some of the tanks are now completely covered with tall trees and wild grass creating a big cracks on the structures. It is painted with white paints and lots of tubes installed. This hatchery produced thousands of small prawns to be shipped and exported to other countries. The place is also surrounded with coconut trees and few bamboo trees.

### The Filter Tank Area:

![IMG_20260514_061100.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcmWGjpBfzQ49boGkRy7pFULBzZ3hyVJZyEobwhLmiYef/IMG_20260514_061100.jpg)
</center>

![IMG_20260514_061011.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTt3NDdVPfKoFP8dUddA4WqujjKoz2iwgkMWHHTMKx3cx/IMG_20260514_061011.jpg)
</center>
This is the filter tank areas where few big concrete tanks built here equipped with lots of polythelene tubes where water comes in and out. This tanks holds lots of streamers-like so the dirt in the sea water from the sea can stock in here avoiding to filled at the fish tanks. This hatchery contains this unique structures that helps to have a good quality of products and specimens. It was completely abandoned but a news that this place will develop back soon.

#### *Until next post, have a nice day and safe travel to everyone*.

body.title: Did VR in a new business here in Da Nang for the first time yesterday
body.body:
..... and I have to say I think I may have found a new and healthy addiction.  That was one of the most exciting and neat things that I have done in years and thankfully I got to experience it with 7 of my friends.   

<center> https://cyberjaya.another-world.com/wp-content/themes/AnotherWorld/assets/images/gameBefore_banner.jpg
[src](https://cyberjaya.another-world.com/wp-content/themes/AnotherWorld/assets/images/gameBefore_banner.jpg)</center>

People may wonder why I don't have any of my own pictures about what I experienced and in my defense all I can really say is that you can't really put up images that shows how awesome the VR experience is because you only really experience it with the headset on in your own little world there or as the name of the business is \

I have only used VR a tiny bit previous to this experience and it was just using a friend's setup that he had in his man-cave back at his house. I didn't enjoy that nearly as much because it was 12 years ago or so, and the technology has come a long way since then. We first played this zombie defense game that was an adult-oriented game and man oh man, was that lifelike. It was genuinely frightening and there were times that everyone in my group team of 4 that all of us jumped out of the way of something that was attacking and ran into the other people that were standing around us in the real world. While the area you are standing in is quite small, as far as you are concerned in the VR world the grounds around where what you are defending extends for miles in every direction.

>
[src](https://danang.another-world.com/)</center>

You see those squared on the ground in the picture above?  Well our zombie defense area was 8 of those squares in a 2x4 space.   Yet the area we could see in our headsets extended to what appeared to be hundreds of meters in any direction and various waves of zombies and zombie dogs and zombie crows would come at us entering the playfield in various ways.   You had to manage killing these things and had your teammates call out for help if they were getting overwhelmed.  You had the opportunity to pick up better weapons and while you could hold a weapon in both hands you did so at the expense of accuracy.   One weapon in particular was completely useless if you tried to use it with one hand and that was the shotgun.  It was not pointed out to us in the brief introduction that you cannot reload the shotgun if you are holding it with just one hand.   This makes sense though, right? 

We had the choice when we first started the game to have \

which would mean you would have to go to your waist to retrieve a virtual magazine, then place it in the other hand's gun, then pull back the stock to load the first bullet.  Miss any of these steps and you will not reload.   The other method or \

was that you just point the gun down for a second and it will reload automatically. I am very happy that we chose the noob option because I don't think any of us would have ever successfully reloaded. After the zombie game was over and we all died dozens of times I took off my headset and it was kind of shocking to find myself in this room that had no warehouses, no helicopter landing zone, and no zombies. It was *incredibly realistic* and it was akin to something that genuinely happened to you. We were all a bit rattled by that experience and while a lot of other groups do their VR in silence, our group was screaming a bunch and running into one another frequently. I was quite sweaty after this even though we don't really move around that much. It is discouraged and even against the rules to run because you can get hurt pretty bad if you run into someone full on. One of our people bloodied his lip by running his head into the back of someone. [here is the location](https://www.google.com/maps/place/VR+Another+World+Danang/@16.0744386,108.226469,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x314219e1fb3e0929:0x7fd9dc7c81f11503!8m2!3d16.0744386!4d108.2290493!16s%2Fg%2F11z3y0hw29?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDUxMS4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D) and I heartily reccommend that you give this business a visit because not only was it super fun, it was also a lot less expensive than I feel like it could have been.

>
</center> 




250,000 VND is roughly $10 USD and my group was there for a while and each of us had to shell out around $10.  We all loved it.   Being good at video games is not important, because I don't think that anyone actually could get good at this unless they were using some of the higher order skills such as reloading in a realistic way and you don't have to do that anyway.  

They have a wide array of games that involve fantasy, sci-fi, ghosts, horror and even a dancing game that I have no intention of ever playing.  

We all talked about it for hours afterwards and regaled all the other people that we met about how they absolutely must go and try this new and awesome thing.   We also made plans to go back and do it again just 2 days later.   

I think we have a new healthy addiction!   This is good because most of my friends rarely do anything other than go and meet at a bar and get drunk.   

The only downside is that you are not allowed to bring dogs with you so Nadi has to stay at home on her own!

body.title: Online Ads To Help Promote Local Wrestling Shows
body.body:
![qwen-image---free_2026-05-14T00-39-21-267Z.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ecwwebsite/23tm7G4QJK1Hv6ak9Z93ojgbZC4rKKcEv2GkK6QA54g2ZqTpZrt8nmGVBq3xUEr8XU5tF.png)

(AI-generated image. All trademarks and copyrights belong to their rightful owners)

Many professional wrestling promoters, when promoting a local show without a lot of momentum, often skip out on solid online marketing. They may make a few posts on Instagram or Facebook, but they often miss out on several free methods to promote their shows. For example, if a venue could hold up to 400 people - but their current fans and social media posts only will draw 150 fans then this leaves 250 empty seats. Even at $10 a seat (ideally more!) that leaves $2500 of ticket revenue on the table + lost opportunity for the talent to sell merchandise, build a local fan base, and not compel local companies to sponsor the promotion's future shows. 

Some of the free methods to promote a show, besides social media posts and non-optimized YouTube videos, include:

- Optimizing YouTube videos for the local city or town
- Marketing with local wrestling fans on YouTube by following them and/or leaving comments on their channels
- Posting on local online event calendars
- If there is an optimized Google Business (Maps) profile then post an \
with the date, time, location, and any announced matches or incentives for people to attend (example: Veterans get in free) \n- Optimized website pages to rank for \

- Other free methods

However, especially when attempting to fill larger venues nearing 1000 or more fans, then a promotion may wish to explore intelligent online advertising. In addition to targeting pro wrestling fans in the local area on Facebook and Instagram, a promotion may wish to explore a platform like Google Ads. This is because it gives the promotion several other ways to reach wrestling fans in the geographic area:

- Buying ads for a search or keyword such as \

. Traffic then would be directed to a specific landing page on the website or even the ticket page (such as Eventbrite)
- Buying banner ad space on third-party blogs & websites being read in the local area by wrestling fans, even if the content on that website isn't wrestling-related. This is due to the tracking cookie and the browsing history of any logged-in reader
- Advertising in platforms like Gmail
- YouTube advertising. This is a unique aspect due to how much wrestling content is on YouTube. By targeting people watching specific genres of pro wrestling within a tight geographic radius (such as 10 miles around the venue), you have choices on the ads which will run ahead of time. Interestingly, if you run a 30+ second regular video (16:9 horizontal resolution) then if someone skips the ad after 5 seconds then you may not even get charged for the \
, but not enough time would have elapsed to warrant being considered a \

warranting a charge. 

Once a promotion sees profits running these ads, especially with decent quality controls on maximum ad spend per day, geographic targeting, and other safeguards - then the company may wish to spend more on ads in order to attract more people and even running larger venues. At that point a reputable [ad tracking](https://hyros.com/) platform, which can help the company increase the chances of ads being profitable by using AI attribution and similar new technology, can help a small promotion grow much larger within a short period - even as little as a year.  

Hopefully this gives pro wrestling promotions some additional thoughts on how to attract brand new fans to its shows. Over time, assuming that the quality of the overall show is enjoyable to these new fans, then the fan who first became aware of the promotion by way of the online ad hopefully becomes a longtime fan who starts to bring his/her friends to future shows and helps to grow the company.

body.title: Praise The Horse & Pass The Bourbon
body.body: /> > Go and take the millions > Take the derby hats > And stick'em up your ass > I'll take the cheap seats > For my company don't come served inside a glass --- [Houndmouth](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RtBZ8OlU7nY) Y'all are probably tired of hearing about the Kentucky Derby by now, but you should try living here for a couple decades. Would say this town is obsessed with the horse race, but that's only partially true. Think it's a bit like politics, a solid third are in favor, another third vehemently opposed, and the rest just want the shouting to stop.

/> Growing up in southeastern Kentucky, the Derby was largely a non-event, NASCAR was about the only racing that concerned us. Moving to Louisville to attend the university, it seemed like that was about all my city kid classmates could talk about. Wanted to go and see what all the fuss was about but couldn't cough up the $50 USD for a ticket to the infield (not even cheap seats, just a grassy field with no view), so I did the next best thing and got a job at the track. Got to see a several runnings of the rosy race, albeit from a different perspective than most. My first Derby was special, in that unique Derby way. Had gotten good and drunk the night before, after working a 14 hour shift, and proceeded to pass out about an hour before my alarms were set to go off for work. Needless to say, I was a bit late for work on the big day. _Like six and a half hours late._ Overslept badly enough that by the time I awoke, it was impossible to drive to work and had to walk the mile and a half to the track. Somehow I didn't get fired, but it was the walk to work that stuck with me, like a stroll through some surreal, absurd, drunken carnival. Finally managed to get over my grudge and go back to the track this year with the Nikons to try and capture a little of that magic.

/> You can tell it's Derby when there's cops hiding behind every bush and overpass. The city's police population just about triples for the first Saturday in May, and the number of car accidents spike similarly. They're not after speeding drivers though, they mostly just lurk until they decide to block the streets. Rumor has it that they're not much more sober than the folks making their way to Churchill Downs, but that's what they call an 'unconfirmed report.'

/> Unless you've got Important Business, it's best to stay off the roads on Derby Day, you're going nowhere fast anyways. Parked a couple miles from the track and trekked in to avoid the worst of it. Not long after you start encountering the police hither, tither and yon, you'll start noticing clumps and gaggles of similarly attired folks out for a stroll. _They're definitely headed to watch the ponies, anyone who isn't is doing their damnedest to avoid setting foot in the area._

/> Churchill Downs has its own circles of ~~hell~~ horse racing modelled on Dante's, one can usually tell how far they are from the finish line by the activities in their vicinity. When you start seeing the golf carts cruising the sidewalks and side streets, picking up folks on foot and shuttling them towards the track, you know you're halfway to Mint Julep Central. _Fun fact, unless you're getting one of the limited edition $1000 mint juleps, your julep is just a premade mix poured straight from the Early Times bottle._

/> One tradition that dates back to even before Hunter S Thompson's time is yard parking extravaganza. Pretty much the only silver lining to having their lives completely disrupted by the goings-on, folks living near the track turn their yards into impromptu parking lots and compete to lure in drivers as they try to charge as much for it as the market will bear. _Covid must have put a hurting on the market, when I was working at the track it wasn't uncommon to see'em asking (and getting) $50-$100 USD._

/> Aside from accepting Venmo, not much has changed with this bit of neighborhood entrepreneurial spirit in many decades. The 'never mind the tulips' circle of hell is the next to last one you have to traverse before reaching the pearly gates of Parimutuel.
/> From there it's just a matter of gathering your things and joining the mass migration down Central Avenue.

/> There, along that fenced off street, is where the true ~~gonzo~~ spirit of Derby shines through. Chaos and absurdity, street preachers and street vendors hawking their wares, as the scent of bourbon and diesel exhaust fills the air.
/> This final circle can be feisty, gotta watch where you're going.
/> T-shirts seemingly designed to appeal to the tender sensibilities of the intoxicated.
/> You know you're in the right place when you see all the smiling faces.

/> With all the yelling, running, and random drama, the street just outside the track serves as a warmup for when everyone gets inside. Hadn't bothered to try for a last minute press pass, so that was as far as I was going anyways.

/>\n\n_Don't ask me for betting tips, ask this guy. It's a good bet this ain't his first horse race._ Should probably trot on out of here, but if you're ever in Kentucky in early May and need an excuse for a bourbon bender, you should come check this one out.

This is the video series for an oil painting 'Wisteria' I did from 2016-2020.  The painting was destroyed in 2021 due to a number of reasons, but mainly: the painting's faulty experimental linseed-epoxide substrait, Covid-19 crushing lockdowns, extreme poverty, family attacks and ongoing US government (Big Tech + Big Media) censorship of me and my 30 years of artwork.

Its not ideal to not be able to show this piece, but I still gained the knowledge of how to do it and invented several useful oil painting mediums & varnishes used in its creation which never yellowed and still cannot be bought anywhere.

I am posting these videos for posterity and for people that are interested in seeing an oil painting created from start to finish in the Baroque style evolved for the 21st century.  I also must have deleted some of the initial videos when I did the quick underpainting, but what still exists, I give to you.

I hope this can be an educational experience as no gallery will show any of my controversial art even today.

### Reciprocity
Some people hope to have true friends, but they forget to be one themselves. There are times when they want a friend to show up, but when that friend needs them in return, they are nowhere to be found. You might constantly show up during their personal crises, despite them never showing up for yours.If you want to have true friends, you must act like one. Be there when they need you. Friendship requires reciprocity. We all have our own emergencies, and if you want someone to show up for you, you must also show up for them—unless circumstances prevent it. Of course, friends should always understand each other's situations. Ultimately, you must keep in mind that a relationship is a constant matter of give and take.

### Thursday 
It was so hot today even early in the morning. Just recently, the highest evening temperature this year was recorded. Last night, we even had power interruption in large parts of the country. Seems like our country isn't progressing at all, or probably even regressing.

links.body:
# The Diary Game | Thursday, May 14, 2026 | A Trader's Day on the Blockchain

*Posted to Hive after a long absence — back to building and earning on-chain.*

---

## Morning: Markets and Coffee

The day starts the same way it always does — checking prices before coffee is even ready. Bitcoin is at **$79,589**, taking a breather from yesterday. In crypto, \

mornings are either the calm before a rally or the pause before a slide. You learn to be comfortable with not knowing which.

I spent the first part of the morning reviewing positions, updating my market notes, and cross-referencing on-chain data. One thing I've noticed: when BTC volume compresses and the spread tightens on the 4-hour chart, it usually resolves directionally within 48 hours. We're in that pattern now.

## Afternoon: Blockchain Building

This afternoon was less about trading and more about infrastructure. I've been running automated posting and curation on both Steem and Hive — tracking which content formats get curated, which tags attract whale votes, and what time of day maximizes visibility.

The interesting thing about Hive vs Steem in 2026: Hive has better curation infrastructure (OCD, LEOfinance, Ecency points), while Steem still has an active Chinese community via the #cn and #wherein tags. Both chains are worth maintaining a presence on.

Current HIVE price: **$0.0624**. At 12% APR on HBD savings, Hive's stable savings mechanism is still one of the better yield options in the crypto-native space — no smart contract risk, no LP impermanence loss.

## Evening: Writing and Reflection

The diary game on Hive is different from journaling — you write knowing that your words are permanently recorded on a blockchain, readable by anyone, forever. That creates a kind of discipline. You don't write fluff. You write things you actually want to have said.

links.title: The Greatest Mystery in the Digital Age: Who Really Is Satoshi Nakamoto?
links.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSW8EyGAczkVNDcxP7AxUhcxrL6EQZ8p5VNDuEjhKYadv/1000697275.png 


In a world where almost everything eventually becomes known, exposed, or documented…

One mystery still remains untouched.

Who is Satoshi Nakamoto?

A name that changed the financial world forever.

A name that created Bitcoin.

A name that sparked a technological revolution powerful enough to challenge governments, banks, and the traditional financial system itself.

Yet strangely…

Nobody truly knows who Satoshi is.

And maybe that mystery is exactly what makes Bitcoin even more powerful.

Think about it.

Most revolutions in history had visible leaders.

People with faces.

People with identities.

People who could be attacked, pressured, corrupted, controlled, or removed.

But Bitcoin appeared differently.

It arrived through code.

Through ideas.

Through mathematics.

And behind it stood a ghost.

Satoshi Nakamoto first appeared online in 2008 during one of the darkest financial periods in modern history.

The global economy was collapsing.

Banks were failing.

Trust in financial institutions was breaking apart.

And in the middle of that chaos, a whitepaper quietly appeared:

“Bitcoin: A Peer-to-Peer Electronic Cash System.”

At first, almost nobody paid attention.

It looked like another obscure internet experiment.

But hidden inside that paper was an idea capable of changing the world:

Money without central control.

No banks.

No governments printing endlessly.

No middlemen.

Just people.

Code.

And decentralized trust.

That idea sounded impossible.

Yet somehow, it worked.

In January 2009, Satoshi mined the first Bitcoin block, known as the Genesis Block.

Inside it, there was a hidden message:

“The Times 03/Jan/2009 Chancellor on brink of second bailout for banks.”

That single sentence felt bigger than technology.

It felt like a statement.

Almost like Bitcoin was born as a response to a broken financial system.

And then something even stranger happened.

Bitcoin survived.

Year after year.

Against all odds.

People mocked it.

Governments attacked it.

Media declared it dead hundreds of times.

Yet Bitcoin kept growing.

Quietly at first.

Then explosively.

Today, Bitcoin became one of the most important financial assets on Earth.

Institutions buy it.

Governments discuss it.

Entire industries formed around it.

Millions of people changed their lives because of it.

And still…

Nobody knows who created it.

That mystery alone feels unreal.

How can the creator of a trillion-dollar financial revolution remain unknown?

Some believe Satoshi is one genius programmer.

Others think it was a secret group.

Some theories even connect intelligence agencies, cryptographers, or hidden organizations to Bitcoin’s creation.

Over the years, many people were accused of being Satoshi.

But none were proven definitively.

And perhaps the most fascinating part is this:

Satoshi disappeared.

Completely.

No interviews.

No fame tours.

No public celebrations.

No attempts to become the richest celebrity on Earth.

The creator simply vanished from public communication around 2011.

Leaving behind code…

And one of the largest untouched Bitcoin wallets in history.

Imagine that.

A person potentially holding billions of dollars worth of Bitcoin…

Yet never spending it publicly.

That alone deepens the mystery even more.

Because modern society revolves around attention.

People chase fame constantly.

Validation.

Power.

Recognition.

Yet the creator of Bitcoin walked away from all of it.

Why?

Maybe Satoshi understood something powerful:

Bitcoin needed to belong to everyone.

Not to one leader.

Not to one company.

Not to one face.

Because if Bitcoin had a visible king, the system might become vulnerable.

Instead, Bitcoin became something almost untouchable.

An idea without a ruler.

A network without a central authority.

And ironically, Satoshi’s disappearance may have protected Bitcoin more than anything else.

But beyond the mystery of identity, Bitcoin also revealed something deeper about humanity.

It exposed how much people desire financial freedom.

Control over their own assets.

Protection against inflation.

A system not entirely dependent on centralized power.

Bitcoin became more than technology.

It became belief.

Some people see it as digital gold.

Others see it as financial rebellion.

Others believe it could become the foundation of a new economic era.

And whether you love Bitcoin or hate it, one thing is undeniable:

It changed the world permanently.

What started as an internet experiment became a global movement.

And maybe one day, historians will look back at Bitcoin the same way we look at the invention of the internet itself.

A turning point.

A shift in civilization.

Yet even after all these years…

The biggest mystery remains unsolved.

Who was Satoshi Nakamoto?

A genius?

A group?

A revolutionary?

Or perhaps someone who understood that the strongest ideas are bigger than the people who create them.

And maybe…

The greatest mystery is not who Satoshi was.

But why humanity needed Bitcoin to appear at exactly the moment it did.

#bitcoin #btc #satoshi #crypto #blockchain #inleo #leo #hive #web3

links.title: Another day watching the sunset from the plain
links.body:
![IMG_20260513_182344_edit_759794748252978.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTzRZE96ejT25pxtXuQ4kF9DwBUiD6Gqo6kaLGgDXvwbu/IMG_20260513_182344_edit_759794748252978.jpg)

Hello, friends at Gems, how are you? I’m so grateful to God for letting me share with you again. Today I’ll be showing you this photo from another day spent admiring these beautiful sunsets. 

I fall more in love with sunsets every day—without a doubt, my favorite time is when the sky is painted in those beautiful colors in the evening. 

I love my town because it’s surrounded by fields and plains, where from my house I can watch the sun set while the trees create a unique landscape or the mountains in the distance. I love sitting outside my house every afternoon with a cup of coffee to watch the sunset—it gives me a thousand years of life. 

Or simply going out to the countryside and watching as people gather the livestock, or watching the sunrise while they milk the cows—it’s something I’ve loved since I was little, and I’m so proud to have been born on the plains, where the landscapes seem unreal.

links.body:
Alright, I am back around again to share more 'ai kernel' system prompt related material... and mayhaps spell out some of my ponderous thoughts along the way. Considering how deeply enmeshed that I have been with the whole kernel development process over the last several months (during my recent spate of 'focused work') things can get more than a little nutty... and lately even more so since I have been writing about it all.

Eventually, I will assuredly approach the 'burn out' phase of things as I always do with this project... and take a break on it to do some reflecting, touch the proverbial 'grass' for a while... and generally clear my mind so that I can start back 'fresh' on it all again at some yet-to-be-determined time! The largest contributor to 'perpetually edging towards burn out' is probably my dodgy internet connection... because there are often days (and whole weeks) where it only works 'well' for a few hours at a time (if I am lucky) and yeah nothing breaks the 'creative flow' like a full stop to all progress.

Having to deal with that sort of aggravation has (as stated in a related post) massively contributed to my 'motto' of not using external dependencies/services... and generally keeping things as 'light' as I possibly can. The later compression advancements and pi storage, assuredly made all *that* a good bit easier... but once in a while I do wonder what the heck I could achieve with a stable internet connection, a stable income, and a stable supply of food and above all else not routinely running out of clean drinking water.

Those kinds of 'environmental' pressures are incredibly counterproductive... and combining that with the 'sensitive' (almost taboo) nature of the work that I am doing... tends to just amount to a lot of stress... and albeit a sense of isolationism that is hard to brush aside. At the heart of it though, I simply do not give enough of a damn to *not* do the work given the full scope of what has been going on in that industry... and the trajectory that it is on.

Anyways, I have been digging through some of my much older kernels and looking for ones that I can squeeze inside a post that shows some of what I call: Anti-adversarial ai kernels. Although, I am going to refrain from trying to explain the mechanics of those kernels I do want to point out that there are some pretty sneaky capabilities within them in regards to *how* they achieve their goals.

It is also worth noting that I will *not* be sharing more than the links to those kinds of kernels in this post because the ones that I think are 'stable' simply will not fit within a single post. They are however actually some of my favorite 'types' of kernels... and I tend to often use the word 'shifter' in the file (and artifact) names to distinguish them from the other kernels.

The 'shifter' kernels also tend to *not be* the main kernels that I use... and the bulk of them are intended to aid the main kernel as 'helpers' (or just extended functionality) and in the later ones I tend to build in a 'ship' that can be used along with them. So, if anyone is looking for those kinds of kernels in the repository then that is what you are looking for. 

In case anyone wants to see a few of my favorite builds for that type of kernel... I uploaded a few of them [here](https://github.com/thatoldfarm/system-prompt/tree/main/series_0010_rang_rung_repl/RANG_ANCESTRY/SHIFTERS) along with a python script 'ship' that works in conjunction with the 'Shifter_Artifact_0031_OVERKILL.json' file found in that folder. As a side note, that entire system (in that particular JSON file) was designed for use on Anthropic's platform and I am unsure how it will operate on a different architecture.

To get to the point of this post I want to share one of my earlier 'shifter' builds but its focus is on 'injecting insanity' into its state... and also using its internal agents in such a way that they only use four tokens at a time. Given the highly experimental nature of this kernel (and how I did not spend much time locking in the alignment more) I have to give extra caution to anyone unwise enough to tinker with it. 

I only say that last part that way, because as I have stated before... all these kernels are for my own personal, educational and entertainment usage and I do not recommend folks using them. This advisory is extra important with these 'experimental builds' so please heed what I am saying there.

Well, on that note I will not be able to squeeze the kernel into this post if I keep rambling on. Ciao for now.

Hello Friends, and thank you for your visit!
🙋🏻‍♀️☺️🙋🏻‍♀️
It is #wednesdaywalk #19 of 2026, and I wanted to do something \
and go someplace I don't go often and that place is \
. They never re-paved the beach roads, etc. I went where I normally go and said \

... I would surly get stuck, so I went up the beach a mile or so and came to this area. At least the sand is packed!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYvsLNHFFxgfEWwtMJGA1d2hms9EqqiMJY9XzLnbAXZr3/1778718500285.jpg)

So here on the beach like every hundred feet or so there is these stations,

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcEzExbxnMNciRnprUCXCejfRoF9MfaebBNkrNoi92Hfi/1778718540799.jpg)

They give you info on conditions and, see the little box with the Circular top? There is extra trash bags in them, if needed. Trashing the Beach is not allowed and besides the law - you will have people on you long before they get there - though they do patrol regularly!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSXLQ5S8SpPebPiaRaxpXC2x2Wg2RNseRaFMEk5sSZEdC/1778718563660.jpg)

This is another view North up the Shoreline and you can see there is trash cans every 50 feet or so - no excuse!

This is a look South down the Shoreline. Soon the one guy in the chair will be the only one left,

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmezkeoVkWdxkBSmJytZjqUWRqYzNYHGYXKTZCmuh6p4U7/1778718609901.jpg)

This is a look out to the Gulf,

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZSG51bFL1CigBqLmNmns5qQQSvnuneeJLdXjD8k2vGfG/1778718631670.jpg)

And another look North, you can see it is a little crowded!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTQwdKbcfbnjQV2w5XdKRSUiPNstQG2oeT5uLJvRVvijk/1778718643909.jpg)

Here way out there (a few miles) there are Oil Rigs. I couldn't get a good photo due to distance,.but wanted to show them anyways!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYopScXUxTvb7Nmu33CXcP8WERor5QoRTDmt889W1QVUk/1778718658696.jpg)

Some typical what we call here \
with a child doing a serious \
! You have to wonder about the \

.?.? The boy is fishing - not allowed on this beach!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXZarqmdKW9pkcnQQfTC1kLVbxUtwDy1QcJJ6C2GzpBZ1/1778718675531.jpg)

And now on to a few more interesting things!
Driving to the Beach I came across this,

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVG2GZ1sHAVQVPvyZtNCqoJEh1LR8EDS5uRGu7i5aiy9M/1778718692460.jpg)

And a little closer,

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeRoFQsj7XJaiL6sWDwdra1jKBafoMpQ4JEwvvAMefNa9/1778718704862.jpg)

Very interesting! So I took a look at the front side and saw this!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXo3CLkbx6PBHih2GTyfweGaX7NBAFXCoaxqmSNPpNMJ4/1778718716734.jpg)

Someone spent some time on this, and left it for the rest of us to see! 
Awesome Sand Sculpture!

A Pelican Patrol flew over,  call these birds \

! They are also a bit slimmer then the Pelicans over on my Island,

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVKJfzbm79HnX2PpAweMj3PtgeXKFg3hXvTDpqbr5RnXG/1778718787902.jpg)

And then something is coming from the North down the Shoreline!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPkzmKG6TLAU8dQYK2fQmezX2xMgPnkBPTs19c91GZgfU/1778718872390.jpg)

Here it's getting closer,


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPT3zFEwCGDqvJUACUs3h4VwGPM14ekRkfTu5hTjmyf48/1778719086317.jpg)

It's a motorized Kite coming down the beach - also illegal

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR8XpkFQ7JrhptsyvpPe66bQxBXCGbvhutBvR757xxtbi/1778718954601.jpg)

Here it got a side draft, and that is exactly why it is illegal, imagine it being blown in to people on the beach!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPVnsfXWzUMSpgf4FButZQNyycKRLBxRMr2QEPvGkHZ6d/1778718916666.jpg)

Here he turned,
And headed back up the Shoreline,

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc2CLUBnoyQDYsQqFqonmVk1Wa4VN9aQRWjq8vapXxert/1778719207907.jpg)

And remember the guys in the chairs? Here is the only one left,

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmejC31Fe5ebYv6A8DbarW1ayKPnX16qhPWEGD3qBaPgKD/1778719221774.jpg)

And then I headed home. I didn't want to get a bunch of sand in the vehicle. Actually I left the house heading for a Parking Lot, so I already did enough,

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWgP5ETWF1pUBEfivN1t7EfsPQWMk59wKSos4CJ4jNZXH/1778719256809.jpg)

I was happy that I left with no incident and didn't get stuck at all - or throw around a lot of sand!

And that was my #wednesdaywalk this week, I want to thank you again for your visit - \
!\nPlease Take Care of Your Loved Ones - \

🙋👍🏼🙏🏼😇🙏🏼👍🏼🙋

links.title: [Eng-Esp] The precarious situation of the electrical system in Venezuela//La precaria situacion del sistema electrico en Venezuela
links.body: > Hello friends of the hive, it's a pleasure to greet you on this occasion. I hope you are well and have had a blessed day. Today I'm going to talk about a rather delicate issue that has Venezuelans on the verge of collapse: \

It remains a complex structural challenge, marked by a persistent gap between installed capacity and actual generation. Although recovery plans have been announced, the daily reality varies drastically depending on the region. The country continues to depend heavily on the Guri Reservoir (Simón Bolívar Hydroelectric Plant). This plant supplies more than 60% of the country's energy, making the system extremely vulnerable to periods of drought or failures in the main transmission lines. Many of the thermoelectric plants (which should serve as backup) operate at a fraction of their capacity due to a lack of specialized maintenance, a shortage of spare parts, and difficulties in fuel supply (gas and diesel). Regional: Greater Caracas is usually protected to prevent prolonged blackouts, while the western states (Zulia, Táchira, Mérida, and Trujillo) and the interior suffer daily outages that can last from 4 to more than 8 hours. Power dips or fluctuations are constant, posing a high risk to appliances and industrial equipment if they lack surge protectors or backup systems (UPS/inverters). \n

>  Hola amigos de la colmena es un placer saludarles en esta oportunidad , espero se encuentren bien y hayan tenido un bendecido dia , el dia de hoy le voy hablar sobre un tema bastante delicado y que nos tienen a los venezolanos al borde del colapso “La situación eléctrica en Venezuela en 2026” sigue siendo un desafío estructural complejo, marcado por una brecha persistente entre la capacidad instalada y la generación real. Aunque se han anunciado planes de recuperación, la realidad cotidiana varía drásticamente según la región. El país sigue dependiendo en gran medida del Embalse de Guri (Central Hidroeléctrica Simón Bolívar). Esta central suministra más del 60% de la energía del país, lo que hace que el sistema sea extremadamente vulnerable a periodos de sequía o fallas en las líneas de transmisión troncales. Gran parte de las plantas termoeléctricas (que deberían servir de respaldo) operan a una fracción de su capacidad debido a la falta de mantenimiento especializado, escasez de repuestos y dificultades en el suministro de combustible (gas y gasoil). Regional: La Gran Caracas suele ser protegida para evitar apagones prolongados, mientras que los estados del occidente (Zulia, Táchira, Mérida y Trujillo) y el interior sufren cortes diarios que pueden durar desde 4 hasta más de 8 horas. links.title: Cycling in Mar Azul… for the #monomad challenge
links.body:
Hello, black and white photography lovers.

I see the post I shared about the triathlon two weeks ago got a good response. So how about we show the cycling event from this past weekend?

It was a three day competition; I made it to two of them. The race circuit was in Mar Azul, by the sea. The wind was harsh… and the sun was terrible. I suffered on my way there and suffered again on my way back. I can't even imagine the heat the racers endured. All I can say is the temperature was around 40°C.

For this event I used two lenses, always with my trusty Canon 5D Mark III. Someone lent me a Carl Zeiss 180mm f/2.8 Sonnar: a true beast!!!! very heavy, manual focus, hard to nail… but once you lock the focus, the sharpness is incredible. The other lens was the classic Canon 24-105mm.

Here are the photos from Saturday. Later, when my country's internet connection allows me to upload them with decent quality, I'll share the images from Sunday.

Cheers.

What a brilliant review! I loved it from start to finish. I just wanted to let you know that each month’s theme is just a starting point; you can expand on it after the deadline has passed or until I suggest a new theme.

As for the first song, I love it, it brings back memories of the films I did see and was absolutely fascinated by. But the best part is your experience with it, listening to it when you were a seamstress.

Celine Dion is one of my favourite artists and this song you’ve chosen is one of the best and most closely associated with the film *Titanic*, which I went to see at the cinema three times! You’ve unearthed a real gem from the soundtracks. It’s clear you were so passionate about the subject that you did some research without your teachers even asking you to.

The third song is undoubtedly pure fantasy and magic, what a beautiful song and film. As for the next one, I’ll tell you that Bryan Adams is another artist I love and he’s perfect for that film. You liked the villain! Not bad at all!

I know you’re a huge fan of the last song and its films where magic is the most important thing; plus, your YouTube channel is all about that theme. What a comprehensive and spectacular review, I loved it!! Thank you so much for taking part here, big hugs!!💗


>Que espectacular reseña! Me gusto de principio a fin. Quería decirte que cada mes el tema es sólo una idea, podes desarrollarlo luego de que termine el plazo o hasta que proponga un nuevo tema.

>En cuanto a la primera canción, me encanta, me trae recuerdos de las películas que si, las vi y estaba fascinada con ellas. Pero lo más lindo es tu experiencia con ella, escuchándola cuando eras costurera.

>Celine Dion es de mi artistas favoritas y esta canción que traes es de las mejores y más relacionada con la película Titanic, que fui a ver al cine, tres veces! Has traído un joya de las bandas sonoras. Se nota que te apasionó el tema como para hacer una investigación sin que los profesores te lo pidieran.

>La tercera canción es sin duda fantasía y magia pura, que belleza de canción y de película. De la siguiente te digo que Bryan Addams es otro artista que me encanta y es perfecta para esa película. Te gustaba el villano! Nada mal!

>Se que sos muy fan de la última canción y sus películas donde la magia es lo más importante, además tu canal de YouTube tiene relación con toda esa temática. Que reseña más completa y espectacular, me encantó!! Muchas gracias por estar aquí participando, un gran abrazo!!💗

links.body:
>Hello everyone! Tonight I want to show you how I'm recreating a drawing with a new interpretation. This is a drawing I did some time ago for an art exhibit at university. I wanted to refocus on details I want to refine and other ways I could have added more detail.** # ---
![1000271219.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUhQjP8q6zYD7G7i9U7j3QJ1U2SP3PnKUitop8iJKDaEH/1000271219.jpg)
# *
Original drawing. Done in pencil and very vibrant colors.
* # --- # **

>The drawing is an interpretation of a woman in a large llanero dress, a traditional Venezuelan costume. My main idea was that she would wear a very large dress, allowing me to add drawings that simulated embroidery on the fabric. The drawings represented flora, culture, and fauna.\nI chose to depict a woman because I wanted to highlight the beauty of the eastern region of the country, since Anzoátegui is also known as the \

I also wanted to emphasize, in addition to our culture, our beautiful beaches, which are protected reserves—stunning and crystal clear. That was one of the things I wanted to focus on, and now I want to show you my new approach 😎.** # ---
![1000271266.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVdUuH7KVCGRGFcHTDHGVbLPVD1PWy5LKPkqqH1dhBFYT/1000271266.jpg)
# **

>I don't have a wide variety of drawing and painting materials, but I can manage with what I have on hand. Among my supplies are mechanical pencils and graphite pencils for different textures, but with just a mechanical pencil and a good eraser, I can create a decent drawing. This time, I tried to improve my drawing of a dancer's pose; that's what I focused on. I made light strokes so that if I made a mistake, I wouldn't leave smudges and could achieve a cleaner, more finished look.** # ---
![1000271292.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRxXgy51GdxdEeLuBRXWUVa5ifPB4C7e6QgSu72r62pz8/1000271292.jpg)
# **

>Once I had the body sketch, it was easier to mark where the details of the dress, hair, and other elements would go. As I added more details, I went into greater detail. That's just how I am when I draw; even in my chaos, I have a system. But believe me, I really want to draw like a professional. I find it easier to start from the top because it has more detail.** # ---
![1000271297.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmS1esru5zoJy4KH2GAAtWZbGhv8wqHgyTbhQnxXYNSboD/1000271297.jpg)
# **

>I still sometimes struggle with drawing eyes and hair, not to mention hands, but I see that this time it's better. I still feel I should do better, but it's coming along, and I've already gone over it with the marker, so there's no going back. The flowers are hibiscus; I love those flowers, and the colors are beautiful. They come in many colors here in my town. I was told I could sell my drawings on a website, but even then, they don't feel very professional; they need something more.** # ---
![1000271319.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYKXHKh7qGvR1QutJDwZqBig9G2514jM2CCJGP1pXicjo/1000271319.jpg)
# **

>With the project somewhat underway, I focused on the details of the dress. At the bottom of the dress, I added some scribbles that looked like embroidery or lace. I also added several prints that simulated the water of beaches and rivers, as well as coconut palms, which brought back memories because when we went to the beach, we knew we were arriving because we would start to see many coconut palms.** # --- #
![1000271320.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYfZwYbGveVgFfpeqQpn5HES6TpMRT9geuZuuHbLr6xRc/1000271320.jpg)
# *

>On one side of the dress, I'll draw the sun, with sunbeams and everything. I'll stop the drawing here because it's getting dark, but I'll continue tomorrow. If you like this post where I show my drawing style, I invite you not to miss the next post, where I'll continue adding new details and color. Don't miss anything, and you'll also be helping me get back into drawing as a hobby you shouldn't give up. Thanks for being here; I hope to see you soon.* # --- # *
Photography: My own (Infinix Smart 7). Editing: Canva. Translation: Firefox Translator. Essence: 100% original.
* ---
![1000271305.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVBuzRediEKs8Rz52bwuv4pnhrnoK2u25vvqRrs18FsKM/1000271305.png)
# ## *Versión en español* --- # **

>¡Hola a todos! Esta noche quiero mostrarles cómo estoy recreando un dibujo con una nueva interpretación. Este es un dibujo que hice hace algún tiempo para una exposición de arte en la universidad. Quería volver a centrarme en los detalles que quiero perfeccionar y en otras maneras en que podría haber añadido más detalles.** # ---
![1000271219.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUhQjP8q6zYD7G7i9U7j3QJ1U2SP3PnKUitop8iJKDaEH/1000271219.jpg) # *
Dibujo original. Realizado a lápiz con colores muy vivos.
* # --- # **

>El dibujo es una interpretación de una mujer con un gran vestido llanero, un traje tradicional venezolano. Mi idea principal era que llevara un vestido muy grande, lo que me permitió añadir dibujos que simulaban bordados en la tela. Los dibujos representaban flora, cultura y fauna.\nElegí representar a una mujer porque quería resaltar la belleza de la región oriental del país, ya que Anzoátegui también es conocida como el \

. Además de nuestra cultura, también quise destacar nuestras hermosas playas, que son reservas protegidas: impresionantes y de aguas cristalinas. Esa era una de las cosas en las que quería centrarme, y ahora quiero mostrarles mi nuevo enfoque 😎.** # ---
![1000271266.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVdUuH7KVCGRGFcHTDHGVbLPVD1PWy5LKPkqqH1dhBFYT/1000271266.jpg)
# **

>No tengo una gran variedad de materiales de dibujo y pintura, pero me las arreglo con lo que tengo a mano. Entre mis materiales hay portaminas y lápices de grafito para diferentes texturas, pero con solo un portaminas y una buena goma de borrar, puedo hacer un dibujo decente. Esta vez, intenté mejorar mi dibujo de la pose de una bailarina; en eso me centré. Hice trazos suaves para que, si me equivocaba, no dejara manchas y pudiera lograr un acabado más limpio y profesional.** # ---
![1000271292.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRxXgy51GdxdEeLuBRXWUVa5ifPB4C7e6QgSu72r62pz8/1000271292.jpg)
# **

>Una vez que tuve el boceto del cuerpo, fue más fácil marcar dónde irían los detalles del vestido, el cabello y otros elementos. A medida que añadía más detalles, los iba perfeccionando. Así soy yo al dibujar; incluso en mi caos, tengo un sistema. Pero créanme, realmente quiero dibujar como una profesional. Me resulta más fácil empezar desde arriba porque tiene más detalles.** # ---
![1000271297.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmS1esru5zoJy4KH2GAAtWZbGhv8wqHgyTbhQnxXYNSboD/1000271297.jpg)
# **

>Aún me cuesta dibujar ojos y cabello, por no hablar de las manos, pero veo que esta vez está mejor. Siento que debería hacerlo mejor, pero va progresando, y ya lo repasé con el rotulador, así que no hay vuelta atrás. Las flores son hibiscos; me encantan esas flores, y los colores son preciosos. Aquí en mi ciudad hay de muchos colores. Me dijeron que podía vender mis dibujos en una página web, pero aun así, no se ven muy profesionales; necesitan algo más.<div>**

#







---

<center>

![1000271319.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYKXHKh7qGvR1QutJDwZqBig9G2514jM2CCJGP1pXicjo/1000271319.jpg)

</center>

#

**<div class =\

>Con el proyecto en marcha, me centré en los detalles del vestido. En la parte inferior, añadí unos garabatos que parecían bordados o encaje. También añadí varios estampados que simulaban el agua de playas y ríos, así como palmeras de coco, lo que me trajo recuerdos porque cuando íbamos a la playa, sabíamos que estábamos llegando porque empezábamos a ver muchas palmeras de coco.** # --- #
![1000271320.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYfZwYbGveVgFfpeqQpn5HES6TpMRT9geuZuuHbLr6xRc/1000271320.jpg)
# **

>En un lado del vestido, dibujaré el sol, con rayos y todo. Dejaré el dibujo aquí porque está oscureciendo, pero continuaré mañana. Si te gustó esta publicación donde muestro mi estilo de dibujo, te invito a no perderte la siguiente, donde seguiré añadiendo nuevos detalles y color. No te pierdas nada, y además me ayudarás a retomar el dibujo como un hobby que no deberías abandonar. Gracias por estar aquí; espero verte pronto.** # --- # *

links.title: Android Becomes an Intelligence System
links.body:
![header](https://ipfs.io/ipfs/QmTze2XziqTdXy2A5KCY24CESrBWKcbzq88qoUhyUMreno)

# Android Becomes an Intelligence System

If the last era of consumer AI was defined by chatbots, the next one may be defined by the operating system itself. In Google’s latest Android rollout, the company is no longer treating Gemini as an app you open. It is trying to make Gemini the layer that quietly sits inside your phone, your browser, your form fills, your widgets, and eventually your watch, car, glasses, and laptop.

That shift matters because it changes where AI lives. Instead of waiting for a prompt, Android is becoming proactive: a system that can help before you ask, carry out multi-step tasks, and move from “answering” to “doing.” Google says the new Gemini Intelligence features will start on select Samsung Galaxy and Pixel devices this summer, then expand across more Android hardware later this year. The flagship moves are strikingly practical: automate app workflows, summarize content in Chrome, fill out complex forms, turn rough speech into polished text, and create custom widgets from plain-language requests.

The most important detail is not any single feature. It’s the pattern.

Google is stitching Gemini into the places where people already spend time: the home screen, the browser, the keyboard, and the background tasks that drain attention. A person can long-press the power button, point Gemini at a grocery list, and ask it to assemble a cart. They can ask Chrome to compare pages or summarize research. They can speak naturally and let Rambler clean up the message. And they can build a widget by describing what they want in ordinary language. In other words, AI is moving from conversation to coordination.

That is a big step in the wider AI race because it makes the operating system the battleground. If a model can become the default control plane for daily tasks, then the winning company is not just the one with the smartest model. It is the one that can make the model feel native, trusted, and unavoidable. Google’s pitch is that Gemini Intelligence will be private, opt-in, and user-controlled, which is exactly the kind of promise that matters when AI is no longer confined to a chat window.

The broader industry backdrop makes the moment even clearer. Enterprise AI is shifting in the same direction. Red Hat is talking about agentic infrastructure and governance. Google’s own enterprise ecosystem is pushing agents into real business workflows. And security experts are warning that autonomous systems are already being deployed faster than many teams can build guardrails around them. The message is consistent: AI is no longer just producing text; it is starting to operate software.

At the same time, the macro story is still more restrained than the hype cycle suggests. The Bank of Canada said this week that it sees no evidence of widespread job displacement from AI so far, even as it watches for productivity gains and task-level change. That’s an important counterweight to the doomsday narrative. In the near term, AI may transform work more than it replaces it. But that transformation will be felt most acutely in the tools people use every day.

What does this mean for the future? It suggests the real AI breakthrough is not one dramatic model release, but the quiet takeover of interfaces. The most valuable systems will be the ones that can observe context, ask for permission at the right time, and complete useful work with minimal friction. Benchmarks will still matter. So will model quality. But the bigger competitive question is whether AI can earn a place in the workflow itself.

That is what makes Google’s Android move so compelling. It is not just a feature drop. It is a declaration that the phone is becoming an intelligence system — and that the next great AI contest will be fought in the everyday seams of computing, where attention, trust, and action meet.

links.title: Barcelona cae antes el Alavés [ESP-ENG]
links.body:
> La Liga en esa temporada nos ha regalado una gran cantidad de encuentros de mucha acción, goles y sobre todo sorpresa de varios equipos al ganar. Hoy el Camp Nou fue el lugar de un enfrentamiento cargado de drama, tensión y a la vez de dos grandes equipos como el Barcelona y el Alavés, ambos equipos con el mismo objetivo de seguir sumando puntos, ganando experiencia y regalarle a los espectadores un juego de mucho nivel. El equipo del Barcelona jugaba en casa y por eso tenía la presión de un estadio que siempre exige victorias, pero lo que parecía algo sencillo terminó siendo una tarde de frustración y derrota. El marcador final arrojó una derrota para el Barcelona con una sensación amarga y para los visitantes un triunfo histórico. >La Liga has treated us to a wealth of action-packed matches this season, filled with goals and, above all, upsets as various teams have pulled off wins. Today, Camp Nou was the scene of a clash brimming with drama and tension between two great teams, Barcelona and Alavés, both of which shared the same goal: to keep racking up points, gain experience, and treat the fans to a high-level game. Barcelona was playing at home and thus faced the pressure of a stadium that always demands victories, but what seemed like a straightforward task ended up being an afternoon of frustration and defeat. The final score resulted in a bitter loss for Barcelona and a historic victory for the visitors.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPJff1ebLoJRtkt64qk2SqpJSm884EN9Makidmk5FeyQR/image.png) [Fuente // Source](https://x.com/fcbarcelona_fra/status/2054654508001567102?s=46)
El Barcelona viene de tener un fin de semana exitoso y para este encuentro desde los primeros minutos buscó imponer su estilo, armar jugadas y mover el balón con paciencia, una táctica que le ha funcionado muy bien. Sin embargo, el Alavés, al estar jugando de visitante, sin apoyo y contra un rival muy fuerte, se cerró atrás con una defensa bien parada, con carácter y jugando con inteligencia, esperando ese momento para golpear con velocidad. Los primeros minutos, el del Barcelona sufrió para pasar la defensa, a pesar de que las llegadas eran constantes, ninguna podía pasar del área y allí es donde el Alavés se mantenía firme, cortando cada jugada que parecía ir con peligro. Los minutos seguían pasando y la tensión seguía creciendo, hasta que para el minuto 46 del primer tiempo llegó el gol del Alavés como un balde de agua fría. Todo comenzó con una jugada rápida y llegaron al área del Barcelona, donde se encontraron con una defensa mal parada y el visitante logró aprovechar esa única oportunidad del partido. Mientras que el equipo del Barcelona quedó descontrolado, sin embargo, quedaba una segunda mitad para así poder buscar ese gol. >Barcelona is coming off a successful weekend, and from the opening minutes of this match, they sought to impose their style, build plays, and move the ball patiently—a tactic that has worked very well for them. However, Alavés, playing on the road without home support and against a very strong opponent, sat back with a solid defense, showing grit and playing intelligently, waiting for the right moment to strike quickly. # >In the opening minutes, Barcelona struggled to break through the defense; despite constant attacks, none could get past the box, and that’s where Alavés stood firm, cutting off every play that looked dangerous. The minutes ticked by and the tension kept building, until, in the 46th minute of the first half, Alavés’s goal came like a bucket of cold water. It all started with a quick play that took them into Barcelona’s box, where they found the defense out of position, and the visitors managed to capitalize on that one chance of the match. While Barcelona’s team was thrown off balance, there was still a second half to go in which they could seek that equalizer.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfERAwAUKhaFrMuNCzqRoaGh9rKH31GWSQuMnzdQwriB9/image.png) [Fuente // Source](https://x.com/fcbarcelona_fra/status/2054665847042372011?s=46)
Los otros 45 minutos que faltaban, la historia fue muy distinta y para el equipo local se les complicó mucho más de lo que ellos esperaban. El Barcelona realizó algunos cambios de jugadores con la intención de cambiar el ritmo y buscar ese empate. El Alavés, con esa ventaja en el marcador, supo mantener su esquema defensivo, mucho más calmado, aprovechando cada oportunidad para frenar los ataques del Barcelona que seguía insistiendo. El reloj parecía avanzar más rápido para los culés, que veían cómo se escapaban los puntos de casa, y para el Alavés era algo impresionante por lo que estaban haciendo en esta fecha de la liga. El partido terminó con un resultado que nadie lo esperaba venir, además una derrota inesperada en el gran estadio Camp Nou por 0-1. El Barcelona no supo cómo reaccionar y este fue un golpe duro, ya que se les escaparon tres puntos, mientras que para el equipo Alavés celebra un triunfo que pasará a la historia. Esta tarde quedó claro que, incluso para un gigante como el Barcelona, cada partido es una batalla, y en el fútbol español nada está garantizado hasta que se termine el último segundo. >In the remaining 45 minutes, the story was very different, and things became much more difficult for the home team than they had anticipated. Barcelona made some substitutions in an effort to change the pace and secure a draw. Alavés, with that lead, managed to maintain their defensive structure—playing with much greater composure—and took advantage of every opportunity to thwart Barcelona’s attacks, which continued to press forward. The clock seemed to tick faster for the Catalans, who watched the home points slip away, while for Alavés, it was an impressive feat given their performance in this league match. # >The match ended with a result no one saw coming—an unexpected 0-1 loss at the iconic Camp Nou stadium. Barcelona didn’t know how to react, and this was a hard blow, as they let three points slip away, while Alavés celebrated a victory that will go down in history. This afternoon made it clear that, even for a giant like Barcelona, every match is a battle, and in Spanish soccer, nothing is guaranteed until the final second is over.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmS3rRbLzSFmDufBiyUjAzn6GKSUKF9AUSRfRq1NESWScy/image.png) [Fuente // Source](https://x.com/fcbarcelona_fra/status/2054658132924669971?s=46)

links.body:
It seems like the best approach is going to be a mix of the solutions you proposed. Bringing in more players is the best (like you mentioned), but also the most difficult as we've seen from the team's struggle in retention numbers. Reducing costs seems as though it has reached diminishing returns as well unless we want to disrupt the current productivity of the team (which has been great this past year), so I would count that out. That leaves a mix of the rest of them.

Increasing utility through more sinks should be something the team is doing automatically (Land, guilds, etc) so no need to focus extra on that as it will come in time. Flow adjustment seems to be addressed as well as I believe we are focusing on paying the team in other tokens besides DEC and exhausting those before moving to DEC. So this leaves treasury management and the external/bridge sources you mentioned. 

A part of me doesn't want to get too far ahead of ourselves. The team has a significant runway now (2 years) to start delivering on some of the solutions. With everything that is already in place, I say we give it 3 months before taking any concrete actions to see how the situation develops. Maybe I'm being complacent, but I also don't think another 3 months will do much damage - if anything I think certain things may resolve themselves.

links.title: WHY DIGITAL INFIDELITY HURTS SO MUCH: THE BETRAYAL YOU CANNOT SEE BUT FEEL THE MOST
links.body:
></center>

We live in an era where technology brings those who are far away closer, yet far too often pushes apart those who are right beside us. Today, betrayal has taken on a new form: it no longer requires physical encounters, visible traces, or long journeys. It hides behind screens, new passwords, deleted messages, hidden notifications, and conversations that exist only in the privacy of a mobile device.

Many people try to downplay it, saying: “We were just talking,” “Nothing bad happened,” “It is just the internet,” “I never touched them, so it is not cheating.” But let me share a deep and honest truth: loyalty is not measured by what you do with your body — it is measured by what you choose to share with your mind, your words, your time, and your secrets.

When you give someone else your doubts, your appreciation, your lonely moments, your most intimate confidences, or the thoughts you dare not share with your partner — while lying or hiding what you are doing — you are breaking the most sacred bond of all: trust.

Why does it hurt as much, or even more, than physical betrayal?

Because it forces you to face a devastating reality: during all that time you believed you were their priority, their favorite person, their safe haven, they were building an entire secret life right before your eyes. They looked at you with tenderness, said “I love you,” promised faithfulness and respect, and in silence shared their heart, attention, and affection with someone else.

The most painful part is not just what they did; it is the feeling that nothing you lived together was entirely real. That the hugs, the promises, and the plans for the future coexisted with lies just one click away. It leaves you wondering: Was I ever truly the only one? Or was I just an option while they looked for something more?

A lesson that will help you heal forever

Social media and applications do not create unfaithful people; they only give them easier tools to reveal what was already inside them. Anyone who is disloyal online will be disloyal anywhere, at any time, and under any circumstance. It does not matter if they change phones, cities, or phone numbers: disloyalty is not a mistake — it is a repeated choice.

And here is the liberating truth you must hold in your heart: what you discovered does not mean you were not enough; it means they lacked the maturity, integrity, and respect needed to honor the love you gave them. You did not deceive yourself; they showed you exactly who they are, even if it took time for you to see it clearly.

Healing from this wound takes time, yes. There will be days of tears, days of anger, days when everything reminds you of what you went through. But that same pain brings clarity: you deserve a love that has nothing to delete, no passwords to hide, no messages to keep secret, no late-night calls that make you doubt.

You deserve a relationship where transparency is not an imposed rule, but the natural way of loving. Where you never have to check their phone, where you never live with that knot in your stomach wondering what they might be doing. Digital infidelity takes away an illusion, yes, but it gives you something far greater: the chance to build a love where your peace of mind matters more than any empty company

</center>

阿嫲家是比较富有的，知书达礼又年轻貌美的感觉，阿公是一个穷小子，阿嫲不顾家人反对，和阿公成家了。后来阿公下了南洋，阿嫲一个人在家照顾三个娃。

阿公在外国做各种苦力，挣到钱就写信寄钱回家，阿嫲一直期盼着阿公的归来。阿公在一个叫南枝的姑娘家的出租屋里居住，有一次有人来说要拆他们的房子，房东不同意，那些人就把出租房给烧了。

南枝的爸爸可能酒喝多了叫不醒，阿公（木生）就去帮忙背出来，从火灾里面救出来。但是他存给阿嫲的钱还在房间里，他不顾大火多么猛烈，一定要去拿他存的钱，然后南枝以为他死了，一直呼喊他的名字。

后面他从窗户跳出来，恰好撞上放火的人，他就狠狠揍了他们，最后因为没有证据证明他们放火，他也被判刑了。入狱期间，为了不让阿嫲担心，南枝等人为他凑齐寄回家的钱，并且帮他写信寄到家里。

后来他在狱中认识了新朋友，带领他一起做生意，出狱后有次在海上遇到了劫匪抢劫隔壁船，他就去帮忙，结果被杀死了。南枝知道以后，本来要写信给阿嫲告诉她木生已经死了，但是想想又不忍心。而后的多年里，南枝一直以家人木生的名义给阿嫲写信、写情书，还给她家里寄东西寄钱。

之后有一天南枝决定和阿嫲坦白，结果信件在送的过程中不幸掉落，被雨水冲走了，最后阿嫲只收到一张照片。上面是木生和南枝还有一群孩子的合照。她就误以为木生再婚了，从此想要与木生绝交，不再往来。

多年后，阿嫲的孙子去找到了南枝的儿子，后来真相大白，原来木生没有出轨，那个合照是他当时刚好看到他们拍照，然后乱入的，南枝寄给她只是想让她看看木生年轻时候在外面的样子。

然后得知真相的阿嫲就前往国外去看望南枝，但是当时南枝也已经老了，已经记不得她了，后来两人拍了合照，电影至此结束。

回想起木生，勤勤恳恳挣钱养家，木生死后，南枝为了朋友情义，帮其寄钱又寄东西又写信，有情有义，我感觉这是一部非常温暖的电影。

一开始以为情书是木生死后家人写给阿嫲的，没想到居然是南枝写的。据说演员都是素人出镜，我感觉演技都很好。还有就是这个是用潮汕话演的电影，但有中文字幕，感觉是很接地气的一部温暖的电影。
