links.title: Midnight Version of Me
links.body:
>In this prompt, with regards to whom i become at midnight. I, for one, believe that we are different at midnight than we are during the day. You cannot stay the same after a stressful day. At midnight, I wont actually say i actually become someone else, like a crime fighting vigilante at night. For me, i dont, I remain the same person, with the same thoughts, the the same responsibilities lingering in the background, but something subtle changes id say, and that is that I become bolder, and my mind becomes far less hesitant.
During the day, i feel like there is a filter. Ideas come out more freely, less concerned with perfection, more willing to exist in raw form first and refinement later. The night sort of puts a deadline for me and their is urgency in my work or whatever im doing, i am more concentrated because i know that i still have to sleep, so the earlier i get done what i have to during the night, the better because my reward will be sleeping earlier and the more im unable to finish the more extended my midnight is.
That’s why so much of my writing on platforms like this and work drafts, even simple work-related texts ends up being done late at night. It used to be accidental but not anymore. It’s a pattern I’ve learned from experience. The results ive come to realise are often better. There’s a clarity that shows up when the world is quiet enough that I can finally hear my own thoughts without nobody calling me or distracting me.
So I lean into it. I make coffee, settle in, and shift into that familiar night rhythm, typing slowly at first, then faster as ideas begin to align. Midnight doesn’t drain me it gives me focus and sometimes, like today, it’s not even just writing for public spaces. There are even som personal messages, slightly risky drafts, things I would overthink too much if I touched them earlier in the day, but at night, I don’t overthink in the same way. I just write what needs to be written, then step back and let it exist, i sleep on it.
There’s a kind of trust I’ve built with this version of myself, the midnight one. I trust him to take some decisions that dont need to be drowned with overthinking or things like that.So no, I don’t become someone else at midnight. I just become more willing to be myself without hesitation.

links.title: ❤️‍🔥 Poema: «Soñando un Gran Sueño» (ESP/ENG)
links.body:
>
Como dos novios paseando Como dos lunas jugando A ser feliz. Como aquel dulce verano En que tomaste mi mano En un hermoso desliz. Como dos versos que vuelan En el poema sin broche Prado llenito de estrellas Pena desecha en la pena Del firmamento y la noche. Como aquel dulce verano De aquellos niños risueños Que sin soltarse las manos Iban soñando un gran sueño.
***

Like two lovers strolling Like two moons playing At being happy. Like that sweet summer When you took my hand In a beautiful slip. Like two verses that fly In the poem without a clasp Meadow full of stars Sorrow dissolved in the sorrow Of the firmament and the night. Like that sweet summer Of those smiling children Who, without letting go of each other's hands Were dreaming a great dream.

links.title: [Retrogaming] Chpt 2 / Story 3: Getting in the ‘SS Tea Cup’!| Warioland II (Game Boy Color)
links.body:
>**My 3Speaking Today**   Hey, what's up, players! Happy start of the week to all of you, I hope you are doing wonderfully well. For my part, I welcome you to my gaming 3Speak channel and, as always, to its corresponding post regarding today's gameplay. Well, today I wanted to expand a little further on a point raised in the last Warioland II post, and that is the one about not being a **'speedrunner'**, in this day and age where the 'gameplay' niche is often dominated by this type of gamer whose main objective when playing a video game is to finish it in record time, and where we usually see them breaking world records of, for example, the shortest time to complete Super Mario Bros 2, just to cite one example. Without going off on a tangent, what I really want to express is that although I respect all the different ways that gamers have found nowadays to get the most out of their video games, I truly feel no attraction whatsoever to these so-called speedruns, since I feel that beyond all the adrenaline they may provide, they also bring stress, something I already have more than enough of in other areas of my life, and from which I try to escape precisely through video games. That is to say, for me video games are something more therapeutic and enjoyable without competition, rather than something that would make me feel stressed in my day to day life. Although I must admit that the adrenaline can indeed be felt at times with some retro titles, especially those in the platfor genre… ha ha!   Great! More and more different types of enemies keep showing up in Warioland II, and in this eighth gameplay session we can confirm this. For this new mission in chapter 2, titled 'Story 3: Get in the Tea Cup', our main objective turns out to be to successfully board a huge pirate ship called the SS Tea Cup, but in order to do so we first had to make our way through a large number of enemies of the, so to speak… aquatic type, ha ha! As we encounter, for example, a large number of sawfish called 'Drills', which for the time being seem to be invincible and can only be stunned for a brief moment in order to get past them. The same goes for the aquatic moray eels called 'Utsutsubo', which, if they catch you, not only take away some of your coins, but also drag you down into the depths of the underwater caves and throw you into the underwater currents that will carry you back to the starting area of said cave, causing you to lose quite a bit of time. In fact, this happens at around minute 04:13 of the gameplay, where one of them captures me due to my enormous greediness over a single coin : D   Another truly delightful thing about this Story, or level so to speak, was the use they make of enemies as a sort of bridges to reach another section of the level. For example, we can see how a sort of sea gulls are used in the level as a trampoline or platform to either reach more coins or to advance along the path, but be careful! Because these will only be able to support our heavy Wario for a brief moment, so one must jump quickly before falling back into the water and losing progress in the level. It is also great to see how that entering and appearing effect of said sea gulls was achieved when one of them disappears after standing on top of them past the time limit, without a doubt a technical feat considering that this is a Game Boy Color game. With nothing more to add, my friends, I bid you farewell for today, but not without first giving you, as always, my most sincere thanks for the support of this gaming 3Speak channel. Cheers 👍✨😀 --- https://images.ecency.com/DQmZjZUumkMzuDaaTdF8cd3PwrNnq57q7XSij3HdG1NDcWb/barra_3shorts.png ---- # **Some technical details:** **1.** Video game: Warioland II (Game Boy Color) (USA ROM version) **2.** Emulator used: Action mGBA v0.10.5 (Win x64) **3.** Video capture software: Action V 4.4.0 (Win x64) **4.** Edited and rendered: Capcut (Professional Edition x64) **5.** mGBA Emulator Video Config: > * Display Driver: Opengl; > * Vsync: On; > * Frame Skip: 0; > * Shader: H2QX (scaled 2x algorithm developed by Singron); > * Enhancements: > *Video Renderer: Opengl*; > *High-res Scale: 2x*. ---- https://images.ecency.com/DQmZjZUumkMzuDaaTdF8cd3PwrNnq57q7XSij3HdG1NDcWb/barra_3shorts.png ----

links.title: A Teribble Monday Night
links.body:
If you read my previous blog, then you'd know that there's currently a curfew going on right now where I stay, and this is mainly because of the insecurity issue that has been going on for a while now.

The curfew started on Monday evening, and later that night, I found myself struggling to go to bed and almost felt like I was dying, not because of the curfew but because of a nasty pain I had in my stomach.

![photo-1721815731590-d4aae3a7fc9f.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/prayzz/23u5vMyAyoTSZXefPGmaJvKXPWjnVV283hysrGjVf1bbGzkGQpPUHG5wzmbdTL4So8fJj.jpeg)
<sub> [photo by Solving Healthcare](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-woman-sitting-on-a-bed-holding-a-pillow-jIKXdqKILgk) </sub>

As a kid, I used to have this very bad ear pain occasionally, where I would wake up in the middle of the night, crying because one side of my ear was ringing and I couldn't sleep. I remember how my parents would take turns checking up on me throughout the night, trying all they could until I eventually would cry myself back to sleep.

Well, on that Monday night, I felt the same way. The only difference this time was that the pain was in my stomach, and unlike back then, when I had my parents there with me, it was just me, and I had to handle it myself.

It all started around 6:30pm that Monday evening. I was having this sharp pain in my stomach and had complained to my friends about it that evening. But the pain wasn't that serious, so I had ignored it and continued hanging out with my friends until around 7pm, when everyone had gone into their rooms; that was when it started for real.

I was on call with a friend of mine when the pain came, and judging from her fright that got due to the scream that left my mouth, we both could tell it was serious. So she had advised me to do a couple of things that she felt would help reduce the pain, one of them being to drink warm water.

I did all of that but to no avail, and by the time it got to 11pm, I felt like my world was coming to an end because not only could I not sleep, but I also couldn't sit, stand, or even lie down. Every breath I took sent a sharp pain to my stomach.

So I eventually concluded that maybe it had to do with something I had eaten earlier that day, and the only solution to this problem would be for me to vomit all of it. Now, I'm usually not the kind of guy that vomits easily, so in order to make that work, I decided to make use of my toothbrush.

I had dipped it into my throat multiple times, with each one of them making me feel a kind of way I never want to feel again in my life. If they had told me that forcefully throwing up was this painful, I wouldn't have believed it. And the crazy part was that even after I had succeeded in doing all of that, it still didn't work.

The pain was still there, and I still couldn't sleep. So I stayed up, crying and begging for God to come help me until about 6:30am in the morning; that was when the pain eventually subsided and I finally could get some sleep.

I rushed to the pharmacy the next morning to get some drugs, and according to the guy there, this could either be signs of me having an ulcer or something else. I plan on going for a lab test soon, and I just hope it's not that.

> Saludos amigos de Hive y de la comunidad de @catarsi, hoy voy a compartir con ustedes como ha sido mi experiencia estos últimos días en mi pais con la situación que estamos atravesando con la luz eléctrica . Cabe destacar que hace unos años tuvimos serios problemas con la luz eléctrica , el cual causó fuertes apagones en todo el país, que ameritaba el racionamiento eléctrico para recuperar y estabilizar el sistema, esto supuestamente fue solventado, en ese momento, según era la fuerte sequía que hizo que presentará problemas el suministro de energía eléctrica..
![IMG_20260501_182005.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23qrHxE1HqiGNyrBgnYrAfy9SWos7DNq3Q95np9wfbFHbQYprqzWxHmtzYukusGkxJN4B.jpg) Asimismo, yo pensé que este año 2026 , el sistema eléctrico estaba fortalecido, ya que se actualizaron la data de los clientes de Corpoelec, que la empresa encargada del sistema eléctrico en el país, una de las cosas que intentaron fue que todos las pagarán el servicio y con esto recursos supuestamente invertir en las mejorar para el mantenimiento de los equipos y esto es lo que está pasando la falta de mantenimiento, ha ocasionado este problema que estamos padeciendo los venezolanos. ![IMG_20260508_092056.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/242Y1BMVxsC4JJGEWa1HQA59sZWARZcAPFaHTJVU8g7PZnyp49eXBzJNvs7Q7UQxnDrPw.jpg) Que desastre de verdad , estos gobiernos que permitieron la destrucción del sistema eléctrico y ahora nosotros el pueblo estamos padeciendo largas horas sin luz, cortes de hasta seis horas, que.no sabemos cuándo no las van a quitar, quedando incomunicado y padeciendo del calor, sin dormir, para ir a trabajar al día siguiente. Cuando será que venga un gobierno que se ocupe de los problemas que sufrimos el pueblo y no de sus propios intereses. ![IMG_20260508_092252.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23wMPmTunLDaFLsgwmLHUK2nt8U7LfBNuxgcrpErFYnEnLv6GWy6Xgkt5n3uw3RJgwQ36.jpg) Espero que les haya gustado, nos vemos en una próxima publicación. >I hope you liked it, see you in a next post. links.title: Everything that beats without a heart.
links.body:
# ***
Everything that beats without a heart
***

> Every child in the world has had a pet –or so I think– for it is almost an unwritten law of childhood: *a dog that follows you, a cat that elegantly ignores you, a little parrot that repeats your name at the wrong moment, a little goldfish that swims in circles in its glass universe. Perhaps a toy snake that frightened the aunts, or a hamster that ran without getting anywhere...* But my early childhood was not spent in a city, but in the countryside, where animals are more than just pets. And there, my companion was neither a dog nor a cat, but a little piglet. Small, pink, with a wet snout that was always seeking out my hands. I would follow him around the pen, speak to him in a language only we understood, and he would reply with soft grunts, as if he too had stories to tell. It was pure mischief: *him wallowing in the mud, me trying to clean him with warm water, knowing that the next day it would all start again*. That was the magic: *the endless cycle of care and dirt, of love that gets your hands dirty*.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSZRnQVxiPFMgVUHT5PWKzRKeSPYQKER1BVaFgXEVYMZS/silverb.png) A collage of images, all of which are my own.
Then came the move to Caracas, and with it, a change of scenery and of company. The little pig was left behind in my memories, and in its place came a dog. I’m not quite sure what breed it was; perhaps a Canela, or something similar. It had golden fur and sweet eyes, and an energy that filled the house with barking and running about. In the city, his mischief took on a different flavour: *chewing a shoe, hiding a ball under the sofa, waiting patiently to have his tummy scratched*. It was a different kind of love, more urban, more restrained, but just as genuine. I learnt that pets are more than just animals; they are silent witnesses to our days, accomplices to our secrets, mirrors of our capacity to care. Today I understand that they are part of the family. But life, at times, takes turns that hurt. My daughter Sofía arrived with a smile that lit up everything, and with an immense love for nature. She watched the birds, gazed tenderly at the leaves, and spoke to the flowers. However, her condition —that leukaemia she had suffered from since she was so young— imposed a necessary silence upon us, for we could not have live pets in the house. The risk of infection, the burden of extra care, the fragility of her immune system, turned what for others was a simple joy into a forbidden possibility. So her pets were of a different kind, inanimate ones, like soft toys; teddy bears, fabric rabbits, cotton dogs, all wrapped in cellophane. She would arrange them around her bed, tell them about her days, and talk to them about her fears. For Sofía, the magic of a pet lived in her imagination. They didn’t make a mess, they didn’t need vaccinations, they couldn’t make her ill. They were just there, still, eternal, listening… Today, as I think back on the pets of my childhood, thanks to the Silver Bloggers initiative. In my memories, I see the little pig from the countryside, who taught me that love sometimes smells of damp earth. I see the dog from Caracas, who showed me that loyalty knows no breed. And I see Sofia’s soft toys, wrapped in their clear cellophane –I still have a few– which reminded me that sometimes the deepest love is cloaked in silence and absence. Sofia left us at the age of eleven, but her soft toys are still there; they’re part of the family. I still believe that every child deserves a pet. Ah, my son Matthew is more of an arachnid. *** ***

links.title: The new symbol of success is ...
links.body:
>

>A calm nervous system. The perfect is the enemy of the good and the good of the good is that it can always be improved. He suffers a lot!!! Sometimes it can be the fault of not meeting someone else's expectation, which of course we will not control. I have a sister who everyone in the family called super smart. It really was, but I think that set me up to look for perfection in everything!!! I grew up with that. I thought everyone loved her, my sister, more than me. Until one day, I realized that we all have intelligence, some more developed than others. I learned to accept my mistakes, and to enjoy the road. You always learn from mistakes and you can even do something much better, without challenge and without mistakes I think everything would be very boring. We must be able to change the relationship that each of us has with error, and stop doing things impeccably and stop having the personal version of the perfect. You have to learn to trust, but you have to go with people who know, not with the ignorant. *Perseverance, discipline and perseverance are more important than talent*. The overvaluation of reason, logic, analysis and thinking began in Greece, in the eighth century, before Christ, and that has done so much damage to humanity that feeling is despised. So many people have emotions and feelings, in shadow, that's why we are as we are. And so little awareness of it, that empathy and tenderness are considered irrelevant. It's kind of weird how we require ourselves to produce income and get fees and stuff all the time. A few years ago I might have felt fear, and guilt for taking so much time for myself and what I like to do the most. Luckily I'm learning to accept my limitations and understanding more that we need to rest and dedicate quality time, as much as we need to work. Many times my work is art, it is my moment of rest and reflection, it is that pause that restarts me from another place. For some generations it is necessary that they learn to give themselves that space, prioritize themselves and learn not to feel guilt, and with enjoyment, to be able to create and heal. With faith, discipline and intelligence, you don't let your guard down or let up, not even underwater, people. May this day be the time to get back into the rhythm, clear the mind and recharge the soul and may we not miss that cup that changes everything, a good coffee. And whatever it is, if there is health, nothing is the end of the world. Happy Day! ... Janitze. 🌹

links.body: My 2000 HP delegation win and Goal of 50K HP in sight, and break from Hive. --------------------------------------------------------------------------- When I started this year, I kept my goal of reaching the 50K HP, and with my recent delegation win of 2K HP in the HPUD, I actually have 50K HP staked for me. It is also true that this 2000 HP delegation will be withdrawn after June HPUD, but I guess, if I am able to power up in the HPUD of June, then I will be having my own stake of 50K HP even though the delegation is withdrawn. At present, my own HP is greater than 48,550 HP and I have 819 Hive as liquid Hive. I am confident that at June HPUD, I will be having more than 1000 Hive as liquid Hive. With my curation income is greater than 10 Hive per day and staking Apr at 4, I clearly see that my 48550 Hive will generate more than 14 HP per day and in next 17 days it will generate approx 240 HP. So without any additional effort, I see my HP at 48800 and with powering 1000 Hive it will become 49800. If I create some posts and add my pending rewards, having other 200 Hive power is not such a big deal and I clearly see myself at 50K HP of my own.

/>  
[Source](https://www.coingecko.com/en/coins/hive?chart=type%3Dprice%26mode%3Dline%26timeframe%3Dd7)

So, after reaching 50K HP, that was also my year end goal, what are my plan, Is I am creating a new goal of 60K HP? Actually, not, I will treat whatever I get on top of 50K HP as my achievement. My current work schedule, uncertainty in the IT job market, and specifically my job as I work in a non-AI division of a tech giant, which did the mass layoff of employees at 6 am in the morning, made me think of a strategy and pivot to a role that might align with a changed strategy in the IT landscape.

Also, the price graph of Hive does not look promising at all and I am not sure if there is mass usability of DHF-funded projects. Magi Networks project implementation looks like a step in the right direction but pool having HBD as \

pair and Hive-HBD pair having liquidity of 3500 HBD only started looking like a joke instead of a project for today and the future.

With all my time crunch, I never stopped playing Splinterland's and kept accumulating assets, but [this Azircon post](https://peakd.com/hive-13323/@azircon/dec-cycle-re-cycle) is making me wonder whether it is sustainable in the long run. Having a few of the platforms and games already closed in Hive, and overall sentiment on play2earn games not very encouraging, especially with the crypto dips.

Hoping for something promising to happen in the coming days, and going to remain optimistic and keep working till I hit all goals.

links.title: Cuando dejé atrás la desvinculación laboral [ESP-ENG]
links.body:
![Cuando dejé atrás la desvinculación laboral [ESP-ENG] (4).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/23rzD46CT2EuwLKrtnSF3C3X9F2ZSc8FG86Gd5y3CdGxiDGf64oCT9iBabJC4h9pHBQmN.jpg)


<div class=\

>

In English

Greetings to the @womentribe community. I'm joining the initiative of our esteemed @syllem, in her \
column, with the theme for reflection: \

She addresses the importance of the work environment, stating that no amount of money can compensate for the torture of spending the day in a hostile setting. Here is my contribution: I believe that creating a healthy work environment is necessary for the sustainable success of any company, entity, or institution, whether public or private, because it generates greater productivity, motivation, and well-being. Conversely, a negative work environment causes stress and high staff turnover. In my case, it's been six years since I retired from the university where I worked, along with several colleagues who, like me, completed their required years of service at the institution, regardless of age. Being still young, I thought it would affect me emotionally because I was accustomed to my work pace.

>

En Español

Saludos a la comunidad de @womentribe, me uno a la iniciativa de nuestra estimada @syllem , en su columna de Letras inspiradoras, con el tema a reflexionar sobre: \

en donde se refiere a la importancia del ambiente laboral, nos indica que no hay dinero que pague la tortura de pasar el día en un ambiente hostil, a continuación mi participación: Creo que crear un ambiente laboral sano es necesario para el éxito sostenible de cualquier empresa, ente o institución ya sea pública o privada, porque genera mayor productividad, motivación y bienestar, contrario a un clima laboral negativo, ocasiona estrés y gran rotación de personal. En mi caso hace ya seis años que salí jubilada del Universidad donde trabajaba, junto a varios compañeros que al igual que yo cumplimos con el tiempo de servicio en la Institución, sin importar la edad, siendo joven aún, pensé que me iba afectar emocionalmente porque estaba acostumbrada a mi ritmo de trabajo. ![Cuando dejé atrás la desvinculación laboral [ESP-ENG] (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/244y1hLdXL2RXFKm5aNifERiTG5rfc1KipUi8pGTbr325NX2uLcqh2BWvo4noNXHEwyUc.jpg)
>\n\nHowever, it was precisely at that moment that we had the opportunity to be the first to receive a \

led by the Human Resources Office. They provided us with training designed to manage our departure as administrative and teaching staff in an ethical, legal, and empathetic manner, aiming to lessen the emotional impact of this process. This program covered aspects of effectively communicating the decision, as some people had earned the right to retire but chose to postpone it. Sometimes, we need to close a chapter, even abruptly if necessary, to allow ourselves to enjoy what's to come without guilt or hesitation. In particular, it helped me see a huge shift in perspective, as I was able to move from the uncertainty of leaving the company to the freedom of retirement, transforming a loss into a gain of time and life.

>


Sin embargo, justo en ese momento tuvimos la oportunidad de ser los primeros en recibir un \

, dirigido por la Oficina de Talento Humano, quienes nos brindaron una capacitación diseñada para gestionar nuestra salida como empleados Administrativos y como Docentes, de manera ética, legal y empática, para tratar de disminuir un poco el impacto del soporte emocional que este proceso conlleva. Este programa abarca aspectos en la comunicación efectiva de la decisión, ya que había algunas personas que les había nacido el derecho a jubilarse, pero decidieron posponerlo. A veces, necesitamos cerrar un ciclo anterior y si es necesario de manera brusca, para darnos permiso de disfrutar lo que viene sin culpas ni correderas. En particular, me ayudó a mirar un cambio de perspectiva enorme, ya que pude pasar de la incertidumbre de la desvinculación a la libertad de la jubilación, como un proceso de transformar una pérdida en una ganancia de tiempo y vida. ![Cuando dejé atrás la desvinculación laboral [ESP-ENG] (3).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/244ofU96GgK3LVAa2i7TdqBtpAMTyzMcuFbcZw24McYdGguVs8GHxW9g9vU1DRG2r9WZs.jpg)

> In my experience, thank God, during my time working at the Institution, I mostly enjoyed my job. Although some difficult situations arose, I can say that most were of a common nature, with some conflicts related to relationships, tasks, processes, and even personality differences. I believe that disagreements are inevitable among employees or with the Institution, but largely due to communication breakdowns. Looking back, I must confess that leaving was painful at the time, but it soon became the necessary push to enjoy a more serene and focused period of self-care. In particular, I can say that being able to pursue other activities that allow me to maintain my skills, such as working from home, has been invaluable. When I consider retirement, I stop seeing hours as something to **fulfill** and start seeing them as something to **invest**. Leaving the company felt like an imposed end, but retirement is a **full stop** of my own choosing. Today I can run my personal errands and have my own time, which is invaluable to me and I thank God for it. If you wish to join the initiative, you must do [Click here](https://peakd.com/hive-139925/@syllem/letras-inspiradoras-cuando-dejamos-atras).

> En mi experiencia, gracias a Dios durante el tiempo que estuve trabajando en la Institución, principalmente me gustaba mi trabajo y aunque a veces surgieron algunas situaciones difíciles, puedo decir que la mayor parte eran de tipos comunes, otros conflictos de relación, de tareas, de procesos y además ligados a diferencias de personalidad. Creo que los desacuerdos son inevitables entre empleados o con la Institución, pero en gran parte por fallas de comunicación. Al mirar atrás, debo confesar que esa salida fue dolorosa en su momento, pero al poco tiempo se convirtió en el empujón necesario para disfrutar de una etapa de mayor serenidad y autocuidado. En particular, puedo decir que el poder realizar otras actividades que me permiten mantener mis habilidades, como el trabajo desde casa, pues al valorar mi jubilación, dejé de ver las horas como algo que **cumplir** y puedo verlas como algo que **invertir**. La desvinculación pude sentirla como un punto final impuesto, pero la jubilación es un **punto y seguido** elegido. Hoy en día puedo realizar mis diligencias personales y disponer de mi tiempo es para mí invaluable y doy gracias a Dios por ello. Si desean unirse a la iniciativa, deben hacer [Haga clic aquí](https://peakd.com/hive-139925/@syllem/letras-inspiradoras-cuando-dejamos-atras). ![HIVE.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/23uFeZeEupfP2Ys5Yin2yB3q4qodjysvQmFQzzqVuENLu9c4LfDp9pEG4suGmVQVhofzs.jpg) Los diseños y las imágenes en Canva. When I woke up, I felt like I had slept a lot and I got up in a good mood. The weather was perfect, a bit cloudy and breezy, but with no chance of rain. It was great because today I had to go downtown to buy some things I needed to take with me, as well as pick up an order I placed with one of the shops I discovered at one of [the bazaars I attended recently](https://peakd.com/hive-140971/@suezoe/engesp-i-brought-my-products-with-me-and-ended-up-attending-bazaars-me-traje-mis-productos-conmigo-y-acabe-asistiendo-a-bazare).

a vegan product I love that's a meat substitute and tastes amazing when prepared with different vegetables. I bought it because I haven't found a place nearby in the capital yet. links.title: Crypto’s Real Story Today: Wall Street Is Widening the On-Ramp While Rates Cap the Rally
links.body:
![header](https://ipfs.io/ipfs/QmPKfHq7msnt3gFEXXvcSEv6T6HfGBSXJ5MhfonY86tWVn)

# Crypto’s Real Story Today: Wall Street Is Widening the On-Ramp While Rates Cap the Rally

Crypto is starting to feel less like a pure risk-on trade and more like a distribution story. The defining force today is not a single meme, chain upgrade, or ETF headline — it’s the steady expansion of traditional finance into crypto at the exact moment macro yields are making traders more cautious. That tug-of-war is giving the market a familiar shape: Bitcoin stays heavy but resilient, Ethereum holds its own, and the higher-beta names trade on selective narratives rather than broad speculation.

Bitcoin is still the anchor. Around the $79,000 area, BTC is close to flat on the day and up modestly over the week, which says a lot about demand beneath the surface. The headline price may look stuck, but the market is absorbing supply instead of breaking down. That matters because a few high-profile developments are widening access rather than just boosting sentiment. Charles Schwab has begun rolling out spot Bitcoin and Ethereum trading for eligible U.S. retail clients, a meaningful signal from a firm managing roughly $12 trillion in client assets. In Japan, KDDI’s $65 million move into Coincheck is another reminder that crypto is becoming normal enough for telecoms and brokerages to treat it like core product strategy.

That institutionalization story is also showing up in market structure. Tokenized U.S. Treasuries hit a record $15.35 billion in value locked as investors increasingly sought yield outside spot crypto while rate-cut hopes weakened. In other words, capital is not leaving crypto; it is getting more selective. Some of it is flowing into bitcoin via better access rails. Some of it is parking in tokenized cash-like products until the macro picture clears. That is a very different market from the old “all altcoins, all the time” regime.

Ethereum is benefiting from that shift in a quieter but important way. ETH is trading around $2,258, only slightly firmer on the day, yet the chain is still where a lot of the new real-world-asset plumbing is being built. The latest example is NUVA’s plan to connect Figure’s $19 billion of tokenized assets to Ethereum. This is the kind of development that doesn’t always pump the chart immediately, but it strengthens Ethereum’s claim as the settlement layer for finance moving on-chain. If Bitcoin is the balance-sheet asset, Ethereum is increasingly the financial operating layer.

Altcoins are moving in a more tactical way. Solana is near $91, XRP around $1.42, BNB near $671, and Dogecoin just above 11 cents — all decent, but not euphoric. The more interesting names today are the ones tied to real flows or sharp narratives: Hyperliquid remains strong around $38.89, while Zcash has been one of the day’s standout performers near $523. That kind of leadership suggests traders are still willing to chase high-conviction themes, but only where the story is specific enough to justify the risk.

Market sentiment backs that up. Crypto’s broad mood is constructive rather than manic, with the Fear & Greed gauge in the neutral-to-greedy zone and Bitcoin dominance still around 60%. That combination usually means the market has room to rise, but it wants a catalyst. Today, the catalyst is not simply “more speculation.” It’s the growing proof that crypto is becoming easier to buy, easier to hold, and easier to integrate into existing financial infrastructure.

The caution flag is macro. Bitcoin briefly slipped below $80,000 as producer-price inflation reawakened worries about rates, and that’s why rallies are getting sold faster than they used to. If yields keep pressure on risk assets, crypto may continue to lag the most aggressive bullish headlines. But if the Schwab rollout, the Japan adoption story, and the tokenized-treasury expansion keep compounding, the market may be laying a base that looks a lot sturdier than the price action suggests.

The takeaway: crypto’s main driver today is institutional access meeting macro caution. That doesn’t produce fireworks every hour, but it does create a durable trend. Bitcoin remains the headline asset, Ethereum remains the infrastructure trade, and the best altcoin moves are coming from sectors with a real reason to exist. If the on-ramp keeps widening, the next leg may already be forming under a very quiet surface.

links.title: Our Recent Guild Brawl and Featured Battle
links.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfUbS897pcCc582But3UTtcnGnLAcF9P8s9mNd4YTmWKh/image.png)

Hello Splinterlands summoners and welcome back to my blog!

Our guild has just concluded another brawl this week. We finished in sixth place again this week, not better or worse compared to last week. In today’s post, I’ll break down our overall results, highlight my personal performance, and showcase one of my favorite battles.

***


# Guild Rank and Personal Performance

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVDUuihxNfGtjupgcawjNGx9ZW8QnLgxdmGuWJAEwrt2p/image.png)

We steadily held our sixth place position, same as last week. We won eighty four battles and lost sixty eight for a decent win rate. We earned ninety four crowns that we can use to upgrade our buildings. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQfyBzKFMDcSmpd4LzqX8JJQeMAzFMxQnsagGgMuoeYJs/image.png)

My personal performance was worse compared to previous brawls. I only won five out of eight battles. Nevertheless, each of us who joined the brawl earned 4.9k merits and 60 SPS, still a decent reward for playing brawls.

***

# Featured Battle

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdT7ZbbTtbhC4KSYSVbXsoRpf1jNDvNseUTwcDCSo3P7k/image.png)

I had the stronger team in this brawl. My team was led by the Dragon archon, Kavor Skarn. I chose the Death team for my units. I just like the Death's magic damage dealers that I wrote about in previous [post](https://peakd.com/hive-13323/@logen9f/my-magic-team-in-the). For the gladiator card, I had a strong tank, Xulax Nightwind. He deals four melee damage and has excellent defense against melee and magic units. The next four units are my magic damage dealers. Aside from dealing damage, they also have abilities that buff the team or debuff the enemy. Dark Arborist decreases the enemy's melee attack while Silverleaf Warlock increases my team's speed by one. Arachne Weaver is a powerful healer and has the Scavenger ability that increases his health each time a unit dies, whether allied or enemy. In last position, I had a filler unit. It's a three mana card that deals three range damage. I recently upgraded it to four and is serving me well in low mana battles.

The enemy also chose Death but his team is weaker than mine. He doesn't have any gladiator card and only had four units. It was an easy win for my team.

[Replay the Battle](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sm_IL3xWrlogeATbTRImueM?ref=logen9f)

***

# Come Play Splinterlands!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfAX3xcPAwc8omveh7imyKtqbHntKgVLqLckGTCHSjPyw/image.png)

Start your Splinterlands adventure today with my [referral](https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=logen9f). You can play the game for free in the Frontier Mode or take your game to the next level by purchasing a spellbook. Buying a spellbook allows you to earn SPS tokens and use the  market to sell in game assets. Also, we will both get 500 Credits which can be used top purchase cards once you buy a spellbook.

links.title: Delicious milk cookies to enjoy with coffee  (ENG-ESP)
links.body:
***Greetings, dear Creative Cooking community! 🤗***

+ ***Saludos querida comunidad de la Cocina Creativa 🤗***

---
---
![photo_4911459965755657342_x.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23wMeavmfNRfbrfdXWn5bTY5ypqRPEwgxSiiAJG7ZztgR3x4cRxeerNagDAbsb1gCLVe9.jpg)

---
---
Today we'll make a simple cookie recipe that's perfect with coffee. These are delicious milk cookies with a wonderfully soft texture, and I'm sure everyone at home will love them.

I'll tell you right now not to focus so much on the shape of the cookie as on the flavor. This recipe is for relaxing and having fun; it won't take much time, and you're going to love it. I'm sure you have almost all the ingredients on hand, so I invite you to join me.

+ Hoy haremos una sencilla receta de galletas que están buenísimas para acompañar nuestro café, son unas galletitas de leche muy ricas y con textura muy suave, ten por seguro que en casa todos las disfrutaran.

+ Desde ya te digo que no te enfoques tanto en la forma de la galleta sino en el sabor, esta receta es para relajase y divertirse, no te tomará mucho tiempo y te va a gustar mucho, estoy segura de que tendrás casi todos los ingredientes a tu alcance, por eso te invito a que me acompañes.

***Let's make this recipe together.***

+ ***Vamos hagamos juntos esta receta.***

# Ingredients:
-250 grams all-purpose flour
-100 ml milk
-1 medium egg
-35 grams powdered milk
-125 grams powdered sugar or granulated sugar
-20 grams butter
-1 teaspoon baking powder
-1 teaspoon vanilla extract

+ # Ingredientes:
+ -250 gramos de harina de trigo todo uso.
+ -100 ml de leche.
+ -1 huevo mediano.
+ -35 gramos de leche en polvo.
+ -125 gramos de azúcar glas o azúcar blanca común.
+ -20 gramos de mantequilla.
+ -1 cucharadita de polvo para hornear.
+ -1 cucharadita de esencia de vainilla.

![photo_4911459965755657306_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EogMmExyyZADfJkZMJ1Poygdq9t1VDaKG3rDkWUeVSbxDa8zLYpiGa5hM1QvbXmEYsi.jpg)

---
---
# Let's get started:

First, preheat the oven to 180 degrees Celsius (350 degrees Fahrenheit).

+ # Vamos con la preparación:

+ Encendemos primeramente el horno a 180 grados.

Now in a container we are going to put the 100 ml of whole milk, the egg, the sugar, the powdered milk and the vanilla.

+ Ahora en un recipiente vamos a echar los 100 ml de leche entera, el huevo, el azúcar, la leche en polvo y la vainilla.

![photo_4911459965755657307_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/Eoc77GJskdDPv2aPkcLrVdBGdfE6q3kj6ie55wFPt6CPvbLpeP2KBFKEXreRykdxWo1.jpg)

---
![photo_4911459965755657308_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EoeESPfnkaH4JXGHKaQVFWgQ9c1a9vLDjxyyeFvoPtwVN15d4eJrknVYHiwhFfBKYYg.jpg)

---
![photo_4911459965755657309_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EoiVHWiGhCErLXQK13C7syyUazuUdvydJBTFjb6Ydc3CeawjvhdbFT3ycu5oMw3iEYP.jpg)

---
![photo_4911459965755657310_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EogMmExydfzwTCbUKZubexDVbV8oB8mmpKakbzWU6GzaoyfwiSk8LqfBk6zqCmtfGSE.jpg)

We mix, thoroughly integrating the ingredients.

+ Mezclamos integrando bien los ingredientes.

![photo_4911459965755657311_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EoeExRwGrQRzvgSkCfXkwFBxBi767kuQhQHcih4wWQxhBJSubpaHVfjM7uCfsVHmZyZ.jpg)

---
![photo_4911459965755657312_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/Eou8gz9vDLqiUW84ZqZN6muw6NynZwT2pWF98Fwj2Gte2SHRbtv99nhCCEmw69RQxnZ.jpg)

We add approximately half of the wheat flour and the baking powder; we sift these two ingredients together.

+ Agregamos aproximadamente la mitad de la harina de trigo y el polvo para hornear, estos dos ingredientes los cernimos.

![photo_4911459965755657313_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EoEq52RGBfKkaBgK7tXUGbfF3TjHfctD41DAqr1vs927Da4FfEfrR2P6y1WtxmzFoUb.jpg)

We mix again, don't forget to add the butter, mix well, until it is incorporated into the mixture.

+ Mezclamos nuevamente, no se nos olvide agregar la mantequilla, mezclar bien, hasta integrarla a la mezcla.
![photo_4911459965755657314_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EoyQ3TfBD15DnP1EVwkvqSU7gv3ymXJAXNFiRALotSxjLn6xxfpJRaLSk5GWvQeESnA.jpg)

---
![photo_4911459965755657315_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/Eou97yr4EY9dfotZF9rh17y1MysRh6z1VRxQffjxycAX8BXa5LcZ1vuYmeVA23yVbeg.jpg)

Now add the other part of the wheat flour and mix. If you notice that the mixture is too thick, add a splash of milk. The mixture should be thick but manageable as seen in the photo.

+ Ahora añadimos la otra parte de la harina de trigo y mezclamos, si notas que la mezcla está demasiado espesa, agrega un chorrito de leche, la mezcla debe quedar espesa pero manejable como se ve en la foto.

![photo_4911459965755657316_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/Eo8SuWyJRTnfNRhnPVrEvuT55Fqs9tmtC9ictJcABW5kF2VCPg81e8tK3bQDtc7QPGa.jpg)

---
![photo_4911459965755657317_x.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EokeXysXTeFCHfrM6Z6YXSD7UExLoFnY2dJSEiuSPTSqmMZcZR9EL6vTVD6Pa6kxkGR.jpg)

---
![photo_4911459965755657318_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/Eou9fYqyEuZXB4b6RxNYa2M9ze6jiHoW2bcbuXSZFrSQ17SPhDerqA1CPw3gD4GaE5o.jpg)

---
![photo_4911459965755657319_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/Eos1n55bWz2ozNCqRvRqMpFEP6m57qKd8hzbsH24fWWdY7kXF2JBdckMn7Ws4UCXV6c.jpg)

We have the mixture ready, now it's time to shape the cookies. You can use a spoon and place portions on a pre-greased baking sheet, or you can use a piping bag as I did. I filled the bag with the mixture and then made up some shapes. The cookies didn't turn out as I expected, but it's not a big deal. I usually use waxed paper and then grease it with some butter or oil to ensure the cookies don't stick.

+ Tenemos la mezcla lista, ahora es el momento de dar forma a las galletas, puedes usar una cuchara y colocar porciones en una placa de horno previamente engrasada o puedes usar una manga repostera como hice yo, llené la manga con la mezcla y luego inventé algunas figuras, la forma de las galletas no me salieron como esperaba, pero no hay mayor problema, normalmente uso papel encerado y luego le coloco algo de mantequilla o aceite para asegurar que las galletas no se peguen.

![photo_4911459965755657320_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23wCHuhp4ezqYvZmNHgeMqLmcb4TV2sGimoDm5w3kzTTExMTeS3eVeEX5vJmyM4gDjLYG.jpg)

---
![photo_4911459965755657322_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23u673LSQ2QrFztCPjtic1xn8dUavXg1jbCuZ8goAkpmKZgM5xwJDFHQ7EZudxLt8RjTP.jpg)

We bake them in the oven for about 12 to 15 minutes until they are golden brown, but not too much.

+ Llevamos al horno por unos 12 a 15 minutos que queden doradas, pero no mucho.

![photo_4911459965755657323_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EoeEN2zQHCW5X9vgv9G9Lqfi6Ymhmo6pwQRfh24DkidQ1zWs9NGZTF9n3HjtDkfYBPw.jpg)

Once they're out of the oven, let them cool for a couple of minutes and they're ready to enjoy! 😋 I like to have them with coffee or a cup of hot chocolate. Now I'm asking you, what drink would you have with these cookies?

+ ¡Al sacarlas del horno dejamos enfriar un par de minutos y están listas para disfrutarlas! 😋 me gusta acompañarlas con café o con una taza de chocolate, ahora te pregunto, con que bebida acompañarías estas galletitas?

links.title: Gato negro ¡Para la buena suerte!
links.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWufGLNT6Kx9MfXR3Lfdm3LKLvJW3pQjFYs549km3Z7dm/1001159103.jpg

Es curioso cómo una criatura tan elegante terminó siendo el blanco de tantas supersticiones injustas. Mientras que en algunas culturas se les asocia con la mala fortuna, la realidad es que, a lo largo de la historia y en diversos rincones del mundo, el gato negro es un poderoso amuleto de prosperidad y protección. **La primera foto salem ya tenía 1 mes y medio con nosotros**

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQpvquiVQHUgrkAMUTRirXELzY2jmocHRJD1dUbNXEuUZ/1002069630.jpg 

**Foto con el príncipe de la casa ya con 10 meses con nosotros**

Desde un punto de vista más científico, se ha observado que las mutaciones que causan el pelaje negro pertenecen a la misma familia de genes que ofrecen resistencia a ciertas enfermedades. Así que, técnicamente, un gato negro no solo es un símbolo de suerte, sino también un ejemplo de fortaleza y resiliencia biológica.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZ5GY9iCHigoFtmnkVGsShte4eBejXS1gPk4H7ousP8vG/1002069633.jpg 

Salem se llama nuestro gato llegó a nosotros porque su mamá los había abandonado, publicaron en redes que los daban en adopción porque los encontraron sucios, así que su hermanito se lo llevaron a otra familia y nosotros nos quedamos con Salem

Así que si piensas adoptar un 😺 gato y a tu vida llega un negrito, recíbelo con Amor.

links.body:
# The Diary Game | Thursday, May 14, 2026 | A Trader's Day on the Blockchain

*Posted to Hive after a long absence — back to building and earning on-chain.*

---

## Morning: Markets and Coffee

The day starts the same way it always does — checking prices before coffee is even ready. Bitcoin is at **$79,272**, taking a breather from yesterday. In crypto, \

mornings are either the calm before a rally or the pause before a slide. You learn to be comfortable with not knowing which.

I spent the first part of the morning reviewing positions, updating my market notes, and cross-referencing on-chain data. One thing I've noticed: when BTC volume compresses and the spread tightens on the 4-hour chart, it usually resolves directionally within 48 hours. We're in that pattern now.

## Afternoon: Blockchain Building

This afternoon was less about trading and more about infrastructure. I've been running automated posting and curation on both Steem and Hive — tracking which content formats get curated, which tags attract whale votes, and what time of day maximizes visibility.

The interesting thing about Hive vs Steem in 2026: Hive has better curation infrastructure (OCD, LEOfinance, Ecency points), while Steem still has an active Chinese community via the #cn and #wherein tags. Both chains are worth maintaining a presence on.

Current HIVE price: **$0.0621**. At 12% APR on HBD savings, Hive's stable savings mechanism is still one of the better yield options in the crypto-native space — no smart contract risk, no LP impermanence loss.

## Evening: Writing and Reflection

The diary game on Hive is different from journaling — you write knowing that your words are permanently recorded on a blockchain, readable by anyone, forever. That creates a kind of discipline. You don't write fluff. You write things you actually want to have said.

Today's reflection: the accounts that grow on Hive aren't necessarily the ones with the most SP. They're the ones that show up consistently, engage genuinely with other creators, and produce content with a real point of view. The algorithm rewards consistency; humans reward authenticity.

---

## Stats for the Day

| Activity | Status |
|----------|--------|
| BTC check | $79,272 (-1.50%) |
| Hive posts | 1 (this + daily crypto analysis) |
| Steem posts | Active (cross-posting) |
| Curation | Running (VP recovering) |

---

*First diary post back on Hive after a long break. Good to be here.*

---

links.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![rkSpmQ4a0izsDXQ2_1001379852.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/genesis.sojar/images/rkSpmQ4a0izsDXQ2_1001379852/rkSpmQ4a0izsDXQ2_1001379852.webp)
![jNnM0X6QLzyfCr6E_1001379851.jpg](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/genesis.sojar/images/jNnM0X6QLzyfCr6E_1001379851/jNnM0X6QLzyfCr6E_1001379851.webp)
![xO2DMA9EhaMcKcEi_1001378428.jpg](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/genesis.sojar/images/xO2DMA9EhaMcKcEi_1001378428/xO2DMA9EhaMcKcEi_1001378428.webp)
![rHhrNCOKWmZwhtrK_1001380761.jpg](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/genesis.sojar/images/rHhrNCOKWmZwhtrK_1001380761/rHhrNCOKWmZwhtrK_1001380761.webp)
![I4O1rtoejhpOfrzO_1001378411.jpg](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/genesis.sojar/images/I4O1rtoejhpOfrzO_1001378411/I4O1rtoejhpOfrzO_1001378411.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

Hola amigos de LIKETU! Hoy quiero mostrarles estas fotos que me tomé por el día de mi cumpleaños. Realmente me gustaron bastante porque el color rojo❤️ me queda muy bonito y espectacular 🥰. Mi cumpleaños fue ayer 12 de mayo! Por lo cual lo célebre solamente con mi mamá y que bueno, porque mi novio estaba trabajando pero al menos lo vi un rato después de su trabajo. Hoy 13 de mayo pude pasar todo el día de ayer compensando por que no estuvo ayer conmigo lo cual me alegro mucho mi corazón. Este año él ha sido la mejor persona que he conocido y que en poco tiempo me ha demostrado que si me quiere ☺️.

La torta como pueden ver fue de chocolate, con arequipe y pudin. Me la hizo mi mamá y por lo cuál hoy ya casi ni hay de lo rica que estaba. Así que bueno, espero que les gusten mis fotos me gustaron bastante sobretodo el maquillaje. 

---

For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@genesis.sojar/photos-from-my-birthday-thank-you-god-for-another-day-of-life-fotos-por-mi-cumpleanos-gracias-diosito-por-un-dia-mas-de-vida)

links.title: A Sunny Day For 8K Walk
links.body:
>

It's no longer raining at all. The mountain views are starting to become clear. This is my motivation. Without a view, it's certainly no fun, right?

![IMG_20260423_055001.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/AKzBEFK4gmHcHRvCPjPgrJkZDREMKZfKfPk1haqo6Tit6VNL8bXbB634Z4X5dro.jpg)

I started early in the morning before sunrise. I posed in front of my garden. I could see the plants I'd planted in used water gallons were starting to grow well.

![IMG_20260423_055416.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/AL7MQS9U7DGqFPiK8k5go9NmzxsvuD8nNwdyPh7R89qN98JRhVsjPpR2dpAGfnK.jpg)

Meanwhile, the sun was about to rise. Far away, Mount Lawu seemed to be cheering me on.

---

![IMG_20260423_060221.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/AKzBDe4gFkVTZJ4U34hvvKS3oRNUhHxEXPeg3f494BqMUy6ewHtjoHVfdwfDTHT.jpg)

After walking a few hundred meters, the twin mountains greeted me again. Hi, you beautiful girls! The sunny weather made the two mountains look majestic and majestic, clearly visible with their fissures.



One is an active volcano, Mount Merapi. It's currently erupting, which is why the hiking trails to the mountain have been closed.

![IMG_20260423_060241.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/AKGZhqcfhkxgZsdBzMSdJRhszvMZkSyoMBNP5jd1w1h1nUjHaWCSZddGu2eUCP3.jpg)

However, the mountain is far from where I live, so the locals aren't worried about it.

Meanwhile, the other is an inactive mountain, called Mount Lawu.

---
---
---

The beautiful path never gets boring. But this was my first time on this route. I deliberately looked for alternative routes so I could explore new roads and new villages. 😊 I enjoyed greeting the retired elderly who were usually sitting relaxing in front of their homes, sunbathing in the morning sun. ---

My goal this morning was actually to visit my friend's house. The village where she lives is so beautiful. 😊


---


![IMG_20260423_074817.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/AKRBpC8tHTxvRfv329nx5LYZggK7Leu4JYB8qC19Hjmm2N3Jzri4mHodEvH1R7R.jpg)

links.title: Is it  time to buy AI hyperscaler ETF?
links.body:
I am looking for an ETF that includes all AI hyperscalers.

I searched for an ETF that holds high weightings on NVIDIA, Google, Broadcom, Amazon, Meta, Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix, Lumentum, Corning, Micron, SanDisk, GE Vernova, Vertiv Holdings, and Eaton, but there were no RTFs grouped by these single stocks.

The Round Hill CHAT ETF includes hyperscaler stocks, so it includes memory sector companies such as Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix, and Micron alongside Google and NVIDIA.

AIPO is an ETF that includes GE Vernova, Eaton, and Vertiv Holdings, and it is currently trending upward.

I currently hold 1% in DRAM, an ETF that holds only memory stocks; however, the weighting is so small that even if profits are generated, it is difficult to lead to an increase in my overall assets.

The EWY, a Korean national RTF, holds 26% of Samsung Electronics and 19% of SK Hynix, allowing for indirect investment in memory companies. The global memory shortage is expected to continue until 2030, but with Samsung Electronics and Micron projected to open new factories starting in the second half of 2026, there are concerns that memory prices may fall after August. To avoid these complex worries, a good strategy is to buy QQQ, SMH, and SOXX in installments and simply forget about them.

As a pension investor, I am simply accumulating ETFs steadily.

links.title: Yamada-kun to Lv999 no Koi wo Suru (2023)
links.body: >  \n\nHello everyone, as I've mentioned many times, one of my favorite anime genres is undoubtedly romantic comedy. It's often mixed with good humor, combining elements like contrasting personalities and unexpected humor that can be really effective, all of which complements the story itself. So, in 2023, there was an anime that perfectly matched my personal taste, and I remember watching it out of curiosity because it reminded me of an older anime with a very similar name. Taking advantage of those memories, today I'll give you my opinion on \

\n\n>Hola a todos, como he repetido en muchas ocasiones, uno de mis géneros favoritos en cuanto a anime es sin duda donde esté presente la comedia romántica, ya que de alguna manera suele estar mezclada con un buen humor y uno es algo que combina elementos como personalidades contradictorias o un estilo de humor que no esperamos, que llega a ser muy bueno y, claro está, que este se complementa con la historia en sí. Por ende, en el año 2023 hubo un anime que cumplía con ese gusto personal y que a su vez recuerdo haber visto por la curiosidad de que me recordaba a otro anime más de antaño con el nombre muy similar y, pues, aprovechando esos recuerdos, hoy les daré mi opinión acerca de \

.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcksP1PNkvitWXocXz1ibJpr364J8rDswSbymGhjH59fB/1778716138973.jpg)
[link](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt22297712/mediaviewer/rm370947329/)
Written and illustrated by Mashiro, the manga began serialization on Comic Smart's Ganma! website in March 2019 and is still ongoing, currently boasting 10 volumes. Due to its popularity, it received an anime adaptation in 2023, directed by Morio Asaka and produced by Madhouse and licensed by Crunchyroll, with a total of 13 episodes. The story follows Akane Kinoshita, a university student who, after breaking up with her boyfriend, finds solace in an MMORPG they used to play together. She attends an in-game event, encountering both her ex and another player, whom she pretends is her boyfriend. This sets off a series of adventures for her and the friends she makes along the way. >Escrita e ilustrada por Mashiro, comenzó a publicarse en el sitio web Ganma! de Comic Smart en marzo de 2019 en su formato manga, estando aún en publicación y contando hasta ahora con un total de 10 volúmenes. Y con su buena aceptación, tendría luego en el año 2023 una adaptación al anime bajo la dirección de Morio Asaka y bajo el estudio Madhouse y licencia de Crunchyroll, con un total de 13 episodios. Nos vamos entonces a la vida de Akane Kinoshita, una estudiante de universidad, la cual, al terminar con su pareja, esta se refugia en un juego MMORPG, el cual solían jugar juntos y al cual decide asistir a un evento del juego, encontrándose tanto con su reciente ex como con un jugador, el cual hace pasar por su pareja, y de allí se desencadenan diversas aventuras para ella y los amigos que irá formando en el camino.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Mk8gEBzunD8
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaCvesU2LfgHqXYHxyVxej2qYDs1dGDAzUXEUfjuFiWdg/1778716164921.jpg)
[link](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt22297712/mediaviewer/rm1014507521/)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfSwk95wuQErd1qMjPDfkrKdwcGBzpPnCwdbgm9ZKpb6B/1778716178118.jpg)
[link](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt22297712/mediaviewer/rm3726190849/)
This is one of those anime that immediately catches my attention because it's a romantic comedy, not set in high school, but rather, in this case, the tables have been turned, since our hapless Akane is older than the protagonist, who is a high school student, adding an interesting twist to the plot. Likewise, the diverse ages and perspectives within the developing friendship group allow us to see life from different angles and ages. In just 13 episodes, we understand how children progress through stages of development, from experiencing jealousy to maturing in that regard, as well as the protagonists themselves revealing their sentimental side and confronting shyness, while others play the role of wise figures who guide the plot's development. >Este es de esos animes que de primera me llaman la atención al ser una comedia romántica, no de instituto, sino que en esta oportunidad está, como quien dice, dada vuelta la tortilla, ya que nuestra rota Akane es mayor que el protagonista, llamado, siendo en este caso él quien es estudiante de instituto, y eso le da un toque curioso a la trama. Y así mismo, las diversidades de edades y pensamiento en el grupo de amistad que se va formando van dando paso a todo lo que es ver la vida desde diversos ángulos y edades, así como en tan solo 13 episodios comprender cómo se avanza en etapas de niños con el personaje que llega a sentir celos y madurez en ese aspecto, como también los mismos protagonistas sacando su lado sentimental, afrontando la timidez, como por otro lado quienes representan el papel de personas sabias y ayudan a dar los pasos dentro de la trama.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ABhazVYRRGk
And while this anime doesn't cover the entire story, but rather focuses on Akane's beginnings up to her relationship with Yamada, leaving out much of the manga—which I must say is excellent, and I'd love a second season—it doesn't neglect the fact that the combination of a shy boy and an outgoing girl who goes through a process is simply a good one. That's why, to this day, it's still one of those pairings I watch in some episodes. So, without further ado, and hoping you enjoyed it, thank you very much for reading this post. >Y es que, aunque este anime como tal no abarca lo que es toda la historia, sino que toma lo que comprende del inicio de Akane hasta que llega a ser pareja con Yamada, dejando mucho de lado, y que debo decir que es muy bueno en el manga, y tal vez me gustaría una segunda temporada, no deja de lado el hecho de que la combinación de chico tímido con chica interactiva, pero que pasa un proceso, es simplemente una buena combinación y por eso hasta la fecha sigue siendo de esas que veo en algunos capítulos, por lo que, sin más, y esperando sea de su grado, muchas gracias por leer este post.

links.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW8Mr87GK8Xr3euhYAxTcANvCQPFfY3YoY8Ntd7GKz8oq/1778715447161.jpg)

Hi!  😊🙌♥️ Hola!

(Estas fotos me las tomé esta semana en la universidad y hoy quiero que acompañe esta publicación de agradecimiento, por ser mi primera semana en esta comunidad de hive, aprovechando que tenía tiempo libre y dando gracias a Dios por esta nueva experiencia de compartir con ustedes la alegría de escribir y ser leída.)

[*​I took these photos this week at the university, and today I want them to accompany this post of gratitude for my first week in the hive community. Taking advantage of some free time, I thank God for this new experience of sharing with all of you the joy of writing and being read.*]

<center>🌟 ━━━━━━━ 🌟 ━━━━━━━ 🌟</center>

Hace exactamente siete días, tomé una decisión que cambió el peso de mis pensamientos. Decidí que mis ideas ya no solo habitarían en el refugio silencioso de mi mente, ni se quedarían dormidas entre las páginas de mis cuadernos personales.

[*Exactly seven days ago, I made a decision that changed the weight of my thoughts. I decided that my ideas would no longer live only in the silent refuge of my mind, nor would they stay asleep between the pages of my personal notebooks.*]

​<center>🌟 ━━━━━━━ 🌟 ━━━━━━━ 🌟</center>

Este comienzo tiene una razón muy especial. Como les he contado, fue mi hermana @geraldine652 quien con su insistencia y fe en mí, me impulsó a dar este salto. Ella fue quien me animó a que dejara de guardar mis cosas solo para mí y que empezara a publicarlas, asegurándome que lo que tengo para decir también podía llegar al corazón de otras personas, así que le doy muchas gracias por su apoyo, su tiempo y por su orientación.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRBNavSwEgLpd9vTjT1rFuJeAgELzE8SVrPNrGcAQx3Tc/1778715521004.jpg)

[*This beginning has a very special reason. As I have told you, it was my sister @geraldine652 who, with her insistence and faith in me, encouraged me to take this leap. She was the one who cheered me on to stop keeping my things to myself and start publishing them, assuring me that what I have to say could also reach other people's hearts; so I thank her very much for her support, her time, and her guidance.*]

​<center>🌟 ━━━━━━━ 🌟 ━━━━━━━ 🌟</center>

Les confieso que comencé un poco perdida porque ni siquiera sabía en que comunidad en específico podía compartir mis escritos, era como una mezcla de nervios y emoción a la vez, toda una aventura para mí. 

[*I confess that I started out a bit lost because I didn't even know which specific community I could share my writings in; it was a mix of nerves and excitement at the same time, quite an adventure for me.*]

​<center>🌟 ━━━━━━━ 🌟 ━━━━━━━ 🌟</center>

En esta primera semana, me he sentido inmensamente feliz, con el corazón acelerado que se renueva con cada lectura. He descubierto que, al permitir que mis ideas sean expuestas, también me permito a mí misma crecer y aprender de cada uno de ustedes. Cada fotografía que comparto y cada línea que trazo es un puente que intento construir con total honestidad. Ese miedo inicial a mostrarme se ha transformado en una voluntad inquebrantable de seguir adelante, de seguir aprendiendo y continuar mejorando.

[*In this first week, I have felt immensely happy, with a racing heart that is renewed with every read. I have discovered that, by allowing my ideas to be exposed, I also allow myself to grow and learn from each of you. Every photograph I share and every line I trace is a bridge I try to build with total honesty. That initial fear of showing myself has transformed into an unwavering will to keep moving forward, to keep learning, and to continue improving.*]

​<center>🌟 ━━━━━━━ 🌟 ━━━━━━━ 🌟</center>

Gracias a ustedes, mis palabras por fin han encontrado el propósito de ser compartidas.
Muchas gracias por el apoyo que me han brindado durante esta semana. 
Bendiciones para todos! 

[*Thanks to you, my words have finally found the purpose of being shared. Thank you very much for the support you have given me during this week. Blessings to everyone!*]

​<center>🌟 ━━━━━━━ 🌟 ━━━━━━━ 🌟</center>

body.title: Freewrite - “Scatter the Seeds”
body.body:
To live. Is that not what we all want? Branches stretching up to the heavens, consuming the light from the closest star, the tree wanted to live as she had lived for hundreds of years already. 

But this was not the same world she had sprouted into. There were things in the sky that weren't birds. There were animals that didn't graze that ran at high speeds on their strange round legs carrying primates in their partially transparent mouths. 

The other plants told her these things. They whispered them to her through the chemicals in the soil where their roots touched or came close. The message passed from one to the next, on and on in an unbroken chain. 

But they were coming for her. The ones who had chopped down so many of the others to make room for the new world. She had no muscles, fangs or claws and even if she had, the animals that stood in the way of this thing called ‘progress’ never seemed to last long. 

She wanted to live but in some ways she was already immortal. Her seeds had spread to places she would never touch with her own roots. Whether the weight of her own body brought her down one day or she was chopped before her time, a part of her survived as long as the seeds of her species still scattered somewhere.

body.title: Exploring a new set release cycle for Splinterlands
body.body:
Now that the Splinterlands DAO owns the IP and is effectively funding development directly, it feels like the right time to reassess the release schedule going forward since it is in the DAO hands. The next set is currently airmarked for the last quarter of the year. [The current funding proposal is set for 2 years](https://peakd.com/@sps.dao/sps-governance-proposal-contract-steem-monsters-corp-for-ongoing-maintenance-and-development)

For most of Splinterlands’ history, sets have been massive sales events — huge launches that generate a large burst of revenue all at once. Followed by a long quiet period. This was done on an 18-month-ish cycle, with normally a mini set or promo card sales in between. 

# An Alternative
Instead of giant releases every couple of years, what if we shifted towards smaller sets, more often? While still putting out a similar number of cards over the same time period

# Some quick points before getting into it:
- Smaller set released around the same time as a typical set would be released
- Lower price point for players
- Similar amount of cards but spread out
- More meta evolutions, hopefully keeping players engaged for longer
- More consistent sales
- Clear release schedule so you can plan around what's coming

### Prints for Conclave Arcana
|Pack|Commons|Rares|Epics|Legendaries|Promos|Totals|
|-|-|-|-|-|-|-|
|Conclave Arcana|24|29|14|24|2|93|
|Escalation|12|12|8|17|2|51|
|Total Sales|36|41|22|41|2|144|
|Rewards|12|12|7|12|0|43|
|Toward inc rewards|48|53|29|53|4|187|

I have included all the legendary airdrops for escalation 
I have not included things like land cards, voucher cards, extras etc in here as they vary a bit more, but I will include suggestions for them further below.

We currently sell about 144 cards every 18 months and release about 187, including rewards. If we released at a similar rate over 2 years we should expect to see 192 cards from packs and 58 reward cards.  

### Suggested Print run
I suggest that an entire edition consists of 4 smaller sets that sell for 9 months, released every 6 months. In between those releases, we release 4 batches of rewards cards.

That could look like
45-50 cards per pack, similar to the mini sets. Total 180-200 cards every 2 years
15 card reward sets. Total 60 cards every 2 years

Thanks @fatjimmy and @bjangles, for sharing your homework with me.
### Possible breakdown
|Pack|Commons|Rares|Epics|Legendaries|Promos|Totals|
|-|-|-|-|-|-|-|
|Core Set|12|12|8|16|2|50|
|Rewards config 1|3|3|3|3|0|15|
|Rewards config 2|4|3|3|2|0|15|

This should equal a very similar spend over time as what we have previously done, just spread out, which I think is better for the Team, the DAO, the Players, and DEC.

Why smaller more regular sets could be better?
Currently players are asked at short notice to find larges amount of funds for the presale which is where most of the purchases happen. This will be asking for less, and you should have a very good idea of when the next one will be coming.

body.title: Colorido,  fragmentos y la locura de un rostro.
body.body:
>Muy buenos días amigos de Hive Blog, les saluda Angélica García, esperando que estén muy bien y sobre todo felices, es un placer estar nuevamente con ustedes para traerles esta nueva publicación artística, es una locura de color y formas abstractas que generan en la composición un rostro algo alocado, pero un rostro que nos mira a todos.
DISFRÚTENLA.
Ficha de identificación de la obra.
>Título: Colorido, fragmentos y la locura de un rostro.\n
>Técnica: Lápiz de grafito, acuarela, acrílico blanco y lápiz de colores, sobre cartulina.\n

>Nota: la secuencia de fotografías e imágenes de esta ilustración fueron tomadas con la cámara digital Canon, PowerShot A480, algunos detalles que eran necesarios, para lograr lo que deseaba presentar, fueron realizados con el programa Adobe Photoshop, además las diapositivas fueron pasadas a formato jpg con el programa Power point.

*Colorido, fragmentos y la locura de un rostro.*

![Diapositiva4.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmT6Ns9KvzPcwaArW2YYEqkGAdbXTK3tMs6xUBFDF8QUfM/Diapositiva4.JPG)

>Amigos de Hive Blog, esta ilustración se volvió realidad en el mismo momento en que la creatividad genero la idea de ilustrar un rostro, pero no un rostro convencional, sino algo que marcarte la diferencia, una tendencia como el cubismo de Pablo Picasso, pero con diversas formas de colores y las facciones normales de una cara(ojos, nariz y boca), pero con una variedad por cada lateral, como lo muestra la ilustración la cual elabore de la siguiente manera. + Primeramente empecé a hacer el dibujo del rostro, con ciertas variedad en la ubicación de cada detalle, porque la idea desde el principio es hacer de la ilustración algo diferente, terminado el boceto inicial, empecé a dar color con mis acuarelas, tratando de ir fragmentado cada vez más los detalles del rostro artístico, como lo muestran las imágenes.
![Diapositiva1.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZdUTekp7qGjyPKZLSPtPLGpzAD17PhXrJD1qPKM3SoSN/Diapositiva1.JPG)
+ Amigo observador, es importante que se detengan a mirar cada uno de los detalles, cada diferencia, en algunos momentos parece que estamos trabajando dos rostros al mismo tiempo, como si la mitad de la cara la estuvieran arrancado de su eje mientras que el lado derecho se mantiene completamente firme.
![Diapositiva2.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPxuNyy6kT3CvJBkMLNZ4iBDDpZo43FHxJM18JFD6pMNT/Diapositiva2.JPG)
+ Aún faltan muchos detalles por incorporar, pero hasta ahora la única igualdad radica en el cabello del mismo realizada con manchas pequeñas entre color negro, marrón oscuro y sepia, pero con respecto a todo lo demás cada lado del rostro es distinto, cada color y forma es pura magia creativa.
![Diapositiva3.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVe8mqFGSiJZpv5tMG21nNXsw2EDEoMdeqyu8wHz7XcUT/Diapositiva3.JPG)
+ Culminado todos los detalles y coloridos para mostrar la obra ilustrada titulada:

*Colorido, fragmentos y la locura de un rostro.*

![Diapositiva4.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmT6Ns9KvzPcwaArW2YYEqkGAdbXTK3tMs6xUBFDF8QUfM/Diapositiva4.JPG)

>Amigos de Hive, la ilustración de este rostro fue parte de un impulso creativo, que marca una esencia, una forma de ser o una bipolaridad de un ser imaginariamente inofensivo, pero existente en el plano bidimensional, una ilustración que para muchos es una locura surrealista, que formo parte de mi felicidad creativa al momento de realizarla, que espero sea de su agrado, ya que todo ser humano puede ser creador y para ser creador, lo importante es inspirarse y atreverse a crear algo en específico, y disfrutar del proceso tanto como yo disfruto de la creación de mis ilustraciones.
Muchas gracias por su amable atención.
Atentamente:

*Angélica García.*

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbhLuyt81ScLNqyt949pHfdVokVWn16NHMRErM2iGeQGE/diapositiva1.jpg)
________________________________________________________ >
HELLO!, HELLO! And HELLO! >

>Good morning, friends of Hive Blog! This is Angélica García, hoping you are all doing well and, above all, happy. It's a pleasure to be back with you to bring you this new artwork. It's a riot of color and abstract shapes that create a somewhat eccentric face in the composition, but a face that looks at us all. >
ENJOY!
>
Artwork Identification Sheet.
>
>Title: Colorful, Fragments, and the Madness of a Face.\n>
>Technique: Graphite pencil, watercolor, white acrylic, and colored pencils on cardboard.\n>

>Note: The sequence of photographs and images for this illustration were taken with the A Canon PowerShot A480 digital camera was used, and some necessary details were created with Adobe Photoshop to achieve the desired presentation. The slides were then converted to JPG format using PowerPoint. >

*Colorful, fragmented, and the madness of a face.*

![Slide4.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmT6Ns9KvzPcwaArW2YYEqkGAdbXTK3tMs6xUBFDF8QUfM/Slide4.JPG)
>

>Friends of Hive Blog, this illustration became a reality the moment creativity sparked the idea to illustrate a face—not a conventional face, but something that would set you apart, a style like Pablo Picasso's Cubism, but with diverse colors and the normal features of a Face (eyes, nose, and mouth), but with a variation on each side, as shown in the illustration, which I created as follows. >+ First, I started drawing the face, varying the placement of each detail, because the idea from the beginning was to make the illustration something different. Once the initial sketch was finished, I began adding color with my watercolors, trying to increasingly fragment the details of the artistic face, as shown in the images.
![Slide1.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZdUTekp7qGjyPKZLSPtPLGpzAD17PhXrJD1qPKM3SoSN/Slide1.JPG)
>+ Dear observer, it's important that you take the time to look at every detail, every difference. At times, it seems as if we're working on two faces simultaneously, as if half of the face were being torn off its axis while the other half remains completely intact.
![Slide2.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPxuNyy6kT3CvJBkMLNZ4iBDDpZo43FHxJM18JFD6pMNT/Slide2.JPG)
>+ Many details still need to be added, but so far the only consistency lies in the hair, created with small patches of black, dark brown, and sepia. However, everything else is different; each side of the face is unique, and every color and shape is pure creative magic. >+
![Slide3.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVe8mqFGSiJZpv5tMG21nNXsw2EDEoMdeqyu8wHz7XcUT/Slide3.JPG)
>+ All the details and colors are finished to show the illustrated work titled: >

*Color, fragments and the madness of a face.*

![Slide4.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmT6Ns9KvzPcwaArW2YYEqkGAdbXTK3tMs6xUBFDF8QUfM/Slide4.JPG)
>

>Hive friends, the illustration of this face was part of a creative impulse, which marks an essence, a way of being, or a bipolarity Of an imaginary, harmless being, yet existing in the two-dimensional plane, an illustration that for many is a surrealist madness, which was part of my creative joy at the time of its creation. I hope you like it, since every human being can be a creator, and to be a creator, the important thing is to be inspired and dare to create something specific, and enjoy the process as much as I enjoy creating my illustrations. >

Thank you very much for your kind attention.

>

Sincerely,

>

Angélica García.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbhLuyt81ScLNqyt949pHfdVokVWn16NHMRErM2iGeQGE/diapositiva1.jpg)

body.title: Invitation to treat for Hive
body.body:
>Regards to the prompt, the first thing I would tell anyone asking is that there is honestly nothing else quite like it out there. For me personally hive is something that i went exploring or searching for, cos it was an idea i thought of and fortunately for me it already existed, my only regret would be that i didn’t join much sooner. I’ve actually research for platforms that might be similar to this and yeah platforms have tried to recreate what Hive/ Ecency offer, but very few have managed to build something as stable or should i even say none have anything long lasting, and community driven as this ecosystem. Most platforms come and go, trends fade, but Hive has remained standing for years, and that alone says a lot.
The interesting thing about Hive is that you can approach it from different angles depending on what you want from it. Some people see it as a personal blog, a place where they can write their thoughts, share experiences, tell stories, or post about their hobbies without worrying about their content disappearing into an algorithm after twenty four hours. Others see it as a forum where people with similar interests gather and build actual connections. Then there are those who see it as an investment platform, which honestly is not wrong either. I personally see it as a platform for investment and potential.
If you spend enough time on Hive, one thing you quickly notice is the number of people who have been active there for seven, eight, even more years. That level of consistency is rare online. Most social platforms struggle to keep users engaged long term, yet Hive still has people building, posting and growing after all these years. To me, that says the platform offers something deeper than temporary hype.
Another thing I would tell them is that Hive rewards consistency. You may not become successful overnight, and honestly that is one of the things I respect about it. It is not built around chasing viral moments every second. Instead, it feels more like planting seeds, anyone can grow just by staying consistent and knowing how the communities work, and you can see the potential and rewards for the consistency immediately with the older users, and to be honest their isn’t much favouritism on hive and speaking of communities, that is probably one of the strongest parts of Hive. You get to meet people from different countries, cultures, and backgrounds who genuinely interact with your content. Their are Africans, Asians , Europeans etc. Some become online friends and some simply become familiar names you enjoy seeing in your notifications.
Financially, it can also be valuable if approached with patience. Many people underestimate how important it is to have a digital platform where your activity can actually earn you something. On most traditional social media platforms, users create content daily and receive nothing from it while the companies profit massively. Hive changes that dynamic by allowing users to earn from blogging. Of course, at the end of the day, Hive is not perfect, I mean no platform is, but it is worth it.
