body.title: The Beauty of Those Who Never Stop Trying
body.body:
1776457911636.jpg

Once I went to the mountains. The weather was cold, a soft wind was blowing, and looking at the snow-covered peaks in the distance created a strange kind of silence in the heart. There was a young man standing there, looking again and again towards the top of the mountain.
At first, I thought he was just enjoying the view. But after a while I noticed something interesting. He would move a little forward, then stop, and then again look up at the mountain. It felt as if he was fighting some kind of battle inside himself.
At that moment, a thought came into my mind.
Life is probably just like this.
All of us stand in front of our own “mountains.” Sometimes that mountain is success, sometimes respect, sometimes peace, and sometimes it is our dreams.
But many people look at the mountain once, feel that it is difficult, and then turn back.
However, there are some people who keep looking again and again. They do not give up. They say to themselves, “Let me try one more time.”
I remember when I started a small work in my own life. In the beginning, everything was not easy. Sometimes there were very few customers, sometimes the tiredness was too much, and sometimes a question would appear in my mind: Will this really work?
But then I learned something very important.
People who keep trying again and again slowly change. Confidence appears in their eyes, calmness appears in their personality. And that is what makes them truly attractive.
This beauty is not in clothes or appearance.
This beauty is in courage.
The world usually sees the result, but the real beauty lies in the journey a person takes. Standing up after every fall, trying again after every failure — this is the real strength.
That is why when I look at this picture, I do not just see a person standing on the edge of a mountain. I see a thought.
The thought that when a person refuses to give up, when he looks again, thinks again, and tries again — he is no longer an ordinary person.
He becomes an example.
And maybe that is why it is said:
“Look again, then look again, and then look again… because those who achieve are truly fascinating.”

body.title: El día de la bienvenida en la universidad | University orientation day 🥹💗 [ESP/ENG]
body.body:
![1000019914.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23tbuKznYT1vnW2sNp52sKM7s8kdRSX35ExYAAoqUXQ3F76dPA3eUHFyofAEmo7kasXHW.png)


Hoy fue un día emocionante, mi primer día comenzando de nuevo en la universidad. Hay muchas emociones encontradas en mi, sentí nervios y a la vez una alegría increíble. No pensé que fuese posible este momento, a pesar de las lluvias que han estado fuertes en el lugar donde vivo. Pude llegar hasta la universidad y tener mi primer día de bienvenida a la carrera de Psicología. Es una sensación indescriptible que me hace sentir orgullosa no solo por no haberme rendido, sino por darme el más grande acto de amor que es confiar en que puedo lograr las metas que tengo en mente. 

Estuve acompañada de mi mamá quién es la persona por la que haré que este camino sea posible de transitar y por la cual nunca dejaré de luchar. Ella siempre ha estado presente, la vi muy feliz tambien muy conmovida, me alegra tenerla conmigo para que viva estos momentos y los que vendrán. Todo estuvo muy bien arreglado, escuchar el himno nacional y el himno de la universidad me llenó de orgullo por pertenecer ahora, a tan prestigiosa universidad. Donde se graduó mi hermano y quien me enseño que nunca es tarde para lograr las metas que deseas en la vida, sin mirar atrás, siempre confiando en que las cosas se pueden lograr con esmero y corazón. 


![1000019290.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23vrrRyYMNjbZJDreqqakrYm1LPen8dBU87rUUVXminLAgUqExoMgTCov7Tbq3SCKnhUr.jpg)


Se que no es una carrera sencilla, al pertenecer al área de la salud y tratar directamente con personas que tienen problemas tan reales como los míos o los de cualquiera. Debo aprender todo lo que pueda de mis profesores y también de mis compañeros, hoy conocí a la mayoría, muchos más jóvenes que yo y otras personas que me sorprendió ver porque tal vez me doblan la edad, pero con el mismo sueño de cumplir está meta. Es increíble que sin importar el tiempo, mientras uno desea algo, lo mentaliza y lo lleva a la acción, se pueden lograr grandes cosas. Y así vi hoy a todos, muy entregados y emocionados por pertenecer a esta carrera y por tener la fortuna de poder estudiarla. 

Una chica me mencionó que ella tenía miedo porque ya tiene 24 años y no sabía a qué edad podría estar culminando la carrera, que tal vez ya sería demasiado \

para estudiar. Y aún así pensó que de alguna u otra forma estudiar es algo importante, que además de llenarte de conocimientos y experiencias, te deja un aprendizaje que nadie puede robarte. Yo le dije que yo era mayor que ella, y que también había pensado lo mismo, pero que si me ponía a pensar en si cuando terminara iba a ser muy mayor entonces nunca iba a tomar la decisión de estudiar. Y que tal vez no somos tan jóvenes pero eso no quiere decir que es imposible el lograr un título universitario, ahora es cuando nos queda tiempo para ver nuestro sueño hecho realidad. 


![1000019909.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23wX1BGd6f61KretGB8qfrFF3KxfU46i9SRctn8KX6s2asvCA5RBPa4uztmgf5T5rtNKa.jpg)


Así que hoy me lleve una gran lección, no siempre todo va a llegar cuando queremos, tal vez no en el momento preciso o perfecto, ni en las mejores condiciones. Pero cuando aparezca la oportunidad de ir por un sueño, no debemos mirar atrás, simplemente seguir adelante y hacer lo mejor que podamos cada día y así veremos en algún punto que todo por lo que hemos luchado ha valido cada intento, cada error y cada caída. Hoy me veo como lo que siempre quise ser y aunque aún no estoy de cerca en serlo, voy por el camino que me guía mi mente y mi corazón y se que muchos tendrán dudas en si es posible empezar la universidad después de los 20. Siempre va a ser posible en la medida en la que así lo creamos, no debemos dejarnos llevar por comentarios o limitaciones ajenas. Así que sigan luchando por sus metas. 💗🥹


![1000013988.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23uRN2p2M1BfYb3qDs64wHhPoPYSVCJYDQeutpgdwd1BKRi4Na3efKTtjPs9VvivchkJo.png)

![1000019914.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23tbuKznYT1vnW2sNp52sKM7s8kdRSX35ExYAAoqUXQ3F76dPA3eUHFyofAEmo7kasXHW.png)

Today was an exciting day, my first day starting over at university. There are many mixed emotions within me; I felt nervous and, at the same time, an incredible joy. I didn't think this moment would be possible, despite the heavy rains that have been hitting where I live. I managed to make it to the university and have my first welcome day for the Psychology program. It is an indescribable feeling that makes me feel proud, not only for not giving up, but for giving myself the greatest act of love: trusting that I can achieve the goals I have in mind.

I was accompanied by my mom, who is the person for whom I will make this path possible to travel and for whom I will never stop fighting. She has always been present; I saw her very happy and also very moved. I am glad to have her with me so she can experience these moments and the ones to come. Everything was beautifully arranged; hearing the national anthem and the university anthem filled me with pride for now belonging to such a prestigious university. It is where my brother graduated, the one who taught me that it is never too late to achieve the goals you desire in life, without looking back, always trusting that things can be achieved with dedication and heart.

![1000019290.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23vrrRyYMNjbZJDreqqakrYm1LPen8dBU87rUUVXminLAgUqExoMgTCov7Tbq3SCKnhUr.jpg)

I know it is not an easy major, belonging to the health field and dealing directly with people who have problems as real as mine or anyone else's. I must learn everything I can from my professors and also from my classmates. Today I met most of them; many are much younger than me, and I was surprised to see others who perhaps double my age, but share the same dream of fulfilling this goal. It is incredible that regardless of time, as long as you desire something, visualize it, and put it into action, great things can be achieved. And that’s how I saw everyone today: very dedicated and excited to belong to this career and to have the fortune of being able to study it.

One girl mentioned to me that she was afraid because she is already 24 years old and didn't know at what age she would be finishing the degree—that perhaps she would be too \

to study. And yet, she thought that somehow, studying is something important that, besides filling you with knowledge and experiences, leaves you with a lesson that no one can steal from you. I told her that I was older than her and that I had thought the same thing, but if I spent my time thinking about whether I would be too old by the time I finished, then I would never have made the decision to study. Perhaps we aren't \

young, but that doesn't mean it's impossible to earn a university degree; now is exactly when we have the time to see our dream come true.

![1000019909.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23wX1BGd6f61KretGB8qfrFF3KxfU46i9SRctn8KX6s2asvCA5RBPa4uztmgf5T5rtNKa.jpg)

So, today I took away a great lesson: things won't always arrive when we want them to, perhaps not at the precise or perfect moment, nor under the best conditions. But when the opportunity to go after a dream appears, we must not look back; simply move forward and do the best we can every day. That way, we will see at some point that everything we have fought for has been worth every attempt, every error, and every fall. Today I see myself as what I always wanted to be, and although I am not close to being it yet, I am on the path where my mind and heart guide me. I know many will have doubts about whether it's possible to start university after 20. It will always be possible to the extent that we believe it is; we must not let ourselves be carried away by the comments or limitations of others. So, keep fighting for your goals. 💗🥹

![1000013988.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23uRN2p2M1BfYb3qDs64wHhPoPYSVCJYDQeutpgdwd1BKRi4Na3efKTtjPs9VvivchkJo.png)

title.body:
<liketuimages>

![gmsTRKTMjNSFny5Y_nwt3.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/alpha-omega/images/gmsTRKTMjNSFny5Y_nwt3/gmsTRKTMjNSFny5Y_nwt3.webp)

昨天写Hive帖子时候感慨天气特别凉快，结果写完过了一会就下雨了，大概只下了一两个小时就停了。然后我晚上还出去一圈，把孩子的压岁钱存到银行，前两天在家里翻出来一个红包，大概是过年时候孩子的压岁钱，放家里怕丢了赶紧存到银行里变数数字，下过雨的晚上还是有些凉飕飕的。今天早上起床后，看到外面并没有下雨。早上还是正常送孩子到学校，然后我再去上班，一路上都没有下雨。

到了上午9点多，看到有些同事打着伞来公司，这才注意到外面下雨了。到中午吃饭时候还在下雨，幸好我在公司里有放雨伞。天气凉快物业没有开空调，中午吃完饭回来感觉办公室有些闷热。下午依然在下雨，我有点担忧因为下午5点要去接孩子放学，没有带雨衣来公司，如果到时候还在下雨怎么接孩子呢。幸运的是下午5点多雨基本停止了，路面有些湿滑，一路上我不敢骑的太快，学校门口的小路上又堵的严严实实，没办法一遇到下雨就是这样。

接了孩子就赶紧回家，今天晚上要上语文网课，从晚上7点到9点，中间只有一个小时吃饭时间，还有完成其它作业。回到家后我打开天气预报，好家伙未来几天都有雨，一直到下周一都有雨。现在只希望上下学时候别下雨，尤其是放学时候人多都打着伞太麻烦。

title.title: A Habit of Appreciation
title.body:
Every time I go outside for a walk, it has now become a must for me to take photos. I think it has already become part of my routine, and honestly, I do not mind at all. Why would I, when there is beauty almost everywhere if we only take time to notice it? Even during simple walks, there is always something that catches my attention—small flowers, interesting leaves, soft light, or even little details that many people might pass by without noticing. For me, taking photos is one of the best ways to appreciate those moments. It helps me slow down and really look at what is in front of me. Sometimes I realize that beauty does not need to be rare or grand. It can be found in very ordinary things, as long as we make an effort to appreciate them. That effort matters. In a world where people are often busy and rushing, choosing to pause and notice something beautiful can already change the mood of the day. These photos are my own way of doing that. Through photography, I feel like I am saving little moments that would otherwise pass too quickly. A flower in bloom, a small leaf, or a quiet scene during a walk can become something meaningful when I take the time to photograph it. In black and white, I feel the beauty in a different way too. The details, contrast, and mood become stronger, and even the simplest subject can feel special. I think everyone has their own way of appreciating life. Mine just happens to be photography. Maybe for you, it could be something else, or maybe taking photos will also work for you. What matters is making that effort to see and appreciate what is already around us. Have a good day ahead! *** ![1000142407.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/Eo43s2ZFvivJXJQ7Uyhr7hJ3YV5JF79aqLLzeV1HnaVU68WCbw1Kb2wXwJgZ7KZFqj5.jpg) ![1000142409.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/EnynA6XkdMp3WS4LkSiNggYGXGDctz7autMxrYbeTCDwYUqiypMGKjepgcMxQJXGVrP.jpg) ![1000142406.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/EoATUJFKjWVm1mw1RGsBiX1fuCszdWKZv1cU9Ukf4tAWhrwDmxHRBYDT6URmezVFjC4.jpg) ![1000142408.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/Eo6C8LrqD9TaZwqHyn8taK3rySk2TLPcH2FPnqwvwqMvWoudNAY8Ta1LMSshfzfUmnS.jpg) ***

”To see in color is a delight for the eye, but to see in black and white is delight for the soul.”

*~ Andri Cauldwell*

title.body:
拉叔有个幻想孖生兄弟。一只拉叔是天使般，而另一只是恶魔。但是，如果你有细心研究旧约圣经，其实不难理解天使和魔鬼本来就是同一类异界品种。他们之所以会被认为是两类“不同”的生物不是因为他们不同品种，而是他们是同一类异域高级生物却有着截然不同的道德思想和方向。

大家好鸭。我是拉叔，一只奔五却幼幼稚稚无所事事的保险从业人员。头十几年，这只拉叔和每个世界上的婴儿、小孩、少年都一样在学业中打滚。当到了该出来社会工作打滚时，却漫无目的、毫无方向的~~小鹿~~野猪乱撞。我当过电脑维修员、咖啡店经理、电器供应商的销售猿、制衣厂搬运工、钢铁厂品管、开过网吧、路边摊卖椰浆饭、摆摊卖二手电脑、旅游局客服、网管……等等。不记得有没漏掉。

然后，前面三十几年就这样过去了，最后一次转行已经是十六年前的事了。就是这样一眨眼时间就过去了。这十六年间虽然换了五家保险公司（其中一次是因为公司合拼）每次跳槽都是回归同一门工作。理论上，这个是最好的发展方向，但是奈何我来迟了。古语说，世上无难事、只怕有心人。这句话我是听多了，但在保险公司做到奔五还在销售前线……同一句话，对于公司来讲是行不通的。拉叔你很有心要当经理，我们公司也feel到你很有心是个有心人，问题在于再过几年你就可以退休了。那，与其升你职，不如升个三十来岁的，将来他才是那个带领团队向前冲二十年的销售英雄鸭。

我不是上来颓的。你们拉叔我只是想找个突破口。如果你奔五的时候，你会继续留守大本营？还是想办法跳出这个框架？我也有想过再出来搞生意，但也想不到自己能搞什么。再说，身体出了状况后，医药保险对于我的“新”雇主来说也会成为成本考虑范围之一。换句话说，如果我再跳槽，我的新公司就会头疼要怎么替我弄医保。所以，我现在跳槽的可能性已经是微乎极微了。大渣请问有啥想法吗？

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeLdwsx8kHrz3An84GpoSyE4km6w1oRTS84ZefsCuAK9v/1778712502731.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfY6yMF59VVsTicnUaMDzDYV3AzzP3ErG9SHd8isfrAv7/1778712502803.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmadKwZTWpHzkJuqV9idQrb1gHyaUt4ExvcQjpzwmpXoUW/1778712502888.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ6u46ieKBcJzDdfXyL7DfabkJkcQ2dvcb6nMfmC2EDhN/1778712502941.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVrUVbmhPtU6RrZDu9p2bFaXm5jqcoKMzwDBQfUmQRakp/1778712503027.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYSb94Sn1reDm7gFL18CD7jpxndG2W245TGrfcDFxWMs9/1778712528603.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdvKbHBD9Z7AskkKuA5gPZwfGTMMzY1AHPMZai6ChronU/1778712528688.jpg)

至于拉叔的康复进度，虽然最近这一个月来上班忙，再加上几乎每个傍晚都下雨，锻炼也随之减少了很多。不过，我倒是将锻炼的强度增加了。只要每次有机会锻炼，我都将体能极限往上挪一些。每次心跳率都会尽量再推高一点点。我觉得，我的速度已经进入了慢跑的速度范围了。

title.title: God of War: Ragnarok- Kratos vs Heimdall [ENG+ESP]
title.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1778714727934-7b56d0e2dfddb7d3.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=edeyglezsosa/8bfdc007) ▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=edeyglezsosa/8bfdc007) --- ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edeyglezsosa/23xKmt5EYRqjqE2U9UFXWoX3zaeHmZnHqyEND7VP48Dbu1tSMbmUcfTbKeag9h57K48NT.png) It’s been a few months now since I finished replaying both installments of God of War IV. Unfortunately, I was never able to share my experiences with that gaming masterpiece because I lost all my screenshots and gameplay videos. Or so I thought. Inside the Videos/NVIDIA folder, I found some of my videos that apparently survived when I switched operating systems. Not all of them were there, but there were some really good ones. Among them is Kratos’s fight with what I consider to be the most insufferable and annoying enemy in the entire series. And yes, as you may have already guessed, I’m referring to **Heimdall**, who is undoubtedly the most arrogant *Aesir* of them all. >Hace ya algunos meses que terminé de jugar nuevamente las dos entregas de God of War IV. Lamentablemente, nunca pude compartir mis experiencias en esa obra maestra gamer porque perdí todas las capturas de pantalla y videos de mis gameplays. O al menos eso pensaba. >Dentro de la carpeta Videos/NVIDIA encontré algunos videos míos que al parecer se salvaron cuando hice el cambio de sistema operativo. No estaban todos, pero sí algunos muy buenos. Entre ellos destaca la pelea de Kratos con el que para mí es el enemigo más insufrible y molesto de toda la saga. Y sí, como ya se habrán fijado, me refiero a **Heimdall**, el cual es sin dudas el *aesir* más engreído de todos.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNskJZ6touaojJg4zpqUfTEMKnXe3UcKgpubwFDiZKKpR/snapshot.png)
Before the fight, I was accompanying **Freya** in the world of Vanaheim as we searched for her brother. The exact location was the **Plains of Vanaheim**. And well, after some taunting from **Heimdall**, **Kratos** orders **Freya** to move on because he must face this challenge alone. So this battle is fought without assistance. >Antes de la pelea me encontraba acompañando a **Freya** en el mundo de Vanehain mientras buscábamos a su hermano. El lugar exacto era **Plains of Vanaheim**. Y bueno, tras algunas burlas por parte de **Heimdall**, **Kratos** le ordena a **Freya** continuar porque él debe enfrentar este desafío solo. Así que este combate es sin asistencia.
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edeyglezsosa/23swgSiCqcL3mWvVrcJDV5GT7uZeG7wjug2EG1cKsMFfW92hsDhNbG91JUmtK9Lqad2f2.gif)
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edeyglezsosa/48FiEcJFtHKZr2nkfZHVEwARwXmK2KcFwJFhSuEzTiqpzZ6chYRoy3VUAjGmnsMMeg.gif https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edeyglezsosa/48FE36eDb6V7qECjWjPEkhuhnXQdvK4Sed3ZNje4CfxGyG3rsGvNomaHg3Moot7EzK.gif
The first phase of the fight is against Heimdall and his mount, Gulltoppr. This part isn't usually difficult, since you can deal significant damage from a distance with the spear Draupnir until the mount's health bar is completely depleted and it is defeated. >La primera fase de la pelea es contra Heimdall y su montura Gulltoppr. Esta parte no suele ser difícil, ya que con la lanza Draupnir se logran asestar muy buenos golpes a distancia hasta bajar toda la barra de vida de la montura y asesinarla.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edeyglezsosa/48Fi6RL4TfH7HSJtw9kUv59TXDQcAfd8zyyjcMob1MCVEWucci4VnHDVaBSwGcrrEe.gif https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edeyglezsosa/23tGTdpjZASJsv2icPNsQAR747KNcunK9rVMZ79F4sNxcnvJhD8rafTNc798mgqr7KmDi.gif
https://images.ecency.com/0x0/https://images.ecency.com/DQmTnj3MnRRcQZUNbWD7gDsK6PtxKvyEH6dFLs3Lfcp1dS3/gif_6.gif
The second phase of the battle is a one-on-one fight against Heimdall, who makes it clear from the start that he considers himself superior to Kratos. And that was indeed the case for a while, because every time Kratos managed to stun him, Heimdall would recover and dodge every single blow. But as the saying goes: third time’s the charm. >La segunda fase del combate es un mano a mano contra Heimdall, el cual deja bien claro desde un principio que se considera superior a Kratos. Y fue así durante algunos instantes, pues cada vez que lograba aturdirlo, este se recuperaba y evadía cada uno de los golpes. Pero como dice el dicho: a la tercera es la vencida.
https://images.ecency.com/DQmZCPWBEgzXozi7dSzR5wzyLdBsUny75NEsu6mKCbVaGu5/snapshot_4.png https://images.ecency.com/DQmRhMEizDM35r4cdRns56vv5htzaxKxLhbipKG6kwJsUkF/snapshot_6.png
Heimdall himself couldn't believe that, after all these years, an opponent had finally made him bleed. What he also didn't expect was that Kratos was going to beat him to a pulp time and time again. >El propio Heimdall no podía creer que, luego de tantos años, por fin un contrincante lo había hecho sangrar. Lo que tampoco se imaginaba era que Kratos lo iba a moler a palos una y otra vez.
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edeyglezsosa/23t7938nQY5XbNM2iLUo61Fx1cCNDr5htuH4eP7t9dV2Die3w6vnmMzPfwDkMhMsPKhcv.gif)
The second phase of the battle continued with several exchanges of blows, including Kratos’ Spartan Rage and a strange ability of Heimdall’s that allows him to slow down time, making it harder to react or dodge. >La segunda fase del combate continuó con varios intercambios de golpes, incluyendo el modo ira espartana de Kratos y una habilidad extraña de Heimdall que le permite ralentizar el tiempo, lo cual hace más difícil reaccionar o esquivar.
https://images.ecency.com/DQmabtoVUUNeW2YxRqziB3DC6wDaVtkYTU8FkVoSMCUcSJc/snapshot_8.png https://images.ecency.com/DQmWdvn6FzUkAMMeNsepbU8hfBC75kLyS4azzKseJwm7raL/snapshot_9.png
https://images.ecency.com/DQmTczw8yBnJ2iiBWce6wSCeAisjALT8QKKWSVtzqRqd4WY/snapshot_10.png https://images.ecency.com/DQmQN3ofc6oXTgPQvDrzEjPykWewvQxqDE5m6H7u58dnzvb/snapshot_11.png
The second phase ends with Heimdall being impaled against a wall by the spear Draupnir, which was stuck in his right arm. Kratos, guided by Mimir’s words, had intended to spare his life in exchange for him staying away from Atreus, but faced with Heimdall’s threats, he had no choice but to detonate the spearhead, successfully tearing off Heimdall’s right arm. >El final de la segunda fase llega con Heimdall siendo empalado a un muro por la lanza Draupnir, la cual tenía clavada en el brazo derecho. Kratos, siendo guiado por las palabras de Mimir, tenía pensado perdonarle la vida a cambio de que se alejara de Atreus, pero ante las amenazas de Heimdall, no le quedó más remedio que hacer explotar la punta de la lanza, logrando arrancarle el brazo derecho a Heimdall.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPLLT7HgXprVatYUVdUj99HPj8vuRzjJxYD6vUPuLhfky/snapshot_12.png)
But far from stopping Heimdall, this action only enraged him further, to such an extent that he channeled his Aesir divinity into a new right arm made of pure ancient magic, thus ushering in the third phase of the battle. >Pero esta acción, lejos de frenar a Heimdall, lo que hizo fue enloquecerlo aún más, a tal extremo que concentró su divinidad Aesir en un nuevo brazo derecho de pura magia antigua, dando comienzo así a la tercera fase del combate.
https://images.ecency.com/0x0/https://images.ecency.com/DQmWw9FTuCkECYWS2jLSjthtfe5TRyzzWWsY4TrXA9WrWfG/gif_9.gif https://images.ecency.com/0x0/https://images.ecency.com/DQmYceeSKTcP2p2FsFW1myFH8WJzkQQYLtRetwcFNfxBBYT/gif_10.gif
In the third phase, the fight picks up the pace, and while I managed to land some solid combos on Heimdall, I have to admit he landed a few on me too. >En la tercera fase, el combate se hace más rápido y, si bien logro hacer que Kratos le conecte unos buenos combos de golpes a Heimdall, también he de admitir que este también me dio unos cuantos.
https://images.ecency.com/DQmYvFQRWU3M8kjx9MwVLk2ExaPa33oA3miRoSx7YVLLzc2/snapshot_19.png https://images.ecency.com/DQmePXKLruDApsK4eyKn5TptvTdV3WqinmBvyR6GGgNtvSL/snapshot_21.png
But since nothing lasts forever, the third phase and the battle itself end with Kratos—almost consumed by rage—strangling Heimdall with his own hands as Heimdall watches his life slip away before his very eyes. At the end, we see Heimdall’s body lying on the ground as the Gjallarhorn is taken from him. This object will later play a significant role in the story. >Pero como nada es eterno, la tercera fase y el combate en sí terminan con un Kratos casi poseído por su ira ahorcando con sus propias manos a un Heimdall que ve cómo su vida se desvanece ante sus propios ojos. Ya al final vemos el cuerpo de Heimdall tendido en el piso y siendo despojado del cuerno Gjallarhorn. Este objeto más adelante en la historia tendrá un gran significado.
https://images.ecency.com/DQmeaFp6JFzyRqWRn5788SUYDvNfCLK2quqHSgua1NWgNWF/snapshot_24.png
And that's all for today. I recommend watching the video for the full experience, since I've tried to roughly summarize the match using GIFs for my fellow countrymen who often can't watch the videos. I hope you enjoyed it, and please leave any suggestions or questions in the comments—as always, I'll be happy to answer them. >Y esto sería todo por hoy. Les recomiendo ver el video para disfrutar de una mejor experiencia, ya que de manera burda intenté resumir el combate a través de GIFs para esos paisanos míos que muchas veces no pueden ver los videos. Espero que les haya gustado y me dejen en los comentarios cualquier sugerencia o duda, pues yo, como siempre, estaré encantado de responderles.
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edeyglezsosa/23tRrCsM8uF676cQdqTbrS852E58grkkwobSLvMV8UmdqmnfpWAdw8W5FyUCZhjvEzPts.png) ######

>Credits and Resources // Créditos y Recursos Cover page created in [**Canva**](www.canva.com) and Copilot Desinger Translated by [**DeepL**](https://www.deepl.com/translator) Cover image [Source](https://magica.com/youtube-summarizer/analyzing-the-epic-showdown-kratos-vs-heimdall-ihQaigMgP5Y)
![resized-square-removebg-preview.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edeyglezsosa/23vhnuDV7gzoArE3Gqv4o3t1qkZJ39ux6ceFC1YXEaWauWoMJHrifTmoeg1pVKGwDxGwt.png)

In the third phase, the fight picks up the pace, and while I managed to land some solid combos on Heimdall, I have to admit he landed a few on me too. >En la tercera fase, el combate se hace más rápido y, si bien logro hacer que Kratos le conecte unos buenos combos de golpes a Heimdall, también he de admitir que este también me dio unos cuantos.
https://images.ecency.com/DQmYvFQRWU3M8kjx9MwVLk2ExaPa33oA3miRoSx7YVLLzc2/snapshot_19.png https://images.ecency.com/DQmePXKLruDApsK4eyKn5TptvTdV3WqinmBvyR6GGgNtvSL/snapshot_21.png
But since nothing lasts forever, the third phase and the battle itself end with Kratos—almost consumed by rage—strangling Heimdall with his own hands as Heimdall watches his life slip away before his very eyes. At the end, we see Heimdall’s body lying on the ground as the Gjallarhorn is taken from him. This object will later play a significant role in the story. >Pero como nada es eterno, la tercera fase y el combate en sí terminan con un Kratos casi poseído por su ira ahorcando con sus propias manos a un Heimdall que ve cómo su vida se desvanece ante sus propios ojos. Ya al final vemos el cuerpo de Heimdall tendido en el piso y siendo despojado del cuerno Gjallarhorn. Este objeto más adelante en la historia tendrá un gran significado.
https://images.ecency.com/DQmeaFp6JFzyRqWRn5788SUYDvNfCLK2quqHSgua1NWgNWF/snapshot_24.png
And that's all for today. I recommend watching the video for the full experience, since I've tried to roughly summarize the match using GIFs for my fellow countrymen who often can't watch the videos. I hope you enjoyed it, and please leave any suggestions or questions in the comments—as always, I'll be happy to answer them. >Y esto sería todo por hoy. Les recomiendo ver el video para disfrutar de una mejor experiencia, ya que de manera burda intenté resumir el combate a través de GIFs para esos paisanos míos que muchas veces no pueden ver los videos. Espero que les haya gustado y me dejen en los comentarios cualquier sugerencia o duda, pues yo, como siempre, estaré encantado de responderles.

body.title: “The One Who Pushed Us Off the Mountain Was Our Own Daughter…”
body.body:
Sometimes, the people we spend our whole lives loving are the same people who leave the deepest wounds behind.

I always believed old age brings peace. Children grow up, build their own homes, and parents quietly live the rest of their lives together with memories that feel warm and safe. My life once looked exactly like that. A loving husband, a small peaceful home, and memories I thought would always protect me from loneliness.

But some truths never stay buried forever.

One day, they break through the grave of silence.

That day still stops my breathing whenever I remember it.

We were standing near the edge of the mountain. The wind was strong, and Alina kept smiling strangely. There was something cold in her eyes that I could not understand. I softly told her,

“Beta, step back a little…”

And the next moment…

She pushed us.

While falling, I felt time freeze. My body kept hitting the rocks, my breath was breaking apart, and when I finally landed, it felt like every bone inside me had shattered. I could taste blood in my mouth, and the sky above me spun like a nightmare.

But the worst pain was not the broken body.

It was the realization that the person trying to kill us was not a stranger…

It was our own daughter.

Yousaf slowly whispered into my ear,

“Don’t move… pretend to be dead… because the real danger is not over yet.”

I stayed completely still.

Above us, I could hear footsteps. Then Alina’s voice came down from the cliff,

“It’s done… just like it was twenty years ago.”

Those words destroyed something inside me.

Twenty years earlier, our son Hamza had also been found dead beneath the same mountain. The police called it an accident. We accepted it because sometimes parents refuse to hear the truth their hearts are afraid of.

But that day, lying there broken and bleeding, I finally understood…

It was never an accident.

Our own daughter had taken her brother away from us too.

Even today, I still ask myself one question:

How does greed grow so deeply inside a person that they become the enemy of their own blood?

We gave her love, trust, comfort, and every happiness we could offer. But maybe some hearts are never softened by love, no matter how much they receive.

The hospital, the police reports, the endless questions… everything passed like a blur. Then one night, the police told us she had confessed.

I closed my eyes.

In front of me, I saw Hamza’s innocent face…
and then Alina as a little child.

At that moment, I realized something painful.

I had not only lost a son.

I had lost my daughter a long time ago too.

Life still moves forward somehow. The wounds are healing, but some scars never disappear. Some pain stays alive inside a person forever.

And maybe that is the most terrifying truth of all:

Sometimes the most dangerous people are not the ones we fear…

They are the ones we love the most.

body.body:

Let me be honest with you.
You are already online every single day. You scroll, you post, you comment, you create — on Facebook, on Instagram, on X, on TikTok. You spend real time, real energy, and real creativity on these platforms without thinking twice about it.


But here is the question nobody stops to ask: what are you actually getting back?
Not likes. Not followers. I mean something real — something that compounds, something that grows, something that one day you can point to and say: I built this, and it built me back.
That is what Hive is. And that is exactly why you should start your journey here today.
Think about every post you have written on Facebook. Every thread on X. Every caption on Instagram. Every opinion you typed out carefully, edited twice, posted — and watched get fourteen likes before disappearing into the algorithm forever.
Now ask yourself honestly: who got paid for that content?
Not you. The platform did. Your attention, your creativity, your time, your genius — all of it converted into advertising revenue for a company that does not know your name and does not care whether you eat tomorrow. You were the product. You were the engine. You were the entire show — and you got absolutely nothing except the temporary dopamine hit of a notification.
Hive demolishes that arrangement completely.
On Hive, when you write a post that resonates — when real people read it, upvote it, engage with it — you earn. Not points. Not badges. Not \

Actual cryptocurrency with actual value that you can convert into actual money. The blockchain records your work permanently. Nobody can delete it. Nobody can shadowban it. Nobody can decide one morning that your kind of content no longer fits their monetization strategy and quietly bury your reach overnight.
Your words, for the first time in your online life, belong entirely to you. And they pay you for existing.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bestbeauty/23wMPgdgEhACrj3e4XEzLRpgbLNCHQ64oTWYaoTijNwySYMZobQiCiBKsKhpMgUHCEeUV.png)
The earning potential is real — but it is honestly the smallest part of Hive.
What surprised me most was the people. On traditional social media, engagement is performative. People scroll, double tap, and move on. We have thousands of followers and feel completely alone.
Hive is different. When someone comments here, they actually read your work. When a curator upvotes you, it was a deliberate choice. You will come for the earnings. You will stay for the community. Everyone says that — because it is simply true.
Now here is what nobody thinks about until it is too late — your Facebook can be suspended tomorrow. Your Instagram can vanish overnight. Years of work, gone, because a platform decided to pivot.
On Hive, your content lives on the blockchain permanently. No corporation can erase you. No algorithm can bury you. Your work, your audience, your earnings — truly yours.
You are already creating. You are already spending hours online. Stop doing it for free on ground that doesn't belong to you.
Come to Hive. Your words deserve better.

body.title: What difference between the white basil plants we have at home
body.body: > Being home since the beginning of this week, I started cleaning and tidying up the patio, as it was a bit neglected. As I went along, I came across two white basil plants that were given to us some time ago. It wasn't a surprise to me, but one of them is very beautiful, while the other has almost completely dried out, leaving only a few seeds. I'm not sure if we can grow more plants from those seeds. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfSQE1nBrHWRQCSXcxjLY1yA8xLWVy7CTLkp9oW31DCaX/1778714153826.jpg) These first photos are of the plant that's doing very well. If you look closely, you can tell it's a basil plant because of its characteristic scent. There are also some dried seeds that could sprout new plants. I'm not sure if I should make a small seed tray to keep them in, or just scatter them on the ground and wait for nature to do its work. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSTgTNcQUW4i8QXv46b2XBandD5iyrm3xMaCf8k3irK7o/1778714247179.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd7SFg3WRu4BMxarp37xKpKiu6pxi4155T83YCNrpoumi/1778714247224.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcmgGiE3DvyPJ2sgTGDckpUgDmuCWktXNMxW8AFfTFFkX/1778714247281.jpg) Then there's the other one, which, as you can see, is completely dry. We don't want to pull it up yet, hoping that with a little water in a few days it might revive. If not, we'll have to pull it up and try to scatter its seeds nearby, and maybe with luck, we'll get some more. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbCNaCQ48schx6sKFfDsSSgqAt8bshd2xnEP7VxHNGLAh/1778714341206.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXn4yeaSfmi3p7Vs9StsNezsoUw4GaazKMXjSk4CNEMCf/1778714341110.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT4cHq1qFJxxSQMd2Ha5ZvwnPi7t9Vt73Vy3D1BYf3Uam/1778714341158.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR8NfR2nTmepBSkVYQnmYHjNS27CwfgExtMTCXaBuvs8r/1778714341061.jpg) Of all the herbs we use when preparing our meals, basil is one of our favorites, although there's another one we also really like, cilantro, which has a wonderful aroma, especially in salads. Unfortunately, the one we had also dried up due to lack of water, and we're looking to see if anyone will give us some plants, but we haven't found anyone who has any. I'll sign off now, but not before thanking the #hivegarden community for the support they give us on our posts.

body.title: Visitando la Universidad de Lomas de Zamora / Visiting the University of Lomas de Zamora
body.body:
<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmYojPPQjButk5zMTKjxqa4Skh3ig1CiGKyt66jB65tCzN/back_to_college.png</center>

Durante mucho tiempo, luego de mi retiro de los medios de comunicación, me desempeñé como profesora en dos universidades, y luego pasé a un cargo administrativo, en el cual me mantuve por años, hasta que decidimos emigrar y todo ese mundo quedó guardado, a la espera de poder volver a ejercer.

Como para mi fue imposible conseguir una cita de apostilla, aunque lo intenté cada media noche por un mes completo, terminé trayendo mis papeles tal cual estaban, quedando guardados como un recuerdo de mi vida pasada, pero justamente esta semana me activé a buscar alternativas para volver a ejercer mi profesión en Argentina.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmZkkMs6kEZuUxZM3TdJ3c7cbVor71pKd55uD7LBRGLkAi/20260511_144943.jpg</center>

Es por eso que luego de trabajar, me fui a la sede de la Universidad Nacional de Lomas de Zamora, para averiguar in situ sobre el trámite a seguir, pues había información en la web, y quería verificar que estuviera actualizada, antes de lanzarme a la aventura de empezar el trámite.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmadPA4kbDJ3Jx6ZuDH3SyfoAqELyZE9A7y3kHDzQymohn/20260511_145050.jpg</center>

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmc8Q1dhvzF3jzgLBTfVBwPGGpmDJunQuKLTvmBNqCJxZp/back_to_college_1_.png</center>

La magia empezó apenas entré en el recinto, el cual es además de espacioso, lleno de muchos campos verdes bien cuidados, que me hacían recordar los de la UCV en Venezuela, aunque el ambiente en general, era como el de mi alma mater, la Universidad Católica Andrés Bello.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmeyeydYWDDmjqydbo43g9HoyEeiBL9y9gF78TpfXpjfde/back_to_college_3_.png</center>

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmaDsxXDQ9ykR8aEMmkcjjzeyXXCGLiqdLX3qefBZe2CoQ/back_to_college_4_.png</center>

Como iba con afán, me fui directamente a la oficina del rectorado a buscar la información, y por fortuna, la oficina de la secretaria académica aún no cerraba, así que me brindaron una dirección de correo por donde me facilitarían toda la documentación requerida para acceder al trámite.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmWwJe8FUA7ZMG1Zi8rhCpCvo4ARF59eSC4EiDtj7WdkGK/20260511_145705.jpg</center>

Ya luego, recorrí algunas de las zonas verdes del recinto universitario, cargándome de esa energía académica que siempre me ha gustado, y que considero mi hábitat natural, para luego volver a casa.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmRpyK55fUBaEVupcDZk9gZr3BYjpuWqjPZABxo4WqMYfb/back_to_college_5_.png</center>

Si bien, en mis planes no está iniciar una carrera nueva, creo que este paso va a cambiar radicalmente mi situación no solo económica, sino también emocional con respecto a mi desempeño para generar ingresos en este país.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmXZgYxB7Y4bUe2vd2NLkE9tckZ7feNPa8jkbBYt15Biba/20260511_144937.jpg</center>

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmdMF6VAmof76erXV7LR9carnDKtUjZKziX8tQ8GG1acHg/20260511_150128.jpg</center>

Además, que al estar mi hijo mayor en las puertas de egresar del secundario, tener ese contacto con la vida universitaria, me permite animarlo a seguir con estudios terciarios, aunque él me ha dicho que no desea hacerlos, pero prefiero que viva la experiencia antes de decidir si realmente quiere quedarse con una tecnicatura.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmdtKFxG3k1aqKCRxF6CENw8QAQ619PQEQyveCxArQbFTq/20260511_145728.jpg</center>

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmYXjroTNpLwQi6BcHKgUG7uzc8GTDfHqgh9AAQrsezFuj/20260511_145318.jpg</center>

De esta visita, volví a casa con las mismas dudas, pero con energías renovadas en cuanto a mis intenciones, además de un panorama más amplio con respecto a la necesidad de insistirle a mi hijo en que viva la experiencia universitaria, aunque ya luego queda de su parte si decide culminarla o no, cosa que espero decida llevar a buen fin.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmcMNxZLX3nyQd4z3z36B8GmMQ8e8PN44qLnocC8hsWu8u/separador_ingles.png</center>

For a long time after I retired from the media, I worked as a professor at two universities, and then moved into an administrative position, which I held for years, until we decided to emigrate and that whole world was put on hold, waiting for the chance to return to teaching.

Since it was impossible for me to get an appointment for an apostille—even though I tried every midnight for a whole month—I ended up bringing my papers just as they were, keeping them as a memento of my past life. But just this week, I took the initiative to look for alternatives to resume my profession in Argentina.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmZkkMs6kEZuUxZM3TdJ3c7cbVor71pKd55uD7LBRGLkAi/20260511_144943.jpg</center>


That’s why, after work, I went to the National University of Lomas de Zamora campus to find out firsthand about the process, since there was information online and I wanted to verify that it was up to date before embarking on the adventure of starting the process.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmadPA4kbDJ3Jx6ZuDH3SyfoAqELyZE9A7y3kHDzQymohn/20260511_145050.jpg</center>

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmc8Q1dhvzF3jzgLBTfVBwPGGpmDJunQuKLTvmBNqCJxZp/back_to_college_1_.png</center>

The magic began as soon as I entered the campus, which is not only spacious but also full of many well-maintained green spaces, reminding me of those at the UCV in Venezuela, although the overall atmosphere was like that of my alma mater, the Andrés Bello Catholic University.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmeyeydYWDDmjqydbo43g9HoyEeiBL9y9gF78TpfXpjfde/back_to_college_3_.png</center>

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmaDsxXDQ9ykR8aEMmkcjjzeyXXCGLiqdLX3qefBZe2CoQ/back_to_college_4_.png</center>

Since I was in a hurry, I went straight to the rector’s office to look for the information, and fortunately, the academic secretary’s office wasn’t closed yet, so they gave me an email address where they would send me all the documentation required to start the process.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmWwJe8FUA7ZMG1Zi8rhCpCvo4ARF59eSC4EiDtj7WdkGK/20260511_145705.jpg</center>

Afterward, I walked through some of the green spaces on campus, soaking up that academic energy I’ve always loved—and which I consider my natural habitat—before heading home.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmRpyK55fUBaEVupcDZk9gZr3BYjpuWqjPZABxo4WqMYfb/back_to_college_5_.png</center>

Although I don’t plan to start a new degree program, I believe this step will radically change my situation—not only financially but also emotionally—in terms of my ability to earn a living in this country.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmXZgYxB7Y4bUe2vd2NLkE9tckZ7feNPa8jkbBYt15Biba/20260511_144937.jpg</center>

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmdMF6VAmof76erXV7LR9carnDKtUjZKziX8tQ8GG1acHg/20260511_150128.jpg</center>

Furthermore, since my oldest son is about to graduate from high school, having this exposure to college life allows me to encourage him to pursue higher education, even though he has told me he doesn’t want to. However, I’d prefer that he experience it firsthand before deciding whether he really wants to pursue a technical degree.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmdtKFxG3k1aqKCRxF6CENw8QAQ619PQEQyveCxArQbFTq/20260511_145728.jpg</center>

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmYXjroTNpLwQi6BcHKgUG7uzc8GTDfHqgh9AAQrsezFuj/20260511_145318.jpg</center>

From this visit, I returned home with the same doubts, but with renewed energy regarding my intentions, as well as a broader perspective on the need to insist that my son experience college life—though it’s ultimately up to him whether he decides to complete it or not, which I hope he chooses to see through to the end.

[Fuente de la imagen.](https://www.publicdomainpictures.net/en/view-image.php?image=601288&picture=standing-businesswoman)

* * *

Al mismo tiempo que Luo Ting le explicó a Ye Tiantian en el hospital la situación y le pidió perdón, Rong Xuan e invitados de la misma industria alcanzaron con éxito una intención de cooperación y aseguraron más oportunidades para la empresa.

Después de regresar a la antigua casa de la familia He, su padre llamó a Rong Xuan directamente al estudio para escuchar su informe sobre el próximo plan de la empresa. Rong Xuan explicó con calma sus planes futuros para la empresa, centrándose en puntos implementables. Solo abordó algunas cuestiones difíciles, destacando su gran confianza en la gestión de la empresa.

Su padre quedó muy satisfecho después de escuchar esto, porque la ira que sintió por el compromiso fracasado se disipó naturalmente. Dijo con voz profunda: “Ya que hoy has ganado la oportunidad de cooperar, hazlo bien y no te dejes influenciar por cosas insignificantes ni pierdas la cara de la familia He”.

Rong Xuan respondió naturalmente: “Esto es, por supuesto, lo que haré. Soy miembro de la familia He y todo se valora en nombre de la familia He. Incluso si Luo Ting me hubiera salvado cuando niña, no habría dejado que afectara a la familia He.”

“Bueno, tienes razón.” Su padre hizo una pausa, miró a Rong Xuan con atención y le preguntó: “Mencionaste ‘el don de salvar vidas’ varias veces hoy. Luo Ting te salvó y nuestra familia He le dio un generoso regalo de agradecimiento y nunca se le debió nada”.

“Lo sé.” Rong Xuan sonrió: “Pero cuando digo esto, la gente siente que valoro más la emoción y la rectitud, ¿no es así? No importa lo que haga Luo Ting en el futuro, él ha perdido su reputación y la oportunidad. Siempre seré una víctima comprensiva y honesta.”

Su padre entrecerró ligeramente los ojos y miró a su hija con una mirada rara y seria. Se debe admitir que todas las respuestas de Rong Xuan hoy, incluida su actitud actual, han anulado por completo su impresión de Rong Xuan. ¡Pero eso lo pone de buen humor! Es la sensación que deberían provocar sus hijos en él.

Entonces su padre asignó generosamente una suma de dinero a Rong Xuan, lo que le permitió desarrollar la empresa con mayor fluidez en el siguiente paso.

Toda la familia pensó que su padre estaría furioso. Después de todo, desde la infancia, la aversión de su padre por He Rongxuan era visible para las personas que tengan ojos perspicaces. Como resultado, lo que esperaban no ocurrió y vieron al padre y la hija llevándose bien, algo que nunca verían en tiempos normales. ¿Por qué Rong Xuan fue abandonada hoy por su prometido, pero en lugar de ser ridiculizada, ella obtuvo el favor de su padre?

He Rongjin, la hija menor y favorita de la familia He, se encontró con Rong Xuan en el pasillo y le dijo con una sonrisa: “Mi hermana mayor está en muy buena forma hoy. Mucha gente te mira fijamente en el banquete. Como dice el refrán ‘frustrada en el amor, orgullosa en el centro comercial’, cuando lo piensas de esta manera, no parece malo que Luo Ting se enamore de otra persona. ¿Escuché que Ye Tiantian fue hospitalizada? ¿Por qué mi hermana mayor no le envió una canasta de fruta como regalo de agradecimiento? Si no fuera por ella, hoy no tendrías estos beneficios.”

He Rongxuan ha escuchado innumerables de estas palabras sarcásticas desde que era niña. En la familia He, no hay afecto familiar en absoluto. Todo el afecto y la belleza son solo ostensiblemente para el padre de He. Como es la hija favorita de su padre, He Rongjin actúa aún más descuidadamente.

Pero a Rong Xuan no le importaba la burla de la niña de jugar a la casita. Miró a He Rongjin con aún más orgullo del que mostraba ella y dijo con frialdad: “Luo Ting y Ye Tiantian insultaron a nuestra familia He y casi convirtieron en una broma la ceremonia de compromiso. ¿Realmente sugieres entregar cestas de frutas? Realmente dudo de lo que sueles aprender. Si tienes mucho tiempo libre, haz algo serio. Ya sea amor o profesión, tienes que lograr alguna cosa que muestre que estás orgullosa de decir que eres de la familia He, ¿verdad? ”

El rostro de Rongjin cambió y habló en voz baja: “¿Qué pretendes? ¿Quién no sabe que amas a Luo Ting hasta la muerte? ¡Tengo miedo de que vuelvas a casa para llorar en secreto!”

Rong Xuan negó con la cabeza decepcionada y caminó hacia su habitación. He Rongjin estaba furiosa por la actitud de esta hermana mayor que mostraba que era como una adulta que no se preocupaba por la opinión de los niños. Ella acababa de cumplir catorce años, momento en el que sentía que podía hacer cualquier cosa cuando fuera mayor. Ahora la pobre hermana mayor la ignoraba y no la había tomado en serio. No se esperaba quedar tan avergonzada.

Rong Xuan dobló la esquina y vio a su segundo y tercer hermano. El segundo hermano, He Yuliang, sonrió suavemente y explicó: “Mi tercer hermano y yo estábamos a punto de salir cuando te escuchamos a ti y a la Pequeña Jin hablando, así que no salimos a molestarte”.

Dio dos pasos para acercarse y le dijo a Rong Xuan con dolor: “Hermana mayor, hoy te han hecho daño. Si necesitas ayuda con algo, no dudes en preguntar.”

Rong Xuan asintió levemente y He Yuliang se fue con una sonrisa. Sus ojos se posaron en su tercer hermano, He Yucong. He Yucong nació de la actual señora He, y también era el favorito de la señora He. En cambio, He Yuliang, que había perdido la protección de su madre, era mucho menos favorecido que He Yucong. Además, He Yuliang es un hijo ilegítimo y su estatus no es tan glorioso. El mundo exterior cree principalmente que el recién adulto He Yucong será el heredero definitivo de la familia He.

He Yucong creció con mucha atención y estaba muy orgulloso de corazón. Metió las manos en los bolsillos y se quedó allí de manera elegante, colgando a su hijo y diciendo calmadamente: “La hermana mayor es muy poderosa. Juega muy bien con las manos. Incluso su padre te presentó personalmente a tantos tíos. Es realmente una persona real que no muestra su rostro. No puedes ver que tengas tales intrigas en absoluto. Simplemente no sé si has usado tus pensamientos en casa y el peso de tu familia en tu corazón no es rival para tu salvador.”

Rong Xuan miró su reloj: \

¿De verdad crees que eres el jefe? ¿Fue sorprendente que él naciera primero? ¿Tú también te preocupas por mí?”

En ese momento, Rong Xuan ya estaba apoyado contra la cama para leer atentamente los documentos. Rong Xuan lo soportó una y otra vez y finalmente no pudo evitar preguntar: 【¿Vivirás así para mí en el futuro? Entonces... Todos esos insultos los soportarás por mí; algunas cosas son difíciles de soportar...】

body.body: > ## 🎬 Technical Details - **Episode:** White Christmas (Special) - **Series:** Black Mirror - **Year:** 2014 - **Director:** Carl Tibbetts - **Cast:** Jon Hamm, Rafe Spall, Oona Chaplin, Natalia Tena.

>Poster
</center>

## ⚖️ First Impression

If you thought the first two seasons were intense, this Christmas special takes it to a whole new level. It is, without a doubt, a masterpiece of storytelling. It reminds me again of those \

stories where everything seems normal until the pieces start to fit in a terrifying way. This episode doesn't just blow your mind; it shatters it. It’s creepy, philosophical, and incredibly dark.

## 📖 Spoiler-Free Synopsis

Two men, Matt (Jon Hamm) and Joe (Rafe Spall), are spending Christmas in a tiny, isolated cabin in the middle of a frozen wasteland. To pass the time, they start telling stories about how they ended up there. Matt tells about his job helping people with dating through high-tech implants and his experience training \
—digital clones of human consciousness. Joe eventually shares his own tragic past involving a \

that erased a person from his life. But as the fire burns low, the true purpose of their meeting is revealed.

## 🎭 Analysis and Rating: Digital Purgatory

What makes this episode a 10/10 is how it handles the concept of time and consciousness. The idea of the **\
**—a digital copy of you that feels and suffers—is the peak of psychological horror. Imagine being trapped in a small white egg for \
just because someone pressed a button.\n\nThen there’s the **\

**. The image of seeing someone you love as a pixelated gray silhouette, unable to hear or speak to them, is heartbreaking. But the ending... the way everything connects and the punishment handed out to both characters is probably the most brutal thing ever shown on TV. It makes you realize that in the future, justice could be much more terrifying than death.

### The Positive:
- **Jon Hamm’s Performance:** He’s charismatic but hides a cold, manipulative side that is perfect for the role.
- **Narrative Structure:** Three stories that weave together into a perfect circle.
- **The Soundtrack:** Using \

as a torture device is a stroke of genius.

### The Disappointing:
- **The \

:** It leaves you with such a heavy feeling that you might need a break from the screen for a few days. It's that powerful.

## 🏆 Fun Fact

- **Grandchild of a Legend:** The actress who plays Greta (the one who gets her consciousness copied) is Oona Chaplin, the granddaughter of Charlie Chaplin.
- **Connectivity:** Keep an eye out for references to *The Waldo Moment* and *15 Million Merits* in the background news and songs.
- **Robert Downey Jr. Again:** He was so impressed with the technology shown in this series that he has expressed interest in producing a film based on the \

concepts.

## ⭐ Final Verdict

The ultimate Black Mirror experience. It’s the perfect closing to the \

of the show before it moved to Netflix. It asks the question: if a copy of you feels, is it still you?

My rating: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 10/10

Es, sin duda, una obra maestra narrativa. Me vuelve a recordar a esas historias de \

donde todo parece normal hasta que las piezas empiezan a encajar de forma aterradora. Este capítulo no solo te vuela la cabeza, la destroza. Es inquietante, filosófico y sumamente oscuro.


## 📖 Sinopsis Sin Spoilers

Dos hombres, Matt (Jon Hamm) y Joe (Rafe Spall), pasan la Navidad en una pequeña cabaña aislada en medio de un desierto helado. Para pasar el tiempo, empiezan a contar cómo terminaron allí. Matt relata su trabajo ayudando a hombres en citas mediante implantes tecnológicos y su experiencia entrenando \
(clones digitales de la conciencia humana). Joe finalmente comparte su trágico pasado relacionado con un \

tecnológico que borró a una persona de su vida. Pero mientras el fuego se apaga, se revela el verdadero propósito de su encuentro.


## 🎭 Análisis y Valoración: Purgatorio Digital

Lo que hace que este episodio sea un 10 de 10 es cómo maneja el concepto del tiempo y la conciencia. La idea de la **\
** —una copia digital de ti que siente y sufre— es el máximo exponente del horror psicológico. Imagina estar atrapado en un pequeño huevo blanco durante \
solo porque alguien pulsó un botón.\n\nLuego está el **\

**. La imagen de ver a alguien que amas como una silueta gris pixelada, sin poder oírla ni hablarle, es desgarradora. Pero el final... la forma en que todo conecta y el castigo que reciben ambos personajes es probablemente lo más fuerte que se ha visto en la serie. Te hace darte cuenta de que, en el futuro, la justicia podría ser mucho más aterradora que la muerte.

### Lo Rescatable:
- **La actuación de Jon Hamm:** Tiene ese carisma que oculta un lado frío y manipulador perfecto para el papel.
- **Estructura Narrativa:** Son tres historias que se entrelazan hasta formar un círculo perfecto.
- **El Final:** Es, posiblemente, el cierre más impactante de toda la serie. Te deja mudo.

### Lo Decepcionante:
- **El efecto posterior:** Te deja con una sensación tan pesada que quizás necesites un descanso de las pantallas por unos días. Así de potente es.

## 🏆 Dato Curioso

- **Nieta de una leyenda:** La actriz que interpreta a Greta (la que se hace la copia de conciencia) es Oona Chaplin, nieta de Charlie Chaplin.
- **Conectividad:** Hay referencias a *El momento Waldo* y *15 millones de méritos* en las noticias y canciones que suenan de fondo.
- **Justicia digital:** Charlie Brooker, el creador, quería explorar qué pasaría si pudiéramos aplicar la ley no al cuerpo, sino a la mente del criminal.


## ⭐ Veredicto Final

La experiencia definitiva de Black Mirror. Es el cierre perfecto para la \
de la serie antes de pasar a Netflix. Plantea la pregunta: si una copia de ti siente, ¿sigue siendo tú? **Mi calificación: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 10/10** --- **Leave me your comment!** **¡Déjame tu comentario!**

body.title: [ESP/ENG] Dibujando a MU DE ARIES (+Proceso)/ Drawing MU OF ARIES (+Process).
body.body:
¡Hola, Comunidad de Hive! Hoy les comparto un nuevo dibujo de la colección que estado trabajando, inspirada en Saint Seiya. Ya en la recta final, le toca a MU DE ARIES, uno de los caballeros más sabios y poderosos entre todos. A continuación les muestro el proceso que seguí para dibujarlo. 
.
Hello, Hive Community! Today I’m sharing a new drawing from the series I’ve been working on, inspired by Saint Seiya. As we approach the final stretch, it’s time for MU OF ARIES, one of the wisest and most powerful knights of them all. Below, I’ll walk you through the process I followed to draw him. 
![IMG_20260511_212528_525~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXbL6UtxG1rvSgukoNm73pDiZxvaVVMEbyRWPJ8Mkztr9/IMG_20260511_212528_525~2.jpg)
El primer paso fue dibujar un boceto del personaje con un lápiz Reeves HB. 
.
The first step was to sketch the character using a Reeves HB pencil. 
![IMG_20260509_175810_553.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNpe99hHL6aNEYSAgixZD52BVyUziCNDTzZtA9ipq5iRK/IMG_20260509_175810_553.jpg)
Después, lo entinté usando un marcador negro Kores y un bolígrafo negro Offi-Esco. 
.
Then I inked it using a black Kores marker and a black Offi-Esco pen. 
![IMG_20260510_221356_039.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaMWyZ9Hn1b8fFmUABAcwYoyptWong6PXVCH6tnp6quwd/IMG_20260510_221356_039.jpg)
Por último, le agregué colores usando algunos lápices Faber-Castell. 
.
Finally, I added some color using Faber-Castell colored pencils. 
![IMG_20260511_212528_525~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXbL6UtxG1rvSgukoNm73pDiZxvaVVMEbyRWPJ8Mkztr9/IMG_20260511_212528_525~2.jpg)
Eso fue todo por hoy. Muchas gracias por leer. 
.
That's all for today. Thank you very much for reading.

body.title: (ENG/ESP) - Lecciones Morales Bajo la Máscara del Entretenimiento - Blog / Moral Lessons Beneath the Mask of Entertainment - Blog
body.body:
official artwork as reference image***

¡Hola comunidad de amantes del anime y el manga!

Muchas veces, al ver un anime o leer un manga, pensamos que hay sólo entretenimiento superficial.  Sin embargo, estas son máquinas de enseñanza ética ocultas bajo lo que se vería como \

.

Así que, en el post de hoy, vamos a analizar cómo el anime y el manga pueden enseñarnos complejos valores éticos y morales en una forma que nunca veremos en los libros de texto.

Tanto el anime como el manga cuenta con un increíble poder para el Storytelling moral.

Cuando leemos libros de ética o asistimos a clases sobre moralidad, una parte de nuestro cerebro suele apagarse e incluso podemos sentirnos aburridos.  Pero, cuando este tema es tratado a través del manga o el anime donde un personaje debe enfrentar un dilema moral, estamos completamente activos.  Y esto ocurre ya que llega un punto en que el personaje importa, los resultados importan...nuestros sentidos están completamente activos absorbiendo todo que sin darnos cuenta, aprendemos sobre el tema.

Pongamos como ejemplo a \

.  A simple vista, la historia pareciera un thriller de un muchacho que puede matar a cualquiera con solo escribir su nombre en una libreta.  Pero, cuando analizamos la historia, estamos ante un relato profundo sobre el poder, la corrupción y la justicia.  Encontramos que Light Yagami, comienza su camino pensando que está haciendo lo correcto y con el paso del tiempo, termina convirtiéndose en un tirano.  Acá, los espectadores pueden ver claramente como el poder absoluto llega a corromper de manera absoluta.  No se necesita que alguien dé una charla sobre moralidad en este aspecto.  La audiencia puede entenderlo perfectamente siguiendo el desarrollo de Light.

El manga y el anime también nos traen a la mesa, dilemas éticos muy complejos que distan de tener una respuesta fácil.

Mientras el cómic y la animación occidental prefiere presentar los dilemas morales con una respuesta clara (el héroe está en lo correcto y el villano es quien está equivocado), el manga y anime ama incluir dilemas éticos sin soluciones simples en sus tramas.

Pensemos en \

como ejemplo.  En esta historia, los hermanos Elric cometen un grave error al tratar de resucitar a su madre por medio de la alquimia.  Las consecuencias fueron devastadoras.  Ahora bien, ¿fueron malvados al hacer esto? No, definitivamente. Pero...¿merecián el castigo que recibieron?  Allí entra el debate ya que la serie no te da una respuesta concreta sino que te lleva a pensar y analizarla.\n\nOtro ejemplo de esto que podríamos mencionar es \

.  La figura de los demonios es técnicamente una imagen de la maldad encarnada.  Sin embargo, muchos de ellos fueron convertidos en eso en contra de su voluntad.  Acá podríamos preguntarnos ¿Son responsables de sus acciones en este escenario? ¿Merecerían la compasión?  En la serie, esto se explora de manera constante demostrando a la audiencia que la moralidad no es en blanco y negro, también tiene sus áreas grises.

El manga y el anime también nos lleva a analizar lo que significan las consecuencias reales de las decisiones.  Y en este aspecto, el anime lo hace muy bien.

Cuando, en una historia, un personaje toma una decisión ética que podría ser cuestionable, no desaparece de la trama sin impacto alguno.  Cada personaje vive su historia a través de las elecciones que hace.

En el anime \

encontramos al personaje Lelouch, quien obtiene el poder de controlas las mentes.  Utiliza este poder para lograr sus propios objetivos, pero cada vez que lo hace, se va corrompiendo más.\n\nEn esta serie, no nos dicen abiertamente \

, sino que nos demuestran la destrucción interna del personaje.  El público puede ver cómo el actuar sin ética trae grandes consecuencias psicológicas y morales.

Acá, no se enseña la ética con reglas abstractas, se muestra que las acciones tienen peso y que las decisiones son importantes.

Otra lección de ética importante que nos trae el anime y el manga es la empatía por los enemigos, lo cual lo traduciríamos en la vida real como la empatía con quienes no estamos de acuerdo.

En muchas historias se nos presentan personajes antagónicos con motivaciones que pueden ser compresibles aún cuando sus métodos para solucionar las cosas sean cuestionables.

En este caso, podemos tomar a Dabi, personaje de \

.  Él es un villano pero tiene una historia trágica:  Fue abandonado por un padre abusivo.  Acá nos podemos preguntar ¿Eso, justifica sus acciones?  No, pero podemos entender la razón por la cual se convirtió en un villano.  La enseñanza moral acá es, que podemos rechazar las acciones del individuo y a la vez sentir compasión por su naturaleza humana.

Y, una última lección moral y ética que podemos encontrar en el manga y el anime es la de la responsabilidad social y la justicia.

Esta lección la podemos encontrar en series como \
, las cuales exploran la responsabilidad social y la justicia desde una perspectiva nada simplista.\n\nEn \

, encontramos esta lección al iniciarse la serie como una historia de venganza la cual, paulatinamente va cuestionando la validez de la venganza misma.  Thorfinn, el protagonista, anda en la búsqueda del hombre que mató a su padre para acabar con él, pero cuando la oportunidad aparece, cae en cuenta que la venganza no le traerá paz, sólo se sumará más dolor, dejándonos esta lección ética envuelta en una narrativa muy emotiva.

Como hemos visto a través de los ejemplos, el anime y el manga son herramientas muy poderosas al momento de enseñarnos la importancia de los temas morales y éticos complejos, dejándonos envueltos en interminables debates y consideraciones sobre lo que es correcto, incorrecto, el bien y el mal y hasta qué punto es justificable las acciones y decisiones en los diferentes escenarios que enfrentan los personajes.

Dime, ¿Hay algún anime o manga que te haya enseñado un gran lección en el tema ético y moral?  ¡Cuéntanos tu experiencia en los comentarios para que podamos debatir sobre esto!

¡Hasta el próximo post!

Hello anime and manga lovers community!  

Many times, when we watch an anime or read a manga, we think it’s just superficial entertainment. However, these are **ethical‑teaching machines hidden beneath what appears to be “stories with high emotional charge.”**  

So, in today’s post we’ll analyze how anime and manga can teach us complex ethical and moral values in a way we never see in textbooks.  

Both anime and manga possess an incredible power for **moral storytelling.**  

When we read ethics books or attend morality classes, part of our brain usually shuts down and we can even feel bored. But when this subject is dealt with through manga or anime where a character must face a moral dilemma, we are fully engaged. This happens because a point is reached where the character matters, the outcomes matter… our senses are completely active, absorbing everything, and without realizing it we learn about the topic.  

Let’s use **“Death Note”** as an example. At first glance the story seems like a thriller about a boy who can kill anyone simply by writing their name in a notebook. But when we analyze the story, we are faced with a deep narrative about power, corruption, and justice. We see Light Yagami start his path thinking he is doing the right thing, and over time he becomes a tyrant. Here, viewers can clearly see how **absolute power corrupts absolutely.** No one needs to give a lecture on morality for this point; the audience understands it perfectly by following Light’s development.  

Manga and anime also bring to the table **very complex ethical dilemmas** that have no easy answer.  

While Western comics and animation tend to present moral dilemmas with a clear answer (the hero is right and the villain is wrong), manga and anime love to include ethical dilemmas without simple solutions in their plots.  

Consider **“Fullmetal Alchemist.”** In this story the Elric brothers commit a grave mistake by trying to resurrect their mother through alchemy. The consequences are devastating. Were they evil for doing this? No, definitely not. But… **did they deserve the punishment they received?** This is where the debate enters, because the series does not give a concrete answer; it makes you think and analyze.  

Another example is **“Demon Slayer.”** The figure of the demons is technically an image of embodied evil. However, many of them were turned into that against their will. Here we could ask: **Are they responsible for their actions in this scenario? Do they deserve compassion?** The series constantly explores this, showing the audience that morality is not black‑and‑white; it also has gray areas.  

Manga and anime also lead us to examine the **real consequences of decisions**, and in this respect anime does it very well.  

When, in a story, a character makes an ethical decision that could be questionable, it does not disappear from the plot without impact. Each character lives their story through the choices they make.  

In the anime **“Code Geass”** we meet Lelouch, who obtains the power to control minds. He uses this power to achieve his own goals, but each time he does, he becomes more corrupted.  

The series does not openly say, “Hey, mind‑control is bad, don’t do it,” but rather shows the character’s internal destruction. The audience sees how acting without ethics brings huge psychological and moral consequences.  

Here, ethics are not taught with abstract rules; it is shown that actions have weight and decisions matter.  

Another important ethical lesson that anime and manga bring is **empathy for enemies**, which in real life translates to empathy for those we disagree with.  

Many stories present antagonistic characters with motivations that can be understandable even when their methods are questionable.  

In this case we can look at **Dabi** from *My Hero Academia*. He is a villain but has a tragic backstory: he was abandoned by an abusive father. We can ask, **does that justify his actions?** No, but we can understand why he became a villain. The moral teaching here is that we can reject an individual’s actions while still feeling compassion for their humanity.  

Finally, a moral and ethical lesson we find in manga and anime is **social responsibility and justice.**  

We can see this lesson in series like *Attack on Titan* and *Vinland Saga*, which explore social responsibility and justice from a non‑simplistic perspective.  

In *Vinland Saga*, the series begins as a revenge story, which gradually questions the validity of revenge itself. Thorfinn, the protagonist, searches for the man who killed his father to end his life, but when the opportunity arises he realizes that revenge will not bring him peace; it will only add more pain. This ethical lesson is wrapped in a very moving narrative.  

As we have seen through the examples, anime and manga are powerful tools for teaching us the importance of complex moral and ethical topics, immersing us in endless debates and considerations about what is right, wrong, good, and evil, and to what extent actions and decisions are justified in the various scenarios the characters face.  

Tell me, is there an anime or manga that taught you a great ethical or moral lesson? Share your experience in the comments so we can discuss it!  

Until the next post!

body.title: When the World Goes Quiet #26
body.body:
Hello everyone, writing at 12:00 AM…

During the day, life can feel very busy and distracting. There is always something to do, somewhere to be, or something demanding attention. Sometimes, the day passes so quickly that I barely have enough time to sit with my thoughts properly. Everything feels like it is moving fast, and I am just trying to keep up. But at midnight, everything becomes quiet, and I feel like I become a different version of myself.

At midnight, I become a quiet observer of my own thoughts. It is usually the time when I think deeply about my future, my life, and the kind of person I want to become.The night feels very different from the busy energy of the day. The weather becomes cooler, everything feels calmer, and somehow my mind slows down enough for me to reflect properly. It feels like the world is finally still enough for me to hear myself think.

Sometimes, midnight brings thoughts I don’t notice during the day. Things I push aside or don’t have time to think about suddenly become clearer. In those moments, I also realize how much I am changing. Not in big, dramatic ways, but in small thoughts, decisions, and how I see life differently from before. Midnight makes me notice my own growth quietly. and it reminds me that becoming is a slow process, not something that happens all at once.
![IMG_7280.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/helenxxo/23tbF1LxcgaEEJ6zzoj3bUEqGa4gQqHPzcsQtqhSFp2MinouW4tEBJBRz7zteB37muHTX.jpeg)


Even though I enjoy the calmness that comes with midnight, I honestly do not like staying awake for too long because once I wake up, it can take me a while to fall asleep again. So most nights, I would rather sleep peacefully. But on the nights when I do stay awake, I sometimes surf the internet, pray, or simply lie quietly with my thoughts. Those moments feel different from the rest of the day. There is no pressure, no rush, just me and my mind moving things I am still learning to understand, and even things I am trying to let go of quietly.


Midnight also feels like one of the few moments where there is no pressure from the outside world. No noise, no rushing, no expectations. Just silence and my thoughts. It becomes a moment where I can reflect on things I may have ignored, things I am still learning to understand, and even things I am trying to let go of quietly.

I think midnight brings out a softer, more hopeful side of me. It gives me a strange sense of peace and reminds me that life is still moving forward and that I am slowly becoming more aware of myself and my journey.

At midnight, I become someone reflective, calm, and hopeful about the future.

Thanks for checking by my blog❤️

body.title: Five Minute Freewrite: Scatter The Seed
body.body:
Charles has been farming maize on a land Jude pledged to him for three years now. Every harvest season he records low yield whereas his neighbours usually record high an bountiful harvest. The second year of his farming on the land he went for improved variety and when harvest time came it was also the same old story - poor yeild.

This farming season, Charles has vowed that the downward trend must stop. So he decided to pay a visit to Rex who has a farm next to his. When he told Rex his ordeal, his friend simply smiled and told him to relax. Things will change for food now that he has spoken up. 

Charles was a bit surprised to see his friend talk lightly about his problems. Rex went into his barn and came.out with a bunch of dried maize and handed them over to Charles.

\

, Charles opined as he heads towards the exit door. 

That night Charles did as was directed and after twenty-four hours he went straight to his farm and scattered the seeds.

After three days he came back and saw how the maize were growing. Some could not germinate while those who did look nourished and in need of first wedding. 

After a fortnight, Charles mobilized his workers to weed the farm and add.more manure to the maize. He is well sure that he will have a bountiful yield this year.

body.title: Phillies are victorious in close game vs Red Sox | Andrew Painter on the mound tonight for Phils
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW756KjZpKHJ5gG1j7raQ1L3q3b86qcFBhAvUbszKu7Nu/1778711619904.webp)
[Src](https://loodibee.com/mlb/philadelphia-phillies/)

Ah yes back with another Phillies post! I'm currently very tired from staying on the grind delivering food, phone battery dying, life stressing... But I am committed bruh! I still consider myself lucky to even be able to make any type of money writing about sports! Pretty cool. 

Zack Wheeler has looked solid in his return so far from his injury, but yesterday he really shined. At one point he was averaging about eight pitches per inning or something similar! He was cruising pretty much all night. Things got mildly shaky towards the end of his outing, but he still held strong. He finished his night going 7 1/3 innings while allowing just a single run. It was so great to see Wheeler look like his dominant self. 

Oh yeah, and Kyle Schwarber homered, AGAIN! That's now SIX homers in just five games. This dude is ridiculous! Good times man! [The Phillies ultimately won 2-1.](https://youtu.be/ypgJ_CvYXic?si=vE-znYICB1JZOfEE)

The Phillies send out the struggling rookie Andrew Painter to the mound tonight. Painter hasn't really had a great start to his career for the most part. This Red Sox offense isn't too powerful so hopefully Painter can gain some confidence tonight. It must be an exciting feeling to be able to pitch at Fenway Park, happy for the guy!

Hopefully this Phillies offense can look a bit stronger in this game two and secure the series victory!

Not my greatest post ever but, I'm glad I got it out before my battery died!

body.title: Five Minute Freewrite: scatter the seed
body.body: >A long time ago, there was a village called Umundu. Their major occupation was farming and almost all families own or work on a farm.  One day, there was an argument between farmers about whether it's better to scatter the seed or place them together during planting. Those supporting scatter believe that this would give each individual seed a high survival chance while those placing them together believe that it would make them struggle to survive which ensures that only the strongest gene survives. This argument went on for a long time until the village head had to step in. He made them understand that both methods are good, however he informs them that it all depends on the type of seeds and he even encourages them to try both methods on the same seed to see and understand the difference.   Those who love to experiment went ahead to do this while those who are ignorant and unwilling to learn choose to stick to their own ways. That was how the issue was resolved and it never occurs again. ** ** ** ** You can participate by clicking [here.](https://ecency.com/hive-161155/@daily.prompt/13-may-2026-freewriters-community-daily-writing-prompt-day-3102-scatter-the-seed) [Image source](https://pixabay.com/photos/rice-hand-harvest-grain-thailand-1549130/) ** ** ** **
