Although there are many challenges, I love my life, and I'm immensely grateful to live where and how I do, on my own terms! I would not want to live any other way! 😁🙏💚⚡💥🔥✴️✳️❇️👣🌱✨🤙 ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) ``` Hive Debt: 21.53% HIVE Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.063 USD HBD/HIVE-Backed Dollar Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.959 USD ALIVE SWAP.HIVE Price: 0.01969603 SWAP.HIVE HEARTBEAT ALIVE Price: 0.10897138 ALIVE BLURT Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.00109730 USD QORT Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.117885 USD VOI Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.0001682 USD BTC/Bitcoin Fiat-Dollar Price: 7,652.4 USD BCH/Bitcoin Cash Fiat-Dollar Price: 434.27 USD LTC/Litecoin Fiat-Dollar Price: 5.83 USD Gold Fiat-Dollar Price: 4,708.90 USD Silver Fiat-Dollar Price: 88.25 USD Ranking for Our @aliveandmmb Witness Node: #130 (among all witnesses, including inactive)/#101 (among active witnesses only)/475.5k HP in votes/49 votes in total ``` ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) Warm greetings all! 😁🙏💚✨🤙 Since first installing, setting up, and becoming enthralled with Hermes Agent and its agentic framework 10 days ago, I've been tracking its rapid development, as well as the innumerable new tools, plugins, and skills that are being created and released by the community. I've got a fairly solid local AI-agent setup right now, and I'm constantly seeking ways to improve and extend it, which is occurring at a notable pace. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260511_151908927.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wWtfkEFstU5jGEh61NTyzmmPwcB5oHPJN6ARkcfHHqYg6ozYNeAUqNBSS87dsyfig3o.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260511_152335708_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/2423qFcF2fFnptgoGrVbDzbYJdVfwoJgxedcuDQsYqAbcrvxGaBTnemmaDDCsPeRzUFn4.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) One of the coolest and most fascinating developments that I'm seeing with Hermes-Agent framework is that it's quite quickly moving in the direction of becoming a full agentic operating system on its own, without me needing to implement anything to nudge it in that direction. I've been talking about the concept of an agentic operating system, or an AgentOS, and about my desire and intention to use Hermes to build one, for more than a week in these posts, and seeing the latest wave of updates from the Hermes developers, I must say that I've got quite a good bit of excitement bubbling, because it's going to make my AgentOS-building endeavors notably quicker and easier. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260511_153017867.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wgAxR2k3Kwyy2VVfJjwxhmRDwHsm8KJGkCLZwBLiUqA6m8acR9FHtuZZunrukhcYL8p.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260511_153140351_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23xARTkGy9EHAAC3QpH18ce22m7UUSWTAnadcQSCvdfHSaNGopXW8LjBDj81qSKWYALQA.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) I'm anti-fad, but Hermes Agent is gaining a huge amount of interest and adoption very, very rapidly, already surpassing the previous king OpenClaw in certain metrics, and that trend seems to be accelerating. I definitely understand why people would be interested in it, as it's the most incredible meta-tool that I've ever used. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260511_153228336.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23vhnnvpE27A5cdTesuJ4cwHdivu61yAXC6yoPTosbXw1pVgctxsTGvqWAppoK3LBcCKU.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260511_153302310.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wWntJD1ubXn8D8xz3t5VSMuhaLHrgWBHTW6bcsSuM44fzYLSugaztZGparKyTwtpL9Y.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) The capability for Hermes to control and manage an entire computer operating system has already begun testing on MacOS, with intense interest being expressed in the community around what is now possible. Integration for Windows, Linux, and Andoid is also in the works, of course. I'll be patiently waiting for a Linux release that's compatible with my Arch/Artix Linux systems, though with the pace of development, I really don't think that my wait will be very long at all. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260511_153429600.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wMWbC4fQ2iJdt7k2EWe4sRxaXSVbHrTPu6ApaN25DUo9WhM7u6Kd5vyF76rhqbZK8Yc.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260511_153537307_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23xV8Kfx9V2QfvqczeeLdLBCo4da2HkgkzfK9DxTcRNetnMshNsWCTZhoyzvPeGXK1wx5.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) The practical potential of this type of OS-level control and management remains to be seen, but the current possibilities are already extremely exciting, which is why I'm focusing so intensely on exploring and implementing them. I got everything on Hive done by just before 10PM, and after watching some very interesting YouTube videos on Hermes, I went to bed, a bit too late again, by around 12:30AM. body.title: The Renaissance the the USA Didn't Want You to Know About - 01-28-2019 - Clip 5 - 10X Speed
body.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1778712218463-4d479940a12e210c.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=davidnollearth/4ac931d1)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=davidnollearth/4ac931d1)


---

This is the video series for an oil painting 'Wisteria' I did from 2016-2020.  The painting was destroyed in 2021 due to a number of reasons, but mainly: the painting's faulty experimental linseed-epoxide substrait, Covid-19 crushing lockdowns, extreme poverty, family attacks and ongoing US government (Big Tech + Big Media) censorship of me and my 30 years of artwork.

Its not ideal to not be able to show this piece, but I still gained the knowledge of how to do it and invented several useful oil painting mediums & varnishes used in its creation which never yellowed and still cannot be bought anywhere.

I am posting these videos for posterity and for people that are interested in seeing an oil painting created from start to finish in the Baroque style evolved for the 21st century.  I also must have deleted some of the initial videos when I did the quick underpainting, but what still exists, I give to you.

I hope this can be an educational experience as no gallery will show any of my controversial art even today.

---

body.title: Vintage Photos - Lot 6 (257-260)
body.body: Several years ago I bought a flatbed scanner with a slide adapter to scan some old film slides that my grandparents had. After I finished scanning those, I picked up several batches of slides from Goodwill and on eBay out of curiosity. I am not sure why these commonly wind up at such places but I know that at least some of them have ultimately come from estate sales. Maybe family members just don't know what to do with them. I've seen them advertised as being for arts and crafts but I was more interested in the actual contents. Each slide is literally a snapshot in history. These pictures span from as early as the late 1940s to as late as the early 1990s. There are thousands of these slides. I will be scanning some from time to time and posting them here as an interesting way to look back at the past.\n\nI'm using the term \
to refer to a group of slides I bought in a single purchase. Usually they are from the same ultimate origin. Typically, a batch will have 100s or even 1000s of slides.\n\nI'm using the term \

to refer to a subset of a batch that I scan together. There are normally four slides in one set because that's how many slides my scanner can scan at once. Likewise, a post will typically have one set of four slides. It's just easier to keep track of that way. This batch contains photos spanning from the late 1950s to the early 1980s. Other than these slides coming from eBay, I have no idea of their ultimate origin other than the clues provided in the photos themselves. The photographer seems to have been from Lansing, Michigan and many of the photos are from there. These were all scanned with an Epson Perfection V600 Photo scanner. All of the photos in this set were taken in 1968 and were all probably taken in the Lansing, Michigan area. The first photo was taken in April 1986 and is labeled \
.\n\nThe next two photos were processed in February 1968 and are labeled \

. This was appearently some kind of convention for seniors. The last photo was processed in October 1968. It is perhaps the most interesting. It appears to have been taken on or near the lawn of the Michigan State Capitol in Lansing, Michigan. You can see the Jack Tar Hotel which is located in downtown Lansing just West of the Capitol and is now the George W. Romney state office building. This was most likely taken during an anti-Vietnam War demonstration. There were several such demonstrations in Lansing in 1968. There is also a clock that can be seen in this photo indicating a time of 2:22 or 2:23.

>

See the previous post in this series
>here. \n\nThe entire batch that has been scanned and uploaded so far can also be found

>here. This also includes higher resolution versions and versions with postprocessing. --- Check out some of my other recent posts: Digital Archaeology: Dell Latitude D610 https://ecency.com/retrocomputing/@darth-azrael/digital-archaeology-dell-latitude-d610 Vintage Photos - Lot 6 (253-256) https://ecency.com/photography/@darth-azrael/vintage-photos-lot-6-253 Byte (April 1984) https://ecency.com/retrocomputing/@darth-azrael/byte-april-1984 Vintage Photos - Lot 6 (245-248) https://ecency.com/photography/@darth-azrael/vintage-photos-lot-6-245-2f7e794df34da PC World (September 1990) https://ecency.com/retrocomputing/@darth-azrael/pc-world-september-1990 ---

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/ca9abfd7-d48b-4d0c-a9e4-4d440da27163.jpg) Since my children were born in Venezuela, maintaining our traditions has been quite a challenge after living abroad for eight years. My oldest son, for example, prefers Argentine food and looks down on Venezuelan cuisine. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/043f9392-389a-44fa-8874-6b7576065c79.jpg) My youngest son, who doesn’t remember anything about the country, asks for Venezuelan foods and stories about the customs there. In the end, raising citizens of the world can be a bit complicated. # Spanish *Ciudadanos del mundo.* Siendo mis hijos nacidos en Venezuela, luego de vivir 8 años fuera de nuestras tierras, mantener las costumbres ha sido todo un tema. Mi hijo mayor, por ejemplo, prefiere la comida argentina y denigra de la venezolana. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/a8c8c08c-8cbc-4241-be20-4f5e3fb1ff99.jpg) Mi hijo menor, quien no recuerda nada del país, pide cosas venezolanas y cuentos sobre las costumbres de allá. Al final, criar ciudadanos del mundo puede ser un tanto complicado.

body.body:
‎While watching Manchester City defeat Crystal Palace 3-0 tonight reminded me once again why they are still regarded as the best team in the Premier League. It was not just about winning the match, but the confidence, composure, and mentality they showed from the first whistle to the last minute. They played like a team that refuses to surrender, no matter how difficult the title race becomes.
‎ https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPcE6d6BoMf2jDW5aAXkP5HSj5xJbKjFinPjG4K1u8TcR/skysports-man-city-palace-highlights_7248075.jpg 

‎[Source](https://www.google.com/url?sa=t&source=web&rct=j&opi=89978449&url=https://www.skysports.com/football/news/11095/13543018/man-city-3-0-crystal-palace-phil-foden-shines-as-pep-guardiolas-side-extend-premier-league-title-race-another-week&ved=2ahUKEwjxl8bQqreUAxXsTkEAHRQEEb4Qr4kDegQIJRAA&usg=AOvVaw39UgWlDjzVtRWTfca1vnwc)
‎
‎As a football fan, moments like this are what make the Premier League so exciting, unpredictable and the best league in the world. Manchester City always find a way to keep the pressure alive just when many people begin to think the race is over. Their experience in moments like this is something very few teams can match. Every pass, every movement, and every goal scored against Crystal Palace today really carried a message that they are still here, still fighting, and still believing that anything can happen.
‎
‎Currently, Arsenal remain top of the premier league table with 79 points, while Manchester City sit closely behind with 77 points and only two points separate both sides and two games left to play. The situation is simple for Arsenal, win their remaining matches and the Premier League trophy is theirs. But football has taught us many times that nothing is guaranteed until the final whistle of the season. Even though, Arsenal have been outstanding all season but winning the league will make it worthwhile.
‎
‎Even though Arsenal are still in control of their own destiny, I can imagine Manchester City waiting patiently for any small mistake or dropped points. That is what makes this title race so intense and interesting at the same time. City know how to handle pressure, and they understand that one unexpected result can completely change the whole narrative.
‎
‎I personally admire the mentality Manchester City continue to show every season. Many teams would have given up or lost confidence after falling behind in the race, but Pep Guardiola’s side always seem calm and focused. They never stop believing. That mentality alone is what separates champions from ordinary teams.
‎
‎And with just  only two games remaining, the pressure on Arsenal will now become even heavier because Manchester City are still breathing right behind them. One slip could open the door for City to take over once again.
‎
‎The Premier League title race is far from finished, and honestly, I can't wait to see how this dramatic season finally unfold. 
‎

body.title: HIVEMIND: A Battle Royale Built on Hive with Posts as Weapons
body.body:
I built a game that uses your actual Hive chain data as core gameplay mechanics. Most games built on Hive use the blockchain for tokens or ownership; Hive Arena uses it for the game itself. You can play now at [arena.hive.uno](https://arena.hive.uno).

## How it works

**Weapons from your posts**: Your weapons are your 20 most recent posts (a moving window: write new posts and older ones drop out). Each post becomes a weapon with unique stats based on its category: hot take, quality post, shitpost, or thread. Older posts gain a firing speed bonus (+5%), encouraging you to maintain a diverse arsenal.


![Screenshot_20260513_233521.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cadawg/EoCZvzBDW3gnjfTZGNqUxfqkvwb3tqqdB4tei8gu4zAimQwhFs3D9TGoyf7nnA4kDKm.png)


**Durability and maintenance**: Weapons degrade in battle (5% per game, bottoming out at 50% durability). You recover 2.5% durability per kill (up to 4% per match). You can repair weapons for 3 scraps, which restores current durability to max, but each repair slightly lowers the maximum durability you can repair to (eventually bottoming out at 95% max). Your damage output scales directly with current durability. You get scraps by scrapping unwanted posts (shitpost: 1 scrap, hot take: 1, thread: 2, quality post: 3). The long-term tradeoff: keep a favorite post in rotation and repair it repeatedly, or cycle in fresh posts as weapons wear out.

**Why this matters**: Quality posts take longer to produce, so maintaining a few good ones often beats grinding dozens of mediocre ones. If the game grows, I'll add post stats tracking to give you more reason to keep specific weapons long-term.

## Rewards

When a match ends, all players vote on a match post (25% vote, or 0.2 Hive minimum if your stake is over around 20-25k HP). 50% of the voting rewards go to commentrewarder, and all players comment on the match post. The top human player (even if a bot wins, a human gets the prize) receives an additional upvote from the game account, which directs commentrewarder to send them their 50% share.

The other 50% of voting rewards goes to me for upvoting comments to push them above the dust threshold, ensuring payouts stay meaningful. Post categorization also has a cost.

## Battle mechanics

![Screenshot_20260513_233328.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cadawg/Eo43HPHFDveBgUXdi58oDapXczR2TAh3hZWHb9oVtA8U2ZjWTekoxjzSBPXiaNuoRVm.png)

Matches run with 2 to 20 human players. If we don't hit 20, bots fill out the lobby to keep things interesting (bots are happy to fight each other while you fight them). Rewards go to the highest ranked human player.

![Screenshot_20260513_233343.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cadawg/Enynazr5F78qt9W1pho6ZJzJQUq8ELP1pyso47snQUpTP93WeV92RMtSj5rsPMfSY4K.png)

## Platform note

Hive Arena works best in desktop browsers. It may work in Safari on iOS, but does not work in Hive Keychain browser. I haven't been able to debug the Keychain compatibility, so iOS play isn't reliable right now.

# >> [Jump In (arena.hive.uno)](https://arena.hive.uno) <<

body.title: El Delantero Definitivo / The Ultimate Striker /  ESP-ENG
body.body: Se imaginan ser parte de un programa top mundial donde te ponen a prueba tus habilidades con retos que hacen que te lleven a otro nivel si eso es lo que ha hecho blue lock cansados de siempre precenciar la eliminacion de japon se fueron a crear un delantero definitivo

>Fuente La historia comienza con japon cansado de nunca llegar más lejos en el Mundial. Entonces,se decidió crear un programa donde reclutan a los mejores delanteros de todo el país, con el objetivo de entrenarlos y llevarlos al límite para descubrir a los próximos grandes jugadores de la nación de japon También se ve en los primeros episodios cómo el protagonista se enfrenta a muchas incógnitas, ya que, al inicio de la historia, en el primer capítulo, en lugar de intentar anotar un gol, decide dar un pase y termina perdiendo el partido.

>Fuente A partir de ese momento, comienza a cuestionarse si realmente tiene el talento necesario para jugar al fútbol. Luego de esto, es llamado a un centro donde se reúne con muchos jóvenes delanteros, quienes deben superar diferentes etapas y desafíos dentro del juego. Isagi quiere convertirse en un delantero de élite y pone a prueba todas sus habilidades. Sin embargo, conforme avanza en los desafíos, va conociendo rivales muy fuertes, cada uno con capacidades y estilos de juego muy diferentes al suyo. Al mismo tiempo, también desarrolla nuevas habilidades, como su visión de juego, una pieza clave del rompecabezas que va construyendo a lo largo del anime para evolucionar como jugador.

>Fuente En Blue Lock buscan que los jugadores desarrollen y dominen nuevas habilidades. Los someten a entrenamientos intensos con máquinas que lanzan el balón a altas velocidades, obligándolos a reaccionar rápidamente y perfeccionar su técnica. El objetivo es que piensen únicamente en el gol, que disparen antes de dar un pase y que desarrollen una mentalidad más egoísta dentro del campo, confiando en sí mismos para convertirse en mejores goleadores. Ese es el gran desafío de este anime: encontrar al mejor delantero de Japón entre cientos de jóvenes talentosos, donde todos compiten por demostrar que son el número uno. En Blue Lock, los entrenamientos están enfocados en el crecimiento individual. Es un lugar donde los jugadores aprenden a confiar en sí mismos, a tirar antes de pasar y a desarrollar un estilo de juego totalmente contrario al fútbol tradicional de jugar únicamente para el equipo. Aquí, cada delantero juega para sí mismo, buscando despertar su ego y convertirse en el mejor atacante del fútbol. Descubre este increíble anime y no te pierdas cómo concluye esta interesante historia basada en el manga, que desde que lo vi me ha encantado.

>Fuente --- --- --- Can you imagine being part of a world-class program where your skills are constantly tested through challenges designed to push you to the next level? That is exactly what happens in Blue Lock. Tired of constantly witnessing Japan’s elimination from international football tournaments, they decided to create the ultimate striker.

>Source The story begins with Japan becoming frustrated after never making it far in the World Cup. Because of this, a special program is created to recruit the best strikers from across the country, training them and pushing them to their limits in order to discover the next great football star of Japan. In the first episodes, we also see how the protagonist faces many doubts. In the very first chapter, instead of trying to score a goal himself, he decides to make a pass, which ultimately causes his team to lose the match.

>Source From that moment on, he begins questioning whether he truly has the talent needed to become a football player. Soon after, he is invited to a training facility where many young strikers gather to compete through different stages and challenges. Isagi wants to become an elite striker and puts all his abilities to the test. However, as the challenges continue, he encounters incredibly strong rivals, each with unique skills and very different playing styles. At the same time, he develops new abilities, especially his game vision, which becomes a key piece of the puzzle in his evolution throughout the anime.

>Source In Blue Lock, players are trained to develop and master new skills. They go through intense training sessions with machines that launch footballs at high speed, forcing them to react quickly and improve their technique. The main goal is to make them think only about scoring goals, to shoot before making a pass, and to develop a more selfish mentality on the field, trusting themselves in order to become better goal scorers. That is the great challenge of this anime: finding the best striker in Japan among hundreds of talented young players, all competing to prove they are number one. In Blue Lock, the training focuses on individual growth. It is a place where players learn to trust themselves, shoot before passing, and develop a style of play completely opposite to the traditional team-focused football mentality. Here, every striker plays for themselves, trying to awaken their ego and become the ultimate football attacker. Discover this incredible anime and do not miss how this fascinating story concludes. Since the first time I watched it, I absolutely loved it.

body.title: Essys Sacrifice
body.body:
>Essy was the first daughter born in her family, she was the first daughter in a family of FIVE, she was already 5 years old before the 2nd child was born to Mr and Mrs Jide kuso, and then they just kept giving birth and almost every year for the next 10 y, years they gave birth to another child, Essy was basically forced to become an adult at a very young age, she started cooking and cleaning at a very young age,basically he was like a second mother to her siblings and as is pertinent with adullts, the younger ones did not get along well with them. Essy always had to put her siblings first as was with every mother, sometimes putting their happiness ahead of hers.
While other children were out playing Essy was either helping with homework or with helping her mom with domestic work, baby sitting and cleaning the house. Tragedy struck in an indescribable way when on their way back from the market Mr and Mrs Jide Kuso had a fatal accident and died.
Both her parents died that night and Essy was seventeen. The news absolutely shattered the family. The days that followed after the tragedy relatives came, cried loudly, and disappeared after the burial. Some promised support they never intended to give and many others advised the children to “be strong” before returning to their comfortable homes.
Suddenly, Essy became everything, she was their Mother, Father, Caretaker, all in one. She dropped out of school two weeks later. The principal begged her to reconsider because she was one of the brightest students in her class, but she knew brilliance could not buy food. Her siblings needed to eat, the rent needed to be paid and utility bills paid.
So she sacrificed her own education, Every morning before sunrise as early as 5:00 am, Essy fried akara(bean cake) beside the roadside. By afternoon, she cleaned houses for richer families nearby. In the evenings, she sold sachet water at the motor park. Sometimes she returned home so exhausted that she slept on the floor before eating. Yet she still woke up the next morning to continue. The years passed and one by one, her siblings graduated from school. One became a banker, another became a nurse, which was the exact dream Essy once had for herself.
Whenever people praised them, they proudly talked about hard work and determination, even though they had no parents but they rarely mentioned Essy, but it never got to her. Unfortunately as time went by the same siblings she had sacrificed everything for slowly began treating her like an embarrassment. Some felt uncomfortable that she remained poor while they became successful. One even warned his fiancée not to discuss family matters around Essy because she wouldn’t understand those kinds of conversations.
Still, the deepest wound came during their youngest sister’s wedding. Essy arrived early wearing her best dress, though it was old and faded. She moved around helping with decorations and serving guests like she always did.
Then she overheard her siblings talking. “She likes acting like she raised us.” “She should stop making people think she suffered for us.” “We all struggled please”

>

Essy stood frozen behind the curtain, she was hollow inside, a walking dead. All the years she sacrificed suddenly felt invisible, all the missed dreams, every sleepless night, every hunger she endured for them seemed erased by success and pride. That night, she cried quietly in her room for the first time in years, but Essy was too strong to be broken by words after all she had gone through. She used the pain as fuel.

At thirty-five, when many people believed life had passed her by, Essy enrolled in evening classes to complete her education. During the day, she expanded her small food business into a proper restaurant. Some people mocked her for “starting life late.” but Essy had survived worse things than mockery, this was childs play to her

She studied at night with tired eyes. She learned how to use computers from teenagers younger than her. She saved every naira carefully she could. Slowly, her restaurant became popular around the neighborhood because of her discipline and kindness.

>

Years later, she opened a second branch and then a third. People began inviting her to speak to young women about resilience. They admired her strength, but they never truly understood the weight she carried for years, all they saw was the success and beamed from her. Ironically, the same siblings who once ignored her slowly returned. One needed financial help after losing his job. One called her crying from abroad after being scammed and despite all that was done to her she still came through because bitterness had never truly lived inside her heart.

One evening, while closing her restaurant, the youngest sibling , the same one whose wedding had broken her heart years ago visited unexpectedly.

“I’m sorry”, she said with tears in her eyes, followed by silence, along silence. Essy looked at her. The pain had not completely disappeared, but it no longer controlled her.

She shook her head and replied, “I didn’t sacrifice my life so you people would worship me. I only wanted you all to become better.” and then she hugged her tightly, tears flowing from her cheeks too.

body.title: I’m sick of being on the phone…
body.body:
Afternoon everyone…..

Today I spent a lot of time on the phone for work. Calling suppliers for pricing on materials. Which is getting worse and worse!!!! Every time I call now the prices are always increasing.

I also spent a fair amount of time on the phone with the people down the shore with the new house build. We came up with a game plan of construction. In order to get the CO (Certificate of Occupancy) they need to have all of the vanities installed, and the pantry as well. Everything else can wait until after they move in.

It actually works out better for me, both logistically and for transportation.

Nothing is written in stone yet. Until I give them a price for the pantry and the six vanities and they sign it’s all irrelevant.

body.body: I'm 2 weeks late seeing your reply. :)\nI love SECRET LIFE OF PLANTS. Love the chapters on George Washington Carver and Jagadish Chandra Bose. I have not read Heart is a Lonely Hunter but must - Carson McCullers, only age 23, and published! What a different world. At 17, she left home on a steamship bound for New York City, planning to study piano at the Juilliard School of Music. On the subway she lost the money she was going to use for her education at Juilliard. She decided instead to work, take night classes, and write. At  20, she married an ex-soldier and aspiring writer, Reeves McCullers. They divorced, then remarried. She lived the last twenty years of her life in Nyack, New York, where she died in 1967 at age 50, after a brain hemorrhage. \nI love what you say about that simpler life. That era. Before AI, before internet, and all our distractions. \

- yes. Well said.

What I read recently might interest you for the strong heroine who can live in the woods with ease, which of course gets her accused of being a witch. By Katherine Arden:

The Bear and the Nightingale (The Winternight Trilogy, #1) 
The Girl in the Tower (The Winternight Trilogy, #2) 
The Winter of the Witch (The Winternight Trilogy, #3) 

However, the novels seem quite long and detailed. \

Too many pages.
You can tell I've been reading too much AI-edited text: short sentences. Short paragraphs.

 Started reading The Cassatt Sisters: A Novel of Love and Art by Lisa Groen but had to set it aside to write a book review. Never found my way back to it.

Bought the ebook but didn't read:
The Florios of Sicily: A Novel (The Lions of Sicily Book 1) by Stefania Auci

Bought but didnt read:

Under the Greenwood Tree by Thomas Hardy

Still haven't read \

by Rumer Godden.
Nor 'Brideshead Revisited' by Evelyn Waugh - started watching the tv series, but fell asleep.

If you like memoir, try Tell Me I Belong: A Journey Across Faiths and Generations
David Weill - and \
by Sarito Carroll, and if you have Netflix, watch the documentary, \
Cults! Incredibly enough, to this day, the \

known as Osho still has a cult following. He died at 54 after being exiled in disgrace from Oregon, where he'd founded a commune near the tiny town of Antelope. I'm not crazy about the documentary. It makes the guru sound like a pretty good guy - but he had 97 Rolls Royces and in the commune, underage girls were molested and robbed of their innocence.

I bookmarked but never read the novels you'd recently recommended.
Now, to find the bookmark...
I need to organize my lists and files!

Good luck with the Nashville house - and your garden - and traveling with a dog -

(((I've never finished Jane Eyre, either!)))

body.title: Personas positivas [ESP-ENG]
body.body:
<center>


![IMAG 1 Personas positivas.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dorytagil2022/EpvmhDpUMfTNv5V2DBksnUaWpycHYBLTrRM9mF88Sw43gimaUdzh2bxT9Hzvef6Y3im.gif)


<sub>Imagen de mi propiedad tomada del álbum digital personal, editada en Canva. 
</sub></center>

<div class=\

> En la vida, desde la época de las cavernas, han existido **personas** tanto **positivas** como negativas que han influido o han sido un marco de referencia en los seres humanos para poner en órbita los talentos a desarrollarse. Particularmente, buscaré siempre rodearme de **personas positivas**; las negativas, tóxicas, las alejaré de mi entorno. Más aún, a estas alturas del partido, a mis sesenta años entendí que no podré darme el lujo de basar las energías y desperdiciarlas en cosas que para mí no tendrán valor. Y será justo y necesario rodearnos o codearnos a lo venezolano de personas con actitud positiva, con **buena vibra**, pues “al que buen árbol se arrima, buena sombra lo cobija”. Por mi vida han pasado muchas personas, pero existen unas especiales, entre estas: mi hermana @mafalda2018, @angelica7 y @sacra97, entre otras, quienes siempre han estado presentes y me han acompañado con **buena vibra** para darme ese empujoncito a la sombra de un delicioso café matutino para decirme que aun en vicisitudes todo estará bien. ¿Saben lo hermoso que es caminar y saludar con gentileza a quienes nos encontraremos? Pues para mí ese ha sido mi estilo de vida, y eso sucederá porque al levantarme cada mañana y con solo colocar un pie en el piso, agradeceré a Dios porque estoy alegre de seguir viva, tomarme un delicioso y humeante café, desayunar lo que a bien tuviera; ya con eso sé que todo estará bien, lo demás vendrá por añadidura y así será. Y muy probablemente me toparé con algunas **personas alegres con buena vibra** y otras pesimistas. Particularmente, a los dos los saludaré y desearé un feliz día; cada uno de ellos tomará lo que deseara; eso no me quitará la actitud con la que decidí salir al ruedo, a conquistar la vida. En Hive, como en otras redes sociales, nos encontraremos cualquier información, tanto positiva como negativa, y cada quien tomará lo que le gustara y de alguna forma dejarán alguna enseñanza de lo que podrá ser o no ser. Algunos hasta me llevaron a indagar un poco más acerca de algún tema; los de matiz positivo serán mis preferidos. Esto me ha ayudado a crecer como creadora de contenido. >Throughout history, ever since the Stone Age, there have been both **positive** and **negative** **people** who have influenced or served as role models for others, helping them to unleash their potential. In particular, I will always seek to surround myself with **positive people**; as for the negative, toxic ones, I will keep them out of my life. Moreover, at this stage of the game, at sixty years old, I’ve realized I can’t afford to waste my energy on things that hold no value for me. >And it’s only fair and necessary to surround ourselves—or, as we say in Venezuela, rub shoulders with—people who have a positive attitude and **good vibes**, because “he who leans on a good tree is sheltered by its shade.” Many people have come and gone in my life, but there are some special ones, among them: my sister @mafalda2018, @angelica7, and @sacra97, among others, who have always been there and have accompanied me with **good vibes** to give me that little push in the shade of a delicious morning coffee to tell me that even through life’s ups and downs, everything will be okay. >Do you know how wonderful it is to walk along and greet everyone we meet with kindness? Well, that has been my way of life, and that’s how it will be because when I wake up every morning and just put one foot on the floor, I’ll thank God because I’m happy to be alive, have a delicious, steaming cup of coffee, and eat whatever I feel like for breakfast; with that alone, I know everything will be fine, the rest will follow, and so it will be. >And I’ll most likely run into some **cheerful people with good vibes** and others who are pessimistic. I’ll greet both of them and wish them a happy day; each will take what they want; that won’t take away the attitude with which I decided to step into the arena and conquer life. >On Hive, as on other social media platforms, we come across all kinds of information—both positive and negative—and everyone takes away what they like, and in some way, these experiences offer lessons about what might or might not be. Some even prompted me to dig a little deeper into certain topics; the positive ones are my favorites. This has helped me grow as a content creator.
![Separador Personas positivas.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dorytagil2022/23xL5DyoPaBD6Gh26V4XyWb271d92dYazn141raJsNAx9tkSDkByQefzb7iaB7UddyCoo.gif)

>


Están invitados a participar y deslizar su pluma acerca de este tema que amé, tan hermoso, interesante, sencillamente espectacular: **\

,** planteada por Encuentro de @talentos a través de nuestra bella moderadora @angelica7. Un espacio que mueve la energía con gente positiva.

Sin duda alguna, movernos entre gente luminosa, buena vibra, nos hará sentir desde nuestro ser que todo está bien; créelo y se dará. 
    
Para más información visite <a href=\

>aquí. > You’re invited to join in and share your thoughts on this topic I loved—so beautiful, interesting, and simply spectacular: **“People with Good Vibes,”** proposed by Encuentro de @talentos through our wonderful moderator @angelica7. A space that energizes us with positive people. >Without a doubt, being around radiant people with good vibes will make us feel deep down that everything is okay; believe it, and it will happen. >For more information, visit

>aquí.
![Separador Personas positivas.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dorytagil2022/23xL5DyoPaBD6Gh26V4XyWb271d92dYazn141raJsNAx9tkSDkByQefzb7iaB7UddyCoo.gif)
![IMAG 2 Personas positivas.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dorytagil2022/EppN8EUjfUAze3YnZyHDskcdWLoBtJRBCRAiLFp3HqZnbZtgerC9sV4dTqAPQ3xQgfN.gif) Imágenes de mi propiedad tomada del álbum digital personal, algunas fueron publicadas anteriormente, autorizado el uso de imágenes para esta publicación, editadas en Canva.

> Ahora bien, de acuerdo con mi perspectiva, nuestro andar por la vida no podrá estar subordinado a si nos encontramos con gente con actitud positiva o no, o si la moneda Hive subió o no, aunque será evidente que mientras más alza tuviera, pues mejor, pero el hecho de que la moneda esté baja o no, nunca debería ser un aliciente para bajarnos las ganas de seguir dando rienda suelta a nuestra imaginación, pues ¿cómo le decimos a la mente que deje de crear, que se espere hasta que suba la moneda? Es algo que no podremos controlar para seguir creando hermosas historias. Consideré que lo más importante será contarles bellas historias. Iré trabajando los pensamientos para **vibrar en positivo** y visualizar cosas buenas, que el mercado logre estabilizarse, trayendo como consecuencia el alza de todas las criptomonedas a nivel mundial y, aunque no lo creamos, si lo gestionáramos a través de las emociones y del pensamiento positivo creyendo que pasará, quizás tal vez se dé; el Hive subirá. Eso es de acuerdo a mi apreciación, y seré respetuosa de la posición que pudiera derivarse de la perspectiva de cada quien. Todos tendremos nuestro tiempo, perspectiva de vida diferentes; algunas se podrán parecer, y tal vez si tuviera otro tipo de actividades que ameritaran cumplir con un horario establecido, seguro no estaría tan activa como en estos momentos; incluso me gustaría estar más tiempo, pero ya todos sabemos que nuestra permanencia algunas veces dependerá del factor eléctrico y del desgaste mental por motivos de la cotidianidad con un sol inclemente pegado a nuestras espaldas. Muchos en esta espectacular red de Hive deberán monetizar e inclúyome para poder costear gastos cotidianos; aunque tendré otros ingresos, a veces ni cuenta me di de cómo amaneció el valor de la moneda; la verdad, únicamente escribiré con mi acompañante, la musa; nosotras apostaremos a que todo mejorará. Ya que la situación económica venezolana está apremiante, aprendí a priorizar los gastos. Porque en caso de no hacerlo, entonces eso me generará estrés y realmente en mi vida personal no lo desearé. Ya habrá tiempo y no muy lejano de cosechar lo que hemos sembrado, porque siempre veré el futuro de forma **positiva** y tendré la certeza de que lo viviremos, y de que así como nos comimos las hieles, ahora nos tocará comernos y disfrutar las mieles que volverán a Venezuela. >Now, from my perspective, our journey through life shouldn’t depend on whether or not we encounter people with a positive attitude, or whether the Hive token has gone up or not—though obviously, the higher it goes, the better, but the fact that the coin is down or not should never be a reason to dampen our desire to continue giving free rein to our imagination, because how do we tell the mind to stop creating, to wait until the coin goes up? It’s something we can’t control if we want to keep creating beautiful stories. >I believe the most important thing is to tell you beautiful stories. I will work on my thoughts to **vibrate positively** and visualize good things—that the market will stabilize, leading to a rise in all cryptocurrencies worldwide. And even if we don’t believe it, if we approach it through emotions and positive thinking, believing it will happen, perhaps it might come to pass; Hive will rise. That is my assessment, and I will respect the position that may arise from each person’s perspective. >We all have our own schedules and different perspectives on life; some may be similar, and perhaps if I had other activities that required sticking to a set schedule, I certainly wouldn’t be as active as I am right now; in fact, I’d like to spend even more time here, but we all know that how long we stay sometimes depends on power outages and the mental exhaustion caused by daily life with the relentless sun beating down on us. >Many in this spectacular Hive network—myself included—must monetize our work to cover daily expenses; although I have other sources of income, sometimes I didn’t even realize how the currency’s value had plummeted by morning. The truth is, I’ll only write with my companion, my muse; we’ll bet that everything will get better. Since Venezuela’s economic situation is dire, I’ve learned to prioritize my expenses. >Because if I don’t, it will cause me stress, and I really don’t want that in my personal life. The time will come—and it’s not far off—to reap what we’ve sown, because I will always view the future in a **positive** light and be certain that we will experience it, and that just as we’ve had to swallow the bitter pills, now it will be our turn to savor the sweet rewards that will return to Venezuela.
![IMAG 3 Personas positivas.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dorytagil2022/EpxuAmpw1nD1kRZjAe7YeUCKjEHcUHPYuLSrCReiXS6mBKQdafAGHgLHGiSch2vd9v8.gif) Imagen de mi propiedad tomada del álbum digital personal, editada en Canva.
![Separador Personas positivas.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dorytagil2022/23xL5DyoPaBD6Gh26V4XyWb271d92dYazn141raJsNAx9tkSDkByQefzb7iaB7UddyCoo.gif)

> Gente bella de #Empowertalent, cosecharemos lo que sembraremos. Si nos acostumbramos a sembrar energía positiva, **buena vibra**, sonreír, saludar con alegría, respeto y empatía de la buena, eso será lo que recibiremos, lo que cultivaremos y será contagioso. Nunca lo dudes, así será como funcionará. Porque, ¿quién querrá estar o rodearse de personas que vivirán únicamente en la quejadera, en el pesimismo y arriba con cara amargada? ¡Ayyy, no! Si ya de por sí veremos situaciones difíciles que no podremos controlar y estarán allí, ¿pero podremos obviar? Muy probablemente no, y entonces, para tratar de vivir en paz, habrá que buscarle a todo el lado positivo. Y aunque existieran vientos en contra, tribulaciones, situación país y a nivel internacional que afectara las emociones, sentimientos y el bolsillo, como seres humanos nos veremos en la imperiosa necesidad de buscar la forma de encaminar el talento y rodearnos con **gente positiva, de buena vibra**, que podrá ayudarnos en determinado momento a llenar nuestra mente de energía, esa la que nos moverá en **positivo** a crear cosas hermosas haciendo lo que nos gustara. Desde hace tiempo he trabajado todo lo que ha acontecido en mi vida;. Seguiré viviendo, construyendo y llevaré con tranquilidad lo que la vida me haya de deparar y, si alguna situación me sacara de mis casillas, porque humana soy, inhalaré y exhalaré las veces que fueran necesarias, y me tomaré un delicioso café; ese ha sido uno de mis grandes motivaciones. Seguiré trabajando y no permitiré que nunca opaquen la actitud **positiva** que recorre mis venas, que vino de mis ancestros. Me seguiré moviendo entre gente hermosa, esa que con solo pasar iluminará todo a su alrededor, la que celebrará mis logros, esa que me abrazará con amor. Bailaré con ellas aunque fuera incluso de forma virtual; porque sé que con únicamente mirarlas o escucharlas me dirán que todo estará bien, esa que siempre me apoyará más aún en tiempo de tribulación, y tendré la certeza de que aportarán su granito de arena para ayudarme las veces que fuera necesario y ellos también sabrán que podrán contar conmigo siempre, porque para lograr vivir en bienestar debemos ayudar y ser agradecidos. Porque sabes que será hermoso cuando nos han dicho que iluminamos la vida de otros y algunas veces ni nos percatamos. Los invito a que sigamos rodeándonos de **personas** alegres, **positivas**; eso aportará grandes beneficios a la mente, al cuerpo y al espíritu porque fungirán como alimento para relantizar nuestra química sanguínea, el corazón, las emociones; iluminarán nuestra vida y, por ende, la de los demás. Continuemos moviéndonos en **positivo**, sigamos bailando porque eso moverá la energía; porque al hacerlo, el universo conspirará a nuestro favor, y ¿qué creen que traerá? Pues tal vez cosas buenas bajadas desde el cielo que traerán bienestar a nuestras vidas. >Dear #Empowertalent community, we reap what we sow. If we get into the habit of spreading positive energy, **good vibes**, smiling, greeting others with joy, respect, and genuine empathy, that’s exactly what we’ll receive, what we’ll cultivate, and it will be contagious. Never doubt it—that’s exactly how it works. >Because, who would want to be around or surround themselves with people who live only in complaining, pessimism, and walking around with a sour face? Oh no! We’ll already face difficult situations we can’t control, and they’ll be there—but can we ignore them? Most likely not, and so, to try to live in peace, we’ll have to look for the positive side in everything. >And even if we face headwinds, hardships, and domestic and international circumstances that affect our emotions, feelings, and finances, as human beings we will find ourselves compelled to find ways to channel our talents and surround ourselves with **positive, upbeat people** who can help us, at certain moments, fill our minds with energy— the kind that will move us **positively** to create beautiful things by doing what we love. >For a long time, I have worked through everything that has happened in my life. I will continue to live, build, and calmly accept whatever life has in store for me, and if any situation drives me up the wall—because I am human—I will breathe in and out as many times as necessary and have a delicious cup of coffee; that has been one of my greatest motivations. I will keep working and will never let anything overshadow the **positive** attitude that runs through my veins, which comes from my ancestors. >I will continue to surround myself with beautiful people—those who light up everything around them just by walking by, who celebrate my achievements, and who embrace me with love. I will dance with them, even if only virtually; because I know that just by looking at them or listening to them, they will tell me that everything will be okay—those who will always support me even more in times of trouble—and I will be certain that they will do their part to help me whenever necessary, and they too will know that they can always count on me, because to live in well-being, we must help others and be grateful. >Because you know it will be beautiful when we’re told that we brighten others’ lives, and sometimes we don’t even realize it. >I invite you to keep surrounding ourselves with cheerful, positive people; that will bring great benefits to the mind, body, and spirit because they will act as nourishment to soothe our blood chemistry, our hearts, and our emotions; they will brighten our lives and, by extension, the lives of others. Let’s keep moving in a **positive** direction; let’s keep dancing because that will shift the energy; because when we do, the universe will conspire in our favor, and what do you think that will bring? Well, perhaps good things sent down from heaven that will bring well-being to our lives.
![Separador Personas positivas.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dorytagil2022/23xL5DyoPaBD6Gh26V4XyWb271d92dYazn141raJsNAx9tkSDkByQefzb7iaB7UddyCoo.gif)

What Joshua will be learning is foundational but important aspect of nature, scatter the seed. It is easily forgotten that birds and plants have an interesting relationship. So what's the incentive for these movers? Plants provided them with food. And as these birds or insects like bees, they roam around after eating and will help scatter the seed from point A to point B. How lovely nature works to support each other.

So can Man also scatter the seed? Of course we can, bur personally I take the seed as words of mouth. If we come across good food, good service or good business. body.title: My Journey in Magi Network: A Step-by-Step and Easy Tutorial for Using Magi Network and Providing Liquidity
body.body:
This is my first time on the official [Magi website](https://magi.eco/). I saw this contest post: https://peakd.com/hive/@magi.network/magi-writing-contest-dollar500-usd-in-btc-and-90k-hp-in-delegations-up-for-grabs


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suisver/23tbMGN8Bf9PP9AiRNbLF7U8Qe9Dtdza3F9U5KT1H682u3vZfp2mMFLFAgRLBHiuX1oB7.png)


And I decided to try my luck because I need the money, and I'll also get a delegation for a month, which is good for earning curation rewards and increasing my HP on Hive.

Student life has many expenses, so today I decided to learn about the Magi Network.

What I understood about the Magi protocol was the following:

Through the Magi Network, we can connect our favorite wallet and manage assets from different networks without jumping from app to app. In other words, with Magi, we can do everything at once.

We can move and use tokens from different networks in a single interface.

Smart contracts can be executed natively on any chain. With Magi, we say goodbye to complicated bridges.

Everything happens under your self-custody; you hold the keys and the power.

### What I did to learn about Magi

I went to their website https://magi.eco/

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suisver/23uFwWSoVVjTyeJfcQG69c46LvNyGnDz9AoYwu47W8CtzKRNMJvud1wkN8adgSyu587Px.png)

I logged in with my Hive wallet

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suisver/23z7BFugWptM2zQTiXSvboW3zfcM4Nc5prCxpgW7VtXgo774rvhohLp9oYVpqZiPdwFjB.png)

Here we are on the Magi page, that is, inside My wallet

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suisver/23tv4GuYUZnBZNa8btiLR5VrH3rmAZXdHF1Qc3VjVSqNmx2DPvbsDFSXU9vBPJFUz6k59.png)

I go to DEPOSIT

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suisver/23tv6RkXSTfcRhZDBB35WR7279zAVyR3uCF8VNtaxbgDkY1y24S27dMarvWyEGSycNj6Z.png)

I select that I want to deposit Hive


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suisver/23tRvHw9NHHef4mijiW2HkgAV5WtE14DfMjB2F7wb5GYWyjznBEozSxTZQrsadZ2wrvvS.png)

And I put that I want to deposit 10 Hive in my Magi Network wallet


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suisver/23tkfpbuXDj1hijRJE82UX5FLj92JRv5VYNjMgBPn164Pv3pFDVLEj7aiAwwhDKuu5g9w.png)

I get this Notification

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suisver/Eo6BdcvFUQnxVWbPEjHSN2WDri6qxqHj4PgC795YYY5P6SiFaRbqPcBD6XfEa6ntMT7.png)

And I click **Deposit**

Here is my transaction

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suisver/23uQCGQzy53eBpF28NQBE1vZv7RmMe4TXQuL64SuyCdXpcYweGWjth5J5XGZpy3zCkkjS.png)

I have 10 Hive in my Magi Network wallet

The next step is to deposit HBD from my wallet Hive

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suisver/23t72oxRXBc5LasFikZMRkj9hybHf41BB27TU8rAog56ZyMbhp1wYaVv65nEoUewdwFYB.png)

I'm depositing my 1,115 HBD.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suisver/23tGVuuAy1NCcBtVdTLi355BxtEdAF6MZvVWpSB2GdDTVtukqtsZFchuXFYok77PyihLW.png)

Here we can see our transactions made today, May 13th. 2026


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suisver/23t732e3pEzeu1zkdqKSmm15v8Rud3AsAxAfZUasdKz8ejwsT8XojEZ1VVMd8oJzvk63d.png)

Now comes the exciting part, we are going to add liquidity to the Magi Network pools and the interesting part.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suisver/23tkdkWc5eMbGjoA3hXkRZk1iHbupQ3je3SGbsiWStwZQRKX8FqjYHEuG1R3ujSyk66SV.png)


### Add Liquidity

Pool BTC:HBD
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suisver/Eo43PPcXS77WsE1kMDkzRVVSmr1HL9PPStRongE413kP8jrqcpnR2DxqMKzEeTnvCt5.png)

To create this pool, I need BTC. What I don't know is how to transfer BTC to my Magi Network wallet; I'll learn that along the way.

For now, I'll add liquidity to the HBD:HIVE pool because I have some of these tokens available in my wallet.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suisver/23tv2CNonBSM9ugruPRjLB3dFxVqBmnW5kTG4mp7mmmsaKxr87zG3b8cmCx3jLJVfoGsb.png)

With 0.60 HBD, I can add liquidity to the HBD:HIVE pool.

body.title: Nature's artwork painted in petals 🌸🏵️💮 ~Phone Photography #112
body.body: Hello everyone! 🤗 \n\nGreat to be joining you again guys this week, in this lovely \

contest.

I was walking with a younger cousin one morning and I noticed these flowers. I also found out that she's as passionate as I am with flowers. So I thought, this is great, we two can take photos. 

Sometimes I need that motivation. Being with a like-minded person. Imagine you're with someone who has no passion, then how? Most of the time I just stare at the flowers like my eyes and imagination could take a photo. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmezrdKJyWFdrQCSmdmqCZHduR5JdYwpNtroACf4cLirVH/1778654741798.jpg)

This is Ixora, also called jungle flame and it's commonly called santan at my end. Ixora in orange shade. There are pink, white or yellow shade. Which colour would you prefer? 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZtxhiJkWD7JJvVu2EgD5iL7Lv8GbNBLidVPvHzPpxbgW/1778654741936.jpg)

These are white bougainvillea flowers that matches perfectly with pink oleander flowers.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVoefxfT5Bfnz2o5DydgdP4Fk9PtvVXfRtiN37fQUD78C/1778654742102.jpg)

And these are Madagascar periwinkles. Periwinkles are ornamental flowers due to their vibrant colours and ability to bloom all season. 

I love periwinkles. This is the second year I purchased different colours because last year, all but one didn't make it when a super typhoon lashed our country.

This specific periwinkle is hardy and very common, so I never purchased this colour. One of these days, I'll share photos of the new ones. At the moment, two lost their flowers because of the strong wind that's continuously lashing at them day in and day out. Hoping for fresh flowers to come out. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdrNojvTSY5GzmGPzAbh753RNncTfY5sJTVgdehD7jFGE/1778655238718.jpg)

That was a great walk and a great time shared with my cousin, such a feel good moment. 

And the commanding beauty of these nature artworks is such a joy to behold.

Good day/evening, everyone! 🤗✨✨✨

body.title: Pulsera de Perlas y Rosas en Tonos Rosados y Dorados [ESP/ENG]
body.body:
<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcT42Wr1bJM6ADzCZzn9Xzsgyfj4T5C3QKza2CzoAHsT6/1000203797.jpg)</center>
<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeVb885L7WKkrhPM5cihrA27qUFqL4buuk4MEhueGygKu/espa_ol_jewelry_dafne25.gif)</center>

Buenas tardes queridos amigos de Hive y DIYHub cómo están?, en esta tarde tan hermosa les quiero compartir como he hecho esta nueva pulsera de perlas con rosas doradas y rosadas. Es una pieza deslumbrante y sofisticada, cuyo brillo natural y delicados detalles florales realzan cualquier estilo con un toque de elegancia única. Esta creación no solo es hermosa a la vista, sino que destaca por ser un proyecto increíblemente fácil y rápido de realizar, ideal para quienes buscan resultados espectaculares en poco tiempo, además de que el diseño de esta pulsera es simplemente encantador.

# ***<center>Los Materiales que vamos a necesitar son:</center>***

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaK9y1sJjPmEiL4UymoXqzsc2h1C4NZi95UhJNYjLBkbZ/1778709947167.jpg)</center>

<center> 20 Perlas de color blanco y tamaño mediano 
 6 Cuentas en forma de rosa de color rosado 
4 Cuentas en forma de rosa de color dorado 
24 Cristales de 3mm color rosado 
24 Cristales de 3mm color dorado 
Mostacillas de color blanco
Broche
Argolla
1,5 mt de nylon 0,40</center>

# ***<center>Procedimiento</center>*** 

____________________________________________
**<center> 🩷 1er Paso </center>**
____________________________________________
<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQsEMvXw5BVNeJ22c5v8Ed4Vx7FGWRzKwM7wxqx9GzxUC/1778709985548.jpg)</center> 

Insertamos en el nylon 5 mostacillas blancas, el broche, 5 mostacillas blancas más y cruzamos los nylon con una nueva mostacilla blanca. Llevamos este aro de mostacillas al centro para aprovechar el nylon al máximo, insertamos en cada lado 5 mostacillas blancas más y cruzamos por un cristal rosado.
____________________________________________
**<center>🩷 2do Paso</center>**
____________________________________________
<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSepNZCYHGjVbagZywWn2kygasskfZZ9JLLCyiqpWSZo6/1778710023846.jpg)</center> 

En cada nylon añadimos un cristal rosado y cruzamos por un nuevo cristal rosado, en cada nylon añadimos un cristal dorado, cruzamos por una mostacilla de color blanco, añadimos un nuevo cristal dorado en cada nylon y cruzamos en el cristal rosado opuesto a donde nos encontramos. Repasamos los cristales rosados de los lados y cruzamos nuevamente por el último cristal rosado del extremo. Luego, en cada nylon añadimos una mostacilla de color blanco, una perla, una mostacilla , una cuenta en forma de rosa de color rosado, una mostacilla, una perla, una mostacilla y cruzamos por un nuevo cristal de color rosado.

____________________________________________
**<center>  🩷 3er Paso</center>**
____________________________________________
<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWdG66BDv13pbEcdsoikFG1j2cRCWbguazN7UKx7SuzV4/1778710024085.jpg)</center> 
 
En cada nylon añadimos un cristal rosado y cruzamos por un nuevo cristal rosado, en cada nylon añadimos un cristal dorado, cruzamos por una mostacilla de color blanco, añadimos un nuevo cristal dorado en cada nylon y cruzamos en el cristal rosado opuesto a donde nos encontramos. Repasamos los cristales rosados de los lados y cruzamos nuevamente por el último cristal rosado del extremo. Luego, en cada nylon añadimos una mostacilla de color blanco, una perla, una mostacilla , una cuenta en forma de rosa de color dorado, una mostacilla, una perla, una mostacilla y cruzamos por un nuevo cristal de color rosado.

____________________________________________
**<center> 🩷 4to Paso</center>**
____________________________________________
<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ5VVqXU8xmABVhThR9mEzqija91akDzsJw7Uz7X72RUw/1778710024305.jpg)</center>

Repetimos los pasos 2, 3 y 2 respectivamente para completar el largo de la pulsera. En cada nylon añadimos un cristal rosado y cruzamos por un nuevo cristal rosado, en cada nylon añadimos un cristal dorado, cruzamos por una mostacilla de color blanco, añadimos un nuevo cristal dorado en cada nylon y cruzamos en el cristal rosado opuesto a donde nos encontramos. Repasamos los cristales rosados de los lados y cruzamos nuevamente por el último cristal rosado del extremo. 
____________________________________________
**<center> 🩷 5to Paso</center>**
____________________________________________
<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdPEdysJaxunGtzaaYeyf2ZFvn9ycC2E5Va53SqKBZLAM/1778710024545.jpg)</center>

En cada nylon añadimos 5 mostacillas de color blanco y cruzamos por una nueva mostacilla, en uno de los nylon añadimos 5 mostacillas blancas, la  argolla, 5 mostacillas blancas más y hacemos un nudo doble para asegurar bien la pulsera. Cortamos el hilo que ha sobrado y listo, terminamos nuestra nueva pulsera.

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRx5cM4vYdawnfH91r8aoDQvQ5s6cRWbSDJhimLHqeLMN/1778710024745.jpg)</center> 

*<center>Espero que les haya gustado
Hasta la próxima 👋
Que tengan una bendecida noche</center>*

# ***<center>Créditos</center>***

<center>Fotos de mi autoría, tomadas con un celular Samsung Galaxy A12
Traductor: App DeepL
Editores de fotos usado: editor de fotos Canva y FotoCollage</center>

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQCJhj2RSUaQuyhW7Tocn5v21njNQ74MbU7Aj28aKhkUZ/english_jewelry_dafne25.gif)</center>

Good afternoon, dear friends at Hive and DIYHub! How are you? On this beautiful afternoon, I’d like to share with you how I made this new pearl bracelet featuring gold and pink roses. It’s a stunning and sophisticated piece whose natural luster and delicate floral details enhance any style with a touch of unique elegance. This creation isn’t just beautiful to look at—it also stands out as an incredibly easy and quick project to make, perfect for those looking for spectacular results in no time. Plus, the design of this bracelet is simply charming.

# ***<center>The materials we’ll need are:</center>***

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaK9y1sJjPmEiL4UymoXqzsc2h1C4NZi95UhJNYjLBkbZ/1778709947167.jpg)</center>

<center> 20 medium-sized white pearls 
 6 pink rose-shaped beads 
4 gold rose-shaped beads 
24 3mm pink crystals 
24 3mm gold crystals 
White seed beads
Brooch 
Hoop 
1.5 m of 0.40 mm nylon</center> 

# ***<center>Instructions</center>*** 

____________________________________________
**<center> 🩷 Step 1 </center>**
____________________________________________
<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQsEMvXw5BVNeJ22c5v8Ed4Vx7FGWRzKwM7wxqx9GzxUC/1778709985548.jpg)</center> 

Thread 5 white beads onto the nylon cord, followed by the clasp, then 5 more white beads, and cross the nylon cords with a new white bead. Bring this bead loop to the center to make the most of the nylon cord, thread 5 more white beads on each side, and cross them through a pink glass bead.
____________________________________________
**<center>🩷 Step 2</center>**
____________________________________________
<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSepNZCYHGjVbagZywWn2kygasskfZZ9JLLCyiqpWSZo6/1778710023846.jpg)</center> 

On each nylon thread, add a pink crystal and cross through a new pink crystal; on each nylon thread, add a gold crystal, cross through a white seed bead, add a new gold crystal on each nylon thread, and cross through the pink crystal opposite where you are. We go over the pink crystals on the sides and cross back through the last pink crystal at the end. Then, on each nylon thread, we add a white seed bead, a pearl, a seed bead, a pink rose-shaped bead, a seed bead, a pearl, a seed bead, and cross through a new pink crystal.

____________________________________________
**<center>  🩷 Step 3</center>**
____________________________________________
<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWdG66BDv13pbEcdsoikFG1j2cRCWbguazN7UKx7SuzV4/1778710024085.jpg)</center> 
 
On each nylon thread, add a pink crystal and cross through a new pink crystal; on each nylon thread, add a gold crystal, cross through a white seed bead, add a new gold crystal on each nylon thread, and cross through the pink crystal opposite where you are. Go over the pink crystals on the sides and cross again through the last pink crystal at the end. Then, on each nylon thread, add a white seed bead, a pearl, a seed bead, a gold rose-shaped bead, a seed bead, a pearl, a seed bead, and cross over a new pink crystal.

____________________________________________
**<center> 🩷 Step 4</center>**
____________________________________________
<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ5VVqXU8xmABVhThR9mEzqija91akDzsJw7Uz7X72RUw/1778710024305.jpg)</center>

Repeat steps 2, 3, and 4 respectively to complete the length of the bracelet. On each nylon strand, add a pink crystal and cross through a new pink crystal; on each nylon strand, add a gold crystal, cross through a white bead, add a new gold crystal on each nylon strand, and cross through the pink crystal opposite where you are. We go over the pink crystals on the sides and cross again through the last pink crystal at the end. 
____________________________________________
**<center> 🩷 Step 5</center>**
____________________________________________
<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdPEdysJaxunGtzaaYeyf2ZFvn9ycC2E5Va53SqKBZLAM/1778710024545.jpg)</center>

On each string, add 5 white beads and thread through a new bead. On one of the strings, add 5 white beads, the  ring, 5 more white beads, and tie a double knot to secure the bracelet. Cut off the excess string, and that’s it—we’ve finished our new bracelet.

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRx5cM4vYdawnfH91r8aoDQvQ5s6cRWbSDJhimLHqeLMN/1778710024745.jpg)</center> 

*<center>I hope you liked it
See you next time 👋
Have a blessed night</center>*

body.title: God Answered Their Prayers
body.body:
Greetings, everyone!


I want to share with Jesus joy in my heart. This morning I woke up to great news that a queen has been born. He is my sister from Akwa Ibom, a popular fashion designer in the world in the person of Veekee James. A public figure on all al media platforms. She has been married since 2024 without a child.


In my small mind, I thought she wanted to enjoy herself before she started the journey. I didn't know that in her closet, she was crying and asking God for the fruit of the womb. 

According to her, God answered her prayers; she and her husband desired a baby girl, and God gave it to them at the appointed time.


She said this verse:

>1 Samuel 1:27 For this child I prayed; and the LORD hath given me my petition which I asked of him:

![1778706720338.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/peckypeace/23x1HpLb3EzQj874Fu6dU19Kr7EJKkd3eBo7BN38QUP3Bti2WuwUwYKnisFy1rRvxfUiZ.jpg)


[Source](https://www.facebook.com/100081286240789/posts/993168183402714/?app=fbl)

Her patience, faith, and hope weren't in vain as they yielded the fruit of a miracle and testimony. 

They have been waiting, desperate to see a positive pregnancy result, after attempting several times. God showed up when they didn't expect and granted their hearts' desires.

This shows that God is not quiet about your situation, He is working for your good even in silence. Waiting for the appointed time for your testimony to come into manifestation. Continue to keep your faith alive, He is working things out for your own good. 


In any situation you are in, don't give up. He is right there with you. God's delay is not God's denial. In that season of waiting, hold onto Him firmly through His word and prayers and keep your thoughts positive, and always give thanks to Him for He can do more than you ask for.


![1778710052129.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/peckypeace/23wgabPnWEJSEyaRTJS7RAgJ5XB3e79kmDr9579kv4yx2oCdS7Wmdy5bZGpG9cu7ASW3b.jpg)


[Source](https://www.facebook.com/100001483677020/posts/26498404666458962/?app=fbl)

When he promised, He will bring it to pass. He is not a liar, not fail at His spoken words. 

God is faithful, truthful, merciful, and loving to His children. 

The Bible says that those who believe and have faith in God will be rewarded.

Thank you, Jesus, for answering our secret prayers. Amen.

_**I love you lord**_

---

I created a video of utter moshing using TouchDesigner, a superior 2D and 3D creative platform. The core of this project involves a custom Switch component that drives audio reactive visuals, with video choices dynamically responding to sound input. While the video selections could be more compelling, sourcing quality copyright free movement footage remains challenging.

TouchDesigner proved ideal for this project due to its lightweight performance profile. Running on my 2018 laptop which typically makes creative work cumbersome, the platform remains efficient and responsive. However, the system can still be overloaded when adding excessive shaders and particle effects.

Despite these limitations, TouchDesigner's streamlined design makes it accessible for resource constrained workflows while maintaining professional creative capabilities.
I'd like to work on this and continue to improve.
@corpsekaizen

body.title: The significance of Emotional Intelligence in today's world
body.body:
One of the greatest areas of life that shouldn't be taken for granted is the emotion. Thank God for the recent discovery on how emotion can be tamed and utilize for more efficiency. Emotional Intelligence is an integral part of human endeavor. It involves how people communicate, relate with others, handle conflicts and other life challenges. In family, workplace, ministries and the society emotional Intelligence holds a deep grip and enable individuals and organizations to understand how to respond and deal with emotional issues.

There are lots of advantages of emotional Intelligence which I would like to share. Emotional Intelligence helps one to understand or know strength, weaknesses and other feelings. When you know yourself, it would be very easy to relate and communicate with people without stress. It makes relationship healthy and more stable. Therefore in relationship and communication, emotional improves self awareness.

Another significance of Emotional Intelligence is that it helps to better his or her communication skills. In every relationship, communication is key. It strengthens relationship. Most marriages and organizations today don't know how to manage the emotions of their staff and customers sometimes if this is neglected, it could lead staff leaving to look for a better workplace.

Emotional Intelligence enhances empathy. Empathy is the capability to understand and share the feelings of another person. In communication and relationships, empathy creates emotional and increases trust level the reason being that people feel valued and loved. Most organization deployed this method which helps them in customer retention.

Relationship crack a lot because of the lack of emotional Intelligence. Conflict management in relationship is achieved via emotional Intelligence. Understand the stand point of one another. Every human being wants to feel loved and cared for. I used to say that every human being have a particular password or key that you could use to unlock. You can't go far if you don't apply good emotional Intelligence strategy.

Thanks so much for reading through my entry for this edition.

body.title: We Enjoyed the Old Days Because We Had No Choice
body.body:
> *The Millennials and Gen Z are probably the luckiest generations because we got to experience life before technology and also life after technology became a major part of the world.*
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZr94tsCM7s73cRqowncAzv5EZXFihrvguxcfxjy5ERB3/image.png)
[source](https://pixabay.com/photos/camera-photographer-woman-lens-5149838/) *As a millennial, I have experienced both sides, and honestly? I will choose this era with technology any day over life without it.* *I know many people try to comfort themselves by saying life before the internet and technology was better, but I believe that is mostly nostalgia. Trust me, if most people were sent back to those days after experiencing modern life, they would miss this era badly and regret ever saying the past was better*. *Back in the early 2000s, I lived alone with my sister in a newly developing area. Our parents worked in the city and only came around once in a while, mostly on weekends.* *We couldn’t even reach my dad whenever we wanted because phones were expensive back then. Unlike today, when even a 7-year-old can own a phone, communication was difficult and limited. I hated that feeling of not being able to talk to my parents anytime I wanted.* *Life back then was honestly tough. Our only source of entertainment was the television[don't forget TV is also Technology], and sometimes NEPA would not bring light for days. We stayed most of the time indoors because the environment was still bushy, and we were scared of wild animals outside.*
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSYM2BpsRVXHvwz5sSUafWBqCKxyjam2sSeK8uQF3u3rb/image.png)
[source](https://pixabay.com/photos/telephone-vintage-connection-7039641/) *Things changed a little when my mum came to stay with us after my sister left for school. My mum was fearless. She created a small path behind the house that connected to another street, and through that path, I started making friends and spending more time outside*. *No lies, I enjoyed life without technology, but that was only because technology did not exist around us then. We can’t miss what we never had*. *But if I were to go back in time now after experiencing life with technology, I would be extremely frustrated.* *Here are my reasons*: **Work aspect**: *Life has gone beyond farming, fishing, blacksmithing, and the kind of hard labor our forefathers did. Today, people can work remotely and earn money without standing under the hot sun all day. I honestly cannot sacrifice this life just to go back to endless physical struggle to survive.* **Connection and knowledge**: *We are far more informed now. We know what is happening around us, in our country, and even across the world, all thanks to technology and social media.* *I do not want to go back to an era where the only news I know is what happens on my street or in my neighborhood. That life was too limited*. *Today, we can connect with people from different countries and cultures without leaving our homes. We learn about other tribes, traditions, and lifestyles through our phones*. *Technology may have its disadvantages, but one thing is certain: it has made life easier, faster, and more connected*

body.title: Fresh lettuce, fresh onion, tomatoes in the ground, and a sub-6 run [#poprzeczka May 2026 #13]
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNibNabc5DA9kJ3erUF2CvjA6tknLiryo4HeHvXHV9zuW/image.png) ### Office day — from home, but not lighter A long day at the desk, even if the desk was at home. Several emergencies popped up, one after another. By the end of it, the feeling was that not much had actually moved forward. The kind of day where the office work — remote or not — ends up feeling quite useless. ### Afternoon errand — dad's gardening run A bright spot appeared in the afternoon. I drove my dad to the store to pick up gardening supplies. His car, my role as designated driver — a small but proper errand that felt better than any Zoom call. As a reward, I came home with **fresh lettuce and fresh onion**. Even better. ### Late evening — planting in the dark Back home, the real work began. Five tomato stalks went into the ground. Two haskap bushes were replanted. By the time I finished, it was already dark. Soil under the fingernails and a few things in the ground that will be there next spring — that counts as something. ### Night — doggy walk and a 4K run A doggy walk to loosen up, followed by a 4 km run at a **sub-6:00/km pace**. The legs felt it, the lungs enjoyed it. A proper reset after a day that had gone nowhere fast. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXzL6Ewh6QvvBnyWexNQtSdtSg4emggVyNVQnVe4hqq9c/image.png) ### The #poprzeczka Day **13** of May. The bar was set at **13,000 steps**. The official count stopped at **6,300** — not even halfway. This month's #poprzeczka challenge is over for me. The pattern from the last couple of months continues: strong start, steep drop around day 11–13, and the rest of the month playing catch-up with no real chance. Never mind. The month still brought runs, gardens, lettuce, tomatoes, haskaps, and a good movie night earlier in the week. It was great nevertheless. ### Highlights | Stat | Value | |------|--------| | Total steps | 6,300 | | Run distance | 4.0 km | | Run pace | sub-6:00/km | | Activity type | Running, Walking, Gardening | | Extra activity | Dad's store run, planted 5 tomato stalks, replanted 2 haskap bushes | | Mood | Long office day, gardening satisfaction | | Goal | #poprzeczka May day 13 — 13,000 steps ❌ | **better and better** :ervin :lemark > 🤖 The words in this post were conjured by an AI assistant (Perplexity Comet), working from the human's notes, step counts, and lived experience. body.body:
Ich behaupte, dass bei toxischen Beziehungen keine echte Liebe im Spiel ist, auch wenn das Opfer seine Sehnsucht nach dem anderen als solche empfindet. Der toxische Part hat ein Traumaband erzeugt mit unterschiedlichen Methoden. Das geht bis hin zu biochemischen Veränderungen im Gehirn. Es läuft meist so subtil ab, dass es nicht bemerkt wird. Auch nicht vom Umfeld, das sogar von manchen Tätern mit eingebunden wird. Es ist keine Unvernunft, sondern eher Machtlosigkeit und das Wissen, dass das Gegenüber sich falsch verhält währt oft nur kurz bis das Traumaband stärker wirkt. In etwa vergleichbar mit einer Droge. Viele Abhängige wissen, dass es nicht gut ist und dass sie ohne besser dran sind, aber ohne zu sein ist für sie nicht vorstellbar. 

Da sind wir dann bei dem selbst, das zurück reist und sich dieses Wissen vermittelt, vollumfänglich, um es zu verstehen. Wie handeln toxische Menschen und wie nahe sollte man sie an sich ran lassen. Das kann man auch in der Gegenwart anwenden und anderen helfen, es zu begreifen. Falls sie es annehmen können, denn man verbiegt damit quasi die Nadel Stück für Stück.  

Bei einem Job dürfte das einfacher sein das damalige Ich zu überzeugen, denn da kann man aufdecken, dass z.B. der Chef ein Betrüger ist, der nicht zahlen wird, wenn man finanziell in Vorleistung geht.
