Se trata de arcontes nuevos que se incorporarán al meta de moderno y siempre que se anuncian nuevos arcontes, es sinónimo de buenas noticias. Vamos a revisar.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/EoASXtDE6K3hnpgso5uZGyzW1apMk4WHNoZSV8bPaZNYTEzeNUx1ZHY9nR7FTdfa6zJ.png)

> Okay, if we project ourselves into the immediate future, a future without the infamous legacy of the Rebellion set, we have 6 rare archons and 7 legendary archons that arrived via airdrop/conflict, the latest and most recent being Dragonlord Mancer. There would be 13 Archons, each with modifiers and tactical abilities that can make all the difference on the battlefield, hence the importance of having each one. These 13 Archons can reach 18 if we include the Foundation Archons, and at that point I thought we wouldn't see any more Archons in the current Modern meta. But then these new conflicts were announced, adding 6 more Archons, the first of which is Meredrool. > Bien, si nos proyectamos hacia el futuro inmediato, un futuro sin el legado infame de la edición Rebellion, tenemos entonces 6 arcontes raros y 7 arcontes legendarios que llegaron vía airdrop/conflict, siendo el último y más reciente, Dragonlord Mancer. Sumarían 13 arcontes, cada uno de ellos con modificadores y habilidades tácticas que pueden hacer la diferencia en el campo de batalla, de allí la importancia de contar con cada uno de ellos. Son 13 arcontes que puede llegar a 18 si sumamos a los arcontes Foundations, y hasta aquí pensé que ya no tendríamos más arcontes en el meta actual de moderno. Pero entonces se anunció estos nuevos conflictos que añadirá 6 arcontes más, siendo el primero de ellos Meredrool.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23wgDEap2dajgYAZBwpY9rciqGFGxVZqBcoUVFpRpKutbdhZcDQtoawgLE8PHsYoBchJe.png)

> Meredrool is a legendary Archon with 3 mana, and he also offers a tactical ability: Reckless, which affects 2 allied units. In general, it's sufficient for a 3-mana Archon. What's interesting is its legendary rarity because, looking back, in Untamed with the Azmaré Dice miniset, we had rare Archons. In Chaos Legion with the much-maligned and forgotten Riftwatchers (I still don't understand the disdain Splinterlands showed for being released so quickly from this miniset and plunging into the abyss that was Rebellion), we had epic Archons for the second time, since we got the first ones in the Beta/Orb miniset. So, this is definitely the first time a miniset has offered us legendary Archons to complete the entire Conclave Arcana set. > Meredrool es un arconte legendario de 3 de mana, y nos ofrece además de 1 habilidad táctica que es Reckless a 2 unidades aliadas. En general es suficiente para un arconte de 3 de mana, lo interesante es su rareza legendaria porque si lo vemos en retrospectiva, en Untamed con el miniset Azmaré Dice tuvimos arcontes raros, en Chaos Legion con la maltratada y tirada al olvido Riftwatchers (sigo sin entender el desprecio que tuvo Splinterlands por salir lo más pronto de este miniset y lanzarse al abismo que fue Rebellion) tuvimos arcontes épicos por segunda vez ya que los primeros, los conseguimos en el miniset Beta/Orb. Por lo que en definitiva es la primera vez que un miniset nos ofrece arcontes legendarios para así completar todo el set Conclave Arcana.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23xA2ERCh6u6JLMM1q6cdh99Sv6H1gjh5kvUFKZ6z5xbThXpsjPapoaZMoZHWy5aAMF9W.png)

> The interesting thing is that this Reckless ability reinforces what I've been saying in other posts about the characteristics of the new meta. The Reckless/Painforge pairing will be the hallmark not only of the current meta configuration but also of the future meta structure in the medium and long term. It's no coincidence that Portia Nyr, the star card of Conclave Arcana, has the Painforge ability to benefit from units with the Reckless ability. This promotional card, Portia Nyr, is equally interesting; it's rare to see Splinterlads create a card set whose purpose revolves around the ambitions of a single card. I wonder if this strategy will work and if Portia will become a memorable card for a long time, or if, on the contrary, she'll become just another promotional card that faded into obscurity like Heloise the Hollow. Do you remember her? > Lo interesante es que esta habilidad Reckless, viene a reforzar lo que venía diciendo en otros post sobre las características del nuevo meta. el par Reckless/Painforge será la impronta no solo de la actual configuración que tiene el meta, sino de la futura estructura que tenga el meta en el mediano y largo plazo. No por nada la carta protagonista de Conclave Arcana que es Portia Nyr, cuenta con la habilidad Painforge para beneficiarse de unidades con la habilidad Reckless. Es igualmente interesante esta carta promocional: Portya Nyr, es decir, es raro ver a Splinterlads crear una edición de cartas cuyo propósito gire entorno a las ambiciones de una sola carta, me pregunto si esta estrategia funcionará y Portia se convierta en una carta memorable por mucho tiempo o si por el contrario se convierta en otra carta promocional más que terminó en el olvido como Heloise the Hollow ¿Se acuerdan de ella?
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/EoprXjB3x4ZgSnVUfiB3cZd7c6jVUWSTZiXBv8NvFHzYR4FY23mKbSCZ4K9qfhFztk7.png)

> Regarding her Divine Construct lineage, there are currently only three units that share this lineage in Modern. If we expand to Wild, we'd have ten such units. Personally, my favorite unit, and one I still frequently use in Brawls and tournaments, is Voidmaw from the Chaos Legion set. > En cuanto a su linaje de Divine Construct hay actualmente solo 3 de estas unidades que comparten este linaje en moderno, si lo ampliamos a wild, tendríamos 10 unidades de este tipo. En lo particular mi unidad favorita y que aún sigo usando frecuentemente en Brawls y torneos es Voidmaw de la edición Chaos Legion.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23uEwtZxCb6MMcFCzysiKxKe1nXLLpcc1pt3XLC3Eeh7k6msZqVMQkB4tYKxXvZnJbVKq.png) ***Voidmaw***

> Alright, friends, we have 6 days to prepare for this conflict. My dear @mirlenyjerez has inspired me to buy at least one cart. As my hatred and contempt for all the bad things Rebellion left behind is fading, I'm thinking of buying one or two of these items and seeing if I can acquire this archon and the next ones that come out. > Bien amigos, tenemos entonces 6 días para prepararnos para este conflicto. Mi estimada @mirlenyjerez me ha contagiado las ganas de comprar al menos una carreta, como ya se me esta pasando el odio y desprecio por todo lo malo que dejó Rebellion estoy pensando en comprar 1 o 2 de estos objetos y ver si tengo la posibilidad de adquirir este arconte y los próximos que salgan.
![SPL sponsor 1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23t7hC4jEuXVeQxNBaPU9Am7xvdCnSufDr1kqC7J9UjnCURXity2f3J1417iUN6Wytdu8.png)
# Brawls

> Today was the closing of the guild battles for this week. It's the third time I've been assigned to the Silver League with all the cards, and I'm still having trouble adapting. I'm still thinking about lineups as if I were in the Gold League, and that's cost me a few losses. The good news is that we secured first place for the third week in a row, which has given us a good amount of SPs for staking, as well as merits to buy our Gladius cases. > Hoy tuvimos el cierre de las batallas de gremios esta semana, es la tercera vez que soy asignado a la refriega de plata con todas las cartas y aún me cuesta adaptarme sigo pensando las alineaciones como si estuviera en la liga de oro y eso me ha costado algunas derrotas. La buena noticia es que hemos asegurado el primer lugar por tercera semana seguida, lo que nos ha sumado una buena cantidad de Sps para el staking, así como méritos para comprar nuestras gladius cases.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23tbMPWuRT2dr5aMTj2ksvmcFoWn3aMq1YWbWmRqW25j699WDNtZcimAnMyEgNbNzDGpH.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23tbPF8wVBhV16RbqEPqB1hEQMs9CSkRKBCy1GdpP6QuTBQYGU8Huj6kJXMYcsmdvssyE.png) --|--

> Among the standout battles, the first was this one using Possibilus the Wise. This was undoubtedly one of the most devastating Water-class Archons in the CL era! Even now, facing the most recent legendary archon from Arcane Conclave, it remains a very powerful archon. If you don't already have it, you should at least consider getting it to level 1 or 2 since it's very cheap on the market. > Entre las batallas destacadas, la primera fue esta utilizando Possibilus The Wise, este sin duda que fue uno de los arcontes más devastadores de la clase agua en la era de CL! Incluso ahora, enfrentando el arconte legendario más reciente de Conclave Arcana, sigue siendo un arconte muy potente, si aún no lo tienes, deberías pensar al menos en tenerlo nivel 1 o 2 ya que esta muy económico en el mercado.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme8yRU5ckw7y1zuQgrtGjA3D4upugJjcm3wcK9CML44j4/batalla_1.gif) # Battle Link: https://splinterlands.com/battle/sm_PoYcdnO6iSUMlLF3Ybz8?ref=bulkathos
---

> The second standout battle was with the Anemic ruleset. I already talked about this new ruleset in last week's [post](https://ecency.com/hive-13323/@bulkathos/junior-varsity-anemic-and-enraged), and basically, the strategy here with the Anemic ruleset is to focus your damage on a single point and make sure you're fast. In this context, Katrelba Gobson, who is characterized by her double-hitting ability and great speed, is the ideal gladiator for this battle. She only needs to eliminate one target to activate Bloodlust and become an unstoppable force. > La segunda batalla destacada fue con la ruleset anemic, ya había hablado de esta nueva ruleset en este [post](https://ecency.com/hive-13323/@bulkathos/junior-varsity-anemic-and-enraged) de la semana pasada y pues básicamente la estrategia aquí con la ruleset anemic, es enfocar tu daño en un solo punto y asegurarte de ser rápido. En este contexto Katrelba Gobson que se caracteriza por golpear 2 veces y una gran velocidad es la gladiadora ideal para esta batalla, solo le basta eliminar 1 objetivo para activar el bloodlust y volverse en una fuerza imparable.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYk8jjPc956PiGHhfH2jevQc78SHjgdiiMqJjMe21kB1P/batalla_2.gif) # Battle Link: https://splinterlands.com/battle/sm_d3yQ4vDYG9yRiWweDDNk?ref=bulkathos
---

> We bought a total of four Gladius cases for this round of Brawls. I'm interested in common and rare cards since I'm getting closer to level 7 rare and level 8 common gladiators, so I just need to be consistent in opening packs with each round of Brawls. I could buy merits in the store, but I prefer to invest them in reward cards since with the release of these latest conflicts, I feel the moment when the new card set comes out is near, the one that will finally replace Rebellion and shape the new modern format, so I want to secure at least the common, rare, and epic reward cards. Compramos en total 4 Gladius cases para esta ronda de Brawls, me interesan las cartas comunes y raras ya que me estoy acercando a gladiadoras de nivel 7 raras y nivel 8 comunes, así que solo debo mantenerme constante en la apertura de packs con cada ronda de Brawls. Podría comprar méritos en la tienda pero prefiero invertirlos en cartas rewards ya que con la salida de estos últimos conflictos siento cercano el momento en que salga la nueva edición de cartas, la que finalmente reeplazará a Rebellion y dará forma al nuevo formato moderno, por lo que quiero asegurar al menos las cartas comunes, raras y épicas rewards.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcqkAsRPjwXHjAio6cNMMbaNXZgG837RnLPHVNUDEavjP/opn_gladius_cases_bkths_13_5_26_i.gif) --- ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmed8mv5yNGbC5zJxZYR4CBivGFJRi6NPyQYBx7qyWbY9B/opn_gladius_cases_bkths_13_5_26_ii.gif)

> We got exactly what we were looking for: lots of common and rare cards. Starting with the rares, we have Palidon Rakk. This is a powerful tank, virtually a damage reservoir, for a cost of 7 mana. We're just one copy away from leveling this card to 7 and gaining the ability that increases the maximum health of our entire team by +1. > Obtuvimos justamente lo que estábamos buscando muchas cartas comunes y raras, si comenzamos por las raras, tenemos a Palidon Rakk este es un poderoso tanque, virtualmente un reservorio de daño a un costo de 7 de mana, estamos a solo 1 copia de llevar esta carta a nivel7 y ganar la habilidad de aumenta la vida máxima de todo nuestro equipo en +1.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXf27PpopdM6gYZsn5jJFS3dKMSbKiw1Qhw43DwdB7jQj/image.png)

> Then we have two common cards quite close to level 8. We don't have any yet, which shows how difficult it is to get cards of these rarities to these levels. Katrelba Gobson is the most important. In fact, I use this card more often than Quora Towershead because of its double attack on the back position. Finally, the second common card nearing level 8, we have Whistling Damon. Previously, a card like this wouldn't have interested me, but in the current modern format, cards with snipe are not only more numerous, but there are now more magic units with this ability, so only now are we going to see this card shine. > Luego tenemos 2 cartas comunes bastante cerca del nivel 8, hasta ahora no tenemos ninguna y es una muestra de lo difícil que es llevar las cartas de estas rareza a estos niveles. Katrelba Gobson es la más importante, de hecho uso esta carta más veces que Quora Towershead y es debido a su doble ataque a la última posición. Por último la segunda carta común ya cercana a nivel 8, tenemos Whistling Damon, anteriormente una carta como esta no me habría interesado, pero en el actual formato moderno las cartas con snipe no solo son más, sino que ahora hay más unidades mágicas con esta habilidad, así que solo ahora es que vamos a ver brillar esta carta.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbD7PHtFtfejhiuBzopSXtjBHNu75s6gKEzzA4fbKSYgR/image.png) --- ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNqpPAekYSCwgzXZ6iN4fSdTjxrCTYkqMwoGBSWwBAzeC/image.png)
![Divisor CA.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23tkpM9CW8qgbNnXFyxJfBYbPQbLHt9btyhjkjYqQgqYQTvsdV6RzhyjG6jwikkfoFLMX.png)

> Well, friends, with that, I conclude this Brawls report and update on the new Conflicts phase with the Archons from the Escalation mini-set, which I consider great news. The more Archons added, the greater our possibilities will be in the Modern format. Although I would have liked these Archons to be Epic, an Epic Archon allows you to use level 7 rare units, offering a significant advantage compared to other common, rare, or legendary Archons. On the other hand, they have the advantage of costing 3 mana, allowing them to be used in battles with the Little League ruleset. We'll see the true potential of these Archons when all these Conflicts are released. See you in the next report. Regards. > Bien amigos con esto cierro este reporte de Brawls y actualización de la nueva fase de Conflicts con los arcontes del mini set Escalation que considero una gran noticia.. Mientras se añadan más arcontes mayores serán nuestras posibilidades en el formato moderno, aunque me habría gustado que estos arcontes fueran épicos, un arconte épico te permite usar unidades raras de nivel 7 por lo que ofrecen una gran ventaja en comparación al resto de arcontes comunes, raros o legendarios, pero por otro lado tienen la ventaja de que al ser arcontes con un coste de 3 de mana pueden usarse en batallas con la ruleset little league. Ya veremos cuando salgan todos estos conflictos el verdadero potencial de estos arcontes. Nos vemos en un próximo reporte. Saludos.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQKvah5NvgDrWvjJety1HhoUysywihosy9jjE1qfKjUSn/ending_conclave_ii.gif)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23w2h1pfjUzPGN6DEFEq6UrLcngGWUKNE6TwVbMb3YJDerXKXnvjgXJgjTdBup5CQtbMa.png)
If you are new to splinterlands and want to get into and get to know this game you can do it at the link below: >Si eres nuevo en splinterlands y quieres adentrarte y conocer este juego puedes hacerlo en el siguiente enlace:
# [Bulkathos](https://splinterlands.com?ref=bulkathos)

![Gold league divisor.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23tkk3SVXKQnf291jj1EcgVvhpbK4Tw6xDu5q1rrss572mAKLNQddcW2HVCmHH8CXbda8.png)

![Gold league divisor wild.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23tbM6GZHqUjFZHRmt9wWEuQcRm4j4ggQ4QLRc1cq2bdtBAQ25fZt93je3ZFeQV9sU1jB.png)

The DAO Treasury Report offers insights into the financial structure of the Splinterlands SPS DAO Community, serving as a prime example of decentralized autonomous organizations (DAOs) in action. This community empowers its members to actively participate in financial decision-making.

Liquidity Funds play a pivotal role in stability and growth, being allocated to projects, marketing efforts, and rewards. Liquidity Pools ensure access to liquidity while fostering trust.

In the following report, we will delve into Liquidity Funds and Liquidity Pool positions to illuminate the financial health of the Splinterlands SPS Shards Community. This showcases the transformative potential of DAOs in the crypto world and the participatory nature of the blockchain community.

## Liquidity Pools

### **Liquidity pool positions on SPS-BNB**

The SPS-BNB pool on PancakeSwap is a liquidity pool where users can provide two different cryptocurrencies, namely SPS (Splintershards) and Binance Coin (BNB). This liquidity allows other users to swap cryptocurrencies and pay liquidity fees. In return, those who provide liquidity receive shares in the pool and earn fees based on their share of the liquidity provided. This pool facilitates trading between SPS and BNB on the PancakeSwap platform and supports the liquidity and smooth exchange of these two cryptocurrencies.

body.title: The Value of Letting Someone Finish
body.body:
This might sound simple.
But I think it’s rare.
Letting someone finish what they are saying.
No interruption.
No rushing.
No turning the topic back to yourself.
Just listening.
I didn’t think much about this before. It felt normal to jump into conversations, to respond quickly, to share my own thoughts.
Everyone does it.
But then I started noticing the people who don’t interrupt.
And also… the people who get interrupted the most.
There’s a pattern there.
Usually, it’s the softer voices.
The ones who don’t fight to be heard.
One small moment changed how I see this. A woman tried to share something in a gathering. She wasn’t confident, but she tried.
She didn’t even get to finish.
Conversation moved on.
She didn’t try again.
That moment was small… but it stayed.
Because I realized something — confidence is not something people magically have.
It grows when it’s allowed to grow.
And something as simple as listening can either build it… or quietly destroy it.
Now I try — not always successfully — but I try to stop myself from interrupting.
To give space.
Because sometimes the most powerful thing you can say in a conversation is nothing at all.
Just listening.

body.title: Porto City - Jardins Palácio de Cristal - Part 3 / Riding Portugal
body.body:
![COVER.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23rzF3pn3j4LraD7u2cCarx18b5WV45KbPzENyztQ3huAc3kkqV9NyYgWU2VYxv7rBdP9.jpg) ##### Hello everyone and welcome to my blog :-) As the walk through the Gardens drew to a close, I walked towards one of the highest points of the space, where the garden ceases to be just a garden and begins to function almost like a balcony overlooking the city. The atmosphere there changes somewhat. There is less constant movement, fewer children running around, less scattered noise. People slow down naturally, perhaps because the view forces them to, and so does the staircase. ##### PT À medida que o passeio pelos Jardins se aproximava do fim, fui caminhando para uma das extremidades mais altas do espaço, onde o jardim deixa de ser apenas jardim e passa a funcionar quase como varanda sobre a cidade. O ambiente ali muda ligeiramente. Há menos movimento constante, menos crianças a correr, menos ruído disperso. As pessoas abrandam naturalmente, talvez porque a vista obriga a isso e escadaria também. --- ![20260406_121211.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/243zbwhU1ABUGxQmhAziNHJ68etPcm1DMGgvXcF2Eo1jLq7vrzjTT5KzBJYozUFE8DymT.jpg) ![20260406_120955.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/243zdUSz5qsNnWxBusEYhp2YgoSxJRvLaTvqCqJVeCkE78a14oWCJm2bWG2yEUqxcNjNt.jpg) ![20260406_121004.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23wqnscHir3Be4xfS15ibE3ajVvjV8LLunn1ssL4nsG9ZNqxu29FPzDx9RnFwwRjXm4N7.jpg) ![20260406_121158.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23u65K7BHgkpwgpzeoVwVaKNDynWw7gnJ9G74G7WPYXaiAMkUF1oN6RS1nX2CdR26gjFW.jpg) ![20260406_121100.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23wgN8nzwBZdFjnxwXs63RWpXYxnBNh3yg2Q8hhTKU2WgLZPttgGcoLWFKg6FVA9PWCMf.jpg) ![Untitled-1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/EnymeWrmhSU78wMzJahA3HNMn7fja3hxMQGfPEyMEZJM3KLTfXNA89yMUNpMgmZyvpY.png) From the top of the hill, the Douro River opens up completely. Down below, the city operates at a different speed. Cars crossing the bridges, people walking hurriedly along the banks, small gatherings near cafes and terraces. Everything is far enough away to lose its aggressiveness. From up there, even the traffic seems silent. ##### PT Do topo da colina, o Douro abre-se por completo. Lá em baixo, a cidade funciona noutra velocidade. Carros a atravessar as pontes, pessoas a caminhar apressadas pelas margens, pequenas concentrações junto aos cafés e esplanadas. Tudo distante o suficiente para perder agressividade. Dali de cima, até o trânsito parece silencioso. --- ![20260406_120806.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/243WVy4GQQcCVHBd1zRFTaV9cKYkLyU9zV6UmyBGydx6PfYnCwChhcgTPYZvktGayitGB.jpg) ![20260406_120826.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23ynNSPGnChTEaJTskEMz2QiH69isx1JthMmfY5daxMp6MdauHWhXmfubZZ9gTQjwVLWv.jpg) ![20260406_120755.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23z7G1BzhZmTJSP5dDbBRK2826pBnbCmrw9pMtGGwnvZEBebDW1B9VZmFhzqh9VSm4t73.jpg) ![20260406_120724.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23zGeFqVt2orkgW5vn79Myz3J5EcFhVPXv9vn8hemfVahE4sFauASUYsn2ZRsoqBTARSL.jpg) ![20260406_120815.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23yd3zqHWXhMZz7YkncrrkSXkLR5DKGdWpPQ6rXkRxsvHcsvopogXiDRWd7Q79oRe4Wpo.jpg) ![Untitled-1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/EnymeWrmhSU78wMzJahA3HNMn7fja3hxMQGfPEyMEZJM3KLTfXNA89yMUNpMgmZyvpY.png) I spent a good amount of time leaning against the stone wall observing the river. Tourist boats went up and down slowly, crossing paths with smaller vessels. There was a strange sense of separation between the two rhythms. Up here, calm, and down there, urgency. ##### PT Fiquei bastante tempo encosta ao muro de pedra a observar o rio. Os barcos turísticos subiam e desciam lentamente, cruzando-se com embarcações menores. Havia uma estranha sensação de separação entre os dois ritmos. Cá em cima, calma e lá em baixo, urgência. --- ![20260406_121305.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/2458NMUZZ4Hzv5HQgHex5PH8KmFipD7wcyNaP1TJMd5ZfCLFcjbdotao6Qa27vEHVWvMv.jpg) ![20260406_121320.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/243M79Q9hwuXgrhivPENgTxziZLCNbMaq64jU7wz3D6ToBNGF62gTrPNspNyLHL6526hn.jpg) ![20260406_121241.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23wqnsatwFuaG8swHX7pfCnd3keizRDKCdT9Dtw2n2piggNc8CFesoAsEfqFVTBQWF1RP.jpg) ![20260406_121223.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/243frcHf6wox4efhKwrJR57zbiKPtzf2HPDhhFLADtcPtzkNjufs8nT3NcW2rRTk97ioy.jpg) ![Untitled-1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/EnymeWrmhSU78wMzJahA3HNMn7fja3hxMQGfPEyMEZJM3KLTfXNA89yMUNpMgmZyvpY.png) Perhaps this was the strongest point of the entire visit. Not because of the imposing view, although it is there, but because of the clear difference between observing the city and being inside it. There is a very specific tranquility in watching the movement without being part of it for a few minutes. ##### PT Talvez tenha sido esse o ponto mais forte de toda a visita. Não pela imponência da vista, embora ela exista, mas pela diferença clara entre observar a cidade e estar dentro dela. Há uma tranquilidade muito específica em olhar para o movimento sem fazer parte dele durante alguns minutos. --- ![20260406_121414.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/243WRx7E1nFULuLG25YnrS6271o73XrY7u6syQ6Pp7ow9EViKFAX1JpLLXgWj2Xz1uRw7.jpg) ![20260406_121632.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/242DLX5cpE9oGgXQ9fNdF1tGkcMhgCLYnVUuj8tvTrwzEp5XA1Fy6ixhFdxVufzBxYzsS.jpg) ![20260406_121346.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23uFW8SbWMAaURnf8cbmBRRciHFMJ8wzDhkf3p7h8pqtPbb3kp54jh8vbVSLNaLW7xd8s.jpg) ![20260406_121434.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23wWuGUAHzS9obvz1it8sCm3UuiwiCUFxG55VJqSdzYRpMETSNZvKkhkqFD4mjkCgS8Ax.jpg) ![20260406_121526.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23xebXHfK1HSV2y4a9VHtk3szWKuHPxoTYRHLvanNdjS6EsWiKgq6uFeUaFHyvwTP4SW5.jpg) ![Untitled-1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/EnymeWrmhSU78wMzJahA3HNMn7fja3hxMQGfPEyMEZJM3KLTfXNA89yMUNpMgmZyvpY.png) Here we also find the Chapel of Charles Albert, a discreet but quite striking building. The romantic cenotaph stands out more for its atmosphere than its size. There is something melancholic about the construction. Perhaps because of its more isolated location, perhaps because of the history associated with the exiled king who was honored there after his death. ##### PT Aqui ainda encontramos a Capela de Carlos Alberto, um edifício discreto mas bastante marcante. O cenotáfio romântico destaca-se mais pela atmosfera do que pela dimensão. Há qualquer coisa de melancólico na construção. Talvez pela localização mais isolada, talvez pela própria história associada ao rei exilado que ali foi homenageado após a morte. --- ![20260406_123145.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/245wKkB7cPXseKdz9LXT3qzom2Nq4CLmaqAWPhRgJ4bMVK1kxLc5ZipV4WtiTdXbvYAEU.jpg) ![20260406_122206.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23tvefYg6zARvXTtkn58Cg78Q6paMqgFLLf1v24vCgT1NwBkmrxCmtpxeT3xbs2LHpimo.jpg) ![20260406_122128.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23zS1P3ENjKAUFFk74Hu9pkqwXyJLNdKB19BYZXBmJGXBuJyZ3mqMFcF5s3Rk93fgF5tv.jpg) ![20260406_122152.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23wCBXWRvn8hKSC8ZdmkoQarC6F3nHQSdAF57cf7x939ZH8cvo93TR8NGBEKWsf1SJo9y.jpg) ![Untitled-1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/EnymeWrmhSU78wMzJahA3HNMn7fja3hxMQGfPEyMEZJM3KLTfXNA89yMUNpMgmZyvpY.png) There weren't many people near the chapel. Just a few people sitting on nearby benches and others passing slowly, almost always in silence. I liked that. Further down, already nestled in the hillside, appears the Mirante da Torre da Marca viewpoint. There is a constant movement of people descending to it. There is almost an automatic impulse. To see the tower, to approach, to climb. Some take photos quickly, others take longer trying to find the best angle over the river and the bridges. ##### PT Não havia muita gente junto à capela. Apenas algumas pessoas sentadas nos bancos próximos e outras a passarem devagar, quase sempre em silêncio. Gostei disso. Mais abaixo, já embrenhado na encosta, surge o Miradouro da Torre da Marca. É um movimento constante de pessoas a descer até lá. Há quase um impulso automático. Ver a torre, aproximar-se, subir. Uns tiram fotografias rapidamente, outros demoram-se mais tempo a tentar encontrar o melhor ângulo sobre o rio e as pontes. --- ![20260406_123301.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/244eC7vy1gLbm4ZVSUCWTRabWSp1MBto6f4mHFXuJYgJU1Jjn6wGtfdHtHq7MaxeRahob.jpg) ![20260406_123359.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23ywwA3xLti8s5xHtJ5auvAEGBzTd1vSJ4fSYDjU6JAdPDXzmEyLV1RfFdqG1vVLyCLJS.jpg) ![Untitled-1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/EnymeWrmhSU78wMzJahA3HNMn7fja3hxMQGfPEyMEZJM3KLTfXNA89yMUNpMgmZyvpY.png) I ended up climbing too. The tower itself sparks curiosity precisely because it seems out of place. It's not grandiose, but it functions as a natural point of attraction. From up there, the perspective changes slightly. The river gains more detail, the boats become more present, and the people on the banks cease to be just small moving spots. We returned to the first level. The space was still crowded, but less intensely than hours before. Some people were going home, others remained seated with all the calm in the world. ##### PT Acabei por subir também. A torre em si desperta curiosidade precisamente porque parece deslocada. Não é grandiosa, mas funciona como ponto de atração natural. Lá de cima, a perspetiva muda ligeiramente. O rio ganha mais detalhe, os barcos tornam-se mais presentes, e as pessoas nas margens deixam de ser apenas pequenas manchas em movimento. Voltamos ao primeiro patamar. O espaço continuava cheio, mas de forma menos intensa do que horas antes. Algumas pessoas regressavam a casa, outras continuavam sentadas com toda a calma do mundo. --- ![20260406_123256.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/245wF5MSdgc45ZFk8q4HxxPNA3W57gdEAFXJk6LtW3vQNSpSbqMwUXuxps1irhyAUeCyF.jpg) ![20260406_123338.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23zkrrNUcrvUVCwXsX1djhTvBEAF1sEsbwN3eA69KP1TFpErDRZeQumsueBtAzBtRvozg.jpg) ![20260406_123344.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/2423whePJMNrsu5FkHY75D25LLePFJmdV54qMu2Z9WNETiUfJbjrg97uSWRKHhDv3RG2G.jpg) ![Untitled-1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/EnymeWrmhSU78wMzJahA3HNMn7fja3hxMQGfPEyMEZJM3KLTfXNA89yMUNpMgmZyvpY.png) I left with the feeling of having spent an entire morning amidst different rhythms without ever truly leaving the same place. Between free-roaming animals, tourists, ancient trees, viewpoints, and brief pauses, the garden ended up functioning less as an attraction and more as a temporary refuge in a city full of life. And perhaps that is precisely what continues to make it relevant. It doesn't force anyone to do anything in particular. It simply offers space to pause a little before returning to the noise down below. ##### PT Saí dali com a sensação de ter passado uma manha inteira entre ritmos diferentes sem nunca sair realmente do mesmo lugar. Entre animais soltos, turistas, árvores antigas, miradouros e pequenas pausas, o jardim acabou por funcionar menos como atração e mais como refúgio temporário numa cidade cheia de vida. E talvez seja precisamente isso que continua a torná-lo relevante. Não obriga ninguém a fazer nada em particular. Apenas oferece espaço para parar um pouco antes de voltar ao ruído cá de baixo.
I hope you enjoyed. See you around. Wishing you much peace and health > Those who pass by us do not go alone. They leave a bit of themselves, taking a piece of us.\

title.title: MCGI Topic Review | The best way to live a good teenage life
title.body: > https://youtu.be/5v9TWK6UECE?si=hhiYWGtGRfOxN1d4 Teenage is a most vulnerable time in life. It's a time when many young people are attempting to find out who they are and what their future holds. The challenges that many teenagers are experiencing today are different, e.g. bad friendship, social media pressure, immorality, depression and disobedience. For these reasons, it is best to live well in these teenage years by fearing God, keeping His commandments, having good friends and practicing discipline. I am convinced that in giving God control over a teen's life, it becomes more peaceful and meaningful. The Bible teaches us in Proverbs 1:7 that, “The fear of the Lord is the beginning of knowledge.” This is the first truth to remember: All good life starts with God. I have discovered as a teen that when I pray, study God's word and fellowship, I am stronger in my soul. The word of God is a strong support to me in times of temptation. A young man's way shall be cleansed: by taking heed thereto according to thy word. (Psalm 119:9) Obviously, this scripture tells us that the word of God can lead the teenager to a righteous and clean life. Friendship is another aspect of a good teenage life that is crucial. Our behaviour and our choices are greatly influenced by our friends. Bad friends can cause someone to smoke, drink, steal or commit other sins. I have witnessed a lot of teens ruin their lives due to bad company. In the Bible it is written that in 1 Corinthians 15:33, “Be not deceived: evil communications corrupt good manners.” Our good friends may inspire us to do good and to progress in our spiritual and moral development. I also think that self-control and discipline are quite important to teens. Today, there are a lot of distractions, particularly on social media. Some teens waste too much time watching things that aren't beneficial to their lives. A disciplined teenager will work on his/her education, learning skills, assisting at home, and creating a better future. Remember now thy Creator in the days of thy youth—12:1. That is, our young age is the optimum time to serve God and make a contribution to a life of value. I had a personal experience that deeply impacted me. I wanted to be accepted into a group once, and followed some of my friends on the wrong path. In my heart, I felt it was not right. I recalled an MCGI topic review lesson on living a holy life and pleasing God – not people – that night. I prayed in earnest and chose to come out of that crowd. I didn't find it easy at first and I felt lonely at first, but then I realized that I wouldn't have made the same mistake if I didn't have to make the decision. Since then, I am more careful when it comes to moving around with people and the decisions I make. To sum up, the key to a good teenage life is to put God first, take God's Word seriously, select good friends and live within God's discipline. A teenager can have many difficulties during the teenage years, but with God's guidance, a teenager can have a peaceful life and become a responsible adult. I pray that every teen will learn the importance of living for God while still young, for such a life never goes to waste.

title.title: Medizinprodukte und wie die Preise in die Höhe gehen
title.body:
Hallo Freunde,

wisst ihr was ich immer wieder lustig finde, die Preise von Medizinprodukte. Wenn man sich verschiedene Produkte anschaut, dann gibt es sie oft als Medizinprodukt und als normales Produkt, der unterschied ist nur, dass Medizinprodukte um einiges teurer sind, oft um den Faktor fünf oder mehr. Und woher kommt das ganze? Die Frage habe ich mich auch einmal gestellt und etwas nachgeforscht und es ist durchaus interessant. Es beginnt schon damit das jeder Handschritt im vier Augen Prinzip geschieht, also muss jeder Handschriff sobald er passiert ist durch jemand anderes kontrolliert werden. Meistens wird das realisiert, indem zwei Leute den gleichen Schritt durchführen und sich dann gegenseitig kontrollieren oder man hat jemanden der nur Schritte durchführt und jemanden der das alles nur noch kontrolliert. Und alleine dadurch hat man schonmal den doppelten Personalaufwand, gut sagen wir man hat achtzig Prozent mehr, da man immer eine gewisse Qualitätskontrolle braucht.

Und dann kommen noch andere Faktoren dazu, die Hersteller von Medizinprodukten stellen sicher, dass die Produkte sicher im Umgang mit Patienten sind und wenn etwas passiert, müssen sie dafür haften. Das ist dann immer lustig, wenn auf einmal Rettungsdecken ein Ablaufdatum haben, dass sie vor allem bekommen, weil der Hersteller nicht für alle ewigkeit dafür haften will. Und hier sind wir bei einem Grund für die hohen Preise, die Hersteller müssen sich gegen Folgen von Produktfehlern absichern und entsprechend teuer sind die Haftpflichtversicherungen der Hersteller oder sie müssen Rücklagen dafür bilden. 

Und zu guter letzt, in der Medizin ist es wie im Militär, wenn es funktioniert, fragen viele nicht mehr nach wie viel es kostet. Da kommt mir ein Satz von Krupp in den Sinn, der mal gesagt hat, dass er Waffen herstellt, weil dort keiner nach dem Preis fragt, bei Nägeln aber jeder Pfennig zählt. 

Also in dem Sinne, gehabt euch wohl.

title.title: The Pain Just Won't Go
title.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZTG5oTcU3ptXJZG45KQCX7YSTfnFCUmyUekQ165TrUQD/1000241096.png 
*Image is AI generated.*

It feels ridiculous to try and write about this lower back pain once again just to try and help myself in some way; I mean, I do not even know if this pain is getting out or just building up inside anymore, but it is a pain that I do not know how I will get over any longer. The problem is that the pain won't just go, no matter what I do. That is what is really upsetting; it is as if I am not even trying my hardest to address the problem and just keep suffering the pain.

I was at the hospital on two separate occasions just this past month, I have taken the correct prescription medication, used herbal remedies just to see if any would get me relief and if the pain would go, but the pain will seem like it's gone, then not even over a day it returns again.

What is also worrying is that it doesn't need anything to triggers it just appears for no reason whatsoever, other times it changes position from lower back to my left leg down to my toes. Not only is this painful, but it is mentally draining too.

It is at night time that the pain is at its worst and I no longer look forward to having peaceful night sleep at night because of the pain. It gets worse at night when I lay down on the bed. The only period I am feeling a bit of relief is when I am in motion or standing.

I think this now has to be addressed properly, and what has happened is that I have been told to go and see a specialist hospital, get some scans done and find out what is wrong as to make sure that I have the proper treatment and am not guessing it anymore.

However, along with all of this, what worries me more is that I am currently at a tight corner financially, which is another real issue. Knowing what to do but not being able to do it is another layer of stress It is already hard dealing with the pain itself, but it becomes even much difficult when money become the barrier to getting proper care.

This is now where I find myself, trying to manage the pain and at the same time living with limited resources. It's not an easy situation to be into, and I do not wish it to anyone. 

I think it's right for me to speak out at this point and seek for help. But who do I know that can be of help to me at this critical time of my life? I would just leave it out here in writing, perhaps someone might find interest in it. Therefore I am writing to you now; not because it is necessarily any easier anywhere. I am speaking because at the moment, I really need help from wherever I can get. 

I am just here waiting to see if things ever improve and I hope that I find help soon before the pain gets worse than it's presently.

title.title: Quiet People Are Not Always Heartless
title.body:
Sometimes a person stays silent not because they do not care, but because they are tired.
Explaining everything, defending yourself all the time, clearing every misunderstanding… after a while, these things make a person emotionally exhausted. Then silence becomes easier than words.
A few days ago, I had a small argument with a friend. At first, I thought maybe she would text me herself, explain things, or at least ask what went wrong. But many days passed. No message. No call. In the beginning, I felt angry, but later that anger slowly turned into sadness.
One night, I finally texted her myself. I only wrote this:
“If the friendship really mattered, why did the silence become so long?”
Her reply came after quite some time. She said:
“Sometimes people simply run out of words.”
That one line stayed in my mind. Because honestly, not every silent person is careless. Some people are fighting battles inside themselves that they cannot explain to anyone. They become quiet, distant, and people start thinking they no longer care.
In relationships, we often only notice our own pain. We think the other person has changed, but maybe they are carrying something heavy inside. Some people express pain loudly, while others hide it behind silence.
I feel that nowadays silence has become one of the most dangerous things in relationships. Because when people stop talking, feelings slowly start fading too. Relationships rarely break in one moment; they slowly disappear in long periods of silence.
Now I try not to judge silent people too quickly.
Sometimes silence is also a cry for help — it just needs someone willing to understand it.
Question
Have you ever lost someone who spoke very little but carried a lot inside their heart?

title.body: > Be thankful for what you have. You have no idea how many people would love to have what you've got.\n\nA story is told of a man who was tired of life. Looking at his possessions only reminded him of how wrecked he was. He could swear he was the poorest man. Exhausted, he decided he was going to end his life. He rose and went to the place where he wanted to kill himself. As he tied the rope on a tree, someone who saw him said aloud, \
\n\nThe man looked at the other man who had begged for his pants and realized one thing. He was way better off than him, but on his face he still held that smile that says \

He untied the rope and decided he was going to live, grateful for that which he has. He understood better that he wasn't the worst. There are many people who would love to have what he got.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNS6DU94U9TKeVRmJbVRmV53orHVVnpJyHQhsyM8Z2oPK/1778708192158.png)

Such is life. We never know how blessed we are until we come across people who desire to be in our position. We are not the worst, yet we fill our hearts with worries, while people we are better than are appreciative of the little they have. If we are not grateful for the little we have every day, how can we be grateful when God increases our earnings? Be appreciative. Be thankful for what you have. You have no idea how many people pray and wish to be where you are. You're not the worst. You never will be. Be grateful.

This is the video series for an oil painting 'Wisteria' I did from 2016-2020.  The painting was destroyed in 2021 due to a number of reasons, but mainly: the painting's faulty experimental linseed-epoxide substrait, Covid-19 crushing lockdowns, extreme poverty, family attacks and ongoing US government (Big Tech + Big Media) censorship of me and my 30 years of artwork.

Its not ideal to not be able to show this piece, but I still gained the knowledge of how to do it and invented several useful oil painting mediums & varnishes used in its creation which never yellowed and still cannot be bought anywhere.

I am posting these videos for posterity and for people that are interested in seeing an oil painting created from start to finish in the Baroque style evolved for the 21st century.  I also must have deleted some of the initial videos when I did the quick underpainting, but what still exists, I give to you.

I hope this can be an educational experience as no gallery will show any of my controversial art even today.

title.title: Mi lugar seguro para entrenar 😎🏃🏽‍♀️‍➡️🙌🏽
title.body: > Hoy me toco entrenamiento en el estadio, mi lugar seguro para entrenar, me siento como en un gimnasio al aire libre, ya desde un tiempo atraz son mas los dias que entreno en el estadio que en el asfalto, primero porque me ha tocado entrenar sola, y e estadio esta muy cerca de casa, y estoy segura alli, siempre salir sola al asfalto da un poco de nervios, por lo que cuando no salgo con mi esposo entreno aqui. me siento muy feliz entrenando en el estadio, ya todos me conocen los porteros, es como llegar a mi casa, tambien he conocido mujeres que vienen temprano a entrenar, nos saludamos, hasta ya nos preocupamos cuando vemos que pasan varios dias y no han ido a entrenar. Ademas que el estadio tiene su gramita, florecitas, puedo contemplar el cielo no puedo pedir mas, por eso este espacio se ha convertido en mi lugar seguro para entrenar, y lo mejor de todo que puedo realizar una gran avriedad de entrenamientos aqui, que me preparan para el asfalto. 🙌🏽🙌🏽🙌🏽 --- . >Greetings and blessings Friends.! >

>Today I have a training session at the stadium—my safe space for training. It feels like an outdoor gym. For a while now, I’ve been training at the stadium more often than on the streets, mainly because I’ve had to train alone, and the stadium is very close to home, and I feel safe there. Going out alone on the streets always makes me a little nervous, so when I don’t go out with my husband, I train here. I feel very happy training at the stadium; all the janitors know me now—it’s like coming home. I’ve also met women who come early to train; we say hello to each other, and we even worry when we see that several days have gone by and they haven’t come to train. Plus, the stadium has its little patch of grass and flowers, and I can gaze at the sky—I couldn’t ask for more. That’s why this space has become my safe haven for training, and best of all, I can do a wide variety of workouts here that prepare me for the streets. --- --- Todo el contenido es de mi autoría y las imágenes son de mi propiedad Fotos fueron tomadas con mi HONOR X6a Plus Separador editado en Canva Traducido con [Deepl](https://www.deepl.com) > All content is my own and the images are my property. > Photos were taken with my HONOR X6a Plus > Translated with [Deepl](https://www.deepl.com) > Publisher edited in the application Canva --- --- For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@mcookies/mi-lugar-seguro-para-entrenar)

Así que al llegar al hipermercado Auchan me dí cuenta que tenían varios modelos disponibles pero muy rápido me enamoré de una que además de que se veía muy elegante tenía un excelente precio pues costaba 279 eslotis o 77 dólares aproximadamente y por supuesto era de la marca Qilive modelo Q.5623, así que sin tanto pensarlo compramos esa y sin duda alguna puedo decirl que nos ha encantado. Este robot de cocina es muy fácil de usar pero también tiene algunas indicaciones pintadas sobre él y les cuento que tiene un motor de 1500 vatios además de una capacidad de 5 litros, incluye un bol de acero inoxidable pero también cuenta con 3 accesorios para mezclar, batir y amasar, ya nosotros la hemos usado para hacer tortas y amasar masa para pizza y toda ha salido muy bien, de hecho nos impresionó lo bien y rápido que bate las claras de huevo y como ven en las fotos, también dispone de varias velocidades de funcionamiento, y te indica cuales son las que se usan para cada accesorio, y es que sin duda alguna este robot de cocina nos encantó. So when I got to the Auchan hypermarket, I realized they had several models available, but I quickly fell in love with one that, besides looking very elegant, had an excellent price—it cost 279 zlotys, or about $77—and of course, it was the Qilive model Q.5623. So without giving it much thought, we bought that one, and I can definitely say we’ve loved it. This stand mixer is very easy to use, but it also has some instructions printed on it. It has a 1,500-watt motor and a 5-liter capacity, and it comes with a stainless steel bowl as well as three attachments for mixing, whisking, and kneading. We’ve used it to make cakes and knead pizza dough, and everything has turned out great. In fact, we were impressed by how well and quickly it whips egg whites, and as you can see in the photos, it also has several speed settings, and it tells you which ones to use for each accessory. Without a doubt, we absolutely loved this food processor. So now I recommend it to you. If you love making desserts or baking pizza every week like we do, I’m sure this stand mixer will be very useful to you and you’ll love it just as much as we do, especially given the price—which is very good for all the features it offers.

title.title: The Most Beautiful Animal: The Peacock (En/ Es)
title.body:
> This time, I’m participating in this new challenge from this wonderful community, featuring [THE MOST BEAUTIFUL ANIMAL ](https://peakd.com/hive-174680/@hive-174680/final-results-winner-resultados-finales-ganador), and immediately, an animal came to mind that, ever since I saw it when I was very young, caught my attention with its beauty and elegance—none other than the [Peacock](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pavo_cristatus), the common name by which it is known in my country, though it has other names such as Indian Peacock, Blue-breasted Peacock, or its scientific name, Pavo Cristatus.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/brujita18/23tviP4CC7JChSrMJDb5VE4PjdrJE15WhbJH7Hq5RVt2VdWannrf63MrVtdXqerN5n9ug.png)
So, upon remembering it, I went back to where I first encountered it—a zoo in my city—where they have always kept this species of bird and where they allow them to roam relatively “free” throughout the park grounds. They are not confined to any cages or enclosures; instead, they move freely wherever they please, displaying their beauty and elegance in all their splendor.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/brujita18/23x1BALW5sgCVYnNdU2eNS1g1F9CrvHvrCjKPYvBMYzhfZfCKU4GtiMuvdfWV1J59aDhF.png)
These birds originated in India, from where various historical figures brought them to different countries, where they were welcomed as symbols of great beauty, eventually becoming and integrating into various cultures across several nations. Their history dates back to the years of the Old Testament, that is, before Christ—a rather striking fact, since this animal has been present in various religions in one way or another as a symbol of beauty and even as part of one of the most exquisite dishes among the nobility and warriors.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/brujita18/23xVMSMquHqnS5Vfx2FBsvT1Adj732LK8HdEpvgcAfJDxkZsQX1ZuRNXeJnCPQ4XnSYUq.png)
What really catches the eye is the vibrant color and beautiful pattern of its plumage, which it tends to display in full, proudly showing off its beauty, as if knowing it is being admired; in fact, when I went to take the photos I’m sharing here, it stood right in front of me as if posing for someone who admires it. That little detail caught my attention because generally these animals are quite territorial—that is, they like to be admired, but from a distance—and this one, the star of my post, stood just a few meters from where I was.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/brujita18/23x176gLASTytXH7Qf5u3gf8cC2MgAF7vNeAnDcmpdZD2qRpeca3Y5o7VudmF87DzVSFN.png)
It was as if he knew I just wanted to capture his best angles, and I was actually lucky, because I know from personal experience with my daughters that when they were little, they tried to get close to them during one of our many visits to the park, and the animals chased after them, hahahaha, so I know firsthand that they’re territorial, since they’re wild animals by nature; therefore, they aren’t exactly domesticated and are only displayed in zoos or natural habitats where they can be “free” without being caged.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/brujita18/23xehpa5dqAT3BC4on1uLCQYkTGpbEDWFeib89iNMAKTsXJjJc6YwhMR9DcxgkwmZmSFZ.png)
Because their elusive nature isn’t conducive to domestication, and they’re only raised as ornamental animals, as is the case here. So as I examined it closely and admired the delicacy of its form, its tiny head, its slender blue body, I couldn’t help but think I hadn’t made a mistake in choosing it as one of my most beautiful animals, since that’s undeniably clear; besides letting me take their photos, they posed for me, offered beautiful angles, and were friendly, since it didn’t try to flee or show any inclination to attack me, and just as it approached, it went on its way to continue strolling with its friends.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/brujita18/23vsQTjrSVS4ruuc7M2hg8LayxBseMNPuR1Erj7P8Hvnqz22CRAKib8vagykhHz4yPqnq.png)
I hope you enjoy the beauty of these birds. I also invite my friends @Theshot2414, @solozanot, @roswelborges, and @merit.ahama to participate. Cheers!

Español

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/brujita18/23swpWm6YijWGJshp5TPkX4sF4GNE4Ak2RPvfm2Scq3mboeFdiRBBz79iXc3RBU2FQxGy.png)
En esta ocasión llego a esta nueva propuesta de esta bella comunidad, con [EL ANIMAL MAS BONITO ](https://peakd.com/hive-174680/@hive-174680/final-results-winner-resultados-finales-ganador)y de una vez, vino a mi mente un animal que desde que lo vi siendo muy pequeña llamó mi atención por su belleza y elegancia y no es otro que el conocido como [Pavo Real](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pavo_cristatus), nombre popular en que se conoce en mi país, pero que tiene otros nombres como Pavo Real de la India, Pavo Real de Pecho Azul o con su nombre científico Pavo Cristatus. Entonces, al recordarlo, me fui donde lo conocí, a un zoológico de mi ciudad, donde siempre han tenido esta especie de ave y donde la mantienen relativamente en \

por los espacios del parque, ya que no está en ninguna jaula o espacio para ellos, pues se encuentran transitando libremente por donde les apetece, exhibiendo su belleza y elegancia en todo su esplendor. 


Estas aves tuvieron su origen en la India, desde donde diferentes personajes históricos los fueron llevando a los diversos países y donde fueron recibidos como símbolos de gran belleza, convirtiéndose e integrándose, incluso, en parte de varias culturas en varios países. Su historia se remonta a los años del Antiguo Testamento, es decir, antes de Cristo, cuestión bastante llamativa, ya que este animal ha estado presente en las diferentes religiones de alguna forma u otra como símbolo de belleza e incluso como parte de uno de los platos más exquisitos entre la nobleza y los guerreros. .

Y es que lo que llama más la atención es su gran colorido y diseño hermoso que tiene en su plumaje, que tiende a desplegar en su plenitud, luciendo orgulloso su hermosura, como sabiéndose admirado; de hecho, para cuando le fui a tomar las diferentes fotografías que aquí presento, se paró frente a mí como quien posa para alguien que lo admira. Ese detallazo llamó mi atención porque generalmente estos animales son bastante territoriales, es decir, les gusta ser admirados, pero desde lejos, y este, el protagonista de mi post, se paró justo a unos cuantos metros desde donde yo estaba.

Como que supiera que solo quería tomar sus mejores ángulos y tuve suerte en realidad, porque sé por experiencias personales con mis hijas que cuando estaban pequeñas intentaron acercárseles en una de tantas visitas al parque y ellos la salieron persiguiendo, jajajajaja, entonces sé por primera mano que son territoriales, pues son animales silvestres o salvajes en sus orígenes; por lo tanto, no son precisamente domésticos y solo se exhiben en zoológicos o lugares naturales donde puedan ser \

sin estar encerrados. Porque su naturaleza huidiza no es propicia para ser domesticados y solo son criados como animales ornamentales, como es en este caso. Así es que mientras lo detallaba y admiraba la delicadeza de sus formas, su pequeña cabeza, su delgado cuerpo azul, no podía menos que pensar que no me equivoqué al elegirlo como uno de mis animales más bonitos, pues indudablemente eso está a la vista; aparte de dejarse tomar las fotos, me dieron poses, ángulos bellos y amabilidad, ya que no buscó huir ni tuvo ánimos de atacarme y, así como se acercó, así mismo se fue a seguir paseando con sus amigos. Espero que disfruten de la belleza de estas aves. Así mismo, invito a mis amigos @Theshot2414, @solozanot, @roswelborges, @merit.ahama a participar, saludos!
![Añadir un título.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/brujita18/EpLjnqM8ptWQ4Du5t5CwS6WYp1eCBU7DpXt3ACNMACzh5nnshNkUPpfATytGxcHuqFx.png)

Not a dramatic Thursday, it was not a Thursday with rain and cinematic music playing in the background,Just a regular, dry air Lagos Thursday where NEPA had taken light since morning and his generator was drinking fuel like it had a personal vendetta against his account balance.

He called his friend Seun.

'Guy, I just paid rent, electricity bill, and data subscription in the same week.'

Seun did not even flinch, 'Welcome to the other side.'

'What other side? nobody told me there was another side.'

'Everybody knows there's another side'

'i didn't know.'

'You knew.'

Tide sat on his bed, the one he was still paying for in installments  and stared at the ceiling, Three months ago he had been excited about his new apartment, His own space, no parents monitoring his movement, no younger siblings finishing his food, freedom. That was the word he used when he packed his things, freedom.

Freedom, it turned out, cost forty five thousand naira a month before you even touched food.

His mother called that evening, He almost didn't pick up because he knew what was coming  the check in that wasn't really a check in.

'Tide, how are you?'

'I'm fine ma.'

'You've eaten?'

A pause, He looked at the pot on the counter, there was garri somewhere. Maybe, \

' you don't sound fine.' 'I'm just tired.' She went quiet for a second, the way mothers do when they know exactly what's going on but are giving you space to say it yourself, he didn't take the space, pride is a fulltime roommate when you are a young adult trying to prove something to everybody including yourself. 'okay,'she said, 'Call me if you need anything.' He wanted to say, I need someone to remind me to eat,i need someone to tell me what to do when my landlord is giving me attitude and my boss is sending emails at 9pm and I don't know how to do my taxes and I think I have been washing this bedsheet wrong for six months. He said, 'I will ma Goodnight.' He hung up and sat with the silence. This was the thing nobody explained about adulting , it wasn't just about money, although money was everywhere in the conversation, it was the weight of being the one who figures things out now, growing up, there was always someone above you in the chain, someone who knew, Someone who had the answer or at least pretended to, now Tide was the someone, and most days he was pretending too. He texted his group chat him, Seun, and their friend Abike who had just gotten married and therefore everyone agreed had unlocked the final boss level of adulting. 'How do you people do this every day?' Abike replied first, 'My brother I don't know, i just wake up and start doing.' Seun sent a voice note. Tide played it, it was just Seun laughing for eleven seconds and then saying 'e go be' and hanging up. That was it, that was the advice, E go be. And the annoying thing the truly annoying thing,bwas that it helped. Not because it solved anything, the rent was still forty five thousand, the light was still out, the garri was still the only confirmed food in the house,but something about knowing that everyone around you was also just waking up and doing, just figuring it out in real time, just saying e go be to themselves in the dark it made the ceiling easier to stare at. Tide got up, found the garri, and made a bowl. Adulting,Nobody prepared them for it. But somehow, they were all still here. title.title: Forgiveness of Sins//Mcgi Topic Review ( part 2)
title.body:
https://youtu.be/oAcMa8zhQgY?si=WcvHeEf7ERgZgbaT

I have come to understand that forgiveness of sins plays a very significant role in my life. There have been many times when I made wrong choices and did things I am not proud of. Sometimes, I feel a deep heaviness in my heart because of those mistakes. Yet, I am grateful to God because He is always willing to forgive me whenever I approach Him with a sincere and humble heart.

The Bible reminds us in 1 John 1:9 that if we confess our sins, God is faithful and just to forgive us and cleanse us from all unrighteousness. This gives me hope, knowing that no matter what I have done, God’s mercy is always available to me.

There was a time in my life when I felt overwhelmed with guilt over something I had done. I was so ashamed that I struggled even to pray. But one day, I decided to open my heart fully to God and ask for His mercy. As I poured everything out to Him, I found myself in tears. After that moment of prayer, I felt a deep sense of peace, as though a heavy burden had been lifted from me. That experience reassured me that God truly forgives.

Forgiveness is more than just saying “I’m sorry.” It requires a genuine change of heart and a commitment to turn away from wrongdoing. As Proverbs 28:13 teaches, those who hide their sins will not prosper, but those who confess and abandon them will receive mercy. This encourages me to be honest with God and to truly repent.

I have also learned that just as God forgives me, I must also forgive others. This can be difficult at times, but it is what God expects from us. Ephesians 4:32 teaches us to be kind and compassionate, forgiving one another just as God forgave us through Christ.

Forgiveness brings peace, freedom, and a fresh start. I am thankful that God never grows tired of forgiving me whenever I genuinely repent.

**Thanks for reading.**

title.title: Malleus Maleficarum Esp 🇪🇸 / Eng 🇬🇧
title.body:
Esp 🇪🇸 

![images.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valderalazaro/AKYMNPjVP5oXi19gKtCdViqcDmfFyeuoa1KPes7FZwsZKGZj3zZwiQfC4CiKnFq.jpeg)

Hoy, mientras escuchaba al grupo  feuerzchwanz , una canción llamó especialmente mi atención:  Malleus Maleficarum, Y al pensar en ella, me llevó a una historia real, oscura, de la Europa de finales del siglo XV. Imagina las calles estrechas, las casas de madera crujientes con el viento, y una Iglesia que no solo dictaba la fe de las personas, sino también sus miedos más profundos. En ese contexto surge un libro que marcaría la historia de la superstición y del terror: el Malleus Maleficarum, o El martillo de las brujas   escrito en 1487 por los inquisidores dominicos Heinrich Kramer y Jacob Sprenger.
Este libro no era una novela ni un entretenimiento. Era un manual, una especie de guía práctica para la caza de brujas. Su propósito era claro y aterrador: enseñar a reconocer, juzgar y castigar a quienes se creía que habían hecho un pacto con el diablo. Lo inquietante es cómo un texto pudo moldear la realidad de millones de personas a través del miedo y la autoridad religiosa.
El Malleus Maleficarum se divide en tres partes principales. La primera establece la teoría: qué es la brujería y por qué es peligrosa. Kramer y Sprenger argumentaban que las brujas no solo existían, sino que eran responsables de todo tipo de calamidades: cosechas arruinadas, enfermedades y desgracias inexplicables. En un mundo donde la ciencia aún no podía explicar la realidad, estas palabras tenían un peso enorme. Cada relato y cada acusación reforzaba la paranoia, creando la sensación de que el mal estaba al acecho en cada rincón.
La segunda parte es aún más inquietante: cómo reconocer a una bruja. El libro enumera señales, comportamientos y supuestas marcas físicas que podrían delatar a alguien, e incluso justifica la tortura para obtener confesiones. Es estremecedor pensar que un simple gesto sospechoso, una mirada, o un rumor podía ser suficiente para acusar a alguien. En gran parte de Europa, esa acusación equivalía a la condena de muerte.
La tercera parte describe cómo castigar a las brujas y organizar los juicios. Aquí se ve la mentalidad de la época: un miedo extremo a lo desconocido, reforzado por la autoridad religiosa. Las penas eran severas, y la misericordia casi inexistente. Lo más grave es la profunda misoginia: la mayoría de las acusadas eran mujeres, señaladas por comportamientos cotidianos que hoy consideraríamos normales.
El impacto histórico del Malleus Maleficarum fue devastador. Durante los siglos XV y XVI, ayudó a avivar la caza de brujas en Europa y contribuyó a miles de ejecuciones. Su influencia no solo moldeó leyes, sino que también afectó la cultura y la percepción social de la brujería, creando un miedo que trascendió generaciones. Hoy, sabemos que gran parte del contenido es cruel, irracional y falso, pero leerlo nos recuerda cómo el miedo y la autoridad pueden distorsionar la realidad y la moralidad.
Lo más inquietante es pensar que, en aquel entonces, la gente creía en cada palabra escrita; un libro podía ser tan poderoso como cualquier espada o decreto. El Malleus Maleficarum no fue solo un manual de caza de brujas: fue un espejo de la humanidad y sus temores más oscuros, un recordatorio de cómo la ignorancia y el miedo pueden transformarse en violencia y persecución.
Curiosamente, aunque fue escrito por inquisidores, la Iglesia no siempre lo apoyó oficialmente. Algunos clérigos lo consideraban demasiado exagerado. Hoy, es uno de los documentos históricos más citados cuando se estudia la caza de brujas y la superstición en la Edad Media.
Y mientras escucho   Malleus Maleficarum,
, no puedo evitar pensar en cómo la música puede conectarnos con la historia, con miedos antiguos y con reflexiones que siguen siendo válidas hoy: la fragilidad de la vida frente al miedo, y la fuerza que tiene la palabra escrita, para bien… o para mal.

Gracias como siempre a @bradleyarrow y a su comunidad BBH
A mí mamá de Canadá @cathyarrow muchas gracias por llegar a nuestras vidas también a mi esposa @diazktty por siempre tener una sonrisa en su rostro  y por la familia que hemos formado

![IMG_20260509_184440.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valderalazaro/23sUc9x8A2Qqn6mgt7eGV3G9mCNEZQmApgHimF3SZJYMbKhVXTpmy8V5wTqQSYZ8ybTDg.jpg)

   ![images.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valderalazaro/AKYMNPjVP5oXi19gKtCdViqcDmfFyeuoa1KPes7FZwsZKGZj3zZwiQfC4CiKnFq.jpeg)
Today, while listening to the band Feuerschwanz, one song caught my attention in particular: Malleus Maleficarum. Thinking about it led me to a real, dark story from late 15th-century Europe. Imagine the narrow streets, the creaking wooden houses swaying in the wind, and a Church that not only dictated people's faith but also their deepest fears. In that context, a book emerged that would mark the history of superstition and terror: the Malleus Maleficarum, or The Hammer of Witches, written in 1487 by the Dominican inquisitors Heinrich Kramer and Jacob Sprenger.
This book was neither a novel nor entertainment. It was a manual, a sort of practical guide for witch-hunting. Its purpose was clear and terrifying: to teach how to identify, judge, and punish those believed to have made a pact with the devil. What is unsettling is how a single text could shape the reality of millions of people through fear and religious authority.
The Malleus Maleficarum is divided into three main parts. The first establishes the theory: what witchcraft is and why it is dangerous. Kramer and Sprenger argued that witches not only existed, but were responsible for all sorts of calamities: ruined crops, diseases, and inexplicable misfortunes. In a world where science could not yet explain reality, these words carried enormous weight. Every story and accusation reinforced paranoia, creating the sense that evil lurked in every corner.
The second part is even more unsettling: how to recognize a witch. The book lists signs, behaviors, and supposed physical marks that could reveal someone, even justifying torture to obtain confessions. It is chilling to think that a simple suspicious gesture, a glance, or a rumor could be enough to accuse someone. In much of Europe, that accusation was equivalent to a death sentence.
The third part describes how to punish witches and organize trials. Here, one sees the mindset of the era: an extreme fear of the unknown, reinforced by religious authority. The penalties were severe, and mercy was nearly nonexistent. The most troubling aspect is the deep misogyny: the majority of the accused were women, targeted for everyday behaviors that we would now consider normal.
The historical impact of the Malleus Maleficarum was devastating. During the 15th and 16th centuries, it helped fuel witch hunts across Europe and contributed to thousands of executions. Its influence not only shaped laws but also affected culture and social perceptions of witchcraft, creating a fear that transcended generations. Today, we know that much of its content is cruel, irrational, and false, but reading it reminds us how fear and authority can distort reality and morality.
The most unsettling thought is that, at that time, people believed every word written; a book could be as powerful as any sword or decree. The Malleus Maleficarum was not just a witch-hunting manual: it was a mirror of humanity and its darkest fears, a reminder of how ignorance and fear can turn into violence and persecution.
Interestingly, although it was written by inquisitors, the Church did not always officially support it. Some clergymen considered it exaggerated. Today, it is one of the most cited historical documents when studying witch hunts and superstition in the Middle Ages.
And while I listen to Malleus Maleficarum, I cannot help but think about how music can connect us with history, with ancient fears, and with reflections that remain valid today: the fragility of life in the face of fear, and the power that the written word holds, for better… or for worse.
Thanks as always to @bradleyarrow and his BBH community.
To my mom from Canada, @cathyarrow, thank you so much for coming into our lives. Also, to my wife @diazktty, for always having a smile on her face and for the family we have built

title.title: Technology, Tradition, and the Question of the Best Era
title.body: > Looking back to ten or fifteen years ago, we can all say an bear witness to the fact that we lived in a totally different era. Things were totally different as compared to the era we are living in today. Then, technology wasn’t this advanced, and the world itself was yet to achieve some level of growth that we see today. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbuhkPE5Kf4vNiRm1btbrRZhPt7Njfb5Mw2RsESDHyHRV/d0c2702b_458b_4e68_90d5_2e94f90e58da.jpeg) Growing up, I was always told by older people that things were very different and easy during the time they were growing up. Today,I would also tell the young and upcoming ones the same thing- the era I grew up in was the best, especially my childhood. Everyone would say their childhood was the best era but you see the period between the end of the 90s to the early twenties, that was peak peak best era, ngl. The period when I was born had to be the softest era ever because the system was working. Then, my dad was furthering his education all over the world and I was living my life because I always had goodies and new stuff from over the world to share with my friends. And honestly, these times things were a lot easier than they are now. Goods and service were affordable for all. Schooling was cheaper than it is today. You could go to university, further to even your PhD and you’d be able to complete everything and get a well paying job. You’d probably have a good and comfortable life by 25 just like I dreamt I would have then. I guess this dream of mine stemmed from the fact that people 25 and above then could start their lives then- have a partner, a decent job,a home and even think of starting a family. My dad started his family pretty early- he wasn’t rich rich, but we were more than comfortable just like every other person then. And oh, when we talk about enjoyment and the spirit of community, those were the days. People would actually leave everything they were up to just to sit with others and stream football matches. Others would dress up as masquerade and dance at the end of every match. During election season, there was literally music everywhere from the various political parties. There was fun everyday, everything and honestly, these memories are ones I don’t think will ever escape me. Someone will say this era is the best era - I’d say it’s the best era in terms of technology. But when it comes to real fun, real living, the spirit of community and oneness, the era of no pressure to make it in life, the era where everyone was content, let’s give it to the late 90s to the early 2000s But then again, I can’t say that this era isn’t one of the best eras to live in. Most people would kill to enjoy the opportunities and life we get to live today. Thanks to technology , we are able to explore various aspects of life with no hassle. What a time to be alive indeed! - - - all images belong to me. - - - ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXuSJ2V9NneWQW9Jxgobw7BtKvMb3UBPdxv3jaAhx5vpA/f40b32ec_5287_4867_ae7e_9fa77d7f679b.png)

title.title: Forgiveness of Sins//Mcgi Topic Review ( part 2)
title.body:
https://youtu.be/oAcMa8zhQgY?si=WcvHeEf7ERgZgbaT

Greetings once again, and welcome back to my blog. I am grateful that you are here as we continue reflecting on the life-changing power of forgiveness. In my previous post, I shared how God’s mercy has lifted the weight of guilt from my heart. Today, I want to explore how forgiveness not only transforms our relationship with God but also with ourselves and those around us.

I have come to realize that holding on to anger or resentment toward others can weigh just as heavily as carrying guilt from our own mistakes. There were times when I found it hard to forgive someone who had hurt me deeply. I wanted justice, or at least an acknowledgment of the wrong done. Yet, I noticed that keeping my heart closed only prolonged my pain.

Through prayer and reflection on God’s word, I understood that forgiveness is not about excusing wrongdoing, but about freeing myself from bitterness. Matthew 6:14-15 reminds us that if we forgive others, our Heavenly Father will also forgive us. This was a challenging lesson to learn, but when I finally chose to forgive, I felt a sense of liberation I had never experienced before.

I also discovered that forgiveness is a process. It doesn’t always happen immediately, and that’s okay. Sometimes, it takes prayer, self-reflection, and a conscious effort to let go of resentment day by day. The important thing is that we are willing to forgive sincerely and not allow anger to take root in our hearts.

Another insight I’ve gained is that forgiving ourselves is just as important as forgiving others. God’s forgiveness is complete, and He does not hold our past mistakes against us once we truly repent. Learning to accept His mercy for ourselves allowed me to move forward with confidence and hope, rather than being trapped in regret.

Finally, I have seen that a life rooted in forgiveness is a life filled with peace. Relationships are healed, burdens are lifted, and there is room for love, joy, and gratitude. Colossians 3:13 encourages us to “forgive as the Lord forgave you,” and I am learning to live this verse daily—not perfectly, but sincerely.

Forgiveness is a gift, a choice, and a journey. I am thankful that God walks with me every step of the way, reminding me that mercy and grace are always within reach.

**Thank you for Reading**
