title.title: Freedom With Side Effects
title.body:
Adulting did not come with a manual, and honestly, if it did, I am very sure most of us would still skip the instructions and jump straight into the struggle, because tell me why you will wake up one morning, stretch like a normal human being, and suddenly remember you have bills to pay, responsibilities to handle, and people expecting you to have your life together, it is like life just tapped you on the shoulder one random day and said, Oya, you are on your own now, No warning, no soft landing, just vibes and pressure.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSoTjWstk3aFiVKBdUQg62LWTfraLpGoetBFEeyHWwi2Q/1778707166509.jpg)


Guy, I am tired, Tunde said, dropping his phone on the small plastic table in the buka.

Ayo laughed as he dipped his spoon into his plate of jollof rice, “Tired of what? you just resumed work two months ago.”

That’s exactly why I’m tired, Tunde replied, Two months and I already want to resign from adulthood.

Bisi, who had been quiet, shook her head, you people are funny, this is just the beginning, wait till you start paying rent.

Tunde looked at her like she just cursed him, Please do not say that kind of thing around me, I am still managing my data subscription and feeding.”

They all laughed, but deep down, each of them knew there was truth hiding inside the joke.

Ayo leaned back, See eh, adulting is not even about age, It is when you start making decisions and nobody is there to guide you again, If you mess up, na you go fix am.”

Exactly, Bisi added Like last week, I spent almost all my salary in the first five days, I was just buying things I thought I needed Now I’m counting the days till month end like a prisoner.

Tunde burst out laughing, you? The same you that used to advise us about saving money in school?”

Bisi rolled her eyes. Life will humble you, don’t worry.

A woman walked past their table shouting, Hot amala! Fresh soup!

Tunde turned immediately, Madam, come! Add meat o, no do me dirty.

As the woman served him, Ayo shook his head, see this one, you said you are broke but you are still ordering extra meat.”

Let me enjoy small, Tunde replied , if adulting wants to stress me, I will still chop good food.

They laughed again, but the conversation slowly shifted.

Youu know what scares me? Ayo said quietly, the future. Like… are we really going to figure everything out?

Bisi sighed, I ask myself that question every time, Because right now, it just feels like w eare all guessing.

Tunde nodded, True, nobody really knows what they are doing, everybody is just acting like they do.


There was a brief silence, the kind that comes when truth hits too close.

Then Bisi spoke again, but I think that’s the point, You grow into it, you do not just wake up and have everything sorted,tou learn, you mess up, you adjust.


Ayo smiled, so basically, we are all just learners in this adult life.

Exactly, she said, Paid learners.

Paid? Tunde scoffed. More like paying learners, because na we dey pay for everything.

That one hit all of them, and they burst into laughter again.

Ayo checked his phone and frowned,Ah, my landlord just texted me.

Don’t open it, Tunde said quickly, “
Protect your peace.

Too late, Ayo replied, sighing , He’s reminding me about rent.

Bisi leaned forward. See, this is what I mean, adulting is just constant reminders that life no be beans.

Tunde raised his hand like he was making a speech, at this point, I just want to go back to when my biggest problem was assignment.

Same, Ayo said, Now it is bills, responsibilities, and trying to become something in life

Bisi smiled softly, but you people won’t lie, there’s also some kind of freedom in it, you make your own choices, you decide your path, nobody is controlling you.

Tunde thought about it for a moment. That one is true sha. Even though the freedom comes with stress.

Everything comes with a price, Ayo added.

They sat there for a while, eating, talking, laughing, and lowkey worrying about their lives.

Finally, Tunde spoke againz  you know what, I think adulting is just learning how to survive while still trying to be happy.

Bisi nodded, And not losing yourself in the process.

Ayo raised his bottle of drink, To surviving adulthood.

Tunde and Bisi raised theirs too, To surviving.

And just like that, in the middle of laughter, complaints, and small moments of honesty, they realized something simple, nobody really has it all figured out, we are all just trying, one day at a time.

[image source](https://unsplash.com/photos/low-angle-photography-of-two-men-playing-beside-two-women-UmV2wr-Vbq8)

title.title: #232 - Diamenty, krew i polityczna miotła, czyli o książce „Miejsce i imię” Macieja Siembiedy
title.body:
>

![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm/23tbP7Hqs8irum5kghqsKNySD7eKXGPkwCBVnk1VLQ1NEP1hkW5DBCL9AtpSMM1rfM1FR.jpg)

Często łapię się na tym, że autorzy cykli wpadają w pułapkę kopiowania własnych schematów. Z tego powodu rzadko czytam kolejne części jedna po drugiej – potrzebuję oddechu, by nie mieć wrażenia, że jem ten sam odgrzewany kotlet. W przypadku „Miejsca i imienia” Macieja Siembiedy – kontynuacji przygód Jakuba Kani znanego z „444” – momentami czuć ten znajomy rytm. Nie dyskwalifikuje to książki, ale sprawia, że o prawdziwe zaskoczenie u stałego czytelnika jest nieco trudniej.

### **Misja eks-prokuratora dla Jad Waszem**

Po odejściu z IPN Jakub Kania nie idzie na emeryturę. Zaczyna współpracę jako konsultant z izraelskim Instytutem Jad Waszem. Zlecenie? Odnaleźć na Górze Świętej Anny zbiorową mogiłę żydowskich robotników zabitych pod koniec wojny. Z prośbą o pomoc zwróciła się grupa jubilerów z Amsterdamu, choć – jak można się domyślić – Holendrzy zataili swój prawdziwy, „diamentowy” motyw.

Fabuła toczy się dwutorowo. Pierwsza ścieżka startuje w latach 20. XX wieku, by potem rzucić nas w sam środek piekła hitlerowskiego obozu na Górze Świętej Anny. Druga to współczesność, okolice 2012 roku. Obie nitki są tak samo przesycone faktami i ciekawostkami, że akcja pędzi bez trzymanki.

Głównym bohaterem historycznym jest Dawid Schwartzman – kuglarz, który całkiem przypadkiem stał się genialnym szlifierzem, twórcą „czarnego szlifu”. Miłość do córki szefa pakuje go do więzienia, a wolność odzyskuje dopiero podczas okupacji... by natychmiast trafić do transportu do Auschwitz. Pod fałszywym nazwiskiem Johan Pinto ląduje jednak w obozie Annaberg. Tam, pod okiem generała SS Albrechta Schmelta, powstaje specjalna grupa szlifierzy, która na boku obrabia zrabowane Żydom kamienie.

Współcześnie Jakub Kania szuka punktów zaczepienia u ostatnich żyjących świadków. Problem w tym, że każdy jego krok śledzi Wiesław Paluch – jego dawny szef z IPN, którego „polityczna miotła” zmiotła ze stołka. Paluch, w poszukiwaniu łatwej kasy, sypia teraz z wrogiem, czyli współpracuje z Holendrami. Śledztwo szybko okazuje się wielowarstwowe: nad jedną mogiłą krzyżują się interesy jubilerów, byłego agenta KGB, neonazistki, ABW i skorumpowanego gliniarza z Trójmiasta.

### **Moje wrażenia: Czy lepsze niż „444”? Bez dwóch zdań!**

Mimo moich początkowych obaw o schematyczność, Siembieda w „Miejscu i imieniu” poszedł o krok dalej. Przymiotnik „wyjątkowa” to za mało – ta powieść jest momentami wybitna. Research autora to absolutny majstersztyk; sposób, w jaki zrekonstruował realia Amsterdamu i obozu na Górze Świętej Anny, zwala z nóg. Wszystko podane jest z taką lekkością, że te setki archiwalnych dokumentów zamieniają się w czystą przyjemność z czytania.

Wątek Dawida Schwartzmana to literacka perła. Fikcja tak gładko wchodzi w autentyczną historię, że czytelnik przestaje pytać, co wydarzyło się naprawdę, a co zrodziło się w głowie autora.

Mam jednak jedno „ale” – psychologia postaci. Siembieda jest mistrzem faktów, ale jego bohaterowie bywają irytująco jednowymiarowi. Paluch to klasyczny „zły z kreskówki”, a Kania i jego rodzinka są tak nieskazitelni i idealni. Ta „cukierkowatość” Jakuba momentami wręcz drażni – przydałoby mu się trochę więcej brudu za paznokciami, chociaż pod koniec można było odnieść wrażenie, że związek Jakuba zostanie poddany próbie. Liczę na to, że autor trochę namiesza w tym „cukierkowym” świecie Kani.

### **Podsumowanie – lekcja historii, której nie chcesz przegapić**

To nie jest zwykły thriller. Siembieda potrafi przyciągnąć uwagę, spasować wątki i zmusić do refleksji nad tym, jak usilnie promuje się czasem „jedynie słuszną” wizję dziejów. „Miejsce i imię” to przede wszystkim opowieść o zapomnieniu. O tym, że zbiorowy grób na Górze Świętej Anny naprawdę tam był, a przez dekady nikt o niego nie pytał.

Polecam gorąco, najlepiej zacząć od pierwszego tomu, choć „Miejsce i imię” broni się świetnie jako zamknięta całość.

**Ocena: 8/10 ⭐**


![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm/23tknNWVLTQYDSuYw1mcMj2SfsPv82PYWiS1r6yfCM63o3iwJSSr9cB28zzsQxfPQfGve.jpg)




<div class=\

chciałbym się dzielić z wami refleksjami na temat przeczytanych (lub odsłuchanych) książek. Kryminały i powieści sensacyjne są mi zdecydowanie najbliższe, ale często sięgam po political-fiction albo książki dokumentalne, biogramy czy wspomnienia. ***

title.title: WHAT DREAMERS DON'T DO
title.body:
Sometimes the dream feels hidden between faith and fate, but art keeps speaking.
This poem is a reminder to myself that no matter how slow the journey looks, dreamers never stop creating.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNXeMYadSsnQxck6bPZ9eGqSoYxpJP8CZNLJeyoyQ7qon/1778706578683.jpg)

What Dreamers Don’t Do
I dream of becoming a sculptor
who speaks through his hands,
one who makes the known truth visible,
who silently speaks to the hearts of the possessed
like walking zombies,
through the truth they can finally see.

Yet, all remains a mystery,
caged deep in the heart,
resting between faith and fate.

But there’s something
dreamers don’t do—
DREAMERS DON’T QUIT!!
— Abefe Art

title.title: The Road to the Tower.
title.body: > I grappled up a tower and ziplined to meet Juan's contact, Raiza after the checkpoint. She provided a parachute and led me to a double agent for intel. After using a workbench and scouting a fortified base with my phone, I prepared to parachuting in to steal uranium. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRDHms4sYie7mvZvTcMEpYVKwfmayTuQ6Npi7jKiRZFCW/screenshot_1_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ7f49dxqFT6XKyAz5hq5RADwn3yLtBU7hS6tPdAxTrmp/screenshot_2_.png) After liberating the checkpoint, I decided to get back on the job Juan asked me to handle. I rode a horse through the winding mountain paths till reaching this point where I had to grapple up the side of a steep cliff. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYmAfqocxea4VcTMy5ZhNBZuEiGSeps4uLxP4cAyqBJJg/screenshot_3_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYrJRre2WJiz3knVGvAXQpS8TwUMvsPWmAKDosGuZYjpX/screenshot_4_.png) After running for some time through the open world, at last I found the tower I was commanded to reach. The structure was rusted and leaning, and I had to try a grapple to climb up the exterior to reach the upper observation deck. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNpL1PHsv1z4qPFQxHk7iNzicjrxUcGiocCmntG1mtw29/screenshot_5_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP6xqti4CgtTmjvtp22eTaWvdgksfADE927ANRtNYR2GA/screenshot_6_.png) After getting up there, I was suggested to slide down the zipline, which would take me to an abandoned camp far below. The wind rushed past as I descended, heading toward the spot where Juan's contact was waiting for me. It was a fast way to cover ground. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYy1NJStEx3ZtfMq5j1qkit2qsa9mQqifmFC8pJmTx9gY/screenshot_7_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcuy4WDz8JzhNQXsMUxwLARy8UHaXboUZH6f2z9gXKAHa/screenshot_8_.png) I continued moving ahead through the overgrowth and at last I found the contact Juan was talking about. She was Raiza, and she was waiting to help me steal supplies from Castillo's forces. She looked like she had been living in the wild for a long time. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSf3r2eagHiztDyS8hDtNpwwy1yNF2cNrShqn5mvLeQtd/screenshot_9_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd2r6GZSpCGrGipRJQbCp9wNsUoJcWhbQVv9doNjRPdVp/screenshot_10_.png) After handing over a parachute to me, the lady asked me to follow her deeper into the hills. Before following her, I looted some supplies from the crates nearby, as I knew I might not get back to this specific place again. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRRp4fsozBv2WP4zxY7MWVznnmCi5JM1BSVu8EZunphG2/screenshot_11_.png) I followed the lady all the way to this lookout that was guarded by an enemy soldier. Raiza told me we could bribe this soldier, who is actually a double agent working for the resistance. It was better than wasting bullets. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQUMaeb7aNkKQK5iBhkWLDEAaSko8p8NDY2DGJ7pCL3kL/screenshot_12_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPeLgacFzjSTG4hwQnvYSYMBXoy4HChaKoxBweJPaTMPw/screenshot_13_.png) I had to holster my weapons before approaching the double agent, otherwise he would open fire. He accepted the payment and gave me important intel about the local military movements and the location of the precious uranium. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSwR6zEcFYEGTztsvAWmA56kZKDFW9JbXWtS8pxd29624/screenshot_14_.png) After getting the intel from the double agent, I climbed up a small tower to find some extra supplies left behind. I found a workbench as well, which allowed me to quickly check my gear before the main mission started. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRpy2xRobHVREb1bnHZ85Xdh66ZHbhS63sXSSLgqWKHKh/screenshot_15_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXFnS15ZY9QGBpPPuDBvXJ6L4uxdE1KhKcHK3k8UrfFGo/screenshot_16_.png) Then there came Raiza climbing to my position, and it looked like I had to climb up there anyway to see check on the enemy fort ahead. I had to scout fort from there, getting a clear view of the fort across the valley. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPuV1ZhyuNq1ow1pkAquMvkwdYdrHyEKMize9mVh4hbkb/screenshot_17_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZiBPHiszAT3W9NLvtmdBVBo3kxkrgr8Ps7WQJMP4DRx4/screenshot_18_.png) I used my phone camera to scout the fort and tag soldiers, as per Raiza suggested to identify the threats. And then she asked me to go and snatch the uranium over there, using the parachute she gave me to drop in silently. How about we continue in another post? --- Thanks for reading my post. --- ▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=artchef/317642d5)

title.title: Be careful: Scammers on Discord!
title.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23tbPKVJGsj5NRjcrBZAhWpkhomb8exQi8JKNuSaf8oRgWgiV3VHbc9fSD4FBFWDQdFZq.png)


I just wanted to create a short blog to warn you about scammers on Discord. 
A lot of you that have been active in different Hive related Discord servers probably have experienced bots from scammers reacting on questions posed in the Discord servers. 

But today I experienced something different which I'd like to warn you for. I received a friend request from an unknown user. I work in the IT security field, so I'm quite distrustful. I think that’s professional deformation. But it comes in handy sometimes.
 
This morning I received a friend request from a certain Jordan.
I didn't recognize the name as a hiver, but curious as I am, I accepted the request. 
Jordan, with ADMIN in his avatar asked me if I had any issues and if I needed some assistance... .how nice!
I played stupid to see what the next 

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23u6X11XGrWXPKAZejpHhY3oc2rn1SyErBmpZWPbXNZcCzHurRY2JKCJFpXp97SXx5gpu.png)

When I told him I was fine, he immediately told me I needed to migrate my wallet to 'the system portal'? to avoid any further issues (Despite the fact that I had just told him I had no issues). 
I played stupid and asked how I would do that and within a minute I received a link I had to click with a procedure to follow. 
If I would have followed it, my account would probably be hacked. 

Be aware!

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23tw8Ldwm9GcgKtF64yZZbyRwCuCgCnR5ARJuZ4pUzBtwzPmjt6KzXwfqtpyKQsxSsKz1.png)

Since this guy was in the Official Hive Discord I reported it and he was banned.

But then, tonight I received another friend request. I must be very popular. This it was someone with the Hive logo as avatar and the name of the account was **Hive Support**. 
Ans if you ask yourself; is there an official Hive Support account 😂 
There isn't!!!!
I haven't received a reply from the account yet, but this confident_starfish does smell phishy!


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23twAQD1xFFnCFRfxPyv3wDeXhbuFyT9VwXgfqWyg4QiN6Z4bCubapLLcjH4RsQZr5RsD.png)

I think a lot of you are quite aware of the scammer that are out for your Hive keys to witdraw all the funds from your wallet, but every now and then I see a cry for help in the Hive Discord Server of somebody that has fallen victim to these scammer, so I thought it wouldn't hurt to make this blog to create some more awareness.

# Remember!
- There is no official Hive Support account!
- Never! I repeat: Never! share your Hive keys. 
- If you lose your keys, you lose your account!
- Never make rushed decisions, especially when it's concerns your account. 
- Scammer often create fear (you lose access) and urgency (you should act immediately).
- Pause, think, and if in doubt, ask someone you trust through a trusted channel.

![divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23t7YWoNDewJkbQoM9yiSvwjFh4yHJuCWXPjgX31Eep5JGnZChA88ZNWdDr6H5FBgdVaj.png)

Spread the word!

<center>
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/245n3faSf1E4HdNCPePvHHzVkaLUPjScGnEhLJdQ9YtAeD2ZUpVCBcm9i3TRJ1AHZFLr4.png
# Friendlymoose
</center>

### Good evening, #Monomad friends Here is my entry for the #monomad contest by @brumest and @monochromes. There are few things more pleasant than a sunny afternoon in an outdoor garden. The play of shadows and their patterns on the green grass soothe the restless spirit of even the most distracted passerby. The invitation to play soccer with friends, take a carefree stroll, or simply enjoy an unhurried nap is something that appeals to many. title.title: ElReyLobo Primer capítulo: la batalla de las sombras
title.body:
Contexto: está historia va a tener varios capítulo,va ser mi primera serie y espero que les gusten

El sudor me escocia en los ojos pero no me atrevía a parpadear. Dentro de la habitación estaba mi hermosa Julieta dando a luz al próximo heredero de diamantus. Todo parecía ser hermoso hasta que note la fecha del parto: 24 de zafiro profundo.
_________________________________________________
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQsebYC3aKdFTK7W9d3So1Pai4hm56mtgN9S1y81RVh3M/1778706089625.png)

 No entendía como podía ser posible, el mismo día que nace mi cachorro, es el mismo día que llega mi peor enemigo: Lobusno.

Lobusno es el dios de la muerte, y cada año llegaba a buscar el alma de cada cachorro de diamantus. No podía permitir la entrada de mi peor enemigo, pero ya era demasiado tarde.  Veo a Julieta por última vez, y luego cuando cierro la puerta para luchar contra lobusno. Alzó mi mano lentamente y mi diamante aparece para convertirse en una espada y cuando salgo para empezar la batalla ahí estaba: Lobusno. 

Con su oscuro pelaje, alto, y con una mirada impenetrante que hasta el propio ser más valiente de estás tierra, se podría asustar. Lobusno con una voz profunda y fría que hace vibrar los suelos me dice: -\

-. Dice lobusno. No iba a permitir que lobusno le haría daño a mi familia y me lanzo al ataque.
__________________________________________________
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcTk3JDXifgXyWZpp8J9acdbgQqxL38mAUmx8crYrJbwm/1778706128754.png)

 No hubo ráfaga, solo un vacío repentino, su espada de esmeralda choco contra mi espada de diamante brillante, pero solo era entretenimiento. Derrepente lobusno saca sus filosas garras y la clava en mi estómago, sentí como poco a poco mi alma era consumida por sus filosas garras, pero de pronto escucho una voz suave y hermosa que había reconocido.-\

-. Era Julieta. Lobusno se da cuenta, y se sorprende al ver a Julieta levantada y con fuerza, pero sin el cachorro. Julieta se lanza al ataque y le clava la espada a lobusno en el pecho, yo caigo pensando que por fin había logrado derrotar a lobusno, aunque como siempre había dicho \

.
_________________________________________________
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP8kARrQ4R6TdVj97a2eYCeJn58he7bwWYqUhMoEAKwKg/1778706172807.png)

 Lobusno se levantó con fuerza y empieza atacar fuertemente. Nadie sabe que pasó con Julieta y conmigo, lo único que se es que morí sabiendo una cosa: Que mi padre, Kairus se llevó a mi hermoso cachorro y espero que crezca sabiendo que sus padres murieron por protegerlo, y que ese diamante lo cuide al igual que me protegió a mi yo de cachorro.
__________________________________________________

title.title: I Miss My Best Friend...
title.body:
The Lord refused to let me forget about this one! 🥹
--------------

Last night as I fell asleep, I was taking a moment to be grateful for everything 🙏 I thought to myself, *please God, I will be surrounded by my children on my deathbed,* and suddenly I was flooded by memories from a time long since gone...

*🎶 Our children around and you looking down from / Heaven's a julep on the porch... 🎶*
------------------

https://youtu.be/Ppn7eQSBdJQ?si=VwJjKzXwqpL_Blri

When this song first came into my life, it was at the same time that my best friend did. I was in the thrilling beginnings of a new friendship. I had never met another person who was so identical to me in so many ways -- the same kind of humor, at that! 🥺 We bonded over our passion for music, with perhaps this song being the very first one that united us. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWFJFNSdXNzrz3FdwNH522ntAMB1DMCQ9ESYskHcYRt3F/1778706241281.jpg) **(My best friend and I in 2018, our last photo)**

That was back in 2016, about a decade ago. 

Today, now with a family of my own, the song carries an entirely different meaning for me. 

I never imagined that I would be married, never mind a mother, someday... Now, I am married to the love of my life -- my soulmate -- and I would not have it any other way...

Granted, he is nearly 15 years my senior, and I pray that we will continue to spend every waking minute together for the next 50 years (please God), but accepting the reality that he will more than likely pass on before me is very hard...

Hence, this is where my mind was when I prayed that we will be surrounded by our children when death begins to draw near. I have God with me regardless -- I have nothing to fear -- but the dream of being reunited with my husband while our children watch on beside me, is pure bliss...

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTExkqATJgubsNX4Mawuq8MHVoMBfaofk31Sgqg6CQiGi/1778706304002.jpg)

---------------
---------------

Thank you for checking out this week's post! I appreciate anyone who takes the time to do so. Please enjoy the rest of the week 🙏
------------------

title.title: Sensors and Desensitisation
title.body:
>

All those cameras and sensors, and this person still couldn't park straight outside of the school. She hardly left any space on the footpath where kids have to walk, so I guess if one happened to scrape their bag down the side, it would be her own fault. Sometimes I wonder how far people's driving skills have fallen, if those sensors were taken away. Or how much attention they are actually paying when doing things, if the sensors failed. I suspect that many people over the last decade or two have become so reliant on a beep to tell them where the front or back of their car is, that if that beep didn't come, they wouldn't realise until they hit something.  

---


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tarazkp/23xepKyNgPD23dPQJp5kJL2m2S5bmap3NgS8fKKVq38xD1ykuukc1uHA62kvR6oxRehud.png)


---

> I am a bit sad tonight.

For the last few weeks and for the second year in a row, a pigeon has been nesting in an apple tree that sits outside of our lounge window, and we have enjoyed watching the story unfold. However, today a crow spied the nesting female and called its friends and started trying to get to it through the branches. I went outside a couple times to shoo it away, but when I got back from getting Smallsteps from school, the inevitable had happened and the nest was empty, with a few pigeon feathers on the ground.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tarazkp/23xKxMMFe7N4DHH4hGbytH1QRoysmGsFz14bWuDxtefizbVDCCuUK1vnjJnfAu9u7MtKa.png)

> Smallsteps was very upset.

I assumed that the pigeon would have tried to defend the eggs and the three or four crows (a technical \

of crows) being much larger would have killed her. When Smallsteps and I were eating a bit later, the father pigeon landed on the tree and we watched it as it stared forlornly at the empty nest that had raised their previous clutch. After a minute or two, it flew away and landed atop a light pole, and then was joined a moment later by the smaller mother pigeon. So she wasn't killed after all. And while happy she survived, Smallsteps realised that they won't be back again next year. \n\nYes, they are just pigeons and it is a \

situation, but still, it saddens me also. The garden should be filled with life during the spring, not death. Maybe it is a bad omen for us, not that I believe in those - though I must have smashed a lot of mirrors, walked under many ladders, and had several black cats cross my path. I think that in many developed countries it is a privilege to not be surrounded with death all of the time and in many ways it makes us soft. Yet at the same time, in many other countries life seems to be incredibly cheap, and the lives of animals valueless, which means that crime and animal cruelty seem to be daily living. I don't understand people who are intentionally cruel to animals for pleasure or profit. But yes, much like the many crashes that would happen if all the driving aids were taken off cars, the lack of exposure to the realities of life makes us soft and more sensitive when reality bites. Life is filled with death, it is unavoidable, but this doesn't mean we have to be so comfortable with death that we no longer value life. I don't think we should be so desensitized to reality that we no longer feel it, no longer appreciate it, no longer notice the beauty in the world. But, I also don't think we should be so surrounded by comfort and supports that we are no longer capable of dealing with the situations life throws at us. The pigeon couple have lived to see another day and perhaps, they will live long enough to have another go and bringing life into the world, even if it might not be at our place. Though, pigeons can remember faces and can tell the difference between hostile and friendly people for years, so maybe they will come back and I can try to find a way to protect them a bit more from the murdering crows. > The crows are of course just being crows, and I am just being me. title.title: Is Banning Underage Adolescent Marriage Leading To Human Extinction?
title.body:
![TheDigitalArtist is the creator of this image/Source:  Pixabay](https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2019/11/06/16/46/extinction-rebellion-4606639_1280.jpg)

Whenever there is any conversation about the declining birth rate in the United States, usually the statistics that the journalists will bring up is the drop in pregnancies among women between 15 years old and 44 years old.  Not women between 18 years old and 44 years old.  Not women between 21 years old and 44 years old.  The starting point for the statistical information is almost always 15 years old.

Regardless of whether radical feminists wish to argue that 15-, 16-, and 17-year-old girls are still children, the fact of the matter is that girls that young are bearing children and statisticians are calling them women instead of little girls.  Why?  Because they're not little girls.

I don't really buy into all the hype about the human race going extinct merely because young men are refusing to become Macaulay-Culkin/Tony-Danza centaurs.  However, hypothetically speaking, let's pretend that all this hype is true.  Then enacting tougher statutory-rape laws and banning all teenage minors from getting married are not helping the situation any.

It greatly bewilders me why anyone takes any of these radical feminists seriously whenever they weigh in with their rhetoric about \

being a human-rights violation.  I agree that no place in the world should allow a little girl to get married at age 7, especially to a 95-year-old man.  However, these radical feminists are using the term \

as a misnomer in their mission to stop adult men in their twenties or older from marrying teenage girls in middle school or high school. These radical feminists are screwed up in the head, because adult men in Generation Z are not even getting married or starting families. Many of them aren't even having sex at all. The video below explains this trend. Sex Has Become Unpopular Among Gen Zers, And Babies Simply Aren't Being Born Because Of It https://youtu.be/2SkJLnPUXVI?si=cUOjpC1Nkqq-A44p If everything in the video above is true, then who are all these older men that keep getting pubescent and adolescent girls pregnant that these female elected officials keep babbling about whenever a bill regarding the age of consent for marriage comes up in discussion in state legislatures? If a 23-year-old man is sitting in his parents' basement all day long and all night long, playing video games, he's certainly not out there getting every 12-, 13-, 14-, and 15-year-old girl pregnant. All right. Some of you are going to tell me that perhaps such male Gen Zers are hooking up with these underage girls online and sneaking them out of their bedrooms at night. I'm not denying that possibility. However, I don't believe that this is happening in epidemic proportions. The fact still stands that when a state legislature imposes a ban against teenage marriage, not including 18- and 19-year-olds, and enacts tougher statutory-rape laws than the ones currently on their law books, the number of adult men going to prison increases. When that happens, there are more teenage girls below 18 years old having to apply for social welfare benefits to care for their babies than before. Society pays for it in the long run. Underage middle-school and high-school boys that get underage girls pregnant will usually look for an easy way out of having to take responsibility for their actions whenever these girls decide to keep their babies. However, whenever a man in his twenties or older finds out that his supposed 19-year-old girlfriend is really only 13 or 14 years old and has become pregnant with his baby, the first thought that comes to his mind is what he can do to support her and the baby financially. When the law is allowed to step in and haul this man off to prison, it throws a monkey wrench into the whole situation, because then the teenage mother-to-be loses access to any financial help that he can give her. That young girl then becomes vulnerable to social services agencies and other government entities like them coming in and taking their babies away from them while the adult fathers of their babies are locked up. Femi-Nazis like Oklahoma House Delegate Nicole Miller and others like her throughout the nation will ramble on about how pubescent and adolescent girls are in danger of sexual exploitation and abuse and then bring out their famous fear-mongering threats of potential human trafficking of minors, but they don't truly care about the youth of our nation. What is so outrageous is that these femi-Nazis exist on both sides of the aisle. If these radical feminists actually cared about the youth of our nation, then they would be fighting to get forced heirship laws passed everywhere in the United States and outside it in our extended jurisdictions. If they really wanted to put a stop to the human trafficking of pubescent and adolescent minors, they would be passing tough laws to disallow law-enforcement officials to lock up minors in adult prisons. They would even go as far as making prison rape a capital offense punishable by death. It doesn't take a genius to figure out all these facts. You merely have to study and observe the negative trajectory of our nation to know what the bigger picture is really all about. Ms. Miller? If you really care about pubescent and adolescent girls, why don't you do something about Jesse Mack Butler getting away with the violent rapes he committed against underage girls? Oh, I forgot. He was underage himself when he committed those same crimes, so I guess he gets a get-out-of-jail-free card because of it despite that he badly injured one of his victims. Better yet, Ms. Miller? Why don't you reform the sex-offender-registration laws in Oklahoma? A number of people on the sex-offender registry don't belong there. The video below demonstrates how abusive the sex-offender-registration laws are in our nation. Norman Michael Achin Attacks The Ludicrous Nature Of The Sex-Offender Registry In His State Jurisdiction https://youtu.be/p4yS8pmLhp4?si=VbWVokVvcbJWOHkn Also, as Americans, we need to realize that these underage marriage bans are also going to contribute to other problems. There are going to be more and more cop killers and gay bashers coming out of the woodwork in years to come. I firmly oppose any form of genocide, but we all must face reality about human nature in times of crisis. When elected officials shove laws like these down people's throats without at least giving the voters some say in it, the masses begin to develop hostile feelings against the criminal justice system. The number of young men going to prison and being raped behind bars increases dramatically, and this adverse trend contributes to the spike in ex-convicts engaging in gay bashing insofar as it becomes homicidal. We also have to remember the children born to an adult-teenage couple in an age-gap relationship. While it be true that a child born of a forcible rape may grow up hating his or her biological father, a child born as a result of a \
so to speak, will likely grow up hating everyone in the criminal justice system.\n\nIf a child born as a result of a \

so to speak, discovers that his or her father was raped in prison, that child may grow up to become a violent gay basher.  Hating on homosexuals may become their regular coping mechanism.

Ladies and gentlemen?  We cannot afford to allow radical feminists and others like them to absorb us into their make-believe world of age-appropriate perfection and wholesome purity.  They are pulling our civilization downward to its final destruction.

Never mind all the pedophile-panic propaganda that you read about in social media.  The majority of people that get accused of being pedophiles have never been clinically diagnosed as one.  Don't listen to any of the so-called research these femi-nonsensical idiots shove in our faces, because much of it is inaccurate and fabricated.

![Tumisu is the creator of this image/Source:  Pixabay](https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2020/01/09/00/55/ballot-4751566_1280.png)

As Americans, we all have the right to demand that our elected officials allow a referendum to be placed on ballots so that voters can decide whether or not it should be illegal for teenagers to get married before they're old enough to enlist in the military.  In state jurisdictions where minors can legally get married under certain conditions, state legislatures should not have the right to impose restrictions against how much of an age gap can exist between the minor and their future spouse.

Elected officials should not be deciding these laws for us.  The voters should be doing so.  Even if you live in a state jurisdiction that has already banned any form of underage marriage, you have the right to find out whether you can seek to get a referendum placed on the ballot to overturn these laws and restore the previous ones.

We don't work for these legislators.  They work for us.  Otherwise, we must vote them out of office.

If there are elected officials fighting against these bills to set 18 years old as the age floor for marriage in stone, then there must be voters out there that have been communicating with these legislators to keep the status quo.  And, no, they're not pedophiles, human traffickers, or serial child rapists.  They're people that have researched into the consequences that such bills will cause if signed into law.

Radical feminists will ramble on about how they believe that allowing teenage minors to marry is an anachronism in this day and age.  Well, American statutory-rape laws are archaic at best in that they have existed for over 700 years in one form or another, and yet our elected officials neglect to downgrade these victimless crimes from being strict-liability offenses to intent offenses that require proof that a victim was actually harmed.

Radical feminists absolutely love to tell horror stories about some 75-year-old man marrying a 10-year-old girl and attacking her with acid on their honeymoon night.  They'll even find a picture of a girl that young lying in a hospital bed with acid burns all over her face and body and attribute it to an old man being allowed to take her hand in marriage.  Using fear-mongering tactics is how they misguide and lure elected officials into buying into their harmful agendas.

Also, nobody here is saying that it should be legal for a 75-year-old man to marry a 10-year-old girl under any circumstances.  Most girls that age haven't even started going through puberty yet.

Nonetheless, if a pregnant girl is 16, 15, 14, or even 13 years old and she wishes to marry the 23-year-old father of her unborn child, she should have that same option without the fear of the authorities zeroing in on the love of her life.  In these situations, the police are nobody's friends.

Stop listening to femi-Nazis like Fraidy Reiss, Jeanne Smoot, and Shanley Kane.  They're not truly looking to serve the greater good despite what they may have you to believe.

body.title: Blowing Dandelions in the Four Winds - My Actifit Report Card: May 13th, 2026
body.body:
<center>

### Welcome to  
## ***Liquid Eye’s*** Actifit Blog

# Wednesday ☀️ 10016

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/F527D1B2-65AF-4D80-96E7-EEB7FA2B47931778705791.625577) 

It was a cool and windy morning, with rain forecast sometime in the late morning. So I got up early to walk the Tiergarten route and, of course, starting with interval walking. It had rained again overnight, and since it had rained a lot in the days before as well, everything was a vibrant shade of green everywhere. All the plants have really shot up, and many new little ones have joined them. The dandelions are especially striking, the dandelion clocks are everywhere and in all sizes. I’ve brought some for you to admire up really close today, after of course blowing a few in every direction and making wishes as I did so. The air was perfect for breathing and meditation exercises at the Neuer See in the Tiergarten, in an almost eerie yet relaxed calm. Few birds were out and about at that moment. In the end, I got caught in the beginning of the rain that was to come and really enjoyed the fine, refreshing drizzle because I knew I’d be home soon.

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/F527D1B2-65AF-4D80-96E7-EEB7FA2B47931778705798.581774) 

Ein kühler und windiger Morgen mit angesagtem Regen irgendwann ab dem Vormittag. Also bin ich früh raus, um die Tiergartenroute zu gehen und natürlich mit Intervall-Walking zu beginnen. In der Nacht hatte es bereits wieder geregnet und da es die Tage vorher auch schon viel geregnet hatte, war alles überall intensiv grüner als grün. Alle Pflanzen sind sowas von aus sich heraus geschossen und viele kleine dazu gekommen. Besonders auffällig ist der Löwenzahn, die Pusteblumen, überall und in allen Größen, die ich euch heute auch zum bestaunen aus nächster Nähe mitgebracht habe, nachdem ich natürlich auch fleißig ein paar in alle Himmelsrichtungen gepustet habe und mir dabei Wünsche gedacht habe. Großartige Luft für Atem- und Meditationsübungen am Neuen See im Tiergarten in fast schon gespenstischer, aber entspannter Ruhe. Wenige Vögel unterwegs in dem Moment. Am Ende bin ich noch in den Anfang des späteren Regens geraten und konnte das feine, erfrischende Nieseln sehr genießen, weil ich wusste, dass ich gleich zuhause sein werde.

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/F527D1B2-65AF-4D80-96E7-EEB7FA2B47931778705800.926116)

¡Hola, mis queridos amigos de HIVE! 💛

Hacía varios días que no pasaba por aquí para compartirles fotos mías, y la verdad es que las extrañaba. Ustedes saben que me encanta sentir su apoyo, sus comentarios y esa buena energía que siempre me transmiten.

Pero hoy ¡aproveché la oportunidad al máximo! Resulta que estaba en casa, un poco más tranquila de lo normal… más bien, un poquito ociosa, como a veces nos pasa a todos, ¿no? 😌 Y fue justo en ese momento cuando pensé: “¿Por qué no tomar algunas fotos y compartirlas con mi gente linda de HIVE?”

Así que me puse creativa, busqué un buen ángulo, buena luz (lo más natural posible) y capturé el momento. Y ya que estamos en confianza, quiero saber su opinión sincera:

¿Qué les parece mi combinación de blusa con saya negra? 🖤✨

Traté de lograr un look sencillo pero con personalidad. La blusa tiene ese toque casual que me encanta, y la saya negra le da un aire más estilizado y versátil. Ustedes que siempre tienen buen ojo para la moda y los detalles… ¿me lo aprueban o me sugieren algún cambio para la próxima?

Los leo en los comentarios, como siempre. Y no olviden dejar su huella con un voto o un reblogue si les gustó la publicación. ¡Eso me motiva muchísimo a seguir compartiendo más momentos con ustedes!

Un abrazo enorme desde mi rincón favorito de la casa 🏡💫
Nos vemos en la próxima publicación.
Con cariño, @yuli05




Hello, my dear friends of HIVE! 💛

It's been several days since I last shared some photos of myself with you, and honestly, I've missed it. You know how much I love feeling your support, reading your comments, and soaking up all that good energy you always send my way.

But today, I finally took the chance! The thing is, I was at home, feeling a little more relaxed than usual… actually, maybe just a tiny bit bored, as we all feel sometimes, right? 😌 And right then, I thought to myself: \

So I got a little creative, looked for a good angle, found some nice natural light, and captured the moment. And since we're already here and comfortable with each other, I want your honest opinion:

What do you think of my combination of a blouse with a black skirt? 🖤✨

I tried to put together a simple but stylish look. The blouse has that casual touch that I love, and the black skirt adds a more elegant and versatile vibe. You always have a great eye for fashion and little details… so do you approve, or would you suggest any changes for next time?

I'll be reading your comments, as always. And don't forget to leave your mark with an upvote or a reblog if you liked the post. That really motivates me to keep sharing more moments with all of you!

A big hug from my favorite corner of the house 🏡💫
See you in the next post.

With love, @yuli05

body.title: When Karma Doesn't Work the Way We Expect.
body.body: Sometimes as humans we cause ourselves some damages that cannot be fixed in the long run, and most of the time these things will later haunt us because we are messing around with what we should have taken as a priority. Study has told us that in the human race there is something we call \
But one thing is that this thing called \

works in a very different way, which we might not think of sometimes. Most of the time we do something and we think the results will show immediately that incident happens. To me, I feel it's a big lie. Well, I am not against the law that says karma speaks, but come to think of it, do we really understand what karma is and its modes of operation?\n\n

>Source Now let's discuss this, and I will be sharing this according to my own little understanding. Karma, to me, is having an idea that what you do will come back to you, either good or bad. It is actually a cause and effect, which means that for every action there is a result. Actually that is what most of us know to be karma, and truly this works; either fast or slowly, it will surely surface at some point in time. But leaving that aside from what I have just discussed. Does karma truly work? This question keeps ringing in my head these recent days, and what made me think about this? I wonder how our leaders have been manipulating us into lots of promises that are always empty and just a few of them will stick to what they truly say they will do. Now let's leave that aside and come back to the normal circular world. Me as a person and not talking about others this time. There are sometimes some things that happen to me, and I will just feel like karma is really working in the wrong way. For instance, I had a friend who had a financial issue, and I came over to help him not knowing that he was facing some issues that were pivotal. I came into the picture, and I showed him some ways to do things. That same day we went to get solutions to his problems. I lost most of my clients that work with me. At first I was wondering what was happening because it was very unusual. I texted him about what happened, and he told me it was not just about the clients, and he said he was the cause and I might have been sharing in the punishment meant for him. I was just worried, and I prayed to God and slept. Within my mind, I was not happy, and I kept wondering what must have happened that made him suffer this way and still extend that punishment to me. After that he explained the cause of the situation, and then I wondered why karma had refused to take judgment on those who were rightfully meant to serve the punishment but instead decided to go another route. This is me saying that we must act in a normal way because karma's judgment is not always according to what we think as humans. It's far beyond our imaginations, and only karma itself decides how it will judge every action we do. We should always stay wise and be mindful of our actions towards people. Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@the-lead/when-karma-doesnt-work-the-way-we-expect-bfj)

body.title: Kids And Loans!!!!
body.body:
![Gradient Modern Business Youtube Thumbnail (56).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/23wC3cbsyr5g2HLiscXfBaqjGPeKBRrPkGFRnCdK5VpuP6Cwhmr2zD57JK1Bra2rWSXXV.png) ***
![2dk2RRM2dZ8gKjXsrozapsD83FxL3Xbyyi5LFttAhrXxr16mCe4arfLHA37mQtCuynkak9C9VAyTtPNZ193z3v9HzUXNRYfNBKpop4B452wXWGAr95ns7Froa3QYr2tHe7aDsDXTJuz6E8PeAV3edWS3NGxHQJHC9xJn9eUpGW.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/23uEz3qUu1cpWPYjmp2LnK1i4RcXoAhocX2Rzpq9uYyMScovNm77MZBozX7i1NM59BnSf.png) I had to step out today, and while I was on the bus, I was overhearing a conversation between two friends. They were simply talking about one of them whose mother was asking for a loan from them. He was not happy about it because apparently, his mother has a habit of not paying back the loans she takes from him. With her being his mother, he has no issues leaving the money with her, but if he’s going to give her something, it has to be an amount that he doesn’t have any important thing tied to, or that money would be gone for good. And as a result, he was considering giving her only a fraction of what she needed. And as I overheard, I couldn’t help but pity the poor woman. Not because her son was shortening the money she wanted, but because of how she had brought him to that level. For him to say that his mom wasn’t going to pay back, it was because she had most likely done it in the past. Borrowing something and not returning it. Over and over again, to the point where they stop expecting you to ever return anything they’ve given you. ![2dk2RRM2dZ8gKjXsrozapsD83FxL3Xbyyi5LFttAhrXxr16mCe4arfLHA37mQtCuynkak9C9VAxm3nacdB7gLmLiZLuYVhHeNsRgxL6WKJoam3hs2B7ZLAp2jwaLFEwoAbLKzAfpv2DhtyvHbJunTbU58RMbxtkvefNK4qj8EA.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/23uQkLUmr2XGp8UpLcdtKeQrWDNnK5jemLpyFynqgRKtzZaqtByEwcX3DoUEyB8Pwi9DN.png) There used to be a running joke that you can loan your mother things, but when it’s time to pay back, she asks you things like: “What about the food you’ve been eating and the clothes you wore as a child?” And the truth is, while many people probably experienced that as a child. I honestly couldn’t relate. My mom just dislikes borrowing ehn, and she’s always clear with what she wants. If she wants a loan, she’ll ask. And if he wants you to give her something, she’ll simply tell you. My mom will never tell us to borrow her money and then not pay it back; she’ll give us a timeline and then pay it that very day she sets. And I’ve tried telling her not to bother, but she doesn’t like it. She sha likes to pay off all her debt. I’m just saying that she has always had this habit of paying off her debt, no matter how little they are. ![1686801205968.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/23tm9Y6mSN5jiXP2MkMms9veu7FRZJYQBiLcCLTE4oN4LCa8mfscnTNZ2jP9Hc1HWF8y5.jpg) And she passed this habit down to us, her children. There are people who will lend money and suddenly turn into ghosts, others will lend money and become monsters just because they don’t want to pay back. That’s how insane it is. One thing I’ll never do is take a loan I’m not planning to pay off. Like, what the hell? And then do it to my kid? If my child lends me money, and then I fail to refund it as I promised, he’ll never take me seriously, especially with money matters. And in the future, when I’m in a bind, and I ask for a loan, he’ll most likely shorten the money because he already knows I’m not good for it. This is not to say that you shouldn’t give your mom loans or take loans from your kids, just… as a parent, learn to keep your word! If you want them to give it to you, then be clear about it. Do not say you’ll give it back to them, then use emotional blackmail to stop them from asking for it. It’s cruel. Because in the end, it’s better for the children to choose to leave the loan for you, not you making that choice for them. Really, these little things matter. P.S: Loan doesn’t necessarily mean huge amounts of money. It can be quick fixes, money to do one or two basic things, easy money that can be gotten from you without stress. So, it can be as little as N500 to as high as N10 billion. Regardless of the number of zeros, integrity and honor should be the key!!! Because little things like these determine the legacy you leave for your children. ![IMG_20230914_153034~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/23sJbTRqSxGoBbn6ZRy8rysu8uCUvAWxe96odjhzCT5SekgKGYHhC52jRSmvGFocFGGMh.jpg) ***
Thank you for reading. Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments below, I would love to know what you’re thinking. Till we meet in the next post.
***

body.title: Give it Time: The Power of Patience and Persistence
body.body:
Hello, Hive community! 

I am feeling great to be back with another post, I am trying to be consistent with my Blogs. If you’ve been following my journey at **HIVE**, you know I like to keep things real, whether I'm talking about the EU's new battery rules or why we sometimes feel like a cricketer who can't find their form, I have discussed many topics with my experiences, if you missed any go and check at @nabbas0786. 

Today, I want to share some thoughts on a topic that affects all of us: **THE IMPORTANCE OF GIVING TIME TO OUR TASKS.**


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV7HYgu9wrnQMb851cHjSb7WkTZbebbdHkJr54SXh8LzS/1778705103036.png)
###### Image Generated with Using Google Gemini.

## Don't Just Watch, Work.

We all have those big goals we dream about, maybe you want to grow your account reputation, or perhaps you're working on a personal project. But there’s a big difference between wanting something and actually going for it, both are different if you know you know. I’ve seen so many people sit on the sidelines, just watching and wondering \

Success doesn't come to those who just sit and wait to see what happens. It comes to the people who are willing to put in the hard work. If you want to succeed, you have to get off the bench and get into the game. Instead of being a spectator in your own life, give your goals the effort they deserve. When you stop watching and start doing, that’s when the magic happens.

## Changing Minds Takes Space, Not Force

While we should be firm with our goals, we need to be gentle with people. Have you ever tried to force someone to change their mind? It almost never works. In fact, the harder you push, the more they usually push back.
If you really want to help someone see things differently, you have to give them space. Think of it like a plant you can’t force a flower to bloom by pulling on the petals. You give it water, sunlight, and most importantly space to grow. People are the same way. By giving someone the room to think and breathe without pressure you’re actually making it easier for them to change.

## The Bottom Line

Whether you are pushing yourself toward a new milestone or trying to improve a relationship, remember that **time is your best friend.** Be patient with others but stay persistent with your own work.

Change isn't something that happens overnight it’s a slow process that requires a lot of hard work and even more patience. So, keep grinding, keep giving people grace, and just give it time.

body.title: Modern Streaming Trends That Are Changing Home Entertainment
body.body:
Home entertainment has evolved far beyond traditional television. Modern audiences now expect flexibility, convenience, and personalized viewing experiences that fit seamlessly into their daily routines. As digital technology continues to advance, streaming has become the center of this transformation.

From on-demand content to multi-device accessibility, today’s streaming trends are redefining how people consume entertainment at home. These changes are not temporary. They represent a long-term shift in viewer behavior and expectations.

## The Shift From Traditional TV to Streaming

Traditional broadcasting once dominated the entertainment industry, but viewers are increasingly moving toward internet-based solutions. Fixed schedules and expensive cable bundles no longer align with modern lifestyles.

Streaming platforms offer a more flexible alternative by allowing users to watch content whenever they choose. This freedom has become one of the biggest reasons behind the rapid growth of digital entertainment.

Modern audiences want convenience, and streaming services are designed to deliver exactly that.

## Personalized Viewing Experiences

One of the most influential trends in entertainment today is personalization. Streaming services now use advanced recommendation systems to suggest content based on user preferences and viewing habits.

This makes discovering movies, series, and live channels much easier. Instead of browsing endlessly, users receive tailored recommendations that match their interests.

For viewers, this creates a more engaging and efficient entertainment experience.

## Multi-Device Accessibility Is Now Standard

Entertainment is no longer limited to a single television screen. Streaming platforms support smart TVs, smartphones, tablets, and laptops, giving users complete flexibility.

This allows viewers to continue watching content wherever they are, whether at home or while traveling. Families also benefit because different members can watch separate content simultaneously.

This seamless [modern streaming](https://nordiciptvkings.net/) approach has become one of the defining features of digital entertainment today.

## Rise of On-Demand Content

On-demand viewing has changed how audiences consume media. Instead of waiting for scheduled broadcasts, viewers can now access entire libraries of content instantly.

This trend supports busy lifestyles by allowing users to watch shows and movies whenever time permits. Binge-watching has also become more common because of easy access to complete series.

The convenience of on-demand entertainment continues to attract more viewers every year.

## Live Streaming Is Expanding

While on-demand content remains popular, live streaming is also growing rapidly. Sports events, news broadcasts, and real-time entertainment are major drivers of viewer engagement.

Modern streaming services combine live channels with on-demand features, creating a balanced entertainment experience.

This integration gives viewers more control while still allowing them to stay connected to live events and updates.

## Smarter User Interfaces

Streaming platforms are investing heavily in user experience. Cleaner layouts, faster navigation, and intuitive interfaces make it easier for viewers to find content quickly.

Features such as personalized dashboards, voice search, and watchlists improve convenience and reduce browsing time.

These interface improvements play a major role in keeping users engaged with streaming services.

## Flexible Subscription Models

Modern viewers want control not only over content but also over pricing. Flexible subscription models are becoming increasingly common across streaming platforms.

Instead of committing to expensive long-term contracts, users can choose monthly plans or customize subscriptions based on their preferences.

This flexibility makes streaming more affordable and accessible to a wider audience.

## Improved Streaming Technology

Advancements in internet infrastructure and streaming technology have significantly improved viewing quality. High-definition and ultra-high-definition streaming are now standard features on many platforms.

Faster internet speeds have also reduced buffering issues, making online entertainment more reliable.

These technological improvements continue to strengthen streaming as the preferred form of home entertainment.

## Social and Interactive Features

Streaming is becoming more interactive. Some platforms now include live chat features, shared watch experiences, and community-based recommendations.

These additions create a more social entertainment environment, helping viewers connect with others who share similar interests.

Interactive features are expected to become even more common as streaming platforms continue evolving.

## The Future of Home Entertainment

The future of entertainment will likely revolve around even greater personalization and smarter technology. Artificial intelligence will continue improving recommendations, while enhanced streaming infrastructure will support higher-quality playback.

Viewers can also expect more integration between streaming services and smart home ecosystems.

As competition increases, platforms will focus on delivering better experiences, more diverse content, and greater convenience.

## Conclusion

Modern streaming trends are transforming home entertainment by offering flexibility, personalization, and accessibility that traditional television cannot match.

From multi-device streaming to on-demand viewing and advanced recommendations, digital entertainment continues to evolve around the needs of modern audiences.

As technology progresses, streaming will play an even larger role in shaping how people experience entertainment at home.

---

body.title: The Older We Become
body.body:
If there is one thing I have learnt in this world, it is that the older we get, the more we realise that most of the struggles for wealth we pursued in the past, and some of the arguments we engaged in, were not even worth it at all. Another thing we learn is that life means nothing if we gather everything only to leave it behind for people who never struggled with us while we were building it. The fact that some family members will eventually gather and fight over such inheritance is even more sickening.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRbW8GpMmL1qcHW1V7i6YPmNUbAF9tqKw3rpGji6hfhg4/img_0060.jpg)


Another important thing to notice is that the world does not really care about you in the first instance. So, living our lives trying to please people who do not genuinely care about us is as useless as anything else. Hardly will people remember the clothes you wore the previous day because everyone is busy battling with their own lives and trying to make things better for themselves.

Life should not be taken too seriously. I was at work today and saw pictures of past principals from several years ago. If not for those pictures hanging on the wall, we would never have heard about them. No one would even know such people once worked in that capacity as principal. What does this teach us about life? It is all vanity. People who are not even born yet will still sit on those same chairs someday. That is why we have to tread softly in whatever position we find ourselves in as bosses or leaders. We should not use our offices to manipulate, oppress people, or make life difficult for them.

Another thing life teaches us as we grow older is to value and enjoy the time we have with our parents and loved ones, instead of focusing only on work. Most times, those moments cannot be bought back once they are gone. We also realise that it is not about age but achievement. You will see people moving and associating with others who are far younger than they are. That is just life and how things work as we grow. At some point, people care less about your age and more about the achievements you can show for your life.

Another thing is that there are truly no permanent friends or enemies for everyone. At some point in our lives, we may find ourselves alone. Many of the people we grew up with may no longer be there for us. Some might have died, while others may have relocated far away. Old age and life circumstances naturally make people drift apart.

Life is only for a while, so we should not live holding too many grudges. It never ends well. Life goes on regardless of whatever it throws at us.

body.title: My Actifit Report Card: May 13 2026
body.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/d576c9fe-9265-4e63-a35c-ff31f3a66687.jpg) There is something incredibly motivating about beating your own records two days in a row. After yesterday's success, I wasn't sure if I’d have the same energy today, Wednesday, May 13th. However, the fresh air and a bit of nature-watching proved to be exactly what I needed to push even further, reaching 13,214 steps. ​While walking through the local green spaces, I spotted a feathered friend standing tall in the grass, as seen in photo. Watching wildlife while getting my steps in makes the whole experience feel less like exercise and more like a peaceful retreat from the digital world. It’s these quiet moments just me, the grass, and the occasional bird that remind me why I started this fitness journey in the first place. ​Consistency is the Secret Sauce. ​Looking at my Actifit dashboard today, I can see a massive spike of activity during the late morning hours, with several points hitting over 1,000 steps per interval. This burst of movement really set the tone for the rest of my day. My current AFIT token balance has reached 20,773, and seeing that number grow alongside my physical stamina is a great double win. ​I've also been paying more attention to my User Rank, which currently stands at 38.27. It’s a slow climb, but every step counts toward building that community presence. As I mentioned in a previous discussion with my friend @elizabitbit, finding a community that supports your health goals makes it so much easier to stay on track. ​The Mental Boost of Outdoor Walking. ​Walking 13,000 steps isn't just a physical achievement; it’s a mental one. By the time I reached the midpoint of my walk, any stress from the morning had completely vanished. There is a specific clarity that comes with a long walk in the sun. The photo in perfectly captures that feeling of wide open space and the simplicity of nature. ​Looking Forward. ​With two days of high activity behind me, my goal for the rest of the week is to maintain this momentum without overworking myself. Recovery is just as important as the activity itself! To everyone in the Actifit and Hive community I hope you’re finding your own mural foxes or park birds to keep you company on your journeys.

body.title: Lockpick vs. Locksmith: How AI is Redefining the Cybersecurity Arms Race
body.body:
<center> https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZieqFgeDzgC7BjbuWScR77MVsvdrLsSk9cB5SwyWfLo1/images%2010.jpeg 

[Source](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/ai-vs-new-cybersecurity-arms-race-ritik-saini-888uc)</center>

When Google Intelligence actually said that they intercepted a planned mass vulnerability, an exploitation operation that is built around everyday exploits, they appear to have been deployed with the help of an AI model. The news didn't actually go viral in every place, but some AI enthusiasts and some people who are very good in server security have started to look into the issue. The bug was in the popular open-source web-based system.

And the exploit lived in a Python script that automated the 2FA bypass for this tool to actually happen. How did Google get to know that AI was involved? Google is not guessing about the AI angle. They have seen the pattern and the fingerprint of AI codes in it.

And it started with an hallucinated CVSA score and their likes. They structured Facebook and formatting the code and accompanying comments. They look like they've been written to satisfy a documentation rubric.

So it's something that has been done several times over. Then Google researchers described this incident as the first known case of AI being used to do something more crazier than what AI would have been taught to do in the wrong way in previous times. There is actually a forthcoming coding language that is coming, which is Mythos.

But this has to be suspended just because of this issue. In parallel, there is a myth of Flood, Opus 4.7, as a more general-purpose model with stricter safeguards around prohibiting and enabling cybersecurity applications. The bigger shift here is that AI is both a lockpick and a locksmith.

So an AI can safeguard a program. AI can also become that key to unlocking any program that we ever thought of. Governments are now discussing the Mythos class system as a similar cyber model in the context of regulation, alongside other frontier AI models used for code and security.

So what should we actually take away? AI hackers are already here. There's nothing we can do about it. And it's not just a punchline.

It's a direct fruit of what we are seeing here. There are now real criminals that are using AI to help find and package every day into operational exploits against widely-used software. And that is becoming more these days.

And if this penetration can go through, it means that most of the programs and the platforms that we thought are secured, we can actually penetrate them through an AI model. And there is nobody that is going to be exempted. Thank you.

body.title: Tras bastidores De la idea a la pantalla
body.body: >A menudo vemos el resultado final -un video editado, un post maquetado, una idea pulida- y olvidamos que detrás de cada publicación exitosa hubo un caos que luego fluyó a través de la organización, un café frío y varias páginas de cuaderno rayadas con dudas y certezas. Hoy, después de un mes intenso como lo fue abril para mí con el lanzamiento de mi serie \

, quiero confesar tras bastidores y mostrarles las costuras de mi proceso. Porque, como comunicadora, sé que la historia más real no es la que se proyecta, sino la que se construye en el silencio del estudio.

\n\n
>Imagen creada con inteligencia artificial Gemini.
>Mi nido: El espacio de trabajo donde cultivo cada idea

>Mi escritorio no es solo un mueble; es mi centro de mando cuando mi hermana no lo utiliza para trabajar virtualmente. Para que mi creatividad fluya, necesito que mi entorno refleje mi filosofía de slow living. No falta mi luz natural entrando por la ventana de la sala, un vaso de agua que me recuerde que debo hidratarme para tener energía y saliva para cantar o leer mi post en voz alta y, por supuesto, mis herramientas técnicas.

>Pero más allá de la laptop y la cámara de mi teléfono, mi espacio se define por un orden consciente con mi agenda de Espacio Ananá abierta, para leer todas mis acciones importantes del día. Pienso que si hay ruido visual, habrá ruido mental y me costará concentrar mi energía en crear con sentido.
>De lo analógico a lo digital: Mi sistema de organización

>Mi cerebro funciona de dos formas prácticas:

\n\n1.

>En papel: Mis primeras ideas nunca nacen en una pantalla. Necesito sentir la fricción de la tinta, por eso utilizo mis cuadernos para hacer brain dumping. Ahí es donde dibujo los bocetos de lo que quiero transmitir, sin filtros, ni SEO, solo palabras al azar.

\n2.

>En computadora: Una vez que mi idea tiene pies, a veces la mudo a mi aplicación de Word, aunque a menudo, la paso de una vez al editor de Ecency tradicional, en donde voy redactando letra a letra, basada en una estructura que previamente ya he elegido, pienso en palabras claves que jamás debo dejar pasar. Es el puente necesario para que la inspiración no se quede en el aire, sino que se convierta en una realidad sólida.

\n\n
>Desafíos técnicos: la realidad de una recién graduada

>Ser profesional audiovisual, no me hace inmune a las crisis técnicas. En este primer mes de muchos lanzamientos, me enfrenté a retos que no aparecen en los libros, y que también me hacen reírme.

\n\n*

>Luchar contra la electricidad y los bajones que pueden dañar mi computadora, ha sido uno de los retos más grandes que he tenido que enfrentar, sobre todo, cuando no he guardado o salvado los cambios que he realizado en mi escritura. Ese es uno de los momentos en donde debo respirar hondo, profundo y exhalar con confianza y esperanza, porque desgraciadamente, a mi computadora se le dañó la batería, así que no sobrevive cuando se va la luz.

\n*
>Sintetizar: Como apasionada de la investigación, mi mayor reto es recortar. Aprender que \

y que para ayudar a esa madre que me lee en su descanso, debo ser precisa, digerible y directa.

\n*

>El perfeccionismo vs la acción: Entender que es mejor una píldora de valor publicada hoy, que un documental perfecto guardado en el disco duro por miedo al qué dirán. Hay que prepararse y hacer del presente, el momento perfecto para crear.

\n\n

>Finalmente, si algo he aprendido en este detrás de cámaras, es que el flujo creativo, es hermoso cuando es un acto de servicio. Organizo mis ideas pensando en ustedes, en otorgar valor y propósito constante. Cada etiqueta que elijo, cada color de mi línea gráfica y cada párrafo bien centrado tiene el ideal de ser un puente. No quiero que solo reconozcan lo que hago, quiero que sientan que ustedes pueden ser creadores de su propia realidad, de sus post transformadores y de un blog con metas claras.
>Abrir mi proceso me hace sentir vulnerable, pero también más conectada con ustedes.

>¿Cómo es su detrás de cámaras?

>We often see the final result—an edited video, a formatted post, a polished idea—and forget that behind every successful post there was chaos that eventually gave way to organization, a cold cup of coffee, and several notebook pages filled with doubts and certainties. Today, after an intense month like April was for me with the launch of my series “From Idea to Screen”, I want to take you behind the scenes and show you the seams of my process. Because, as a communicator, I know that the most real story isn’t the one that’s projected, but the one that’s built in the silence of the studio.

\n\n
>Image created with Gemini artificial intelligence.
>My Nest: The workspace where I nurture every idea

>My desk isn’t just a piece of furniture; it’s my command center when my sister isn’t using it to work remotely. For my creativity to flow, I need my environment to reflect my philosophy of slow living. There’s plenty of natural light streaming in through the living room window, a glass of water to remind me to stay hydrated so I have the energy and saliva to sing or read my post aloud, and, of course, my technical tools.

>But beyond my laptop and my phone’s camera, my space is defined by a conscious sense of order, with my Espacio Ananá planner open so I can review all my important tasks for the day. I believe that if there’s visual clutter, there will be mental clutter, and I’ll struggle to focus my energy on creating with purpose.
>From Analog to Digital: My Organization System

>My brain works in two practical ways:

\n\n1.

>On paper: My initial ideas never start on a screen. I need to feel the texture of the ink, which is why I use my notebooks for brain dumping. That’s where I sketch out what I want to convey—no filters, no SEO, just random words.

\n2.

>On the computer: Once my idea takes shape, I sometimes move it to my Word document, though often I transfer it directly to the traditional Ecency editor, where I write it out letter by letter, based on a structure I’ve already chosen, keeping in mind keywords I must never overlook. It’s the necessary bridge so that inspiration doesn’t remain up in the air, but instead becomes a solid reality.

\n\n
>Image created with Gemini artificial intelligence.
>Technical Challenges: The Reality of a Recent Graduate

>Being an audiovisual professional doesn’t make me immune to technical glitches. In this first month of many launches, I faced challenges that aren’t covered in the books—and that also make me laugh.

\n\n*

>Dealing with power outages and voltage drops that can damage my computer has been one of the biggest challenges I’ve had to face, especially when I haven’t saved the changes I’ve made to my writing. That’s one of those moments when I have to take a deep, deep breath and exhale with confidence and hope, because unfortunately, my computer’s battery is broken, so it doesn’t survive when the power goes out.

\n*

>Summarizing: As someone passionate about research, my biggest challenge is knowing when to cut things out. I’ve learned that “less is more” and that, to help the mother reading this during her break, I need to be precise, easy to digest, and direct.

\n*

>Perfectionism vs. Action: Understanding that a single gem of wisdom published today is better than a perfect documentary stored on a hard drive out of fear of what others might say. You have to prepare yourself and make the present the perfect moment to create.

\n\n

>Finally, if there’s one thing I’ve learned from this behind-the-scenes look, it’s that the creative process is beautiful when it’s an act of service. I organize my ideas with you in mind, striving to provide constant value and purpose. Every tag I choose, every color in my graphic design, and every perfectly centered paragraph is meant to serve as a bridge. I don’t just want you to recognize what I do; I want you to feel that you can be creators of your own reality, of your transformative posts, and of a blog with clear goals.
>Opening up my process makes me feel vulnerable, but it also makes me feel more connected to you.

>What's it like behind the scenes?

body.title: MN Investment Fund April Figures Down - Kind Of Reassuring For Those Not Trading
body.body: /> Every month I receive the MN Fund results due to having inquired about the investment fund over 12 months ago. At the time the way of how the MN Fund operated was not for me as I want to invest in a fund and not physically do the work. If you are the one running the fund and being paid a commission or percentage on the results/profits then you must control everything and deliver those results.

/> The MN Fund had a few setbacks this last month with certain investments like AAVE who experienced a hack and that created a $10 billion drop in market cap value. TAO dropped 25% within 6 hours due to some huge sell offs and SUI also dropped in value. This is why using charts to trade does not account for the unexpected and like most crypto there is risks involved.

/></center>

When you consider a team with over 21 years trading experience is struggling then it shows how difficult this market is when we know the crypto cycle has changed and this is all new to us. 

The big difference is when you are trading and have lost funds those are lost until you earn them back through more trades. When you are staking and earning you may lose overall value similar to those trading, but you are also increasing the size of your bag at the same time. You may be not seeing an increase in value immediately and more like holding your ground, but are growing without seeing the impact of that growth. At some point when the markets turn that growth will be slowly revealed when the prices start to increase.

This is one of the reasons I like to follow this project because I find it refreshing and reassuring to see others struggling. We have become so accustomed to seeing and hearing about others winning on social media with their crypto investments yet the full story is never revealed. The MN Fund showing how they are battling through monthly is no different to our experiences and reassures us what we are doing is the correct way of growing through staking and consistency.

Crypto has been a minefield for the last 54 months which is a hell of a long time to be on the slide heading downwards. At least in the previous cycle we had some big swings up and down but this current cycle since December 2021 till now very little upwards movement besides a handful of crypto's. I f we look at 99% of all the alt coins they are 90-98% down over those 54 months which is rather severe. One can understand when you hear that statistic 90% lose in crypto and depending when you invested the chances are you will be down.

Friends of mine invested months ago and I thought at the time how lucky they were to be investing when they did and yet they are down between 60 and 70% with the only difference they are staking so the losses are not so severe. If they use that as a marker when they invested and invest more at these lower prices then they are diluting the cost of each token and this will guarantee a healthy return in the future. I have no concerns as I know what crypto projects they invested into and will be shocked or pleasantly surprised when the green candles reappear.
