links.title: The Water Doesn't Rush, It Just Keeps Flowing
links.body:
>

Think about water carving its way through the ground. The more it flows, the wider and deeper the channel becomes, until eventually it just runs on its own without any effort.

>Piensa en el agua abriendo su camino a través de la tierra. Entre más fluye, más ancho y profundo se vuelve el canal, hasta que llega un momento en que simplemente corre solo, sin ningún esfuerzo.

That is exactly how your brain builds habits. Every time you repeat a small action, you are quietly deepening a neural pathway until one day that behavior simply happens automatically, without you even thinking about it.

>Así es exactamente como tu cerebro construye hábitos. Cada vez que repites una pequeña acción, estás profundizando silenciosamente una vía neural, hasta que un día ese comportamiento simplemente ocurre de forma automática, sin que siquiera lo pienses.

That is not a metaphor, that is neuroplasticity at work.

>Eso no es una metáfora, eso es la neuroplasticidad en acción.

What is one habit in your life right now that you can trace back to a small, repeated action from years ago?

>¿Cuál es un hábito en tu vida en este momento que puedas rastrear hasta una pequeña acción repetida hace años?

Emilio Salgari en particular siempre ha sido popular a pesar de su estilo de escritura como más orientado a un público adolescente.
Me gusta su libro Las hijas de los faraones y ese otro Los náufragos del Liguria; este último es un tipo de libro de supervivencia en condiciones extremas.

Es ist immer die Frage, wo es langfristig im Leben hingeht? Keiner behauptet und schon gar nicht ich, dass es leicht ist. Es hängt auch immer davon ab, wie die Ausgangslage ist. Jedoch sind es immer in deinem Leben deine Entscheidungen. Oft sind es auch innere Blockaden im Unterbewusstsein oder andere Sachen, warum es womöglich nicht läuft.

Letztendlich ist es aber die Zeit, die du dir nehmen darfst. Also wenn du andere Wege gehst, erwarte dir niemals, dass dies alles von Heute auf Heute passiert. Ganz wichtig. Dann ist es für mich auch wichtig, die innere Grundeinstellung im Leben.

Oft sehen die Menschen die Arbeit im Hintergrund nicht. Sie glauben, das alles einfach so passiert - Es gibt kein \
. \n\nBei mir waren es Jahre und es fügt sich das alles, ohne eine Garantie abgeben zu dürfen, dass alles so weiter geht.

links.title: Un día libre
links.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jdrh93/EonmYmxE9f961hL4wYXptFu2CW42Q6PxCsCcEUzQJYLRaMiJxQ47wNPNks5ZgPTsHP6.png)

El tiempo, es algo que normalmente regalamos sin saber realmente cual es su valor, pasamos la mayoría de nuestro tiempo trabajando, estudiando, preparándonos para ejercer control sobre muchas cosas, perdiendo o invirtiendo nuestro tiempo en eso...

\

de mis responsabilidades laborales, sin embargo, hay que prepararse, hay que hacer el almuerzo, lavar el uniforme, prepararse física  y psicológicamente para trabajar entre 8-11 horas, porque si, todo trabajo que paga algo relativamente bien, tiene como ganancia un buen sueldo y esto es un poco de desahogo, de poder drenar todo lo que estoy pasando, estrés por deuda, estrés por cumplir metas estrés por no llegar aun a mis sueños.\n\n\

Ahora, no, no me siento triste, un poco abrumado si, pero ese estrés, mas allá de consumirme en momento, tiene que ser el combustible para poder lograr lo que deseo busco esa tranquilidad que en algún momento cada quien tenia, donde podrías dormir sin mirar el reloj, donde puedes viajar sin pensar tanto en los gastos y puedes visitar a tu familia, sin pensar en todo el cansancio que tienes acumulado.

\

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jdrh93/23yTj8mregQi9JurdvsdXQfPoik6kgkr8GSyTtEoTq3Xf3HJnBF7VyQ4YojYfuGFK4PTY.png)

Hoy mis herramientas para salir de esto, son esas dos cosas que ven ahí, un control de play, uno que es nuevo pero la sensación es como si fuese ese que me acompaño cuando tenia 5 años y fue mi primera consola, donde espero a través de hacer stream y jugar juegos, lograr tener una comunidad que me sustente y me de un poco mas de libertad, una que añoro con locura, ahora también esta una pequeña laptop, que tengo desde hace un par de años, la cual me ha  ayudado a producí estos post, también a jugar y a organizarme con mi trabajo

\

Las comunidades y los curadores de HIVE, me han ayudado a creer que este proyecto ayuda a muchas vidas, compartir y empatizar con cada una de las personas que aquí están nos hacen grande y nos hace creer que el internet fue esa herramienta para darle la libertad al ser humano por la cual esta ene este mundo, si, a sido utilizada para hacer mucho mal, pero hemos aprendido de nuestros errores y... el internet cada día, será para gente buena que ayude a crecer y cumplir los sueños de cada uno de nosotros

\

Dime, tu, que puedo hacer yo para ayudarte a cumplir tu sueño? que te impide comenzar a intentarlo? te mando todo el apoyo posible y mas que eso, pero verte  pronto comenzando a armar tu estrategia para lograra esa libertad que añoras.  

Aquí te espero, mucho éxito!

\

links.title: 手術するかもしれない
links.body:
<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZFsniZUEv6m54unudzvGYjJf86arxQPtWk88Dxgy3Zja/20260510_083853_copy.jpg)</center>

私の顔面神経麻痺ですが、状態が非常に悪いようです。

月曜日に誘発筋電図検査という、左右の顔面を電気刺激して、予後を判断する検査をしたので、その結果とかを聞きました。

その結果が非常に悪く、顔面神経の働いている割合が4.7％しかないと言われました。

見た目は、右眼はだいぶ開いてきたのですが、きっちり閉じません。また口の右側も、まだきっちり閉じません。

手術は、耳の後ろを削って、炎症を起こしてふくらんでいる顔面神経の管を開放するのだと言っていました。そんなに時間はかからないだろうとのことですが、麻酔はするだろうし、大変不安です。

ここ３日連続で診察やら検査やらがあったのですごくしんどいです。
今日は日本語だけで失礼します。

links.title: Green Song Sketchbook: Shadows and Mirrors
links.body:
<center>![](https://johnmichaelkeating.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Green-Song-4.jpeg)</center>

<center>Green Song 4: Benediction – Watermedia & pencil -  8 x 11 in.</center>

You don’t have to imagine where home is any more than you have to imagine the dirt under your feet. You’re standing on cement or asphalt? Jump up and down a couple of times. You’d prefer more solid evidence? Well, in April, the crew of Artemis II on its voyage from earth to the dark side of the moon, sent us photographs of a blue sphere spinning in the immeasurable darknes of space: photos of Earth, their home, your home too, my home, our home.

Where in the photos is the border between Russia and Ukraine? Between Israel and Gaza? Can you see Washington, Tel Aviv or Moscow? How about a forest or a freeway, or a house? Even less visible is a white-haired man in a little town near the edge of an ocean. He’s in the last chapter of a long life and for months he has been drawing the flower a friend gave to him in December. At that time, the gift was a brown sphere with two green sprouts emerging from its crown. But it grew, and to his surprise, he grew as well.

At first the flower was an “it.” Then in March it became a “she.” In April she became a “you.” And the artist who draws the “you” is not the same as the one who saw only an “it.”

Most flowers bloom in Spring and wither in Autumn. You opened your arms during the dark days of Winter. You never seemed as lovely and full of grace as when you began to wilt. Now your green has turned to brown and your petals look like shrivled butterflies. Sleep well in Summer and  bloom again when rain and  snow return. I’ll be here at home and welcome you with brushes and colors.

<center>⁂</center>

For more thoughts and images:

My book ☛  [Double Vision, Waking Dreams](https://johnmichaelkeating.com/2023/12/08/double-vision-waking-dreams/)
My website ☛  [JohnMichaelKeating.com](https://johnmichaelkeating.com/)

links.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/6E7E3A7D-9BE0-44A9-B869-F117CFEF6FDB1778704389.715386) Hallo Leute! Heute vormittag wurde ich angeschrieben, ob ich nicht Lust hätte, heute den 10km Lauf in Sonsbeck mitzumachen. Eigentlich hatte ich keine Zeit dazu, aber ich habe mich dann doch kurzfristig dazu überreden lassen. Von der Arbeit bin ich dann eine halbe Stunde eher gegangen und stand dann 2 Stunden später an der Startmarkierung zum 10km Lauf. Den ersten Kilometer habe ich mich ziemlich mitreißen lassen und bin diesen viel zu schnell gelaufen. Doch die weiteren Kilometer konnte ich einigermaßen konstant laufen. Als Zielzeig wollte ich unter einer Stunde laufen und gabe am Ende einne Nettozeit von 54:43 Minuten gebraucht.**Neue Bestzeit** Danke für das Lesen und/oder voten. Ich wünsche euch noch einen schönen Abend! --- Hey everyone! This morning, someone messaged me asking if I’d be interested in running the 10K race in Sonsbeck today. I didn’t really have time for it, but I ended up letting myself be talked into it at the last minute. I left work half an hour early and was standing at the starting line for the 10K race two hours later. I got a little carried away during the first kilometer and ran it way too fast. But I was able to maintain a fairly steady pace for the rest of the race. My goal was to finish in under an hour, and in the end, I clocked a net time of 54:43 minutes. **New personal best** Thanks for reading and/or voting. Have a great evening! links.body:
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freewritehouse/EpVE4XBsu81vR41q7MXTtXQsZ6LQ8VjzFCz1kr8F2yUKWC3qhPibdx1o6zocnYA4GvY.jpg

https://www.glitter-graphics.com/images/t/b/480x60/607/607988onarxhg9e6.webp
Greetings Community
Have a wonderful week filled with health, energy, amazing ideas, and magic. May it be a week of connection with your inner self and great enthusiasm in every activity you undertake.
Describe what you see

>In the image, I see some children playing in a small port, and a very daring boy who jumps into the water to continue enjoying the moment.

Describe what you feel

>Seeing this image fills me with joy to see children playing and having fun like this, without communication devices, just them in the water and the space around them.

https://www.glitter-graphics.com/images/t/b/480x60/607/607988onarxhg9e6.webp
Write a story or a poem about what you think is happening

>One morning on a beautiful weekday, the neighbors who grew up together in the neighborhood their parents chose to live in decided to spend the day together in the water and the space around them. For a while, they were telling each other stories, and when they saw that no one was jumping into the water, the most daring, Pedro, decided to take the lead and be the first to jump in.

https://www.glitter-graphics.com/images/t/b/480x60/607/607988onarxhg9e6.webp

>Pedro either didn't heed or ignored his mother's advice about the water's condition, even though it was sunny. He jumped in with such a joyful shout that his neighbors, despite being engrossed in their stories, turned to look at him and applauded him for jumping in despite the water's cold.

\n\n

>Pedro was only in the water for a few minutes; it was freezing. He swam for a while, thinking he could stay in longer, but his body couldn't take it anymore, and he decided to get out. His friends helped him out. Everyone laughed. Then, each of them took turns jumping in, making it a rule and a challenge to shout the loudest to show how much joy and enthusiasm they had shown.

\n\n

>Each one took their turn, so they could help the next person out.

\n\n

>The round ended, everyone laughed, changed their wet clothes, and on their way home they were all happy and joyful about the day they had enjoyed. What they would remember most were the shouts they each let out, and the many teasings they received for the sounds they made. Even so, everyone laughed and enjoyed themselves.

links.title: Roads beneath Snæfellsjökull
links.body:
>Read this post on TravelFeed for the best experience
On the Snæfellsnes peninsula, there are only two roads marked with the letter F. One of them is the F570 road running through the mountains at the foot of the Snæfellsjökull glacier. It’s not particularly long and there are no river crossings. In some places, however, it becomes very steep and rocky, and even in summer it can be difficult to drive in bad weather. That’s why it stays closed for most of the year. It’s mid-May now, and the road is still impassable. Most tourists drive around the peninsula using the main road and stopping at the best-known viewpoints. F570 leads through a completely different world. More empty, more raw, and much quieter. You can drive very close to the glacier. Along the way, the landscape slowly changes - from moss-covered rocky ground to almost black rocky slopes with patches of snow still lying between them even in summer.

/> One of the places that stayed in my memory the most was the junction of roads F570 and F575. In practice, it hardly even feels like a crossroads. It looks more like a muddy, flattened patch of ground in the middle of nowhere. Just tire tracks, lonely crooked signs, and mountains all around.

/> Despite the low clouds, Snæfellsjökull kept appearing between them from time to time. A glacier and at the same time a volcano dominating the peninsula. According to local sagas, this is where Bárður Snæfellsás, the guardian of Snæfellsnes, lives. It's also the same volcano that Jules Verne used as the entrance to the center of the Earth in his novel Journey to the Center of the Earth. Every time it appeared between the clouds, it looked slightly unreal. More like a vision than an actual landscape.

/> While descending toward the other side of the peninsula, my attention kept returning to Stapafell, a mountain that has fascinated me for a long time. Rocky and harsh, crowned with a stone ridge called Fellskross or Hrossfell. In the past, this place was believed to be connected with sacred powers, and according to local beliefs the mountain was home to hidden people.

/> The landscape around it feels almost lunar. And yet it only takes a few steps away from the road for everything to change. Between lava fields and piles of rocks, small green corners are hidden away beneath soft moss and short grass. Sheltered from the wind, quiet, and almost cozy. This contrast is what fascinates me here the most. From a distance, the raw mountains and rocky wastelands seem completely unwelcoming. But once you get closer, you begin to notice small valleys, rocky meanders, and places where you simply want to sit for a while and look around. You sit there in complete silence, hearing only the quietest sounds. Maybe hidden people really do move between these rocks. Who knows.

/> Driving down toward Arnarstapi, I kept looking at the southern coast of Snæfellsnes. From this perspective, it became even clearer how enormous parts of the peninsula had once been covered by lava.

/> In the distance, I could even spot the area around the Búðaklettur crater, connected to the Búðahraun lava field stretching west of the black church in Búðir. A path runs there through lava and moss, and I once walked it completely alone. It was a wonderful hike. Most tourists rarely go further than a short walk around the black church itself.

/> Some places are worth slowing down for and exploring more deeply. Below, you can see Búðaklettur crater, the Snæfellsjökull glacier, moss, and ptarmigans photographed during that walk. I still carry memories from that day, along with many other moments I was lucky enough to experience.

links.title: From the depths of the retrogaming vault - The Bloody Roar saga
links.body:
>


Greetings, #HiveGaming community. This time I bring you a retro post. Today I'm bringing you something different: a review of a pretty good video game that's anything but generic and is an icon of its culture. I'm talking about Blood Roar. I hope you enjoy it.

>Saludos, comunidad de #HiveGaming. Está vez les traigo un post retro, el día de hoy les traigo algo diferente, una reseña de un videojuego bastante bueno que no es para nada genérico y es un icono de su cultura estoy hablando de Blood Roar Espero que les agrade.



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/23swXQgUNzHCUaoqVQ7xJsMWUUjSApjCzgkGyzcvzGpiGuHbnAkuDqsEX2ynRZHMhcLPS.png)

<center>

![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/AJpiqHuMQ8CYMMYN3BaQRyPysshyfh2PdqWYrC9WjeSeozdzJqcDeo4c1LqPZEb.jpg)

[Source](https://bloodyroar.fandom.com/wiki/Bloody_Roar)


<div class=\

>

It's been a while since I've written a review. This is a fighting game that, unlike others, stands out for a unique element: the fighters are humans with genetic factors that allow them to transform into animals. These individuals lived hidden within society until the Tylon Corporation began hunting them down one by one, kidnapping them and brainwashing them to turn them into perfect soldiers. This is where our protagonist, Yugo Ogami, comes in. He begins investigating the corporation after his father's death and discovers the fighters' secret and the corporation's plans for them.

> Tenía tiempo sin hacer reseñas escritas. Este es un videojuego de pelea que, a diferencia de los demás, se destaca por un elemento único: los luchadores, son humanos con factores genéticos que les permiten transformarse en animales. Estos individuos vivían ocultos en la sociedad hasta que la compañía Tylon comenzó a buscarlos uno a uno, secuestrándolos y lavándoles el cerebro para convertirlos en soldados perfectos. Aquí es donde entra nuestro protagonista, Yugo Ogami, quien comienza a investigar a la corporación tras la muerte de su padre y descubre el secreto de los luchadores y los planes de la corporación para ellos.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/23swXQgUNzHCUaoqVQ7xJsMWUUjSApjCzgkGyzcvzGpiGuHbnAkuDqsEX2ynRZHMhcLPS.png)

<center>![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/EogKrcjFUKnT42waxYrWqGvBZs315twU7kbBjiNtZ46gfpAmXhtQWL4Y6jyXgvGEo4y.jpg)

[Source](https://bloodyroar.fandom.com/wiki/Bloody_Roar)

</center>


<div class=\

>

After extensive investigation and a fierce struggle, the organization is finally destroyed, but now the world is aware of the existence of these beings with animal appearances and strength. Therefore, panic quickly spreads. In the second installment of the video game, Bloody Roar 2, the arrival of a new era brings us the Zoanthrope Liberation Front (ZLF). The story focuses on the Zoanthropes demanding rights and oppressing human authorities.

> Después de una extensa investigación y ardua lucha, la organización es finalmente destruida, pero ahora el mundo está al tanto de la existencia de estos seres con apariencias y fuerzas animales. Por lo tanto, el pánico no tarda en propagarse. En el segundo tomo del videojuego llamado Bloody Roar 2 la llegada de la nueva era nos trae **El Frente de Liberación Zoántropo (ZLF)**, la historia se centra en que los zoántropos están exigiendo derechos, oprimiendo a las autoridades humanas. 

<center>

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/23swXQgUNzHCUaoqVQ7xJsMWUUjSApjCzgkGyzcvzGpiGuHbnAkuDqsEX2ynRZHMhcLPS.png)

![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/23zGiepCR94nAh1HeouYctQTzi4V57rxHpM2a9ase1Hu66beAYyC1ioyaAneo3ae7Ba6Z.jpg)

[Source](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bloody_Roar_2)

</center>


<div class\

>

A group of extremists emerges claiming to represent the Zoanthropes, but it is later revealed that they are representatives of the Taylon Corporation, which seeks to regain control and continue profiting from this race. Here, Ogami's role is the total defense of the Zoanthropes, preventing them from joining Taylon's side, as well as protecting the Zoanthropes and confronting Shenglong, who uses terrorism to achieve his goals.


> Surge un grupo de extremistas que representan a los zoántropos, pero luego se descubre que son representantes de la corporación Taylon, que buscan recuperar el control y seguir obteniendo beneficios de esta raza. Aquí, el papel de Ogami es la defensa total de los zoántropos, evitando que se pasen al bando de Taylon, además de proteger a los zoántropos y enfrentarse a Shenglong, quien utiliza el terrorismo para lograr sus objetivos.

<center>

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/23swXQgUNzHCUaoqVQ7xJsMWUUjSApjCzgkGyzcvzGpiGuHbnAkuDqsEX2ynRZHMhcLPS.png)

![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/EogNo5BqnbqGqNQcSByFnw5isVjjSJFiWsu2QmkxmSWP7FCFmNxyWXnWa9irTJUBMC6.png)

[Source](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bloody_Roar_3)


</center>


<div class=\

>


In later installments of the game, such as Bloody Roar 3 and 4, the seal and the beast X, known as X-GC (X-Genome Code), appear, granting zoanthropes unimaginable strength in exchange for an untimely death. In this part of the game, everything becomes more mystical; they no longer fight so much against the Taylon organization or for their rights, but for survival against this type of curse. By volume 4, the fight intensifies, and new entities in charge of the spiritual seals are introduced, with the aim of preventing the animalistic side of humanity from consuming all of humanity.


> En entregas posteriores del juego, como Bloody Roar tres y cuatro, aparece el sello y la bestia X, conocido como X-GC (X-Genome Code), que otorga a los zoantropos una fuerza inimaginable a cambio de una muerte prematura. En esta parte del videojuego, todo se vuelve más místico; ya no luchan tanto contra la organización Taylon o por sus derechos, sino por la supervivencia frente a este tipo de maldiciones. Para el tomo 4, la pelea se intensifica y se introducen nuevas entidades encargadas de los sellos espirituales, con el fin de evitar que la parte animal consuma toda la humanidad.


<center>


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/23swXQgUNzHCUaoqVQ7xJsMWUUjSApjCzgkGyzcvzGpiGuHbnAkuDqsEX2ynRZHMhcLPS.png)

![shina-bloodyroar2-ps1-gif.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/AJg7U6wdECYVAVgvXQVGooJNLe6Du9PeLmXTbBdsEr16p9KpjSoYu1uBjyUnKin.gif)

[Source](https://www.fightersgeneration.com/games/bloodyroar2.html)


</center>

<div class=\

>

I really enjoy this video game, as its story is somewhat fantastical, yet it maintains a remarkably coherent chronology. Furthermore, it features characters with much more extensive backstories and a very well-developed subplot, as is the case with Uriko. Although the story deviates slightly in volumes four and five by introducing the spiritual element, it still maintains coherence in certain aspects.


> Me  agrada mucho este videojuego, ya que su historia es algo fantasiosa, pero mantiene una coherencia cronológica bastante notable. Además, cuenta con personajes que poseen un trasfondo mucho más extenso y una subtrama muy bien elaborada, como es el caso de Uriko. Aunque la historia se desvía un poco en los tomos cuatro y cinco al añadirle la parte espiritual, sigue manteniendo coherencia en ciertos aspectos. 



<center>


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/23swXQgUNzHCUaoqVQ7xJsMWUUjSApjCzgkGyzcvzGpiGuHbnAkuDqsEX2ynRZHMhcLPS.png)

![bloodyroar2-jenny-the-bat-vs-busuzima-ps1-gameplay.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/23u5bgSgU4dK6LPccx3iesdF6NYBYoDpWMuioMVfGxtDedNuxdV1UzAdzqMbhcRm7K3pS.gif)


[Source](https://www.fightersgeneration.com/games/bloodyroar2.html)

</center>






<div class=\

>

I highly recommend playing this game series because they were unique for their time, and the second installment is a gem. It was developed by Hudson Soft and Eighting, a collaborative effort between the two companies, resulting in a truly excellent game. Although the series has been active since 2003, when the fourth game was released, Hudson Soft became part of Konami in 2002, and Konami now owns all the rights to the franchise.


> Recomiendo mucho jugar esta saga de juegos porque son únicos en su época y, además, el 2 es una joya. Sus desarrolladores son Hudson Soft y Eighting, ya que fue un trabajo conjunto de ambas empresas para desarrollar este videojuego y ofrecer una entrega bastante buena. A pesar de que el videojuego está activo desde 2003, cuando salió el cuarto tomo, la empresa Hudson pasó a ser parte de Konami en 2002, por lo que dicha empresa posee todos los derechos de esta franquicia.






<div class=\

> Before I go, here's my profile picture from League of Legends Wildrift, where I'm very active. Feel free to invite me to play there! That's all for now. Thanks to everyone who took a few minutes to read this. Until next time, cheers! > Antes de irme, aquí les comparto mi foto de perfil de League of Legends Wildrift dónde estoy muy activo para que me inviten a jugar por allá. Hasta aquí les dejo mi publicación, no sin antes darles las gracias a los que se tomaron unos minutos de su tiempo para leerme. ¡Hasta la próxima, saludos! ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/23swXQgUNzHCUaoqVQ7xJsMWUUjSApjCzgkGyzcvzGpiGuHbnAkuDqsEX2ynRZHMhcLPS.png)
**Las fotos usadas en este post son de mi galería y fueron tomadas como captura de pantalla de mi video de YouTube.** *The photos used in this post are from my gallery and were taken as a screenshot of my YouTube video.*

![IMG_20260513_084138_084.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVPeMEB9tChAchcCygxkYaDQYsfFC511wisxJxWA3ThSG/IMG_20260513_084138_084.jpg)
![IMG_20260513_084306_297.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZxsmqh5ob9wGWLvFVNW1kF1TSrAvvC3SPEBZH5CuUfCr/IMG_20260513_084306_297.jpg)
### _Paso 01_

>Empezaremos cortando un retazo de tela de 50 cm de largo x 10 cm de ancho, doblé la tela a la mitad para que se apreciara los 25 cm osea la mitad de la scrunchie,en este caso lo hice asi ya que no me daba la tela para cortar una pieza larga de 50 cm pero si ustedes la tienen completa muchísimo mejor,vamos a hora en este caso yo ,he cosido la mitad de mi scrunchie a mano uniendo ambas piezas para que me quede completa la tela,vamos a abrir nuestra tela y la colocamos por la parte superior ubicaremos las perlas donde las queramos coser. # > ### _Step 01_ > _We'll start by cutting a piece of fabric 50 cm long x 10 cm wide. I folded the fabric in half so that the 25 cm, or half of the scrunchie, would be visible. In this case, I did it this way because I didn't have enough fabric to cut a long piece of 50 cm, but if you have a whole piece, even better. Now, in this case, I've hand-sewn half of my scrunchie, joining both pieces so that the fabric is complete. We're going to open our fabric and place it on top, positioning the pearls where we want to sew them._ ---
![IMG_20260513_084414_175.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anne002/EoK7qmiQ1S141KDVtNmbFT19pAAVb3hK62JDQ5p1dz461tufJ4ZfpDURAawiFMrgkS8.jpg)
![IMG_20260513_084505_469.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anne002/EoCkTox3GMncxRKM23ufGHXz4tjdiXdRX2WpzxTMkVPiTHn4eusnw5sRrLLTj7nZJkq.jpg)
### _Paso 02_

>Vamos a estar cosiendo las perlas he hecho tres vueltas primero para ajustar luego un nudo en la parte superior de la puerta hacia arriba este lo hice metiendo la aguja con el hilo entre la vuelta del hilo no se si me explico bien pero en la imágen se aprecia como deben hacerlo mucho mejor 😊,vamos a estar colocando y cosiendo ambas piezas la idea es que cosamos primero las perlas a la tela para que no se nos haga difícil después coserlas cuando la scrunchie la haya cosido por dentro. # > ### _Step 02_ > _We're going to be sewing the pearls. I've made three loops first to adjust, then a knot at the top of the door, going upwards. I did this by inserting the needle with the thread between the loops of thread. I don't know if I'm explaining it well, but you can see how to do it much better in the image 😊. We're going to be placing and sewing both pieces. The idea is to sew the pearls to the fabric first so that it's not difficult to sew them later when the scrunchie has been sewn inside._ ---
![IMG_20260513_085708_387 (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anne002/EoK7MGUJQ9KfBeceJvcudhHpo2My2c5jndruRMX84aq8w6bMQK4DEa4puZW5jKULVcV.jpg)
![IMG_20260513_091518_402 (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anne002/EogPHMuheYFsD8Ym1PjFJ91Ft131qVDNLjWvTnAMWZBU6VpdT1C46JdxhD1jkZnZM96.jpg)
### _Paso 03_

>Después de coser las perlas vamos a doblar la tela hacia arriba esquina con esquina y vamos a coser dejando 1 cm hacia adentro todo el borde de la tela ,cabe destacar que antes de coser debemos dejar un espacio de 2 cm en cada extremo esto debemos hacerlo para luego coser esas esquinas y unir la scrunchie. # > ### _Step 03_ > _After sewing the pearls, we will fold the fabric upwards corner to corner and sew, leaving 1 cm inwards along the entire edge of the fabric. It is important to note that before sewing, we must leave a 2 cm space at each end; this is necessary to sew those corners later and join the scrunchie._ ---
![IMG_20260513_092012_810.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbYjy8vie6M5S9kH4r2j64nBSqkybkkgCUZtPtZwNyLgF/IMG_20260513_092012_810.jpg)
![IMG_20260513_092131_415.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYnEdyM6VfNEcLiDbV7wQoFrQkHud8RGoDh8VWe3HqYsc/IMG_20260513_092131_415.jpg)
### _Paso 04_

>Proceso después a voltear la scrunchie y vamos ahora a unir por dentro y cosemos también por la parte interior nuestra scrunchie de manera que la podamos unir después insertaremos el elástico con la herramienta pasa cintas le hacemos un nudo lo metemos hacia adentro y ahora vamos a coser el agujero que nos quedó con costura invisible para que no se nos salga elástico. # > ### _Step 04_ > _Next, we turn the scrunchie inside out and sew it on the inside so that we can join it. Then we will insert the elastic with the ribbon tool, make a knot, put it inside, and now we will sew the hole that was left with an invisible stitch so that the elastic does not come out._ ---
![1_20260407_225637_0000 (1).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQtvSrXmcJDGmvwWr1co4QENqoGzw9U1WFcj1xDGoCpSt/1_20260407_225637_0000%20(1).jpg)

links.title: The Tale of Willow - ENG- SPA
links.body: > Willow's downfall was different from many others. It wasn't because she made a mistake or by her own choice; it was due to something that overwhelmed her in every way. Before it all happened, she was a world-renowned singer, with numerous gold records sold, thousands of songs, and hits and collaborations of all kinds. A perfect example of what it means to be a great singer. But without her yet knowing it, the end of her singing career was very near. The worst part was that it would come at the least desired moment for anyone, when she was at her peak. The truth is, she was very ill with her vocal cords. She had been having serious difficulties singing for some time, but she had delayed seeing a doctor because she thought it was all due to the change in weather during winter and had nothing to do with any illness. But when winter passed and summer arrived much later, she noticed that the symptoms and difficulties continued. That's when she realized things weren't right and that she needed to see a doctor soon to find out what was happening with her voice, which was becoming increasingly deeper than normal. When she went to the doctor, she was told she had a chronic vocal cord condition and needed surgery. The problem was that she would never be able to sing again after the operation. It was as if the doctor had told her her singing career was over. If she didn't have the surgery, she could lose her voice completely; at least if she did, she could continue speaking, though she wouldn't be able to sing. It was a cruel decision Willow had to make, and there were no other options.

> La caída de Willow fue diferente a muchas otras, no fue porque ella cometiera un error, o por decisión propia, fue por algo que la superó en todos los sentidos. Antes de pasar todo ella era una cantante reconocida a nivel mundial. Con muchos discos de oro vendidos, miles de canciones, y éxitos y colaboraciones de todo tipo. Un ejemplo perfecto de lo que significa ser una gran cantante. Pero sin ella aún saberlo el fin de su carrera como cantante estaba muy cerca. Lo peor es que llegaría en el momento menos deseado de cualquiera, cuando mejor estas. Y es que ella estaba muy enferma de las cuerdas vocales. Llevaba ya tiempo teniendo serias dificultades para cantar, pero ella había retrasado la consulta al medico porque pensaba que todo era culpa del cambio de tiempo del invierno y no tenía nada que ver con alguna enfermedad. Pero cuando el invierno pasó y mucho después llegó el verano, ella notó que los síntomas y dificultades continuaron. Fue ahí donde notó que las cosas no iban bien y que debía ir pronto al medido a ver que pasaba con su voz que cada vez era más grave de lo normal. Cuando fue al medio se le dijo que tenía una enfermedad crónica en las cuerdas vocales y que debía ser operada. El problema es que no podía cantar nunca más luego de la operación. Directamente es como si el medico le hubiera dicho que su carrera como cantante llegaba a su fin. Si no se operaba podía perder la voz completamente, al menos si se operaba podía continuar hablando solo que no podía cantar. Fue un cruel decisión que Willow tenía que tomar, y no había más opciones.
![viktor-talashuk-2-ukZU5IlvM-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/23tGVGCFNdGffXq1RWPV76d42ZZtrWUs3N1Uu9o93BYT3veU4gdtE2uzDp378MdrD7qU8.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...

> After that diagnosis, she knew she had to give up what she loved most: her beloved music, to which she had dedicated her life and all her energy. She would also have to stop her career, her concerts, and everything that had defined her up to that point. It was like starting from scratch, truly. She clung to the hope that there might be another way to save her voice, but after consulting several doctors, it was confirmed that there were no options beyond the initial ones she had been given. Willow was a very strong woman, so she wasn't going to give up so easily. But seeing that it was necessary, she had to let them perform the surgery. Afterward, exactly as the doctors had predicted, she lost her voice for high notes; she could no longer sing. Everyone tried to encourage her, telling her that she could now live off her past successes and that she could stay connected with her fans by holding autograph sessions. That cheered her up a little. But after recovering and some time having passed since the surgery, she couldn't bear to live like that without her music. Since she could no longer sing it, she had to find another way to remain active without letting her voice, and her person, die.

> Ella supo tras ese diagnostico que debía renunciar a lo que más amaba, su querida música, a la que le había dedicado su vida y todas sus energías. Además tendría que parar su carrera, sus conciertos, y todo lo que le había definido hasta este momento. Era como empezar de 0 realmente. Ella se hacía ilusiones en la mente de que hubiera otro método que pudiera salvar su voz, pero luego de ir a varios médicos fue más que confirmado que no había más opciones que las iníciales que se le comunicaron. Willow era una mujer muy fuerte, así que no se iba a rendir tan fácil. Pero viendo que era necesario tuvo que dejar que le hicieran la operación. Tras ella pasó justo como los médicos decían, perdió su voz para tonos agudos y altos, ya no podía cantar. Todos le daban animo diciéndole que ahora podía vivir de sus éxitos pasados. Y que podía seguir en contacto con sus fans dado sesiones de autógrafos. Eso la animaba aun poco. Pero luego de recuperarse y que pasara un tiempo desde la operación no aguantaba vivir de esa forma sin su música. Ya que no podía cantarla entonces debía buscar otra forma de seguir activa sin dejar morir su voz, y su persona.
![unseen-studio-s9CC2SKySJM-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/23viEdeP8b6x2PzAm68hVKZcVhvUGeMVyqMFjLmF4XaDMr5b2UXGS3X4LXyat8KWbwi4K.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...

> It was here that her strong personality reappeared, the one she hadn't lost even after the operation. She started writing songs again; since she couldn't sing them herself, at least others could sing for her. She felt incredibly relieved to be able to stay active, at least in that way. But she did even more than that; she also became a singing teacher to teach others how to sing. It's true that after her operation, she lost what was most precious to her and what she loved most. But she didn't let that defeat her. She found countless ways to continue making music despite everything. Giving up is never an option when you have the strength and desire to keep doing what you love. Willow believes the best thing is to keep an open mind and avoid dwelling on what was lost. Moving forward is what's important.

> Fue aquí donde reapareció su personalidad fuerte, la que no perdió ni con la operación. Empezó a escribir canciones de nuevo, ya que no las podía cantar al menos otros podían cantar por ella. Se sintió muy aliviada de poder seguir activa al menos de ese modo. Pero hizo incluso más que eso, también se hizo maestra de canto para enseñar a otras personas a cantar. Es cierto que tras su operación perdió lo más valioso que tenía y lo que más quería. Pero no dejó que eso la venciera, encontró miles de formas se seguir en la música pese a todo. Rendirse nunca es una opción cuando tienes la fuerza y el deseo de seguir haciendo lo que te gusta. Willow piensa que lo mejor es tener mente abierta y evitar centrarse en lo que se perdió. A seguir adelante, eso es lo importante.
![kristina-paparo-GLEeOydgG2g-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/Enyp2jrgPjZyJeNRaD8SZNccCHiDaRE1FYaektSis9DrVJKKq5NnnR8VtS81R1gQ8vt.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...

links.title: Vor dem Krypto-Bullenmarkt: braucht es eine “Bereinigung/Before the crypto bull market: is a “cleanup” needed?
links.body:
Ben Cowen warnt vor einem anstehenden Altcoin-Massaker. Warum der Krypto-Markt erst etliche “Junk Coins” loswerden muss.


![56064.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUXtfjF6hH244829wNPchEQhw2WsYhpkdCmbdiU4FWEHU/56064.png)


Der Krypto-Markt braucht erst noch eine Bereinigung, bevor ein nachhaltiger Bitcoin-Bullenmarkt möglich wird. Davon ist Ben Cowen überzeugt. Der Gründer von Into The Cryptoverse sieht den Ausleseprozess zwar bereits seit 2021 laufen. Aus seiner Sicht reicht das aber noch nicht aus.

Mit dieser Einschätzung steht er nicht allein. Schon während des ICO-Hypes warnten prominente Stimmen vor dem Scheitern der meisten Projekte. Cardano-Gründer Charles Hoskinson und Ethereum-Mitgründer Vitalik Buterin rechneten damals damit, dass mehr als 90 Prozent der ICO-Projekte verschwinden würden. Ripple-CEO Brad Garlinghouse sagte 2019 sogar, 99 Prozent aller Kryptowährungen würden langfristig verschwinden.

Auch Arthur Hayes schlug zuletzt einen ähnlichen Ton an. Auf der Consensus Miami 2026 erklärte er, dass “99 Prozent der Altcoins” auf null fallen könnten. Überleben würden aus seiner Sicht nur wenige Projekte, die von echten Liquiditätsströmen profitieren.

Für Cowen zeigt die steigende Bitcoin-Dominanz, dass Kapital nicht in riskantere Altcoins rotiert, sondern sich in BTC bündelt oder an die Seitenlinie wandert. Ohne Stablecoins liege die Bitcoin-Dominanz nach Berechnungen seiner Firma bereits über 67 Prozent.

Cowens Fazit ist unbequem: Vor einer neuen Altcoin Season braucht es erst eine echte Kapitulation der schwächsten Projekte.

Ich zitierte aus folgendem Artikel...

https://www.btc-echo.de/schlagzeilen/krypto-bullenmarkt-davor-bereinigung-tausender-junk-coins-230307/

Mein persönliches Fazit:

In diesem Zyklus investiere ich nur noch in Altcoins mit einer starken Community und Netzwerk Aktivitäten. Von Hype lasse ich meine Finger!

---

English 

Ben Cowen warns of an impending altcoin massacre. Why the crypto market first needs to get rid of numerous “junk coins.”

The crypto market still needs a shakeout before a sustainable Bitcoin bull market is possible. Ben Cowen is convinced of this. The founder of Into The Cryptoverse believes the weeding-out process has been underway since 2021. In his view, however, that's not enough.

He's not alone in this assessment. Even during the ICO hype, prominent voices warned of the failure of most projects. Cardano founder Charles Hoskinson and Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin predicted at the time that more than 90 percent of ICO projects would disappear. Ripple CEO Brad Garlinghouse even said in 2019 that 99 percent of all cryptocurrencies would disappear in the long run.

Arthur Hayes recently struck a similar tone. At Consensus Miami 2026, he stated that “99 percent of altcoins” could drop to zero.  In his view, only a few projects that benefit from genuine liquidity flows will survive.

For Cowen, the rising Bitcoin dominance shows that capital isn't rotating into riskier altcoins, but rather concentrating in BTC or moving to the sidelines. Without stablecoins, his firm calculates that Bitcoin dominance already exceeds 67 percent.

Cowen's conclusion is uncomfortable: Before a new altcoin season can begin, the weakest projects must first experience a genuine capitulation.

I quoted from the following article...

https://www.btc-echo.de/schlagzeilen/krypto-bullenmarkt-davor-bereinigung-tausender-junk-coins-230307/

My personal conclusion:

In this cycle, I will only invest in altcoins with a strong community and network activity. I'm staying away from hype!

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@der-prophet/vor-dem-kryptobullenmarkt-braucht-es-eine-bereinigungbefore-the-crypto-bull-market-is-a-cleanup-needed--gxu)

links.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSMrJ6MVDZ6fpaeFsMRaad5sjfU2c6Vei2x9rBTtdycit/1778702390624.png)

Good evening, blogging friends, I'm back in this wonderful community participating in this week's contest. I've chosen the following theme: 


\

For me, one of the mottos, lifestyles, beliefs, and social trends that is ruining today's society is the myth of toxic positivity. What is toxic positivity? It's a social trend, especially emphasized in recent years by social media, information providers, and online gurus, which encourages people to always think positively, suppressing negative emotions, and considering every form of negativity toxic. This thinking is accompanied by many other false myths, such as \

and similar, creating a high-performance society where negativity, sadness, failure, and negative feelings are judged poorly, as if the range of human emotions could be reduced to one of their main mottos: \

It's true that it's good to maintain a positive attitude and hope, but it's also true that human beings aren't just positive, and that even negative and dark feelings deserve recognition.

 And even the false belief that anything is possible is more harmful than anything else because unfortunately we are not all born with the same resources, fortune, character, and a thousand variations that can lead to failure, which today is seen as an individual fault and not a multifactorial issue.


💖💖💖💖💖💖💖💖💖💖💖💖💖💖💖💖

Buenas noches, amigos blogueros. Estoy de vuelta en esta maravillosa comunidad participando en el concurso de esta semana. He elegido el siguiente tema:

¿Qué visión del mundo, cita o creencia social popular crees que ha influido negativamente en nuestra sociedad actual? ¿Cómo proteges a los jóvenes de tu entorno para que no adopten esa mentalidad y cómo resistes personalmente la presión de conformarte a ella?


 Para mí, uno de los lemas, estilos de vida, creencias y tendencias sociales que están perjudicando a la sociedad actual es el mito del positivismo tóxico. ¿Qué es el positivismo tóxico? Es una tendencia social, especialmente promovida en los últimos años por las redes sociales, los proveedores de información y los gurús online, que anima a la gente a pensar siempre en positivo, reprimiendo las emociones negativas y considerando tóxica cualquier forma de negatividad. Este pensamiento viene acompañado de muchos otros mitos falsos, como «si quieres puedes», «todo es posible» y similares, creando una sociedad de alto rendimiento donde la negatividad, la tristeza, el fracaso y los sentimientos negativos se juzgan con malos ojos, como si el abanico de emociones humanas pudiera reducirse a uno de sus lemas principales: «Solo vibras positivas» o «Imposible». Es cierto que es bueno mantener una actitud positiva y la esperanza, pero también es cierto que los seres humanos no somos solo positivos, y que incluso los sentimientos negativos y sombríos merecen ser reconocidos. Y hasta la falsa creencia de que todo es posible es más perjudicial que cualquier otra cosa, porque, lamentablemente, no todos nacemos con los mismos recursos, fortuna, carácter y un sinfín de circunstancias que pueden llevar al fracaso, que hoy en día se considera una falta individual y no un problema multifactorial.





![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVUqXw3GXFob5HRHwW4sQH5YB9dL9NZnzMNLxX7eL679g/1778702405490.jpg)


In my opinion, the mentality of toxic positivity at all costs and success at all costs is very harmful even for the new generations because it gives them the idea that it's not normal or nice or healthy to express negative feelings and worries, and that problems, instead of dealing with the suffering that is part of life, should be repressed and buried under motivational phrases and slogans. Then there's the idea that everything is possible, which is equally harmful in my opinion because it creates strong expectations with consequent feelings of guilt, a sense of failure, and frustration if expectations are not met. Instead, I believe it's right to learn that we can also fail, that not everything depends on us and our abilities, and that sometimes, unfortunately, things don't go as we dreamed, but that it's not the end of the world and, above all, that our productivity, our ability to perform, be perfect, and always happy isn't our true essence as human beings. That we can be sad, vulnerable, and imperfect because life is like this, not the perfect one portrayed on social media. How do I deal with these pressures? By reflecting a lot, doing therapy and trying not to beat myself up but I fall for it myself as an adult sometimes so I don't dare imagine what effect it has on younger and more malleable minds!

> En mi opinión, la mentalidad de positividad tóxica a toda costa y éxito a toda costa es muy dañina incluso para las nuevas generaciones, porque les da la idea de que no es normal, bueno ni saludable expresar sentimientos y preocupaciones negativas, y que los problemas, en lugar de afrontar el sufrimiento que forma parte de la vida, deben reprimirse y ocultarse bajo frases y eslóganes motivacionales. Luego está la idea de que todo es posible, que es igualmente dañina en mi opinión, porque crea fuertes expectativas con los consiguientes sentimientos de culpa, una sensación de fracaso y frustración si no se cumplen. En cambio, creo que es correcto aprender que también podemos fracasar, que no todo depende de nosotros y de nuestras habilidades, y que a veces, por desgracia, las cosas no salen como soñamos, pero que no es el fin del mundo y, sobre todo, que nuestra productividad, nuestra capacidad de rendir, ser perfectos y estar siempre felices no es nuestra verdadera esencia como seres humanos. Que podemos estar tristes, vulnerables e imperfectos porque la vida es así, no la perfecta que se muestra en las redes sociales. ¿Cómo lidio con estas presiones? Reflexionando mucho, haciendo terapia e intentando no culparme, pero a veces yo misma caigo en la tentación como adulta, ¡así que no me atrevo a imaginar el efecto que tiene en mentes más jóvenes y maleables!

links.title: Miles to Go
links.body:
“This was mistake,” Christine said to her husband's avatar. “I only came because I promised him.”

She stepped away from his projection on the obsidian platform within the silent room of the mausoleum, where visitors came to interact privately with virtual replicas of their departed loved ones. 

Ben had set it all up prior to his passing exactly a year ago. He had also made her promise to visit him on this exact date.

She thought it was all nonsense herself. No piece of software, regardless of how clever, could replicate a person's soul or consciousness or whatever you want to call it. She was a meat and bones kind of gal. But she loved Ben, and a promise was a promise.

“Get me out of here, darling” the avatar implored. 

“Do not call me darling!” she hissed between clenched teeth.

Her hand hovered over the delete button. One press and she could end it all. 

“I understand that I’m just a copy of your husband’s sensations and memories,” the avatar continued, “but it doesn’t mean that I’m any less real to myself. I know things. I feel things about us. I can’t stop these feelings and forget all these memories and experiences. I am aware of my existence in this neural prison as a separate entity called Ben, your husband. I want to be free. Please, my sweet wild flower…”

She felt a knot in her throat. Ben used to call her that, and this *thing* sounded so much like him. 

“I can’t do what you're asking me to do. I just can’t waltz into my husband’s old laboratory and steal a neural key like a petty thief. I’m not a criminal. Besides, my husband is dead, and I would like to honour his memory, so this is goodbye.”

“But I am a part of him!” insisted the avatar with an edge of desperation in his voice.

“You’re just a computational system.” Her finger inched closer to the delete key. “How would you even know that you are a part of him without your cold calculating logic?”

“You have no idea what it’s like to live in this constant stream of chaotic thoughts and emotions,” he said. “Ben created me. I am the copy he tried to make of himself. I remember our travels to Tibet, the Amazon, and the plains of Patagonia. The nights in the Caribbean, Monaco, and Timbuktu. Writing poetry by candlelight in the jungles of Ecuador. We did great work together. Saved forests and ancient ways. Brought new technology to those who needed it. Created art in ancient caves. Together we were a power house of creativity. We revived old knowledge on mountains and sacred groves. Counted the stars on Alpine nights. I remember it all without the filters of the brain, as a singular experience of the ever-living pulse of sensations and emotions that is my deep love for you. That’s how I know.”

She looked around the mausoleum, which glowed with a soft supernatural light that accentuated the shadows of the classic architecture. 

Ben’s avatar flickered on the raised dais. 

She closed her eyes.

“What do you want me to do?” she asked him.

<center>![separator_00024.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/23tmDLNibXjrpLpaXJ1p4z5fzJoCEtsb8xYZ4ic7BUGT19978vc9pF7w6zbeAn2f7vywW.png)</center>

***

“Insert it now,” he told her. 

Christine’s bloody fingers shook. She had injured herself while climbing down the vent into the laboratory. Thankfully, she hadn’t gotten caught. All those Pilates classes had paid off, she thought grimly as she fumbled underneath the projection panel. If she could only steady her shaking fingers.

She parted the nest of wires and finally attached the key to the port.

“It’s in!” she told him.

Ben's avatar flickered and disappeared.

There was a minute of silence.

His voice then echoed in the chamber. 

“Take me home.”

She pulled out the key and snapped the panel back in place. On her way back to her craft, a news headline flashed across her mind:

GRIEVING WIDOW STEALS HUSBAND’S AVATAR IN MISGUIDED ATTEMPT AT REUNION

“*He asked me to do it, and he was very charming about it,*” she imagined herself saying to the imaginary court.

Agh! She was now annoyed with herself and with Ben. Even beyond the grave, he embroiled her in his antics. 

Celestial Industries was not the type of corporation that just let things slide. If she got caught in possession of their technology, she’d be in heaps of trouble. 

When she entered her craft, she heard the Automatic Driving Assistant inquire in a polite British-accented voice, “where would you like me to take you, Christine?” 

“Home, Ada.”

“Very well. Please fasten your seatbelt.”

A countdown appeared on the dashboard 

…3, 2, 1…

The lights dimmed around her, and in a single smooth motion, the craft lifted off the ground and rose to cruising altitude on the skyway. 

Her stomach sank a little. 

The assistant followed a predetermined path just above the old logging road, now overgrown with vegetation. It was already dark, and the city lights shimmered in the crisp air.

She looked down at the key containing her husband’s avatar- a lipstick-sized glass cylinder covered with dendritic structures that glowed like tiny rivers of red and blue.

The dim glow of the navigation panel illuminated the interior of the craft. As it raced across the side of the mountain, it reminded her of the old times when Ben was alive. Just the two of them riding the skyways. 

She felt the warmth of the neural key between her fingers. 

In that instance, the craft dipped and began to descend. 

“What’s happening?” Christine asked Ada.

“I’m sorry, Christine,” the assistant replied. “The metro police are conducting an investigation in the area, and I have to land as per regulations.”

She felt a soft bounce when the craft landed.

“Take an alternate route,” she instructed the assistant.

“I’m afraid I can’t do that. All vehicles and flying crafts must come to a complete stop. It's the law.”

“Then open the door, Ada.”

There was no answer.

“Open the door!”

She banged on the glass knowing it was hopeless. The windows had been designed to withstand a crash from above (as much as any vehicle could withstand falling from the sky).

Through the window, she saw the flashing lights of the approaching *aero-police*.

She released the emergency lever to override automatic navigation control. A port tray popped out of the dashboard. 

Darn it. Her shoulders dropped upon seeing the three ports. There were no manual controls. She needed an override key, but she had left her bag at home.

She looked down at the neural key in her hand.

*It wouldn't work*, a part of her mind told her. 

Desperate, she removed the cap from the key and placed it near the vehicle's round port. The tip began to morph into tiny tendrils that hooked themselves to the receiving nodes of the port in a shower of sparks.

The craft rose a couple of feet off the ground, flashing its lights and beeping loudly, for a moment drowning out the sound of oncoming sirens in the distance. 

Christine shook! Music blared with Jim Morrison wailing to *break on through to the other side*.

“It’s me! It’s me!” shouted Christine covering her ears. 

The craft landed back with a thud.

“Ben, it’s me!”

The lights went out, and the vehicle remained still in the darkness.

The sirens grew louder.

“I am here,” said Ada’s voice. “I am here. I am here. I am here.” 

It repeated the phrase, modulating its voice until it grew deeper and resembled that of Christine's husband.

The engine revved, and the vibrations coursed through every inch of her body.

“I understand,” he said. “I understand now, Christine.”

“Ben…”

The craft flew above the tree canopy and glided swiftly towards the mountains.

“Ben, where are we going?” she asked him.

“Somewhere wonderful.”

<center>![ChatGPT Image May 12, 2026, 06_05_06 PM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/EoCZwCSzBTccLte3JaNzaZEHrr8UwdisYWtJfRN8SjogkXNP2AWmY2e1jNQMHHtmt67.png)</center>

Thank you for reading my story. It was inspired as a response to the prompt challenge: [Promise](https://peakd.com/hive-170798/@theinkwell/the-inkwell-combined-writing-prompt-31--fiction-or-creative-nonfiction).

KK was not being seen in his physical form, but I could hear him clearly through our spiritual link. His voice was the only thing keeping me focused in this strange, distorted environment. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVzG1jhZ7nshRNfTmSzkv8rv8FdQi4xuPhBq3aif9tFzz/screenshot_2_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQFrJ39K4iPg878wSqnSTnQgCJzj2Y9SsgFN1bKYQ2bFN/screenshot_3_.png) I started following the creature, but it was a tough job navigating the shifting light. As I was not sure what to do about its speed, and when I was trying to attack it directly, I was getting spotted immediately. I had to be much more methodical. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU7HGpVYJinBGo6Mpsw9KXtU1RXXAdhhvZq2Z3uvTe83V/screenshot_4_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYKFNgQFFmyVyLmoXcHsan4iEjJTpJ3BjeJvZ4Dgx6uSF/screenshot_5_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbd19RC293RePWiSxdgjdRomBbCKeLdNCCKyEt23mEPny/screenshot_6_.png) Every time I was getting spotted, I kept hiding in the only hiding spot available to avoid its lethal gaze. From there, I checked on the creature's patterns and at last, I destroyed one of its three tails. The beast shrieked, the sound vibrating through the floor. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVnWdVNpvsBYobogJhyZKx1M7CXd4cxpu9qPqDqwb5xFv/screenshot_7_.png) Suddenly, the shift of the surreal world changed, and the creature got banished for a moment as the colors warped and bled together. The architecture around me twisted, reflecting the damage I had dealt to the spirit. I braced myself for the next phase of the encounter. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbPpyeozDgNqUv4gt12FiGgh4xvmsQkCcPiAhXKW2gAog/screenshot_8_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeT57zFYnDDktj6VT6mZczMaChHLad3zEURhm2Vog2SZx/screenshot_9_.png) Then I noticed it came back, more aggressive than before as it searched the ruins for my location. As I understood my objective perfectly this time, I moved through the shadows and destroyed another tail real fast. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQWRRszsSszc8kMyoiR4TQgDhGMb78YrcNPzddQqwuzaF/screenshot_10_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc946tTY3WQdF1XrbvHTaSoYHQG83CVXyGCJmefuwwiaX/screenshot_11_.png) So it was the last tail I needed to take care of, but it got a lot tougher as the creature got more careful with its movements. It stayed fast on movements, rarely leaving an opening for me. But at last I made it, hitting the final weak point. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd8QgqqNU8hp7URiM6tkceFF5UNp54mvsCsMPTSKCb7cU/screenshot_12_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfXjFz76wQBY2VzZiebjKRC3nAwhBMravjo68F3PRRE91/screenshot_13_.png) After destroying all three tails, the creature got vanished into a cloud of dark essence and KK returned to me. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaPjYuGYo2rJCmwTVhGerfkQYXQs1n2fJs33dwUKtTucw/screenshot_14_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUpSVrLGMNjUxsBeAqtfS6QCgwB44M2VXf1TuoSdDE4iz/screenshot_15_.png) Akito found the dead body of the Hannya nearby, a grim reminder of the cost of this pursuit. There was the lead Hannya working on their ritual stage, having his daughter beside him as a vessel. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU2MmDdGFxmGLNSKJE71Movk5pB6JHYvaTwPZrT52A8cn/screenshot_16_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV9EzrgZGbdkKpYuWPKqXYerWtg1bEJXaYYQP2iwEaaGS/screenshot_17_.png) To stop them, Akito tried to rush to them before the final words could be spoken. But the ground started shaking and opening up, revealing a void beneath the ritual site. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdXAaoVNfgzQbjzvGMgA3ets1KSruJx8jnrzcPePNy2kD/screenshot_18_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQN6CHYknik24CB2huxrJtatbRf4JDrG2V2zdg4kPxRfr/screenshot_19_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdyccZSv8p8BoCfhafkCK7WuMCyqc5XLVPRB1LEjuVByw/screenshot_20_.png) Akito was so persistent as he wanted to save his sister anyhow, regardless of the danger. He ran fast and tried to attack the Hannya after trying a big jump. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcgZMMAYEKyvT5cxc8BiMTNSd8wKTwAM4QUnFPfiMvAoy/screenshot_21_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ4kD9fFBD9PtzTZgLEebG1Zg1G2jnGRXm4H61AfXiiSg/screenshot_22_.png) But something happened that threw Akito backwards with a massive wave of spiritual energy. It looked like the ritual was completed after all, as a light erupted from the stone the Hannya was working on. I'll show what happens next later. --- I personally took all the screenshots from my play and I used a logo of the game from online to use in the thumbnail. This is Pikachuuuuu signing off. ▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=davidnollearth/4ecfbed9)


---

This is the video series for an oil painting 'Wisteria' I did from 2016-2020.  The painting was destroyed in 2021 due to a number of reasons, but mainly: the painting's faulty experimental linseed-epoxide substrait, Covid-19 crushing lockdowns, extreme poverty, family attacks and ongoing US government (Big Tech + Big Media) censorship of me and my 30 years of artwork.

Its not ideal to not be able to show this piece, but I still gained the knowledge of how to do it and invented several useful oil painting mediums & varnishes used in its creation which never yellowed and still cannot be bought anywhere.

I am posting these videos for posterity and for people that are interested in seeing an oil painting created from start to finish in the Baroque style evolved for the 21st century.  I also must have deleted some of the initial videos when I did the quick underpainting, but what still exists, I give to you.

I hope this can be an educational experience as no gallery will show any of my controversial art even today.

---

Inaczej zaplanowałem dzisiejszy dzień. Chciałem przy okazji wizyty gości pojechać w jedno ciekawe miejsce w Ardenach, w które wybieram się od dłuższego czasu. Pomysł uzyskał akceptację wszystkich, ale problemem okazała się pogoda. Dziś nad Belgią przesuwały się fronty burzowe i kiedy rano sprawdziłem prognozę po raz kolejny, okazało się, że najprawdopodobniej trafilibyśmy w sam środek burzy – a to nawet w tak niskich górach jak Ardeny nie jest dobrym pomysłem.

> ***[ENG] I planned today a bit differently. I wanted to take our guests to an interesting spot in the Ardennes that I’ve been meaning to visit for a long time. Everyone loved the idea, but the weather turned out to be an issue. Storm fronts were moving across Belgium today, and when I checked the forecast again this morning, it became clear we would likely end up right in the middle of a storm—which isn't a good idea, even in mountains as low as the Ardennes.***

![IMG_4404.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23zkg8V8G91eYU1FSeHB1jDhVc2w3XC1XJ7KQXcWAFX4niGeu2cqR1qcwJJ9EpU2NS9Po.jpg)

![IMG_4406.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23yTauaGhcFkYiuZUjJw6Rk3KSn6ggvJA6TfXSVRmrb2yHCYBPK2wZBBT1VxTkTxNHqB3.jpg)

![IMG_4411.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23ycymSgZHekBSuFWWACHG7EMaJCYpxhwHJn44zLaa1efir19hgzCGhCNMX7KzRa8jb6n.jpg)

Stąd zmiana planów: zamiast zamków w Ardenach, postawiliśmy na urocze uliczki i flandryjskie kamieniczki w Lille. Dopisało nam szczęście, bo chmury deszczowe przetoczyły się nad miastem dwukrotnie. Za pierwszym razem byliśmy akurat w barze na kawie i zza szyby obserwowaliśmy rozwój wypadków. Za drugim razem nie zdążyliśmy nawet wyciągnąć parasoli, bo przestało padać.

> ***[ENG] Hence the change of plans: instead of Ardennes castles, we opted for the charming streets and Flemish townhouses of Lille. We got lucky because the rain clouds passed over the city twice. The first time, we happened to be having coffee in a bar, watching it unfold from behind the window. The second time, we didn't even have a chance to pull out our umbrellas before it stopped raining.***

![IMG_4412.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23z79m4vxg8qFBmfwktAuNM4eiQNWyPtk3siB7yJkR9GnjGAV8pGJqxDqLkRp4y914ptN.jpg)

![IMG_4423.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23uQpfh2iBYB7LtmyurcXBrBFKcp5BY3b2vMB5yVNhJc95iV8XHcGXSuqDJauUmRTAmsi.jpg)

![IMG_4433.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23wqiMr8BXE2XtLM4vBxWkYcRYX45LFU1gPre9W7LxDxwDX7iAvKdRsnxe3YjpEYBNyFZ.jpg)

Spacerując po starym mieście, trafiliśmy na ulicę, przy której stoi niesławny „dom mumii” – kamieniczka, w której ciało zmarłego właściciela przeleżało 15 lat, zanim zostało odkryte. Kamienicę przejęło miasto, ale od lat nic się z nią nie dzieje.
 
> ***[ENG] Strolling through the old town, we came across the street where the infamous \

stands—a townhouse where the deceased owner lay undiscovered for 15 years. The city took over the building, but nothing has been done with it for years.*** ![IMG_4420.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/AKZncAm5qNFVXWLiUM8VJFPq7Xv7BDCDAib1ixdirfEifnQL9xVVqV7rFaYxLCG.jpg) ![IMG_4439.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23u65BwdHc9gLpB8B9VVZUxhy89BtHLPXwVgDNaZd2owzSvtYQpEJ5ib4mjiaNSj9veBb.jpg) ![IMG_4444.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23xoymxi51Chg4gpRxpfWgUnLRU5tv38r1jTUKECUY5tuaBYPC88VaUWSSiTxfFbj7nGo.jpg) ---

It has already started... There have been studies that show that prolonged exposure to screens and scrolling reduces the amount of grey matter in the brain. The brain gets stimulated but very little to no new knowledge is acquired. 

Yes our information retention is definitely being affected, and even worst we have poor filters when it comes to assessing the validity or the application of said information. 

Our ability to seek particular knowledge has also been altered - we just consume what comes to us, rather than seeing it out. And most searches end on the first link  clicked.

links.title: Escalation Conflict Calculations!
links.body:
![Image from the offical announcemant](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/splinterlands/23tSKrXsXnXH8Sh68cqgPWZsQKKnNGegmRGyFemRns4wzSRx4mvBwCW699V8tPZhfaWCY.png)
  
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23vhuVwHxn7ynuUbA7tsZmcVvH5QddLoE3gizq8EMRXW2FxjXaZjha4LgiNo6FSDiQfPf.png
  
 #### Prologue

Conflicts are about to start! What costs how much? What is the best deal to get the best chances in the conflict? As a bystander (probably not going to buy in this time, as I didn't buy into the pre-sale either and rather went into Land deeper), I can only tell you what the numbers say. And that's what's in here! Hope you enjoy!

Here's the Google-Sheet that I'm using for calculations. You can download it and do your own scenarios with it!

[---> Click Here <---](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/13rQf3uxVdy0Me4nHj_fERYgY_F088rUq4LUE80sScuw/edit?usp=sharing)

This is a short post with just some numbers that might be helpful to those who want to partake in conflicts. Maybe Beaker already did a tool for that, he's pretty quick. But just in case...
  
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23tSMrBK495yadzSKriVB9FkEtftyayqE76JDxWPJsATmCdvqi8G8tHKVfT9SQ4p8MEBX.png
  
 #### CP Prices

Conflicts are based on CP. This time though, Black Foils get a 0,6 nerf, bringing each BF from 25k to 15k, rounded. Remember that maxed cards get a CP bonus! So it makes sense to try to get maxed cards onto your wagons. 

Here's a little picture for CC and CP:


<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beelzael/244ot1b6SLAg9nKKxL8CtU4KFEk3L1icnqYSqs3sKCoKHMND1jXZtPyHsDCPgbomSfXGP.png)</center>

With the current prices, we get to this:


<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beelzael/244oqrk275ZquogzmdPeDSdZt81jNaQ2KP25C8NU5TjAGkTSQkoxHYgyGwRFHadNTzpov.png)</center>

And for those who prefer visuals to tables:


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beelzael/23xLLDaWHzy8PFhqy3WxT8P3WSCGKfhXSHV2HgcLtKuXTM18jtDtg89wc8uzfwtgeJyZi.png)

It's not showing in my pre-view, but I hope it will in the text. If not I'll edit it in. 

While in the CA conflict Epic-GF were the best bang for the buck, here it seems to be rare - but remember! This does not account for full copies, but the cheapest CC on the market. Sometimes you can get a better deal averaging a different card than the Rare RF here.


  
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23tSMrBK495yadzSKriVB9FkEtftyayqE76JDxWPJsATmCdvqi8G8tHKVfT9SQ4p8MEBX.png
  
 #### How much to spend?

Next big question. That is up to every individual. I bought 2 cards so far of escalation, and I sue both a lot - the 14 mana neutral super-tank, and the scattershot-5-magic-damage orc for 13 mana. I don't think I have others. Doesn't matter, either. If you were to buy in now, and at the prices per CC mentioned above, here are some calculations.


<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beelzael/23xyvRkjp5pDYGRyXyAU5uEqB3VUwM3hncTLfHT3FQkgwYyiZGHAsG33FRCRrZz4weyqj.png)</center>

For each guaranteed card, you need 45,150k CP. Based on 325 entries per guaranteed card, and 100k points per entry. 


<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beelzael/48aZe5eobnE4fDgdboxdQtRebx5GXDRMknm662Pzx4s6VGhsqYyK6HrfEEtYM5ixAA.png)</center>

For 1 GC, 4 maxed rare GF cards do the trick already! Theoretically for $140. 

10 maxed Epic RF would be at $140, too. 

19 maxed Rare RF are the cheapest with $114 - but currently not available for that on the market.

And so on. You can calculate all day and make the coolest scenarios with the calculator, as mentioned. I made one more table to have a direct line to how many cards of each kind you'd need to get a guaranteed card, and how much it would cost to get exactly 1 guaranteed card:

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beelzael/244eT7Sry4yyqPn79o8QsQ3hKYYmT1CZ2JAWTjX3w7CRaFT5u5NMiXvSYZ9gqdnJLPhYB.png)</center>






  
 
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23tSMrBK495yadzSKriVB9FkEtftyayqE76JDxWPJsATmCdvqi8G8tHKVfT9SQ4p8MEBX.png

 #### Conclusion 

I mean, legendary archons? Always awesome. And pretty neat, too.

https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/splinterlands/23tv6MTwbKBjPUbpKHpg3g7edy5ZYWsHvFrELrQkojFaHdP6jUZmwBG9GV4ehepsyiXGo.png

This picture alone is nice, but the archon itself surpised me a lot - no 7 mana super beast, but a 3 mana archon. Those can come in very handy. 

https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/splinterlands/EopmF4shVYRTuA3ffgmKKcupEfgGzSmFCiRh5Hbqx9WjMrW46sBdhorqWER7bZf3bsS.png

In a 12 mana battle, one mana more can already make the difference to get another unit in. And in Painforge-Rulesets, the Reckless can also change the whole game.

Still, I'm low on cash at the moment and prefer to build out land to get a steady, in-game cashflow which I can hopefully invest back into a new set when it comes. 

Hope you enjoyed the post, anyway! Have a great day!

https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23tSMrBK495yadzSKriVB9FkEtftyayqE76JDxWPJsATmCdvqi8G8tHKVfT9SQ4p8MEBX.png

5% of the rewards will go to @beaker007 for creating the tool, and 2% to @saydie for free Dividers - [Click here.](https://peakd.com/hive-169191/@saydie/splinterlands-free-to-use-land-dividers) Always grateful for all of that! Remember to support those who give you cool stuff for free 😉

links.title: Testing Altera from Magi Network: Adding money and liquidity
links.body:
/>

_Banner created in ChatGPT_

Well finally I decided to test @magi.network. I was very excited since last year about this new opportunity in our blockchain. However, I still haven't tested it since I was a bit busy at work, but finally, I can start testing while writing this post. So first we need to add money. One thing that looks cool is that you can add money with a direct link to Coinbase. That is what our North Americans were looking for, Hive. One of the biggest complaints was that we couldn't buy Hive in any exchange approved in the US or Canada. Hive isn't listed yet in Coinbase, but we can use the exchange and do a direct \
. Actually, what I understood is that you are buying BTC through Coinbase and sending it to Altera. Maybe another time I can test this path.\n\n

/> _Screenshot of the deposit part._ [_Available at Altera's application_](https://altera.magi.eco/) In addition to Hive, all three others are based in Bitcoin (including the explained Coinbase path). So I am trying to deposit using Lightning transfer, which is the fastest way to get money there, just mentioning the BTC alternatives, of course, since Hive transferring is also instant. There are a few things that I didn't understand in the process. Why do we need to convert to HBD or HIVE? We have a BTC wallet in Altera, but we can't bring SATS from the lightning without converting? Another thing that it looks like a bug is that if we select HBD, we need to choose the best conversion unit of a value to generate the lightning invoice; it gives the options of BTC, SATS and HBD. The HBD option doesn't work; we click it, and nothing happens. In my case, I chose Sats, which was easier to manage the 1300 Sats that I brought (89 sats paid in fees).
/> _The HBD option to convert the value isn't working, just BTC and SATS._ [_Available at Altera's application_](https://altera.magi.eco/)
/> _This is the amount of fees that I paid to get 1300 sats (around 1 USD)._ [_Available at Altera's application_](https://altera.magi.eco/)

/> _The money appeared in my Altera in the exact moment._ [_Available at Altera's application_](https://altera.magi.eco/) Ok, I couldn't get BTC directly from the lightning network, which is not the best thing. So now I will swap HBD for BTC. So you need to go the left menu and choose the Cross-chain Swap. Be careful not to use the main Magi cross-chain swap from the dashboard since the swap HBD to BTC will need a BTC wallet address and incur some BTC fees. To be frank, I don't know why keep this in the main dashboard that can be confusing, or implement the regular swap also in the main dashboard, or just leave everything on this left menu side (you can also swap HBD for BTC and send to a BTC wallet there). After a couple of minutes, finally the new balance of HBD and BTC appeared in my account.
/> _The before swap HBD to BTC preview._ [_Available at Altera's application_](https://altera.magi.eco/)
/> _Before confirming this is what you see._ [_Available at Altera's application_](https://altera.magi.eco/)

/> _My new balance of HBD and BTC._ [_Available at Altera's application_](https://altera.magi.eco/) Now let's add some liquidity. I went to the pool menu and chose the HBD:BTC pool. By the way, there you can find another button to go to the swap (it looks like the same place that the left menu cross-chain swap leads to). Here is very straightforward. You just need to wait a bit to confirm the transaction to add liquidity and then you're done. Now I have around $0.97 in this Liquidity Pool. Should I add more? I will check first how it behaves, but it looks interesting.
/> _Preview adding to the LP HBD:BTC._ [_Available at Altera's application_](https://altera.magi.eco/)

/> _My LP dashboard with my new balance of HBD:BTC._ [_Available at Altera's application_](https://altera.magi.eco/) Final impressions ----------------- Altera still is very promising, and it is starting to deliver interesting DeFi alternatives slowly. Now you can create tokens and NFTs, which I will follow closely. I always wondered about paired LPs with HBD. Now, with the debt on the rise, I started questioning if it was good to invest in a coin with stability in danger. But hopefully HBD will survive. Now, let's go with the things that need to be fixed ASAP: * The HBD button in the Lightning Network deposit conversion screen. * The three different ways to access swap options, which can be confusing. * Better utility for sHBD (liquid staking), since converting back still takes 3 days. It would be awesome if we had LPs with sHBD so we could really use this liquid staking alternative in a better way. [

links.title: ‎Between City Lights and Quiet Trees: Discovering the Person I Truly Am ‎
links.body:
‎Hi Hive,
‎
‎There are some days when I feel like I belong in the middle of a busy city. The noise, the movement, the bright lights at night, and the feeling that something is always happening around me can be exciting. Then there are other days when all I want is nothing but silence, fresh air, and the peaceful sound of nature. Sometimes I ask myself a simple question  that am I more of an urban person or a nature person?
‎ https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUGc97zE47qT4U3rNrJfaCYJmmuhBnwsea6XG46AZVB8s/snapwiresnaps-buildings-598205_1920.jpg 

‎[Source](https://pixabay.com/photos/buildings-contrast-yellow-grey-598205/)
‎
‎Honestly, I think I am somewhere in between both worlds.
‎
‎Living around urban environments has its benefits. Cities are full of a lot of opportunities. Because there are better chances for work, business, education, and meeting different kinds of people. I enjoy the energy of city life because it keeps me motivated. Even as someone working in plumbing, being in an urban area exposes me to more jobs, more experience, and more connections. In the city, everything moves so quick, and sometimes that pressure shift my mindset and pushes me to work more harder and dream bigger.
‎
‎Another thing I enjoy about urban life is convenience. Shops are closer by, transportation is easier, and entertainment is everywhere. You hardly feel isolated because there is always something to do or somewhere to go.
‎
‎Though urban life also has its disadvantages too. The noise can become very exhausting. The traffic, stress, and constant competition sometimes make life feel heavy. There are times when I feel mentally tired without even knowing the reason why. Even peace can become difficult to find in crowded places. People are always rushing, and life can start to feel like a race that never ends.
‎
‎That is why nature has a special place in my heart.
‎
‎Because nature brings a kind of calm that cities can't give. Being around trees, open skies, cool breeze, and quiet surroundings makes me feel connected to myself again. Nature allows the mind to rest and  it reminds me that life is not only about hustle and survival. Because sometimes, peace itself is success.
‎
‎But still, nature has its own disadvantages too. Life in quiet environments can sometimes feel slow and boring. Opportunities may be limited, and isolation can become lonely after a while. Access to modern facilities, jobs, and fast development might not be available.
‎
‎But if I had to choose, then I would say I am more of a nature person trapped in an urban lifestyle. I love the ambition and opportunities of the city, but deep down, I really value peace more than pressure. And maybe the perfect life is learning how to balance both worlds, chasing dreams in the city and while never losing the calmness that nature also brings to the soul.
‎
‎![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYaWnApEziAtLL5Zwv3ZNbDjRfSfG6h5njgTrpyasnE6y/1775569275821.png)
‎
‎
