links.title: My Actifit Report Card: May 13 2026
links.body:
<center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g7453f534e637e8125f002dd926eecfbbdbfed0650aef6bf112c5571f1284b3da1e4ba4093f8819792ba11bcf627f61c535e6a4085cf6676eba300d80d6ca13c8_640.jpg)</center>My last walk took me along the picturesque Cotswold Way, a stunning trail that showcases the beauty of the English countryside. I started my journey in the charming village of Chipping Campden, known for its honey-colored stone buildings and the historic Market Hall.

As I ventured along the path, I was greeted by rolling hills, lush meadows, and vibrant wildflowers. The landscape was dotted with sheep grazing peacefully, a quintessential sight in this part of England. I took a moment to appreciate the views from Dover’s Hill, where I could see the Severn Valley stretching out before me—it was quite breathtaking!

Along the way, I met a lovely couple from London who were also enjoying a weekend hike. They were quite knowledgeable about local history and shared some fascinating tales about the area, including the origins of the wool trade in the Cotswolds, which played a significant role in the development of many of the towns and villages. We spent a pleasant half hour chatting about our favorite walking spots and even exchanged tips on hidden gems to explore.

As I continued my walk, I stumbled upon the picturesque village of Broadway, often referred to as the \

The high street is lined with quaint shops, galleries, and cafes. I took the opportunity to pop into a small tea shop for a cream tea—a perfect treat after a long walk! The history of Broadway is quite fascinating too; it used to be a coaching stop on the route from London to Worcester in the 18th century. I could feel the history seep through the cobblestones as I wandered around, imagining the travelers who once passed through. By the end of my walk, I felt rejuvenated, having soaked in not just the stunning scenery but also the rich history and friendly encounters along the way. The Cotswolds never fails to enchant me, and I can’t wait for my next adventure! _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). About last night. 🧡

Another Tuesday. Another full table.
Another reminder that what we’re building is becoming very real.

Yesterday’s Letz OffChain at Brasserie Millewee was a special one because we officially celebrated something big: Innopay is now FULLY live at Millewee. 🧡

From:

* QR codes at the table
* digital menus
* ordering system
* payments
* cashback
* and now even… tips for the waitresses 🧡

And honestly, seeing the staff genuinely excited about the tipping feature made us smile.

Because that’s the point: technology should improve the experience for everyone involved, customers, merchants, and staff alike.

As always, the night went far beyond payments.

Great food. Great people. Great conversations.

And maybe most importantly: real opportunities to show newcomers who we are, what we’re building, and why we believe blockchain belongs in everyday life not only online discussions.

Real infrastructure. Used by real people. In real places.

Big thanks as well to Niamkey for joining us yesterday! 🧡

We’ve already started discussions around potentially integrating the Cauris wallet into Innopay in the future… Stay tuned!

And if you don’t want to miss the next steps, make sure to follow the Innopay page!

Next week: double appointment.

Tuesday → Letz OffChain at Qosqo (back where we held our January event!)

AND…

Another great event incoming.
Another occasion to experience crypto payments in real life.

links.title: U.S. Senate Advances “Clarity Act” as Committee Vote Nears (May 2026)
links.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaXrKRHXvB17ZApXZw9e4zKqh9zPyUsjiaLuRAx4nA7ff/image.png)

Image source: [Reuters](https://www.reuters.com/sustainability/boards-policy-regulation/us-senate-committee-set-consider-long-awaited-crypto-bill-next-week-2026-05-09/)

Finally, it appears that the Clarity Act is progressing forward with an anticipated review on May 14, 2026. One issue that many have had with cryptocurrencies is the ambiguity of the regulatory environment and how digital currencies are governed. With no established framework defining how digital currencies are regulated or how to classify and govern them, there has been much uncertainty for \

alike; consequently, uncertainty has created confusion, legal risk, and hesitancy throughout the crypto ecosystem. Clearly, cryptocurrencies have grown very quickly over the past several years; however, the regulatory framework governing crypto has not caught up.

Why is this moment in time so significant? If the Clarity Act is enacted into law, we may finally have a definitive framework establishing clear-cut definitions regarding how cryptocurrencies are to be classified within the financial services industry and what governmental agencies will have the authority to govern them. These definitions and regulatory responsibilities may help reduce confusion and provide a stable marketplace in which companies can build. In turn, this could increase confidence among investors, encourage increased institutional investment in the crypto asset class, and potentially contribute to sustaining the long-term growth of the crypto asset class.

However, at the same time, some concerns remain. Although the new framework will provide greater regulatory clarity, this increased clarity could also lead to stricter compliance requirements, particularly for exchanges and for smaller, less-established blockchain companies, which may not have the resources/infrastructure required to adapt to comply with a more defined regulatory framework in the near term. The debate about how to achieve the balance of encouraging innovative new products while regulating the products has been one of the more difficult discussions in this area.

From my perspective, it seems that we have reached a tipping point in the evolution of cryptocurrencies. What began as an innovative, experimental new asset class has quickly evolved into a more traditional asset class within the global financial system, and it was a forgone conclusion that regulation of the cryptocurrency market would eventually occur. The critical question now is whether the Clarity Act will ultimately facilitate or impede the ongoing growth of the cryptocurrency market. Regardless of the answer to this question, the conclusion of the Clarity Act is likely to be a watershed or defining moment for the future of digital assets across multiple jurisdictions.

References

Reuters. “U.S. Senate Committee Set to Consider Long-Awaited Crypto Bill.” [Link](https://www.reuters.com/sustainability/boards-policy-regulation/us-senate-committee-set-consider-long-awaited-crypto-bill-next-week-2026-05-09/)

Reuters. “What Is in the US Senate’s Landmark Crypto Bill?”

links.title: Inflation Is Officially Back
links.body:
Yesterday, the April CPI report came out. And it did not come in the way markets were expecting at all.

Inflation reached the highest level we’ve seen since May 2023. That means the highest reading in three full years, at the exact same time markets continue breaking records and pushing to new highs.

# THE NUMBER THAT FROZE WALL STREET

Let’s start with the numbers. CPI came in at +0.6% month-over-month and +3.8% year-over-year, while analysts were expecting 3.7%. Small difference, you might say. True. But in moves like these, even small deviations genuinely matter.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeS6qqc91hBSKXB7doz5HhuSpSe9ELaEGmXe6D8ByVY4y/image.png)


Core CPI, meaning inflation excluding food and energy, came in at 2.8% annually and +0.4% monthly. And that tells us something very specific. The biggest pressure is not coming from the core. It’s coming from non-core categories. Mainly energy.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYpkCatD2qqbZ1VEgxSxdVQJkoNnuPw58FAyPisaN8niG/image.png)


“So what happened with energy?” you’re probably wondering. Very simply, oil moved back above $100 as concerns around Iran started heating up again. And as you know, when oil rises, everything rises.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUCHp3Xy7pzgTzDF72DqApfMrxB3ZCYvYYbq9ej2h2Rho/image.png)


At the same time, there’s another factor in the background. Trump’s tariffs. Even though the Supreme Court struck down most of them in February, the economy is still dealing with the hangover from that whole tariff theater.

# THE FED IS IN A WEAK POSITION

Now let’s get to the most interesting part of the story. What has the Fed been doing this whole time? Nothing. It’s sitting back and watching.

Interest rates remain frozen at 3.50%-3.75%. And pay attention to this. According to market futures, traders have now removed every probability of a rate cut until April of… 2031. Yes. 2031. Not 2026, not 2027. Five years from now.

And that’s not all. The yield curve is now showing a higher probability of rate hikes rather than rate cuts. The exact opposite of what everyone was expecting just a few months ago.

“So how did the Fed end up here?” you’re probably asking. Very simply, when inflation is above 3% and your target is 2%, you cannot cut rates.

In fact, the latest FOMC meeting had the highest number of dissents in 34 years. Since 1992. And that tells us something important: even the Fed itself is divided.

And this is where the leadership change comes in. Powell is leaving. Kevin Warsh is coming in. Many expected this transition to bring a more dovish stance. But Paul Tudor Jones, one of the most respected investors on Wall Street, said something very specific a few days ago:

“There is absolutely no chance Warsh manages to cut rates.”

With inflation this high, it simply cannot happen. No matter who is in charge.

Contentos (COS) is posting an eye-catching +34.17% gain on Binance today, spiking from $0.001167 to a high of $0.002181 on a staggering 18 billion COS in volume worth $30.65 million USDT. On the surface, this looks like one of the biggest altcoin moves of the day. But behind this chart lies a risk profile that every responsible investor must understand before making any decision.

 What Is Contentos?

Contentos is a decentralized global content ecosystem backed by Binance Labs, DHVC, and various top-tier funds, with strategic partners LiveMe and Cheetah Mobile amassing over 60 million monthly active users. The platform aims to create a decentralized ecosystem where digital content is freely produced, authenticated, distributed, and monetized  rewarding both creators and consumers with COS tokens.   The team has also been developing TradeyAI  an AI powered trading tool announced in late 2025  and completed a token buyback campaign in October 2025.

CRITICAL RISK DISCLOSURE READ BEFORE TRADING

This section is not optional. Before considering any position in COS, the following facts must be clearly understood

Risk 1  Binance Monitoring Tag 

On March 6, 2026, Binance the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange  officially added a Monitoring Tag to COS, flagging it for low liquidity, weak trading volume, and project instability. According to Binance, assets carrying this tag face a high risk of being fully delisted from the platform if the project does not meet the exchange's listing standards upon review.  
Such monitoring tags often precede full delisting, causing immediate investor flight and reduced market access. Recovery would require the project to regain full exchange compliance  a steep uphill challenge. The threat of losing a Binance listing is a critical bearish overhang that directly attacks the token's liquidity lifeline.  

Risk 2  Network Support Already Being Removed

Effective March 20, 2026, Binance ceased supporting deposits and withdrawals of COS via the Ethereum Network. Any deposits made after that date were not credited to accounts, with potential for permanent asset loss.  This is not a warning  it has already happened.

Risk 3  This Pattern Has Occurred Before

COS experienced a 131% surge in March 2026  followed by a sharp reversal. Historically, these have been temporary speculative rallies driven by social media rotation and market hype, not sustained fundamental adoption. For a token already 96.51% below its all time high, buybacks and product announcements have so far provided only brief price support.  

Risk 4  Extreme Volatility Profile

As a low cap altcoin, COS is prone to extreme volatility driven by social media hype and broad market rotations. COS's future hinges entirely on navigating imminent exchange delisting risk  any positive catalyst is currently overshadowed by existential threats to its market access.  

 The Technical Picture  For Context Only

The Binance 1H chart shows price breaking above all three EMAs  EMA(25) at 0.001592, EMA(50) at 0.001462, EMA(100) at 0.001349 on exceptional volume. The move is technically valid as a breakout. However, given the fundamental risks outlined above, technical analysis alone is insufficient for evaluating this trade.

 Conclusion.
COS is moving. The chart is green. But the risks are real, documented, and exchange level  not speculation. If Binance removes the monitoring tag, COS could continue higher. If Binance proceeds with a full delisting, the consequences would be severe and rapid.

links.body: /> [source](https://x.com/SAgovnews/status/2054169724603572536) The unemployment rate in South Africa has been consistently above 30% for the last 5 years so adding an extra 1.2% for the first quarter of 2026 is hardly a shocker. It is the way this is reported that is hard to actually work out as they have a system that does not tell the entire truth so the 32.7% is a manipulated percentage that hides the real facts.

/> [source](https://x.com/FMFSouthAfrica/status/2054176918971334753/photo/1) There are so many official/unofficial stats the important part is not the exact number, but knowing these are increasing in a negative way. The recent tax report stated that only 10% of people working are paying taxes and the more people out of work creates more pressure to raise taxes on those working. How about using those taxes to create employment before there is no money left to create enough taxes to make this a possible solution? If no tax revenue is filtering back into the economy then the economy has no boost to get things working how they should. In my thought process if you do not have a job and are also of working age then you are unemployed, but the stats do not work that way. That would be too easy and would also show how bad the figures really are which is not good for the government.

/> [source](https://businesstech.co.za/news/government/860202/south-africas-unemployment-rate-gets-worse-as-over-300000-people-lose-their-jobs/) As you can see from the above the official labor force is 24.9 million which somehow does not include the other 17.3 million who are still of working age and unemployed. The official/unofficial total as no one knows the real figures of how many people reside in South Africa is a working population of 42.2 million with 16.8 million employed leaving 24.4 million unemployed. A simple calculation tells you that the unemployed rate is virtually smack bang on 60% which is nearly double the official unemployment rate. Imagine governing a country where 60% of the population has no work and no future prospects of finding work and justifying any form of corruption at the top. The money being stolen should be used on creating jobs and getting the economy moving through upgrading infrastructure and the likes. The BEE excuse of raising more capital by charging businesses 2% of net profit is a sham and is only making those at the top of the food chain richer and those at the bottom poorer. This is why keeping the mases uneducated works because they do not understand the game being played which is a game of screwing the masses for self enrichment. How refreshing it would be if corruption seized to exist and the population was put first like it should be. The economy would boom and everyone would be positively affected which is only a dream scenario as the government cannot see this as the only ones sacrificing would be them by not stealing. Finally the world has woken up to the fact that funding NGO's in African countries does not work as that money will be diluted by those in power and you have to be woke not to realise this. Without that free NGO money the problem is now they are having to get creative in other ways to steal.

/></center>

[source](https://businesstech.co.za/news/government/860202/south-africas-unemployment-rate-gets-worse-as-over-300000-people-lose-their-jobs/)

The stats are most likely far worse than the unofficial stats due to the way the stats are compiled. The government uses an external agency who uses a small settlement outside of Pretoria for their figures. They know if they ventured further a field like to the Eastern Cape these figures would show a very different reality and most likely would be the end of the ANC controlled government.

Over 300K jobs lost in the community and social services sector is rather telling as the vast majority of households are deep in debt and with the increase in minimum wages back in March would have seen many jobs lost. The biggest red flag for myself is seeing 28K jobs lost in private households which would be gardeners and housekeepers known as domestic workers.

These are generally unskilled workers on the lowest salaries and the bottom of the food chain. When households start cutting back to this extent that is a sign that things are rough in the economy and there will be more unemployment on the rise. Stats say there is roughly 1million employed in this sector and they will always be the first ones to be let go when the economy is struggling. The next quarter will be telling if this figure continues to rise which it should do as the economy is not improving plus extra fuel costs and inflation making more households cut back on expenses.

***
Todos sabemos que vamos a envejecer pero mi mayor miedo siempre ha sido ese porque no se trata de vernos más allá del físico sino de lo que hemos logrado y yo realmente siento que aún me falta mucho por obtener. 

También y tú de las fotos representa la autoestima ya que a pesar de que me gustan las fotos nunca me había sentido tan bonita A pesar de que tengo ya la mitad de los años cumplidos que me veo más feliz pero sobre todo se siente el amor propio porque nada es más bonito que un amor propio así sea el camino que te toca. 

Gracias a todos mis lectores a mis poéticos y manualistas que se disfrutan de mis contenidos aunque no sea tan frecuente como antes.

Welcome back to my blog! I’m here to share some recent photos of myself—pictures I took to pass the time during a long power outage. I’ve decided to title this series: \

*** We all know that we are going to age, but that has always been my greatest fear. It’s not just about how we look physically, but rather about what we have achieved—and I truly feel that I still have so much left to accomplish. These photos also serve as a reflection of my self-esteem. Although I’ve always enjoyed having my picture taken, I’ve never felt quite as beautiful as I do now. Despite having reached a certain age, I look—and feel—happier than ever. Above all, these images radiate self-love; for there is nothing more beautiful than loving yourself, no matter what path life sets before you. Thank you to all my readers—my fellow poets and crafters—who continue to enjoy my content, even if my posts aren't quite as frequent as they used to be.

title.title: An artist in my city: Ortuño Mató
title.body:
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-10 at 11.01.29 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florecitamejias/242hese7koqEZ1sqEPq3WZMpXWJk1uKbigfbvK8LasB7DZ2hfMdugZmr3YrBETdhY9pQt.jpeg)

Hey! @digi-me and the whole community, I hope you’re all doing great.

<div class=\

>Today I don’t want to share a special image, but rather tell you about a man whose handwriting and signature have become a local icon for identifying cars, buses, businesses, schools, and even social causes. Today I want to tell you about a graffiti artist named:
# Ortuño Mató ![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-10 at 11.01.26 AM (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florecitamejias/242DGDx7ia9nGwoRDQHVoZgJnBJpZj8Xh1tpMdMXyNtC7fhGQdfJ1PSyhP9haKJvuFCyn.jpeg) ![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-10 at 11.01.26 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florecitamejias/23wqgVN6hE7rx7G7F4vPB3R9CYFq7tppjQe26PVAtqMU2jAJ2SX6cEiUvZHFKJ3iZ35b1.jpeg)

>In La Guaira, Venezuela, it’s common to see phrases signed with his name all over the city. Ever since I arrived there, it caught my attention because anything not bearing his handwriting feels like it belongs elsewhere.
\n\n

>His writing is characterized by a humorous and reflective tone, typical of the 1990s, when people raised their voices not only through weapons or protests, but also through writing.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-10 at 11.01.27 AM (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florecitamejias/23vsV9ZwcTqmr1Sw8XQD4ohaNmzqTXQEdm1TQbtyGMeGvrJnw6XBDF69zpFiUNDVYwTiM.jpeg)

>There isn’t a single place you pass by or walk through that doesn’t bear some trace of his history or his mark; I could spend an entire day photographing the city and still have more than 100 photos to share, because so many businesses seek his services to promote themselves.
\n\n

>One day, as I was leaving home, there was a van parked there, and there was Mr. Ortuño. What a wonderful moment that was! I never imagined what he would look like in person, but I think he blends in so well with the city’s character that he blends in with everyone else—except that he carries his brush and paint, which set him apart.
\n\n

>I didn’t dare get out of the car; I just took a photo to prove that he really exists and that his mark is unique 😊.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-10 at 11.01.26 AM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florecitamejias/23x15FcBjJmPQPJ6hSh8mJ5i3P2vKpr5761M2XhHqAvgx7xmnaXHnap6pgDZna3NQpUj2.jpeg)

>On another trip to some distant towns, having long since forgotten that encounter, I came across his writings on the beach. His talent knows no bounds and transcends geographical boundaries, and although I was surprised, I realized that, given his fame, it was only natural that even on the beach—nearly an hour’s drive from where I had seen him at home—his pen would be present and immortalized for locals and visitors alike.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-10 at 11.01.27 AM (3).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florecitamejias/23xp8m4cSttRZYF2p5cXriwGeYnYXQYjFPR4kygiybnKNzSsgHAmVQv3fKuVS548YzUR1.jpeg) ![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-10 at 11.01.28 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florecitamejias/23tmN1jKS5AS4ktCXjjRRybzjHJfeKdVAVykBkKqop17EQs8smdQaEbPp29pDHkGUyS2P.jpeg)

>Some of the graffiti is already faded, but as long as it’s still legible, its essence remains.
\n\n

>That’s why, whenever I visit the city now, I stop to read each piece because I know it comes from his thoughts, combined with a touch of the humor typical of coastal towns.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-09 at 7.00.25 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florecitamejias/23yd1r1RFZvWwpi6zFemxAuidFzphwiLpbWxtHELuYV6c2T5DqaN564isStgowGpFDy8G.jpeg)
_The photos are my own. I created the cover and banner in Canva. I used DeepL as my translator._
# See you next time 😊 https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florecitamejias/23wrE6CM8aYD9sK9BCSAzpm9fZJh9oWMaq4qjXBCo9KasNqQn3DTG9FaAH7ywupqrx3Vn.png

title.title: Are We Truly Living in the Best Era?
title.body: Sometimes, I watch my kids operate computers and smartphones far better than some adults do, and I keep being in awe of how far we have come in our world today. A lot of answers Google provides in the twinkling of an eye and many more things unfolding in our generation today make me wonder if we are truly living in the best era. ![17786947085268763386049902317779.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nkemakonam89/23z7JCpngTyiWCqoY4HPhdEKdnKv6Byj3fupFHqfBCi1YVLgzL3SbxJ1smVCXTXhw5LYt.png) Well, looking back at the history and with what I know now, I think we are living in one of the best eras, although each era has its peculiar challenges. Reflecting on the many stories Grandma told me about the history, I doubt I would have survived to those time of our ancestors'. I am aware they lived peacefully; they lived a very simple life without pressures like it is now, but they also swam in the ocean of hardship ...something I can't imagine when I hear them. Imagine travelling a long distance before having access to communication, including vital ones; that's a lot to think about. In this era, we all can comfortably video call our family abroad within seconds. I also learned that some persons died carelessly those days due to strange illnesses that herbs couldn't take care of, but today, the medical care humans need has improved for good. Even premature babies can still survive in incubators and live their normal lives. A lot of lives are being rescued daily due to improved medical care in this era. I am just imagining how I would have survived the many complications I had during childbirth if I were born in that era of our ancestors. Maybe I could have died? God forbid, lol. In this era, we are privileged to have different innovations that have brought open doors for both learning and businesses. With the many digital platforms, we advertise our business, and things are just much easier, including making money and living better. I can imagine the hectic stress our ancestors passed through farming just to earn a living, but today the story is different; today we can also use our smartphones to learn digital skills and be okay. To be sincere, there are a lot of advancements in this era compared to the old, but even at that, I wouldn't say that this era is perfect. I am aware that our generation today is strongly battling with different problems our ancestors didn't face back then. Talk about the social media pressure, pressure to keep up with the current trends, depression, and the like. Even with the advanced world, many people are still exhausted emotionally. Sometimes, I admire the simple world our ancestors enjoyed those days, the time we can comfortably leave our kids to our neighbors and go to the market; those days we can leave the children outside to play together, and also those evenings kids gather under the moonlight, listening to folktales and sharing laughter together. All these brought a stronger bond among each other, but in this era, the screen has taken over. Even in our evening moments together, we are carried away with our phones; it is what it is. However, if I am to choose another era, I will still prefer this current one, honestly, regardless of the challenges we see today. I love the advancement and how easier life has become. I also love to see that women now have voices compared to the olden days; with other areas, we have improved drastically. Overall, each era has its blessings and challenges, but the thing is not to focus on one to live in but rather to choose how to live within the era you find yourself in. ***Image was created using chatgpt***

title.title: [ES/EN] Escalation – Conflict 1° - MEREDROOL
title.body:
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPBAV2Gbb1fLQDNkGmENV9PmdjCHncUd9qDSpwAH8c4Lg/Portada%20-%20Escalation%20-%20Conflict%201.png</center>

<center>We already have the first **Conflict** of the **Escalation** mini-set called **Snot on My Watch** and with all the information of the first card that serves as a basis to know what the following cards will be like and what parameters they will have in common, aiming to be low mana cost **Archon** with **Bloodline Dominion** of small groups and with **táctica** that will be weaknesses or less potent abilities but that will give space to more creative strategies or with some little exploited until now starting with a warrior **Archon** / **Summoner**… or slime…. Called **Meredrool** a fusion of a man and a part of the essence of **Uul** that comes to cause chaos and drain the energy of everything it finds on the battlefields attracting the other creations of **Uul**.</center>

><center>Ya tenemos el primer **Conflict** del mini conjunto de **Escalation** llamado **Snot on My Watch** y con toda la información de la primera tarjeta que nos sirve de base para saber como serán las siguientes tarjetas y que parámetros tendrán en común a puntando a ser **Archon** de bajo costo de mana con **Bloodline Dominion** de grupos pequeños y con **táctica** que serán debilidades o habilidades menos potentes pero que darán espacio a estrategia mas creativas o con algunos poco explotados hasta ahora empezando con un **Archon** / **Summoner** guerrero… o slime …. Llamado **Meredrool** una fusion de un hombre y una parte de la esencia de **Uul** que viene a causar caos y drenar la energia de todo lo que encuentra en los campo de batallas atrayendo a las demás creación de **Uul**.</center>

# <center>[MEREDROOL](https://hive.blog/splinterlands/@splinterlands/escalation-conflicts-prepare-for-battle)</center>
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQpY9yxoaNWjzNDJmsi5JvQan78L26SZszFRmLvMJXrRY/Stats.png</center>

<center>[**MEREDROOL**](https://splinterlands.com/card-detail/979/regular/20?tab=stats) is a **Legendary** rarity **Summoner** / **Archon** of the **Fuego** element with the Bloodline: **Divine Construct** and a **3** mana cost.</center>

><center>[**MEREDROOL**](https://splinterlands.com/card-detail/979/regular/20?tab=stats) es un **Summoner** / **Archon** de rareza **Legendaria** del elemento **Fuego** con el Bloodline: **Divine Construct** y un coste de **3** de maná.</center>

<center>**Meredrool** is the first **Summoner** / **Archon** with a solitary **Bloodline Dominion** which means that it gives no advantage to allies that are **Divine Construct** but knowing that is quite logical because it is not that much advantage can be taken because a team cannot be assembled due to how limited it is.</center>

><center>**Meredrool** es el primer **Summoner** / **Archon** con un **Bloodline Dominion** solitario lo que significa que no ninguna ventaja a los aliados con que sean **Divine Construct** pero conociendo ese bastante lógico porque tampoco es que se le pueda sacar mucha ventaja porque no se puede armar un equipo por lo limitado que es.</center>

### <center>Bloodline Dominion</center>
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcJ3tooTsjQfLsAasWXTrnczZPo3TwuszL1Jq4gR2Rfg6/ability_on-bg_racial-dominion_300.png</center>

<center>**Meredrool** is the first **Archon** that has **Bloodline Dominion** without being linked to an ability which means that it does not give an ability to the units it shares **Bloodline** which is something curious but that is understood by its low **mana** cost.</center>

><center>**Meredrool** es el primer **Archon** que tiene **Bloodline Dominion** sin estar vinculado a una habilidad lo que significa que no da una habilidad a las unidades que comparte **Bloodline** lo cual es algo curioso pero que se entiende por su bajo costo de **mana**.</center>

### <center>Divine Construct</center>
<center></center>

<center>**Divine Construct** is a rather small **bloodline** being **Meredrool** the first **archon** of this type and with **10** monsters it is a very limited and small group in its **mana** cost with most being less than **6** **mana** and only one with **9** **mana** cost being the highest which means that the **mana** saving using **Meredrool** is not an investment to use a powerful high **mana** cost **Divine Construct** in battles with moderate **mana** but it can be very useful to complete **mana**, give team support by having most stat modifiers or as a substitute card if they cannot use another card.</center>

><center>**Divine Construct** es un **bloodline** bastante pequeño siendo **Meredrool** el primer **archon** de este tipo y con **10** monstruos es un grupo muy limitado y pequeño en su costo de **mana** siendo la mayoria menor a **6** de **mana** y solo uno con **9** de costo de **mana** lo mas alto lo que significa que el ahorro de **mana** usando a **Meredrool** no se una inversión para usar un **Divine Construct** poderoso de alto costo de **mana** en batallas con **mana** moderado pero que puede ser una muy util para completar **mana**, dar soporte del equipo a tener la mayoria modificadores de estadísticas o como tarjeta de sustituto si no pueden usar otra tarjeta.</center>

### <center>TACTICS</center>

Grants to **2** units: **Reckless**.

>Otorga a **2** unidades: **Reckless**.

### <center>Reckless</center>
<center></center>

- **Reckless**: Each successful attack also deals **1** damage to adjacent allied units.

- **Reckless**: Cada ataque exitoso también inflige **1** de daño a las unidades aliadas adyacentes.

<center>**Reckless** is a **Debilitation** which at first sight is bad because normally the cards that have it are to try to balance them but by being able to decide which units to give it to, it becomes a very interesting advantage because it can damage enemies but it has a better utility by being able to enable or activate abilities that require being damaged such as **Enrage** or **Painforge** which is better than depending on units with **Reckless** since sometimes their positioning can be complicated because although the **Fuego** element has enough units with **Painforge** in addition to several **Neutral** units there are not so many cards with **Reckless** to position them in the optimal places.</center>

><center>**Reckless** es una **Debilitation** lo que a primera viste es mala porque normalmente las tarjetas que la tiene es para intentar balancearlas pero a poder decidir a que unidades darsela se vuelve una ventaja muy interesante porque puede dañar a los enemigos pero tiene una mejor utilidad al poder habilitar o activar habilidades que requieren ser dañadas como **Enrage** o **Painforge** lo que es mejor que depender de unidades con **Reckless** ya que a veces su posicionamiento puede ser complicado porque a pesar de que el elemento **Fuego** cuenta con bastantes unidades con **Painforge** además de varias unidades **Neutral** no hay tantas tarjetas con **Reckless** para posicionarlas en los lugares optimos.</center>

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYBoJzQSHFUcehJPc5wVyxPDfiW1zaQdZ3QcsQpQ6Uygq/Opinion%20-%20Meredrool.png</center>

<center>**Meredrool** is a very interesting **Archons** being one of low **mana** cost and instead of giving an advantage to the allied team it gives a **Debilitation** that you can choose and give it to your team to activate abilities like **Enrage** and **Painforge** or give it to the enemy team to damage it or hinder its strategy although it is not the first to give a **Debilitation** since **Underboss Fabino** is earlier and could apply **Poison** to a unit but unlike him **Meredrool** is more versatile by being able to give it to more units and the damage being less it can be managed better both to activate the abilities and to damage the enemies.</center>

><center>**Meredrool** es un **Archons** muy interesante al ser uno de coste bajo de **mana** y en lugar de dar una ventaja al equipo aliado da una **Debilitation** que puede escoger y darla a tu equipo para activar habilidades como **Enrage** y **Painforge** o darse al equipo enemigo para dañarlo o entorpezer su estrategia aunque no es el primero en dar una **Debilitation** ya que **Underboss Fabino** es anterior y podía aplicarle **Poison** a una unidad pero a diferencia de el **Meredrool** es mas versátil al poder darselo a mas unidades y ser menor el daño se puede gestionar mejor tanto para activar las habilidades como para dañar a los enemigos.</center>

title.title: MATTERS OF THE HEART
title.body:
Hello everyone your welcome to my blog

I just came out from one very serious heartbreak that landed me in the hospital and I was going in and out of the hospital for sometime. I am a bit better now though no more sickness, no more crying, no more moping and gasping for breathe. When I say \

I mean when you go online people do come out to say this man did this to me, that man did this to me, he broke my heart, he did this he did that and then the generalizes that all men are scum because one man did something today.



 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZb9b2ZmhSkZH8X96gxfJPj4sfuDJnXZtrXGCZdn99FC7/4281.png 



I almost fell into that category because I give my all in this relationship but it met a dead end and we just had to go out separate ways. I almost started thinking in that direction but thank God for the friends I have around me. If you go online on social media you hear a lot of people talk bad about men and then people kind of agree to what they are saying because this particular guy broke my heart it is generalized that everybody that bears that particular name are hearts breakers. I could mention a few names there are termed \

number one Kelvin, two Emmanuel, three, Femi etc.

And I think this has done a lot of harm than good because even those who haven't even gone into relationship or met the person personally would think every man walking on the street or everybody bearing the name Femi is a walking red flag and that's not true and greatly misleading. I could carry my phone and then set my tripod to make a video and say everybody that that bears this particular name is bad because he broke my heart. Meanwhile, deep down I know it's a lie because this is me generalizing it because what one man did. It could be both genders.

A lot of things are factors to these things, the so called ex/ scum could not be the bad person. I'm not trying to defend them though because.

Thanks for stopping by my blog.

title.title: 🌌 SpacePicture of a Day: NGC 188: Old Cluster in the New General Catalog 🪐
title.body:
![NGC 188: Old Cluster in the New General Catalog](https://apod.nasa.gov/apod/image/2605/Polarissima1024.jpg)

***

>The New General Catalog of star clusters and nebulae really isn't so new. In fact, it was published in 1888 - an effort by J. L. E. Dreyer to consolidate the work of astronomers William, Caroline, and John Herschel along with others into a useful single, complete catalog of astronomical discoveries and measurements. Dreyer's work was largely successful and is still important today, as this famous catalog continues to lend its \

to bright clusters, galaxies, and nebulae. Take for example the star cluster known as NGC 188 (item number 188 in the NGC compilation). It lies about 6,000 light-years distant in the northern constellation Cepheus and represents a galactic or open star cluster. With an age of about 7 billion years, NGC 188 is old for an open cluster. Its old, evolved red giant stars have yellowish hues in this colorful, deep sky view. NGC 188 also enjoys the designation Caldwell 1 in a modern compilation of deep sky objects. Located well above the plane of the Milky Way and seen in the direction of planet Earth's north celestial pole, the ancient stellar group is known to some as the Polarissima Cluster.

title.title: Building a Modern React eCommerce Website 🚀
title.body:
Hello Hive 👋

I’m Kolapo, a web developer from Nigeria. Recently, I worked on building a modern eCommerce website for a client using React, Node.js, Express, and MongoDB.

Today, I want to briefly share the experience, some challenges I faced, and what I learned during the project.

The Goal 🎯

The aim was to create a fast and responsive online store where users could:

- Browse products
- Add items to cart
- Complete payments smoothly
- Receive confirmation emails

The main focus was:

- clean UI
- mobile responsiveness
- smooth user experience

Technologies Used 🛠️

For this project, I used:

- React.js
- Node.js
- Express.js
- MongoDB
- Nodemailer
- Render for deployment

I really enjoyed working with React because it made component reuse and UI management much easier.

Challenges I Faced ⚠️

One major issue appeared after deployment.

Everything worked perfectly locally, but email notifications suddenly stopped working in production. After debugging for hours, I discovered some backend environment variables were missing on the hosting platform.

I also faced:

- CORS configuration issues
- Mobile responsiveness fixes
- Backend deployment debugging

Classic developer problems 😂

What I Learned 📚

This project taught me that:

- Deployment is a skill on its own
- Small UI details matter a lot
- Real-world projects teach faster than tutorials
- Debugging is part of every developer’s journey

Most importantly, I learned to stay patient when things break.

Final Thoughts ✨

As a student developer, projects like this continue to improve both my frontend and backend skills.

I’m still learning every day and building better applications step by step.

Thanks for reading 🙏

Have you faced any frustrating deployment issues while building projects? I’d love to hear your experience in the comments 👇

title.title: [ENG/ESP] Mother, wherever you are: Congratulations on your 80th birthday
title.body:
Celebrating my mother's 80th birthday, even though it has been eight years since she physically departed, is an act of emotional justice and luminous memory. It is not a simple anniversary: it is the confirmation that a truly great life does not end with death, but expands in those who love and venerate it.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYKaZupXWojyi4saAmdXHN1nemBwwDrA3Vd3CGe6qsVtq/1778695532365.jpg)


My mother was born eight decades ago, and, despite her death, her time did not stop in 2018. It continues to grow in me, in my gestures, in my way of looking at the world, in my way of doing good without looking at whom, in the way it sustains me even on difficult days. There are lives that are not measured by their duration, but by the mark they leave, and my Tata's is one of those lives that continue to breathe in silence.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbKgAoQ99y3L6vX17TVmCkwB6QnMUdM8euRciTg4MeyPr/1778695550749.jpg)


Eighty years represent a complete story: the girl she once was, the young woman who dreamed, the woman who fought, the mother who gave more than she received. Each stage of his life was an act of love, sacrifice, firmness and tenderness. And although she is no longer around to blow out candles or receive flowers, her legacy continues to flourish in each of her children and grandchildren. Because a mother who truly loved does not leave: she becomes a root, a compass, an inner refuge.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbCwLhZB7JEXxLuLpg2bJ2wKyXn137GMLzfC6ff6tWB8K/1778695566590.jpg)


To remember my mother's 80th birthday is to recognize that her existence is still present. She lives in my way of caring, in the sensitivity that accompanies me, in the strength to get up, in my ability to be grateful even after pain. He lives in the memory that does not fade, in the laughter I remember, in the word he taught me, in the calm he left me as an inheritance. It lives in my pride as a son, in my way of naming it and in my decision to keep it alive through words.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ6tBaTcmfJe1P7gvhc59eeZVUtwy84b9QAzzP4gu5yYZ/1778695581010.jpg)


Today I do not celebrate an absence: I celebrate a different presence. I celebrate that my mother is still my mother, that her love was not broken by death, that her story continues to beat in my chest. I celebrate that eighty years after its arrival in the world, its light is still on. And that I am one of the places where that light shines most brightly.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ9dnDvh2gwR17JraLZLkkijZQSbjZsostqV7qFkLjEnQ/1778695594609.jpg)


To conclude I leave two tenths dedicated to my mother on her 80th birthday. My siblings will be proud of these poetic verses because like mom, they enjoy this way of expressing feelings.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd9YJPyBmUTMtUa277Gyx1p1PVpoagW72GdJF4bsmqoda/1778695606605.jpg)



80 springs

Mother, eighty springs  
you fulfill today from your dawn;  
Your life still treasures me  
with its true lights.  
You're still alive in my ways  
in my voice and in my path;  
Your steadfast, crystalline love  
It accompanies me every day.  
You are strength, you are poetry,  
You are a beacon in my destiny.


Even though time took you  
your root is in my breast;  
Your tenderness is the right  
that life left me.  
Everything in me reminded you  
noble mother, my mother;  
Your memory is melody  
that never stops burning.  
Today your eighties give birth  
Your greatness in my joy.

Note: The images are my property.
I used the DeepL Translate translator.



ESPAÑOL 




Celebrar los 80 años de mi mamá, aun cuando hace ocho que partió físicamente, es un acto de justicia emocional y de memoria luminosa. No es un simple aniversario: es la confirmación de que una vida verdaderamente grande no termina con la muerte, sino que se expande en quienes la amamos y la veneramos.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYKaZupXWojyi4saAmdXHN1nemBwwDrA3Vd3CGe6qsVtq/1778695532365.jpg)


Mi mamá nació hace ocho décadas, y, a pesar de su muerte su tiempo no quedó detenido en el año 2018. Sigue creciendo en mi, en mis gestos, en mi forma de mirar el mundo, en mi manera de hacer el bien sin mirar a quien, en la forma en que me sostiene incluso en los días difíciles. Hay vidas que no se miden por su duración, sino por la huella que dejan, y la de mi Tata es una de esas vidas que continúan respirando en silencio.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbKgAoQ99y3L6vX17TVmCkwB6QnMUdM8euRciTg4MeyPr/1778695550749.jpg)


Ochenta años representan una historia completa: la niña que alguna vez fue, la joven que soñó, la mujer que luchó, la madre que entregó más de lo que recibió. Cada etapa de su vida fue un acto de amor, de sacrificio, de firmeza y ternura. Y aunque ya no esté para soplar velas ni para recibir flores, su legado sigue floreciendo en cada uno de sus hijos y nietos. Porque una madre que amó de verdad no se va: se transforma en raíz, en brújula, en refugio interior.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbCwLhZB7JEXxLuLpg2bJ2wKyXn137GMLzfC6ff6tWB8K/1778695566590.jpg)


Recordar los 80 años de mi madre es reconocer que su existencia sigue siendo presente. Ella vive en mi manera de cuidar, en la sensibilidad que me acompaña, en la fuerza para levantarme, en mi capacidad de agradecer incluso después del dolor. Vive en la memoria que no se apaga, en la risa que recuerdo, en la palabra que me enseñó, en la calma que me dejó como herencia. Vive en mi orgullo de hijo, en mi forma de nombrarla y en mi decisión de mantenerla viva a través de la palabra.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ6tBaTcmfJe1P7gvhc59eeZVUtwy84b9QAzzP4gu5yYZ/1778695581010.jpg)


Hoy no celebro una ausencia: celebro una presencia distinta. Celebro que mi madre sigue siendo mi madre, que su amor no se quebró con la muerte, que su historia continúa latiendo en mi pecho. Celebro que ochenta años después de su llegada al mundo, su luz sigue encendida. Y que yo soy uno de los lugares donde esa luz brilla con más fuerza.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ9dnDvh2gwR17JraLZLkkijZQSbjZsostqV7qFkLjEnQ/1778695594609.jpg)


Para concluir dejo dos décimas dedicadas a mi madre en su 80 cumpleaños. Mis hermanos estarán orgullosos de estos versos poéticos porque al igual que mamá, ellos disfrutan de esta manera mis de expresar sentimientos.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd9YJPyBmUTMtUa277Gyx1p1PVpoagW72GdJF4bsmqoda/1778695606605.jpg)


80 primaveras


Madre, ochenta primaveras  
cumples hoy desde tu aurora;  
tu vida aún me atesora  
con sus luces verdaderas.  
Sigues viva en mis maneras,  
en mi voz y en mi camino;  
tu amor firme y cristalino  
me acompaña cada día.  
Eres fuerza, eres poesía,  
eres faro en mi destino.


Aunque el tiempo te llevó,  
tu raíz quedó en mi pecho;  
tu ternura es el derecho  
que la vida me dejó.  
Todo en mí te recordó,  
madre noble, madre mía;  
tu memoria es melodía  
que nunca deja de arder.  
Hoy tus ochenta hacen nacer  
tu grandeza en mi alegría.

title.title: 🏗️ Little Engineer's Big Dream: Eyan and His Toy Blocks.
title.body:
> ![IMG20260508120133.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTsVs9SPpcu6Mkz59SigLBbKSrULXpRLSs46KH8j9g8JH/IMG20260508120133.jpg) What could be more joyful for a parent than seeing their child's little hands obsessed with building something new? My son Ian is just like that. When he sits down to play with blocks, he feels lost in another world. In today's digital age, where children are trapped in mobile screens, I am filled with joy when Ian makes toys of various shapes with these colorful blocks. Sometimes he makes skyscrapers, sometimes strange cars, and sometimes some magical device of his own imagination. ![IMG20260508120136.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXtCu3qdnmbo8ik9KR7MrS77MuDY6qX5JB8HYDsN4xh1E/IMG20260508120136.jpg) Playing with blocks is not just a waste of time, it plays a great role in the child's mental development: Imagination: He creates a picture in his mind and tries to make it a reality. Patience and concentration: It takes a lot of patience to arrange the desired toy by arranging the blocks one by one. Problem-solving skills: When a block doesn't fit or breaks, he finds a way to fix it himself. I always believe that children should be allowed to spread their creativity, not just confined to reading books. When Ian comes running to me screaming with joy with a new toy he has made, that joy is greater than anything else in the world. Pray for my little Ian, that he can become a craftsman like this when he grows up. Maybe these small efforts of his will lead him to something much bigger one day. ___ |

title.title: Hive Open Mic Week 318 || You Are My All in All by Dennis Jernigan (A Freestyle)
title.body: >Hello everyone! It is a beautiful day, and it is beautiful to here for this week's Open Mic. I am so much in love with the week's theme. Immediately I saw the theme \
the first thing that came to mind was \

; and then Jesus the Lamb of God. 

>¡Hola a todos! Hace un día precioso, y es un placer escuchar el Open Mic de esta semana. Me encanta el tema de esta semana. En cuanto vi el tema «Cordero», lo primero que me vino a la mente fue «Cordero de Dios»; y luego, Jesús, el Cordero de Dios. 

---


![1000349445.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ernesto6402/23z7QHHArcrSYUfM7gwbp9BagFoKeFZ66wZt6B2Dh723KWbT6s3NB5Jv37co13qA9iryS.png)

---


Christ is the one true Lamb who takes away the sin of the word, and that was the first thing that came to my mind when I saw the theme for this week's Open Mic. The song that followed was the popular \

by Dennis Jernigan, and so I decided to work with that. 
>Cristo es el único Cordero verdadero que quita el pecado del mundo, y eso fue lo primero que me vino a la mente cuando vi el tema del Open Mic de esta semana. La canción que sonó a continuación fue el popular tema «You Are My All in All», de Dennis Jernigan, así que decidí basarme en ella. 


For this week's Open Mic, I will be performing \

by Dennis Jernigan; but a unique version. I will take just the Chorus of the song, play around with it a little bit, and then add a powerful verse that aligns perfectly with the message I want to pass. I simply want to focus on the fact that he is the Lamb of God who took away our sins by his death on the cross of Calvary. I just hope I am able to do that. >En el Open Mic de esta semana, interpretaré «You are my all in all», de Dennis Jernigan, pero en una versión especial. Me centraré solo en el estribillo de la canción, jugaré un poco con él y luego añadiré una estrofa impactante que encaja a la perfección con el mensaje que quiero transmitir. Simplemente quiero centrarme en el hecho de que Él es el Cordero de Dios que quitó nuestros pecados con su muerte en la cruz del Calvario. Solo espero ser capaz de hacerlo. Hello. I mentioned last week that I would be publishing a report on the SHORT token. The HBD/SHORT liquidity pool has been active for a week now. Activity in the liquidity pools is increasing daily. However, we are progressing quite slowly in the token market. The current trading volume in the Hive/SHORT market is $19. We need market makers in the Hive/SHORT market.

![short.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anadolu/23tGZdpvyB9GNXMmo9JANsGCNBwrgnou1BFVi3fDTT4eEdwivrzMgiwk2b4cXwVzMVApz.jpg)

There are 100,000 SHORT tokens in circulation. Approximately 85,000 of these tokens are in liquidity pools. The liquidity pools hold approximately $1750 worth of liquidity. You can see the current status of the pools below.

Hive/SHORT
Liquidity: $146
Weekly trading volume: $99
APR: 82.8%

HBD/SHORT
Liquidity: $36
Weekly trading volume: $5
APR: 1006.4%

Cent/SHORT
Liquidity: $1560
Weekly trading volume: $501
APR: 120.8%

The @centtoken account actively acts as a market maker in both the liquidity pool and the token market. It provides liquidity to liquidity pools and executes transactions to stabilize the token price using tools like @dswap. @centtoken does not receive LP rewards from the Cent/SHORT liquidity pool. However, we can earn LP rewards if we provide liquidity to HBD/SHORT, Hive/SHORT, etc. liquidity pools. Our aim in doing this is to maintain the APR balance in the liquidity pools.

We will soon begin distributing rewards to market makers in the Hive/Cent and Hive/SHORT markets. You can find the relevant announcement [here](https://peakd.com/hive-173575/@centtoken/cent-token-market-making-transactions-event-jez). Cent buybacks are ongoing. 香辣虾仁炒饭真是一道让人垂涎欲滴的美食！每一口都有鲜嫩的虾仁，搭配香喷喷的米饭，混合着微微的辣味，既刺激又让人回味无穷。那种香料的味道渗透在米饭中，让人一口接一口停不下来。再加上一点青葱和红辣椒的点缀，色香味俱全，实在是满足了我的味蕾，真是一道绝妙的家常美味！

title.title: May Spring stroll in the Kingdom of Fife
title.body: > Hello Hello Hivers, Hivians and any other wonderful being who has stumbled onto this! I am back with another wee stroll in the spring sunshine here in the Kingdom of Fife in Scotland, come let's walk the now. ![May Spring Stroll.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tengolotodo/48PTHa4Bg4wTVuon2TxRHB5XmxYmjLDEyC621am3MaviRjuVECjixPqgbWy57hUZrg.jpg) *** ### Last week we finished with white bluebells so today we start with the normal bluebells! ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tengolotodo/23wqcMx9MBTGzczHEdfF11LnnC7ZJF7swbAZFSWBCRQHEw42VtuKtNjERH32kbrdQFBe9.png) They renovated this old lodge in the park and turned it into a primarty school. But the pillocks of a council have put the sign covering up one of the lion statues, which are over a 100 years and were restored. Fkcuing useless corrupt arses they really are. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tengolotodo/244xsKMBDDQy4bvUc8NZg8r8YDAZfBo46Ea8taNiukBgjxwbpNBi12PW7Du2VM1DjYecQ.png) Post 5pm is becoming the best part of the day here lately, the sun seems to come out then lol! ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tengolotodo/23wC387CtdfLsxy7M5iDdzZUqGf2axekjTQ3nvCxXq3ASTXwmaMaHnDDaQ7RGP74kqE8w.jpg) This park used to host motorbike races, and these avenues of trees I just imagine with spectators as motorbikes sped past at breakneck speed! ### The first race was in 1948 ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tengolotodo/23wqc4aN1qxWc4yqpDUM9sTu9QNcGcCNPA1ZXc8Bk3csKpEGBYPwUh92NJAfkYp1uDPbx.png) Npw then, I call these raspeberry pink and it is my favourite colour of wool I think! ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tengolotodo/23vhwUdwRyWJTwEGXpsnjJBSqFEZypSaVHY2y5z2UhSdWtxPHGCSMjcbPw2oC5ySERY8N.png) It is from a Rhododendron bush. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tengolotodo/23tbsB9on7G1M5UuL2gtTptdAv9Vq9Ccvd97HmfMXLsyDJBzDp7sgJGwBJtFnnyN6HBQk.png) I am pretty sure it is the popular hybrids 'Germania' ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tengolotodo/23wMWajwwo1t1rttAp7N1t25RZQHTCbDfVjSnwm7NP6g84Xjd5uBXaQzxstK2QtzLnuXn.png) Anyway one more avenue until we go 'offtrack'! ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tengolotodo/23uQfVvn2hzMGBG4C87sak6cbXrudjht4pcV24mPWnPvxKeBod6fdNqLuExu4GyTwfje9.png) Time for the offroad experience. Each day I walk past I do notice more greenery and leaves appearing on things! ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tengolotodo/23tvXvchcbcp3ugAa8q2JApBNBqRUsaDpey8SFNVhPBED9KrsuVUTvqctwsV9FcSXaqPL.png) We did let Sir Michael sleep and stayed on the lower path today. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tengolotodo/23vsFw7mB7Wo4aV1N1Q2nC73NZRSweqcGDLubgi9VU5UzQU8dMfwwntnPqNZ65um2dt4i.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tengolotodo/23tbicCrCGH4XZCjfcRFjXtPtRBpegUyASF64xLqme5RB8AZa8Hcsc6ebLKMpbHEqaj1r.png) There are quite a few on and offramps to the main park from the woods, I wish there was more onramps to Hive lol. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tengolotodo/23u5tBBeS2qB6P7Sy3FGcvwBCc4BVoxuZeER97powanXn5FifmcnqLZLexMvRigaPeaCz.jpg) Wild garlic and bluebells! ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tengolotodo/23tbnxkynQkWR5xh1Cwr3yH5CrNHnpMLjxpnn7zoVrDJHbZVQDMxEbA2FM3mP7foc58Qa.png) This whole trail at this time of the year is a scentfest. The smell of wild garlic is amazing, and if you are a garlicaholic like me then you will be in ecstasy walking along the trails! ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tengolotodo/23w2cXUCGGPMk4NSBB2PSZNt5m3Pg2ryzQxbxHccAn58yJuVnNMfUuRojJMcH9Kv1XjXm.png) There were a few clumps of Spanish bluebells but for the most part the originals still rule the roost! ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tengolotodo/23tm6rZNWujyJ2WwaV4awCLLB3eGKQWFTPurNTkLdBs9dAZWg2ZNGmQD3vMA7qL7KaQdx.png) The larger white flowers in the foreground are Spanish bluebells. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tengolotodo/23tGbvrRZ62PPLFCrUrz1tG4ybAAL8KTVpQkiaZdqeTrHRuTBNGPd4VER1V99fTHvvioW.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tengolotodo/23yTacBiR4yyQxFPtKdgMXzdnqif53BcZwA2yEeMiK3euKLG17c6jeqqz9HNUAYqF8uNS.png) ### 3 types of bluebells! - Can you spot them? ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tengolotodo/23tbkox7DuED2fj8WU2RjdNb2ZBGUV7aZtZFKVjxhhdi5KAoTZ6E1uUTBF1MyZgvQNnUj.png) Back on the final stretch and time to get home and make dinner! ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tengolotodo/23uFHFjT3caoQX9GnSwdXr78tz1ZgYWrJLQoB5FcSTFpkNeBeTdwdXxxac5txq6NHfMEe.png) --- And there we have it. That is my second Wednesday walk in May which happened to be yesterday. Anyway, have a good one.
/> This post is for #wednesdaywalk which was inspired by @tattoodjay ### Thanks for visiting and I hope you managed to get out for a walk this week.

/> **_All images and ramblings are from me, the mad Scotsman TengoLoTodo unless otherwise stated. Note images are all snapped by me with my Google Pixel 9 XL Pro smartphone on Tuesday May 12th 2026. @tengolotodo May 13th 2026_** DO WHAT YOU LOVE AND DO IT OFTEN -------------------------------- ### Haste Ye Back! title.title: La coqueta de Jade | Jade the diva
title.body:
> Hola de nuevo! Hoy les traigo un nuevo post bastante genial, esta vez de un nuevo set de fotos de uno de mis bellos gatos, Jade. He estado extremadamente full de actividades toda esta semana y no he podido tener la constancia que tuve la semana pasada, sin embargo algo que me ayuda mucho a subirme a los ánimos y que me acompaña cuando necesito estar tranquila, son mis gatos, como una de ellas la cual es Jade. Desde que llegó ella ha sido una gata bastante peculiar, le gusta mucho su espacio, es algo odiosa y además le costó un poco adaptarse a nuestras formas de dar cariño. Yo soy una persona que adora a cargar a los gatitos porque me parecen muy adorables y les doy muchos besitos, con Remy no hay ningún problema ya que él es bastante amoroso, al igual que con Lia, pero con Jade es diferente ya que a ella de por sí no le gusta que la carguen, y si la cargas se altera y pide desesperadamente que la bajen. No obstante con el tiempo ella se ha podido acostumbrar a vivir con nosotros y actualmente es una gatita extremadamente cariñosa, y creo que en ese proceso ayudó mucho a traer a la gatita más pequeña, Lia, con la cual ella es bastante apegada. Algo que me gusta destacar de ella es que es una gata muy femenina, camina tongoneándose, tiene una mirada muy delicada, además que es muy fotogénica. Me parece una gatita extremadamente hermosa y esponjosa, cada vez que la veo me provoca comerla besitos pero sé que con ella me tengo que controlar, porque no le gusta para nada tanto afecto, igualmente ella es muy cariñosa y duerme conmigo, frota de vez en cuando para pedirme cariño, y además a veces me despierta en las mañanas. Otra cosa me gusta d ella es que es la más tranquila de los tres gatos, aunque aún así es bastante traviesa, siento que es la que amortigua todas las travesuras que hacen los otros dos gatitos. Sin embargo cuando Jade es traviesa, lo es bastante, porque a veces se aparece con unos objetos bien raros que se nota que tuvo que agilizar mucho la entrada a ciertos lugares para conseguirlos, por lo que a veces hay que tener cuidado con lo que dejamos afuera. Jade realmente es una gata preciosa y quería compartirles algunas fotos de ella como espero que les guste!
Hello again! Today I’m come to your with another really cool post, this time featuring a new photo set of one of my beautiful cats, Jade. I’ve been extremely busy all week and haven’t been able to keep up the same consistency I had last week. However, something that really helps lift my spirits and keeps me company when I need some peace and quiet is my cats, like Jade. Ever since she arrived, she’s been a pretty unique cat. She really likes her space, she can be a bit of a handful, and she also had a hard time adjusting to the way we show affection. I’m the kind of person who loves to hold kittens because I think they’re so adorable, and I give them lots of little kisses. With Remy, there’s no problem at all since he’s pretty affectionate, just like Lia, but with Jade it’s different because she doesn’t like being held in the first place, and if you do hold her, she gets upset and desperately begs to be put down. However, over time she’s gotten used to living with us, and now she’s an extremely affectionate cat. I think bringing home our youngest kitten, Lia, to whom she’s quite attached, really helped with that process. One thing I’d like to highlight about her is that she’s a very feminine cat, she walks with a swaying gait, has a very delicate gaze, and is also very photogenic. I think she’s an extremely beautiful and fluffy little cat, every time I see her, I just want to shower her with kisses, but I know I have to control myself with her because she doesn’t like that much affection at all. Still, she’s very affectionate and sleeps with me, she rubs against me from time to time to ask for affection, and she even wakes me up in the mornings sometimes. Another thing I like about her is that she’s the calmest of the three cats, though she’s still pretty mischievous. I feel like she’s the one who softens all the mischief the other two kittens get into. However, when Jade is mischievous, she’s really mischievous, because sometimes she shows up with some really strange objects that clearly required her to sneak into certain places to get them, so sometimes we have to be careful about what we leave lying around. Jade really is a beautiful cat, and I wanted to share some photos of her with you, I hope you like it!

title.body:
On this day, I enjoyed the long-awaited cloudy weather combined with the beginning of vegetation greening. Spring is no longer yellow, but it is also not green. That's the time when the colors start to change.

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQme6eRJNUijvwhyK4iFEoFWeUBPRZDL7Yy6UNdij8388gM/image.png)

Gloomy coolness – what a lyrical sophisticated title of the post and how it differed from reality ...
https://sun9-60.userapi.com/s/v1/ig2/KbCw6-Z0kZ4dD-z2OAUKyTpmvoZcvik-5peQ2lQssy8t0ryEqd0G4R7Jf2thovRnk4REk93kJFBKtHexftNdF_Ge.jpg?quality=95&as=32x21,48x32,72x48,108x72,160x107,240x160,360x240,480x320,540x360,640x427,720x480,1080x720,1280x853,1440x960,2560x1707&from=bu&cs=2560x0

Strange...the pictures in the post are quite reportage-like.
https://sun9-62.userapi.com/s/v1/ig2/61MbuJyMmAKQvNx18aDEnzjxii76TkaClFHPyRzEl08y5dbF5MFAQI0pcaPJe0q_CgVR_Q9AvpLyF6Z0X3INe97u.jpg?quality=95&as=32x21,48x32,72x48,108x72,160x107,240x160,360x240,480x320,540x360,640x427,720x480,1080x720,1280x853,1440x960,2560x1707&from=bu&cs=2560x0

But the reportage code from them disappears smoothly. I can feel it.

title.title: Business Growth in the Digital Era: A Complete Guide for Success\n
title.body:
![Your Smart Learning Partner for Academic Success.jpg](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/cf05b94b111b0c52fe336f2e9b6f638bf4b5c3070aa3d3cdcb10878956a67dee)



Business is one of the most important parts of modern society. It drives [economic growth](https://guestpostnow.com/maryrsmith), creates employment opportunities, and provides products and services that improve everyday life. From small local shops to large international companies, businesses help shape industries and communities around the world.

In today’s digital age, the business environment is changing rapidly. Technology, online marketing, artificial intelligence, and global competition are transforming how companies operate. To succeed, businesses must adapt to new trends, understand customer needs, and develop effective strategies for long-term growth.

This article explores the meaning of business, its importance, types of businesses, growth strategies, challenges, and future trends.

# What Is a Business?

A business is an organization or activity involved in producing, buying, or selling goods and services for profit. Businesses can be small, medium, or large depending on their size and operations.

The main objectives of a business include:

*   Earning profit

*   Providing value to customers

*   Expanding market reach

*   Building brand reputation

*   Achieving long-term growth

Businesses exist in nearly every industry, including:

*   Technology

*   Healthcare

*   Education

*   Finance

*   Manufacturing

*   Retail

*   Transportation

*   Entertainment

# Importance of Business in Society

Businesses play a major role in economic and social development.

## Economic Growth

Businesses contribute to national economies by generating income, increasing production, and encouraging investment.

## Job Opportunities

Companies create millions of jobs worldwide, helping people improve their financial stability and quality of life.

## Innovation and Development

Businesses invest in research and technology to create better products and services.

## Improved Living Standards

From healthcare to transportation, businesses provide essential services that support modern lifestyles.

# Types of Business

There are different forms of business structures depending on ownership and operations.

## Sole Proprietorship

A sole proprietorship is owned and operated by one person.

### Advantages

*   Easy to start

*   Full control

*   Simple management

### Disadvantages

*   Unlimited liability

*   Limited resources

## Partnership Business

A partnership business involves two or more individuals sharing ownership.

### Benefits

*   Shared responsibilities

*   Combined skills and experience

*   More investment opportunities

## Corporation

A corporation is a separate legal entity owned by shareholders.

### Features

*   Limited liability protection

*   Larger investment opportunities

*   Long-term business continuity

## Online Business

Online businesses operate through the internet and digital platforms.

Popular online businesses include:

*   E-commerce stores

*   Freelancing services

*   Blogging

*   Affiliate marketing

*   Digital agencies

# Key Factors for Business Success

## Strong Business Planning

A business plan provides direction and outlines company goals, strategies, and financial projections.

A good business plan helps:

*   Attract investors

*   Manage operations

*   Measure growth

## Customer Understanding

Successful businesses focus on customer satisfaction and market demand.

Businesses use:

*   Surveys

*   Customer feedback

*   Social media engagement

*   Data analysis

to better understand consumer behavior.

## Effective Marketing

Marketing helps businesses reach potential customers and build brand awareness.

Popular marketing strategies include:

*   Search engine optimization (SEO)

*   Social media marketing

*   Content marketing

*   Email campaigns

*   Paid advertising

## Financial Management

Managing money effectively is essential for sustainability.

Businesses should monitor:

*   Revenue

*   Expenses

*   Profit margins

*   Investments

*   Cash flow

# The Role of Technology in Modern Business

Technology has transformed business operations worldwide.

## E-Commerce Expansion

Online shopping platforms allow businesses to reach global customers.

## Artificial Intelligence

AI improves:

*   Customer service

*   Automation

*   Data analysis

*   Decision-making

## Cloud Computing

Cloud systems improve communication, storage, and business efficiency.

## Digital Communication

Modern businesses rely on:

*   Video conferencing

*   Messaging apps

*   Collaboration tools

*   Remote work platforms

# Business Challenges in 2026

Despite opportunities, businesses face many challenges.

## Strong Competition

Global markets create intense competition among companies.

## Economic Uncertainty

Inflation and changing economic conditions affect profits and investments.

## Cybersecurity Threats

Online businesses must protect customer data and digital systems.

## Rapid Market Changes

Customer trends and technologies evolve quickly, requiring businesses to adapt continuously.

# Strategies for Business Growth

## Build a Strong Brand

A trusted brand increases customer loyalty and recognition.

## Focus on Customer Experience

Excellent customer service encourages repeat business and referrals.

## Invest in Digital Marketing

Online marketing helps businesses reach larger audiences efficiently.

## Expand Products and Services

Diversification creates new revenue opportunities.

## Use Data and Analytics

Business analytics help companies make smarter decisions.

# Entrepreneurship and Startups

Entrepreneurship continues growing globally as people launch startups and innovative businesses.

Successful entrepreneurs often have:

*   Creativity

*   Leadership skills

*   Risk management abilities

*   Problem-solving talent

Startups contribute significantly to innovation and job creation.

# Future Trends in Business

The future of business will be shaped by technology and sustainability.

## Artificial Intelligence Integration

AI will continue automating business processes and improving efficiency.

## Sustainable Business Practices

Consumers increasingly support environmentally responsible companies.

## Remote and Hybrid Work

Flexible work environments are becoming more common.

## Digital Payments and Cryptocurrency

Online payment systems and digital currencies are expanding worldwide.

# Conclusion

Business is the foundation of economic growth and innovation. Whether small or large, every business contributes to society by creating jobs, offering products and services, and improving living standards.

Success in modern business requires strategic planning, financial management, customer understanding, and adaptability. Companies that embrace technology, focus on customer satisfaction, and invest in innovation are more likely to achieve sustainable growth.

As the digital economy continues evolving, businesses must remain flexible and forward-thinking to stay competitive in the global marketplace.

# FAQs About Business

## What is the main purpose of a business?

The main purpose of a business is to provide products or services while generating profit.

## Why is business important?

Business supports economic growth, creates jobs, and improves quality of life.

## What are the main types of businesses?

Common types include sole proprietorships, partnerships, corporations, and online businesses.

## How can a business grow successfully?

Businesses can grow through effective marketing, customer satisfaction, innovation, and strong financial management.

## What role does technology play in business?

Technology improves communication, productivity, automation, and customer engagement.

## Is online business profitable?

Yes, online businesses can be highly profitable with proper planning and marketing strategies.

Thank you, Judy. It's not that I don't like to have them, I embrace them with all my heart. I just don't hold on to them.

They flow. I accept to be sad, I accept to be happy. And I accept the sadness that lies in every happiness as well.

But don't get me wrong, I love my emotions. I love them with all my heart. Thank you.

I think Metapoop had her hands up, and then Blue had his hands up. Go ahead, Metapoop, and then we'll go to Blue. First of all, Juan, mahalo and blissful post-birthday, but every breath is a birthday, so blissful now, blissful birthing through every momentum.
