title.title: A Light Stroll That Turned Into a 5-Hour Mountain Hike: From Pokhara to Sarangkot (Nepal)
title.body:
![77788hhggtt.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/x-rain/EpA25xwx2rgvybTTF9ARNPrBMDpVAJ4BrXacwfSPxjcFt33JDjjeJuFdzQ9Gg2if5rh.jpg)


Around 2:30, after pondering where to go for a walk, I decided to explore an area over Sedi (a neighborhood where I have been staying since the end of March 2026). It was too late for a serious adventure, and I wanted only to spend some time with nature, observing plants and trees, maybe some cool birds... On my way, a local man started asking questions, including where I was heading, and I repeated: \

Sarangkot is a village at the top of a mountain over Sedi and the entire Pokhara City. It's known to have a stunning vista of snow-covered peaks of the Himalayas, standing together like actors on the stage after a play, receiving applause. And as everyone says, these rocky actors do deserve that recognition - each glorious and resplendent in their snowy, heavenly beauty.

However, to reach them on foot, as I knew from Google, you need something between 2 and 3 hours, and, secondly, those celebrities - continuing the silly analogy, lol - normally disappear behind the curtain of clouds at noon or so... Moreover, it often starts raining around 4 p.m... Thus, 2:30 was obviously too late for anything except for visiting the nearest shrubs or stuff...

But I  thought: nobody makes me walk all the way to Sarangkot viewpoint, I can just have a stroll up the slope, nothing serious...

The pathway, crossing the woody slope, was very steep but equipped with stairs made of rocks, so the ascent was tiring but not difficult. The sweat quickly paid off with a beautiful view through the gap between trees:

![DSC_6565.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/x-rain/242XuQDqQreEZEnGotgDP8wnk81XUx5SaEijeUkpn7dSUNDCNQSX6kiyicLGUJDMv7SRs.JPG)

When the forest came to an end,

![DSC_6575.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/x-rain/2423yioZEBwy7cawbKyEXCWhQrnSRKhpMmb7ZFqNxUVM9EpNZwU2fByoVFu2Rr3eZposa.JPG)

the panorama became even more breathtaking:

![DSC_6582-2.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/x-rain/243zZnuFW2cD94VEntoQ3ok7AJDZ8p6qt7s4PFLfYj1Qnkr8kwVXBQGQSbHpMWh2W6uBQ.JPG)

And even slightly dizzying.

![DSC_6608.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/x-rain/242NYNPVpJin6Wy6SmCGC5yW6RZHqnQnnutfQtdcHwZHPPfLEfDoQb2Qa4ggpuiHvWcZb.JPG)

The forest then gave way to a steep meadow with farm constructions, that was the very bottom of Sarangkot village:

![DSC_6595.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/x-rain/23zGaNHnM6cCZjxZpuCj5uZ2sMbmxqCP2cFrioG1dtELMQ4fa41dzGcaWYhhmLSJtXFXn.JPG)

I was celebrating the victory - I needed only 45 minutes of intense hiking to reach the village.

\

![DSC_6613.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/x-rain/23z79qtqP8ErdyeWhzWFZXCcSS8RtkNYU72FP8cfyE7DWSUNPgPwr3o9t8zjZujjF5y2C.JPG)

I kept walking up the mountain, photographing views opening up behind me.

![DSC_6615.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/x-rain/243zZnxHy7XuZKi1dXTU2vRCqyKWQCVWhF8Ftb6v6CQmSuQHwjqYKvSmVPYnx8ynjL9uN.JPG)

This is Phewa Lake and semi-rural Sedi, where I am staying.

![DSC_6626.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/x-rain/2449scKuBqoAJUxLJaZD2d2y4B6q9hYJUefPhw2Hru7byUQ3enLKC9s8eqzXe8E1md2r9.JPG)

And this is a lowland to the west of the lake.

![DSC_6627.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/x-rain/23wC7QPWokGBaX6cQNsVT9SYCVZ6aUVvSJQK2R3EB7AWS1GmQDqjVe2zsNq1vbR4YFM2o.JPG)

The village turned out to be a quite developed touristy area, with decent houses (maybe many owned by outsiders from Pokhara?) and with locals living a simple life, carrying water in giant bottles on their shoulders and herding goats...

![DSC_6630.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/x-rain/23r1sNoWPadvMCNrsJiHSLVEekivf6ZVJMdY8PQF75RVEP6eWchLHgdpAfF4rhVuyPBV7.JPG)

Locals...

Of course, a big camera was an attraction for kids.

![DSC_6639.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/x-rain/23tbwUwBYYroyZ5GjR1ywm3dYmLPSjUKrrXahg6fHcqFVMUTordgQ8LEGPuGPmKv19R5B.JPG)

The shot was taken by a lil boy with tiny monkey fingers, I was helping... That's his elder sista, watching him as a strict teacher.

I didn't mind except for the fact that it was 4 pm, and I was still far from Sarangkot's top. Yes, after I entered the lower part of the village, I thought, \

![DSC_6681.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/x-rain/244KTHJyYP7hD8WJcS9qiFsGPf4ceFeuZDn2jkdJm1JmgoDPJzryaWx7FGH5dyy3YsmKY.JPG)

That ambitious plan also meant I had to hurry up 'cause I didn't want to walk the forest rocky stairs at night, really didn't want... Especially because my phone's battery was low and I couldn't rely on it as a torch.

![DSC_6618.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/x-rain/242DJ5rdjFnqvXm4JwW4TG9ZQKVQYJXuyTn2B7p7LMogAxusBeoiVmNbwd4pG5eTs1AxD.JPG)

Higher and higher but the ascent didn't end.

![DSC_6649.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/x-rain/244UfPyU319dQJNQ1bM65ZsuKyHUjfHh9zPHnL3rjzy4MFERhnsoxijDxnnDQZbavPCN4.JPG)

Most of the way, I followed a pathway between houses and it wasn't easy to find where to go. I asked people, once lost the way and found myself at someone's garden...

![DSC_6652.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/x-rain/245HkmLN88TevbRohSBWG8gWQ75DYNDq95iJ4Sr8D4TM3rsjFJNtfRfD8Li58VATy139R.JPG)

The dramatic part was that my legs got very tired, and my initial fast pace turned into a hobble powered by the last of my strength.

![DSC_6656.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/x-rain/23yJGPCQRHFZHDe8DZn7A9JHrdPEk4SbywcLyrSfpQPBgJCEUVFJNKKwvnn59yCXn6n4P.JPG)

This damned village didn't want to end... Higher, higher, and higher.

![DSC_6678.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/x-rain/23s9R7PKRhRDQscm9AvpDGGz1pcbnAVRfGu17aNJPvmVFwtZQAQ8hzqJ1kYeg1FtGNhhV.JPG)

But eventually I reached the natural citadel of Sarangkot. It was like a small town with the dense development and paved/cobbled streets, full of tiny souvenir shops - \

I didn't expect to see those huge mountains as it was late afternoon, and a local on my way told there would be no mountains seen from the viewpoint. However:

![DSC_6664.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/x-rain/2449xNUT2R8GpqkebMSmsbuax8AVscSuxnBv6RANYkV2VuAffcWaK6qXwqy3FpK2KSZJx.JPG)

I was truly blessed by this beauty, a Himalayan celebrity, called Annapurna South with an elevation 7,219 meters (23,684 ft). It was a stunning spectacle - high in the sky where, all my life, I  could see only clouds... there was this miracle, a flying mountain, like if it was there all the time but opened to me only when I came to Nepal and made this hard walk...

...Despite pain in my legs, I was jogging down along the pathways and roads back to the forest trail, to be there before the dark. And I did it. 

5:31 pm:

![DSC_6687.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/x-rain/242rkjMhF2HeyphABXqPNa8CciToajKJ5Em5TC6C9zzoLZpe2zie3KNS64Vir6FjhfdZr.JPG)

Since I was already safe, I let myself give in to exhaustion - I barely managed to hobble my way down through the shady forest, and had a rest every now and then.

When I finally got back to the guesthouse, I promised myself I'd never do it again. But the very next day, I thought, well, maybe I should make the climb to the lower part of Sarangkot my \

twice a week?..

We'll see.

*The photos were taken with a Nikkor 50mm f/1.8G on a full-frame DSLR Nikon D750 on May 10, 2026, in Sarangkot, Nepal*

title.title: The Leap of Faith.
title.body: >\n\nThanks to me and Hytham, Eivor performed his first Leap of Faith. Captured in photo mode, the jump was a success, leading Eivor to thank Hytham for the \

After returning to the settlement, Hytham revealed the mission to eliminate the Order of the Ancients throughout England. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaEEdz5XY92SDKJzAj3BMKUmLYzNGHVU6ENktbatjiX7L/screenshot_1_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSjREj99EizKXPXihgf7t7HKhPtJTqBzQ7Fgw3D1zFGhs/screenshot_2_.png) Eivor was worried about Hytham after the jump, wondering if he survived the massive drop. Before performing the leap of faith, I called Synin and noticed this light behind Eivor that seemed to glow with an otherworldly intensity. It cast a long shadow across the cliffside. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXi8xW8oBm3FS228Tr2mKjqyEDf5yZJmMjoqaUCU12Yat/screenshot_3_.png) But after getting back to Eivor's perspective, I didn't see the light anymore, which told me only Synin could see it from that high vantage point. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfZsoV388mtxfbJw7m4ySYSW4MBPxPsmpWdXeKVSgqGzR/screenshot_4_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSUE9MS2jc2mmD3SC7jLjemzSN8JhfjU4m8JQxSk7tjte/screenshot_5_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme3dZbTAidQxtGpsfXVhi9cfAc2by3JUq4d86aXokeBaX/screenshot_6_.png) And at last, I performed the leap of faith, the first leap of faith of Eivor that was going to be smooth and effortless. The world seemed to slow down as I stepped off the edge, falling toward the small target below. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRS3S4CBxcMmPqRGdJw9HmKyCLgXFsjrzcUp35NB6SX8Y/screenshot_7_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmahkUoT8vy21JSE9MFRB8zVF4nxzoHwwvYHbeuNnNntcN/screenshot_8_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPyjVUUb8tLHo6oeEemUyWed22A7xN45HrPcYr6b9wK1y/screenshot_9_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXE3VSEKQwt8RuoucpHFPEjESiAw3cHuMcJL1bcjKNAAS/screenshot_10_.png) I tried the photo mode to capture some good angles of Eivor performing his first leap of faith. I also tried to capture the surroundings and our new settlement, Ravensthorpe, growing steadily in the distance. The view from the height was truly breathtaking. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS1ESiNmU46DvcotJ9szfpaEKHkJMG4DNS7cjSZ8mCjgb/screenshot_11_.png) And at last, Eivor landed on the haystack below safely, with the straw cushioning his impact perfectly. After getting out of the haystack, he mentioned it was really a gift he gave himself and thanked Hytham for showing him the way. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf2JqLX587hZKhmL5GrjA85tujxpF6JskpkabrXFJ8KZr/screenshot_12_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY1T8v2U3pw8Maupk3FhaP7oVr8SbJQmZAqSrgh2Hs3bo/screenshot_13_.png) I had to follow Hytham back to the settlement. And when he waited for me on the boat, I interacted with that tree log where I could sit and have a look on the settlement. It was a peaceful moment to appreciate our progress. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmebvhJkAtYYC19yYdgFqPhB4BWxzEcYDwuYdLcXgRMQGf/screenshot_14_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUYH2xXUWrFJRySmy3hoe5mnCQCZ3wv5DSfCWVG4STSgy/screenshot_15_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaFY5DXoXLNLDfEE9qpGgCSgAkUuryiKeMdekz76jyyd5/screenshot_16_.png) Then I jumped on the boat so Hytham could take us to the other side of the river once more. And then I followed him all the way to the newly built Hidden Ones Bureau in the heart of the town. The building looked sturdy and ready for work. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZD9zyXdduyAJHoxEktHvqpRetQJBh2Vd9oKae1a8Lzm3/screenshot_17_.png) After getting inside, Hytham talked about the last task Basim has given him, which is to locate and eliminate the Order of the Ancients in England. He said he needed Eivor's help with that task. Then I got a menu where I would find his targets next. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRoxK5mmm5kWL6h2VdEQFgbnzpT74nB8c2JeZfutn8xFD/screenshot_18_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPVTYp5sViQqktNj48Hs9zDYQQs8CnavzidRVQDnh7X7P/screenshot_19_.png) After checking on some profiles of the Order of the Ancients to understand their influence, I came out of the menu and completed the quest. And then I came out of the bureau to look for a new quest, being ready to hunt the shadows. That's all for now. --- ▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=coooldude/69922596)

title.body:
Hi!\
I had a day off today, but due to the not-so-great weather, I only went for a run in the afternoon, and then we went for a walk with the dogs around the neighborhood.

**

*Ahoj!\

title.title: LIMA STREET DIARIES: THE DIGITAL ANCHOR / EL ANCLA DIGITAL [ENG-ESP]
title.body:
# LIMA STREET DIARIES: THE DIGITAL ANCHOR / EL ANCLA DIGITAL [ENG-ESP]
### Urban Photography / Fotografía Urbana

<center>

![_DSC4917.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cabzphoto/Eo8RLnS16M2ADrPRFaH1pDQF4ivseReRfixZQa5rRWSgaFmXUmvu8sGJjEXqrZV4w1i.jpg)

*“We traded our instincts and creativity for a screen; it's time to look up.”*
*“Cambiamos nuestro instinto y creatividad por una pantalla; es hora de levantar la mirada.”*

</center>

![linea separadora hive.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cabzphoto/23u5LMZycR2ks1nWRqsVWJkcVyTpYcmV9JKkGrKrTj1mTsSwXWn33PjZ99nQYGWJQaLRV.png)

<div class=\

>

### English

Hello friends of the Black and White community and warriors of the MonoMad Challenge! Today I bring you a topic that catches my attention in every photo I take daily: our incredibly close bond with cell phones. Everything revolves around the phone now; we are no longer independent at all.

I come from a generation that barely watched TV as a child. To find a friend, it was a toss-up—you either showed up unannounced or coordinated a week in advance, hoping they’d remember. At 4 PM, everyone went to the park to play football or any other game that flowed from our imagination. To get somewhere, you just asked around and followed your instinct; getting lost was always an option. I remember carrying a bag full of CDs to listen to on my Discman, with a pouch of chewed-up batteries just to keep it going. I even recorded music from the radio! I loved reggae, and on Sundays, I’d hit \

on my cassette player to capture new artists and later trade tapes with friends.

It's amazing how one device has made us so dependent on a single thing. Creativity and critical thinking have been pushed aside. Now, people even consult AI for matters of the heart. But please, put down the phone and live your life. Go back to being like children and don't raise your kids this way; in the long run, it will just be lost time. Thanks and good vibes to everyone!

### Español

¡Hola, amigos de la comunidad en Blanco y Negro y guerreros del MonoMad Challenge! El día de hoy les traigo un tema que me llama mucho la atención en todas las fotos que saco diariamente: nuestro vínculo tan cercano con el celular. Todo es celular ahora; ya no somos independientes para nada.

Yo vengo de una generación que a las justas veía TV de niño. Para buscar a un amigo, era una moneda al aire: aparecías sin aviso o coordinabas con una semana de anterioridad, rogando que se acordara. A las 4 PM, todos íbamos al parque a jugar pelota o cualquier otro juego que fluyera de nuestra imaginación. Para llegar a un lugar, solo preguntabas y seguías tu instinto; perderse era una opción. Recuerdo que tenía mi mochila con un maletín lleno de CDs para escuchar en mi Discman, con una bolsa de pilas masticadas para que duraran un poco más. ¡Y eso que yo grababa música de la radio! Amaba el reggae y los domingos le metía \

a un programa para conocer nuevos artistas y luego cambiar cassettes con mis amigos. Es increíble cómo un aparato nos ha vuelto tan dependientes de una sola cosa. La creatividad pasó a un lado, el criterio también... ahora hasta consultamos cosas de amor a la IA. Pero bueno, de vez en cuando suelten el celular y vivan su vida. Vuelvan a ser niños y no críen a sus hijos así; a la larga, será tiempo perdido. ¡Gracias y vibras a todos! > **¡Kachkaniraqmi!** — *(Quechua: Until we meet again)* ![linea separadora hive.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cabzphoto/23u5LMZycR2ks1nWRqsVWJkcVyTpYcmV9JKkGrKrTj1mTsSwXWn33PjZ99nQYGWJQaLRV.png)

title.title: Walking through the Djerdap Gorge-Lepenski Vir
title.body:
For a walk on Wednesday with my wife, I chose a trip to Lepenski Vir, an hour and a half drive from my town.Lepenski Vir is one of the most important prehistoric sites in Europe. It is located in Eastern Serbia on the right bank of the Danube River in the Đerdap Gorge.It was discovered when I was 10 years old, so one of our school excursions happened to be here.Today I am here again and a lot has changed. The site was moved to a higher altitude because the largest hydroelectric power plant in Djerdap was being built there. We arrived around 10 o'clock and first headed towards the museum, which already had a lot of visitors. After the tour, we also watched a documentary film.Houses from that period were built in a trapezoidal shape, with a stone hearth in the center.The population engaged in fishing, hunting, and gathering fruits, but they also had the first forms of agriculture. Numerous sculptures made of stone have been found, depicting human and fish-like figures.
![698658754_4238297243087603_1613377338232982618_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dragan1957/EowEGFJQuJxY3qepAV4p3Dd7Zza9gez5qPhvVUhbVtmU4UDWhUNpo83hMUHyBCLYqPD.jpg)
![698536617_4238298589754135_2615224166397296078_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dragan1957/23u63LxrvCn9MEvPU3kyiZWjh8yDEkCEpdsupcnbHviCvLo6HgKc9d9pvu9GUHTQ9NMNj.jpg)
![696233976_4238297893087538_8845356458792007013_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dragan1957/23xydNXtPn3Jd5jtre2MRC2ikMKCJeLT4pwuXWY3q9tAJNXH3927feNDj1r2AVWynEPKW.jpg)
![698536611_4238298313087496_4368731243494575505_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dragan1957/23wX7qoi5Jq2zFwVF4bQbUQ3Nb7eaRRyMB4EZVj4VycCzNuxUZAK4KELBLirAX9eHK2AM.jpg)
![699860163_4238298226420838_6237963813196038634_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dragan1957/Eokf3M7sy3KaANoG9jDySrDb1QCM4hNdDdtMisA9PLE2J5BRq2ruTPp6wrtkQFV9tmL.jpg)
![700035665_4238297746420886_2102253086555174602_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dragan1957/23wCDwGzxFLmAjrYuufSjhEgMmeTyi1PGUsVgXTQPXaAq9J4w2H2QA8ESncREHWYmhy8U.jpg)
![697127123_4238298019754192_3091795279287007907_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dragan1957/23uFTQGr8Ft2MkB4n6oaHhwY6EdsGPZStzCxwNqP843LAwUhdqs2fhDYz8wmhDVuvTj87.jpg)
After leaving the museum, we drove to the Kovilovo viewpoint. Parked the car and then followed the footpath to the viewpoint.And then came a spectacular, 25-kilometer-wide panoramic view of the entire Donjomilanovac Valley, the Danube and neighboring Romania.
![696213496_4238298183087509_8881122652238893804_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dragan1957/23rB597mEHT66XAFH9JqS2vQeKRSdpRkVQdovbh8xSAk26hnd6ZyFw8RLki9ZM8K7dPZD.jpg)
![698706270_4238298453087482_465769828445140298_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dragan1957/243frcfwisPSTzbJ6hTkkhVK6EvaTwnQAG2u65z1QrYbJKSqqj319yCpBfozQUxZGbSsE.jpg)
![696017256_4238298709754123_6990955644338531553_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dragan1957/243zbnBWPGajpPRNkZ6FyFUWkkYHPsuGPz81cE3FhRpdAZTQUsNGotPAWVGgrEMQAdxMJ.jpg)
We continued towards the ethno complex Kapetan Misin breg. We were hungry and thought we would find a restaurant. However, we were only greeted by the buffet table. There was a variety of delicious food.I was especially delighted with the homemade bread and brandy.There were several houses in ethno style and we saw the open-air gallery \

with over 400 sculptures made of wood and stone, as well as the Wine Museum.
![698621803_4238297576420903_1212363729402812487_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dragan1957/Ep3dtNrH9iMAaLVUHYLt2Fod24Mtqu7LAvN7AgRsyCGJiJ2qviRPq32hMmaB928cNbu.jpg)
![695952794_4238298399754154_2309035967450067922_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dragan1957/243zZhzjHgEni2EDdreySEmikuDDY4KPUA9oDuqVKEPf7KM654YYmTMrPdFY6eVnRqmnp.jpg)
![698818138_4238298439754150_8277440303019744104_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dragan1957/Ep7tfgQ5rM3WQNaCgBR6f14EZmP87RjWKdyS1BJ26vkBHpRd13ffum8nYbSngViax9u.jpg)

title.title: An Even More Stubborn Partner
title.body:
I'm grateful that my husband, he's going through some healing journeys, which means he's not having confidence in himself, and that he could today appreciate his ass kicking back. I mean, he calls me money shit, but also he calls me, you know, ass kicking wifey. Because sometimes the real, the most stubborn people need an even more stubborn partner.

So he chose wisely. And I kicked him to a beautiful community meeting every Sunday, which he was rejecting all the time because he doesn't want to be seen in his bad condition. And that makes him even worse.

And today was a breakthrough. We went there. Tears were flowing.

Everybody embraced him. Everybody offered his help. And he just felt overwhelmed with joy and gratitude that he received himself for other people because he is and was always there for others.

But those who are always there for others in need have a really challenging time. Not everybody, but I would say that the majority I know, including myself, to receive the same what we give. And today it was a beautiful switch.

My husband surrendered to his ass kicking wifey, and he received the most beautiful pour in from the entire community. So I'm very grateful for that. Thank you.

That's beautiful. Thank you, men. I like that.

I want to say hi to Blue. How are you? Happy Sunday. And what are you grateful for? And then we're going to go to Juanito.

Blue, how are you? Hi, everybody. And, yeah, no, there's only one thing I'm grateful for, and that is the company of beautiful people around me. And I will forever be grateful for that.

So that's it. Thank you. Maybe you can dig into your pile of poems, and you'll find one that's about love or being grateful or love or being grateful.

No pressure. Juan, are you ready? Juan, because it is DJ's birthday, and it was released yesterday. Yes.

title.title: Money And Happiness the Balance Of Life
title.body: > **Hello Hive family 👋. Good day to you and welcome to my blog 🥰** ## In today's world money is one of the most important things that everyone needs in order to live a stress-free life. Once there is enough money in your account, you can purchase whatever you want. Name it: purchase good food, provide shelter where you can lay your head peacefully and comfortably, and get your personal needs whenever you need them and how you want them. Money makes things happen mostly in your own way and in your own favour. If you have enough money that can clear all your bills and still sustain you continuously all the days of your life, then life will be very sweet to live because you will be 100% capable of getting everything you need financially as a person. ## In the absence of money, life mostly feels difficult because there is nothing in the world that does not require money to get. Especially now that the economy is getting worse and everything that has to do with goods and services is becoming more costly, everyone needs money to take care of himself or herself, talk about family needs, think about the kids, and your personal needs as well. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcPJMAMW4KKddP9ehRf9761wkE241FYiJz6cc6w1CUcKU/IMG-20260513-WA0011.jpg You also have relatives who look up to you for help, and everything requires money to be solved. In a situation like this, the world will just be like a living hell because there are many responsibilities that need to be taken care of. And the only solution that can put an end to all of the problems is money. Sometimes the salary you earn from your job will no longer be enough to properly take care of all your needs. The very moment that happens, things will begin to turn around, and it can even mount pressure on you to begin finding more jobs that you can manage at once, all so that things can get better. All these struggles are as a result of finding a means of survival. The very moment that you start handling two or more jobs at a time, you are going to understand that everything is becoming very hard on you, and it's because we human beings are very connected to our nature by trying to overdo more than ourselves. ## The struggle of becoming financially stable mostly never comes easy anywhere because it is very difficult to create something useful and very easy to damage useful things. Money is connected so much with happiness, but the question is, does money truly bring happiness? Money contributes so much to making everything that has to do with financial needs solved. And once we don't have money to take care of ourselves, it's going to put us in a condition where smiles will totally disappear from our faces every second that passes. Lack of financial stability has pushed some people into doing what they never wanted just to get money to solve their needs. I believe there are many innocent citizens today who intentionally get into different bad acts because they have seen the bad side of life, which pressured them into criminality and other acts. But still, involving yourself in all those dirty acts can never be the best solution to happiness. And again, I don't believe that money alone can provide the full happiness that everyone needs in this life. It is true that money makes life more comfortable and peaceful, and once you have it, things will become easier for you. ## So I am leaving a conclusion that.. money has a lot to do with happiness, peace of mind, and a comfortable life because it has the possibility of helping anyone live a better life and also reducing too much stress by making stress a little less instead of stressing too much on a daily basis just to survive. And lastly, true happiness needs balance in both money and personal contentment. I believe if money and personal satisfaction were together, it would go a long way in improving happiness in everyone's life. And I believe for this to be achieved, everyone first needs to understand how our nature is in the world. > **IMAGE IS AI GENERATED** Thanks for visiting my blog 🙏 and for your continuous support 🤝 Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@youngezeblinzz/money-and-happiness-the-balance-of-life-dvx)

title.title: Aprendiendo a reconocer mis emociones y mi valor | Learning to recognize my emotions and my worth
title.body:
<center>  <div class=text-justify>

Como que no me gusta mucho celebrar el día de las Madres, no tengo un buen presedente que me haga anhelar ese día, para empezar no tengo mamá desde muy joven, no guardo recuerdos junto a ella en un día tan especial como el día de las Madres, la tía con la que me crié tampoco era tan dada a ciertas celebraciones y mucho menos a muestras de cariño así que los recuerdos que tengo de las celebraciones de esa fecha en el colegio era solo ir, ver y callar, cuando hablo de callar me refiero a que el detalle que hacíamos junto a la maestra para las Madres se quedaba guardado en una cajita, en una gaveta que luego pasaba a la basura sin que nadie lo notara, el por que no se lo entregaba a mi tía quizás por temor al rechazo, por vergüenza de expresar una emoción y no ser correspondida o simplemente por mi baja autoestima y la timidez que siempre me caracterizó. 

>I don't really like celebrating Mother's Day. I don't have a good president who makes me look forward to that day. For starters, I haven't had a mother since I was very young, so I don't have any memories with her on such a special day. The aunt I grew up with wasn't very fond of certain celebrations either, much less of showing affection. So, my memories of celebrating that day at school are just of going, seeing, and keeping quiet. When I say keeping quiet, I mean that the little gift we made with the teacher for our mothers would end up in a box, in a drawer, and then be thrown away without anyone noticing. The reason I didn't give it to my aunt was perhaps because of fear of rejection, shame at expressing an emotion and not being reciprocated, or simply because of my low self-esteem and the shyness that has always characterized me.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV1YkwkpbqFsxZh4JeMQEniu3qs74WesZ3TGQyoQdwuXw/1778692657883.jpg)

Luego de ser madre disfrute a mi manera de celebrar, de honrrarme, de regalarme, siempre compraba algo para mi no esperaba que nadie me regalara aunque mis hijos de pequeños siempre me daban obsequios hechos por ellos en la escuela y algunas veces comprados, mucho cariño, me tocó un esposo poco detallista, decía que yo no era su mamá, aunque le daba dinero a los niños para que ellos mismos me compraran algo, por supuesto ese día en mi casa siempre fue tipo normal, un domingo más sin sorpresas, yo misma cocinaba algo diferente, iba donde mi suegra y compartía un rato, así pasaron los años, me conforme con los detalles que me daban mis hijos, yo era feliz tenerlos a todos juntos en ese día, realmente no me hacia falta nada más, no conocía algo más. 

>After becoming a mother, I enjoyed celebrating in my own way, honoring myself, treating myself. I always bought something for myself; I didn't expect anyone to give me anything, although my children, when they were little, always gave me gifts they made at school and sometimes store-bought ones. It was all very loving. I had a husband who wasn't very thoughtful; he said I wasn't his mother, even though he gave the children money so they could buy me something themselves. Of course, that day at my house was always pretty normal, just another Sunday without surprises. I would cook something different myself, go to my mother-in-law's, and spend some time with her. The years passed like that. I was content with the little things my children gave me. I was happy having them all together on that day; I really didn't need anything else. I didn't know what else was needed.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb3quDd524X4AzBvtNp3QN7hU7tcYeJ96CzYRFuf3441w/1778692686564.jpg)

Hoy que me he hecho mayor empieza a pasarme factura mi conformidad, me incomodaba, me hacia sentir mal ver estados de WhatsApp con mensajes honrrando a las Madres, eso hizo darme cuenta que no soy esa mejor madre del mundo que la mayoría presume en sus redes sociales, este año nadie me dijo madre te quiero, nadie me presumió en sus estados, nadie me preguntó como estas, nadie me compró mi postre favorito, creo que mi familia ni siquiera sabe eso, comí pizza comprada por mi, no quise cocinar este día, se me cayó la máscara esa qué ocultaba y aparentaba lo que no era, el domingo pasado 10 de mayo, por fin supe ser yo con todo lo que soy quedé al descubierto ante mis ojos que soy madre pero no la mejor, sino la que aprendió a ser madre sin modelo a seguir creyendo que lo estaba haciendo bien, el tiempo, las distancias, las circunstancias me hicieron entender que no es así, no supe sembrar esa conexión emocional con mis hijos, entonces como esperaba ser honrada, sin embargo tampoco lo esperaba, no me hice espectativas y ocurrió tal cuál lo imagine, no hubo algarabías, abrazos, besos ni palabras bonitas aunque si algunos detalles que estaba lejos de cubrir la cuota emocional de una madre, pero tuve la certeza de saber quien soy para mi y para los demás, para nada me siento mal sentí esa coherencia externa e interna que me llenó de paz y libertad personal.

>Now that I'm older, my complacency is starting to take its toll. It bothered me, it made me feel bad, to see WhatsApp statuses with messages honoring mothers. It made me realize that I'm not the \
that most people boast about on social media. This year, no one told me \

no one showed me off in their statuses, no one asked me how I was, no one bought me my favorite dessert. I don't think my family even knows that. I ate pizza I bought myself; I didn't want to cook that day. The mask that hid and pretended to be something I wasn't fell away. Last Sunday, May 10th, I finally knew how to be myself, with all that I am. I was laid bare before my own eyes: I am a mother, but not the best, rather the one who learned to be a mother without a role model, believing I was doing it right. Time, distance, circumstances made me understand that it wasn't like that. I didn't know how to cultivate that emotional connection with my children, so how could I expect to be honored? However, I didn't expect it either. I didn't have any expectations, and it happened exactly as I had imagined. Imagine, there were no celebrations, hugs, kisses or kind words, although there were some details that were far from covering the emotional quota of a mother, but I had the certainty of knowing who I am for myself and for others, I don't feel bad at all, I felt that external and internal coherence that filled me with peace and personal freedom. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP1hNToNDKRTkEK3Gp5G9DxbrzYnFGpTzka9ydUbra9Kb/1778692728376.jpg)
>
_¡Gracias por leer, hasta una nueva oportunidad !_
>
Las fotografías mostradas son de mi propiedad, .
La Versión en Inglés la realicé con el Traductor de Google.
>
_Thanks for reading, until next time!_

title.title: Alabama Zack – Chapter VI
title.body:
is a 40-chapter science fiction serial, published in the Scholar and Scribe community once a week on Wednesdays. You can start the serial from the beginning by visiting the [Curated Collection.](https://peakd.com/hive-199275/@cliffagreen/alabama-zack)
Previously in our story
*Alabama Zack, our hero and a war veteran, found himself standing on a train station platform in another time and dimension. At his feet lay a man in a brown suit. The man was dead, and Zack was arrested and jailed.* *Zack can not remember how he had arrived on that platform, let alone whether or not he had anything to do with the man's death.* ***In last week's chapter,** Zack was taken to a type of court hearing, in an enormous cave, where he met with an inquisitor instead of judge. The inquisitor asked him what he was curious about. When Zack answered that he was curious about the smiling doctor on the train station platform, he was projected flying from the cave into daylight.* ![goldenhills (1280 x 40 px) (1280 x 780 px).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cliffagreen/23tvgH8He7LLrCEDBrr5bW3CuuP6Ej49B9chZd9D8zGXixdsv9vvZCKVCpicLDBPhGQ1G.png) Flying was like nothing our hero had known. His body was useless. He couldn't move at all; his arms and legs just trailed behind him as that incredible force pulled him along. The wind tore at his eyes and hair and snapped his cape; he tried instinctively to crook his arms to keep his overcoat from being ripped off, though that would have been prevented by the shackles. There was green countryside beneath him and sunshine behind his head. He seemed to be following a set of train tracks. A plume of black smoke showed a train approaching; past the smoke trail he could see some kind of structure. As the train clattered under him he realized it was the train station platform where he had been arrested. Soon he was arching down to it. He clumped down on the boards just three steps from the double row of benches, and his momentum carried him forward. He spun and sat down hard. And just like that there he was, sitting on a bench next to the doctor, looking at a dead man he was supposed to have murdered. It was too much. He moved to bury his face in his hands, but the shackles prevented him. He couldn't block it out. He really was back on the platform. He shook his head. At the top of his field of vision there was a hint of green light that wouldn't go away. “It's a tracking device, and it identifies you to the rest of us as a prisoner of the realm,” the doctor said. “You'll get used to it.” He turned to the doctor and the green light lagged behind, almost disappearing before moving back into place when he stopped. The doctor sat there with his elbows propped on the back of the bench, his fedora cocked back over an unfurrowed brow, and his jacket folded neatly beside him. His legs were crossed, right over left, in a slanting straight line. He looked like a man who knew something. Zack turned back, barely noticing the green light, as the doctor had suggested. In front of him, the train had left the station, revealing a broad dirt avenue that led to a little town. The men in blue uniforms with handlebar mustaches had multiplied in number. They had replaced the dead man with a mannequin of exact proportion and dress, and now they surrounded it in a lopsided circle, striking various poses of contemplation: some squatted with their fingers laced between their knees; others stood with their arms crossed, gazing intently; and a few stood twirling the ends of their mustaches to perfection. One man circled outside the rest, peering through the others at the mannequin. The doctor was talking. “They're going to have to bring Cork in on this case,” he said. “Although we have apparently caught the murderer, that being yourself, red-handed standing over his victim, no one has yet been able to determine how you committed it. My examination of the body revealed that there was blunt force trauma to the back of our victim's head, possibly from a pistol butt. But I've been told that you were not armed; if fact, you did not have anything on your person. So what did you hit him with? And how did you dispose of it? Our search around the platform found nothing.” Our hero said, “I did not kill him,” and he was surprised, because he still had not remembered anything. The doctor laughed shortly. “None of the murderers I've talked to ever killed anyone.” “I killed plenty,” Zack had to say. “But not this man.” The doctor looked him over. “All right,” he said, and he sat up and leveled his hat. “Let's go see Cork. I think I believe you.” *** **Next week in our story** *“Where are folks?” Zack asked.* *“They keep low whenever a prisoner comes to town,” the doctor said, and our hero looked around for the fearsome convict – before remembering it was him. They stopped in front of a narrow, two-story building with a hand-lettered sign that read “Cork McGraw: Resident P.I.”* **Chapter VII (link to come)** **[Start at the beginning](https://peakd.com/hive-199275/@cliffagreen/alabama-zack)** *** *** ![2r8F9rTBenJQfQgENfxADE6EVYabczqmSF5KeWefV5WL9WCwdLfK8wNVLEHQvZYiQREccyWxK5G2ch4CSZgaYyLkDLsrmU75s1vZ.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cliffagreen/23tbAxe9UurHqj93C1PyF6RHyMNFBdcbTNZ9aHXXBCbKxa46oDwugrXpfRaF9sW4BWAtP.gif) *** ***

title.title: Men live for the happiness of their families.
title.body:
Greetings Family is the most precious thing for a man. When a man is born, he has a lot of responsibility on his shoulders. A few days after a man is born, his responsibilities start and he starts taking responsibility for himself. After taking responsibility, a man does not get time to remember himself. The life of a man is very strange. If you are a responsible man, then you will understand the meaning of today's post. Being born as a man is not such an easy thing. As long as a man lives on earth, he has to bear responsibility. Without responsibility, one can never be a man. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ5iroPzDCc4iRpgyhiBkxKV7eky3RurGuVPCz6omKjHd/1778692039064.jpg) [Source](https://www.pexels.com/photo/joyful-family-pileup-portrait-with-smiles-35640969/) After waking up in the morning, the whole day's activities are only about the family. If a man is doing agricultural work, then he gets up early in the morning and goes to the field for his agricultural work. A man, burnt in the sun and wet in the rain, prepares the crop. The man starts the process of preparing the crop and the man collects food for his family. On the other hand, if a man is working, then his whole day's activities are only about the family. The thought of how a man can improve his life by working is always going around in the man's mind. The life of a man is very difficult. As a man grows up, his responsibilities become greater. After getting married, a man's responsibilities increase a hundredfold. Before marriage, a man only takes responsibility for his parents and siblings. But when a man gets married, he has to take care of another family. The man becomes old at the age of 20 while taking responsibility for his wife's family and children. And these words may seem quite strange to you. But this is the normal life of a man. After marriage, a man can do everything for his wife. He has to live in harmony with his wife, her family and everyone. A man is the worst when he forgets his own responsibilities. Being a man means living life with hardship. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma7K6qUsRZ4jxq7cdyhysoVFd9CXRbmY9fL2gUGQcXknA/1778692149601.jpg) [Source](https://www.pexels.com/photo/portrait-of-family-21642977/) A man lives only for the good of others. When Eid or Puja is celebrated, there is no problem even if he does not have new clothes on these days. But to keep the family happy, a man arranges new clothes for everyone in the family. But at the end of the day, a man lives in this society as the most neglected. Everyone wears new clothes on various festivals. However, no one looks for men in this society. Men are neglected is a word, where a lot of responsibilities have to be fulfilled but there is no time to take responsibility for themselves. A man has to live by working tirelessly from morning to evening, working hard in the office and winning everyone's hearts when he comes home. Being a man is not an easy thing. I have already informed you that a man becomes old in 20 years. In this world, men are neglected the most and the average life expectancy of men is only 60 years. But in some cases, men die before 60 years. Men's hair turns white at the age of 30 only due to family pressure. Tireless work, collecting food for the family without eating himself, organizing and participating in various festivals by wearing old clothes himself. Despite all this, why are we, the male race, so neglected today? At the end of the day, a man works hard thinking about his family. But when that man has to be neglected by his family, nothing can be more painful than this. Men do not live for themselves, men live to keep their family well and to keep everyone happy. At the end of the day, there are some families that give men dignity and value. But I have seen from my real life experiences that no one ever wants to value these men. Everyone seems to put pressure on the man's head and always create a mental turmoil on him. A man has to live in society and survive by winning the hearts of his mother-in-law, wife, children and parents. When will this society understand the sorrow of men? I think that one of the most neglected races in the world is men! People do not have the slightest interest in looking after them or knowing whether they are well. Men only know how to give, men do not have the ability to take.
|![Screenshot_20260306_110201_Brave.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTo6AtBjfVhy6Ve7tAGM9WizHiq9iYqNGwBgtk8dTJ18p/Screenshot_20260306_110201_Brave.jpg)|![Screenshot_20260306_110157_Brave.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmazhDtN5NBtVSfu3HSX2yV9JniVEVZx1o7v7GaVLTFL8y/Screenshot_20260306_110157_Brave.jpg)| |---|--| |[WITNESS SUPPORT](https://hivebuzz.me/@bestrakibul2)| [8 YEARS oF EXPERIENCE ](https://hivebuzz.me/@bestrakibul2)| ### WARM REGARDS ![Red and White Minimalist Furniture Business Card_20251226_125732_0000.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfAjsFDxHffvZ2Vv5BcjZLpB3PoLmCuYxfzz79kRCJFvf/Red%20and%20White%20Minimalist%20Furniture%20Business%20Card_20251226_125732_0000.png) ### ***@bestrakibul2***

title.title: Should kids be paid allowance
title.body:
Giving children an allowance is one thing I am trying to balance. I keep asking myself what the reason is for giving them an allowance since the child is living under their parent's care and they provide everything for them. I am of the opinion that since parents clothe them, feed them, pay their school fees and give them a comfortable life, there is no need of paying this kid’s allowance. I have this uncle of mine that always gives their kids allowance at the end of every month. He pays them their monthly allowance one day. I asked him why he places the kids on monthly allowance because he provides everything for the kids. His answer was he sees that allowance as a valuable way to teach them responsibility and how to manage finances at an early stage. In a way, I see reason why it is not totally bad to give them allowance. At the end of every year these kids will break their saving box, and they will be able to save up enough money. With this foundation, they will manage their finances very well in the future.



In the world we are into, kids are exposed to money; for instance, snacks at school. It is not totally bad to place these kids on a monthly allowance; it will help them to have a clearer understanding of how to manage money in real life and how money works. They will understand that money should be built; that is why choices matter. They will get to understand the importance of saving and investing.


![IMG_0973.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cindynancy/48QuNno5onErioG1VAxd8iVzjKJm7SEmnSVELuXEUCqYeWAzQGtmRHNboDVQhhyzQg.png)


Before now I didn't pay the idea of giving kids allowance, but after living with my uncle I get to understand that there are many ways to teach kids. My little niece and nephew learn the importance of budgeting and planning. At the end of every year, their dad buys shares for them from the money they were able to save. Must time be amazing of how determined these kids are? They don’t spend their money unnecessarily; before bathing, they will always think before spending. Giving them an allowance will help them to learn financial discipline early, and when they are adults, they don’t need to struggle with how to manage their money.



When these kids are given allowance, they don’t need to ask their parents for money over everything, which is at an early stage; they learn to be independent. Which will help them when they are adults with a small amount of money; they will be able to manage, and they will be able to survive without depending on anyone. At this stage parents need to guide them to save, plan and spend wisely.



Just like my uncle, he was giving them allowance with purpose; he never gave them unlimited money without structure. I have to learn from my uncle, kids. He bought them three boxes: one for spending, one for saving and the other one for generosity. It has really helped these kids many times I go to them for financial advice.





![IMG_0974.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cindynancy/48PTGviQTrZHFJwPh1yrZm3PutTj6gz85UDeHnYtrciMLTixJvfUVPnaMKwFtZ1oFo.png)



There are some parents that link allowance to chores, and that is amazing; it helps to teach the kids that money is earned through hard work and effort. It helps the kids to understand both responsibility and earning. The most important thing is the value attached to the money, not the amount itself.





It is not about giving them the allowance as a parent, but balancing and guiding them matters.


***All image are generated with AI***





Thank you for stopping by my blog. I appreciate your comments, support and upvotes. Do have a lovely day.

title.title: Are the Magnificent 7 Overvalued? Signs of Fatigue and the Looming Risk of a Sharp Correction
title.body:
— Apple, Microsoft, Nvidia, Amazon, Alphabet (Google), Meta, and Tesla — have been the undisputed drivers of the U.S. stock market for years. Their collective dominance, fueled by the AI boom, cloud computing, and digital transformation, pushed their combined market capitalization to peaks around $22 trillion by late 2025, representing roughly 34-36% of the S&P 500.

As of mid-2026, however, cracks are appearing. The group has largely underperformed the broader S&P 500 year-to-date, with the equal-weighted Magnificent Seven ETF (MAGS) showing minimal gains compared to the index. This shift raises a critical question: Are these tech giants significantly overvalued, and when might a major correction arrive?

### Elevated Valuations Amid Slowing Momentum

The Magnificent 7 trade at a premium to the broader market. The group's forward P/E ratio hovers around 36x, well above the S&P 500's approximately 26x. Individual valuations vary: Meta and Amazon appear relatively more attractive on cash flow and earnings multiples, while Tesla stands out with an extremely high multiple unsupported by near-term growth in EV demand. Nvidia, the AI poster child, commands a premium but faces questions about sustained hyperscaler spending.

High valuations leave little room for error. Many of these companies have delivered exceptional earnings growth, particularly in AI-related segments, but investor expectations are sky-high. Capital expenditure plans for major players like Microsoft, Google, Amazon, and Meta are projected to exceed $650 billion in 2026 — a massive increase that could pressure margins if returns on that AI infrastructure disappoint.

Market concentration adds another layer of risk. With the Mag 7 still comprising over 33% of the S&P 500, any synchronized pullback in these names can drag the entire index lower, even if the remaining 493 companies perform reasonably well.

### Signs of a Rotation and Fatigue

2026 has seen a notable rotation out of the Mag 7 into \

tech names and other sectors. This isn't surprising after years of outsized gains. Several Mag 7 stocks are down double digits from their 52-week highs, and sentiment has cooled as questions mount over the pace of AI monetization and adoption.

Broader market indicators, such as the Shiller CAPE ratio for the S&P 500 nearing historic highs (around 40), echo levels last seen before major corrections like the dot-com bust — though fundamental differences exist today, including stronger profits from these tech leaders compared to many dot-com era companies.

### When Could the Big Fall Come?

Predicting exact timing is impossible, but several catalysts could trigger a significant correction:

- **Disappointing AI Returns**: If heavy capex fails to translate into proportional revenue and profit growth, investor confidence could evaporate quickly.
- **Interest Rate or Economic Pressures**: Persistent or rising rates would pressure growth stock valuations by increasing the discount rate on future earnings.
- **Regulatory or Geopolitical Risks**: Antitrust scrutiny, trade tensions, or energy constraints on data centers could weigh on the sector.
- **Earnings Misses**: With valuations stretched, even slight shortfalls in quarterly results from key players like Nvidia or Microsoft could spark a broad sell-off.

Analysts and economists have flagged 2026 as a potential year for an AI-related pullback or broader market correction of 20% or more, driven by these dynamics. While not everyone agrees a full \

is imminent — some view current levels as justified by transformative technology — the risk of a sharp de-rating is elevated.

### A Balanced Perspective

Not all Mag 7 stocks are created equal. Companies like Meta (with strong advertising and AI efficiency) or Microsoft (cloud and enterprise stability) may prove more resilient. Others, particularly those most exposed to speculative AI hype or cyclical demand (e.g., Tesla, Nvidia in certain scenarios), carry higher downside risk.

The Mag 7 aren't going away — their competitive moats, cash flows, and innovation pipelines remain formidable. However, their era of effortless outperformance may be maturing. Investors heavily concentrated in these names should consider diversification, as market history shows that extreme concentration rarely ends without volatility.

In summary, yes, parts of the Magnificent 7 appear overvalued relative to realistic growth scenarios and broader market multiples. A \

may not be inevitable in the immediate term, but the setup for a meaningful correction — potentially 20-30% or more for the group — is in place if earnings momentum falters. Prudent investors would do well to prepare rather than assume endless upward momentum.

title.title: Gold price increases after our PM advices people not to buy for a year
title.body:
In the last few days this has been the hottest news where our Prime Minister Narendra Modi Ji has advised people a few things. Recently the value of our Indian currency reached a all time high value against dollars in the global markets. This means that we are doing a lot of imports compared to exports and the cost of living is getting higher in India. If the currency value against dollars is increasing, it is a good sign but the value of Rupee is decreasing and this is a bit of a concern.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeN3anfhUFWTDgSW5TW1pYX7DB6WicBHC42KX5yjwt6uY/pasted_1778692728038.png)

Source - Gemini 


Out of some of the advices given by the Prime Minister, not buying gold for one year is also one among that. We have been paying a lot of import duty to bring Gold into India. If people stop buying gold. They will reduce the demand and the money going out as import duty will also reduce. This is a good thing because the value of Gold will also reduce and it can become affordable for people. But I personally doubt that the value would considerably reduce again because so far we have only seen upper trend for gold and other top commodities. Value of Rupee is also another contributing factor though. 

But one thing that is very strange is that the value is increasing even further after Modi Ji announces that people should refrain from buying gold. It looks like only now people are buying more gold. Apart from gold, the PM has also asked people to use public transport more compared to own vehicles. The intention behind this is to reduce the consumption of fuels that again we are importing from other countries. The alternative for the petrol consumption can be the use of electric vehicles. This can be a great choice. If public transportation is very good then I think people might consider using public transportation. 

I currently don't have any plans to buy gold and the price is also not very attractive right now to buy anyways. Maybe in the future if at all the price goes down people might buy it again. I think the reason we have not made any lab made gold yet is also another reason why we have this demand as high. Similar to diamonds if there is a lab made gold available in the market, then gold might lose its value but that's not realistic at least now.

>



### Saludos hivers.



Hoy entrevistamos a @robotgirl2024, una chica soñadora que ha dejado su huella en el mundo literario, sus poesías han sido fuente de motivación y agrado para muchos hivers. Ella nos contará sobre sus inicios en Hive, sus éxitos y desventuras. 

Uno de sus logros es ser moderadora de la comunidad *Voto Venezuela*, acá desempeñó un rol muy importante que ha marcado un antes y un después en su vida dentro de la plataforma. Leamos con atención sus respuestas, seguro encontraremos algunos consejos que nos serán de mucha utilidad. 



![1000430252.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hispapro/23wWrbHAoKcbMS8QeiixXxcdk8Mn7uxQYWotwF5hP52EaPH49a9HmunBgRx5cyfESZqKt.jpg)





# <center> Hiver: @robotgirl2024</center>



### 1. Cuéntanos un poco de ti. ¿Quién eres fuera de la pantalla de Hive? (Profesión, hobbies, de dónde eres, etc.)

*\

Mi mayor cosa con la plataforma es haber asistido a eventos grandes, en los cuales he sido un poco reservada. Y ver que todos compartimos la misma visión, la gran experiencia, como también ha sido ser moderadora de Voto Venezuela, ayudante y suplente*

### 7. ¿Qué fue lo más difícil de aprender en tus inicios?

*Lo más difícil siempre han sido las etiquetas, hasta el sol de hoy todavía, y el maquetado, aunque eso ya lo domino. También ha sido difícil encontrar comunidades que se adapten a ti, en la cual tú debes adaptarte a las comunidades.*

### 8. ¿Cómo describirías tu visión a futuro dentro del ecosistema de Hive?

*Son muchos los altibajos, como muy pocos los altos. Muchas veces he decidido más bien dejar la plataforma; sin embargo, estamos aquí para hacer de nuestras habilidades algo productivo y verlo trabajar. Entonces, realmente espero que todo sea para bien y no para mal.*

### 9. ¿Qué consejo le darías a un hiver que apenas está comenzando?
*Que no vea Hive como un recurso económico.*
*Que tenga constancia pero sobre todo que haga las cosas con amor y paciencia.*
*Que no se límite a encontrar su lugar.*

### 10. Si quieres explicarle Hive a un familiar o amigo, para que se una a la plataforma, ¿qué le dirías para convencerlo?

*Conchale para mi Hive es mi libro abierto y la verdad no invito a nadie 😂.*

*Es como dejarlo leer mi diario...*
*Pero si tocara tiene que saber que si tiene una meta clara la constancia te ayudará.*


### 11. Para finalizar, ¿Has tenido alguna experiencia directa con Hispapro? Si es así, ¿qué tal ha sido?

*Mi experiencia directa con Hispapro fue ser su participante fiel en las curaciones desde 2021, donde ni celular tenía para escuchar y aún así me dejaron.*

Queremos conocer sus opiniones, si tienen otra pregunta en mente pueden dejarla en la caja de los comentarios. Estaremos atentos a sus sugerencias.

body.body: The old farmer threw seeds over the dark soil. His grandson walked behind him carrying a wooden bucket that was as big as him.\n\n\

The old man smiled a little and slowed down.

\

he asked.

The farmer bent down. Put a seed in the ground.

\

The wind blew gently through the fields around them.

\

The boy looked out at all the rows of soil that lead towards horizen.

The farmer laughed.

\

For a while, both remained silent. Then the old man threw some seeds into the ground.

\

he said.

The boy watched as the small seeds disappeared into the soil. How something so small could someday turn into a whole forest.

The farmer recognized that look. It's the same one he had when he was a kid.

description.title: Introducing HivePro DEX | First-Ever Native Crosschain HIVE Swaps
description.body:
![image](https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRmA9WYgtPia3xRoSdaiRa3Pdznrxuxbc54TVQ8rCdqoX/image.png)

HIVE Just Became a Multichain Asset. It's been a long time coming but we have finally achieved native onchain HIVE Swaps. No compromises. Instant settlement.

**HivePro DEX is live in open beta -> https://dex.hivepro.ai.**

For the entire history of this chain, getting native HIVE to anywhere useful meant a multi-hop waltz. 

Bridge somewhere or bow down to a CEX. Hope your money shows up. Meanwhile, hope the CEX doesn't Delist HIVE or KYC in a jurisdiction you don't have access to. 


That entire dance is now one screen. You got to a single page and swap HIVE or SWAP.HIVE directly into BTC, ETH, USDT on Ethereum, or USDC on Arbitrum. You can do the inverse just as easily — send USDC on Arbitrum, receive native HIVE in your Hive account.

Signed by your own keys. Delivered to your own address. No exchange account. No account signups. No custody handoff at the destination.

**Important Note**: While in Open Beta, we will slowly scale up the available capacity (how large you can swap). The minimum swap is ~$10 driven by the underlying DEX Protocols (1INCH, Maya Protocol, etc.). The Max capacity is driven by **us**. As we see swaps performing well, we will regularly scale up the capacity. More swaps = more capacity as well. 

We urge you to trade small at first based on these capacities and allow us to continue to scale up. The team has been testing both on local and on production. Things are working incredibly well and we are ready for your feedback!


## What's Actually Different Here

![image](https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZuhakRPvH5joaC3kW2yNi4YRm58L5qcfja7kdPtgWWCB/image.png)

There have been Hive swap interfaces before. None have done this.

When you buy/sell HIVE on HivePro DEX, your assets are read onchain and instantly settle on crosschain. 

The actual route of a swap is Your Wallet -> HIVE -> SWAP.HIVE -> LEO -> Arbitrum LEO -> DEX Swap to BTC/ETH/USDC/USDT -> Your Wallet.

The critical part: all of this happens in the background. The moment you hit swap, your assets are detected onchain and HivePro DEX routes your swap on the crosschain protocols that are supported. This is made possible through our [LeoKit](https://leokit.dev) integration which plugs us into 107+ DEX Protocols.  

All fees inclusive of Gas, Slippage, Protocol Swap Fees, etc. are all included in the swap estimate. So when you see an estimated output, you see everything. 

This is a **REAL** L1 HIVE Swap. You go straight from your wallet's HIVE to USDC (or one of the other crosschain assets) back into your own wallet. You set the destination address (Arbitrum, Bitcoin, etc.) and receive on that chain immediately. 

![image](https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSuXVEEn3vZmCBT1F14z6gqHqh35FfoVEmqG2CTPZaT4h/image.png)

That's the first time a cross-chain stablecoin → native L1 HIVE route has existed as a single product flow. Anywhere.

## How Fast It Settles

The fastest route — USDC on Arbitrum into native HIVE — typically lands in **under a minute** from the moment your Arbitrum deposit clears six confirmations. The longer routes, anything going out to Bitcoin, Ethereum, or USDT, go through Maya Protocol's cross-chain rails and complete in seconds to minutes depending on the destination chain.

![image](https://img.leopedia.io/DQmaGA9FseryzW1dZ3kq9qvh9uNNFVZSoeNiTQZ169rVkzP/image.png)

Every order has a **live four-step tracker**. Deposit detected → exchanging → sending to your wallet → done. Close the tab. Come back. The state lives on the server, not on a flag in your browser.

## This Is a Beta. Capacity Is Real

**Capacity is limited**, and you'll feel it in these early days. The more that Hive Pro DEX gets utilized, the greater the capacity for larger swaps will grow. Continue to utilize it and you'll see capacity scale in real-time. 

With this Open Beta, we are scaling up every time a swap completes. 

As volume rises, the caps rise as well. 

Smaller now. Bigger later. That's the deal!

## The Feedback Loop

![image](https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYqMz21SptofbFaNLk15p8YH9xcXpn3a6GCgqETmRHKCU/image.png)

In the bottom-right corner of the page there's a small **question-mark icon**. That's the feedback widget. It's not a generic support chat. It's wired directly into our engineering loop — every submission opens a labeled GitHub issue in our repo and pings our Discord at the same time. Stuck on a swap? Refund taking longer than expected? Token you want added? Click the icon. We see it within seconds.

If you want to help this thing scale faster, the cheat code is to bring people in. **Word of mouth grows volume**. Volume grows the treasury. The treasury raises the cap.

## Try It

Go to **https://dex.hivepro.ai**. Connect Keychain. Run a small swap. Tell us what broke. Tell us what felt good.

This is the move I've wanted to make on Hive for years. It's live now. It's yours.

The process is super simple and seamless. It supports **ALL HIVE WALLETS** and also supports Metamask, Keplr, Brave Browser + Keystore (with more EVM wallets + BTC Wallets coming soon).

description.title: Sowing And Reaping While On Hive: India United Contest
description.body:
Greetings to dear hiveans and dearest friends of indiaunited community 😀🥰.

“How would you convict someone to start their hive journey?” This is the Theme for this week’s contest question. And I see this question as one that is interesting because convincing people to do something in life usually takes lots of tactics especially for a place like hive where one needs to work hard 😓.

I see hive as a platform that needs commitment if you truly come here to stay and not just wanting to breeze in and then out in a short term goal because joining hive platform is a journey that is based on working hard from the starting point and hoping to reap as the month or years progresses.

My hive journey was made possible by my daughter @chelkoby who started hive through playing Splinterland because she loves games. And as begin to process and earn on hive, she talked me into joining hive which I never saw as something possible because I never knew then that hive comprises of many communities apart from Splinterland and Rising Star ⭐️ where @chelkoby was focused then.

So when I finally made up my mind to join hive, she told me there are other communities where I can write ✍️. This caught my attention since I love ❤️ to write as a hobby. And to be honest, it was hard initially through some months before I stated even earning little by little. But I was not discouraged by this because then I have seen other hiveans who were earning more. So I just told myself that I have come to stay here on hive and will only need to put in my best to grow like others.

# If I Have To Convince Someone?

The first thing I will need to do is letting the person to know how different Hive platform is. A platform that is different from other platforms because its decentralized. Hive is the only social media platform you can present any kind of content as far as it is your original work. You can comment freely here on hive and share your own personal opinions on issues.

Earn on hive is one big opportunity the person have to know about. But here I will make the person to understand how it works. Joining hive needs lots of motivation when it comes to earning, because you don’t expect upvote on every of your post. This is very crucial when convincing anyone to join Hive due to how many onboarded individuals has left hive because they saw that they are not being upvoted. You need to be very patience here on hive if you need to grow because a suitable “slogan” for hive should be “SLOW AND STEADY”.

With constant creativity and originality, your work on hive begin to be noticed which will help you earn rewards. But many are not patience enough because they need the immediate earning means to sustain. So its better the person is aware of how earning works here.

One big opponent here on hive too is the right one has to join any community of your choice. And as far as you keep to the rules of the communities where you are a member, you will definitely began to grow because hive is like a “Farm” where you sow during sowing time and reap when the harvest has matured. You can choose join communities for writing ✍️ prompts, contest and stories . And at the same time join gastronomy communities like Foodiesbeehive, Hivefood plantpowervegan or Creativecuisine. if you love cooking 🥘. And Amazingdrinks for healthy homemade drinks 🍹 

If I have to convince someone to join hive, I will also use myself as an example. I will take the person through my page to see how far I have come on hive. I will first let the person know how long I have been here, the years I have spent, the hard work 😓 through writing ✍️ in my favorite communities and my cooking efforts in the gastronomic communities. I mean, this very aspect of proof needs to totally convince the person if she or him wants to be convinced because the popular saying is “seeing is believing”

However, in all, you need to be very active if you want to grow on hive. You must be very interactive with your communities, comment regularly and constantly reblog contents, post, because this activity is very essential here on hive if you want to grow or be noticed. Community interaction is basic to enable prove truly that you are a member. And it is only when you have accepted hive as your place that your mind con be committed to be doing all these. Hive is a journey with patience.

This is my entry into the indiaunited contest. Join #here 

# Thank you for reading friends 🥰.

# Best Regards @sunshine29 🧡

There are moments that feel like a reward after so many busy days. Standing in the ocean, feeling the calm water and the sun on my skin, I remembered that life does not have to be perfect to be beautiful.

I work, I take care of my responsibilities, and I keep moving forward for my daughter and for myself. Some days are harder than others, but I also know that every effort is building something better little by little.

My dream is not only to look good in a photo, but to create a life with more freedom, more peace, and more control over my time. I want to keep learning, keep growing, and one day live from the decisions I am making today.

For now, I enjoy this little piece of paradise and take it as a reminder: the future I want is possible, as long as I do not stop believing in it. 🐚✨

description.title: Segundo llamado Concurso “Somos también fábula”
description.body: Reciban nuestros saludos, amigos de #Literatos y usuarios hispanohablantes de #Hive. Este es el segundo llamado del concurso literario titulado [\

](https://peakd.com/hive-179291/@es-literatos/concurso-somos-tambien-fabula), que se anunció hace ya una semana, y con el que queremos recordarte que todavía estás a tiempo de participar. Tal como se expresó en ese primer post, la idea es que escribas una fábula, en forma de prosa o verso, en la que se trate el horror de la guerra o/y la destrucción de la naturaleza. Recordemos que una fábula es una composición literaria breve, en donde los protagonistas son animales, vegetales o cosas inanimadas, los cuales actúan como seres humanos, y en donde se presenta una historia, generalmente con un propósito de carácter ético y universal, que concluye con una moraleja. En esta ocasión, pedimos que la moraleja no se incluya en el relato.
![Fábula La destrucción de la naturaleza.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nancybriti1/243BieiA1mtSN9NwDBCeMQjiCuGv4QVVmkeojkQeoeezSpRWmshq9NgzgTDHuez44v8i4.png)
Imagen creada en Canva

Bases del concurso

1. La comunidad #Literatos convoca al concurso \

. 2. Se participará con una fábula de una extensión mínima de 150 palabras y una máxima de 300, escrita en verso o en prosa. 3. La fábula debe ser, como es propio del género, una anécdota cuyos protagonistas pueden ser animales, vegetales o seres inanimados, y deberá versar acerca de la destrucción de la naturaleza y/o el horror de la guerra. 4. Debe estar escrita en español. 5. Solo se aceptará una entrada por participante. 6. El texto debe ser inédito, de creación propia, no presentado en otro concurso. 7. Se tomará en cuenta, de modo prioritario, la creatividad, calidad literaria y el tratamiento del tema, así como el uso gramatical apropiado, tanto en ortografía como en redacción. 8. La recepción se abre a partir de la publicación de estas bases y cerrará el 21 de mayo a las 12:00 de la noche, hora de Venezuela. El veredicto será anunciado durante la semana siguiente al vencimiento del plazo para concursar. 9. Se entregará un primer premio de 25 hives y un segundo de 15 hives. 10. El participante deberá colocar su presentación de la siguiente manera: Entrada al Concurso \

| Título del texto. 11. Las participaciones deben ser publicadas en la comunidad #Literatos (hive-179291), y colocarse el enlace en el servidor de Discord de La-Colmena (https://discord.gg/SYwngna ), canal #concursos-literatos. 12. Asimismo, se solicita que el post donde aparecen estas bases sea votado y reblogueado por el participante. 13. El jurado estará integrado por tres miembros del equipo de Literatos. 14. Lo no establecido en estas bases será resuelto por el equipo de Literatos. 15. El incumplimiento de alguna de estas bases podrá descalificar al participante.
Nota: Se recomienda a los participantes, a fin de evitar, en lo posible, errores gramaticales en general, hacer uso de la aplicación https://quillbot.com/es/corrector-ortografico, que pueden descargar en su dispositivo.
![Diseño sin título (22).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nancybriti1/23tvkfbB1VKYyoaUNkNQnFjtCJQ31RfFLbmp8U3FmoieTndnomWjeqXaqk7YBmXT1Kcb1.png)
