description.title: Warum Eigenverantwortung der wahre Schlüssel zur Freiheit ist ✌️Ownership: The Real Key to Freedom [GER/ENG]
description.body:
![IMG_5802.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/2432QQJofWLKUCmK63wgoMTbyAgDfNRcbx6NL4d54UMNnbkp51L5JhFHfWhqvScycozCM.jpeg)



![IMG_5749.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23xpAuxdaBm9dcqNtgM8ePL7Ls9s4BuxdFjorc1E6mi5U6WMZe8eFDY3SBL8Pjd2PcS6R.jpeg)








Es sind Momente wie diese, in denen ich in Dankbarkeit verfalle und gerne über mein Leben philosophiere. Ich bin erfüllt von Dankbarkeit und Lebensenergie, denn es ist alles andere als selbstverständlich, das hier erleben zu dürfen. Aktuell bin ich in der Casa Irene, einem Reitstall wie aus dem Bilderbuch. Hier laufen die Pferde frei herum und werden gehegt und gepflegt. Meine beste Freundin hat hier Reitunterricht und ich muss sagen: Das Dressurreiten macht sie wirklich gut!


![IMG_5886.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23xAVtfsgdYaq3p2pBTPUMtzfrpZARLBrfBSPWtnpWS6j5k9F7JjV2e86uXohEdjYS3L5.jpeg)

![IMG_5848.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/241ZhnXeJJzvtLwz8jRit1fdq6xEVaL3sVkRNyv3WgqC2zqbrYRYHDYXU73djhgNJWrY3.jpeg)


Niemals hätte ich gedacht, dass ich mit all dem Support hier und da so etwas jemals erleben darf. Aber Moment – richtig verstehen: Diesen Moment kann im Grunde jeder erleben. Man muss „nur“ ins Flugzeug steigen, nach Chiclana de la Frontera fahren und den Sonnenuntergang hier im Nationalpark genießen. Oder einfach mal an diesen Ort kommen, der sich wie das Paradies anfühlt, und abschalten. Ich liebe das, und das sind auch die Augenblicke, in denen ich gerne blogge. Es ist mir bewusst, dass viele Menschen das aufgrund von Geldmangel oder Verpflichtungen nicht können: einfach spontan verreisen.


![IMG_5804.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23y8usGD6dLsJU5jgy2pxpFMdYqPE1fkHqaozBgoS6UjxG6XncfXe4u96pDeg39G1E1NB.jpeg)



Es ist unglaublich, und um ehrlich zu sein, ist es diese Dankbarkeit und die Lebensfreude – der Moment im Moment. Eigentlich wäre es sinnvoll, einfach mal komplett abzuschalten. Doch immer wenn ich glaube, ich könne mal in Ruhe chillen, passiert wieder etwas Unerwartetes in meinem Leben, mit dem ich mich beschäftigen darf.


![IMG_5711.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/246G2ZCCdgMAC5FvaeroJc4dwTjnhJCqprrZ5QC1oVDxDPwdQLw7oAqgcDsk88F4vuAtP.jpeg)




Genau aus diesem Anlass sind neulich ein paar Videos entstanden, und ich will gewisse Worte unbedingt nochmals loswerden. Das, was ich hier mache, worüber ich blogge und schreibe, sind Wege, die ich gehe, Erlebnisse, die ich haben darf – meine „Learnings“ im Leben. Es ist definitiv keine Empfehlung oder gar irgendein Gewinnversprechen, gerade im Online-Business oder auf HIVE. Ja, ich nehme online ganz passiv Geld mit. Ja, ich verdiene damit mittlerweile „gutes“ Geld, und das Leben wird dadurch entspannter. Jedoch würde ich niemals jemandem ungefragt dazu raten oder gar Garantien abgeben.


![IMG_5838.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23s9Xn3cmybCpYEJNKtjF8TVTtRYRfNmFPY2jjtzBFRZ39RcWGCz9PKp7ZLDRwokGwkGp.jpeg)


Wenn du Geld irgendwo parkst oder investierst – ganz gleich ob offline oder online – kann es immer auch einmal weg sein. Das gilt überall, auch im Kryptospace und auf HIVE. Das zu wissen, ist essenziell. Investments haben ihr Risiko. Meist braucht es neue Kunden, Investoren oder Menschen, die die Geschichten weiterzählen, damit ein Projekt wachsen oder sich nach Rückschlägen wieder erholen kann. Ich würde HIVE nicht als Scam bezeichnen, aber klar ist: Wer bei 3 Dollar oder 65 Cent investiert hat, hat bisher viel Geld verloren.

Deswegen: Übernimm bei jeder deiner Entscheidungen im Leben die Eigenverantwortung und trage die Konsequenzen. Kein Mensch hat mich gezwungen, hier zu investieren oder zu bloggen. Dennoch mache ich es, habe auch Geld verloren und bin immer noch hier. Verstehst du, was ich meine?



![IMG_5766.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23wgHUNoHeJquUyry8Th7UTMQGFTcWCsXjKpo1Quet9kkHn6sinjB5pW7ib8HBZU4fiR1.jpeg)



Die Eigenverantwortung im Leben zu übernehmen, war für mich ein großes „Learning“, und es bleibt enorm wichtig. Tja, auch ich bin schon auf Betrüger reingefallen, und die haben ihren Job leider echt gut gemacht...

Ich will jetzt nicht ins Detail gehen, aber es ging um ... ;-) Dennoch lebe ich noch, schaue nach vorne und bin dankbar für jeden schmerzfreien Tag im Leben. Solche „Bloggerspaces“ und Orte, wo man übrigens auch ein Appartement mieten kann, sind dann noch die perfekte Draufgabe.


![IMG_5849.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/241ZdCMamf3Rjsw3wmFxedsbpCJPqKngBd653QZmcyRBE88nYZXepdQjCDd9AcDzWdm8F.jpeg)



Genau aus diesen Gründen sind Videos entstanden, die ich demnächst online stelle. Ich will zukünftig gar nicht mehr mit jedem zusammenarbeiten. Ich will mit Menschen arbeiten, die:

* **a)** verstehen, was ich tue,
* **b)** andere Menschen nicht schlechtmachen, nur um sich selbst als Superstars darzustellen, und
* **c)** die Risiken verstehen und aus Eigenverantwortung Geld in die Hand nehmen.

In diesem Video erkläre ich nochmals kurz, was ich mache:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YesQwUPzM9M

Letztendlich gibt es kein „Schnell-werde-reich-System“. Natürlich gibt es immer wieder Rückschläge. Jeder Unternehmer wird mir das bestätigen. Genauso ist es hier auf HIVE. Wir alle können als Community dafür sorgen, neue Menschen onzuboarden, nach vorne zu schauen und in HIVE zu investieren: nämlich Zeit, Erfahrungen und womöglich auch Geld.



![IMG_5246.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23ywyvSuxiESJM9ewUmT9E7bR9QVjNc1fpsGpFmHedidioX9Ax4bBYnm3sdYDR3HSmiGS.jpeg)

![IMG_5647.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23x1BF64zuVsz7sM4xzSuwwaB4f8EQjUPp132rLpsH1ha4znRvgTKxVPTaXGjb4pUh2zQ.jpeg)


Die #HOD (Hive Open Days) waren der Hammer! Ich freue mich auf weitere Aktivitäten und auf das nächste Meetup in Wien. Oft sind es die kleinen Schritte, die langfristig den Erfolg bringen. Beim #wienerhivestammtisch und dem #hivemeetupvienna gehen wir genau auf diese Punkte ein.

Federführend sind hier @stayoutoftherz und @pantha.rhei, inklusive dem HIVE-Guru @thermoplastic mit seinen über 80 Jahren. Immer wieder gibt es Besuche von @vikisecrets, @cpufronz und vielen anderen... mal mehr, mal weniger. Mal kommen Gäste aus Graz, aus Prag und so weiter.


![IMG_5910.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23zGafZndBSgwLujCfcNoY7mPGDh5HtKUvYiSF9oah7JgKHJ5hSZZV9htpYuRr3QTV5Zu.jpeg)




Es sind diese Momente der Dankbarkeit an solchen Orten, an denen ich in mich gehe und einfach nur das Leben feiere. Mit allen Höhen und Tiefen. Das Weitermachen und der Blick nach vorne – genau das hat mir am Ende den Erfolg gebracht.

Grüße aus Chiclana del Fontera
@schmidi 

# Englisch


## Moments of Gratitude and Real Talk

![IMG_5751.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23xejeBFRUArbsp7ZcSFgLNRmmvT3dLw4qBUCknkdGVM8jb4xHwpuJfGygYs9PfjptfAj.jpeg)


![IMG_5807.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23zS5gKMk8DRSKhgyGkbMwn5ZjazWQ6pmmnf9R3zyZrQaExHn7R1DLSaU5gRo6GrfzP61.jpeg)



![IMG_5797.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/242NmLSejd8J5Z6TKGMNnxnJe9YGtKGA8m1cKPhoC9uLMk4WhEC6PVfzM5H8hvMohSm2Y.jpeg)




It is moments like these where I fall into a state of deep gratitude and find myself philosophizing about life. I am filled with thankfulness and life energy, because it is anything but a given to be able to experience this. Currently, I am staying at Casa Irene—a riding stable straight out of a storybook. Horses roam freely here, cherished and well-cared for. My best friend is taking riding lessons here, and honestly, she’s doing a great job with the dressage.

![IMG_5778.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23ynQansru2192S7rA432Hfi7AUESTEfbu6e2NsrvRijG3Ax55VUfHuXi625a5qeTouE7.jpeg)

I never would have imagined that, with all the support from here and there, I would ever be allowed to experience something like this. But wait—let’s be clear: anyone can experience a moment like this. You just have to hop on a plane, head to Chiclana de la Frontera, and enjoy the sunset here in the national park. Or simply find your way to paradise and switch off. I love it, and these are the moments where I love to blog and keep the story going. I am mindful of the fact that many people, due to financial constraints or obligations, cannot do this: travel somewhere spontaneously.


![IMG_5852.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23qrJ339np1WDkqjLHBD6cVwmMXsWyf2cwhLpiC6HJukZchM4zsXa9ZsowTDd8SEipxSw.jpeg)




It’s incredible, and to be honest, it’s all about the gratitude, the joy of living, and being \

Actually, it would make sense to just completely unplug. But every time I think I can finally just chill, something unexpected happens in my life that requires my attention.

![IMG_5851.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/2466eK16wS2276256U6NqDnxZ7Ru1ZVt9ZZGMYCqYBk4z74vvaDvTzUL2KwqDa31ixtJw.jpeg)

Exactly for this reason, I recently recorded a few videos, and there are certain words I desperately need to get off my chest. What I do here—what I blog and write about—are the paths I walk, the experiences I am fortunate to have, and my \
in life. It is definitively **not** a recommendation or any kind of profit guarantee, especially regarding online business and HIVE. Yes, I generate money online quite passively. Yes, I am earning \

money with it by now, and life has become more relaxed because of it. However, I would never advise anyone to do exactly as I do, let alone offer guarantees.


![IMG_5834.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/245n3YMdfrWSjB1WnFBQ2HnDdQsc2GSA2s59UnhaGQWTXMCmjipn2CWjAA8Yxgi5LJL7J.jpeg)



If you park or invest money anywhere—whether offline or online—it can always be gone. No matter where you put it. That includes HIVE! It applies everywhere in the crypto space, and that is vital to understand. Investments carry risk. Usually, you need new customers, investors, or people to keep telling the story for a project to grow or recover. I wouldn't necessarily call HIVE a scam, but it’s clear that those who invested at $3 or $0.65 have lost a lot of money so far.



![IMG_5707.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/241ZhNQ7Z1ok8v9SxAYqFM3op1S8bTc5Ts7EqGWMwsEaCEYSTrjrTQmSwWa3ftVMkx5M7.jpeg)




That’s why you must take personal responsibility for every decision in your life and accept the consequences. No one forced me to invest or blog here. Yet, I do it; I’ve lost money, and I’m still here. Do you understand what I mean?



![IMG_5745.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23xpAdT5W4UZ1C8p9L7hTYofjQsn7TV9FyXGdHjgSX8bEpCUUCcfAvcNhiJQCEWLGf2xY.jpeg)




Taking ownership of my life was a massive \
for me, and yet it is so important. Well, I’ve fallen for \

too, and they did a really good job of it...\n\nI don’t want to go into detail now, but we’re talking about thousands of Euros. And yet, I’m still here, looking forward, and I’m grateful for every pain-free day in my life. Having \

and places like this—where you can also rent an apartment, by the way—is just the perfect cherry on top.

For all these reasons, I’ve created a few videos that I’ll be posting soon. In the future, I don’t want to work with just anyone. I want to work with people who:

* **a)** understand what I am doing,
* **b)** don’t put others down just to claim they are the \

and
* **c)** understand the risks and put money on the line out of their own personal responsibility.

In this video, I briefly explain again what I do:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YesQwUPzM9M -> In German


![IMG_5393.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/243fxXVGEe8DaadB75anHc8L1khFW2W3aSW5uwFpiU34uPAtVaFnNUAKJY1bX8Bm9bkSm.jpeg)




Ultimately, there is no \

system. Of course, there are setbacks here and there. Any entrepreneur will tell you the same. It’s the same here on HIVE. As a community, we can all ensure that we onboard new people, look ahead, and invest in HIVE—specifically our time, our learnings, and possibly our money.



![IMG_4661.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23wCLPRABXsxnTwqxEP182q8TvSEjUy9exuarpy5xxg7Hvo9rNrZsGMDqfexp7b4G83Cx.jpeg)

![IMG_4515.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23vi1seVLs5JpghxDi35SdJNwkuWsCtHvejRPPtfRGhX8NwvSUSvhQdomYNyQDAm8xyjw.jpeg)

![IMG_4504.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23ynQMhYZZFyfQhWgfdmLsibXNLdWpdWWjKfjgY87iffBJ9MfU82gLifLfucmLhsqkrDY.jpeg)



The **#HOD** (Hive Open Days) were amazing, and I’m looking forward to more activities and the next meetup in Vienna. Often, it’s the small steps that bring long-term success. At the **#wienerhivestammtisch** and the **#hivemeetupvienna**, we address exactly these points.

Leading the way are @stayoutoftherz and @pantha.rhei, including the HIVE guru @thermoplastic with his 80+ years of wisdom. We also get regular visits from @vikisecrets, @cpufronz, and others... sometimes more, sometimes less... guests from Graz, Prague, and so on.



![IMG_5781.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23xyVLzSZFPcjXRyfDVQc535yzFPR3Z6zng2zbQ9vZuYp3Xq6qXC7XoZzKehZ2gHV8LWG.jpeg)

![IMG_5801.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/242hd5aiwcEq3aMpvR4zn38uP1snTKGWXQERc5v4G6qLTJk8AsxDE6B1emLaA9vjmeqsU.jpeg)

![IMG_5712.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/241QEYUPTMNzwt7iQKGXeeYXwJCEXhohmvpY6rZCPcQs1KXdqphWBbHAUnqjbJ4yr75VA.jpeg)

![IMG_5765.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23uQpVTGm8HyM5eA7wndicGsHUtNUDJyN7M4kXBCgdsBndur6DYABhKyHpfwiWattSu6F.jpeg)




It’s these moments of gratitude, in places like this, where I go within and simply celebrate life. With all its ups and downs—staying the course and looking forward is what eventually brought me success.

Greets from Chiclana del Fontera
@schmidi ✌️

description.title: ¿Ayudas a tu hijo a hacer tareas escolares? Yo si y pienso que es una terapia también.
description.body:
Cuando a los hijos les mandan a hacer actividades donde las manualidades son la base de la tarea, esto ayuda mucho a desarrollar la creatividad y la fortaleza de la energía femenina que es creativa. Todos tenemos energía masculina/femenina y debemos de aprender a equilibrarla a través de lo que hacemos, pensamos, decimos y sentimos. 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVMjZ12VgHaU8fUMueMgBtKiiyHkmy7rTD3wMnnMzgoGU/1002073577.jpg 

Al ser padre *(pero realmente soy padrastro de ellos)* mi energía masculina da apoyo y asistencia por la experiencia que tengo como adulto, pero también al ayudarlos a pensar a como hacer las cosas y sentir lo que están haciendo, darle ese valor por la tarea, es la energía femenina la que se manifiesta a través del ser.

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmasdW3yTM4GqSCaWoc3UHMgNtRwN1gEbiXNfidkLZGWZp/1002073553.jpg 

El resultado final de la tarea es un rompe cabezas del estado Zulia de Venezuela, en sus normas hay problemas de razonamiento matemáticos para niños de 2do a 3er grado.

Aún tenemos trabajito por hacer y completar la tarea. Ayudar a tus hijos en las tareas te reconecta con tu niño interno y eso es terapia para nosotros los adultos.

description.title: Batman vs The Giant Excavator Machine | Arkham Knight Gameplay
description.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1778692011487-4c527e62ceb55a80.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=yakubnoyon/8209dd93)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=yakubnoyon/8209dd93)


---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVRPJo7n5jhe44xkdojaJzLNcPjUuQhhXyJXEuyr8qfVr/gaming_photography_2_.gif)

So the battle begins. It wasn't easy to fight against that monster truck. It was undestructible, unbreakable and impossible to stop. Gordon wasn't inside that tunnel. It was a trap set by the Arkham Knight. He lured Batman inside that tunnel using the location tracking trap. There is no way out here.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYWUM3dmJ8emNczgzmSwut7JxS9CLZU3m4SBtJZU5chvX/snapshot.png)

The problem is you can't fight that monster. Cannon shots don't affect at all. But it has the power to crush the Batmobile instantly. So the only way to survive is to hide from it. But Arkham Knight is not going to let his golden opportunity to kill Batman.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW6y46keEBe5Y1W8vGnbma4VaXT61rohqntmEP8doGF1r/snapshot_1.png)

The tunnel was very narrow. Also there were many obstacles on the road so it is very hard to drive there. You need to be a good driver if you want to survive. If you're stuck on the road, the Excavator will come from behind and crush you. I fail around 5/6 times.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaJLKkByCd5vX8vpUcyK552UmMnxs4dkUcZE7ursw7EKT/snapshot_2.png)

After a few chances, I found the way to get out of there. But it was locked by a huge door. Alfred could have opened the door but Arkhan Knight jammed the signal using some energy from that Excavator. So you have to destroy the machine that is attached to the Excavator. But how can you damage the part? Cannon shots don't affect at all.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdA2KkFN8U3TJuyH4WvpKidW14DSDCAjwK4gc7ksNsvLS/snapshot_3.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZFwzZHpymA5xUKAAsgyH8wTifF1PMxfyEKaNgyNcBqxj/snapshot_4.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRvb24b15jkax2Ex22b5nbhbkWWiQj7jQXaUZRxmZQCVj/snapshot_5.png)

There is only one way. There is a road that ends that is full of explosive bombs. You can drive the Batmobile at ease with that road but the Excavator wouldn't be able to pass. It touches the explosive and boom. A huge explosion occurred and the ground fell on it. Like that, it damaged the signal jammer.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNQDAYwxQtyWqFNqQ9c3mN86v5RdaMKhuAk8SbZU6rZCf/snapshot_6.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNSXgjJZ5VzVtGMCU4kGwzXTPG1gTupMK57GJJG88YjwB/snapshot_7.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeE6hNM4Dpv4N4rr87bMeVH4nTmcic444o8J1ESihEB1t/snapshot_8.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdkYSaFmkx8jEaVPArfxmptTVn5o2TkRHptYNFZzoDSgk/snapshot_9.png)

But yet, Arkham Knight doesn't stop chasing me. He is determined to kill me so he isn't able to understand my plan. There are 3 tunnels with explosives. If the machine takes damage from all these explosives, there is a chance that the signal jammer will be destroyed and Alfred will open the gate from where I can escape. It isn't easy at all but after a lot of tries, I finally made it. The signal jammer is destroyed.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTvFjdYVrcAj42DvP3CydUFDNSbaMxnkKSLfiMVkmxhJe/snapshot_11.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeNtjBDogwHjjJKXgXckPmN3vdL6RQKf3dRtccdBP2die/snapshot_12.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbw6XdYsTgfakpHSysdxX4hU4R2ts7mZ2x1LRiALeLt4q/snapshot_14.png)

Alfred opens the gate. There is an exit fan that I broke and find the way out. But the Excavator reaches there. Arkhan Knight thinks there is no way out so he moves forward at full speed.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZv4xY6EqsLvQjA9gbF33iEodt1sy1zr5wqgEg5PtRQT5/snapshot_17.png)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNzSWJqSckB6iKrpzfaZpepu6g3imcA3qWfwgCFVQXE1z/snapshot_15.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSX3BUbEk28mrZ6PE1qKVbDtnZ8P36ceVHzr7zZC1qJoC/snapshot_16.png)

I use the boot glide option to directly fly up through that open space. Arkham Knight crushes the Batmobile with the Excavator at ease, like a piece of cake. I fell so bad for the car. I think, I have to play the game without my beast.

---

* **Thank you for reading. See you all on my next blog.**

---

---

description.title: Dziennik #79/2026 - upadek
description.body: > Dzień dobry. Znowu cichy tutaj weekend, a jak tu milczę to wiadomo, że odjebałam. I to strasznie. W sobotę rano wstałam i nie mogłam sobie znaleźć miejsca. Niby nic mi nie było, ale jakoś tak no. Pojechałam do ziomka i sobie posiedzieliśmy nad rzeką i popierdoliliśmy kilka godzin. I w sumie się trzymałam. Dobrze spędziłam czas. Jakieś tam pomniejsze rzeczy mi dokuczały, ale ogólnie było git. I po powrocie do domu też było git, ale wieczorem dostałam depresyjnej jazdy. Strasznej. Odezwał się chyba każdy mój jeden demon, który trawi mi duszę. KAŻDY KURWA. I co zrobiła jakże inteligentna Paulina? Zamiast zadzwonić czy napisać po pomoc to dałam się namówić na imprezę. Pojechałam do kolesia no i zaczął się upadek kompletny. Alkohol lał się do rana, narkotyki sypały się do rana, ale w niedzielę rano mnie tknęło, że przecież jestem odpowiedzialnym właścicielem psa, którym trzeba się zaopiekować no to dawaj do mnie. No i tak się przeciągnęło do poniedziałku. Weekend mam kompletnie wyjęty z życia. Wtorek był moim najgorszym dniem od jakiś myślę 15 lat. Nie dlatego, że miałam zjazd po narkotykach czy kaca, wyjebane. Nie pierwszy raz. Dlatego, że musiałam stanąć naprzeciw przyjaciółki, która mnie po prostu zmasakrowała. Nawet się nie broniłam, nie było po co. Skoro odjebałam to po co używać jakiś kretyńskich wymówek. Stało się i tyle, muszę to naprawić. No może nie muszę, ale chcę. Pogubiłam się. Obiektywnie mam dobre życie: mam bliskich, którzy mnie kochają, a ja ich, mam zajebistą pracę i mogłabym tak jeszcze wymienić z kilkanaście pozytywów, a jednak wciąż szukam chuja do dupy i co rusz tracę kompletnie motywację do życia tak jak teraz. Nie chcę sobie zrobić krzywdy, nie idzie mi w samobójstwo kompletnie, ale po prostu nie mam kompletnie motywacji do życia. Wszystko co się wokół dzieje, co się działo w moim życiu, co czuję i myślę tak bardzo mnie dojeżdża, że momentami mam totalnie wyjebane na to co jeszcze się wydarzy. I wtedy się zamykam w sobie, bo oczywiście nikomu nie mówię, że dzieje mi się źle i zaczynam odpierdalać głupoty. Wszystko co mi powiedziała przyjaciółka dotknęło mnie tak do żywego, że wstanę. Może na razie nie dla siebie, bo do tego trochę brakuje mi werwy, ale dla tych kilku osób, które jeszcze we mnie wierzą. Póki jeszcze mnie nie skreślili, ale jak się nie uspokoję to nie wiadomo ile to potrwa jeszcze. Kurewsko boli mnie dusza. Co dzisiaj.. Wstałam jak z krzyża zdjęta, bo spałam jakieś 2h. Noc była ciężka. Dużo łez, wymioty, tachykardia i inne tego typu przyjemności. Niemniej trzeźwa, więc pojechałam do pracy. No i w pracy nie było lepiej, bo moja asystentka zapytała mnie jak rozmowa z przyjaciółką, więc jej powiedziałam, że źle, bo znowu odjebałam no i od niej też się nasłuchałam. Kilka zdań mi powiedziała takich, że po pracy w aucie jebłam beksa. Nie wgniotła mnie w ziemię, ale też dotknęła do żywego. Po pracy weszłam do domu, siadłam w butach na kanapę i po prostu zasnęłam. Jestem wykończona, a do tego wszystko mnie boli. Zmogło mnie na godzinę z hakiem i obudził mnie ojciec telefonem. Zdziwiłam się, bo nie gadamy od miesiąca no i zadzwonił z wiadomością, że teść mojego brata jest w szpitalu, bo ma guza mózgu. Nie chce mi się tego komentować. Nie mam siły komentować tego, co się dzieje. Zrobiłam obiad, którego za dużo nie udało mi się zjeść, bo mdłości i ból żołądka i pojechałam objechać apteki, żeby w końcu dostać moje leki i alleluja, dostałam. Zablokowałam i wyjebałam z telefonów wszystkie kontakty, które są moralnie lub prawnie wątpliwe. Mam leki. Miałam jechać na miting, ale tak mi ciało dokucza, że nie jestem w stanie dlatego włączyłam sobie miting online. Zaraz zrobię drugie podejście do obiadu i po mitingu idę spać, bo jestem wyczerpana, po prostu wyczerpana. Nie żalę się, zbieram co zasiałam, ale jest kurwa ciężko. Jednak wstanę, bo mam dla kogo. Póki jeszcze mam dla kogo. Do jutra.

description.body:
[//]:# (!worldmappin 10.14114 lat -69.54522 long  d3scr)

<center>
![Brown and Beige Vintage Travel Plan Presentation.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/arteyviajes/23vsE9VimAbXGwJmEiVKgdNGAdPGWg1yRmKUaHkgc5LSaAF6hX9N7h7VqMPjUn6ub5Zjt.jpg)

</center>

<div class=\

> Desde el año pasado comencé con mis amigas a organizar salidas mensuales y uno de estos planes que surgieron fue este, ir a ver las estrellas. Ninguna demuestra un interés profundo por la astronomía, pero era un plan diferente que se adaptaba muy bien al presupuesto así que terminamos yendo a nuestro primer camping para ver las estrellas.

Last year, my friends and I started organizing monthly outings, and one of the ideas that came up was this: going stargazing. None of us are particularly interested in astronomy, but it was a unique activity that fit our budget perfectly, so we ended up going on our first camping trip to stargaze.
---
![mochilla y botas.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/arteyviajes/EoEiLVzM9fsdk8ktNVDwhPPpNjyUcnoGdXgtnFwEHfVbQz3AVfxomYMNctWgD9EzUdx.png)
---

Listas para ver los objetos de Messier
Lists for observing Messier objects

> Como todos los viajes aquí en la ciudad nos enteramos por Instagram, un grupo de personas que se dedican a observar los astros estaban ofertando esta ruta para para una noche acampando con la finalidad de observar los más de cien objetos que catalogo en su momento el astrónomo Charles Messier.

Since we find out about all the events here in town through Instagram, we learned that a group of stargazers was offering this trip—a one-night camping trip—to observe the more than 100 objects originally cataloged by the astronomer Charles Messier.
\n\n

> Que vamos, que yo en un principio no tenía ni idea de lo que estaban hablando con esto del Maraton Messier, más adelante, nos explicaron bien de que se trataba. Una vez hecho el contacto del viaje al que básicamente confirmamos asistencia un día antes, nos pidieron como requisito para vivir de mejor forma la experiencia del campamento descargar la App Stellarium que funciona como una guía para ayudarte a ubicar y reconocer cada punto que ves en el cielo.

To be honest, at first I had no idea what they were talking about with this “Messier Marathon,” but later on, they explained it all to us clearly. Once we'd made the arrangements for the trip—which we basically confirmed our attendance for the day before—they asked us, as a requirement to get the most out of the camp experience, to download the Stellarium app, which serves as a guide to help you locate and identify every object you see in the sky.
![1000330921.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/arteyviajes/EpVAapSLtogF1gHWXpnXR9jcRtioYj1ag38d5FXwuv87LMps1yx5qZuMWdBaHvMhF1Z.jpg)

> El campamento sería en un lugar llamado Padre Diego, del estado Lara, Venezuela. Allí se ubica la caseta de los guardaparques del Parque Nacional Cerro Saroche.

The camp would be located in a place called Padre Diego, in the state of Lara, Venezuela. That is where the park rangers' station for Cerro Saroche National Park is located.
\n \n

> Llegamos a eso de las 6 de la tarde y lo primero fue comenzar a armar las carpas, en nuestro caso decidimos optar por alquilar una a los organizadores del viaje en 5 USD, para mi sorpresa es un tipo de carpa que se arma casi como abrir un paraguas, super fácil y rápido.

We arrived around 6 p.m., and the first thing we did was start setting up the tents. In our case, we decided to rent one from the trip organizers for $5. To my surprise, it’s the kind of tent that sets up almost like opening an umbrella—super easy and quick.
![1000330941.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/arteyviajes/EoyP16ANUwj83djaSUwMP7LRsyymWYWEQJWJAhmgxZZj1Utrm96R3Q6cjdnPvQoPjiM.jpg) ![1000330942.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/arteyviajes/Eoryt6WaEqGbBHSF3GUhGLefb4Q7DcXH9mN42iZV913t3QkZPnkuPFir3bd5gkr5RfR.jpg)

> La siguiente actividad estaba guiada por los guardaparques y consistía en hacer el sendero de interpretación Cardenalito Larense que tienen en el parque.

The next activity was led by the park rangers and involved walking the Cardenalito Larense interpretive trail in the park.
\n\n

> En el sendero nos encontramos 7 estaciones donde vamos a ir viendo los tipos de vegetación, en especial en una zona xerófila. Entre todas las cosas que nos hablaron una curiosa es el nombre de Saroche que viene de la lengua indígena gayona y significa \

Along the trail, we’ll come across seven stations where we’ll observe different types of vegetation, particularly in a xerophytic zone. Among all the things we were told, one interesting fact is the name “Saroche,” which comes from the Gayona indigenous language and means “refuge on the hill.”
\n\n

> Aqui te dejo algunas de las plantas que vimos allí.

Here are some of the plants we saw there.
![1000330958.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/arteyviajes/EpzxhsnGEH6jaVcCX2JDMH3wXEA3GurWKqXC5tU63jvkmBWW25vvsMjrbQw1sQ7Hb3y.jpg) *Yabo en floración* ![1000330980.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/arteyviajes/EorzQ2RYN4syVxXreYLdXJMk1ED9285JuwEvPTNsUck8Mw6jR6bJFkRARrFcnuJ5FZE.jpg) *Kalanchoe* ![1000330991.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/arteyviajes/EoyR23HjMB71Ju2cthhFUneBLGRwxgPHBU62dzW2DTM2xABgREoXU5jNrqG7wW3H5W2.jpg) *Tillandsia o gallito* ![1000330994.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/arteyviajes/EqFpY6iUNMSvy1qWjHAJLpjuUfd3Qc8kgC1nbEH2q1BcPdx4bYTHKJy3Eq3qLdu3o58.jpg) *Cocuiza*

> Este recorrido duro aproximadamente unos treinta minutos por lo que cuando salimos ya el sol se despedía de nosotras regalándonos este hermoso atardecer.

The walk took about thirty minutes, so by the time we left, the sun was already setting, treating us to this beautiful sunset.
![noche2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/arteyviajes/Ep1V4K4HDZiZm3usKuuArwXnjYiiMtJWuJjDhsymvfwVAZBH8oFem6Pag18TFMuKn9o.jpg)

> Y con la puesta de sol comenzaba nuestra tarea de observación, aquí lo primero que se deja ver es el planeta Venus, pero disculpa lo borroso, mi zoom no dio para más.

And as the sun set, our stargazing began. The first thing you see here is the planet Venus, but please excuse the blurriness—my zoom just couldn't get any closer.
![1000331024.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/arteyviajes/EoATujLovU2EGqp7JbF4PrrYvpqzFkUq4LVAsrriuxM8JG8JMeBD99FdqBQ1vkMWzLh.jpg)

> Nos dieron una clase para explicarnos todo al respecto del Maratón Messier y cómo usar la App de Stellarium para reconocer lo que veíamos en el cielo, además de ello, también nos mostraron lo que es un planisferio celeste que es una herramienta que te ayuda también a ubicar que objeto astronómico vas a ver en qué lugar y a qué hora.

They gave us a lesson to explain everything about the Messier Marathon and how to use the Stellarium app to identify what we were seeing in the sky. In addition, they also showed us what a star chart is—a tool that helps you locate which astronomical objects you’ll be able to see, where, and at what time.
\n\n

> En este punto estábamos preocupados porque el cielo desde que llegamos estuvo muy nublado y nada que se despejaba. De todas formas, también estábamos preparados con los telescopios armados para en el primer momento de claridad salir corriendo a observar.

At that point, we were worried because the sky had been very cloudy ever since we arrived, and it didn't look like it was going to clear up. In any case, we were ready to go—with our telescopes set up—so that the moment the sky cleared, we could rush out to observe.

> Lo siguiente que vimos fue al planeta Jupiter y aquí se puso increíble todo, no podía creer lo cerca que se podía ver ese gran planeta. A eso de las 10 de la noche estábamos cenando y nos la pasábamos entre la carpa y saliendo y entrando observando las nubes en el cielo.

The next thing we saw was Jupiter, and that’s when everything became truly amazing—I couldn’t believe how close that huge planet looked. Around 10 p.m., we were having dinner and kept going back and forth between the tent and the outside, watching the clouds in the sky.
![1000331048.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/arteyviajes/EoEhJ5c34ou2djRzUFSKxLK4d6Y8Q4VKui27EB5rjKU5hsi4v75Bh83gfVbGbn97fBE.jpg) ![1000331055.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/arteyviajes/Ep3dR5vTQXXF6TWfkcKc7wmwVd8RmnBCKuavKuUAtCReuYRofnxTW2KMBmxMeXNAjMD.jpg)

> Bien entrada la madrugada comenzamos a ver constelaciones como la de Géminis, la Canis Mayor que tiene una estrella llamada Sirio que destaca bastante, también vimos a Orion, la estrella del norte, la constelación de la Osa Mayor y muchas otras más.

Well into the early hours of the morning, we began to see constellations such as Gemini and Canis Major, which contains a star called Sirius that really stands out. We also saw Orion, the North Star, the constellation Ursa Major, and many others.
![1000331069.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/arteyviajes/Eo8KZ418qBEbJpdKL8hmZAE3DbJfxenf1wPA4MZrjHeKANWCiC45q54PLA5s7LkyP2L.jpg)

> Esta noche estuve despierta hasta eso de las 3 de la madrugada y de todo lo que vi esa noche lo que más me sorprendió fue ver el planeta Júpiter. Tenían un telescopio de mayor alcance y se allí se podía ver con claridad el planeta más dos de sus lunas, fue lo más increíble. Por supuesto que con un teléfono común y corriente no podía capturar fotos de estos objetos astronómicos.

Last night I stayed up until around 3 a.m., and of everything I saw that night, what surprised me most was seeing the planet Jupiter. They had a high-powered telescope, and through it you could clearly see the planet and two of its moons—it was absolutely incredible. Of course, with a regular cell phone, I couldn’t take any photos of these astronomical objects.
![cruz.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/arteyviajes/EoATvVPeK1geX1NnrtDZNBBYHNXQFVHukg6HHfHFt9gmTJidR8hdxTmTt12NnHEi7t6.jpg)

> La mañana comenzó desde bien temprano, pasa que cuando estamos en un lugar tan alejado de la ciudad puedes escuchar con mayor intensidad el canto de los pajaritos, funciona como una alarma, pero una alarma agradable de escuchar.

The morning started very early; when you're in a place so far from the city, you can hear the birds singing much more clearly—it's like an alarm clock, but a pleasant one to listen to.
![1000331090.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/arteyviajes/23zGafjAUdQS4cHoQzQTFuYCJeczsvesGeKQbEzuf6Dev18gmhqCgohSEJz7JhRcbXoA2.jpg)
---
![botas.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/arteyviajes/EpCFmnfQJRzm5S8fHCgkhepusrZy5N2mnZQUYWf6YdHyNxRMT6ooKQSF6ZNV4bZLr6t.jpg)
---

> La verdad que iba con cero expectativas de la actividad y de hecho pospuse mucho la decisión de ir o no, pero ahora que lo hice te recomiendo con toda seguridad participar en una actividad como esta. Estas aprendiendo y maravillándote con todo lo que hay mas allá de lo que nos permiten ver nuestros ojos. Una cosa más, si te interesan las constelaciones descarga la App de Stellarium en tu teléfono, es muy sencilla de usar y la verdad puedes entretenerte bastante cualquier noche observando el cielo.

To be honest, I went into the activity with zero expectations, and I actually put off deciding whether or not to go for a long time. But now that I’ve done it, I can wholeheartedly recommend participating in an activity like this. You’ll learn and be amazed by everything that lies beyond what our eyes can see. One more thing: if you’re interested in constellations, download the Stellarium app on your phone—it’s very easy to use, and honestly, you can have a lot of fun any night just by looking up at the sky.
\n\n

> Todas las fotografías aquí expuestas son de mi autoría y fueron tomadas desde un teléfono Poco X6 PRO.

All the photographs shown here are of my authorship and were taken from a Poco X6 PRO phone.
\n\n

> Les dejó mi cuenta de Instagram y mi canal de Youtube por si desean echar un vistazo.

I leave you my Instagram account and my Youtube channel in case you want to take a look.
[@1.diadeviaje](https://instagram.com/1.diadeviaje?igshid=NzZlODBkYWE4Ng==) [@Undiadeviaje](https://youtube.com/@Undiadeviaje?si=2Zw9ikoYEPajlcsM)

Nos leemos en la próxima aventura, chao.

See you in the next adventure, bye.

![hn.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/arteyviajes/242NcUUtQfTV26mHFvEKEqyWVSsp5nqi47A87CJSNAMpHi7xrgx7hVNk5tPwyQDKbWDAL.jpg)

description.title: Feliz miércoles, hace calor
description.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbAS4aPPgDumCUH5HdwN7YghdPZppxcSEcLexSXq26QS3/IMG_0200.jpg 

Mi gente bella, feliz miércoles para todos. Hoy amaneció con ese calorcito fuerte que no perdona, de esos que apenas sales ya sientes el sol pegando con todo. Pero bueno, aquí estamos, poniéndole buena cara al día porque el ánimo también ayuda a llevar mejor el clima, ¿verdad?

Desde temprano me tocó elegir ropita fresca, algo cómodo que me dejara respirar, porque con este calor no hay de otra. Me hice mi cafecito —aunque cueste con este clima— y me tomé un momento para arrancar el día con calma. A veces el calor desespera un poquito, pero también tiene su lado sabroso: provoca cosas ligeras, bebidas frías y andar más relajada.

Hoy, siendo mitad de semana, siento ese empujoncito de seguir adelante. Ya vamos avanzando, paso a paso, y eso también se celebra. Aunque el calor nos quiera quitar energía, hay que buscar la forma de mantenerse con buena vibra, tomar agüita, descansar cuando se pueda y no estresarse de más.

Te deseo un miércoles bonito, a pesar del calor, que todo te salga bien y que encuentres momenticos para sentirte cómodo y tranquilo. No dejes que el clima te tumbe el ánimo, más bien tómalo con calma y con esa actitud chévere que nos caracteriza.

Por aquí sigo yo, sudando un poquito pero con una sonrisa, dándole gracias a la vida por otro día más. 💛✨

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@gysela/feliz-mircoles-hace-calor-cuq)

description.title: Use A Solid Team During Small Mana Battle
description.body:
![image by OpenAI](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23wC9YGo74iXU5Jx5wWtgPzkxD7HsTGTHyjPJ48y7f8sgHDyWyLY1wh5ysuVHtpBxxHVS.png)


Greetings Summoners

As usual I am sharing my Splinterlands battle once a while, especially if I have found some interesting battles. Some battles might be interesting for you but I might not be interesting for me, it goes vice versa. So I hope what I share today can spark up some joy in your Splinterlands journey.

Today it is about setting a solid tactic instead of dropping strong units. What I mean with this is that during small mana battle, when you have less than 20 Mana available, most of the time the best way is to set a solid tactic, a strong meta or a pin point laser beam strategy instead of dropping some strong units.

Strong units are important, sometime they can carry out the whole team by themselves. However in small mana battle, sometime you can not set anything else to ensure the safety or those strong units, or maybe to buff up them.

So let see the battle then!

#### The Battle

[![~Click The Image Above To See the Full Battle~](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23tbRPsfwN95S2a8AMCeSnkxqdfzmkzwCs5CDFT6ugAACMr5AZGLaM5MfhBYDgAXh4vsf.png)](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sm_n7UXKxFmmwfRRwz27ijP?ref=dewabrata)

I pick this from one of my brawls. I play in Gold Foil Frays, so things like this is usual, bound to happen frequently. You know what I mean, right? We come into battle field with messy leveling, some are at good or max level, some are not.

The main reason why I chose this battle, regardless the level we have, because both of us here took different route. Let's talk about their team first.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23wMMSNKJZtFAyA1qrud2tVKXCehVqrMH28xEB5oGwjADgAZyX1RFZ1G1ZN5d7zgtXWoy.png

I believed his core unit was Chimney Wallstop. It was a bold move to use 10 mana unit in 18 mana cap battle, this could be a suicidal or stupid move or maybe a high paying gamble. Personally I would avoid this one, the risk was too high and did not fit my risk preference.

Instead of building a team that support Chimney Wallstop, my opponent did the double top. He put in another Gladiator unit.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23w2ajPAC1RGwcLMgEYMEJqA4Knp2Fgi7H1AoEmpob27ChUpXvUaAjCgsW7dZAYWSZp9B.png

Orella Abadon might seem weak but I see him as a great choice during small mana battle. He only needs 2 mana, so he could fit in many meta as an X factor, or maybe you could build a lineup to support him by guarding him or buffing him up.

So a couple of Gladiator units... sounds scary right? but this is a 18 mana cap battle, so as we can see here, they can not support any of those two units. Is this a blunder? a bad move? I think it is not that bad, because both of them are very strong units. These units could carry up an entire team.

In contrast with my team, I only brought one core unit. It was my favorite gladiator unit from life element, Captain Katie!

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/EoeDSmPeX2StAQ9Sz6XyyGpGVxR1LZemxzJR94RvzhbDAWRXavB9dH1ELUkN6HvsWLZ.png

Captain Katie is not the strongest gladiator unit however she is very effective. She has 3 magic damage with snipe ability, good health point and not a slow one. These traits make her able to fit in many line up.

I often build up a line up that fully support her growth from her bloodlust ability, and that was what I did in this battle. I put a tank, a healer and a backline wall just to buy more time for her to grow.

So let see what happen after 2 rounds in this battle

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23tkmzH2rjxWrxpKKZtZRAJfC3FQcTpnmW7BHQaibxKwixUxbXGgprD7Xt9nzNMXLPN2h.png

When round 3 started, My Captain Katie had 4 magic damage and 4 speed. She looked strong, did she? but please check on her opponent, those two gladiator units were no less than her, especially that Chimney Wallstop. In general, each of those gladiators could go rampage beating all the other units.

However this was a low mana cap battle, this was not about 2 strong units vs 1 strong unit. WE did not have enough mana to facilitate everything. so this became two strong units vs 1 strong unit supported by her team mate.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23tbMTtvcTbjvU3iZ4KhLDBhPPmyHPiAttP41o3iby1ok1g1patgrAZRLKQXbWUZmjpYu.png

The result was clear, the battle ended at round 5. Captain Katie grew too strong for Orella Abandon. Good game dude!

My opponent tactic was not bad, however it became bad for low mana cap battle. If he came with only one gladiator card or one core unit and tried to build a support system around that one, he might get a better team. I would prefer he went with one Orella Abandon as his core, and put some buff and tank in front to facilitate Orella Abandon.

Or maybe you think that Captain Katie is too OP for those two?Feel free to leave any comment and thank you for visiting my post!

---

![https://splinterlands.com?ref=dewabrata](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23tbH2XfEqZJAFKMvoBTZG6B1pBkH9XJz79EpLXCGCCHvNVgeBbigFfqAtfmeowZ49T85.gif)

description.title: Why Old Times Felt More Peaceful Than Today
description.body:
Nowadays so many sad incidents are happening around us as if war is going on everywhere and something or the other is going on all over the world due to which the whole world has become a little shaken. Earlier the situation was not like this, I will not say that there were no wars earlier, wars are happening all the time, now there are much less wars than before, if you look even 100 years ago, there would be so many wars going on all over the world and a lot of things would be happening, but I feel that such an atmosphere would not be there everywhere because there would be some times who would be peace loving. That's right, in every era, at every time, some or the other leader keeps getting born who keeps spreading stability all over the world, you can say. Although we have access to all kinds of comforts and amenities these days, we are connected to people in every way, and a lot is available around us, yet deep inside I feel a sense of emptiness.



![empty.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bhattg/23wM4W5ofpY9U1xJaXjWuBWXEgfM2ZBfkCJzn3W62BuUvg8oPjbUmzyDsTgk2sDtaqJeq.png)



[ImgSrc](ChatGpt.com)


I don't know whether you feel like this or not but I feel like this a lot because earlier the time was such that things were much more limited, now we have all kinds of comforts and facilities available to us, even after that we are very much disconnected from people and are not able to connect with anyone. I used to like the old days a lot better when letters used to be circulated or there was no other medium of communication and then life used to be much more peaceful and fake news used to spread less and people used to spend more of their time in their real life than on the phone. Yes, I would not say that nowadays we are not getting the most, nowadays we get everything instantly but this is making all the things much more ungrateful.




Look, I like to live a very simple life, I don't like complex things. Look, what do you need to live a life? A house, a job, a small family, your parents and farming. To me this seems like a peaceful light and we need more than this too. Do people run after money? Life is full and what do they get in the end? Nothing, nothing is achieved. Earlier the life of people used to be very simple. Earlier they used to do farming and used to eat whatever grain or anything was available or whenever there was any need for food, they used to go to the market and buy the stuff but nowadays things have changed a lot.


![emptuy.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bhattg/243fxqozSjUZSHHme8QYPBwGQH6znN37vqbUdzxSiLZBuVHUjncxnYQBVMn26p3tGYDuH.png)



[ImgSrc](ChatGpt.com)


I like the old times better even though technology wasn't so advanced back then but people had value. Nowadays people are running after money and there is an endless race going on in which only money is seen and a person is judged on that basis and sometimes no matter how good a person is, if they don't have money then their habits have no value. Today's society has become so hollow that if you do a job then they think you have money, if you roam around like a poor person then they think what is there to talk about. This is too much. It is poor. Inequalities were there everywhere at all times, it was there earlier also, it was not that there was no discrimination of any kind earlier, discrimination was there earlier also and it will always continue but it is very much necessary to have a peace like this and I feel that it was there in the earlier times when there was less technology and people were much more connected with each other.

Nowadays it has become a world of selfishness and people remember each other only for their own selfishness, though we all have contacts of each other but how many people do you talk to regularly, yes there will be some people to whom your date is visible today or your family members, apart from that think for yourself how many numbers do you talk to in your contacts. But if you live in a village, then the people there are very much connected, they know everything about each other and I find that life very peaceful. Some time ago I went to my village, I felt very good and it seemed as if my old childhood days had come back, though they may not come back but the feeling that I had was a very good, a wonderful experience.



![hive divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bhattg/23tbkwCohekqmu5nehKDpgCMH8M4WVpEmbEhHKB6uZZQNDq6LT9X7yoX7HBbirncwouys.png)

description.title: Sapien Loop 3: Chapter 5: Back to Downs
description.body:
![Sapien_Loop_3_Cover_HIVE.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spectrumecons/23wC7hkTDDpnHvZegULctqg6Mrrd9t72byH8zWkVgfNiHGiHqm7aVAeGi9PiELYyYAuVf.jpg)

Meanwhile, in the Downs Region. Commander Cecil had just arrived back with Daily, who was badly injured, and the body of Emily. Miro and a small group of underground Linap enforcers approached them.  

‘I see you put an end to their little escape,’ said Miro to Cecil as he watched him climb out of the flying vehicle. 

‘Three are dead, and this one is not looking too sharp,’ replied Cecil as he pointed to the enforcers to remove Daily and Emily from the flying vehicle.

‘Not exactly what I asked for,’ said Miro, sounding a little annoyed. ‘We don’t want to risk him saying too much.’ 

Miro watched the enforcers remove Emily from the flying vehicle.

‘Where are the other two?’ asked Miro.

‘They are rotting in the wreckage,’ chuckled Cecil. ‘Don’t worry. This lot aren’t going to find them.’

‘You’ve had a very long day,’ said Miro to Cecil. ‘Come join me and Hamish in the hotel for a drink.’

‘Yeah, that sounds great, thank you,’ replied Cecil as the enforcers rushed Daily into an emergency vehicle. ‘It’s good to be appreciated.’

Tiberius, who was still believed to be Hamish, and Duffo were sitting at a table casually chatting in the hotel restaurant. Polly was standing behind them. Miro and Cecil approached them.

‘Welcome back,’ said Tiberius as he gestured towards a chair for Cecil to sit on. 

Cecil smiled and sat down. Miro sat down beside Cecil.

‘Polly, could you please get our friends a nice coconut filled with the region’s finest juices?’ requested Tiberius.

Polly headed towards the bar to make the drink.

‘Were you able to handle the escapees?’ Tiberius asked Cecil.

‘Orcilla, the twin, and the technician were killed, and her fool husband is in critical condition,’ replied Cecil, sounding proud as he quickly glanced at Miro, who had a concerned look on his face.

‘This is truly tragic, but I’m sure you did your best to save lives,’ said Tiberius calmly. ‘We must give Orcilla and little Yassmay the funeral they deserve. The Downs residents would appreciate that.’

‘We don’t have their bodies,’ replied Cecil, sounding slightly nervous. ‘I didn’t feel the need…’

‘You didn’t feel the need to think,’ interrupted Tiberius abruptly. ‘This is their leader, and they have a sister still in Downs.’

‘Are they even dead, or are you just covering for your incompetence?’ asked Duffo angrily.

‘I took photographs,’ said Cecil in a panicked tone. ‘Look!’

Cecil pulled out his phone and showed both Tiberius and Duffo.

‘This is beyond distasteful,’ said Tiberius as he turned his head away from the photographs.

Polly approached the table carrying two giant novelty coconuts.

‘Please, Polly, could you give Duffo Cecil’s coconut?’ requested Tiberius. ‘I’m now displeased with Commander Cecil.’

Polly placed one coconut on the table in front of Duffo and the other in front of Miro.

‘Thank you, Polly,’ said Duffo and Miro in unison. Polly nodded and returned to standing behind Tiberius.

‘How may I rectify my error?’ asked Cecil as he glanced across at Duffo, who was slowly and joyfully sucking on his straw.

Tiberius put his hands on his face and leaned his head back.

‘Go back to the wreckage and get their bodies,’ said Miro firmly as he turned to Cecil.

‘Yes, of course,’ replied Cecil as he quickly got to his feet and then rushed out of the hotel restaurant.

Meanwhile, Daily had arrived at the medical centre. He had been rushed into surgery. Yassme, who had been told about Daily’s condition, had arrived to help.

Yassme, with the help of medical technicians, was able to stabilise Daily’s condition quickly. It appeared he was going to be fine. 

When Yassme exited the surgery, two underground Linap enforcers approached her. 

‘We need to question him,’ said an enforcer.

‘He needs to sleep,’ replied Yassme firmly.

The enforcers tried to push past Yassme, but she forcefully blocked them.

‘Try that again and you’ll both be taking a long nap,’ snapped Yassme angrily.

The enforcers reached for their batons.

‘A little eager, eh?' called out Head Enforcer Eugene. ‘In Downs, we respect each other’s space.’

The two enforcers looked at each other and then backed away.

‘These new enforcers are horrid,’ said Yassme to Eugene loudly so that the enforcers could hear her.

‘The packaging might be off, but I’m sure I can salvage something on the inside, friend,’ said Eugene as he glanced at the two disgruntled enforcers who were staring at him and Yassme.

‘Daily was with Yassmay,’ said Yassme, sounding concerned. ‘What if my sister is hurt as bad or worse?’

‘I bet Yassmay is having a picnic or riding a rogue Sape,’ said Eugene as he rubbed Yassme’s hair. 

‘I just want her to be here,’ said Yassme as she hugged Eugene. 

‘Sapes are really stubborn, friend,’ replied Eugene. ‘It might take a few weeks if she’s short on carrots.’

Yassme and Eugene decided to spend the night in the medical centre. Yassme would check on Daily every few hours. Each time she checked, he was still asleep. Eugene waited in the waiting room. Yassme would return to him, and they kept each other company throughout the night. 

Around mid-morning, Miro and Duffo arrived at the medical centre. Yassme and Eugene approached them.

‘We appreciate you keeping guard of the fugitive,’ said Duffo in a cocky tone.

‘Fugitives, friend,’ replied Eugene as his eyes started to dart. ‘The enforcers’ attention never drifts from the accused, the guilty, and the suspicious.’

‘Well, we’re here for Daily,’ said Miro in a stern tone.

‘You’ve already put him through enough,’ replied Yassme in an angry tone. ‘You’ll leave him alone.’

‘His reckless behaviour cost your twin sister her life,’ said Duffo, shaking his head. ‘Yet, you still defend him.’

‘My sister could never die in a vehicle crash,’ said Yassme as she walked closer to Duffo and stared up at him.

‘I’m afraid he’s right,’ said Miro in a solemn tone. ‘Commander Cecil confirmed her death. The enforcers will release her body tomorrow. I’m deeply sorry for your loss.’

‘I’m afraid you’re wrong,’ said Eugene firmly. ‘Enforcers don’t deal with bodies.’

‘He’s talking about the real enforcers,’ said Duffo angrily. ‘Not your bunch of losers.’

‘Ha, the words of an amateur who knows nothing of sleuthing,’ replied Eugene, raising an eyebrow. ‘I suggest you leave or I’ll give you a taste of how enforcement works around here.’

‘I apologise for our blunt approach,’ said Miro politely. ‘We will return with the necessary evidence.’

Miro turned to leave. ‘Thin ice,’ added Duffo as he turned to follow Miro.

‘Thanks for holding your ground,’ said Yassme as she smiled at Eugene.

‘These newcomers are clearly uneducated,’ replied Eugene, shaking his head. ‘The Downs Region is subtropical.’

Yassme wrapped her arms around Eugene and hugged him.

Tiberius, accompanied by Polly, had arrived at the warehouses; he wanted to speak to Colin. Colin was outside one of the larger warehouses where he was training a technician named Henders to replace him as resource manager.

‘Dear Colin,’ said Tiberius as he walked towards Colin and Henders. ‘Hard at work as usual, I see.’

‘There’s so much to do, friend,’ replied Colin. ‘This is the biggest reorganisation we’ve done in years.’

‘Which, of course, is absolutely necessary,’ said Tiberius, nodding.

‘I’d like you to meet the new resource manager Henders,’ said Colin joyfully as he patted Henders on the shoulder.

‘A reliable senior technician, I assume,’ remarked Tiberius.

Henders nodded enthusiastically.

‘Excellent!’ replied Tiberius, who turned to look at Colin. ‘I’m interested in the technology you salvaged from the other regions.’

‘We managed to accumulate plenty of great gadgets, friend,’ replied Colin as his eyes widened slightly. ‘Anything in particular you’re looking for?’

‘I’m looking for technology from Cellrebrum,’ said Tiberius. ‘I’ve been told it was the most advanced region.’

Jennifer, through the chip in Tiberius’ head, had informed him of the technology that was used in the rehabilitation centre.

‘We have a large section of this technology in that warehouse,’ said Colin as he pointed at a warehouse around a hundred metres away. ‘I’ll speak with you after lunch,’ he said as he turned to Henders, who nodded enthusiastically in response.

Colin led Tiberius and Polly into the warehouse and took him to the section where technology from Cellrebrum had been placed. 

‘You managed to salvage quite a bit of good-looking tech,’ said Tiberius, sounding impressed.

‘Well, it was Vulay and her teams that did the hard work,’ said Colin. ‘I only organised and categorised it once it arrived here.’

‘She is in serious need of reform,’ said Tiberius as he became slightly angry.

‘Of course,’ said Colin, sounding nervous. ‘I was out of place mentioning her.’

‘That headset over there,’ said Tiberius as he nodded in the direction of a headset. ‘What does it do?’

‘It’s some type of virtual game, friend,’ replied Colin as he climbed up to grab it. ‘It just needs charging, and then it’ll work fine.’

As Colin was retrieving the headset, Jennifer was informing Tiberius about the headset and several other pieces of technology that he could see in the section.

‘Here you go,’ said Colin joyfully as he handed the headset to him. ‘Hours of fun gaming awaits you.’ 

‘I’d like you to fetch me that box of gadgets over there too,’ requested Tiberius in a polite tone as he pointed again.

‘Oh yes, I see it,’ said Colin as he reached up and grabbed the box. 

Out of the corner of his eye, Tiberius thought he saw a child covered in blood. He instinctively looked away and then looked back, but she had gone.

‘Everything okay, friend?’ asked Colin as he approached Tiberius while holding the box.

‘Yes, of course,’ replied Tiberius in a slightly frustrated tone as he held out his hands to receive the box.

Colin handed the box to Tiberius, who was surprised by its weight.

‘You’re incredibly strong for your size,’ remarked Tiberius as he struggled to hold the box.

‘Great exercise routine,’ said Colin joyfully.

‘I see,’ replied Tiberius in a suspicious tone as he handed the box and headset to Polly.

A little later, Tiberius and Polly went to the trailer where Demadrian was being held. Demadrian was kept inside a cage, which gave him barely any room to move. Tiberius wanted Demadrian to be held under special detention for his attempt on his life. This also enabled him to have his way with Demadrian without needing to worry about Eugene and the Downs enforcers.

‘Oh my, this trailer stinks!’ exclaimed Tiberius as he opened the trailer door. 

Demadrian stared angrily at Tiberius as he and Polly entered the trailer.

‘I’m deeply concerned about your wellbeing,’ said Tiberius as he squatted in front of Demadrian. ‘Being shut in the dark twenty-four seven must be horribly boring. The smell certainly doesn’t make great company.’

Demadrian continued to stare at Tiberius.

Tiberius stood up. ‘Let him out,’ said Tiberius to Polly.

Polly opened the cage. Demadrian slowly got to his feet. He was wincing in pain. His legs and back hurt after being kept in the cage for around a week. Just as Demadrian exited the cage, Polly struck him hard, causing him to fall to the ground. 

‘Give him a good dose,’ said Tiberius as he handed Polly some syringes. ‘I want him out for a week.’

‘I’ll have to reinject him every day to do that,’ replied Polly.

‘Whatever works,’ sighed Tiberius as he stepped back from Demadrian. ‘I want him to catch up on some of those thousand years he missed.’

Polly gave Demadrian one full injection. She then placed the headset on his head. She switched it on. 

‘You’re going to experience a hundred virtual years of hell,’ chuckled Tiberius as he watched Polly shove Demadrian back into the cage.

description.title: One Dollar 1925
description.body:
Hello, another day, another coin. Today I’d like to show you a recent addition to my collection – specifically, a lovely circulating coin from the US. I bought the coin at a market in a small town called Działdowo. I can safely say I’ve got a new hobby, which involves wandering around local markets looking for antiques. As well as coins, this time I found a stall selling other antiques, where a couple had a few original glass hens from the Ząbkowice glassworks for sale. These are one of the most sought-after collectables from communist-era Poland. Their prices range from $250 to several thousand dollars. Returning to coins, I made a slightly smaller purchase from this gentleman, as I had to sift through a mass of copper-nickel and counterfeits, but someone with a keen eye will always find something interesting.

<center> One Dollar 1925 </center>

This is the One Dollar 1925, also known as the Peace Dollar. The coin is one of the most popular types of American silver dollars, and to be honest, that doesn’t surprise me at all, because this coin has everything I like in circulation numismatics. It’s a good size, has a decent silver content, is clearly legible, attractive, and, what’s more, it isn’t some modern invention made solely to look good in a display case. It was a normal coin that circulated and could have passed through thousands of hands. The Peace Dollar was created after the First World War, at a time when the world was trying to return to some semblance of normality following the immense tragedy known at the time as the Great War. The very name of this coin is no coincidence, as it was intended to symbolise peace and a new chapter in history. All in all, it is interesting that so much meaning can be encapsulated in an ordinary circulation coin. It is just a dollar, just an ordinary denomination, and yet behind this silver disc lies an entire era, the mood of the people, politics and the need to show that a more peaceful era was beginning. If only they had known how wrong they were. My specimen dates from 1925 and was struck in Philadelphia, which is why there is no mint mark on it. This year is not particularly rare, but that is precisely what makes it such a pleasure to collect. You don’t have to sell a kidney to have a classic US silver dollar in your collection, and the satisfaction is still very great.

On the obverse, we see the head of Liberty facing left. Her hair is flowing, rays emanate from her head, and you can immediately see that the Americans liked to do things their own way – a bit boldly, a bit symbolically – but you have to admit that the effect is very good. At the top is the inscription LIBERTY, at the bottom the year 1925, and on the sides the inscription IN GOD WE TRUST. All in all, it’s a seemingly simple design, but it has a certain something about it and looks much better in the flesh than in photos. The reverse is also very pleasing, as we see an eagle perched on a rock, holding an olive branch, with the inscription ‘PEACE’ at the bottom. And this is probably the best feature of this coin, because you immediately know what it’s all about. There is no aggression here, no great struggle, nor any excessive scheming. There is an eagle, there is peace, there is fine silver, and there is a great atmosphere. My copy isn’t perfect, of course, as it’s seen a bit of circulation, but to be honest, that’s exactly the sort of coin I like. When a coin is a bit worn, I immediately start wondering where it’s been, who’s held it, how many times someone’s paid with it, and how on earth it ended up at a small market in Działdowo after all these years. Perhaps to some it’s just an ordinary dollar, but to me it’s a piece of history you can actually hold in your hand. And I think that’s precisely why I really like circulation coins – because they aren’t lifeless. They really did once live amongst people. I have a good way of putting it – they have a soul, something so sorely lacking in these modern times, which rush on and on without pause.

---
# <center> Wersja Polska </center>
---



Witam, kolejny dzień, to kolejna moneta. Dziś chciałbym wam przedstawić świeży nabytek w kolekcji, a dokładniej coś miłego obiegowego ze stanów. Monetkę kupiłem na targu w małym miasteczku o nazwie Działdowo. Mogę stwierdzić, że mam nowe hobby, które to polega na chodzeniu po ryneczkach i szukaniu staroci. Oprócz monet tym razem znalazłem stanowisko z innymi antykami, gdzie małżeństwo posiadało na sprzedaż kilka oryginalnych szklanych kur z huty Ząbkowice. Jest to jeden z bardzo poszukiwanych smaczków z Polski komunistycznej. Jej ceny osiągają od 250 dolarów do kilku tysięcy. Wracając do monet, to u tego pana zrobiłem trochę mniejsze zakupy, gdyż musiałem przebierać przez masę miedzioniklu i podróbek, ale osoba z dobrym okiem zawsze coś ciekawego znajdzie.

<center> One Dollar 1925 </center>

Jest to One Dollar 1925, znany również pod nazwą dolar pokoju. Moneta należy do jednego z tych najbardziej lubianych typów srebrnych dolarów amerykańskich i powiem szczerze, że wcale mnie to nie dziwi, bo ten krążek ma w sobie wszystko, co lubię w numizmatyce obiegowej. Jest spory, ma ładną próbę srebra, jest czytelny, ładny i do tego nie jest jakimś współczesnym wynalazkiem robionym tylko po to, aby ładnie wyglądał w zamkniętym kapslu. To była normalna moneta, która funkcjonowała w obiegu i mogła przechodzić przez tysiące łapek. Peace Dollar powstał po pierwszej wojnie światowej, czyli w czasie, kiedy świat próbował jakoś wrócić do normalności po ogromnej tragedii, którą to w czasach ówczesnych nazywano wielką wojną. Sama nazwa tej monety nie jest przypadkowa, bo miała ona symbolizować pokój i nowy etap w historii. W sumie jest to ciekawe, że na zwykłej monecie obiegowej można zamknąć tak dużo treści. Niby tylko dolar, niby zwykły nominał, a jednak za tym srebrnym krążkiem stoi cała epoka, nastroje ludzi, polityka i potrzeba pokazania, że zaczyna się coś spokojniejszego. Gdyby oni wiedzieli jak bardzo się mylili. Mój egzemplarz pochodzi z 1925 roku i został wybity w Filadelfii, dlatego nie znajdziemy na nim znaku mennicy. Rocznik ten nie jest jakąś ogromną rzadkością, ale właśnie przez to jest bardzo przyjemny do zbierania. Nie trzeba sprzedawać nerki, żeby mieć w kolekcji klasycznego srebrnego dolara ze stanów, a satysfakcja i tak jest naprawdę spora.

Na awersie mamy głowę Wolności zwróconą w lewą stronę. Włosy są rozwiane, z głowy wychodzą promienie i od razu widać, że Amerykanie lubili robić rzeczy po swojemu, trochę mocno, trochę symbolicznie, ale trzeba przyznać, że efekt jest bardzo dobry. U góry znajduje się napis LIBERTY, na dole rok 1925, a po bokach napis IN GOD WE TRUST. W sumie niby prosty projekt, ale ma coś w sobie i na żywo wygląda dużo lepiej niż na zdjęciach. Rewers też jest bardzo przyjemny, bo widzimy orła siedzącego na skale, z gałązką oliwną, a na dole znajduje się napis PEACE. I to jest chyba najlepszy element tej monety, bo od razu wiadomo, o co tutaj chodzi. Nie ma tutaj agresji, wielkiej walki ani przesadnego kombinowania. Jest orzeł, jest spokój, jest dobre srebro i jest super klimat. Mój egzemplarz oczywiście nie jest idealny, bo coś niecoś obiegu już widział, ale powiem szczerze, że właśnie takie monety lubię. Jak moneta jest trochę przetarta, to od razu  zaczynam sobie myśleć, gdzie ona była, kto ją trzymał, ile razy ktoś nią zapłacił i jakim cudem po tylu latach trafiła na mały targ w Działdowie. Może dla kogoś to tylko zwykły dolar, ale dla mnie jest to kawałek historii, który można normalnie wziąć do ręki. I chyba właśnie za to naprawdę lubię monety obiegowe, bo nie są martwe. One naprawdę kiedyś żyły między ludźmi. Mam dobre określenie - one mają duszę, której tak brakuje w czasach obecnych, które pędzą i pędzą, bez przerw. 


![Dollar.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/matthew1/23vhwVgFhu7wG358cpGj8ocGnASkCJSjxoc4avuaysUQ8jd2iRwsa21ZHdc5e5VpoH2FZ.jpg)

description.body:
Habrán días en el béisbol de las Mayores en que los venezolanos no destaquen especialmente. Es decir, algunos hicieron cosas maravillosas ayer, pero sus equipos perdieron. Entonces, pienso incluir trabajos en aquellos días donde no haya nada por destacar en el contingente criollo. Y hoy, éste redactor pensó en tratar el asunto del pitcheo, como una tendencia que se impone en la temprana temporada. Es decir, si hemos visto marcadores abultados, pero conforme los brazos entran en calor con la entrada fuerte de la primavera, estos últimos han tendido a estabilizarse incluso con blanqueadas. Y ya, podemos abrir apuestas sobre quien será el siguiente pitcher en lanzar un no-no. Lo podemos hacer porque los inventos de maneras de lanzar no se detienen y cada vez es más difícil pegarle a la pelota. Se está haciendo lejano aquel 02 de Agosto de 2024 cuando Blake Snell, jugando para los Gigantes de San Francisco, lanzó las nueve entradas con 15 ponches para propinar un no hitter magistral a los Rojos de Cincinnati. Ahora Snell juega para los Dodgers, pero está lejos de tener el estado físico de entonces, aunque sigue siendo un lanzador dominante. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     There will be days in the Show when the Venezuelan contingent doesn't exactly light up the box score. Some players put up massive numbers yesterday, but their squads still took the L. The plan is to include deep-dive pieces on those slow days when the home-grown crew stays quiet. Today, the focus is on pitching, which is shaping up to be the dominant trend early in the season. Sure, there have been some absolute football scores on the board, but as the arms lock in and get warm with spring in full swing, the hurlers are settling down and hanging zeroes. It is time to start placing bets on who is going to chuck the next no-no. It makes sense because pitchers never stop developing nasty new stuff, making it incredibly difficult to barrel up the ball. It is starting to feel like a long time since August 2, 2024, when Blake Snell, rocking a San Francisco Giants uniform, went the distance for nine full innings and racked up 15 Ks to toss a masterpiece of a no-hitter against the Cincinnati Reds. Now Snell is wearing Dodger blue, and while the physical form is still catching up, the right-hander remains a dominant force on the bump.

# ---

![Ohtani.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/23wqe9V5NPbvWepA9tJBx5vihPeU66hvRE2mNZgwWfpqpRouNvVwCjBY3VQ2KCiFcUxes.jpg) Screenshot from [video](https://www.mlb.com/es/news/shohei-ohtani-lanza-contra-gigantes-no-bateara) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
#
     Entonces ¿Quienes son nuestros tres candidatos más fuertes, para lograr la hazaña? A éstas alturas de su carrera, Shohei Ohtani ha hecho todo lo que ha querido en el béisbol y sólo es cuestión de tiempo, para reunir los números suficientes y llegar al templo de Cooperstown. Pero ¿Qué no ha hecho todavía? Lanzar un no hitter ¿En cuanto están las probabilidades? Bueno, en sus seis primeras aperturas éste año, el fenómeno japonés reúne una EFE de 0.97 carreras limpias por cada 9 episodios lanzados. Ha ponchado a 42 oponentes en 37 entradas de labor y los bates contrarios le batean para AVE de .160, resultando todo en un minúsculo WHIP de 0.81. Y eso que su efectividad se vio dañada por dos cuadrangulares solitarios que le batearon en su última salida. Aunado a esto, ya no saldrá a batear en los juegos que funcione como abridor y está tejiendo una temporada digna de un premio Cy Young (sería el primero de su ilustre carrera). Entonces ¿Quién no pondría su dinero por apostar a que Ohtani lo logrará? Por supuesto, hablamos de probabilidades, pero las del samurai son bastante altas. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

      So who are our top three picks to go the distance and throw a masterpiece? At this point in his career, Shohei Ohtani has checked every box in the book, and it is only a matter of time before he punches his ticket to Cooperstown. But what is missing from his resume? Flipping a no-no. What are the odds? Well, through his first six turns on the bump this year, the Japanese phenom is sporting a microscopic 0.97 ERA. He has punched out 42 hitters over 37 frames of work, holding opposing bats to a measly .160 average, all resulting in a tiny 0.81 WHIP. And that is with his ERA taking a hit after giving up two solo jacks in his last outing. On top of that, he is no longer pulling double duty in the lineup on days he starts, putting him on track for a Cy Young caliber season, which would be the first in his legendary career. So who wouldn't lay down some cash on Ohtani pulling it off? Of course, it is a numbers game, but the samurai's odds are looking pretty good.

# ---

![Skenes.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/23zbTdCnm2WTwUWDCWVXyr9ncJe9yWmxdgiYMGA8pLVtFDsrMqENWhkjoZvTA2M5QsUs5.jpg) Screenshot from [video](https://www.mlb.com/es/gameday/rockies-vs-pirates/2026/05/12/823385/final/video) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
     Si usted no ha visto lanzar a Paul Skenes, no sabe lo que es mirar intimidación, al otro extremo del morrito. El último lanzador que yo recuerde en hacer temblar al bateador contrario fue Randy Johnson. Paul tiene más de dos metros de altura, es una masa de músculos haciendo wind-up hacia la goma, con pitcheos que rondan las 100 MPH. Sus últimas dos salidas han estado marcadas por lo magistral: ocho episodios cada una con más de 10 ponches. Incluso, en la última, no le dieron hit hasta el octavo episodio: un globito inofensivo detrás del campocorto. 56 ponches en 50 entradas, además de EFE 1.98 y diminuto WHIP de 0.91, además de limitar a sus oponentes a un AVE de .191, son credenciales más que suficientes para decir, con mucha seguridad, que es cuestión de tiempo antes de que lance su primer no-no. El hombre no se inmuta con nada y le pega la pelota al cuerpo a quien sea. Con esa clase de intimidación ya le consideran \

, un mote que se ha ganado a pulso en los barrios altos de Pittsburgh. Y con razón. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     If you haven't seen Paul Skenes toe the slab, you don't know what it is like to see pure intimidation on the bump. The last pitcher I can remember making hitters shake in their cleats was Randy Johnson. Paul stands at over six-foot-six, a house of muscle winding up toward the dish and firing absolute gas sitting around 100 MPH. His last two turns have been pure dominance, going eight frames apiece with double-digit punchouts. In fact, during his last outing, he carried a no-no into the eighth before giving up a cheap bloop single behind short. Racking up 56 Ks in 50 innings, paired with a stellar 1.98 ERA and a tiny 0.91 WHIP while holding hitters to a measly .191 average, gives him more than enough credentials to say that it is only a matter of time before he tosses a no-hitter. The guy has ice in his veins and is not afraid to pitch inside to establish the inner half. With that kind of intimidation, they are already calling him \

a nickname he has fully earned in the Steel City. And for good reason.

---

![Wheeler.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/23wgPhM7aerNcDDXoPcMyJhUxvnqE8cichTdySFGs2heWhLSGQ5S8WzMCGMrfkhQ93kxr.jpg) Screenshot from [video](https://www.mlb.com/es/gameday/phillies-vs-red-sox/2026/05/12/824764/final/video) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
     El último de nuestra lista es el abridor de los Filis Zack Wheeler. Quizás su efectividad acumulada de 2.55 no sea intimidante o sus 22 ponchados en 24 episodios no se vean especialmente extraordinarios. Pero hay algo que éste veterano posee y que es difícil de encontrar en estos días: eficiencia de pitcheos. La cantidad de lanzamientos determina cuan lejos se puede llegar en un juego y ¿saben ustedes cuántos lanzamientos necesitó en su última salida para sacar los primeros 3 episodios del juego? ¡16 pitcheos! Esto es 5 píldoras hacia la goma por entrada, menos de dos pitcheos por oponente. No fue sino hasta el 5to episodio de ese juego, en que un conteo llegó a dos bolas malas, imaginen eso. Desde el año 2000, sólo el venezolano Omar Daal (2001) había lanzado tan pocos pitcheos para sacar los primeros 3 innings ¡Y fueron 18! Dos más que los usados por Wheeler. El primer hit que aceptó fue bateado en el 7mo. episodio ¿Cuán cerca está de poder lanzar un no-no? Por supuesto, hay muchos más candidatos en las mayores, como Jacob Misiorowski o Dylan Cease, pero todavía tienen que madurar un poco antes de llegar a la forma necesaria para tirar un no hitter. Volveremos. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     The last guy on our list is Phillies ace Zack Wheeler. Maybe his 2.55 ERA doesn’t jump off the page, or his 22 punchouts over 24 frames don't look flashy. But this veteran has something that is hard to find in today's game: pitch efficiency. High pitch counts dictate how deep a guy can go, and do you know how many pitches he needed in his last outing to breeze through the first 3 innings? Just 16 pitches! That is about 5 bullets toward the dish per frame, less than two pitches per batter. It wasn't until the 5th inning of that game that he even reached a two-ball count, imagine that. Since the year 2000, only Venezuelan hurler Omar Daal back in 2001 had thrown fewer pitches to get through the first 3 frames, and that was 18! Two more than Wheeler's masterpiece. The first knock he allowed didn't come until the 7th. How close is he to flipping a no-no? Of course, there are plenty of other candidates in the Big Leagues, like Jacob Misiorowski or Dylan Cease, but they still need to mature a bit before getting in the right shape to toss a no-hitter. We'll be back.
