links.title: The Cadaver Pipeline: The Militarization of Donated Bodies in a Navy-IDF Network
links.body:
![w2.png](https://img.blurt.blog/blurtimage/web2.support/870946a659c0bdd4c154e8829fdbec643908a39b.png)

Freddie Ponton 21st Century Wire The revelation that a major US university has been quietly feeding bodies donated “to science” into a Pentagon pipeline for Israeli military training collapses the usual moral firewall between campus, the US security state, and Israel’s war machine. Recent student reporting by USC Annenberg Media and a follow-up report on the Al Jazeera documentary show that the University of Southern California has, for years, transferred human cadavers to the US Navy under paid contracts. Those cadavers were then used in trauma courses for Israeli military medical teams, including at the Navy Trauma Training Center at Los Angeles General Medical Center, without donors or families being told their remains could be used to train IDF soldiers. VIDEO: Israeli Military Medics Are Training On Dead Americans (Source: Al Jazeera English) . The underlying documents and investigations describe a straightforward commercial relationship: USC receives federal money to provide “fresh cadaver” bodies to the Navy, and the Navy, in turn, runs joint training that rotates US and Israeli medics through live-tissue style exercises on human remains. Administrators at USC’s Keck School of Medicine have defended the program as part of trauma education. Still, that framing obscures the core allegation: people who believed they were contributing to medical research and education were instead folded into a military-to-military partnership with the Israeli army, which is facing genocide proceedings at the International Court of Justice. The lack of explicit donor consent for that use sits at the heart of the scandal. Civil-rights advocates such as CAIR-LA have called the practice “disturbing” and demanded full transparency on how many bodies were used, what contracts were signed, and which units were trained. For Palestinian, Arab, and allied students already facing repression on campus, the idea that their own university is helping prepare Israeli medics for battlefield conditions in Gaza and the West Bank lands like a grotesque betrayal. What began as a niche campus investigation has quickly widened into a national debate over consent, commodification of the dead, and the deep institutional entanglement between US academia, the military, and Israel’s ongoing war. To dig deeper into how this pipeline was built and how USC is now scrambling to explain it, the article we are featuring today draws on Annenberg Media’s original campus investigation, which traced the cadaver contracts and their expansion, alongside Al Jazeera’s documentary “Israeli Military Medics Are Training On Dead Americans”, which puts faces, testimony, and hard numbers to a program that donors were never told existed. IMAGE: Navy Trauma Training Center then-director Travis Polk leads a tour of the facility in 2019. (9source: Courtesy of David Kolmel) Malik Gamble reports for USC Annenberg Media… Al Jazeera documentary highlights USC’s sale of dead bodies to US Navy, Israeli military Reporting by Annenberg Media, which was first published last year, exposed the sale of bodies from the University of Southern California and the University of California schools to the United States Navy. The Navy used some of these bodies to train Israeli military medical personnel. AJ+, a youth-focused, digital-only outlet part of Al Jazeera, released the documentary “Israeli Military Medics Are Training On Dead Americans” on Monday. Collaborating with Peabody Award-winning AJ+ show Direct From with Dena Takruri, it follows the story of two college newsrooms. Annenberg Media and the UC San Diego Guardian teamed up for one of the stories that followed the reaction of families whose relatives were donated to the program. The documentary looks at a series of stories and provides follow-up reporting. “The lack of transparency and informed consent for donors and their families is at the heart of this story and something we felt demanded deeper scrutiny,” wrote Takruri, the AJ+ senior presenter, to Annenberg Media. “What made this investigation especially important was revealing how a war many Americans perceive as distant is directly connected to institutions here in the United States.” USC’s sale of bodies to the Israeli military was first discovered by a USC-affiliated physician in 2024. “Every answer I found was more horrific than what I had imagined,” said the physician, who requested anonymity out of fear of retaliation, in an interview with AJ+. When 101-year-old Jeanette Volpin died, her body was donated to USC’s Anatomical Gift Program — but she was never informed of the possibility that it could be used to teach Israeli military medics. Her daughter Miriam said she was “furious” after reading the article. “It really has destroyed any trust,” Miriam said. Dr. Mohamad Raad, a USC-affiliated physician, talked about the lack of trust that arose in the aftermath of the reporting. “Even during the genocide, even when the Israeli army was bombing schools and hospitals and kidnapping physicians, these contracts were being renewed,” Raad said. “What happens when these institutions lose moral legitimacy?” UC Health only recently added to its FAQ page that donated bodies may be “shared” with other institutions and used to train military personnel. In a letter sent to Wendy Smith, who revoked her donation to UCSD after the Annenberg Media story broke, the school stated: “We will not be responding to factually inaccurate reporting by student reporters who have an agenda.” USC issued a statement to AJ+ through the Keck School of Medicine: “Our mission is to advance the highest standards of medical education and care for all people, and in the divided world we live in, it is even more important for us to carry out that mission irrespective of political ideology, social status, or creed.” The student journalists involved have said they hope the investigation will pave the way for more transparency between the schools and those who choose to donate their bodies. “We see the connections to our own university. I think just consistently our reporting reminds us that we’re a part of something much bigger than just our campus,” said Sasha Ryu, one of Annenberg Media’s investigative reporters. If you have any information regarding this program and its participants or would like to speak with Annenberg Media about this, please email millsjacksonn78@gmail.com or securely message @jmills08.99 on Signal. links.title: MCGI Topic Review | Depression and Anxiety — how to overcome this biblically
links.body: > https://youtu.be/rgandxgAJiA?si=bGSJmZzUMWYwEj_C Many people experience depression and anxiety and suffer silently from them every day. I was quite tired emotionally and mentally at some point in my life. I was happy, but frightened, irritated. At times I couldn't even describe my pain. However, with the help of God's Word, prayer and faith, I started to get a grasp that God does not want us to live in darkness for eternity. We are assured in the Bible that we can throw our worries on God and He cares for us. In 1 Peter 5:7, it states that we should, “Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.” This verse takes me the strain because I know I don't have to do everything by myself. Whenever I feel anxious, I attempt to pray with sincerity and not retain it within myself. Another way of biblically overcoming depression is to read the word of God every day. Sometimes it is the sadness which makes us feel inadequate or unloved, but God's promises bring hope. The Lord is near to those who are of a broken heart (Psalm 34:18). This is a reminder to God that He is not far from those in distress. When things get tough, I know this and it gives me strength. I also learned that my association with Godly people helps a lot. A troubled heart may be healed gradually by encouragement from the brethren, worship and fellowship. Anxiety may get worse when we isolate ourselves, but when we share our burdens with trusted believers, it's a time of peace and comfort. Philippians 4:6-7 also reminds us to pray about everything, rather than being anxious about anything. I think the real peace is in trusting God no matter how difficult life is. While it may not be a cure all, healing is possible with prayer, faith, patience and the word of God with regard to depression and anxiety. Joy, peace and hope are restored again by God.

links.title: Some People Only Exist in Our Search History Now
links.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPi5JGZqiuPRcVcCDNeBv9wn5DgdgmMiFdfZka1SE9HQK/img_4137.png)

There was a time when some people were part of our everyday life.
We knew their favorite songs, their typing style, the exact time they woke up, and even the mood behind a simple “hmm.”
Now, they only appear as a name in our search history.

It sounds strange how relationships can slowly turn into memories stored inside a phone.

Sometimes we search their profile not because we want to talk again, but because a small part of us still wonders how they are doing.
Are they happy now?
Did they finally achieve what they talked about for hours?
Do they ever search our name too?

The internet made people easier to find but harder to keep.

One search.
One profile picture.
One old username.
And suddenly hundreds of memories return together like a late-night storm.

We pretend we moved on, yet our fingers still remember their account name without typing it fully.
That is the scary thing about memories — they don’t really leave.
They just become quieter.

Sometimes people disappear without a proper goodbye.
No final conversation.
No dramatic ending.
Just slower replies, shorter texts, and eventually silence.

And somehow silence hurts more than anger.

The weirdest part is that social media keeps everyone frozen in time.
You can still see their old photos, old captions, old playlists… even when the connection itself no longer exists.
It feels like visiting a digital ghost town.

We often think heartbreak is only about losing a person.
But sometimes it is about losing the version of yourself that existed with them.

The “you” who smiled more.
The “you” who waited for notifications.
The “you” who believed certain people would stay forever.

Now everything lives quietly inside search bars, archived chats, and forgotten screenshots.

Maybe that’s why late nights feel heavier.
Because during the day we distract ourselves, but at night the mind starts searching for unfinished emotions.

Some people are no longer part of our lives.
But somehow, they still survive in tiny digital places:

Recent searches.
Saved songs.
Old passwords.
Draft messages never sent.

And maybe that’s the modern form of missing someone.

Not letters.
Not photographs in drawers.

links.title: My opinion about Red Magic
links.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNTvoYiSfy4GP14s9zK7hZYV5XqZYtNBtYwj8qjtwQDoj/1778684690514.png)
*Image created with ChatGPT* 

The Magi lottery is something that really excites me, even though I know there’s no guarantee of winning. I joined by depositing 1 HIVE into a raffle organized by @yecier, and even if it’s just a small amount, I love the idea of being part of a blockchain-based lottery. It feels different from traditional lotteries because here everything is done in a decentralized way, without depending on companies or governments.  




![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbPRDewB7WXL6LC2tn9pN93j6yyUMChiAffWegmuV9gHc/1778684718164.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmasGmZihS6ftzn8jLKxsu1wedTF7StcgadqAXyptXSrvG/1778684731141.jpg)




The @magi.network might sound complicated at first, but in simple words, it’s a project that expands what Hive already offers. Normally, Hive is used to publish posts, vote, and earn rewards, but Magi adds new features connected to cryptocurrencies. For example, it allows you to use Bitcoin inside Hive, swap between different digital coins, and even use smart contracts—which are programs that automatically carry out agreements without needing a middleman.  

What makes this possible is a system called TSS (Threshold Signature System). Basically, Hive witnesses sign transactions together as if they were one single signature. This makes everything more secure and trustworthy. To make it easier for users, there’s an app called Altera App, which works as a simple interface where you can deposit, swap, and manage your wallets. Magi also connects with well-known cryptocurrencies like BTC, LTC, DASH, DOGE, and BCH, opening up many opportunities.  

As for the lottery itself, the process is very straightforward: you buy a digital ticket with tokens, wait for the draw, and if your number is chosen, the prize goes directly to your wallet. The rewards are usually in HIVE or HBD, which makes it even more exciting because you’re not just playing for fun—you can actually win crypto with real value.  

What I like most is that everything happens on the blockchain, so the results are public and anyone can check them. That gives me confidence, even though I know this is still an experimental project. For me, the Magi lottery is a mix of entertainment and hope. I don’t know if I’ll win, but I’m thrilled to participate and feel like I’m part of something new in Hive.  

  *The photos are my property, taken with screenshots*

links.title: The Dead Yet to Arrive: What September 11 Reveals About the Health Effects of the Wars in Iraq and Ukraine
links.body:
>When the Twin Towers were toppled on September 11, 2001, 2,977 people died in New York City. This figure was engraved in memorials, is repeated on every anniversary of the tragedy, and is taught in schools across the United States.

After the World Trade Center collapsed, particles of asbestos, lead, mercury, arsenic, polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons, polychlorinated biphenyls, glass fibers, cement, and jet fuel residue were released into the air, settling over Lower Manhattan and into the lungs of everyone present.

The World Trade Center Health Program —established in 2010 and funded until 2090 by the James Zadroga Act— has identified more than 60 types of cancer affecting over 44,000 people to date. It has also documented respiratory diseases, neurological damage, cardiovascular conditions, and two dozen other illnesses directly linked to exposure at Ground Zero.

As of 2025, more than 3,800 people have already died from 9/11-related illnesses, surpassing the number of direct victims of the attack. I reference this fact because this event revealed something about war and massive fires that was unknown until now: beyond the official death tolls, there are other secondary victims who do not know they are going to die due to the inhalation of toxins in the days, months, and years following the main event.

Prior to the 2010 study, authorities claimed the air was safe. However, it was not. Firefighters who arrived on the morning of September 11 showed a 30% higher rate of prostate cancer and more than double the rate of thyroid cancer compared to firefighters from other cities without WTC exposure. By late 2024, 30% of the members enrolled in the program had a cancer diagnosis—compared to just 8% in 2007. The biological clock is still ticking.

The lesson left by the 9/11 tragedy is that the destruction of buildings is a form of toxic environmental pollution that extends far beyond the moment of collapse. The cloud of a destroyed city is not just dust. It is a slow-motion chemical death sentence affecting many who breathe it.

(Sources: World Trade Center Health Program, CDC/NIOSH, 2025; Scientific American, 2024; OncLive, 2025; Asbestos.com/WTC, 2025; WTC Health Program Statistics, 2025)

>Before asking what this means for Ukraine, we must look at what has already occurred in Iraq, as its tragedy serves as a long-term mirror of what sustained urban destruction does to a population's health.

A study published in the Iraqi Ministry of Health’s Cancer Registry, and cited in multiple peer-reviewed publications, shows that childhood leukemia cases in Basra more than doubled over a 15-year period (1993–2007). A 2009 report from the Health Improvement Directorate recorded 340 cases of leukemia between 2001 and 2008 in Basra alone—compared to just 17 cases in 1988. The national cancer incidence rate in Iraq rose from 38.91 per 100,000 inhabitants in 1994 to 78.93 in 2020; it nearly doubled in less than three decades.

The causes are multifaceted:

• Depleted uranium from munitions: It pulverizes into fine radioactive particles upon impact, contaminating soil, water, and air for generations.

• Burn pits: Open-air incineration pits used by military forces to dispose of waste—including electronics, medical equipment, plastics, and chemicals—which generated constant clouds of toxic smoke inhaled by both soldiers and civilians.

• The pulverization of buildings: Constructions containing asbestos, lead, and heavy metals—the same mechanism as Ground Zero, but repeated across entire cities for years.

(Sources: ReliefWeb/Ministry of Health of Iraq, 2009; PMC/Cancer Trends in Iraq 2000–2016; Journal of Contemporary Medical Sciences, 2024; MERIP, 2020).

* * *

>
If the collapse of two buildings in a single morning in one city produced decades of deaths for tens of thousands of people—and if Iraq shows us that sustained urban warfare creates a much larger analogous toxic footprint—what health damage will years of continuous bombardment produce over an entire country like Ukraine?

We are talking about cities like Kyiv, Mariupol, Kharkiv, Bakhmut, Kherson, Zaporizhzhia, among many others, where residential buildings, factories, hospitals, schools, fuel depots, and industrial facilities have been repeatedly attacked for years.

Science reveals the following:

• In Kyiv alone, less than a month after the start of the full-scale invasion, air pollution reached 27.8 times the safety limit recommended by the WHO.

• In the first 13 months of the war, 36 fuel storage facilities were destroyed, releasing pollutants from 108,000 tons of burning oil and gasoline.

• Chemical plants, fertilizer facilities, and industrial infrastructure were targeted, releasing substances that linger in the air for months.

• A 2024 study published in the Journal of Occupational Medicine and Toxicology stated that, once the war ends, thousands of people will require treatment for health conditions caused by environmental toxins—many of which have not yet been diagnosed.

Furthermore, a report from Brown University’s Costs of War project documented dangerously high levels of uranium and lead in cities that experienced sustained bombardment, including chronic diseases and potentially intergenerational health effects.

(Sources: International Organization for Migration, 2022; Journal of Occupational Medicine and Toxicology, 2024; Costs of War Project, Brown University).

* * *
>The Accounting We Are Not Doing

>September 11 has revealed something significant from a scientific standpoint. Occurring in the United States, in a wealthy city with world-class research institutions, it became the first disaster in modern history where the long-term health effects of toxic dust from destroyed buildings were systematically tracked for decades.
The official death toll in any conflict counts those who died from bullets, missiles, fires, and bombs. It does not count those who will die from the air they breathed while their city was being destroyed. The 9/11 monitoring revealed a truth that had not been documented until then: the destruction of cities does not only kill on the day it happens, but sows diseases that claim lives in the following decades.
A health program like the World Trade Center's does not exist in Ukraine. No long-term oncology registry is being built for the people who survived the siege of Bakhmut or lived for months in Kharkiv under continuous bombardment, breathing in what those explosions released into the air. The infrastructure for that type of accounting does not exist and, in the midst of a war, it is very difficult to build.
But the biological clock is already ticking for hundreds of thousands of people. The question of how many there will be—one million deferred deaths? two million?—is one that Ukrainian medicine has not yet raised on this scale, and for which there is no budget.

>That is why I am asking you directly: Have you seen the health effects mentioned in this post within your communities, or have you shown health problems after leaving Ukraine? Do you know of researchers or organizations in Ukraine conducting this type of long-term environmental and epidemiological monitoring?
I ask because I am working on a book titled \

, which addresses this issue from the perspective of the anthropology of disasters, a new field of study worldwide.
I do not have much data on what is happening to you. I do not have your experience. What I have is a pattern documented across three distinct historical events—New York, Iraq, and now the early data from Ukraine—pointing toward a future health crisis that is not being discussed. This is why any on-the-ground information you could provide would be invaluable to me.
With nothing further to add, sincerely, J.L.A.T.

* * *
>Sources cited in this post: • World Trade Center Health Program (CDC/NIOSH) — Program Statistics, 2025 • Scientific American — \
NIH  \n• ReliefWeb / Basra Health Directorate, Iraq — Cancer data, 2009  \n• MERIP — \

2013  
• Journal of Occupational Medicine and Toxicology — Environmental health in war zones, 2024  
• Costs of War Project, Brown University — Long-term environmental pollution  
• International Organization for Migration — Ukraine environmental impact report, 2022

**Note 1**. This post was translated from Spanish into English using Google Translate.

**Note 2**. All images were generated by Gemini AI.

links.body: > Lev discovered a hidden path that led us to a steep cable descent. After passing a melted corpse and a risky ledge, we were ambushed by a hiding Stalker. I used my hearing ability to eliminate a Clicker with a shotgun before fending off more Stalkers with Lev's help. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcC9mapJTP7DADFhbs3reg7tx7v7gkBXZGP4EzRrciWEZ/screenshot_1_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRrtcJvavuyJnTJYDfs4SpAD4qWaTN7M2JZiSEXk9y7s1/screenshot_2_.png) Lev found a way that I didn't noticed earlier, which first ascended us through a narrow crawlspace. We climbed higher of the building, just to look for a way to descend further into the darkness to reach the lower levels. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTEdyhYujN2KfQGNPrT2Cteh7u22o4stnfUg4KuvJVfXV/screenshot_3_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmegmzwTEbVkfJqnhGy8YP8k667p4mN9rVVY3wLzt6U1aA/screenshot_4_.png) As we found a big cable going downwards through a central shaft, I jumped on it without hesitation. While climbing down into the gloom, I noticed Lev was following me at the same time, moving with an agility that made the dangerous drop look effortless and easy. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZjkVFEjoC5ZepFcxSYq294RB54rCwbj4uzDwVhDhuULq/screenshot_5_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSSisPihPEpwVtqJNKUwjBC8sFnu96w2hCxWefmKm8hX3/screenshot_6_.png) After getting below on the floor, I noticed there was a melted dead body fused into the fungal growth. We then had to pass this risky edge of the collapsed floor, pressing our backs against the cold concrete to avoid falling into the abyss lurking just inches away. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPW5SPYPFJfyZFo3EbhPQH8vdAWigAxWKA5wecAcWrUxv/screenshot_7_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUvheSmKF8yaU7NwAD2JA2y7miGWVBAjrxdyYK8MHkb93/screenshot_8_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeM4V3UjV7EJVm7BXot1WjjVYU2oFZjkq7dCBh1MaKkku/screenshot_9_.png) Suddenly, this stalker attacked me out of nowhere, who was actually hiding inside a growth on the wall. I had to take care of it with quick melee strikes before it could sink its teeth in. The struggle was loud, echoing through the silent, spores-filled corridor. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma4Uy1coE6vUZb9NtPhcXW8xWgikAT4Mpzyz3zwNjXywg/screenshot_10_.png) Then on our way, I noticed there was a clicker relaxing against a doorway, who would attack me for sure if I stepped any closer. But fortunately, I used the hearing ability to pinpoint its exact location and movement. I stayed low, keeping my breathing shallow and controlled. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWpREUKLE9wmaoA8xBBib7ZoqRi4pL5Gqi4S4FDg6kS1A/screenshot_11_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUJgQy9MXDbWZHYvQt278K3gJM93ckYHiy53kZ6B2Kywy/screenshot_12_.png) After distracting the clicker to come out a little into the light, I shot it with shotgun shells. And when I went close to it to confirm the kill, I noticed the head of it was blown perfectly. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeSnhxyYdNSaqgtcUuDa1y5HT9q9b4y7AeNETXEj6qLni/screenshot_13_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeLVLmofjS4EXvoLHGDR1p4dTsChk7cwfekDpAsB4BGvr/screenshot_14_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW6ACoxwfTVa46kuyKRRHayD7WmFLFBXyxRfg52cspAcn/screenshot_15_.png) Then suddenly, another stalker attacked us on our way and caught us off guard from a dark side room. But it was no match for the two of us as Lev provided the distraction I needed to land a fatal blow. We were becoming a lethal team. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUQdrWyfZza9BtL9ZARKV9G5bGDZcsFiNbBZ8W5b35G2A/screenshot_16_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ1Ww99nFrDbUUTBkm79QTRrsZsLFpUoRSvaS5rKQYh7W/screenshot_17_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmehLRZ3TchWoYDgJULpxtm8CEPcsQPbMKsLhax9hXTJmF/screenshot_18_.png) When I was looking around to find an exit way, there came another stalker from behind a pile of rubble. I didn't give it a chance to get close to me as I opened fire and took it down real fast. The room finally went quiet again, for the time being. We'll check what happens next in another post. --- Image Source: In game screenshots. End of the post. Peace. --- ▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=bong1011/b141f496)

Fake AI: Rise of the Machines and a genocide in preparation [eng/срп] Лажна ВИ: Успон машина и геноцид у припреми
[![Rise of the Machines.mp4_snapshot_00.03.347.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lighteye/23u5zfci7p4DaLroTMT41Lr6BbedicFC368HrdnxSsrQLrz77QzGsHAx15gTpePUBKhhz.jpg)](https://swentr.site/shows/news/639831-rtnews-may-11-09msk/)

>So, China has released new guidelines for integrating AI across industries, focusing on fair competition, privacy protections, and worker rights…
The move follows a court ruling that companies cannot fire employees or cut wages simply because AI is being introduced. But that is China. The state that imposes a control over corporations.

On the other side of the World are the corporations who has their own states, and who are creating fake AI not to help people, but to enslave them. To control them, to make them doubt their reality. And even more important – to absolve of responsibility those who would control and hypnotize people into doubting their reality…

>

Дакле, Кина је објавила нове смернице за интеграцију ВИ у индустрији, фокусирајући се на фер конкуренцију, заштиту приватности и права радника…


Потез је уследио након судске пресуде да компаније не могу отпуштати запослене или смањивати плате само зато што се уводи ВИ. Али то је Кина. Држава која има контролу над корпорацијама.

С друге стране света су корпорације које имају своје државе и које стварају лажну ВИ не да би помогле људима, већ да би их поробиле. Да би их контролисале, да би их натерале да сумњају у сопствену стварност. И још важније – да би ослободиле одговорности оне који би да контролишу и хипнотишу људе да сумњају у сопствену стварност…

#### Rise of the Machines at YouTube. Duration / Трајање: 5:52 (енг.) https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HDXDoZ6RtcE
#### [Rise of the Machines](https://rumble.com/v79p55o-chinese-court-rules-companies-cannot-replace-workers-with-ai.html) at Rumble. Duration / Трајање: 5:11 (енг.)

[![Rise of the Machines.mp4_snapshot_05.21.739.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lighteye/23xAZphYzjpYYv5nVGgHyGqrb5qTwFM2kwfEXfVr6oDMucTYJfdCikj4hbux8N8DvGryx.jpg)](https://swentr.site/shows/news/639831-rtnews-may-11-09msk/)

#### [Rise of the Machines](https://bastyon.com/index?v=0b67d8a9ab522d4e60814c5a44a3c8cbe6e415971b477f0f441427446692c31c&video=1&ref=PKLvDiBvAsTbYDJhC1xNfby2GFnybCQpHn) at Bastyon. Duration / Трајање: 5:52 (енг.)
[![Rise of the Machines.mp4_snapshot_00.03.347.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lighteye/23u5zfci7p4DaLroTMT41Lr6BbedicFC368HrdnxSsrQLrz77QzGsHAx15gTpePUBKhhz.jpg)](https://bastyon.com/index?v=0b67d8a9ab522d4e60814c5a44a3c8cbe6e415971b477f0f441427446692c31c&video=1&ref=PKLvDiBvAsTbYDJhC1xNfby2GFnybCQpHn)

>

Of course, the West would not be the anti-civilization that it is if it did not first turn every technological development – into a weapon! However, there’s a big problem here: Fake AI can’t replace troops on the battleground. What can it do? In the words of Zach Vorhies, LLM can provide real-time reporting from the front. Great. It will be able to report back to the ukronazis practically instantly: “You know what? You’re mostly fu*** up!”

>

Наравно, Запад не би био антицивилизација каква јесте, кад од сваког технолошког развоја не би најпре правио – оружје! Међутим, ту постоји крупан проблем: Лажна ВИ не може да замени трупе на ратишту. Шта може? По речима Зака Ворхиса, ЛЛМ може да обезбеди прављење извештаја са фронта у реалном времену. Сјајно. Моћи ће да извести укронацисте практично тренутно: „Знате шта? Нај***ли сте!“

#### Zach Vorhies. Duration / Трајање: 9:08 (енг.) https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=E4Ta6h-WqOI
#### [Zach Vorhies](https://rumble.com/v79s7y8-interview-with-palantir-insider-and-google-whistleblower-zach-vorhies.html) at Rumble. Duration / Трајање: 9:08 (енг.)
[![Interview with Palantir insider and Google whistleblower Zach Vorhies.mp4_snapshot_09.07.905.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lighteye/23xefsqzY5NEFaBcveMU68rm3rz3tfwkZu9o9aAJ3pzo3Z5k3EgZxnhHccwaNF1P4crXV.jpg)](https://rumble.com/v79s7y8-interview-with-palantir-insider-and-google-whistleblower-zach-vorhies.html)

#### [Zach Vorhies](https://bastyon.com/index?v=fee2205770e06efc104c412d395a8595d0c24a2b2fb59f95e6b44cd155ea4e2b&video=1&ref=PKLvDiBvAsTbYDJhC1xNfby2GFnybCQpHn) at Bastyon. Duration / Трајање: 9:08 (енг.)
[![Interview with Palantir insider and Google whistleblower Zach Vorhies.mp4_snapshot_09.07.905.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lighteye/23xefsqzY5NEFaBcveMU68rm3rz3tfwkZu9o9aAJ3pzo3Z5k3EgZxnhHccwaNF1P4crXV.jpg)](https://bastyon.com/index?v=fee2205770e06efc104c412d395a8595d0c24a2b2fb59f95e6b44cd155ea4e2b&video=1&ref=PKLvDiBvAsTbYDJhC1xNfby2GFnybCQpHn)

>\n

\nWhat is presented to the public as a weapon for fighting foreign enemies and terrorists is actually unusable for these purposes. Even one of the creators of the freakish American policy, arch-neocon Robert Kagan,

>in an article in the magazine ‘The Atlantic’ admitted that the US lost the war against Iran, and that the consequences cannot be avoided!

So no Palantir will be able to change the situation on the ground. If we listen carefully to Vorhies, at 3:50 he says that AI can hallucinate, and then these hallucinations are incorporated into the reporting. He openly tells you there that the system is not reliable for serious warfare. And all these ‘mistakes’ are used to justify new investments in fake AI, ‘for the sake of improvement’, and in fact, for the opening of new data centers, which are – to go back to the beginning – a system of control and mass killing of people without responsibility!

All of you who follow me know that I’m always interested in solutions to problems. This time, the solution, believe it or not, was offered by the head of BlackRock, Larry Fink himself! You have to see this:

>\n

\nОно што се јавности представља као оружје за борбу против страних непријатеља и терориста, заправо је за те намене неупотребљиво. Чак је и један од креатора наказне америчке политике, архинеокон Роберт Каган

>текстом у магазину ‘Атлантик’ признао да су САДисти изгубили рат против Ирана, и да се последице не могу избећи!

Никакав, дакле, Палантир, неће моћи да промени ситуацију на терену. Ако пажљиво послушамо Ворхиса, он на 3:50 каже како ВИ уме да халуцинира, па су онда те халуцинације уграђене у извештавање. Он вам ту отворено каже да систем није поуздан за озбиљно ратовање. И све те ‘грешке’ користе се за оправдавање нових улагања у лажну ВИ, ‘ради усавршавања’, а заправо, за отварање нових дата центара, који су – да се вратимо на почетак – систем контроле и масовног убијања људи без одговорности!

# 隐秘的旅行目的地：发现不为人知的美丽

旅行是探索世界的绝佳方式，而有些地方却因其隐秘性而鲜为人知。今天，我们将带您走进一些隐藏的旅行目的地，帮助您发现那些不为大众所熟知的美丽景点。

## 1. **阿尔巴尼亚的贝拉特（Berat）**

贝拉特被誉为“千窗之城”，以其独特的奥斯曼建筑和迷人的山景而闻名。这里的老城区被联合国教科文组织列为世界遗产，您可以在古老的城堡中漫步，享受当地美食，感受浓厚的历史氛围。

### 必游景点：
- **贝拉特城堡**：俯瞰城市的壮丽景色。
- **安吉尔教堂**：一座保存完好的古老教堂。

## 2. **斯洛文尼亚的布莱德湖（Lake Bled）**

虽然布莱德湖在当地颇有名气，但仍然不如其他欧洲湖泊那么拥挤。湖中心的小岛上有一座迷人的教堂，周围环绕着壮丽的阿尔卑斯山脉，是一个完美的拍照地点。

### 必游活动：
- 划船到湖心岛，体验宁静。
- 在湖边的咖啡馆品尝当地的布莱德奶油蛋糕。

## 3. **葡萄牙的阿尔加维（Algarve）**

虽然阿尔加维以其美丽的海滩而闻名，但仍有许多隐秘的海湾和小村庄等待被发现。这里的悬崖、隐秘的沙滩和清澈的海水是完美的度假胜地。

### 隐藏的宝藏：
- **卡尔哈（Cacela Velha）**：一个风景如画的小村庄，拥有迷人的海滩。
- **拉各斯（Lagos）**：探索美丽的海岸线和隐秘的洞穴。

## 4. **日本的高野山（Koyasan）**

高野山是一个神圣的佛教圣地，位于日本的和歌山县。这里有许多寺庙和静谧的环境，非常适合冥想和放松。尽管这里吸引了一些朝圣者，但仍然是一个相对安静的目的地。

### 必游体验：
- **宿泊于寺庙**：体验传统的日本寺庙生活。
- **拜访奥之院**：感受历史和灵性的交汇。

## 5. **秘鲁的库斯科（Cusco）**

虽然库斯科是通往马丘比丘的门户，但许多游客往往忽视了这座城市本身的魅力。这里有丰富的历史遗迹、迷人的街道和独特的文化。

### 必游景点：
- **萨克塞华曼（Sacsayhuamán）**：古印加遗址，俯瞰整个库斯科。
- **库斯科大教堂**：融合了西班牙和印加建筑风格的美丽教堂。

## 总结

这些隐秘的旅行目的地不仅能让您远离人群，还能让您体验到更真实的文化和自然之美。下次计划旅行时，不妨考虑这些不为人知的地方，开启一段独特的探索之旅吧！

今天开始热起来，走在外面，感觉夏天可能真的要来了，估计特别热的时候，也快来了，之所以能看看太阳，晒晒太阳，主要是最近部门走了十几个人，要招一些人上班，欢欢今天可开心了，因为今天学校义卖活动。

昨天晚上我就帮准备了24瓶钦料，还有个2个福娃，还有三个笔记本，当作义买品捐赠物资，不管怎么样，学校活动动，当然得支持呀，欢仔早早就把50元钱准备好了，准备下午买东西吃了，这些家长捐的东西，然后孩子又去买，卖来的钱都捐给盆困山区了，搞这样的活动，挺好的，孩子又可以玩，而且还做了好事。

上班倒是很顺利，只是今天有几个同事交过来的单，总是弄错，我都检查了几次，退单给别人了，搞笑的是，有个同事既然把自已名字写错了，差点帮他出错机票。

这段时间也挺辛苦的，除了要上班，晚上九点后还要接欢欢回来，我平时习惯，晚上去凤山走走，这个月是没有机会去了，想着他的骨折有点烦的，希望早点好吧，也快二十多天，这孩子真的不让人省心。

爱心义买，售买得不错，家长捐赠品，既然买到了二千多，也算不错，如果有十几个教室，也有几万，也不是一笔不少的开销，欢欢说今天家长带的都是钦料，呵呵，可能太忙，没有时间准备其他的吧！晚上英语课还是很有意思，搞笑的是，今天来了三个大老板，在教我们，真的很开心，难得他们有时间这么齐心的教我们，真的很开心。

links.title: Aiselu: Hidden gem in hilly Nepal
links.body:
Himalayan orange raspberry, also known as Aiselu in Nepali language is one of the most consumed wild fruits in Nepal.

It grows naturally across the forests and slopes of Nepal especially during the spring season. 

For many Nepalese people, it is not just the fruit, it is the icon of climbing hill sides, wandering through the forests and friendship.

Apart from taste, it is also rich in antioxidants, vitamin C and natural fibres making is a good nutritional source.

It is also consumed by birds and wildlives, thus maintaining a good ecosystem in hilly Nepal.

links.title: Monomad: Elbow Falls Winter TIme
links.body:
No matter what the season, I find that Elbow Falls is such a great place to visit; even as a popular spot, I never feel like it's crowded. The pathways give many great views and are not too steep; the waterfall itself seems to be viewable from many angles. I think I was also there at a good time, as I wanted to do some long exposure, and the cloud cover helped in making things a bit darker, while the snow can be quite bright; it created a challenge that I was happy to accept. I wanted to make the water look smooth and silky, and with longer exposure, as many know, you are allowing a lot more light in, which can make things seem too washed out if you don't have the right settings.

links.title: 5 reasons (and 5 cards) why today is a great day in  Splinterlands.【 🇪🇸 - 🇺🇸 】
links.body:
> 

Saludos, gamers que dan vida a #Splinterlands. De nuevo por aquí para compartir con ustedes la expansión de mi colección de cartas doradas. Y es que cuando veo buenas ofertas, no puedo evitar comprarlas; mi billetera sufre, pero mi mazo crece.


> Greetings, gamers who bring #Splinterlands to life! I'm back again to share with you the expansion of my Golden Card collection. When I see good deals, I can't resist buying them; my wallet suffers, but my deck grows.

<center>![sep.2026.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/23tbPXTf1bvy4jaGNjptgQFy5gWYhWKJKS8g2jUuibSPhe56BuNS1C7amKtxLNKAEqeKn.png)</center>


<center>![1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/23w2DK9xbeWHK62vzzVRLicZTcAJjLZ6HGfJxqG23GqT9UJTMZfBNWdAYrcfpeawEzgC5.png)</center>


<div class=\

>

Así voy con mi avance en el juego: sigo estando en el rango de Gold I, uno de los rangos más difíciles que se me ha hecho alcanzar y por supuesto, mantener. Esto es así porque el juego, a medida que uno avanza en él, empieza a exigirle más, no sólo con las cartas sino a nivel estratégico y ese nivel estratégico es el que estoy intentando mejorar conforme pasan los días y voy jugando.

> So, here's how my progress in the game is going: I'm still in the Gold I rank, one of the hardest ranks I've ever reached and, of course, maintained. This is because, as you advance in the game, it starts to demand more, not only with the cards but also on a strategic level, and it's that strategic level that I'm trying to improve as the days go by and I keep playing.



|![Echelon_lv3_gold.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/2432KtYQYNyU9SKWcQhabs4kcHaeycTztTphbF6NaFBsc6HW6B5ffFJ7utyov8sY98jQb.png)|![Ember Roast Sow_lv2_gold.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/241tZ2k9AhmtgRWEY6DKh7ezBhotTaCTxaTRPXpSUPn2TZY6fuLk5Q9AXhw6yhS8H3PBS.png)|
|-|-|




<div class\

>

Compré un total de 10 cartas. Y esta vez las cartas no estaban tan caras como en otras ocasiones; sin embargo, aun así quise hacer mi inversión. Esta vez con cartas de fuego, neutrales y de tierra. Las primeras que adquirí fueron las de fuego. **Echelon** estaba a muy buen precio para el nivel máximo que se muestra y en su versión épica dorada más todavía, mientras que **Emer Roast Sow** estaba en oferta; no pude dejar de comprarlas todas para subirla de nivel.

> I bought a total of 10 cards. And this time the cards weren't as expensive as usual, but I still wanted to make my investment. This time I bought fire, neutral, and earth cards. The first ones I bought were the fire cards. **Echelon** was a great price for the maximum level shown, and even better in its golden epic version, while **Emer Roast Sow** was on sale; I couldn't resist buying them all to level it up.



|![Glimmermancer_lv2_gold.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/23xVCzYvgTWR5FDaqwXwsKGsR8WEWw3GxdDjKzwZLupYvYHh77jDW6NN7npeAxtQR36cf.png)|![Time Bandit_lv2_gold.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/23xyNUL9jSshTmiw9YguGPCA2Y5Vk73jReQfoyXuh7kMpmqqL2VS1DFw3j91a2u2AgXFv.png)|
|-|-|

Luego adquirí las cartas de tierra de **Glimmermancer** y **Time Bandit**. De la primera adquirí 3 para subirla de nivel y de la segunda, sólo una, porque estaba a buen precio. Ambas cartas las uso bastante en mis batallas y tenerlas en estas versiones aporta mucho a mis partidas.

> Then I acquired the land cards for **Glimmermancer** and **Time Bandit**. I bought three of the former to level it up, and only one of the latter because it was at a good price. I use both cards quite a bit in my battles, and having them in these versions adds a lot to my games.

<center>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/23y8mdzpVRi7Yx8pAkVvKTFvrQkzcrSt5y4yAC9ZaoMebtEyiB3S43GJs9P5prU9rX39Y.png</center>

<div class\

>

Por último y no menos importante, compré **Vengeful Monk** a un excelente precio de oferta. Vale la pena decir que mis compras habían terminado, pero cuando vi su precio enseguida la adquirí.


> Last but not least, I bought **Vengeful Monk** at a great sale price. It's worth mentioning that I had finished my shopping, but when I saw the price, I immediately bought it.


|![2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/23tkhcmWg6J8HnAdpsEeW861qoe7yZiJ5T5UCvWsNruh7Vxksta5eQuQQ87gEWfMkUXRa.png)|
|-|
|![3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/23tvAV4bxq3L2YZNgcq72qTFxp6gMWktZkWmCxFyTSb7UozuWtC9XM6BErX94BaVj1tp2.png)|
|![4.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/23tbLvevcH34KGty2YScw3adzmvUYyFduqZPVCt2FGqpF3sm8ZJoF6kyKphULVPvsQEvv.png)|
|![5.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/Eo44LJqhNBgWWrM7R4dbgu9pYfxGqdbY8zkHgCSnnPUA1kqJCmjfynnnLCoRgppFbPq.png)|
|![6.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/23tGVvGfm9RpuaF3xiTahryCKKKxwPfj66so2CfbCC971jfE5DU9ixdQ8WRUSRHWTSKha.png)|




<div class\

> Esta vez mi inversión fue menos excesiva que en otras ocasiones. Y es que cuando veo ofertas así no puedo evitar querer comprar cartas, sobre todo si son doradas legendarias, épicas o raras. Si llegaste al final de mi post, te doy las gracias infinitas por haberlo leído. ¡Hasta una próxima publicación! 🌸 > This time, my investment was less excessive than usual. When I see deals like this, I can't help but want to buy cards, especially if they're legendary, epic, or rare gold cards. If you made it to the end of my post, thank you so much for reading! Until next time! 🌸

links.title: Television Review: Chain of Command, Part II (Star Trek: The Next Generation, S6X11, 1992)
links.body:
![(source:tmdb.org)](https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/original/hvYWb8wxj25lmid7hdFiPNpCH4b.jpg)

**Chain of Command, Part II (S06E11)**

Airdate: 21 December 1992

Written by: Frank Abatemarco
Directed by: Les Landau

Running Time: 46 minutes 


In the realm of grand television series, the two-part episode structure carries an inherent peril, particularly when the instalments are helmed by different writers or directors. The first part often establishes such a high standard of tension, character depth, and narrative intrigue that the concluding segment risks feeling like an inevitable letdown, a mere mopping-up operation that fails to deliver on its predecessor's promises. *Star Trek: The Next Generation* deftly sidestepped this trap with its sixth-season episode *Chain of Command*. While [the first part](https://peakd.com/hive-166847/@drax/television-review-chain-of-command-part-i-star-trek-the-next-generation-s6x10-1992) is a very good piece of television—setting up a compelling change of command and a covert mission gone awry—the second part is arguably even better. It transcends its bottle-episode constraints to deliver one of the most psychologically harrowing and memorably intense instalments in the entire franchise, a testament to the power of performance and writing over spectacle.

\

deals immediately with the consequences of Captain Picard's capture by the Cardassians. Aboard the USS *Enterprise*-D, the newly installed Captain Edward Jellico must deal with negotiations that have turned palpably more hostile. Gul Lemec coldly informs Jellico that Picard is in Cardassian custody and, crucially, that he will not be afforded the protections of a prisoner of war. The Cardassian rationale is brutally pragmatic: for Picard to be recognised as a POW, the Federation would have to publicly admit its covert action on Celtris III—an admission that Admiral Nechayev, embodying Starfleet's realpolitik, is utterly unwilling to make. Simultaneously, a Cardassian proposal to release Picard in exchange for a Starfleet retreat from strategic sectors goes nowhere, leaving the captain in a legal and diplomatic limbo. It is within this stifling atmosphere that Commander Riker, embodying the crew's loyalty to Picard, suggests a rescue mission. Jellico, however, overrules him with a steely, uncompromising logic that prioritises the broader strategic picture over individual life. The resulting clash is a fundamental collision of leadership philosophies, culminating in Riker being temporarily relieved of his post as first officer.\n\nThe episode's true centre of gravity, however, lies in a stark, oppressive Cardassian interrogation room. Here, Picard is subjected to a relentless and sophisticated torture regimen orchestrated by Gul Madred. The objective is not merely to punish but to extract strategic information regarding Starfleet's defensive plans for the Minos Korva sector. Picard truthfully insists he possesses no such knowledge, but Madred, a master of psychological warfare, proceeds undeterred. The physical degradation is immediate and humiliating: Picard is stripped naked, hung from the ceiling, and has a pain-inducing device surgically implanted in his chest. Madred, who pointedly allows his young daughter, Jil Orra (Helen Lauren Olson), to witness his work, employs a chilling array of psychological manipulations alongside the physical torment. His ultimate goal is to break Picard's perception of reality itself, famously demanding that the captain look at four glaring lights and confess to seeing five. Picard's repeated, defiant assertion—\

—becomes a mantra of resistance. Yet, the episode masterfully charts the erosion of that resolve; the physical agony and psychological isolation exact a terrible toll, making each denial feel increasingly fragile.

Aboard the *Enterprise*, a parallel strategic narrative unfolds with quiet ingenuity. Chief Engineer La Forge, examining the Cardassian delegation's ship, discovers microscopic traces of a rare particulate matter found only in the nearby McAllister C-5 Nebula. From this forensic clue, he deduces the presence of a hidden Cardassian invasion fleet. Jellico, demonstrating the tactical acumen that justifies his command, authorises a daring plan: using shuttlecraft, the *Enterprise* crew will covertly seed the nebula with antimatter mines, effectively trapping the Cardassian armada. The plan's success hinges on piloting skill of the highest order, forcing Jellico to swallow his considerable personal dislike and reinstate Riker for the mission. This narrative beat is crucial, transforming their conflict from petty squabbling into a professional respect forged under pressure. Riker executes the manoeuvre flawlessly, and the Cardassians, realising they are caught in a tactical checkmate, have no choice but to retreat and, as a bargaining chip, agree to Picard's release.

This liberation arrives at the most critical psychological moment. Madred is subjecting Picard to yet another session, demanding he acknowledge the fifth light. As Picard gathers his will for another refusal, he notices the arrival of guards. Realising his ordeal is over, he summons a final, magnificent defiance, snarling \

back at his tormentor. The victory is profound, but the episode refuses a simplistic triumphalism. In a deeply poignant scene back on the *Enterprise*—after Picard has resumed command from Jellico—he confides in Counsellor Troi. With raw, unvarnished honesty, he admits that had the torture continued, he would have been broken. He would have said he saw five lights. This admission of human fragility, from a character often portrayed as an unshakeable paragon, is the episode's most devastating and important moment.

Written by Frank Abatemarco and directed by series veteran Les Landau, *Chain of Command, Part II* is not an episode rich in visual pyrotechnics or action set-pieces. It compensates entirely through the sheer force of its drama. The torture sequences are intensely visceral, featuring an uncharacteristic level of nudity for 1990s network television (though strategically lit, Patrick Stewart was reportedly fully nude on the closed set). The depiction of sustained physical and psychological violence was so stark that the episode faced censorship in several international markets. Its power derives from a disturbing authenticity. Abatemarco and Stewart consulted extensively with Amnesty International, reviewing video testimonies and documentation to ground Madred's techniques in real-world interrogation practices. Furthermore, the literary shadow of George Orwell's *1984* is unmistakable, particularly the scene where O'Brien breaks Winston Smith by forcing him to betray his own sensory evidence about the number of fingers held up.

The episode also serves as vital piece of franchise world-building, providing seminal insight into Cardassian society. Madred, in a rare moment of ideological exposition, explains that his people were once enlightened pacifists, whose subsequent descent into poverty and scarcity made them embrace militarism and expansion as a means of survival. This nuanced motivation, painting the Cardassians as products of tragic history rather than cartoonish villains, provided a foundational template that *Deep Space Nine*—which premiered mere weeks after this episode—would explore in magnificent detail over its seven-season run.

Ultimately, the episode's greatest asset is the towering performance of David Warner. The esteemed English actor, who remarkably attended the same acting school class as Patrick Stewart yet had never before shared a screen with him, delivers a masterclass in subdued menace. Warner had previously appeared in two *Star Trek* films (*[The Final Frontier](https://hive.blog/hive-166847/@drax/film-review-star-trek-v-the-final-frontier-1989)* and *[The Undiscovered Country](https://hive.blog/hive-166847/@drax/film-review-star-trek-vi-the-undiscovered-country-1991)*), but it is his portrayal of Gul Madred for which he is most remembered by Trekkies. He is neither a raving lunatic nor a sadistic monster; he is a chillingly rational, almost paternalistic figure, convinced of his cultural and personal superiority. His calm, methodical cruelty, juxtaposed with moments of apparent kindness towards his daughter, creates a villain of profound and unsettling complexity. His scenes with Stewart are nothing short of electrifying, a duel of acting titans that elevates the material into the realm of classic drama.

*Chain of Command, Part II* stands as a landmark not only for *The Next Generation* but for television sci-fi as a whole. It boldly replaces phaser battles and technobabble with an unflinching examination of torture, resilience, and the limits of the human spirit. By focusing on character and ideology, and by being anchored by two phenomenal performances, it achieves a depth and emotional resonance that few other episodes in the series can match.


RATING: 8/10 (+++)

links.title: WISDOM IS PROFITABLE TO GUIDE ANYTIME
links.body:
Hello 👋 pals, it's another beautiful moment of sharing beautiful thoughts and memories about things, people and places.

This is me saying that not every opportunity is worth taking.

In a world that glorifies speed and constant movement, many people believe every opportunity must be grabbed immediately.

But wisdom says otherwise.

Just because something looks attractive doesn’t mean it is right for you.
Just because a door opens doesn’t mean you are supposed to walk through it.

![17786841606563411368850799173743.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnpetra/AKPnDDmmpQMFobkjuZPkKnTHE41LwdT8WfbivhZVx9GG2wRkCTmy7KBoNNLGx7r.jpg)


Some opportunities bring growth.
Others bring distraction.
Some may give quick rewards but damage your values, peace, or long-term future.

That is why calculated thinking matters.
Before saying yes, pause and ask yourself:

What if this opportunity costs me my integrity?
What if the short-term gain creates long-term regret?
What if saying yes to this means saying no to something better later?

Here’s a mindset to remember:

If it compromises your values → reject it.
Else consider it wisely.
Not every opportunity deserves urgency.Some deserve observation first.

![IMG_20260512_123810_501.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnpetra/AKJ1JRGK29aNJ1dVcqLywnxU9s4YYVebECcQLctwi2vCU4kiYqsYZgtgz9LR7pA.jpg)


Wise people don’t just ask,
“What can I gain?”
They also ask,
“What could I lose?”

Because success without character eventually becomes destruction.
Patience gives you time to evaluate clearly.
Morals help you choose correctly.

And sometimes, the most powerful decision you can make is saying no to something everyone else is chasing.

Don't always forget but remember that a good opportunity should not force you to abandon your principles.

Think carefully.Choose wisely.Protect your future.
It's a Truth at a time and you're reading from your handsome friend John Petra!

links.title: Monomad: Nighttime skatepark [Eng/Esp]
links.body:
>

This is my entry for the #monomad challenge.

Depending on which photographer you ask, taking photos at night can be really tricky, and many (myself included) prefer not to do it. But when you’re in a situation where you have no other choice, you do the best you can. Today I’m sharing these photos I took at the skatepark at night; I hope you enjoy them.

Dependiendo de a qué fotógrafo le preguntes, el hacer fotografías en la noche puede ser muy complicado y muchos (así como yo) prefieren no hacerlo, pero cuando estás en un lugar y no queda más opción, se hace lo mejor que se puede y hoy les comparto estas fotografías en el skatepark en la noche; espero que las disfruten.


https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23tRxGDyV5jMBagm4K37oAe2LsFf61qqpTUcKr3eDKM2iL2NZjkExrJGT5o5ScvPmoQju.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23tvB2n3uY6TuapfajZDSqx69NWqxbhSEWqyWyJJDQa3Rm6PPqdyMjPpwwvhiwTvfE8KX.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23u5zfbc1BSR8tmLfusbL3qsnTadNB3WfikDpop5Sf7hQdk9idbSdaqLon5dnCzoUZJtL.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23uQp4ugjnoC3crKRN42mCEKdXGq4e2s9nRvfiPcVMJjzKgihtcupGWsxkoDMt8k6oyq7.jpg

>

Obviously, two things you need for night photography are a subject and light, the light helps you focus on your subject and luckily, the lights at the skatepark were what helped me with this; I also had to increase my camera’s ISO.

Evidentemente, algo que necesitas para hacer fotografías en la noche es un protagonista y luz, la cual te ayudará a enfocar a tu protagonista y, por suerte, las luces del skatepark fueron las que me ayudaron en este proceso; además, también tuve que aumentar el ISO de mi cámara.


https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23tSKwpd6xNtCfDNMia75nAiv3caHKxhV6MC4w4skpHFZqfA49W1PozZWZehPDxkikseM.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23y8mMBA4VV4MG6QFpj1dGYMFUjUgnZjEqhCxjTaK6n4224gYi8reoy6TzvTBn77y3PWh.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23uQg3McCuxdgRkiQPvjTgVrytqpNk3nSx8JPMA6xERkxXx6p6eQthjMUs169ja3xLov1.jpg

>

Personally, I’m not a fan of noise, at least not the kind my camera produces in photos, but to be honest, I didn’t complain much this time around; I think I did the best I could with what I had on hand, and that’s worth something in itself, especially when you’re trying to take photos while your subjects are constantly moving.

Particularmente, no soy amante del ruido, al menos no el que hace mi cámara en las fotografías, pero para esta ocasión no me he quejado mucho, la verdad; creo que logré lo mejor que pude hacer con lo que tenía a mi mano y eso también tiene cierto valor, más intentando hacer fotografías mientras tus protagonistas están en constante movimiento.


https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23tSN1tsGFwgEZ7AbCXt2McQoHyJMTL2bqwYyqksA2DEzC7i1rfD46gLCmJhG3qKHn5sv.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23tvW4EYJw59FLj2EN7SapuvGp978ZZVGhi3E1jakDks76qVEQPXdxUtSKU8bcF6N1R75.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23wC2yRj6voxwBcaGA6rzbfAKKKzDMmHTp9srAhQTVhz94REwVNEF9rrDCGRgn4dZJmDL.jpg

>

That's all for today; as always, thank you for taking the time to look at my photos again, I really appreciate it. I hope you all have a great Wednesday and wish you all a wonderful day. See you next time!

Esto es todo por el día de hoy; como siempre, les agradezco por tomarse el tiempo de ver mis fotografías un día más, lo aprecio bastante. Deseo que todos tengan un excelente miércoles y espero que todos tengan un estupendo día. ¡Hasta la próxima!

/>

Pankkisiirto live casinoon voi hidastaa prosessia, jos kasino venyttää käsittelyä. Kotiutusajat kannattaa katsoa ennen kuin euronkaan antaa mennä sisään.

Kun KYC-tarkistus on hoidettu heti alkuun, kotiutus ei yleensä jää siitä kiinni. Muuten saat odottaa kuin VR:n korvauspalautusta.

### Talletus Ja Kotiutus Arjessa

Arjessa hyvä polku on simppeli: talletus näkyy heti, pelaaminen alkaa nopeasti ja kotiutus menee eteenpäin ilman turhaa odottelua. Pelaaja näkee tämän suoraan omalla tilillä, ei pr-tekstissä.

Mobile live casino pitää toimia puhelimessa ilman, että kaikki näyttää siltä kuin olisi venytetty väärään kokoonsa. Responsiivinen pelialusta ja viiveetön yhteys näkyvät heti.

Moni avaa live pöydän bussissa tai sohvalla, joten mobiilin pitää olla oikeasti käyttökelpoinen. Jos nappulat on liian pienet, peli on heti hankala.

Hyvä sivusto toimii puhelimessa niin, että tekstit, pöydät ja painikkeet pysyvät järkevinä. Ei tarvitse zoomata jokaista liikettä varten.

Kun alusta mukautuu ruutuun kunnolla, pelaaminen tuntuu paljon selkeämmältä. Tässä kohtaa erot näkyvät heti.

Selaimessa pelaaminen sopii monelle, koska peli aukeaa nopeasti eikä erillistä sovellusta tarvita. Suora videolähetys toimii niin kauan kuin yhteys pysyy kunnossa.

Jos haluat päästä pöytään ilman ylimääräisiä vaiheita, selainversio on usein se helpoin tie. Yksinkertainen on tässä usein paras.

### Sovelluspohjainen Pelaaminen

Sovelluspohjainen pelaaminen auttaa, jos haluat pitää oman pelitilan vakaana. Se voi tuntua mukavalta etenkin, jos pelaat usein samalla laitteella.

links.title: Lagos Has Accepted You
links.body:
>




Chinedu forgot to turn off the pot of beans when he first got it on the stove, and slept off, in his one room apartment.

He was awakened at 2:13 AM and began to cough as if it were an old generator. There was a lot of smoke in the room. The pot changed color and had become black. Even the beans were unhappy!

“Ahn-ahn!”, his neighbour shouted out at the door, pounding the door. \
Excuse me, sir, but it was due to traffic.”\n\n\

Chinedu was silent and sat at his desk.

His phone vibrated.

Mummy.

He didn't move his lips but his smile turned into the answer.

“How are you, my son?”

“I’m fine, Ma.”

“Have you eaten?”

Chinedu looked at the pure water and gala on his table.

Smoothly he lied, \
Your rent balance is still two weeks.The man said, \

now you will wash your own clothes.

“Unfortunately.”

Ada laughed loudly. You have to suffer, “so you have suffered.”

“A little.”

“Can you send me money for shawarma?”

“look at this little girl.”

“Please na.”

He looked at his bank statement and lowered his head in dismay.

“You guys believe that Lagos is heaven.”

“Is it not?”

Chinedu glanced around his small room. The fan was unstable if it spun too rapidly. One lizard was standing on the wall, just like a house inspector.

Finally, \

he said. “But I've got used to it now I think.” For two days that night had brought darkness, but electricity suddenly came back. The whole compound broke out in rejoicing. “Up NEPA!” Music played in some way down below. Children were running about happily. Chinedu was standing by his window and smiling. Afterwards, his cell phone buzzed. Salary alert. He blinked, before coming back to check again. The cash was in. Right away he burst out laughing. Not a cool laugh. Not a mature laugh. He heard a roar of laughter, a joyful sound that resounded throughout the space. From the outside, Mama Tobi called out from her door, “Why you laughing like somebody that won bet?” Chinedu came out with a smile on his face. “Today I can purchase chicken, for I'm not hungry anymore.” Mama Tobi clapped her hands, and it was dramatic. “Ah! You are accepted here now, Lagos.” Chinedu thought maybe for the first time since she moved into that small flat it was possible she was correct.

The Roland SN-R8-04 Electronic is a vintage ROM expansion card designed for the R-8, R-8 MKII, and R-8M drum machines. It features 26 high-quality, 16-bit digital samples that replicate the classic sounds of the legendary Roland TR-808 analog drum machine. The card includes iconic kicks, snares, and cymbals alongside unique reverse waveforms, synth bass, and gated percussion effects. When plugged into a compatible drum machine, these sounds can be deeply edited using real-time parameters like pitch, decay, and velocity-sensitive nuance control. It remains highly popular among electronic music producers for its punchy, mix-ready sound profile that easily fits into techno, house, and hip-hop tracks.

---

World War Heroes is a war-based game. It is a mobile game. It is a very interesting game. Where the game is played in the environment of World War II. Many types of weapons can be used like in World War II. It is played online. I liked the game the first time I played it. Its graphics and sound quality give a realistic vibe. It makes the game very realistic.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVKhRYPo7676rfXPtz8payiH6umiAKJpbQ6L4QVNyRCgr/img_3416.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmavHHybt77RBttPQt9CdjpDDLWaZZAdLfP1DPPWqEVqNb/img_3417.jpg)

The game is often played in free time. The game has different moods. As soon as you enter the game, you can see many other moods including team death match, bomb defuse, free for all. Most of the time, I play team death match. There, many people defeat the opposing team. My team has unknown players from different countries. We all go to the battlefield together. We defeat the opposing team. Sometimes we ourselves are defeated.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRdsxxYF4SiqcR4VsyP1zWCfW5uUdFUMffpQZfe8KMAS1/img_3418.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPdfAcfbrSgJ4KXwBmqKAiShopfEUwRZNy5DPD3FHB9f4/img_3419.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRoWaDoJQ5nNfq6qVoEAoVU39te52ztzGywifqcdEPKJE/img_3420.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTv1F7hNrPv1ChQQ1vp5orEnRhxAwuSPYDudYcsiJQgcH/img_3422.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRUmDpjm6RfjNHgR2gpprcf9K6KYtwDKjjUGAytQSLiVj/img_3423.jpg)


There are many types of weapons in the game. Such as snipers, shotguns, rifles and submachine guns, etc. There are many more terrible and powerful weapons. The most fun is shooting with a sniper. You can shoot from a long distance. And when the target is right, when the enemy character falls to the ground, I feel like a professional sniper. I feel a different peace in my mind. If you win the match, you get a lot of coins. Along with that, you get many other prizes.With these coins, weapons can be updated later, new weapons can be obtained. Weapons can be made more powerful. This increases interest in the game.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVyDNUcuvduYLGrV86DHPaeiJYdrhtV1dBRca2qxDHDGh/img_3424.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQomiDaEtRQ8MjnKMmCnEEYconYS43gK6R1w4Yo8KCeoG/img_3426.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUcasiNcFNdY3yn2RKsVVzGmB8CGyeftScWEjddnv7oiG/img_3427.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfRVT66GQL7vWxXNYPLMbjJPKrfmrNZHoPDwAMWGtvV8q/img_3428.jpg)

A good game to feel good in your free time. Since you have the opportunity to play in a team, it creates a good experience of patience and teamwork. You can also learn and understand how to do what to do during the war. A game full of excitement and learning. 


Thanks for watching this video.

---

links.body:
Today, I am excited to introduce a special piece of digital art I’ve recently completed—a beautiful Chrysogonum Virginianum Flower photography. This photos means a lot to me because I put a lot of effort into creating it.

These photos have been taken by my smartphone Mi note 11 before editing .





![C3TZR1g81UNaPs7vzNXHueW5ZM76DSHWEY7onmfLxcK2iQbJEpajuPu8yXEFtnj3TAkWSFDL7asuynvHDQPM75hAofKCf9essJHVGEGwafJq6AZJyDE4nNA.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kidivi/AJmqzaLQXzBteW9pPyRTD1Wi5D8qbEEM9KNYWg1ZXmRN3V9GKGQfXJ7M4RXmmRM.png)


I didn’t do it all on my own; I relied on a few different Android apps on my phone to help me shape the image into something I’m happy with. Each app played an important role, whether it was for adding color, adjusting shadows, or fine-tuning details. The result is a vibrant, lively piece that captures the beauty of the beautiful flower in a fresh and modern way.




![C3TZR1g81UNaPs7vzNXHueW5ZM76DSHWEY7onmfLxcK2iPPX5FZtPz5UeeC5drERuuMzE9pH4VjjCQsLuzdDdBAmDULwdupJHqGTkJa3Cq6srRvJuhip6Un.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kidivi/AKDgxX4SAysN99TxX8XuDisYbQzC7yTz6iKdLXLR4Bh1xBSmS21iQ7pEr7v4bFh.png)



So, I hope you enjoy this piece and find some inspiration from my journey. Whether you are a fellow artist or just someone who appreciates colorful, lively images, I invite you to explore your own creative side.

links.title: カウシェ-Web3よりWeb3っぽいWeb2アプリ
links.body:
マルコ最近農業やってます！

2ヶ月くらい前からやってるんですが、既に2品目収穫できました。

お米と玉ねぎ。

農業って肉体労働で大変ってイメージですよね？
でも僕の場合、寝転んで指でスマホをポチポチしてるだけ。
経営者で沢山小作人雇って口先と指先で指示してるの？
いえいえそんないい立場じゃないですw

『カウシェファーム』
って農作物育成ゲームの中で農業してるってわけです。

WebCMでけっこう流れてくるので知ってるかもしれませんが、ゲーム内で育てて収穫した農作物が実際に家に届く、という面白いサービスです。
最初聞いた時は胡散臭さ満載でした。

ものは試し、自分でやってみました。


![IMG_1522.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marcomedia/23u69dJZrhBMToigqyJ3qREMCCm2AkQ9SF5t8oCHmZBBToJU8AviZuhzUJRXVLGX1ZuK1.jpeg)

![IMG_1523.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marcomedia/23u6Fi5Kb6Q4prFf7DgoXjYMUvGjFFM98ZY8w1YcNpcF8G55HNtzGaVD9G4TAAmaAhFUq.jpeg)

ちゃんと届きました！
ウソじゃなかった😊

ゲーム内で育てたのはこの子↓


![IMG_1375.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marcomedia/23wX7nz1FoEaYGoMeGS351XfW2t1o8E1bprQDyuN9iwXVmeG1FViSj2ECw4ochic6gmCn.png)

![IMG_1374.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marcomedia/23wMcpAjazjv8A5s177o7PE9McPmd746trMw5RiP2n5jrmTcFNbxyvATvqeqeDHE5KinB.png)

可愛いでしょ？

育て方は大まかに言うと、

朝昼晩にログインや広告など見て、「水」と「肥料」をGETして、ひたすらそれらを作物にあげるだけ。
経験値が一定以上貯まるとレベルアップして形態（1-6）が変わり、6段階目で経験値がMAXになると上の画像のようにHarvest（収穫）できます。

育てられるのはお米の他にも、
玉ねぎ
ジャガイモ
にんにく
トマト
お茶
等、複数あります。

詳しくは今後ブログで書いていこうと思います。

そして、収穫したゲーム作物はいくつかのブランドから実物の作物を選んで、家に届けてもらえます。

これってなんかWeb3のRWA系の仕組みっぽくないですか⁈

RWA（Real World Asset）とは:不動産、農作物は、金、法定通貨など現実世界の資産の事。

Web3ではRWAをトークン化してオンチェーンで売買•管理•所有する流れが来ています。

『カウシェファーム』、なんだか方向性がそれっぽくないですか？

Web3じゃないけど、体験はWeb3なWeb2サービス。
最高です😊

皆さんも一緒にゲーム内で作物育てて、リアルで作物ゲットしませんか？
招待コード使って登録すると、水やりの効率が上がる肥料が貰えます☺️

⚫️招待リンク

育てた作物を無料でゲット！？
カウシェファームでいっしょに遊びませんか？

このリンクからカウシェファームを始めると、お得な報酬ももらえます🎁

https://kauche.go.link/jAVyQ?openExternalBrowser=1

一応、招待コードも載せておきますね☺️
招待コード: 6VAQBHW

皆さんは最初育てるとしたら何を育てたいですか？
コメントで教えて下さいね♪

links.title: Trip Down Memory Lane
links.body: One of the advantages of this digital era we're living in right now is, that there could be evidence of almost everything. There's a word, digital footprint and if you know what it is, or what it means, you know how many we leave behind. Yesterday, while I was searching for some photos of my laptop and components, came across a lot of nice photos I took a few years ago and today I thought I take a walk back memory lane and post some of them. The reason is the changing seasons. ![Trip Down Memory Lane.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/48YdaCL8NPiVQBPheTYwbVHShG7ZH3YAPc4HJGsGoscESn8jENLYBorwYYTfAsao6s.jpg) My country officially has four seasons. Yes, you read it right, I wrote officially, because in reality we only have three. Some seasons are extended and some are non existent, like spring for example, or should I say we have a couple of weeks of spring, then jump into summer with both feet. Winters have become more milder and longer as well. The fact that temperatures are mild, doesn't bother me much, if you want real winter with snow and low temperatures, you can still go up to the mountains, but getting more grey, gloomy days is not something I fancy. Anyway, let's see what I brought to you today. ![20221114_110756a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23ywnxj4NShP3MWmGuzeWYXEDTj6rPKax3ttS9yo1qPZWfDm9T6MfaiHzJsAUNj3NAmJp.JPG) This photo was taken in November, 2022, the last time I saw fog. This is my favorite place to go to, when it's foggy, but unfortunately there's never enough foggy to be able to take the photo I like. ![20221114_110855a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/EnWJY1kxZ6ne1F8gqinpvYe4CAh6neoQVfpguMW3htGkWviapna28i6n8zxJExykhws.JPG) This is the best you can get, which is not enough for my taste. ![20221114_110610a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/EpLfbRp2e2b4ZjwucovMhUJHMNQ7M9DBqQizGCZKMMQpngHPixCe24QZzWc3yddyAeC.JPG) ![20221114_110733a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/EpzyB42U5KxAzmrMhEmx86KEZtJBRkUojksqdauwREkLenVLhSnJjzFUkbvQzEGjZaA.JPG) The reason I like this place so much is because there are two very cool U turns and if the fog is dense enough, you can see the road disappearing, then appearing on the other side of the photo. Please disregard the bin and the scooter. There was no way to avoid them. ![20221114_111237a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23xejdi9m3pRPnmraGk7f2yj2QtQ1yowezUzfCQxQq8jCCopzjraCCdMwQbw5jxJv8c8V.JPG) ![20221114_111223a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23y8uoMbXkEtbUTWAcBWxZkUnNiCpbTZnRVtytiyGJZ2r9aaCVBqmm2fpvRp2Ca9Zh3Ds.JPG) I remember I took this photo the same day and never found it after, till now. This is some kind of tinder, grown on a tree and found it interesting. ![20221114_111459a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23yTh7h4cS5t3pBmLnSYJJXNt5L2TCBDe4UfiqNyUhCBVbhuXuKSTU5pvPkuAnKUDf1p2.JPG) Another thing I love to photograph late autumn or early winter is the fruit of the ivy. Yes, it's not grapes, these are tiny fruits taken with macro lens. There was a frost and I was lucky to be in the right place the right time. ![20220528_114635a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/EqDk4d2cy5T6D2Q9g5GJUKKEdga6BaE2yxShnzcLXrSdb5XKMY3GU4GKBxMs9gRUHmJ.jpg) And this is *da house*! The very one that I love to photograph, no matter the season and you can see why. This photo was taken in May, 2022. ![20221021_120700a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/EqDicmV5kVAefxSXqbmdjNx1BKE6cSZVv5BUcGPa1E1i8N6tY2y5Ki1UKvGyEPVRUDo.jpg) And this is *da house* in October, same year. Can you see the difference? Can you see why I love it? But this is not all. ![20221019_150602a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/EpxrjTCGNmYMRoLYDEzwQoYqcUNULwwytXc5TD3Hii7RYk7UpqQZFCdy8a8zoe1zNe8.jpg) This photo was taken three days before the previous one. What I'm trying to say here is that at some point, the whole house is turning red. It's difficult to know when, so I have to visit it often, to take a nice shot, when the whole ivy cover is red. ![20230421_100027a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/EogPGPkQLcmRXBf2suDrMsDMJgMdx86BeP7K52zmVSBAn95Wd2DkE3qzW9mASXv295t.JPG) A random cutie pie I met at the crosswalk, in April, 2023. ![20230510_121014a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/EoeGRBWnen3gWypYqA3V78TnVjbayo1LUVdSQmdHTqhJTppimcU1XfUDfZj4uf2Ss5B.JPG) And this is a photo I love so much. This scene can tell you a lot, if you know how to read it. Now I'm undecided, whether to tell you what I mean, or leave it to you to figure it out. I guess this will be your riddle for today. Tell me what you see here. ![20230519_110943a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23wWw81FatzJy24PkkZ7bkTEuMSnPqysM3GtCsibMAcvsPZ1QT1qDNeaH6TkwMUroGrjy.JPG) Last, but not least, a peony but, from May, 2026. These should be budding now, but I have not seen any yet. April was cold, maybe they are a bit late. I love peonies, they are wonderful, too bad they don't last for long and make a mess as well.

links.title: 영화 마이클
links.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUgyLh1YQ3Mh6P3r6sykYYobDCPJ32zvbeXUqMCtHX6gS/image.png)
[source](https://namu.wiki/w/%EB%A7%88%EC%9D%B4%ED%81%B4(%EC%98%81%ED%99%94))

2026년 5월 13일자 한국에 개봉한 마이클 잭슨의 전기 영화.
마이클 잭슨의 초기 일생을 다루었으며, 영화에서는 마이클 잭슨의 친조카이자 저메인 잭슨의 아들인 자파르 잭슨이 마이클 잭슨 역을 맡았다고 한다.

개봉하자마자 딸들이 영화를 보자고 해서 영화 할인 쿠폰 적용해서 4명이서 보고 왔습니다. 

영화를 보고 나오는데, 한 사람의 인생이 얼마나 찬란하면서도 외로울 수 있는지 오래 남았다.
특히 무대 위에서 모두에게 환호받던 마이클이, 정작 무대 밖에서는 늘 사랑받고 인정받고 싶어 했다는 게 마음 아프게 느껴졌다.

어릴 때부터 아버지 조 잭슨의 강압적인 교육 속에서 성장한 장면들은 성공 뒤에 숨겨진 상처를 그대로 보여줬다. 완벽한 공연을 위해 쉼 없이 연습하고, 실수하면 혼나고, 외모까지 지적받던 어린 마이클의 모습은 안쓰러웠다. 그래서인지 이후에도 계속 자신의 외모에 불안해하고 스스로를 끊임없이 바꾸려 했던 모습이 더 이해됐다.

가장 인상 깊었던 장면은 역시 “Billie Jean” 무대였다.
모타운 25주년 공연에서 처음 문워크를 선보이는 순간은 단순한 공연이 아니라 시대가 바뀌는 느낌이었다. 관객들의 함성과 함께 마이클이 진짜 세계적인 스타가 되는 순간을 보는 것 같아서 소름이 돋았다. 그리고 MTV가 흑인 아티스트의 뮤직비디오를 외면하던 시절, 끝내 벽을 깨고 자신의 음악을 세상에 알리는 과정도 굉장히 의미 있게 다가왔다.

또 한편으로는 마이클이 단순히 스타가 아니라, 사람들에게 위로를 주고 싶어 했던 사람이라는 점도 기억에 남는다. 어린이 병원을 방문하거나, 펩시 사고 이후 합의금을 화상 치료 센터에 기부하는 모습에서는 그의 따뜻한 마음이 느껴졌다. 특히 심각한 화상을 입고도 다시 무대로 돌아가려 고민하는 장면은 정말 프로다운 모습이었다.

마지막 Victory Tour 공연 장면은 왠지 뭉클했다.
가족과 함께 시작했던 음악 인생이 결국 가족과의 단절로 이어졌다는 사실이 슬프기도 했고, 동시에 마이클이 비로소 자신의 삶을 선택하는 순간처럼 느껴졌다. 웸블리 스타디움에서 “Bad”를 부르며 홀로 무대를 가득 채우는 마지막 장면은, 이제 완전히 ‘마이클 잭슨’이라는 하나의 전설이 탄생했음을 보여주는 것 같았다.

영화를 다 보고 나니 단순한 성공 스토리가 아니라, 천재성과 외로움, 가족에 대한 상처, 그리고 자유를 찾으려 했던 한 사람의 이야기처럼 느껴졌다.
나의 기억속에 마이클 잭슨의 노래 \

은 가장 기억에 남아있고 문워크는 종종 따라 해본 기억이 있다. 
무대 위에서는 누구보다 빛났지만, 그 빛만큼 깊은 그림자도 함께 가지고 있었던 사람. 그래서 더 오래 기억에 남는 영화였다.
