links.title: Vidas de Gatos [Es-En] Cat Lives
links.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNUjbuYqvWGu8pXt1HJAHPMkN4gV8csZeddY8CKbbR2ET/image.png)
Como perros y gatos, expresión de enemistad irreconciliable. Que con frecuencia observamos en como se relacionan ambas especies que nos acompañan en nuestro cotidiano vivir. Esta primera imagen corresponde a Blaky, mi gata que quedó en casa al cuidado de familiares y vecinos. Sé que me extraña, pues el vecino con quien acostumbraba charlar en las tardes, a veces con un café. Me informa que la gata aparece por su jardín a la hora que yo los frecuentaba, donde se presentaba a buscarme si en su parecer me estaba ausentando de casa por demasiado tiempo. Después de hacerme notar su presencia, me esperaba a cierta distancia, evitando molestar al perro del vecino, que las veces que asomó por la puerta de casa, no dudó un instante en echarlo, haciéndolo correr. En la calle evitaba a perros y gatos, salvo algún congénere de su agrado o con parentesco familiar, pues varios de sus hijos e hijas se quedaron a vivir en las cercanías. Pero nuestro patio y jardín es territorio exclusivo donde ningún perro es bienvenido y solo los gatos de su agrado. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXNNidYR59zJXR6wubzXbWU7q97mhx28X3KsaNH8kT1wb/image.png) Este otro es un ejemplar callejero que, junto a otros, ronda por el estacionamiento del edificio donde resido en Buenos Aires. Aunque en la calle viven en peligro, disfrutan de libertad y la verdad no pasan hambre. Ni siquiera les he visto interés en cazar las muchas aves que vuelan por el lugar. Son varias las personas amantes de los felinos que con regularidad les dejan agua y comida para gatos en envases y lugares estratégicos donde se acercan a comer cuando bien les parece. Este ejemplar tiene cierto parecido con Intruso, un gato que vivió con nosotros en Caracas junto a un pastor alemán. El perro lo adoptó cuando apareció en casa erizado frente al perro que se lo tomó a juego, aunque el minino estaba de lo más agresivo. Al final, el perro dormía junto a la puerta como buen guardián y el gato muy cómodo sobre su lomo. Cuando nos mudamos al edificio de al lado, Intruso nos abandonó para irse a vivir a la panadería que quedaba entre ambos. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmckzo6oKVH12kF56SUoeoTDJwwEMZ2xCcr2L1DzzEQtZq/image.png) Gatos y perros me han acompañado a lo largo de mi vida, que, por ser la de los humanos más larga, me ha tocado ver cómo las mascotas se van antes y su pérdida se siente tanto como la de un buen amigo. Siendo los gatos más despegados e independientes que los perros, pensé que sería diferente el sentimiento, pero en realidad es igual; claro que cada animal, al igual que las personas, tiene su carácter individual, con lo cual unos son más apegados que otros. Canelita, hija de Blaky, se la regalamos a unos vecinos, pero se la llevaron ya crecida y a poca distancia, por lo que con frecuencia volvía a visitar a la madre y cuando parió fue en nuestra casa, donde la camada se crio al cuidado de la madre y la abuela, con lo que fue muy complicado darlos en adopción. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSFWXGFysYPcHXyjAYE3g5Hpi3hincxgLFxiA2RfRQVMm/image.png) Por hoy termino el cuento con la historia de Paquito, que, aunque mestizo, nació igual que su gemelo Loquito con el aspecto de un siamés, ojos de diamante. Cariñosos pero distantes, su aristocrático aspecto no les granjeó simpatías entre sus congéneres y menos entre los perros de los vecinos. Sus vidas fueron muy cortas; primero perdimos a Loquito, que con frecuencia retaba a los perros del vecino, paseando por lo más bajo del muro, hasta que un día, uno de los perros lo alcanzó en un salto que para Loquito fue mortal. Paquito llegó a la madurez, y en cada ocasión en que salía de parranda, volvía cubierto de heridas, las que nunca lo hicieron desistir de seguir sus instintos por los tejados, hasta que en una ocasión desapareció para siempre. La libertad tiene precio y no es para todos; algunos prefieren la seguridad. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS6PYR3YbiAWjce2RGZVhAZ2sNoTNDVZ2o3vXdCuTSjyz/image.png) Aunque las mascotas y sus amos se parecen con frecuencia, tengo la impresión de que los animales con frecuencia nos dan lecciones de convivencia que los humanos deberíamos adoptar. >Como siempre, escribo en mi lengua materna, el español, dejando la traducción al inglés a cargo de Google. Todas las imágenes son de mi archivo personal y algunas seguramente ya fueron publicadas antes. # Cat Lives
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNUjbuYqvWGu8pXt1HJAHPMkN4gV8csZeddY8CKbbR2ET/image.png)
Like cats and dogs, an expression of irreconcilable enmity. Something we frequently observe in how these two species, who accompany us in our daily lives, interact. This first image is of Blaky, my cat who stayed home in the care of family and neighbors. I know she misses me, because the neighbor with whom I used to chat in the afternoons, sometimes over coffee, tells me that the cat appears in his garden at the time I used to frequent it, looking for me if she thinks I've been away from home for too long. After making his presence known, he would wait for me at a distance, careful not to disturb the neighbor's dog, who, whenever he appeared at the front door, didn't hesitate for a moment to chase him away. On the street, he avoided dogs and cats, except for the occasional one he liked or a relative, since several of his sons and daughters lived nearby. But our patio and garden are his exclusive territory, where no dogs are welcome, only cats he likes. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXNNidYR59zJXR6wubzXbWU7q97mhx28X3KsaNH8kT1wb/image.png) This other one is a stray who, along with others, roams the parking lot of the building where I live in Buenos Aires. Although they live in danger on the street, they enjoy freedom and, in truth, they don't go hungry. I haven't even seen them try to hunt the many birds that fly around. There are many cat lovers who regularly leave water and food for their felines in containers and strategic locations where they can come and eat whenever they please. This cat bears a certain resemblance to Intruso, a cat who lived with us in Caracas along with a German Shepherd. The dog adopted him when he appeared at home, his fur standing on end, which the dog took as a joke, even though the feline was quite aggressive. In the end, the dog slept by the door like a good guardian, and the cat was quite comfortable on his back. When we moved to the building next door, Intruso left us to go live in the bakery located between our two buildings. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmckzo6oKVH12kF56SUoeoTDJwwEMZ2xCcr2L1DzzEQtZq/image.png) Cats and dogs have been my companions throughout my life, which, being the longest human lifespan, has meant I've witnessed pets leaving us sooner, and their loss is felt as deeply as that of a good friend. Since cats are more detached and independent than dogs, I thought the feeling would be different, but in reality, it's the same; of course, each animal, like people, has its own individual character, so some are more attached than others. Canelita, Blaky's daughter, was given to some neighbors, but they took her when she was already grown and to a nearby home. Because of this, she frequently returned to visit her mother, and when she gave birth, it was at our house, where the litter was raised by the mother and grandmother, making it very difficult to find them homes. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSFWXGFysYPcHXyjAYE3g5Hpi3hincxgLFxiA2RfRQVMm/image.png) For today, I'll end the story with the tale of Paquito, who, although a mixed breed, was born just like his twin Loquito, with the appearance of a Siamese cat and diamond-like eyes. Affectionate but aloof, their aristocratic appearance didn't win them favor among their peers, and even less so among the neighbors' dogs. Their lives were very short; First we lost Loquito, who often challenged the neighbor's dogs, walking along the bottom of the wall, until one day, one of the dogs caught him in a jump that proved fatal for Loquito. Paquito grew up, and each time he went out partying, he returned covered in wounds, which never deterred him from following his instincts across the rooftops, until one day he disappeared forever. Freedom has a price and isn't for everyone; some prefer security. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS6PYR3YbiAWjce2RGZVhAZ2sNoTNDVZ2o3vXdCuTSjyz/image.png) Although pets and their owners are often similar, I have the impression that animals frequently teach us lessons in coexistence that humans should adopt. As always, I'm writing in my native language, Spanish, leaving the English translation to Google. All images are from my personal archive, and some have likely been published before.

 In the dark of night, a blind man came out with a hurricane in his hand. Seeing him, some people around started laughing. links.title: Hollyhock
links.body:
Hollyhocks rise from the earth like quiet storytellers, their tall spires lined with open-faced blooms that seem eager to catch both sunlight and conversation. Often found leaning gently against old fences or cottage walls, these flowers carry a nostalgic charm, as if they remember gardens from another century. Their height alone gives them a dignified presence, making them feel less like background plants and more like garden companions watching over everything below.

Each hollyhock flower unfolds with a simple, honest beauty. The petals are soft and papery, arranged in wide circles that reveal delicate veins and a warm, inviting center. From pale creams and blush pinks to deep maroons and sunny yellows, hollyhocks celebrate color without excess. They don’t shout for attention; instead, they draw you in slowly, encouraging you to pause and really look.

links.title: A Growing Waterfall
links.body:
### Have you ever seen a growing waterfall?

I suppose it may not even be that uncommon, but it was the first time I saw one (or maybe was aware of this special fact). Over the years this waterfall has grown to over 6 m in height and is a relatively rare sight to behold in this part of the country. 

During the construction of a railway line in 1912, some water streams were combined which led to the creation of the waterfall. The heavy growth of mosses, together with diatoms accelerate the growth of the waterfall by increasing the surface area and binding precipitating lime. Apparently this amounts to around 4,500 kg per year! Due to its constant growth, the moss escapes encrustation with carbonate on its surface. However, in the area of its adhesion to the calcareous sinter, it dies, becomes encrusted, and thus continuously forms new, porous sinter rock which causes an annual growth of around 10 cm.

I assume the growth is therefore the result of both the moss as well as the rock constantly accumulating more mass. Since the stream feeding the waterfall is, however, not very big and water seeks the least resistance, I think it is probably reasonable to assume that the waterfall might rather increase in width than in height over the years to come. 


![photo_2026-05-13_16-09-47.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tobetada/EpA25sUcMwhT1HPFUuDZZ6Rm1ti9xMqdWM8itj14TerqK99vhA9VCsFkazxu4HhHYTz.jpg)



![photo_2026-05-13_16-09-41.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tobetada/23xKtLZAzpQATtVnyvUHU1xhcwhkAwVcbVhkZJ3B773ZwTsiQQNhnzccqBfod9dBKZrko.jpg)

There is a small cave inside as well - and I got soaked standing in it after just a minute or so. The water is very clear and clean as you can see. 


![photo_2026-05-13_16-09-39.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tobetada/EoK5sQtEbf6Xr8mrAPvqa1FNcLMjBmJWjEPFMThB61fqRVPUfrPLRGNEZ14Fz6gDYhR.jpg)


![photo_2026-05-13_16-09-42.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tobetada/245SzuHsEmPxJVqcf62hFx6dJFpFZ87nAL6GuyZin9kDUxZxpCbcDqwR5HLm1XLj8tYVP.jpg)

After a bit of climbing I managed to capture a shot from the top. As you can see the stream feeding the waterfall is not very big. Yet it somehow manages to create a fairly impressive display further down below. 

![photo_2026-05-13_16-09-44.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tobetada/23tSWg7aKJPFF5Y69HMqfkkgmoPDxQG9nm4TdwDSKukNC4cEHryBh8QnKV8qve7odPYoi.jpg)

In the nearby woods some people started to layer some rocks to create these interesting stone formations. I couldn't resist the temptation to build one myself of course...

Hi everyone, How are you? Two of the most aggressive teams in the history of IPL are Delhi Capitals and Punjab Kings. Although Punjab Kings were earlier known as **Kings XI Punjab (KXIP)**, their fighting spirit is still the same. In today's blog, we will discuss the beginning and end of the battle between these two teams. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXRfe4f9Es1VhbhHXus3WsXU4W7CK8qsFcP77pGDqNNpk/1778682881194.jpg) [Source ](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/sports/cricket/ipl/top-stories/ipl-2025-points-table-latest-standings-after-punjab-kings-vs-delhi-capitals-match-in-dharamsala/amp_articleshow/121005976.cms) The battle between Delhi and Punjab is always quite fierce. Statistics show that the two teams have played more than 32 matches against each other so far. The winning margin is almost equal. Some seasons, Delhi dominates, while sometimes Punjab turns around. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYupyX5Wi1jpvubnaqebPQgo93Pr18oCatE23H4iGuQ34/1778683144661.jpg) [Source ](https://www.instagram.com/p/DYMbWVuoKZH/) Delhi Capitals won an incredible victory in the match held at the Himachal Pradesh Cricket Association Stadium in Dharamsala on May 11. However, an interesting fact is that in the first leg match held on April 25, 2026, Punjab Kings created history by chasing 264 runs, which is one of the biggest run chases in IPL history! IPL means uncertainty. Delhi Capitals are desperate for their first title, while Punjab Kings are also looking to end their trophy drought. links.title: How I Would Convince Someone to Start Their Hive Journey
links.body:
>
![IMG_2970.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/princessbusayo/EonosByBBM3km6KCHydbyN9KMiGyhy8uj4RPhbdrZz5D1tjLp7o2PkqMmqvm3iTxqYM.jpeg)
The way I talk about Hive hasn’t changed. I explain to people how Hive is a good place to be. I explained that it is a platform that enables one to develop themselves if they know what they are doing. Hive is not just a place to post content randomly; it’s where consistency, creativity, and intentionality shape a person over time. When it comes to freedom, it's different from any other social media platform. For instance, there are things one must not post on other platforms, especially because one's account can be controlled by the owners, and any mistake can lead to one's account being banned. However, on Hive, you can post on almost anything as long as it meets the community's guidelines. That freedom gives people confidence to express themselves, share their experiences, and connect with others without being restricted. Apart from that, the only thing that Hive shuns is plagiarism. They value authenticity and originality. This way, one can develop themselves where needed. Hive pushes people to think creatively, improve on their skills and become better at what they do - whether writing, photography, art, music or even video creation. Hive is full of opportunities, creativity, and connections. I would use myself as an example, starting from where and how I started on Hive. The people I have met, and how I am no longer a novice in writing, because Hive gave me a space to keep writing and hone my skills. One beautiful thing about Hive is that growth happens naturally when you are active and willing to learn. The more the engagement, the better the connections and improvements. I would tell them the advantage they would get from a decentralised blockchain like Hive, which cannot be compared to the Web 2 platforms we use. I would also make them know the importance of being intentional and serious about Hive because they will gain a whole lot. Unlike many traditional social media platforms, where users only contribute content for the owners to profit from, Hive rewards content creators for their efforts and gives them ownership. That alone makes the platform unique and valuable. For the reward part, of course, I won't ignore this because this is one of the major reasons people want to be on Hive. But I will not hesitate to make them understand that, even though making money is important, one still needs to be serious and not for the money alone which could make them feel disappointed later on when they aren't getting what they expect.
![IMG_2969.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/princessbusayo/EoH1MCUnUWNdCquV6R2vuy4QCvygPxojfr61viNZuSeD24sVqRx6pf7tbJ19puPx3Dk.jpeg)
Hive is not a get-rich-quick scheme platform. It takes patience, consistency, learning, networking, and improving one's skills. The reward system encourages people to put effort into what they do instead of chasing shortcuts. I would explain how the reward is distributed on their posts and how they work. It is also important to be familiar with various communities where they can learn from others from different countries. I will make them understand what it means to dedicate an ample amount of time if they'd enjoy this platform. Communities on Hive are like different families with shared interests. Whether someone loves writing, gaming, music, food, teaching, finance, lifestyle, or photography, there is always a community where they can belong and grow. The beautiful part I won't hesitate to let them know is how talents are formed on a platform where their voices would be heard and efforts rewarded. Many people joined Hive without confidence in themselves, but over time, they discovered gifts they never knew they had. And that alone is a plus to them. Some became better writers, some became content creators, some built consistency, while others had meaningful friendships and opportunities across different countries. To me, Hive is more than a platform; it is a journey of growth, learning, creativity, and self-development. If someone is willing to learn, stay original, connect with others, and remain consistent, Hive can become a place that changes their life positively in ways they never expected.
> *This is my entry to the IndiaUnited Contest that can be found [here](https://peakd.com/hive-197685/@indiaunited/indiaunited-new-contest-and-last-41a9e1ae2ea64)* *Images are mine*
![1000414885.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/princessbusayo/AK2C7dr7CG9amqSNarRKhrFGqPF8Ybcwt5PM5t352JKw1xMTByAzPkuAARjrqQw.png)

links.title: I Was So Sad About The Papaya I Ate So I Fixed It By Drawing It Using Oil Pastel LOL
links.body:
![Copy of Copy of Copy of Copy of strawberry oil pastel.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoeGqTGQUfz98MHa9wTAdUEvdEf1b1Ho6s8DGA82STWpWM9Ax7LDknLnpEyFSKkqbfe.gif)
Hello, how are you? Sometime dissappointment can be an inspiration to make art, I am saying it for myself LOL. Last week, my mom bought a papaya. I was so excited to eat one because it had been a while since I ate one, and to our disappointment, the moment that anemic yellow appeared inside, not the vibrant orange one, I am telling you that was the saddest papaya I ever tasted. To ease that disappointment, I drew a real papaya that looks like using oil pastel. I will be making it as tasty as I remembered what a real papaya tastes like. So yeah, I wanted to release this frustration of mine. -----
Materials I Used:

> ![2.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoeGpgd4qezCKT5xHrjpFv8KcKiAWGqxk1EJx6VzHZ9oqpGG1wWmC5PimZAHo3zCHYQ.JPG) Using this ochre pastel, I drew the papaya. I was looking at the sad papaya I took, LOL. -----

> ![4.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoyRyWTjvsFmxbAjzJUWLJee8U482rQBi89n59CYkko2Unz7LtThPY96qGMFk3B8fwP.JPG) To my frustration, I almost didn't finish this piece of drawing, but the moment I slept, I was ready to continue it, haha. So yeah, it looks basic at this moment, but trust the process. ----

> ![6.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoiY9RELnxcmLqD743au26JtW9rUTZX25PB3S9ZuxZaEBaUnKXAqJA57YMejXH7MMnw.JPG) So the color of our tablecloth is red, so I am going to stick to the color, just lay that color in the light first. And then I added the first layer, which was the lighter version of the orange shades. ----

> ![8.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EopvkFTpb447rTzCTcFshVQ4yiLGgnF4f1fc7us2YkocngVKxAXGpj8hpzZTbbFaC9K.JPG) Then I layer it with the darkest shade of orange, then with lighter shades, and I thought I would not get the right color of the seeds inside, but I trust the process and felt like it was going in the right direction. LOL. ----

> ![10.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EokfwmdG2Je9qqWpEUPh7Vk1iNaN5fnB4yaR4tmziiASrnKLLPWRoFBXa6nrAdSjnpC.JPG) Now the drawing is getting there, I felt like it was time to add the shadows to make it dimensional, so I did. ----

> ![12.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoAd3whEJ331oHrRcEFReWBTFtfRNLY66Uo2cJxGfhpQxLCPEamwuu1njP5F9zZqGEw.JPG) When I was sick, adding shades to the first papaya, I did the second one, LOL. ----
> ![14.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eokfb9FtVBf7pxb5aXkgxrLP5xYRyuE6i6SuLWN1fyN78w2JGmnw64UaEz6wf15NeP1.JPG) I felt sick, so I called it done for the seeds. ----

> ![16.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eoc9xGxxyAMRw8D2Xv4eCjaJqcm3k7LX8r5T2J6uj5ZhvuM4DsrWWaZkfBozkB2TuGG.JPG) And then decided to color the background completely. -----

> ![18.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EouAdv46J4cicYDaB54gX3j7neUJNKu7dgDkmK87s9AidtqhAMLPEDZM8CAB3dgH9UB.JPG) Time to add the texture, this is one of my favorite parts of all. -----

> ![20.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EokfzV6JhspgZxxsWuWEYUZQGxMURn43BFuBf8MnzZL1ddVD1oZwDQWUeNC8zuBVKo5.JPG) Here is a close-up look at the final drawing. ----- ![21.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoiXZ85DM19Gyh2hDkw82vjgvfV2UYT7n8Anv4cASHjT9ZBu6X1wrw7FPZzu8j2g8FP.JPG) I was talking inside my head that time I finished this drawing, \

. Now my mind is at ease. I hope you like it. ----
Thank you for visiting, see you on my next blog. :D Please take care of your mental health as well. I hope you are okay today :))
---

links.title: Confección de lindo mono -pijama 🪡🧵🥰❤️ [esp/eng]￼
links.body:
>

___Saludos, amigos de NEEDLEWORKMONDAY! ___🪡🧵❤️

espero estén disfrutando de un agradable día, el día de hoy quiero compartir con ustedes una linda confección de un mono tipo pijama bastante sencillo y fácil para confeccionar, acompáñame y te comparto el paso a paso:

> Greetings, friends of NEEDLEWORKMONDAY! 🪡🧵❤️
>
> I hope you're having a lovely day. Today I want to share with you a cute and easy-to-make pajama-style jumpsuit. Join me and I'll share the step-by-step instructions:


<div class=\

>

![Logo para Salón de Uñas Moderno Simple Rosa.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWonqRaSEpH9hSCEF2S2nQ6mRzBudzH9wnc6NJME9Csow/Logo%20para%20Sal%C3%B3n%20de%20U%C3%B1as%20Moderno%20Simple%20Rosa.png)


<hr>

<div class=\

> ___MATERIALES___ > MATERIALS He tenido un poco abandonadas las costuras, ya que las ocupaciones con mis hijos me agotan muchísimo y el momento que tengo disponible tristemente se va a la luz y esto me desanima por completo, actualmente en mi país tenemos muchos problemas con la luz y de verdad que nos perjudican nuestras actividades diarias, hoy decidí retomar un poco mis costuras confeccionando un lindo mono para pijama en una hermosa tela con diseño de Animal, print bien colorida, aquí les dejo la lista de materiales a utilizar: - 1M de tela elástica - elástico del grosor de su preferencia, en mi caso, estoy usando uno de aproximadamente 3 cm de ancho - Tijeras e hilo - Máquina de coser > I've been neglecting my sewing lately, as caring for my children is incredibly exhausting, and the little free time I have sadly vanishes, which is very discouraging. Currently, we have many problems with electricity in my country, and it really disrupts our daily activities. Today, I decided to pick up sewing again by making a cute onesie from a beautiful, colorful animal print fabric. Here's the list of materials you'll need: > > - 1 meter of stretch fabric > - Elastic of your preferred thickness; I'm using one that's about 3 cm wide > - Scissors and thread > - Sewing machine

> ___PASO A PASO___ > STEP BY STEP Para la confección de este mono voy a guiarme con uno de mis hijas que le confeccioné hace un tiempo, el tamaño es casi el mismo, sólo que este será un poco más largo, pongo mi tela al revés sobre mi mesa y luego coloco el mono guía, primero por la parte delantera, voy dibujando dejándole excedente para las costuras, marco en el centro para guiarme, y luego coloco mi mono guía por la parte de atrás, dibujo y luego corto. Para que tengan una idea estas son las medidas aproximadas, este mono lo cortamos en sólo dos piezas, marcamos 8 cm para el tiro delantero hacia adentro y le damos una caída de aproximadamente 33 cm, en la parte superior, dejamos esos 3 cm extra para darle la inclinación hasta el tiro de atrás, el tiro de atrás la marcamos de 14 cm hacia adentro y le damos la forma, la cintura nos viene quedando de aproximadamente 50 cm de ancho, la medida desde la punta del tiro de atrás hasta la punta del tiro de alante por la parte del fundillo es de aproximadamente 72 cm de ancho, la bota en la parte inferior es de 50 cm de ancho > To make this jumpsuit, I'm going to use one I made for my daughters a while ago as a guide. The size is almost the same, only this one will be a little longer. I put my fabric face down on my table and then place the jumpsuit pattern on top, first on the front, drawing and leaving extra for the seams. I mark the center to guide me, and then I place my jumpsuit pattern on the back, draw and then cut. > > To give you an idea, these are the approximate measurements. We cut this jumpsuit in just two pieces. We marked 8 cm in for the front crotch and gave it a drop of approximately 33 cm. At the top, we left those extra 3 cm to give it the slope to the back crotch. We marked the back crotch 14 cm in and shaped it. The waist ended up being approximately 50 cm wide. The measurement from the point of the back crotch to the point of the front crotch at the seat is approximately 72 cm wide. The leg opening at the bottom is 50 cm wide.

> |![IMG_0229.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPj4kMo97eW7eGG7tDwZm31qeaBzQeKXcsMyKfaNCz5Ge/IMG_0229.jpeg)|![IMG_0230.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcUTgx9UTPcz1oLhEqw5LqKbbmamNNVnEDj5wLFJyBV23/IMG_0230.jpeg)| |---|---| |![IMG_0231.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZf26Vs7MSXXoywxWkEZKZPFg93zBhjct49VQfTpX5fJY/IMG_0231.jpeg)|![IMG_0232.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdhMpKGBpK5bGnNnb86Sqs8ouN9xYkFn899SmB7jTFsVb/IMG_0232.jpeg)| En este paso vamos a comenzar con las costuras, primero pasamos costura en el tiro delantero, luego en el tiro de atrás, en mi caso le paso Overlook y luego costura recta para reforzar bien, luego vamos a pasar costura por el entrepierna, comenzando desde el centro del fundillo hasta abajo del lado y lado para el ruedo, le paso sólo costura o verlo, ya que así lo quiere mi clienta > In this step we'll begin with the seams. First, we'll sew the front crotch seam, then the back crotch seam. In my case, I'll use an overlock stitch followed by a straight stitch for extra reinforcement. Next, we'll sew the crotch seam, starting from the center of the seat and going down the side seam and hem. I'll either just sew it or sew it over, as that's what my client wants.

> |![IMG_0234.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXv2ep37YhxDy6vWLNaaYSRD5wXu84kbJAjExdjW3N2Zd/IMG_0234.jpeg)|![IMG_0236.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmf445RJA9MH397QB11tVvifnuEXp4TH5HodrE7JEZqnnK/IMG_0236.jpeg)| |---|---| |![IMG_0237.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdBopuUxXJPg6dATS3X1Kpb2fKDDuDR9MnMNcC4aANcvZ/IMG_0237.jpeg)|![IMG_0238.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfMLcL7DszjucoJcyDAxE9JrENtdxWmNYSeqiEouh5PAa/IMG_0238.jpeg)| Ya está casi listo, ahora vamos a colocarle el elástico en la parte de la cintura, en este caso, el elástico lo voy a dejar de aproximadamente 40 cm al doble, corto, uno con costura, y luego fijo a mi mono, igual primero paso costura de Overlook, luego le hago el dobles hacia adentro y luego le paso costura recta y así ya está listo este lindo mono pijama espero les guste > It's almost ready! Now we're going to attach the elastic to the waistband. In this case, I'm going to leave the elastic about 40 cm long, double-cut, sew one end, and then attach it to my jumpsuit. First, I'll do an overlock stitch, then fold it inwards, and then sew a straight stitch. And that's it! This cute onesie pajama is finished. I hope you like it!

> |![IMG_0239.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVTLtvgKMyAzjkgW1An3tc6oSgF5jpMKaywTYeoyKk3CY/IMG_0239.jpeg)|![IMG_0240.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQme2dtEcpZ1mhFKNt5L7wKpxU9hdnr1ncyzUP5tEQ9EYLy/IMG_0240.jpeg)| |---|---| |![IMG_0241.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZfcTT5gKRkc7hGxGwhk32eXhDtFuNvHwkgv517qF8jNB/IMG_0241.jpeg)|![IMG_0242.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdAEN61RrtZA3ZoXHEhAvJ9Qd1vdmKL4QZ5F6dJ7kSSwB/IMG_0242.jpeg)| Me gusta mucho este tipo de monos, ya que son bastante fáciles de hacer, aparte que esta tela me encantó es fácil de trabajar y de un diseño muy lindo , y solo espero que el problema con la luz en mi país me mejore ya que me hace mucha falta de dedicarme a mis costuras, espero poder hacerlo otra vez más seguido, y eso es todo por hoy amigos, me despido, deseándoles muchas bendiciones, hasta otra oportunidad > I really like these kinds of jumpsuits because they're quite easy to make. Besides, I loved this fabric; it's easy to work with and has a very cute design. I just hope the power outages in my country improve soon because I really miss being able to dedicate time to my sewing. I hope I can do it more often again. And that's all for today, friends. Goodbye, wishing you many blessings. Until next time!

> |![IMG_0253.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRfEatNV9FuXahuKdzywdMtkq7GAcBUvFT8ig3zSWcSwA/IMG_0253.jpeg)|![IMG_0244.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPPvgoDo5qTEQFYia2F55rxqYVM1dKi9AvXnZv84hvdFa/IMG_0244.jpeg)| |---|---|
![14 sin título_20241126180154.PNG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTHVyi75ZjssR4rHoFxZQLfegNCrYGW91CBUipRdJE81p/14%20sin%20ti%CC%81tulo_20241126180154.PNG) ***las fotos aquí compartidas son de mi propiedad tomadas con mi teléfono iPhone 16, la edición fue hecha en Canva, para la traducción del inglés utilice el traductor de Google***

links.body: Although I've never used Tesla's FSD on a cross country trip I've used it quite a bit on road trips within Minnesota and around town. I'd say it's ready for full unsupervised driving at this point—the government just needs to approve it and legalize autonomous driving. The current version will literally take you from your driveway or garage to parking spots wherever you're going and back without you ever having to touch the wheel or pedals. I can't wait until the US approves it. I'll probably get my 83 year old Mom a used Tesla so she can regain some of her independence. Her neuropathy forced her to stop driving last year. If you can find a used Tesla with Full Self Driving already paid for and included on the car and with the latest cameras/computer (Hardware 4) it's like a goldmine. Otherwise FSD is $99/month to subscribe and will probably increase in price from there. I'll definitely keep you posted how this goes. Our first driving day is nine hours so I'll be relying heavily on FSD that day.

links.title: Butterfly Pea Flower
links.body:
The butterfly pea flower feels like a quiet marvel of nature, unfolding its deep blue petals with an elegance that seems almost unreal. Found climbing gently along fences and trellises, it does not rush to be noticed, yet its color stops people in their tracks. The blue—sometimes edged with white or purple—feels like a piece of twilight captured in bloom, reminding us that nature often saves its most striking beauty for those who look closely.

There is a soothing presence to the butterfly pea, as if it carries calm within its petals. In many places, it is known not just as a flower, but as a companion to daily life—used in teas, rituals, and traditional remedies. Watching it bloom each morning feels like witnessing a small act of renewal, a gentle promise that the day can begin with grace and balance.

What makes the butterfly pea especially meaningful is its quiet versatility. It decorates gardens, nourishes pollinators, and transforms simple water into a vivid blue drink that changes color with a squeeze of lemon. This transformation feels symbolic, reflecting how small shifts in perspective can change how we see the world. The flower teaches us that adaptability can be beautiful, not forced.

links.title: Splinterlands: When the modifiers include both 'Up Close & Personal' and 'Thorns', only the Deflect ability can save you!🔥
links.body:
>Here is another interesting battle that I played just a short while ago. This battle featured a Mana cap of 59 and a total of three rulesets. The first was 'Shapeshift,' which opened up a wider range of options for card selection, allowing any card to be utilized to support any Bloodline. The second ruleset was 'Up Close & Personal,' which restricted card selection in this battle exclusively to Melee cards. The third ruleset was 'Briar Patch,' which equipped every card with the 'Thorns' ability—creating an extremely challenging situation for you on the battlefield. Why? Because you cannot deploy any cards other than Melee units, and since every unit possesses the 'Thorns' ability, every single Melee attack triggers a retaliation, inflicting an additional 2 points of damage in return.

\n\n[

>Until now, whenever I encountered this situation, I used to focus on heavy melee attackers—reasoning that while I might take 2 points of health damage from Thorns, if I could deal double that amount of damage back to the enemy, it would inflict significant harm upon them and pave my way toward victory. However, I recently learned about a different ability called \

which provides a shield to cards against Corrosive Ward, Magic Reflect, Thorns, Return Fire, and Blast splash damage. Well, while the description itself is sufficient to explain what it does, if you want to see it in action, check out the short video above—it is a screen recording of <a target=\

>In case you didn't notice, let me point out that thanks to the 'Deflect' ability, my cards were completely shielded from 'Thorns' damage in retaliation to any of their attacks. However, the opposing team did not enjoy this advantage; which is why, when it was their turn to attack, 'Thorns' inflicted -2 ​​damage upon every single one of their cards in retaliation to each of their attacks. This marks the first time I have utilized the 'Deflect' ability against 'Thorns,' and this single, minor strategic adjustment has yielded quite surprising results—results that are manifold superior to my previous strategy. I hope you found this post to be a valuable learning experience. Thank You!

* * *

>Splinterlands isn't an easy place, but that's what makes it even more fun. A perfect strategy takes into account many factors, including stats, abilities, rulesets, mana caps, and more. That's why it's even more important to consider all these factors when developing a strategy. Add good cards to your deck, but also work on improving your strategies, and strive to win as many battles as possible!🔥\n\n

#

#

**<div class =\

>Buenas buenas querido grupo de hive hoy les muestro como hice una franelilla musculosa para caballero usando como siempre tela microdurasno,que es con la que más trabajo por su versatilidad y comodidad,los materiales que utilice:** # > Hello everyone, dear Hive group! Today I'm showing you how I made a men's tank top using, as always, microdurano fabric, which is what I work with most often because of its versatility and comfort. The materials I used are: ---

Elaboración|Elaboration
* #
![1000271013.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRrfc4hNaaRh9UD5xqa1x5G3xeLcnDFt2esAUqMtqU1oW/1000271013.jpg)

![1000271070.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcrYPnDLfcSE66y18p1CoSp83SBs74N3Z9BjS3MHDAYdQ/1000271070.jpg)
# * #### Paso nro 1 **

>Para cortar la parte delantera estire la tela sencilla sin doblar por el reves, ya que así será más fácil de cortar ya que es una franelilla asimetrica.Igual hice con la parte de arrib, está franela está desglosada en varias partes así que hay que cortarla de esta manera.Aproveche para cortar unos sesgos que usaré para el cuello y la sisa.Corte los laterales del microdurazno negro.Ya teniendo toda la parte delantera use el mismo patrón para cortar la parte trasera ya que solo es la tela sin diseño solo la tela azul.** > * #### Paso nro 1 > To cut the front piece, lay the plain fabric flat on its wrong side, as this will make it easier to cut since it's an asymmetrical flannel. I did the same with the top piece; this flannel is broken down into several pieces, so it needs to be cut this way. I took the opportunity to cut some bias tape that I'll use for the neckline and armholes. I cut the side seams of the black micro-peach fabric. Once I had the entire front piece, I used the same pattern to cut the back piece, since it's just the plain blue fabric. ---
![1000271021.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmV7jD42mFU7aiZf7TbSLPKNdug6air3RzvJtwkigC31y6/1000271021.jpg)

# * #### Paso nro 2 **

>Ya teniendo todas las piezas de la parte delantera empezar a coser primero los sesgos para hacer detalles en los laterales y luego la parte superior formando así todo el frente.** > * #### Paso nro 2 > Once you have all the pieces for the front, start sewing the bias tape first to make details on the sides and then the top part, thus forming the entire front. ---

links.title: So Cute Long-Tailed Tit Bird
links.body:
The Long-tailed Tit is a small, endearing bird that has charmed birdwatchers and nature enthusiasts across Europe and Asia with its fluffy appearance, acrobatic behavior, and sociable nature. Despite its tiny size, this bird boasts one of the most striking appearances among passerines, with a long, graceful tail that often doubles its body length. This post explores the Long-tailed Tit’s biology, behavior, habitat, and significance in the ecosystem.


Physical Description..

The Long-tailed Tit is a diminutive songbird, measuring around 13–15 cm in length, with its tail making up more than half of that. Weighing just 7–10 grams, it has a round, fluffy body and a short, stubby bill. Its plumage is soft and downy, usually displaying a mix of white, black, pink, and grey.
Head and Face: Depending on the subspecies, the head may be snowy white or have darker markings around the eyes.
Body: The underparts are typically pale pinkish with subtle buff or salmon tones on the flanks, while the back shows more grey and black.
Tail: Long and narrow, often black with white edges, giving the bird its name and a sense of elegance in flight.

links.title: Premio para la banda 17 - Historia [ESP-ENG]
links.body:
Dani tomó el sobre, pero sus manos temblaban de mucho miedo. —Ábrelo ya — grito Michelle, entonces Dani y rompió lentamente el sobre y resulta que dentro había cuatro boletos de avión. Lucas quedó sin palabras y Stewie tomó uno rápidamente y leyó en voz alta: —“Destino: Europa”. Cada uno tomó su boleto y festejó, además dentro del sobre también había una pequeña tarjeta que decía: Ganaron mucho más que un concurso, ahora el mundo quiere escuchar a la Banda 17. Lucas pensó que nada de eso era real, sin embargo, reviso cada detalle del pasaje y se dio cuenta de que eran en primera clase y la salida era en tres días. Stewie se sentó dentro del carro completamente en shock —Hace un tiempo estábamos tomando un café en el estudio y ahora nos mandan a Europa. Michelle comenzó a llorar de la felicidad, Dani miró y seguía sorprendida por los fans que seguía allí todavía. Finalmente, el conductor encendió el carro y mientras avanzaba los cuatro entendieron algo por primera vez: La Banda 17 ya no era solo un sueño de adolescentes ahora todos eran imparables. >Dani took the envelope, but her hands were shaking with fear. “Open it already!” Michelle shouted. So Dani slowly tore open the envelope, and it turned out there were four plane tickets inside. Lucas was speechless, and Stewie quickly grabbed one and read aloud: “Destination: Europe.” Each of them took their ticket and celebrated; inside the envelope there was also a small card that read: You’ve won much more than a contest—now the world wants to hear Banda 17. # >Lucas thought none of it was real, but he checked every detail of the ticket and realized they were first class and the flight was in three days. Stewie sat in the car, completely in shock. “A while ago we were having coffee in the studio, and now they’re sending us to Europe.” Michelle started crying with happiness. Dani looked around, still surprised by the fans who were still there. Finally, the driver started the car, and as they drove off, the four of them realized something for the first time: Banda 17 was no longer just a teenage dream—now they were unstoppable. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUD31XcyZY7nkgjdLYhQhJESWnFQZRCvNCv6s9hw3A9X3/image.png) [Source](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/feliz-navidad-tarjeta-de-embarque-5219496/) Los días siguientes fueron muy buenos para todo, comenzando por el cariño que les tenían, las redes sociales explotaron, entrevistas y programas de televisión constantemente, todo el mundo hablaba de la banda 17. Sin embargo, también se tomaron su tiempo para descansar, disfrutar y a la vez gastaron parte del dinero que venía con el premio. Lucas compró ropa carísima, Michelle compro muchos regalos para su familia, Dani gastó en firmar con un estudio donde pudiera grabar nuevas canciones y Stewie mandó a enmarcar la bandera negra y roja que atrapó aquella noche, ya que quería un recuerdo eterno. >The days that followed were great in every way, starting with all the love they received; social media went wild, with constant interviews and TV appearances—everyone was talking about the band 17. However, they also took the time to rest and enjoy themselves, while spending some of the prize money. Lucas bought some really expensive clothes, Michelle bought lots of gifts for her family, Dani spent money on signing with a studio where he could record new songs, and Stewie had the black-and-red flag he’d caught that night framed, since he wanted a lasting keepsake. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbVe1zE2TeW2Wum5vgPDH374J9DHzfUFiooXsDmsFG2xB/image.png) [Source](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/concierto-hombre-imagen-video-1034041/) Tres días después, llegó el momento del viaje, así que fueron al aeropuerto y estaba lleno de fanáticos, cámaras y cuando los cuatro aparecieron, el lugar explotó en aplausos. Michelle miraba todo y saludaba Lucas no dejaba de grabar videos, Dani simplemente caminaba y Stewie observaba los carteles de los aviones que iban a salir. Todos tomaron su boleto en la mano, se dieron un aplauso y justo antes de entrar a la zona de abordaje, un niño gritó con todas sus fuerzas: —¡BANDA 17 POR SIEMPRE! Los cuatro se voltearon y entendieron que ya no eran solamente músicos, se habían convertido en un símbolo y en la inspiración de muchas personas y ahora es que venía lo mejor para ellos. >Three days later, it was time to leave, so they went to the airport, which was packed with fans and cameras. When the four of them appeared, the place erupted in applause. Michelle took it all in and waved; Lucas couldn’t stop filming; Dani just walked along; and Stewie looked at the departure boards. # >They all took their tickets in hand, gave each other a round of applause, and just before entering the boarding area, a boy shouted at the top of his lungs: “BANDA 17 FOREVER!” The four of them turned around and realized they were no longer just musicians; they had become a symbol and an inspiration to many people, and now the best was yet to come for them.
![pngwing.com 3.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPvWeswjaMnCtt69QxnpZHm1una1iw2HUxZJpGBgEY2RH/pngwing.com%203.png)

links.title: Time to Smell the Roses - Crime Fiction Short Story
links.body:
>Unsplash ___ My name is Elisha Crow and I hate my job.
I'm waiting in my office, a sealed envelope before me on the mahogany desk.
I glance at the potted plant, plastic since the real ones keep dying on me. Then at my Harvard's law degree nailed to the wall.
Geralda Heather, nee Connors, died last week, alone in her villa. Her husband left her with twelve million bucks, which she held very close, and a vast hatred towards humankind, which she spread passionately. She died with locked doors and closed windows; dogs and gardener outside on the lawn. No signs of a struggle. She had a weak heart.
I adjust my special glasses and examine my guests.
Sprawled on the sofa as if it belonged to her alone, Brigitta Connors scowls at me. She disapproves of any skin color but her own, and I'm black, wearing a suit that she decided I've stolen. She's the victim's sister, but they weren't on speaking terms. She has the only spare keys to the villa and an alibi.
Sitting rigidly on the small chair near the window, once-violin-prodigy Pearl Heather wilts under my scrutiny. She ran away from home in her teens. She's bald, wrestling with one of the bad cancers. Lost her flat and savings to the medical bills. She's the victim's estranged daughter. She has no friends, no prospects, a pair of lovely eyes and a motive.
Shuffling his feet and glancing at the armchair wondering if it's all right to sit down is John Cotter, the gardener. Employed by the Heathers for fifty years, and they weren't kind people. He's the key witness and a stubborn one, insisting nobody came to visit on that fateful day.
My cell phone vibrates and I glance at the screen. Finally!
Aconite. How did you know, you old fraud.
It's Francine. So bright, so full of life. I wish she'd let me date her, but she's too smart for my cheap lies.
I type: 'I had a hunch, Fran.'
Bull. And I'm Lieutenant Brown to you. Where are they now?
'They're all here. I'm about to start.'
We'll be there in thirty minutes. None of your theatrics, you read me?
'Can't promise that.'
I'm warning you, Crow!
I put down the phone. Sighing, I take off my special glasses, clean them with a handkerchief and leave them on the desk.
I blink as my vision clears. I see Brigitta, looking bored and haughty. Pearl, gazing dreamily at the sky outside. John, who settled for balancing uncomfortably on the armrest.
And the pale specter of Geralda Connors, my client, staring at her killer. She's livid.
I hate my job. I wish it was a job I could quit. You can stop an investigation; you can exit a tribunal. But anywhere I run, I'll still be a psychic. And the dead can tell.
\

>Unsplash “Mr John Cotter.” “Yessir”... his southern drawl mingles with the smoke in the air from Brigitta’s cheroot which dangles lazily from its holder. This blue haze seems to hollow out the room in a soundless moment as a purple flower shades into the distance, dispersing into the mahogany wall-panel, purple to brown. Fading motes of life spark a supernova in the eyes of Geralda, mirroring lavender with the flowers expiration. John bobs his head playing nervously with the rim of his hat clutched at his waste. \

Brigitta lets out a theatrical gasp as I look from her to Pearl who's watery eyes well up in sudden tears and then back to John Cotter. 

\
The gardener leans forward suddenly fierce, all pretense of nerves gone. His eyes blaze under bushy eyebrows. \

I crack my knuckles as I settle back in my chair to begin.

\

I pause as I eye them all one by one.

\

Even the smoke hangs still in the air now, heavy and bloated with expectation.

\

He slumps back into the armchair, uncaring if it is his place anymore. His face falls heavy with long years of always coming last, heavy like the smoke's expectation, heavy with the thought of being shafted by capricious fate, again.

\

“Let me interrupt you Ms Heather. I also know someone has added you as primary beneficiary to Geralda Connors estate and fortune in her will. Also, I have discovered from records at Medicax that her private care giver was recently changed to a Mr Davis. A registered specialist for alzheimers, dementia and other related illnesses. She was being treated with an experimental medicine administered by injection and the person in charge of mixing and recording data for said treatment was none other than Mr Davis.” The shade of Geralda Connors' eyes burst blue fire at her murderer as her thoughts scream out for only me to hear. I trusted you. I made you my favorite, the only one I loved. ___ Speckled sunlight dances across purple flowers engorged in summers fading paradise. The breeze blows across my neck cooling the sweat in an ecstasy of fluttering goosebumps. The shade of Geralda Connor's eyes follow me as I snip the bushes around the flower bed. Her thoughts echo quietly, muffled by my psychic guards. I trusted you. I made you my executor, I made you contingent beneficiary Crow. I look away from her snarling eyes and stare at the mansion on the hill, all twenty three rooms of it. Life is good. **The end.**

links.title: 人有多成功，背后就有多自律
links.body:
中午出去散步的时候，发现了这个非常漂亮的小花儿，后来一查才知道，这个美丽的小花就是蔷薇花儿。 颜色艳丽，花蕊上还有小蜜蜂采摘花蜜呢！这些漂亮的小花儿，让我忍不住多拍了几张。 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVggQHjCdBwmvrtJChSshYMU9XJF73tXAP1r6L9vSDEUP/_1.jpg)



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX4ReS1METhkVR9D8w84W49ecvQgrJ4SsPFdYsJfToq8m/_.jpg)


而且在街上还看到了这个漂亮的小娃娃，也就是大家超级喜欢的拉布布，这个摊主卖的也不贵，25元一个。 还有一个烤焦炸毛娃，这个要的就是丑这个效果，炸毛的头发，让人看到了就想去摸摸。 这个是超级解压款！

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb6XGc3p2cTWiP8JeSvEcjGuDmpZZWxkY6DVjUf1k7JoC/chimao.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNfDGcBwPX2XFM75APnxPVHDEw9uiRkcuGLWp2Hs9bYym/_.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVRPhjyw3BPoHxrFgdxbzgGtKnebVAV6mv5y54j7MHgeW/yellow.jpg)

在街上散步的时候一边走路，一边听小说。 现在如果手机翻看比较累的话，干脆也不看了，直接听音频，我发现这种方式更好，省的还的看那些小字，这个收音对我来说是再合适不过了！

今天听的是曾国藩，其实对于曾国藩本人，我早在多年以前就曾经看到他的全传，非常佩服曾国藩这个人。 他为晚清建功立业，封侯拜相，是晚清重臣。 

但是他个人所取得的成就，全靠日复一日，严于律己的自我约束，所以成大事者，都是一个极度自律的人！有两件事印象深刻，深为佩服。 大家都知道一个人如果有烟瘾，那么戒掉就会很困难。 

年轻时期的曾国藩烟瘾成性，水烟袋常年不离身。他也深感吸烟的害处，尤其是当他看到好友因为肺癌去世，联想到自己，痛感吸烟百害无一利。 而且他发现那些圣贤们，例如孔子，孟子等都不吸烟，于是痛下决心开始戒烟。曾言：“连戒烟都做不到，还谈什么修身，治国，做圣贤？”砸烂所有烟具，最终成功戒掉烟瘾。 

还有一件事就是长期坚持写日记自省。 他的日记不是很长，有点像今天的微博。每天记录的是自己反省，心得体会，最重要的是， 他记日记绝不是单单给自己看，过了一段时间就会给亲朋好友传阅，借以督促自己，其实就是监督自己，这样自己的一些问题毛病得以解决。

他长年累月如此，哪怕后来身居高位，军务繁忙也从未间断写日记反省，因此靠着不断自省自查，改掉了傲慢浮躁，懒散拖延的坏毛病，心性越来越沉稳，格局也越来越开阔。 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNZuWAFasJYZmiJrZqNaaC7UFfMM3cay8VTpSyifqCQSo/3.jpg)

所以让我佩服的就是他能够将生活中的这些小事处理好，戒烟，写日记自省，这些看起来是小事，但是背后藏着一个人的高度自律，而相比之下， 我想控制一下自己的体重都很困难，所以这就是我为什么一直是微不足道的的那个小人物，而像曾国藩这样的圣贤都是一个对自己痛下杀手的一个狠角色！所以要想看看一个人能否成功，那就看看他是否自律吧！

Sua observação sobre a conexão entre a necropolítica de Mbembe, a banalização do mal de Arendt e os dados do Instituto Patrícia Galvão, bem como a valorização das vozes do Sul Global, mostra que o cerne da minha proposta foi compreendido. É exatamente essa a estrutura que busco desvelar para expor a natureza estrutural do feminicídio.Agradeço muito pelas sugestões do hivestats.io e hivepro.ai; com certeza irei explorá-las para otimizar meu trabalho aqui na Hive e acompanhar de perto o desenvolvimento do perfil.
 É sempre valioso receber indicações de ferramentas que podem aprimorar a experiência na plataforma.
Sobre a próxima publicação, sua pergunta é muito pertinente e toca em pontos cruciais. Acredito que, para dar continuidade à profundidade teórica que o primeiro post iniciou, o diálogo entre a teoria decolonial e a criminologia feminista será o caminho mais estratégico. Isso me permitirá aprofundar as bases conceituais que sustentam a análise da violência de gênero, estabelecendo um terreno sólido para, em publicações futuras, explorar a interseccionalidade da violência de gênero com a riqueza e a complexidade que o tema exige. Um passo de cada vez, construindo um arcabouço robusto.Mais uma vez, muito obrigada pelo seu tempo e pela sua contribuição tão valiosa. Espero vê-lo nas próximas discussões!\

body.title: Why Do Investors Prefer Startups With an MVP?
body.body:
## TL;DR

*   MVP shows the product actually works in real market conditions

*   It reduces investor risk before large funding decisions

*   It proves real user interest and demand

*   It gives early data like usage and feedback

*   It shows founders can execute ideas, not just pitch them

***

## Introduction

In the startup world, ideas are easy but execution is everything. Investors don’t just invest in concepts; they invest in proof. That’s why startups with an MVP (Minimum Viable Product) attract more attention. An MVP is a simple working version of a product that helps test real users, validate demand, and reduce uncertainty before scaling. In many cases, startups collaborate with an [mvp development company](https://www.creolestudios.com/mvp-development-company/) to quickly turn their idea into a functional product and accelerate validation in the market. 

***

## 7 Reasons Why Investors Prefer Startups With an MVP

### 1. Validates Real Market Demand

An MVP helps test whether real users actually need the product. Instead of guessing, startups get real feedback from real customers.
 This gives investors confidence that the idea solves a real problem. Without validation, even good ideas can fail in the market.

### 2. Reduces Investment Risk

Investing in startups is always risky, but an MVP lowers that risk significantly.
 It shows that the idea has already been tested in a real environment. Investors feel safer because the uncertainty is reduced.

### 3. Shows Early Product-Market Fit Signals

Even a basic MVP can reveal how users respond to the product.
 Metrics like engagement, retention, and feedback help identify early product-market fit. This helps investors see long-term potential.

### 4. Demonstrates Founder Execution Ability

An MVP proves that founders can actually build and deliver, not just plan.
 It reflects technical capability, problem-solving, and execution speed. Investors trust teams that can turn ideas into reality.

### 5. Provides Real User Data

MVPs generate real-world data such as user behavior, sign-ups, and engagement.
 Investors rely heavily on this data to make informed decisions. It replaces assumptions with measurable proof.

### 6. Speeds Up Investment Decisions

When an MVP is available, investors can directly test and evaluate the product.
 This reduces long pitch cycles and speeds up funding decisions. Seeing the product in action builds faster trust.

### 7. Helps Understand Scalability Potential

An MVP shows how the product performs under real usage conditions.
 Investors can evaluate whether the idea can scale or needs improvements. This helps them predict future growth potential.

***

## Conclusion:

An MVP is not just a starting point it is proof that a startup can survive in the real world. It reduces investor uncertainty, builds trust, and provides valuable data. That’s why startups with an MVP always stand a better chance of getting funded compared to idea-stage businesses.

***

## FAQs

## 1. What is an MVP in simple terms?

An MVP is the simplest version of a product built with only core features to test an idea with real users.

### 2. Why do investors trust MVP-based startups more?

Because MVPs show real validation, user feedback, and working proof instead of just ideas.

### 3. Is an MVP necessary to get funding?

Not always, but it significantly increases the chances of getting investment.

### 4. How does an MVP help reduce risk?

It allows testing the idea before large investment, reducing chances of failure.

### 5. What happens after an MVP is successful?

Startups improve features, scale the product, and move toward full market launch.

---

[Posted](https://waivio.com/@waivio_karan-chauhan/7utxyd-why-do-investors-prefer-startups-with-an-mvp) by Waivio guest: [@waivio_karan-chauhan](https://waivio.com/@waivio_karan-chauhan)

body.body:
https://youtu.be/0mhRqCfD_mY?si=y4BlyeSaSTB3rFjf
Watch on YouTube 

Pepsiman is a famous and unique game released on Sony Computer Entertainment's platform PlayStation PS1. This game is still quite popular among gamers today because of its humorous style fast paced gameplay and interesting levels.


You control the superhero Pepsiman who keeps running non stop.  

You have to avoid obstacles that come your way like cars walls and pits. 

In each level your goal is to deliver Pepsi to people. 

The game's speed system keeps getting faster over time.


The humorous cutscenes that appear in between the gameplay make it even more entertaining where a character keeps drinking Pepsi non stop this is what gives the game its unique identity.


*Simple but challenging gameplay 

*A classic feel that brings back old memories*  

*Fast paced action and entertainment

If you like classic PS1 games, Pepsiman is a must play game. Its unique style and humorous approach make it completely different from other running games.

body.title: A Nice Roasted Meat Dinner at Haoyouji
body.body:
I originally went to Geylang Bahru for dinner, but when I arrived, the food centre was closed for general cleaning. At first, it was a little bit inconvenient because I already had my mind set on having dinner there. But then again, I understand why these things need to happen.


![1000149716.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EpQwqaYf9EHh2XALJuHEpzTozFyibaB8TFdEibtNFBY5JgePBGXFmQKdxYExStcazdK.jpg)


Big hawker centres usually have scheduled closures for a few days so they can do a more thorough cleaning of the whole place. It may interrupt our dinner plans sometimes, but I actually appreciate it because it means the management is putting in effort to maintain the cleanliness and quality of the food centre. So even though my original plan didn’t happen, I wasn’t really annoyed by it.

Good thing there were still smaller food places nearby, so I decided to walk around and see what else I could have for dinner. That was how I ended up at Haoyouji.


![1000149706.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EpC9sZVry1JHpF1j2DP1Hbwgf8zb8q8TuiM3LPDsYTMFubhcZyPDFDt5m7vPdicM8Kr.jpg)


Among the options around the area, Haoyouji caught my attention because of the roasted meats displayed at the counter. The roasted duck, roasted pork, and char siew were all hanging beautifully under the warm lights, looking glossy, smoky, and very appetizing. Sometimes the display itself is already enough to convince me, especially when the roasted meat looks like it has been prepared with care.


![1000149708.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/23ywuQnw14zPbUKyqLgXhPZWage6hFF1rZwevRb3mTe3fMsE257qXbseiogy7LsmJD1JV.jpg)

![1000149707.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/Ep5nhaueieSzSyvgGifJR6vMfi2F4wCWkTyFhG46jUwRMYVoLNxN4eWbUrjnZ2VbB3j.jpg)

![1000149709.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/Ep1YJTuG2pD5NGPd1bfjDnFdZvEjGEb31LrGGZXHmeze8M96j1bbLBGVmkNc29SZujJ.jpg)


They also serve other dishes that are cooked upon order, but for me, the roasted meats looked like the main attraction. Many customers were ordering them too, so I thought it was a safe and good choice for dinner.

I chose the Roasted Meat Char Siew Rice.


![1000149714.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EopvL1fiNuuwR6wezJe419uK3WcZ23dorcNWV7uK5v7zrTQs8znk1rq2T7gq75rZKyV.jpg)


Since I already had chicken during lunch, I wanted something different for dinner. The combination of roasted pork and char siew felt perfect for that craving. It gives you two different kinds of satisfaction in one plate. The roasted pork brings that savory, meaty, and slightly crispy bite, while the char siew gives a sweeter, stickier, and more caramelized flavor.


![1000149721.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoyQsRFjtxxJ3GmBhSXiRQfe34nmb8jnQCBMBvrSGuR2CymYDHRfxBHo7ZqKDkhEjbv.jpg)


I really enjoyed switching between the two meats with every spoonful of rice. One bite would be more savory and roasted, then the next bite would be sweet and saucy from the char siew. That alternating flavor made the meal more enjoyable because it didn’t feel boring at all.


![1000149717.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EpLh1tX1TNvdnRDUypJPHGSH9gvdyFn2egU1uFzCU2QkwEdXyR9zQHUcBbnCh9YF9jW.jpg)


The sauce over the rice also helped bring everything together. It added that glossy, slightly sweet and savory coating that made the plain rice much more flavorful. I always think rice dishes like this work best when the sauce touches the rice just enough, so every spoonful has some flavor without becoming too wet.


![1000149718.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/Ep5p8NJH4XBRMaZoonyVXa4mgvG5jrxMoGgtskgzZdGDG1adiUjMvEWjqSVYtXn8rev.jpg)


Another thing that made the meal better was the pickled green chili on the side. I really like adding a little bit of chili when eating roasted meat rice because the tangy flavor cuts through the richness of the meat. That combination of savory roasted pork, sweet char siew, warm rice, and tangy pickled chili was really satisfying.


![1000149720.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoyQQfEYC8njb9LLfP6jebfre8GpcLgixWfARbdYxRyUwkBBakFHDds9NRnQ94kfw85.jpg)


The only small issue for me was the vegetable portion. There was a bit of steamed vegetable on the plate, but I wished there was more of it. The bright green vegetable added a nice fresh balance to the dish, so having a bigger portion would have made the meal feel more complete. Maybe next time I should order a separate vegetable dish too, so I can make the dinner more satisfying and slightly healthier. LOL.


![1000149715.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EpEKAW3sdceDomgEr1bpASzW5Hstd3wqV2XwEm2NC7tDxSXhw44ALa1zVU7rU5uA8ye.jpg)

![1000149719.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EpCBnpepGyqQSaojsA4gjYfu2YJVVbBfBydTTFFY7dDFDXXRkNRp8JCv5doMZSa78bL.jpg)


***Overall, my unexpected dinner at Haoyouji turned out to be a nice one. What started as a small change of plan became a simple but enjoyable roasted meat meal. The roasted pork and char siew combination was flavorful, satisfying, and definitely worth trying again.***

body.title: 🖤 Confidence looks better in black
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXZTAzcXE2bdL3NJBEL78s4GAibgixCJrAAXZtKSovJrR/IMG_9322.PNG 

Some outfits don’t need extra details… they just speak for themselves ✨

Today felt calm, elegant, and focused. The kind of day where I don’t feel the need to impress anyone, I just want to feel comfortable in my own energy.

Working as an *image consultant for boutique brands* has made me fall even more in love with simplicity. Clean lines, neutral colors, confidence without trying too hard… that’s the vibe I always come back to.

And honestly, I think that’s how life should feel too.

No forcing. No pretending. Just growing into the best version of yourself little by little.

Sometimes people think modeling is all about attention, but for me it’s more about presence. Learning how to carry yourself with quiet confidence no matter where you are.

Still dreaming big… just doing it more gracefully now 🖤

body.title: Does God listen to idol worshippers? |The Oldpath
body.body:
https://youtu.be/5fXbvluYcfw?si=WAQ2UC3znUs8m3FM

God pays attention to those who call on Him. Those who practice in idol worshipping distance themselves from God. God is not happy with that. Among the Lord's ten commandments it is stated that we should have no other god except God in Heaven.
‎
‎If we truly desire for God to hear us then we must do away with every other thing. We cannot hold on to God and at the same time hold on to idols . It doesn't work that way. We are either for God or for the devil, we either choose light or darkness.
‎
>**Joshua 24:15 (KJV) ‎**
And if it seem evil unto you to serve the Lord, choose you this day whom ye will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were on the other side of the flood, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but as for me and my house, we will serve the Lord. ‎

‎This was Joshua's statement. God can never have His glory shared with idols. We have to be decisive with who our submission lies to. There's no sitting on the fence. This is a decision that we have to get straight. Worship to God and idols cannot work. Anyone who sincerely loves God cannot even think of getting involved in idol worshiping.

body.title: 12  May 2026 @marinnewest's Freewrite Writing Prompt Day 3101: I'm A Engineer.
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVCMsSY6aqQi8i9hFuCkXb58X6TobPapmC6TtcsEVb2U5/1778681597333.jpg)[source](https://www.pexels.com/photo/portrait-of-an-african-engineer-in-safety-gear-36453960)

This is my post on #freewriters3101 #dailyprompt I'm a engineer hosted by @marinnewest's.
The morning sun began to crest over the Uyo skyline, casting a golden hue across the bustling landscape of the Akwa Ibom State capital. Ubong Etuk stood on the balcony of a rising infrastructure project, the cool Atlantic breeze carrying the faint scent of rain and damp earth. In his hands, he held a set of blueprints that mapped out more than just steel and concrete; they mapped the future of his community.
As a dedicated engineer, Ubong saw the city through a lens of structural integrity and sustainable innovation. Today’s focus was a complex drainage and road network designed to withstand the region’s tropical downpours. He walked the site with a rhythmic pace, checking the alignment of the reinforced beams. To the casual observer, it was a construction site, but to Ubong, it was a mathematical symphony. He could see the forces of tension and compression at play, calculating load distributions mentally as he greeted his team in a mix of professional English and warm local dialect.
By midday, the heat was intense, but Ubong remained focused. He spent an hour at his workstation, refining a series of calculations for a new solar-integrated power system for the complex. He believed that engineering wasn't just about building tall—it was about building smart.
As the evening settled and the lights of Uyo began to flicker on, Ubong looked out at the city he helped shape. There was a profound quiet satisfaction in knowing that the bridges he built and the grids he designed would carry his neighbors safely into tomorrow. Engineering was his craft, but Uyo was his heartbeat.

body.title: Withdrawals and Burn Proposal
body.body:
# Withdrawals are Available

We actually released withdrawals a week ago, but then we got busy with other things and never posted the announcement. So here it is!

You can withdraw your THREE earnings from Three Legacy. As part of the release, we did extensive analysis of the hydration gates, and we softened the restrictions extensively. Almost all players have enough hydration to withdraw, and any returning player can target a hydration level sufficient to withdraw within a few days of activity after their return.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/three.legacy/23tGTKr6bzDuS2n7nYAJmiE8ot7ek9ZqvMNeBhXDMczMB33W31FvNsfyhMFrjVhjcvtdm.png)


# Burn

Now, let's talk economics. As part of the hydration analysis, we did a deep dive into the current state of the economy. It's healthy, although lack of new content has of course caused some slowdown. The real issues come from our over-emphasis on new content at time of launch, rather than getting all the blockchain wiring in place.

Here are the proposed flows:

1. Revenue comes in from signups or booster packs
2. Revenue is apportioned out to various game accounts, depending on the particular booster pack.
3. As the player plays the game, on-chain flows roughly mirror in-game flows.
4. Reward pool is perpetually funded by cash flows from LP and other on-chain assets.
5. As players do in-game actions, some contribute to burn targets or add to reward pools.

This was always the plan, and continues to be the plan, but notice a couple of important details.
The game itself never sells any THREE; but on-chain flows mirroring in-game activity result in regular purchases of THREE, particularly enough THREE to mirror the reward pool flows.

Everything works fantastic as long as we are doing the THREE purchasing right away. The game's purchases of THREE provide buying pressure, which changes the valuation of THREE, and then subsequent in-game flows are at lower THREE amounts for the same economic value activities. But if we're not doing purchases right away, the in-game THREE flows are logged are too low a valuation. If this went on long enough, then tracking proposed burn in THREE could result in a proposal to burn more THREE than exists. We are not yet at that long a delay, but we have enough delay already to propose a burn of more THREE than exists in the three.growth account.

We are not going to do that. Using all the funds from the three.growth account just to meet the scheduled burn would shortchange our future. We need those funds to fully back a free-to-play mode when we are ready for that.

So here is what we are going to do...

We are going to prioritize the backend wiring before releasing any more content. The game is in a stable state right now, and we don't want to risk any new bugs or delay factors before the wiring is in place. Instead of immediately burning the proposed amount, we will gradually fund the three.burn account with the proposed burn value but inject it into the LP. That account will then proceed with buy&burn with all of its own cash flows. 

Once every other game account is caught up to its target holdings levels to fully mirror in-game flows, we will target 100% holdings in THREE on three.growth until it holds more THREE than it was originally issued. Then we will increase our THREE burns to keep its holdings at that target level until the total THREE that we have burned catches up to our proposed burn levels.

As we burn THREE, we will gradually shift funds back from the three.burn account to keep its holdings at (proposed burn minus actual burn) so once we are caught up three.burn will hold nothing.

It's a gradual plan that gets us back to where we wanted to start, but enables us to still release free-to-play when it is ready instead of having to rebuild the growth fund because we burned it all.

# TLDR
We are still going to burn THREE, but more slowly at first, at a sustainable rate that reflects current game economics, not the low THREE valuations that existed at launch. We will not release any new game content until all the blockchain wiring is working correctly, so that we don't potentially destabilize again.

[What Will Your Legacy Be?](https://www.threelegacy.com/lore)

body.title: MSCI Inc.  A Money Making Machine Finally Back to a Sane Valuation
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVEvF8aVgVPA2JDfp9EiS9zp4vVD4p7HG4X9Xk3jHgLjK/1000006672.png 

Time flies in the market, but there’s one name that always seems to sit comfortably in big institutional portfolios MSCI. Honestly, most people just know them as the guys who make indices, but when you dig into their guts, this company is actually a high performance money printing machine. In this article, I want to break down why I’m keeping a close eye on this stock using some solid fundamental data plus a quick look at the technicals to see if it’s currently a steal or a skip.

**Revenue That Never Looks Back**
Check out their annual revenue growth chart from 2017 until now.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUZvEPAqjEBWA9TJKDwtmrmxyNhu6c2aD5o7fy8m2zS8C/1000006625.jpg 

To me, this is the definition of a dream chart for long term investing because it moves up steadily like a staircase. From 2017, where revenue was around $1.27 billion, it’s now sitting pretty at $3.23 billion (LTM). That’s a total increase of **154.24%** with a **12% CAGR.** For a mature company, that kind of growth is super stable. It shows that their ESG data indices and analytics aren't just a trend they’re a must have for fund managers worldwide.

**Profits Growing Faster Than Sales**
One thing I really respect about MSCI’s management is their ability to make profit grow even faster than their sales.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZU69EbZAqYKGAtZ9Sdt5x2PFWJtsg8mG774GuDn8At2e/1000006621.jpg 

You can really see the operating leverage magic here. While revenue grew by 12%, their Net Income actually grew with a **19.5% CAGR.** The total jump in profit since 2017 is insane up **334.16%.** This means every new dollar coming in doesn't require a lot of extra cost to manage, so the profit just flows straight to the bottom line.

**Magic Margins and Cash Flow**
If we’re talking quality, we have to look at the Net Profit Margin.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRaGqQcH9sDRdyhGY2ryYHEZeHNBVW28XWK65xFAFdDCK/1000006623.jpg 

Their margins are some of the thickest in the industry, currently sitting at **40.7%.** It even peaked at 45.4% back in late 2023. It’s very rare to find a company that can maintain these kinds of margins consistently unless they have a massive moat that competitors can't touch.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPhyzb4Yp6fQ3LSfadv9e3i91Rsqc8ELXbALydt5QBrQb/1000006624.jpg 

Then there's the cash flow. MSCI isn’t just a company that looks good on paper; their actual cash is overflowing, with **19% CAGR** growth. They use this cash to pay dividends or buy back shares, which eventually goes right back into our pockets as shareholders.

**Finally a Price That Makes Sense**
Now for the part every trader loves to argue about valuation.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYyM5e4RaenKtzEVctUcrvnxtxj6QbvaW3HbEENafqudY/1000006622.jpg 

Flashback to 2021, and MSCI’s valuation was honestly kind of nuts the Forward P/E soared above 60x. That was basically buying a dream. Luckily, the market has cooled off and given us a healthy correction. Now, their Forward P/E is at **28.75x.** For a diamond tier company at a big discount from its peak, this is definitely something worth watching.

**Technical Peek Chilling in Consolidation**
I just checked the daily chart for MSCI, and it's currently moving in a pretty wide consolidation zone.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRWKe3ZHcaRac2shGXenPHsrmaT5h89DKiRWjqFvmQBQe/1000006665.jpg 

Price is currently holding around $581 after bouncing between $525 and $633. Looking at the indicators, the RSI is at **52.70,** which is neutral. However, the Stochastic at **29.78** is getting close to that oversold territory. Usually, once it dips below 20, we might see a short term bounce. That **$578 - $581** area is super crucial to hold.

**The Future 2026 - 2028 Projections**
I also took a look at what analysts are predicting for the next few years.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZxofLfkroh6v67gpB9giQi9UsXYhAuuYZDdjon8531v6/1000006683.jpg 

The future looks bright. Sales are projected to climb from $3.49B in 2026 to **$4.10B by 2028.** Earnings Per Share (EPS) is also expected to jump from 19.63 to **25.52.** For the upcoming quarter (Q2 2026), EBITDA and EPS are expected to show solid growth of **6.70%** and **6.50%** respectively. If this plays out, the valuation will naturally get even cheaper over time if the price stays here.

**Important MSCI News**
To keep it real, I gathered a few key updates on what’s happening with MSCI.


- **Expanding in Asia According to Reuters,** MSCI is doubling down on its dominance in the Asia Pacific region by launching new ESG indices focused on energy transition. This perfectly explains that revenue growth we saw earlier.
- **Solid Earnings Performance** Based on the latest quarterly data from their investor relations, MSCI continues to report double digit revenue growth. Their subscription based model is proving to be incredibly resilient, even when the broader market gets a bit shaky.

Basically, because so many ETFs are tied to their indices, MSCI can raise fees without losing clients. This is exactly why those net profit margins are staying thick at over 40%.

Honestly, MSCI is the kind of stock that lets you sleep at night. The fundamentals are rock solid, margins are massive, and the cash flow is undeniable. A 28x Forward P/E is way more friendly than what we’ve seen in years past.

Technically, we might have to be patient while it consolidates, but for long term investors, this area down to the support level is a sweet spot for scaling in. Remember, investing is a marathon, not a sprint so keep your money management tight.

body.title: A Summer Festival Under the Ocean
body.body: > The weather here sometimes gets so hot that we literally wish we could just be immersed in a pool or some body of water and remain there all day to salvage the heat situation that comes with a particular season here in this part of the world. The weird one is wishing that we could be locked in a refrigerator or something like that, to keep cool and avoid the heat that gets extremely overwhelming. Bathing always feels cool and soothing. But only long enough till you're out of the shower or bathroom, and the next minute you're already sweating profusely. The heat season comes with all of these. In other parts of the world, this is known as the summer season. It's that time people like to go to swimming pools, beaches, to cool off and all of that to manage the weather or season. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbqehMkdToGhiSGmVKwbEa6HAQrk4s5MRMS973MnvPFR2/1778679261870.png Say there's an opportunity to escape the heat and burden of this season in the form of a holiday or festival beneath the ocean, with some form of measures in place for a safe environment for people who would be coming in for the festival, would I want to do this? Would I choose to partake in this idea and adventure of a summer festival beneath the ocean? How about when the access ticket price is high? I've always mentioned how I consider and like the idea of adventure. I mean, it feels good to experience and try new things. You tend to have more exposure and some stories to tell. All that could make me want to go to that festival. Perhaps, I could experience what mermaid life feels like. Chuckles. One thing I do always say as well in respect to adventures is, at what cost would I be choosing that adventure? This is where I consider the nature of that adventure and whether it's one to take by all means. And for me, this isn't one adventure and festival I would be willing to partake in. Not even when the ticket price is high. I understand that there'll be provisions for a safe environment for people. But the thing is, with water, anything can happen. Even if the ocean plants and animals don't interfere, the water body itself is a threat, and one of the greatest threats humanity has faced. We see that in the likes of floods due to dams breaking or overflowing. What's worse is that it's dangerous and harder to control, unlike fire, wind and other elements. I consider all these and I feel the better option is chilling back at home, perhaps with AC through that summer. I could use that ticket money to subscribe to some movie platform, maybe watch Aquaman and see what life beneath the ocean looks like. Then possibly, I might go in the event of a next one. --- *Image is AI generated.* --- ###### Thank you for reading!
