body.title: Chandramallika
body.body:
The Chandramallika flower, widely known as the chrysanthemum, is one of the most cherished blossoms in South Asia, especially in India and Bangladesh. Known for its vibrant colors and full, layered petals, this flower thrives in the cooler months and is often seen brightening gardens during late autumn and winter. Its name “Chandramallika,” meaning moon’s petal in Bengali and Hindi contexts, reflects its round, radiant appearance that resembles the soft glow of a full moon.

body.title: Restoring the Spark.
body.body: > To avoid a fatal fight, I lured Infected away from a tight room and escaped through a vent. I manually pulled a cable from a generator room to the top of a tower while being chased. After restoring power and earning the sheriff's trust, a bitten ranger committed suicide. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcj3t3rfyaUzH3mjVnzseYM5zQw1CTofKbxxP7c6jHzSU/screenshot_1_.png) I had to go out as it would be a fatal decision to fight the infected inside that tight room where I was cornered. And the first thing I did was taking down another infected outside who was blocking my path. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdXndJUyyhPRyrET1HYd8Wt46RVpLVb3KjHHPwshZYYZB/screenshot_2_.png) I didn't want to fight the remaining infected as I didn't have enough weapons to waste on them. So I lured them to another side of the roof to slow them down and escape by using a quick distraction. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmabkSoYZmDo4z4W2PnHyLe5yvcpqmMBpus7MWtgrbJrtc/screenshot_3_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcAiu7JX3debyU8JD7upe6hc55DU7Gy4gZyAw92XAJoDE/screenshot_4_.png) Then I jumped off from another side where the infected couldn't see me and I went inside this generator room after picking a lock. I found the generator and switched the power on, but it looked like the cables were shredded, by some monsters probably. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYQt2SrkW8cLB2N2tC2Xo4NjuHPyTY7BvomsMauJynVSg/screenshot_5_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYnXZqXUiNEt2DLeDRqDizzSSpvgeHPZ67TVdzQBfvAyt/screenshot_6_.png) So I had to restore the power manually by taking a cable out from the circuit board to all the way towards that tower. The cable was heavy and slowed my movement, making me feel exposed as I crossed the open ground toward the structure's base. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP84BWX4z2pCTTeLDtnk6Q5E9yk9bBXMPBzZdpgx9igAp/screenshot_7_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRx83Z4YtE5k81X64h7vobjyNr6trGMfmwUs4q67egUfk/screenshot_8_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXGa2USLeZUVV9XRMb6WF4BeLbY9GK9bD3YH4ryrU1jCW/screenshot_9_.png) After pulling the cable out of the circuit board, I noticed there was a small vent hole that I used to get out of that room. I squeezed through the tight space, hoping the noise wouldn't attract any infected. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeGyzLnHn8u5A5qaycya1x3hpLmbrw8tPNtkd2hPpCp1a/screenshot_10_.png) Right after getting outside, I noticed some infected were climbing up the tower real fast to get to the sheriff at the top. I knew I had to be faster if I wanted to save her. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSvVDRiWdGhULfotuf4pxxSiaWXCBnReAK3ZzVrrfzHAA/screenshot_11_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQsUdaN6eZ7Tzq64WkEasFUk7CJuHVuLfJje5DwAKEEiM/screenshot_12_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeiUV8PWLCe2HJ7Rdbq4CXp7eJs3oMPjvSYSqpCaveWcH/screenshot_13_.png) I also started climbing up, taking the cable with me and I reached the infected climbing up earlier were shot down. Their bodies were scattered across the platforms, evidence of the sheriff's accurate aim during the chaotic struggle below. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfPvnPiWYsLcE4kfQNfUTdC9tJy1hKsAwbq2AnWHf2sxX/screenshot_14_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZXwXszBHzrHmGANLMaDFuBtEQw4dakJ8u1QtorJauyRK/screenshot_15_.png) At last, I reached the top of the tower and I turned the power on by connecting the cable to the circuit there. The machinery hummed to life, and the lights flickered on, signaling a successful restoration. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWLresPAzLWZtS2JnJexZAcwmi671LtcXWX3PrmM773Qq/screenshot_16_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTSERJm6Dx9uAb2DRk44E6homeiE4s9tjv2UfKPhSv9W3/screenshot_17_.png) After doing this task, Kyle was brought into the group as the sheriff would at last trust him to be a good hand. It was the first step toward building a real alliance. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTgGeKJNPNttL2EWX8YMLeiUaZ57bvesZ2nMUfNRwbRmU/screenshot_18_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeFV4TZEGLDq38VK8P1b8b2Hj4xJ3n49SP5G7hurjf9m9/screenshot_19_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb9KrwYha4VgowLM2iCcPFqytqtjPxe9zTHGdyDS1ny72/screenshot_20_.png) That ranger who was injured on top of that tower came back, who got bitten by an infected. Realizing his fate, he shot himself dead before the fever could take him. Everyone stood in silence, mourning another loss in this endless war. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf8My7oxtXHhqmLqJvEZcTsPnYcThRSh6ARWp7eRGVuEt/screenshot_21_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmekPyA8DLSskPPJsGmzB7Pyqiz1MPELrM316itw78tSVW/screenshot_22_.png) The sheriff asked his peoples to give the body a proper burial, then this old man said I didn't kill the beast, I killed a different monster. He asked me to meet him when I was ready. I'll show what happens next later. --- I personally took all the screenshots from my play and I used a logo of the game from online to use in the thumbnail. This is Pikachuuuuu signing off. Over and out. --- ▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=pikachuuuuu/b34ba21e)

body.title: Wednesday Walk: Seahouses: Harbour Boats, Yarn Bombs and Other Quirky Things
body.body:
https://images.hive.blog/DQmV9ohKjf2SC9EnstsMxY3LQzMx3gyDufpSjGYwAMeTTPQ/InCollage_20260512_193955230~2.jpg

While on a visit to Seahouses, a coastal village in Northumberland, UK, we really enjoyed walking around the harbour and streets.  This is my #wednesdaywalk, initiated by @tattoodjay.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmWTTUGin3bh5gaVeCni8vcnyDvcT1QBYQwg5bqFt1xH2c/Messenger_creation_86E350AD-D10A-41DD-8C7F-9CEA3B26FB76~2.jpeg

The harbour in Seahouses was busy with colourful fishing boats lined up beside the docks. Nets, ropes and fishing equipment were stacked on the boats, showing the harbour’s connection to the fishing industry. 

https://images.hive.blog/DQmUPQuEDm4saP5W2mJCUm3hiB2WmGEs8d2PgNo8B6ctQM3/Messenger_creation_812B8647-2120-4D80-8649-9B4C8B3CDFDF~3.jpeg

There was a boat in the shallow water while the tide was out. A nice reflection of the boat could be seen in the water. 

https://images.hive.blog/DQmWh5j2dQvxuNNoVEEYq8GqP7Smae1Tr3YBBKG5QBA82v4/Messenger_creation_102F55B8-ADAB-4A51-89BB-73EF7D5F5646~2.jpeg

Further along the coast, the sea was rougher with waves crashing against the rocky shoreline.  The rocks along the beach were covered in patches of green seaweed.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmTKKBxC2T4nPaqsqRSf122Er1F9PfvY1ikGYhWwDwBqyL/Messenger_creation_FB1F6A6A-51F8-4AEB-92C2-E15D01ADF232~2.jpeg

https://images.hive.blog/DQmfBZze37T9gnoa8wAsNpAchryyPa4wQvqhRLVTti7cN2a/Messenger_creation_36B97A1B-8011-4196-97FD-113FD4F7D227~2.jpeg

Along the streets there were lots of colourful displays of sea themed yarn bombing hanging on posts. We spotted  knitted seals, lobsters and other sea creatures in bright colours. The displays definitely caught your attention as you walked past.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmaTQTpteucpy6u7sz1Cg85inZvFgxLWjCH1CtL4CHmypi/Messenger_creation_08C238CA-3B79-47CD-8D10-A1C2C54E32F6~2.jpeg

One of the things that made us smile was spotting plant pots shaped like wellington boots in somebody’s window.   

https://images.hive.blog/DQmXwTHy9Wq5a7a68rr3cdRwJSg8B3AbyHCPSAgvrS5LRpr/Messenger_creation_F274D6D9-460B-4969-9A19-BC227534013E~2.jpeg

Overall, it was a really enjoyable walk around Seahouses with a mix of the harbour, colourful boats and the quieter streets. Even the yarn bombing and the quirky displays, added a bit of character to the village. It’s the kind of place where you can just wander without much of a plan and still keep spotting little things that bring a smile to your face. 

https://images.hive.blog/DQmTQF6wQW4xj6B6wQh99WqmNgkL1JrpKsWChsLv5k5Lq4b/PaRgthAvamAmR7uZi4RENh3BWaKjnQbhHtF9iaSV1cVaeSir8SCZYpmzMLvBrDLdiD44L3w4RUXvxqnkBg2eqoHbbUCFgVMLCokxymJ6uR...g2EUvmwMbS8rDTmwiZZiXJVfaSEG5zu7KhSz75fp2aWUpTTXMModEMjmcJDocpskjENinHpDX2Xfhqs6PzWxPZxGDEgVmqwVo162Vb1AHTA1YxrG6iGLyJ3Dqw.gif

Desde comienzos de año, mis ingresos mermaron drásticamente, llevándome a reducir gastos y sacrificar salidas que acostumbraba con mis hermanos e hijos. Recientemente, la situación se puso “color de hormiga” y me sentí ahogado; fue entonces cuando decidí hablar con alguien. Le conté a un amigo que las cosas estaban tan serias que incluso mis medicamentos para la hipertensión estaban siendo objeto de las restricciones.

Mi amigo se alarmó y de inmediato me preguntó: “¿Por qué no pides ayuda?”. De hecho, ya lo había hecho con mi familia y ellos respondieron, pero como la situación se fue agravando, no quería convertirme en una carga para ellos. Me encontraba en un callejón sin salida, y me resistía a buscar otras opciones hasta que mi amigo me impulsó.

Esa fue la primera ayuda. La segunda fue hablar con los líderes de la iglesia, quienes actuaron con la rapidez de Flash; el apoyo llegó para seis meses, tiempo suficiente para recuperarme y seguir mi cauce. Esta ayuda calmó mi ansiedad y mi estado mental, pero, más que eso, el gesto de mi amigo y de la iglesia me llenó de amor. Eso me sacó a flote anímicamente y hoy me siento muy bien. Dios siempre está con nosotros, reflejado en la familia, los amigos, los hermanos y sus acciones. Como siempre, amigo @emiliorios, tú con tus excelentes temas. Un abrazo.

!ALIVE

body.title: (ESP-ENG) Nuremberg | The hidden side of the trial - Movie Review!
body.body:
**<center>Hola amigos, buenas vibras para todos.</center>** 

> Hello friends, good vibes to all.



![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/23xKjjATzSN1497ER5cc1SfNBphk1Sp6DcpP7VgicXpJPJBDh1xJDkwdKWZKY95R6ciHx.jpg)


[Source!](https://www.primevideo.com/-/es/detail/0QEQJXN1HM5DV0D8GH9YJR9SF8)

<div class=\

>Como una persona amante de la historia y sobretodo de la segunda guerra mundial ver series, documentales y películas que tengan que ver con lo sucedido en aquellos nefastos años siempre será un buen plan para mi. Después de que la Alemania nazi cayera era imposible que ese poco de hombres, todos escondidos y buscando escapar, quedaran impunes de todas las atrocidades que cometieron cuando estaban en el poder y es precisamente a raíz de esa necesidad de justicia que nace la idea de hacer un juicio, uno que estuviera precedido por las cuatro naciones que ayudaron a conseguir el fin del tercer Reich. Así pues fue en Nuremberg, lugar simbólico para los nazis, en donde se decidió hacer el cobro de la justicia para los monstruos que aún quedaban, que aún no se había suicidado.

> As someone who loves history, especially World War II, watching series, documentaries, and films about those dark years is always a good plan for me. After Nazi Germany fell, it was impossible for those few men, all in hiding and trying to escape, to go unpunished for all the atrocities they committed while in power. It was precisely this need for justice that gave rise to the idea of ​​a trial, one presided over by the four nations that helped bring about the end of the Third Reich. Thus, it was in Nuremberg, a symbolic place for the Nazis, that the decision was made to deliver justice to the monsters who remained, those who had not yet committed suicide.

>Este film se centra en tres personajes. Hermann Göring, mano derecha de Hitler (Russell Crowe), Douglas Kelly, psiquiatra del ejército estadounidense (Rami Malek) y Robert H. Jackson, fiscal de USA (Michael Shannon). Basicamente la película narra los días previos del juicio, justo en el momento cuando Göring es capturado, Kelly es llamado para que lo estudie y analice en pro de sacar información para el juicio y la parte en como el fiscal Jackson es clave para que dicho juicio se lograra concretar. La trama es esa, ver como este psiquiatra logra ganarse la confianza de un ser completamente narcisista y enfermo de poder que incluso estando capturado soñaba y anhelaba mantener todo lo que Hitler alguna vez construyó.

> This film focuses on three characters: Hermann Göring, Hitler's right-hand man (Russell Crowe); Douglas Kelly, a U.S. Army psychiatrist (Rami Malek); and Robert H. Jackson, the U.S. Attorney (Michael Shannon). The film essentially narrates the days leading up to the trial, specifically the moment Göring is captured. Kelly is called in to study and analyze him in order to gather information for the trial, and the role of Attorney Jackson in bringing the trial to fruition. The plot revolves around how this psychiatrist manages to gain the trust of a completely narcissistic and power-hungry individual who, even in captivity, dreamed of and longed to maintain everything Hitler had once built. ![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/243zbn3L93KWefuihSXjdxTSGW59Uj7H9U1hpysf2iCq75eSMchMHxwwasfvCWk6MKPp4.jpg) [Source!](https://mubi.com/es/ve/films/nuremberg-2024) --- ![3.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/23tkpLc4gmxhRFyVQp5ivnpLMs2mkfaJ9HBQqLi8quHYXao6d8mPWZPmSfwxdxNMJNmtC.webp) [Source!](https://mundocine.es/noticias/peliculas/nuremberg-2025-nuevo-trailer-estreno-cines-russell-crowe-rami-malek/)

>Porque si, hay mucha crítica hacia esta película por sobre su manera de mostrar los juicios cuando en la realidad lo que estamos viendo es la perspectiva del psiquiatra y de cómo logra adentrarse en la mente o dentro de la confianza de este alto cargo nazi. Pero claro, es que la película se llama \

, como no se va a hablar del juicio como tal? - y si se habla pero de una manera muy superficial, no tiene la profundidad que pudiera ameritar. Tengo entendido que hay otro film, de hace unos cuantos años más atrás el cual es mucho más fiel al momento de relatar lo sucedido, de repente (Judgment at Nuremberg de 1961) pudiera ser algo más acertado. Todo esto no quiere decir que esta película sea mala, personalmente la disfruté mucho sobretodo por las actuaciones tanto de Crowe como de Malek.

> Yes, there's a lot of criticism of this film regarding its portrayal of the trials, when in reality what we're seeing is the psychiatrist's perspective and how he manages to delve into the mind, or rather, the trust, of this high-ranking Nazi official. But of course, the film is called \

—how could it not address the trial itself? And it does, but in a very superficial way; it lacks the depth it deserves. I understand there's another film, from a few years earlier, that's much more faithful to the events; perhaps (Judgment at Nuremberg from 1961) might be a better choice. All this doesn't mean the film is bad; personally, I enjoyed it a lot, especially because of the performances of both Crowe and Malek.

>Interpretar a un tipo como Göring no es fácil, de él se han dicho muchas cosas y como casi todos los nazi tenía una personalidad muy extravagante. El trabajo que hace Russell Crowe es bastante decente y bueno, al final debajo de esa personalidad desafiante y aparentemente dura y sin fisuras los nazi eran tipos profundamente cobardes y débiles de mente, de ahí a que muchos se terminaran suicidando, incluido Göring minutos antes de ser llevado a la horca. Por otro lado tenemos a Kelly, un psiquiatra el cual era bastante bueno en lo que hacía pero se acercó mucho al fuego que terminó quemándose; él ayudó mucho a conseguir información para \

a Göring en el propio juicio. Creo que sin Kelly las cosas hubiesen sido diferentes. Lo que hace Malek con ese personaje también es bastante top.

> Playing a man like Göring isn't easy. Many things have been said about him, and like almost all Nazis, he had a very eccentric personality. Russell Crowe's performance is quite decent and good. In the end, beneath that defiant, seemingly tough, and flawless facade, the Nazis were profoundly cowardly and weak-minded, which explains why so many ended up committing suicide, including Göring minutes before he was to be hanged. On the other hand, we have Kelly, a psychiatrist who was quite good at what he did but got too close to the fire and ended up getting burned. He was instrumental in obtaining information that ultimately led to Göring's downfall during the trial itself. I think things would have been different without Kelly. Malek's portrayal of that character is also top-notch. ![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/23tbRLZ1U3beQnFJMdsb7hxnYY9JtsGtVjpuJm8oTqcoeJd6xzkM6Ao9wxdfQbjNtEiCU.jpg) [Source!](https://www.filmaffinity.com/es/film597108.html) --- ![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/23t7DYpukYxxvULr4i3JmA66bvzoGMRiJt7Bu6rpQMBNXdJijttMjPpJqa3o778fhFLBM.jpg) [Source!](https://www.zendalibros.com/cuando-los-perversos-se-sentaron-en-el-banquillo/)

>En fin, la película es muy buena pero creo que es una versión muy simplista de lo que fueron realmente esos juicios. Hay varias inconsistencias por la forma en como plasmaron a ciertos personajes, el fiscal Jackson por ejemplo, que es una persona que dista mucho de como es mostrada en este film. La realidad es que, y vuelvo a repetir, estamos ante la perspectiva de Douglas Kelly y de como logró tratar a una persona como Göring; de ahí a la probable falta de profundidad del film. Ambientación, actuaciones, cinematografía; todo esto es un 10. A la película le doy un 7.5/10. Dura dos horas y media pero la verdad se pasan muy rápido. Si te gusta la historia y quieres ver buenas actuaciones, está más que recomendada. Les dejo el tráiler por acá abajo.

> In short, the film is very good, but I think it's a very simplistic version of what those trials were really like. There are several inconsistencies in the way they portrayed certain characters, Prosecutor Jackson for example, who is a very different person from how he's shown in this film. The reality is, and I repeat, we're seeing Douglas Kelly's perspective and how he dealt with someone like Göring; hence the film's likely lack of depth. The setting, acting, and cinematography are all top-notch. I give the film a 7.5/10. It's two and a half hours long, but they really fly by. If you like history and want to see good acting, it's highly recommended. I've included the trailer below. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WvAy9C-bipY ***

Bueno mi gente por hoy es todo, espero que les haya gustado. ¡Un abrazo a todos, nos vemos en la próxima!
***

> Well folks, that's all for today. I hope you enjoyed it. ¡Hugs to everyone, see you next time!

body.title: Book review of El Capitán Tormenta [Eng-Esp]
body.body:
Hello, community.

I recently reread Captain Storm. Truly, when I was little, I remembered this book as something enormous, the kind that seemed like it would never end. I don't know if it's because in childhood we're desperate to get to the last pages of these kinds of books, and when it's about to finish, you feel a bit sad that the reading is over. And it's a very short book that packs a lot of action and also a lot of emotion into just a few pages.

Many current novels, with twice as many pages, don't achieve what Salgari accomplishes here in such a short space. The interesting thing is that, even as years go by, this story still feels current. Think about it: a Neapolitan countess named Leonor who disguises herself as a man, leads a company of soldiers, and faces an army to rescue the man she loves. That's no longer just a swashbuckling adventure; it becomes a story of female empowerment, without much speechifying or moralizing. Leonor simply grabs her sword, puts on the disguise, and does what she has to do.

>_Saludos comunidad_

>_Hace poco volví a leer El Capitán Tormenta, verdaderamente cuando era pequeño, recordaba este libro como algo enorme, de los que parecen no acabarse, no se si será porque en la infancia, estamos desesperados por llegar a las últimas páginas de este tipo de libros, y ya cuando se esta por terminar, da un poquito de tristes, que se acabe la lectura, y pues es un libro muy corto, que en pocas páginas condensa mucha acción y también mucho sentimiento. Muchas novelas actuales, con el doble de páginas, no consiguen lo que Salgari logra aquí en tan poco espacio._

>_Lo interesante es que, aunque pasen los años, esta historia sigue sintiéndose actual. Si pensamos, en una condesa napolitana llamada Leonor que se hace pasar por hombre, lidera una compañía de soldados, para enfrentar a un ejército para rescatar al hombre que ama, ya  rso no es solo una aventura de espadachines, viene siendo una historia de empoderamiento femenino, lo que sin mucho discursos ni moralinas. Leonor simplemente coge la espada, se pone el disfraz y hace lo que tiene que hacer._
********
<center>https://m.media-amazon.com/images/S/compressed.photo.goodreads.com/books/1309102675i/9561718.jpg</center>
********
<center>[Source/Fuente](https://www.goodreads.com/book/show/9561718-el-capit-n-tormenta?ref=nav_sb_ss_1_20)</center>

The book is of its time; there are exaggerations, somewhat theatrical dialogues, and Salgari takes liberties with historical facts. If you're looking for an exact lesson on what happened during the siege of Rhodes or Constantinople, it's better to look elsewhere. Here the author does not adapt the story to real events, but rather adapts real events to the adventures of Captain Storm. This seems fine to me, because in the end what he seeks is the readers' enjoyment.

At a time when young adult literature is full of fantasy worlds and science fiction, it's a pleasure to rediscover a novel as down‑to‑earth as this one, with medieval settings, sword duels, ships and gunpowder, especially considering that we have somewhat abandoned the adventure genre, as if it were only for children, which it is not. Captain Storm is for anyone who wants to dream, be moved, and have a good time.

Furthermore, you can learn things almost without realizing it: about the Knights of Malta, the clashes between Byzantines and Turks, geography... All of this while you suffer and celebrate with the protagonist. If you haven't read Captain Storm or you have it tucked away as \

I encourage you to look for it. You might be surprised by how modern a novel from over a hundred years ago can be, and also by how much can be told in so few pages.

>_El libro es de su época, hay exageraciones, diálogos un poco teatrales y Salgari se toma sus libertades con los hechos históricos, si se busca una clase exacta de lo que pasó en el asedio de Rodas o Constantinopla, es mejor mirar hacia otro lado, pues quí el autor no adapta la historia a los hechos reales, sino que adapta los hechos reales a las aventuras del Capitán Tormenta, cosa esta que a mí me parece bien, porque al final lo que se busca es el disfrute de los lectores._

>_En un momento donde la literatura juvenil está llena de mundos fantásticos y ciencia ficción, da gusto reeencontrar una novela tan terrenal como esta, con sitios medievales, duelos a espada, barcos y pólvora, especialmente si tenemos en cuenta que el género de aventuras lo tenemos un poco abandonado, como si fuera solo para niños, y no es así. El Capitán Tormenta es para cualquier persona que quiera soñar, emocionarse y pasar un buen rato._

>_Además se pueden aprender cosas casi que sin darte cuenta: de los caballeros de Malta, los enfrentamientos entre bizantinos y turcos, de geografía... Todo eso mientras sufres y celebras con la protagonista. Si no has leído El Capitán Tormenta o lo tienes arrinconado como \

, te animo a buscarlo, te puede sorprender lo moderna que puede ser una novela de hace más de cien años, y también lo mucho que se puede contar en tan pocas páginas._

body.title: New Horizons in Splinterlands!!
body.body:
# New Horizons in Splinterlands: Upcoming Educational Series

Exciting things are brewing at the studio! I am thrilled to announce the launch of three distinct video series designed to empower the community, from absolute beginners to returning veterans.




![Gemini_Generated_Image_s2vs9es2vs9es2vs.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iblast/23uQrDL5s2uHa7A1zE5LkM399LjUvErEihF1Fmg3UGT4cuJdYnxbzGNGabiU9Cjk8hNWa.jpg)

Whether you are looking to master the complexities of Land or just trying to figure out how to put workers on your first plot, these series are built for you.

## The Roadmap: Twitch Live to YouTube Masterclass
Each segment will debut live on my Twitch stream. This allows for
real-time interaction, Q&A, and that authentic live energy. However, I know your time is valuable.

![Copilot_20260513_085555.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iblast/AKU6Vos3nXq1gXUbztKKBNkrPLmmD18TBAnbXzxoUD99HcixJ9HXe4FTq2fMdv2.png)





Following the live broadcasts, I will be meticulously editing the footage into smaller, digestible segments for YouTube. This format allows you to watch at your leisure, skip to the parts you need most, and use them as a permanent reference library.

1. Introduction to Land
Land is one of the most sophisticated layers of the game. This series will provide a comprehensive introduction, breaking down the mechanics and strategies of Land ownership and management. We’ll simplify the complex so you can maximize your productivity.

2. The New Recruit: Step-by-Step Onboarding
I’ll be sitting down with a brand-new player—someone who has never even seen the game before. You’ll watch as I walk them through every single step, from account creation to their very first battles. It’s an end-to-end overview delivered in manageable installments.

3. The Veteran’s Return: A Refresher Course
For those who played in the past but haven't logged in for a year or two: this is for you. We are bringing back an old player with existing assets and showing them exactly how the game has evolved. We’ll explore all the new features and mechanics to help you get back into the competitive spirit.








![Copilot_20260513_085753.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iblast/AKVUsdzp5A3N4oRBWtNy2pGTwqvECzuCWDmXp9CKgbJdnrN84dFC2HZUXrfC6kF.png)

## How You Can Support the Community
The goal of these videos is to create a documented knowledge base that the community can revert back to at any time. I have a small favor to ask:

Share the Knowledge: If you meet a new player or someone who needs a refresher, point them to these videos. See links below.

Boost the Visibility: More views and engagement mean more eyes on the game we love.

Grow the Category: Active streams help the Splinterlands category stay \

and visible on platforms, increasing the chances of discovery by new players.





![sss.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iblast/23xyZ9BUMRKrqvG7J9C6JsaC83Dc7bS4NbXscppvqC2SVRuzhYYa829MnLtbRZhCxdqVr.png)

Stay tuned for the first live dates. Let’s get to work!

body.title: 🔥Return of the Cowboy Hero
body.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1778680051483-ee82d8f57aedc174.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=zeyr-gamer/f896f3cf)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=zeyr-gamer/f896f3cf)


---

After years away, the lone cowboy rides back into his hometown — a place now ruled by bandits and fear. The sun burns over the desert, dust rises beneath his horse, and his eyes show one thing: determination. He’s here to bring justice, to free the town from chaos. The people whisper his name, the bandits prepare for war, and the legend of Zeyr‑Gamer begins again.

The lone cowboy stepped into the saloon, scanning every corner. Some folks were drinking, others playing cards, but his eyes locked on a group of bandits sitting quietly in the back. He knew they were his target. Calm at first, deadly in the end — this mission would mark the beginning of justice’s return to the town. The saloon was about to witness a legend in action.

Under the blazing sun, the lone cowboy stands at the shooting range. Dust rises around him as he grips his revolver with steady hands. Each shot hits its mark — precise, powerful, and calm. This is not just practice; it’s preparation for justice. The legend of Zeyr‑Gamer sharpens his aim before facing the bandits once again.

The town erupted in chaos once more. The last group of bandits tried to fight back, but the cowboy hero stood firm. Bullets flew, dust rose, and every corner became a battlefield. In the end, justice prevailed — the bandits were defeated, and peace returned. The people cheered for the legend who restored honor to their town: Zeyr‑Gamer.

Leaving the town behind, the cowboy hero rode into the blazing desert. There, he found the last bandits hiding among the rocks. Bullets echoed through the canyon, dust filled the air, and every shot carried justice. When the fight ended, silence returned — the desert had witnessed victory. A moment of strength, courage, and redemption — the legend of Zeyr‑Gamer lives on.

---

body.title: How Would You Convince Someone To Start Their Hive Journey?
body.body: > ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdPsJkVtRRBuycLTZdVjEMUvEBM7KprDyKQ36DHzqSAZt/1778680841887.png) [Source](https://chatgpt.com/s/m_6a0483e8cb9c8191a64a59c0a490ea0a) Hive is one of the most interesting platforms for me. It is a decentralized social media platform where I can share posts, comment freely, express my thoughts, and connect with people from different countries. Through Hive, I have gained many new experiences by learning about different cultures and interacting with people around the world. Another motivating part of Hive is the opportunity to earn Hive tokens by sharing content. It feels rewarding when your creativity and effort are appreciated by others. At the same time, the platform gives enjoyment because people can share their own ideas, photography, art, travel stories, gaming experiences, and many other types of content. To grow on Hive, I have learned that following community guidelines and content-sharing rules is very important. These guidelines help me stay disciplined and improve the quality of my work. Hive is not only about posting content, but also about learning how to become a better creator and communicator. If I had to invite someone to start their Hive journey, I would first explain the positive sides of Hive. I would tell them how the platform works, how they can improve here step by step, and how the Hive ecosystem supports content creators. I would also talk about the earning opportunities because that can motivate new users to stay active and consistent. However, I would also remind them that patience is very important on Hive. Success does not come overnight. Instead of focusing only on rewards, they should focus on learning, improving their content, and building good relationships with others. With time, consistency, and engagement, better opportunities will come naturally. One of my favorite things about Hive is the variety of contests and communities available on the platform. These contests encourage creativity and help users discover new ideas. I would definitely mention this while convincing someone to join Hive. Another special thing is the chance to connect with people from different countries. Working and communicating with international friends is truly a wonderful experience. It helps improve communication skills and creates meaningful connections. To me, Hive is more than just a blogging platform. It is a place for creativity, learning, freedom, and personal growth. That is why I would happily encourage anyone to begin their Hive journey.

body.title: Meeting with the Internal Audit Department at Puregold Duty Free
body.body: /> When the first quarter of 2026 arrived, our manager mentioned holding our annual meeting to plan the tasks we need to accomplish this year. She told us the meeting place would be Puregold Duty Free Subic, located in the Subic Bay Freeport Zone. It's about 30 minutes from my base store, so I needed to leave early to get there. I got to Ayala Malls Harbor Point on time, and we traveled to the meeting place together with the other internal auditors from different clusters.

/> When we got there, we had already started the meeting and were discussing concerns and queries regarding many issues in store operations. Then, our manager let us roam around the store to check out some items on sale. We started checking the aisles for something to eat since it's almost lunchtime. There are a lot of chocolates on sale and a promo when we got there. Our manager told us lunch was ready in the meeting room, so we went back in to eat. We ordered some burger steak and pizza to energize us for the rest of the day.

/> After having our lunch, the meeting continued. We discussed the compliance audit reports we need to submit and the monthly performance targets we need to meet as auditors. We also received the 2026 Work Plan as our guideline for the whole year. Our manager ended our meeting early and gave us some time to roam around the store again. We checked out other items on sale and bought some before clocking out of the store.

/> Finally, it's time to clock out and go home. I asked my co-auditors for a quick group photo before we hopped inside the car. We just shared a quick laugh and conversation, too. It was nice meeting them after a while.

/> * * * ``` Hive Blog No. 376 Date Published: May 13, 2026 ``` * * * > **_About the Author:_** > She is a career-driven Filipina from the province of Zambales, paving the way for her career in blog content writing through sharing her experiences, reflections, and daily life happenings. She is currently an Internal Auditor at Puregold Price Club, Inc., and a Freelance Writer at Upwork Global, Inc., specializing in SEO Writing.

body.title: Three Divisions, One Goal: Building a Complete WOO Roster
body.body:
A Big Hello to all WOO Fans! 🥳🥳🥳 WOO! 

When I first saw that Mayday Mayhem was structured around three distinct Jobber divisions, it immediately caught my attention. Not because it was unexpected, but because of what it represents. It tells me that WOO is not just thinking about individual characters anymore. It is thinking about structure, balance, and how players build their collections across different categories.

As someone who enjoys the collecting aspect of WOO just as much as the gameplay, this is a big deal. Because now, it is not just about what you have. It is about how complete your roster really is.

>*Don't miss out on yet another limited time event from WOO, \

, taking place from 1st May 2026 till 31st May 2026! Go to [THIS LINK](https://play.wrestlingorganizationonline.com/event) to join and get another chance to win even more WOO Jobber packs now!*

---

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/blitzzzz/23uQp2ZJDv236yHEinx4pDrZi7DSXGH4SoG1UgExVQm73CqdyqXczbb8GPGF79QkEJvH7.png)

---

## Some quick thoughts...

* **Male Division Provides the Foundation**
  
The male Jobber division feels like the backbone of the system. With characters ranging from Common to Legendary, it offers a clear progression path that players can follow. From my perspective, this division gives a strong starting point for building a collection, and it sets the tone for how rarity works across the board.

* **Female Division Adds Balance and Depth**
  
What I really like is that the female division is given equal importance. It is not treated as an afterthought. Instead, it mirrors the same rarity structure and offers its own set of unique characters. This adds balance to the system and ensures that players are not just focusing on one area.

* **Tag Team Division Introduces Strategic Variety**
  
Tag Team Jobbers bring something different to the table. They represent partnerships rather than individuals, and that creates a different kind of appeal. Collecting Tag Teams feels distinct, and it adds variety to the overall experience.

* **Encourages Players to Think Holistically**
  
With three divisions in play, collecting becomes more than just accumulating as many cards as possible. It becomes about building a well-rounded roster. As a fan, I find myself thinking about gaps in my collection and how I can fill them, which adds a layer of strategy.

* **Completeness Becomes a Personal Goal**
  
There is a certain satisfaction that comes from having representation across all divisions. It feels like you are building something complete rather than something fragmented. That sense of completeness is something that keeps me motivated throughout the event.

---

## To round up everything I've said so far...

The three-division structure in Mayday Mayhem adds depth in a way that feels natural and engaging. It encourages players to think beyond individual pulls and start considering the bigger picture. And as a fan, that shift makes the entire experience feel more meaningful. Because in the end, it is not just about collecting. It is about building something that feels whole.

---

Well, that's it for today. We will continue again tomorrow! 😁 WOO! 🎉

body.body:
>       Algo que destaca de mi hogar es que @zutodoterreno siempre se encarga de que haya algún tipo de fruta en nuestra cocina. En invierno se hace más difícil consumirla, ya que de repente preferimos tomar un rico mate, o quizás un café, o en última instancia una chocolatada con churros. Pero las frutas son necesarias, aunque hoy en día vienen modificadas o, para decirlo como lo siento, ultrajadas. Mi indignación nace a partir de una fruta de mi preferencia, y así sucede en la mayoría de los casos. Pero hoy quiero dedicarle esta especie de **catarsis** a las mandarinas. >*Something that stands out about my home is that @zutodoterreno always makes sure there is some kind of fruit in our kitchen. In winter it becomes harder to eat it, since we sometimes prefer to have a nice mate, or perhaps a coffee, or as a last resort a hot chocolate with churros. But fruit is necessary, even though nowadays it comes modified or, to put it the way I feel it, violated. My indignation stems from a fruit I particularly like, and that is how it goes in most cases. But today I want to dedicate this kind of catharsis to mandarins.* > ___
![@palabras1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palabras1/23w2aHoR3FgUu1UErUSTcbpsf6iUH2qgT1wvACVG33BWRTMt38bEtGZtU3fRwmmHDgwkv.png)
      Los avances tecnológicos mejoran nuestras vidas en muchos aspectos, y eso es innegable. Pero en ocasiones tengo la sensación de que matan, y quizás en el futuro nosotros entraremos en peligro. **Quizás hoy ya estamos en peligro y ni siquiera nos damos cuenta.** *Feliz día para todos.* > *Technological advances improve our lives in many ways, and that is undeniable. But sometimes I have the feeling that they kill, and perhaps in the future we will be in danger. Perhaps we are already in danger today and we do not even realize it. Happy day to everyone.* > > ___ ___

Pero las frutas son necesarias, aunque hoy en día vienen modificadas o, para decirlo como lo siento, ultrajadas. Mi indignación nace a partir de una fruta de mi preferencia, y así sucede en la mayoría de los casos. Pero hoy quiero dedicarle esta especie de **catarsis** a las mandarinas. >*Something that stands out about my home is that @zutodoterreno always makes sure there is some kind of fruit in our kitchen. In winter it becomes harder to eat it, since we sometimes prefer to have a nice mate, or perhaps a coffee, or as a last resort a hot chocolate with churros. But fruit is necessary, even though nowadays it comes modified or, to put it the way I feel it, violated. My indignation stems from a fruit I particularly like, and that is how it goes in most cases. But today I want to dedicate this kind of catharsis to mandarins.* > ___
![@palabras1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/palabras1/23w2aHoR3FgUu1UErUSTcbpsf6iUH2qgT1wvACVG33BWRTMt38bEtGZtU3fRwmmHDgwkv.png)
      Los avances tecnológicos mejoran nuestras vidas en muchos aspectos, y eso es innegable. Pero en ocasiones tengo la sensación de que matan, y quizás en el futuro nosotros entraremos en peligro. **Quizás hoy ya estamos en peligro y ni siquiera nos damos cuenta.** *Feliz día para todos.* > *Technological advances improve our lives in many ways, and that is undeniable. But sometimes I have the feeling that they kill, and perhaps in the future we will be in danger. Perhaps we are already in danger today and we do not even realize it. Happy day to everyone.* > > ___ ___

body.title: Hoy En ORGULLO Y PASIÓN 🇨🇺 Minnie Miñoso \
body.body: ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZe5hctpQfz2MxsEYbwFCiGvKRrUFxbaJEU1W4NWAnvZA/img_20260510_145753_645.jpg)\nHoy como cada Miércoles vengo hablarles de las leyendas Cubanas del béisbol a nivel #mundial, para mí es un privilegio evocar la figura de Saturnino Orestes Armas Miñoso Arrieta, conocido mundialmente como \

. 

Su legado trasciende el diamante, pues fue el primer jugador afrocubano en las Grandes Ligas y el pionero que abrió las puertas a la diversidad latina en la era de la integración.

Miñoso fue un pelotero de una longevidad y vitalidad sin precedentes, cuya carrera profesional se extendió desde finales de los años 40 hasta los 80.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdAv6DBcfQCZRvaWg8gPp8oVDpZep8Lvj1PufBgV2C9qq/img_20260510_145733_641.jpg)
Debutó en las Ligas Negras con los New York Cubans (1946-1948). En la #MLB, transitó principalmente por los #Chicago White Sox (1951–1957, 1960–1961, 1964, 1976, 1980) e hizo paradas en los Cleveland Indians, St. Louis Cardinals y Washington Senators.

En #cuba jugó para los Tigres de Marianao en la Liga Profesional Cubana, donde fue una estrella absoluta y guió al equipo a Series del #caribe.

Terminó su carrera en MLB con un promedio de .299, 196 jonrones, 1,093 carreras impulsadas y 216 bases robadas.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSANHoy2FZuovRLUhPgMVZ46v5NVfz2iZrarwqbYG2SXN/img_20260510_145748_099.jpg)
Miñoso fue la definición de un jugador \
. Aunque en gran parte de su carrera no existía el \

(instaurado en 1980), su palmarés es impresionante:

Participó en 13 Juegos de Estrellas de mitad de temporada (9 selecciones de MLB y 4 en las Ligas Negras).

Ganó 3 #premios Guantes Oro (1957, 1959 y 1960), demostrando su excelencia defensiva en el jardín izquierdo.

Se coronó #campeón de la Serie Mundial de las Ligas Negras (1947) y múltiples veces líder en triples y bases robadas en la Liga Americana.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYJaj8CNbMVDyzMEr6JGZCQtRgWSfRGL2riBu7ZKa35Hs/img_20260510_145738_904.jpg)
Un récord que parece sacado de la ficción es su permanencia en el juego. Miñoso es uno de los poquísimos jugadores en aparecer en partidos oficiales de #beisbol de las Grandes Ligas en cinco décadas distintas (40, 50, 60, 70 y 80). Su última aparición fue en 1980, con los White Sox, conectando un hit a los 54 años, lo que lo convirtió en el cuarto jugador más longevo en jugar en la historia de la MLB.

Minnie tenía un estilo de juego agresivo y se pegaba tanto al plato que se convirtió en un \
para los lanzadores. Lideró la liga en pelotazos recibidos (HBP) en 10 temporadas. Se decía que Miñoso no solo bateaba la bola, sino que \

. Su alegría era tal que, tras ser golpeado por una recta de 95 millas, se levantaba, le sonreía al lanzador y salía disparado hacia la primera base como si nada hubiera pasado.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme4vC82x4g7TwEt2Styzdmk2aqMpi89dDYbX4tMwNbCoU/img_20260510_145742_871.jpg)
Minnie Miñoso es recordado hoy no solo por sus números, sino por su sonrisa inquebrantable ante la adversidad #racial. Fue el puente entre la segregación y la era moderna para los #latinos. Su exaltación al Salón de la Fama de #cooperstown en 2022 hizo justicia a un hombre que fue el rostro de los White Sox y el orgullo de Cuba. Su número 9 está retirado en Chicago, pero su espíritu de \

sigue vivo en cada pelotero cubano que pisa un terreno de Grandes Ligas.

body.title: Walking Through the Art Gallery / Caminando por la Galería de Arte
body.body:
> ***English Version*** ### **Walking Through the Art Gallery** I’m a person with simple tastes who loves her city and enjoys walking, so what better way to explore than by immersing myself in the artistic heart of Caracas. On this occasion, I ventured into the National Art Gallery, but I didn’t head straight to its exhibition halls; instead, I chose to wander through its open spaces, discovering interesting sculptures, cozy nooks, and an atmosphere steeped in art, history, and academic tradition. >***Versión en Español*** >### **Caminando por la Galería de Arte** >Soy una persona de gustos simples, que ama su ciudad y que disfruta caminar, así que qué mejor manera para pasear que sumergiéndonos en el corazón artístico de la ciudad de Caracas. En esta oportunidad me adentré en las instalaciones de la Galería de Arte Nacional, pero no me fui directo a sus salas de exposiciones, sino que en esta oportunidad preferí danzar a través de sus espacios abiertos, para de esta manera descubrir interesantes esculturas, rinconcitos acogedores y un ambiente marcado por el arte, la historia y el academicismo. ![Blue and white natural summer photo collage.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iscrak/48QuifRsYeCvtKnHuzmeyzuMtA96bz7trPhXgAbofPXg4j6v6ZTeJDTq6iNNmXDUsH.png)
*Design Made with Canva*
Surprisingly, I discovered a small book fair featuring numerous cutting-edge and thought-provoking titles that seek to challenge certain ideas while simultaneously building a somewhat more alternative world. Perhaps these political themes serve as the starting point for many discussions from the perspective of social reality, but I didn’t come here to delve into that topic; rather, I came to stroll among the shelves, flip through a few pages, and perhaps discover something that interests me. >Sorpresivamente, descubrí una pequeña feria del libro en donde existen numerosos títulos de tendencia y reverentes, que buscan romper con algunas ideas y al mismo tiempo construir un mundo un tanto más alternativo. Quizás estas diarias políticas sean el punto de partida de muchas discusiones desde el punto de vista de la realidad social, pero no vine acá para ahondar en ese tema, sino para caminar entre sus anaqueles, pasar algunas páginas y quizás descubrir algo que me interese. gris de la arquitectura brutalista converge con el color y la alegría de la contemporaneidad, con las formas abstractas del arte y con las ideas divergentes de tantos títulos que cobran sentido en ever-changing times is like navigating the paths of living history; it is becoming part of a world that has never been static, but which, on the Venezuelan side, seems to be moving faster and faster. This is why places like this hold such deep meaning and value, as they allow us to immerse ourselves in a small bubble that takes us away from daily problems and difficulties, letting us relax and enjoy those things that, at the same time, intrinsically leave a lesson and a message in our hearts. >Caminar por esta ciudad en medio de una actualidad compleja y cambiante es surcar los caminos de la historia viva, es formar parte de un mundo que nunca ha sido estático, pero que en el lado venezolano pareciera moverse cada vez más rápido. body.title: Wild Petunia
body.body:
The wild petunia flower grows where it chooses, often along roadsides, open fields, and forgotten corners of the land. Its soft trumpet-shaped blooms, usually shaded in gentle purples and lilacs, appear without ceremony, brightening spaces that might otherwise be overlooked. There is a quiet confidence in the way this flower lives—untamed, unplanned, and deeply authentic.Unlike garden varieties that depend on careful hands, the wild petunia survives through resilience. It withstands heat, sudden rain, and poor soil, continuing to bloom when conditions are less than ideal. This strength does not show itself through boldness, but through persistence, reminding us that endurance can be graceful rather than harsh.


The wild petunia also plays an important role in the natural world. Bees, butterflies, and other pollinators are drawn to its open blooms, finding nourishment where little else grows. In this way, the flower becomes a quiet supporter of life, offering help without recognition—an act of generosity reflected throughout nature.There is a gentle poetry in seeing wild petunias scattered freely, never arranged yet always harmonious. Their presence feels like a reminder that beauty does not always need boundaries or labels. Sometimes, the most meaningful things grow when left to follow their own rhythm, guided only by sunlight and time.

body.title: Spring Cleaning Gardens and Planting Seedlings - by Sunscape
body.body:
![strawberries.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWGeusBq3yZ6zLDK1rEBEgEoJUrKPQZEPRP7Pr9CXKhL4/strawberries.jpg)

The Strawberry Tower garden needed sprucing up since they were starting to flower.  I pulled off all the dead leaves and a few dead crowns that did not survive the winter.  I think I lost half the plants, and I hope I can find some slips at the nursery when I go today to replace them.


![hivegarden-flowers-garden-12.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfK24cmGNZ9PQG88qGVPQ48zACAuSDoB2VdkjWXnBEAyN/hivegarden-flowers-garden-12.jpg)

I cleaned out all the gardens surrounding the back porch, then planted some snapdragons, verbena, and lobelia.  Once that was done, I put down a bag of mulch. 


![hivegarden-flowers-garden-14.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQme38UqdQLh8TRttehGKPxcTtd5sTFkaJxP7fu3tnAoMp1/hivegarden-flowers-garden-14.jpg)

All the Hosta and Ferns had grown so quickly, and it looks nice and tidy now.


![hivegarden-flowers-garden-ferns.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVrx1rLpVWCKzcP2tgcjZKqc88yVZQSP7yheq5uwTJs6Z/hivegarden-flowers-garden-ferns.jpg)

All the sides around the porch are done, I got tired and took a coffee break while Mika lay on the grass watching Sparrows search for bugs.

![feathered-friends-birdwatching.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSHHr1UT3DF7sSQm2btYVszWcbKntQZ5kgbdxBpz4ZkM8/feathered-friends-birdwatching.jpg)

Interestingly, the birds come so close to her.


![hivegarden-flowers-garden-2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNsRMkKiu2cqrA32Rx9YCinkf2vZpTc9tiWEXipQELJwf/hivegarden-flowers-garden-2.jpg)
  
The large garden under the Kousa Dogwood had a lot of weeds, grass, and spring bulbs that needed a serious cleanup.  


![hivegarden-flowers-garden-1.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRP64E4uvRmv6QMdkunjsx4JZFufyjDbqbABF2hgn2NXo/hivegarden-flowers-garden-1.jpg)


It took me a while to do this bed.  Some of the bulbs had taken over many areas, so I carefully thinned them out as much as possible.  Then I pulled out some of the Candytuft that had overgrown one whole area.  I know it is pretty in the spring, but I like to cover the bare areas with Impatiens plants for color all summer long. 


![hivegarden-flowers-garden-3.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmczR6nn42A8FeAEGU2ETTgNqCrsqrwyii4WNonHx9bKzd/hivegarden-flowers-garden-3.jpg)
 
I didn't clean up the rock edges where grass has grown; that will have to be a whole other day. 


![hivegarden-weeded.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWBPwQNmeQsnpBXYZ26oBrGHD5argnx4r9Bugad8KtVqo/hivegarden-weeded.jpg)

Looking at the same garden from the opposite side, it looks so much better.


![weeded.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWfWy1Vpo9kiiunNfm7uV5pMru1dbo9tMiT1Lcmovk7dR/weeded.jpg)

Now, it is ready for the annual plants.  I did plant a large cluster of snapdragons the following day.  All that is left is to put the flat of Impatiens in.  That will have to wait another week, with our temps still a bit on the cold side.


![onions.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWnpPhn69GMGt8s3Dv5Z2J4zMFr3ZZd564sHhfn6KazKT/onions.jpg)

All of the onions are standing up nicely and putting up new shoots.  I ended up with over 160 onions with four different varieties.  I'm hoping for a bumper crop this year.  



![potato bags.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYMSboEFobnxMXGGaEZNFosL2TWgKeB9LCvkV1ame9FS5/potato%20bags.jpg)

These potatoes are getting huge since putting them outside.  They will certainly get harvested very early this summer at the rate they are growing.


![garden.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbpipB2Q6YCv49tLmFfjAfXRAT63wd1V6kGRZWsSw9spW/garden.jpg)

This area where the Lilac tree died is now ready for planting.  I plan on putting zucchini in this area with some peppers, too.


![hivegarden-flowers-veggies-8.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYZaeY14sSWG3MnNUQGY6AhkdBYbPzsfRqhau4gHHYGQx/hivegarden-flowers-veggies-8.jpg)

The lettuce and arugula survived the light frost two nights ago and seem to finally be taking off.  The far bed has signs of some beets finally sprouting.  


![hivegarden-flowers-veggies-7.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYmHKxYC6gVpBJh39LHBdLmVe4heDvXSGLa5EeHDrqhZ1/hivegarden-flowers-veggies-7.jpg)

You can see that the cabbages in the large frame are growing, and so are the weeds all over the stone paths.  lol  I will have to tend to them shortly.


![hivegarden-tomatoes.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRYZwiiUhFfLVRgpqNXjPfkoookQt2iiRoVpV4MX3Fj6j/hivegarden-tomatoes.jpg)

Back in the greenhouse, the tomatoes are outgrowing the pots.  I'm tempted to plant them this weekend even though it's a bit early.


![greenhouse.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQgxQpCXyRM1jwGiKt4kTzYb5W2B8nPrgmBoYG9i1ZREh/greenhouse.jpg)

The hanging baskets of Petunias have really started to fill in.  I will put those out this weekend as they can handle cooler temps. 

![hivegarden-plants.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWSV1gkkRGqFTechrMoSS39qaTyxdKKwTgCxzDA33S1o1/hivegarden-plants.jpg)

The peppers and zinnias on the top rack should have been transplanted into larger pots earlier this month.  They are showing signs of stress.  I don't know if I should do it now or wait to see if the weather warms up next week.  It's a dilemma!


![marigolds.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmP4eLG7GkjNuL1ca6PcwaDXLy5V8jDHtYeoKZxUZZRRVb/marigolds.jpg)

The flat of Marigolds is putting on flowers and will be ready to plant out into the vegetable garden this weekend.  I guess I had better do some errands today while it is raining, and I will have all weekend to work in the gardens.  

How's your spring gardening coming along?  Soon, we will have everything planted and can sit back and watch them all grow.  Right?


![banner-sunscape-2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYr3stqM7yx8cpipf8v6F4YgkM2aD282NSQrGYzJZqCxE/banner-sunscape-2.jpg)


![banner hive garden.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcp7EQtr8ydXN6KUHUYD7naiLsMd6JKivWitg6Me1y6z4/banner%20hive%20garden.jpg)

body.title: From Cart to Door in Just One Day: My Sweet, Soapy, and Surprising Online Haul!
body.body:
![Brown & white family photo collage.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/48Je3HANVD97ENYCCQAbxrquksvDMLRvgpfitvNagoizwE9HtYVkfaqYDFRLBsPvKX.png)

**Hello Hive Family, and most especially my ever-supportive Hive Friends! 💖** I’m excited to share a little story with you today that made me smile; and I think it will make you smile, too.

![parcel.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/23tvCfH4fNTMhmDy1tmVGArdCv5LTHLKNsxLMgNJACxUN6v8JViECzQTAXfUd6kWdiXYX.jpeg)


![parcel2.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/23tvc9VUambgeeCjV9t5viqksSuvoZ2W1xfBzJuwUdFGV6VLgZ97zMDKPmdnwMPhRZFn8.jpeg)


Yesterday, I placed a simple online order, and to my surprise, the parcel arrived today, lightning fast! Inside the package were some of my favorite everyday essentials and treats:

**•	Kit Kat Chocolates 🍫
•	Kopiko Blanca ☕
•	Pantene Shampoo ✨
•	Silka Bath Soap 🧼**

![6f5353f6-32fa-49a6-8864-3bca54475d3f.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/23wMef7R64SwJmc2FzMZw2iKvUEmpr4VxDu1BUDFErWQBmxoNwUxxNoe7gtmq6iQN6D2L.jpeg)

![aece5cc6-9e90-4ce0-8725-ac108e772d4d.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/23tbs3wYExkcAHTnrnPr1CLJ88gX1K5hDDYTaDdYgoo4P5t5AwZB5S99n3cZU9rUTFTu7.jpeg)

I decided to buy them online instead of going to the grocery store. Why? Because the shipping fee was actually cheaper than the fare I would have spent traveling back and forth. It’s amazing how convenient online shopping has become, saving both time and money while still getting exactly what I need.

![e43d1b29-2296-433a-98cb-e189f1c75063.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/23uFTcpAywWs97g5QHCYS5dggcbXVjkhNLv223d3VWcnPQBVVwce2qtkmXgp9PaidRzL7.jpeg)

This little haul may seem ordinary, but the speed of delivery and the joy of opening the parcel made it feel special. Sometimes, it’s the small things that brighten our day!

![ffa6456a-6f63-4a0c-9ce8-c08a97bc6e43.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/23wC9LjnJorftJ5pWQscAYATfJVJ61Fg9RwnxHxt6k5s34CURGUzeJb63gvP46jSGBKt1.jpeg)

**Thank you so much for reading, Hive Family and Friends.** Your support always inspires me to share more of my everyday experiences. Until next time, may your days be filled with sweet surprises, too!

body.title: 🍹 Conversations, Lights, and Little Escapes
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVHGg87AQrbwMoPqfWsa2GxN687FTcBBpeQJmCerUyPPA/IMG_3089.PNG 

Some nights are not about parties or big plans.

They’re about finding a cozy place, ordering something sweet to drink, and having the kind of conversations that make time disappear for a while.

Tonight felt exactly like that.

After spending most of the day working as a **social experience planner** — helping cafés and small businesses improve the atmosphere they create for people online and offline — I realized how much I appreciate places that simply feel warm and real.

Soft lights. Wooden tables. Quiet music.  
And that feeling of finally slowing down.

I think we all need moments where we stop thinking about deadlines, expectations, and everything waiting for us tomorrow.

Just breathe. Smile. Enjoy the moment.

And honestly… this little escape was exactly what I needed 🍹✨

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@dayanamalenka/-conversations-lights-and-little-escapes-j11)

body.body:
Last month I went to Iowa to learn more about my family. One of my stops was Vinton, Iowa. 

Look at these colorful Queen Anne houses! 

https://photos.smugmug.com/Personal/2021-Photo-Book/2026-Book/n-j8srDw/April/i-g3GP9Tv/0/M36Z7ppTwWKfqvvPkTSFSMfMb4k4JtrGdxJQXDzn7/M/PXL_20260420_181903660~2-M.jpg

|https://photos.smugmug.com/Personal/2021-Photo-Book/2026-Book/n-j8srDw/April/i-sBW3RZ6/0/LkNkWndGKGxSQwnPWFtkmj8VCbp4wtxDGkZ6rLzz6/XL/PXL_20260420_181618231~2-XL.jpg||https://photos.smugmug.com/Personal/2021-Photo-Book/2026-Book/n-j8srDw/April/i-r4Gcbnz/0/NXSjMQGdrgcGF3cJzvTbSwPtZCj5wZhhQL7LmTqWv/XL/PXL_20260420_181634749~2-XL.jpg|
|-|-|-|


__________

I was talking to my sister about the trip and she made the comment that it is Vinton, Benton, Iowa. 

Yes! 

We have done so much family history and read **Vinton, Benton, Iowa** so many times when we were looking at information about our Shockley ancestors. Here are a few examples. Clinton is my great, great grandfather and Lena, Elsie and Helen are his sisters. They were all born and were buried in Vinton, Benton, Iowa. 

|https://photos.smugmug.com/Blog/Posts-for-blog/n-WZHcZk/Vinton-Benton-Iowa/i-M7FwSqs/0/KGkRS7Vxqh6xg3msbFJ8DKVBZcg7FRvzzhrSj8DwM/XL/Clinton%20Shockley%20Sr-XL.jpg||https://photos.smugmug.com/Blog/Posts-for-blog/n-WZHcZk/Vinton-Benton-Iowa/i-PmQ8j6S/0/KkBwwBrqF9BMHDH8SsZfPQLLvsPJbvK97HqNH6zsc/XL/Lena%20Ann%20Shockley-XL.jpg|https://photos.smugmug.com/Blog/Posts-for-blog/n-WZHcZk/Vinton-Benton-Iowa/i-L5Tk4J9/0/KxtxSLK2dgPV3D34qtwmTSSmdqNg8fG4MWBgZTjs3/XL/Elsie%20Morris%20Shockley-XL.jpg|https://photos.smugmug.com/Blog/Posts-for-blog/n-WZHcZk/Vinton-Benton-Iowa/i-pnVsjST/0/NJrxL7k7pSML3TZMs486Z688q6H3n4TM8k3fddcB2/XL/Helen%20Edola%20Shockley-XL.jpg|
|-|-|-|-|-|

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Over the years, while doing family history, I would think, \

It was a far off thought...until I was planning this trip and realized I would be renting a car when I was in Waterloo, Iowa and Vinton is 37 miles away. 

So I planned to drive there and go to the Evergreen Cemetery. 

https://photos.smugmug.com/Personal/2021-Photo-Book/2026-Book/n-j8srDw/April/i-JNCjM2x/0/MGg5mLrzthMrjTLDzCtJj2Vc7GP8KjRcFgq5Tk2Ht/XL/PXL_20260420_182350088.PORTRAIT.ORIGINAL~2-XL.jpg

Thank goodness for the grounds keeper that totally helped me. I am a rookie at going to cemeteries and only had the family names. That is not enough, some cemeteries are really big! This one was big. Luckily the grounds keeper was out and took me to the office and we looked up my family and looked at the map and he had me follow him on his 4 wheeler, to the sections of the cemetery where my family was, which was in two very different locations. Thank you again nice man that helped me! 

https://photos.smugmug.com/Personal/2021-Photo-Book/2026-Book/n-j8srDw/April/i-c2t47K2/0/KkWv3k5WRNF9vNWkXg4CBVGwLVkmK4c9Mm4NHmCDX/M/PXL_20260420_183938283.PORTRAIT.ORIGINAL-M.jpg

|https://photos.smugmug.com/Personal/2021-Photo-Book/2026-Book/n-j8srDw/April/i-FZH7SSf/0/MSPFjsGvS5fcGd5nnkmdC4LDpnkdfqqB8dkDmbNHx/XL/PXL_20260420_184051475-XL.jpg||https://photos.smugmug.com/Personal/2021-Photo-Book/2026-Book/n-j8srDw/April/i-wZTVpGj/0/LNdrdJN95Lwm2BMrFQTqKTLgnthRLmjd8bBHGML8n/XL/PXL_20260420_184549667.PORTRAIT-XL.jpg|

 I went on a beautiful, sunny day in April. 

<div class=\

> https://photos.smugmug.com/Personal/2021-Photo-Book/2026-Book/n-j8srDw/April/i-hZjSZqS/0/MfhGR5PqvczbD34MvmmgHvzJSL5Lp8kNt4RfRT8Md/XL/PXL_20260420_192057648.PORTRAIT-XL.jpg ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Here is the area of the cemetery that Clinton, Lena, Elsie and Helen are buried. Their parents (Morris and Amy) and Clinton's wife (Jennie) and son (Clinton) are also here. https://photos.smugmug.com/Personal/2021-Photo-Book/2026-Book/n-j8srDw/April/i-8FfNBRq/0/NKC5HSnq5hCjMrDHkGq6D3bnnDspPS6w3fdBTdQ2q/XL/PXL_20260420_185522789.PORTRAIT~2-XL.jpg https://photos.smugmug.com/Personal/2021-Photo-Book/2026-Book/n-j8srDw/April/i-G8W2bpg/0/NZsvGJXHcdXBV58mZjsSd22HF46KD8mm87kTjxdh6/XL/PXL_20260420_185625081-XL.jpg |https://photos.smugmug.com/Personal/2021-Photo-Book/2026-Book/n-j8srDw/April/i-9khQFx6/0/LBr5qTFNNWh23nmsgzLQcnCcKhk9FLPgtzcnHQFNK/XL/PXL_20260420_185841001~2-XL.jpg|https://photos.smugmug.com/Personal/2021-Photo-Book/2026-Book/n-j8srDw/April/i-rZtrVPK/0/LMGc9hd5BWcXP7KN3TvzBqm8cTpZgGTFmCd6SFC3J/XL/PXL_20260420_185734262~2-XL.jpg|https://photos.smugmug.com/Personal/2021-Photo-Book/2026-Book/n-j8srDw/April/i-wQ6jScZ/0/L4QWQqXj9b9R3kj5g7PJDsBPHML4qNbKkHsKFBhCp/XL/PXL_20260420_185739245~2-XL.jpg| |-|-|-| |Clinton my Great great grandfather|Clinton's Sister Elsie|Clinton's Sister Lena| |https://photos.smugmug.com/Personal/2021-Photo-Book/2026-Book/n-j8srDw/April/i-PLvVRtF/0/Kgp8QmPf95ZBQ3mJRbgBrPVpqxfSjCTrb2kjQ6xFm/XL/PXL_20260420_185834902~2-XL.jpg|https://photos.smugmug.com/Personal/2021-Photo-Book/2026-Book/n-j8srDw/April/i-gj6GXKq/0/MjSBp4MhP5QS4XP8pJnzpH3wbDGGdRz62x35KDrV7/XL/PXL_20260420_185706164.PORTRAIT~2-XL.jpg|https://photos.smugmug.com/Personal/2021-Photo-Book/2026-Book/n-j8srDw/April/i-724Vh9M/0/MDk7jVzvzm6ZTr2gxGCN5QrK33SKzkMbfHqct4FmL/XL/PXL_20260420_185728634~2-XL.jpg| |-|-|-| |Clinton's wife Jennie|Clinton's Father Morris|Clinton's Mother Amy| Clinton's Son, my grandma's brother *While I was on this trip I also visited my uncle and we found this picture of Clinton.*

> https://photos.smugmug.com/Personal/2021-Photo-Book/2026-Book/n-j8srDw/April/i-D4g9zMT/0/K7TxGmspkrQXjCJgqM8HQFSvtkFCsJDGrQPCLPxX8/L/PXL_20260419_224958262.PORTRAIT.ORIGINAL-L.jpg --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Remember how I said that the family is in two very different sections? This section is a bit older and includes Clinton's great grand parents Phillip and Sarah and two of their girls- Lizzie and Lelia. https://photos.smugmug.com/Personal/2021-Photo-Book/2026-Book/n-j8srDw/April/i-LBZrxpP/0/Kb6t7q3t9xW5wSwTQ6NTXg29GV5JrgzqxR56gShN3/XL/PXL_20260420_191920796.PORTRAIT~2-XL.jpg |https://photos.smugmug.com/Personal/2021-Photo-Book/2026-Book/n-j8srDw/April/i-txRb6DX/0/MrxBg8psHwwTKLq8Bts9fch5TfzLj75p4h4JnXWmW/XL/PXL_20260420_200236800~2-XL.jpg|https://photos.smugmug.com/Personal/2021-Photo-Book/2026-Book/n-j8srDw/April/i-rkfQfSz/0/LFzFv9zZjCPtQPSszWZw2Bk45VNMMcP5QLXVdSdc4/XL/PXL_20260420_191944309.PORTRAIT~2-XL.jpg|https://photos.smugmug.com/Personal/2021-Photo-Book/2026-Book/n-j8srDw/April/i-85PLN2n/0/KXd3vFW359kBM7rHWns7nq35cTgprLNzfhX6BvSC9/XL/PXL_20260420_191931678.PORTRAIT~2-XL.jpg| |-|-|-| Mother is Sarah, Father is Phillip then Selina or Lelia who died at 16 and Lizzie who died at 15 year old. Sarah and Philip had 7 children. Morris is their oldest child. He and his wife Amy and three of their children and their grandson are the one's buried in the other section. Fun Fact: There are a lot of Sarah's in my family history. My parents never said anything about being named after any one of them. Maybe I am named after all of these women.

> **My mom's side** *Sarah Ann Miller Shockley 1825-1907 *Sarah Jane Robson Redfearn 1850-1921 Sarah Maud Redfearn 1888-1888 Sarah Brand Morris 1828-1903 *Sarah Garrett 1791-1850 Sarah Russell 1780-1867 Sarah Ann Lamson 1822-Deceased

>

While at the cemetery I wrote an except for my book. 

This trip, to Iowa, was a research trip for the \

book. I don't have a title yet. I am writing a historical fiction book about my grandparents honeymoon trip in 1939. I am going to have them looking back and dreaming about the future and in those places I will be able to put in things I know happened! --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- I had a really beautiful afternoon in the Vinton, Benton, Iowa cemetery. https://photos.smugmug.com/Personal/2021-Photo-Book/2026-Book/n-j8srDw/April/i-b782mPF/0/Kcm38SRC8rHZ6GBn5K4WHrB98H6cxBhMSnS2KDkrd/XL/PXL_20260420_192407047~2-XL.jpg As I was driving out of town I stopped at the beautiful Vinton courthouse. https://photos.smugmug.com/Personal/2021-Photo-Book/2026-Book/n-j8srDw/April/i-25Z9x6m/0/LZ9XzznGPrpfrpXVwRLR85KrsZ5ghnpv8JZ77NSzZ/XL/PXL_20260420_203136510-XL.jpg While my stop was brief Vinton is a nice little city, with some great architecture and a very nice cemetery! https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hive-146701/2432f7unmo28aXAMGzs9AhK3eZW9L1JmeENvbKHXZEWS1Lim79AngsW71XWwVxnyMwQjv.png [//]:# (!worldmappin 42.154832 lat -92.003292 long the Vinton, Benton, Iowa cemetery d3scr)

body.title: Wednesday walk: along the side of the small river (Pistoia)
body.body:
Hello hivers, an happy Wednesday to you all!
It's time to write a new content for the awesome #Wednesdaywalk community! ❤️ Now here it's raining hard, but this morning there were just few clouds on the sky and so I spent a pause from my work on art walking along the side of the river close to my home. 
At first you have to know my home is out of the center of my city (even if my city is a small one and I can go side by side in just 30 minutes by walking 😁) and a small river called Brana is just few minutes from here. It's a nice, quiet green area where ducks and birds live and, not so far, there is the main graveyard so it's a silent area, perfect to walk to move the legs in relax in a springtime day.

When I go there I have always my camera with me, because there are awesome different birds and also some families of mallard ducks. This morning I walked there with my hubby @paolobeneforti before the lunch. While we were walking  I watched a couple of beautiful grey wagtail (Motacilla cinerea) with their yellow bellies and I took some pics of them to share with you. Here in my area we use to call this kind of bird \

and it's very common to watch a lot of them close to the rivers or the lakes. These 2 ones were flying and jumping on some branches fallen down on the water after the rainy and windy days. They fly and jump very fast and so it was not so simple for me to take decent pics, sorry. ❤️ ![DSCN0196is.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silviabeneforti/23w2sCfiTqwwbJUQ3bqh9eGiDc11KBjyCuzfydjqStpJ6dvgRbk1KTSJJDjvuJZpkzwPe.JPG) ![DSCN0190.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silviabeneforti/Eo6Ksk2uLNqtkSav7JWcyMjpSUMbpWfLdQxNcW2V3ax4eQQrhpJRYcu4SmCsVBPXk4i.JPG) ![DSCN0194.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silviabeneforti/Eo6Kq1mwQLeYRa5FTFFR2zhZzFXmQCAmtUgAjszynjH7wPsM4nxZ2sgnygF7Vg7e97u.JPG) ![DSCN0191.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silviabeneforti/Eo8TGvoNDJJr8Dz8LuE7WurYh7tWeHosqJH62JRTiqLDMnUSWeezhYuDR3ic2TqKSqs.JPG) Close to them there was also a beautiful female mallard duck. She was cleaning her body after she took a bath in the water. Around one month ago, during one of my walking there, I watched many little mallards, the newborns of some families that live there and I'm pretty sure soon we could see them in a adult way swimming around during the next months. ❤️ ![DSCN0192.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silviabeneforti/EoCidKtfYLk9iPh1wmLjD1u1j4ow4MEkCS73fa5EM9NdXL7dHAHb3ymAi5yb9QWdyRP.JPG) ![DSCN0193.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silviabeneforti/EoErU52tYavu9PepJMV9sQnAC6uhoJEsu8B51qs9WXp4KNZV7GFg5g8cqg4a1FsvJFm.JPG) ![DSCN0198.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silviabeneforti/EoK7pYY82xQPk3C8NMPeyk5w7YtHDswPN6EqsqSyZ3f5mx1VSbPsuS7qCGHsGz73eug.JPG) Well, now I have to come back to my brushes and colors while the raindrops are falling down from the sky in a very hard way. I cross my finger for a couple of sunny hours tomorrow, so I could come back to walk along the side of the river. See ya soon and stay safe, Silvia

body.title: Today's walk, life's silent achievement, My Actifit Report Card: May 13 2026
body.body:
> How are you all? Of course, you are fine. Today has been a very busy day. I often don't realise when morning turns into evening while doing family work. Earlier, I used to forget to keep my mobile phone with me because of my busy work. As a result, even if I walked a lot, the step count would not be correct. However, for the past three days, I have been trying to keep my phone with me at all times. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/9904b2ae-1063-4926-87d5-4c6ec11d0ea5.jpg) Maybe that is why my steps have been quite good today. It was good to see on Actifit that I completed 7061 steps today. For me, it is not just a number, but a small account of the whole day's effort. Even if I don't have time to exercise separately, I walk a lot while doing housework. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/569d5ad3-934d-4c54-83b6-10f882ae8d36.jpg) The sky tonight also looked very beautiful. I took some time to look outside after work. Small stars were shining in the calm sky, and that moment really made me feel better. So I also took two pictures of the stars tonight. Friends, the day was not bad, although it was tiring. It is really nice to see your small achievements at the end of the day.

body.title: WALKING AROUND THE LIGHTHOUSE OF THE NOTHERN PART OF CEBU PHILIPPINES
body.body:
![4a091bff-b4d8-4f9f-9495-2c81fdb469b3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ronimarie82/EqqvQvz5ozoXeJR3XozN7QgCSiGzwwSEYNSHhi7Z8gy4xhwE7z9peGBC1TK5n9Jwdwk.jpg)
 The weather was so hot because it is still summer in the Philippines. We decided to take a walk in the neighboring town to witness the beautiful tourist  spot . A lighthouse in the northern part of Cebu.  The lighthouse was located in  Bagacay, Brgy. Catarman Liloan Cebu. It was established in 1857 but the current structure was built in 1904 by the American colonial government. The purpose of the  lighthouse was to guide the fishermen, ships and navigators through the Mactan channel. 

![06a42430-285a-4128-96cc-5a122cb63b4a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ronimarie82/EqqvJEmFUEK1pvG9uShiY6ctjmRM5M2hiTgXJorwrJLduGWX9nUXSajMzZprjTWchzZ.jpg)

 The lighthouse is also famous for its panoramic view of the sea. Liloan was called “The Light of the North” because the lighthouse serves as guide to all mariners going to the northern part of CEBU.

![08c04e29-b130-4942-be55-60239db38ee6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ronimarie82/EphxTuvZzaJZ9SzBqp8SkWivvLehCRNwYwyXzpbTcnz2DsiPbpwCLfHZfRPcuCkTyYt.jpg)
  They have a solar panel to supply electricity for the lighthouse at night.  
![61bdc4ab-5337-4776-9643-5991dba063db.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ronimarie82/23yd3TbPwFecCfrgFgCGPdKDuRi8wHerUMFyrzZpxYMPto4hvRJpUwN3XqfQ1GXCc2YHo.jpg)

  Lighthouse is  [PAROLA ]in Bisaya the local dialect in Cebu.

![c4c236bb-159a-402e-b8da-ba26137a8b6e.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ronimarie82/23ywuRDDDksRzun1AYHp44p8sCk5Mc7BwUcsbdcAVDwftkMyaBiooG2VmWhwA2mDNdaRt.jpg)

We walked around the lighthouse but we were also careful because so many children were playing in front of it. 

![17579f40-6fc7-4ccd-bcc4-452c05393c85.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ronimarie82/23zbMge8K8RqKib9YwAhTUSbQ9gda6YT7CgA3rjVXrLkn28jsE4YpVrXExn5yXB5jNYgU.jpg)

![af190f12-0b34-496b-9111-1e70a0900e0b.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ronimarie82/23z7BFwf8Zg7v4MSdE4cQJsWAoNZSGCs8GjHV1njJDzq8YXZLbPsMR7JVRTWhviEkN5DH.jpg)

 The view of the ocean is very beautiful from where we are standing. The wind blows chilly.  Then we decided to fly our drone to  get perfect shots.
 We enjoyed our walked around the lighthouse. That’s all for today’s vlog my beloved Hiver’s and hope to see you on my next Vlog. Have a nice Wednesday to all of you.


![092a6087-816d-4680-9822-157d36f97cbb.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ronimarie82/23viLvWVQV6zw3c6qhtN4qPUE52YpFNFJH7Rqr1DjDgbdqu64kksCvzeMaNmguSp7jHRf.gif)
