body.title: MONTALBÁN - STREET PHOTOGRAPHY
body.body:
![Tcats.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/AK3dzgU8F3Qmm9bUKcFFArKixZoNwAxY3i7gJoVNafxgKMB5er1dym4H4xJn299.jpg)

----

**T**his town isn't exactly a beautiful place anymore, but that very decline in the aesthetics of its streets has turned it into an endless wellspring of street scenes; at least from my point of view... And besides, I myself am part of these streets, because I've always been here and I understand their stories and memories as my own...

>**E**ste pueblo no es ya precisamente un lugar hermoso, pero ese mismo descenso en la estética de sus calles, lo ha convertido en un interminable abrevadero de visiones callejeras; cuando menos desde mi punto de vista... Y además, yo mismo soy parte de estas calles, porque siempre he estado aquí y entiendo sus historias y memorias como mías... 

![T01.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23vhuB8wcs6uXmBCgXmAGnYtAZLHanWLyADTVaVkdqNDdZgx7ZGmLHD8tdVonna1bfgT4.jpg)
###### <sup> <center> 📷 01 </center> </sup>

![T02.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23uQvjx4aVRU9G9dtXwXRF4ZQeAXD69CCVkfm7cMgt7WW81ewc8VmLMnunDJk35qUiTBu.jpg)
###### <sup> <center> 📷 02 </center> </sup>

**I** walk down the street and I see the old Ford pickup truck from the Barela family's grocery store (📷 01 and 02) and I think about how I've seen it since the 80s and how it's been painted several times with the same old shade of green...

>**Y**o voy por la calle y observo la vieja camioneta pick'up Ford del abasto de la familia Barela (📷 01 y 02) y pienso en que la he visto desde los años 80 y la han pintado ya varias veces con el mismo tono verde de siempre...

![T03.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23wMiypyc1MsGVAdGTR1dhWRWfVRkdQg8N3ZxFpNTSjfKQ5sP2j9cTDfiU3a5onSD2ZJN.jpg)
###### <sup> <center> 📷 03 </center> </sup>

![T04.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23z7HzMP8YyfgbgtpqbgAGJnJPE5VA9gf2Xpz51igK92M2GFzdmRdj6K3n7hj47ZXZ6NH.jpg)
###### <sup> <center> 📷 04 </center> </sup>

![T05.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23wqrxsRcxL5dfKeV8GX5xkQToXbZcJg2hZpgMRodqpbUvL1jARXpsFQWDo1zb3R1jqiX.jpg)
###### <sup> <center> 📷 05 </center> </sup>

**T**he streets here \

very quickly, and I might be remembering my teacher Trina while gazing into her old window (📷 03), and then be interrupted by the voices of a group of boys resting under a shaded corner who want me to take their picture there (📷 04)... And a few meters further on, another old window (📷05), one of those that are still abundant here, gives me an almost anarchic view of time passing between shadows and light...\n\n>**L**as calles aquí \

muy rápido, y lo mismo puedo estar recordando a la profesora Trina mientras observo su vieja ventana (📷 03) que ser interrumpido por la vos de un grupo de chicos que descansan bajo una esquina sombreada y quieren que les haga un retrato allí (📷 04)... Y pocos metros más allá, otra vieja ventana (📷05), de esas que aquí abundan aún, me regala una visión casi anárquica del tiempo pasando entre sombras y luces... 

![T06.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23uFK5nVjiBXJmg3pFbHgynzzTqh7EuBpbEjLwRayY4Ltw25etDmcQzrLtowdZ77DBpzV.jpg)
###### <sup> <center> 📷 06 </center> </sup>

![T07.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23yws6qxdL5tWqpq1TMh8uVH2gmomxQcXWpmqkaq96jwsbmCuu6yKnPEKuQHA585n9MK3.jpg)
###### <sup> <center> 📷 07 </center> </sup>

![T08.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23wqgaDLjdYLocECqJDmC1jeszPYZMHZcYFyEu9CTofLUXq3SncX25veWe1xVrfFMSp43.jpg)
###### <sup> <center> 📷 08 </center> </sup>

**A**nd it's not everywhere you can walk down the street and feel like someone is watching you, and that \

is a huge rooster (📷 06) perched over a makeshift metal fence, because if there's one thing Montalbán has, it's that the rural and the urban blend together without too many rules or limits... And Juan \
(📷 07) seems a little more lucid when someone gives him a beer, which he drinks with pleasure outside a liquor store... And, a few streets later, \

(📷 07) sits waiting on the sidewalk outside a bakery for someone to give her a coffee... How could I not go out and take street photos here?, I often think to myself...\n\n>**Y** no en todas partes se puede ir por la calle y sentir que alguien te observa y que ese \

sea un gallo enorme (📷 06) asomado por encima de una barda improvisada de laminas de metal, porque si algo tiene Montalbán, es que lo rural y lo urbano, se mezclan sin demasiadas reglas ni limites... Y Juan \
(📷 07) parece un poco más lúcido cuando alguien le obsequia una cerveza que él bebe con placer en las afueras de alguna licorería... Y, pocas calles después, \

(📷 07) espera sentada en las banquetas de una panadería que alguien le obsequie un café... ¿Cómo no saldría yo a hacer fotos de calle aquí?, pienso para mi mismo con frecuencia... 

![T09.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23wqvtpB8JbgfY2Lr667F9U8hrrUtdoq8SiEQ4Sau1mjcTe11vBaZtD1xPW8eRUfjLyBe.jpg)
###### <sup> <center> 📷 09 </center> </sup>

![T10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23xL5EVBmkT1DZ7RzU1ZasXHRYqnJaumTfuwseLruHvaaZ8xqRzDVqvaDcVzZyFW8K6ab.jpg)
###### <sup> <center> 📷 10 </center> </sup>

**And** neglect and decay are also serious matters here, because places are becoming lonely and abandoned, like the once thriving Barbershop of Franklin and Fernando (📷 09) and the old School (📷 10), but even that has its own narrative and charm for a street photographer...

>**Y** el olvido y desgaste también son cosa seria aquí, porque los lugares van quedando solos y abandonados, como la otrora próspera Barbería de Franklin y Fernando (📷 09) y la vieja Escuela (📷 10), pero incluso eso tiene su narrativa y encanto para un fotógrafo callejero...

![T11.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23yd9wzp8iUuLjg1PXGDUJasx73j6GErstNzd4mZv4tANgYfzKX14wbKnSwvirdX5iQdN.jpg)
###### <sup> <center> 📷 11 </center> </sup>

![T12.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23w2kyDiK3yiLCXgfnkGZ6j4SdBe7nG3iYLMe9F1TawQrY288uokwzVLwYxdCVCbu2ejN.jpg)
###### <sup> <center> 📷 12 </center> </sup>

**T**here are places \

like the corner by the pharmacy with Rodolfo's old Chevrolet pickup truck (📷 11), which he uses as a kiosk to sell his merchandise. But there's also a certain dynamism that I can capture photographically in the streets; like in that photo (📷 12) on Miranda Avenue, where a motorcycle passes by while I was trying to photograph a repair shop for brush cutters and electric generators.\n\n>**H**ay lugares \

como la esquina de la farmacia con la vieja camioneta Chevrolet de Rodolfo (📷 11) , la cual le sirve como quiosco para vender su mercancía. Pero también hay cierto dinamismo que puedo explotar fotográficamente en las calles; como en esa foto (📷 12) en la Avenida \

en donde una motocicleta pasa por la calle mientras yo intentaba fotografiar un taller de reparación de maquinas desmalezadoras y generadores eléctricos.

![T13.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23zbMF4j1vQmrRSGQgPSSFpY4atbwDv1rCiHa2cJkJ4CPLmAViUN133C5j3mFKAtW3CBb.jpg)
###### <sup> <center> 📷 13 </center> </sup>

![T14.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23vsSN5DvzpH7adZnAobHoh57twusz9XgTE2y675Qk2AHqFndS3a1wtstRT21oZcoJDvX.jpg)
###### <sup> <center> 📷 14 </center> </sup>

**A**nd speaking of \

the old bicycle repair and knife-sharpening shop (📷 13 and 14) is precisely that; besides containing a touch of surrealism for always being empty, full of old artifacts, even though it's open without anyone coming in as a customer...\n\n>**Y** hablando de \

, el viejo taller de reparación de bicicletas y afilado de cuchillos (📷 13 y 14), es precisamente eso; además de contener algo de surrealismo por estar siempre solo, lleno de artefactos viejos, aunque abierto sin que nadie entre como cliente... ![T15.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23wMq6f5TeSvvYUcAbF3hbJrmGhM9BdAKypFTqyN5Bbq7Eio1zeqgrRhcEjndDnpQKGAq.jpg) **A**nd the last photo (📷 15) is a small sample of what I can see on the walls of the town, and that's a task I have pending, to do an update of this kind of thing and share it here with you on #Hive... >**Y** la ultima foto (📷 15), es una pequeña muestra de lo que puedo ver en las paredes del pueblo, y esa es una tarea pendiente que tengo, la de hacer una actualización de este tipo de cosas y compartirlo aquí con ustedes en #Hive... ----- ##
***Thank you very much for your visit and appreciation!***
> ######
*¡Muchas gracias por pasar y apreciar!*
--- **ADDITIONAL TECHNICAL NOTE**: Photographs captured with my Nikon D7000 DSLR camera in RAW format, then processed in Adobe Camera RAW for adjustments regarding light, sharpening, contrast and depth... They were then exported to JGP format on which minor modifications such as straightening and adding watermarks were carried out using PhotoScape v3.7 >**NOTA TÉCNICA ADICIONAL**: Fotografias capturadas con mi cámara DSLR Nikon D7000 en formato RAW, procesadas posteriormente en Adobe Camera RAW para ajustes relativos a luz, afilado, contraste y profundidad... Luego fueron exportadas a formato JGP sobre el cual se llevaron a cabo modificaciones menores como enderezado y agregado de marcas de agua usando PhotoScape v3.7 ---
#PHOTOGRAPHY # ***END / FIN*** @jlinaresp ---

**Camera**: Nikon D7000 **Lens**: Sigma 18-200mm f3.5-6.3 II DC OS HSM **Lens**: Tokina ATX-PRO 100mm f/2.8 d MACRO **Lens**: AF-S DX NIKKOR 55-300mm f/4.5-5.6G ED VR **Lens**: AF-S DX NIKKOR 18-55mm f/3.5-5.6G VR **Lens**: Nikon AF Nikkor 50 mm f/1.8d FX **Lens**:AF-S DX NIKKOR 35mm f/1.8G

body.title: My Response to  To Ease My Troubled Mind - The Authorised Unauthorised History of Billy Childish
body.body: A quote that has to be challenged.... \n

/>  \nMy response to a quote in the book To Ease My Troubled Mind - the authorised unauthorised history of Billy Childish that I stress I haven't read. A friend of mine has, and phoned me last night to let me know what's been written and quoted about the [Heckel's Horse](https://edgeworth.blog/collaboration-paintings-with-billy-childish/) paintings Billy and I make together. I wasn't interviewed for this book, despite having been working in Billy's painting studio on a weekly basis since 2013 (apart from a year off during covid) and collaborating with Billy on 150-200 paintings that hardly anyone's seen, under the name Heckel's Horse. Billy's a good friend, has been amazingly helpful to me and my art and is an honest man I trust and respect. But this quote is nonsense, and has to be publicly contested. I don't know how this quote came about, but it can't just sit like this on record, given the lack of publication about Heckel's Horse that currently exists. I work extremely hard on my art and music and have dedicated a large part of it to this series of paintings Billy and I have been collaborating on. I'm also a self-representing artist, so don't have any big clout gallery representing me and my work. Publishing misleading, at the very least, information about my art and work I do with others is something I have to stand up to. Heckel's Horse is a collaboration between myself, Edgeworth Johnstone, and Billy Childish that we've been working on for the past thirteen years. body.title: Chicken Teriyaki
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYyZcLNK9y7MXjZNydT6vL7Ajqgb3QoprAU7W9zVXMNCt/1778677507945.png)

Hi bloggers and food lovers, how do you usually like your chicken? Fried, grilled, or something else? This time, I’m going to share an easy recipe featuring chicken as the main ingredient. The chicken is marinated in seasonings until the flavors are absorbed, then cooked—it’s very simple and perfect for meal prep. Alright, let’s get started

**Ingredients:**

- 200 grams chicken thigh fillet 
- 2 tbsp soy sauce
- 1/2 tbsp oyster sauce
- 1 tbsp soy sauce
- 1 tsp salt
- 1/2 tsp sugar
- 1 tsp black pepper 
- 1 clove garlic
- a small piece of ginger (about the size of a fingernail)
- 1/2 onion
- chopped scallions
- sesame seeds
- 1 tsp chili flakes ( optional )
- olive oil or cooking oil
- 50 ml of water 

**Steps:** 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP2ThwR4P64Zad2CkD9HGqfmTzN34ZeK3nsk1okdhMow3/1778677535667.jpg)

- Rinse the chicken thoroughly under running water, then dice the chicken thigh fillets into several pieces
 
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYfzUBBqpuJXNM7NpH8r7NpjkVnwDf31Ak3zLaiX6uTSk/1778677561603.jpg)

- Place in a bowl

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ76q2KW3TG1Lf6FZn9btgNPHZWSajvmQeep1nDGE2Rrj/1778677575376.jpg)

- Add the sweet soy sauce, soy sauce, oyster sauce, sugar, salt, and pepper

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRD5WBxXCWuo18nwrQW8XdRPmphEctuSEqQCShTNrH6jq/1778677588344.jpg)

- Add the grated garlic

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeEwAjwbCtxRZPxoHUyXTXgBgQZzMHhipyBLBGFmPwr5r/1778677610359.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUFnsfQZUzTrFrGWeZddkTdpT4meZL9iNgtJMLahoW7rJ/1778677610538.jpg)

- Stir until well combined, then transfer to a smaller container that fits in the chiller 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTQaU5zwQMFQsWnhW238Ya5dqune6FaNcvpADsJwBNAfp/1778677640833.jpg)

- Let it marinate overnight or for at least 30 minutes

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYwTRMyfLUgJeYBrY2FRB5yoxdNoBKJDgj6xFoxb7unnX/1778677662435.jpg)

- In the morning, I add grated ginger to the chicken and mix them well

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZTWRdvd1QB1jNTYz21ZjECGs3smoiWAPnp3Dg83G61Mg/1778677662665.jpg)

- After marinating overnight, remove the chicken from the refrigerator

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTjAhbGauHhTHK7BXL8XYLh1Dk92MdJQS5Nmc4qczJHKT/1778677781444.jpg)

- Heat a pan, then add olive oil

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNm8L3zscGGoW7CL358RndLp1431naC9Bp9mwuaHcXgMP/1778677796162.jpg)

- Once the oil is hot, add the chicken that has been marinated overnight

- Cook the chicken while stirring

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ2Z5uA1LMvtjTTJvMyZVvymMLt6WGfX2PaXMUbxW4eVw/1778677808903.jpg)

body.body:
>

I have yet another mini projector review haha.  Another brand contacted me and asked that I review this one.  It's a slightly upgraded version of [one that I've done before](https://peakd.com/video/@adetorrent/hy300-pro-mini-projector-a-uk-best-seller), so I won't go on about the specs etc. Everything is basically the same as that one, but with noticeably brighter display ( higher lumens).  This comes in very handy actually because it makes the difference when using it in daylight or an illuminated room.  The older version required a dark room to be properly enjoyed while this one was just fine, even with the windows open.

By the way, these gadgets are all made in the same factories in China. Brands create \

companies and market them under their own brands. The can often request some minor customisations to the products but these are usually limited to superficial properties like colour, placement of the brand logo or what they're bundled with. That's the only way they can be mass-produced as cheaply as they are. It would cost these brands multiple times more if they were to actually create their own products (even delegated to China) because of the overhead. This cost would be passed to the consumer which means a projector like this one would be going for many hundreds of pounds, let alone sub-fifty pounds like they sell for. Unfortunately this has created a *race to the bottom* environment when it comes to price competition, because we expect to pay less and less. This has also created products with very short lifespans because they are designed to break early so we are forced to buy the latest ones. A such, the heaps of plastic garbage keep getting higher and higher. No idea what we can do about it to be honest. I've mentally thrown in the towel to all this stuff for my own mental health 😂 ____ # [🛒 Buy on Amazon](https://amzn.to/4dmOzNL) *This is an affiliate link* Peace & Love, *Adé*

Nickelback

---


Nickelback is a world-renowned Canadian rock band that formed in 1995 in the small town of Hanna, Alberta. The original lineup featured brothers Chad Kroeger (lead vocals and guitar) and Mike Kroeger (bass), along with their cousin Brandon Kroeger (drums) and friend Ryan Peake (guitar). The band’s name famously originated from Mike Kroeger’s time working at a local Starbucks, where he would frequently tell customers, \

while giving change. Initially starting as a cover band called Village Idiot, they eventually transitioned to writing original material, leading to their first full-length album, Curb, in 1996.  \nThe band's connection to Hanna remains a significant part of their identity and local history. Located approximately 220 kilometers northeast of Calgary, the town has long celebrated being the \
featuring highway welcome signs and murals of the band's album covers on local buildings like the curling rink. The town served as the backdrop for their hit 2005 music video for \

which prominently featured the high school the band members attended, the local train station, and other community landmarks. Although the original wooden highway signs were removed in 2023 due to disrepair, the community remains a proud supporter of the band, who in turn have continued to support local fundraisers and events over the decades.  

---

---

This collection is a remarkable physical record of rock history, featuring a diverse array of guitar picks gathered from some of the most legendary North American tours. Each piece represents a specific moment in time, coming directly from the hands of the most influential touring bands of the last 20 to 40 years. From the thrash metal precision of Megadeth to the grunge-era icons like Eddie Vedder, these picks are more than just gear—they are tangible artifacts from the high-energy arenas and stadiums that defined a generation of music.
The significance of these picks lies in their connection to the peak of live performance culture across the continent. Over the past four decades, touring reached a massive scale, and these picks were used by artists who headlined the most iconic festivals and venues in the world. Whether it's a specialty \

design or a classic tour-stamped plectrum, having items from bands that shaped the sound of the 80s, 90s, and 2000s makes this a curated chronicle of modern rock’s touring legac. I'm putting this guitar pic together. Alphabetical order over the next few weeks and months.\n\n---

body.title: The future of Hive
body.body:
![39738.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ephraimm/23zm167VTG3zeAgY6QdLyr5YMdwmacwAUtskeMtyqHbjY9swMnC6wWceW6mM8hTvVF2GX.jpg)

Am the least of who should be saying these right now but Sometimes I wonder what Hive could look like in the next 10 years if the people inside it keep showing up with a long term mindset and patience. No body is chasing fast attention or temporary gains, but people who are actually understanding the power of staying committed to something for years.
Most things fail because people get tired too early. They want results immediately, and once things slow down, the passion disappears. But communities built by people who think long term usually end up different. Over time, the mentality changes. Experience grows naturally. People begin to understand each other better, ideas mature, and the environment itself starts producing a different kind of individual.
*Imaginary*
I imagine a future where Hive is no longer seen as just another online space, but as a place that shaped people mentally, financially, and creatively. 
The interesting thing about time is that it rewards people who remain steady while everybody else keeps restarting their lives every few months. Ten years of continuous effort from a focused group of people can create something most outsiders would never expect.
A lot of people only notice success when it becomes visible, but they rarely pay attention to the silent years that built it. That is usually where the real transformation happens.
If Hive truly keeps attracting people with patience, discipline, and vision, then the next decade could turn it into something far bigger than what it appears to be today.

Weteran Nintendo, który pracował dla korporacji od wielu lat, zrezygnował z niej. To w dużej mierze dzięki niemu zawdzięczamy pomysł na Mario-Słonia.
https://gamerant.com/super-mario-zelda-retires-nintendo-takashi-tezuka/

[GTA 6] 
Gamerant przygotował artykuł o zapowiedziach Rockstara dotyczących GTA VI i ich pokrycia w rzeczywistości. 
https://gamerant.com/grand-theft-auto-6-gta-6-rumours-confirmed-speculation/

[GTA 6 x Sony]
Kończąc temat newsów o GTA, Sony zaczęło wysyłać powiadomienia do graczy GTA V, że muszą ulepszyć swoją konsolę przed premierą kolejnej części. Wygląda na to, że Sony kłamało ws. ich umowy z Rockstarem. Zupełnie mnie to nie dziwi, jeśli GTA6 będzie chodziło \

, to fani GTA są tak zdeterminowani, że będą gotowi kupić konsole.
https://gamerant.com/playstation-ps4-ps5-upgrade/

https://gamerant.com/gta-6-playstation-marketing-deal-promo-emails-ps-store-theory/

[Call of Duty]
Posiadacze PS4 również nie doczekają się kolejnej części Call of Duty. To już pewniak.
https://gamerant.com/call-of-duty-skipping-ps4-2026/ 

[PS6]
CEO Sony wypowiedział się na temat kolejnej konsoli, ale nie padło tam nic poza ogólnymi hasłami.
https://gamerant.com/sony-ps6-price-release-date-comments/

Ten sam pan, wypowiedział się również o AI.
https://gamerant.com/sony-ceo-ai-playstation-future/

[PS+]
Na PS+ pojawiła się gra-niespodzianka - Time Crisis.
https://gamerant.com/ps-plus-premium-games-may-2026-time-crisis/ 

Doszła kolejna darmowa gra (przynajmniej dla niektórych). 
https://gamerant.com/ps-plus-extra-abiotic-factor-free-cosmic-companions-update/

A skoro mowa o ich sklepie, Sony zapowiada duże promocje po 13 maja.
https://gamerant.com/playstation-next-level-sale-may-2026/

[Uncharted]
Jeśli jesteście ciekawi, jak bardzo różni się pierwotna wersja gry od tego, co ostatecznie trafiło do sprzedaży, to polecam nowy film dokumentalny o powstaniu 4 części Uncharted.
https://gamerant.com/uncharted-4-naughty-dog-amy-hennig-version/

[Marathon]
Nie lubię tego mówić, ale... \

Marathon i inne gry-usługi nie przyniosły żadnych zysków Sony, a jedynie same straty. Jakbym cofnął się do czasów szkolnych, gdy kiepski nauczyciel dawał nagrody słabym uczniom, a karał tych dobrych - studio Bluepoint. 
https://gamerant.com/sony-financials-destiny-marathon-bungie/

[Wolverine]
Gra od twórców Spider-Man trafi do sprzedaży 15 września tego roku.
https://gamerant.com/insomniac-games-wolverine-release-date/

[Baldur's Gate 3] 
Posiadacze konsol dostali update od firmy - nowe klasy postaci, mody i nie tylko. Super, jak w końcu odpalę tę grę, to będzie więcej opcji. 
https://gamerant.com/baldurs-gate-3-update-console-mods/

[Starfield]
Niedługo pojawi się kolejny patch.
https://gamerant.com/starfield-ps5-update-crashing/ 

[Bioshock]
Podobno sytuacja z rozwojem gry poprawiła się. CEO twierdził, że produkując grę, nie przemyśleli wszystkich założeń, przez co utkwili na jakiś czas w Limbo. Podobno jest już jednak dobrze, proces produkcyjny zbliża się do końca. 
https://gamerant.com/bioshock-4-state-update-issues-deeply-disappointed-boss/

[Forza]
Nowe materiały promocyjne pokazują, że gra zaliczyła upgrade od wcześniejszych zapowiedzi do dnia premiery. Miła odmiana po tych wszystkich downgrade'ach.
https://gamerant.com/forza-horizon-6-graphics-images-comparison/ 

https://gamerant.com/forza-horizon-6-car-pass/

https://gamerant.com/forza-horizon-6-leaks-before-launch/

https://gamerant.com/forza-horizon-6-release-times-how-to-play-early/

Za to podobno nie wszystkie modele są dopracowane... 
https://gamerant.com/forza-horizon-6-ae86-model/

Poznaliśmy bonus, który dostaniemy za pre-order.
https://gamerant.com/forza-horizon-6-j50-ferrari-pre-order-bonus/

[First Light]
Poznaliśmy PC-towe wymagania sprzętowe dla gry. Od dawna gram na konsoli, więc wybaczcie ignorancję. Pełna specyfikacja jest w linku poniżej.
https://gamerant.com/007-first-light-pc-specs/

IO Interactive potwierdziło też, że gra będzie chodzić z 60 klatkami na sekundę w wersji PS Pro. Z kolei podstawowa wersja konsoli będzie miała 2 standardowe tryby. Raz z nich skorzystałem, gdy grałem ze swoją kobietą w God of War, więc nie pamiętam jak się nazywają xD. 
https://gamerant.com/007-first-light-60-fps-ps5-pro/

[Worms Galactic Tactics]
Jak wynika z plotek i przecieków opublikowanych na X, trwają prace nad wskrzeszeniem jednej z najpopularniejszych marek mojego dzieciństwa. 
https://gamerant.com/new-worms-game-leaks-xcom/

[Star Wars Zero Company]
W 2026 dostaniemy kolejną grę ze świata SW. Póki co jednak, poznaliśmy jedynie nowe informacje dotyczące kampanii fabularnej. 
https://gamerant.com/star-wars-zero-company-story-details-early-empire/

[Battlefield 6]
Dostaliśmy informacje na temat kolejnego sezonu, nadchodzących aktualizacji oraz treść nowego patcha.
https://gamerant.com/battlefield-6-season-3-roadmap/

https://gamerant.com/battlefield-6-season-3-update-patch-notes/

[Escape From Tarkov] 
Jean Tyulegenov, czyli Lead Game Designer, zrezygnował z pracy po 9 latach.  
https://gamerant.com/escape-from-tarkov-dev-leaving-battlestate-games/

[RE Requiem] 
Jeśli zastanawialiście się czemu w grze nie ma Ady Wong, odpowiedź jest prosta - nie było praktycznego powodu, by tak zrobić. Ada Wong była zbędna w tym scenariuszu.
https://gamerant.com/resident-evil-requiem-ada-missing-why/

Z kolei niedawno dodana mini-gra podzieliła graczy. 
https://gamerant.com/resident-evil-requiem-dlc-bad/

https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/news/2026-05-08/resident-evil-requiem-game-update-adds-postgame-leon-must-die-forever-mode/.237181

Ludzie kopiący dane, znaleźli mechaniki, grafiki i inne rzeczy, które nie trafiły do ostatecznej wersji gry. 
https://gamerant.com/resident-evil-requiem-cut-content/

[From Software x Piraci]
Po raz kolejny usłyszałem (już 3), że twórcy Soulsów robią grę o piratach. Nie wiem, ile w tym prawdy, ale skoro to Japońskie studio, to mogli się zainspirować niedawnym tytułem od Yakuzy np.
https://gamerant.com/fromsoftware-pirate-game/

[Kingdom Hearts]
Istnieje szansa, że zobaczymy 4 część gry na Tokyo Game Show. 
https://gamerant.com/kingdom-hearts-4-tokyo-game-show/

[Stellar Blade 2]
Twórcy jednej z najlepszych gier na PS5 stwierdzili, że sami wydadzą swoją grę, zamiast polegać na Sony. Bardzo dobra decyzja, Sony ostatnio podejmuje głównie głupie i szkodliwe decyzje. Zniszczyli już jedno studio, wyrzucili setki milionów dolarów do śmieci rozwijając słabe lub przeciętne gry. Danie im dobrego tytułu do dystrybucji wiąże się z podobnym ryzykiem, jak danie małpie AK-47.

Podobno sequel ma zostać pokazany w tym roku. 
https://gamerant.com/stellar-blade-2-shift-up-publisher/

[Discord x Game Pass]
Microsoft wprowadził kolejne zmiany do swojej usługi. Ciekawe czy znowu zepsują Discorda. 
https://gamerant.com/xbox-game-pass-discord-partnership/

[Subnautica 2]
Dostaliśmy nowy pokaz gameplayu przez beta testami, które rozpoczną się za kilka dni. 
https://gamerant.com/subnautica-2-gameplay-preview-trailer/

https://gamerant.com/subnautica-2-global-release-times/

[Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2]
Powstaje sequel do uznanej i podobno lubianej gry. Dostaliśmy trailer, a gra pojawi się na Xbox, PS5 i PC. Nie wiemy, czy gra trafi na NS2. Premiera latem tego roku.
https://www.comingsoon.net/games/trailers/2129919-new-aliens-video-game-trailer-sets-exciting-release-date-window

[Stranger Than Heaven] 
Tej zimy na X-box, PS5 i PC, zadebiutuje nowa gra od Ryu ga Gotoku. Gra trafi do Game Pass. Sam rzucę okiem na tę grę, o ile będzie przypominać Ghost of Tsushima. Like a Dragon odrzuca mnie swoim anime-dziwactwem, systemem turowym i specyficznym klimatem. Sami aktorzy głosowi robią wrażenie - Snopp Dog, Ado (bardzo znana piosenkarka) i Akio Otsuka (mój ulubiony aktor głosowy z anime). 
https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/news/2026-05-06/stranger-than-heaven-game-reveals-story-gameplay-cast-winter-launch/.237134

[Steins;Gate Re:Boot] 
Odświeżona wersja znanej, Japońskiej gry, zadebiutuje już 20 sierpnia. Będziemy mogli zagrać na PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Switch, Switch 2, Xbox Series X|S i PC poprzez Steama.
https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/news/2026-05-07/steins-gate-re-boot-game-reveals-august-20-release/.237154

[Sekiro]
Od 4 września przez 3 tygodnie, Japońskie kina będą emitowały prawie 2-godzinną adaptację słynnej gry. Jeśli nie mieszkacie w kraju Sakury, nic straconego! Film będzie emitowany na streamingu Crunchyroll. Poza tym dostaliśmy nową grafikę promocyjną. 
https://www.facebook.com/LiveChart.me/posts/pfbid0nwHqvzAymZKssAZqC7bB9Kh2VJsHk7rLWpRX4pC4T2tx4R4P9m1s2G4DQFoAERkxl

[MK 2]
Tremor miał mieć początkowo bardziej rozbudowaną rolę (walczyć np. z Sonyą Blade), ale nic z tego nie wyszło. Było za mało czasu, a fabułą go nie potrzebowała.
https://www.comingsoon.net/movies/news/2131139-mortal-kombat-2-cast-fighters-cut-tremor-villain-jeremy-slater

Reżyser wypowiedział się również na temat 3 części. Podobno dwójka jest już znacznie lepsza, więc... Jeśli tak naprawdę jest, to niech tworzy dalej. 
https://www.comingsoon.net/movies/news/2130808-mortal-kombat-3-teased-by-director-it-never-really-stops

body.title: ᴀᴛᴛᴇɴᴅɪɴɢ ᴀ ᴍᴇʀᴍᴀɪᴅ ғᴇsᴛɪᴠᴀʟ.
body.body:
>

‎There are places worth exploring but the issue is difference in individual lifestyle. There are places you hear of people having parties, you will be like; what exactly are they up to? But the most common among it all is having parties on land. It is the regular places for humans to have parties but would you believe it, if I told you I have not attended any party for about 2 years now, only if is religious gatherings or anniversaries count's as parties.
‎
‎I am not a party person not to talk of festivals, which means having festival on land is already too much for me. What about cruise parties on ships? It definitely sounds like fun but I'm a very careful person. I think the titanic incident still holds a special place in my heart. With that being said, how about having a festival under water? of all places, you want me to consider having a festival beneath the ocean!!!
‎
‎The last time I checked, I'm still human. I'm not a mermaid, so we should both maintain our territory. Why would people want to have a festival beneath the ocean? These are the kind of question that really bothers me, of all places in the universe, you chose to have a festival beneath the sea. I don't care how much the tickets are sold for, cheap or costly, I'm definitely not buying.
‎
‎Where will I say I'm going to? On a normal day, I'm not a lover of the beach, it is just too cold for me. I don't just decide to visit the beach, or else there is something extremely important to do there or it is a family vacation. Ordinary festival held in my own state of origin, I don't attend, it is now a festival held beneath the ocean, that I will now attend. This sounds like \

joke to me, if you know what I'm talking about.
‎

body.title: Giro,Session, Mowing, Fungus, Creek, Borked Mower, Parts? What Parts? - Tuesday
body.body:
It is crazy how many riders are falling out of the Giro. Crashes and illnesses have left the field and some teams in tatters. I was looking at the weather for Sunday and it is looking like I will have a cool ride for my first 50 miler as it is to be 64F with chances of rain mid day. Hoping for little wind... ![IMG_20260512_080539.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23w2mG35mc9GyVSP6TS757BayW1kJmmMUBj7myxtWniwUCZDkZvv6nSrPzXgb8cWNd1kb.jpg) I got the boys to school then went to my weekly session which went well. It was getting warm already by the time I got home so headed out right away to get mowing done. I went across the creek and made it maybe 2 passes before the mower head borked. I was left with only one string on the cutter head but managed to power through and cut until the gas ran out. It is the densest grass on the farm and the mower did great even with just one line. ![IMG_20260512_112926.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tbsGVfA3vUjHzxRNgr1Dh8iu1k7mMVRy3vAARWfxRPf5pEZeJZPFun4hDtgTJ98Dn2K.jpg) After cooling off for a bit and setting the chicks on the deck in the heat I went and wandered up the hillside. One of the downed trees is COVERED in fungus. The entire tree is sprouting. ![IMG_20260512_131641.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tSSKafgwUnvVJsSyXLiCa1ZLSTNDSLEUhaGJPudd4qHhYzGFjtJsRiHUUEX2nLGUNRB.jpg) Cut one open to see. Not positive what it is exactly. I made a round of the upper pen fence line and found no issues. ![IMG_20260512_131755.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tvegWv5pJ538yPchr724EcKQjVdVqLYg1ey7vyTGwoNCsv5wCfzdhFvL5N3XgWkg6uK.jpg) The creek is flowing wonderfully ever since I removed the obstructions from this pinch point. No backups and it has finally returned to the original stream bed. ![IMG_20260512_140400.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tm93KuwaH6gTGiqWbKE3foV6yjpcKJvdDrTLPTEdwfx4kjjwtyJfzSW2nwVSUezm8wj.jpg) I spent a good bit of my afternoon hunting for the replacement part for the mower. Toro seems to no longer provide the part, ANYWHERE. You can see the missing wire. I am figuring I will have to make my own line attachment using the 2 slots. I have heavy wire or metal rod and a welder so will rig something up. The worst part is missing the grass guard from the main shaft which allows the grass to nearly lock it up. Maddening and I am not able to model it for 3d printing as of yet... ![IMG_20260512_144605.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23wMefk1BumaQZjBDEVSuPKgsAHpLrFFLASETEjQr19ivgCK7RvwUxjVR5pGMXHNckmhS.jpg) ![IMG_20260512_144613.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23wX1G2oVif7R5T32gzedSGAXSd7Gd9iKR8WaUfSUkk3A37DMZ596KwcnkdBprhUJMCYL.jpg) Much cooler today and we are expecting rain this afternoon. I get the boys to school in a bit, Giro is on, make sure things are covered for the rain and try to rake the cut grass before it hits, I will do a trainer ride, setup a trencher rental, wash my clothes, and figure out dinner this evening. ---

body.title: My School Pool Party
body.body: /> School life becomes more exciting when special events are arranged for students, and one of the most memorable events for me was our school pool party. It was a day full of fun, laughter, music, and unforgettable memories with friends and teachers. The party was held on a sunny afternoon at the school swimming pool area. A few days before the event, everyone in the class was talking about it with excitement. Students brought colorful swimming outfits, towels, and snacks. The whole pool area was decorated with balloons and bright lights, which created a cheerful atmosphere. As soon as the party started, music began playing loudly, and students jumped into the pool with great energy. Some students were excellent swimmers, while others simply enjoyed splashing water and playing games. There were different activities like swimming races, water volleyball, and fun competitions. Teachers also joined some activities, which made the event even more enjoyable.

/>

One of the best moments was when our friends formed teams for a swimming race. Everyone was cheering loudly for their classmates. Even students who were usually shy became active and confident during the games. The laughter and happiness on everyone’s faces made the day feel special.

The school management also arranged delicious food and cold drinks for everyone. After swimming for a long time, enjoying snacks with friends felt amazing. Many students took pictures together to save the memories of the day.

A pool party is not only about fun but also about building friendship and teamwork. It gave students a chance to relax from studies and spend quality time together. Events like these make school life more colorful and memorable.

In the end, our school pool party became one of the happiest experiences of my school life. I will always remember the fun, excitement, and beautiful moments shared with my friends.

![1000035932.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cleanplanet/23wC9vRfKtNXeYuPfXfhZUDyDS9zaBgEuh7mXeta4zHWmEBdjckoHqdLfNx6TRwWhdni6.png)

# En constante concertation 

Le projet commence à être mis en forme.

De l'idée au projet, les membres de l'équipe se concertent pour avancer. 
Lorsque nous nous regroupons pour l'entraînement, les discussions fusent.
Chacun donne son point de vue et tout le monde est content de recevoir un équipement digne de ce nom avec les couleurs de @cleanplanet.

Chaque membre de l'équipe remercie déjà l'association non gouvernementale @cleanplanet pour cette initiative. 
Lorsqu'on pratique le cyclisme, les équipements sont lavés très souvent et l'usure se fait sentir au bout de 2 ans.
Ce sont des équipements spécifiques et techniques, on le comprend bien, puisque la selle de vélo est vraiment très fine et des mesures de protection sont appliquées.

Dans mon enfance, j'ai commencé le cyclisme avec des équipements très (trop) chauds et bien moins étudies.
Le short de cyclisme est appelé \

. Et à l'intérieur de ce cuissard lorsque j'ai commencé le vélo, il y avait une peau de chamois, une vraie peau de chamois. C'était assez inconfortable, mais cela protégeait le fessier des irritations sur la selle.
Aujourd'hui les techniques d'amortissements, en gel ou en mousse sont vraiment adaptées à la pratique de ce sport et nous pouvons rester sur la selle quatre à cinq heures, voire plus sans irritation.

![saparator_new_logo2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cleanplanet/23tRvNLsq4yRKjSijK87uRvtLxbCvD284LMZW8jcYS558uiLQq6Zv33BKLeuJ9rv6gedD.png)

# LE NOM DE L'EQUIPE

> LE FLAHUTE.... MAIS QU'EST-CE DONC QUE LE FLAHUTE ?

*Définition
Le mot « flahute » est un terme d'argot français, qui désigne en général une personne originaire du Nord de la France ou de Flandre. Il fait référence à l'image stéréotypée des habitants de cette région, souvent perçus comme robustes et endurants.*

*Dans le domaine sportif, notamment dans le cyclisme, un flahute est un coureur courageux et tenace, capable de braver les conditions météorologiques difficiles telles que le vent, la pluie ou le froid. Ce surnom a été attribué à plusieurs champions belges et nordistes au fil des années.*

*Ainsi, le terme « flahute » peut avoir une connotation positive, valorisant la force et la persévérance, mais aussi négative, renvoyant à un certain folklore régional.*

*Source : © lalanguefrancaise.com*

Alors oui, ce terme nous définit assez bien puisque nous, nous allons faire des kilometres de route sur notre velo, nous entraîner, par tous les temps, et toujours avec plaisir.

C'est surtout un terme et une connotation qui nous amuse ! Et dans la région, nous sommes reconnus par nos collègues cyclistes, qui nous saluent bien avec un \

lorsque nous nous croisons.

![saparator_new_logo2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cleanplanet/23tRvNLsq4yRKjSijK87uRvtLxbCvD284LMZW8jcYS558uiLQq6Zv33BKLeuJ9rv6gedD.png)

# DESIGN DU MAILLOT 

Ne soyez pas impatient ! Vous serez informés de l'allure et de la couleur du futur maillot de l'équipe TEAM FLAHUTES - CLEANPLANET ! 

Une première proposition a été faite, mais a été rejetée finalement.
En concertation, nous avons conclu que c'était un coloris qui allait être trop salissant et lorsque nous pédalons sous la pluie et l'orage, il y a vraiment de grosses projections salissantes qui sont difficiles à faire partir au fur et à mesure du temps.

Voila donc le modèle non retenu 👇👇👇


![1000035625.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cleanplanet/23zGsGLmJzsPuf8uEGM9J2p2VybknSzyKbf93GJsigqxSE6ie6ze3cRYXLFQYsELBLa5Z.jpg)


![1000035623.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cleanplanet/Epvmjd6ezzuGp4hUcek2MBsAok8uyLQPQKpe5qJHgLheZcndE8zHysn1cNtnUgPxxgD.jpg)

Alors que très lumineux, et certainement salissant, j'ai trouvé que le logo de @cleanplanet n'était pas assez voyant.

Il serait dommage pour un sponsor de ne pas être vu.
Le but étant quand même de faire une campagne publicitaire pour @cleanplanet.

Aimez-vous ce design ? Était ce une bonne ou mauvaise idée ?

Mais patience... nous sommes désormais sur un autre design.

A suivre...

body.title: Burano - The Hidden Gem of Venice 🏰🛳️
body.body:
Today I want to tell you about my visit to a very colorful and fabulous place. As an avid photographer, I was looking for new adventures and inspirations. As I researched the options, Burano caught my attention with its promise of colorful houses and authentic Italian culture. Located just 30 minutes by boat from bustling Venice, this small island in the lagoon proved to be a treasure trove of surprises.



![Bu (1).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeg9iMqqgeACMZz1kNbkRUhMATVQJeGUhyCmoHXNTmemd/Bu%20(1).jfif)

One of the most fascinating experiences of Burano was undoubtedly the opportunity to watch the local artisans in action. Burano is famous for its lace, a craft that has flourished here for centuries. In small workshops decorated with samples of their work, these talented craftsmen demonstrated their skills, creating intricate designs with incredible precision. Conversations with them revealed stories of tradition and heritage that added depth to the island's charm.


![Bu (11).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSzPRXrSNayXFkdoAPJKUtJweCnFDX7r6wq8BGSe1RBMU/Bu%20(11).jfif)

Upon arrival I was greeted by the sight of houses painted in vibrant hues stretching as far as the eye could see. Each house was a feast of colors reflecting each other in a mesmerizing palette. This visual delight was a sight to behold, but it also served a practical purpose. These dwellings were originally painted in different colors to help fishermen identify their homes when returning from the sea in foggy conditions.


![Bu (10).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQmRWzB8p4hM1RBdFAZ8MkHPGB7foXNRae6JYUJwySTCa/Bu%20(10).jfif)

Walking through the narrow sidewalks, I felt as if I had stepped into a scene from a fairy tale. The air was filled with a mixture of aromas - the salty sea breeze mixed with the aroma of fresh pasta and home cooked food wafting around. Here, life flowed at a slower pace, far from the hustle and bustle of Venice. There were times when I seemed to be the only person on the island, allowing me to fully immerse myself in its peaceful atmosphere.


![Bu (9).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVAb24fvEVg2Z79ethM4xGpPe3B7iux754s3UvJxK3je3/Bu%20(9).jfif)

The food here is also not to be missed. As a fishing island, they offer an abundance of fresh seafood at reasonable prices. The saffron risotto dish, made with the highest quality saffron grown in the nearby paddy fields, was a culinary delight I won't soon forget. And for dessert, try the traditional Burano pastries filled with a mixture of cheese, sugar and eggs - a delightful end to a meal filled with the flavors of Italy.


![Bu (7).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYJDa7BRNX9E9s9T77sUVAA6mfnsFTKDNS2rsDSvv46RH/Bu%20(7).jfif)

![Bu (8).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVFka9XTiG8TRozW1UUa2beahoYvGUT1oVUqmxbzkvtSD/Bu%20(8).jfif)


But perhaps Burano's most valuable quality is its sense of community. As I wandered the streets, I often came across groups of locals engaged in friendly conversation or participating in social events. There was a sense of belonging and camaraderie that is lacking in many tourist hotspots. This human touch added an extra layer of charm to my visit to the island.


![Bu (6).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVPwKR5XdC7VHraREW35oiKZQp9KzmLCeuNHFHkaN1obC/Bu%20(6).jfif)

I couldn't resist the allure of the colorful glassware that Burano is known for. Crafted on the nearby island of Murano, these pieces were a testament to the island's centuries-old glassmaking tradition. Each piece was a work of art, reflecting light in a mesmerizing range of colors. They were the perfect finishing touch to my collection of Burano souvenirs.



![Bu (5).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYLojgeqCsAKhmYzFdSiRhMtp1HQSCCqmtwcpxgytbJur/Bu%20(5).jfif)

After moving away from the busy canals and into the maze of narrow streets, I found myself surrounded by peace and quiet. The noise of tourists and traders disappeared, replaced by the soothing hum of insects and the distant lapping of waves against the shore. Time seemed to slow down here, allowing me to fully immerse myself in the atmosphere of the island.


![Bu (4).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbzJjUEfjD9kM5RheYWr1pCazwptRv6LrdAXKFFF5DP7W/Bu%20(4).jfif)

Suddenly the sound of a TV on broke the silence. I followed him to a modest house, the door of which was slightly ajar. Inside, a family was gathered in front of the screen, engrossed in a show they were broadcasting. Their faces expressed total concentration as the characters unfolded on the screen. It was a snapshot of everyday life, a fragment of the life of the people of Burano rarely seen by outsiders :)))


![Bu (3).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTB1DnTiYnMaynt4VpmqeddPLXMKoHiTg2yWaJk6os7YS/Bu%20(3).jfif)

Finally, I can say from personal experience that if you are looking for an escape from the usual tourist routes, consider visiting the enchanting island of Burano. With its vibrant color, rich history, unique culture and warm welcome, it offers an experience that is hard to match. Whether you're a photographer looking for the perfect subject, a foodie looking to try authentic Italian cuisine, or just someone looking for a break from the crowd, Burano is sure to capture your heart. So pack your camera, grab a pair of comfortable shoes and get ready to embark on a journey to the fairytale world of Burano!


![Bu (2).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZbiyszNMjPAtrFboUD4CraqUZbBHtBDd4KMnneBFwanu/Bu%20(2).jfif)

># <center>**ENGLISH VERSION**</center>

Squares and cubes are among the most common shapes in our constructions, and their repetition can create beautiful patterns that transform structures into works of art.

<center>[]!(https://images.ecency.com/DQmYj9YYz7RLccsjHqAUELt71zfQUDAfKJ76rYj3ivvoRrF/cuadrados_1.jpg)</center>!

In this image, you can see a slide at a trampoline park, among other fun attractions. This popular slide, where you descend on an inner tube, provides a wonderful sensation.

<center>[]!(https://images.ecency.com/DQmRAVBgYp93K2hvc2gUtyyAftzmzspg5XhY587upckbv9Y/cuadrados_3.jpg)</center>

As you can see, the surface of this slide is made of thick, square-patterned foam, which provides safety for children in case of a fall, preventing them from hitting the hard floor too hard. It also contributes to the beautiful artwork.

I hope you like it, and I look forward to your comments.

># <center>**VERSION EN ESPAÑOL**</center>

Los cuadrados y los cubos es una de las formas mas comunes en nuestras construcciones y la repetición de ellos puede crear patrones hermosos que hacen de las construcciones una bella obra de arte.

<center>[]!(https://images.ecency.com/DQmYj9YYz7RLccsjHqAUELt71zfQUDAfKJ76rYj3ivvoRrF/cuadrados_1.jpg)</center>!

Así en esta imagen que se ve un tobogán de un parque de camas elásticas, y otras cosas de diversión se ve este tobogán muy demandado en este parque por el que se desciende en un caucho, lo que da una sensación maravillosa.

body.title: A Small Piece of Nature At The Heart of A Busy City...
body.body:
>Right in the middle of one of the most stressful weeks I’ve had in a while, to the point where I’d actually cried from feeling overwhelmed by responsibilities and the chaos that always comes with the last stretch of the year, a friend came up with what was honestly the best idea of November: *“What if we go for a walk at the Botanical Garden?”* Believe it or not, pretty much everyone I know had already told me I needed to visit that place. They all described it as magical, perfect for disconnecting, breathing, exercising, and clearing your head. And today, well, technically yesterday by the time I’m writing this, I ended up having one of the nicest surprises I’ve experienced in my own city: a forest, clean air, and absolute peace.

\n\n

>Not too long ago, I moved from my hometown, Guacara, to San Diego, the neighboring city in my home state. Even though I already knew the main spots and most interesting places around where I now live, somehow I had completely overlooked the fact that right in the middle of a city full of concrete there’s this enormous park stretching all the way from the main avenue that crosses the city from north to south down to the river itself. And what I’m trying to say is this: in the heart of San Diego there’s not just a huge park, but an actual forest hidden inside the Botanical Garden. A place that honestly feels unreal once you’re standing in it.

\n\n

>For one reason or another, I’d never managed to visit before. And trust me, the pictures I took don’t even come close to showing how massive that place really is. Before going there, I checked Google Maps and realized how ridiculously large it was. It literally begins in the middle of the city and stretches all the way to the foothills of the mountain range that separates where I live now from the city I grew up in. It’s insane when you actually think about it. One second you’re surrounded by traffic and buildings, and the next you’re walking through something that feels untouched.

![IMG_20231108_174535.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23w2eXcN7xeRcy4SJFFJJuApZXeXX3aNSao2NyDYUcvitjRyMAUaziSuz1SwDiR1QL2ZN.jpg) ![IMG_20231108_181152189.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/EpJXcuosQraLQWpPQcuHpMJJDcbBJD7ACxW11tupVerVEemyyHdqW9AZzPfr27FPAFd.jpg) ![IMG_20231108_175459_1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/EoEp5oLPkdBvmoy63Y3nmYhL2efyHv1sAyKDdtBvjMuizfAn4oD81MLrB9ahbDcShLp.jpg) ![IMG_20231108_173759199.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23uFPkirLL9DJ3BHbxeikrhWgRciJSQnPSqtk7utqEE4qPNqB2EFSwzhVkcAYuJ9DJEjs.jpg)

>Every single day of my life tends to follow the exact same structure. My routines are painfully organized and repetitive. I swear sometimes I go sit at a coffee shop and eat an irresponsible amount of desserts while drinking gigantic lattes just to feel like life and its problems aren’t crushing me for five minutes straight. Obviously that habit isn’t exactly healthy, but it is comforting. Still, walking for miles, taking pictures, and exercising outdoors is probably much better for me mentally, just like it is for the people constantly visiting this giant park in the middle of the city. And honestly? I completely fell in love with the place.

\n\n

>At one point I genuinely felt like I was inside Jurassic Park. The trees are absurdly tall and thin, and the leaves are so dense that even during golden hour the sunlight barely manages to filter through. It’s the kind of environment that feels alive in every direction you look. I saw mushrooms growing in the middle of autumn, surrounded by humid forest air. Trees with trunks so huge I couldn’t properly capture them in photos because I’d impulsively decided to go alone. Like I said before, I desperately needed to disconnect, and lately that need has become more and more important in my life.

\n\n

>The flora there is gorgeous. From the dirt trails cutting through the forest to the smell of the place itself, everything feels fresh in the purest sense of the word. And no, I’m not trying to sound poetic for the sake of it. It genuinely feels that way. The fading sunlight of a warm afternoon barely touched the vegetation because everything there grows upward, endlessly stretching toward the sky. And thankfully, the paths built by people to make the area accessible don’t feel invasive or destructive at all. The place is surprisingly clean, organized, and respectful toward nature itself.

![IMG_20231108_175154288.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23wgHvvS1Kk7DbasYmbdLAUk38Tf3Sqoyyh2rgmkU91KgnU82Sng742RGoHcDT43M34ra.jpg) ![IMG_20231108_180841405.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/244Umr4SMSGLkUhh21P699tnbGWJawgucdqabZ8DR1ZH4VkY5fEjN1Zt7d7p5TJqpmydW.jpg) ![IMG_20231108_174949.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/EqQNC2n7EHfqUJmWf9rdovbxLPw8qsqenw71gkPzzhv76N4PZXxYHqnU1HjyFy5NVrZ.jpg) ![IMG_20231108_173741148.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/EpT4gReXgfiQEqzi52QT9PTikwtpqZrnftik2VqKXPS5sfndr53ih16wg212PA3NbVE.jpg) ![IMG_20231108_174322.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23zRy9SXbXMFy1LDbzmo4bbTq1HQ9RWfvB3BPEdx7urgBP99rq9BZcYBV7yCVhjn89sTj.jpg) ![IMG_20231108_175949991.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23x19JQNhZymFr8rveaTXiHucf6rucRFjwERdGfD7KYcfbA4CuVNQMeT3Cv3UQKHqGqcs.jpg) ![IMG_20231108_180357556.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23z7BFyJrTTut2NupAXPQjkWT7P2YebNAW5ZNRS3ZLrh7ZzBMeBXjK5obJXnCR2JRBXvx.jpg)

>It’s the perfect place for outdoor exercise too. People go there for running, hiking, camping, and even full excursions. I swear the Botanical Garden is gigantic. I spent almost two hours there and didn’t even manage to explore fifteen percent of it. Every day that passes, I fall a little more in love with this city. San Diego definitely has flaws like any other place, but when it comes to spaces capable of making you reconnect with life and appreciate where you live, it’s honestly unique. Whoever designed this city somehow managed to perfectly combine the harshness of concrete with the overwhelming green beauty that comes from living inside a mountain valley.

\n\n

>So, is the Botanical Garden in San Diego worth visiting? Absolutely. If you’re anywhere in Carabobo, which is the state where it’s located, you should come. Chances are somebody has already recommended it to you, and if they do again, listen to them. Don’t make the same mistake I did by underestimating the idea of the place. I ended up having one of the calmest, most peaceful afternoons I’ve had in a very long time. It felt like a balm for my anxiety and exhaustion. A small break from monotony. A reminder that sometimes the best way to reconnect with yourself is by getting lost in nature for a while. *That’s exactly why I titled this post the way I did: the beauty of nature inside a city.*

![IMG_20231108_182009512.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/243zRGQbagDvDqmaDEYt2WgHstXQob4R4s94Pg5fvoYo2YDX5nxjmQMZ9jp11NpRrqtnx.jpg) ![IMG_20231108_173358086.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/244Uak87tjedrifExaHc8a1A9TLozEAbe4cyqzh253zYhJrFpJAHuX4wpn7BGRxiS2Lf6.jpg) ***
All photographs and content used in this post are my own. Therefore, they have been used under my permission and are my property.

body.title: The Road to Happiness: a must-see for travelers 🇻🇪Camino a la Felicidad  una parada obligatoria para los viajeros 🇻🇪
body.body: >\nA trip to Falcon State in Venezuela includes a must-see stop at a place called \

where every traveler leaves a memento of this beautiful spot. Although it is just a stretch of highway, it runs alongside Morrocoy National Park and connects two towns that are popular tourist destinations: Tucacas and Chichiriviche. >Viajar a el estado falcon en Venezuela es hacer una parada obligatoria en un lugar llamado el camino de la felicidad donde cada viajero deja un registro de este hermoso lugar aunque es solo un tramo de la carretera este bordea el parque nacional Morrocoy y a si vez conecta dos pueblos con hermosos destinos turísticos como es tucacas y Chichiriviche ![1000597135.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nill2021/EpnDoE7sQttcSt49d95RdmmTpzGgnVQsuEPAA2pQdN846o3aBhdQ2ftHL429GQVcRp6.jpg) ![1000597134.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nill2021/Ep3fJPW5PZRmD53vjfq5N6imTroQPeMxyYB4MTA3bLCGYA6YKMG5SbhaF56QnQ3eZ9C.jpg) What makes this stop so great is its beautiful scenery, which brings a sense of happiness just by looking at it. As you approach your destination—the beaches—you’ll see lush vegetation; at least that was my experience. The first thing you see is a tunnel of giant palm trees, and there’s a beach and lots of mangroves. >Lo que hace está parada genial es sus hermosos paisajes dando esa sensación de felicidad a través de los ojos, aquí puedes encontrar una vegetación que te acercas a tu destino que son las playas o por lo menos ese fue mi caso lo primero que vez es un túnel de palmeras gigantes, hay una playa y muchos manglares. ![1000572239.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nill2021/245cYRUcEe69iQxb1xGJZQC1ADAhkC2vUA77HLHApmpxxbP5Jm5dJhoPjyaaeSAHxrLxw.jpg) ![1000572235.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nill2021/EpVC9ZerU2K8R7Tz1G89HKf9azcbiGB8enVEZJQm2fco7QSoxNVLgVL9CcDu8ieW75y.jpg) ![1000572234.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nill2021/Eq5Ex8JqXweBhyg3PerpsvAJSTEobPSe5WEQYERKZzBmDQ5HB2F7wRLUhVzStArULiS.jpg) Here you can also watch the flamingos fluttering about; during peak season, you’ll find street vendors selling beach goods, breakfast, and more. I usually go for a full day, so I can just take in the scent of salt air and the sea breeze—and, of course, the photo session. >Aquí también puedes observar los flamencos que revolotean en temporadas altas puedes encontrar vendedores ambulantes ofreciendo sus artículos playeros, desayunos etc, yo normalmente voy en full day así que solo puedo sentir el aroma a salitre y la brisa marina obvio la sesión de fotos ![1000573131.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nill2021/EqWmCo9CNKC1UDKVRXEq35X3zHc9pYqNtruuEb1vWNLQbV7WWukgrYrzwa1z6h3vFZ3.jpg) ![1000572503.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nill2021/244UozvhhJL269LvQBF8rNz6ZhHcdHWi7LhnpAxYPfUhnnegwJBkmfrHnRECraEKsAEzZ.jpg) I usually go on full-day trips, so this stop is brief—just for taking photos and enjoying the scenery. But for those traveling by private car without a set itinerary, you can take your time exploring the area or stop for breakfast, as there are concrete tables, a playground, and a volleyball court. >Yo normalmente viajo en full day está parada es corta solo para fotografías y disfrutar del paisaje, pero para los que van en carro particular que no tienen un itinerario pueden disfrutar de todos sus espacios o pararse a desayunar ya que hay mesas de cemento, también parque infantil y cancha de voleibol. ![1000597303.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nill2021/EoyQvFhiYimK7c9gQ9GMxka9ya3hqMKTQAbr6xZodWR5AvSFcAc8mefcvXbfbrVYRK9.jpg) ![1000597299.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nill2021/EprV5txze42JUhujxpCihH67HtyCpQEUsd2fhiGMLYScDPAKUhmzqBotBj6W9zGwHsa.jpg) ![1000597302.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nill2021/Eq371j15jgdhEtpdCD8GyxmYUqqqJ1LXcfrLq6mgG8S4DAX8uBEfmcmPzYiroLHaqsV.jpg) My experiences on the Path to Happiness have always been during the off-season, which is my favorite time to travel, but with such beautiful scenery, I’d like to enjoy it as the sun goes down. However, the Path to Happiness is a place that can be enjoyed at any time of day, >Mi experiencia en el camino a la felicidad siempre ha sido en temporada baja que son los momentos que me gusta para viajar pero con este paisaje tan hermoso me gustaría disfrutarlo cuando cae la tarde, sin embargo el camino de la felicidad es un lugar que se puede disfrutar a cualquier hora del día. ![1000572232.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nill2021/EnYTQ3fLW2k9SjLbZmc1wmRjSRaj5FSU8BGkbNXusC2GAPFJf8MPDuKuBknjvbhg391.jpg) ![1000572233.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nill2021/EqSXrbYsyzaD94AoTaaDikFHXhYuTrKrFe3tPyBGrWzyohKq8uianaYStgtvGwXDzwu.jpg) ![1000597305.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nill2021/23xL11bm7hHuwxjsHzrSvAWSmrMTwnpoEPbMaeazpTYLzG2hpb6zzhtTH2TAwQvshgA6v.gif)

body.title: What worldview or belief do you think has had a negative influence on society? | Contest #288
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWZT5GqxyUCfQjYWXD5br3pymk6Yp79DSuYLSeyXZrPsP/img_6590.jpg)

Fast trains.  
Fast WiFi.  
Fast replies when someone you love calls at 2am and you know, before they even speak, that they need you.

So you jump up, clear your throat, and use that fake-awake voice we all know too well.

“No, I am awake.”

You were not … But love has its own speed. 

And somewhere along the way, speed stopped being a tool and became a measure of worth.

Now people rush everything.

We rush childhood.
Rush healing.
Rush love.
Rush grief.
Rush success.

We rush people into becoming before they have even met themselves properly.

The world rewards quick answers now. Quick opinions. Quick certainty. And if you hesitate too long, it can feel like everyone else has already moved ahead without you.

But I do not think human beings were built to bloom at the speed of algorithms.

Some things need wandering.
Some things need silence.
Some things need time.

**How do you personally resist this belief?**

I think I started resisting it the moment I realised exhaustion was being celebrated like a personality trait.

Somewhere between deadlines, responsibilities, and trying to hold everything together, I noticed how easy it is to become efficient at life without actually experiencing it.

So now I try to return to slower things.

I reread paragraphs.
I take long drives without needing a destination.
I let conversations breathe instead of rushing to fill every silence.

And when life becomes loud, I remind myself that not every season needs to look productive to be meaningful.

Some seasons are simply for becoming.

**How do you protect younger people from this belief?**

I try to remind younger people that there is nothing wrong with taking the scenic route through life.

Not everyone discovers who they are at eighteen.
Twenty five… forty.
Or even fifty.

And that is okay.

I want them to know they are allowed to change their minds. To begin again. To outgrow old dreams. To rest. To be uncertain without feeling left behind.

Because the truth is, some of the most beautiful parts of life arrive slowly … s-l-o-w-l-y.

Like trust.
Like wisdom.
Like becoming someone you genuinely like being alone with.

Fast has its place.

But slow is often where the real story begins.

body.title: Why Live Radio Feels More Refreshing Than Playlists

今天通天下来就一个字——热——啊——热啊热死了。我的头发就没有干过，早上睡起来就黏在头皮上直到现在晚上又该睡觉了根本没干过，而且我的头还爱出油，所以我这个头皮难受的要死(๑-﹏-๑)

昨天是第7天，我把这7天穿的这衣服洗一下，脱下来就全部丢洗衣机里，专门搅了个50分钟，洗完已经10点多了，又因为这两天军训服上床，所以我把床单也顺带丢进洗衣机洗了一下，洗完后回去我铺好床单的时候已经11点半了，着急忙慌熄了灯，唉。一天就过去了。

我之前一直都是手洗上个学期，包括这前半个学期，结果发现实在太费时间了，还太费我的力气，嗯，虽说公共洗衣机确实不干净吧，哪怕它机子会自动清洁，嗯，但是确实是这个环境不允许，那我也最后也就选择妥协，总不能真手洗四年吧，这我可真受不了啊。

昨天我以为我换衣服很快了，跑到洗衣机跟前去发现还有更快的，她们已经把所有的洗衣机都占了，有人还在后面排队，有人都快洗完了，我就只能跟在后面。

幸好我跟了，我靠，因为我发现有人会专门斜着放在你的后面，假装她也在排队，实际上她就会趁你不注意。插队在你前面洗，到时候衣服已经丢进去了，你能奈我何？我后面那个女生是这样的，幸好我是一直跟着我的盆子，否则我就真的洗完就到11点多了。我去咋这样啊这个女生？而且我看她后面还心思不轨，看我把我衣服丢进去之后，她没有继续跟在我后面，而是继续像这样偷偷摸摸的找别的队伍插队，这个人咋这样啊？

今天真的热死了我们宿舍里开了空调，温度真的很凉快，阳台和宿舍隔着扇门，那简直冰火两重天啊。早上起来我的衣服裤子都没怎么干，我觉得和昨晚差不多，洗衣机已经甩的够干了，可是一晚上过去也没怎么变化，我穿身上就很黏，还不得不穿……穿一阵子因为我在活动所以也就也慢慢干了，但是之后活动剧烈了，这层衣服简直就跟狗皮膏药一样，一直糊在身上糊了一天到这会了，黏唧唧的难受的要死。

学校已经够人性化的了，给我们的下午的军训时间调到了4点。但是真的很热——即使到了4点。我整个人不动弹，就只是坐在板凳上，那汗也止不住的淌，我俯下身来玩手机，手机屏幕上全是我从头上掉下来的汗水。那汗珠密密麻麻的就跟洗完澡一样。唉，真的难受啊，这一天真的很煎熬，很煎熬，现在只求回去后洗个澡。舒舒服服的躺床上就够了。

前两天下午没吃饭，买了个酸奶当晚饭，突然吃上瘾了魔怔了，赶紧去上网上买了一大堆酸奶盘算着又是当早餐又是当晚餐。今天到了，这才发现我们宿舍没有冰箱，而且今天还这么高的温度，酸奶会放坏的。收货了我才看到它的存储条件是2~10度，我才恍然惊觉，但是已经迟了，整整24罐酸奶，我要想不喝坏肚子的话，必须在这一两天内解决掉。再三考虑之后，我决定分给我的每个室友一人一罐，然后今天下午我已经喝了5罐酸奶了，明天和后天早上应该就能全部喝完了，赶紧喝完解决掉吧，哎呀，真的是考虑不周贪了小便宜了😖

昨天忘了向大家展示学校给我们的慰问礼物了，一罐蜜雪冰城，一个面包，一根香蕉，还有一瓶专门印着SICE❤️U的可乐——SICE是我们的学院😊吃美了

</liketuimages>

有那么一句俗话好像叫做。世事无常，大肠包小肠。好像有这么一束花。
还有一句叫做不作死就不会死。我昨天还在说这事呢。就是我那些同事。
一直都是在作死的边缘里面来回。上班的时候一直在摸鱼，玩手机。

我也看开了，虽然只是过来帮他们这一组小组干活。也就没想那么多了。
还是安安静静的做事。所以把该做的活做完之后剩下的问题标志在图纸上面。
方便以后如果有事情可以在这里面找找。这应该是最有节操的做事方式吧。

然而，那些同事还一直不以为意的，还是像之前那样。上班直接玩手机了。
知道我下午在用拉尺量尺寸的时候。把一些材料给标注出来。
良后用本子给记起来。做好之后肯定是要有个交代的。等我忙完事之后才看到老板原来站在我后面。

也不知道他站了多久了。还有一个更好笑的。跟我一起的小弟后面才告诉我。
我过去他们小组在帮忙这两个人在玩手机。被老板逮了个正着。
跟着我笑到抽风的是他们两个竟然在开黑。可以说是直接抓活的。

如果不出意外的话，可能这个月发工资之后。这两个人就会打包走人了。
即使是留下来，估计也是会被人重点照顾。肯定是被人给看的死死的。
后来才听同事们说这两个人一直都是这样的，难怪他们做事做不动，还要叫我过去帮忙。

body.title: Hivechess lecture: Improve your worse piece
body.body:
![17786037672387426325124225367603.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/AK56Ya5bU9ebUivWjV2zhTFA7JDheP5hKkffjCPj17Vu8aByMPvJUmCxPJ7xQLM.jpg)
Welcome to a new Hivechess lecture and we will be looking at a new lesson that talks about improving your worse piece. Our game study will be coming from the Round 4 of the Czech Chess Championship, between Grandmaster David Navara, a well known chess grandmaster with an understanding of what it takes to play on the elite level of chess, against a fellow Czech Chess grandmaster of 2495 rating, Krejci Jan. **1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bb5 a6 4. Ba4 Nf6** ![Screenshot_20260512-174314.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/23tvwCkvy3Cyxr8tNkUvHc8W1akHWdjxy6qWxvWLmmgHBbCwugL4dqfPcukUU5gZwsEou.jpg) The game was a product of the Ruy Lopez: Closed, Breyer Defense, Zaitsev Hybrid, which has an attribute of no capture on the f6 square. This usually leads to a closed position style of play in the game, which I anticipate will happen in this game between Navara and Jan. **5. O-O Be7 6. Re1 b5 7. Bb3 d6 8. c3 O-O 9. h3 Nb8 10. d4 Nbd7 11. Nbd2 Bb7 12. Bc2 Re8 13. Nf1 Bf8 14. Ng3 g6** ![Screenshot_20260512-175207.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/23tvwjEhekyYUxYFS1mFddg9hsYMskWRQoKnK3eBpWGhvFEKgUJTNjrXxcFApgkbNzhcZ.jpg) From the choice of the opening, you can tell that it is going to be a product of positioning where both sides will be looking for opportunities through the maneuvers of their pieces. You can see it is already taking place through the movement of white knight. The white knight has moved from b1 to d2, down to f1 and now g3. While black is doing the same thing with his king side by bring his pieces to that angle as well. Also, you can see that through the bishop going to f8 and then trying to go on to g7 since the pawn has moved to g6. **14. Ng3 g6 15. b3 Bg7 16. d5 Nb6 17. Rb1 c6 18. c4 Qc7 19. Bd3 Nfd7 20. Be3 Nc5** ![Screenshot_20260512-180602.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/23u6MwfFAsDUU48kcfBjkvhN1FsqExmk2uvA3WxXkDKWqMpKwSUByYRC639RAT3MSFG3N.jpg) Things got interesting when the kingside was locked and now the game play shifted towards the queenside, now looking for breaks. ![Screenshot_20260512-181440.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/23tcC6MXxUvij64jaBdom4JjSAnNcg4kv1SLUT5LWchGK6txmCexS3MyJyZKjZz7orHZq.jpg) **21. In the launch of the king side attack through the movement of the queen towards the black king's position, which is why Qh4 is on board, inorder to attack the king. body.title: OpenClaw-, LLM Wiki- und Meilisearch-Erfahrungsbericht
body.body:
Hallo zusammen,

 

Im Februar habe ich meinen ersten Openclaw-Agenten installiert. Hier sind meine alten Erfahrungsberichte:

[1. Installation von OpenClaw und erste Erfahrungen](https://peakd.com/hive-121566/@achimmertens/openclaw-bot-installation-und-erste-erfahrungen)

[2. Openclaw lernt Mailing](https://peakd.com/hive-121566/@achimmertens/openclaw-mailverkehr-und-weitere-agenten-erstellen)

[3. Openclaw speichert Code in Github](https://peakd.com/hive-121566/@achimmertens/wie-man-das-openclaw-und-ein-eigenes-git-repository-kombiniert)

[4. Openclaw lernt hören und sprechen](https://peakd.com/hive-121566/@achimmertens/speechtotext-mit-openclaw-und-whisper)

 
Seitdem ist Einiges passiert.
Hier möchte ich meine weiteren Erfahrungen und vor allem die Erstellung meines eigenen Wikis mit meinen persönlichen Tagebuch-Daten, sowie das schnelle Finden der Daten beschreiben:

 

# LLM-Wiki

 

Andrej Kaparthy kam auf den großartigen Einfall, mit einem KI Agenten (wie Openclaw) ein eigenes Wiki zu bauen. Dies war die erste Gamechanger-Idee. Die zweite ist, dies in Git nicht als Code, sondern  als Ideenvorschlagsprompt zu hinterlegen. Es steht dort nicht etwa genau beschrieben, was zu tun ist, sondern ein Set von Prompts, mit denen man im gemeinsamen Dialog mit dem Bot, eine individuelle Wiki-Seite erstellt.

 

[Link zum Githup-Projekt von Karpathy](https://gist.github.com/karpathy/442a6bf555914893e9891c11519de94f)


![grafik.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/achimmertens/Ep7xxFNWUSrLB3Q4Qz99nxJkW7zzKFaXPTHLzJXXjnzy2bbvdgsPkFh8cSekFiHsAfJ.png)


*(Dieses Bild wurde auch im Dialog mit meinem Bot, basierend auf dem gemeinsam erstellten LLM-Wiki-Schema-MD-Dokument, erstellt)*

 

## Was ist ein LLM-Wiki?

LLM steht für Large Language Modell, also für künstliche Intelligenz. Das Wiki steht für eine Wikipedia-ähnliche Webseitenstruktur, die Dokumente beinhaltet, die die KI und ich gemeinsam erstellen, bzw. erstellt haben.

Dieses Wiki wird also mit Hilfe von KI gefüttert. Es läuft als Webserver bei mir lokal auf meinem Raspberry Pi, man könnte es aber auch auf einem Cloud Server installieren - muss dann aber sehr darauf achten, dass die Daten sicher sind. Mein Wiki steht nicht im Internet. Ich kann aber indirekt über meinen Bot in Telegram Inhalte abfragen. Das erlaubt mir persönliche, geheime Daten überall dabei zu haben, ohne mir einen großen Kopf um die Sicherheit machen zu müssen.

Ich nutze es derzeit um meine Tagebuchsammlung mir zur Verfügung zu stellen. Ich mache jetzt täglich Tagebucheinträge (ebenfalls mit Openclaw - Ich spreche sie einfach in meinen Telegram-Kanal). Dort hinterlege ich auch Informationen zu meiner Gesundheit und meinen Gemütszustand, da ich den Ursachen meiner manchmal auftretenden Erschöpfungssymptomen näher kommen möchte. Ich schreibe aber auch über die schönen Dinge des Lebens und ja, ich schicke auch schon mal Fotos dazu, die Openclaw dann nach Backblaze (Achtung, öffentlich) hochlädt und mir dann die URLs der Bilder zurück gibt. Meine Tagebucheinträge sind in Markdown geschrieben. Eine für die Öffentlichkeit von Openclaw erstellte und mir überarbeitete Wochenzusammenfassung poste ich dann nach Hive: https://peakd.com/@achimmertens/posts

 

In der Startseite meines Wikis habe ich außerdem noch eine Überwachung meiner gehosteten Webseiten und eine Suchleiste zu Begriffen innerhalb meiner Wiki-Dokumente (Details dazu siehe unten in Meilisearch)


![grafik.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/achimmertens/23tmjfMWMTvA4u3rCNAtHJKqYJ9RFrKPXV4Wypfr8YqdB4niGRhW1LWV7arUwjbTrFJSf.png)
*Diese Webseite hat Openclaw mit mir zusammen erschaffen*

 

 

 

## Erstellung eines LLM Wikis

 

Also, was habe ich getan, um mein LLM-Wiki zu erstellen? Ich habe die Ideen-Seite von Karpathy als Text kopiert und in den Chat-Kanal meines Openclaw-Bots eingefügt. Daraufhin begann ein Dialog, im Laufe dessen wir gemeinsam ausgearbeitet haben, was ich eigentlich will. Daraufhin wurde auf meinem Raspi ein Nginx Webserver installiert mit einer Wiki-Startseite. Es wurde definiert, welche Entitäten (Wiki Einträge) als Mardown Dokumente erstellt werden sollten. Es wurden bestehende MD-Dateien und html-Seiten eingefügt.

Das Ergebnis nach einigem Hin- und Her ist eine schöne Wiki-Startseite, die alle Entitäten als Link auflistet.

 

### Auftretende Probleme

Der Spaß hat letztendlich doch einige Stunden und auch Euros (Größenordnung 10 €) an LLM Tokenkosten verbraucht. Einige dieser Tools und Hilf-Tools (Python Scripte) wurden sehr schnell und erstaunlich gut von der KI geschrieben. Der Großteil der Zeit (>90%) ging aber in die Fehlersuche, bei manchmal Kleinigkeiten. Openclaw gerät immer wieder in eine Schleife, die letztendlich eine Sackgasse ist oder sich im Kreis dreht. Dies gilt es schnell zu finden. Zum Glück ist in einer neueren Version von Openclaw der Agent durch das sogenannte \

gesprächiger und man kann erkennen, woran der Agent gerade arbeitet.

Wenn er sich festgebacken hat, sollte man ein /reset eingeben. Das löscht den Tokencash und damit den Knoten im Kopf.

 

Ein weiteres Problem ist, dass Openclaw mehrere Versuche unternimmt um sein Ziel zu erreichen und nicht immer die Altlasten aufräumt. Auch bleiben nach einem Reset oft Code- oder Dateileichen liegen.

Es entstehen Parallelstränge und doppelte Datenhaltung. Wenn ich dann eine Datei nicht im Wiki finde, Openclaw behauptet aber Stein und Bein, dass der Eintrag da und korrekt sei, ist es erforderlich unter die Haube zu schauen um dann zu erkennen, wo wir aneinander vorbei reden.

Es ist oft ein Tanz, der vier Schritte vor und drei zurück geht.

 

Aber mit Geduld und sich gegenseitiges Kennenlernen, werden Ziele erreicht. Es ist sinnvoll nach jedem kleinen Meilenstein Openclaw zu sagen: \

Ich habe mir jetzt auch durch Openclaw ein Backup-Script erstellen lassen.

 

# Meilisearch

Ein Wiki ist ja schön und gut, wird aber schnell unübersichtlich, wenn man viele Dokumente hat. Daher ist ein Suchindex eine tolle Idee.

Ich habe als Prompt Openclaw darum gebeten die Wiki Dokumente zu indizieren und eine Suchleiste in die Startseite einzubauen.

Openclaw hat ca. 5 Minuten (und weniger als 10 Cent) gebraucht um den Suchindex zu erstellen.

Es hat im Internet nach gängigen Tools gesucht und letztendlich Meilisearch, das ich bis dahin gar nicht kannte, installiert. Dieses Tool läuft als eigener API Server mit Port 7700 und hat eine Textdatei als \

, in der der Index aller Wörter der gescannten Dokumente drin steht.

Ich kann also mit einem Curl-Befehl nach einem Wort suchen und erhalte eine Liste der Dokumente zurück, die dieses Wort beinhalten.

 

Beispiel einer Meilisearch Curl Abfrage:
> curl -X POST \

}'

![grafik.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/achimmertens/23swq3dcNLWPDcZKkCKwujkAb9qMYXqM4cPPquZ9Uu4wEredS7ixZskRmTveFaPQaMWGk.png)

Und so sieht es dann in meinem Wiki aus:

![grafik.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/achimmertens/23u6Ygv8c2ESw75sjQv2tnqghKNVbKzRbkmS9mTp6PxRadZgqv4xtkNVT9BJujoeMkFX7.png)


# Fazit

Ich habe nun eine Datenbank mit meinen persönlichen Daten, auf die ich sicher und jederzeit  zugreifen kann. Ich erhalte die Inhalte in Telegram und kann sie auf Wunsch auch als Mail weiterleiten.

 

Openclaw ist weiterhin ein spannendes Projekt, indem der Bot und ich uns gegenseitig immer besser kennen lernen. Openclaw wächst mit seinen Aufgaben und wird tatsächlich immer häufiger ein echter Helfer. (Letztens hat er mir ein Dokument zugeschickt, das ich brauchte, aber nicht dabei hatte)

Die Kosten halten sich in Grenzen. Ich habe in den letzten 4 Monaten 60 € an Tokenkosten bei Openrouter.ai ausgegeben. Das Meiste davon für Programmierung. Eine einfache Abfrage kostet wenige Cents (oder darunter). Die Kosten hängen stark vom Model ab; beste Erfahrungen habe ich mit Deep Seek 4 gemacht. Wichtig ist zu erkennen, wann der Agent festhängt (und wann er seinen Job macht). Es bedarf immer noch einer kurzen Leine.

 

Als nächstes möchte ich meine Datenbasis erweitern. Ich habe Fitness-Daten, die ich ebenfalls in mein Wiki aufnehmen möchte. Ich versuche auch meine Playlists und Geo-Daten zu integrieren (was nicht einfach ist, da Google und Spotify eher geizig meine mir gehörenden Daten rausrücken).

 

Es bleibt also spannend, so, stay tuned,

 

Achim Mertens
