body.title: Dash, 12 Maggio 2026 — Aggiornamenti sugli sviluppi della Dash Core Group (DCG)
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUTWxpnjeEyDLfbfKwpEKhzq23QYtXyMpaZmRpKYBNjPu/12%20Maggio%202026%20-%20RIASSUNTO%20IN%20ITA%20CON%20AI.jpg 

*✍️ Riassunto in 🇮🇹 della seguente Live realizzata da Dash Italia By AI NotebookLM Tool 🤖*

https://www.youtube.com/live/QagFtL5liWY?si=9dufJ7FgxlguRiQ7

**Dash Evolution 4.0: Privacy, Query Avanzate e la Nuova Era del Mobile**

L’ultimo aggiornamento del Dash Core Group ha segnato un momento storico per il progetto: il salto di versione alla 4.0. Quella che inizialmente era stata pianificata come la versione 3.1 è stata ufficialmente rinominata Dash Platform 4.0 a causa della vastità e dell’importanza delle nuove funzionalità introdotte, paragonabili per impatto al rilascio dei token o alla stessa architettura Evolution.

**La Rivoluzione delle “Count Trees” e delle Query Verificabili**

Una delle innovazioni tecniche più rilevanti presentate da Sam riguarda l’implementazione delle “Count Trees” (alberi di conteggio) all’interno di GroveDB. Si tratta di una funzionalità che, secondo gli sviluppatori, non ha precedenti nei sistemi decentralizzati esistenti. In termini semplici, questo sistema permette di interrogare la blockchain per ottenere conteggi specifici — ad esempio “quanti utenti hanno più di 45 anni” o “quante auto rosse sono registrate nel sistema” — ricevendo un’unica prova crittografica.

A differenza dei sistemi tradizionali dove bisognerebbe scaricare tutti i dati per contarli, le Count Trees aggregano le informazioni al momento dell’inserimento. Questo garantisce che la complessità della query rimanga estremamente bassa (logaritmica), rendendo il sistema incredibilmente efficiente anche su larga scala. Queste funzioni sono fondamentali per applicazioni come Yapper, il social network decentralizzato, che necessita di mostrare statistiche e conteggi in tempo reale senza compromettere la decentralizzazione.

**Privacy e Shielded Balances su iOS**

Sul fronte della privacy, sono stati fatti passi da gigante nell'integrazione dei saldi protetti (shielded balances) sui dispositivi mobili. Sam ha confermato di aver eseguito con successo i primi trasferimenti protetti sull’SDK Swift per iOS. Sebbene la logica tecnica sia già funzionante, il team sta ora lavorando sulla parte visiva per rendere l’esperienza utente il più semplice possibile.

I nuovi design mostrano un processo di “trasferimento interno” dove l’utente può spostare fondi dal proprio portafoglio Dash principale al “pool protetto” (shielded pool). Questo passaggio è fondamentale per garantire la privacy prima di operazioni sensibili, come la creazione di un nome utente Dash Pay, evitando di collegare pubblicamente i propri fondi alla propria identità digitale.

**Evoluzione Mobile e Integrazione Maya Protocol**

Brian ha fornito aggiornamenti cruciali per le applicazioni Android e iOS. La novità più attesa è l’integrazione di Maya Protocol per gli scambi decentralizzati direttamente nel wallet. Dopo aver risolto alcuni problemi legati al calcolo dei tassi di cambio, il team prevede di rilasciare una beta pubblica per Android entro una settimana.

Parallelamente, è stata introdotta una nuova funzionalità per l’acquisto di gift card tramite Piggy Cards. Gli utenti potranno ora acquistare più carte contemporaneamente in un’unica transazione. Questa modifica, oltre a migliorare l’esperienza d’uso, risponde a esigenze normative e di gestione del rischio, evitando che acquisti multipli e frammentati vengano segnalati erroneamente come attività sospette.

**Verso un Sito Web Totalmente Decentralizzato**

Il progetto di migrazione del sito ufficiale verso un’infrastruttura decentralizzata procede spedito. Il team sta lavorando per abbandonare definitivamente WordPress in favore di uno strumento proprietario che gestisce i contenuti tramite la Dash Platform e li archivia su reti distribuite come Lighthouse. Attualmente, il nuovo sito è in fase di test su una rete parallela e il team sta verificando la corretta visualizzazione dei contenuti tradotti prima del passaggio definitivo in produzione sulla Mainnet, previsto entro il prossimo mese.

**Sviluppo Core e Infrastruttura**

Sul lato Dash Core, prosegue il lavoro di “backporting” delle ultime versioni di Bitcoin (V25) e il miglioramento della pulizia del codice. È stato introdotto il supporto per gli indirizzi Bech32 di tipo Platform, necessario per creare “Asset Locks” che inviano fondi direttamente alle identità sulla piattaforma. Inoltre, lo strumento Dash Evo Tool (Wash) sta subendo una fase di manutenzione per prepararsi all’integrazione completa dei nuovi moduli del portafoglio platform.

**Conclusioni**

L’aggiornamento ha mostrato un ecosistema che non sta solo rifinendo il codice esistente, ma sta inventando nuove strutture dati per rendere il Web3 scalabile e verificabile. Con l’arrivo della versione 4.0, la privacy integrata nel mobile e gli scambi decentralizzati a portata di mano, Dash si prepara a offrire un’esperienza utente che unisce la semplicità delle app moderne alla sovranità assoluta della blockchain.

body.title: Shattered SelfImage: Abundance Year Episode 1965 (audio: noxsoma.substack.com)
body.body:
Full Metal Ox Day 1900
Wednesday 13, May 2026
Abundance Year Episode 1965
Noxsoma Life Camp:  

Shattered Self Image
Salvation 
Cosmic Fibonacci
Advancing the herd. Investing your soul, in tech that steals your soul.    

![1965.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmd3JZZGBJVcLNQ2eYy9UyYbK8Qa59gMBnwj25yBRf3hKR/1965.png)

Today's Episode:    https://odysee.com/@Noxsoma:2/1900_full_5-13-26_1965_selfimage:a?r=47k2ScJsm9Uex9eETqgCCA8q1fukdST9  
Channels: go to noxsoma.substack.com and subscribe. 

 THE LAST CALM

 How Astrology, Apocalypses, Magical Math & Survivor Skills. 

The science of the Universe is not “real” because real would be too complicated.  

You think you know what time it is.

You glance at your wrist. 5:22 PM. Happy hour. That’s fine. That’s useful. That won’t save your life. Unless you’re dying for a cocktail special.

There’s another clock. The big one. The one carved into every stone circle, painted in every cave, and whispered in every flood myth from Mesopotamia to the Mississippi. It doesn’t tick in seconds. It ticks in ages. Each age is exactly 2,160 years. Each age reduces to the number 9. Everything reduces to 9. And that’s what makes it fake. Everything reducing to a single base number? C’mon man! 

You were born in the Age of Pisces. The fish. The age of faith, of redemption, of two roads that never meet. Let’s say it started around the year 1 CE, give or take a murdered carpenter. The latest Sun Deity. Then it ends in 2160 CE. No one really knows. So let’s pretend. 

That gives us about 135 years of the ichthys. That’s Greek for fish. That the word you see in the Jesus Fish metals on the trunks of cars. 

Relax. That’s the good news. 

The bad news is that you don’t know what an “age” actually is. You think it’s a vibe. A personality quiz. “Oh, I’m such a Pisces, I’m so creative.” 

Nope. That was fine for newspapers back in the day, or a barstool ice breaker. But here’s the etymology, if you will.   

An astrological age is a postcataclysm survival manual. And so is the zodiac. But we’ve forgotten how to read it.  Most of us anyway. 



 Festivals should be called,  “Feastivals.” 

Let’s start with the word you actually need: Feastival.

Not festival. Feastival. Because every single holiday on the calendar is about one thing: food at the right time. 

 Easter isn’t about bunnies. It’s about the first fresh meat after a winter of starvation. The lamb. The egg. The spring equinox, when you stop huddling and start planting. 
 Thanksgiving isn’t about pilgrims. It’s about the autumnal equinox, when you slaughter the surplus because you can’t feed them until spring. 
 Christmas isn’t about a savior. It’s about the winter solstice, the darkest day, when you kill the fatted calf and have one last orgy before the famine. 

The stars told you when. Sirius rising over the Nile? Plant. Orion standing vertical? Harvest. The Pleiades setting at dusk? Run. 

That’s astrology. Not psychology. Logistics.

We’ve degraded it into a parlor game because we’ve never actually been hungry. A mudslide in Spain is a “climate catastrophe” to us. A pillar of fire to a Younger Dryas survivor was Tuesday.



The 100 Generations of Hell

Speaking of the Younger Dryas.

That was a 1,200 year period of constant calamity. It started with a comet impact (or something very mean) and ended with temperatures rising 10°C in a few decades. In between? Mud. Flood. Ash. Fire in the sky. Over and over.

That’s not an event. That’s 100 generations of fighting for the survival of the species. No wonder humans are so psychotic. 

Think about that. Your greatgreatgreatgreat (add 95 more) grandmother was born under an ash-choked sky. She died under an ash-choked sky. Her grandchildren’s grandchildren never saw a clear horizon. 

To those people, calamity wasn’t a “crisis.” It was eternity. They built stone calendars not because they were curious about the cosmos, but because the sky was the only thing that didn’t lie. The river lied. The game lied. The ground lied (especially when it shook). 

But the stars? The stars marched in perfect, indifferent time. 

So they carved the rules into stone. When the sun enters Pisces, the rains come. Feastival. When the sun enters Virgo, the grain is dry. Feastival. When the sun enters Capricorn, the days stop shrinking. You made it. Feastival. 

These weren’t “holidays.” They were launch checklists for survival. Maybe those days were more “whole” than “holy.” 

And then the climate calmed down. The Holocene arrived. And we forgot why we wrote anything down in the first place. Those stone calendars became locations for ritual sacrifice. What a difference an age makes. 



When the Language Dies.  

“Who needs a book when you have a PDF?”

Answer: The person who survives the collapse. 

A PDF requires a charged battery and a working screen. A book requires a literate reader. But a book written in a language no one speaks? That’s not a book anymore. That’s a brick. Or an amulet. Or a holy text. Eli had such a book. (The Book of Eli.) 

This is the lifecycle of every technology. 

1.  Utility: You carve a calendar because you will die if you plant too late. 
2.  Convenience: You print the calendar because paper is easier. 
3.  Obsolescence: You put the calendar on your phone because you’re not a peasant. 
4.  Collapse: The power grid fails. The phone is a pretty black mirror. 
5.  Mystification: Your grandchildren find the carved stone. They can’t read the symbols. But they look important. Magical, even. Someone claims to understand them. That someone now has power. 

Congratulations. You’ve just invented religion. 

That’s not cynicism. That’s archeology. The Egyptian hieroglyphs were inventory lists (“300 jars of oil, 50 chariots”) until no one could read them. Then they became sacred magic. The Greek Linear B was accounting until it became a mystical puzzle. The Hebrew Bible was tribal boundary law until it became the unerring word of God. Tens of thousands of Sumerian cuneiform clay tabled of shopping lists, receipts and honeydew lists. (Honey, do this. Honey, do that.)  

When the original purpose fades, we project meaning into the void.  

We’re doing it right now with astrology. We think it’s about “personalities” because we’ve never had to ask the stars when to plant or die. 



 The Math of 9.  

Here’s something we noticed. Something the astrologers don’t like to admit.  

All the numbers of precession reduce to 9.

 The Great Year: 25,920 years. 2+5+9+2+0 = 18. 1+8 = 9.
 One age: 2,160 years. 2+1+6+0 = 9.
 Degrees in a circle: 360. 3+6+0 = 9.
 Precession rate: 72 years per degree. 7+2 = 9.

Only the 30 degrees of each zodiac sign breaks the pattern. (30 reduces to 3, which is just 9 waiting to happen.)  

Here’s the secret they don’t tell you: They fit the stars to the math, not the math to the stars. 

The actual precession of the equinoxes is 25,772 years. A messy, irregular number. But you can’t build a religion on 25,772. You can’t build a calendar. You can’t teach it to survivors standing around a fire, shivering, watching the sky for any sign that the world isn’t over. 

So they rounded it. They made it perfect. They made it sacred. 

The universe isn’t perfect. The universe is a chaotic, wet, indifferent machine. But we are patternmakers. We see 9 in everything because we put it there. 

That’s not a flaw. That’s the only reason we’re still here. 



 The Calm. 

Here’s the part nobody wants to hear.

We are living in the most stable climate in 100,000 years. The Holocene. 11,700 years of mild temperatures, predictable seasons, and sea levels that mostly stayed put.

It’s an anomaly. A geological fluke. But maybe, it has to do with a population of humans on the planet. Maybe we should call this, “human caused global stability.” 

The Younger Dryas survivors couldn’t imagine calm. They assumed fire and flood were eternal. We assume calm is eternal. We’re both wrong.

The difference is that they built monuments to remember how to survive. We built spreadsheets to forget.

 A mudslide in Italy is global news.
 A flood in Spain is a catastrophe.
 A heat wave in Canada is unprecedented.

To a Younger Dryas human, these would be quiet afternoons.

They saw pillars of fire (volcanoes). They saw skies that stayed dark for years (comet dust). They saw deluge after deluge (meltwater pulses). And they looked up at the stars—the only reliable thing left—and they carved the rules into stone.

We look up and check the weather app.



 Happy Hour Bar Talk. 

So here you are. Sitting at a bar. Someone says, “I’m so a Pisces.”

Me, being a smart-ass having recently co-composed this article for my Substack, “Actually, the Age of Pisces ends in 2160. It’s a 2,160 year postal code for survival. The fish meant flood. The fish meant faith. The fish meant two paths: plant or die. Every festival on your calendar is a feastival, and every feastival is a memory of a famine.”

They will stare at you.

Then order another round. (If they don’t throw it in your face, it’s a good sign.) 

Because that’s what we do now. We drink to forget that we ever knew how to read the sky. We outsource our memory to PDFs, and chat-bots, and we assume the power will never go out. 

But the stones are still there. Göbekli Tepe. Stonehenge. The pyramids. Every flood myth. Every harvest holiday. Every time you eat a hot cross bun on Good Friday or turkey on the fourth Thursday of November. 

You are executing ancient code. Survival firmware. Written in a language you no longer speak. 

The sky is not a personality quiz. 

The sky is the oldest clock we have. And it’s still ticking. 

135 years left on the current age. 

That’s not a threat. 

That’s an invitation to remember.  

For the survivor who keeps a stone in their pocket and a PDF on their phone. One of them will outlast the other. You know which.

body.body:
Das sind auch so 100 Euro im Monat, die ich schriftlich schwarz auf weis seit vielen Jahren haben koennte jeden Monat mehr, wenn ich diesen Antrag je gestellt haette und ich war schon oefter soweit, das zu machen.

Jetzt muss ich das machen, ich komme garnicht drum herum. Erfahrungswerte zeigen mir das es mir unmoeglich normal zu stemmen waehre wie es bisher gelaufen ist fuer mich alleine.

Das ist aber das Ziel, das ich net irgendwo in einer Einrichtung vergammele, sondern einfach wieder auf die Beine komme und dort dann mein Zeug brav weitermache.

Davor graut es mich jetzt schon, ich habe ja alles durchgerechnet auf den Euro genau wenn man so will.^^

Mit allem was man von mir kennt!!!

Auch das Computerzeug.^^

Ja, das alles durchgerechnet und da fehlt viel zu viel an vielen Ecken, deswegen, stelle ich endlich mal den MEB Antrag und bekomme das bestimmt auch gleich ohne Probleme haben es ja auch alle unabhaengig voneinander immer gleich gesehen an Aertzen. 

Der ist zu Duenn der Bou, mit dem Essen kommt er nicht hinterher, das ist ja schon ein Problem, zu Essen, also das zu tun, im Zweifel.

Frueher waren das uebrigens mehr an Unterstuezung die man bekommen haette weis ich durch die ersen Ueberlegungen dazu.

Falscher Stolz, wenn ich mich so umgugge. 

Das ich mit der Arbeit in Zukunft was dazu verdienen will auf ehrenamtlicher Basis in genau Definiert korrektem legalem Bereich, habe ich ja auch schon angekuendigt, ist quasi mit dabei, bei der ganzen Ueberlegung als Grundlage, nicht mehr als Option.

Das kann keine Option mehr bleiben was ich da treibe und ich moechte mir keine Sorgen machen muessen, das es an ein paar Euro scheitert oder an der falschen Stelle zu sparen gilt. :-)

Salve

Sascha Pürner

body.title: Viviendo terribles experiencias / Letras inspiradoras: Lo mejor de dos mundos [ENG/ESP]
body.body:
>

I hope you're all doing well. I was reading the [Best of Both Worlds](https://peakd.com/hive-139925/@syllem/letras-inspiradoras-lo-mejor-de) initiative proposed by @syllem, who I must say always has the initiative to help me vent in the moment, because I recently went through a heartbreaking experience at my job and I really wanted to let out everything I've been going through. Okay, so, since I graduated and long before, it's been hard for me to find a job, whether it's because of my age (I'm 25) or my degree and many other things. Eventually, my cousin offered me a job working for her; that is, she would be the one hiring and I would do the work, since it's remote. For me, it was a blessing and I will always be grateful to her.

---

<div class=\

>However, in recent months I've been bothered by the payment issue. At one point, he paid me $22 less, supposedly because of Zelle and the conversion to Binance. Okay, I accepted it, although the fact that he told me it would be more noticeable when converting to bolivars and all that, which is a lie, because the salary amount remains the same and with prices going up, well, I really don't see any benefit. Anyway, I let it go. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-05-13_075937_www.magnific.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/EoiVGZD4c1H3kYV7EaKEVDYTraXVwjXV5WRhVwpUPXReZmQUjz9PvKg71VLLb764eGK.png) [Source](https://www.magnific.com/es/foto-gratis/mujeres-asiaticas-adultas-jovenes-inteligentes-usan-ropa-informal-trabajando-tarde-noche-reunion-teleconferencia-casa-linea-socios-comerciales-concepto-cuarentena-aislamiento-hogar_25118027.htm#fromView=search&page=1&position=2&uuid=a5b1fc31-1a92-4143-b39f-d4fc391862ad&query=ambientes+laborales+online) ---

>However, towards the end of March, the head of design, who had her own team, resigned. She told me there might be a raise if I took on more of her responsibilities and that there would be some weekends available. I agreed, but asked if they could let me know in advance if it would be the following weekend, because I take advantage of those days to run other errands, and I thought it was a valid suggestion. Besides, I also depend on her schedule, since she loves going out on weekends—not every weekend, but most of them. She never mentioned it to me again, and April was really tough. Plus, with the electricity issues, I felt like I was doing a lot. Even so, I still had faith that I would get paid a little more. ---

>Anyway, the end of the month arrives and I get paid the same amount, so I ask if that's all there is to it. She replies that yes, I should know it was just a stipend, and so on. I respond that fine, but for this month I'll only do the work I've always done, not what the other designer does, because it's much more work and there's no monetary reward. If you only knew what she answered! She said it's good that the other designer will have to do that part, that she can't abandon the project, that she can't be so arrogant, and so on and so forth—a whole host of things that make me the one who should be offended. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-05-13_080021_www.magnific.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23xevn44YVF17xUTvqwXoFouaqUMQRHSP48Vh6NMvkcuSajD1xcbT8pXdvgkuWxe5gUHE.png) [Source](https://www.magnific.com/es/foto-gratis/mujer-cuarentena-tiro-medio-trabajando-casa_26394076.htm#fromView=search&page=1&position=1&uuid=d0196936-7dbf-4291-994f-5174ddd1b97b&query=estres+laboral) ---

>She brings up a lot of things in general. For example, I often tell her how annoying it is when they keep changing a part of the design after it's already been approved, reviewed thousands of times, and approved by the head boss. Even worse, it's frustrating when I've already finished it in all three languages, because yes, I have to do it in English, Spanish, and French. She tells me that's just how it is at work, that clients change all the time. I reply that I'm just commenting, that I've already made the changes. They were short, inoffensive responses, unlike what she was doing to me. ---

>And the worst part is, I asked her about five times if that was the design they wanted to modify, because the text change they wanted to make seemed too long, and in my opinion, it was from a different design that was easier. After I'd already made changes to that other design, I had to do three times the work, all over again, because she didn't read properly. The saddest thing is that, since I have her Telegram open for some work I have to do there, I accidentally opened her boss's chat. It was my mistake, since I only check what I'm supposed to and that's it, but I saw that she was paid much more, and, to be honest, she only gave me about a quarter of that payment. That's when I realized she's always been overpaid and gives me much less. Okay, I understand you keep some of it because you're the intermediary, but at least if I have more work, pay me a little more, not the same amount. ---
![sad-female-workaholic-keeps-hands-chin-busy-making-project-work-studies-papers-wears-elegant-white-shirt-sits-desktop-unknown-people-stretch-hands-with-notes-alarm-clock-smartphone.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23uFm6uMLYnSudygHFmgBF3sqdNf985PAhfMFTYjFNNLwgyvr742GK8YKH368H4QxLaPA.jpg) [Source](https://www.magnific.com/es/foto-gratis/triste-adicta-al-trabajo-mantiene-manos-debajo-barbilla-ocupada-haciendo-trabajo-proyecto-estudia-papeles-viste-elegante-camisa-blanca-sienta-escritorio-personas-desconocidas-estiran-manos-notas-reloj-despertador-telefono-inteligente_11576101.htm#fromView=search&page=1&position=46&uuid=d0196936-7dbf-4291-994f-5174ddd1b97b&query=estres+laboral) ---

>From there, I've tried to find another job, which is difficult since my degree is in Fine Arts, not Graphic Design, and therefore there aren't many opportunities. The only way forward would be through contacts, and I don't really have many. I have to put up with it because I have no other choice. I have to help at home, and with the situation in the country, even more so. But without a doubt, the moment an opportunity arises, I'll leave it, without hesitation or anything. I don't want to continue with it; it's exploitative for me and everything I do, the knowledge I invest. It's made me depressed; I've cried a lot. Even so, my faith remains intact that things will get better. ---

>Honestly, sometimes I prefer to start my own business and earn little, but know exactly what I'm earning, rather than work excessively and be given whatever others feel like giving me. That kind of work environment depresses and consumes anyone, especially with the rationing. I've felt a mental and physical breakdown. Therefore, don't burn yourself out at any job. No one is indispensable. I'm not saying it's like that everywhere, but it's better to take care of our mental health than to leave it to others. Oh, and the worst part is that some people say, \

as if they almost put up with it. I feel like we have a bad concept of what jobs should be like. It's not about being treated like royalty or being given all the money in the world. What you want is for your investment of knowledge and time to be rewarded fairly. ---

>On this occasion, I would like to invite @irenenavarroart and @yasmarit to join us. --- ![SEPARADORFINAL.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23t7DhyLsnCvap7nZh5KQhSei8HfFKRCDACSsevDY6FtCrxZEtkcEjJFcgM5dmXK527Py.png) ---

# ESPAÑOL
---

> Espero se encuentren bien, estuve leyendo la iniciativa [Lo mejor de dos mundos](https://peakd.com/hive-139925/@syllem/letras-inspiradoras-lo-mejor-de) propuesta por @syllem, que debo expresar que siempre tiene la iniciativa que me ayuda a desahogarme en el momento, porque hace poco viví una experiencia desgarradora en el trabajo que tengo y realmente he querido dejar salir todo lo que atravesado actualmente. Ok, les cuento que, desde que me gradué y mucho antes me ha costado conseguir trabajo, que si por la edad (teniendo 25 años) o si por mi carrera y muchas otras cosas y eventualmente mi prima me ofrece trabajar para ella, es decir, ella seria la que contratan y yo haría el trabajo, ya que es por remoto; para mí fue una bendición y siempre le estaré agradecida. ---

>Sin embargo, los últimos meses me ha venido incomodando por el tema del pago, en un momento me pago 22 dólares menos a según por el tema de zelle y el cambio hacia binance, ok, yo lo acepté, aunque el hecho de que me haya dicho que eso se ve más al cambiarlo a bs y todo ello, lo cual es mentira, porque sigue siendo la misma cantidad el sueldo y con las cosas en aumento, pues realmente no le veo nada de ganancia. En fin, lo deje pasar. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-05-13_075937_www.magnific.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/EoiVGZD4c1H3kYV7EaKEVDYTraXVwjXV5WRhVwpUPXReZmQUjz9PvKg71VLLb764eGK.png) [Fuente](https://www.magnific.com/es/foto-gratis/mujeres-asiaticas-adultas-jovenes-inteligentes-usan-ropa-informal-trabajando-tarde-noche-reunion-teleconferencia-casa-linea-socios-comerciales-concepto-cuarentena-aislamiento-hogar_25118027.htm#fromView=search&page=1&position=2&uuid=a5b1fc31-1a92-4143-b39f-d4fc391862ad&query=ambientes+laborales+online) ---

>No obstante, para finales de marzo renuncia como que la jefa principal de diseño, quien tenía su equipo, ahí ella me dice que puede haber un aumento si tomaba demás tareas de la otra y que habría algunos fines de semanas para trabajar, en eso le digo que está bien, que solo si podrían indicar con antelación si sería el fin de semana próximo y esas cosas, porque esos días aprovecho de hacer otras diligencias y creía que era válido hacer esa sugerencia, aunado que también dependo del tiempo de ella, ya que le encanta salir los fines de semana, no todos, pero si en gran parte. Ella no me volvió a comentar ni nada y realmente el mes de abril fue rudo, aunado que, con los temas de la energía eléctrica, sentí que hice muchas cosas, aun así, tenía fe de que me pagaran algo más. ---

>En fin, llega el fin de mes y me pagan lo mismo y le pregunto que si eso era todo, lo cual me respondió que si, que debía saber que era un apoyo, que esto, que lo otro; a lo que yo le respondo que bueno, está bien, pero para este mes solo haría el trabajo que siempre he hecho, no haría lo que, hacia la otra diseñadora, porque era mucho más y no hay recompensa monetaria. Pues si supieran lo que me respondió, que bueno que ella tendrá que hacer esa parte, que no podría abandonar ese proyecto, que no podría estar de alzada, que esto, que lo otro, un sinfín de cosas que más bien la que debería estar ofendida soy yo. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-05-13_080021_www.magnific.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23xevn44YVF17xUTvqwXoFouaqUMQRHSP48Vh6NMvkcuSajD1xcbT8pXdvgkuWxe5gUHE.png) [Fuente](https://www.magnific.com/es/foto-gratis/mujer-cuarentena-tiro-medio-trabajando-casa_26394076.htm#fromView=search&page=1&position=1&uuid=d0196936-7dbf-4291-994f-5174ddd1b97b&query=estres+laboral) ---

>Me saco muchas cosas en general, por ejemplo, es que yo le digo muchas veces que es molestoso que vuelvan a cambiar una parte del diseño, cuando ya fue aprobado, visto miles de veces y que la jefa mayor ya lo había aprobado, y peor aún, cuando ya lo había terminado en los 3 idiomas, porque si, tengo que hacerlo en inglés, español y francés. Sacándome que eso es así en los trabajos, que los clientes cambian a cada rato, a lo que le respondí que solo estaba comentando, que ya había hecho los cambios, y bueno, fueron respuestas cortas y sin ofensa, algo que ella estaba haciendo contra mí. ---

>Y lo peor de todo, es que le indiqué como 5 veces si el diseño que querian modificar era ese, debido a que, esa parte que querian modificar lo veía como muy largo el cambio de texto y para mi razón, era de otro diseño que era más fácil y ya cuando había hecho cambios a ese otro, pues tuve que volver a trabajar el triple, hacerlo nuevamente, por ella no leer bien. Lo más triste de todo es que, como tengo su telegram abierto, por cuestiones de unos trabajos que tengo que hacer ahí, sin querer abrí el chat de su jefa, fue error mío, ya que solo reviso lo que me toca y listo, pero vi que le pagaron mucho más y, sin decirles mentira, me dio como la cuarta parte de ese pago, ahí entendí que siempre le han pagado de más y me da mucho menos, ok, yo entiendo que te quedes con algo porque eres la intermediara, no obstante, por lo menos si tengo más trabajo, págame algo más, no lo mismo. ---
![sad-female-workaholic-keeps-hands-chin-busy-making-project-work-studies-papers-wears-elegant-white-shirt-sits-desktop-unknown-people-stretch-hands-with-notes-alarm-clock-smartphone.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23uFm6uMLYnSudygHFmgBF3sqdNf985PAhfMFTYjFNNLwgyvr742GK8YKH368H4QxLaPA.jpg) [Fuente](https://www.magnific.com/es/foto-gratis/triste-adicta-al-trabajo-mantiene-manos-debajo-barbilla-ocupada-haciendo-trabajo-proyecto-estudia-papeles-viste-elegante-camisa-blanca-sienta-escritorio-personas-desconocidas-estiran-manos-notas-reloj-despertador-telefono-inteligente_11576101.htm#fromView=search&page=1&position=46&uuid=d0196936-7dbf-4291-994f-5174ddd1b97b&query=estres+laboral) ---

>A partir de ahí, he intentado buscar otro trabajo, lo cual se me hace dificil, ya que mi título es de Licenciada en Artes Plásticas, no en Diseño gráfico y, por ende, no hay muchas puertas abiertas y la única forma tendría que ser es por contactos y realmente no tengo muchos que se digan. Tengo que calármela, porque no me queda de otra, tengo que ayudar en casa y con la situación en el país, más aún, pero sin duda, al momento de presentarse una oportunidad, lo dejo, sin dolor ni nada, no quiero seguir con ella, es un abuso para mí y todo lo que hago, los conocimientos que invierto, eso me ha tenido deprimida, he llorado mucho, aun así, mi fe intacta de que mejorará. ---

>Realmente, a veces prefiero emprender y ganar poco, pero saber qué es lo que realmente gano, a trabajar de más y me den lo que los demás les dé la gana; ese tipo de ambiente laboral deprime a cualquiera y lo consume, más con los racionamientos, he sentido un colapso mental y físico. Por ello, no se desvivan en ningún trabajo, nadie es indispensable, no digo que en todos lados sea así, pero es mejor cuidar nuestra salud mental que dejárselo a otros; ah y lo peor es que alguno dice, “los trabajos son así”, como que casi soporta eso, y siento que tenemos un mal concepto de cómo deben ser los trabajos, no es que te traten como una reina ni te den todo el dinero del mundo, lo que uno quiere es que uno invierte en conocimiento y tiempo, sea retribuido de buena manera. ---

Up till today many sports pundits and reputable sports papers have expressed divergent opinions on the die-minutes goal scored by West Ham which the referee chopped off after a lengthy VAR check. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/2f260a62-7557-45d5-8415-1e021841d35c.jpg) Arsenal won that game by (1-0). But that was not even all. That loss by the Hammers have pushed them down into the relegation murky waters. West Ham's fate looked doomed following the (1-1) draw played out the next day by their nearest relegation battlers Tottenham Hotspur who played against Leeds United. Spurs now 17th on the table have a two point advantage over 18th placed West Ham United. body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![FUQNppminqpPx2C5_1000329970.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/im-yanizet/images/FUQNppminqpPx2C5_1000329970/FUQNppminqpPx2C5_1000329970.webp)
![DYo2vrJrIfUtZtik_1000329969.jpg](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/im-yanizet/images/DYo2vrJrIfUtZtik_1000329969/DYo2vrJrIfUtZtik_1000329969.webp)
![joDAvBS7earCDsrb_1000329968.jpg](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/im-yanizet/images/joDAvBS7earCDsrb_1000329968/joDAvBS7earCDsrb_1000329968.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

Ayer fue uno de esos días pequeños, pero profundamente felices, que te recuerdan cuánto pueden cambiar las cosas con algo tan simple como unos espejuelos nuevos.
Desde antes de ayer, cuando recibí la noticia de que ya estaban listos, la emoción no me cabía en el pecho. Fui a recogerlos enseguida y, desde ese momento, solo pensaba en estrenarlos en un lugar donde realmente marcarían la diferencia: el quirófano.


Después de tantos años sin usar lentes, confieso que adaptarme nuevamente será un proceso poco a poco. Al principio se siente extraño, diferente… como reencontrarme con una versión de mí que había olvidado. Pero ayer, en cuanto entré al salón y comencé mi trabajo, entendí que este cambio era justo lo que necesitaba.


Todo se veía mucho más claro, más definido, más preciso. Esa sensación de tener que acercarme demasiado al paciente para ver mejor quedó atrás, junto con la tensión constante en mi cuello. Fue increíble notar cómo algo tan cotidiano podía transformar tanto mi comodidad y seguridad en un espacio tan importante.
Sentí alivio, emoción y hasta un poco de orgullo. Porque sí, a veces cuidar de nosotros mismos también significa reconocer lo que necesitamos para estar mejor, para trabajar mejor y para sentirnos bien.


Ayer no solo estrené unos espejuelos nuevos; también estrené una nueva manera de mirar mi día a día, con más claridad, comodidad y confianza.


Y aunque todavía estoy en proceso de adaptación, sé que esta decisión será una de esas pequeñas grandes mejoras que harán mis jornadas más ligeras. Porque al final, ver mejor también es vivir mejor… y pocas cosas se comparan con la alegría de descubrir un mundo más nítido justo frente a tus ojos.




# English Version 




Yesterday was one of those small yet deeply joyful days that remind you how much life can change with something as simple as a new pair of glasses.
The day before, when I received the wonderful news that they were finally ready, I could hardly contain my excitement. I picked them up right away, and from that moment on, I couldn’t stop thinking about wearing them for the first time in the place where they would truly make a difference: the operating room.


After so many years without wearing glasses, I admit that adjusting to them again will take some time. At first, it feels strange, different… like reconnecting with a version of myself I had almost forgotten. But yesterday, the moment I stepped into surgery and began working, I realized this change was exactly what I needed.


Everything looked so much clearer, sharper, and more precise. That constant need to lean in too close to my patient just to see better was finally gone, along with the neck pain that often came with it. It was amazing to realize how something so everyday could completely transform my comfort and confidence in such an important space.


I felt relief, happiness, and even a little pride. Because sometimes, taking care of ourselves also means recognizing what we need in order to feel better, work better, and live better.


Yesterday, I didn’t just wear new glasses for the first time; I embraced a new way of seeing my daily life with more clarity, comfort, and confidence.


And although I am still adjusting, I already know this decision will become one of those small but meaningful improvements that make every day easier. Because in the end, seeing better is also living better… and few things compare to the joy of discovering a clearer world right before your eyes.

body.title: Brazalete tres en uno/ 3-in-1 bracelet 😍💗
body.body:
> Hello, gente, qué tal todo? Por estos lados del mundo bastante bien y con materiales nuevos de bisutería así que por supuesto comenzó la fiebre de hacer cositas y el día de ayer me hice una pulsera o brazalete que me gustó muchísimo cómo quedó y por supuesto tenía que compartirlo con ustedes. Es un brazalete que lo llamé **Brazalete tres en uno porque** porque básica son 3 pulseritas en una sola.
Hello everyone, how are you all doing? Things are going pretty well over here, and I’ve got some new jewellery-making supplies, so naturally I’ve got into a bit of a crafting frenzy. Yesterday I made myself a bracelet that I absolutely loved the way it turned out, so of course I had to share it with you. It’s a bracelet I’ve called the **Three-in-One Bracelet** because, basically, it’s three little bracelets in one.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW7pSqhj7t5u2TSZVZSChPbxdB5cdArMJDqSo11ySYmWY/1778674050340.png) *** Como les comenté arriba se trata de tres pulseras conectadas en una sola y en esta oportunidad utilicé mostacillas blancas tornasol, mini balines dorados y una cadena por supuesto dorada bien delgadita y la verdad es que quedó súper linda la combinación con el blanco y el dorado, y como pueden ver cada una guarda relación con la otra, por ejemplo, tenemos una que tiene una combinación de mostacillas blancas y balines dorados, otra decidí hacerla totalmente blanca con un pequeño dije dorado y la otra la hice con solo balines. así que como ven en cada una se utilizan las piezas de la primera, lo que me pareció súper lindo ya que combinan entre sí, y ahora sí, sin mas vamos con el paso, paso de estas pulseritas.
As I mentioned earlier, these are three bracelets joined together into one, and this time I used iridescent white beads, tiny gold beads and, of course, a very fine gold chain. To be honest, the combination of white and gold turned out absolutely lovely, and as you can see, each one ties in with the others. For example, we have one that combines white beads and gold beads, another I decided to make entirely white with a small gold charm, and the other I made using only gold beads. So, as you can see, each one incorporates elements from the first, which I thought looked really lovely as they all go together. And now, without further ado, let’s get on with the step-by-step guide for these little bracelets.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaVy8oeLJVVtEJ4Bn2HVfMqH85XX94FmZ8b3xG8CibNVb/1778674050591.jpg) *** ## Materiales Mostacillas pequeñas en color blanco tornasol Balines pequeños Dije Cadena Alfileres de ojo Argollas pequeñas Broche para cerrar Tenaza Pinza redonda Pinza plana
## Materials Small iridescent white beads Small beads Charm Chain Eye pins Small jump rings Closure clasp Pliers Round-nose pliers Flat-nose pliers
## Paso a paso/ Step by step Para la elaboración de este brazalete vamos a comenzar realizando la primera de nuestras pulseritas y esta será la que combina de balines dorados con mostacillas blancas y lo que haremos es pasar cada pieza por un alfiler de ojo intercalando una mostacilla y un ballín para finalmente cerrar nuestro alfiler creando un arito, que como saben lo hacemos con ayuda de la pinza redonda ubicandola en el extremo del alfiler de ojo y girando sobre sí misma hacia adentro, y de esta manera tenemos la pieza central de la pulsera.
To make this bracelet, we’ll start by creating the first of our small bracelets, which will combine gold beads with white seed beads. We’ll thread each piece onto an eye pin, alternating a seed bead and a gold bead, and finally close the pin to form a small ring, which, as you know, we do using the round-nose pliers, placing them at the end of the eye pin and twisting it inwards; and in this way we have the central piece of the bracelet.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYR94SqDRAjtQCVPKpfm9Wwy7518UTkBCgZK3HujCS2PV/1778674050812.jpg) *** El siguiente paso es cortar las piezas de cadena que van a los extremos de la pieza central y para esto vamos a tomar en cuenta el largo de nuestra muñeca o el largo del que queremos el brazalete, y una vez las tenemos cortadas las conectamos a cada extremo. Para esto, debemos abrir los ojitos, hacer pasar la cadena y volver a cerrar nuevamente, y ya que la pieza está lista lo que hacemos es asegurar con la pinza plana cada ojito para que no se desarme nuestro brazalete.
The next step is to cut the pieces of chain that will go to either end of the central piece; to do this, we need to take into account the length of our wrist or the desired length of the bracelet. Once we’ve cut them, we attach them to each end.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSQ8TBrLn7SVycU9pdREXxGxq9srA1j3GaLUhjuAJBgmV/1778674051039.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZHWg9m9MwSo2qoALfjUZypMsm9duVbAQGWyG8v8pZ69Z/1778674051283.jpg) *** Lista la primera de nuestras pulseritas vamos a elaborar la segunda y para esto vamos a utilizar las mostacillas blancas y un dije, y por supuesto, el alfiler de ojo, así que lo que hacemos es pasar por el alfiler de ojo las mostacillas y en el centro de ellas ubicamos el dije, y al igual que en el caso anterior agregamos las dos piezas de cadena a los extremos y de esta forma está lista nuestra segunda pulsera.
Now that our first bracelet is ready, we’re going to make the second one. To do this, we’ll use the white beads and a charm, and of course, the eye pin. So, what we do is thread the beads onto the eye pin and place the charm in the centre. Just as before, we attach the two pieces of chain to the ends, and our second bracelet is now ready.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbUGPpChTcBBPYN5aJYMM9qiGDgnXESQNhw9QHKK9EQza/1778674147362.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSZrg8dzkEjwKqZxRSDWFwZM4mUgjm5Z9hRLvQXYRuXUJ/1778674147530.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPL5kFqCVFS6P6WeMWQMZtqUQokPc2W6x5TtjxBocqeAB/1778674147686.jpg) *** Para la tercera pulsera, vamos a crear la pieza central solo con balines dorados, así que lo que hacemos es pasar los balines por el alfiler de ojo y crear nuestro arito al final, y lo haremos de la misma manera en que lo hemos hecho anteriormente y para finalizar conectamos los dos extremos de cadena y tenemos listas las tres pulserietas que van a formar nuestro brazalete.
For the third bracelet, we’re going to create the centrepiece using only gold beads, so what we do is thread the beads onto the eye pin and form a loop at the end, following the same method as before. Finally, we connect the two ends of the chain, and our three small bracelets—which will make up the main bracelet—are ready.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeUJqQFeXBinKmtJKGkZpBUr42RuU8aN4koBT4Am2QPv6/1778674147833.jpg) *** El siguiente paso es crear 2 piezas que serán las que nos ayudarán a conectar las 3 pulseritas y decidí hacerlas con una pieza creada con 2 mostacillas blancas para darle también un toque lindo a la parte interior del brazalete, entonces lo que haremos será tomar un alfiler de ojo, hacer pasar 2 mostacillas, cortamos el excedente y creamos el arito. Como ya saben para esto utilizamos la pinza redonda y lo que hacemos es colocarla en el extremo del alfiler, giramos hacia adentro y listo. De esta pieza vamos a crear dos.
The next step is to make two pieces that will help us connect the three bracelets. I decided to make them using a piece created with two white beads to add a nice touch to the inside of the bracelet. So, what we’ll do is take an eye pin, thread two beads onto it, cut off the excess wire, and form a loop. As you know, we use the round-nose pliers for this; we place them on the end of the pin, twist inwards, and that’s it. We’re going to make two of these pieces.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmacxaUHsAU6jyLvJNmmbRy1fQUg7asN7ebQ44mjc1Xp81/1778674147990.jpg) *** El siguiente paso es conectar estas 2 piezas a las tres pulseras, y lo que hacemos es abrir uno de los extremos de la pieza de mostacillas y hacer pasar las 3 cadenitas y cerramos nuevamente el aro con la pinza plana y hacemos lo mismo en ambos extremos. >The next step is to attach these two pieces to the three bracelets. To do this, open one end of the beaded piece, thread the three chains through, and close the loop again using the flat-nose pliers. Repeat this process at both ends. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXDzHejzEziHKWEkBTFeMxxhwYwrrYBwKLJuhdAfwC8hW/1778674262899.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcUhN2mQ8xnQ6XehGaXGfWC5kLNRgqZ29GpcDpn6n4c6K/1778674262496.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbZgzT4XEGhiBjPDXeqxAgzHiWwfcHLfEBRJKDjaRhWKs/1778674262681.jpg) *** Ya por último, conectamos los cerradores agregando una argolla en cada extremo y luego en uno de ellos incorporamos El broche para cerrar, y de esta manera tenemos lista esta bellísima pulsera que, básicamente son tres en una. >Finally, we attach the fastenings by adding a ring to each end, then fit the clasp onto one of them to secure it. body.title: Meena
body.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1778673696807-bb0a1cd413d5fdf4.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=angelmitu/c272b6e0)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=angelmitu/c272b6e0)


---

No matter how rich and wealthy you are, you have to remember your childhood.No matter how high up in a 10-story building you live, you have to remember the childhood you left behind when people lived in small villages with mud houses and tin roofs.I still haven't forgotten the small village and the small houses by the river and surrounded by nature.No matter how far away, that childhood still moves me.

Some people's lives are happy and some people's lives are sad but in the midst of everything, there is a need to enjoy joy in life.And childhood makes us happy and emotional for some time.So I don't want to forget childhood.In today's social media era, we have lost that childhood and small house of the past.But many things remain in our memories.But the most joyful thing is that even in this current era of digital social media, we are getting back to our childhood through some means.

In our childhood, we had a television in that small room that had only one channel. The channel was called Government Television BTB.There was no internet or Android phones.There wasn't as much social media or gaming videos as there are today.

There was only one TV channel and one movie every week.We eagerly waited to see that one movie of the week.Apart from the weekly movies, some documentaries and programs were shown on that TV channel.One of them was the Meena cartoon.I was young then, so I eagerly waited to watch the Meena cartoon.

It was a popular cartoon serial at the time.The Meena cartoon was aired on TV only once a week.I was eagerly waiting to see a Meena cartoon just once.That childhood Meena cartoon has been lost for many years.But the happiest thing is that today I received a game called Meena Cartoon and I am very happy and excited to receive it.Yes this is the childhood Mina.

Today I played the Mina cartoon game and got lost in that childhood.Mina cartoons were the best things to watch.They showed how to stay clean and fight disease.They showed how to be a good student or how to fight thieves.

Meena had parents and brother Raju.Meena had a parrot that talked.Meena was a very intelligent girl. She wished everyone well and well.She always did good deeds and stayed away from evil.Mina cartoons showed a beautiful standard of living.He lived in a beautiful village and raised chickens.

There is a game made in the style of that Mina cartoon that I saw for the first time today and I saw that Mina, that Tia bird, and that Raju.Mina is the main character in the game and she will move forward.The parrot will fly with Mina and sometimes talk.The parrot's name is Mithu, so he will say my name is Mithu.

Mina will run and collect six chickens from the road.She has to complete this task.When she moves forward, she will run over various objects and occasionally collect food and necessary things.He will collect five chickens from the road first.A thief wants to steal chicken number 6, so Mina will chase the thief.

But eventually Mina will catch the thief and be able to collect the chicken.Yes in the end I was able to catch the thief and my six chickens are complete.Today I played this fun game and shared it with you.The game took me back to my childhood for a while.

Thumbnail source: Thumbnail screenshot captured during gameplay with my own hands.

Thank you.

@Angelmitu

---

▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=angelmitu/c272b6e0)

body.title: 🌱 Algunas semillas se siembran con el corazón [Esp - Eng] 🌱 Some Seeds Are Planted with the Heart.
body.body:
>

*13 de mayo de 2026, Freewriters Community Daily Writing Prompt Día 3102: Esparce la semilla.*

Muy buenos días, mi gente, por acá escribiendo nuevamente para ustedes desde Buenos Aires, #Argentina. Apenas leí el tema de hoy, ***Scatter the Seed (Esparce la semilla)***, sentí que conectaba de inmediato con mi manera de ver la vida.

Y es que, si algo he aprendido con el paso de los años, es que muchas de las cosas más valiosas que hacemos no producen resultados inmediatos. A veces una palabra, un gesto, una ayuda sincera o una simple reflexión parecen pequeñas e insignificantes, pero con el tiempo pueden echar raíces en el corazón de alguien y transformarse en algo mucho más grande de lo que imaginamos. Por eso hoy quiero compartir un poco de mi historia y de esa necesidad que siempre he sentido de sembrar, donde quiera que la vida me lleve, una semilla de amor, esperanza y humanidad.
___________

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcVreRguMgjDka6HQ8sesin1tSFhvoRDQDtpaJ3eE98KL/image.png)</center>

<center>***\

***</center>
__________

Desde muy pequeño la vida me enseñó que hay pérdidas que dejan marcas profundas. La partida de seres queridos a temprana edad me hizo mirar el mundo con otros ojos y me volvió mucho más sensible ante el dolor ajeno. Con el tiempo entendí que esas heridas, aunque duelen, también pueden convertirse en una fuente de empatía. Quizás por eso siempre he sentido la necesidad de tender una mano, de escuchar, de acompañar y de hacer algo por quienes atraviesan momentos difíciles. Porque cuando uno ha conocido el sufrimiento de cerca, aprende a valorar más que nunca cualquier gesto de amor, por pequeño que parezca.

Durante dieciocho años tuve el honor de servir en una institución policial en mi querida Venezuela. Mi trabajo consistía en investigar delitos, y muchos de ellos estaban relacionados con homicidios. Fueron años intensos, duros y llenos de experiencias que me marcaron para siempre. Ver a madres, padres, hermanos e hijos llorando sobre el cuerpo de un ser querido es algo que deja huellas profundas. Son escenas que uno nunca olvida y que te hacen comprender lo frágil que puede ser la vida. Pero en medio de esa realidad tan dura, también aprendí que nunca debemos perder nuestra humanidad y que incluso en los contextos más difíciles siempre existe espacio para la compasión.

Recuerdo que muchas veces, mientras patrullábamos las calles de Puerto Cabello, nos encontrábamos con niños en situación de abandono o con familias atravesando grandes necesidades. Siempre que estaba a mi alcance, me detenía a conversar con ellos. Les preguntaba por sus padres, por su hogar, y en más de una ocasión terminábamos llevándolos a comer, comprándoles ropa, calzado y algunos alimentos para su casa. No entregábamos dinero, pero sí apoyo real y una palabra de aliento. Lo hacíamos con la esperanza de sembrar una pequeña semilla en esos niños y en sus familias. Una semilla de confianza, de esperanza y de la certeza de que todavía existían personas dispuestas a ayudar sin esperar nada a cambio.

Hoy estoy lejos de #Venezuela y mi vida tomó otro rumbo, pero esa manera de pensar sigue intacta. Tal vez incluso más fuerte que antes. Hace pocos días, mientras estaba en mi trabajo aquí en Buenos Aires, levanté la vista al cielo y me encontré con un hermoso arcoíris dibujado entre las nubes. En ese instante sentí que Dios me estaba regalando una señal, un recordatorio silencioso de que después de cada tormenta siempre aparece un motivo para seguir creyendo. El arcoíris, para muchos, simboliza esperanza, renovación y la promesa de que los días difíciles también pasan.

Quizás por eso, conversando con mi familia, les decía que me gustaría algún día viajar a lugares como África, Haití o Cuba. No por turismo ni por simple curiosidad, sino con el deseo de conocer a su gente y, si Dios me lo permite, llevar un poco de alivio, de alegría y de esperanza. Siempre le pido a Dios que me dé los recursos necesarios para poder sembrar buenas semillas en cada rincón al que llegue, aunque sea con una palabra, una ayuda concreta o una simple palmada en el hombro que le recuerde a alguien que no está solo. Y cada vez que veo señales como ese arcoíris, siento que Dios me confirma que vale la pena seguir soñando y seguir sembrando con el corazón.

Y justamente por eso valoro tanto a #Hive. Porque esta plataforma me ha permitido hacer algo muy parecido a lo que siempre soñé: sembrar semillas a través de las palabras. Cada publicación, cada comentario y cada reflexión puede llegar a algún lugar del mundo y tocar el corazón de alguien que quizás necesita leer justo eso en ese momento. Tal vez nunca sabré a cuántas personas he podido inspirar o acompañar con mis historias, pero eso no es lo más importante. Lo verdaderamente valioso es seguir sembrando. Porque cuando uno escribe desde el corazón, con honestidad y con el deseo sincero de aportar algo bueno, siempre existe la posibilidad de que esa semilla, tarde o temprano, termine floreciendo en la vida de alguien.

<center>![SeparadorHive.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mballesteros/23t7YWoN53XUARh93PVvS9mqaVjjjMGSNi6uJUMjKptGwBVoiTyadsRVjRPAE27xgxsc7.png)</center>

Por eso que para mi, sembrar una semilla, no es otra cosa que dar lo mejor de sí sin esperar nada a cambio. A veces será una palabra, otras veces un gesto, una ayuda concreta o simplemente el tiempo que dedicamos a escuchar a alguien que lo necesita. Quizás nunca lleguemos a ver con nuestros propios ojos todo lo que esas pequeñas acciones pueden provocar, pero eso no les quita valor. Al contrario, allí está la verdadera belleza de sembrar: hacerlo con fe, con amor y con la esperanza de que, en algún momento, algo bueno florecerá.

Hoy sigo creyendo que ninguna buena acción se pierde, que toda palabra dicha con sinceridad encuentra su destino y que cada semilla plantada con el corazón tiene el potencial de transformar una vida. Por eso, mientras Dios me dé fuerzas, seguiré escribiendo, ayudando y compartiendo lo que soy y lo que he aprendido en el camino.

Quiero agradecer a la comunidad #freewriters, en especial a @daily.prompt, @mariannewest y @felt.buzz, por este hermoso espacio que nos permite sembrar pensamientos, emociones y experiencias que pueden tocar el corazón de otras personas.

Gracias por leer y acompañarme una vez más. Y ahora te pregunto, ¿qué semillas estás sembrando hoy en tu vida y en el corazón de quienes te rodean? Los leo en la caja de comentarios.
______

body.title: Points are live on Hive-Swap — and so is multi-hop routing!
body.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hive-swap.com/23tGRcAcyKj8DP1hbsfNTkoHLg6JKAweHymtwHBtdxKXLT8CRmbMPTa1LcwY9kAxhyZ3J.png)
This was the cycle where Hive-Swap stopped being a pure router and started rewarding people for using it. Two things drove most of the changes: a full Points + leaderboard system built on top of the existing fee-event log, and a new 3-hop graph router that finally makes the tokens-with-no-SWAP.HIVE-pool corner of Hive Engine actually swappable. Everything else (treasury auto-sweep, four new bridges, public HTTP API, analytics dashboard) is in the cycle too — those land further down.

---

## Points, profiles, and a leaderboard

Every successful swap and bridge now rewards points based on the USD value of the action at the time it happened, and that history is permanent — points don't drift when token prices move later. The whole thing piggybacks on the existing 5-minute fee-event sync, so there are no new on-chain ops to pay for and no new sync loops to keep healthy. Two D1 tables back it: `points_events` is the per-event audit log, and `user_points` is a denormalized rollup so profile and leaderboard reads are cheap. Awarding is idempotent on `op_id`, so a concurrent or replayed sync can't double-credit.

The progression curve is 30 levels split across 6 tiers (Shrimp → Whale), with **L30 anchored at ~$1M lifetime volume** — meaningful for serious users without being unreachable. Tier and milestone badges are computed at read time, which means new badges apply retroactively when added later without needing a migration backfill.

Three new public endpoints went up alongside the UI:

```
GET /api/v1/profile/{username}
GET /api/v1/profile/{username}/activity
GET /api/v1/leaderboard
```

The top-nav `WALLET / PROFILE / RANKS` dropdown is the entry point in the app. The profile `@username` is also clickable straight through to `peakd.com/@<username>` so you can jump to the user's full Hive social profile from anywhere on the site.

A few infra fixes had to ship the same week to make Points trustworthy:

- **`fee_usd` is snapshotted at sync time**, so totals on /analytics and the leaderboard stop sliding when HIVE or a fee-token moves. A backfill job fills in NULL rows on every `/analytics/refresh` and inside the regular `maybeSync` tick. Points-sync defers NULL rows until backfill catches up instead of recording zero-point events.
- **Points-sync RPC fan-out is throttled** to 25 events/tick with a 60ms gap between `getTransactionInfo` calls. The first backfill hit `api.hive-engine.com` with 500 sequential requests, got 429'd on most of them, and only resolved 4-5 events per tick. Multi-tick backfill now keeps us well under the rate limit.
- **Stale `__null__` route cache invalidated** — the same rate-limited burst poisoned the route resolver cache, and six out of nine fee-event users never made it onto the leaderboard because a transient 429 got cached with a 1-hour TTL. Bumped the cache key prefix (`route4` → `route5`) and dropped the null TTL from 3600s to 120s so a blip recovers in two minutes instead of an hour.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hive-swap.com/23sweNFN3TpLqFTz84xJC1T7kdjGBJR3dhYupsLD1Yd7j7MjtV7MKHDXXQBc5qefdgttf.png)



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hive-swap.com/Enyn3yy5jGw9xZ7udZWcmX7CWjgCxbQUKzeHKEA75bTmL9Hi8tzWkXGP8gySPiLUGcY.png)


## Real 3-hop routing across the full pool graph

Up until this cycle the router could only quote direct pairs or 2-hop swaps via SWAP.HIVE. Tokens whose only pools pair with other intermediates — HSBIDAO is the canonical example, it has pools only against ECOBANK, LBI, PIXYDUST, and THREE — would appear in the token dropdown and return `NO_ROUTE` every time. The new router walks the full pool graph up to 3 hops, evaluates every candidate path (capped for runtime), and picks whichever yields the highest output after fees. The same algorithm picks up real arb gains on pairs that *were* routable: FLUX→SCRAP +2.1%, LSTR→LBI +77%, SWAP.HBD→LBI +17%.

A handful of routing-correctness fixes shipped alongside the graph walker, because once you start chaining three hops together the rounding behavior of low-precision tokens matters a lot:

- **Dust routes are rejected.** Two production txs (`e397d31c`, `d492889d`) showed the same failure: hops through LEO (precision 3) and BEED (precision 4) intermediates produced sub-satoshi outputs that the SDK silently dropped, and later hops drew from the user's pre-existing balance of the intermediate token. Now the router refuses any path whose intermediate output is below 10 satoshi, and `buildSwapWithFee` throws `DUST_ROUTE` rather than emit a partial chain.
- **Intermediate `minAmountOut` is wired tighter.** Pool-only intermediate hops set `minAmountOut` equal to the next hop's `tokenAmount`, so a successful hop is provably enough to fund the next draw. The last hop's `minAmountOut` is recomputed against the actually-emitted `poolIn`, not the router's full-precision prediction.
- **Multi-hop inputs get a 50bps buffer.** Each non-first hop's `tokenAmount` was hard-coded to the quote-time prediction of the prior hop's output, so any pool drift below that prediction — pool snapshot caching, in-flight third-party swaps — tripped `insufficient input balance` and reverted the whole atomic `custom_json`. A small buffer is now shaved off intermediate-hop inputs (compounded per hop); the user-facing `slippagePct` still drives the final minOut.
- **Dead pairs are filtered out of routing** — pools with zero reserves on either side no longer silently produce dust quotes (RIP `BRO:LBI`).
- **Deepest pool wins per leg** when multiple pools exist for the same pair.

Order-book routing pairs naturally with the multi-hop path: the router now considers each leg's HE order book (`market.buy` / `market.sell`) alongside the AMM pool and picks pool-only, book-only, or a ternary-search-optimal pool+book split. Two things make this clean in practice:

- The market contract's 0.001 BEED multi-tx fee is auto-bundled in the same atomic tx when the user doesn't already hold BEED — including a pre-leg pool buy of BEE → BEED through SWAP.HIVE when they don't hold BEE either. All bootstrap ops are exempt from the BEED fee so they ride for free in the user-signed tx.
- BEED routing is now an **always-visible toggle** below the To box (persisted in localStorage), so users can pre-opt-in rather than having to discover the hint tooltip on a quote where a book opportunity happens to exist.

`/docs/api`, `/llms.txt`, and `/llms-full.txt` were all updated in the same commits as the router changes — `/quote` and `/swap/build` responses serialize the new `poolPortion` / `bookPortion` fields, and the docs now show a split-route example plus the BEED multi-tx fee disclaimer (which the public API does not auto-bundle, unlike the web UI).


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hive-swap.com/Enyn4xEFvA7o7ZNcoecAxozERVgwsiY4ioEpJSutF55QCZtEDSN3iNRTjq9zietVbKR.png)


---

## Also shipped this cycle

- **Four new bridges.** `/bridge` now covers **BTC, LTC, DOGE, BCH** via the `@btc-swap` converter, plus native **ETH, BNB, POL, SOL** peg-out gateways. Shared splitters were taught about 8-decimal precision, so a 0.05 SWAP.LTC peg-out sends 0.04987500 net (above the gateway minimum) with a 0.00012500 platform fee, instead of the prior 0.049/0.001 split which would have been rejected by the daemon. Verified end-to-end on mainnet — 0.05030000 SWAP.LTC went out and 0.04978114 LTC landed at the destination address.
- **HBD ↔ SWAP.HBD bridge** via DSwap (`@graphene-swap`), including a gateway health check, estimated time, and direct support links to dswap.trade.
- **Bridge beta gating.** A dismissible amber banner above every `/bridge` tab plus a $50-USD threshold confirmation checkbox on each bridge subcomponent. The checkbox auto-resets whenever the amount changes, so a user can't pre-confirm a tiny amount and then bump it up. USD value is derived per token via a new `useTokenUsd` hook that reuses the existing HE pool price-map pattern — HIVE, HBD, wHIVE, the four converter coins, and the four native bridges are all priced with no new network endpoints.
- **Public v1 HTTP API** at `api.hive-swap.com` — `/quote`, `/swap/build`, `/bridge/*`, `/pools`, `/tokens`, `/gateways`, `/status`, `/analytics/*`, `/health`. Per-IP rate limit (30/60s) via the Cloudflare ratelimit binding, full docs at `/docs/api`, plus `/llms.txt` + `/llms-full.txt` for AI consumers. Returns unsigned `custom_json` ops — the caller signs and broadcasts.
- **Platform analytics dashboard** at `/analytics`. Derives platform-wide swap and bridge activity from the on-chain history of `hive-swap-fees` (HE `accountHistory` + Hive L1 `condenser_api`). KPI cards, area chart with volume/fees toggle, activity histogram, top-fee-earning tokens with sparklines, polling recent-activity feed with token-logo route pills and on-chain failure detection. A globally-shared Refresh button is rate-limited to one request per 60s across all users via a single KV lock.
- **Ownership-proven Keychain connect.** The connect modal previously stored any typed username with no Keychain involvement, so the UI would happily render balances and history under a spoofed account. Now we issue a randomized `signBuffer` challenge against the posting key — Keychain rejects if the extension has no key for that account, so a successful sign proves ownership.
- **Multi-account switcher.** Store multiple Keychain accounts and one-click switch between them, so power users can hop wallets without re-verifying each time.

## Smaller improvements

- Activity feed and history pages render every route as token-logo pills (the same component everywhere — RecentActivity, SwapHistory, PoolHistory).
- /analytics caches recent activity in localStorage and paginates past 10 rows so the page hydrates instantly.
- Per-token spinner on Recent Activity during initial load, the 60s poll, and manual refresh.
- All / Swaps / Bridges filter on Recent Activity.
- Chart bucket sizes scale smoothly with range — 30d no longer jumps from 6h to daily.
- /analytics polling now uses an in-isolate L1 cache layered over KV, dropping us well under the 1k/day KV write free-tier ceiling.
- History resolver now recognizes the BEED order-book leg (`market.sell` / `market.buy`) and flags malformed multi-hop routes as partial, so a tx like `e397d31c` (which silently drained a pre-existing ONEUP balance) stops rendering as a clean success, and a working split-route tx like `74b5bc45` stops dropping its first hop.
- Wallet button on mobile compacted to fit the header; long usernames truncate in the connected state.
- Profile button + new menu items pulse subtly so users discover the Points page, Ranks, and account switcher instead of leaving them hidden behind a hover.
- Top beta banner: smoother GPU-composited marquee, shorter line height, single-copy scroll that clearly enters from the right and exits past the left.

---

**Try it:** [hive-swap.com](https://www.hive-swap.com)
**Public API docs:** [hive-swap.com/docs/api](https://www.hive-swap.com/docs/api)
**Follow:** @hive-swap

body.title: Discovery of insects and fungi
body.body:
## Good night to all my beloved hive friends ❤️ ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXCw3tPpvT7AT1VXicN6nD81ExxHuqJmMYdGiVjnGReaz/1778671629645.jpg) In this post I will share an experience and moment of my success in finding a unique insect and a mushroom in the forest. A few days ago it rained very heavily in my area, it made me remember one thing that mushrooms will soon grow. In the morning, I and some of my friends decided to go into the forest to look for mushrooms called Pak (edible mushrooms), when the rainy season arrives looking for these mushrooms has become a common habit that is often done by many people in my area. However, finding Pak mushrooms is not an easy thing, because these mushrooms only grow in a few places, and these mushrooms grow directly on the ground. At that time we were not successful in finding them, but under a pile of oil palm fronds I managed to find a very unique mushroom, namely the curly white mushroom. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNw8avP4e3P32Tx25ebn8xw87F24knULpb14zyWfPMNeE/1778671629700.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUrfjnbAiSQ44NxtGS7H7V25QZ7cdQ5gF7fjH6jQvZWqj/1778671629755.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmagW83bh8uJTe7wFo5utpVBLVZNX6ayW1NP9tuWftqU9b/1778671629798.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWyA46nkG7XpReqfNXVDr3W5on8tfEVARDXvYweeYA5j2/1778671629846.jpg) This mushroom usually grows on dead trees such as on the fronds of oil palm trees. When I was young, this mushroom will be pure white but when it is old, this mushroom will change color to yellowish white. The texture is also soft when it is young, and will become harder when it is old, but this is not a mushroom that has a long life, if I am not mistaken,this mushroom can only live for a few days . If we want to be able to easily find this mushroom, we have to look for it when the rainy season arrives, because in the dry season we will never find it. On one of the wild plants, I also managed to find a very interesting insect. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ1hktVoYa7Uthm4ZJqi4XX5a8WheE787rH6SSH1TvtTT/1778671648469.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc2MNq94ASoXnF5S4MbidV3FQDj8PuDpkCP1cxLm3nfvd/1778671648528.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeRV2UzSgYNnZ31aZdNPewLs62zZmhmrQujNRCBRuMR6n/1778671648576.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYxPvbg3WeXmw9bGcCczAuc8qfsC3ctYKAWwmnp8U9ago/1778671648624.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTHCkCz2i7HnvyQZA24828KbowwXZuGidNB1wh5ggoAEM/1778671648674.jpg) Until now I don't know the name of this insect, but in my area many people call this Bapak Pucung Kapas,this is because this insect is often found on cotton trees, and we can easily find it there. The uniqueness of this insect lies in its very striking colors, namely red, black and white, and the good news is that this insect is completely harmless to humans, we can even hold and play with it. ----

Life is a responsibility Be yourself, keep learning and don't hesitate to start😉

body.title: Era and Its Beauty
body.body:
Greetings, everyone!

Well, no era is greater or better than another. Each comes with its beauty and was a blessing to each individual who lived by it. They enjoyed the moment, time, and season. All comes with different lifestyles of people. In those days things were very cheap, and people lived in love with their families and others outside. They weren't divorced as it is today in our present era. People were in one accord thinking about themselves and others. They weren't killing people and sort of that. So you see that there is beauty in the old era, and they encountered issue after issue, and they endured with it, and they embraced it because that was what happened during their era. 


![file_00000000f1b8720ca55fa760e358dba9.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/peckypeace/AKchepsfsBrr7YRMYboW4SpepFdDUhcPux1bcajkxFtG44DN52osuLmjkAK4fNX.png)
_**AI generated Image**_

By then, children were so open and obedient to their parents and to the teachers in school. No student had the effrontery to challenge his or her teacher in the classroom. They correct them and they accept them. I could recall those days when beaten by our teachers without our parents coming over to school to fight the teachers. That era was the best era for them. You can quantify the good times they had together, the differences they had. Life was easy according to their standard of living.

Goods were sold at the lowest price, and I had seen it. The biscuits they are selling at #5, are now #200. 

You see their way of living and every involvement in that era was beautiful and acceptable even without technology and smartphones. 

Folk music, story and plays were displayed. People's culture was intact. Local delicacies were intact and a lot more.

However, in our present era, we have seen that some things practiced in the past era have gone extinct. Prices have skyrocketed, and the culture of people is not maintained, people are not loving or in unity any longer. Now, we have access to smartphones, AI, and development in technology, and the skills too to make life comfortable for people who want a simple life.

According to this contest question:

# Are we living in the best era?

My response is no. I earlier said, No era is better than another. Every era comes with its beauty and differences. So I can't place one era over another. So I see each era as a seasonal change.

With our advances in technology, we still experience good and bad times. We still have good and evil reports.

# I'm happy to be in this era?

I was happy in that era, and I am happy in this era. As long as I have breath and God with me, I will still be happy forever.


Therefore, every era has its story, and every story has its beauty. So, in any era we find ourselves, we should embrace and enjoy the season. It's a blessing and not a curse. We enjoy it while it lasts.

_**This is my response to the Hivelearners featured contest week 217 episode 2**_

_**I love, I care, and I forgive**_



Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@peckypeace/era-and-its-beauty--2ea)

# Python: 10 хитростей и библиотек, которые упростят вашу жизнь

Привет, программисты и те, кто просто зашел посмотреть, что тут происходит! Сегодня мы поговорим о том, как сделать вашу жизнь с Python чуть более приятной и менее запутанной. И не переживайте, здесь не будет сложных формул — только полезные трюки и библиотеки, которые помогут вам сэкономить время (и нервы)!

## 1. **List Comprehensions: магия в одной строке!**
Зачем писать циклы, когда можно создать список за одно мгновение? 

```python
squares = [x**2 for x in range(10)]
```

*Примечание: если ваш код выглядит слишком красиво, не забудьте проверить, не скрывает ли он баги!*

## 2. **`enumerate()` — для тех, кто не любит считать**
Забудьте о ручном подсчете индексов! С `enumerate()` вы получите и индекс, и значение в одной строке.

```python
for index, value in enumerate(['apple', 'banana', 'cherry']):
    print(index, value)
```

*Идеально подходит для тех, кто забыл, сколько раз он уже заказывал пиццу!*

## 3. **`zip()` — для тех, кто любит объединять**
Объединяйте списки, как будто это ваши старые друзья на вечеринке!

```python
names = ['Alice', 'Bob', 'Charlie']
scores = [85, 90, 95]
combined = list(zip(names, scores))
```

*Теперь вы можете составить идеальную команду для соревнования по программированию!*

## 4. **`collections.defaultdict` — для ленивых**
Не хотите проверять, есть ли ключ в словаре? Используйте `defaultdict` и забудьте об этом!

```python
from collections import defaultdict

d = defaultdict(int)
d['apples'] += 1
```

*Теперь у вас всегда будет запас яблок, даже если вы не умеете их собирать!*

## 5. **`itertools` — для настоящих магов**
Комбинируйте, перемешивайте и создавайте бесконечные итераторы с помощью библиотеки `itertools`. 

```python
import itertools

for combination in itertools.combinations(['A', 'B', 'C'], 2):
    print(combination)
```

*Идеально для тех, кто не может решить, что надеть на вечеринки!*

## 6. **`pandas` — ваш новый лучший друг**
Если вы работаете с данными, то `pandas` — это то, что вам нужно! 

```python
import pandas as pd

data = pd.DataFrame({'Name': ['Alice', 'Bob'], 'Score': [90, 80]})
```

*Теперь ваши данные будут выглядеть так, будто они прошли курс по стилю!*

## 7. **`requests` — для любителей API**
Работаете с API? Библиотека `requests` сделает это проще простого.

```python
import requests

response = requests.get('https://api.example.com/data')
```

*Не забудьте проверить, что API не требует от вас подписки на рассылку!*

## 8. **`virtualenv` — изоляция на высшем уровне**
Создавайте виртуальные окружения, чтобы ваши проекты не мешали друг другу. 

```bash
virtualenv myenv
source myenv/bin/activate
```

*Теперь вы можете работать над проектом, не боясь, что ваши зависимости сбегутся на вечеринку!*

## 9. **`pytest` — тестируйте, как будто от этого зависит ваша жизнь**
Пишите тесты с `pytest`, чтобы убедиться, что ваш код работает так, как задумано. 

```python
def test_add():
    assert add(2, 3) == 5
```

*Потому что если ваш код упадет, вы не сможете объяснить это на собеседовании!*

## 10. **`flask` — для создания веб-приложений без лишних заморочек**
Хотите создать веб-приложение? `Flask` — это легкий фреймворк, который поможет вам в этом!

```python
from flask import Flask

app = Flask(__name__)

@app.route('/')
def hello():
    return 'Hello, World!'
```

*Теперь вы можете создать свой собственный сайт для продажи носок с лицами программистов!*

body.title: entry smash 425: in the sand
body.body: the dry sand on the beach tends to become shaped in waves by the wind. when the sun is low, either sunrise or sunset the waves cast more or less rhythmic shadow patterns. any disturbances such as footprints add interest especially because of their shadows the level differences cause. it's not about one shadow or any particular shadows but rather designs created by the mix of degrees of highlighted and shaded areas\n\n
/> seagulls and crows. the seagulls feet are designed for swimming and walking on land so their print is far bigger than the crow's whose feet are suited for grasping onto tree branches
/> dry wildflowers and grasses rooted in the sand shrivel and fall to the ground where they get spun around by the wind and create circular patterns. here with wavy sand and seagull prints
/> older prints and waves fade as the wind continually moves and reshapes the sand

/>\n\nthis is my entry with waves in the sand with seagull, crow and human footprints. i took all these shots in September at Oddane Sand, a nearby beach in southern Norway. it's one of the nicest sand beaches in the area and very popular in the summer but in the offseason if you are lucky you can have the entire beach to yourself
