body.title: Sapien Loop 3: Chapter 4: Lessons from the Loops
body.body:
![Sapien_Loop_3_Cover_HIVE.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spectrumecons/23wC7hkTDDpnHvZegULctqg6Mrrd9t72byH8zWkVgfNiHGiHqm7aVAeGi9PiELYyYAuVf.jpg)

Around an hour later, Orcilla and Yassmay joined Angelo for breakfast. To their delight, there was a huge stack of pancakes next to a plate of mixed fruit on the table.

‘Oh, I didn’t know you could make pancakes down here,’ said Yassmay as she plonked herself down on a chair.

‘It’s our first attempt,’ said Angelo excitedly. ‘We haven’t had access to ingredients to make it work until now.’

‘Your effort to make us feel welcome is greatly appreciated,’ said Orcilla, grinning. 

Yassmay began to desperately shovel pancakes onto her plate. 

‘Preparing your staple breakfast is the least we can do,’ said Angelo as he cut into the pancake on his plate.

‘It’s a bit different, but it’s still super yum,’ said Yassmay as she squirted more sweet sauce onto her pancake.

‘I’m so glad you like it,’ said Angelo as his face lit up when he tasted it.

‘I never see you eat; you should join us,’ said Yassmay as she turned to Julio, who was standing in his usual place.

‘It is not my place to dine with the High Philosopher,’ replied Julio.

‘He endures our staple of baked potato,’ chuckled Angelo.

‘I feel privileged to eat,’ replied Julio. ‘Many of the followers miss meals because of shortages.’

‘With access to the surface, that will never have to be the case again,’ said Orcilla. ‘Even in our post-apocalypse world, food is abundant.’

‘Pancakes every day, if you want,’ chuckled Yassmay.

‘That I can get used to,’ replied Angelo as he shoved another piece of pancake into his mouth.

The three of them joyfully continued eating their pancakes until all of them and the fruit were gone.

‘I can give you a strong passing score on your pancakes,’ said Yassmay contently as she wiped her mouth with a napkin. ‘I think your next challenges are to make cakes, pies, ice cream, and donuts.’

‘Sounds delightful,’ replied Angelo as he glanced over at Julio, who shrugged his shoulders in response. ‘You’ll have to pass on the ingredients we need.’

‘I’d be happy to do so,’ said Yassmay.

‘As promised, it’s time for me to share our knowledge of the loops,’ said Angelo as he got up to grab several books off the bookshelf in the corner of his room.’

‘I don’t mean to sound ignorant, but what are the loops?’ asked Yassmay, slightly nervously.

‘Asking questions to acquire knowledge are not the actions of someone who is ignorant,’ replied Angelo as he placed the books on his table. ‘A thirst for knowledge is a cure for ignorance.’

Yassmay smiled proudly and nodded her head.

‘Civilisations run in loops,’ said Angelo as his tone became more serious. ‘Civilisations emerge, they rise, they grow, they mature, and eventually they fall. This is to give rise to a new loop. We have found ourselves moving from one loop into another.’

‘Your theory is that this is inevitable and does not fall on anyone?’ asked Orcilla.

Angelo paused for a moment as he looked thoughtfully at Orcilla. He then turned to Julio, who responded by nodding. 

‘You’re not the reason for the end of the twelfth loop,’ said Angelo in a calm tone.

Yassmay glared at Orcilla.

‘The Sentray attacked because of me,’ said Orcilla as she turned to Yassmay. ‘I called them using the infant’s scream.’

Yassmay did not respond. She looked down at the table.

‘I couldn’t live with myself for years,’ said Orcilla. ‘I brought about all this destruction and suffering. However, I also know that this was the only way. Complete destruction had to happen for us to rebuild. For us to build something that would never be possible otherwise.’

Yassmay got up from her seat. She was about to walk to the door.

‘Sometimes the truth can hurt, but it is also necessary,’ said Angelo. ‘Enlightenment is always worth the pain.’

She turned around and looked at Orcilla. Orcilla stood up as well. They looked at each other for a few seconds. Then Yassmay put her arms around Orcilla, and the two hugged each other.

Angelo looked at Julio and smiled. Julio nodded his head.

Both Orcilla and Yassmay sat back down.

‘The content of these books has been compiled by the great leaders and High Philosophers that have come before me,’ said Angelo as he patted the books. ‘They contain content from the House of Divine Knowledge’s hidden libraries as well as writings from the tunnels and underground cities themselves.’

Julio frowned slightly.

‘And of course from divination from the higher power,’ added Angelo, who looked across at Julio, who was now nodding.

‘Is it all written in Parelic?’ asked Orcilla.

‘That’s right,’ said Angelo. ‘It is the language of the higher power. I have some translated summaries I can give you.’

‘That’s very considerate of you,’ replied Orcilla.

‘Ah yes, well, it helps us spread the word,’ said Angelo as he opened one of the books. ‘Okay, let’s begin with Loop One.

In the beginning, as it is today, Sapey was one large continent surrounded by a vast ocean. Unlike today, thousands of different species of Sapes populated Sapey. They were quite different from the most common Sapes of today. At some point, as depicted in text and art, a species known as the lower power visited Sapey. The lower power has often been mistaken for the higher power. The lower power were a group of mysterious beings who had exceptionally long lifespans. Thus creating the impression of immortality. They had the ability to create life. This was not through divine power but scientific knowledge. Their intelligence provided them with the means to create, but they lacked the wisdom to understand what to create and why.

The lower power studied the Sapes. They wanted to genetically change a species of Sape so that species would have the ability to serve them and worship them. They found a strong boar-like Sape that was very strong and hardy that could work hard for them. They genetically changed this Sape with their own DNA. These Sapes became more intelligent, but they could not utilise this intelligence. They were unable to use their four legs and trotters to perform tasks using sophisticated tools. They were also unable to adequately communicate because they had no speech and limited ability to use body language. They did not consider this species a failure. Instead, they considered it a lesson in what needed to be done to create their ideal creature. They created many more of these Sapes. They studied how they interacted and observed their shortcomings. 

Based on what they had learned, they searched all of Sapey for a more ideal species. They came across a rare Sape that had two legs and two arms instead of four legs like the other Sapes. This Sape more closely resembled the lower power. They believed they could recreate this species in their own image. Thus, this would make them the perfect servant. The genetic changes to this species were a success. This species was more intelligent than their first attempt but considerably less intelligent than they were. This species could also speak and communicate more easily using their body language. The lower power called their new species ‘Servi’, meaning ‘servant’ or ‘slave’. The other species they created were not renamed. They were still called ‘Sapes’. However, to a certain extent, these Sapes were considered sacred. The Servi were not permitted to eat them.

The lower power were happy with their newly created species, the Servi. They fervently worshipped the lower power, and they worked very hard to provide them with whatever they needed. This relationship continued for several generations of Servi, who had vastly increased in numbers. Eventually, the Servi became aware that the lower power only wanted to exploit them. Their loyalty and devotion towards the lower power were starting to turn to anger.

An angry group of Servi decided to rebel against the lower power. This rebellion failed, as they did not have the numbers or capabilities to defeat the lower power. The rebellion enraged the lower power. They forced the Servi to execute the disloyal Servi as a form of sacrifice. However, the lower power were still not satisfied. They decided to punish all the Servi for the disobedience of the few. They made them work twice as hard, worship them twice as often, and halved their daily rations.

The lower power’s strategy to punish the Servi backfired. Instead of building loyalty, it made the Servi angrier. This led to a second much larger rebellion. This rebellion was more successful. The lower power left. The Servi believed they were free from their rule. However, the lower power were not finished with the Servi. They found their new betrayal unforgivable. 

The lower power decided the Servi were evil. The lower power felt the name ‘Servi’ was no longer appropriate. They initially wanted to rename the ‘Servi’ to ‘devil’. The ‘devil’ was the name the lower power used to personify a creator for all evil, which they considered the opposite of themselves. However, the name ‘devil’ carried too much status, which they considered the Servi undeserving of. Instead, the lower power rotated the word ‘devil’ 180 degrees so that it appeared upside-down. The lower power considered inversion symbolic of evil. 

When rotated, the last letter ‘l’ became the first letter, and ‘i’ became the second letter. The third letter, an inverted ‘v’, now became an ‘n’; the inverted ‘e’ became an ‘a’; and the inverted ‘d’ became a ‘p’. The Servi were now known as the Linap.

The lower power decided the evil Linap must be destroyed. The lower power decided they would create enormous, powerful and almost indestructible monsters to hunt and kill the Linap. These monsters would be created using a combination of the largest land and water Sapes. They added their own genetics to this monster to make them carnivorous, intelligent, and almost invulnerable to attack from a smaller species such as the Linap.

Several decades passed. The lower power had dedicated an offshore facility to breeding an army of this monstrous creature. Once they believed they had enough of them to wipe out the Linap, they released them. The lower power decided to call their new monstrous being the ‘Sentray’. They were ‘sent’ as a ‘ray’ of light to cleanse the world of the evil Linap. This was the last recorded mention of the lower power. It appeared they had disappeared as mysteriously as they had appeared. 

Once the Sentray arrived on the mainland, they went on a rampage. They ripped through the Linap settlements with ease, killing any they encountered. The Linap were unprepared and suffered huge losses, but they were not wiped out. The few survivors hid in caves. The Sentray were too big to enter these caves, thus offering them protection. However, the caves offered little in terms of food. Therefore, the Linap were forced out to forage or hunt. This put them in great danger. Many of them were killed; only the most skilled survived.

The number of Linap dwindled further; this was both bad and good for the Linap. It was bad because the Linap population was becoming dangerously low for their survival. It was good because the Linap were no longer a sufficient food source for the Sentray. The Sentray turned their attention to the Sapes. This meant the remaining Linap could become more effective at collecting food.

Most Sapes could not escape or fight off the Sentray. The only Sapes that had a chance of defending themselves were the species created by the lower power. This species was stronger and more intelligent. They worked together in herds. This made attacks more dangerous for the Sentray. Therefore, they focused on the easier-to-kill Sapes.

The Linap decided that they could exist underground. They used their intelligence to invent tools that would allow them to tunnel into the ground. This also allowed them to tunnel out into safer locations where they could find food. Eventually the Linap became so successful that their populations began to increase again. The food gatherers had developed techniques to camouflage themselves so that the Sentray would not detect them.

The Sentray were beginning to struggle, as they had overhunted the Sapes, and the remaining modified Sapes were putting up strong resistance. The Sentray decided that the vast ocean was now the most reliable and safest source of food. Over the next several decades, the Sentray migrated almost entirely to the vast ocean. The Linap eventually learnt of this and gradually began to move out of their caves.

In the absence of the Sentray, the Linap had no natural predator. Their intelligence could have allowed them to thrive unhindered. However, things did not work out that way. The new enemy was themselves. The Linap divided themselves into tribes. Most of the Linap desired to live peacefully with the other tribes. However, the leaders of these tribes did not share this desire. Instead, they desired power over peace. To do that, they would manipulate their tribe members into believing the other tribes were the threat and desired to attack them to steal their wealth and resources. They used this as an excuse to prepare for war with the other tribes. 

Eventually wars broke out. Tribes would conquer each other, but the conquered tribes would rise up again at some point. Under new leaders, they would eventually succeed. These new leaders, like the old leaders, desired power, and the wars would continue with control bouncing back and forth between tribes.

The tribe leaders desired to have a decisive advantage. New technology and weapons helped swing the wars in their favour, but most of this technology could be replicated by the other side, and the balance swung back again. A tribe leader from one of the larger southern tribes decided that they should use the Sentray as a weapon against the other tribes. They sent out several boats into the vast ocean. They did not need to travel far before they encountered a Sentray nest. They took many of the Sentray’s eggs, and they sailed towards the coast closest to a rival tribe. The Sentray found out their eggs had been taken. They followed the scent of the eggs to the coast of the rival tribe. 

The Sentray went into a rage and destroyed the tribe. However, they did not retrieve their stolen eggs and leave. They went on to attack other tribes. The tribe that drew them in was next. The leaders of the tribes and many of their most loyal followers escaped underground into their old tunnels and caves. The aboveground settlements were completely destroyed in a matter of weeks.

Some of the Sentray returned to the vast ocean, while others remained. The Sentray had learnt from their past mistakes. They were now better hunters. They did not greedily kill every Sape they encountered. They only took what they needed and enabled the rest to thrive. They even protected them from Linap hunting parties to maintain their numbers. It appeared the Sentray were going to keep a permanent land presence. The Linap appeared to be stuck underground for the long term. This is how the first loop ended.

‘Oh wow!’ exclaimed Yassmay. ‘That was a wild first loop. It would be great if it were re-enacted. You just need to add some fun characters.’

‘We were unable to establish who the main characters of that time were,’ replied Angelo. ‘This account is based mostly on wall art with a few collaborating excerpts from scripture.’

‘So the creator is the lower power and not the higher power,’ said Orcilla. ‘That is a great contradiction to what is taught by the House of Divine Knowledge to both Linap and Sapiens.’

‘It is a common misconception,’ replied Angelo. ‘The higher power offers much more than creation. It offers universal knowledge to whoever opens themselves to receive it.’

‘Which loop does that happen in?’ asked Yassmay excitedly.

‘It happens in every loop,’ replied Angelo. ‘In Loop One, the Linap did not understand it.’

‘How do we understand it?’ asked Orcilla.

‘You must read the signs,’ replied Angelo. ‘Let me take you into Loop Two. There is much more to explain.’

Yassmay nodded emphatically.

Many of the Linap tribe leaders met underground. They decided to form a truce and work together for their own mutual benefit. This time underground, they had better knowledge and some of their more advanced technology. They expanded their tunnel network further and even built an entire underground city located near a large source of glow rocks. They cut through the roof of the city and replaced the removed rock with glow rocks. These glow rocks gave them a source of light that would enable them to grow their own food underground. 

Many generations passed, and the Linap population had grown significantly. The food they could grow from the glow rock light source was no longer sufficient. They were forced to collect food from the surface. However, the Sentray were still roaming the land. The tribe leaders sent out their best-trained scouts to search for locations where they could collect or even grow food. The Sentray soon became aware of the Linap’s presence. Many of the scouts were hunted down and killed. 

Some of the scouts managed to avoid detection by being able to blend in with their surroundings. Their skin tones could change to match the foliage, thus making them hard to see by the Sentray. This ability was triggered automatically when the Linap became afraid. This was a huge potential breakthrough for the Linap. They decided to start a breeding programme to enhance this genetic feature. Within a handful of generations, many of the Linap could become partially invisible. 

The Linap used this ability to venture above ground more frequently. This allowed them to collect more food. The Linap population continued to grow. Food collecting was not sufficient to feed the larger population. The tribe leaders decided they needed to farm and hunt; however, their newfound invisibility was not sufficient to protect them from the Sentray to do this. They needed to force the Sentray to leave. The easiest target for them was the eggs and the infant Sentray. 

The Linap used their invisibility to get close to the nests. Once inside the nest, they would use their weapons to destroy the eggs. The Sentray were furious when they found out, but they were unable to find the culprits. The Linap continued their attack on the eggs. In most cases, all the eggs were destroyed, but there were a few occasions where the infant Sentray survived the attack. This was the beginning of the evolution of the amazing healing power of the embryos and infant Sentray. 

The Linap relentlessly went after the Sentray’s nests in the surrounding area. The loss of infant life became too high for the Sentray. Some of them retreated into the ocean, and others relocated far from where the attacks were occurring. The Linap were finally able to safely spend enough time above ground to grow crops and farm Sapes again.

The Linap population continued to grow. The tribe leaders, who were now known as the elite, had grown more interested in breeding and genetics. They wanted the best genetics. They wanted to be healthier, stronger, and smarter and, above all, have the ability to become invisible. 

Several generations passed. The elite Linap had managed to differentiate themselves from the other Linap. They had an advanced ability to become invisible and were considerably smarter, but they were neither healthier nor stronger. They had achieved a trade-off for what they valued the most in exchange for what they valued less. For most, the compromise was small, but for a few less fortunate, the compromise was more significant. A sign of poor health was the appearance of a blue pigment in the eyes.

‘Wait!’ interrupted Yassmay. ‘We have blue eyes and have always been in the peak of health.’

‘Well, this condition only applied to the Linap,’ chuckled Angelo. ‘Both of you have always had a little something else in you.’

Both Orcilla and Yassmay started to look a little concerned.

‘Don’t worry; I’ve known this the whole time,’ chuckled Angelo. ‘May I continue?’

Both Orcilla and Yassmay nodded.

The majority of the Linap were not aware that the elite had distinguished themselves from them. The Linap used their genetic advantage to solidify their positions of power. The families of the tribe leaders that were no longer part of the elite, i.e., enhanced through breeding, were demoted into the regular population.

The Linap continued to thrive. New tribes were formed, and their area of control expanded both above and below ground. This time they did not wage war with each other. Instead, they cooperated to maintain control over their populations. However, their expansion brought them closer to the Sentray again. 

The elites decided to employ the same strategy of targeting the Sentray’s eggs. The eggs and the embryos inside had become notably stronger, but most were still vulnerable to the Linap’s upgraded weapons. The Sentray’s inability to protect their young from an enemy that was almost impossible to detect forced them to abandon land living altogether. Therefore, they returned to the vast ocean where the majority of the Sentray were thriving. This was a victory for the Linap. Before long, they returned to surface living. Within a century, their settlements expanded across the entire continent, and their overall population had increased by more than tenfold in that time.

The success of the Linap was becoming a problem for the elite. Prosperity was raising the expectations of the majority. They wanted more than the basics. They wanted more freedom and a greater say on how their tribes were run. On top of that, the number of the genetically ‘elite’ had also vastly increased. The ruling elite felt threatened by those who could match their intellect and cunning. 

The ruling elite met in secret to decide what to do. After several weeks of talks, they decided war was necessary. Unlike the previous wars for domination, this war would serve the purpose of controlling and reducing their populations. 

War could not start for no reason. The elite of each tribe would start provoking each other’s tribes. This caused tension between the Linap of these tribes to rise gradually. The ruling elite also wanted to reduce the threat from the non-ruling genetically elite, who were wealthier and more successful than the majority of the Linap. The elite made it a point to highlight their greed and the harm they were causing to the broader society. They would promote a few Linap from the majority to attack the non-ruling elite. This was done primarily in just one tribe. This tribe would eventually be labelled the bad tribe. Tension with that tribe, as well as tension with other tribes that had a large number of non-ruling elites, began to rise.

The next step was to trigger the war. The elite decided they would orchestrate attacks on each other and blame it on the non-ruling genetically elite. These attacks were the final straw for the majority populations; they now called for war with the opposing tribe and its elite. The elite were happy to oblige to their calls.

War broke out. The elites could easily pursue greater powers over their populations. They convinced the majority that these powers were needed so that they could fight the war and keep them secure. The elites made sure their sides were of similar strength so that the war could be prolonged as long as possible. Prolonged war ensured they could normalise their control over the majority. The non-ruling elites also benefitted as they became richer from the production of weapons and control over the now scarce resources.

Non-ruling elites’ fortunes soon changed. Their increased accumulation of wealth had made them a greater threat, but they were also despised by the majority of the Linap on both sides of the war. The ruling elite decided it was time to massacre the non-ruling elite as well as a few of the ruling elite who had become less cooperative. This massacre was to be orchestrated by mostly the bad tribe. This started the first great massacres of the second loop. Executions were being conducted everywhere, and the killers were greatly rewarded. 

These massacres continued for almost a year. It did not stop until another tribe, which had previously agreed to remain neutral, decided to attack the bad tribe. Tribes that were supportive of the bad tribe also switched sides. The strength of the multiple tribes against just one eventually became too strong, and the war ended. 

The loss of life was immense. A tenth of the Linap population had been eliminated, and almost half of the non-ruling elites had been slaughtered. The non-elite leaders were captured and executed. The threat to the ruling elite had been close to eliminated. The majority of the population accepted the continued loss of freedom if it guaranteed peace. The elite also started to rebuild their societies from the damage that had been done by the war. This further increased their wealth and power.

This was not the last war. The elite decided every few decades a new war was needed to trim the population and eliminate at least half the elites, whom they considered the greatest threat. The elite believed that keeping their elite group small was the easiest way to maintain power.

As technology improved, these wars became more destructive. Eventually a war became so destructive that the Linap almost wiped themselves out. However, the elites were confident they could rebuild once again as they had done many times before.

This incredibly violent war caught the attention of the Sentray. They believed the recent destruction would enable them to retake the continent. The Linap had forgotten about the Sentray, and because of the damage and loss of life caused by the war, they were not prepared to fight the Sentray. The Sentray attacked with force and defeated the remaining Linap. The surviving Linap were once again forced underground. This ended the second loop.

‘Geez!’ exclaimed Yassmay. ‘The Linap are truly the orchestrators of their own demise.’

‘They are so obsessed with power they would slaughter their own,’ said Orcilla in disgust. 

‘I’m afraid it is a common theme throughout many of the loops,’ replied Angelo. ‘There was less necessity for such massacres in your loop, as disease kept the Linap population small.’

‘Maybe that was by design,’ said Orcilla. 

‘That would be consistent with the actions of the Linap in the previous loops,’ replied Angelo.

‘The Sentray might have failed if the Capital Region had been properly defended,’ said Orcilla as she sat up straight with an enlightened look on her face. ‘Someone else wanted the Capital Region destroyed. The riots were an excuse to leave it undefended. Pardi had a cure for the Linap that they wanted stopped.’

‘Who are “they”?’ asked Yassmay, sounding confused.

‘“They” are whoever are behind what’s happening now in Downs,’ said Orcilla as she turned to Yassmay. ‘I think Lily might know who “they” might be.’

‘The true lesson of the loops,’ said Angelo. ‘Whatever has happened before will happen again in some form or other. That is why understanding our history, our true history, is so important.’

‘The higher power, what about the higher power?’ asked Yassmay. ‘You haven’t explained it yet.’

‘You are experiencing the higher power right now,’ replied Angelo as he grinned. ‘All that has been and is are expressions of the higher power.’

‘I don’t understand,’ replied Yassmay.

‘The higher power does not create the tangible,’ said Angelo as he raised his hands. ‘Does not create the rivers, the mountains, the ocean, the sky, or even any of the creatures that inhabit them. The higher power is the collective of everyone. It speaks to us through the words of others, our dreams, our thoughts, and our visions.’

Yassmay pulled a perplexed face.

‘Orcilla listened to my teachings, but she also drew on something else that stimulated her thoughts to help her understand her present,’ said Angelo as he leaned forward a little. ‘That was the higher power communicating to her, and she responded by drawing in the knowledge that it was imparting.’

‘Well, that’s fascinating,’ replied Yassmay, who looked at Orcilla, who was gently nodding.

‘Let us break for lunch,’ said Angelo. ‘There are a few more loops that I think you will find enlightening.’

A fruit platter lunch was brought in. Orcilla, Yassmay, and Angelo chatted for around half an hour. Then Angelo opened another book and began explaining loop three.

## Sapien Loop: Worlds Collide

![Loop_Series.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spectrumecons/23uFHJ6RctoaR7JdX6JCqpxxZqfbR1uEmwbcd6NoJfaiCzK5S3sGDs5tFqqvNGY7ouzYh.gif)

Sapien Loop: Worlds Collide is the final book in the Sapien Loop trilogy. It continues directly after the events of the second book. The world above and the world below merge into one world. The conflicts in the underground world are brought to the surface. The new ruling elite attempt to crush any resistance from above and below in an attempt to create a new global empire.

Currently, three books from the series have been published on Amazon; see the links below:

Wake to a grey day. Was up early to drive my wife to the station. She cannot drive with a moonboot on. Would-be a good way to jam in a more full day. Nope. Grey. Cold. Go back to get warm. With the prospect of a call to pick up from station, chose to stay home. Had been thinking pickle ball but timing was not great As it happened I was right - got the call when pickle ball would have been one. As it happens she got a taxi home. Walked to shops for a few things. Dropped the shopping off and did a steps walk ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/c22bf13f-3755-476e-9e69-4c3f312d9e2d.jpg) Autumn walks are camellia walks ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/aecd7ddb-c540-42bf-b443-8988b57384f1.jpg) A few colour flavours ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/d0b3a0fa-affa-4ff0-8538-ccb71344857f.jpg) Nestled in pink ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/9c8901b4-f69d-4c04-899f-480bccdd675b.jpg) My ladies tresses orchids started flowering at home # photos were out of focus but it does give me a signal to check the orchid man house down the road. Buds forming on these ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/801f8a9f-0243-4d45-b62d-a61edc7500e2.jpg) Oncidium is flowering - a burgundy version. Was not game to climb the fence for a close up. Never know what cameras are running. body.title: First-night Dinner: 100 montaditos [Eng][Esp]
body.body:
![IMG_9677.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23w2sRLfqFkGZtfeHgDGkKKvcbhf72DonPUEscTdX3Z1zx81VxmthLrms48g3X57zYrve.jpeg)
100 montaditos
Cervecería, montaditos y tapas
Rambla de Méndez Núñez, 28. Alicante, Spain
[//]:# (!worldmappin 38.34567 lat -0.48373 long d3scr)

> #HODAlicante kicked off with a bang, and when I say “a bang,” I'm not just talking about the great vibes, the event organization, or all the contests and activities we found out about during the welcome talk—I'm also talking about all the food you'd expect to try when you come to Spain. We got off to a great start in the event hall with a [fully catered spread] (https://peakd.com/hive-148309/@ninaeatshere/hod-alicante-so-we-got-the-party-started-engesp) that I personally enjoyed immensely—proof of this is that many of the photos of me out there show me constantly stationed at the catering bar, as if I were living there. I couldn’t miss out on the feast. But each venue had a time limit, and we’d planned to spend more time together outside the main venue, so we waited for instructions via Telegram and headed to the next stop at 8 p.m., where we’d have dinner together. The difficult thing in these kinds of situations—where some attendees arrive so exhausted from traveling that they can’t make it to dinner, or others arrive later from their trips—is that it’s very complicated to make a reservation in advance, so we had to find a place without much notice.
[Esp]
> Los #HODAlicante comenzaron con todo, y cuando me refiero a todo, no hablo solamente de las buenas bivras, la organización del evento o todos los concursos y actividades de los que nos enteramos en la charla bienvenida, sino tambien de toda la comida que te esperarías probar llegando a España.
Comenzamos muy bien en la sala de eventos con un [catering super completo](https://peakd.com/hive-148309/@ninaeatshere/hod-alicante-so-we-got-the-party-started-engesp) que yo particularmente disfruté muchísimo, prueba de ello es que, muchas de las fotos mías que hay por ahí, me retrataron continuamente apostada en la barra del catering, como si allí estuviera viviendo. No podía perderme el festín.
Pero cada espacio tenía su tiempo límite y habíamos planeado pasar más tiempo juntos fuera del recinto base, así que esperámos las indicaciones por Telegram y acudimos a la siguiente parada a las 20h, en donde cenaríamos juntos. Lo dificil en este tipo de situaciones, en las que algunos asistentes llegan tan agotados de viajar que no dan para unirse a la cena o que otros llegan de viaje mas tarde, es que se complica mucho hacer una reserva propia, así que había que conseguir un sitio sin mucho tiempo de antelación.
*authorized photo by @haastrecht
![IMG_0598.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23u695W9J3jwKPNMkw91h9YPTmn6yLMhy3KGygrRXd8EKJ76oDLneCpFHYBBzL4GQ5tBH.jpeg)
![IMG_9666.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23xAXxmcmYPdgg43SJkqst1SvE7G2q93RZik9nYZouNJJrsQKvwTU7vGSqBWPXnGqLCnF.jpeg)
The venue we chose for our first dinner was **100 Montaditos**, a popular tapas chain in Spain that, in addition to being known for its affordable prices, features spacious locations with plenty of tables. Just what we needed. Our idea was to find a place where we could all sit close together and stay within the event’s food budget, since, as is customary at these #BuzzParty events, a couple of dinners are included for attendees. For those unfamiliar with the chain—which can be hard to imagine, given its locations across several countries in Europe, North, and Central America—one of the things that makes this place appealing is its constant food and drink deals. Every day of the week there’s a bargain to be had, and if you want to unwind without worrying too much about your wallet, this is the perfect spot. When we arrived, we asked for a large table on the second floor of the restaurant, which was less crowded, since the outdoor terrace and the main dining room were packed. Although all the tables are quite small, they let us push several of them together so we could sit as a group, even though we were three different party groups. It was **Double-Up Thursday**, and that worked out perfectly for us! Two appetizer portions for the price of one, with the option to choose different items. It was great for those who were hungry, and for those of us who weren’t—since we’d stuffed ourselves at the buffet earlier—it was a good way to share with someone else and stay within our budget, including drinks. We spent a while figuring out the wide range of options on the menu, which was conveniently printed on each table, but after double-checking with the waiter about the daily special, we decided that ordering the double portions was much more appealing to all of us. However, the name of the place refers to the hundreds of versions of the mini sandwiches offered, called *montaditos*, but after the previous feast, we weren’t really in the mood to eat a lot of bread.
[Esp]
> El destino elegido para nuestra primera cena fue **100 Montaditos**, una cadena de tapas muy común en España que, además de ser famosa por sus precios accesibles, cuenta con locales muy amplios y gran cantidad de mesas. Justo lo que necesitabamos.
Nuestra idea era contar con un lugar en donde pudieramos sentarnos todos cerca y que se mantuviera dentro del presupuesto del evento destinado a la comida, pues como es costumbre en estos eventos de #BuzzParty, hay un par de cenas incluidas para los asistentes.
Para los que desconozcan la cadena, que a veces resulta difícil de imaginar, teniendo sucursales en varios países de Europa, Norte y Centro América; una de las cosas que hace atractivo a este sitio son las perennes ofertas en comida y bebida que ofrecen, cada día de la semana hay algún chollo que aprovechar y, si lo que deseas es desconectar sin preocuparte mucho por el bolsillo, este es un sitio ideal para hacerlo.
All llegar consultamos por una mesa grande en la segunda planta del local, que estaba más desocupada, pues la terraza exterior y la sala principal estaban abarrotadas, y aunque todas las mesas son pequeñitas, nos dejaron juntar muchas de estas para sentarnos juntos, y sin embargo ocupabamos tres grupos diferentes.
¡Nos tocó **Jueves de Doblemanía** y esto nos venía súper bien! Dos raciones de entradas por el precio de una y con opción de que fuesen diferentes. Para los que estuviesen hambrientos estaba genial y para los que no tanto, por habernos atiborrado en el buffet de antes, era una buena táctica para compartir con alguien más y ajustarnos al presupuesto, incluyéndo las bebidas.
Estuvimos un rato comprendiendo la amplia gama de opciones en el menú, que estaba convenientemente impreso sobre cada mesa, pero luego de asegurarnos preguntando al camarero sobre la promo del día, concluímos que pedir las doble raciones nos interesaba mucho más a todos. Sin embargo, el nombre del lugar hace referencia a los cientos de versiones que disponen de los mini emparedados ofrecidos llamados *montaditos*, pero tras la comilona previa, no había muchos animos de comer mucho pan.
![IMG_9664.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23uQzjtMmsKw8a3k5z1Z12F7AfPqmvknLNaQp9yYZW3Y6yxtkD6vweFpKiYZ5suYjNjTW.jpeg)|![IMG_9667.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23x1BKWMJdxvVCGBwGzeaeu33LyXrFeZH59eTeXe9poA3WZwg2rV2aM8bssjAky7TWueS.jpeg) --|-- ![IMG_9670.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/EoK7miZMbBGihm9KciGk21drXkTH7CtLcZo9PJW1sK1P8duck5B3rF8Tm1xk5ZRfYgN.jpeg)
![IMG_9668.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23xL2zikBy4AZWZttWAHaoekRodTjf9cH8XrNv2Mqhkgs3jDS3XPqfQFterHvZUkFjWqq.jpeg)
When it came time to order, we each went to the counter separately to place our orders; after all, this restaurant chain operates like a typical fast-food joint, where you have to go to the counter to order and then pick up your order at the counter when it’s ready. To do this, they give you one of those pagers that beeps and flashes when your food is ready. The average wait from the time we ordered until the food was ready was about 15 minutes—not bad for a place that was absolutely packed. But we enjoyed our first drinks while we waited, since they serve them right at the counter when you order your food. In my case, I shared some dishes with @palomap3, and we decided on one of Iberian Cebo pork shoulder ham and the other of ham croquettes—yes, I went a little overboard because I’d been craving Spanish ham ever since I got back. We’re not going to get too picky about the food review—I used to go to *100 Montaditos* all the time back in my university days, and it is what it is: a laid-back spot to hang out with friends, grab some snacks, and have a cheap drink. Still, I don’t dislike it—the ham was pretty decent, and while the croquettes didn’t stand out for their depth of flavor, they were crispy on the outside, which was exactly what I was in the mood for at the time. For how cheap the place is, the quality of these dishes is more than fine. As for drinks, again, since they offer cheap beer mugs, they’re not going to serve anything craft or premium. The most popular options are the Cruz Campo beer mug or the sangria mug, and while they’re very cheap, for just 50 cents more you can order an Águila beer mug, which I like much more than the first option—that was my choice that night. What you have to give them credit for is that all the taps are nice and cold and the pitchers are pre-chilled; the first sip of beer felt incredibly refreshing, and the beer stayed at a good temperature much longer than I expected.
[Esp]
> Al momento de ordenar la comida fuimos cada uno por separado a la caja para pedir, a fin de cuentas esta cadena de restaurantes funciona como el típico lugar de comida rápidas, en donde debes ir a ordenar a la caja y también recoger tu pedido en el mostrador cuando esté listo. Para ello te dan un busca de esos que suena y da luces al momento de avisarte que tu comida ya está lista.
El tiempo medio desde que ardenamos hasta que el pedido estuvo listo, fue de unos 15 minutos aproximadamente, nada mal para un local que estaba sumamente lleno. Pero las primeras bebidas las fuimos disfrutando mientras esperábamos, pues las sirven directamente en el mostrador cuando pides la comida.
En mi caso, compartí raciones con @palomap3 y nos decidimos por una de jamón de Paleta de Cebo Ibérica y la otra de croquetas de jamón, sí, me salí un poco con la mía porque tenía añoranza de los jamones Españoles desde mi regreso.
No nos vamos a poner muy escrupulosos en cuanto a la reseña gastronómica, he estado muchas veces en los *100 montaditos* en mi época de estudiante y es lo que es, un lugar desenfadado al que ir a juntarse con amigos con algo de picar y beber barato. Aún así, no me desagrada, el jamón estaba bastante decente y aunque las croquetas no destacaban por su profundidad de sabor, estaban crujiente spor fuera, que era lo que me apetecía en el momento. Para lo barato que está el sitio, la calidad de estás raciones está más que bien.
En cuanto a las bebidas, nuevamente, para tener acceso a jarras de cerveza barata, no van a servir nada artesanal o premiun. Las opciones mas populares son la jarra de cerveza Cruz Campo o la de Sangría y aunque son muy baratas, por solo 50 céntimos más se puede pedir una jarra de cerveza Águila, que me gusta mucho más que la primera opción, esta última fue mi eleeción esa noche. Lo que hay que reconocerles es que tienen todos los grifos bien frios y las jarras heladas previamente, el primer sorbo de cerveza se sintió muy sumamente refrescante y la cerveza se mantuvo a buena temperatura mucho más tiempo del que yo me esperaba.
![IMG_9671.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23xAeGzRnMidN1KgYXc5otB6ve3oV3xohfdsdZnGS5ujyk36eXiyoJ6KM37b33DhNCy2G.jpeg)| ![IMG_9673.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23wgSRuUzKxCtCY6oZJ4Za7z63K4XcR1fZD58ZfXn6hX7yCJDdrJW3iA6o9rjKavHDrw4.jpeg) --|-- ![IMG_9676.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23vsQPS5FxLgt8uyxEt5Z4hzqTVw782zAt9NJTLLS6pWBqRUPCzGL6DcamCCM67Mpjzvn.jpeg) ![IMG_9675.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/EoCjbnUQw3sAcK3KfgaURP5LTqgxk5WfjWiYzNFVd2PNM5tLJ2KyXrgdWq7oWZexX9r.jpeg)
![IMG_9669.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23x1Huii5Lue2nHkXdTKMye7k1F4LFwAJD9WVaiPNm5NTw5Uz6gqnE27Pips5Vtaj2yiK.jpeg)
We ate and drank to our hearts’ content for a couple of hours, chatting about a little bit of everything on this first day of our gathering and feeling encouraged by how promising the coming days looked. Although what was evident in most of us was the typical fatigue from the previous hours of travel—not everyone, though, since some had been proactive and decided to arrive at the destination a few days early—but many others, including myself, needed to recover from the long hours of travel to get to Alicante.
After a couple of hours, we decided to call it a night; we had to get a good night’s rest since the next day would be when the main part of the program would take place. A clock atop a building read 10:01 p.m. and signaled a pleasant night with a temperature of 21 degrees Celsius, inviting us to stroll carefree through the streets, which were filled with people just beginning their night of partying.
Before leaving, we all had to make sure to send @tibfox the receipt for the payment we made in person, so he could transfer the reimbursement of up to €10 via hbd. My bill was only €10.50, so practically all my expenses were within the budget.
It was decided to issue a refund to each user afterward, because it was an easier way to keep track of individual expenses and ensure that no additional items were overlooked. After all, we were a large group, and any method that helps minimize errors is always welcome.
Below is a screenshot of the reimbursement, received a few days after the event ended, following verification of receipts, expenses, and attendance. 11.78 BHD, which is equivalent to 10€.
[Esp]
> Comimos y bebimos a gusto durante un par de horas, comentando un poco de todo en este primer día de encuentro y animados por lo prometedor que se mostraban los proximos días. Aunque lo que se evidenciaba en la mayoría de todos, era el cansancio típico de las previas horas de viaje, no de todos, pues algunos habían sido previsivos y habían decidido llegar unos días antes al destino, pero muchos otro, incluyéndome, necesitabamos recuperarnos de muchas horas viajando para llegar a Alicante.
Luego de un par de horas decidimos dar la noche por terminada, teníamos que descansar bien pues el día seguiente sería aquel en el que el contenido grueso del programa tendría lugar. Un reloj en lo alto de un edificio marcaba las 22:01 horas y nos avisaba de una noche agradable con 21 grados celsius, invitándonos a caminar despreocupadamente por las calles, llenas de gente que apenas estaba dando inicio a su jornada de juerga nocturna.
Antes de irnos, todos debiamos cuidarnos deenviarle a @tibfox el recibo del pago que hicimos personalmente, así este podría transferirnos en hbd el reembolso del precio pagado de hasta 10€. Mi cuenta fueron tan solo 10,50 € así que practicamente todo mi gasto entraba dentro del presupuesto.
Se decidió hacer un reembolso posterior a cada usuario, porque era una forma mas fácil de llevar cuenta de los gastos individuales y de no dejar pasar por alto algún item adicional, al final eramos un grupo grande y cualquier manera que ayude a minimizar errores siempre será bienvenida.
Abajo adjunto la captura de pantalla del reembolso, recibido dias después de haber finalizado el evento, tras comprobar los recibos, consumos y participación. 11,78 hbd que corresponden al valor de 10€. ![IMG_0803.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/244Ur9kMGEJX4edndpgZ1LPEKrz8qv9jvZntPPY8eaAp7wt9X8nGQRR7SCxhaGABcxAPn.jpeg) ![IMG_9682.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23xVCz7ZDaJywNioRoS1tgBEDwSbXwPSeoZdPHdQEba2RpQhk1Gn4aF4nuZPgFS7D5rgV.jpeg)|![IMG_9681.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/242ri8UPNhuDrd9PWmTmjdPx3APYJSrsrAVbwdwW7s9Fn5sBdHNXrXCQ1p3aNzo48ZkXD.jpeg) --|--
![IMG_0806.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23viCkeLQoJYBRjyzFyZHSEzLywPavAh3GeVwSwvNuue75rhurMSipwgRVofDyqiwvqUB.jpeg)
Just before we said goodbye, @honeydue came up to me with one of the sweetest surprises of the whole trip: a friendship bracelet personalized just for me.😍
I’m sure the @worldmappin team will love it too, since she combined the two things I came here to represent—both the team itself and the Hispanic community at #HiveOpenDays—in the friendship bracelet, as shown in the event’s slogan, “vamos.” The bracelet says “Go worldmappin” and it couldn’t be cuter! ❤️
I plan to wear it all the time. I thought it was such a lovely gesture, with all the colors, the little blue heart in the team’s color, and the happy face that makes me smile every time I look at it on my wrist; it’s also a reminder of how important we users are within the Hive ecosystem, and of the support and affection we manage to convey even though we’ve barely seen or known each other. It’s unconditional and fills you with motivation to face whatever comes your way, until you get to attend the next meetup with all these wonderful people. Thank you so much, honey, you’re the best! 🤘
[Esp]
> Poco antes de despedirnos @honeydue se acercó a mí con una de las sorpresas más bonitas de todos estos días: un brazalete de la amistad personalizado para mí.😍
Estoy segura que al equipo de @worldmappin también le encantará, pues ella unió en el brazalete de la amistad las dos cosas que yo venía a representar aquí, tanto al equipo mismo como a la comunidad hispana en los #HiveOpenDays, que se muestra en la parte de la consigna del evento \

¡y no podía ser más bonita! ❤️
Pienso llevarla conmigo todo el tiempo. Me ha parecido un detalle tan bonito, con todos los colores, el corazoncito azul del color del equipo y la carita feliz que me hace sonreir cada vez que la miro en mi muñeca; además es un recordatorio de la gran importancia que tenemos los usuarios dentro del ecosistema de Hive, del apoyo y cariño que logramos transmitirnos con a penas vernos o conocernos. Es incondicional y hace que uno se llene de mmotivación para afrontar todo lo que venga, hasta conseguir asistir al siguiente encuentro con toda esta gente tan bonita. ¡Muchas gracias honey, eres la mejor! ![IMG_9683.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/EoK6GtjN8XcLt3zqcNndubFJoPKxHVPnGPKCQfmRRpSRKCMWZHrz6W5zhKVVbzrb853.jpeg)
![IMG_0804.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23wgHHn3cQ5tZdUkGwVhzn44tDH9rzdeC4Jq8g7oqQ8xz8stj6vmKKMc8Ydrph7EQgj1b.png)
Thanks for dropping by! [![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/AJmthV3QiiU3f2pVE2wEzBrLJp6AYgFwbB9WWqWFhA7ta3ejN2BcFkpbhTLDCQb.png)](https://www.instagram.com/ninaeatshere/) | [![11053969_x_logo_twitter_new_brand_icon.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/AJbhBb9Ev3i1cHKtjoxtsCAaXK9njP56dzMwBRwfZVZ21WseKsCa6ZkfAbLGnbh.png)](https://twitter.com/ninaeatshere) | [![1865606_books_ebooks_g_goodreads_read_icon copia.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/AJpkUkMYpoVBmYDWsVtg7vaddiSqbMufvdoJ6w3FbzbvNTbkC6fgma1R8b47CMn.jpg)](https://www.goodreads.com/user/show/5981918-nina) [ ![Proudly member of the curation team](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://worldmappin.com/notify.png?1) ](https://peakd.com/c/hive-163772/created) Free Icons from: [Iconfinder](https://www.iconfinder.com/) Block screenshot: [Hive Hub Dev](https://hivehub.dev/) Event ticket: Acquired through [Buzzparty](https://peakd.com/hive-148309/@buzzparty/h-i-v-e-o-243f194886b02) Photo credits: Unless otherwise noted, the photos in this post were taken by me, with my iPhone 11, and belong to me.

body.title: [Eng./Esp.]   Why do I choose peace over reason?   ||   ¿Por qué elijo tener paz y no la razón?
body.body:
*** *** #
Si eres de habla hispana, la versión en español es mejor para ti; debes hacer clic 👉 [**AQUÍ**](#english)
*** ***
# ***
***

> Sowing the seed, not as one performing a ritual, but as one who breathes: *without thinking about it, because it is necessary*. This week has struck me right in the chest with its intensity, and amidst all the global clamour, that phrase took hold of me like a gentle yet firm necessity: *if I do not sow today, what empty hands will I have tomorrow?*
# ***
Why do I choose peace over reason?
*** I live far from my homeland, but I carry it in my gaze, in that lump that sometimes forms in my throat when I think of my loved ones. And though the future is a thick fog, I still believe that every kind gesture, every word that chooses peace over reason, is a seed that falls on fertile ground. It’s not about winning arguments, but about building bridges; about understanding that the other person is also carrying their own storm.
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/245TGLtfWqb51yDxKiY4B8XkWJWm6nfL5c8pir8wbQzTRa4BUcSMe4LCgDg7ecpPBCQDT.jpeg)
Today I gave up my seat on the VIA Rail Canada, I listened without interrupting, I smiled at the stranger who seemed to be carrying the weight of the world on his shoulders. Small acts, yes, but they are the ones that weave the web that sustains us when everything is shaking. Sowing the seed does not guarantee a harvest, I know, but sowing is an act of faith, of defiance against cynicism, of love for what might be. I want my hands to smell of damp earth, not of a clenched fist. May my legacy not be having the last word, but having left a corner of the world a little more liveable. And when time has passed and the accounts are settled, they will not ask me how many battles I won, but how many seeds I entrusted to the wind with hope. And I, dear life, want to answer with hands full of furrows, not excuses. So I will sow, even if it hurts, even if it tires me. Because in every seed lies a piece of my peace, and that is the only reason I have left. *** ***

> Come and participate, there's still time. You can find all the information daily in the [#Freewritehouse](https://peakd.com/c/hive-161155/created) Community. Specifically, today's prompt post:

[PROMPT: «scatter the seed»](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@daily.prompt/13-may-2026-freewriters-community-daily-writing-prompt-day-3102-scatter-the-seed)

*** ***
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/23swkfAXGs5WxHg49jyEWGAanWReDpMUQbxUB4FYX98iMaztGejMtj5HJUN6abwpCZhUN.png)

*** *** ### **
Dedicated to all those writers who contribute, day by day, to making our planet a better world.
** *** ***
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/23vhudAgmrPvXnYXzmsiD5366jktCLxdeWqxFQg2nCeezVK4yv7CJ9dQpSevYb8nEeqTR.png) https://images.ecency.com/0x0/https://images.ecency.com/DQmbdpsZFqtrcoLk94sUV8oHkjnx8PAdgfACMfJ9UpcriNF/perfil2026_hecho_con_clipchamp_2_.gif
*** *** ***

> Esparcir la semilla, pero no como quien cumple un ritual, sino como quien respira: *sin pensarlo, porque es necesario*. Esta semana me ha golpeado el pecho con su intensidad, y en medio de tanto ruido mundial, esa frase se me clavó como una suave pero firme necesidad: *si no siembro hoy, ¿qué manos vacías tendré mañana?*
# ***
¿Por qué elijo tener paz y no la razón?
*** Vivo lejos de mi tierra, pero la llevo en la mirada, en ese nudo que a veces se me hace en la garganta cuando pienso en los míos. Y aunque el futuro sea una niebla espesa, sigo creyendo que cada gesto amable, cada palabra que elige la paz por encima de la razón, es una semilla que cae en tierra fértil. No se trata de ganar discusiones, sino de tender puentes; de entender que el otro también carga su propia tormenta.
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/242Y3kmXkCsSAgLqqsQLx3yN7JU2NuVDjKaBgUg1nZaaKJUhStnmeQqZsZ5bMvxSrPxmZ.jpeg)
Hoy cedí el paso en el VIA Rail Canada, escuché sin interrumpir, sonreí al extraño que parecía cargar el mundo sobre sus hombros. Pequeños actos, sí, pero son esos los que tejen la red que nos sostiene cuando todo tiembla. Esparcir la semilla no garantiza la cosecha, lo sé, pero sembrar es un acto de fe, de rebeldía contra el cinismo, de amor por lo que podría ser. Quiero que mis manos huelan a tierra mojada, no a puño cerrado. Que mi legado no sea tener la última palabra, sino haber dejado un rincón del mundo un poco más habitable. Y, cuando el tiempo pase y las cuentas se ajusten, no me preguntarán cuántas batallas gané, sino cuántas semillas confié al viento con esperanza. Y yo, amiga vida, quiero responder con las manos llenas de surcos, no de excusas. Esparcir, pues, aunque duela, aunque canse. Porque en cada semilla va un pedazo de mi paz, y esa es la única razón que me queda.
*** ***

body.title: MCGI Topic Review | Is being a single mother acceptable in the eyes of God
body.body: > https://youtu.be/l13EhMBseRY?si=9QXE2PJ1f1bcyvV_ The question, whether it is acceptable in the sight of God to be a single mother or not? is something that touched my heart. When I perceive life, I realize that not all things are ideal. There are single mothers who had to become single mothers due to various reasons such as death, separation or errors. However, there is one thing that I have realized and that is God is full of mercy and compassion. He does not turn away people due to their circumstances. The Bible says in Psalm 68:5, “A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.” This indicates to me that God is concerned about people who are lonely and have heavy burdens. I have also learned that God looks in the heart and not the condition that someone is in. In 1 Samuel 16:7, the Bible says, “Man looketh on the outward appearance, but the Lord looketh on the heart.” This makes me feel better since it assures me that God is aware of all the difficulties and all the pains that a single mother experiences. He observes her struggle, her tears, and her sacrifices in raising her child well. This was the moment that I observed a woman who was so close to me; she became a single mother. People criticized her and talked negatively of her condition. I was depressed and disoriented. But I also beheld how powerful she was. She labored, prayed daily, and did her best to bring up her child in the fear of God. Seeing her made me understand that being a single mother does not imply that one is rejected by God. Rather it made me understand that God could provide strength to any person who relied on Him. But I also know that God had a perfect plan of a family, that man and woman should raise their children together. In Genesis 2:24, we see the coming together of husband and wife. However, in the event that life should not take that path God can still offer his grace. In Romans 8:1, we read, There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus. This informs me that God does not judge those who resort and live a righteous life. I believe in my heart that a single mother, who fears God, lives in righteousness and raises her child with love is okay in the sight of God. God sees her effort and will reward her. I also reckon that rather than judging, I should embrace love, support and encouragement. Ultimately, a pure heart which strives to seek God daily is what matters to God more than the outward appearance of the person seeking God.

body.title: Colonial Havana in the Plaza of the Catedral [EN/ES]
body.body:
![InShot_20260512_184622742.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/243qFRfnEgLeuaGpTd6YiNzAAbPqhuMou6uYFq2Vz5qB6uTFaPWjSN5U67i42K4nNg67E.jpg) English Version On my visit to Old Havana I always like to pass by the Plaza of the Catedral. Although I have been there more than once, I never stop admiring on each visit the atmosphere of the place. It is incredible how they have managed to preserve that style of old and colonial city that so attracts all visitors to Havana. # ![1778624673506-01.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/EqWmF5YjB798BJmosv2SuEL6CrNkVkaRBt2GozexyFuYpVcRb74tnxqUbuaPRmTmEod.jpeg) # ![1778625138631-01.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/241tZCru6FSce4QtuagynwiMYr2A1yCZNUj4AD7BUhmTuwZtitWSdq4M1MS12DpCFkCBn.jpeg)
The square is wide, cobblestoned, and when I stand in the middle I feel something special. Being surrounded by so much history and so much art impresses me. Knowing that through this site have passed over the years such different Cubans: bishops, rich merchants, counts, slaves, and every inhabitant throughout the centuries, amazes me and makes me feel a little insignificant, but in a beautiful way, as if I were stepping on something very important. Here I always find something new to admire, or rather, something old to remember. # ![1778625344612-01.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/23y8onVGFbJxoFPPyUffMNtDkDUK5fnVVbLmFGucFxkLvUMg6c6PoTSTnyxtSWwua4rdd.jpeg) # ![1778624986832-01.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/23uQvjc52bPvVth5YTo2C8m84ZqvvZzRDBjkhGTVcBKuQHjpf5irUe9YNFLoj6Mar97cq.jpeg)
The most notable thing about the place is, without a doubt, the Cathedral, the building for which this site is known. The Cathedral is majestic and absolutely beautiful. It not only impresses for the imposing nature of its structure from the outside but also for the beauty of its interior. But the square is not only the Cathedral: around it there are other buildings and mansions that have been restored and preserved with such care that they seem frozen in time, and that can currently be visited, since they house museums and art galleries. # ![1778625256163-01.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/242NexjVESdkGJ5C2zMHHtfZVEKqjZy2hAN7nmkvVXqFp3bRNn9SSdMNg9dE9HhXCbqyA.jpeg) # ![1778625455127-01.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/Ep5mj7fMZiLG145xY8dTj5oNiZN1QwGeR2Yk62ATkkd35KutY2zFPmcYYADzukF8peG.jpeg) # ![1778624897734-01.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/23sUCKLz7C1dD44bBxtYkvnABeKb8BJsRjyQkLD8rCJUP6VMZG5F21DSS6nocMHZasJTG.jpeg) It is very pleasant to find here that the atmosphere of the place also remains alive. This is, moreover, a tourist area and one of the attractions is to preserve the traditions of life just as the habaneros lived it in other centuries. In spite of the tourists, the photos and the cameras, the square keeps its essence. That is why we can see women wearing the typical dresses of the time, with colorful scarves in their hair. Some sell flowers, others read the fortune of the visitors and of anyone who has the courage to want to know what awaits them. The Plaza de la Catedral always manages to surprise me. I, as a habanera, feel proud that we still have a place like this, so well preserved and with so much personality. Each time I go I am left with the same feeling: this is the real Havana, the one that does not go out of fashion. # ![1778624762680-01.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/EqHxyc6Rc4BwTe6x99MBCeyVY5CS9DqucDrUUxZtkM6L4fwn9cFtjYW4X2cQZqpTWCg.jpeg) I hope you have enjoyed this tour. Cheers and until next time!
Versión en Español

En mi visita a la Habana Vieja siempre me gusta pasar por la Plaza de la Catedral. Aunque he estado allí más de una vez, nunca dejo de admirar en cada visita el ambiente del lugar. Es increíble cómo han sabido conservar ese estilo de ciudad antigua y colonial que tanto atrae de La Habana a todos los visitantes. La plaza es amplia, adoquinada, y cuando me paro en medio siento algo especial. Estar rodeada de tanta historia y tanto arte me impresiona. Saber que por este sitio han transitado a lo largo de los años cubanos tan diferentes: obispos, ricos comerciantes, condes, esclavos y cada habitante a lo largo de los siglos, me admira y me hace sentir un poco insignificante, pero de una manera bonita, como si estuviera pisando algo muy importante. Aquí siempre encuentro algo nuevo que admirar, o mejor dicho, algo antiguo que recordar. Lo más notable del lugar es sin duda, la Catedral, la edificación por la que se conoce este sitio. La Catedral es majestuosa y absolutamente hermosa. No solo impresiona por lo imponente de su estructura desde afuera sino también por la belleza de su interior. Pero la plaza no es solo la Catedral, a su alrededor hay otros edificios y palacetes que han sido restaurados y conservados con tanto cuidado que parecen congelados en el tiempo, y que actualmente se pueden recorrer, pues guardan museos y galerías de arte. Es muy agradable encontrarnos aquí con que también el ambiente del lugar se mantiene vivo. Esta es además, una zona turística y una de las atracciones es preservar las tradiciones de la vida tal como la vivían los habaneros de otros siglos. A pesar de los turistas, de las fotos y las cámaras, la plaza mantiene su esencia. Por eso podemos ver a las mujeres vistiendo los típicos vestidos de la época, con pañuelos coloridos en sus cabellos. Unas venden flores, otras leen la fortuna a los visitantes y a cualquiera que tenga el coraje de querer saber qué le espera. La Plaza de la Catedral siempre logra sorprenderme. Yo como habanera, me siento orgullosa de que todavía tengamos un lugar así, tan bien conservado y con tanta personalidad. Cada vez que voy me quedo con la misma sensación, esto es La Habana de verdad, la que no pasa de moda. Espero que hayan disfrutado de este recorrido. Un Saludo, y hasta la próxima!

body.title: Листівка для сина
body.body:
![IMG_20260513_082839.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shady/23vsSmiFHHsagbETttG7rhiDsVcxLBG5sUKAc33QBcgCjQGwcRmLMqhdXssuAHhCKgT8D.jpg)

Привіт друзі! От тільки вчора відбувся виступ класу мого сина. Точніше, це навіть ще не клас (перший), а група так званих “п’ятирічок” (бо в перший клас ідуть у шість років, тому така назва) — щось середнє між садочком і підготовкою до школи. Вчителька (вихователька? 🤔) організувала для дітлахів невеличке свято до Дня матері. Але про це я ще не хочу розповідати, бо то окрема історія, і вона варта окремого допису. Можливо, завтра, якщо матиму час, то обов’язково поділюся 🙂

А сьогодні я хотіла похвалитися іншим — тим, яку листівку ми разом із сином зробили для його вчительки, адже сьогодні в неї день народження (тому я і згадала про вчорашній день).

Батьки вирішили, що буде гарно, якщо кожна дитина зробить щось своїми руками. Маркіян намалював власне листівку — такого кумедного чудіка 🤪. Це його авторське бачення себе: кремезний хлопчина, дуже серйозний і водночас милий (мабуть щось у стилі однієї із своїх ігор на планшеті). 

А я вирішила додати до листівки трохи “родзинки” й зробити маленький букетик із сухоцвітів. Ви знаєте, що я дуже люблю всілякі такі речі: вінки, сухоцвіти, шишки, декоративні композиції. ☺️ І мій головний помічник у цьому — клейовий пістолет, який плавить силіконові стрижні й дозволяє швиденько склеювати між собою різні дрібнички.
Тож сьогодні я взялася до роботи: зробила маленький букетик, приклеїли його до листівки — усе швиденько, бо вже треба було бігти проводжати сина на шкільний автобус. І, звісно ж, у цій метушні я забула вимкнути клейовий пістолет 🙈

Чоловік потім трохи сварився. Хоча, чесно кажучи, нічого страшного б не сталося — я ж нікуди далеко не їхала і все одно швидко повернулася додому. Але звичка в мене така справді є: можу забути вимкнути праску чи ще щось подібне. Треба з тим щось робити 😕.

![IMG_20260513_082900.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shady/23vsLXdhrAesDVnTeTXYNaeKZezCy66MuivZoG7agpGCkj9HqgcKesV8FMhhofZ9hKHCj.jpg)

body.title: The Best Era
body.body:
/>  
Every generation believes it is living through either the greatest age or the worst one. The past becomes a romanticized period when we examine history because we create an image of peaceful villages, stronger family bonds, and simpler lives which enable deeper human connections. The future receives our admiration because of its technological advancements and innovative developments which create limitless future possibilities. So, are we truly living in the best era?  
  
In my opinion, this era is one of the best times to be alive, though not a perfect one. Human history has always been filled with struggle. People from hundreds of years ago faced deadly diseases without medicine and traveled for months to reach nearby lands while only possessing limited educational opportunities. Even our ancestors who lived close to nature endured hunger, wars, and harsh living conditions. The most significant accomplishment became the ability to stay alive.  
  
The world has undergone remarkable changes because of contemporary technological advancements. We possess the power to connect with anyone worldwide through our handheld devices which enable us to discover knowledge online and express our thoughts without restriction. Medical science has increased life expectancy and transportation has established connections between continentswhile information has become accessible to almost all people. The opportunities which once belonged to kings and wealthy individuals have become available to everyone.

People today face multiple difficult challenges which they must address in their daily existence. People experience loneliness even though they maintain continuous online connections. The use of social media platforms establishes a system which requires users to make social comparisons which leads to their developing anxiety symptoms. The world moves so fast that people experience difficulties which make it hard to achieve mental serenity. Environmental pollution together with climate change and violent conflicts continue to endanger human existence. We now possess greater ease of use but we experience difficulties because modern technologies have made life less straightforward.  
The present time presents all the knowledge together with freedom and opportunities which I value. The past provides me knowledge which I use to experience current modern day benefits. The present era needs our efforts because we must work to enhance our existing time for better results. People should stop desiring different birth periods because they should dedicate their efforts to building a better future from their current period.  
The best era may not be defined by technology, wealth, or power alone. The way humans use their time for creating kindness and progress and building understanding defines this attribute. Every generation experiences both beautiful and painful moments but this current generation possesses the capability to study past events and create better future outcomes. I experience happiness because I live in this specific time period.

body.title: How confident are you?
body.body:
>

I was talking with a friend the other day that I am becoming increasingly insecure, even in areas where previously I was quite confident in my skills due to experience and feedback. What I find interesting about it is that there are many people who are confident despite lack of experience and feedback pointing to incompetence. Is it delusional confidence or is it a strategy that helps them navigate their shortcomings and helps them overcome? 

---



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tarazkp/23xyrLc8vg1xLETaVhDXaa7MWLixy1osiSYaNJhbNuqcFAr9yUjGmhwuV3BEG9Yjw1H7u.png)



---

The other thing I find interesting about it, is how a lack of confidence in one area can lead to profound effects on other areas. For example, I have a friend who is highly skilled in their field, but also very self-conscious of being quite overweight. While she tries to lean into her skillset, obtrusive thoughts about her weight come in any time she facing any kind of situation she deems as negative, like getting professional feedback on some of her ideas. She can't help feel it is \
even when it most likely has nothing to do with it at all. \n\n> \

Because her own weight is constantly at the forefront of her mind, it has become her hammer, her lens through which she views everything. When things go well she feels she has overcome despite her weight, and when they don't, she has failed due to her weight. It doesn't really matter what the subject is, pretty much everything is anchored to her weight insecurities, which is why body image is so important, but also something that we should severely limit in importance. 

But it is our focal image about anything that is going to become our lens, whether it be our financial position, the colour of our skin, our education, our perception of beauty, our height, or a million other possible points. We accept that for instance, there is such a things as \

where short *men* overcompensate for their stature with aggressive, domineering and overly ambitious behaviour - though Napoleon was actually of average height for his time. Yet, pretty much *anything* can become a complex and how it \

in an individual can vary a great deal. While I have never been very confident as a whole, I have been confident in some aspects of my life, but have had those same areas impacted heavily by external influences. For example, when I was young I had a lot of confidence in my physical abilities, but through chronic illness at 16, I became bedridden within a few months - taking away any confidence I had. But at least I had my mental prowess, only to lose that due to a stroke five years ago. > This is what has been leeching my confidence heavily. At the same time though, there are people who are *supremely confident* even though they don't have close to the abilities I currently have. They just don't care. Yet, I question whether it is a better life to be confidence without warrant under a dunning-Kruger effect, or be somewhat insecure and understand limitations. From moment to moment my intuition tells me it is better to be confident, but then I also see some very confident people continually getting themselves into trouble because they don't view the reality of a situation and align poorly in behaviour. > What about you? Are you generally confident in yourself, or generally insecure? I think that I have moved from *somewhat confident* down to *somewhat insecure,* and I notice it impacting on my thoughts and behaviours, where I spend a lot more effort interrogating decisions that in the past would have been made far more easily, especially when they carry low cost of failure. I assume being extremely insecure would be quite debilitating and while it might present as aggression, I suspect it would more likely result in self-exclusion instead. A bit like my friend who avoids any activity where she feels she may be judged on her physical abilities, even with friends. >Is it important at all? I am interested to hear what your relationship with confidence has been so far, and some of the reasons for changing dynamics and shifts over time. What do you think is valuable about being confident or not, and how do you think an individual can best utilise it in their daily life.
