body.title: Modificador de Letras: Como Criar Nicks Criativos e Bios Estilosas Para Jogos e Redes Sociais
body.body:
forma como uma pessoa escreve seu nome na internet virou parte da sua identidade digital. Em jogos competitivos, plataformas sociais e aplicativos de conversa, os detalhes fazem diferença. Um simples apelido pode ganhar muito mais destaque quando recebe um toque visual criativo. [Letras estilizadas,](https://modificadordeletras.art/) símbolos modernos e fontes diferenciadas ajudam qualquer perfil a parecer mais original, memorável e chamativo.

Nos últimos anos, milhões de jogadores passaram a procurar maneiras de transformar seus nicks em algo mais exclusivo. Isso acontece porque nomes comuns acabam ficando repetitivos dentro dos jogos e das redes sociais. Em ambientes competitivos como Free Fire, PUBG e Fortnite, muitos usuários querem transmitir personalidade apenas pelo visual do nome. Um nick estiloso consegue chamar atenção rapidamente em partidas, rankings, chats e transmissões ao vivo.

Além do universo gamer, perfis do Instagram, TikTok, Facebook e WhatsApp também ganharam uma nova tendência: o uso de letras decorativas. Bios criativas passaram a se destacar mais entre milhares de contas semelhantes. Influenciadores, criadores de conteúdo e até pequenas marcas utilizam textos personalizados para criar uma presença visual mais forte.

Uma das maiores vantagens dos modificadores de letras online está na facilidade de uso. Em poucos segundos, qualquer palavra pode ser convertida em dezenas de estilos diferentes. O usuário simplesmente escreve o texto desejado, escolhe o formato que mais combina com sua personalidade e copia instantaneamente para utilizar onde quiser.

Esse processo eliminou a necessidade de instalar programas complicados ou aplicativos pesados. Hoje, tudo pode ser feito diretamente pelo navegador, de forma rápida e gratuita. Isso permitiu que pessoas sem experiência com design também pudessem criar nomes visualmente impressionantes.

Outro fator importante é a enorme variedade de estilos disponíveis. Algumas pessoas preferem letras elegantes e minimalistas, enquanto outras gostam de símbolos ousados e combinações mais chamativas. Existem fontes inspiradas em escrita cursiva, caracteres futuristas, formatos góticos, letras pequenas, estilos japoneses, símbolos decorativos e muito mais.

Os jogadores de Free Fire, por exemplo, costumam buscar nicks capazes de intimidar adversários ou transmitir um visual profissional. Já usuários do Instagram normalmente procuram algo mais sofisticado para bios e nomes de perfil. Em ambos os casos, a personalização se tornou parte essencial da presença online.

Muitos usuários acreditam que apenas criadores famosos conseguem ter nomes diferenciados, mas isso não é verdade. Qualquer pessoa pode montar um visual único utilizando ferramentas modernas de modificação de texto. O segredo está em testar combinações diferentes até encontrar uma identidade visual interessante.

Outro detalhe que chama atenção é a praticidade do sistema copiar e colar. Depois que o texto é transformado, o usuário consegue utilizar imediatamente em praticamente qualquer plataforma. Isso torna o processo extremamente simples até para quem nunca utilizou esse tipo de recurso antes.

As letras diferenciadas também ajudam perfis a parecerem mais profissionais. Em plataformas lotadas de conteúdo, pequenos detalhes visuais fazem enorme diferença. Um nome estilizado pode aumentar a curiosidade de visitantes e tornar o perfil mais memorável.

No universo competitivo dos jogos online, o nick muitas vezes funciona como cartão de visita. Jogadores habilidosos acabam sendo reconhecidos pelo visual do nome. Alguns criam assinaturas únicas usando símbolos especiais ao redor do apelido. Outros preferem combinações mais discretas, mas igualmente elegantes.

O interessante é que a personalização não serve apenas para estética. Muitas pessoas utilizam fontes diferenciadas para demonstrar humor, criatividade ou até pertencimento a determinados grupos e equipes. Clãs de jogos frequentemente adotam padrões específicos de escrita para fortalecer a identidade da equipe.

Outro ponto positivo é que ferramentas modernas funcionam em celulares, computadores e tablets. Isso permite criar nicks personalizados em qualquer lugar. Não importa se o usuário está no Android, iPhone ou PC, o processo continua simples e rápido.

As redes sociais também passaram a valorizar mais elementos visuais. Perfis organizados e estilosos costumam causar uma impressão melhor logo no primeiro contato. Por isso, muita gente investe tempo escolhendo fontes bonitas para bios, legendas e nomes.

Quem trabalha com criação de conteúdo percebe rapidamente como pequenos detalhes visuais influenciam no crescimento online. Um perfil visualmente atraente costuma parecer mais profissional e interessante para novos visitantes.

Outro benefício importante das letras estilizadas é a possibilidade de criar exclusividade. Muitas vezes, o nome desejado já está ocupado dentro de um jogo ou rede social. Com pequenas modificações usando caracteres especiais, torna-se possível criar uma versão personalizada sem perder a identidade original.

Isso é bastante comum em plataformas populares, onde milhões de usuários disputam nomes semelhantes. Um [modificador de letras](https://modificadordeletras.art/) ajuda a transformar apelidos simples em algo totalmente diferente.

Também vale destacar que essas ferramentas costumam utilizar padrões Unicode. Isso significa que os caracteres gerados funcionam em diversos aplicativos e plataformas. Em vez de serem apenas imagens, as letras realmente podem ser copiadas e utilizadas como texto normal.

Essa compatibilidade amplia muito as possibilidades de personalização. O usuário consegue utilizar o mesmo estilo em diferentes redes sociais sem precisar criar tudo novamente.

Muitos criadores de conteúdo usam letras decorativas para melhorar títulos de vídeos, descrições e publicações. Isso ajuda o conteúdo a chamar mais atenção visualmente no meio de centenas de posts comuns.

Até mesmo mensagens pessoais ganharam um toque mais criativo com fontes diferentes. Algumas pessoas utilizam estilos personalizados para enviar frases especiais, recados românticos ou mensagens divertidas para amigos.

Com tantas opções disponíveis, o importante é encontrar um equilíbrio entre criatividade e legibilidade. Um nome muito exagerado pode acabar difícil de entender. Já um visual bem escolhido consegue transmitir personalidade sem comprometer a leitura.

Perfis modernos geralmente combinam símbolos discretos com letras diferenciadas para criar um resultado elegante. Esse estilo se tornou extremamente popular principalmente entre jogadores e usuários jovens das redes sociais.

Outro motivo para o crescimento dessa tendência é a busca constante por originalidade. Em um ambiente digital cheio de perfis parecidos, qualquer elemento visual diferente ajuda a chamar atenção.

As letras decorativas também funcionam muito bem para status, biografias e frases motivacionais. Pequenos detalhes estilizados deixam qualquer texto mais interessante visualmente.

O melhor de tudo é que não existe limite para criatividade. O usuário pode testar quantas combinações quiser até encontrar o formato ideal. Algumas pessoas preferem algo minimalista. Outras gostam de efeitos mais chamativos e ousados.

Hoje em dia, ter um nick estiloso ou uma bio diferenciada virou quase uma extensão da personalidade online. A aparência do texto comunica estilo, humor e até preferências pessoais.

Por isso, ferramentas de [modificação de letras](https://modificadordeletras.art/) continuam crescendo em popularidade entre jogadores, influenciadores e usuários comuns. Elas oferecem uma maneira simples, rápida e gratuita de transformar qualquer texto em algo muito mais interessante.

Seja para criar um nome marcante no Free Fire, personalizar o perfil do Instagram ou deixar mensagens mais criativas, as letras estilizadas já fazem parte da cultura digital moderna. Com poucos cliques, qualquer pessoa consegue transformar palavras simples em textos visualmente impressionantes e muito mais atrativos.

body.title: Letras Bonitas: La Nueva Forma de Dar Personalidad a Tus Redes Sociales
body.body:
Las redes sociales se han convertido en el espacio perfecto para mostrar creatividad, estilo y personalidad. Cada día millones de personas publican historias, estados, comentarios y biografías intentando destacar entre una enorme cantidad de contenido. En medio de esa competencia visual, los pequeños detalles hacen una gran diferencia. Uno de esos detalles que ha ganado enorme popularidad es el uso de letras bonitas creadas con [caracteres Unicode especiales.](https://letrasbonitas.dev/)

Actualmente, los usuarios buscan maneras simples de llamar la atención sin tener conocimientos de diseño gráfico o edición avanzada. Las letras bonitas ofrecen exactamente eso: un método rápido para transformar textos comunes en frases llamativas que se pueden copiar y pegar en cualquier plataforma.

Muchas personas creen que estas letras funcionan como fuentes tradicionales instaladas en una computadora, pero en realidad se trata de combinaciones especiales de caracteres Unicode compatibles con la mayoría de aplicaciones y redes sociales. Gracias a eso, es posible utilizar textos decorativos en Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, WhatsApp, Discord, Twitch y muchas otras plataformas sin descargar programas adicionales.

La popularidad de este tipo de texto ha crecido especialmente entre creadores de contenido, gamers, influencers y pequeños negocios digitales. Una biografía atractiva puede generar más visitas al perfil, mientras que un nombre visualmente diferente puede hacer que una cuenta sea mucho más fácil de recordar. Incluso en plataformas saturadas de información, un simple cambio de estilo en el texto puede captar la atención [en cuestión de segundos.](https://letrasbonitas.dev/)

Además, las letras bonitas no solo sirven para nombres de usuario. También son utilizadas para crear frases decorativas, títulos llamativos, estados originales y mensajes personalizados. Algunas personas las emplean para darle un toque elegante a sus publicaciones, mientras que otras prefieren estilos divertidos o modernos que reflejan su personalidad.

En el mundo digital actual, la imagen tiene un peso enorme. Las personas suelen tomar decisiones rápidas basadas en lo primero que observan en una pantalla. Un perfil visualmente atractivo transmite creatividad y cuidado por los detalles. Por esa razón, las herramientas de conversión de texto se han vuelto tan populares entre quienes desean mejorar la apariencia de sus publicaciones.

Uno de los aspectos más interesantes de las letras bonitas es su facilidad de uso. No hace falta registrarse ni instalar aplicaciones complejas. El proceso normalmente consiste en escribir una palabra o frase, elegir el estilo deseado y copiar el resultado final. Después, ese texto puede pegarse directamente [en cualquier red social.](https://letrasbonitas.dev/)

Esto resulta especialmente útil para quienes desean actualizar constantemente sus perfiles. Cambiar el estilo del nombre o de la biografía permite renovar la apariencia de una cuenta sin modificar el contenido principal. Muchas marcas personales utilizan esta estrategia para mantenerse frescas y modernas frente a su audiencia.

Las tendencias digitales cambian rápidamente y las personas siempre buscan nuevas formas de expresión. Hace algunos años, los emojis dominaron la comunicación visual. Luego llegaron los stickers y GIFs personalizados. Ahora, las letras decorativas forman parte de esa evolución visual que transforma textos simples en elementos más atractivos.

Otro punto importante es la compatibilidad. A diferencia de las tipografías tradicionales que pueden perderse en ciertos dispositivos, los caracteres Unicode suelen mantenerse visibles en la mayoría de sistemas operativos modernos. Esto permite que las publicaciones luzcan similares tanto en Android como en iPhone, computadoras o tablets.

Las letras bonitas también tienen una fuerte presencia en el mundo de los videojuegos y las comunidades online. Muchos jugadores utilizan nombres personalizados con símbolos y estilos únicos para diferenciarse dentro de plataformas multijugador. Tener un nickname original se ha convertido en parte de la identidad digital [de muchos usuarios.](https://letrasbonitas.dev/)

En plataformas como TikTok e Instagram, donde la competencia por captar atención es enorme, incluso un detalle visual pequeño puede marcar la diferencia. Los perfiles más memorables suelen cuidar elementos como colores, imágenes, estilo de escritura y presentación general. Las letras decorativas complementan perfectamente esa estrategia visual.

Además, las personas disfrutan experimentar con diferentes estilos. Algunos prefieren textos elegantes y minimalistas, mientras otros eligen opciones más extravagantes llenas de símbolos y detalles creativos. Esa variedad permite que cada usuario encuentre un diseño acorde a su personalidad.

También existen usuarios que utilizan estas herramientas para ocasiones especiales. Por ejemplo, crear mensajes decorativos para cumpleaños, celebraciones, invitaciones o publicaciones románticas. Un texto diferente puede darle un toque más personal y llamativo a cualquier mensaje.

Otro motivo por el cual las letras bonitas han ganado popularidad es la rapidez. En pocos segundos es posible transformar un texto común en algo visualmente interesante. Esto es especialmente útil para creadores de contenido que publican constantemente y necesitan mantener [un estilo atractivo.](https://letrasbonitas.dev/)

Las pequeñas empresas y emprendedores digitales también aprovechan este recurso para mejorar la presentación de sus perfiles comerciales. Una biografía creativa o un título diferente puede ayudar a transmitir una imagen más moderna y profesional. En un entorno tan competitivo, cualquier detalle visual puede influir en la percepción de los clientes.

El impacto visual en internet es cada vez más importante porque las personas consumen contenido de manera rápida. Muchas veces un usuario decide en segundos si continúa viendo un perfil o sigue desplazándose. Por eso, generar una buena primera impresión se ha vuelto fundamental.

Las letras bonitas ofrecen una manera sencilla de personalizar contenido sin necesidad de conocimientos técnicos. Esa accesibilidad es precisamente una de las razones por las cuales millones de usuarios las utilizan diariamente. Cualquier persona puede transformar textos comunes en diseños creativos con apenas unos clics.

Incluso quienes no son activos en redes sociales encuentran utilidad en este tipo de herramientas. Algunas personas usan textos decorativos para mensajes privados, firmas digitales o nombres personalizados en aplicaciones de mensajería. La posibilidad de copiar y pegar fácilmente hace que el proceso sea práctico y rápido.

Con el crecimiento constante de las plataformas digitales, la búsqueda de originalidad seguirá aumentando. Los usuarios desean diferenciarse y encontrar nuevas formas de expresar su estilo personal. Las letras bonitas representan una solución simple, moderna [y efectiva para lograrlo.](https://letrasbonitas.dev/)

En definitiva, el uso de caracteres Unicode decorativos se ha convertido en una tendencia visual que continúa expandiéndose en internet. Ya sea para mejorar una biografía, destacar una publicación o crear un nombre único, estas herramientas permiten transformar textos simples en elementos mucho más atractivos.

La creatividad digital evoluciona constantemente, y las letras bonitas forman parte de esa nueva manera de comunicarse visualmente. En un entorno donde captar atención es cada vez más difícil, un detalle diferente puede convertirse en la clave para destacar entre millones de perfiles y publicaciones.

Quienes buscan una forma rápida y sencilla de darle más estilo a sus textos encuentran en este tipo de herramientas una excelente alternativa. Gracias a su compatibilidad, facilidad de uso y variedad de estilos, las letras bonitas continúan creciendo como uno de los recursos favoritos para personalizar contenido en redes sociales [y plataformas online.](https://letrasbonitas.dev/)

This video features Stevie Wonder’s “*Signed, Sealed, And Delivered*”
## THE NAME OF THIS SONG is as follows: “*Signed, Sealed, And Delivered*” Do a search without Stevie Wonder and you will see several interpretations of this phrase in music and art… and my video’s title is wrong. It got ouch while editing.

#### The original bass part is highly rememberable in my opinion, but I don’t know it exactly. I’ve listened to the song many times and my chart only contains chords. I make it up. I think I get pretty close to the original part. I just try to think like James Jamison might. I try to think of other Stevie Wonder songs that have challenging bass parts. Keep the pulse and energy good and emphasize the ends of 4 and 8 bar sections. People won’t know if I reinvent the bass part.

body.title: 带父母逛世博园（中篇）
body.body:
继续给大家分享这次和媳妇带父母逛世博园期间拍摄的照片哦，这是第二篇（共三篇）。

![20260507_115702.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVLVjK4yQjK8A7JD3st4Xh4bd4mRY2TFAHxJAMdc4XLcu/20260507_115702.jpg)

开上世博园的小观光车逛世博园就是爽，无论逛多远逛多久都不累，看到风景好的地方就下车拍照，风景一般的就开车“风驰电掣”般前行。

当然了，风驰电掣是不可能真的风驰电掣啦，小观光车被设置了限速，我把油门踩到底，时速也不过5公里/小时，若是大上坡就更慢啦。

这速度比牛车都慢，和游人步行差不多，不过这样也好，比较安全，不然真整20-30公里每小时，那撞到人就芭比Q了。

闲话少叙，继续分享照片了。

在百合塔附近发现一片郁金香花海
![20260507_113651.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPZags4MbB4eRm2bwGJ36jPWVHJDXDRm5bwmeTbEFHEyB/20260507_113651.jpg)

就是有点开过头了，若是再早几天来，大概会更好
![20260507_113638.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYU1auQpj13M55DkpTxYFhotCrApshBdDDbvPYcETiM8x/20260507_113638.jpg)


百合塔附近的布景
![20260507_113837.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmb8hW7jWxJYEiXxnrLWm6pVdkSQChVPWxRX4Wx9Aw3HKm/20260507_113837.jpg)

这张光线更好一些
![20260507_113918.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPzpv1iYqtZxzM7tsfh1TV9tNi44kFFDV7nLivJpg8YDs/20260507_113918.jpg)

小屋子和水车，宛如童话世界一般
![20260507_113913.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWiwmwbAjG9LywEBWA81GqmDFLC1DhEjEsSTK3DYuPZ1T/20260507_113913.jpg)


哇哦，这是财神嘛？
![20260507_113928.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdDZaf4Cs8QmTNLZq2WNf3MnWkfBTPUF5BBXTGSy9kTn9/20260507_113928.jpg)

这里还有一个甜品站
![20260507_114025.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcgiUZNo5QnncpTJPqN3bJmq2NRTcu9mquB2zBznFRo34/20260507_114025.jpg)

谁知道这是啥花？一串串的，是风信子嘛？
![20260507_114149.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYa4vgh6wyxmoNjEiM4bSw2kSXZiX24bgnyTS63Ms9XXj/20260507_114149.jpg)

额，这里的花海没长好
![20260507_114315.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmd4Bw2yrXKA52xZX9RK5G52xiWDRrU8dMnS6yWkvLcBEE/20260507_114315.jpg)

准备去植物园玩啦
![20260507_114626.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPJ4fFd5QiwmAQVZeyeqCi2NU4wbJvb1jeDYd5QMWEEBM/20260507_114626.jpg)

荷花池
![20260507_114635.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbpu2LVkzonRfoaHHx7PM6nEyFq2ThpmAqvDLCeWmkqUD/20260507_114635.jpg)

这个角度拍百合塔如何？
![20260507_114749.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYRUC6EVSDfHevfD5Kw4SsXCUntr1iGBBQEqaPe7Jfb81/20260507_114749.jpg)

红松林栈道
![20260507_115355.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmennK751rm4d4Ev3tVHRRboL8BBnt8dawSmddnMRhTxHu/20260507_115355.jpg)

林间主题邮局
![20260507_115510.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmayoJq9yus7gMCF8g5XSjZQnjvKxLvhB9HokripMXBxGx/20260507_115510.jpg)

嫦娥奔月
![20260507_115624.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVcEUNLyyNFULsbgkPa64vtDe3RxASGknKPz33vbHDBh3/20260507_115624.jpg)

这张好看，拿来做封面
![20260507_115702.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVLVjK4yQjK8A7JD3st4Xh4bd4mRY2TFAHxJAMdc4XLcu/20260507_115702.jpg)

儿子小时候最喜欢看这个啦
![20260507_115817.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQme3qZW21puB5EyJtGbmAYHVLkTvYWQXyMDE2u9K596Jaa/20260507_115817.jpg)

这个经典的大蛋
![20260507_115935.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaWPFkjrJfv7DZSgr5y3HMUaXt3T6ZYgKnBkzcLJrqfKq/20260507_115935.jpg)

这是杜鹃花嘛？
![20260507_120326.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeDH33MtX9NuNvtsbdVG8GCwtqKPXJpiuq6zjwYqmYstF/20260507_120326.jpg)

又发现一大片郁金香花海
![20260507_121240.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcTtJn4Fmdy86Dgc9Gd3e2mRHPxEukqMBhRAHBu3YBBad/20260507_121240.jpg)

哇哇哇，比百合塔附近的要漂亮好多好多
![20260507_121259.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQma52S8sHtXsrbdr2n68SGUA7Erq8eGdRR2YVCPBdaWDWb/20260507_121259.jpg)

美不胜收
![20260507_121340.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfXUo2KAdRnuA7GscWKkTcYrmxsbrjFBHd4vmApXXnADF/20260507_121340.jpg)

让人流连忘返
![20260507_121605.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRgcAoRuSVna3fcDKBYJmM9hsRpcM8NXtgfs4tJhc6qMe/20260507_121605.jpg)

好看好看真好看
![20260507_121723.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmd3HkdeqjjSC9mz74C4obdiCSQkpm9vf3tNgBTFponkuU/20260507_121723.jpg)

心生赞叹，但想不出来用啥更好的词汇形容啦
![20260507_121851.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRWBHLupjj6GHBAm1ZVQ8SmXy5mZutwQUHpMKwffZDyVm/20260507_121851.jpg)

此处适合拍照打卡
![20260507_122019.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaGCUwGpzJK4a846E4EQcAUJjRunAccNBGrEk33GAWXTC/20260507_122019.jpg)

好大一片郁金香，漫山遍野
![20260507_122228.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmd1EngZ87zxh7vaG22R5sxdQ7AczFkyc8nuo2zHdHrrfw/20260507_122228.jpg)

咦，这边还有一个科普园，里边一个科普馆，不过他们都不感兴趣，我也不进去逛啦
![20260507_122503.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcXwBbCfX72Cb44aL2ypDi5dMfVP54vPyFRLnFT7mPM2P/20260507_122503.jpg)

科普园旁边的木化石森林，是真的木化石哦。

这些都是距今16到18亿年中侏罗纪时代的原始雪松型木化石哦，是和恐龙一个时代的哦
![20260507_122648.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRQpBJPaMLsDd7xuQnbuUUtbzht1URq6x7xZVzwJYho4b/20260507_122648.jpg)

科普园对面在搞一个脆皮青年养生局
![20260507_122541.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbu7riTJeCGttcxqtGR6qM5htPTUxeGrwV7ndi7izEp6J/20260507_122541.jpg)

脆皮青年养生局看着好热闹的样子，好像去听听他们讲些什么，不过陪父母玩好更重要，况且咱也不是脆皮青年啦，哈哈哈。

body.title: HivePulse.app: Financial Transparency Report update before launching
body.body:
The [Hive Pulse](https://hivepulse.app) aims to offer real time insights and intel on user activity on the Hive blockchain. The project is development on my own (@behiver) and all the costs are supported out of my own pocket. The only revenue streams foreseen in the near future is through content creation and engagement on the project with communities and users from the Hive blockchain. I intend to present periodic financial reports about the costs and revenues that the project will involve or attract.

![hivepulse_finances_report1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hivepulse.app/48GCHoNcWYRxYZ295zb4tEjiM6oMpMXHtUBtVzZj2zHWMmZXNWCqYUNBwHzFvDjxgp.png)

While I am still laying down the infrastructure for the app, I already have associated costs. I will start with them as the project evolves and also keep an eye on eye revenue coming my way. I don't have big hopes in the beginning, but maybe in time things will improve. And if this initiative or experiment proves itself - who knows, maybe this will open doors for additional projects in the Hive ecosystem. So let's start and see some financial data even before launching the app.

|**Activity**|**Item Type**|**Ocurrence**|**Amount ($)**|
|-|-|-|-|
|Domain name|Cost|Annually (1)|$24.44|
|VPS hosting|Cost|Annually (1)|$61.28|
|Development (incl tools, software, etc.)|Cost|Monthly (1)|$24.20|
|*Revenue from @hivepulse.app account on the Hive blockchain*||||
|0.00 Hive|Revenue|Ongoing|$0.00|
|0.00 Hive Power|Revenue|Ongoing|$0.00|
|0.00 HBD|Revenue|Ongoing|$0.00|
|*Profitability (based on current market prices)*|||-$109.92|

There are two people actively involved in this project, but for now (and maybe forever) the time and work put will imply $0 (zero) costs. One is an OG developer, the other is myself which I am managing the app and putting things together from my own experience in this ecosystem (since 2017), but not limited to it. We are both well anchored in software development, so some hustles will be easier to overcome than for some people without background in the industry.

This is the first Financial Report for the hivepulse.app project. I intend to make it a weekly report in order to see how feasible it is to run it on my own, even if considering that I put my time for free maybe doesn't full reflect the associated costs. But this can be maybe a starting point and an inspiration also for others that might want to start a project and see what it takes to launch a product on the market. At the moment I think that by having the domain name, VPS hosting and initial development put in place, it should be a good starting point. But I still need to do some work on infrastructure until I will be launching the app (like TLS certificates, Load Balancer and/or Web server that the app will be deployed on) and others around that.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hivepulse.app/23swcKAAdGsZCQ7PUcaLSmJsL8W8LDqx4qbXEV3xzwbY2QejHeYrVAnoTynG25v3FGXwB.png)

And while the scope of this article is to track the financial overhead of such a project, as a teaser I've put also a screenshot from the app. Hopefully this week I will be able to advance more on it and lay down the full infrastructure for it... and maybe even deploy it. That's all from my side, see you with further updates soon.

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@hivepulse.app/hivepulseapp-financial-transparency-report-update-before-launching-7ph)

body.body: > Buen Día amigos de @TheAnimeRealm, saludos y feliz día, en esta oportunidad vengo para hablarles sobre un anime que me causo mucha intriga, además de que no es tan sencillo de entender al principio se vuelve algo confuso, pero ya luego le agarras el hilo a lo que quiere llegar, es como un detective intentado saber que pasa y comprender a cada uno de los personajes para lograr el objetivo final, salvarles la vida a todos, se trata de Gnosia. --- ![MV5BNGM4OTk3MTctYWE0OS00YTA1LWJjNDItNDg4ZWZkOTEyZjkwXkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23yTj8qzFq7UBcHqkiFCGUJVfppxXWNKYhhmoRwxjejn3fg3ULj3X3M6tfcYQehxVDqzA.jpg) [Fuente](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt34852231/mediaviewer/rm2013897474/) ---

>Es una historia basada en un videojuego, donde un grupo de personas o bueno algunos humanos y otras especias, en un futuro muy lejano, deben abordar una nave, pero en un momento de abordar algunos se contaminan con un virus, el cual hace que pierda la cabeza y maten a los que no son de su grupo, son conocidos como Gnosia, realizan reuniones para descubrir quién es el Gnosia, aunque no es sencillo, ya que miente y en ese proceso de mentir y enviar a congelar a quien creen que puede estar contaminado ps mueren más y más los individuos. --- ![MV5BZWM5Y2RlNzMtNWJiZi00OWQ5LWE3NWItMWIyNzEwNGVhMGVjXkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/EoyMdEbF1NnEowZahK7BWE1ACAqVw65BLjVsPQiK3BHc5kpwWEM4LyTqdA13WwNZMK3.jpg) [Fuente](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt34852231/mediaviewer/rm3692337154/) ---

>En ese grupo esta Yuri, un joven que tras un incidente despierta y tiene pérdida de memoria, sin saber que pasa entra en la asamblea donde hablan y deciden a quien tienen que mandar a dormir para saber si es o no un gnosia, al principio sin saber que pasa Yuri a través de Setsu una mujer que dice no tener género y que parece que es la única a la que puede confiar, le indica que están en un bucle el cual se repite cada vez que él vaya a morir, sin entender nada de lo que ocurre Yuri al morir se va dando cuenta que es cierto, vive en un bucle, que aunque crea que siempre será lo mismo ps no es así. ---
![Yuri_-_Gnosia3.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/AKF96gWgVLhMXp1RNErdA1JjBqtLHZEWhtC6A7UJTyiycm63umQqZaHNiqVU4mS.webp)
[Fuente](https://doblaje.fandom.com/es/wiki/Gnosia?file=Yuri_-_Gnosia.jpg) ---

>Cada bucle es distinto, aparecen diferentes personajes o hasta más, lo cual ocasiona que Yuri se vea más inseguro en determinar quién es el Gnosia, o como ayudarse con los roles que comienzan aparecer para determinar a los infectados, es una batalle del tiempo en no solo sobrevivir porque aunque es el único que puede regresar tal cual es en los bucles, la idea es ayudarlos a todos sin necesidad de morir para ello, pero cada vez es diferente, el recaudar información se vuelve importante ya que el saber cómo es cada uno puede ayudarlo en otro bucle. ---
![Setsu_-_Gnosia4.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/AKJ1zdAmaK5H6s7tAr1zSfpxcdsbJAkwCFyp82cB6MdpSLJ8N2kxZ6kF7HTrbf8.webp)
[Fuente](https://doblaje.fandom.com/es/wiki/Gnosia?file=Setsu_-_Gnosia.jpg) ---

>Sin embargo, cada vez se vuelve como subir de nivel, más difícil, y no siempre la información que tienes puede ser la más certera, así que será una lucha por sobrevivir, salvar a los demás y recaudar la información necesaria para cerrar el ciclo, pero no será nada sencillo ya que Yuri desconoce cómo empezó ello y que hará para salir de esta locura espacial. Cuenta con su primera temporada de 21 capítulos. ---
![SQ_-_Gnosia5.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/AKDiDWqCapCoSBYVWbFMRschd3MrYruLtGj93qexmaxtn4WjXfL7AhrbaP1UcA9.webp)
[Fuente](https://doblaje.fandom.com/es/wiki/Gnosia?file=SQ_-_Gnosia.jpg) --- **Creador Petit Depotto, género acción, ciencia ficción, estudio de animación Domerica.** ---

> **Muchas gracias por leerlo. Espero sea de su agrado. Cualquier comentario con gusto estaré para responder y si quieren saber más de mi les dejo mis:**
![EL FINAL DE POSTHIVE (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tmBcG1dhAWXHSeTXHGahwcGe8eAbcEpZutQrCnSNiXxDwJJ31QA17giTgLpxPgJtEqN.jpg)

> Good morning friends of @TheAnimeRealm, greetings and happy day, this time I come to talk to you about an anime that caused me a lot of intrigue, plus it is not so easy to understand at first it becomes somewhat confusing, but then you get the hang of what it wants to get at, it is like a detective trying to find out what is happening and understand each of the characters to achieve the final objective, saving everyone's lives, it is about Gnosia. --- ![MV5BNGM4OTk3MTctYWE0OS00YTA1LWJjNDItNDg4ZWZkOTEyZjkwXkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23yTj8qzFq7UBcHqkiFCGUJVfppxXWNKYhhmoRwxjejn3fg3ULj3X3M6tfcYQehxVDqzA.jpg) [Source](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt34852231/mediaviewer/rm2013897474/) ---

>It is a story based on a video game, where a group of people or well some humans and other species, in a very distant future, must board a ship, but at a moment of boarding some become contaminated with a virus, which causes them to lose their minds and kill those who are not part of their group, they are known as Gnosia, they hold meetings to discover who the Gnosia is, although it is not easy, since it lies and in that process of lying and sending to freeze whoever they believe may be contaminated, more die and more individuals. --- ![MV5BZWM5Y2RlNzMtNWJiZi00OWQ5LWE3NWItMWIyNzEwNGVhMGVjXkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/EoyMdEbF1NnEowZahK7BWE1ACAqVw65BLjVsPQiK3BHc5kpwWEM4LyTqdA13WwNZMK3.jpg) [Source](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt34852231/mediaviewer/rm3692337154/) ---

>In that group is Yuri, a young man who wakes up after an incident and has memory loss, without knowing what is happening he enters the assembly where they talk and decide who they have to send to sleep to find out if he is a gnosia or not, at first without knowing what Yuri is going through, through Setsu, a woman who claims to have no gender and who seems to be the only one he can trust, tells him that they are in a loop which repeats every time he is going to die, without understanding anything of what happens when Yuri dies, he leaves. Realizing that it is true, he lives in a loop, that even if he believes that it will always be the same ps it is not like that. ---

body.title: This Summer Proved Planting Trees Works — So Why Are We Still Cutting Them?
body.body:
> is it true that most of these summer days aren't as heated as they were back then, I've this feeling that summer isn't as hot as it was back in the days.
most of these days it rains and we have had the coolest day of the summer never seen in a decade or so and it is all happening in just one city where you can say we have made a lot of progress on first thing and that is our environment.

The billion tree tsunami did wonders in this city

A couple of years ago when ik was the president our city Islamabad had this one project where they were supposed to plant everywhere and called it billion tree tsunami. Everyone knew what was going around and appreciated that, this city is so far the greenest one in the entire country and that is it's beauty. Perks of living in capital is that you'll see initiatives for people that'll be beneficial for coming generations and changes that have happened throughout the years I've seen it all while growing up And this one tree project has had most impact because I remember back when I was a kid and had to go from school to home we used to sweat like hell because it was so hot you'd literally pass out if you weren't drinking enough water. The dizziness and everything was in the air but now it's changed.

still have blankets in summer

Nights are so cold that I have flu because whenever I comeback home at night on bike it just become the reason why I have cough And living under a fan at night and waking up to a sore throat is another thing. So have decided to stick with the blankets during the peak summer days, believe it or not. It is all because of the tree's cause everywhere else it's way too hot and people are crying about it. I believe we should plant more trees rather than cutting it down. You're suppose to increase tree population but since the new government took over they have plans to build skyscraper in this city and are cutting down tons of tree's now which is sickening and no one is speaking about it cause they are naive. I'd do whatever it takes to plant more tree and save them from people who are cutting it down for their own benefit. We shouldn't trust a government that isn't eco friendly. Yet again I'm surprised how this summer is going so far without those heatwaves and being grateful that somehow there's something that is positive about this place but also deep down I'm afraid there are people who want to tear this thing up. Wonder how's the summer treating you in your place? Do share your thoughts about it in the comments.
that's all folks.

body.title: The Influencer Effect
body.body:
<center>![PXL_20260502_164016276.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23wCBrjnwVLMo34JLWgk8sVBDj1B8VaUCMNozBR623TQcY2Esbvvb4VvfPeAPnKgBWgPt.jpg)</center>

-----------------------

As I mentioned in some of my other posts, my wife and I recently took a trip to the west side of Michigan.  After visiting the lantern festival at the zoo, and then the Tulip Time festival in Holland, MI, we had a few other places I wanted to stop and check out.  Check out my full blog page if you missed the previous two posts.  

I'm sure by now, many of us are familiar with the influencer effect.  I might have the definition a little wrong, but to me it's when a place that is altogether not that remarkable suddenly becomes a popular spot due to someone highlighting it and then a flood of people start visiting the place to recreate the moment or magic of the original poster.

That turned out to be the case with Tunnel Park on the shores of Lake Michigan outside of Holland. 


<center>![PXL_20260502_164019806.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23w2oCNFQXxKvAPznUmBzH9x8WDBbB7XWzSjG6KER9FHBZA4YX7gmTKRP7aYEnYTLkoZQ.jpg)</center>

------------------------

It's one of those things I saw on Facebook or something like that and since we were so close after visiting the tulip time festival, I decided to take a quick drive over to check it out.  Much to my surprise, the place was packed with people.  On top of that, some of them were people who think the rules don't apply to them (seems to be everyone these days).  There's a sign that specifically says no bicycles, but you can clearly see three people in the photo above walking their bikes through the tunnel.

Anyway, the tunnel takes you through one of the iconic Lake Michigan sand dunes to get you a pretty breathtaking view of the lake.


<center>![PXL_20260502_164047914.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23wCDigP46mE1Xz6PA8FUCBEhJrMHoANaiUWtRQnqpRYUCMxzCBRcXtBSGgKANMmFpZa8.jpg)</center>


<center>![PXL_20260502_164050383.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23ywoAoRpyaXAfJfqz1djqi62So258zTzx7Ai117JLGvn7Sj4N9Z5Wi5WoPDPiFnuTKG6.jpg)</center>


<center>![PXL_20260502_164058523.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/245Hh1X3CLwPkUGJcq55bLUgCoFrLbqwPWMGkpGyfnkvSyTj2hQ8FwCWBrQMCUXNHBCTK.jpg)</center>


<center>![PXL_20260502_164112479.MP.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23zvCwEgXCqbK5vfqebdvdpbhNitRzDU9BSMsL49qihcq615Wcs15JSUfJ2ZmeBunpCcK.jpg)</center>

------------------------------------

Given how busy the park was for no apparent reason in the middle of the day, I would hate to see what it is like at night.  You see, the main draw for the park is the fact that in the evening as the sun is going down over the horizon on Lake Michigan, you can get a glimpse of it through the tunnel if you are at the right angle.  There are some pretty spectacular photos online of this phenomenon, so I kind of get it, but it still bugs me a bit that I fell prey to the influencer effect.


<center>![PXL_20260502_164120910.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23zGgJ1ybaVAZzCNXStvQgX6r4YvxwAp9goPVLg1BVU29GSg1EnnAmfNLrKefEyD23Aet.jpg)</center>

------------------------

Seriously though, it was an endless stream of people through the tunnel both ways...


<center>![PXL_20260502_173244788.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23x1DTvX9RabP1biMVAdbEJhpM6zGhYFhiJXGhbFFopNmFwPaQJJtTNGYCKUTf7UYmXDK.jpg)</center>


<center>![PXL_20260502_173827348.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23y8t1Kc15WHP8yUNNAYgvzvhzr4pscAcfW3pHATKUYtbM4rDMLyvbzHLzU1JA6ZJTWig.jpg)</center>

-------------------------------

After visiting Tunnel Park we were pretty hungry from all the walking and sightseeing we had done that moring, so we found a nice little place along the shores of Lake Macatawa which leads out into lake Michigan called [The Reservoir](https://reservoirholland.com/).  It was a trendy little place that served some amazing food.  @mrsbozz got the chicken sandwich that you see in the bottom photo above and I got the perch dinner that you see in the top photo.  The food was amazing though the breading on the fish was a little thicker than I would have preferred.  I had a bite of my wife's sandwich and it was quite good.  They had a good combination of flavors happening.  I would definitely come back to The Reservoir again.


<center>![PXL_20260502_160957727.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23u616CLgMNCksAvnbkvB3wb3BytVe3LAvxB67SjU1UBDa3uQwvoMhAiHe8PEwvCRo1og.jpg)</center>

--------------------------

During our time in Holland, we also had the chance to visit three different used book stores.  This has been a bit of a tradition for us in the past couple of years.  Especially since I have started to read more than I used to.  We both found a couple of things at each store that we were more than happy to part with our money over.  

<center>![PXL_20260503_140039295.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23x17JfDWCmp7Ak6kZwsJTN5Rz3Bo1UMJTx7N2XAESZaQCyZm4imwKiXS69K5dPcH7Bx6.jpg)</center>

------------------------

In fact, at one of the stores I found this used copy of Faces \

on vinyl that I can't wait to spin. I think in all we spent about $20 and we came away with a record, and six books total, three for each of us.  Not a bad haul am I right?!



<center>![PXL_20260502_202649706.NIGHT.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23wqCLrdXAEA1Jj7Mv35crWpmQXhfPecLG74qMmKXk7psQAE2LmyzKytcnxECXQADg5sV.jpg)</center>



<center>![PXL_20260502_203111338.NIGHT.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23tbijP9zPsFPxygcRijCDpXw5wL1puZBJbDK8pAge2KppFcNN8Hy8XEgCMHdXuiyCJJc.jpg)</center>


---------------------------------

After our busy morning/afternoon, we made our way back to the hotel in Comstock Park to rest a bit.  We still had the rest of the night left and we didn't want to waste it, otherwise we could have just driven home, so we decided to go see a movie at the theater across the parking lot from the hotel.  There wasn't a ton playing and as much as I wanted to see \
(not really, I would have though), @mrsbozz suggested we see \

instead.  So, $50 later ($30 for the tickets, $20 for the popcorn and soda), we kicked back and started watching the show.

It's crazy how expensive movies are these days.  It's also crazy how a movie that is supposed to start at one time doesn't start until a half hour later because of all the trailers.  Don't get me wrong, I love trailers, but this was excessive.  The seats were comfortable if not worn, and after a while, I started getting a cramp in my leg from having the foot rest up the whole time.

The movie was great and it gives you a very honest if not one sided view into the life of Michael as a youngster up until about the \

era.  They don't get into any of the crazier stuff past that.  It's sad just how controlling and abusive the dad was.  It's also kind of sad to see how lonely Michael supposedly was despite all the people he had around him.


<center>![PXL_20260508_232621237.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23xVEmhKdat654YLg7QxaierANnyvDGjzDrg7JtfqbdDD78tKEcMFhmfUp78FRQ5VoASS.jpg)</center>

--------------------------

After the movie, we went out to a nearby Mexican restaurant for dinner, and then I walked across that parking lot to the liquor store to see if they had any interesting whiskey.  I picked up this bottle of Wilderness Trail Bourbon.

Sunday morning we packed up, hopped in the car, and headed home.  It was a great weekend with lots of laughs, exercise, and fun.  I'm glad I was able to spend this special moment with my wife and check some items off her bucket list.

title.title: Progress in the Big Garden - May 12, 2026@goldenoakfarm
title.body:
![New rose - Sunrise Sunset crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/Eops1ncE23P8oufqSL3RaPxmXY6V4UaYH2CiCDGdS2gU8dfUB3RAaYtxwhWwedjfH92.jpg)

On Tuesday morning I was up at 5:30AM and got my post up. I got a load in the dishwasher and finally got out to the gardens at 9:15AM. I was determined to at least get the new rose planted.

I collected all the equipment for the Big garden and what I’d need for the planting and dragged it to the Big garden. The rose had been in the cold frame since Saturday.

It had a large dead branch on it and I tried for a discount because of it when I bought it, but no dice…

![New rose collage text crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23y94BhzmXS6nPiDmWoycFtn8yFZXwQFC5YCTQJSHwvRPTQ5E7gWGyHvJt2Q7sDEEsjjx.jpg)

So the first thing was to prune off the dead from the winter. I found a single bud on it when I was doing this.

Next I dug a hole where the dead rugosa rose had been and got out all the old roots. The new rose went in but because I had recently put down FlowerTone and greensand, I didn’t add more.

It was only 9:45AM when I finished and I had to go by the poor Big rose so I stopped and decided to prune that.

![Big rose collage text crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23xpGrwkBHHBFcxkScPd2kK5qiUqtKzu6hHuWijssXc2Kc3fqMSKQcWkVvdW1Qrsiiw4h.jpg)

It still had a lot of oak leaves around it, but not much mulch. I got it cleaned out then got the loppers and started cutting off the dead stuff. There seemed to be a good amount of life at the base of the rose and some leaves had come out.

I put down FlowerTone and greensand and mulched it well. I had a leaf of hay left so I cleaned out the hibiscus and put down FlowerTone and mulched that. It had tiny leaves just starting at the base.

Once I cleaned up from this, I headed into the Big garden.

![Big garden - 2nd pea area cleared crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/Eou9jGXnipg4aVqZqfV49X6D2Pd6X1T5bBVfG4mKt1J5uBa1Ua3Vt85ZYdgVS6VSAT6.jpg)

I started laying out in the middle third of the garden to find out where the sugar pod pea fences went. My helper friend arrived at 10:30AM and after getting the chores in the house done, he came out to help.

I started moving mulch for the sugar pod pea area and he raked it behind me. Then we went and got the T posts out and got them up. We had gone to get the rest of the T posts and the pea fences for the green pea area when I realized at noon that I should deal with the tarps as it was to rain for 2 days starting Wednesday.

![Drying tarps crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/Eou8Hcw8ok6A2eRkRmgEnHdBFFdbWqRpojTqTPhfNNrLQVDeQ1MD1LZyChUVUmLiuQ9.jpg)

So we dragged out the plastic that had covered the cold frame and got that folded and put away. Then we dragged out the tarps that had covered the kindling in the truck and got them on the line to dry.

![Pea fences out crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/EoGypJCTNHfE3x8UiF6cV2KZpvwykfg8PjcX7v2U9NCRJf1L3ALAeqs4JZG7sf1XrZe.jpg)

I had to go to the barn to find wire for attaching the fences to the T posts and my helper friend brought the rolls of fencing to the garden.

![Big garden - 1st pea area posts in crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23ywptafDshmFJEbNV32dBYD6JdsZF4pkgXHHurnXxBGbBBHKaWDj9DXdWqPGywd9frY8.jpg)

As I was thinking about how he wouldn’t be back until next Tuesday, I decided to layout the green pea area and see how many posts we had and needed. Turns out I was 5 short, so he went to the lumber yard to get more while I finished laying out.

Then he got them pounded in. It was 2PM by now and so we cleaned up and went to get the tarps off the line and put away.

I sat under the trees and made my notes and rested a while. My helper friend has a new app on his phone that can identify bird calls from an amazing distance. So we listened to the songs around us and he read off the IDs as they appeared. I think this has been the most useful app anyone has had on their phone.

Once he left, I went in for something to eat and laid on the couch “watching” ‘Murphy’s Romance’ but really dozing for an hour. I got up at 5:30PM and got a shower and made some supper. Shortly after, my #1 intern arrived with her nephew who is 3. He was sleeping over in Auntie’s room.

I was in bed after pulling shades by 8PM. My son would light a fire during the night as it’s to rain most of the morning on Wednesday, then cold and cloudy and start raining Wednesday night and all day Thursday.

Too bad we didn’t get the peas in…sigh…

The window guy is supposed to arrive at 9AM so I have to prep the second floor for that. I also have to water all the seedlings. That ought to finish me off in grand style…

![Mini bio framed Jan 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23xyn876JURgHHjsp757ZTvXeEEBjdDeLXWynRcLCeuqwPPsqtEtXTosSPyKZdAgWivJB.jpg)

title.title: Robbie looked very perplexed.
title.body:
*Say mate*, he said, *this rain is now interfering with my love life, as it keeps on dousing my romantic candle flame every night.* :)
![077 D.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23tvZzb1Sr48ANfh7zoGgzzqqeSNMZHx7i7nxACeYriLo7pGuHzfwwqiSWYC5PauScS4z.jpg)

Robbie is a Cape Robin-chat, and he was not very chatty today.

Yet another stormy day as the second cold front moved in. Cold, and wet with gale force wind gusts, that rips the trees apart. We ran out of milk and popped out to the local shop. At the same time, I wanted to have a look at our surroundings as we had very heavy rains and wind during the night. Nature was in a dark mood, and it created havoc across our province with floods and damages.
It is a short trip to the shop, and I picked up some interesting shots along the way. And so, let me show you what things looked like over here now.



The wind cleared out our neighbor's granadilla fence.
![002.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EoChAuGxikLgar34Tx915WpTNicbP6ESXLFfUjdrKUsSYwKwfrYrzGhbBpBGFwhry3e.JPG)

A first casualty as the wind ripped this branch off a high tree. (2 shots)
![108.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23wC7dz1yF7yk3czW5KQzvYRMtVrqVCy3Z3v2RUeJxUnrR4qT2ZnPkhgDRy3C9qCcToaa.JPG)

You can see the rotten parts at the tip that weakened the branch.
![116.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EpVC5jfAdyrrfYNwgiUMu6gtkJ2zd8xM7B7F5xaRD4DgWUeoV7GK8zsEuvZFZWA5cJa.JPG)

As we turned a corner, we saw this wet baby again. 
![102.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23u67BakkPGTP3gHYfnY595Q7bcCh5JBzhx6uY5RgFpn24ybB2uhxk8AnJqu52yLGfaFe.JPG)

Searching for something to eat.
![104.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23tvgqKoAosnF4BtadWej5SvYZMDzAEvHRyDrCWc1eBeUFd8HJsC7hYgHSJ9asdpaixCf.JPG)

**Let me show you the road on our way.** 

We had to carefully find our way around those branches, and I did not have a raincoat on else we would have stopped and I would have dragged them to the side. But the rain was heavy and they have road clearing teams at work in this area. 
![005.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/Ep1WsnCmpjhvvBdSnxWYD3rz1SRXRWFgkRwZT8YfqhQXkdX5xa3tewGXK3SKJqncu3Q.JPG)

One had to battle to see the far end of the road, as the rain blocked it.
![009.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23xVHPcJwGJingrp2ynXQ8nKDVdriv8shwby8Rnv8XdM5S9AaTT9bhDowJqHz3wZ4Frws.JPG)

At least our car had a free wash:)
![014.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/243frmJD58wKxhAFsS1KXcw5NmdVM82J5NPXTxhqB6PY9m1Un49QMfKyuenCyqnxnMoPu.JPG)

And this was on the way back home. 
![016.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23wWw7WsLmhDeyVAtQk3JCrYeVjvQmKPeGBJkxUUrLCww4oxhvgtE6o5MX5W7HrPJwb9T.JPG)

So, minimal damages in our immediate area and we are so sad to see what's going on elsewhere in the country. We have many very old trees, some one hundred years plus old, and when the wind drops one of those trees it can flatten whatever it falls on, cars or houses. Recently, the owner of the property also informed me that they will have to remove the giant pine tree where I get the Peregrine falcon on. The old branches are starting to come off, and it is a fear that the tree will topple over in the wind as it can destroy anything that it falls on. 

A bit of good news is that the dam levels are increasing, but that is about all the good news that there is as some farmers inland had their entire crops washed away. Losses abound during periods like this, and it takes years to recover. But South African farmers are hardy people who know how to survive and that is why they have become famous worldwide. So, now we have to wait until this cold front clears up and, in the meantime, people continue to suffer in the provinces inland as the cold front moves over. 
Such is life. 

I hope you enjoyed the pictures and the story.

Photos by Zac Smith. All-Rights-Reserved.

Camera: Canon PowershotSX70HS Bridge camera.

Until next time, cheers until I see you again!

title.body: That's a solid list of editing apps, I've used a few of them myself. Snapseed is definitely underrated. But honestly, editing photos is only half the story. Lately I've been more curious about what people are actually doing on Instagram, not just what they post. That's when I started looking for an [instagram activity tracker](https://accountviewer.org/blog/how-to-check-someones-instagram-activity-without-them-knowing/). Not to spy, just to understand patterns and see what's public without logging in all the time. Some tools let you view profiles without leaving traces, which is useful. The apps you listed make photos look great, but tracking activity is a whole different game.

title.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![71TduuQcfduZSwjn_1.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/huigezi/images/71TduuQcfduZSwjn_1/71TduuQcfduZSwjn_1.webp)

![5rNz2Hhi9cx3JOT1_4.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/huigezi/images/5rNz2Hhi9cx3JOT1_4/5rNz2Hhi9cx3JOT1_4.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

许久没收到远在斯里兰卡小网友兼助理朋友安妮的消息，我发的微信她也没回。没想到，今天下午突然收到了她的微信。

原来，这段时间她一直失联，也是生了一场病，没办法上网联络。细细问了几句近况，得知她身体已经慢慢好转，心里总算松了口气。

安妮说，她找了份削椰子壳的零工。这种活枯燥劳累，整日围着椰子不停削壳，满屋子都是细碎的粉尘，长期下来对肺部伤害特别大。但这耗体力、还伤身体的辛苦活，一天收入也不过3到4美元。

这样的薪资，搭上健康和精力，实在太不值当了。也难怪她撑不下去，最后只能无奈辞职，我也劝她别干这种体力活了。安妮说，还是想找一份线上工作，不用风吹日晒，也不用做这种伤身的体力活，稍微轻松一点就好。

她小心翼翼试探着问我，现在还有没有她能做的线上工作。自从我不做自媒体之后，早就没有合适的活儿可以安排给她分享。即便如此，我还是会时不时拉扯她一点。我如今也并不宽裕，还背着负债，日子过得也紧巴巴，但还是想能帮一点是一点。

以前做自媒体顺风顺水、收入稳定的时候，我对她一直很大方，那时她在当地日子过得十分宽裕，算得上生活无忧，身边不少亲友还都找她借钱，只是借出去的那些，没有一个人能还得上，她也不打算要了。

如今大环境不景气，各行各业钱都难赚。我的店铺也不是很景气，互联网上我早已没了收入，自身处境也步履维艰，没办法再像从前那样大方资助，只能偶尔给她个红包意思意思，也算聊胜于无。

我们至今素未谋面，但毕竟曾经并肩一起做项目、一起在互联网世界打拼过，这份情谊一直都在。我想着，等往后我的日子熬出头了，一定会多拉她一把。

安妮没有主动开口跟我借钱，但我还是主动给她转了个小红包。谁都有身不由己的难处，大家都不容易。希望往后日子慢慢回暖，我们所有人，都能越来越好。

今天把裤子补货到位了，生意也越来越好，业绩也越来越好，熬出头，指日可待，至少，每天都是努力的状态。

越来越好，钞票多的嗷嗷叫。来来来，我哼了起来。。。。。。

title.title: Television Review: Chain of Command, Part I (Star Trek: The Next Generation, S6X10, 1992)
title.body:
![(source:tmdb.org)](https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/original/vvEeJkAt2Rb4Ax8doGBZoUtgBeF.jpg)

**Chain of Command, Pt I (S06E10)**

Airdate: 14 December 1992

Written by: Ronald D. Moore
Directed by: Robert Scheerer

Running Time: 46 minutes 


At the close of 1991, one distinct era of *Star Trek* drew to a definitive curtain with *[Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country](https://peakd.com/hive-166847/@drax/film-review-star-trek-vi-the-undiscovered-country-1991)*, the franchise’s poignant farewell to the original series and its iconic cast. Roughly a year later, another era was beginning to stir, as *Star Trek: The Next Generation* prepared to hand over the narrative baton to its forthcoming sibling, *Deep Space Nine*. It offered a symbolic prelude with a two‑part episode featuring the alien race that would serve as the principal antagonists of that new series: the Cardassians. That episode was “Chain of Command”. Its first instalment remains a solid piece of television craftsmanship, yet it suffers palpably from an artificial division mandated by production logistics and from its own over‑theatrical, somewhat hackneyed cliffhanger ending.

The episode opens with the USS *Enterprise* rendezvousing with the USS *Cairo* near the Cardassian border. Captain Jean‑Luc Picard is summoned to meet Admiral Nina Nechayev (Natalia Nogulich). In a brisk, unceremonious briefing, Nechayev informs Picard that he is to be relieved of command of the *Enterprise*. His replacement is Captain Edward Jellico (Ronny Cox), who arrives immediately to take the centre seat. The stated rationale is a major Cardassian military build‑up, coupled with their sudden abandonment of the Bajoran sector—circumstances that Starfleet Intelligence interprets as precursors to a possible incursion or a new war. Jellico’s remit is not merely to assess the tactical situation; owing to his prior diplomatic experience with the Cardassians, including having helped draft the treaty that ended the last conflict, he is to handle any negotiations that may arise.

Simultaneously, Picard is chosen to lead a top‑secret covert mission into Cardassian territory itself. The objective: to infiltrate the planet Celtris III and verify the existence of a suspected Cardassian metagenic‑weapon research facility, where scientists are reportedly developing a new delivery system based on theta‑band subspace emissions. Picard is accompanied by Dr. Crusher, to provide essential medical expertise, and Lieutenant Worf, for security. The trio undergo extensive, immersive training in the holodeck, rehearsing every conceivable contingency.

Jellico’s assumption of command does not sit well with the *Enterprise* crew. He is immediately portrayed as more formal, more rigidly by‑the‑book, and conspicuously lacking in the collegial warmth that defined Picard’s tenure. He shows little enthusiasm for his new subordinates, with the notable exception of Data, whose positronic nature appeals to Jellico’s preference for unambiguous efficiency. Yet, when he consults Counsellor Troi prior to negotiations with the Cardassian representative Gul Lemec (John Durbin), Jellico reveals himself to be acutely perceptive and strategically adept. He pointedly—and famously—insists that Troi wear a standard Starfleet uniform on the bridge rather than her customary civilian attire, a directive that would become permanent for the character henceforth. This moment is more than a costume change; it is a symbolic assertion of military discipline over therapeutic informality, a small but telling illustration of Jellico’s philosophy.

Meanwhile, the covert mission unfolds. Picard, Crusher, and Worf infiltrate Celtris III with the aid of a Ferengi smuggler, Solok (Lou Wagner). Upon penetrating the alleged secret base, they discover the entire setup is an elaborate Cardassian trap. A frantic firefight ensues; Crusher and Worf manage to escape via their transporter, but Picard is captured. The episode concludes with Picard being brought before the chillingly composed Gul Madred (David Warner), setting the stage for the psychological ordeal of Part II.

Behind the scenes, *Chain of Command* was written by Ronald D. Moore, one of *Star Trek*’s most respected and prolific authors. It was originally conceived as a single, dense episode. However, logistical and budgetary considerations prompted the producers to split it into two parts, with the second half effectively serving as a minimal‑set “bottle episode” centred on Picard’s interrogation. The division feels artificial in this first part; the narrative is forcibly stretched, with the Jellico subplot required to carry substantial weight to fill time before the inevitable cliffhanger. Moreover, the episode was deliberately crafted as a tie‑in to the imminent *Deep Space Nine*. References to Bajor and the Cardassian withdrawal are explicit groundwork. Originally, the Ferengi smuggler was intended to be Quark, a regular from *DS9*, a plan altered likely due to scheduling, leaving Solok as a somewhat generic substitute.

Notwithstanding these structural compromises, Part I is exceptionally well‑written and deftly directed. It stands as one of the rare instances in *TNG* that successfully resurrects the classic Cold War espionage tropes that animated the original series’ encounters with the Romulans. The Cardassians are presented not as mindless aggressors but as capable, cunning, and patient adversaries—a sophisticated mirror to the Federation’s own calculated idealism. This revival of geopolitical nuance gives the episode a gripping, tense atmosphere that distinguishes it from more routine technobabble‑driven plots.

The episode is further elevated by a superb guest performance from Ronny Cox. Cox, drawing perhaps on his famed roles as corporate antagonists in sci‑fi classics like *[RoboCop](https://peakd.com/film/@drax/retro-film-review-robocop-1987)* and *[Total Recall](https://peakd.com/film/@drax/retro-film-review-total-recall-1990)*, imbues Jellico with an initially villainous aura. He is the bureaucratic interloper, the stern disciplinarian who disrupts the *Enterprise* family. Yet the writing and Cox’s nuanced delivery carefully avoid caricature. Jellico is manifestly a competent, even brilliant, officer; his methods are different, not inherently wrong. This complexity makes him a fascinating counterpoint to Picard and generates genuine friction among the crew, a friction that feels earned rather than contrived.

Where the episode notably falters is in its concluding moments. The cliffhanger—Picard captured, Crusher and Worf escaping, the ominous face‑off with Gul Madred—is executed with a heavy‑handed theatricality that verges on the conventional and predictable. After a hour of building subtle tension and character conflict, the resort to a standard “hero in peril” finale feels like a narrative regression, a concession to the requirements of the two‑part format rather than an organic culmination. It undermines some of the sophistication that preceded it.

Despite this flawed ending, “Chain of Command, Part I” remains one of the stronger entries of *The Next Generation*’s sixth season. It provides a compelling study in contrasting leadership styles, expertly introduces the Cardassians as a formidable long‑term threat, and serves as a vital narrative bridge between the closing chapter of the classic films and the ambitious expansion of the franchise to come. Its virtues substantially outweigh its structural imperfections, even if those imperfections remind us that even the best of *Star Trek* was sometimes bound by the pragmatic realities of television production.


RATING: 7/10 (+++)

title.title: My childhood pet (Silver Blogger) ESP/ENG
title.body:
![Brown Orange Organic Cake Presentation.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/23z7JNTdVp4pQnzFxGp7a2cBERV8sMcrWyy6NTBKCtf1JHh6iUgvzMkJrzkEg2NV7EjMU.jpg)

Hello dear friends of Hive and specifically of #Silverbloggers, I'm very happy to participate in this week's topic because it brings back some great memories. To be completely honest with you, I didn't have any pets during my childhood, except for a little dog that I remember my dad had, but I don't have many memories of that time, or of the dog itself. But the one I do remember perfectly well is Jou, my German Shepherd. I adopted him when I was about 18 or 19 years old. >Hola queridos amigos de Hive y especificamente de #Silverbloggers, hoy me complace mucho participar en el tema de esta semana porque me trae muy buenos recuerdos. Para ser completamente franco con ustedes yo no tuve mascotas durante mi infancia, salvo una perrita que recerdo que tenía papá, pero no conservo muchos recuerdos de esa epoca, ni del animalitoen sí, pero al que sí recuerdo perfectamente bien es a Jou, mi pastor alemán. A él lo adopté cuando yo tenía ya unos 18 o 19 años de edad.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/23tSQ5pD1Ny7CJKoK2pY9XdT3ZKApbdbHZVcm4GxYFEvgnDPsGwzwWVvh5VTED73e8c5w.png)
[Fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/pastor-alem%c3%a1n-pastor-aleman-pastor-4889095/)

Jou was very nice, he had a very docile character and the strangest thing of all is that he respected the other animals that were in the house (ducks, chickens and rabbits) that Mom had in the yard, he never chased them or bothered them, he liked to sit next to me when I read the newspaper or a book, as a reminder that he was there for me, but the most surprising thing of all is that for some reason that I still cannot explain, he had a great sense of sensitivity for music.

>Jou era muy agradable, tenía un carácter muy dócil y lo más raro de todo es que respetaba a los otros animales que había en la casa (patos, gallinas y conejos) que tenía mamá en el patio, nunca los correteaba ni los molestaba, le gustaba sentarse a mi lado cuando yo leía el periódico o algún libro, como un recordatorio de que estaba ahí para mi, pero lo más sorprendente de todo es que por alguna razón que todavía no me explico, él tenía un gran sentido de sensibilidad para la música.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/23uFMBFRNoQgY3JBoGKxjJjJBFw9qTmyYLp14opucePH4ACHow82phNrqYJW3fhbkQCAP.png)
[Fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/perro-perro-pastor-alem%c3%a1n-3955337/)

My brother and I loved listening to Paraguayan folk music, but as soon as the first chords of a particular song called \

(The Bellbird) began, Jou would run out and stop whatever he was doing. He'd stand in front of the record player, staring intently. Other times, he'd close his eyes and have a peaceful expression, clearly enjoying the music. As soon as the song finished, he'd leave. It was so amazing that sometimes my brother would do it to impress neighbors, friends, and other family members. He'd say, \

and then he'd put the song on the record player, and people would watch as the dog listened attentively to his favorite song. That's one of the things I miss most about him, even to this day.

>A mi hermano y a mi nos gustaba mucho escuchar música folklórica paraguaya, pero cuando apenas sonaban los primeros acordes de un tema en particular llamado “El Pájaro Campana”, Jou salía corriendo y dejaba de hacer lo que estuviese haciendo en ese momento, y luego se apostaba frente al tocadiscos mirándolo fijamente, otras veces cerraba los ojos y se le notaba una expresión plácida, claramente disfrutando de la música, y apenas terminaba de reproducirse el tema, él se marchaba, era algo tan sorprendente que a veces mi hermano lo hacía ara impresionar a vecinos, amigos y demás familiares, les decía: “Ya van a ver lo que hace Jou” entonces ponía la canción en el tocadiscos y la gente veía como el perro escuchaba atentamente su canción favorita. Esa es una de las cosas que más extraño de él todavía hasta el día de hoy.
https://youtu.be/X6LzXFHXAYg
[Fuente](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=X6LzXFHXAYg)

Jou will always hold a special place in my heart; he'll always be a part of my life, not only because of his unique personality, but because he showed me love and loyalty like no other pet ever did. Well, I think that's all for today, but I'm truly happy to share this beautiful part of my youth with you. Blessings to all. >Jou siempre estará en un lugar especial en mi corazón, siempre formará parte de mi vida, no solo por su particular forma de ser, sino porque me demostró amor y lealtad como ninguna otra mascota lo hizo. Bueno, creo que esto ha sido todo por hoy pero de verdad me satisfizo compartir con ustedes esta parte tan bonita de mi juventud. Bendiciones a todos.

![Brown Beige Cream Modern Illustration Coffee Project Presentation.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/23u6FdQ2j9v8DRjnGY86szgGFgnNavrFjBHMZrFV9aDdSAH4iQ5F3XMeJj7iYpz2d18ok.jpg)

title.title: Movie Soudtracks [Theme of the month on YouHive] ESP/ENG
title.body:
![Yellow and White Modern Daily Vlog YouTube Thumbnail.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23u62hpTV3JGqYyDDmMogeeZv3Y4ziASzEeYoUzDuA3xb3g29bZ9Agcnh3ReKWKVLRrA5.jpg)
(Cover designed by me in canva editor)
>Portada diseñada por mi en el editor de Canva

Ahh, I'm really excited about this month's theme on Youhive because if there's one thing I love, it's movie soundtracks and themes. There are so many I love and so much I have to say about them that it wouldn't all fit in one post, so I'll have to keep this post as brief as possible, hehe. But I'm taking this opportunity to invite everyone who wants to participate in this month's theme from the wonderful @youhive community. I especially want to invite my dad @victor2356, my mom @carmen1659 (well, actually, she's the one who mentioned this theme to me last night 😄 while we were having dinner), my sister @bethyjade, my cousin @emperatriz1503, and my great friend @eugemaradona to join in with their contributions. Here's the link to the original post 😃 >¡Ahh el tema del mes de Youhive me entusiasma bastante porque si algo amo yo son los soundtracks o temas de películas y la verdad es que son tantísimos los que me gustan y lo que tengo que decir sobre ellos que n cabrían en un solo post, así que me queda resumir este post lo más que se pueda, jeje, pero aprovecho la ocasión para invitar a todo aquel que quiera participar en el tema de este mes de la hermosa comunidad de @youhive, en especial quiero invitar a mi papá @victor2356, a mi mamá @carmen1659 (bueno aunque fue ella quien me comentó anoche sobre este tema 😄 mientras cenábamos) también a mi hermana @bethyjade, a mi prima @emperatriz1503 y a mi gran amiga @eugemaradona para que se unan con sus participaciones. Por aquí les dejo el link a la publicación original 😃

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23xVRKNLpsxcdF8aVtxxCjVJU4gMK7x1X2PkeA1N55YEiAySiakKnNPAfVcrSyWKjuawL.png)
[Fuente](https://peakd.com/hive-135183/@avdesing/film-soundtracks-and-theme-tunes-theme-of-the-month-on-youhive)

Nothing's Gonna Stop Us Now

This is the theme song from the movie Manikin, and my story with it is quite unique because, honestly, I must confess that I've never really seen the film properly. But a while ago, I worked as a seamstress in a sewing workshop, and sometimes I would play old songs in the background, from the eighties, even much earlier, because I've always loved old songs, especially the Beatles. Anyway, while the songs were playing, this track came on: \

by the band Starship, and the beat completely captivated me. I loved it; I loved the lyrics, the music, the message it conveys—everything. In fact, I sang it at one of my performances for Hive Open Mic 🤗. For me, it's a very powerful song that instills a lot of confidence; it's perfect for starting the day. >Este es el tema de la película Manikin, y mi historia con ella es muy particular porque honestamente debo confesarles que nunca he visto bien la película, pero hace tiempo yo trabajaba como costurera en un taller de costura, y a veces yo ponía de fondo canciones viejas, de los ochenta, incluso de mucho antes, porque siempre me han gustado las canciones viejas, en especial los Beatles, el caso es que mientras se reproducían las canciones apareció este tema: Nothing's Gonna Stop Us Now de la banda Starship, y el bit me enamoró por completo, lo amé, me encantó la letra, la música, el mensaje que transmite, TODO, de hecho la canté en una de mis presentaciones para el Hive Open Mic 🤗. Para mi es una canción muy poderosa que e infunde muchísima confianza, es perfecta para iniciar el día.

https://youtu.be/3wxyN3z9PL4
[Fuente](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3wxyN3z9PL4)

Céline Dion - My Heart Will Go On

It's the theme from Titanic. I was about 12 years old back in 1997, and I was head over heels in love with DiCaprio, haha ​​😄 He was one of my first crushes. I remember that at that time I was obsessed with everything related to the sinking of the ocean liner. I looked for information in the library and even wrote a review about the accident that no teacher at school asked me to write; I did it for myself because the movie had motivated me enough to look for more information. Listening to this melancholic melody in Celine Dion's beautiful voice mentally transported me to the scene of the tragedy, and sometimes I even teared up imagining the number of dead scattered in the sea because of the accident—1,700 people, to be exact. >Es el tema de Titanic, yo tenía unos 12 años por allá en 1997, estaba perdidamente enamorada de Di Caprio jaja 😄 fue uno de mis primeros crushes. Yo recuerdo que en esa época yo me había obsesionado con todo lo referente al hundimiento del transatlantico, buscaba información en la biblioteca y hasta hice una reseña sobre el accidente que no me pidió ningún profesor de la escuela, la hice para mi misma porque la película me había motivado lo suficiente como para buscar más información. Escuchar esta melodía melancólica en la preciosa voz de Celine Dion me trasladaba mentalmente al lugar de los hechos, y a veces hasta se me salían las lágrimas al imaginar la cantidad de muertos que habían regados en el mar a causa del accidente, de hecho 1700 personas, para ser exactos.

https://youtu.be/9bFHsd3o1w0
[Fuente](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9bFHsd3o1w0)

The Neverending Story • Theme Song • Limahl

It's not from my generation, just like \
but I grew up listening to it because I always watched the movie \

when it was on TV. Who didn't cry when Atreyu's horse sank? That's right, this song is perfect for the movie because those chords remind us of the magic and fantasy the film contains. When I was little, I would listen to it and get goosebumps (in a good way), and it still has the same effect on me. That's why I screamed with excitement when I heard it again in one of the final episodes of Stranger Things 😄 >No es de mi generación al igual que Nothings Gonna Stop Us Now pero crecí escuchándolo porque siempre veía la película La Historia sin Fi cuando la pasaban por televisión ¿Quién no lloró con el hundimiento del caballo de Atreyu? Así es, esta canción es perfecta para la película porque esos acordes nos recuerdan la magia y la fantasía que contiene el film. Cuando yo era pequeña la escuchaba y se me ponía la piel de gallina (en el buen sentido) y todavía me genera el mismo efecto, por eso grité de emoción cuando volví a escucharla en uno de los episodios finales de Stranger Things 😄

https://youtu.be/lHytjEj7B9g
[Fuente](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lHytjEj7B9g)

Bryan Adams - (Everything I Do) I Do It For You

Ahahhhh! is one of my favorite songs; it's the main theme from the movie Robin Hood: Prince of Thieves, where, strangely enough, my crush wasn't the protagonist but the villain, the Sheriff of Nottingham, masterfully portrayed by the great Alan Rickman with his usual sex appeal and his knack for playing these kinds of characters. The song has a very subtle melody at the beginning that helps immerse us in the story and the romance between Lady Marianne and Robin, but the power it gains in the chorus and coda—wow!—perfectly defines the movie. I really enjoyed watching the video (which, by the way, I couldn't find). In that video, Bryan Addams was in Sherwood Forest itself, where the movie was filmed, or at least it seems that way. The song is undoubtedly wonderful; it relaxes me a lot to listen to, and I remember that I particularly liked listening to it at night to fall asleep; it was like a lullaby for me. >¡Ahahhhh! es una de mis canciones favoritas, es el tema principal de la película Robin Hood Príncipe de los Ladrones, donde extrañamente mi crusch no era el protagonista sino el villano, el Sheriff de Nothingham, interpretado magistralmente por el gran Alan Rickman con su acostumbrado Sex Appeal y su habilidad para interpretar este tipo de personajes. La canción tiene una melodía muy sutil al inicio que nos ayuda a sumergir en la historia y el romance entre Lady Marianne y Robin, pero esa fuerza que cobra en el coro y la coda ¡Wow! define perfectamente la película. Me gustaba mucho ver el video (que por cierto no pude encontrar) En ese video estaba Bryan Addams en el mismísimo bosque de Sherwood donde se filmó la película, o bueno, al menos eso parece. La canción sin dudas es maravillosa, me relaja mucho escucharla, y recuerdo que me gustaba escucharla particularmente por las noches para dormir, era como una nana para mi.

https://youtu.be/Y0pdQU87dc8
[Fuente](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Y0pdQU87dc8)

Hedwig's Theme

And obviously, I couldn't leave out the main theme that characterizes all the Harry Potter films, since I'm a super mega fan of the franchise. What can I say about what it means for a Potterhead to hear this theme? It made us scream with excitement in the movie theaters. It's not just a theme for Headwig (Harry's owl); it's more than that. It's an icon that characterizes the saga. In fact, I use it as the intro for my YouTube channel, La Magia es Poder (Magic is Power). In short, this melody knows how to stir the most sensitive fibers of the hearts of fans of the saga. >Y obviamente yo no podía dejar de lado el tema principal que caracteriza todas las películas de Harry Potter, ya que yo soy super mega fan de la franquicia ¿Qué les puedo decir acerca de lo que significa para un potterhead oír este tema? Nos hacía gritar de emoción en las salas de cine, no es solamente un tema para Headwig (la lechuza de Harry) es más que eso, es un ícono que caracteriza la saga, de hecho yo lo tengo como intro para mi canal de youtube La Magia es Poder, en resumen, esta melodía sabe como estremecer las fibras más sensibles de los corazones de los amantes de la saga.

https://youtu.be/wtHra9tFISY
[Fuente](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wtHra9tFISY)

And well, that was my selection. As I said, I'd like to tell you about many more songs I have in mind, but honestly, the post would be endless, haha. So, all that's left for me to do is say goodbye, but not before inviting you to share your opinion about my selection and to participate in this month's @youhive theme. >Y buena, esa fue mi selección, como les dije, me gustaría hablarles de muchas más canciones que tengo en mente pero honestamente el post sería interminable jaja, así que lo que me resta es despedirme, no sin antes invitarlos a que compartan su opinión acerca de mi selección y que se animen a participar en el tema de este mes de @Youhive.

![Presentación Propuesta de Proyecto Portfolio Scrapbook Marrón y Negro.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23wqwC8G3pmfAmUg1E61Zg3gUWbUypQbajqdteMGTFid9mWcYbLuHqe1kY7FxJ8zAiMM5.jpg)
(Image designed by me in canva editor)
