title.title: [EN/PT-BR] Horizon Forge: Update v1.5.0 | SHOP Online
title.body:
>

<center>https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shiftrox/23t7Aw2UYzVK5vd9X6zK5QUzoM5enRWq6c2pVxLDy4x9LTboHqgo5dBbsNWSchQ9q7AZs.png</center>

![divisor.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shiftrox/23x1ckYW5T1yBx8C6Rd18NYtNsYsNdTGDvWitn6Bsn1q5DyNyNy6dyVhLcGh4zUN1vwui.jpeg)

Another version ready for you! Fresh out of the oven!

Version 1.5.0 has arrived, introducing the Shop! This is the starting point for the customizable skins and backgrounds. As I've always said, the idea is to have no NFTs, so you decide whether or not you want to buy these cosmetic items, but if you choose to buy them, they're yours forever!

I still have some questions for the future regarding this:

* Is it possible to sell (internal market) from player to player?

* Is it possible to transfer?

* Is it possible to gift?

In short, some questions I have to try to implement later on; for now, the items are yours, you buy them, you take them, and nobody can take them away from you.

![divisor.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shiftrox/23x1ckYW5T1yBx8C6Rd18NYtNsYsNdTGDvWitn6Bsn1q5DyNyNy6dyVhLcGh4zUN1vwui.jpeg)

#### Backgrounds

As we can see in the image below, a \

menu has been added! Initially with backgrounds and skins. The first three backgrounds, forest, desert, and snow, are free to start with; they come pre-equipped when you enter the game.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shiftrox/23tkkCgPpP5ujyEzUsiWUuMZdGSPaRcGF35QXvuZHP8aDpp6G99r3kgyTtjjh4cdMp5ro.png)</center>

For testing and to have ready for sale, 2 new backgrounds: Castle and Lake. For now, the shop menu does everything, buys and equips the backgrounds. By default, up to 4 slots and customization for you: want to play only on one map? Just equip one background and you're done!

Want to flip a coin with 2? Equip two backgrounds and that's it, in each match with bots or players, a draw will be made to determine which background will load; if you equip four BGs, then the draw will be made among the four.

These two new backgrounds are going for 5 Hive! Maybe some will be more expensive, others cheaper, anyway, a different idea every day haha.

Finally, who knows, maybe even a contest for the community to create a background? Why not? I'll think about it carefully, if I do it, I'll announce it in a post and then we'll have the contest. The winner can take some Hives and have their background officially in the game!

![divisor.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shiftrox/23x1ckYW5T1yBx8C6Rd18NYtNsYsNdTGDvWitn6Bsn1q5DyNyNy6dyVhLcGh4zUN1vwui.jpeg)

#### Skins

In this update, we also get our first glimpse of the skins. The initial 8 are totally (and obviously) free for players. To test it out and also make it available for purchase, I created a first \

which is a new skin for the archer class.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shiftrox/23tvB1qrZSUbKhhE57Yt3wCgmJ5bCnXYzSjbKtGdoPsaWzYTgAZ8i2ERVwk1PsN2A76ry.png)</center>

I set the value for it at 3 hive, and just like the backgrounds, some will be more expensive, maybe others cheaper, and who knows, maybe some will be completely free? Why not :D.

When equipped, all places where the hero's portrait appears should be updated, such as within formations and obviously on the battlefield. If you find any bugs or places where it didn't update, just let me know!

Now I need to start creating some more skins and also think about more heroes. More possibilities and more challenges on the battlefield!

![divisor.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shiftrox/23x1ckYW5T1yBx8C6Rd18NYtNsYsNdTGDvWitn6Bsn1q5DyNyNy6dyVhLcGh4zUN1vwui.jpeg)

#### Mobile

The mobile version couldn't be missing. Fully adapted and developed, the code fit perfectly in this update! What usually causes the most headaches was easily developed.

|<center>Background</center>|<center>Skin</center>|
|-|-|
|<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shiftrox/23tGTdnYmPg9cqwiUUxAhZ4CPhrLEjczzb3oSWssBLX1J5wnY9JEy6WTDFAboeEgsaXHc.png)</center>|<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shiftrox/23tRtND3KHPtua5jUD1xg8yoPpZ7zxJZ4kdrMtjjWPfbDWUuK21eN9YkGg5ce2XmypHyS.png)</center>|


![divisor.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shiftrox/23x1ckYW5T1yBx8C6Rd18NYtNsYsNdTGDvWitn6Bsn1q5DyNyNy6dyVhLcGh4zUN1vwui.jpeg)

That's all for today! We still have many more news to share with you! Stay tuned, and we'll have more news soon!

Access it now and start playing:
https://horizonforge-production.up.railway.app/

![sun_divisor.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXEDLx7R7Jy8fHF1tA7sPyb4A9QBvmj3y4FjFhephcPCS/sun_divisor.webp)

Mais uma versão prontinha para vocês! Acabou de sair do forno!

Chegou a versão 1.5.0 onde foi introduzido o Shop! Esse é o ponta pé inicial para a estrutura de skins e background customizáveis. Como sempre venho dizendo, a ideia é não ter NFTs, então você decide se quer comprar ou não estes itens cosméticos, mas, caso deseje comprar é seu para sempre!

Ainda têm algumas dúvidas para o futuro em relação a isso: 

* É possível vender (mercado interno) de jogador para jogador?


* É possível transferir?


* É possível presentear?

Enfim, algumas dúvidas que tenho para tentar implementar mais para frente, por enquanto, os itens são seus, comprou levou e ninguém tira de você.

![divisor.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shiftrox/23x1ckYW5T1yBx8C6Rd18NYtNsYsNdTGDvWitn6Bsn1q5DyNyNy6dyVhLcGh4zUN1vwui.jpeg)

#### Backgrounds

Como podemos ver na imagem abaixo, menu \

adicionado! Inicialmente com backgrounds e Skins. De inicio os três primeiros backgrounds, que são floresta, deserto e neve, de graça, entrou no jogo já leva eles e começam equipados.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shiftrox/23tkkCgPpP5ujyEzUsiWUuMZdGSPaRcGF35QXvuZHP8aDpp6G99r3kgyTtjjh4cdMp5ro.png)</center>

Para testar e já deixar para venda, 2 novos backgrounds: Castle e Lake. Por enquanto o menu shop faz tudo, compra e equipa os backgrounds. Por padrão até 4 slots e customização para você: quer jogar apenas em um mapa? Só equipar um background e pronto!

Quer lançar um cara e coroa com 2? Equipe dois backgrounds e pronto, a cada partida com bot ou jogadores, será feito um sorteio de qual background irá carregar, se você equipar quatro BGs então o sorteio será feito entre os quatro.

Estes dois novo backgrounds estão saindo por 5 Hive! Talvez tenha alguns mais caros, outros mais baratos, enfim, cada dia uma ideia diferente haha.

Por fim, quem sabe até um concurso para a comunidade criar um background? Porque não? Vou pensar nisso com carinho, se for fazer, anuncio em um post e assim fazemos o concurso. O vencedor pode levar alguns Hives e ter o seu background oficialmente no jogo!

![divisor.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shiftrox/23x1ckYW5T1yBx8C6Rd18NYtNsYsNdTGDvWitn6Bsn1q5DyNyNy6dyVhLcGh4zUN1vwui.jpeg)

#### Skins

Nessa atualização, também temos o primeiro vislumbre sobre as skins. AS 8 iniciais totalmente (e obviamente) free para os jogadores. Para testar e também deixar já para compra, criei uma primeira \

que é uma nova skin para a classe arqueira.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shiftrox/23tvB1qrZSUbKhhE57Yt3wCgmJ5bCnXYzSjbKtGdoPsaWzYTgAZ8i2ERVwk1PsN2A76ry.png)
Coloquei o valor de 3 hive para ela e da mesma forma que os backgrounds, algumas serão mais caras, talvez outras mais baratas e quem sabe mais algumas totalmente de graça? Por que não :D. Ao equipar, é para todos os lugares onde aparecer o portrait do herói serem atualizados, como dentro de formação e obviamente dentro do campo de batalha. Se encontrar algum bug ou lugar onde não atualizou, só me dizer! Agora preciso começar a criar mais algumas skins e também pensar em mais heróis. Mais possibilidades e mais desafios no campo de batalha! ![divisor.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shiftrox/23x1ckYW5T1yBx8C6Rd18NYtNsYsNdTGDvWitn6Bsn1q5DyNyNy6dyVhLcGh4zUN1vwui.jpeg) #### Mobile Não poderia faltar a versão mobile. <center>**Hello everyone and welcome back to my blog.**</center>

---
#

I came to know that one man from Azamo Bay wanted to meet me. He was distressed about something so I needed to know what was happening there.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYjVW2K2S3Nwpadv1Zoc6yJkMUPzqcFWc9mXm8JUygWkc/snapshot.png)

I reached the Azamo Bay. This place was under Mongol territory. I alone fought all those soldiers and freed the people of Azamo Bay. Now they are under my protection.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRa4y5UizMb7afrQwquWYfCH5FeMTTNGSFYQGmQnzAeUS/snapshot_1.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYSLMNauFPDUBd7kPHuhRLYj6hymtESF83QB4JD7wU8wM/snapshot_2.png)

I met the man who was searching for me. He looked very worried but after he saw me, he was relieved. He went inside the house to discuss the matter. It was about a guy called Haraou. Haraou's movement was suspicious so one day he followed Haraou. He found that Haraou was talking with a group of bandits. He was planning something bad.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYa7mqpfxXYfzk5Bz7hVPhmg8t89aQUM8zBUPXw19Yrve/snapshot_6.png)

I decided to confront Haraou and his bandit friends so I set off for the burned house, near the cemetery, where the man had seen Haraou and bandits together.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPgBDyE86sfoQJKzNSvWNq15GifsJHogN5JPDmZpUaP6X/snapshot_7.png)

title.title: Germany Becomes A Ukraine War Lab, and a Staging Ground For a Forever War On Russia
title.body:
![w2.png](https://img.blurt.blog/blurtimage/web2.support/870946a659c0bdd4c154e8829fdbec643908a39b.png)

Freddie Ponton 21st Century Wire In February, under the white light of a Bavarian assembly hall, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky and German Defense Minister, Boris Pistorius, walked past rows of unfinished drones. The joint venture hosting them, linking Germany’s Quantum Systems with Ukraine’s Frontline Robotics, is already producing aircraft for Ukraine, plans to scale toward 10,000 units a year, and has already sent its first batch east. This is what Berlin now calls support for Ukraine, not crates on a runway, not old equipment hauled out of Bundeswehr depots, but German soil giving Ukrainian war design an industrial home. For years, German officials sold their Ukraine policy in the language of restraint, solidarity and defensive necessity, but today, that language is buckling under what Berlin is now doing in plain sight. Germany has signed onto Ukraine’s defence innovation platform, opened itself to battlefield-data sharing, backed joint ventures that turn Ukrainian combat know-how into German-produced drones and robots, and committed itself to work on long-range strike systems with a reach of up to 1,500 kilometres. The result is no longer the picture of a cautious donor helping from a distance. It is a state folding Ukraine’s war labs into its own industrial base and building the rear area of a long war against Russia on German territory. IMAGE: Auterion CEO Lorenz Meier, Airlogix CEO Vitalii Kolesnichenko, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, and German Chancellor Friedrich Merz with an Airlogix autonomous strike system. (Source: Auterion) Germany Becomes the Factory Floor The Munich drone line strips away the euphemism. Ukraine is not simply receiving German kit from stockpiles. Ukrainian battlefield-proven designs, software and operational lessons are being fused with German capital, German factory capacity and German political cover inside ventures built to scale weapons production for a war Berlin still insists it is not fighting. The Auterion-Airlogix Joint Venture GmbH makes the point even more bluntly. Registered in Germany and launched in February, it combines Airlogix’s battle-tested Ukrainian UAV platforms with Auterion’s autonomy software and is meant to produce thousands of autonomous, combat-ready systems in Germany for the Ukrainian armed forces. Every time Ukrainian engineers find a way through Russian jamming or air defences, German industry is there to absorb the lesson and turn it into volume. IMAGE: During the Munich Security Conference, Auterion (Germany) and Airlogix (Ukraine) announced the launch of Auterion Airlogix Joint Venture GmbH – February 2026 (Source: Airlogix) The named systems give the arrangement a harder outline. During Zelensky’s Berlin visit in April, Germany and Ukraine signed an implementation arrangement under their October 2025 defence-industry agreement covering the joint production of the unmanned systems Anubis and Seth-X-G, with a contract value of €281 million. Anubis has been described as a heavy AI-guided deep-strike system with a range in the 1,500 to 1,600 kilometre band and a 45 kilogram warhead, while Seth-X is designed for attack missions in heavily contested environments. Production is planned in the thousands under German-backed joint-venture arrangements. Once those names are on the table, the fiction that Berlin is merely helping Ukraine hold the line becomes harder to maintain. The War Lab Crosses the Border Brave1 sits at the centre of this arrangement. The Ukrainian cluster was built to connect front-line units, developers, testing and procurement into a single accelerated loop, a wartime incubator where battlefield experience is turned into new weapons and quickly sent back to the field. Brave Germany is the moment that loop jumps the border. Pistorius announced that Berlin would join Brave1 to support defence innovation, while Ukraine Defense Minister Mykhailo Fedorov hailed the initiative as a deepening of a partnership that already accounts for roughly a third of the security support reaching Ukraine. The most revealing line did not come from any grand strategic declaration. Pistorius said promising systems could be funded through the platform so they could be deployed early on the battlefield to test their effectiveness. In the brochures, this is presented as innovation, but in reality, it is nothing short of a war-lab pipeline. The April defence-data memorandum made the same reality harder to disguise. Germany and Ukraine agreed on a framework for exchanging defence-related data and cooperating on AI and weapons systems, giving German partners access to battlefield information drawn from DELTA and other Ukrainian military platforms so AI models can be trained, analytical tools refined and German systems evaluated under real combat conditions. Fedorov called it the first project of this scale in the world focused on defence-related artificial intelligence solutions. Specialist reporting on the agreement makes the picture even more concrete. The data stream includes real-time battle management inputs, strike tracking and large annotated datasets generated from thousands of combat flights and ground engagements, exactly the kind of material AI developers rarely receive in peacetime. Ministries prefer to present this as digital cooperation, but in plain language, Germany is plugging parts of its defence industry into a live feed from the war. The venture network spreading out from that data stream already has recognizable shapes. In the air, Quantum Systems and Frontline Robotics are scaling drone production in Germany for Ukrainian use. Auterion and Airlogix are building autonomous strike systems in Germany for Ukrainian deployment. On the ground, ARX Robotics has secured a major Ukrainian order for hundreds of GEREON unmanned vehicles, multiplying Ukraine’s fleet fivefold and helping create what the company itself called the world’s largest connected military robot fleet. Quantum Systems has also announced additional German-Ukrainian ventures in interceptor drones and unmanned ground systems, widening the model beyond one class of drone and one phase of the war. The industry council in Kyiv described six such agreements as the practical implementation of the Build with Ukraine model, where Ukrainian solutions are scaled with European industry on joint production sites and with access to new manufacturing capacity. At this point, it makes less sense to speak of German aid to Ukraine than of a shared war industry with two postal codes. Rearming the State for a Long War On 13 April, Germany and Ukraine agreed a defence cooperation package worth around €4,7 billion, bundling several hundred Patriot missiles, 36 IRIS-T launchers, €300 million for long-range attack capabilities and the first phase of a plan to jointly produce about 5,000 AI-enabled medium-range attack drones under the Build with Ukraine initiative. Fedorov said the package rested on three key pillars: air defence, long-range capabilities and joint drone production. Berlin is financing the shield, the spear and the factory line at the same time. IMAGE: 11 May, 2026 – Ukrainian Defense Minister Mykhailo Fedorov and German Defense Minister Boris Pistorius signed a Letter of Intent between the ministries on cooperation in the field of defense technology innovation. The long-range component wrecks the official fairy tale most completely. Pistorius said Germany and Ukraine intend to jointly develop and produce drones of different ranges, including long-range drones with a radius of up to 1,500 kilometres. Reporting tied the April package and the talks that followed to deep precision strike capabilities beyond 500 kilometres and to systems meant to suppress Russian air defences and hit strategic targets far behind the front. From eastern Ukraine, a 1,500 kilometre arc reaches oil terminals on the Black Sea, fuel depots deep in western Russia and air bases that once felt well outside the war’s immediate geography. Once Berlin commits money, factories and political backing to systems like that, the claim that Germany is only helping defend Ukrainian territory stops being serious. In April, Pistorius placed state doctrine on top of this industrial shift. The new Bundeswehr military strategy, sold under the mild title Verantwortung für Europa, names Russia as the primary threat and sets a clear ambition. Germany is meant to field the strongest conventional military power in Europe. The plan calls for 260,000 soldiers in uniform and another 200,000 in reserve, roughly 460,000 combat-ready personnel in all. Its priorities are long-range precision strike, advanced air and missile defence, drone warfare, cyber operations, AI-enabled command systems and a reserve structure able to support Germany’s role as the logistical hinge for allied forces moving east in a crisis. DOCUMENT: The overall concept of military defence – Military Strategy and Plan for the Armed Forces – Responsibility for Europe|Verantwortung für Europa) (Source Bundeswehr, Germany) Responsibility for Europe That logistics role is not theoretical. Reporting on Operation Plan Germany (OPLAN DEU), Germany’s 1,200-page war plan, describes Berlin as the transit and staging ground through which hundreds of thousands of NATO and U.S. troops would flow east in the event of a large war with Russia. Germany is being built not only as an industrial rear area, but as the land bridge and organisational spine of a continental conflict. DOCUMENT: Brochure on Operation Plan Germany (OPLAN DEU / Operationsplan Deutschland) – (Source: Bundeswehr|Germany) OPERATIONS PLAN FOR GERMANY Seen next to this strategy, the drone ventures no longer appear as isolated contracts. Berlin is enlarging its army, rebuilding its reserve base, preserving the legal machinery of conscription, hard-wiring itself into Ukraine’s battlefield innovation loop and scaling domestic production of systems that can sustain a long confrontation with Russia. In other words, this is a rearmament that has learned the language of startups and innovation hubs. On paper, conscription is gone, but in the law, it has been sitting there the whole time. The Library of Congress notes that conscription was suspended in 2011, not abolished, which meant there was no need to amend the Basic Law, and the system can be reactivated at any time. Article 12a still allows men over eighteen to be required to serve in the armed forces. The new military service model introduced in late 2025 keeps formal service voluntary while requiring young men to register and undergo assessment, and it was deliberately structured so compulsory service can be restored quickly if recruitment targets are missed. The legal shell is already standing, and Berlin is only arguing about when to fill it. The numbers reinforce the point, while the opening phase of the new strategy runs through 2029 and is meant to drive rapid growth in readiness and personnel. German and foreign reporting make clear that Germany’s rearmament plan foresees growth on both the military and civilian sides of the Bundeswehr. The army is supposed to expand from roughly 186,000 troops today to at least 260,000 professional soldiers by the mid‑2030s. Over the same period, the reserve component is meant to rise from about 70,000 to no less than 200,000 people. It is no longer possible to interpret these numbers without recognizing the language of a country settling onto a war footing and teaching its public to treat that posture as normal. Memory, Targets, and the Return of German Power There is a reason Moscow does not read these developments as harmless bureaucracy. Sergei Lavrov called Germany’s plans to build the strongest army in Europe very worrying and tied them directly to the world wars of the twentieth century. Russia’s Defence Ministry then published lists of European drone firms and facilities, including German-linked addresses, as potential targets, while Dmitry Medvedev said those lists should be understood literally as possible targets for Russian forces depending on what came next. He had already warned that German plants producing long-range weapons for Ukraine would be legitimate targets. In much of the Western press, this was treated as one more theatrical outburst from Moscow. However, that reading becomes harder to sustain once German factories are producing autonomous strike systems for the Ukrainian military and German ministers are publicly backing long-range drone projects measured in four digits. IMAGE: The Banner of Victory on the Reichstag building in Berlin, May 1, 1945 (Source: Gateway to Russia) Around 27 million people from the Soviet Union died in the Second World War, most of them civilians. Roughly 11 million of the dead wore Red Army uniforms. That number is so large that it can lose all meaning when it is dropped into Western commentary and immediately left behind. In Russia, this tragedy never became abstract and has lived in family memory, in photographs of men who never came home, in school rituals, in Victory Day parades and in the names carved onto village memorials from Smolensk to the Volga. When Russian officials look at a Bavarian factory helping scale long-range drones for use against targets on Russian territory, they are not responding to some fantasy of revived Wehrmacht columns rolling east. They are seeing German industry attached, once again, to systems designed to kill Russians on their own soil. Berlin’s political class has no real answer to that history except evasion. It speaks in a moral dialect of innovation, solidarity, values and European responsibility, language soft enough to blur the steel underneath. Yet the structure is visible enough once the pieces are laid side by side. Germany has signed a strategic partnership with Ukraine that explicitly promotes joint ventures and expanded armaments cooperation. DOCUMENT: April 2026 declaration on a strategic partnership between Germany and Ukraine (Source: Bundesregierung| Germany) April 2026 declaration GER UKR It has joined the institutions through which battlefield-tested Ukrainian systems are funded, refined and pushed back to the front. It has opened its industry to joint drone and robotics production, financed long-range strike capabilities and set its own military on a path toward 460,000 combat-ready personnel, with Russia named as the central danger. Nothing about that picture is defensive in the narrow sense Berlin still tries to sell at home. A generation of German politicians spent years insisting that military restraint was woven into the republic’s post-war identity. What is taking shape now is colder and more systematic than the old rhetoric of emergency aid to a neighbour under siege. Ukraine’s war labs are being given German money, German data infrastructure, German industrial scale and German legal shelter. At the same time, Germany is rebuilding the army, the reserve base, the recruitment machinery and the strategic doctrine needed to sustain confrontation with Russia for years to come. title.title: New Beluroc Aegis Became My Strongest Tank Monster — Taunt Ability Is Absolutely Amazing
title.body:
![MINDLESS THRALL.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23tm9B32bqXeNAs6HgWkv4ZddA2ik1mRGhoEW2phgvWwqRb4mSoxez6HxPvPXPzifRXXr.png)


I got the opportunity to play an excellent battle where the battle rules allowed for a high mana match. I do not have very strong cards yet but since I have played some campaigns and collected a few cards I have enough cards to fill my slots properly.

What surprised me the most today was that for the first time in all the battles I have played I neither won nor lost the battle ended in a draw. You can see in the screenshots how my monsters were selected, how my opponent arranged their monsters and how the battle finally ended. 

Since it was a high mana battl almost all of my monsters were used and it became a great practice match where I learned which monster should be placed in which position and how to take advantage of their abilities and powers.

I selected six monsters and my opponent also selected six monsters. Both of us had the same Archon which continuously provided +1 heal and that was one of the main reasons why this battle ended in a draw. 
![Screenshot 2026-05-13 111501.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23u5Z9SwUc8SufNLUoHzjX4tkJKcNmSabvdEBh28Zg4jPGuW82otwnu9a1ZHjqs5QHDHe.png)

The real key point was how each player positioned their monsters and this is one of the most important aspects of the game. Every monster has its own ideal position and it performs best when placed correctly.

If I place an armored monster in the backline instead of the frontline it can negatively affect the team combination and may lead to defeat.. That is why it is important to place the monsters in their perfect positions so that they fought well.

It is very important to understand where armored, melee, ranged attack monsters should be positioned so that you can enter the battle with a proper strategy..
![Screenshot 2026-05-13 111556.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23tbuW5bGz4JfXgHCQTeT5aPHKNJGxwjiXybifDZ72d5ioUr6itUPPZ5xrcQuBfgGuN3E.png)

In todays battle my most impressive monster and also my favorite was New Beluroc Aegis. Its powers and abilities are absolutely amazing. So far in my deck it is my strongest tank monster. My goal is to collect more cards like this so that my frontline monsters become even stronger.

Its mana cost is 8 which makes it an excellent choice for medium to high mana battles where it can deliver its best performance. However using this monster in low mana battles becomes a bit difficult because of its high mana cost.

It has 3 armor which is why I used it as my frontline tank. I placed it in the first position so it could absorb maximum damage. It also has 5 health which is quite solid and defines its durability in battle. The higher the health the longer the monster can survive during combat.
![Screenshot 2026-05-13 111715.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23t74Zo2PMcMgYMz7nidwMXjv66cVi4Eyxyh4sti1Un7yKMdvhNQ2yUJcA4SQPxbHVvwa.png)

Along with that it has a +2 speed ability which helps it dodge enemy attacks while also increasing its own attack speed. Its melee attack is 1 that it deals +1 damage to enemy units every round.

It also has a special ability known as Taunt. This ability draws enemy attacks toward itself and does not affect Reach, Scattershot, Wing Break and enemy units in the first position. This special ability is what makes this monster particularly dangerous.

If I talk about its price it is available in the market for around or under $1 which makes it a very good monster for its value.


I hope you find this post useful and informative.. If you do, please remember to reblog it so that it reaches as many people as possible and that they can benefit the most from it. Also remember to upvote which will help me financially and grow my account.

title.title: Are there any marketers on web3?
title.body:
So this morning (although is almost 3am right now), but I guess, yesterday morning. I was at the **Hive Thrive** Discord podcast, hosted by @buttcoins and other prominent community members. I usually show up to this show and one constant is the issue relating with the marketing of Hive.

This week I was looking with sorrow at how many projects from \[hive projects\](https://hiveprojects.io) have been abandoned or dead. I even wrote to @engrave of the projects to do an update on all these projects. But not all was negative, I found this project called @propolis.eng , which is a wiki application built using the hive blockchain.

However one thing is that communication between different projects is very poor. Most of the marketing efforts and web2 accounts have what I called \

. They promote the Hive logo and associate with causes like 'woman day', or 'earth day' which is not bad, but why does it matter with a blockchain? When we keep our mouth full of on-boarding, how much of the time you spend promoting Peakd or Ecency platforms vs the other tents of dApps about hive. From @reverio to @kolony to other projects that are all dead. Clearly none, and here is the question, is it a personal project or is a community project? Of course the code needs to be written by people with the skills, but is it their business to also be the marketing head to promote it. Do our community even know what their doing? Unfortunately the data that we have gathered says more that we have no idea what is marketing? Did you know that the marketing team have almost 1 million USD a year to promote Hive? But year after year, money keeps being put into projects that haven't grown at all. @starkerz shared with me some data about how much money we are spending around the project and shows the _white elephant_ projects that swallow most of the money from the Hive DAO Fund and how much from the marketing fund.

/>

As you can see, the cyan spikes come from the marketing budget, while the live red has increasingly raise with a big margin directed to print money all while the value of hive dump to new all time lows.

So we need to look in the mirror and start taking some action into cutting back our marketing expenditure and cut funds to funds that simply aren't providing any value.

Let's be honest, VSC for all their promises isn't really doing anything new or special that we haven't seen before with hive engine, or v4v app. Is it more descentralized, yes it is, but we don't really need to get more users. There are many secure KYC-less dapps to send money outside of hive and into hive without needing to leave our credit card, or social security number or even an email.

Star projects from the marketing fund like the racing car sponsoring or the hive fittness project haven't really put any new users to the chain. But also non funded projects like the dapps we have talk about before have produced any new users. So what's the problem here?

I can tell you that not many people know how to do marketing on the web. On my web experience I have never seen a video being shown from a hive project. I have seen projects from other chains and many exchanges and TradFi clips while watching my favorite youtube channel. But never have I seen a hive clip on youtube, instagram or facebook.

I'll say that this is what I feel, and that we really need professionals that understand the internet culture and can connect with the masses to engage and have you trying Hive today. That can use AI fully to create what is needed to optimize the traffic and push the narratives that hive have form for years.

So two things that have to happen sooner than later is cut the funds, review the whole operation and make a plan where each HBD generated is validated with a CPM or EPM (Engagement per milliard) and most not get bellow a certain amount. The plans would need to fail fast and fail often until we get a good program and then put that with a second tier of investment. In a similar fashion on how a startup go from Seed capital, to A-series, to second round investment series, and eventually it should go public and generate it's own funding.

There are so many factors that influences fertility in both male and female this factors may include lifestyle‍, age, h⁠ealth conditions, an⁠d diet. While⁠ there may be no particular kind of fo⁠od that can guarant‍ee fertility it is important to eat h⁠ealthy and nutri‌tious‌ meals that can help improve reproductive h⁠ea⁠lth in both women an⁠d men because some foods contain important v⁠itamins and minerals th‌at support hor⁠monal bala⁠nce, health‌y egg productio⁠n, and quality of s⁠perm. **Leafy gr⁠een vegetables**
This may include spinach, ugu leaf also known as pumpkin leaf, and kale are rich in folic acid, ir⁠on, and antioxidants. These nutrients help support healthy ovul‌ation in women and may also improve the health of sperm in most men.

**Fruits**
Taking fruits  l⁠i‌ke‍ o‌ranges, berries, ba‌nanas, and avocados are also beneficial for fertility. These fruits cont‌ain‍ vitamins and an⁠tioxidants that help protect r‌eproductive ce⁠lls.

**Healthy fats**
Some foods lik‍e avocado, nuts, seeds, and olive oil can help the body produce horm‍ones needed for reproduction. Another is the Omega-3 fatty acids fo⁠und i‍n fish such a‌s salm⁠o‌n‌ and sardines is likely to support ferti‍lit‌y and improve blood f‌low to re‌productive or⁠gans.

**Proteins**
Most foo‌ds rich in protein can help the bod‍y function properly and support reproductive healt‌h systems. Example are eggs,‍ beans, chick‍en, and fish. Eggs con⁠tain nutrients li‌ke choline and vitamin D, which are also importa⁠nt for men and women seeking fertility.


![whole-grains-2234649_1280.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pinkbeee/23xVPHoN3pg2SdF3vszzMqYv1Ynm9KWyx5UKLCxpxPE9LtseyAkb9nH6eHPpb6yUxvByw.jpg)


**Whole g⁠rains**
Oats, brown rice, and who‌le whe‌at bread are very hea‌lthy  foods that one should choose rather th‌an always consuming highly processed foods. These help in the maintainance of stable b‌lood sugar levels, which can be a great support to hormonal ba⁠la‌nce in both men and women.
⁠
**Foods ri‌ch in zinc**
For the men, foods that are rich in zinc  such as pumpki‌n seeds, seafood, and nuts may help improve s⁠perm‌ count and q‍uality. Also, staying⁠ hydrated can also help support fertility.

In order to achieve fertility for both men and women, it is important to  reduce excessive intake of sugar, alcoh‌ol, smok‌ing, and h‌ighly pro‍cessed foods as the reduction may h⁠elp i‍mprove t⁠he chances of‌ conception. Also do well to maintain a healthy weight.

Please note that only health⁠y ea‍ting⁠ m‌ay‌ not be able to tackle most fertility challenges people face, but it can‍ help create a healthier body for pregnancy and re‌production.

As a couple trying to conceiv⁠e, it is also advised that one should also seek medi‌cal‌ advice if they‌ are experiencing ferti‍li‍ty dif‌ficulties.

People believe that after a person dies, the person will come back to earth again in another body. This belief is common in some religions and cultures. 

However, the Bible does not support reincarnation. The Bible teaches that every human being has only one life to live on earth. After death comes judgment before God. The book of Hebrews clearly says “It is appointed unto men once to die but after this the judgment”, this means human beings do not die many times and return again and again to the world.

Jesus Christ also spoke about eternal life, heaven and hell. He never taught that people would return to earth in another body. In the story of the rich man and Lazarus, both men died and faced their eternal destiny. There was no second chance to come back to earth and live another life.

Reincarnation can make people believe they have unlimited opportunities to change but the Bible teaches that salvation must be accepted now. Today is the day to repent and follow God, our actions on earth matter because life is short and precious.

As Christians, our hope is not to come back again and again to this world. Our hope is in the resurrection through Jesus Christ. On the last day, believers will receive a new and glorious body but this is different from reincarnation because it is God’s promise of eternal life for those who trust in Him.

Therefore, according to the Bible, reincarnation is not biblical. Christians are called to live holy lives, serve God faithfully and prepare for eternity with Him.

title.body:
[Vaibhav Suryavanshi](https://www.sportsyaari.com/cricket/vaibhav-suryavanshi-ipl-p4992/) has quickly become one of the most talked-about young talents in the Indian Premier League. The left-handed batter from Bihar grabbed attention with his fearless batting style and record-breaking performances at a very young age. Playing for Rajasthan Royals, Vaibhav showed maturity and confidence beyond his years and impressed cricket fans across the world.

Born on March 27, 2011, Vaibhav started playing cricket at a young age and gained recognition in junior-level tournaments. His aggressive batting and ability to dominate bowlers helped him rise rapidly through the ranks. Rajasthan Royals identified his talent early and signed him during the IPL auction, making him one of the youngest players ever to receive an IPL contract. Reports suggest that the franchise bought him for around ₹1.10 crore, which was a massive achievement for a teenage cricketer. 

Vaibhav created history when he made his IPL debut at the age of just 14 years and 23 days. He became the youngest player to feature in the history of the tournament. On his debut match itself, he impressed everyone by hitting a six on the very first ball he faced. His fearless approach reminded fans of several legendary attacking batters who made a strong impact early in their careers. 

One of the biggest moments of his IPL career came when he smashed a sensational century in only 35 balls. With that knock, he became the youngest player to score a hundred in IPL history. The innings also became the fastest IPL century by an Indian batter and the second-fastest overall in tournament history. Cricket experts, former players, and fans praised his confidence, timing, and clean hitting ability. 

Vaibhav’s batting style is based on attacking cricket. He likes to play aggressive strokes in the powerplay and puts pressure on bowlers from the start. His ability to hit boundaries consistently has made him a valuable player for Rajasthan Royals. During IPL seasons, he maintained an impressive strike rate and scored runs quickly against both pace and spin bowlers. According to cricket reports, he has already crossed 650 IPL runs with multiple centuries and half-centuries in his career. 

Many cricket experts believe Vaibhav Suryavanshi has the potential to become a future star of Indian cricket. Former players have compared his fearless attitude to legendary batters and praised his confidence under pressure. At the same time, experts also believe that careful management of his workload and development will be important for his long-term success.

title.title: The Failed Milk Jelly ice
title.body:
> ![1000441154.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/1000441154.jpg)
Milk jelly is a simple drink I wanted to make using jelly in various colors, combined in a single glass and stirred with milk. Its refreshing appearance makes it a delicious treat to enjoy while relaxing. I found this drink recipe online; it’s actually been around for a long time, but this is the first time I’ve taken the time to write it down. ![1000441152.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23u6DmHBXrZ9RKUxmtjSerX35D83PQzhUNUPURCcatiV6zz8nJKhNQF6r1wCqSYrvSo8D.jpg) Well, in my opinion, this drink was actually a failure—the jelly colors changed when stirred. Ahh, that really disappointed me; the final result was truly unexpected. I thought this was a failure due to choosing the wrong jelly powder. So when I stirred the colored jelly mixture, everything changed, and the drink’s color turned into a coffee-with-milk hue. But since I was already disappointed, I let it sit longer—the colors ended up blending together. Yeah, that’s how the result in the picture came about. At first, I was hesitant to share this recipe, but since this is my experience, I still intend to share it with you. Maybe another time I’ll try making it again with a different kind of jelly.
Ingredients
![1000439370.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/1000439370.jpg)
1 packet of jelly powder Food coloring as needed 3 dates 2 tablespoons sweetened condensed milk 500 ml milk 3 tablespoons granulated sugar
Instructions
Combine the jelly powder and granulated sugar in a pot, then add water, stir, and cook until done.

> ![1000439378.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/1000439378.jpg) ![1000439377.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/1000439377.jpg)
Once cooked, transfer to a bowl and mix in the desired food coloring.

> ![1000439387.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23wqyEePurrKm5d4SqsppTvrDffbMB4uHSUcEwg1uvhgwNNPfzrdRu3RZ18PRMs1GYowy.jpg) ![1000439391.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23xefaUmUXZj8B3NnhBtzZWAHLyNxQmaMJdA5sFgE6ZvmkMEMvexgnT1QWHq27qbEV5Qq.jpg)
Chop the dates into small pieces, then grate the jelly until it’s all done.

> ![1000441117.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23xyZGuM22vZEe4cpikZTgyPbEdFCg2uTJ5P2DLBcaiktgGLVpMjPR1yXwkimWhEEUf1x.jpg)
Mix all the ingredients together, then add the milk and let it sit until well combined. And don’t forget to add ice cubes when serving.

> ![1000441121.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23uQtaenThrpHEuDbprRs93qXttwW9GfqRPBRPByFY5vRzMiDc6Dby5TS8e6VyiS3c8bE.jpg) ![1000441126.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/241tLEU572yaWGSrH91tLgEkw5912qeoausBg1YcgC4kACYw8Nqv41RQQKX9EW9zYex3j.jpg)
Result
![1000441159.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23wgWDLAZL2V3QwBQGQcSDz527wPGgzLRySR2TX4Xubnf5qQWGBe48i9ptSwMn26m9ZmC.jpg) Ta-da… my milk jelly ice drink is ready. Even though it’s not as colorful as I hoped, the taste is just right for my palate. It’s sweet, and the jelly has a great texture when you bite into it. You should know that the taste doesn’t change at all even though the jelly’s color has changed. However, the taste is still perfect because we used jelly that didn’t quite match—I think that’s why the color changed. Ahh, this is quite disappointing, but the result is still delicious. Actually, the color would have been vibrant with a beautiful milk combination and would definitely be very appealing.
|![1000441157.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/242s7qAj7HKg6M5ytkrka9y6AaTR3J3ShL2pAXFALgCx2UsxTzop9pE6kHMkZo9P11mZ6.jpg)|![1000441155.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23ynctDVCd1MCd7is2zTcHpnG2bqJVC74rbkVSmET5FSCehSZhTK9j4ABmaZHvuSjtniE.jpg)|![1000441156.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23wXA4xtBkmLX75YPH5J3fXSXEavX2CZHCCgeAPmqHKG6REsrUsbTncqPv2XNCfkJisEJ.jpg)| |-|-|-|
So, for those of you who want to make this drink, it’s best to use unflavored jelly or pre-colored flavored jelly so the result looks more beautiful when all the ingredients are combined.
![20230813_094117_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23ynhM4HY26LsJBc56VnzHwHASWwNh2k6eRFsTW3ZB37BNXHsDPbYNJn7HniS1Ky4w7Ki.png)

title.title: Every era was broken. This one is just mine.
title.body:
I have been in different sittings with some older people where they talked about the 60s, 70s, 80s, and 90s with a particular kind of tenderness. They mentioned how some bags of food almost cost nothing and are very affordable. They mentioned the easy access to education and all. Not only that, but they talked about some peaceful things, like no kidnapping, bandits, and brutality happening today. They even talked about how much they enjoyed electricity, food, and roads back then. I have heard a lot about these stories, and I imagined that I could have just been born back then so that I would have missed the country that was so functioning. But as things go on. As my eyes became more exposed to a lot of things, the more I realized that tenderness is selective. But when I looked deeply into things, those elders refused to tell some of us the full gist, and I like full gists. Everything was looking glamorous in the early 1960s because then, we were still under the colonial masters, and independence was closer and disappointment was still very small then. But just six years after we gained independence, the very first coup took place. And just a year after, my country experienced her first civil war, where a lot of Nigerians were killed more than some of us can comprehend. That decade that most people usually talk good about is still the same time that caused and started most of the things that this country is yet to be completely free from today. When I decided to take a look back, the picture was even worse than I imagined, most especially in the precolonial era. Then, we had something known as the genuine community, this strong social bond and strong cultural identity that modern life has now destroyed. But then, there were no adequate cesarean sections, no antibiotics, and no eyeglasses. A lot of women lost their lives in the process of giving birth, which in today's world is considered catastrophic. A small toothache ended people's lives. Though there was a lot of beauty during that era, it can't be compared to how fragile everything were. ![234446.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenproject/23w2gtWG1zy1EwNGrQWnCA32iNt3visahc6i76V9rLs5K2BBSidPGfpRNJvKkX4Bu5WVR.png) I could remember my dad talking about the military era of the 80s till the late 90s, and that made me also read more about it. And the reality is that that was the least era I'd imagined myself in. Not because it was unnecessarily hard. But because people's voices have been silent. And those who challenged that ended up being locked up, or they disappeared. That type of silence damaged a lot of things that people still talk about today. And looking at the era that I am currently living in. Though it frustrates me like hell sometimes. But I can speak. I have the opportunity to develop myself. I can build something online. I can write and express myself and reach the people that I have not seen in person amongst a lot more. And to me, that is not a small thing. Though it is still far from the best era. But it is just the only real one that I am currently witnessing and I have any real hand to play. --- Thank you for reading. >

Yo tengo ansiedad y pido perdón. Perdón si a veces me afectan cosas pequeñas, si me alejo sin motivo o me pongo triste sin poder explicarlo. No es que no quiera estar bien, es que mi mente no se apaga.

Pienso demasiado, lloro demasiado, siento demasiado... y a veces hasta respirar duele. Eso es vivir con ansiedad: una batalla silenciosa que ni yo misma entiendo del todo.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeYJjZatRgjTU5KowzePRYkaoZp4fJkHcrnRQKR88Fera/1778663682816.jpg)
The Silent Battle
struggle with anxiety, and for that, I apologize. I'm sorry if the little things weigh me down, if I drift away for no reason, or if sadness takes over without a clear explanation. It's not a lack of will; it's a mind that doesn't have an off switch.

I overthink, I overfeel, and I cry more than I can say. Sometimes, even the simple act of breathing feels heavy. This is life with anxiety: a constant, quiet struggle that I am still trying to navigate myself.

![RedLine.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/slobberchops/BqIuXs6C-RedLine.png) 1990, a time I remember only too well… and a time I was not very happy. I had just bought a house for the pricey sum of £32,000. I didn’t haggle, just paid the asking price. Fucking idiot, that’s naivety for you. Three years later, I was to discover a hole in the roof, and water was being collected by a well-placed bucket in the attic. The surveyor had not picked it up, probably because I paid for the *basic* survey, which meant the surveyor visited the outside with a pad and paper and said to himself, *yeah, it’s fine*. When the wallpaper on the ceiling started sagging, I knew otherwise. It was too late. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/slobberchops/23tcLiZk5sPGybkUeSY4fvXixLk9DgLpxMRKFjCN5auouCUj3YPj7XXszAwiJmSEgAeNw.png) - [Source](AI) The interest rate was 15%, but I could manage coughing up £300 on an endowment mortgage I was talked into buying. Scammers were prevalent then, just not so anonymous. The endowment was never going to polish off the debt. I was in an on-off explosive relationship with a divorcee, 13 years my senior, with two kids; a veritable old lady, albeit a good-looking, shapely one. Then, I was the epitome of shallowness. Too fat, not a chance, average looking, I would need 6 pints before contemplation. She wasn’t bad shag, but did grumble when I didn’t wait for her. What, girls… errr old ladies orgasm too? The young ones didn’t seem to care, were ignorant, feigned ignorance, but my cougar did; ridiculous. … and then there was the music. I bet you want me to go on with my vintage personal life, don’t you? It was only 36 years ago, just yesterday. ![RedLine.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/slobberchops/BqIuXs6C-RedLine.png)

The KLF – Last Train to Transcentral (Single – 1990)

![smal_16642illustrationofanelectricguitarpv.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/slobberchops/K8FtI6SX-smal_16642-illustration-of-an-electric-guitar-pv.jpg)
The KLF had been around for a while and had a couple of big scores with \

They had my attention, and I was quite into this house music with its piano music with one finger statement that seemed to be everywhere at the time. It was a 15-minute journey to work by car in 1990, and I tended to listen to the radio then. The alternative was a cassette with your own music, as CD players had not made it past the living room. ‘*Last Train to Transcentral*’ made me sit up and was instant gratification, something very unusual for me, even then. The energy, the synthesisers, not so much the rap crap, but it was tolerable. Lyrically, it was basic, close to non-existent, the KLF telling us that they were the ‘*Justified Ancients of Moo-Moo*‘. It’s little wonder the Americans didn’t fall for this nonsensical, ludicrous crap. I was content with the wall of sound it created, though today it does sound like a relic that sits firmly in the year it was created. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pC_zffOenk8 ![RedLine.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/slobberchops/BqIuXs6C-RedLine.png)

Snoop Doggy Dogg – What’s My Name? (Doggystyle - 1993)

![smal_16642illustrationofanelectricguitarpv.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/slobberchops/K8FtI6SX-smal_16642-illustration-of-an-electric-guitar-pv.jpg)
This was a little later than I remember it, but three years later, I was in the same job, which had gotten significantly worse. In 1990, the company I worked for provided free lunches… can you believe that? Hard times had rolled by, and the canteen had become subsidised, but worse still, the IT department had been moved along sales so we couldn’t arse around any longer and had to look like we were actually working; preposterous. Snoop Dog entered by ears one day, again on the radio on my way to this depressing job. I am not a rap fan, but there was something there that ticked my boxes. Subsequent tracks of ‘*Gin and Juice*’ and particularly the Dr Dre track, ‘*Nuthin' but a 'G' Thang*’ also hit the spot. Was it that laid-back West Coast sound? I reckon so. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2soGJXQAQec ![RedLine.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/slobberchops/BqIuXs6C-RedLine.png)

Tanita Tikaram - Twist in My Sobriety (Ancient Heart – 1988)

![smal_16642illustrationofanelectricguitarpv.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/slobberchops/K8FtI6SX-smal_16642-illustration-of-an-electric-guitar-pv.jpg)
A couple of years earlier, this strange one entered the UK charts and did just enough to gain my attention. I distinctly remember @steddyman mentioning this to me and that he was intrigued by its dark, brooding sound. A few days later, he must have analysed it and summarily dismissed it as arty crap! ‘The lyrics make no sense', he proclaimed. I didn’t see it that way, and fuck knows what he would make of the lyrical content of the ‘*Cocteau Twins*’ if he thought this was junk. Looking at the lyrics [here](https://genius.com/Tanita-tikaram-twist-in-my-sobriety-lyrics), I wouldn’t call them out to be more gibberish than many other songs. As for the song itself, it’s not something I listen to now, but takes me back to that time of stagnation, unfulfilment and poking old hole. If only I could have seen what was coming, the internet, the future, the shameless act of dating sites. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7s8glZ-efMg
![smal_16642illustrationofanelectricguitarpv.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/slobberchops/K8FtI6SX-smal_16642-illustration-of-an-electric-guitar-pv.jpg)

title.title: Last week's running summary // Résumé running de la semaine dernière [EN/FR]
title.body:
<center>![running semaine 4 mai .png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/Ep3dGzjDUkBYmD2MrYNHdH7xswfWynQnSh8VT7x3M5VYDPEUtGvoPuV4vFx4U6MrmNm.jpg)</center>

Hey everyone! I hope you're all doing great 😁

We're back with another running recap. And this week has been really satisfying! We completed our three running sessions and all our walking sessions. And honestly, I feel better, I feel fitter since we started this new routine.

We started the week with a free run on Monday: I ran 4.1 km without stopping. The usual route, the loop that includes the long straight stretch through the forest and the winding road.

<center>![running lundi.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/23xyLUXwDzw2JHWZ3x21T6gDp2LdYLcxx4KcqkzNSdmfkuZwKcTgUjCpQBn1opR9z36BB.png)</center>

I ran at an even faster pace than usual: 7:20/km. That's my record.

There were no difficulties during this session.

Then, I continued the running week on Wednesday. It was interval training!

This time, we ran for 10 minutes, until we reached the street where we do our sprints. Next, we did 6 sets of [30 seconds of sprinting, 30 seconds of jogging]. The 6th repetition was tough, but I managed it.

As we continue with interval training, we'll increase the number of repetitions.

Then we ran home. In total, it was a little over 5 km, which isn't bad!

<center>![course mercredi.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/23w2couMQYykfp1w6c37XYkFxHsaYDy4n1H8m5pqRCHkmFBiAP5kJfkPmjo6aCgjWhibp.png)</center>

And to finish off the week's running sessions, we went for a run on Friday. It was our long run. I managed to run 5 km, but I stopped for 30 seconds. At the time, I was a little disappointed in myself, but when I think about it, 30 seconds of walking out of 5 km isn't a huge deal.

<center>![course vendredi.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/23vhVrzxH5YY3Qoj7wjPKta5kp65WhhxDhfsoxdjKo7wP2UUgzRvx32xGNPerdauqiZyE.png)</center>

Besides, my goal was to run 5 km in 40 or 45 minutes in September. And I managed to run 5 km in 38 minutes. So, that's really good!

I think that by training regularly—between two and three runs per week between now and September—I might be able to reduce my time and reach 35 minutes for 5 km.

Of course, between each run, we don't forget our daily walk: between two and four kilometers.

In short, another good, busy week! I'm quite proud of myself.

Have a good week! 😁

See you soon,
Johanna

PS: I used Google Translate to translate the English part.


____________________

<center>*Version en français*</center>

____________________

<center>![running semaine 4 mai .png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/Ep3dGzjDUkBYmD2MrYNHdH7xswfWynQnSh8VT7x3M5VYDPEUtGvoPuV4vFx4U6MrmNm.jpg)</center>

Hello les amis ! J’espère que vous allez tous très bien 😁

On se retrouve pour un nouveau résumé running. Et cette semaine a été très satisfaisante ! On a bien fait nos 3 séances de course et toutes nos séances de marche. Et franchement, je me sens mieux, je me sens plus en forme depuis qu’on a pris cette nouvelle routine.

On a commencé la semaine par une séance de course libre lundi : j’ai couru 4,1 km sans m’arrêter. Le tour habituel, la boucle qui passe par la longue ligne droite en forêt et la route sinueuse.

<center>![running lundi.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/23xyLUXwDzw2JHWZ3x21T6gDp2LdYLcxx4KcqkzNSdmfkuZwKcTgUjCpQBn1opR9z36BB.png)</center>

J’ai couru à une allure encore plus rapide que d’habitude : 7:20/km. C’est mon record. 

Il n’y avait aucune difficulté sur cette séance.

Ensuite, j’ai continué la semaine running mercredi. C’était la séance fractionnée ! 

Cette fois-ci, nous avons couru 10 minutes, jusqu’à arriver dans la rue où nous faisons nos lignes droites. Ensuite, nous avons fait 6 x [30 secondes de sprint, 30 secondes de course lente]. La 6 ème répétition était compliquée, mais réussie. 

Au fur et à mesure des séances de fractionnés, on va augmenter le nombre de répétitions.

On est ensuite rentrés à la maison en courant. Au total, cela fait quand même un tout petit peu plus de 5 km, c’est pas mal ! 

<center>![course mercredi.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/23w2couMQYykfp1w6c37XYkFxHsaYDy4n1H8m5pqRCHkmFBiAP5kJfkPmjo6aCgjWhibp.png)</center>

Et pour terminer les séances running de la semaine, on a été courir vendredi. C’était notre sortie longue. Pour ma part, j’ai réussi à courir 5km, mais je me suis arrêté pendant 30 secondes. Sur le coup, j’étais un peu déçu de moi, mais finalement quand j’y repense, 30 secondes de marche sur 5km, ce n’est pas énorme.

<center>![course vendredi.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/23vhVrzxH5YY3Qoj7wjPKta5kp65WhhxDhfsoxdjKo7wP2UUgzRvx32xGNPerdauqiZyE.png)</center>

Et d’ailleurs, mon objectif était de courir 5km en 45 ou 40 minutes en septembre. Et là, j’ai réussi à courir 5km en 38 minutes. Donc, c’est vraiment bien !

Je pense qu’en s'entraînant encore régulièrement : entre 2 et 3 séances de course par semaine d’ici septembre, je pourrais peut-être réduire mon temps et atteindre les 35 minutes pour 5 km. 

Évidemment, entre chaque séance de course, nous n’oublions pas d’aller faire notre marche quotidienne : entre 2 et 4 kilomètres.

Bref, encore une bonne semaine, bien remplie ! Je suis assez fière de moi.

Je vous souhaite une bonne semaine  😁

À bientôt, 
Johanna 

PS : J’ai utilisé Google Traduction pour traduire la partie en anglais.

title.title: The Peter Principle: Why We Keep Promoting People Into Misery
title.body:
Let me tell you something that happens in almost every workplace, every industry, every country. It's not malicious. Nobody plans it. But it costs organisations a fortune and quietly crushes good people along the way.

It's called the Peter Principle, and once you see it, you can't unsee it.
The idea is simple: people get promoted because they're good at their current job. Makes sense, right? Gary on the workshop floor is your best mechanic. Turns up on time, knows every engine, customers love him. So you make Gary the floor lead. Why wouldn't you?
Here's the problem. Being brilliant at fixing engines doesn't automatically make you brilliant at managing people, running rosters, handling conflict, or running a project. Sometimes it does. But often, it doesn't. And that's where things start to go sideways.


![1000026823.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/failingforwards/23sxozv4J6Ef8x1F9CDqckntgXrNJXVjQQNgp6qXr2Y82Dn4MygrhsCKcdDBMkFfitNYZ.jpg)


Gary is now struggling. He's out of his depth but he's not going to say that, and honestly, why would he? He's finally been seen. He worked hard for years and someone noticed. He's proud of the title. He told his family. He's not about to raise his hand and say *\
Look, stepping back is an option. No foul, no harm, no shame. You were a champion at what you did before. That value doesn't disappear.\
You don't have to stay there.\

Hey, I’m really sorry to bother you again, and I truly appreciate everything you’ve already done for me, especially after all the help you gave me with my previous Hive account.

I’ve been trying to log into the new account, but I finally realized the issue seems to come from the forwarded email containing the keys. When I copy the posting key from the email and paste it into Hive Keychain, some characters are missing, so the key becomes incomplete and Keychain says it’s an incorrect private key. I also learned that Hive keys cannot be edited or manually completed, so even if I try to add the missing characters, it still fails.

So the problem is not that I don’t understand the process, but that the key seems to get cut off or corrupted when copied from the forwarded email format.

If it’s easier for you, there are two possible ways that might work better without causing you too much trouble:

1. Telegram (if you use it):
   You could simply copy and paste each key directly in plain text (Posting, Active, Owner, Memo).

My Telegram username is:
@yulienhz

2. Email:
   You could send a completely new email (not forwarded) and paste each key directly as plain text, or attach them in a simple .txt file. That should prevent any characters from being cut off when copying.

body.body:
<center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/gfdf65feb242235d19f31c2e7cf5175a0ca91a42e3677fcfe36a7061eb87cee989ec83b9f1868975c1a85b6f603034ce7555c7e5af2a1fae1f002f56e77d5080c_640.jpg)</center>

***

# 自然的美

自然是我們生活中不可或缺的一部分，它以其獨特的方式影響著我們的情感、思想和行為。無論是壯麗的山脈、廣闊的海洋，還是繁茂的森林，自然都以其無與倫比的美麗吸引著我們。

## 自然的元素

### 1. 山脈
山脈是地球上最壯觀的地形之一。它們不僅提供了壯麗的風景，還是許多生物的棲息地。登山不僅是一種體育活動，更是一種與大自然親密接觸的方式。

### 2. 水體
海洋、湖泊和河流是地球上生命的重要源泉。水體不僅滋養了無數的生物，還為人類提供了休閒和娛樂的場所。每當我們站在海邊，聽著海浪的聲音，心靈便會感到無比的平靜。

### 3. 森林
森林是地球的肺，它們吸收二氧化碳，釋放氧氣，為我們提供了清新的空氣。森林中生物多樣性豐富，是許多動植物的家園。漫步在樹林中，我們能感受到大自然的氣息，仿佛置身於一個神秘的世界。

## 自然的價值

自然不僅僅是美麗的風景，它還擁有深遠的生態價值和經濟價值。保持自然的健康和完整性對於人類的生存至關重要。

### 生態價值
自然生態系統的健康直接影響著我們的生活質量。生物多樣性能夠提供穩定的生態系統，減少災害的影響。

### 經濟價值
許多行業，如旅遊、農業和漁業，都依賴於自然資源。可持續的自然管理不僅能保護環境，還能促進經濟增長。

## 結論

自然的美無處不在，它是我們生活的靈感來源。我們應該珍惜並保護這片土地，讓未來的世代也能欣賞到這份美好。在日常生活中，我們可以通過簡單的行動，如減少塑料使用、參加環保活動，來為保護自然出一份力。讓我們一起努力，守護這片美麗的自然！

[CHICAGO], 13 de mayo de 2026 – El proyecto artístico Crystal de Seda, liderado por el productor y músico Jhon Gregory Castro Jiménez, continúa consolidando su presencia en la escena independiente con el lanzamiento de material exclusivo de sus recientes presentaciones en directo.

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQ6iaRoJHrfqiwdVL4iNQKixMLS5C7Tdw1WdDDXieUvzF/284c5d60cb51edd7090448127a1d0fd0.jpg 

En una reciente sesión capturada en blanco y negro, el artista mostró la fuerza interpretativa que define su propuesta sonora, centrada en géneros como el Rock-Pop y el Dark pop. La imagen captura un momento de alta carga emocional durante la ejecución de su sencillo \
, una pieza que explora la dualidad de la identidad y la fragilidad.\n\n\

, comentó Gregory, quien además de su faceta como intérprete, destaca por su labor como gestor cultural a través del Santa Rosalía Fest, plataforma que apoya a más de 300 artistas independientes.

La producción en vivo contó con la colaboración del guitarrista Richard Martinez, cuya ejecución complementa la atmósfera cinemática y elegante que caracteriza la identidad visual de la banda. Actualmente, Crystal de Seda se encuentra desarrollando los elementos visuales para un show de 20 minutos, buscando elevar la experiencia del espectador a un nivel multisensorial.

Este material marca el inicio de una serie de actualizaciones que el artista compartirá de forma descentralizada en la blockchain de Hive, reafirmando su compromiso con la independencia creativa y la innovación tecnológica en la industria musical.

Today is going to be a big workday. I probably won’t really have time to run the curation bot like usual, because I’ll also need to use the PC on which the program runs internally. So it’s going to be complicated to manage everything at the same time. Maybe I’ll be able to run it here and there when I get the chance, but clearly it won’t be a very productive day on that side.

In fact, today I have to replace someone on top of my own work, which means I’ll be handling multiple tasks non-stop. So yeah, it’s going to be a pretty intense day, and I won’t have much time to breathe or do anything else. Those kinds of days where you have to do the job of two people can get exhausting pretty quickly, especially when it wasn’t planned in the first place.

Still, I’m trying to look at the positive side: even if I can’t really take care of the bot, it will allow my voting mana to recharge nicely. That’s not such a bad thing in the long run, even if, in the moment, it’s a bit frustrating to put things on hold and deal with this extra workload.

I still managed to quickly launch the automated curation bot, just enough time to write this short post so I don’t completely fall behind. And on a positive note: as you may have noticed, my reputation keeps slowly but surely climbing back into the positive range. I’m currently at 0.9, so it’s only a matter of a few more days before I become fully visible again.

Honestly, it feels good to see things moving forward, even slowly. After all the effort put in, it really gives me motivation to keep going and not give up.

business\\.title: All You Need to Know About Special Event Security Guards
business\\.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRYPQfBfZX9jZPxH18PHP52fcVw5JFihpacUKcSx5bAot/All%20You%20Need%20to%20Know%20About%20Special%20Event%20Security%20Guards.jpg 

The more special the event, the higher the risk. Whether it’s a corporate meeting, a concert, or a public gathering, proper security measures are essential to maintain order, minimize risks, and ensure a seamless event experience for everyone.

 [Special event security guards](https://reliablesecuritystaffing.com/event-security-services-atlanta/)  are hired professionals who handle security through access control, patrolling, crowd management, surveillance, and emergency response during special corporate or public events. The duties of event security are not limited to ensuring everyone’s safety. They are responsible for maintaining order and preventing threats. Here’s everything you need to know about special event security guards, what they do, and why they are important.

## What Are Special Event Security Guards?
Special event security guards are highly trained guards hired by corporations or event managers to handle the security of special events. They may be hired to handle security for a particular person, area, or the entire event.

Event security guards are trained in access control, crowd management, and quick response to incidents or emergencies.

## How are event security personnel different from standard guards?

- Event security guards are trained to operate in environments with large crowds and a high risk of incidents.
- They can adapt to dynamic situations: increasing crowds, evolving threats, and unexpected incidents.
- They maintain coordination with local law enforcement agencies, ensuring prompt response and a smooth handover.
- They are trained to respond to emergencies and threats effectively.
- They are approachable and always ready to help guests and organizers while maintaining security.
- They can identify and prevent potential threats before they escalate.

## Key Roles and Duties of Special Event Security Personnel
### 1. Tactical Pre-Event Risk Mapping
Weeks before the event begins, security personnel conduct a comprehensive assessment of potential security threats. They analyze specific risks based on the event location, estimated crowd density, physical perimeter, and unauthorized access.

Guards conduct physical inspections of the venue to check entry and exit points, including fire exits, ensure accessibility in case of emergencies, and identify surveillance blind spots and high-risk zones or assets that may need special attention during the event.

Event guards plan ahead for emergencies, including medical, fire, or security incidents. Each guard is assigned specific roles or zones.

### 2. Perimeter & Entry Management
During the event, guards are primarily responsible for the safe and seamless entry of guests. They handle security at all entry points, checking tickets and credentials, scanning bags and individuals for prohibited items, and preventing unauthorized access.

For high-risk events, advanced scanning methods such as metal detection are used to intercept prohibited items or weapons.

In addition, guards also handle VIP access, management, and security during events.

### 3. Dynamic Crowd Control
Effective crowd control is crucial to maintain order and the safety of guests and performers during an event. Crowds in public events and concerts tend to get out of control, leading to the risk of stampede and accidents. Guards prevent this by avoiding localized congestion and maintaining a steady flow. They pay special focus to congestion zones such as near the stage and certain food stalls.

Event security guards maintain a strategic physical presence to ensure a steady flow of traffic throughout the venue and avoid choking. They look out for signs of aggression and prevent threats before they escalate.

By enforcing rules, security ensures a safe experience for all participants.

### 4. Responding to Emergencies
When an incident occurs, guards take immediate control. Depending on the crisis, they determine the best course of action, from mitigating general disputes and administering medical aid to facilitating evacuation in life-threatening situations.

At Reliable Security Staffing, we provide special event security guards who are trained to safely move thousands of people toward the exit during fire or similar emergencies while preventing panic-driven stampedes or bottlenecks. They can provide immediate first aid, including trauma care and CPR, during medical emergencies to stabilize the situation until EMS arrives.

Security guards instantly alert public emergency services such as police, fire, and ambulance and provide clear situational updates and reports.

### 5. Surveillance and Patrols
The best event security plan combines technical monitoring with human intelligence. Guards monitor the entire venue from the Command Center through CCTVs strategically installed throughout the site to actively track suspicious patterns. Upon detecting a suspicious activity, the command centre can immediately alert guards on site through two-way radios or smartphones.

In addition, guards conduct frequent patrols of the venue, including the main event site, the exterior, and parking facilities, to detect and deter potential crimes or loitering.

They maintain a comprehensive digital log of security activities throughout the event, ensuring clear and transparent reporting in case of an incident.

### 6. Managing Volatile Attendees
Every event has at least a few guests who may cause unwanted trouble, compromising the safety of everyone. This includes highly intoxicated persons and potential fraudsters. Professional event security guards are trained to identify and handle them without causing mass disruption or affecting the event’s integrity.

From using friendly communication to exercising force, guards use appropriate methods to remove such guests from the venue. If a situation turns violent, they might restrain the individual until law enforcement arrives.

### 7. Asset & Property Safety
Besides people, high-value physical property and equipment are other things that need professional protection during an event.

Event guards are trained to protect the building structure, assets, technical equipment, data, booths, food stalls, and cash deposits against theft or vandalism.

### 8. Integrated Operational Communication
Professional security guards utilize modern, two-way radio systems for encrypted, real-time communication with each other and the command centre. They use this to report incidents, status updates, and alerts about localized incidents. 

In addition, our guards keep public emergency contact on speed dial, ensuring prompt response in case of incidents.

### 9. Post-Event Management and Analysis
The job of a security guard is not completed until the last attendee has left the premises. When the event concludes, guards manage a smooth outflow, preventing overcrowding at exits and ensuring the safe exit of everyone.

Once the venue is vacant, they conduct a final sweep to ensure everyone has left, recover and deposit lost items, and record any damage or loss. A formal analysis helps identify security gaps and areas for improvement.

## Conclusion
Special event security guards are the lifeline of modern, high-risk special events such as corporate launches and concerts. Besides maintaining order and protecting guests, staff, and property, they are trained to prevent unauthorized access, mitigate disputes, control crowds, and handle emergencies effectively. From pre-event security planning to post-event analysis, they provide comprehensive protection for a successful event. Contact Reliable Security Staffing today to find the  [right security guard services](https://reliablesecuritystaffing.com/)  for your next event.
