business\\.title: Birds, flowers and positive energy accompany me on my walk.
business\\.body:
> --- >You attract what you are, what you feel; you attract your inner self. No one can give what they are not, nor what they do not have within them. That is why every walk in nature responds to us according to the energy we give it. At least that is what I have learnt over the years. --- ![20260512_232127.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xKxKSRXFborZ5NCi42LZewNctibCVkqh5JJH8FfKJskxkUrrMeQyyJUCSRdQaZ6RAPZ.jpg) --- I’ve learnt that the sun doesn’t necessarily have to be shining on a walk; the sun is always there, even if we can’t see it, and it is what gives life to things, along with the rain and other conditions. I look at the photos and it feels as though I’m returning to that lake, listening to the birds and the breeze that caresses me as it passes. I always say that it’s the details that count, and being mindful of every step is the key to truly enjoying a walk. --- ![20260226_182259.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23sJxeYcZhTWzNdDYbQsYmNMFBhmYoxUPSsJkDYpmQkxWTPhphXPpGCE6jZ8AVsNs55dS.jpg) ![20260226_182028.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243WVjxgFz6ksTiobHJkN1jTfC7B1MbyaRDK1QKbwyvtso6phxbMqKtXfMfStr415wn59.jpg) ![20260226_181921.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xp6QAvnobipFvbeZcZc2QiNtuq65dwuARoe81kkNe6ZzWoFcjzrBUPDbzQDy7aueUBm.jpg) --- The other key to connecting with nature is to contemplate it, the paths, the sky, the water, every bush, every tree, the animals, the flowers. The first thing to catch my eye were the beautiful reflections on the lake, like an extension of the landscape itself, where, with no sun, they were the same colour as the vegetation. --- ![20260226_181913.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23zS5QSon57aNaNu7zHUe2SH9koKwTTYWgpbQimGvkfM8z1kUhJ9xDdyXxPHbAxXeLrv6.jpg) ![20260226_181859.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xKxxX63Puf8nHBMy4VUyHTEsU86Yy9zPBoo7w4TjdiGsUBXZKCF8fbVJCVoSBjxp7wM.jpg) ![20260226_182159.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wgUE3U7tqoqjY33fztLtXE1xRHPxQyuJLdPjqyBeahqMZbpH5ufGmTadwsk9ArJxSZS.jpg) --- But then my eyes turned to the birds swimming in it, the turtles and even the large fish. --- ![20260226_182034.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23w2wS9KWSUCpsaMaXMJQ9GXGB7jNB5mcLqQngZhCB42z11X6zAUcYF5Lu7zoxkFCKV4Q.jpg) ![20260226_182103.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xp8dsHuvBcRUWeNfYYnu2iKSiA77TnVpVGv77YfRda1c2Z4TS4jzznSeKRynhDA7XeP.jpg) ![20260226_181936.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23tSgpDdLRpyWo4rSRduCgd47BcCKotyCRQSurSfCy5a8L96rPFwBYNMRroKwRbZPCp5S.jpg) ![20260226_182004.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23tmQ1rBXfaihQCGVjtDx4BZboHhgQk95RvwVzLJmpkHW152k4kPoumnfEdwdRQYyrG9p.jpg) --- As I got closer and closer to the area where the land meets the water, many birds came to greet me, and on looking more closely I realised there was a woman feeding them. Beside her, another woman with her young daughter was enjoying the spectacle, and the little girl also wanted to feed them, but she was a bit afraid of them. Probably because some of the birds, such as the ducks and geese, were almost the same size as her. --- ![20260226_182141.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wCL6WDXn31E9QVTan3sSZksp2kTEjJJJHWzycW5hJ1GinTLoFfSRaZNqcS1av35M5ii.jpg) ![20260226_182144.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wCJXKRaaCGVaYg1AeLtiH5Ebdr264ZXC4NHfTK6TcYvNsksAAjjqfx89QtA2hWd4zmH.jpg) ![20260226_182154.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23uQzkJ2vmnZS8BZfWk6tBXVy8XCGr75DwnMA3d358UrkDmsobfPvTGW4fiDnvhmw9iHq.jpg) ![20260226_182208.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23uFcDksYcLfrdATdC7mjiFEqMjyZ4usQaQJnQCxqrtTv6Jhayb8PHc8ZPejpD5WmG6rj.jpg) ![20260226_182324.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23x1DKhief8aDDkxKseqcRonjnJoJt9DHjhGcRNyPim1xYKnCVnhHBzgeseryAemKJHgL.jpg) --- I didn’t want the little girl to be in the photos, but I did want the birds to be in them, so I focused in one direction and, as they were constantly moving, I took one photo after another. They were all looking for food; they were desperate. But the turtles and fish in the water were also being fed. I stayed there for quite a while, savouring the moment; they were so close I could feel them brushing against my legs as they swam past and moved from one spot to another. --- ![20260226_182245.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/242ryKbTW1Afc8svwDLaK5ndirYztdnUQSToVucpyqV8UyJWPVmCSgEZeXFypwqQz8K8G.jpg) ![20260226_182554.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/241thf6XaQRW5TiMm8H36mGLsAy2jpHV6Jusj3xYusQgoJnCjG1cuwBb3nr49FAnDEBH1.jpg) --- Meanwhile, in the grey and white sky, other birds preferred to fly. --- ![20260226_182724.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23tvegYkhbaLAXLyLnU8GiZSjs7cbWH2zZkXNGBwvqKx4454Q5B9yJPKHJ3KYXnPsXqp1.jpg) ![20260226_182727.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23u5zfmLbUt4JU2DEDP7MikLbG474NrAC9REwetJnFuVbkYxa7xTZi9Q1iWKsdJhk28QT.jpg) --- I left that magical spot and ventured into another, one with various tres, olive trees, pines and I must tell you that I love taking close-up photos of them, as if the camera could almost touch them. It’s incredible to see the details. ---
![20260226_182744.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/245mpU6pRFXVjWoxCYChqyA8RxxjMCqfNzAQfwtqbYF22X9kaiEt94xGroaRdEgvdayxM.jpg)
--- Some of the pines were very tall, but both they and the olive trees seemed to want to be spectacular subjects in the photographs. --- ![20260226_185012.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/244KPG6J5LKayW6o3Raiph9wN1YdyKYvtLA735pPmsVEbtKF67NaBdfd2rvWZhsHh8R4H.jpg) ![20260226_184928.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/244UjZWidqFemFsnzeRwF6biwjCEgxv5cUBACJgD4TbEUzoWvWBLVqt8N5hXuLtW64HNy.jpg) --- The paths surrounding the lagoon and leading down to the lower area, where you find yourself at water level, offer truly beautiful views amidst the vegetation there. --- ![20260226_185102.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23uFKAX9k8rE5Ji99BYJzvAA23he3c9HywrNk2NDUU9qfKhcfYqt6CsyyypWnVeF6RbxL.jpg) --- Every now and then I’d come across a bush or plant with beautiful flowers just beginning to bloom. I like to practise close up photography in these situations, macro shots. I love seeing the sharpness in the centre and the blurring of the background. It’s wonderful; I always enjoy that. --- ![20260226_185348.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xyRDu4xDKVQzPdycDCAF9GpHu5auSHSLnVeQDty8X9TZGtbbQSTG4PQs1jnhB317UNc.jpg) ![20260226_185342.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/245HijKbtVLMjuEFLRQM6EixRfSaZQZXBjF4rF1uCAS7xAmxnDprNvkR6EdSYVtc5RCA3.jpg) --- There are different levels of paths where you can look out over the lagoon, wander through green spaces and watch the birds flying overhead once more. They love flying over the water. If I were a bird, I think I’d feel the same way. --- ![20260226_185428.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/241tVC3QW5Wet6itkDMYmFZ48UBSzerEzoBC9GQLA5GUeimHBZY8Fs8rELraKVdwzcWoW.jpg) --- In the distance, I could see a faint sunset peeking out from beneath the clouds. --- ![20260226_185432.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/242rvtTd95dd3GVfN63dS5LHAbXGit8cB2uxN2tUZk29XNJjxX77qxNPxV2dxSc8RHShs.jpg) --- But when I looked up at the sky again, the dark moving dots, the birds, were still keeping me company. --- ![20260226_185452.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xARb29vzzReF1N2uZNYe8JyCkrWS29re9beuYV9WBCT8Mao5hTqwgz6Nze4nBYt1FfD.jpg) ![20260226_185538.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23w2ighYBv8eAUwBchscRx2jPp2aGyrhduGSfS5q5r2nBGmf8cmjpqiSPSj1sFfjaQS7V.jpg) --- Green spaces with trees to rest for a moment. I love sitting on the ground and feeling the earth, which always gives off good energy and helps us release stress and tiredness, and renew our strength. Not to mention that walks are very good for mental health. --- ![20260226_185622.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wMTzjcapkawyL4SX8US5GDTVSdauyTrpD2AC1Kx4DvXfocrUnStxqbgxQqrSxSubr9L.jpg) ![20260226_185638.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xedbiGQS29F7HUt25JxB3utJ19g99iC9BjeJZd9L9QQM6wwvsuKy11wEwFFsmK4GUH4.jpg) --- Many spaces brought together in a single park, like this garden with its diverse vegetation, many in bloom, others with colours that contrast with one another. --- ![20260226_185657.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/246at4SwriAARuJ5GET8nePN8ct4MFeumFUo38oGwKhyi2CkosbvF3pfeBy76TC1K3JCd.jpg) --- The view if I look into the distance. I always look around me; I don’t want to miss out on anything that nature gives me. --- ![20260226_185705.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23tvaNQmXvMjJuBiLeAQcupYjj8FAvYnaEDLgxUYY11GnaXvn3CrSg3SA3ehS9iEByXYy.jpg) --- Like these random flowers that were about to open and give off an exquisite scent. --- ![20260226_185723.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/246atXLbHq9cciTRcNZ98yy6b2owY1ENFLrohJWj8AMuyt3PyGHUMHL1vq9LMjHbWrhgy.jpg) --- One last look before leaving the park. --- ![20260226_190210.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/242rwAngMkmpiume1QCbhm4QTJFbaz3eaF1APaNJbGAUNkJxVPYJD5dTRK6FZkF2PT9Td.jpg) --- Although flowers and nature are in every corner, if you know how to look with wisdom. Thank you very much for joining me on this Wednesday walk; I send you my warmest regards. See you soon. Amonet. --- --- >All photographs are my own. ![Separador Amonet rosa.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/Eo45huwdpJdeDRRmb3tm3Sv7mxs8Uq3XUZDd5bjvGqBDKfDE5DLGQM1duXTEQQYhyjs.png) [//]:# (!worldmappin 36.727608 lat -4.468647 long Birds, flowers and positive energy accompany me on my walk. d3scr)

business\\.title: Juan's Haunted House | La Casa Encantada de Juan 🏠
business\\.body:
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!) Hello, travelers. Happy Wednesday to everyone. During my visit to the state of Mérida, before heading to the little town of Tabay, we stopped by Juan’s Haunted House. I’d wanted to visit it for a long time, but hadn’t been able to until this trip, when I finally had the chance. This house is right next to El Viejo Molinero, which I showed you in my previous post. ![InShot_20260512_092216300.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmU3Y9hxfRmFqy4zPtYBnJ1NZU4BoeX2ujCuJoY2H2c79T/InShot_20260512_092216300.jpg) Part of the story behind this place is that Juan wanted to get married, but to do so he had to build a house for his fiancée. He had no idea how to do it since he had never built one before. His father told him, “You should build it on flat ground, starting with the walls and finishing with the roof,” but since he was in such a hurry, he didn’t pay much attention to his father, and his house ended up with some flaws that have led people to call it today: Juan’s Haunted House. ![20260403_163658.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmewQixRjQEkxDcbkPB5AriuhSWgXyLqPqaaQGhS4U8xPx/20260403_163658.jpg) ![20260403_163526.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmY9xxmddwMQtjxYF6jZpGkssZKcFgWaMXv6khmEQmPaWW/20260403_163526.jpg) ![20260403_161344.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTm2ntq5nVAi5cmFoSJy6cuAEeQoGvaKJaSByBAnzRsHZ/20260403_161344.jpg) As we entered the house, we walked through a dark hallway. I was holding Ricardo’s hand because I was scared, and we couldn’t use the light from our cell phones. As we walked, I had the feeling that something was hanging from the ceiling. ![20260403_161359.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmU7b7LNizKs1Ep5m616bXU1ojfLucCEM2SnLVh96nqJf7/20260403_161359.jpg) That hallway led us straight to the first room, called the betting room, where the entire floor and the objects—or rather, the chairs—seemed to have a slight tilt. Juan invited his friends, who lost all their money trying to win, since there were several games where no one could win; among them were completing a lap around the circle by following the line and getting up from a chair, It became clear that none of those present could actually win; in fact, none of them could even get up from the chair. ![20260403_161933.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmf86wsP2gQJQYG4NSK3sdqXZXsBnpS5mfdZPkrnngByq5/20260403_161933.jpg) ![20260403_161937.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcuiRQ6APdHZn1XYzKrAkLTTihC4FDhZKFp6snoZmUqMz/20260403_161937.jpg) ![20260403_162227.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmabikJw2zbc1kosig6535X31kNYxoAeGJxmMKX11vegAQ/20260403_162227.jpg) ![20260403_162341.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVRVPZafJxdxHEp1DirgcuVxoZcqwG6ZUMP7upErCU77a/20260403_162341.jpg) Then we went to the game room, where there was a pool table that worked in reverse—I suppose because of the table’s slope. Now, what’s inexplicable is that there was a tube to dispense the balls, and instead of going down, they went up. ![20260403_162707.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcckctFtCKPDrHxFMZxaWUoyR2SVqZkPD1WdqZkesQWXs/20260403_162707.jpg) ![20260403_162714.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZtpnf88axiPxRqHdb5wQ3uU3tCqTgAFPRzeX2tg4T2gi/20260403_162714.jpg) ![20260403_162832.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQvycwdVfS628onHHMiVbBUzySTu7DAHkuz6gBZNh4cun/20260403_162832.jpg) In the bathroom, when they went to take a shower, no matter how much they stood under the showerhead, the water would run off to the side, which is why Juan ended up bathing with a plastic container so he could pour water over his body. ![20260403_162938.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc9zTt1wwuQoLtqCSAgYUGYyVdBQZ53Nfb8FtVm8UCd9E/20260403_162938.jpg) ![20260403_163037.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNjrFNA3yq1pgsUM4JBMLgQPEHjhTY5uUivHAdNNo61gY/20260403_163037.jpg) The last room we visited in the house was the kitchen, where they spent hours cooking because the fire wouldn’t stay in one place, and if they tried to roll out dough, the rolling pin would roll back up, making the task more difficult. ![20260403_163145.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNmLxGjQCnZHmkrv2cD7wqC75fz1JTRdWp8h8dDTwJjvb/20260403_163145.jpg) ![20260403_163220.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPn6Kv2JFtRncFWmctYh5AF3m3tWJ99yqbFjbtbycRHDR/20260403_163220.jpg) ![20260403_163234.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVKAB8YFK2hEAj2sNJHtdetKXnPsCqRQPsUbCwe7eEJUu/20260403_163234.jpg) We said goodbye to this place, and although I don’t really know exactly what goes on in this house, when I left I tried to explain the situations that occur there, and what I thought was that there’s a bit of physics in its inner magic. ![20260403_163310.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfQTybMEucHenZDhHapRX7PR7SkDU4v75KmGt6N43i9dC/20260403_163310.jpg) ![20260403_163425.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbUvaVaHkkEdryoMZ6jSpbiSdHW3qJ2fgz418NxkYuc3y/20260403_163425.jpg)

--- Photos taken with a Samsung Galaxy A35. Collage created in [Inshot](https://v.inshot.com/invite) Content owned by me. Translation by: [Deepl](https://www.deepl.com/es/translator)

>

Hola, viajeros. Feliz miércoles para todos.

En mi visita por el estado Mérida, antes de irnos al pueblito de Tabay llegamos a la Casa Encantada de Juan, desde hace mucho tiempo quería conocerla, pero no había podido hasta que en mi último viaje se presentó la grandiosa oportunidad de conocerla. Esta casa queda justo al lado de el Viejo Molinero que les mostraba en mi anterior publicación. 

![InShot_20260512_092216300.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmU3Y9hxfRmFqy4zPtYBnJ1NZU4BoeX2ujCuJoY2H2c79T/InShot_20260512_092216300.jpg)

Un poco de la historia de este lugar esta basada en que Juan quería casarse pero para eso tenía que construirle una casa a su prometida, el no tenía idea de como hacerlo ya que nunca había construido una, su padre le dijo: \

, pero él como estaba muy apurado no le hizo tanto caso a su padre y su casa quedó con algunos defectos que la hacen llamar actualmente: La casa encantada de Juan.

![20260403_163658.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmewQixRjQEkxDcbkPB5AriuhSWgXyLqPqaaQGhS4U8xPx/20260403_163658.jpg)

![20260403_163526.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmY9xxmddwMQtjxYF6jZpGkssZKcFgWaMXv6khmEQmPaWW/20260403_163526.jpg)

![20260403_161344.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTm2ntq5nVAi5cmFoSJy6cuAEeQoGvaKJaSByBAnzRsHZ/20260403_161344.jpg)

Al entrar a la casa pasamos por un pasillo oscuro, yo iba agarrada de la mano de Ricardo porque tenía miedo y no podíamos utilizar la luz del celular, mientras caminábamos sentía la sensación de como si algunas cosas guindaran del techo.

![20260403_161359.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmU7b7LNizKs1Ep5m616bXU1ojfLucCEM2SnLVh96nqJf7/20260403_161359.jpg)

Ese pasillo nos llevo directo hacia el primer cuarto, llamado sala de apuestas, donde todos el piso y los objetos o mejor dicho sillas parecían tener una ligera inclinación, Juan invitaba a sus amigos, los cuáles perdían todo su dinero intentando ganar, ya que tenía varios juegos en donde nadie ganaba, entre esos se encontraban completar la vuelta al círculo siguiendo la línea y levantarse de una silla, se nos mostró que en verdad no se podía ganar ninguno de los que estaba presente pudieron siquiera levantar de la silla.

![20260403_161933.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmf86wsP2gQJQYG4NSK3sdqXZXsBnpS5mfdZPkrnngByq5/20260403_161933.jpg)

![20260403_161937.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcuiRQ6APdHZn1XYzKrAkLTTihC4FDhZKFp6snoZmUqMz/20260403_161937.jpg)

![20260403_162227.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmabikJw2zbc1kosig6535X31kNYxoAeGJxmMKX11vegAQ/20260403_162227.jpg)

![20260403_162341.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVRVPZafJxdxHEp1DirgcuVxoZcqwG6ZUMP7upErCU77a/20260403_162341.jpg)

Luego pasamos a la sala de juegos, donde había una mesa de billar que funcionaba del lado contrario supongo que por la inclinación de la mesa, ahora lo que no tiene explicación es que había un tubo para dispensar las bolas y en vez de bajar subían. 

![20260403_162707.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcckctFtCKPDrHxFMZxaWUoyR2SVqZkPD1WdqZkesQWXs/20260403_162707.jpg)

![20260403_162714.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZtpnf88axiPxRqHdb5wQ3uU3tCqTgAFPRzeX2tg4T2gi/20260403_162714.jpg)

![20260403_162832.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQvycwdVfS628onHHMiVbBUzySTu7DAHkuz6gBZNh4cun/20260403_162832.jpg)

En la sala de baños cuando iban a ducharse por más que estuvieran debajo de la ducha el agua caía a un lado, razón por la cuál Juan terminaba bañándose con un envase de plástico para así poder echarse el agua en el cuerpo.

business\\.body: Herzlichen Dank für Deine wertvollen Gedanken❣️\n\nAuf so manchen Rat der Eltern oder Großeltern hat man vielleicht nicht gehört und sich danach eingestehen müssen, dass sie Recht hatten und warum. Aber konnten sie die Warnungen verständlich genug transportieren? Konnte man es nur nicht glauben, weil man selbst schon groß war und es die \

Ansichten waren? Ich denke wenn man sich erkennt, älter, reifer aber nachweißlich man selbst, der einem sagt so wird es enden und du wirst lange brauchen dich davon zu erholen..... das könnte eine andere Wirkung haben. Man selbst kann sich da abholen wo man gerade steht. 

Verrat könnte man wahrscheinlich einfacher verhindern, als toxische Beziehungen, denn dafür braucht es die Erkenntnis und die Heilung, was bei psychischem missbrauch extrem schwierig sein dürfte, weil er sehr getarnt daherkommt. Man darf sich dann auch fragen warum die beispielsweise misshandelte Frau, die es ins Frauenhaus geschafft hat, wieder zu ihrem Täter geht, obwohl ihr Körper noch die Wunden zeigt, sie erfahrene Ratgeber hat und schon an dem Punkt war, dass das der falsche Partner ist. Muss sie es durch Schmerz lernen, denn in der Gegenwart kann man sie nicht zwingen fern zu bleiben, jedoch in der Vergangenheit könnte sie es selbst verhindern. 

Der trockene Alkoholiker könnte zurück zu der Zeit, wo er den Alkohol begann zu gerne zu mögen und von dem Kampf in Entzugskliniken reden, dem verlorenen Führerschein und den neuen \

auf der Straße, sowie den Körperlichen Schäden.

Die Frage bleibt was wäre sinnvoll, wenn es machbar wäre? Ist es wie mit dem Kleinkind das versucht die eckige Form in die runde Aussparung des Spielzeugs zu stecken, obwohl man ihm sagt und zeigt, dass das nicht geht und es dies mittlerweile eigentlich auch weiß. Und würde das Kind es lernen, wenn man es ihm nicht zeigt, sondern dieses Spielzeug nur im Kinderzimmer steht. Bunt und schön, aber ohne Anleitung. Wie lange würde es dann dauern?

Dauernde Verhandlungen und hadern können eher nicht zu Frieden führen. Den Frieden sollte man suchen und stiften und das auf alle Fälle in der Gegenwart.

business\\.title: Error - Dud post
business\\.body:
Let me tell you something that happens in almost every workplace, every industry, every country. It's not malicious. Nobody plans it. But it costs organisations a fortune and quietly crushes good people along the way.

It's called the Peter Principle, and once you see it, you can't unsee it.
The idea is simple: people get promoted because they're good at their current job. Makes sense, right? Gary on the workshop floor is your best mechanic. Turns up on time, knows every engine, customers love him. So you make Gary the floor lead. Why wouldn't you?
Here's the problem. Being brilliant at fixing engines doesn't automatically make you brilliant at managing people, running rosters, handling conflict, or running a project. Sometimes it does. But often, it doesn't. And that's where things start to go sideways.

Gary is now struggling. He's out of his depth but he's not going to say that, and honestly, why would he? He's finally been seen. He worked hard for years and someone noticed. He's proud of the title. He told his family. He's not about to raise his hand and say *\
Look, stepping back is an option. No foul, no harm, no shame. You were a champion at what you did before. That value doesn't disappear.\
You don't have to stay there.\

body.title: How to use aluminium foil on walls for heat insulation
body.body:
Aluminium foil is a cheap material that you can use to insulate your walls, and decorate them, if you like

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oasmgnKqEQU

**Is it a good idea to use aluminium foil on walls?**

Aluminium foil is a versatile and inexpensive material.

Since it is used a lot to wrap or cover food to keep it cool or warm, due to its thermal insulation properties, many people might think that it could be a good idea to also use it to insulate a wall.

What I mean is to use plain aluminium foil only, and not any of the aluminium-based materials that also include other materials and can be used for insulation purposes, as you can see in the videos below:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kabzjaKvXIc

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1EW3sdJidgY

Although the solutions that are presented in these videos, which are based on the use of a combination of aluminium and bubble insulation, can definitely work, plain aluminium foil is much cheaper.

Therefore, the aluminium foil method could work for those who either can’t afford more expensive heat insulation materials, or don’t own the property that they want to insulate, and therefore, aren’t willing to spend much, if any, money on it.

Whether it’s the winter cold or the summer heat that makes it imperative you to think of solutions and products to fight it, when you have a limited budget, this immediate need to protect yourself from environmental conditions has to be satisfied through low-cost products, and aluminium foil could be a solution.

**How much aluminium foil do you need to cover your walls?**

Based, for example, on a large aluminium foil package that you can buy from a supermarket, which it is 30 centimeters wide by 50 meters long, you could cover an area of: 50x0.30=15 square meters (about 160 square feet) of wall.

If you cover your wall up to 2 meters high, then the total length/perimeter of the wall area that you could cover would be: 15/2=7.5 meters (about 25 feet).

In order to cover, for example, the walls of a large room (or two rooms) with a total area of 40 square meters (about 430 square feet), you would need about 6 aluminium foil packages like that.

Actually, you would probably need less than 6 packages, taking into account any windows and doors, which would not be covered with aluminium, unless you are going to cover a room that doesn’t have any windows.

By buying a large package, you can save more money than by buying a smaller one, and so it would cost you even less to insulate your walls.

**How much does it cost to cover your walls with aluminium foil?**

According to the above calculations, and assuming that you use 6 packages, it would cost you less than 20 euro, or the equivalent amount in dollars, pounds, or other local currency, depending on what country you live in, and not taking into account any differences in the price of aluminium that may apply to different countries, because of local market prices.

Another minor cost that should be added is the cost of buying a clear self-adhesive tape to stick the aluminium foils on the wall and with each other, and that’s it.

**OK, you’ve covered your walls, but does it really work?**

Unless you live in a community that embraces innovation and looks for frugal ways to save money and energy, chances are that people around you will find it difficult to believe that such a simple and cheap solution can be used to insulate a room efficiently.

Most people believe that you have to pay a lot of money to achieve a good insulation result.

Therefore, if you tell them your idea of using aluminium foil to insulate your walls, they will probably look at you in disbelief, or even laugh at you.

On the funny side of things, there are cases of people who have used aluminium to cover the walls of a room or even a house, as a joke, or to take “revenge” on someone.

From a purely practical point of view, however, the aluminium foil trick seems to be able to do the job.

Although it could not be compared with an expensive solution, in terms of the insulation result, the massive difference cost would definitely justify its characterization as very good “value for money”.

After all, what you really want in the winter, for example, is to keep heat inside and cold outside, and this is exactly what aluminium foil does, by reflecting the heat that falls on it.

So, if you have a source of heat inside the room that you have covered with aluminium foil, the heat that is produced by that appliance stays in the room, since it is reflected back into the room by the foil. Why pay for more expensive products, when such a simple and cost-effective solution can do the same job?

**Aesthetic factors to consider**

Would it look nice to live in an aluminium-covered house, or work in an office covered with aluminium foil all over?

I believe that the majority of people would not like it, and as I said above, people have even used it to make fun of others.

I mean, can you imagine yourself entering a lawyer’s office, the walls of which, are covered with plain aluminium foil?

However, if you are a freelancer who doesn’t have any physical contact with your customers or people that you work and interact with, because you work, for example online, the decoration of your workplace would not matter.

For instance, writers would be just fine with a small room, where they could concentrate far from any noise and distraction.

If such a room is not well insulated, however, it would be like working in a fridge.

Since it takes time to make a living from writing, those creators would probably not afford to pay for expensive insulation materials.

Therefore, using aluminium foil on walls would be a great solution, provided that they don’t mind to be surrounded by walls covered in metal.

**Other things to consider when covering your walls with aluminium**

One thing to consider would be that a room does not only have walls; it also has a ceiling and a floor, and they need to be insulated, as well.

So, just by covering your walls with aluminium you will achieve to warm up a room, although you will not eliminate heat losses completely, unless you use, for example, carpets on the floor and find a way to insulate your ceiling.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yyGQl6APAR4

If your windows and doors are not well insulated, this will also reduce the effectiveness of the aluminium foil method.

**How to make your walls look better with aluminium**

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3jw3sgTxYL8

If you are a bit of an artist, and you like making simple drawings, then aluminium is a material that you can easily use to decorate your walls.

In this way, you can avoid having a wall with a boring metallic look, and you can literally turn it into a work of art, that you wouldn’t be ashamed of showing to people.

In fact, you could even end up being proud of your artistic work, and enjoying the heat insulation benefit, at the same, that is killing two birds with one stone.

**Alternative methods to insulate your walls**

Although aluminium could really make your walls stand out, you could use shiny wallpaper, which has similar heat insulation properties to aluminium foil, due to the sheer fact that is shiny, too, and can reflect heat.

However, it can’t beat aluminium foil, when it comes to price.

_Sources and further reading:_

body.title: Magic Shikika Recipe : Refreshing Homemade Aloe Vera Banana Smoothie 😋😊❤
body.body:
Hello everyone!

Hope all are safe and well! 😊❤🙏

Today, let me share with you one of my simple homemade recipes that I personally made here at home. I always enjoy trying simple food and drink recipes using available ingredients in our kitchen, especially when I want something healthy, refreshing, and budget-friendly. 😊

This time, I made an aloe vera banana smoothie. At first, I was just curious about how aloe vera and banana would taste together in a drink. Since we have fresh aloe vera at home and ripe bananas available, I thought of combining them and turning them into a delicious smoothie. Thankfully, the result turned out really good, creamy, and refreshing. 😊

What I love about homemade recipes is that you can prepare them according to your own taste and creativity. It is also healthier because you know exactly what ingredients are included. Aloe vera is known for its health benefits while bananas are rich in nutrients and naturally sweet, so combining them feels like making a healthy treat for the family. 😊

# **Magic Shikika Recipe: Aloe Vera Banana Smoothie** 😁😊

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX3wUBgJaGG2EcqLuSmFYYgAbmZKMkiLjSP1QZzCEPKV6/copy_20of_20copy_20of_20colorful_20photo_20collage_20food_20blog_20instagram_20post_20260513_162004_0000.png)

### **Ingredients:**

▪︎ 6 stalks - Aloe Vera
▪︎ 3 pcs - Ripe Banana 
▪︎ 1 sachet - Birch Tree Powder Milk
▪︎ 1/2 cup - Water

### **Procedures:**

▪︎First, I washed the aloe vera thoroughly and carefully peeled it. After peeling, I scraped the aloe vera gel using a spoon until everything was completely cleaned and prepared. This part takes a little patience, but it is worth it because the fresh aloe vera gel gives the smoothie its refreshing texture. 😊
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYYWfNJzWkPyoUMLCnaYWYQVhxJcdM7M1XCsxaXfec8Jf/20260509_081608.jpg)
▪︎Next, I peeled the ripe bananas and sliced them into smaller pieces to make blending easier. I used ripe bananas because they are naturally sweeter and creamier. 😊
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPe3PF2MMMwCBDpzc5jUSTNboEWPJmUfMvbDXhNfU6Rek/20260509_080952.jpg)
▪︎After preparing the ingredients, I placed the aloe vera gel and banana slices into the blender. I then added the powdered milk and water. I only used a small amount of water because I wanted the smoothie to have a thick and creamy consistency. 😊
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdh9P6RLvWA8Jov84Qii4DgZJzahiSRcCQNrUaLUSmRiJ/20260509_081816.jpg)
▪︎Then came the exciting part which is blending everything together. I blended it well until the texture became smooth and creamy. Seeing the ingredients transform into a beautiful smoothie was satisfying and exciting at the same time. 😊
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPAZQA94TCACWCehbU6GJpyNfuh2BsLXN3yn85BPcSJjH/20260509_082152.jpg)
▪︎Once the smoothie was ready, I transferred it into a container and placed it inside the refrigerator to chill. Drinking it cold makes it even more refreshing, especially during warm weather. 😊
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZDhzqEQRNMkeqbvp9j8Skkk6cxXzV19TLX99dR9ZmeLq/20260509_082346.jpg)
▪︎Finally, after chilling for some time, it was ready to enjoy. The smoothie turned out creamy, refreshing, and naturally delicious. The sweetness of the banana perfectly balanced the freshness of the aloe vera. 😊
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU1jfbAq9BvSyUWtefZoNNJqXrHm7kJ4wpthdW4PquRJj/20260509_132825.jpg)

Honestly, I was happy with the result because it tasted better than I expected. It felt fulfilling to create something simple yet healthy using ingredients we already have at home. Moments like this remind me that we do not always need expensive foods or fancy recipes to enjoy delicious meals and drinks. Sometimes, creativity and simple ingredients are enough to create something special. 😊

I also enjoy sharing homemade recipes because maybe others can try them too in their own homes. Preparing food and drinks for ourselves and our loved ones is one simple way of showing care and love. 😊

That’s my simple yet healthy and delicious smoothie recipe. I hope you enjoyed reading about it and maybe you can also try making one someday. 😊


Have a Blessed Wednesday everyone! 😀😀😀💖💖💖

Thank You Lord for the blessings and love!

Be grateful in every little/simple things and you’ll find happiness you ever wanted! 😀😀😀

Everyday is worth to be grateful of!

Praying for the safety and wellness of all.

Heal Our Land Oh God!

Lovelots,

Happy new day to us all. It's a blessing to see the light of another day and the grace to have the strength and enthusiasm to continue in all our endeavours. 

![1000210440.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23wgHPWuPhepkNntRqrA4KAV7TTdeH2fiY2KpofaPeEjNKuK7oNRgg7FZfeacj4M8X9JB.jpg)


So it's exactly one week I have planted these water leaves and it's simply amazing to know and understand a better way to grow these. Can vegetables planting within one week grow up to this level.

![1000210401.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/EonjXwDJUL2mTamGHjKEDcZD2PHBftmH4esP9JtPEiRBdjdFmnbr6vcFPGkF4BgBZ9P.jpg)

I'm surprised myself because these are the stems I have planted below 


![1000210421.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23wC7mYCC9Yojoxrwpn5Rq6tmTsN1zVuJRiPcd2WWBSEFywaWB4iqny3jziezhyjgVtUB.jpg)

I had to check the pictures from last week till today to study how much these leaves have grown in just one week. The stems I have planted are completely without leaves and this was done just a week ago here 


![1000210389.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23vsLc1i5KXVwLsJWy5jtR9psdjHkTJHGpybwnqsKUyzYeJ3w8nu23vQRNWhoyRTkC6EL.jpg)

----

![1000210386.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23xATtvrNiERrSc4FjKPS37oVfNdKx2ErYdJqHxWiuRM5ncWPdeLhXnfG6wpLvnpDV8hT.jpg)

Within just one week these stems have acclimatized to the ground and brought forth some leaves. This is the new process of planting water leaves that I have learnt using the stems.

Yesterday I have gone to obtain some of the water leaves pods which I have often planted earlier. Hoping that I will propagate these ones too along side just in case the stems didn't survive 


![1000210383.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23wMaTERz1yJFmeUJU5qUhZhU1WwbKARGLgcD6EpPxboXdiWeg78TW8SLwdYXHLYjsKPb.jpg)

----

![1000210380.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23uFRvQBHxL1WaLJWNNWc8w3eEhqPHb5xcXfrBGxoALpiAWUYVHkq2ZUh4pthsSpmGLX9.jpg)

One thing I have learnt now how much easier it is to plant water leaves using the stems compared to when trying to grow them using the seeds in the pods, often times not all the pods are viable and it takes a hassle to make the plant germinate from the pods. Why go through all these stress when the stems can be propagated.



![1000210423.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23uQvjaD9WweP1wZNbwijjkhX6cdDbtkMjHb17p6Am2utK71TKuP7nguUTZ4HaLHfQoLx.jpg)

----


![1000210407.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23uFPDmgHzJKHEX5XqrToBKwpZ4LHCci2DhZqrBzbeSAu7ABWrcYmbVHNRGggXidca1r6.jpg)

With the rate at which these plant is growing it won't take too long before we would have some veggies for eat here. Yesterday I prepared some bitterleaf soup courtesy of the bitterleaves in my garden here. These are the benefits we enjoy from growing our own veggies. We have them handy, fresh and available for use. And now to see that I can grow my favorite veggies much faster is such a blessing. Can wait to see when these will be ready for consumption. 

Out of the two planting methods I have demonstrated the best methods one can use for planting water leaves and I hope that one gardener will find it useful.

body.title: 📷 Lensball Photography in Glasgow [EN/DE]
body.body:
![_DSC9705.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/travelshots/23z7Dcqnaus8m3qxxxWacNhdbPxubX7zsQcXVL58DSvmi5E2As7o2BAEVkXu6xjSwHyzQ.jpg)

I had my glass ball with me in Glasgow as well, and on my last day in the Scottish metropolis, I used it on several occasions. The first two shots were taken on a covered footbridge that connects the modern buildings at the foot of the River Clyde with the older parts of the city. Its tunnel-like shape was ideal for a few symmetrical shots.

*Auch in Glasgow hatte ich meine Glaskugel dabei und an meinem letzten Tag in der schottischen Metropole kam sie gleich mehrfach zum Einsatz. Die ersten beiden Aufnahmen entstanden auf einer überdachten Fußgängerbrücke, die die modernen Gebäude am Fuße des Clyde River mit den älteren Stadtteilen verbindet. Die tunnelartige Form war ideal für ein paar symmetrische Aufnahmen.*

![_DSC9723.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/travelshots/243BiLq65zaGaE7H84MeNXEZyuFDJcBaTPfJimZHEMPUWB11anSkMg2RWFgzQg8K6M77G.jpg)

The next two photos were taken inside the iconic Riverside Museum, which could certainly be described as a modern landmark of the city. Besides a free exhibition on the history of public transport, there was, of course, Zaha Hadid’s spectacular architecture to admire. I wanted to capture a little bit of that with my lensball.

*Die nächsten beiden Bilder entstanden im ikonischen Riverside-Museum, das man wohl als modernes Wahrzeichen der Stadt bezeichnen kann. Hier gab es neben einer kostenlosen Ausstellung zur Geschichte des öffentlichen Verkehrs natürlich die spektakuläre Architektur von Zaha Hadid zu bewundern. Ein bisschen davon wollte ich auch mit meinem Lensball einfangen.*

![_DSC9551.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/travelshots/23wqcBq8trM9NjYkQMySiDT1uKNsnzBSxKYbgByh3qWWHYjLbrux4ftQcr1fso3cUMYMY.jpg)

![_DSC9565.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/travelshots/23ycVwAFMUaXjjq99xRKysdZrMVqRcZqHbAR9JGDC6oxJo7HpHXqAVKkGLSSd45rsXriK.jpg)

I made the most of the day’s last rays of sunshine to put my glass ball to use on a relatively new bridge, very close to the Riverside Museum. Incidentally, during my ten days in Scotland, that was the only sunset that wasn’t obscured by thick clouds. This made the opportunity all the more precious, and with cold fingers due to the freezing temperatures, but satisfied, I finished my photo tour for the day.

*Die letzten Sonnenstrahlen des Tages nutzte ich noch, um meine Glaskugel auf einer relativ neuen Brücke, ganz in der Nähe des Riverside Museums, zum Einsatz zu bringen.Während meiner zehn Tage in Schottland, war das übrigens der einzige Sonnenuntergang, der nicht von dichten Wolken verdeckt wurde. Um so kostbarer war diese Gelegenheit und mit kalten Fingern, wegen der eisigen Temperaturen, aber zufrieden, beendete ich meine Foto-Tour an diesem Tag.*

![_DSC9847.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/travelshots/244xyh5ajbLs4vhe2WXwjPsv5UbCnwadLv89B61iNkwA94AU21YmdKxdF2xPaKwbXiJuo.jpg)

See you soon!/*Bis bald!*
Stefan

body.body:

![QN8F7sgrYYW9zwlr_IMG_20260513_143824.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/trina77/images/QN8F7sgrYYW9zwlr_IMG_20260513_143824/QN8F7sgrYYW9zwlr_IMG_20260513_143824.webp)
</center>

最近领导心情不错，特意给每个小组拨付了2000元活动经费。趁着午会，我采购了新鲜水果和煌上煌卤味，大家一边享用美食，一边交流工作。
 
原本打算买周黑鸭，算了下性价比实在不高，四盒就要一百多，淘宝闪购也没什么优惠。索性就选了咱们南昌本土的煌上煌，既支持本地品牌又划算。一共买了七盒，叠加红包和优惠券后，只花了145元，特别实惠。
 
卤味配水果，简直是绝配。大家围坐在一起，聊完日常工作，又聊起了股票和基金。自从身边有人开始炒黄金获利后，同事们也纷纷跟风入市，最近行情涨幅可观，大家天天盯着大盘，反倒把本职工作放到了一边。
 
眼下公司各大部门合并的消息传得沸沸扬扬，其他业务部门都已按总经理的指示陆续调整，唯独我们部门迟迟没有动静。自从总裁和总经理关系闹僵之后，总经理推行的各项方针，总裁都不予采纳，甚至还萌生了脱离公司、独立发展的想法。
 
董事长夹在中间左右为难，我们部门总裁不想合并大区，理由竟是——舍不得大区经理。这7个大区总都是跟了他十几年的老兵，让谁离开也于心不忍，至于我们这些小兵崽子他是无所谓的。

说到底，我们普通人的想法很简单，谁保障我们的权益、谁给我们福利政策，我们就跟着谁走。正所谓树欲静而风不止，没有稳固的靠山庇护，我们基层普通人就像风中野草，只能随风雨飘摇。
 
我也时常想，要不要趁空余时间发展副业，像同事们炒股我是不行的，或是转行试试其他行业。但自己在教育行业深耕多年，积累了不少人脉和资源，若是就此放弃，实在太过可惜。

董事长不同意我们独立出去，但同意我们部门自己引进产品，最近总裁物色了显微镜和护眼灯，每天都在培训和参观中。
 
有领导引进产品，我们放手干就好了，不想跳槽和转行的事了。不如调整好心态，深耕当下领域，把手里的资源发挥到极致。学校需要什么，我们就做什么。没有比脚更长的路，没有比人更高的山。市场永远属于有准备的人，加油吧！

body.title: Hiving a New Hobby & an Exciting Project
body.body: I'm a much worse person when I'm not writing. I get too much time inside my head, and that almost never leads to good things. Which in turn leads me to write even when I should be stopping and recharging my batteries, which creates other problems, like burnout and also, much worse by far, shit writing. I'm currently working on a bigger story, which I know I've been saying for a long-ass time, but I've got a feeling this could be something. So I worked on it for a while, and then needed to take a step back for my own good. They're like that, stories. They need space to breathe. So do writers, even if they won't really cop to it. Even if they struggle like mad, once they return. My biggest issue is, I don't know how to take time off creating. Maybe I fill my schedule successfully with other things...for a day. And then, I want back. Start thinking, but how much time does it really need? I swear I've got an objective eye now. Fat chance. I've recently returned to the story, after a couple months' absence, and I can safely say, it was a much-needed space. It awarded me a perspective I was clearly lacking before. There is time - and need -for much adjustment before the story is publication-ready. ### But what have I been doing in the meantime? Well. About a year ago, @godfish playfully asked one evening if I'd be down for doing a comic strip together. Comedy not being my strong suit, I would've been doubtful even as a writer, except that's not what the man meant. What he was asking was, would you be down to *sketch* a comic strip? And me, with my two-bit artistic knowledge, went...I don't see why not.

>


I don't pride myself on being a good visual artist, although I do love to sketch, and I did even create some art myself for the trilogy I published a few years ago. This, however, I feared was on a different level. Still, I got myself a digital pad, and pretty much forgot about it for a time while I wrote out this big story.

But then, suddenly finding myself with fuck-all to do in the absence of writing, I remembered the pad. And, well, I dare say the results weren't half-bad.

The even bigger revelation to me was the fantastic way in which creative pursuits nurture and grow one another. I found the same thing in photography a while ago, that taking a photo-walk in the morning somehow meant writing better in the afternoon. 

And now, taking my break from the keyboard, I found a much-needed and healthy creative outlet in sketching. In teaching myself a new trick, because I had zero idea about digital art before.

I liked seeing an improvement (albeit not a massive one - I will always be more a word person than a visual person). But also, that's kind of a neat thing - with writing, I'm more well-versed and less impressed by minor improvements, whereas here, every little thing was a win-thing. Neat. Even more, I liked the way it consumed me, very similarly to the way writing does on a constant basis. Maybe that's why I struggle with short projects - I like returning to an imaginary atelier and putting in the hours each day. Being sucked into a world, being exposed to new geographies and rules that only make sense in this fantastic place you temporarily inhabit.

\

Was a question I'd never considered before. Not because I don't care about art, but because I recognize my own mediocrity. I'm a strong writer, and don't sell myself short on that. But visual art, like music unfortunately, will always be a realm of mediocrity for me. I thought it was an insult to the craft, not to mention a waste of my creativity, to take myself seriously in it.

How wrong I was. How could it take me so long to realize that these endeavors, even if they will never be \

for me, all have their place in the larger creative tapestry that has so far been life?

And how lucky I was to be pushed when I needed it. 

I enjoyed myself so absurdly much these past few months, dedicating much of my afternoons to drawing out this strip thingy. And having come back now to my story, I see the ways in which it didn't let me stew in my own juices. In forcing me outside my comfort zone, it let me gain some insight that (I hope) will further and improve my story.

#### Why 'Hiving'?

Because we thought it up as a way to promote Hive. Because being a mediocre visual artist myself, I would've been the first to think \
.\n\nI imagine, if you tell someone new to Hive that \

, that's where their mind will go immediately. And of course, it's a complex question. It never bothered me as a writer, even when I had a lot to learn. And boy, did the blockchain help me grow and develop my writing in the past decade. Maybe it can be so with someone's art. Maybe even with mine. And secondly, I call it Hiving because if it weren't for Hive, it would've never happened. I wouldn't have known this part of myself. And that's kinda cool, I think. We'll be publishing the results of this experiment on the @dead-pets account starting next week, so if you're curious, feel free to follow us there.
> #### That's me shutting up for now. What creative outlets have you made a part of your life? And what arts (other than the dark) do you like to blend?

So yeah what I want to say is that I feel lucky in this generation because I have faced what I want to in early people and even at the moment with advance technology. So I enjoy every moment don't compare your life with others you have to face where ever you are so stop complaining and start living.

body.title: She Is Not an Accessory — She Never Was  LOH#288
body.body:
![ChatGPT Image May 13, 2026, 09_30_17 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bestbeauty/48Sq12WLdkQ2x3WHNQkQK5rkYSugi2oq6DFDzeV27Jgqt9qRxivWkJ8FZ88HiSTcpK.png)
[AI GENERATED IMAGE](undefined) 


My father didn't mean it. At least, I'd like to believe he didn't.


But unconscious words carry the same weight as deliberate ones — sometimes heavier, because they slip past your defenses disguised as truth. He thought I was dumb. He may never have said it cleanly, directly, to my face — but children are extraordinarily skilled at reading what adults never finish saying. I read it. I absorbed it. I carried it.


Then came boarding school, and a teacher who looked at me —a young girl with a whole universe behind her eyes —and decided the most useful thing she could say was that I was *good for nothing.*


Good. For. Nothing.


Before I turned 18, I had already learned another cruel lesson: that some men look at young girls and see not a person, but a thing to be taken. The number of predators that circled my early life was not just uncomfortable — it was *alarming.* Each one, in his own way, was reinforcing the oldest and most poisonous worldview our society refuses to bury:


**That women are accessories.**


Decorative. Useful only in service of someone else's story. Pretty when convenient. Disposable when not.


 
![LadiesOfHive-Divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bestbeauty/Eoc5d5a6pcVykRmtpUUQnxRxxGVMoHJgb6twsFDAust283fVygDonEF7gZoVLY9AZpB.png)





This is not an ancient belief locked in history books. It is alive. It is loud. It shows up in boardrooms that don't take women seriously until a man repeats what she just said. It shows up in families where the girl child's education is the first budget to cut. It shows up in the quiet expectations placed on women to shrink, to serve, to smile — and never to lead.


It shows up in the silence we train girls to wear like a second skin.


And it is *devastating.*


Not because it is always violent — though sometimes it is. But because it is quiet enough, consistent enough, and early enough to make a little girl genuinely believe it. To make her stop raising her hand. To make her shrink before she ever had the chance to expand.


I know. Because I was that girl.


![LadiesOfHive-Divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bestbeauty/Eoc5d5a6pcVykRmtpUUQnxRxxGVMoHJgb6twsFDAust283fVygDonEF7gZoVLY9AZpB.png)


My name is **Best-Beauty.**


Not a nickname. Not a stage name. A *declaration.*


Best. Beauty. Two words that refuse to be small. Two words that — if you had seen the girl who was called dumb, called worthless, circled by men who saw her as prey — would sound almost defiant. Almost like a joke the universe told with a straight face.


But here is what I have learned about names: they are either a prophecy you grow into, or a battlefield you fight your way toward. Mine has been both.


I work. Not casually. Not occasionally. I work the way people work when they have something to *prove* — not to the world, but to the girl I used to be. Every project I take on, every piece of content I create, every strategy I build — it is my daily answer to every voice that told me I was nothing.


I do not leave things to chance. I do not fold my hands and wait. I put in my absolute best — and then I place everything, the outcomes, the results, the future — in the hands of God. That is my formula. Human excellence plus divine trust. It has not failed me yet.


![LadiesOfHive-Divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bestbeauty/Eoc5d5a6pcVykRmtpUUQnxRxxGVMoHJgb6twsFDAust283fVygDonEF7gZoVLY9AZpB.png)

But this essay is not really about me.


It is about *you.* The young girl reading this at midnight, phone screen lighting up her face in a dark room, quietly wondering if the voices are right. If maybe she really is too much, or not enough, or somehow both at the same time.


I need you to hear this clearly:


**You are not an accessory in someone else's life. You are the main character in your own.**


The teacher who said you were good for nothing was describing her imagination, not your future. The man who looked at you like you were something to be consumed was confessing his own moral failure, not measuring your worth. The parent who underestimated you — consciously or not — was working with limited vision, not eternal truth.


You are not defined by who failed to see you.


You are defined by whether you *choose to be seen.*

![LadiesOfHive-Divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bestbeauty/Eoc5d5a6pcVykRmtpUUQnxRxxGVMoHJgb6twsFDAust283fVygDonEF7gZoVLY9AZpB.png)

Protect yourself from this mindset the way you'd protect yourself from poison — by knowing what it looks like before it reaches your lips. Teach the younger girls around you to name it when they see it. In the joke that isn't funny. In the compliment that is really a cage. In the relationship that only values her silence.


And resist it — not with rage, though rage is sometimes righteous — but with *work.* With excellence. With the audacity to put your name on things and stand behind them.


My name is Best-Beauty.


And I am *just getting started.*

![LadiesOfHive-Divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bestbeauty/Eoc5d5a6pcVykRmtpUUQnxRxxGVMoHJgb6twsFDAust283fVygDonEF7gZoVLY9AZpB.png)


---


****Ella No Es un Accesorio — Nunca Lo Fue****
*Participación en el Concurso Ladies of Hive #288*


![ChatGPT Image May 13, 2026, 09_30_17 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bestbeauty/48Sq12WLdkQ2x3WHNQkQK5rkYSugi2oq6DFDzeV27Jgqt9qRxivWkJ8FZ88HiSTcpK.png)
[AI GENERATED IMAGE](undefined) 
 


Mi padre no lo quiso decir. Al menos, me gusta creer que no.


Pero las palabras inconscientes pesan igual que las deliberadas — a veces más, porque se cuelan entre tus defensas disfrazadas de verdad. Él pensaba que era tonta. Quizás nunca lo dijo claramente, directamente, a mi cara — pero los niños son extraordinariamente hábiles para leer lo que los adultos nunca terminan de decir. Yo lo leí. Lo absorbí. Lo cargué conmigo.


Luego llegó el internado, y una maestra que me miró — a una niña con todo un universo detrás de los ojos — y decidió que lo más útil que podía decirme era que yo no servía *para nada.*


Para. Nada.


Antes de cumplir 18 años, ya había aprendido otra lección cruel: que algunos hombres miran a las niñas y no ven una persona, sino una cosa que tomar. La cantidad de depredadores que rondaron mi vida temprana no era solo incómoda — era *alarmante.* Cada uno, a su manera, reforzaba la cosmovisión más antigua y más venenosa que nuestra sociedad se niega a enterrar:


**Que las mujeres son accesorios.**


Decorativas. Útiles solo al servicio de la historia de otro. Bonitas cuando conviene. Desechables cuando no.




![LadiesOfHive-Divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bestbeauty/Eoc5d5a6pcVykRmtpUUQnxRxxGVMoHJgb6twsFDAust283fVygDonEF7gZoVLY9AZpB.png)


Esta no es una creencia antigua encerrada en libros de historia. Está viva. Está en voz alta. Aparece en salas de juntas que no toman en serio a las mujeres hasta que un hombre repite lo que ella acaba de decir. Aparece en familias donde la educación de la hija es el primer presupuesto que se recorta. Aparece en las expectativas silenciosas que se ponen sobre las mujeres para que se encojan, sirvan, sonrían — y nunca lideren.


Aparece en el silencio que enseñamos a las niñas a usar como una segunda piel.


Y es *devastador.*


No porque siempre sea violento — aunque a veces lo es. Sino porque es lo suficientemente silencioso, constante y temprano como para hacer que una niña genuinamente lo crea. Para hacer que deje de levantar la mano. Para hacer que se encoja antes de haber tenido la oportunidad de expandirse.


Lo sé. Porque yo fui esa niña.


![LadiesOfHive-Divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bestbeauty/Eoc5d5a6pcVykRmtpUUQnxRxxGVMoHJgb6twsFDAust283fVygDonEF7gZoVLY9AZpB.png)

Mi nombre es **Best-Beauty.**


No es un apodo. No es un nombre artístico. Es una *declaración.*


Best. Beauty. Dos palabras que se niegan a ser pequeñas. Dos palabras que — si hubieras visto a la niña que fue llamada tonta, inútil, rodeada de hombres que la veían como presa — sonarían casi desafiantes. Casi como una broma que el universo contó con cara seria.


Pero esto es lo que he aprendido sobre los nombres: son una profecía en la que creces, o un campo de batalla hacia el que luchas. El mío ha sido ambas cosas.


Trabajo. No casualmente. No de vez en cuando. Trabajo de la manera en que trabajan las personas que tienen algo que *demostrar* — no al mundo, sino a la niña que fui. Cada proyecto que emprendo, cada contenido que creo, cada estrategia que construyo — es mi respuesta diaria a cada voz que me dijo que no era nada.


No dejo las cosas al azar. No cruzo los brazos y espero. Doy lo mejor de mí — y luego pongo todo, los resultados, el futuro — en las manos de Dios. Esa es mi fórmula. Excelencia humana más confianza divina. Hasta ahora no me ha fallado.


![LadiesOfHive-Divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bestbeauty/Eoc5d5a6pcVykRmtpUUQnxRxxGVMoHJgb6twsFDAust283fVygDonEF7gZoVLY9AZpB.png)


Pero este ensayo no se trata realmente de mí.


Se trata de *ti.* La niña que lee esto a medianoche, con la pantalla del teléfono iluminando su cara en un cuarto oscuro, preguntándose en silencio si las voces tienen razón. Si quizás realmente es demasiado, o no es suficiente, o de alguna manera ambas cosas al mismo tiempo.


Necesito que escuches esto claramente:


**No eres un accesorio en la vida de alguien más. Eres la protagonista de la tuya propia.**


La maestra que dijo que no servías para nada estaba describiendo su imaginación, no tu futuro. El hombre que te miró como si fueras algo que consumir estaba confesando su propio fracaso moral, no midiendo tu valor. El padre que te subestimó — consciente o no — estaba trabajando con visión limitada, no con verdad eterna.


No estás definida por quien no supo verte.


Estás definida por si *eliges ser vista.*

![LadiesOfHive-Divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bestbeauty/Eoc5d5a6pcVykRmtpUUQnxRxxGVMoHJgb6twsFDAust283fVygDonEF7gZoVLY9AZpB.png)

Protégete de esta mentalidad como te protegerías de un veneno — sabiendo cómo se ve antes de que llegue a tus labios. Enseña a las niñas más jóvenes a tu alrededor a nombrarlo cuando lo vean. En el chiste que no tiene gracia. En el cumplido que en realidad es una jaula. En la relación que solo valora su silencio.


Y resístelo — no con rabia, aunque la rabia a veces es justa — sino con *trabajo.* Con excelencia. Con la audacia de poner tu nombre en las cosas y respaldarlo.


Mi nombre es Best-Beauty.


Y *apenas estoy comenzando.*


---


*Escrito para el Concurso Ladies of Hive #288*


---

that mug or jug also reminded me of my early days here, which weren’t easy at all, but with perseverance, anything is possible. And I agree with what you say: Hive isn’t just about posting something here and there; it’s much more than that. It’s about finding like-minded people, doing what you love, and dedicating time from your life to it. So you deserve that little treat you’ve given yourself, it’s well deserved.

It looks lovely too, and the girl was right, the white really makes the Hive logo stand out. I love it!!! Thank you so much, big hugs!💗

>Cuando iba leyendo me emocionaba, porque también al ver esa taza o jarra me recordó mis inicios aquí, que no fueron nada fáciles pero con perseverancia todo se logra. y estoy de acuerdo en lo que dices, Hive no es hacer un post ya ya, es mucho más que eso, es encontrar gente parecida a uno, hacer lo que uno ama hacer y dedicarle tiempo de la vida. Por lo que te mereces ese auto regalo que te has echo, bien merecido.

>Además quedó preciosa y la chica tenía razón, el blanco resalta mucho más el logo de Hive. Me ha encantado!!! Muchas gracias, un gran abrazo!💗

links.title: Branding is costly
links.body: The factor of branding in entrepreneurship, especially when it comes to spending heavily and loss is inevitable, is something that's still hard for me to grasp. I still don't understand how people can adopt this when they're in a state of loss or when they know that loss is inevitable at that moment; maybe there will be a breakthrough in the long run. Oh yeah, the focus is always on the long run but why must one experience a loss first at the time of going into that? Don't quote me wrong, it's not like I'm not engaging in the PACKAGING as we commonly call it, of course I'm growing into it little by little but I don't see myself settling into the side that I know that my capacity is not there yet, as we often see people branding their businesses hugely even when the capacity is not there or when they know they'll be at loss. **_Where am I heading to?_**

/> I'm into laundry, I have an office for it, a rented apartment with all the working equipment such as a washing machine, pressing irons, a fuel generator and many others and oftentimes people would come in and start pointing at some aspects that I'm not doing right. To be very honest, I like pointers and recommendations like that and anytime they come, I take note of them.

/> The biggest of them all as of now is PRINTINGS ON MY PACKAGING NYLONS... branding. Yeah, I don't have my name printed on the NYLONS I use to package clothes and to be very honest, I haven't seen this as a necessity because it's costly and it's going to chop off a lot of money from my purse if I decide to adapt to that. This is something that little business owners, I mean the very Littlest business owners do and I keep wondering how they're able to keep up with it. I have been packaging clothes with just plain nylons and I haven't had issues. Although the branded nylons serve as a form of advertisement, I know this but for now, if I go into it, I'll run at a loss for now. I need to plan very well before adapting to branding my NYLONS. Thanks for reading. Photos used are mine Translated with DeepL > > !\[ESPANOL\] El papel de la imagen de marca en el emprendimiento, sobre todo cuando hay que hacer grandes inversiones y las pérdidas son inevitables, es algo que todavía me cuesta entender. Sigo sin entender cómo la gente puede aceptar esto cuando está sufriendo pérdidas o cuando sabe que las pérdidas son inevitables en ese momento; quizá a largo plazo haya un avance decisivo. Ah, sí, la atención siempre se centra en el largo plazo, pero ¿por qué hay que sufrir primero una pérdida al embarcarse en ello? No me malinterpretes, no es que no me dedique al «EMPAQUETADO», como solemos llamarlo; por supuesto que me estoy acostumbrando a ello poco a poco, pero no me veo acomodándome en un terreno en el que sé que aún no tengo la capacidad necesaria, ya que a menudo vemos a gente promocionando enormemente sus negocios incluso cuando no tienen la capacidad o cuando saben que van a tener pérdidas. **_¿Hacia dónde me dirijo?_**

/> Me dedico a la lavandería, tengo una oficina para ello, un apartamento alquilado con todo el equipo necesario, como lavadora, planchas, un generador de combustible y muchas otras cosas, y a menudo viene gente y empieza a señalar algunos aspectos que no estoy haciendo bien. Para ser muy sincero, me gustan ese tipo de consejos y recomendaciones, y cada vez que me los dan, tomo nota de ellos.

/>

Lo más importante de todo, por ahora, es la IMPRESIÓN DE MI MARCA EN LAS BOLSAS DE NYLON que utilizo para empaquetar la ropa... Sí, no tengo mi nombre impreso en las bolsas de nylon que uso para empaquetar la ropa y, para ser muy sincera, no lo he visto como una necesidad porque es costoso y me va a quitar mucho dinero de mi bolsillo si decido adaptarme a eso. Esto es algo que hacen los propietarios de pequeños negocios, me refiero a los propietarios de los negocios más pequeños, y no dejo de preguntarme cómo son capaces de mantenerlo.

He estado empaquetando ropa con bolsas de nylon sin imprimir y no he tenido problemas. Aunque las bolsas de nylon con marca sirven como forma de publicidad, lo sé, pero por ahora, si me lanzo a ello, voy a tener pérdidas. Necesito planificarlo muy bien antes de empezar a poner mi marca en las bolsas de nylon.

Gracias por leer.

Las fotos utilizadas son mías.

links.title: Onchain Sarcasm - The MegaETH Bull Run
links.body:
It’s a new week of Sarcasm Saturday, and what a surprise! We’re still “waiting” for the bull run… even though it’s basically sitting right there in the room with us.

You’ve got people refreshing charts like nothing’s happening, calling for lower prices, waiting for confirmation, waiting for signals, waiting for… I don’t even know anymore.

Meanwhile the market’s quietly doing its thing and half the crowd is still in denial. Classic chad behavior! I’ve said it before ... crypto is strictly 18+ and a bit rude.

It doesn’t care about your feelings, your timing, or your carefully crafted “perfect entry.” It moves when it wants, lures you inside, fakes you out, then runs without you.

So naturally, I took a break from the screens and went for some proper IRL activity… ended up at the Three Cocks pub. Seemed on-brand with the current crime season! 


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRjPq6oAHhY4kiY9gd7yciEZSmMF3d9CUPRF3rCEYNpzX/image.png)


Now let's move from 3 cocks to [3Look](https://3look.io/?ref=pvmihalache&src=invfr)... where the creator score matters on [3Look](https://3look.io/?ref=pvmihalache&src=invfr) and the activity on social media helped users to get their tiers. Brand new season! 

The \

epoch is about showing how building and scaling culture around a project can help it grow. The goal is to create content about a community and show to scale it.

[3Look](https://3look.io/?ref=pvmihalache&src=invfr) it may look like a fashion-focused social platform where people share outfits, discover style content, and sometimes take part in brand campaigns or drops but is not! 

With Season 2 already underway, it’s clear the platform is doubling down on its core loop of AI-powered content, social engagement, and creator incentives to scale Web3 culture fast! 

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaKujPvFsYTuofGBRfkXek1xGmSQpiCi3KNBMLrRtxNAD/image.png)


And speaking of questionable decisions...don’t be a cock and start panic selling the moment you see a bit of green. All the whales and KOLs are now farming on MegaETH! 

I've made life easy for you and published [Dapps And Points Guide For The MegaETH Terminal](https://www.publish0x.com/mind-puzzle/dapps-and-points-guide-for-the-megaeth-terminal-xjyqyxk)! Bookmark it and use it as your to-go guide for farming points and yield! 

MegaETH is a new Layer 2 blockchain built on top of Ethereum, designed to make crypto applications feel fast enough to rival normal web apps. $MEGA also went in May! 

You don't need a ton of capital or time to participate. You see your total points and leaderboard rank. I am starting my MegaETh journey on [Hit One](https://app.hit.one/r/65JB2W)! Start spinning or arcade finance!  

Having some fun on [Prism](https://prismfi.cc/?ref=PVMBOSS) by predicting the price of WTI Crude Oil, market ending soon! This dapp is both a DEX and a prediction market, built by the BadBunnz team! 

Next step was  to draw to pokemon packs on [Mnstr](https://mnstr.xyz/?ref=PVMIHALACHE) but both my draws were bad. It's random so maybe you are lucky! At least I am getting points for each pack I open!  


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYMgEkte4Yq6YeW6jMmk9BFTJFQUQ5mcTQfMXQNJPAzc8/image.png)


I've seen this [$30,000 campaign on Rolly,](https://rolly.io/quests?ref=dJNeOu7Z) where chads are invited to get some $MEGA and other prizes. This campaign is for $MEGA holders, made to honour the launch of MegaETH.

What actually doesn't work? Bridge volume because they're not doing the typical L2 farming thing, NFT floor sweeping, and simple token swaps because everyone does this.

New dapps were added on Terminal! The real opportunity window here is probably 4-6 weeks. Once they announce the next cohort expansion, these multipliers will compress. 

[Pump Party](https://cannon.pumpparty.com/?ref=YCFY3PH4&chain=megaeth) is a real-time onchain game built on the MegaETH ecosystem. So “live, mobile-first gameshow” where gameplay, outcomes, and rewards are all processed fully onchain.

tl;dr: you [shoot the rabbit out of the cannon](https://cannon.pumpparty.com/?ref=YCFY3PH4&chain=megaeth) and you may get prizes for the $ETH you're paying. I played 6 times, with 0.001 $ETH per go, and managed to be 0.002 $ETH in profit! 


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVkLhUXfSHVtX6SUsuNQGxCKeG4fdQeoXCBaf2KtTsUY5/image.png)


Taking profit is smart, sure, but there’s a difference between strategy and folding at the first sign of life. Now I am thinking if should I go all in on MegaETH or not! 

Because let’s be honest, diamond hands sound great on paper… right up until you’re staring at old screenshots thinking “yeah… I probably should’ve done something there.”

I said we’re still “waiting” for the bull run… even though it’s basically sitting right there in the room with us. Every crypto bro know I am right... but my doctor doesn't! 


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQtAvzzJUgdYwqzhwAuC8iDVLvrvbmKKxarQHusNMANPi/image.png)


Nothing in this space is ever straightforward. Crypto charts are chaotic, unpredictable, borderline absurd, and remind me of something else that makes absolutely no sense!

Flags! Yeah anon... flags! Some say they represent history, identity, meaning… but sometimes it just looks like a bunch of shapes, logos and colors thrown together!

Everyone nodding like it’s obvious, but are they JPGS that I can sell on the marketplace? Kind of like trying to explain why a coin just pumped 40% on no news.

The US flag means freedom, liberty ... while the yellow is for not interfering with other countries! Bro... are flags like Bored Ape Yacht Club pfps? They represent who you are?

The Italian flag is a lovely pizza, while the German's blue shade is from the sense of humor! New week... same chaos. Let’s see who’s still “waiting” next Saturday. 


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcsWz8vwbVJJMYoCtdYVqtkCMytzm5fx4DFzoZryquh9q/image.png)

links.title: 12 May 2026, Freewriters Community Daily Writing Prompt Day 3101: I’m a engineer
links.body:
I’m an engineer.
Not the kind who builds giant bridges or tall buildings.
I engineer my life every single day.

Every morning I wake up and try to fix small problems around me. Sometimes the problem is money. Sometimes it is stress. Sometimes it is my own fear. I think carefully, make a plan, fail, and start again.

When I was younger, I thought engineers were people with helmets and big machines. But now I think an engineer is anyone who keeps solving problems without giving up.

My mother is an engineer in the kitchen. She can create a full meal from almost nothing. My father is an engineer of patience. He stays calm even when life becomes difficult.

And me?
Maybe I am still learning.

I build dreams in my mind. I repair broken confidence. I try to design a better future for myself. Some days my plans collapse like weak buildings. Other days I feel strong enough to build an entire city.

People think engineering is only about math and machines. But life itself is engineering. Every choice changes the structure of our future.

So yes, I’m an engineer.
Not perfect.
Still under construction.

links.title: Swapped (2026) || Perfect for A Family Movienight
links.body:
<div class=text-justify>


![IMG_5452.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/EoprtGjhKev2MfCLHTVoiuXEXL4U6mYJqDgNyTiw5cjHCSTgZ6xaektZFqnrTEM8tW2.jpeg)


After a friend posted a short clip of this animated film on her WhatsApp status, I was inclined to watch it because I couldn’t resist such color and wonder! You know, animated films have this habit of looking childish on the surface but then, it randomly sneaks emotional damage into your chest when you least expect it. 

**Synopsis**

![IMG_5473.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/EowFAYARDPiokfbPZREXVgmgrs1iWair1RuKaUxdAY6nTKd9Ck7sHrJz7EKHaFFwAyW.jpeg)

Set in a magical valley filled with strange hybrid creatures, *Swapped* follows Ollie (voiced by Michael B. Jordan), a small woodland creature called a Pookoo, and Ivy (voiced by Juno Temple), a majestic bird-like creature known as a Javan. The two species are natural enemies, constantly avoiding and distrusting each other.

![IMG_5468.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/23xVM4a4HB1FWhHfWYiXvtsgZceSuTmQ221Zbc77C5mdqoVwCKr7ofduYpp8un79tRwkZ.jpeg)

But after a magical accident involving mysterious flower pods, Ollie and Ivy suddenly find themselves forced into each other’s worlds, literally and emotionally. Both of them are irritated by their new look but, they think of survival for their families and embrace their new identities, and learning to understand as they journey across dangerous parts of the valley trying to reverse what happened.

![IMG_5469.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/23wMPmKjXk6doFt5XM4bnn8koGbaLzkmok2Jo65iVGCe4FVyA3Stbu8rAMTcZD1RzWGJf.jpeg)

Along the way, they encounter strange creatures, hidden truths about the valley, and a shocking secret tied to Boogle (voiced by Tracy Morgan), whose role in the story turns out to be much shocking than expected.

**My Thoughts on This One**

![IMG_5456.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/23wqq1YXX2tAKazV1vZtZB1WzJbfpXG3r9KxbVwqKDMkNDzVZ9UyqtkeYEnij9o2rygHk.jpeg)

The first thing I noticed was that this film is beautiful. The animation is lush, colorful, and filled with tiny environmental details that make the creatures world feel alive. The valley genuinely feels like somewhere you could get lost in. And honestly, that visual style carried a lot of the film’s charm. Even if you’re not fully impressed by the story, you’ll praise the world-building and animation.

![IMG_5459.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/23yTgyYV1TyWLYokbBNJvZ2JupfzGTMLeJFjRgmjCopdfqfM2R3v5THHNVi7QiqMkopCx.jpeg)

The creature designs are adorable. The Pookoos especially had me like yeah, merchandising is definitely coming.

About the story, subjectively, it isn’t a trailblazer. The message about empathy and understanding those different from you is very obvious. Like, very obvious. The film doesn’t exactly trust you to figure things out yourself but it still worked for me. Because underneath the predictable setup is a surprisingly sincere emotional core. Watching Ollie and Ivy slowly move from fear and annoyance to genuine care felt natural enough that I ended up rooting for them.

![IMG_5466.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/241tZ3hVamjPJWNUXnX7UEeas4rZGE5dR9sf7nc5sTCVx8fP5Js8w4buCgT5Fh1zwHHeG.jpeg)

Also, some moments do hit emotionally, especially later in the film when certain truths about the valley and Boogle are revealed. I won’t spoil it, but I actually understand why my friend who posted the clip said the twist shocked her.

![IMG_5475.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/242DUtWXeq6McsR3WjQR4wprfzQPCzMxwCNNmmAV3QaR9irMHcqs5X13GV64J2UK3qY48.jpeg)

The voice acting? Trust me, everyone understood the assignment. Michael B. Jordan was honestly really charming here. Ollie could have become annoying very quickly, but Jordan in my opinion, gave him enough warmth to keep him lovable. And Juno Temple gave Ivy this slightly elegant, emotionally guarded personality that balanced Ollie’s chaotic energy really well.

![IMG_5471.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/EoAYry5EcHWBnaVt55fWxNLJcULHxN9s914aVdoBCXQRNPs3ye2bjfj2f7EtDkL1oF5.jpeg)

Even Tracy Morgan surprised me because Boogle starts off feeling comedic and unserious before the story slowly reveals there’s more going on underneath.

![IMG_5460.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/23zRvo47zk4mwxbZc275ASY8b6qBQbvvhZW49vLR2f7432gT2BHp7SpZ8jXSH7Yp8xGc1.jpeg)

Now what didn’t fully work for me was that parts of the film felt too familiar. You can clearly see influences from movies like *Zootopia*, *The Wild Robot*, and other creatures learning to coexist animated films. And because of that, some scenes felt predictable before they even happened. The dialogue also leans very young at times. There’s not a lot of subtlety. Everything is explained very directly, which works just perfectly for kids but leave older viewers wanting something sharper. Don’t say the films weren’t created for adults too. lol
![IMG_5453.jpeg](11)
Still, I never got bored, and I guess that’s what matters.
Finally, I am sure Netflix, when producing this had no intention to reinvent animation, but trust that it has enough heart, charm, and visual beauty to make the journey worth it. It’s cute and emotional in parts. Despite its predictable themes, it still feels sincere.

Additionally, any animated movie that can make me care about magical woodland creatures arguing in a glowing forest deserves some credit 😭

Rating: 7.5/10
	
I do recommend for the family. 


</diva>

links.title: Scatter the seeds ~3102
links.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPMjbpQpCamxxqtygQmB6K2jTeaqobRqkpAaykKZSZygV/1778660897616.jpg)
An image of me

Seeds in agriculture are planted not just to remain in the soil, but to grow, multiply, and produce fruits that will feed many people. 

A farmer does not keep all his seeds in one corner and there by expect a harvest. He scatters them by planting them across different parts of the land so they can spread, take root, and create abundance. 

The beauty of a seed is not in its appearance, but in its potential to multiply when it is properly planted

In the same way, “scattering the seeds” goes beyond farming. It reflects the idea of spreading value, knowledge, kindness, creativity, and talents in ways that create lasting impact. 

A seed that is hidden can never grow, likewise, talents that are unused can never influence lives.  Just like the man in the Bible who buried his one talent.

This write-up isn't about agricultural seeds, it is about the multiplication of talents and the importance of making positive impact wherever we find ourselves. 

For you see, everyone carries something valuable within them, some have the talent to teach, others to lead, create, encourage, sing, write, organize, or inspire. These gifts are not meant to be buried in fear, pride, or self-doubt, they are meant to be shared.

I once believed impact only happened on a large scale. I thought talents only mattered when they gained recognition or applause but over time, I discovered that the smallest acts often leave the deepest marks. Sharing knowledge with someone struggling, encouraging a friend during difficult moments, helping others grow, or simply using your skills to make life easier for people are all ways of scattering seeds.

The most inspiring thing about seeds is that one seed can produce many more seeds. In the same way, one positive action can influence countless lives. When talents are used intentionally, they create opportunities, inspire change, and encourage others to do the same.

True success is not measured by how much talent a person possesses, but by how much impact that talent creates. 

Life becomes more meaningful when our gifts are allowed to grow beyond us, touching lives in different places, just like scattered seeds producing fruit across a field.
