Lets use the example... you want to swap HIVE to HBD via Magi and then withdraw the HBD to Hive mainnet again.

Then the route is...
1. Send HIVE from Hive MainNet into Magi network (watch this video for example https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z05prpPCfMk) - (this is a Hive transaction and only uses RC)
2. Swap HIVE to HBD via the Magi pool, which converts the HIVE you have under the Magi network to HBD also inside the Magi network - (this is a Hive transaction that will execute also something on Magi and uses Hive RC (resource credits) and Magi RC (which is charged by holding HBD on the Magi network side).
3. Withdraw the HBD converted, into the Hive MainNet wallet - (this also uses RC from both sides because the \

process is costed in this case)

Done, you have used Magi network to swap HIVE into HBD.

The importance of this, is that because the Hive internal market has different prices from what the pool on Magi has, one can do these movements of money (sometimes, not always) and \

some bucks. This is called [arbitrage](https://www.google.com/search?q=what+is+arbitrage&ie=UTF-8).

Now, the second part...

If you have both HIVE and HBD on Magi, and you add it to the pool (costs RC from both Hive and Magi). Then, if anyone (including yourself) swaps through that pool, you and all the olders of that pool liquidity get a percentage of that fee equal to the amount of liquidity they hold on the pool.

Under low volume (low amount of swaps in the pool) this is not anything, but under high volume, it can be more lucrative than trying to trade sometimes. Simply because you don't have to do anything... and all the volume and market fluctuations, will incur some profits for the pool based on the flow of the swaps that happen in order to make the pool equal to other places (because when you flow too much in one direction, the prices of each pair inside that pool, change... and it forces the oposite side to be more attractive to be swapped, balancing the situation).

body.title: Family Health Insurance Plan - Should we buy a separate plan along with the insurance plan provided by our employer – Let’s Explore
body.body:
Hey All,


![1000150167.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gungunkrishu/23uQrikwoc56pjWeqog9q5y6sUuH5LcbiD3ogd7JjUiDdEoi68AwxWuU1G6a2C18vYgCp.jpg)


In this post I wanted to express my views around the family health insurance plan.  At times I know most of us would ignore the health insurance plan and rely on insurance that is part of our CTC [Cost to the Company] from our employer. I did this mistake myself but was quick enough to rectify the same in 2020 where in I bought family health insurance plan separately. At that time, I bought this plan from HDFC Ergo Optima Restore for Sum Insured for Rs.20 lakhs by paying a premium of Rs.30K+ approximately yearly. 


![1000150168.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gungunkrishu/Enz317j8RydLZTRsSWoK896ndCn8fDY8tGbagRPqkJuwvmr9awM5aX64PEhuFP915T4.jpg)


Had I taken this decision of buying the insurance plan much earlier then the premium would have been much lower I guess it would have come down another 5K+ INR. Anyways no regrets here what is done is done and cannot be undone now but what can be done is to educate people and family friends around the world. Whenever I have this discussion around the insurance, I make it a point to talk about family health insurance plan and recommend that in case they are not a separate plan apart from be given by the employer one should start thinking about it and must consider buying one separately. The fact is that we are not going to work always and when let’s say one decides to do something apart from 9to5 job then at that point things would be difficult if there is no insurance plan and then buying one would be far much expensive. Therefore, it becomes imperative to consider family insurance plan at a serious note and having a backup plan outperforms in long run along with the benefit of providing financial security, peace of mind, and protection during unforeseen medical emergencies.

Let us now try to understand another scenario were having insurance plan separately comes to our rescue. As a simple example
A family has:
•	Employer insurance cover: ₹5 Lakhs 
•	Separate family floater plan: ₹20 Lakhs 
There is a medical emergency costs that is estimated ₹14 Lakhs:
•	Employer policy pays first ₹5 Lakhs 
•	Personal family policy pays remaining ₹9 Lakhs 

So, from our example we can clearly see that the family avoids paying huge expenses from their savings just by having a separate insurance plan. Therefore, creating a strong financial safety net for the entire family over the long term. I guess this should be it for todays post on – “Family Health Insurance Plan - Should we buy a separate plan along with the insurance plan provided by our employer – Let’s Explore.. ” Let me know your views in the comment section below.

Best Regards
Paras

body.title: Philip Salt IPL Stats Career Records and Team Journey
body.body:
England wicketkeeper-batter [Phil Salt](https://www.sportsyaari.com/cricket/philip-salt-ipl-p787/) has become one of the most dangerous opening batters in the Indian Premier League with his fearless batting style and explosive powerplay performances. Known for attacking bowlers from the very first ball, Salt has quickly established himself as a match-winner in the IPL and a valuable asset for every franchise he has represented.

Philip Salt made his IPL debut in 2023 for the Delhi Capitals. Although his first season started quietly, he soon grabbed attention with aggressive innings at the top of the order. One of his standout knocks came against Royal Challengers Bengaluru where he smashed 87 runs and showcased his ability to dominate world-class bowlers. In his debut IPL season, Salt scored 218 runs in 9 matches with a strike rate above 160. 

In 2024, Salt joined the Kolkata Knight Riders and played a major role in their successful campaign. Opening alongside aggressive batters, he gave the team flying starts during the powerplay overs. His attacking partnership at the top became one of the biggest reasons behind KKR’s title-winning season. Salt scored 435 runs in 12 matches at an impressive strike rate of over 182, proving himself as one of the most destructive openers in the tournament. 

After his brilliant performances for KKR, Salt was picked by Royal Challengers Bengaluru in the IPL mega auction for ₹11.50 crore. The franchise showed strong faith in his aggressive batting ability and retained him for the 2026 season as well. Salt continued his excellent form for RCB and formed a dangerous opening pair with Virat Kohli. Their partnerships helped RCB dominate several matches during the season. 

One of the biggest strengths of Phil Salt is his fearless intent in the powerplay. He attacks both pace and spin with confidence and maintains a very high strike rate. Cricket fans and experts often praise his aggressive mindset and ability to change the momentum of the match within a few overs. Discussions on Reddit and social media have highlighted how Salt’s explosive batting gives teams quick starts and puts pressure on opposition bowlers early in the innings. 

Apart from batting, Salt is also regarded as an outstanding fielder and reliable wicketkeeper. Fans during IPL 2026 frequently appreciated his athletic catches and energetic fielding performances for RCB. Many cricket followers even described him as one of the best fielders of the season because of his sharp reflexes and commitment on the field. 

As of IPL 2026, Phil Salt has played 40 IPL matches and scored more than 1200 runs with an excellent strike rate. His consistent performances, fearless batting style, and ability to perform in pressure matches have made him one of the most exciting overseas players in the IPL today.

Español

¿Alguna vez te ha pasado que algo pequeño —un olor, una canción, un tono de voz— te revuelve el estómago sin que sepas bien por qué? O quizás sientes un nudo en la espalda cada vez que alguien levanta la voz, o un vacío en el pecho cuando estás en silencio. Eso no es casualidad. Eso es tu cuerpo hablando. Y lo que te cuenta no es un cuento cualquiera: es una historia que empezó hace años, quizás décadas, y que seguís cargando sin darte cuenta.

Como psicólogo, he visto muchas personas llegar a consulta diciendo \

, mientras su cuerpo tiembla, su mandíbula se tensa o su respiración se vuelve corta. La memoria no está solo en el cerebro. Cada célula, cada músculo, cada tensión crónica guarda lo que la mente prefirió olvidar. Esa sensación de ahogo ante un conflicto, ese ardor en el pecho al sentirte ignorado, ese cansancio inexplicable… son fragmentos de una trama que repetís sin saberlo.

Pero hoy quiero contarte algo distinto. Tenés la posibilidad de empezar a contarte esa historia de otro modo.

No se trata de falsificar lo vivido. Se trata de escuchar lo que tu cuerpo dice sin juicio, ponerle palabras amables y, sobre todo, entender que el guión puede reescribirse. No desde la negación, sino desde la integración. Porque si tu cuerpo aprendió a reaccionar con miedo, también puede aprender a responder con calma. Si aprendió a encogerse, también puede aprender a expandirse. Eso es la neuroplasticidad emocional, y también es un acto de rebeldía tierna.

Probá algo hoy: cerrá los ojos, llevá una mano al lugar donde más tensión sientas (tripa, hombros, garganta) y respirá ahí. Preguntale a esa parte de vos: \

No esperes palabras. Quizás venga una imagen, una sensación o simplemente un suspiro profundo. Después, agradecele por haberte protegido todo este tiempo. Y luego decidí: ¿cómo querés contarte esa historia desde ahora? Podés imaginarte una versión de vos que abraza a esa niña o ese niño que sufrió, o podés simplemente optar por la frase \

.

Tu cuerpo es testigo, no carcelero. Permitite empezar hoy a narrarte con más compasión. Porque cada vez que lo haces, un nudo se deshace un poquito.

Ever had that moment when a smell, a song, or a tone of voice twists your stomach and you don’t know why? Or maybe a knot in your back every time someone raises their voice, or an emptiness in your chest when it gets too quiet. That’s not random. That’s your body talking. And what it’s telling you isn’t just any story — it’s one that started years, maybe decades ago, and you’re still carrying it without realizing.

As a psychologist, I’ve seen so many people walk into my office saying, “I don’t remember anything important from my childhood,” while their body shakes, their jaw clenches, or their breath gets shallow. Memory isn’t only in your brain. Every cell, every muscle, every chronic tightness holds what your mind chose to forget. That feeling of choking up during an argument, that burning in your chest when you feel unseen, that exhaustion with no clear cause… they are pieces of a script you keep repeating without knowing.

But here’s the good news: today, you have a chance to start telling that story differently.

It’s not about making up a fake past. It’s about listening to what your body says without judgment, finding kind words for it, and — most importantly — understanding that the script can be rewritten. Not by denying, but by integrating. Because if your body learned to react with fear, it can also learn to respond with calm. If it learned to shrink, it can learn to expand. That’s emotional neuroplasticity, and it’s also a gentle act of rebellion.

Try this today: close your eyes, place a hand on the spot where you feel the most tension (belly, shoulders, throat) and breathe into it. Ask that part of you: “What do you need to tell me?” Don’t expect words. Maybe an image comes, a feeling, or just a deep sigh. Then thank it for protecting you all this time. And then decide: how do you want to tell your story from now on? You can imagine a version of yourself hugging that little child who suffered, or you can simply choose the phrase “this happened, but I am no longer just that.”

Your body is a witness, not a prison. Let today be the day you start telling yourself a gentler story. Because every time you do, a knot loosens — just a little

body.title: ‎From Bernabéu Hero to Possible Old Trafford Gamble: Why Valverde’s Situation Feels Unreal ‎
body.body:
‎Football transfer can be so funny and there are some football rumours that immediately sound impossible the moment you hear or come across them. For me, the idea of Manchester United targeting Federico Valverde is one of those stories.
‎ https://img.leopedia.io/DQmNfqj1ZQRUHfTHhCyhaZwzoJyJ99GyimsRnQxsT667zjk/images%2022.jpeg 

‎[Source](https://www.google.com/url?sa=t&source=web&rct=j&opi=89978449&url=https://www.beinsports.com/en-us/soccer/uefa-champions-league/articles-video/fede-valverde-s-love-for-real-madrid-being-captain-is-a-great-honor-2025-02-18&ved=2ahUKEwiWyIKu3LWUAxXQ3AIHHZT9OtYQtaYDegQIBxAA&usg=AOvVaw02iOBECAn0nGpHZhycjIDQ)
‎
‎Nobody would have imagined the hardworking midfielder becoming an “outcast” at Real Madrid a few months ago. Valverde has always looked like the type of player every manager dreams of having, full of qualities, energetic, committed, versatile, and willing  to fight for badge every single match. Seeing his name being linked with uncertainty at the Bernabéu honestly feels strange.
‎
‎Reports now suggest that tensions behind the scenes have pushed the Uruguayan into an uncomfortable situation after a serious training-ground clash with Aurélien Tchouaméni. 
‎
‎What even shocked me most was hearing that the incident reportedly became so intense that Valverde needed hospital treatment for concussion-related issues. Even though he publicly apologized afterward, it seems the damage inside the dressing room may already have been done.
‎
‎And now, Manchester United are suddenly being linked with him as they looking for casimero replacement.
‎
‎And to be honest, I can actually understand why United would be interested. This is not just any midfielder. Valverde is someone who has already played more than 370 matches for Real Madrid and has been part of one of the most dominant squads in Europe. Players with such experience, intensity, and mentality do not become available often.
‎
‎But at the same time, the entire story feels risky.
‎
‎United are already dealing with enough pressure and instability, and bringing in a player coming off internal conflict at one of the biggest clubs in the world could either become a masterstroke or another complicated situation in my own perspective. 
‎
‎Football history has shown that sometimes a fresh start can completely revive a player’s career. Other times, the emotional baggage follows them to the next club.
‎
‎For me, I still find it difficult to picture Valverde leaving Madrid so abruptly because of his quality. He has always looked deeply connected to the club and the fans. And just one heated incident should not completely erase years of loyalty, commitment, and world-class performances. Football can be so emotional, though, and once trust inside a dressing room begins to break, then things can change very quickly.
‎
‎If this transfer eventually happens, then it would easily become one of the most shocking moves of the summer. And if it does not, then maybe this is simply another reminder that even the biggest stars in football are never completely safe from controversy behind closed doors.
‎
‎Even though I don't see this happening but football can be so funny a times. Let's wait and see how the stories unfold. 
‎

ထိုကြောင့် ကျွန်တော့်မှာ ထိုဘလော့များကို
မကြည့်မိအောင်နေရသည်။ 

ကိုယ်တွေက မကြည့်မိအောင် နေပါသည်ဆိုမှ
တူမက လာလာ ပြပါသည်။ သူရို့စားပြသည်က
အများအားဖြင့် စပိုင်ဆီခေါက်ဆွဲများကို အသီးအရွက်၊
အသားငါးပုစွန်ပင်လယ်စာများဖြင့် စားသောက်ပြ
သည်ကို ကြည့်ရသည်။ အခြားစားသောက်မှုများလည်း
ရှိပေမည်။ သို့ပေသိ ကျွန်တော့်တူမက ခေါက်ဆွဲ
စားသည်များကိုသာ အကြည့်များသည်ထင် သူလာပြ
တိုင်း ခေါက်ဆွဲများကို ပလုပ်ပလောင်းစားပြနေသော
ဘလော့ဂါများကိုသာ မြင်တွေ့ရပေသည်။ 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ4hdMAeMPpHeHtSZRuWgokJkPqU5BJRgNRMYEMEr1TTM/image_c6d80eb0_11c4_48cc_9128_0228a1e4f3bb6385606405672617219.jpg)

ထိုဘလောဂါများကို ကြည့်၍ ကျွန်တော်တို့ငယ်စဉ်က
လူကြီးများဆုံးမခဲ့သည်ကို သတိရမိသည်။
ဟဲ့ ဟင်းချိုရည်သောက်ရင်း အသံမမြည်းစေနဲ့။
အစားအသောက်စားတာ လမ်းလယ်ကို ထွက်မစားနဲ့လေ။ 
သူများတွေ မြင်ရင် စားချင်ပေမပေါ့။
ကိုယ်မကျွေးနိုင်ရင် သူများကို မမြင်စေနဲ့။
အစားအသောက်စားရင် ပါးစပ်က ပလပ်ပလပ်
မမြည်းစနေဲ့။ ထမင်းကို စားပိုးနင်အောင် ဗိုက်ကားအောင် 
မစားနဲ့။ ထမင်းစားရင် လက်ငါး‌ချောင်းလုံးကို ထမင်းတွေ 
မပေစေနဲ့ စသဖြင့်ပေါ့ဗျာ ဆုံးမတာကို
ကြားခဲ့ရသည်။ 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTy4xnZrYERf2nTbnPtDcWXiU8n1mH7Xa38jdssdKhseb/1778656805484.jpg)

ထိုအဆုံးအမများက ယခုခေတ်မှာတော့ ဘလော့ဂါ
များကို ကြည့်ကာ ဒိတ်အောက်သွားလေသလားဟု
အောင်းမေ့ရပေသည်။ အချို့အရာများက လိုက်နာ
ရမည်ရှိသလို။ အဆင်ပြေ လိုက်လျောစွာ ပြုမှုနေထိုင်
ရသည်များလည်း ရှိပေမည်။ အစားအသောက်နဲ့
ပတ်သက်၍ တိုးတက်လာသော လူနေမှုပုံစံများအတိုင်း
စားသောက်မှုများလည်း ပြောင်းလဲလာပေသည်။
အစားအသောက်ကို ထူးခြားဆန်းပြားစွာပြုလုပ်သလို၊ 
စား‌သုံးသူကို စားချင်လာစေအောင် ဆွဲဆောင်မှုများ
ကလည်း အမျိုးစုံလင်လှပေသည်။
မနေ့က တူမတို့ဇနီးမောင်နှံကို သူရို့သူငယ်ချင်းက
စားသောက်ဆိုင်တခုမှ စားစရာဝယ်ပေးသည်။ ထိုစားစရာကို 
အိမ်မှ စားကြမည်ဖြစ်သည်။ 
စားသောက်ဆိုင်မှ စားစရာအမျိုးမျိုးမှာပြီး ပါဆယ်ထုပ်ပိုး
ယူလာသည်။ အိမ်သို့ရောင်သောအခါ
စားရန် အထုတ်ဖြည်း၍ စားမည်ပြုလုပ်သောအခါ
ကိုယ်ဝယ်ခဲ့သော ပစ္စည်းမဟုတ်ပေ။ ဟာ ဘယ်လို
ဖြစ်တာပါလိမ့်။ ဝယ်ယူခဲ့သော ဆိုင်က အိမ်နဲ့
အတော်ဝေးသည်။ မြို့ မြောက်နဲ့ တောင်ဘက်
ခရီးများဖြစ်နေသည်။ 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT5vH246HkRtKkCSp2HWuKqX9ooEgRDSiVP3Eb3WdbnHp/img_0.9166843912021378.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTTiJVskXEWuBxD1gWsPjGEbPTdZ2FchYY3on6VdomiaG/img_0.9137305462633307.jpg)

ထို့ကြောင့် စားသောက်ဆိုင်သို့ ဖုန်းဆက်အကြောင်း
ကြားရသည်။ ကျွန်တော်တို့မှာထားတဲ့
ပစ္စည်းက တမျိုး၊ ပါဆယ်ထုတ်ပေးတာက တမျိုး
ဖြစ်နေကြာင်းပြောပြရသည်။ ဆိုင်သို့ ပြန်လာပြီး
လည်လှည်ဖို့ကလည်း ခရီးဝေးသဖြင့် မည်သို့ပြုလုပ်ရမည်ကို 
မေးကြည့်သည်။ ဝယ်ယူသည့်ပစ္စည်းက
တန်ဘိုးများပြီး ပါဆယ်ထည့်ပေးသော ပစ္စည်းက
တန်ဘိုးနည်းနေသည်။ ဖုန်းဖြင့် ပြေလည်စွာ
ပြောဆိုပြီးသည့်အခါ ပိုသောငွေကို ကေပေးဖြင့်
ဆိုင်က ငွေလွှဲပေးပို့လိုက်ပါသည်။ သို့ပေသိ
ကိုယ်ဝယ်သော ပစ္စည်းက ဈေးနည်းပြီး။ ပါဆယ်ထည့်
ပေးသည်က ဈေးပိုများနေပါမူ မည်သို့ရှိမည်မသိ။
တခါတလေတော့လည်း ထိုသို့ အလွဲများကလည်း 
ရှိနေတတ်ပေသည်။

body.title: HIve Comunity Bank is a zero loss loans
body.body: ## The Zero-Loss Advantage: Why HiveCommunityBank Redefines Lending\n\nAt its core, **HiveCommunityBank (HCB)** is built to be \

Unlike traditional DeFi platforms that rely on aggressive liquidations and speculative models, HCB prioritizes the long-term health of both the borrower and the Decentralized Hive Fund (DHF).

By eliminating liquidations and collecting interest upfront, we’ve created a **Zero-Loss Model** that protects the community's principal while offering borrowers a stress-free path to liquidity.

---

### 1. The Power of \
\n\nMost lending protocols (such as Aave or Compound) rely on \

If the value of your collateral drops, the system automatically sells your assets to repay the loan. HCB rejects this model for three strategic reasons:\n\n* **Security Through Independence:** Liquidations require \

to track market values. Oracles are the #1 target for DeFi exploits and flash-loan attacks. By removing liquidations, HCB removes the oracle, making the protocol **immune to price manipulation and technical failures.**\n* **Borrower Peace of Mind:** We believe you shouldn't lose your HIVE because of a temporary market dip. Our model allows you to retain your stake through volatility, ensuring the bank serves its primary purpose: helping you keep your HIVE.\n* **The Yield Backstop:** Instead of a forced sale, HCB uses \
HIVE (HP) as collateral. This HP remains in the ecosystem earning curation rewards. If a borrower defaults, the protocol simply retains the HP delegation, converting a \

into a **permanent, income-generating asset** for the community.

### 2. The Efficiency of Upfront Interest

Rather than tracking monthly bills or accruing debt over time, HCB deducts the total interest at the moment the loan is issued.

* **Immediate Solvency:** On \

the protocol is already made whole. Even if a borrower never interacts with the platform again, the pool has already secured the required revenue for that capital.\n* **Lean Operations:** Upfront collection removes the need for complex debt-tracking engines, late fees, or administrative overhead. This simplicity allows the protocol to function autonomously without dipping into the DHF principal.\n* **The \

Benefit:** This is where the math gets exciting. Because the interest is paid upfront and the remaining HBD can be placed in **HBD Savings (currently 15% APR)**, borrowers can actually earn more in interest over 12 months than the cost of the loan itself. This creates a \

arbitrage for responsible participants.

---

### Summary: A Fortress for the DHF

The HiveCommunityBank model ensures that the community fund is never at risk. By the time a loan is finalized:

1. **Revenue is secured** (Interest paid on Day 1).
2. **Principal is protected** (Never spent; remains in the pool).
3. **Collateral is safe** (HIVE is never sold in a panic).

This is more than just a lending tool—it is a sustainable financial engine designed to grow the Hive ecosystem without the risks of traditional DeFi.

---

Y a mí me recuerda a Shakespeare, en especial a la infausta Ofelia que le regaló una rama de romero a Hamlet diciéndole que era para la memoria algo que también se le atribuye al romero desde la antigüedad...\nSé que cuando tu plantita sea un robusto romero guardarás memoria de tu vecina que te lo regaló y el dedicado esmero con que lograste que llegara a ser una planta con mucho significado dentro de tu muy diversa colección de plantas.

body.title: New Showpieces for Home Decorating and My Afternoon Market Trip.
body.body:
> ![IMG-20260513-WA0005.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTrq7MzwGyfhai5n4rKxW2SSTZ5KmmxaocYad1gj8zpHt/IMG-20260513-WA0005.jpg) Assalamu Alaikum, I hope everyone is well. Today I am going to share a beautiful experience with you. We all love decorating our homes, and yesterday my day was a little different because of that love. I was very busy since morning. Starting from cooking at home, I spent the afternoon organizing all the small tasks. After finishing work, I thought I needed to buy some showpieces to make my home a little more attractive. For that purpose, I headed to the market. After going to the market, I visited several shops. The shops were full of eye-catching showpieces. My heart was filled with beautiful things made of clay, wood, copper and porcelain. Actually, it takes a lot of patience to find something I like, so I tried to take my time and visit each shop. ![IMG-20260513-WA0003.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTZQvC6KsUagLNgRVKFUsxNJxrYYtioB5RbNSZZf96tWr/IMG-20260513-WA0003.jpg) While walking around, I noticed some wonderful traditional and modern showpiece sets in one shop. I was particularly attracted to a copper-colored antique design jug and cup set. Its craftsmanship was very perfect and noble. I also liked another set with dark blue gold craftsmanship. This set had a beautiful dome-shaped design, which exudes a royal atmosphere. After much scrutiny, I bought several showpieces. I felt that keeping these showpieces in the drawing room showcase would enhance the beauty of the house many times over. I am truly fascinated by the artistic craftsmanship of each item. When I find something to my liking to decorate my hobby room, fatigue disappears in an instant. When I returned home after shopping, evening light was all around. This achievement gave me a lot of joy after the crowd in the market and all the work. I am thrilled to think how the house will look when I arrange these new showpieces. Anyway, this was my plan for today. I hope you liked the food photos I took. I will be back with more food photos like this. Wishing everyone good health, I bid farewell today. Wishing everyone good health, I bid farewell today. ___ |

body.title: Creative Nonfiction: Growing Up Faster Than I Ever Planned
body.body:
19 years old, relaxing on her dad's couch and feeling no worries, what a happy adult I am. Dad has gone to work, giving me allowance for the day's expenses. I'm done with the house chores and ready to enjoy a bit from my allowance. Life feels good from this side then I get an email announcing that I got the admission. I had applied to a university reluctantly because it was situated at a far distance but the only available one to take me in. I doubted I'll be taken because my grades were not so good but seeing the email, I jumped with joy and waited for dad. An hour before dad arrives, I begin to feel the weight of what is about to happen to my life. I'm going to leave home, I'll be far away from my family and I'll have to care for myself alone until I make friends in the new environment. I feel almost as scared as I was excited when I first get the news. *Dad enters, looking tired.* My thoughts *(he is an older adult and this tired from work and I've only just become an adult, what will be my fate away from home?)* *Dad, I got the admission and I am to resume in the first week of next month, that is in 14 days.* Dad hugged me with joy, he wasn't looking tired anymore or maybe all I can see now is his relief that his daughter finally got accepted to study. *Dad, I'm not that excited. The school is far, and we don't have much for the expenses now.* *God will provide and remember I told you to learn how to manage what I give you, you'll do fine.* I don't feel encouraged because management is the last thing I ever learned, I didn't see the need to before but I guess I'll have all the need to when I arrive in school 14 days away from now. ![file_0000000020547243aa661479977add33.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/merit.ahama/48aYxUD96JSPhhSq9ZfLStaArfQ6Ld89oor8pQSJrFid7Nhx51bmCN7SJd2h8hkj2m.png) 14 days rolled in like a day. I'm on my way to school, jumping from one vehicle to another no thanks to the bad roads. Thankfully, I arrived at the school safely and unpack my little stuff into my room after cleaning up. I go in for an early rest, I'm tired. A year later in school, I have an imaginable degree in money management because allowances are no longer enough. I started selling some items to course mates and friends long before I realised I started hustling like my dad while I was home. Taking care of myself was beginning to overwhelm me but it didn't end with that, I got calls from my siblings asking for allowances from me. It was super weird at first but before I realized it, I started sending money to my little ones who didn't really care if I was in need of help. I fall sick, alone in my room but get lucky to have a friend come visit. I'm taken to the hospital for treatment, expenses were covered for me and I am told to go home for proper rest before I continue school. The adult girlie couldn't continue. At home, dad let me switch into my baby girl's era and made sure I got whatever I needed. What I didn't see was him preparing me to go back stronger and continue what I had started. I didn't care, I just enjoyed not being the big girl I'm to be. The times at home went by so quickly, I recovered so fast and school activities didn't pause waiting for me, dad sent me back to school with my usual monthly allowance. This time, I felt so reluctant to go on the journey but I had no choice and soon, I was back in my room. 3 years later, I graduated with a flowing income, my ever demanding siblings and even a dependent dad after he had no contracts in his job but I got stronger. I didn't notice how I had been changing through the years but I grew up. Going on trips all by myself, funding major programs for my siblings and living away from family longer than I ever imagined, all that placed me on a path I am never going back from... Adulthood. Dad is proud of his little girl but I am no longer the little girl. Everyday, I wish I still am.
**Image used is AI generated.** Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@merit.ahama/creative-nonfiction-growing-up-faster-than-i-ever-planned-6gy)

body.title: New day - new tasks
body.body:
Hi, guys!

I have a ton of work today, and considering I had a stomach ache all night, I don't have much energy. But I'll still try to get everything done as much as I can, because this month is turning out to be very busy with advertising on my channel, and I need to do it all together for it to work seamlessly. Plus, I have a ton of published books I need to read, so there's a ton of work everywhere I look.

I'm trying to take it easy and get as much done as I can without overloading myself. So right now, I'll calmly finish my coffee, then go grocery shopping, and then get to work. I have a specific plan I need to follow to get everything done on time, so I don't have to rush too much and shoot three million videos in one day; I can easily spread it out over the week.

Today, I'll probably film a book unboxing and try to film a few more toy commercials. Tomorrow I'm supposed to be advertising a promotion at a bookstore, and they'll give me a few books for it, which I'll pick up from the post office today. It's always nice to get a few books for a video like this.

And of course, I promised myself to pay more attention to myself and my health this month, and I've started doing so. I'm actively walking my dogs again and have gotten back into exercise. It's only been two days so far, and I'm skipping today because I felt unwell at night, but from now on I'll try to keep it all on track. My weight continues to drop. And that's the main thing.

Have a great day, everyone!

body.title: 70 Days on InLeo Changed More Than My Account
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWMHeyp6dPFHz2hg8WD27yxVqsDtk5qdq8AxwVxC7tMVV/1000696593.png 



When I first joined InLeo, I honestly did not expect much.

I came with simple thoughts, simple ideas, and curiosity about Web3 communities.

No big audience.

No powerful connections.

No reputation.

Just consistency.

And looking back now, I realize something important:

InLeo was never only about earning.

It became a place that slowly changed the way I think, communicate, build, and grow.

For the past 70 days, I have shown up almost every single day.

Writing.

Replying to comments.

Reading other people’s thoughts.

Learning how communities actually grow.

Learning how attention works.

Learning how mindset shapes opportunity.

At first, almost nobody noticed me.

That phase was difficult.

You post something meaningful and get little engagement.

You wonder if anyone is reading.

You question whether your effort matters.

But instead of stopping, I kept going.

Because deep inside, I understood something:

Momentum is invisible before it becomes obvious.

And that lesson changed everything.

Most people quit during the silent phase.

Not because they are incapable.

But because they expect instant results.

Social media trained people to chase fast validation.

One viral post.

One lucky moment.

One overnight success story.

But InLeo taught me that real growth is usually slower and deeper.

Especially organic growth.

Organic growth is powerful because it is built on real interactions.

Real consistency.

Real people.

Not fake numbers.

Not artificial hype.

Over time, I noticed something surprising.

The more I interacted genuinely with others, the more opportunities started appearing naturally.

Not because I was trying to “farm” engagement.

But because communities respond to authentic energy.

I realized that comments matter more than most people think.

A thoughtful reply can create real connections.

A supportive interaction can open unexpected doors.

A simple conversation can build long-term trust.

That’s one of the most underrated things about InLeo.

It rewards people who actually participate.

Not just people who post and disappear.

And slowly, I became part of something bigger than myself.

I watched builders support each other.

I watched people from different countries connect through ideas.

I watched ordinary people transform into creators, writers, analysts, motivators, and leaders.

That changed my perspective on Web3 completely.

Before this, I thought social platforms were mostly about attention.

Now I understand they can also become ecosystems for growth.

Not only financial growth.

Mental growth.

Communication growth.

Discipline growth.

Confidence growth.

And honestly, consistency became my biggest teacher here.

Some days I felt motivated.

Some days I didn’t.

Some posts performed well.

Some posts disappeared quietly.

But the important thing was continuing anyway.

Because repetition sharpens skill.

Every day I wrote, I improved slightly.

Every conversation taught me something.

Every interaction helped me understand people better.

Even criticism became useful.

It forced me to think deeper.

To communicate more clearly.

To stay grounded.

And perhaps the biggest lesson I learned is this:

People connect more with authenticity than perfection.

You do not need to pretend to be perfect online.

You do not need to act like a guru.

People respect honesty.

They respect consistency.

They respect real stories.

That is why many of my posts focused on mindset, patience, discipline, growth, and inner battles.

Because those things are real.

Everyone fights silent battles.

Everyone experiences doubt.

Everyone struggles during invisible phases.

And I realized those topics create powerful connections because they reflect real human experiences.

Over time, something unexpected happened.

My account started growing.

My HP increased organically.

More people started recognizing my posts.

More conversations started happening.

And that growth felt meaningful because it was earned slowly.

Not bought.

Not forced.

Built step by step.

That process made me appreciate patience even more.

In a world obsessed with speed, patience becomes a competitive advantage.

Most people stop too early.

Most people underestimate the power of showing up consistently.

But consistency compounds.

Quietly at first.

Then suddenly.

And honestly, InLeo taught me that the real reward is not only tokens or visibility.

It’s transformation.

Because if you stay long enough, you realize something:

The person who started the journey is not the same person continuing it now.

You become more disciplined.

More confident.

More thoughtful.

More resilient.

And maybe that is the real power of communities like InLeo.

They do not just help people grow accounts.

They help people grow themselves.

So to everyone who interacted with me, supported me, replied to my posts, or simply read my thoughts:

Thank you.

You became part of this journey too.

And I truly believe this is still only the beginning.

Because Web3 is still early.

Communities are still evolving.

Builders are still rising.

And those who continue building consistently today may become the foundation of something massive tomorrow.

So I will keep showing up.

Keep learning.

Keep building.

Keep improving.

Because after these 70 days, one thing became clear to me:

Small daily actions really can change a life.

### On to today's episode

Here we go! We've spent 65 episodes understanding how AI works from the inside -- from the very first linear regression in episode #10 all the way through building transformers from scratch in episode #56, training LLMs in episode #60, and wiring up full RAG pipelines in episodes #64 and #65. We know how these models work. Now it's time to _use_ them.

In practice, most AI applications don't train models from scratch. They call APIs. You send a prompt, you get a response, you pay per token. The engineering challenge shifts from \

And that's a genuinely different skill set -- one that involves understanding HTTP APIs, token economics, error handling, and provider-specific quirks rather than gradient descent and backpropagation ;-)

## The provider landscape

The major LLM API providers as of 2026:

**OpenAI** (GPT-4, GPT-4o, o1): the first-mover and still the most widely used API. Strong at reasoning, coding, and general tasks. The most extensive third-party ecosystem of tools, wrappers, and documentation. Their API format has become the de facto standard that other providers copy.

**Anthropic** (Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Claude 3 Opus): excels at long-context tasks (200K tokens), careful instruction following, and nuanced reasoning. Strong safety focus. The `messages` API differs from OpenAI's in how system prompts are handled (separate `system` parameter vs system message in the messages array).

**Google** (Gemini 1.5 Pro, Gemini Ultra): competitive with the top models, tightly integrated with Google's ecosystem. Gemini 1.5 Pro handles up to 1M token contexts -- the largest available. If you're already in the Google Cloud ecosystem, the integration is straightforward.

**Open-source** (LLaMA 3, Mistral, Mixtral, Qwen): run locally or on your own infrastructure. No API costs, full control over the model, no data leaving your servers. The tradeoff: you handle hosting, inference optimization, and scaling yourself. We'll cover local deployment in a future episode.

All major providers have converged on a similar API format. Learn one, and switching between them is mostly changing a URL, a parameter name, and maybe how the system prompt is passed. Having said that, each provider has its own quirks and the devil is in the details.

## The Chat Completions API

The standard interface that every provider has adopted (with minor variations):

```python
import os
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(api_key=os.environ[\

)
```

Three message roles define the conversation:
- **system**: sets the model's behavior, persona, and constraints. Processed first, shapes every response. Think of it as the model's \

- **user**: the human's input -- questions, instructions, data
- **assistant**: the model's previous responses (you include these for multi-turn conversations so the model has context of what it already said)

The **temperature** parameter (0.0 to 2.0) controls randomness. We covered this in detail in episode #62 when we discussed sampling -- lower temperature makes the model more deterministic and focused, higher temperature makes it more creative and varied. For code generation and factual Q&A, 0.0-0.3 is typical. For creative writing, 0.7-1.0.

**max_tokens** caps the response length. This is important for cost control (you pay per output token) and for preventing the model from rambling. If you need a concise answer, set it to 200-300. If you need a detailed explanation, 1000-2000.

### Multi-turn conversations

For a multi-turn conversation, you maintain the full message history and send it with every request. The model itself is stateless -- it doesn't remember previous calls. Your code is responsable for maintaining context:

```python
import os
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(api_key=os.environ[\

: assistant_msg})
    return assistant_msg

# Each call includes the full conversation history
print(chat(\

)
```

_This is why context windows matter._ Every turn adds to the message history. A conversation that goes back and forth 20 times might accumulate 10,000+ tokens of history, eating into your context budget. Production chat systems typically implement **sliding window** strategies -- keeping the system prompt and the last N messages, summarizing or dropping older messages to stay within limits. We'll see exactly how to build this kind of context management when we cover building agents in upcoming episodes.

## Streaming responses

For interactive applications, waiting for the full response to complete before showing anything creates a terrible user experience. The model might take 5-10 seconds to generate a long answer, and the user is staring at a blank screen. **Streaming** delivers the response token by token as it's generated:

```python
import os
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(api_key=os.environ[\

, flush=True)
        full_response += delta
        token_count += 1
print()  # newline after streaming completes
print(f\

)
```

Streaming doesn't change the output -- the model generates the same tokens in the same order. It just delivers them incrementally as they're produced. **Time-to-first-token** is typically 200-500ms; total generation time depends on output length. The user sees words appearing in real time, which feels MUCH more responsive even though the total wait is identical.

One subtlety: when streaming, the `usage` field (token counts) is typically not available until the stream completes. Some providers include it in the final chunk, others don't include it at all in streaming mode. If you need exact token counts for billing, you may need to use the non-streaming API or count tokens client-side using a tokenizer (which is its own topic -- we'll cover tokenization in a dedicated episode).

## Function calling and tool use

This is where things get interesting. **Function calling** (also called **tool use**) lets the model decide when to call external functions and what arguments to pass. You define available functions with JSON schemas; the model generates structured calls when it determines they're needed:

```python
import os
import json
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(api_key=os.environ[\

}
```

_This is a critical distinction_ -- the model does NOT execute functions. It generates structured call requests that your code inspects, validates, and executes (or rejects). The model is sandboxed: it can _ask_ for actions but can't take them directly. Your code decides whether to honor each request.

The full loop looks like this:

```python
import os
import json
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(api_key=os.environ[\

, messages=messages, tools=tools)

msg = response.choices[0].message

# Step 2: execute the tool call
if msg.tool_calls:
    tc = msg.tool_calls[0]
    args = json.loads(tc.function.arguments)
    result = get_weather(**args)
    print(f\

)
```

The three-step dance: (1) model sees the question and available tools, decides to call `get_weather`, (2) your code executes the actual function and gets a result, (3) you send the result back and the model generates a natural language answer incorporating the data. This pattern is the foundation for building AI agents -- systems that can take actions in the real world through tool calls. We'll go much deeper into agent architectures in upcoming episodes.

## Structured outputs and JSON mode

Sometimes you don't want free-form text -- you want the model to return structured data you can parse programmatically. **JSON mode** forces the model's output to be valid JSON:

```python
import os
import json

client = OpenAI(api_key=os.environ[\

), you get guaranteed valid JSON. The model might still get the _content_ wrong (hallucinate entities, miss some), but the _structure_ is reliable. For production pipelines where LLM output feeds into downstream code, structured outputs are essentially mandatory.

OpenAI also supports **strict structured outputs** with a JSON schema parameter that enforces exact key names and types. Anthropic has a similar feature via tool use with a defined schema. The specifics differ, but the pattern is the same: tell the model exactly what structure you need, and it conforms.

## Error handling and retries

API calls fail. Networks time out. Rate limits trigger. Servers return 500s. A robust client handles all of these gracefully with exponential backoff:

```python
import os
import time
from openai import OpenAI, RateLimitError, APITimeoutError, APIConnectionError

client = OpenAI(api_key=os.environ[\

}])
# print(result)
```

**Exponential backoff** is the key pattern: wait 1 second after the first failure, 2 seconds after the second, 4 seconds after the third. This prevents hammering the endpoint (which would just extend your rate limit) while giving the server time to recover.

Rate limits vary by provider and pricing tier. OpenAI limits are per-minute (both tokens-per-minute and requests-per-minute). When you hit them, the API returns HTTP 429 with a `Retry-After` header telling you exactly how long to wait. In production, you'd also want to add **jitter** (a small random delay on top of the backoff) to prevent multiple clients from retrying in sync and creating a thundering herd.

## Cost optimization

LLM APIs charge per token, both input and output. At GPT-4o pricing, you're looking at roughly $2.50 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens. That might sound cheap until you're processing thousands of requests per day.

Cost reduction strategies that actually work in production:

- **Use the right model**: GPT-4o-mini or Claude Haiku for classification, extraction, and simple tasks. Full models only for complex reasoning. This single choice often reduces costs by 10-20x.
- **Cache responses**: identical or near-identical queries can return cached results. A simple dictionary cache with query hashing catches repeated questions.
- **Limit output tokens**: set `max_tokens` to prevent verbose responses. If you need a yes/no answer, don't let the model write 500 words.
- **Batch processing**: OpenAI's Batch API offers 50% cost reduction for non-time-sensitive workloads. You submit a file of requests, they process it within 24 hours.
- **Prompt optimization**: shorter, more focused prompts reduce input token count. Every word in your system prompt is multiplied by every request.
- **Local models**: for high-volume, low-complexity tasks, running an open-source model locally eliminates API costs entirely. The upfront cost is hardware; the marginal cost per query approaches zero.

body.title: Consistency with a Comma: Navigating Hive’s Rewards and Realities.
body.body:
Huhm, this week's topic happens to be a very deep and thoughtful one, it is one that forces one to sit and really think things out, like... Why am I really still here on hive. Is it for the rewards or is it that hive has become a home for you...?



![1001032544.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23uFW3cFXgXrGYQuWiCtWGdbr2QoxiLWG6R2RPW6D8nBwKeVob2Bo1PS6Fxw5iVrPzvwU.png)




Now, personally hive has become a home away from home for me, so even if it stops paying I can't stop being here. I come here each and everyday, I mean countless times a day to read, engage, blog, connect, learn and all.. and all of this has now become a part of me, a part of my life. And honestly, I can't see myself leaving hive totally.





And the truth as well needs to be said, hive with no rewards won't be in any way easy, that is for sure. And even though I know this is the reality of some of us if not most of us, I will like to just make it personal; hive has helped me a lot financially and is still helping me to an extent. So, I can't deny that I will feel the effects of no more rewards. Even when the price of hive fell, and hive stopped rewarding in hbd, we all felt it, it wasn't easy, some even stopped blogging entirely, not to talk of if its rewards stop totally.



![1001031537.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23vsL9UpY96gT1Tz6pXRSvpEQnp4v9NU55dgPYRuvVpLgD2nxgGzdBE9QtC45FP2ypzdJ.png)


Like I said earlier, I will still be here, just that there will be a comma now, which is that if hive stops rewarding, I will still be around to read posts, engage with various authors that are still staying, connect, make blog post as well, the comma there is that, I won't be as consistent as before anymore. Reason being that, hive has what is doing in my life financially, and when it stops rewarding then those parts its rewards helps me to fill and cover would be out, and I would need to find another means/way to make money.



What I'm saying in essence is that, I will still be here, because I've come to love hive, just that I won't be as consistent as I am now....

body.title: Wednesday Walking — RSL Club
body.body:
Wednesday Walking — RSL Club

The weather was not great today. Cloudy, little bit of rain on and off. The kind of day where you think maybe just stay home. But I went anyway.
While I was walking, I passed by the RSL Club. 


![1000061273.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erinleeishere/242rnW6K6uhtQm6UMg4bBE8b5GCeFeM7ySuciZC4CeXGynEg1kXuUo6AKdv7zq6ZQNCpB.jpg)

![1000061267.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erinleeishere/23wMW1PJyH7eRyE9Q6d8gcgjyNYMuEXapabTxkpFW5MPH6surrqwuLV2scAjbHeguZrMT.jpg)

RSL stands for Returned Services League — it's an organization for veterans, people who came back from war. Actually the word \

is important here. It's been around since 1916, started during WWI. One of the biggest veteran organizations in Australia.


![1000061270.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erinleeishere/243Ly4qKfVhsr1Jje7mWxfuyx8WisGSDvCnytYeFhQPH52iQEtBDhKq76tGock3fqg8BU.jpg)



In front of the club, there was a memorial for soldiers who died in the war. And what made this one a little special — there was a helicopter model right next to it. I walked up closer and took some photos. It's a strange feeling, standing there on just a normal Wednesday morning.

---

Every year on April 25, Australia has Anzac Day(Australian and New Zealand Army Corps).

 It's a day to remember and honor those who served and died in wars. Dawn services, marches — people really show up for it. And kids learn about it at school too. I think that's really good actually.



This is what I took on ANZAC day service this year. They even remember dog too.

* LEST WE FORGET *

---

The RSL clubs also run restaurants and other activities, and the money goes to supporting veterans and their families. It's a really nice system I think.

![1000061264.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erinleeishere/EqDkZtiEytQPtsCb4E997nyYW2xpgDR1TepHfKjPajL3TD6PW97GW2iqN2uyQe6SMBE.jpg)

Today's walk was good. Got some fresh air and also learned a little something. Not bad for a grey Wednesday.

body.title: Day One with Fujifilm X-A10
body.body:
![macproperty).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/23wgFFe61qLGHgVFGxMmrLmcC9Pkej5HV8DLo2Erddf9bG5LdWXroBQ1FhzzBXCMTs3Aw.png)
I wanted to have a Fujifilm for so long and on my birthday, I was given an XA10 with its lens kit, 16-50mm. I know it’s a bit dated now to have it and for a hobbyist like myself, it’s a good entry point to explore further on this particular hobby of mine. In the past working with fixed lenses and limited settings of Sony DSC-H300, I took so many cool pictures that I was really satisfied with its result. Now though, I realized that I know nothing at all about composition and framing. It is also why I spent the entire day obsessing about its setting and trying to come up with the look that I wanted. Here are some of the results from my first experiment of settings with the camera. There were more options compared to the first camera I had. I needed to re-learn all the theory and put it to practice.
![DSCF1209.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/23zRy9MAsSXg8DEjq4fy4Zs8Pdi77wuNCScUpggbaxqhiqu9pAZRCiuHNncyWwbCCDB4q.JPG)
Just as these two pictures below, they are shot with different film settings on the camera itself.
![DSCF1263.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/23t77FMrikN9hrzvAwD8TQ7oaAs8dvuZBp3WWBSyvkyuKJsGyRzoBWdifst3G9CzkUqAf.JPG)
![DSCF1263.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/23t77FMrikN9hrzvAwD8TQ7oaAs8dvuZBp3WWBSyvkyuKJsGyRzoBWdifst3G9CzkUqAf.JPG)
From the first picture, I think fuji is really awesome for street photography rather than indoor ones. ![DSCF1243.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/23z7Fr2nP3yWHBg8x4n5RsHpFLWWKLBPy9s4NV5tWPs5LpizuzKA4ht6xvgQe3VaeVG4X.JPG) I am still working on creating bokeh but the first time I tried it, the result looks like these ![DSCF1090.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/242hYDUftgBSrRYKe3XPuYJheCgcXzYogmjXvMJwErFFVLwsNx77wxAEbBFYqwKfhETfj.JPG) ![DSCF1046.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/23wqa2y13vPSqZyzr27msbjUPFA8PU7yYvJe1LzRFKyCEgkGQDRtaKUNT53JdTecPs7gw.JPG)
There are many new things I need to discover and I'd do some more photo hunt and walk around some neighborhood. Since now I also live in another city with more object to shoot at, I'd have to much fun with it. I also see the color changes indoor vs outdoor which I am very much looking forward to working with and improve my skills.

body.title: Música rusa: Dos hermanos se fueron
body.body: Música rusa: Dos hermanos se fueron =================================== * * *

>La canción Dos hermanos se fueron (Там шли два брата), es un tema folclórico cosaco lleno de tristeza y añoranza. Cuenta con crudeza la historia del regreso a casa de dos hermanos involucrados en la guerra con los turcos.

>La letra narra las vicisitudes de los hermanos cosacos después de su salida del frente, y describe como luego de ser atacados por los polacos cuando tratan de pasar por sus tierras, uno de ellos está muriendo por causa de tres heridas recibidas en la batalla.

>El moribundo pide papel para escribir unas últimas palabras a su familia, recordando como en casa lo esperan su padre, su madre, su esposa y sus hijos pronto huérfanos.

* * *

>En realidad el origen de esta canción viene de bastante lejos, surge a partir de una obra literaria alemana, Los dos granaderos (Die Grenadiere) de Heinrich Heine, un poema lírico-narrativo de dicho poeta. La obra fue traducida posteriormente por Mijail Mijáilov en 1858 y de ahí surgió la versión comentada sobre los cosacos y la guerra con los turcos.

>Por lo visto la canción también tiene varias versiones más relacionadas con distintos conflictos, además del enfrentamiento entre cosacos rusos y turcos, como la Primera Guerra Mundial o la Guerra Polaco-Soviética entre otras contiendas.

* * *

>En el video expuesto a continuación pueden escuchar la canción interpretada por el Coro de los Cosacos de Kubán:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rJuvANtzRds
>En la descripción del video anterior también está disponible la letra en ruso.

>Por su parte, el video mostrado a continuación puede servirles para conocer otra versión de la canción, esta vez con un ritmo más lento y dramatización:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=00C0-uiwPVw

>La melodía de la canción comentada, también tiene cierto parecido a la de otra canción titulada Del calabozo de Odesa (С Одесского Кичмана), popularizada por el famoso cantante soviético Leonid Utiósov (Леонид Утёсов), y un poco más conocida en su país.
>Pero esta otra canción mencionada trata de la fuga de unos presos y no tiene relación con la otra por su contenido.

>El video expuesto a continuación muestra la interpretación de Tatiana Kabanova (Татьяна Кабанова) de la canción Del calabozo de Odesa:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VbLXPfhhL\_E * * *

>Me despido esperando esta canción folclórica cosaca pueda ser del gusto de alguno, con su música de acordeón; pronto trataré de comentar sobre otra canción propia de una cultura del mundo menos conocida en mi región.

body.title: Ireland's Top 30 Songs of all Time (7, 8, 9) for Three Tune Tuesday - Week 259 - win some HBI
body.body:
](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQScqaY9ZjmaRzQ96jgCMqYSQG543J6Rv7SforBh9pLYx/20210504_140532.jpg) </center>

<center> Here are my week two hundred and fifty eight recommendations for _Three Tune Tuesday_ <center>

#### **Drum roll please.....** </center>

# <center> The Stunning - Brewing Up a Storm  </center>

As I was saying recently, I'm going to take some inspiration from the Irish Public and a recent poll. 

I don't listen to the radio all that much these days. I am more inclined to be listening to a Podcast or an album on Spotify, but when I do tune in my wireless, it tends to be Today FM that I listen to and they did a Top 100 Irish songs of all time poll in the run up to St. Patrick's day.

I am going to give ye the top Thirty three over the next eleven weeks from this count down. Why? Well, I'm Irish and non Irish people are always asking me to say Thirty Three and third which sounds more like Thurty Tree and Turd with our accent!

We are edging ever closer to Ireland's official favourite song!!

So here we are at number 9 and this is a floor filler, a belter, a tuuuuuuuuuuuuune!!!

https://youtu.be/4hWMTSnP1AQ?is=Ofptv7H1VB8dchZu

# <center> Aslan - Crazy World </center>

I suspect the majority won't know this song, as it's from a lesser known Irish band Aslan. They took their name from Aslan the lion in The Chronicles of Narnia by C. S. Lewis. The band chose the name because they liked the strength and symbolism associated with the character, who represents courage, wisdom, and leadership in the novels. The name helped give the group a distinctive identity when they formed in Dublin during the early 1980s.

Let me know what ya think of this song.

https://youtu.be/DPBn99kaqBg?is=YUPW34nwQ7xe0AEU

# <center> The Wolfe Tones - Grace </center>

We will finish out with this song from iconic Irish band The Wolfe Tones.

Grace is one of the most well-known Irish ballads and after I explain the song to you, you'll see why. The song tells the tragic love story of Joseph Plunkett, one of the leaders of the 1916 Easter Rising which led to Ireland's freedom, and his wife Grace Gifford. Written by Frank and Seán O’Meara, the lyrics describe the couple’s final moments together before Plunkett was executed by British forces in Kilmainham Gaol (jail). The leaders of the rising were lined up and shot dead. Its emotional storytelling and gentle melody have made it a powerful tribute to love, sacrifice, and Irish history.

Over the years, “Grace” has become a staple of Irish folk music and is often sung at concerts, commemorations, and gatherings throughout Ireland and among Irish communities abroad. Although many artists have recorded versions of the song, The Wolfe Tones’ performance helped introduce it to a wider audience and cemented its place in modern Irish musical culture. The ballad remains especially popular around anniversaries of the Easter Rising and continues to resonate with listeners because of its combination of romance, sorrow, and national identity.


https://youtu.be/hvfhZn18lfk?is=LTdp-u6il14JJXyb

# <center> Three Tune Tuesday </center>

#

That's right, it's Tuesday folks and for our merry little band of ladies and lads, that means sharing tunes, good vibes and engagement. As another week disappears in the rearview mirror, we have loads of engagement and tunes flying around on Three Tune Tuesday and sure isn't that bloody fantastic! I hope you're ready to share three tunes from wherever you find yourself on this magical spinning lump of rock that we all call home and sure you might even sing us a tune if we're lucky?

It's a time of the week when lovers of music, tunes and craic bring their blockchain community three of their finest and brightest tunes to share and celebrate, so let's roll on and let the tunes flow free.

This is my 259th week waxing lyrical for Three Tune Tuesday and we are still going strong.

It started off with me just sharing tunes into what seemed like a void, but little by little others joined and now I'm thrilled that we have a little corner of Hive where we come and share our tunes every Tuesday, and long may it continue. I almost stopped posting the songs and thoughts a few times, but I stuck with it and now interestingly it is my favorite thing about Hive. I love music and now I have a network of folks around the world who love music too and we share our tunes and catch up with each others tunes and discuss them each week. We get Pop, Metal, Rock, Gospel, Folk, Jazz, Rap, Hip-Hop, Trip-Hop, Reggae, Bippy bappidy Flange Hop. Ok I made that one up, but you get the idea, we are all learning about new artists, bands, back stories and sure isn't it just mighty!

Something that excites me the most is that we even get musicians sharing their covers of famous songs and even their own songs from time to time here on #ThreeTuneTuesday, which is a real favorite of mine, as that takes talent, time and dedication.

We are adding New posters and retaining our core of regulars here on #TTT which is fantastic. Let's keep it growing. Over the years, I have listened to fantastic music shared from like-minded folk from around the globe and interacted with their posts. This has led me to genres I don't know well and to some amazing new bands and artists and has even introduced me to some musical instruments I did not know existed. It also allows me to upvote smaller accounts and find some really interesting people from all over the world, which is heartening.

I hope you enjoy the tunes - be sure to tell me all about it in the comments below and above all else, please enjoy the rest of your Tuesday - smile at a stranger, rub a dog, be a nice human to someone who was not expecting it - peace out.

For those unfamiliar with TTT or Three Tune Tuesday....

# <center> The jist is as follows </center>

#

Every Tuesday I'm going to share 3 songs which I like to listen to and I invite your feedback in the comments below. Better still, why not have a blast of your own Three Tune Tuesday and mention me in the post and I'll come and find the post and upvote it. If you could also use #threetunetuesday tag that would be great, as that is what I use when sifting through all the entries every Wednesday. It'll be a sweet way for us all to discover new music. You'll also be in with a chance of winning the prize - more on that later.

# <center> HBI contest - win up to 6HBI </center>

#

Share your Three Tune Tuesday songs below or create a post with #ttt or #threetunetuesday and mention me so I can find the post.

I'll pick the three songs I enjoyed the most each week as the winner and transfer 1 share of HBI to the winner when this post pays out 7 days from now, but wait there's more...

# <center> Three Tune Tuesday Sponsors </center>

#

We have a sponsor list of six people who selflessly offer HBI in addition to my one. They are as follows @tengolotodo @bozz @coquicoin @ablaze @seki1 @inthenow

Due to a very busy life on my side, the winner posts often come after a delay and may come over 4 to 8 consecutive days. That's just how I do it, so please be patient while awaiting HBI and understand that only my 1HBI is guaranteed. The others are dependant on our lovely sponsors seeing these posts and sending on the HBI. That means some weeks winners may get 3 shares and other weeks they may get more.

Thanks a million to our sponsors above once again and any winners please bear in mind that some people only pop on here every few months, so be patient while waiting for the HBI.

<center> Best of luck!

# <center> Sin é, That's all folks, thanks for stopping by. </center>

That's it for another week. Those are your three songs for this week. Let me know what you think - good, bad or indifferent? Did you like them all or just one or two?

Also, as I said before, I love getting good steers for new tunes, so please tell me about the latest and greatest from your playlist below and I'll be sure to check em out.

_The YouTube videos shared are not owned by me and I am simply sharing great music with the community here on Hive_

## <center> Thanks as always for stopping by everyone and a big shout out to @stickupcurator whose continued generous support to #ttt is noticed and truly appreciated - thanks gents. </center>

# <center> Peace Out </center>

Assalamu Alaikum friends, how are you all? I hope that by the infinite mercy of Allah, you are all well, healthy, comfortable and happy with all your family members. I also wish that by your prayers and the mercy of Allah, I am well and healthy with all my family members. For this, I am grateful to Allah Almighty. Alhamdulillah.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYsQp2GfmBrEbrdpyApmdAEp6UuRhTeUXgCWPDmVgaJES/1778652026755.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ5RDRr89KQLLbC1oHR1t5qfTLUHBqAvqMrikqbRhQTmZ/1778652026886.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeRB9nEnqmCptHKapNFB8JSMd5BcW3iYfpA4pBtJxUuhV/1778652027006.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZqJDTjXzZd5mp5PnQ6A64J5Am4BXex3WuYwZLxHvPKkj/1778652027134.jpg)

Friends, today I have come up with a new video for you. The video is made around the wedding of a doll, which my daughter will be giving to her doll. I will present a video of that wedding to you. So, friends, keep watching and enjoy this beautiful video. My daughter has a beautiful doll. That doll is getting married today. So, on the occasion of the wedding, my daughter is decorating the doll beautifully. You can see it in the video. First, my daughter is putting lipstick on the doll's lips and she has already taken out all the decorating materials she has to decorate this doll beautifully.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeRB9nEnqmCptHKapNFB8JSMd5BcW3iYfpA4pBtJxUuhV/1778652047998.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmay2wn4MzBzHSX7Ay6qfmuLdt3qVCUSkpr3zimtcwcj8a/1778652048193.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd1iRBqk9e6BH4QwbguVLQaaB65wTjAKshBCUPjJvJJsy/1778652048338.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPsGKHsfwks9khfW4J4vhpPokfd15mUjATs2fCxK7wKTU/1778652048417.jpg)

Although my daughter is very young, she has never seen a wedding like this, but in the wedding, what is to be decorated and everything has to be given to her by a parlor, but she is trying to do it through this, since she was not taken to a parlor, so she is sitting at home, but I am decorating this doll. After giving her lipstick, she is applying cream on her face and putting nail polish on her fingers and putting soap on her feet. You can see that in the video, friends. But my daughter is enjoying a lot and sometimes she looks at me but smiles because I am the only playmate for my daughter. Because here there are children, that is, small boys and girls, but here she will play with them, so she has chosen me as her playmate.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYUz51NtFY78ZEa46Wk6FvCS5QHkSvmec8tUgxB7FNTkR/1778652067093.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPCZGU3XZzrhHyShp4bbbz1gpxeaWVCMKzV9vqPzt6jnn/1778652067236.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRmCdhy8JbaC8yUuvS2uacHkYZ3J8TDRrm9a77iWR8vvi/1778652067363.jpg)

And according to the second law of our country, when the bride is given in marriage, the boy's side has to give several things. My daughter bought all those toys, starting from a bed to a gas cylinder stove, and various other materials, but she bought them to give to the boy's side, which you see in the video. Then my daughter decorated the doll beautifully with various types of makeup.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd1iRBqk9e6BH4QwbguVLQaaB65wTjAKshBCUPjJvJJsy/1778652092732.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme4F5jQvWRv1eMG9DDHCSo1bRyXSHPnXgbnZqxy9Zdcsc/1778652092835.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPCZGU3XZzrhHyShp4bbbz1gpxeaWVCMKzV9vqPzt6jnn/1778652092949.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ5RDRr89KQLLbC1oHR1t5qfTLUHBqAvqMrikqbRhQTmZ/1778652093063.jpg)

So friends, we also remember when we were little, we used to dress up dolls like this, we would marry the dolls, we would have a lot of fun, we would enjoy ourselves, we would cook, we would eat, we would say that we had a lot of fun, we were very happy, and that is the situation of my daughter even today. But after marrying that doll, she has become busy with cooking, that is, she has picked up some leaves, some grass-like things and she is cooking them for everyone's food. It is a fun thing, of course, have you ever played the doll game of dressing up a bride with your little children like this? You must give your important opinion.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcviAdiUEKSCnLfpzTPvXRhJK9ZBEmEc95sccq9KYdPup/1778652150098.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZqJDTjXzZd5mp5PnQ6A64J5Am4BXex3WuYwZLxHvPKkj/1778652150278.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNRhTx24vx1Bus9ygVr8z9TudmwjtnuFp1V4A2Ldk3qTc/1778652150431.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeRB9nEnqmCptHKapNFB8JSMd5BcW3iYfpA4pBtJxUuhV/1778652150538.jpg)

So friends, how did you like my video of today's little doll decorating my daughter's doll? body.title: Michael : a movie about self-discovery.
body.body:
After a long-overdue plan, I went to watch Michael yesterday.
I have always been fond of dancing, Hip-Hop, Openstyle, Krumping, and so on. It was only after the death of Michael that I came to know him. Maybe because I was born on later 90's.  I would watch all the videos of him with the world, as dance forms have already grown and advanced, his form and style were highly relevant and copied by some of the best dancers around the world, esp. Les Twins; my interest in dancing again accelerated to world styles.  I have been a casual dancer since 2010, did some shows, and so on. So, that's how I saw Michael and became a fan of music ever since. 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQVRqRK82Dsd9CXDTuDJCMdjPvCjQ5nku4ijBExQyY4T1/mj.png 
 [src](https://encrypted-tbn1.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcRYnunJ2_4xXT4tNUnmSJQkm1XHXJOGw2l46rpRQNGgYmAdZMZG) 



# *Michael:*
The movie is more about Michael finding himself and the journey that comes with it. Its story revolves around his relationship with his father, his lost childhood, and the idea he embraces for his music. With his personal growth, the movie embraces the kindness of Michael and his contributions to his family, extending to the helpless and needy ones in the community.
The movie starts with the existing background of Michael's musical life with his brothers. One can see he had quite a vibe with his musical preferences, but he couldn't open of as of the fear of his father.
And, as he grows up, his talents are discovered by different record labels, and his musical and dance grows along the time, watching different shows on TV. There is a bit of a lack of depth to how his core depth of music and dance is followed, but I can take that as everything is squeezed into the 2-hour movie. Sometimes, the same pattern of showcase happens over-time which kind of distracted me for a bit. But rest was just fine. 

The musical features were what were distinguishable, and Jaafar, in some scenes, was great. Once, for a while, I thought it was Michael, just to realize all that was done by him, not with some visual effects, gave me goosebumps. The musicals and the visualization were something that blew my mind, also the replica of Michael himself in Jaafar keeps you on the edge of your seat. Most of the close-up shots would bring the audience closer to the emotions and mind of Michael. I feel Jaafar was outstanding here. 
As we know the Michael story, the movie has added some of his thought-provoking initiatives and actions that mattered to the community, and also added a sense of freedom. 

I thoroughly enjoyed the film, with the music and the visuals adding the exact replicas of MJ shows around the world. There's always more to ask, but the Movie did the job for me.  This is a must-watch movie for any music lover, not just MJ fans.

body.title: [ESP/ENG] Desastre Blanco. Opinión / White disaster. Opinion
body.body:
**Una introducción necesaria** 


El desastre del Real Madrid este curso no se explica por un único derrumbe, sino por una acumulación de deficiencias que, juntas, revelan un club sin pulso competitivo, sin cohesión interna y sin un proyecto claro. La temporada ha sido un recordatorio de que incluso las instituciones más poderosas pueden caer no por un golpe devastador, sino por una erosión lenta, silenciosa y persistente.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSNXRjmnSUm8Wf4AiHVyv56sRcc965LUZxcxdxjermGDB/1778654808619.jpg)[fuente](https://twitter.com/2010MisterChip/status/2052763299331121216?t=WBqb38SmIypZYDXw8h6Y5A&s=19)



**Crisis deportiva**

El equipo nunca encontró una identidad reconocible. La plantilla, diseñada para dominar, se mostró frágil en los momentos decisivos: desconexiones defensivas, un mediocampo sin jerarquía y una delantera incapaz de sostener la presión competitiva. La falta de gol —un problema arrastrado desde hace años— se volvió estructural. Ni los fichajes ni los jóvenes pudieron compensar la ausencia de un líder ofensivo fiable.

Muchos pueden argumentar que tuvieron al líder de goleo, pero, la realidad es que está ausencia de gol fue evidente en partidos claves que definieron el rumbo y la historia del club merengue.

A esto se sumó la irregularidad táctica. El Madrid pasó de partidos brillantes a actuaciones apáticas sin explicación clara. La sensación general fue la de un equipo que jugaba por inercia, sin automatismos, sin agresividad y sin una idea colectiva sólida.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVVFT2epqbZJm7Vebx6vvKpvDLepHyc93mdTybTq3XDzs/1778654926403.jpg)[fuente](https://www.facebook.com/share/1HjZFL95zc/)



**Vestuario fracturado**

El vestuario, históricamente un espacio de jerarquías fuertes, vivió tensiones internas. Los egos y la necesidad de liderazgo entre pesos pesados trajeron problemas que se manifestaron en el terreno de juego. Hubo filtraciones constantes, señales inequívocas de un entorno contaminado. La falta de liderazgo emocional —algo que siempre sostuvo al Madrid en la adversidad— se hizo evidente.

Las decisiones disciplinarias inconsistentes y la gestión desigual de minutos alimentaron el malestar. Algunos jugadores sintieron que el proyecto no tenía rumbo; otros, que se les exigía sin ofrecerles respaldo.

**Inestabilidad en el banquillo**

El cambio de técnico a mitad de temporada fue el síntoma más visible del caos. El relevo no trajo claridad ni impulso: el nuevo entrenador heredó un equipo emocionalmente desgastado y tácticamente desordenado. Las ideas tardaron en cuajar, y cuando lo hicieron, ya era tarde. La transición se gestionó mal, sin planificación ni comunicación efectiva.

El Madrid, que siempre presumió de estabilidad en los grandes ciclos, vivió una temporada de improvisaciones.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUUvxAtanxvnMUjvEfEBkRYazreFgiqBUfGQbiw6he57g/1778634341367.jpg)[fuente](https://x.com/sport/status/2052485462737014868?t=ung1BCJcy29mpsIZUPzTlw&s=08)


**Dirección del club en entredicho**

Hace unas horas Florentino Pérez dio una conferencia de prensa y ha anunciado que no dimitirá. En cambio ha convocado a elecciones y someterá su cargo, tras 26 años al frente de la entidad blanca, pues no pocos consideran que es tiempo de un cambio de mando.

**Dos elementos más** 

El Madrid vivió una temporada sin brújula y esto se pudo apreciar en la falta de un proyecto coherente, uno que conecte cantera, mercado, estilo de juego y liderazgo institucional. 

Por otra parte, pudimos apreciar un equipo con un gran desgaste emocional: la plantilla transmitió cansancio, desconexión y falta de convicción. De igual manera, hubo muchas lesiones dentro del equipo mostrando un problema en la preparación física de los jugadores.



**Un comentario final **

El desastre del Real Madrid no fue un colapso dramático, sino una decadencia silenciosa: un equipo sin alma, un vestuario dividido, un banquillo inestable y una directiva atrapada en su propio laberinto. No hubo tragedia, pero sí una lenta pérdida de grandeza. Y a veces, ese tipo de caída es la más difícil de revertir.

*Nota: Utilicé el traductor DeepL Translate*.



ENGLISH 


 

A Necessary Introduction 

Real Madrid's disaster this season is not explained by a single collapse, but by an accumulation of deficiencies that, together, reveal a club without a competitive pulse, without internal cohesion and without a clear project. The season has been a reminder that even the most powerful institutions can fall not by a devastating blow, but by slow, silent, and persistent erosion.

Sports crisis

The team never found a recognizable identity. The squad, designed to dominate, was fragile in the decisive moments: defensive disconnections, a midfield without hierarchy and a forward line incapable of sustaining competitive pressure. The lack of goals – a problem that has dragged on for years – became structural. Neither the signings nor the youngsters could compensate for the absence of a reliable offensive leader.

Many can argue that they had the scoring leader, but the reality is that this absence of goals was evident in key matches that defined the course and history of the merengue club.

Added to this was the tactical irregularity. Madrid went from brilliant games to apathetic performances with no clear explanation. The general feeling was that of a team that played by inertia, without automatisms, without aggressiveness and without a solid collective idea.

Fractured dressing room

The dressing room, historically a space of strong hierarchies, experienced internal tensions. Egos and the need for leadership among heavyweights brought problems that manifested themselves on the pitch. There were constant leaks, unmistakable signs of a contaminated environment. The lack of emotional leadership – something that always sustained Madrid in adversity – became evident.

Inconsistent disciplinary decisions and uneven minute management fueled the discomfort. Some players felt that the project had no direction; others, that they were required without offering them support.

Instability on the bench

The change of coach in the middle of the season was the most visible symptom of the chaos. The handover did not bring clarity or momentum: the new coach inherited an emotionally worn out and tactically disordered team. The ideas took time to come together, and when they did, it was too late. The transition was poorly managed, without effective planning or communication.

Madrid, who always boasted of stability in the big cycles, experienced a season of improvisations.

Club management in question

A few hours ago Florentino Pérez gave a press conference and announced that he will not resign. On the other hand, he has called for elections and will submit his position, after 26 years at the head of the white entity, as not a few consider that it is time for a change of command.

Two more elements 

Madrid experienced a season without a compass and this could be seen in the lack of a coherent project, one that connects the academy, market, style of play and institutional leadership. 

On the other hand, we could see a team with a great emotional exhaustion: the squad transmitted fatigue, disconnection and lack of conviction. Similarly, there were many injuries within the team showing a problem in the physical preparation of the players.

A final comment 

Real Madrid's disaster was not a dramatic collapse, but a silent decay: a soulless team, a divided dressing room, an unstable bench and a board trapped in its own labyrinth. There was no tragedy, but there was a slow loss of greatness. And sometimes, that kind of fall is the hardest to reverse.

Note: I used the DeepL Translate translator.

Born in Sialkot, Pakistan, Sikandar Raza later moved to Zimbabwe and established himself as one of the finest cricketers produced by the nation. His rise in international cricket has been inspiring, and his performances in franchise leagues around the world earned him a chance in the IPL. Punjab Kings picked him during the IPL 2023 auction, and he immediately added balance to the squad with both bat and ball.
