That knock also made him the first Zimbabwe player to score a half-century in IPL history. 

Apart from batting, Raza also contributed with the ball through his off-spin bowling. He picked up important wickets during the 2023 season and provided captaincy options in the middle overs. His ability to handle pressure situations made him a valuable player for Punjab Kings. According to IPL statistics, Raza has played nine matches in the tournament and scored 182 runs while also taking three wickets. 

One of the biggest strengths of Sikandar Raza is his versatility. He can bat in different positions, rotate strike during difficult phases, and accelerate when required. His calm attitude and vast experience in international cricket help him perform under pressure. Over the years, he has represented several franchise teams across global T20 leagues, including teams in Pakistan, Bangladesh, UAE, and the Caribbean. 

Raza’s cricket journey is also inspirational because he balanced education and sports during his early years. Before becoming a professional cricketer, he studied software engineering in Scotland. Later, he chose cricket as a full-time career and became one of Zimbabwe’s biggest cricket icons. Fans on Reddit and cricket communities often praise his dedication, consistency, and fighting spirit for Zimbabwe cricket. 

In recent years, Sikandar Raza has continued to achieve major milestones in international cricket. He became the number one ODI all-rounder in ICC rankings and also broke several T20 records through his match-winning performances for Zimbabwe. His consistency across formats proves why he remains one of the most respected all-rounders in modern cricket. 

Even though his IPL career is still short, Sikandar Raza has already left a strong impression with Punjab Kings. body.body: />Hello Everyone! Hope you all are doing amazing and welcome to another #Splinterlands post. Today was actually a pretty fun day in #Splinterlands, not gonna lie. I played a match with one of the craziest modifiers ever, **Blood Moon**.

> If you don’t know, this modifier gives **Bloodlust** to ALL units from the start. And yeah, things can get out of control very fast. Bloodlust basically means: Every time a unit gets a kill, it gains +1 to all stats (attack, speed, armor, health). 𝐄𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐁𝐚𝐭𝐭𝐥𝐞 ==================================== When I saw the ruleset, I instantly knew this was going to be either: A very quick battle. OR Absolute madness with one unit becoming unstoppable. There is no in-between with Blood Moon. I tried to build a balanced team, but honestly in this modifier, strategy becomes a bit different. You don’t just think about defense, you think about, “Which unit can snowball the hardest?” Because once a unit gets 1–2 kills, it starts becoming a monster.

> At the start, both teams looked kinda normal. Nothing too crazy yet. But then, first kill happened. And that’s when everything changed. One of my units got the first kill and immediately I saw the stat boost. It was small at first, but I knew this is just the beginning. The scary thing is, if the enemy got that first kill instead, the whole match could’ve gone opposite direction. Blood Moon is really like that, one moment decides everything.

> Around round 2, my 2nd unit started going completely insane after getting 2 kills. The opponent just couldn’t stop it. Every time it attacked, it was basically another stat boost waiting to happen. This is the real power of Blood Moon. Once a unit gets rolling, it’s over. My unit went from, “okay decent card” to “main character energy” real quick. It started cleaning the enemy team one by one. And the funny part is, the more it killed, the stronger it became, making next kills even easier. It was like watching a boss fight, but I was the boss. In the end, I won the match pretty comfortably.No crazy comeback needed, no last second luck, just pure domination after that snowball started. Honestly, matches like these feel super satisfying. Especially when your unit just carries the whole game.

> 𝐆𝐮𝐢𝐥𝐝 𝐁𝐫𝐚𝐰𝐥𝐬 𝐔𝐩𝐝𝐚𝐭𝐞 ==================================== Apart from ranked matches, I also played Guild Brawls today. Brawls always feel different compared to normal matches. There’s more pressure because, You’re not just playing for yourself, You’re playing for your guild. And that makes every decision more serious. I didn’t have anything super crazy happen in brawls today, but I played decent matches and tried my best to contribute. Hopefully my performance helps the guild overall.

></center>

𝐂𝐨𝐧𝐜𝐥𝐮𝐬𝐢𝐨𝐧
====================

Today was one of those days where the game actually felt really fun. The Blood Moon match was definitely the highlight. Watching one of my units go crazy with stats was just satisfying. And even though brawls weren’t anything special today, it still felt good to participate and stay active.

Anyway, that was my grind today. Please do give your reviews in the comments section below. I would really appreciate it :)

I'll be back with another one soon. So do follow me if you want to stay updated. Till then, Stay Happy and Stay Hydrated.

body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![tieXav8zdoRRaqtp_IMG_20260513_074142.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/angelina6688/images/tieXav8zdoRRaqtp_IMG_20260513_074142/tieXav8zdoRRaqtp_IMG_20260513_074142.webp)
![fbsrXVT7H0HQWKaQ_IMG_20260513_074139.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/angelina6688/images/fbsrXVT7H0HQWKaQ_IMG_20260513_074139/fbsrXVT7H0HQWKaQ_IMG_20260513_074139.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

最近不是夏天了吗？然后蚊子又跑出来了。我们那个大房，我和老公的主卧就没有弄蚊帐，从来都没弄蚊帐。有时候有蚊子就用灭蚊液熏一下，然后基本上就是把大门关好，把纱窗也拉好。
 
基本上夏天还好，偶尔一两只蚊子被我们手动拍死消灭了。再加上武汉的夏天，每天只要人在室内都会开空调，空调一开温度一低，蚊子更是躲得不见了。所以我们这边就是有蚊子，但是也还好，不多。
 
娃他那边的次卧小房，蚊子就稍微会有点多，也不知道为什么。感觉是小朋友新陈代谢更厉害，体温更高，所以特别吸引蚊子。我和老公一起出去走，夏天的时候蚊子就只叮我。
 
但是我要是和我儿子一起出去的话，蚊子就会叮他比较厉害。所以他那个房间每到夏天的时候都会搞一个像帐篷一样的蚊帐。他每天自己睡觉的时候会先把蚊帐里看一看，把蚊子赶一赶，没蚊子了才会关灯睡觉。
 
结果昨天晚上被咬醒了，跑出来跟我说蚊帐里面有蚊子，他说明明记得睡觉之前把蚊子都赶走了，为什么还有？结果后来又开灯，我们俩一起找，就是发现有一只很小的蚊子，然后肚子鼓鼓的全是吸的我们家娃的血。结果发现蚊帐好像有顶上一个角落破了一个小洞，很小的洞，然后那个蚊子又比较小，所以就从那个洞里钻进来了，应该就是这个原因把娃给咬了。
 
哎，我们家其实也楼层并不低，10楼左右，为什么还会有蚊子呢？是不是住到20多层30多层蚊子就会少一点？按我的印象就是一般低楼层一二三层楼蚊子会多一些，不知道是不是像那种超高层建筑四十多层、五十多层楼就没有蚊子了？

經過三月一堆亂七八糟的事後，終於在五月迎來我的新手機，基於上次預購手機遇到的鏡頭問題，這次拿到新手機之後最先試用的自然是相機功能，不管是前鏡頭還是後鏡頭全給他努力試試，每天都要拍上個幾張照片才安心。

這次換的新手機是上一代的，考慮了一整個月，對之前預購的那支新一代手機頗有疑慮，雖然我很喜歡新一代的防窺功能和ESIM，但若是因為用了防窺螢幕而讓我的手機可視度變差那我寧可不要，至於ESIM，雖然我很渴望，但也只能捨棄了，而目前買的前一代手機不僅相機拍照效果很好，上一代的UI使用者介面也下放到我這一代，真的是非常完美的承接。

本來呢，家人頗反對我買上一代手機，因為才差不到台幣五六千元，買新的自然是比較好的選擇，但當我拿到手上這支新手機後我就沒疑慮了，因為螢幕方面真的讓我看著舒服很多，用起來也十分順手，更何況承接著新一代的AI功能，該有的都有，讓我玩的不亦樂乎。

我把之前喝的草莓奶昔請手機AI幫我加了很多草莓，看起來是不是太可口了?還有我隨手拍了一張桌上的小貓，用手機筆在照片上畫了個房子，AI就自動幫我放上和小貓布料相同的房子在他的頭頂上了，是不是很好玩?

body.title: A Night Above the Clouds at Mt. Lanaya
body.body:
![1000004340.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/arikamillan/2458LCkBG557868b6AvCo3rYDcCgvvJMJbWhQuE77MerEGhrJaZxWt9A8FrGcCaTZV8g2.jpg)

People always seem like little ants in the mountains. Perhaps it's the silence, the endless skies or the fact that nature existed before our concerns. It is whatever it is, but it's the feeling I had when we took that very memorable trip to Mt. Lanaya.

It all began with a mere plan that soon became one of the best experiences we had ever shared!

One night, as everyone was just tired from all the busy activities, and all the responsibilities they had, someone said, “What if mag camping ta this weekend?” To begin, the thought seemed impossible. We all had a lot of sleeping in our homes to do and not much to do. The concept somehow remained in our brains though.

We were in Cebu South Bus Terminal a couple of days later, before dawn, with large bags, tents and plenty of snacks to serve an entire barangay. There was already a lot of activity at the terminal: vendors yelling out, cars arriving in succession, sleepy passengers looking for coffee. We were very excited and couldn't sleep at the early hour.

The trip to Alegia was longer than one expected going south, but no one complained. Most of the journey was spent in laughter, music, and picking out things out of the window. The city gradually faded behind us, and it got lighter. With every kilometer, the air fresher, the buildings taller were rice fields and the highways were coastal roads.

After spending hours on the road, we finally reached Alegria.

The town was welcoming and the peace of the village was what you needed to relax your mind. There we'd book habal-habal riders that would get us up close and personal with the starting point of Mt. Lanaya. Just that one ride was an adventure already.

![1000004360.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/arikamillan/23zv8nqiiudEzMw1VgF1RfLUc7fjsSSwQRYBg3bz6oeHJwzgemiUmmrUM7fQM3FC4zrg3.png)

The motorcycles made their way through bumpy terrain, surrounded by greenery, cliffs, and stunning mountain views. The wind blew in our faces, and the road got steep at times making us laugh, but we held on tightly to our bags. Each turn was another stunning view of the southern shores of Cebu. There was a mountain above us and an ocean below us.

We finally arrived at the jump-off point, and I realized.

But we still had to hike.

Initially, they appeared all assured. We got our backpacks adjusted, stretched like a pro, and took too many “before hike” pictures. However, after several minutes of walking up the hill, the truth emerged, we were already exhausted.

Mt. Lanaya wasn't an easy hike, but it was a challenge! In some spots it was very steep, in others it was very rocky, and every couple minutes somebody would have to catch their breath and pretend to be “admiring the view.” Though it was a challenge, we didn't gripe too much, considering the beautiful scenery we saw all around us.

As we ascended higher and higher, everything became more beautiful.

The grass was swaying in the wind, birds could be heard in the distance, and the mountains were in the background. We would sometimes stop to gaze down on the ocean and the horizon line, and the little houses on the hills of Alegria and the narrow, tiny roads from our perspective.

The world seemed to grow quieter with every step that we took up.

Hiking is a great way to travel with friends. Different sides of people can be seen in such times. Everyone gets to the point of extreme fatigue where the loudest person in the group goes quiet. The quiet friend suddenly becomes the motivator for all. When one person runs out of water, someone else will have some to share. Even when the peak is still a long way away, someone will say “konti nalang”.

Those little things somehow draw people together.

It took a very long time, but we did eventually arrive at the campsite at the top.

As soon as we reached there, we felt like we no longer had any fatigue.



The mountain loomed high above the clouds, and the coast stretched out in the distance. There was cold and strong wind, and the scent of the mountains was still fresh in it, like it's not in the city at all. Our bags went onto the ground and we stood there quietly, in awe of what we saw before us.



The afternoon was slowly coming to a close and the sky was starting to turn red for sunset. The mountains were all golden, and warmly glowing. It grew even colder but no one cared. We shared a seat at the outskirts of the camp watching the sky turn orange, pink and purple.

I had never seen such a beautiful sunset at Mt. Lanaya.


![1000004345.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/arikamillan/23yJCTG54s5aeAaH46SZzzSd6nsjLbNqTPbqYQTZ7ZhuTodpuvGEsvXZDTQAVzJWCCPuz.png)




The camp site changed again as darkness slowly set in.

The lights of little towns began to show up, one by one, like little stars on the ground. The real stars started to appear above, The night was clearer and brighter away from the city lights. It was a night out in the sky like you wouldn't want to scroll through your phone because it seemed more beautiful than reality.

We erected our tents and started feasting, and huddled together as the mountain colds swept around us. Music drifted softly and others recounted stories and random jokes that somehow proved more hilarious in the middle of nowhere.

There’s a different kind of peace that exists in mountains at night.

No traffic.
No notifications.
No pressure to hurry.

Just cold air, quiet skies and people who make simple moments unforgettable.


![1000004344.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/arikamillan/EoTbxadWERCnuHRA8CJ6s7EbAXTEb1rU15vrk315A35cTwRyQuiQvLoLrEsgp5fNcq3.png)


The trouble I had in my life prior to the trip seemed insignificant.

Perhaps it is this, and perhaps more, that makes people continue to indulge in adventures such as this, for not only do they see the view but they also see the escape from the noise of everyday life.

The next morning we woke up very cold yet pleased.

The sun gradually emerged from behind the mountains, filling the sky with gentle hues. We were in our tents with our jackets on, sipping instant coffee as the world woke up down there.

No one wanted to go away.

But, after some time, it was necessary to pack up our stuff and make our way back down the mountain.

body.title: Mayonnaise Salad with Cabbage and Apples\\Mayonnaise-Salat mit Kohl und Äpfeln
body.body:
Hello,my friends!
Today we'll be cooking a salad with shredded fresh cabbage, grated fresh apples, and mayonnaise, something American-style. You can make a dressing with a 1:1 mixture of mayonnaise and sour cream, making the salad lighter. The recipe is simple, but be sure to squeeze the cabbage with your hands to release the juices; the cabbage in the salad should be soft and juicy. Let's go, it'll be delicious!


![1.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPyzgYwhvXTTTP7UEMZZ4fm5wcqNbRf6XL7hpk43bWwFj/1.jpg)


Ingredients:
● White cabbage - 1/4 head (400+ grams)
● Apples - 2 pcs
● Mayonnaise - 100 grams or more
● Lemon juice - 2 tbsp
● Sugar - 1 tbsp
● Salt - a pinch to taste
● Mustard - 1 tsp (to taste and preference)
● Greens, sesame seeds - to taste and preference

1.Shred the cabbage with a knife. The pieces can be as small as you like, but the salad tastes best when thin. Add a pinch of salt and a spoonful of sugar to the cabbage and squeeze it with your hands until the juices release. Exercise and sport are everything! Peel the apples (I used Golden apples), remove the seeds, and grate the flesh on a coarse grater. The size of the apple \

is comparable to the size of the cabbage in the salad. Add the apples to the bowl with the cabbage and gently mix the salad with a spoon. Now add lemon juice to the salad. I'm not very good with lemons; I always forget about them, and they quietly \

in the depths of the fridge. So I usually use bottled lemon or lime juice; it's very convenient.



![2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaMpQvBMwU9h8mRUyEs4iQvdxmjuLUU3gmMMQp22CyYLF/2.jpg)



2.Now add mayonnaise (or a mixture of mayonnaise and sour cream) and mustard. Taste and add more salt, sugar, and ground black pepper if needed. Let the cabbage and apple salad sit, then refrigerate for an hour.




![3.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcH6AdHPhUtTHjnc3P26UEgQ2GtzJUszkrpab3XWMGy69/3.jpg)


3.Place the mayonnaise salad with cabbage and apples in individual bowls. Garnish with sesame seeds and serve. This cabbage salad has a very interesting sweet and sour flavor. I should probably make it again. Next time, I'll use carrots instead of apples; that works too!



![4.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXRtmtA5AwL1XW41SpqdS7c5WtQHy4BrKcNSv9wQCoyaX/4.jpg)


Shall we make it?

![3-poloska-1.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYyhhAydYCgxXo6MZeZ3YC526qwyBdU2NCdMXtyoJGAXB/3-poloska-1.png)

Heute bereiten wir einen Salat mit frisch gehobeltem Kohl, geriebenen Äpfeln und Mayonnaise zu – ganz nach amerikanischer Art. Für ein leichteres Dressing können Sie Mayonnaise und saure Sahne im Verhältnis 1:1 mischen. Das Rezept ist einfach, aber drücken Sie den Kohl vorher gut mit den Händen aus, damit er schön weich und saftig wird. Los geht's, es wird köstlich!

Zutaten:
● Weißkohl – 1/4 Kopf (400 g+)
● Äpfel – 2 Stück
● Mayonnaise – 100 g oder mehr
● Zitronensaft – 2 EL
● Zucker – 1 EL
● Salz – eine Prise nach Geschmack
● Senf – 1 TL (nach Geschmack)
● Kräuter, Sesamsamen – nach Geschmack

1.Den Weißkohl mit einem Messer fein hobeln. Die Stücke können so klein sein, wie Sie möchten, aber der Salat schmeckt am besten, wenn sie fein gehobelt sind. Eine Prise Salz und einen Löffel Zucker zum Kohl geben und mit den Händen ausdrücken, bis Saft austritt. Bewegung ist wichtig! Die Äpfel schälen (ich habe Golden-Äpfel verwendet), die Kerne entfernen und das Fruchtfleisch grob raspeln. Die Apfelstücke sollten etwa so groß sein wie die Kohlstücke im Salat. Gib die Äpfel in die Schüssel mit dem Kohl und vermische den Salat vorsichtig mit einem Löffel. Gib nun Zitronensaft hinzu. Ich bin nicht so geschickt mit Zitronen; ich vergesse sie immer, und sie verkümmern dann still und leise im Kühlschrank. Deshalb verwende ich meistens Zitronen- oder Limettensaft aus der Flasche; das ist sehr praktisch.

2.Gib nun Mayonnaise (oder eine Mischung aus Mayonnaise und saurer Sahne) und Senf hinzu. Schmecke ab und füge bei Bedarf mehr Salz, Zucker und gemahlenen schwarzen Pfeffer hinzu. Lass den Kohl-Apfel-Salat kurz ziehen und stelle ihn dann für eine Stunde in den Kühlschrank.

3.Fülle den Mayonnaise-Salat mit Kohl und Äpfeln in einzelne Schüsseln. Bestreue ihn mit Sesamkörnern und serviere ihn. Dieser Kohlsalat hat einen sehr interessanten süß-sauren Geschmack. Ich sollte ihn unbedingt wieder machen. Nächstes Mal nehme ich Karotten statt Äpfel; das funktioniert auch!

Wollen wir ihn zubereiten?


![3-poloska-1.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYyhhAydYCgxXo6MZeZ3YC526qwyBdU2NCdMXtyoJGAXB/3-poloska-1.png)



![U5duDCNw2pr2jpJvE8CRni125dys5tM_1680x8400.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXaogGpoD7LJkEufiNxjF52VcPhQZJYsJet34fDwJyYUV/U5duDCNw2pr2jpJvE8CRni125dys5tM_1680x8400.png)![U5dr1BuE8ejAxctktpDvrzGctPnaMgF_1680x8400.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVmydUTmF1ECe7u87FkCoJYcxT6Xo9spqJBWGi8G3ntXH/U5dr1BuE8ejAxctktpDvrzGctPnaMgF_1680x8400.jpg)

body.title: Benefits of Using self service Car Wash Stations
body.body: Keeping your car clean is important, and many people today prefer a self service car wash station for this task. It is simple, affordable, and gives you full control. At Royal Oak Self Service Car Wash, drivers can enjoy a smooth, hassle-free car-washing experience.\n\n

/>

Full Control Over Your Wash  
One of the best things about a self service car wash is that you are in charge. You can spend more time on dirty areas, such as wheels, doors, and bumpers. Unlike automatic washes, you decide how much cleaning your car needs. This helps you get better results and keeps your car looking fresh.

Cost-Effective Cleaning  
Using a 24/7 self-serve car wash is a great way to save money. You only pay for the time you use, which makes it perfect for people who want a budget-friendly option. You don’t need to spend extra money on full-service washes when you can do it yourself and still get great results.

Convenience Anytime  
Another big advantage of using Royal Oak self service car wash is that it is open 24/7. You can wash your car early in the morning or late at night, depending on your schedule. There is no need to wait in long lines, which saves both time and effort.

Eco-Friendly Option  
Self-serve car wash stations are also better for the environment. They use controlled water systems that reduce waste. Harmful chemicals are managed properly, unlike washing your car at home, where water can flow into drains without treatment.

Learn a Valuable Skill  
Many people often ask how to wash a car at the car wash. Self-service stations make it easy to learn. Clear instructions are usually provided, and the equipment is simple to use. Once you understand the steps, you will feel more confident.  
It is also helpful to know how to use a car wash correctly. Start by rinsing your car, then apply soap, scrub gently, and rinse again. You can finish with wax for extra shine. These simple steps can keep your car in great condition for a long time.

Better Results for Everyone  
Self-service washes are not just for experts. Anyone can use them and get good results. You can take your time cleaning your car however you want. This makes the process more satisfying and effective.

Final Thoughts  
Choosing Royal Oak Self Service Car Wash for a [**self service car wash**](https://burnabycarwash.com/) is a smart decision. It gives you control, saves money, and works around your schedule. With easy steps and better results, it is a convenient choice for every car owner.

body.title: Кількість українських біженців у ЄС незначно скоротилася
body.body:
![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmY7W28tKuM13L3toCaEETp4o26tnkfYHE45xeZu6sh6H9/image)

За даними Eurostat, станом на 31 березня 2026 року загалом 4,33 мільйона осіб-негромадян ЄС, які втекли з України, мали статус тимчасового захисту в Євросоюзі. За рік їх поменшало на 68 980 (-1,6%).

Країни ЄС, які мають найбільшу кількість бенефіціарів тимчасового захисту з України: Німеччина (1 275 тис., 29,4% від загального обсягу ЄС), Польща (960 тис., 22,2%), Чехія (380 тис., 8.8%).

Разом із тим, побільшало наших біженців у Німеччині (+7 500), Іспанії (+2 600) та Румунії (+2 тис.). Найбільше зниження - в Італії (-30 тис.), Чехії (-20 тис.) та Фінляндії (-8 тис.). Причина - одночасне закінчення великої кількості дозволів.
Загалом громадяни України становлять понад 98,4% бенефіціарів тимчасового захисту в ЄС.

Як відомо, Європейська Рада продовжила українським біженцям статус тимчасового захисту до 4 березня 2027 року.

body.title: Cisaat Small Park
body.body:
Hello, how are you all my kind friends?. May God always bless you. Thank you Wednesdaywalk community by  @tattoodjay. On Tuesday, May 10,2026, in the morning I left for the Cisaat sub-district town of Sukabumi Regency, West Java. The sub-district town has a population of around 132 thousand people.


![IMG_20260512_201054.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/23vsG9bVjWsSy7RMDrkAnnbUkoN7mVNXfUN5eEytS4fjGPckWLT82gzTTX5ENCsLGbG5F.jpg)


The distance from my residence is around 5,3 kilometers, to get there I used public transportation which costs 6.000,+ IDR or around ($0,34). After arriving at the sub-district town, it is located on the side of the national road.


![IMG_20260512_201123.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/241tdRok6Sm971W4T3W6pjvW2agxirzRqUjGVHzxieBmg4X1Ar4jQ7DzyiPPLuYWe31Wg.jpg)


I got off and started a short walk around Cisaat park. In this small area, there is a sub-district office that oversees several villages. The area is divided into several smaller areas, such as a Mosque, a zakat agency building, an Adipura monument ( environment award) a few years ago. Entering the park area, it looks like there is morning exercise going on. 


![IMG_20260512_202031.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/23wWrV1Vi7V9QzDonkDQVGHQ5HcQ8CjVgv5xpeChrRErm8RGEGPo4qNHLzrETZ14W4pou.jpg)

![IMG_20260512_202204.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/EoeFtGckvrh517N6ii5wvg1YsjSqqZrb6qNmpyh41W6Ae2RYV8FvqPRvp7FV2ZaL4x9.jpg)

![IMG_20260512_201405.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/245wHbRBsfM552ztFii9cSSJJgiXHtzhdgfeSqVMzJrp3RZaJuThQSzLucs1zwq2tj6rA.jpg)


![IMG_20260512_201609.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/23rz58CxKuX4t3rSFtjKebhFQDxjWqvMgn5cyGzFzeZBCoXWLdxDRPMgaUJ2eqgiS9H5A.jpg)

![IMG_20260512_201238.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/23z7DhBhyH1LABnmrMSNoDBBRDLGLcLJSDS24mu8bCcxdRqZumVB57fqvTepdS7WnyHGC.jpg)


![IMG_20260512_201856.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/23wMWDvr7CjNqqWfd8YPHHtN3njyc8xRbq6JpZAmjD5B7L2KvKusVDaGx7Ch1Jbj2c13e.jpg)




Another point of pride for local resident is the small park located in front of the Mosque. Cisaat Small Park was built around 1994, circular in shape with a path on each side. Besides the fish monument and the blacksmith monument, rare trees are planted around the park as shade trees. 


![IMG_20260512_201935.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/EoCgeYSsTGScZP4bR7JpKEer5SZafztLgu8RkHRyGuDyCZLdryKfYcSdvFVUzWxWkry.jpg)

![IMG_20260512_201334.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/23uQk8rQbHLzYy5kZPyBzrWyssEPTbs76S1bSt56chw6E4frfTNux55bG7ZvN5sVXmcy8.jpg)


![IMG_20260512_202140.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/EoiUmiC8Vi74hfdqc36WhHY2NHWfNCLC7cXu8xJRFGsUsq6j6DQc3kym5gx5CuVxSr1.jpg)



On the middle of the circle there are two freshwater fish monuments. As a symbol that freshwater fish are wisely cultivated in the Cisaat area by local residents as a livelihood. In the circle of the park there is Also a yellow monuments with curved ends. 


![IMG_20260512_201700.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/23wqeGAsJFNqVZrhmPe7Y815oxhFbuU2r34RQPivxkjZu4ddfGPz7pFpzo7VJwVC2wVzk.jpg)


These monuments symbolize the craft of blacksmiths as a basic material for making iron crafts such as making swords, knives, agricultural tools and other crafts from forged iron. Every day the park area is cleaned and the trash is collected by dump trucks. 


![IMG_20260512_202117.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/23tmNDmAWcC6ecBz9QMywdauepeCTcGXbmWFBMiaN8Qwo6QCbRN2tB4wTBVgbcZ16hMsq.jpg)

Thank you for stopping by.
___
**The picture was taken with an Oppo brand cellphone camera**

body.title: How Interactive Trade Games Are Changing the Way People Understand Global Commerce
body.body:
Understanding international trade has always felt difficult for many people. Traditional textbooks often present long charts, economic theories, and complicated terminology that can overwhelm beginners before they even develop curiosity about the subject. Yet global commerce shapes everyday life in ways most people rarely notice. The phone in someone’s pocket may include components from South Korea, Taiwan, Germany, and the United States, while the coffee on the breakfast table could travel thousands of kilometers before reaching a local store.

The challenge has never been the importance of international commerce. The real issue has been how the topic is presented. Most educational resources focus heavily on memorization instead of exploration. As a result, students, geography enthusiasts, and even professionals often struggle to connect trade patterns with real-world understanding.

In recent years, a different approach has started gaining attention. Interactive learning platforms are turning complicated subjects into engaging experiences by combining strategy, observation, and deduction. One of the most interesting examples in this space is Tradle, a browser-based game that transforms global export data into a daily challenge that rewards curiosity and logical thinking.

[https://tradle.world/](https://tradle.world/)

Unlike standard trivia games, Tradle uses actual international export information to create puzzles that encourage players to think critically about how countries participate in the global economy. Instead of simply asking direct questions with obvious answers, the platform encourages deduction. Players examine export clues, geographic hints, and trade patterns to identify countries based on the goods they produce.

This creates a learning experience that feels far more dynamic than reading a static list of exports in a classroom environment. A player might discover that one nation is heavily connected with semiconductor production while another dominates agricultural exports like soybeans or coffee. Over time, these repeated discoveries begin building a mental map of global trade relationships.

What makes this format particularly effective is its ability to make learning feel natural rather than forced. People often remember information better when they actively participate in uncovering it. Instead of memorizing random facts, players gradually develop an intuitive understanding of how geography, resources, manufacturing capabilities, and economic specialization influence international commerce.

For students studying economics or international business, this type of interaction offers a valuable supplement to traditional academic material. Concepts that once seemed abstract suddenly become easier to visualize. Countries are no longer just names on a chart. They become connected to recognizable industries, exports, and regional strengths.

For example, after repeated gameplay sessions, players may begin noticing how certain regions dominate electronics manufacturing while others focus heavily on agriculture, mining, or energy production. These patterns help explain larger economic relationships between nations. They also reveal how interconnected the modern world has become.

Geography enthusiasts also find unique appeal in this type of experience because geographic reasoning plays a major role in solving puzzles. Even when players are unfamiliar with a specific export category, nearby countries and regional clues can help narrow down possibilities. This adds another layer of strategy that combines geographic awareness with economic understanding.

The growing popularity of educational games reflects a broader shift in how people consume information online. Attention spans are shorter than ever, and audiences increasingly prefer interactive experiences over passive reading. Platforms that combine entertainment with meaningful knowledge are becoming far more effective at keeping users engaged.

Daily challenge systems further strengthen this engagement. Returning each day to solve a new puzzle creates routine participation without overwhelming players. The short-form structure makes it easy for people to spend a few minutes learning something new during breaks, commutes, or free time. Over weeks and months, those small sessions accumulate into substantial knowledge.

Another important aspect of trade-based games is their ability to encourage curiosity beyond the platform itself. A player who discovers unfamiliar export products or surprising trade relationships may start researching those industries independently. In this way, the experience extends beyond gameplay and sparks genuine interest in international economics, geography, and world affairs.

This educational approach also appeals to people who enjoy logic games and brain teasers. Solving export puzzles requires observation, pattern recognition, elimination strategies, and analytical thinking. Each round becomes a combination of knowledge and reasoning rather than simple memorization.

Many online games prioritize speed and instant rewards, but trade deduction games offer a more thoughtful style of engagement. They encourage players to slow down, examine clues carefully, and connect information logically. This creates a satisfying sense of progress as users become more skilled at identifying countries and industries over time.

Another fascinating element is how these experiences highlight the diversity of global production. Many people assume only a few major countries dominate world trade, but export data often reveals surprising contributors in niche industries. Smaller nations may specialize in unique products that play crucial roles in international supply chains.

Learning these details can reshape how people view the global economy. It becomes easier to appreciate how interconnected trade systems support industries, technologies, and daily products worldwide. This awareness is increasingly valuable in a time when supply chain disruptions, trade agreements, and economic competition frequently appear in international headlines.

Educational gaming also creates opportunities for younger audiences who may not normally engage with economics-related topics. A student who avoids reading lengthy business articles may still become deeply interested in identifying export patterns through interactive challenges. Once interest develops, deeper learning often follows naturally.

The accessibility of browser-based platforms further contributes to their appeal. People can participate without downloading large applications or investing in expensive software. Quick access encourages casual exploration, making learning feel approachable rather than intimidating.

The combination of real-world data and game mechanics represents an important evolution in digital education. Instead of separating entertainment from learning, platforms like Tradle merge the two experiences into something more memorable. Players leave not only with completed puzzles but with a stronger understanding of how nations contribute to the global economy.

This blend of strategy, geography, and commerce demonstrates that educational experiences do not need to feel academic in the traditional sense to be effective. Interactive systems often succeed precisely because they replace passive observation with active participation.

As online learning continues evolving, experiences built around curiosity and engagement are likely to become increasingly influential. People are drawn toward platforms that challenge their thinking while still feeling enjoyable and rewarding. Trade-focused puzzle games fit naturally into this growing trend.

For anyone interested in economics, geography, global trade, or analytical problem-solving, interactive export-based games offer a refreshing alternative to traditional learning formats. They transform statistics and trade reports into experiences that are both mentally stimulating and genuinely entertaining.

Most importantly, they remind players that the global economy is not just a collection of numbers on spreadsheets. It is a living network of industries, resources, technologies, and relationships connecting countries across the world every single day.

By turning international commerce into a daily challenge built around deduction and discovery, Tradle introduces a smarter and more engaging way to explore the hidden patterns behind the products people use every day.

body.title: У Сумах готують \
body.body: зараз прикута увага багатьох музичних оглядачів. І новини про перебіг подій там легко знайти і в соцмережах, і в ЗМІ. Як і легко в мирній країні провести такого рівня конкурс.\nА от в Україні вже п'ятий рік - війна. І ми знаємо, що через безпекові ризики до нас вже не приїжджав у 2023 році заслужено здобутий \
шанс проведення Євробачення. Від імені України конкурс приймала британська арена \

в Ліверпулі.

А от українські фестивалі та конкурси продовжують своє існування, не дивлячись на війну. І це тільки лишній раз підтверджує нашу стійкість і бажання зберегти свою самовизначеність. Бо проводити у прифронтових Сумах велику подію може тільки свідомий українець. Тим більше, що з початку війни учасники не мають фінансової підтримки від держави.
Тим не менш, у Сумах 16 та 17 травня проведуть щорічний фестиваль “Ніч музеїв”. Тут відбудуться наступні речі: крафтовий та мистецький ярмарки, лавка артефактів, книжковий івент та концерт. 
Відвідувачі фестивалю зможуть побувати одразу на кількох ярмарках. Біля знаменитого фонтану \

, у переході, 30 виробників продаватимуть свої товари ручної роботи. В артДворі — митці пропонуватимуть картини, скульптури тощо. Тут же відбудуться перформанси та концерт.
В музеї “Причал Одессея” відкриється лавка копій історичних артефактів. Тут же можна відвідати виставку київської художниці Саші Луньової “Укус скаженої собаки”. А письменниця і поетка Анна Коршунова та студія “Ладунок” готують книжковий івент. Також фестиваль проводитиме майстер-клас з виготовлення старовинного оберігу. А на завершення, вечором, відбудеться концерт місцевих рок-музикантів.

![0.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/radiogaga/23wC9dZzgdQXEi5a5a7GWCJidWsUUnELSNitfpsP6QZ64x8TwcB8ngRqoJ8LNCt6cnfZ1.jpg)

body.title: Participativní rozpočet a další říčanské zajímavosti
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcoQqmGAhxuyps6nxxgV96gqi2AvcKDKUh5mfZnEgzZ7F/20241025_082404.jpg)
A pokračujeme v říčanské krasojízdě! Plním si svůj zákeřný plán, že nepřestanu psát o Říčanech, dokud si svými články zpětně nevydělám na jízdenku do Říčan a zpět, tedy 52,- Kč. Tohle je můj v pořadí ... Safra, já to zapomněl! Tak příště.

Děkuji tímto za komunitu @tazi -mu, který na můj minulý článek zavolal kurátorskou odměnu Curangela, čímž k velké radosti čtenářstva, jež na moje články omylem zabloudilo, přiblížil konec této série. Tak ještě asi dvakrát a dost ...

Ale k věci. Říčany jsou moderní obec. Vše o nich v mobilu ... Ale tahle cedule je vystavena na vlakovém nádraží. Protože nádraží je to první, s čímž se tu přijedší turista setká a podle nádraží soudí obec. A obec chce vyvolat dobrý dojem.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVEngLsZF8jboXSUTLGfqqaqz9S5Wv9SJ1hC74LLDJp65/20241025_082338.jpg)
Obec nám tu o sobě říká, že obyvatelé mohou mimo jiné participovat na jejím zkrášlování. Mohou si v anketě zvolit, který obyvatelský projekt má obec podpořit. Tohle jsou vítězné, realizované projekty za rok 2024, zveřejněné 2025.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfUSe6qDNMsedmTCxydYAFQcCge4WoMNC8gvU4n63RXod/20260420_074216.jpg)
A tohle jsou vítězné projekty za rok 2025, které se budou realizovat letos.  Jezdím do Říčan každoročně a moje cesty jsou takové časosběrné výpravy ... Mezi pořízením fotografií 2 a 3 je právě jeden rok ...
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVBMaajSzJiFumzuvKtZPg3fPq65mscm4teka71T1DNiT/20241025_082251.jpg)
Si dovolím odbočku. V Praze máme na Hlavním nádraží piano. Tak v Říčanech musejí mít v čekárně také piano ... 

Když bude synova příčná flétna budit v mém domě nevoli, budu je, syna a flétnu, vozit cvičit do říčanské čekárny ...

Jestlipak by si syn vydělal nějakou korunu jako busker ... Příklad mého rozbíhavého myšlení. Ono to není horší, čím jsem starší. Jen se ten fakt v poslední době nestydím více ventilovat.

A všimněte si fragmentu poutače nad čekárnou. \

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTy78kYFZ3dAZnnZq6hftTuTnLu2CHmwPNBsQXJjuVJZJ/20260420_101706.jpg)
Ale zpátky do Říčan. Prochází jimi Mikešova naučná stezka. Taky participační projekt vybraný v anketě. Kdo si chce o Říčanech něco přečíst, může si text zvětšit. A kvízová otázka na závěr ...
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme9UNEAjfcJBsLeUy1ovgRktub3CEJKn2TTC2jMEug4LX/20260420_101741.jpg)
Ano, prevít je WC. Teda bez toho W ... A mě napadlo, zda-li tu mají na záchodech zlaté mísy. Nemají ... Kontroloval jsem to. Ale foto stamodtud sem dávat nebudu. Stačí, že kadibudky jsou stylově obloženy prkny, ne?
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcYNGnnX9RCMtJDQ2NENcj9CcSqA1NNX1izma86vo2ox9/20260420_101654.jpg)
Tenhle prevít je u tohoto dětského hřiště. Taky participativní projekt. Nezabral jsem je celé. Na druhé polovině byly maminky s dětmi. Nechtěl jsem vysvětlovat, proč je fotím.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTidRHMJTQtUMPsFseVgbbWRcHQ8GH1U7WsPSjwsU3PkU/20260420_101903.jpg)
A za dětským hřištěm se nalézá už vybudováné parkoviště k přírodnímu zastavení další naučné stezky zvané \

, která se teprve buduje. 

Parkoviště zdarma. Městské autobusy též zdarma, včetně wi-fi. Jde o to turisty přitáhnout a udržet pro opakované návštěvy. To se vyplatí. Ne je jednorázově pumpnout turisty o pár drobných.

Na snímku též vidíte část říčanského mola na Mlýnském rybníku.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY3uFXAQNtsNP4GT4JLfvoZhxeHjbePnpY1uttPYj43gA/20260420_103510.jpg)
Další naučná stezka. Co se na ní dá vybudovat? Jéje..
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbsow8CU16Kg6eJPkCvhdTvtfhjFShFQ9euuX7HMaPgfH/20260420_103523.jpg)
Dospělí si mohou číst, děti osahávat. Vodu je lze pustit.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTofpgXHjg7dsVkCCZX5jH38Tme3diZWnJG3E2wZ4zEpb/20260420_103434.jpg)
Jsem si neodpustil, když jsem tak trochu ze mlejna ...
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf8oCK6sm9xo43rc7p2qJsi2Lfsr4M7mPQ2yk9fYLCHPQ/20260420_103558.jpg)
Samá voda, samá voda ... 
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUHhtRaqnKW9Yk741cerb2B1zD1UZQQqfarerMU5aBy1P/20260420_103659.jpg)
Nebudu zvětšovat nadpis. Jen ho přepíšu. \

+ Dílo místního umělce. Drobátko excentricky-exhibicionistický. To asi umělci musí ... Připomíná mi svou tvorbou Knížáka.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmagqdhnCp2TYv63uS6pBbEQ36y759GuBrvYKuDhUZDpau/20260420_103739.jpg)
Libo-li se posadit a dát nohám odpočinout? Přečtěte si při tom něco o literatuře provázané s Říčany ...
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWLDBHsa1ZMwaSVutFCZLa7q6jaJC9CxRuvW4UQTw6g1e/20260420_103405.jpg)
A copa je tuto? Nevím ... Je to staveniště mezi ploty. Podívám se sem zase za rok. Schválně...

Nechci strašit. Ale v hlavě mám ještě dva další články o Říčanech. A možná, že se jich narodí i víc ... Já si těch 56,- Kč vydělám!
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdDgUd1vRVhYLicTBuKXiWGJJZz2y9fbEFJ7tkS9kiaTG/image.png)
Čestně prohlašuji, že všechny publikované fotografie jsem pořídil já a při tvorbě jsem nikterak nevyužil umělou inteligenci. A při psaní jsem se bavil. Je otázka, jestli královsky nebo krávovsky ... Jaký z toho máš dojem Ty, laskavý čtenáři?

body.title: MCGI Topic Review | Is Your Partner meant for you?
body.body:
If the partner we want truly loves us for who we are or for our money or anything. When dealing with relationship have to consider the emotional aspects because this is a very important aspect of everything.

As a Christian you must be conscious of what you may choose because they can lead us to God or away from God. To begin the bible tells us that relationship must always draw us closer to God.

*Corinthians 6:14*, it says as follows but ye not in equally yoked with non-believers. This starts as a reminder that plays a very important role when it comes to that
selection. There comes a numerous.

body.title: Letras Bonitas para Transformar Textos en Estilos Creativos y Modernos
body.body:
La forma de escribir en internet ha cambiado muchisimo durante los ultimos años. Antes, la mayoria de publicaciones utilizaban texto simple y sin detalles visuales especiales. Ahora, millones de usuarios buscan maneras originales de destacar en redes sociales, perfiles gamer, canales de streaming y proyectos digitales mediante estilos de escritura mas llamativos y creativos.

Las [letras bonitas](https://letrasbonitases.org/) se han convertido en una de las opciones favoritas para personalizar nombres, mensajes y publicaciones online. Gracias a la tecnologia Unicode, actualmente es posible transformar texto normal en cientos de diseños visuales compatibles con casi cualquier plataforma digital sin necesidad de instalar programas complicados ni descargar fuentes externas.

Este tipo de herramienta ha ganado popularidad porque combina rapidez, facilidad y muchisimas posibilidades creativas en un solo lugar.

Una forma diferente de escribir en plataformas digitales

El contenido visual tiene cada vez mas importancia en internet. Una publicacion atractiva suele captar mas atencion que un texto simple. Lo mismo ocurre con nombres de usuario, biografias y comentarios destacados.

Las letras decorativas permiten modificar completamente la apariencia de las palabras usando simbolos especiales compatibles con dispositivos modernos. En lugar de cambiar una fuente tradicional del sistema, estas herramientas convierten cada caracter en versiones Unicode alternativas que mantienen su diseño despues de copiar y pegar.

Eso significa que un usuario puede crear textos elegantes, modernos o artisticos y utilizarlos directamente en aplicaciones populares sin perder compatibilidad.

Miles de combinaciones visuales disponibles

Uno de los mayores atractivos de las letras bonitas es la enorme variedad de estilos disponibles. Cada diseño ofrece una apariencia distinta que puede adaptarse perfectamente al tipo de contenido o personalidad del usuario.

Entre los estilos mas utilizados destacan:

Letras cursivas elegantes  
Diseños goticos  
Texto con bordes decorativos  
Letras dobles  
Estilos minimalistas  
Simbolos artisticos  
Diseños futuristas  
Texto sombreado  
Letras invertidas  
Combinaciones con emojis

La gran cantidad de opciones hace posible experimentar constantemente con nuevos formatos visuales sin repetir siempre el mismo estilo.

Perfectas para redes sociales modernas

Las redes sociales actuales funcionan como espacios donde la creatividad visual tiene muchisimo valor. Un perfil llamativo puede generar mas visitas, interacciones y reconocimiento rapidamente.

Por esa razon, muchas personas utilizan letras especiales para mejorar diferentes elementos de sus perfiles digitales:

Biografias  
Nombres personalizados  
Titulos de publicaciones  
Historias destacadas  
Comentarios originales  
Frases decorativas  
Descripciones de videos  
Mensajes especiales

Un pequeño detalle visual puede hacer que un perfil se vea mucho mas profesional, creativo o divertido dependiendo del estilo utilizado.

Facilidad para copiar y pegar

Otra razon importante detras de la popularidad de estas herramientas es su sencillez. No hace falta tener experiencia tecnica para crear textos decorativos atractivos.

El procedimiento normalmente funciona de manera muy simple:

Se escribe una palabra o frase normal.  
El sistema genera automaticamente diferentes estilos.  
El usuario elige el diseño que mas le gusta.  
El texto se copia rapidamente.  
Finalmente se pega en cualquier plataforma digital.

Todo el proceso puede completarse en apenas unos segundos y permite probar muchisimas variaciones distintas facilmente.

Compatibilidad con aplicaciones populares

Muchas personas se preocupan por saber si las letras decorativas funcionan correctamente en distintas aplicaciones. Afortunadamente, la mayoria de plataformas modernas reconocen caracteres Unicode sin problemas importantes.

Estas letras suelen funcionar muy bien en:

Instagram  
TikTok  
Facebook  
Discord  
WhatsApp  
Telegram  
Twitch  
YouTube  
Roblox  
Free Fire

Gracias a esta compatibilidad, los usuarios pueden mantener el mismo estilo visual en diferentes redes y plataformas digitales.

Muy populares entre gamers y streamers

El mundo gamer ha contribuido enormemente al crecimiento de los textos decorativos. Los jugadores suelen buscar nombres originales para destacar dentro de partidas online y comunidades competitivas.

Muchos apodos gamer utilizan simbolos especiales, letras goticas o diseños futuristas para verse mas unicos y memorables. Lo mismo sucede con los streamers, quienes frecuentemente decoran nombres de canales, banners y perfiles utilizando estilos llamativos.

Las [letras bonitas](https://letrasbonitases.org/) ayudan a construir identidad visual dentro de comunidades digitales donde millones de usuarios intentan diferenciarse constantemente.

Utilidad en proyectos creativos

Aunque la mayoria relaciona estas herramientas con redes sociales, las letras decorativas tambien pueden utilizarse en muchisimos otros proyectos digitales.

Por ejemplo:

Invitaciones online  
Diseños para blogs  
Publicaciones promocionales  
Frases decorativas  
Presentaciones digitales  
Tarjetas virtuales  
Mensajes personalizados  
Firmas artisticas

El enorme catalogo de estilos permite encontrar opciones adecuadas tanto para contenido informal como para proyectos mas elegantes y profesionales.

Personalizacion sin limites

Uno de los aspectos mas interesantes de las letras bonitas es la libertad creativa que ofrecen. Cada usuario puede experimentar con distintos estilos hasta encontrar el diseño que mejor represente su personalidad o contenido.

Algunas personas prefieren estilos elegantes y limpios, mientras que otras eligen formatos intensos y llenos de simbolos decorativos. Esta flexibilidad hace que las posibilidades practicamente nunca se agoten.

Ademas, constantemente aparecen nuevas tendencias visuales en internet, lo que mantiene este tipo de herramientas siempre actualizadas y populares.

La importancia de destacar visualmente

Internet es un espacio lleno de informacion donde captar atencion rapidamente resulta cada vez mas complicado. Los usuarios suelen desplazarse entre cientos de publicaciones en pocos minutos.

Por eso, los detalles visuales juegan un papel importante. Un titulo atractivo o un nombre decorativo pueden generar curiosidad inmediatamente y hacer que una persona dedique mas tiempo a observar un perfil o contenido.

Las letras bonitas funcionan precisamente como un recurso visual rapido y sencillo para destacar entre millones de textos comunes.

Conclusion

Las [letras bonitas](https://letrasbonitases.org/) han transformado la manera en que las personas personalizan sus textos en internet. Gracias al uso de caracteres Unicode, ahora es posible crear estilos creativos compatibles con casi cualquier plataforma digital de forma sencilla y rapida.

La enorme variedad de diseños disponibles permite que cada usuario encuentre estilos adecuados para redes sociales, videojuegos, proyectos artisticos o contenido digital personalizado.

body.title: A Day at Kaamulan Park
body.body: >Nature's Quiet Corner in Malaybalay City\n

>If you are looking for a place where you can breathe fresh air, hear the sound of leaves rustling in the wind, and just forget about the noise of everyday life — Kaamulan Park in Malaybalay City, Bukidnon is the place to be. I visited the park on a bright and sunny day, and honestly, I did not expect it to be this beautiful. From the moment I stepped inside, I could already feel the difference. The air was cooler, the surroundings were green, and everything felt calm and peaceful.
![2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/23x196MCin4gKjWCyYmK9ixbuygcVkM7iy86nwxWCQTXH9U5WzSgZaLWbVMg9FQ8PXAWp.png)
_____________
![1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/23zGYXDtqL68xD2KrJZWvXoQZ17RTiCZwomquXQt1xRcmQP6XWUhr7FFgQ3HxKrdhVo1S.png)
___________________________
>A Wide Open Space That Welcomes You\n\n

>The first thing you will notice when you arrive is the wide concrete area that stretches out in front of you. It is a big open ground surrounded by tall trees that cast long shadows across the pavement. Even in the middle of the day when the sun is at its strongest, the shade from the trees keeps the area comfortable. There is something relaxing about walking through a space like this. No buildings blocking the view. No heavy traffic. Just open sky above you and green trees all around. I stood there for a moment and just took it all in. The park also has a small roundabout area near the entrance with a nicely arranged garden. Trimmed shrubs, colorful plants, and a flagpole stand at the center. It gives the park a clean and organized look that makes you feel like you are entering somewhere that is well taken care of. ______________________________________________________________________________
![3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/23xVChhuwP4KD6uF3RC8DaeijS9nihy1ptESvrQkNRpH3jsYLRvAyrNkRsJcgmE94Ucak.png)
_______________________________________________________________________________________
![4.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/245w4vkzcywfbDVGnuCLGvSCfzb6hPfCgE9FxTbFpxn9huDRfAmd5ByqgRMnHzAmS1VBt.png)
_________________________________________________________________
![5.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/23zGRbo9ZQLcRUuUsq4QLfe6MJJbCNThNfPoDVW249stpyLUsa1WiGphvDAz7SVhw5Cvd.png)
_______________________________________________________________
>The Trees Are the Real Stars Here\n\n

>I am not exaggerating when I say the trees in Kaamulan Park are something else. Tall, proud pine trees rise up toward the sky like they have been standing there for decades — and they probably have. When you look up at them, they seem to go on forever. I took some photos looking straight up through the pine trees and the blue sky above. There is a certain kind of beauty in that angle. The thin branches spread out like a canopy, and between them, you catch glimpses of bright blue sky. One shot even caught the sun peeking through the treetops, creating a beautiful lens flare that made the photo look like something from a nature magazine. Aside from the tall pines, there are also bamboo groves, leafy tropical trees, and flowering trees scattered around the park. One of the most eye-catching is a tree with soft pink flowers blooming at the top. It stood out against the green forest behind it like a little burst of color that nature placed there just for the view. I think it might be a Yakal or possibly a Pink Trumpet Tree, but whatever it is, it was beautiful.
![6.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/244xMchUB7TVFuA2J6vDyptuVxHBvrnKejcvLaDUayxuWWigDkfhZFr9SBTMHuNj5yFue.png)
![7.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/241szvmJQ4RWwsRtpepBUYqBEF5dzPqpxCTeFYahCi4uPXzUUPTN7rkCEqSLgLyemMNz4.png)
![8.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/23yHgm2BBcRtDR9bEhcS758KChfDKPdBNiGoUfw2PC8gx2BCZrZUkexBcTqDsZAep8Wub.png)
![9.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/23zG6ZttRiBwLxX7kMMhqR4PD78EisJ69a55NukrcbUhr4GTKt4JqkH7oZxjk3pWefkPA.png)
![10.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/23qqnP884BrXihyms44PeTZDNWMNHdrMb6ugaqR9rd3GwaijrWj9L1GQNhrKL9vELQmqj.png)
>Why Kaamulan Park is Worth Visiting\n\n

>Malaybalay City is known as the highland city of Bukidnon, and Kaamulan Park fits that identity perfectly. The cool mountain air, the tall pine trees, and the wide green spaces all remind you that you are in a part of the Philippines that is a little different from the busy lowland cities. The park is not a commercialized tourist spot. There are no souvenir shops or ticket booths. It is simply a public park where people can come and enjoy nature for free. That in itself is something worth appreciating. Whether you are a local who wants a quiet place to relax, or a traveler passing through Bukidnon looking for something to see, Kaamulan Park is a stop you should not skip. Bring a mat, pack some snacks, sit under the pine trees, and just enjoy the moment. Nature does not always need to be dramatic to be beautiful. Sometimes, a wide open sky, a row of tall pines, and a gentle breeze is more than enough.

>All photos taken at Kaamulan Park, Malaybalay City, Bukidnon, Philippines.
![mobile_CANVA.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/EpzzcqxHbNbvKRWPcZiE8vbUscWmHZHdMWD3LkKPKnk6jWnLiu5B5mAJV6KtfxKpbfh.png)

body.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1777960485401-adb864965f3ca7da.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=sagarkothari88/fcd1b825)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=sagarkothari88/fcd1b825)


---

## hSnaps App

### Image Lightbox Fix: Reliable Fallback Handling

- fix(lightbox): fallback to raw URL when hive proxy fails on full-size images.
- Implemented fallback chain:
  - Proxied URL → Raw URL → Error placeholder  


- Ensures consistency with ImageThumbnail behavior.
- Displays “Image unavailable” placeholder:
  - Prevents empty modal when both sources fail.  


- Fixed React hooks issue:
  - Resolved rules-of-hooks violation caused by `useEffect` being called after early return.  


- Root issue addressed:
  - images.hive.blog/0x0/ returning 4xx errors for files hosted on files.peakd.com  


- Result:
  - Image previews now load reliably when opened from feed. 
 

Image Lightbox Fix
![Image Lightbox Fix](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sagarkothari88/23tGXhWywrHaTT3q6aPb1rGuynnMpPWVi9pKYBKzSgXziCwkd3qeXXV7Gh4yDyHunh4sM.png)

Video Lightbox Fix
![Video Lightbox Fix](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sagarkothari88/23xVCuhGbJ5wAJsrSz6g9JPPRqwLsX2drUntC5EBGzv9p1DzTimMNHKsN2vti4V9sjpGr.png)


---

## HiveReactKit

### Profile Enhancement: Growth Analytics Tab

- feat(profile): add Growth analytics tab with rendering and tab fixes.
- Introduced Growth Analytics tab:
  - HP trends  
  - Rewards breakdown  
  - Key performance indicators  
  - Charts (7-day / 30-day views)  


- Implemented `getGrowthAnalytics`:
  - Backward paging  
  - Streaming updates  
  - Accurate HP reconstruction  


- Fixed UI issues:
  - Default tab flicker  
  - Invalid tab restoration logic  


- Performance improvements:
  - 200-page cap on analytics fetch  
  - Reduced delay for faster loading  


- Exported:
  - Growth components  
  - Types for reuse in external applications  


Growth Analytics Dashboard  
![Growth Analytics Dashboard](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sagarkothari88/Eo6BfaTw8XxDRxzf8hstqcqmVkjrZENDN9UbZKgTYNhupaTgdrqLt2WHQ8KZMazZYg4.png)

HP Trends Chart (7d/30d)
![HP Trends Chart (7d/30d)](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sagarkothari88/23u5RA9A839DVgRR6sQmRkaVqSt7RPMBwDRhfnqQUjJXWBAUJC5zCABwZdxQyGxjW6NQa.png)


---

### Poll System Enhancement: Inline Voting with Unified Flow

- feat(polls): inline poll voting with unified submit flow.
- Added reusable `PollListItem` component:
  - Inline poll voting UI  


- Introduced `onVotePoll` callback:
  - Supports cancel via `false`  


- Simplified poll rendering:
  - Removed ~100 lines of legacy code  


- Unified voting experience:
  - Single-choice → Radio buttons + Submit  
  - Multi-choice → Checkboxes + Submit  
  - Vote change uses same flow  


- UX improvements:
  - Previous votes remain visible  
  - Submit button disabled when:
    - Invalid selection  
    - Loading state  


- Exported:
  - PollListItem component  
  - Related types for reuse  


- Documentation and demo updated accordingly.


Inline Poll Voting UI 
![Inline Poll Voting UI ](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sagarkothari88/23uQCC2D7UxSAAfRV2CSysZyzV6qdnhjLCqkRsg4Um9tQ63yJDMayMfKRFkPd45cdhFQk.png)

 


---


## Powering the Hive Ecosystem

- Continuously improving Hive applications with a focus on stability, performance, and scalability  
- Contributing to open-source development and building reusable solutions for the community  
- Working towards a stronger, more accessible, and feature-rich Hive ecosystem

body.title: A normal day building dreams/eng-spn
body.body:
A typical workday 🥴 I'm a physical education teacher, and besides being a teacher, I'm also the architect of my own life. I'm building a better future for myself every day. I live in a country where things don't always go as planned.

But despite the challenges, I go out every day ready to give my best, whether it's in the gym or on the field with my students.

These photos you see here are of the places where I spend most of my time: the gym with my students and meetings with my colleagues at the school where I work.

![11543782.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katriel1/23tmFdxwFjBksGhuy4RWsoJemrAf78hVeGVopHQSLbgtSukANnRNQtZr4N69bu7xQZ7mS.jpg)

This is my life, my work, my home, my hope. I am the architect of my own life. With two jobs a day, one in the morning and one in the afternoon, I try to provide for my family.

![111557432.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katriel1/23xp4FLpskG4ABJcx5F7pizNAQfC9dgUzjvaBuDpk6WAaFLL7TG9RfCBH2WMv2QRQdKM3.jpg)

I give it my all, building my future little by little but with firm steps. I have two beautiful children and a wonderful mother.

![1008130459.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katriel1/23rBC1uA6X3ztJGypkZFWuK9Kvk2yicfsy5XZb2MBUHTgMhTmJE1tJV5gpU7XG4z2ABeJ.jpg)

I am a woman, a mother, a daughter, and the architect of my own life. That's my day-to-day life, @captainquack22. It's a pleasure and an honor to share a little bit of myself with you.

![1080380776.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katriel1/23z7DSD3xH85nuzzE4vWuHN64NNojZtYLRJjiDjr7ziLNFrKZ3uN9xoMuAn3NKNy6ENas.jpg)

*Sources*
**Images from my gallery. I used Google Translate (my language is Spanish).**


### Spanish 

Un día normal de trabajo🥴 Soy Docente de Educación física y además de docente soy ingeniero de mi propia vida. Estoy construyendo cada día un futuro mejor para mí vida. Vivo en un país donde cada día las cosas no resultan como las queremos.

Pero a pesar de las adversidades cada día salgo dispuesta a dar lo mejor de mi; bien sea en gimnasio o en la cancha con mis estudiantes.

Estás fotos que ven aquí son los lugares donde paso la mayor parte de mi tiempo. El gimnasio con mis estudiantes y reunidos con mis colegas de institución educativa dónde trabajo.

![11543782.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katriel1/23tmFdxwFjBksGhuy4RWsoJemrAf78hVeGVopHQSLbgtSukANnRNQtZr4N69bu7xQZ7mS.jpg)

Está es mi vida, mi trabajo mi hogar mi esperanza. Soy ingeniera de mi propia vida. Con dos trabajos diarios, uno en la mañana y otro en la tarde trato de llevar el sustento a mi hogar.

Freewriting is a great way to start or maintain a writing habit. And we've been making it easy for you with a daily prompt for over 3000 days!

And, as an added bonus, we are continuing to award **three freewriters a Hive SBI share every single day**!
<center>![giveaway.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daily.prompt/AJoLtsVsugdVrTuJ5x7bFSQywMHn9X8XiTcDB748kRJdDaiJHvbSAZ6bAHMVj3j.gif)</center>

Every day **three** of the best daily freewrites will be awarded **one** HiveSBI share. 
<sub>Not sure what Hive SBI is? [Find out more here](https://docs.hivesbi.com/)</sub>

What are you waiting for?



# <center>Today's #DailyPrompt is</center>

# <center>scatter the seed</center>

How to freewrite...

- Set your timer for 5 minutes
- Start writing
- Use the hashtag #freewrite #dailyprompt
- Publish your piece (include a link to this post if you wish)
- Copy and paste your URL into the comment section of **this post**.
<sup>Or, if you don't want to publish your freewrite, just copy and paste as a comment under the prompt post.</sup>
- What if you want to write for longer than five minutes? No problem! There are no rules... 

except...

body.body:
>


![portada.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/23vhyMWvvpZhDoXvhLN8rseUu3rQo852DuoVQ38mU9w6oQ8seT6uA5PxbTZ3XkZjcFm4v.webp)

Hello, everyone. Today I’d like to share with you some purchases I made on HiveNFTs, a website that’s been really helpful for my shopping.

Before making the purchases, I obviously had to check Hive-Engine to see what I had. Well, I noticed I had a bunch of tokens I wasn’t using, so I sold them.

>># Español
>>Saludos amigos. Hoy me gustaría compartir con ustedes unas compras que hice en la página HiveNFTs, una página que me ayuda bastante a hacer mis compras. 
>>
>>Antes de las compras evidentemente tuve que ir a Hive-Engine a ver con qué contaba. Pues bien, noté que tenía un montón de tokens que no estaba usando y los vendí.

![Captura de pantalla 2026-05-12 175517.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/23t78uMCGsoJdKdiVGbFymAQTgYCKMZvU5ZcjuvwEhHNoNjSfRef79XmdQBHN8qHRTSjS.png)

![Captura de pantalla 2026-05-12 175450.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/23tbMB5pZztUK5owDguaajxAoLq9rFmB6S1SyK8SADBLHBi9jYgP1vNWWAztBbT6ywGaL.png)

![Captura de pantalla 2026-05-12 175657.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/23tRxswaWcAD6itnGwjsoj5j4T5bDrras2Cn3fcf5jaty99ttmGVUgEnKPVB55nnLD7zu.png)

I sold some POB, a few WAIV, some PIMP, and a few other tokens. I had just under 1 HIVE, so after selling the rest of the tokens, I ended up with 2 SWAP.HIVE. That was enough to buy a few cards that were for sale.

>>Vendí algunos POB, unos WAIV, otros PIMP y unos cuantos tokens más. Tenía poco menos de 1 HIVE, así que tras vender los demás tokens logré 2 SWAP.HIVE. Suficiente para comprarme unas cuantas cartas que estaban en venta. 

![Captura de pantalla 2026-05-12 181103.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/EoCawD4xjFbNDx6z1b9kkYJZWip4ddJ1yHewawSK2vq6e8hBDBtayh3n13vtMRqgFCh.png)

![divisores-14.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/23swrTdV5AEuKHZoNF1QASNfTZ29vt5hb4BJ92YAiRNkQGqiuWHNkbHGGWhKbsmgx7Zzz.webp)

Well, I went to the HiveNFTs website and looked for the cards I want to buy, which are the Epic cards. These aren't cards you usually find when opening card packs, so I tend to buy a few every now and then when they're on sale on the marketplace.

>>Pues bien, fui a la página HiveNFTs y busqué las cartas que cuelo comprar, que son las Épicas. Estas son unas cartas que no suelen ser comunes al abrir packs de cartas, así que suelo comprar de vez en cuando algunas que están en oferta en el mercado.

![Captura de pantalla 2026-05-12 182133.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/23vhsZ7sMPgRHQ6KNFf4S3QsW9abJ6GQtUxfAjSn51fQSWTv9qQKrbNCzzrNhLZw9s1yd.png)

I found a few, so I went back to Hive-Engine and bought the STARBITS I needed. I actually bought a little over 300K STARBITS—about 360K—because I wanted to buy about three epic cards. Although they weren’t cheap, they were unique cards I didn’t have yet, and they would be a great addition to my collection.

>>Encontré unas cuantas, así que fui otra vez a Hive-Engine y compré los STARBITS que necesitaba. En sí compré poco más de 300K STARBITS, aproximadamente 360K, pues quería comprar unas 3 cartas épicas que aunque no estaban baratas, sí eran cartas únicas que no tenía y que sumarían bastante a mi colección.

![Captura de pantalla 2026-05-12 182353.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/23tRzSzQXctfgp3GKz4dvZvFr9uSaqQRhtSmHbctZep87L4KEWeUSmcMaPhfMnCKpHnz4.png)

![divisores-14.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/23swrTdV5AEuKHZoNF1QASNfTZ29vt5hb4BJ92YAiRNkQGqiuWHNkbHGGWhKbsmgx7Zzz.webp)

I’ll tell you about each card I bought, one by one. The first two cards I bought were of people; the first one is E246 Mike. 

This card has 590 fans and 450 skill. It’s a really nice card; it’s discontinued, but there are plenty on the market, so that was the only way to get it. It adds fans, but it also adds ego, because it doesn’t have the same amount of skill as it does ego—it’s not balanced.

>>Les hablaré una por una de cada carta que compré. Las dos primeras cartas que compré fueron de personas, en el primer caso está la E246 Mike. 
>>
>>Esta carta cuenta con 590 fans y 450 skill. Es una carta muy linda, está descontinuada pero hay muchas en el mercado, así que era la única manera de obtenerla. Suma fans, pero también suma ego, porque no tiene la misma cantidad de skill que de ego, no está balanceada.

The second epic character was E209 Verity. Like the previous one, she isn't balanced, since she has 590 fans but only 450 skill points. I'll have to take music lessons to make up for it, but that's an understatement because I found another awesome card that I'll show you next...

>>La segunda épica de personas fue la E209 Verity. Esta, al igual que la anterior, no está balanceada, pues suma 590 fans pero solo 450 skill. Me tocará hacer lecciones de música para compensar, pero esto es decir poco porque encontré otra carta genial les mostraré a continuación...

![Captura de pantalla 2026-05-12 211952.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/23tbRPytiXEY8kUwaEaSE4DuEn1AfPjw3kF8LBb4zZ3Bq7TRQLrtRwghxHJespad6c8Ka.png)

Well, while I was looking for the epic cards I wanted to buy, I also came across some vehicle cards that are really good, but for now I've only decided on one—the first one you see in the image below...

>>Bien, mientras buscaba las cartas épicas que deseaba comprar, también encontré unas de vehículos que son muy buenas, pero por ahora solo me decidí por una, la primera que ven en la imagen de abajo...

![Captura de pantalla 2026-05-12 182719.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/EoEp3d6AsbkRmG43ygjbZT5jZi7AmokGgTn7wMctD81LT4BMyRyzNjwUzwNeFTXPoQc.png)

This is a \

car—one of those epic vehicles that are just so cool. In this case, it's the E114 The Protector. This card isn't balanced at all; it just gives me a ton of ego that I'll have to make up for somehow, whether by buying high-skill cards or simply taking music lessons. In total, the card grants a whopping 1,200 fans. >>Este es un auto tipo monster, esos vehículos épicos que son tan geniales. En este caso es la E114 The Protector. Esta carta no es para nada balanceada, simplemente me suma un montón de ego que tendré que compensar de alguna manera, ya sea comprando cartas con mucho skill o simplemente haciendo lecciones de música. En total la carta suma la enorme cantidad de 1,2K de fans. ![Captura de pantalla 2026-05-12 211709.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/23tm76yoQVq9EH6rdDTuY1wPPWD6d1drnNy6SjeJcYDdVMfcDfjNkVqMedwSarZAHiT16.png) ![divisores-14.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/23swrTdV5AEuKHZoNF1QASNfTZ29vt5hb4BJ92YAiRNkQGqiuWHNkbHGGWhKbsmgx7Zzz.webp) As of today, following this purchase, my ego stands at 2.63%. While writing this post, I’ve been doing a couple of music lessons, so it’s gone down a few points, but there’s still a ways to go. Note that I have over 305K fans and over 310K skill points. You might think that fan ego is less than skill ego and that’s why I shouldn’t have such a big ego, but ego isn’t calculated that way—it’s calculated as fan ego plus mission ego. So right now, my ego is higher than my skill, which is why I’m over 2%. I’ll have to fix that... >>A la fecha, después de esta compra, mi ego quedó en 2,63%. Mientras hago el post he estado haciendo un par de lecciones de música, por lo que ha disminuido unas cuantas unidades, pero falta todavía. Fíjense que cuento con más de 305K de fans y más de 310K de skill. Quizás piensen que los fans es menos que el skill y que por eso no debería tener tanto ego, pero el ego no se calcula así, se calcula Ego de fans + Ego de misiones, así que tengo más ego que skill actualmente, por eso tengo más del 2%. Tendré que corregir eso... ![Captura de pantalla 2026-05-12 220148.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/48J9LCspPuyyntgR3PHXsLxfbou6a1bVxVM5xTmASJE6wTrsBcrE2dRvxkyxC9BDEJ.png) Well, friends, that’s all for now. I hope you enjoyed my post—or at least found it interesting. I invite you to share your thoughts in the comments below; as always, I’d love to read them. With nothing more to add, I’ll sign off for now...

See you next time!

>>Bien amigos, eso ha sido todo por ahora. Espero que mi post les haya gustado o cuando menos les haya parecido interesante. Los invito a dejar sus opiniones abajo en los comentarios, como siempre estaré encantado de leerlos. Sin más que agregar, me despido entonces... >> >>

¡Hasta la próxima!

body.title: Hobby Rooftop Garden: The Fragrance of Lemon Blossoms and the Bloom of Purple Peppers.
body.body:
> ![IMG20260217172400~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaP5gPvXZTqC6ktCT7yrqmtw5cdMAJyv6MkZAUGr1f7tP/IMG20260217172400~2.jpg) It is difficult to express the joy when a tree planted by your own hands blooms and bears fruit. Going to the roof every morning and seeing a new bud or a small fruit on the tree increases the peace of mind several times. Today, I will share with you some great updates on the current status of my rooftop garden. ![IMG20260217172614~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQbsMXWbZdQt7hwut9LVcgAHSFbffbQu66DSCEJTTUZP9/IMG20260217172614~2.jpg) ![IMG20260217172612~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmctCoQbi7iuztreYAvJjyJ6v95P5BDuXt6PBK1mzWFRX5/IMG20260217172612~2.jpg) The lemon trees in my garden are now in full bloom. The most interesting thing is that when the lemon flowers are in bud stage, they take on a wonderful appearance with a mixture of light pink or purple hues. As you can see in the picture, the pink buds are waiting to bloom in bunches. When these flowers are fully developed, the entire roof will be filled with a sweet fragrance. The greatest satisfaction of lemon farming is this fragrance and the assurance of fresh lemons. ![IMG20260217172358~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVgEY8wwewSA9o1grYQXrJRCmc81wHVXNuYcoZDud4isi/IMG20260217172358~2.jpg) I am quite excited about the pepper plants this time. Usually, we are used to seeing green or red peppers, but this time I have beautiful purple peppers in my garden. These dark purple peppers look like showpieces amidst the thick green leaves. As spicy as the peppers are, their color has greatly enhanced the beauty of the garden. The trees have a lot of peppers, which is heartwarming to see. I always try to keep my garden diverse. Not just peppers or lemons, my garden has a variety of fruit and vegetable plants. An ideal rooftop garden means a gathering of seasonal plants. I take care of the plants using organic fertilizers, as a result of which the plants have become quite fresh and healthy. This beautiful garden has been possible to build by watering them regularly and cleaning the weeds. A touch of greenery between the brick and stone walls of the city is like the pulse of life. Spending time on the roof after returning from the office or in leisure time, the fatigue of the whole day disappears in an instant. The satisfaction of eating poison-free vegetables and fruits from your own garden is impossible to find in things bought in the market. The light purple buds of lemon flowers and the spring of hot peppers have made my hard work worthwhile today. My plans for the garden are much bigger. In the future, I am thinking of planting some more exotic fruit seedlings and creeping vegetables. Rooftop gardening is not only a hobby, it is also our small contribution to protecting the environment. If you also have a small terrace or balcony, you can start gardening today. Believe me, when a small seedling grows and bears fruit under your care, that feeling will be incomparable. This was my arrangement for today. body.title: Do Not Allow Fear To Make Decisions For You
body.body:
>

There was a time a friend told me about an opportunity he missed because of fear. There was a job vacancy that was announced, but he kept telling himself that he was not good enough. Out of the fear of rejection, he did not even bother applying for the job. He got to find out that the person they later took for the job did not even have as much qualifications as he did. He missed out of the job because he allowed fear to make the decision for him. He did not even attempt, but he already concluded that he was not going to be taken. This was out of the fear of rejection. This is why you do not have to allow fear to becloud your sense of judgement to the point that it begins to make decisions for you.

<center>![pexels-jjy-media-305648397-13529141.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXFtbxMRbHNun31VGh4Mu6TBX6D3bJqa3UGaZiecrbUJk/pexels-jjy-media-305648397-13529141.jpg)</center>

<center><sub>Image from [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/photo/a-man-with-a-shocked-face-13529141)</sub></center>

It is true that fear is a natural emotion of humans. At least everyone experiences it at some point in their life. More so, fear can warn you of impending danger, so that you can be more careful. However, when fear begins to control your decisions, it will become dangerous. You will be surprised how lots of people miss opportunities on a daily basis, or delay their goals, or even remain stuck at the same spot, simply because they have allowed fear to control them.

Most times, fear does not come out openly and plainly to announce its presence. It can present in form of doubt and hesitation. You will see yourself start thinking like this; \
What if you do not have what it takes to perform the task?\
Hahaha no 😄 Its goat meat, we call it mutton here.

body.title: Oriental Mole Cricket (Gryllotalpa orientalis)
body.body:
| Latin Name | Observation Date | Location |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| ***Gryllotalpa orientalis*** | May 06, 2026 | Purulia, Natore, Bangladesh |

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT2K4G7yZ9igE1ZcauJa6Kwmy2LeKZmGGLbZqJKQTk8QY/mix_20260513_110126.jpg)


When we go out in search of strange creatures hidden in nature, we sometimes come across something that really surprises us. When the surroundings become silent at night, we can appreciate the various forms of nature very closely. Since I am closely associated with farming and fruit gardening, the presence of various types of insects in the crop fields or gardens is a very familiar scene to me. On May 6, at exactly 11:20 pm, I came across such a strange sight of insects and without delay, I immediately took some wonderful macro photos of it.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfAyRMx9Hsjo8kKWc9nZcyD676dA7FMMg2EqgDYpwzfWt/mix_20260513_110455.jpg)

I took the photo from a locality in Bangladesh. At first glance, anyone might think that the insect is a strange hybrid of a common cricket and some other animal. Its body color is dark brown, it has some beautiful folded wings on its back, and its front legs are as wide and strong as a spade or shovel for digging the soil.

To find out more detailed and accurate information about this insect, I took the help of the iNaturalist app and got some great scientific information from there, which I am sharing with you today.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcUgGt26LVjSqwZgTPzGRiv4kV6xic4qkZVRjnDdDq9ck/mix_20260513_110406.jpg)

**​Name and Scientific Name:**
According to the information provided by the app, the common English name of this animal is **Oriental Mole Cricket.** Its official scientific name is ***Gryllotalpa orientalis.***

​Species and Family:
It is basically a mole cricket species belonging to the Gryllotalpidae family. Scientists were once quite confused about the identity of this insect. Long ago, this species was mistakenly identified as G. africana. At that time, it was thought that they were widely distributed in both the continents of Asia and Africa. But after much research, in the 1980s, scientists recognized G. orientalis as a completely separate species.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVoP7BqmCGCF1xTXSaRAtk7vcjr9R9mmGtJEJ17UnP3GA/mix_20260513_110544.jpg)

​Habitat and Habitat:
Since the word 'Oriental' is attached to the name, it can be easily assumed that these are animals from our Asian region. They live widely in most parts of Asia and in Australasia. Their wide front legs show how good they are at digging the soil. They prefer to live in holes or tunnels under damp soil most of the time.

​Food and harmful aspects:
This insect is not at all beneficial for those of us who grow fruit gardens or depend on agriculture. It is a polyphagous pest. Their main food is the roots of plants. They chew the roots of various crops very cruelly from below the ground, causing great damage to the farmers' crops. If the roots of small seedlings are damaged, the plants dry up and die very quickly.

​Reproduction and beneficial aspects:
According to sources, this insect is best known as a deadly pest. Their reproduction process is completed underground and they lay eggs in a humid environment and reproduce. It is difficult to find direct benefits compared to the huge damage they cause in agriculture by eating the roots of crops. However, every animal has some role in the larger food chain of nature. As food for other larger animals or birds, they help to maintain the balance of the ecosystem, albeit indirectly.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXAK5XKbU9u1CWCKNUUew2pRpxMK6Sdg1GLvNPG7HvGaN/mix_20260513_110248.jpg)

I hope you liked the post.

I learned about them from various sites including iNaturalist, Wikipedia and Google.

(All posts are written in Bengali and translated into English using Google Translate.)
