>Easter Egg Collection That Got Completely Eaten (:\n\n

>
The main thing, besides of course being all together with our families, is coloring Easter eggs. One of them, the first one, traditionally red and the most joyful, we keep as The guardian egg of the home. This blog will be about how I dyed eggs on Good Friday. I first boiled 100 of them, really well, for about 20 minutes, because we like them hard boiled and they last longer that way, they truly are something special. Throughout the year, whenever we feel like eating a boiled egg, we tend to say it's nice, well cooked, but not like Easter eggs. And it really is always like that. I'm sure the holy water I added while they were boiling contributes to that as well, the one our priest blessed in every Orthodox home during the Easter fast.

body.title: Sameer Rizvi IPL Journey Stats Records and Career
body.body:
[Sameer Rizvi](https://www.sportsyaari.com/cricket/sameer-rizvi-ipl-p802/) has become one of the most exciting young batters in the Indian Premier League. The right-handed batter from Meerut, Uttar Pradesh, earned attention with his fearless batting style and powerful strokeplay. Over the last few seasons, Rizvi has shown why many cricket experts consider him a future star of Indian cricket. His aggressive approach, calm temperament, and ability to finish matches have made him a valuable player in the IPL. 

Rizvi started playing cricket at a very young age and trained under his maternal uncle in Meerut. He impressed coaches and local cricket circles with his natural talent and six-hitting ability. Former Indian cricketer Suresh Raina also noticed Rizvi’s talent during his childhood and reportedly encouraged him during his early cricketing days. 

Before entering the IPL, Sameer Rizvi made headlines in domestic cricket with brilliant performances in the UP T20 League and Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy. His explosive batting and quick scoring ability helped him become one of the most talked-about uncapped players in India. In the UP T20 League, Rizvi scored heavily and smashed a rapid century that increased his popularity among IPL franchises. 

Sameer Rizvi made his IPL debut in 2024 after being picked by Chennai Super Kings for a huge auction price. His signing created massive buzz because he became one of the most expensive uncapped Indian players in IPL auction history. Rizvi quickly gained attention when he smashed a six on his very first IPL ball against a world-class spinner. His fearless batting style reminded many fans of aggressive middle-order batters from previous IPL seasons. 

Later, Rizvi joined Delhi Capitals and continued his impressive performances. During IPL 2026, he played several match-winning knocks and established himself as a dependable middle-order batter. One of his best innings came against Mumbai Indians when he scored a stunning 90 runs off just 51 balls. That innings included powerful sixes and fearless strokeplay under pressure. 

Rizvi also played a memorable unbeaten 70-run innings against Lucknow Super Giants while rescuing Delhi Capitals from a difficult situation. His partnership with Tristan Stubbs helped Delhi complete a successful run chase after losing early wickets. Cricket experts praised Rizvi’s maturity and composure during the innings. 

According to IPL statistics, Sameer Rizvi has scored more than 400 IPL runs with an impressive strike rate above 145. He has already registered multiple half-centuries and continues to improve every season. His attacking batting style, clean hitting, and ability to dominate spin bowling make him a dangerous batter in T20 cricket. 

Fans and cricket communities on Reddit and social media have also praised Rizvi’s fearless approach and finishing skills. Many believe he has the potential to become an important player for India in the future if he maintains consistency in domestic and IPL cricket.

body.title: CAN CHARITY BE MADE COMPULSORY
body.body:
Hello everyone your welcome to my blog

In my perspective, I think the reason why people easily give money as charity is because money is something valuable that can be exchanged for anything of your choice, whether food, clothing, or payment of bills, depending on what you want to use the money for.


 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQqhEvGuAVjFmaPwYibX53PPPsimgndiZzWyhUtAAGMkg/2663.png 




On the other hand, offering charity as a way of giving a helping hand to someone in need through helping the person become independent on his or her own is one of the greatest ways to help someone in life. But in this type of charity, so many things are involved.

If giving charity becomes compulsory, it will be like similar to tax. In case of tax it’s somehow reasonable as we receive facilities from the government but if charity becomes like it may seems good from the surface because the people will be forced to give fund for charity and the poor will receive a good amount of help and such a thing may seems good but do you think it’s a good thing. I think that such a system is totally ridiculous. Even if I have the mentality to help the poor, I won’t give funds to them as I don’t like to be forced.

Humans are known as the best creatures in this earth and humanity is the thing that makes humans the best creatures in this earth and it’s also the thing which isolates us from other creatures. We are social beings and we can’t live alone and for various reasons we need the help of others doesn’t matter how capable we are. People also give a helping hand for the sake of kindness and doing charity is also for of kindness. Charity is not something that we are forced to do. It’s something we do from the bottom of heart without having any kind of expectations.


Thank you for stopping by my blog

body.title: All Of It
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWqSHC16WQot5DBFDPDLT9LXjeyp5r2X87N1qLZh3dHHq/rbbr.png 


I'm back on the road for a super quick trip in and out of Calgary, Alberta.

And I had my night all planned out too....

- Read the bible.

- Pray.

- Continue my '*theology degree readings*'.

- Watch a sermon or two.

And then....Continue on our journey with the #biblejournal posts here on chain.

And it's approaching midnight here, so I thought it would be a good idea to stop being lazy and open up my notes and see what I found while diving into **1 Corinthians 6**

If I thought chapter 5 was a doozy...Oh boy, did God have something waiting for me.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWtea4MsRzj3EzLi6YQLZuMJjxnL8UnEdUbEW5RD9qPvw/IMG_8868.jpeg 

Reality check.  And this will not be very politically correct in 2026 but alas, God's word is...His word.  So let's see what verses 9 and 10 say:

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZb1tUXgcuwJQ4Km8cF9Uxqo8r4UhojsRwVJtvKcSQotV/1-CORINTHIANS-CHAPTER-6-KJV-05-12-2026_11_29_PM.png 

These verses are thrown around quite a bit by the religious right, to show the world how holy they are and how people of the world are destined to the lake of fire.

But when I read this, I see....Pretty much everyone all the planet.

Remember, all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God (Romans 3:23) so while this is a pretty detailed list of human beings that won't inherit heaven, I think we need to self check all of our own lives before casting stones at anyone.

And see, this is what Paul is doing because in chapter 5, he's telling the church to repent.  Turn from sin!  We have all sinned, and this is why we need a Savior.  

What GOOD NEWS this is!  Because when we 'try' to turn from sin, we fail. Within verse 9 I see our error right there, look what Paul writes:

*\

*

Guess what, when we try to STOP sinning, we start making ourselves idols.  Boasters.  Look at me, I'm free from sin.  Look at me, I did this.  Look at me, I conquered sin!!!

And guess what, when doing that, we break the law because...We are looking at ourselves to fix the sin problem.  We can't do that, which brings me always back to...

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVCQCAQJusZCfbDZp53mZstnffo2GzMELy8oMgj71KQVY/MATTHEW-6-33-KJV-But-seek-ye-first-the-kingdom-of-God-and-his-righteousness-and-all-these-things-shall-be-added-unto-you--05-12-2026_11_35_PM.png 

That's the ONLY cure for the sin problem.  Every single one of those sins laid out in 1 Corinthians 6:9,10 can be conquered through the life, death and resurrection of Jesus Christ.  When we seek HIS righteousness, sin will become ugly to us.  When we focus on Him and His sacrifice for our sin, all these things shall be added unto you.

The gospel is so beautiful.  And while it'll take an eternity to understand the depth of God's love...It's really this simple.

Focus on Christ and what He did.  Accept Him.  And you will naturally turn from sin.

**All of it.**

Starting my new job today and of course there will be induction stuff to do before I really get into the meat of the job, as a full stack developer working with Ruby on Rails and the two React frameworks, the one for the web and Native for building mobile apps.

I’m working at a music school that helps children learn to play instruments, who find it hard otherwise. It’s not always about sheet music, theory and so on. I’m curious to learn more about how they teach. 

I found music a really hard topic at school in the 80’s compared to others and was frustrated because I wanted to play everything but just gave up at the first hurdle. I’ve since learnt to play a bit of guitar and lots of keyboard since then by teaching myself mostly. I was formerly taught guitar by a very good player and teacher. I really only stopped when I met a girl and got distracted - she did become my wife though, so that’s all cool.

I took a break from music completely until Covid and I dug out my old keyboard, got back into making music on the computer and then started writing about it a little later. 

Anyway, my new job will be a great journal topic, I shall encourage myself to write about it.

body.title: Комашина домівка
body.body:
У нашому міському парку з'явився новий об'єкт - комашина домівка. Ніколи не чули? Я - теж. Але наша Джес вирішила показати мені, як це виглядає в реаліях. І стало цікаво - як це працює.

![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valentinalife/23w2sdpCvoD6CtirdFkr5HB852iGBGr37CRJPgjbzrsXPquEaMcmMezyebqdeEndsfGJV.jpg)

Автори проекту стверджують, що така комашина домівка є практичним рішенням для підтримки біорізноманіття. Поблизу полів вона стає надійним прихистком для корисних комах, а в школах — інструментом екологічної просвіти. Адже комахи — основа природного балансу. Вони запилюють рослини, підтримують екосистему, є кормовою базою для багатьох корисних птахів та інших тваринок, вони ж впливають на врожаї.
Зміни природного середовища — розвиток виробництва, інфраструктури й наслідки війни — призводять до того, що комахам дедалі складніше знаходити безпечний простір для життя. Саме тому грамотно побудовані та встановлені комашині домівки так потрібні в нашому просторі.

![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valentinalife/23w2mLPgqvwk1xApspLweUrTchizuYogXFRSSx1ZHAsWHGB7mG5XzfbeYJnA1Ct2GhuDT.jpg)

А тепер - про тих, хто це все реалізував. Це - компанія \

, яка на ділі підтверджує свій відповідальний та довгостроковий підхід до сталого розвитку. А підтримка Уряду Королівства Нідерландів, країни походження компанії, дозволяє залучати до цього проекту більше шкіл та громад.

body.title: Getting closer to averaging 7 mins per km
body.body:
It's been a tough and frustrating road but I am making real progress.  I am not fast, I do not think I ever will be fast because I am starting pretty late in my life and previous to about 18 months ago I was almost entirely focused on lifting and bodybuiding and didn't really do any cardio for years.

Now I do almost exclusively cardio and I keep improving bit by bit.   These days I am pushing towards having an average pace of less than 7 mins per kilometer on 5k runs or longer.   

We are getting really close now and the best part is I don't really feel like I am pushing myself when I do run.

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/normie.fitness/23tRxbUmAkCe3wJVw2FUxzquU2cpjzE6tEQ5C7b26FmCFWJjcAUfz7pcs8KfbTSuN67HJ.png)
</center> 

Now when I say that \

I don't mean that this is easy to me and it takes no effort.  That is not true.  It is difficult for me but I often feel as though the real pain for me is psychological.  I, and most people, are capable of much more than we actually ever accomplish in terms of cardio is concerned, but we have a tough time with the mental block.  This is why on days where I know I am going to run \

a 5k, that the last 400 meters or so seem as though they are a half marathon.   Having an end-goal and being so close to it is kind of a funny phenomenon.  I was exerting no more effort towards the end than I was at the start, but in my mind it is a lot more difficult even though that is not the case at all.

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/normie.fitness/23tRtaFZVQkeLRbqqscS1Ud1CPGBR4qVTCNRizwmSk1Byr2VaUHzspmsEgWPHFz853qGE.png)
</center>

Because it was rather late and I sometimes struggle to see small things in the dark, I wasn't really paying close attention to my heart rate but rather just \

as I went along.  I was pretty happy to see later, when I was checking out my stats, that I managed to stay out of anaerobic zone 4 more often than I was in it and I likely have taught myself how to auto-adjust when I am working a bit too hard.

The good tunes certainly help as well and I have a pretty good and motivating playlist at the moment.

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/normie.fitness/23tbEbLKpEZ4p2LQXqgxmDNkrR3xprBxGszH9x9nHqahz5Fz4c52PXcwxTWq2YfeeKpQa.png)
</center>

You can see here that I am getting really close to my goal of less than 7 minutes per kilometer and I actually got faster towards the end.   I am not consciously doing this though, and I like that.  I am not pushing myself or constantly checking my pace because I don't believe my watch is advanced enough to really know how fast I am moving anyway.  This is just something that I think most runners just have to teach themselves to be able to feel.   I guess I am getting there.

I think with a bit more of a push I can break that 7 min threshold, but I don't want to be forcing it, I want it to come naturally and not feel as though I am dying in the process.  

There was a bit of an issue towards the end of this where a bunch of people were walking on the running track and sometimes I feel like I am going to lose my cool towards these people one day.  I'm glad I didn't though, because I would likely regret that attitude later.   

The first km doesn't really count either because a fair bit of that was spent waiting for the light to turn green and I probably lost at least 15-20 seconds on that alone.

I think I can beat this before the end of May.  I could beat it today but like I said, I don't want to force it, I want it to come naturally.

When you consider that a year or so ago I was in the mid to high 8 minutes per kilometer and not even capable of a 5km uninterrupted, I am happy with this progression.

In the near future though, I am going to have to address my footwear situation, because I can feel a couple of my toes being a bit cramped in the front of my right shoe.   I have put over 1000 km on these shoes, so it is time to get new ones anyway.

I hope you are all healthy and happy and have a wonderful day with God's blessing. This time, I'm sharing how to make a two-tone panty set for a young woman. It's a gift for a friend. It's a top and panty set. First, I made the top in pink and turquoise. The panty combines the same colors and is made of heavyweight micro-peach fabric, just like the top.

> https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kattycrochet/23yTr7DVouLxVD12JG2QmRdLpwmfKbgrJ4uE3Kt8azagY1UjPDSWQbm4tbQDDFGC4YDq2.png Saludos amigos creativos y comunidad @needleworkmonday, deseo se encuentren sanos y felices y tengan un excelente día con la bendición de Dios, en esta ocasión comparto la elaboración de una panty bicolor juvenil, es un obsequio para una amiga, se trata de un conjunto de top y panty, primero hice el top en color rosa y turquesa, la panty combina los mismos colores y está elaborada en tela microdurazno heavy al igual que el top. ![panty (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EoptLtpJPUNiMS3ZoKJP2U8gDC2gvXDdZDHPsp2sXEoVh6EpkdNpdZJ79aSAs6PMjta.jpeg) ![panty (4).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23vsX7kt9mgMwdV67ZrACq6tUHq1s2VzhCoPrui644NyFeenPTnqa767nSLYbTHeqKDt9.jpeg) ![CINTILLO B.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23ydV5FZaqNcDMKtbipQ1N5NLm3e5QMkn955u9dcp41hg2uR4SL2MQnzytKVN11aTGikQ.jpg)

> https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kattycrochet/23w3EVi87zTgsjkDyi2fjmkGr5sBjcr634ePuT16u5PA5iESqEiP1xSxhH7oJ8oPdx8jU.png Heavyweight peach microfiber fabric (turquoise and pink) Elastic bias tape (with blackberries) Chalk Patterns Pins Scissors Sewing machine

> https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kattycrochet/23wCdA5hdkexjCZYwXzKig8eMwhNoufVq399HbbUUzuaHLWMsUJTxeP8HTCLiJL3V4pNa.png Tela microdurazno heavy (turquesa y rosa) Sesgo Elástico (con moritas) Tiza Moldes Alfileres Tijera Máquina de coser ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23wX3KV1F5t3zCbFqhj7kR9SQ9rGqKcEcJRYRWNrym6aC4rF9uhSyhgwMLZVnK9pi9wMM.png)

> https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kattycrochet/23uFwDcmUtAhK2PJERXCcwgK7LAJzSK93RMmPfhFUhL6BHPeiWXCqE9z7uhjBHYuBZ9Yo.png The first step was to mark the pieces of the panty: back, front, and center.

> https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kattycrochet/23w3EdSM4FnEmTm66pZRifkqam3pX8YnocPjwT1i9bSbsmxRc3KY9EDMWfa39wqdMtAQ5.png El primer paso fue marcar las piezas de la panty; trasero, delantero y centro ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23uFcHUa5XtFCSkNpo3JUvb3z7KJA3KdS9x3p2izJZNmmpeU5J7zVx6FrK4ctB8fbrcPv.png)
> Then I joined the center pieces to the back, right sides together the top piece, then the front with the wrong side, pinned it in place and sewed with a straight stitch.

> Luego uní las piezas centrales al posterior, enfrenté por el derecho la pieza superior, luego delantero con revés, sujeté con alfileres y cosí con puntada recta. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23u69Qm28KxHnRqV6vswvyoFLQ3riwH6tj9VgyrBB9nVucQq92N96gohbuAb71hHZKZEY.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EokcCRQapmYgRZJinCL9GUhFRcTUe4z5R85YwKfpueUmozmRDBXDa6Hzcr63M6SxfW8.png)

>\n\nThe next step was to attach the front piece to the center pieces. To do this, I placed the inner center piece against the right side of the back piece and passed the lower piece over the top, forming a sort of \
. I pinned it, sewed it, and pulled the garment out through one of the holes. This way, the seams are hidden and have a better finish.

>\n\nEl siguiente paso fue pegar la parte delantera a las piezas centrales, para ello enfrenté la el centro interior con el derecho del trasero y pasé la pieza inferior por la parte de arriba formando una especie de \

, sujeté con alfileres, cosí y saqué la prenda por uno de los orificios, de esta forma las costuras quedan escondidas y con mejor acabado. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23tmKrntEQrdJfrqoECCvT7tdW6Gfv9BQZCgUX59E6ZgLaLEDXYeTfkXbmbMFyiRW8EKd.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23w2uVJUd3PsZvoKpd4Xz5zE3L8ztc9VGFh3gt1JmtaZC9NG6jSzoMxQcr5NivUvoZN11.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23wMgfmxAiNyJJ4vWdJGayDKPPq5yHXyFDtFSEWoPT5rnfcc6KmP1hYwVqShrPByX4qMP.png)
> After attaching the center pieces to the front and back, I closed the side seams. To do this, I placed the right sides together, pinned them, and sewed with a straight stitch.

> Unidas las piezas centrales al delantero y posterior, cerré los laterales, para ello enfrenté los derechos, fijé con alfileres y cosí con puntada recta. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23t7ezraQzZjdTSUsJxMtRQT2WSFTQG2MixaYUSzXkhfnHWNw3SJQCA3HEBxgoitK9G8r.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23vsWm5ek987PfE6ZTxN3wXnHiMudh4RJCwbfvus1zocedPRmGKVeiFzm8hnrG5w4cJXT.png)

> The last step was to attach the bias tape to the legs and waist, I placed the right side of the bias tape against the right side of the fabric, stretching one (1) centimeter every five (5) centimeters, then I turned the previous seam to the wrong side and again sewed over it to reinforce with a decorative lingerie stitch, with these simple steps the panty is finished.

> El último paso fue pegar el sesgo en las piernas y cintura, enfrenté derecho del sesgo con la tela por el derecho, estirando un (1) centímetro cada cinco (5) centímetros, luego volteé la costura anterior por el revés y nuevamente cosí por encima para repisar con puntada decorativa de lencería, con estos sencillos pasos está terminada la panty. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EoGwwCmcyyj5gxeoRBtvS2Wy4Giajtg55DKPdy4ThTevmqocW2uFHZDWA864SWYtN7S.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23vi7sm4J9yfzoRgmBuX4sgHSZ39cYjXkXLh6HRtp1rmJrA3mLJacpvfu1KMDRqRqGFXU.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23u61B6iXfYQ1VLkkQPyrGgbequJoJHQXHSLYoR1CXBk1DJ46XuRdnmsgAq2GsHBDWyNF.png)

> https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kattycrochet/23w3EdSM2vR5GZCfPgV9Hysb8u9kyS9LDgre9uTVHGYF4farMBmrv9UozZZQ1pTvgPWvV.png I really liked how the panties turned out; the turquoise and pink combination is very pretty, and they match the top perfectly. I hope you find the tutorial useful.

> https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kattycrochet/23wCbbsET1XYd9SFxS8PkQgRUCqF23f22ynoBRA4axcFztZF6y4SvuU7r6PoEsvZ6vbN5.png El resultado de la panty me gustó la combinación de turquesa y rosa es muy bonita, además queda bien a juego con el top, espero el tutorial les sea de utilidad. ![panty (4).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23vsX7kt9mgMwdV67ZrACq6tUHq1s2VzhCoPrui644NyFeenPTnqa767nSLYbTHeqKDt9.jpeg) ![panty (3).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EoK8EtfWXPFmKkG44coY6ecmjyDyPgS8rby7Su38T1cfDVCmRVpZRizBbvudzpcrcbW.jpeg)

body.title: Hive-Engine Needs Better Liquidity, APIs and Trading Tools
body.body:
![ChatGPT Image May 13, 2026, 10_24_50 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23u5X5nztbriu4FRN1jh3TQ79og7LvGTErTWmd13ZwNeFvUpdqLWFXA2pB1vpA5fajSSj.png)
![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)


There are many tokens on Hive-Engine but almost all of them have extremely low trading volume. The biggest problem is that if you buy a large amount of any token, selling it later becomes very difficult because there is not enough liquidity in the market.

That is why whenever a new project is launched or its tokenomics are designed, the first priority should be ensuring strong liquidity. Another important factor is creating genuinely interesting projects that naturally attract people and increase market participation over time.

This has been the main issue with #Hive-Engine tokens. I (with my Uncles)vpersonally develop Python trading bots and have already connected API bots with Binance where I can trade multiple coins simultaneously and exit positions efficiently. 

![Screenshot 2026-05-13 101947.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23tSoCMbxe5G5T8GgiuWAKoHEWKnnprSaoBRCD5BaiKb6orFoZDFAfnpccBAokwWwUGiT.png)
![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)

I was thinking about building something similar for Hive-Engine as well but unfortunately the trading volume there is almost negligible. There is no such API system to connect the bot and other difficulties as well.

If such facilities existed on Hive Engine then why wouldn’t the volume increase and why wouldn’t traders come here? The issue is that these facilities are still not available here. 

There are only a few old projects that have their own platforms and they have a little bit of liquidity. Apart from them finding liquidity here is quite difficult. Also such features and systems have not yet been developed that could connect it with bots or similar automated tools.

I have tried many times to trade tokens with each other but due to low liquidity or you could say the lack of trading volume it has been very difficult for me. I have experience trading various cryptocurrencies on Binance where trading activity is much higher and transactions happen quickly.

![Screenshot 2026-05-13 101908.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23tSqt3JBaRM9aomoenpoT2YXRhEKrhDsw2bVftnLTKtCw16dX4ZGbTAbKY348iwh6Ch3.png)
![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)

At the moment gold and silver are also among the best assets to use for hedge trading. However when it comes to Hive-Engine I have repeatedly faced the same issue low liquidity. Sometimes weeks pass without being able to execute even a single trade.

This is one of the major concerns that Hive users believe should be addressed. The platform has different types of users including traders who want to actively trade and earn within the ecosystem. 

One positive aspect of #Hive-Engine is that there are no gas fees or expensive transaction charges which is a huge advantage for traders.

If liquidity, trading volume and better trading tools were improved it could attract many more traders and significantly strengthen the Hive ecosystem.

![Screenshot 2026-05-13 101836.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23sxfgrXLSEfGjt9ZYtXi7QWDgb9mtgY9NmJV52j4YZVNQ628dHhyZJw2LUir9efweQm8.png)
![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)

I also noticed that if there are some tokens who have good volume but still there is a huge spread in trading them. This is how a trader will not like. You can see an example that I shared in the screenshot of Swap.HBD and Swap.hive that there is still a huge spread and with a low volume here.

In such conditions trading or investing in any project becomes extremely difficult because liquidity risk remains very high.

I hope you guys will like this post and is interesting as well. If you find it informative then dont forget to give me a support. Share you reviews in the comment section below. Thank you all for your time reading the content.

![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)

body.title: Larva of Horsfield's tussock moth
body.body: > On a green leaf, streaked with life, I found a Horsfield's tussock moth larva or caterpillar. It appeared to be sleeping soundly, I noticed it hadn't moved at all. The caterpillar was very small, but its striking coloration was easily visible. Its body was gray with black and bright yellow. From a distance, only the yellow was visible, the other two colors were invisible. I realized the other two colors adorning the caterpillar's body while photographing it, only when I zoomed in did I see them. The yellow ones were hairs that protected its body.

> The hairs covering its body were very long, and they gave me goosebumps while photographing it. Luckily, it was small, I couldn't imagine it being any larger. If it were any larger, it would have looked incredibly scary, and I wouldn't have had the courage to approach it. But the image I took was different. In the picture, it looked adorable with its long hairs. A dark black line ran down the center of its body, making it even more appealing.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX3NKCBcxGRUwtUUN8Twj6osYJEEArqhAhJbw9spNtDh8/1778641079983.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaCGYG5atDt8yJU3BP1bybMfARduJxFGF4B2nqjLcD69a/1778641080059.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbcFciVFZxMxhHuYRnx9haGzve6bGN7VZ2EoHE3TnF19F/1778641080115.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSXT6zDD9DNZe9PWuPKgN9E6yv8H9CJAJE8zJVZXYgfkd/1778641080165.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUk1bRwGFzaTNXc7U2v2AvJmLkLaitP7btLahnQGcBg1h/1778641080219.jpg) Latin name | Calliteara horsfieldii | - | - | Observation date | 13 Mei, 2026 Camera used | realme 7 Pro Photographers | @reachdreams Location | Aceh, Indonesia | Link to original community | | - | https://www.inaturalist.org/observations/361051884 Latitude | Longitude | Map | - | - | - | 4.695135 | 96.7493993 | https://www.openstreetmap.org/?mlat=4.695135&mlon=96.7493993

body.title: IS HIVE BLOCKCHAIN STILL EFFICIENT?
body.body:
https://images.ecency.com/DQmYYDnT8BTF7B7PzL83yeVQdaeiNGFC447YeaRzQH74aTD/1778649667730.png
[source](canva.com) 

We know there are many communities on the Hive blockchain that allows members to use their platform to create content based on their niche. However, in recent times some of  these Communities have not been receptive or accommodating to people that explore their platforms. 

At some point whenever you have issues theh make it feel like they would have your back and resolve issues immediately but reverse is the case as they only put that as a front to publicly save their faces as against all odds.

Things have changed everywhere and even on the Hive blockchain the system is becoming backward and people are no longer worthy of earning rewards according to the content they put out there. Apparently, those who can support a content are holding off rewards and making people's effort look like a waste.

No wonder I was reading a Blog recently and the person claimed that saving his reward which is the hbd on the savings feature is one that he has left for a while now because apparently the hive liquid token is no longer holding value as it used to be. Hence it is better to withdraw your earnings and make use of them in the real world so as to have real profit.

Also, I made a Discovery that in some Communities when you make mistakes like double transactions , they tend to ignore your plea and make it seem like you are not heard. Thses communities make people feel like they have a feedback platform where people can make complaints and they will be attended to in the next 24 hours. 

In this same community, I made a transaction where I paid twice for a service, I really wasn't disturbed at first because I believed the community was an active one and they would respond to my complaints. It's being 2 months now my messages have been read, I have created ticket, I have done everything possible to call their attention to it and till now they have refused to release my transaction.

This is why I posed the question of if really the Hive blockchain is efficient enough because right from the time I joined, more than 30% of those whom we were together and no longer consistent, active or even on the platform anymore.

Thanks for stopping by my blog... 

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@henrietta27/is-hive-blockchain-still-efficient--guo)

body.title: Origami, Anamógrafo y Arte Cinético venezolano 💙 [ENG/ESP]
body.body:
>Greetings to everyone in the Lifestyle community. Today I’m joining you here to share a new day in my life with you. It’s been a while since I last posted, and the truth is, I’ve been really busy. At the same time, several things happened, like a new flu virus that hit the school. I think both students and teachers have been affected. Aside from that, some interesting and very good things have happened. However, I’ll share those stories over the course of the week and the coming days. Today I want to tell you about our class at the start of this week.

\n\n

>Last week I had planned to do origami with the children so they could bring their moms a beautiful gift, but classes were canceled. So since we couldn’t do it the week before, we did it this Monday in the classroom. We made a tulip flower. You need two pieces of paper (one for the flower and one for the stem), and the children were quite focused, trying to figure out how to fold the paper from one side to the other... and when they finished, they were able to decorate it however they wanted. To be honest, I only know a few origami designs, and this activity was in honor of my mom, who is an expert at making all kinds of origami figures. So I couldn’t have honored my mom on Mother’s Day in a better way than this. The children enjoyed the origami.

\n\n>

>Saludos a todos en la comunidad de Lifestyle. El día de hoy me uno por acá para compartir con ustedes un nuevo día en mi vida. Ya tenía tiempo que no publicaba y es que estaba realmente bastante ocupada. Al mismo tiempo sucedieron varias cosas como un nuevo virus de gripe que llegó al colegio. Creo que tanto estudiantes como docentes nos hemos visto afectados. Así que fuera de ello han sucedido cosas interesantes, muy buenas. Sin embargo las iré contando en el transcurso de la semana y los días. Hoy les quiero contar cómo fue nuestra clase de este inicio de semana.

\n\n>

>La semana pasada tenía planeado hacer origami con los niños con motivo de que pudieran llevar a sus mamás un bello regalo, pero se cancelaron las clases. Así que como no pudimos hacerlo en la semana anterior, lo hicimos este lunes en el aula. Se hizo una flor de tulipán. Se necesitan dos piezas de papel (uno para la flor y otro para el tallo) y los niños estaban bastante concentrados, tratando de descifrar cómo mover un pliegue de un lado al otro... y cuando terminaron, pudieron decorarlo a su manera. Siendo sincera yo sólo conozco algunas piezas de origami y esta actividad fue en honor a mi mamá, quién sí es una experta haciendo toda clase de figuras en origami. Así que yo no podía honrar a mi mamá en el día de la madre de una mejor manera que esta. Los niños disfrutaron del origami.

![IMG_4041.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/Eq7NSFCTti76Rxju9TJzjgCccApyfFjS9BfziRkN94J5cZfGwY6RSxvrJuVqCn1TdQk.jpeg) ![IMG_4060.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EpnDpD7Bz3qap7JMgq3eHm2GASScqq868Pt6RJ378z8LrnjHzLBCxLtEa1326FJLRB6.jpeg) ![IMG_4040.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EptbYaYyAPMEaEVbWX2YPsRfRemoksNmShFAgqGr5WZpzxnhK6GgW9Dr4PYSfHWrzto.jpeg) ![IMG_4038.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EonmWh5rh4GmJcLSeFZpiLQGdZ9L59B1Ef83PS4mbJx8QoheAbDoHEuzUt8RAZh7LJ3.jpeg) ![IMG_4062.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EpxrmSnzjmUnv3p1Yb3W3q8nHHXR8rKphA717Dj5vrGrhk26uKhBYEGPYnTgtnr66Kw.jpeg) ![IMG_4035.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/Eq7NJNSgS5MUZRFteERcYfuaU7FDZi3c4wTkaNRZPgPkgFNLzviJvCeA2wtjQ94PwFD.jpeg)

>However, another activity we had planned was making an agamograph, a technique that creates a sense of movement by using two images. This ties in with the fact that this week’s theme is Kinetic Art. Specifically, Venezuelan art. Since we’re in Bolívar State, we have two great exponents: Jesús Soto and Alejandro Otero. So I prepared a “Penetrable” for the children, to recreate Jesús Soto’s Penetrables. It seems like a simple idea, but the truth is that it achieves the goal of immersion, interaction, and experiencing the artwork firsthand. Plus, the kids really enjoyed it—even the older ones, who are usually a bit more hesitant to try something like this. A big surprise is coming up this week, so I’ll tell you all about it soon. Without further ado, thank you so much for stopping by.

\n\n>

>Sin embargo, otra de las actividades que se tenían previstas eran realizar el agamógrafo, una técnica que crea un efecto de movimiento por medio del uso de dos imágenes. Eso en relación a que justamente esta semana tenemos el tema de el Arte Cinético. En específico el arte venezolano. Como estamos en el Estado Bolívar, tenemos dos grandes exponentes que son Jesús Soto y Alejandro Otero. Así que prepare para los niños un Penetrable, para recrear los penetrables de Jesús Soto. Parece una idea inocente, pero lo cierto es que cumple con el objetivo de inmersión, interacción y experiencia de vivir la obra de arte. Y además, los niños lo disfrutaron. Incluso los más grandes quienes suelen estar un poco más recelosos a hacer algo así. Esta semana se viene una gran sorpresa así que pronto les cuento. Sin más que decir, muchísimas gracias por pasar por aquí.

![Thank You for stopping by_20251222_235935_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EqQRuBXhDFu9VJKoUi9KYBHi1fizexq9zibK9463CkCj7BCiSq9HsujVhAP8Vem6kgg.png)

body.title: Roses are in my yard.
body.body:
Roses are in my yard.
And the roses have bloomed in my garden. This year I planted many new flowers, including roses. I love roses. I love flowers in general. There are so many flowers in my garden.
I grow tulips, roses, daffodils, royal jasmine, and other flowers.

This is a bush rose in the photo. I also have climbing roses. They can climb over the right side, on the fence, over the house. I have them growing near the garage and climbing up the garage. It looks very beautiful when the roses climb up the building.

The roses in the photo are new. I planted them this year. They are blooming so beautifully. The bush is still small, but they don't seem to be growing big. This is a border rose. It is usually planted along the border.
Roses need to be cared for. They need to be watered, and you can also add fertilizer for blooming flowers. You also need to remove weeds. With the arrival of autumn, roses need to be pruned. But all this must be done correctly. Then the Rose will delight you with its beauty.

All players with boxes from the new miniset or cards will soon be able to load up their Wagons and start earning points toward the new cards created by the team! There are some differences from the previous CA event. For example, in Conflict Escalation, cards from other sets, such as Arcane Conclave, cannot be used; only everything related to ESCALATION, including promo cards, will be available.

body.title: Three Songs by Guns N' Roses | Music & Natto (Three Tunes Tuesday Edition) [ENG/SPA]
body.body: > Hello, fans of great music. Today, as is our tradition every Tuesday (even though it’s already Wednesday by the time this post goes live, but oh well), I’ll be talking about three songs I’ve specially selected for this Music community event called Three Tunes Tuesday, brought to us weekly by our colleague @ablaze. This time, we’ll continue talking about more rock bands that have become incredibly famous. But not only that—they’re also among my favorite bands because I grew up listening to them since I was a teenager. Guns N’ Roses is a name that completely defined an entire era, a generation, and a musical style forever. The level of popularity and influence this Heavy Rock band has is truly indescribable. And it’s only natural that, back in the day, as I was getting into Rock music, I eventually stumbled upon this band and some of their most famous and iconic singles of all time. Writing this post wasn’t easy at all, since I had to choose from a rather long list of songs that I absolutely love.

>
Hola fanáticos de la buena música. Hoy, como ya es costumbre todos los martes (aunque ya es miércoles a la hora de publicar este post, pero bueno), les hablaré de tres canciones de mi elección especial para este gran evento de la comunidad de Música titulado Three Tunes Tuesday que semanalmente nos trae nuestro compañero @ablaze. En esta ocasión seguiremos hablando de más bandas de Rock que se han vuelto increíblemente famosas. Pero no solo eso, sino que también son de mis bandas favoritas debido a que crecí escuchándolas desde que era adolescente. Guns N’ Roses es un nombre que logró definir por completo toda una época, una generación y un estilo de música para siempre. El nivel de popularidad e influencia que posee esta banda de Rock Pesado es indescriptible, la verdad. Y es normal que, en su momento, al conocer sobre el género del Rock al final me topara con dicha banda y algunos de sus sencillos más famosos y sonados de toda la historia. Hacer este post no fue para nada fácil ya que tuve que escoger entre una lista no pequeña de canciones que me fascinan bastante.

/>

Sweet Child o’ Mine - Guns N' Roses

> Let’s start with one of the first singles that became very popular in the late 1980s. It’s one of the first Guns N’ Roses songs I ever heard, over a decade ago. The song is called “Sweet Child O’ Mine” and is part of the American band’s debut studio album, Appetite for Destruction, released in 1987, two years after the group’s official formation. The song features a unique blend of Hard Rock and Alternative Rock, with the electric guitar solos by the great Slash standing out above all else. The song tells us about a “special place” attributed to a “sweet child” who “has eyes like the bluest skies” and hair that “reminds me of a special place.” It’s a blend of nostalgia with a touch of romance, a love letter to that special person in your life who, just by looking at them, transports you back to that happy past you had when you were just a child. The lyrics of “Sweet Child O’ Mine” contain several phrases that end up being metaphors related to that feeling of love and nostalgia conveyed from start to finish. It’s interesting that a song—especially one by Guns N’ Roses—has lyrics as emotional and nostalgic as those in this single. Honestly, what I liked and was drawn to most about this song—just as I was with many other songs by this Heavy Rock band—is its musical composition. It’s not just the easy-to-follow rhythm, but the way they craft the melody, guided primarily by Slash’s unmistakable electric guitar from the very first second. I now see this song in a better light—a perfect single to kick off this selection.

>
Empecemos con uno de los primeros sencillos que se volvieron muy populares a finales de los años 80. Es una de las primeras canciones de Guns N' Roses que llegué a escuchar hace más de una década atrás. La canción se llama Sweet Child o' Mine y forma parte del primer álbum de estudio de la banda estadounidense titulado Appetite for Destruction lanzado en 1987, dos años después de la formación oficial del grupo. La canción posee una mezcla única de Hard Rock con Rock Alternativo, destacando sobre todo los solos de guitarra eléctrica del gran Slash. La canción nos habla de un “lugar especial” al cual se le atribuye a una “sweet child” quien “tiene los ojos como los cielos más azules” y su cabello que “me recuerda a un lugar acogedor”. Es una mezcla de nostalgia con algo de romance, una forma de dedicatoria de amor a esa persona especial en tu vida que, con solo verla, ya te lleva a aquel pasado feliz que tenías cuando eras solo un niño. La letra de Sweet Child O' Mine posee varias frases que terminan siendo metáforas relacionadas a dicho sentimiento de amor y nostalgia que nos transmite de inicio a fin. Es curioso que una canción, sobre todo una de Guns N' Roses, tenga una letra tan emotiva y nostálgica como la que tiene éste sencillo. Honestamente, lo que más me gustó y atrajo de esta canción, al igual que lo hizo muchas otras canciones de esta banda de Rock Pesado es la composición musical que posee. No solo es el ritmo fácil de seguir que posee, sino la forma en la que componen dicha melodía guiándose principalmente de la inconfundible guitarra eléctrica de Slash desde el primer segundo. Ahora veo esta canción con mejores ojos, un sencillo perfecto para empezar esta selección.

> Let's talk now about another great, very popular single by this American band—it's also been one of my favorites ever since I first started listening to them back in high school. Its slow, ballad-like rhythm and its deeply emotional lyrics, which accompany the song’s incredible melody, are among the most fabulous things I’ve heard since then. “Don’t Cry” is one of the first singles from the first part of their second studio album, titled Use Your Illusion (1991). According to the singer-songwriter and band leader, Axl Rose, it was the first song they wrote. We won’t be discussing the different versions of this song that exist, but rather we’ll focus mainly on its lyrics and meaning. “Don’t Cry” is a Guns N’ Roses Power Ballad that was written right after a breakup. That is why the lyrics tell the story of a couple going through a kind of mourning, and one of them tells the other, “don’t hang your head in sadness.” They also say, “I know how you feel inside, I’ve been there before,” thus showing affection and understanding. But there are also lines like “don’t cry tonight, I still love you, baby”, which makes it clear that this is due to a breakup. The line “don’t take it so hard right now” shows an attempt to lighten the mood and ease the depression of the moment, especially when he adds lines like “there’s a sky above you, baby”, meaning there are much bigger and more important things to remember to stay alive and be happy for. This letter of comfort and heartbreak perfectly complements the song with its slow melody and iconic guitar solos.

>
Hablemos ahora de otro gran sencillo bastante popular de la banda estadounidense y también es una de mis favoritas desde que los empecé a escuchar cuando solo estaba en secundaria. Su ritmo lento como balada y su letra evidentemente profunda y repleta de sentimientos que acompañan esta increíble melodía que posee la canción es de lo más fabuloso que he escuchado desde entonces. Don't Cry es uno de los primeros sencillos de la primera parte del segundo álbum de estudio titulado Use Your Illusion (1991). Según el cantautor y líder de la banda, Axl Rose, fue la primera canción que ellos escribieron. No hablaremos de las distintas versiones que existen de esta canción, sino que nos centraremos principalmente en su letra y significado. Don't Cry es una Power Ballad de Guns N' Roses que fue creada justo después de un rompimiento. Es por eso que su letra nos habla de una pareja que está pasando por una especie de duelo y uno de los dos le dice a la otra persona que “no bajes la cabeza con tristeza”, también le menciona que “sé cómo te sientes por dentro, yo he estado allí antes”, dándonos así una demostración de afecto y comprensión. Pero también hay frases como “no llores esta noche, aún te amo, nena”, lo cual nos deja claro que esto se debe a una ruptura. La frase “no te lo tomes tan a pecho ahora”, nos demuestra un intento de aliviar la situación y la depresión del momento, sobre todo cuando también agrega frases como “hay un cielo encima de tí, nena”, lo cual significa que hay cosas mucho más grandes e importantes por las que recordar estar vivo y ser feliz. Esta carta de consuelo y desamor acompaña de forma perfecta la canción con su melodía lenta y sus solos de guitarra tan icónicas que tiene.

> Finally, we conclude this collection with the most popular song from my old Playlist, which is also this Rock band’s most-streamed song on YouTube and various digital platforms. A song that has stood the test of time, breaking through the barriers of time and charting on various lists in every decade since the 1990s. November Rain is another Power Ballad that is also part of the studio album Use Your Illusion I. The song tells the story of a relationship going through various difficult moments described as a “November rain.” The lyrics describe a “restrained love” shared by this couple, who have experienced this many times throughout their long history. Phrases like “because nothing lasts forever” suggest a kind of fragility in the relationship they share, which is compared to “holding a candle in a cold November rain.” The “November rain” may refer to the problems that arise in life, especially in a couple who have been through so much over the years. This is confirmed by the line “do you need some time on your own?”, which refers to having time alone. We all go through difficult times, but I believe that in a relationship it is much harder because you must not only look out for your own well-being but also for your partner’s. That, combined with making her happy, fulfills your role as a partner by giving her all the love she deserves and everything she needs—which isn’t always easy to achieve. Amid all this, it’s easy to encounter a huge number of problems, difficulties, arguments, and disagreements that are like a “November rain.” And no, it’s not one of those rains that’s pleasant to watch, but rather one of those heavy, prolonged downpours that seem to have no end. Something I’d like to add about this song isn’t just its emotional lyrics and the story it tries to tell us, but the important lesson it leaves us with: to take time alone to reflect on things and move forward afterward. Every relationship, no matter how close it is, deserves time alone to see things from a more independent perspective. Another thing that fascinates me about this song is the musical composition, which is accompanied from the beginning and in parts of the song by a sort of symphony orchestra. The opening with Axl Rose on piano is fascinating, but nothing compared to Slash making his electric guitar wail between each chorus of the song.

>
Finalmente, concluimos esta colección con la canción más sonada de mi antigua Playlist, la cual a su vez es la canción más sonada en Youtube y en distintas plataformas digitales de esta banda de Rock. Una canción que pasó a la posteridad, logrando romper con la barrera del tiempo y que consiguió posicionarse en varias listas en cada década posterior a los años 90. November Rain es otra Power Ballad que también forma parte del álbum de estudio Use Your Illusion I. La canción nos habla de una relación que pasa por diversos momentos difíciles descritos como una “lluvia de noviembre”. La letra nos describe un “amor contenido” que posee esta pareja de protagonistas quienes en su larga historia han pasado por esto muchas veces. Frases como “porque nada dura para siempre” nos denota una especie de fragilidad en dicha relación que poseen ambos y que es comparada como “sostener una vela, en una fría lluvia de noviembre”. La “lluvia de noviembre” puede llegar a referirse a los problemas que hay en la vida, en especial en una pareja que han pasado por tantas cosas durante años. Esto lo confirma con la frase “do you need some time on your own?”, lo cual se refiere a tener un tiempo a solas. Los tiempos difíciles los tenemos todos, pero considero que en una relación es mucho más fuerte ya que no solo debes de velar por tu bien sino también por el de tu pareja. Eso, sumado a hacerla feliz, cumple con tu rol de pareja dándole todo el amor que merece y todo lo necesario, lo cual no siempre es fácil de conseguir. Entre todo esto es fácil encontrar una cantidad enorme de problemas, dificultades, discusiones y desacuerdos que son como una “lluvia de noviembre”. Y no, no es de esas lluvias que son agradables de ver, sino de esas lluvias fuertes y extensas que no parecen tener fin. Algo que me gustaría añadir de esta canción no es solo su emotiva letra e historia que nos intenta contar, sino la lección importante que nos deja de tomarnos nuestro tiempo a solas para recapacitar las cosas y seguir adelante luego. Toda relación, por muy unida que sea, merece de su tiempo a solas para ver las cosas de una forma más independiente. Otra cosa que me fascina de esta canción es la composición musical que va acompañada desde el principio y en partes de la canción con una especie de orquesta sinfónica. El inicio con el piano de Axl Rose es fascinante, pero nada comparado con Slash haciendo llorar a su guitarra eléctrica entre cada estribillo de la canción.

>
Tell me, are you also familiar with the band Guns N’ Roses? Which of their songs is your favorite? Leave your answer in the comments.

>
Dime, ¿también conoces a la banda Guns N’ Roses? ¿Cuál de todas sus canciones es tu favorita? Déjame tu respuesta en los comentarios.

links.title: El falso desmayo /The Fake Faint
links.body:
<center>

En el armario hay un animal
colorido y que bien escondido está,
llega una zarigüeya al lugar,
con una patilla partida por la mitad
y el del armario se asoma para observar.

La zarigüeya va por èl hasta el armario
y le ayuda a salir despacio,
le entrega la comida que ha llevado
y se va por un rato,
dejando al animal bien alimentado. 

>There’s an animal in the closet,
colorful and well hidden,
a possum comes along,
with a split sideburn,
and the one in the closet peeks out to watch.

>The opossum leads him to the closet
and helps him out slowly,
hands him the food it brought
and leaves for a while,
leaving the animal well fed.

![48034.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/23zS9KS71tfnTy4CVXgjY1M6b1eXbsP6pTk5kQkpDu1DPZfScFwVLuwFgBy6yGpBEKL3b.gif)

Cuando la zarigüeya regresa,
al animal desmayado encuentra,
se angustia y lo alza con cautela,
en su espalda se lo cuelga
y sale de la madriguera. 

Llega hasta la ciudad
y comienza a gritar,
pide ayuda para el animal,
que desmayado está 
y ahí podría su vida terminar.

>When the opossum returns,
it finds the animal unconscious,
it panics and lifts it up carefully,
hoists it onto its back,
and leaves the burrow.

>It makes its way to the city
and starts shouting,
asking for help for the animal,
which is unconscious
and could die right there.

![48035.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/23xKvQbdTto9c25RnMxJqz22PcbKvzWAVwLwZGHgvZuxbAihUZ1ffYqmDWWKwqJeuTL5Z.gif)

Una hoja escucha el clamor 
y se acerca para saber que pasó,
revisa el animal con precaución 
y le susurra una canción 
porque sabe que este no se desmayó.

El animal estaba dormido
y al hablarle al oído,
se levanta solito
y se va con la zarigüeya al escondrijo
dónde siempre han vivido.

>A leaf hears the commotion
and creeps closer to see what happened,
carefully checks on the animal
and whispers a song to it
because it knows the animal hasn’t fainted.

>The animal was asleep,
and when the leaf spoke softly in its ear,
it got up on its own
and followed the opossum to their hideout,
where they’ve always lived.

![48036.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/23yJNWbhg9KoL1mwZ8zr6ECCfgZhvLKVJJ9zEba6bo93byMnpa7DZRYYm8YNeog3VJZZF.gif)

Que graciosa situación,
un animal se duerme sin control,
su amiga cree que se desmayó,
busca ayuda y lo que encontró,
es que no estaba desmayado como lo pensó. 

>What a funny situation,
an animal falls asleep without a care in the world,
its friend thinks it fainted,
runs for help, and what she finds
is that it wasn't fainted after all. 

</center>

<center>
![InShot_20230630_124621147.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/EoAfYKqkd84fmD8iEEbc9Es3YuzFg1JTfQ4Hw7VLmJMMx3Db3HdE4WL8Y1yyd2Ms4vL.gif)
</center>

This *goals-and-progress* post serves as my weekly participation in the We Are Alive Tribe's Monday ***'Share Your Goals and Progress'*** Challenge, and in the SlothBuzz's ***Slothly Savers Club***. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) Warm greetings all! 😁🙏💚✨🤙 Welcome to my ***206th Sunday Weekly Hive Goals and Progress Update***! Well, as you might notice, this weekly report was published late yet again. I just can't seem to get it written and published by Monday morning any more, much to my chagrin. All asset data was recorded at that time, however. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) There are only two notable bits of news to mention from last week that come to mind. The first is that I smashed 19,100 HP last week, I just blew past 19,200 HP today (*this is not recorded in the numbers below, since it happened after collecting the numbers*), and that I very well may reach 19,300 HP before the end of the week. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) The other news to share from last week is that, for the first time in multiple years, I didn't do my regular daily Hive asset management, fitting in time to do so maybe every 3 days or so. There were two main reasons for this, firstly, my several of my HP leases to @centtoken got messed up, which means that I had notably less SWAP.HIVE with which to do my asset management, and secondly, my strong focus in my daily research, experimentation, and work into building an agentic-AI operating system using the Hermes Agent has swallowed me whole and taken much of my 'free' time. It also doesn't help that the present state of Hive mostly just makes me feel sad, and exactly because I love this blockchain so much, so it hurts to see it as it is now. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) I pray that those of us who have chosen to stay and to continue building and growing on Hive will be able to turn things around for the better. That's about all I've got for now. May the asset assessment commence! ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) #### ***Last Sunday's Hive Stats*** ``` 19,044.727 Hive Power 637.986 HBD in Savings 73.38 Reputation ``` ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) #### ***Hive Stats Today*** ``` 19,172.760 Hive Power 637.986 HBD in Savings 73.42 Reputation ``` ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) #### ***2026 Hive Goals and Progress*** ``` Goal/Last Week/Today/Progress Over the Week/To Go Hive Power: 25,000/19,044.727/19,172.760/+128.033/5,827.24 HBD in Savings: 750/637.985/637.986/+0/112.014 Reputation: no goal, but tracking/73.38/73.42/+0.04/* ALIVE: 100,000 Staked (not delegated)/48,725.4885/48,725.4885/+0/51,274.5115 BBH: 100,000/51,856.56/52,063.22/+206.66/47,936.78 BBHO: no goal, but tracking/27,127.65648233/27,371.70369146/+244.04720913/* DAB (Liquid): 1,000/125.239/128.458/+3.219/871.542 DAB (Staked): no goal set yet/6.919/6.919/+0/* DBOND (Staked): 1,000/990.34946191/991.00465106/+0.65518915/8.99534894 DUO: no goal, but tracking/216.1014/216.2014/+0/* RUG: 1,000/201.405/201.405/+0/798.595 ``` ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) #### [***My Hivebuzz Ranking***](https://hivebuzz.me/ranking) ``` Today/Last Sunday 871/870 for HP - ⬇️ 1 places from last week 610/611 for HBD in Savings - ⬆️ 1 places from last week 1520/1530 Reputation - ⬆️ 10 places from last week ``` ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) Over the past week I gained ***+128.033 Hive Power***, ***0+ HBD in Savings***, and ***+0.04 Reputation Points***, which means that I still have ***5,827.24 HP*** and ***112.014 HBD in Savings*** to go to achieve my 2026 year-end goals. I will likely reach my HP goal without needing any external boosts, though achieving my goal for HBD in Savings is indeed looking like it may no longer be feasible, considering the present condition of the Hive economy. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) In terms of my HiveBuzz rankings, I dropped ***-1 place*** for HP, I inched up ***+1 place*** for HBD in Savings, and I jumped up ***+10 places*** for Reputation, so a rather mediocre week indeed on this front, even dropping in one ranking. links.title: Local police ask for our help in \
a stray dog
links.body: It's not often that the police have any interactions with us but this time I was quite happy that they even are aware of our organization.  Hopefully this is a partnership that we can utilize in the future because although there is no official word on this, it is suspected that the police engage in an annual \

of the street dog population once it gets out of control.  This is done under cover of darkness and I have never witnessed it, but I have noticed a sudden and dramatic drop in strays after a certain time of the year.  

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kbv.animalwelf/23wqgaJ7TgxQDT4ATDwbEwb2uUK6PmbmoCqRsHjcSwMfUaNrjiXkCPBrSsLiA2XiKcote.png)
</center> 

We were contacted about a dog that frequents the grounds of the police station and officers had tried to capture her in the past but failed at doing so.  They heard, correctly I might add, that we specialize in capturing animals for the sake of sterilization and vaccination and then release them back from whence they came.  It took us quite a while to capture this \

but in the end we got her, and even two of her puppies as well.

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kbv.animalwelf/23tmKrSgRviMS1XGxKLyVrue9cmyNWv65t94osBsL1KufaREkVMf8pJRnrkAptpKoDfu7.png)
 </center> 

She wasn't very happy when the cage closed behind her, and was a bit aggressive towards us when we carried her out of there.  We have a lot of experience in this realm as well as protective gear including gloves and if need be, sedatives.   I do NOT recommend that anyone without the proper equipment attempt to do this because even though this mama-dog doesn't really want to hurt us, she was afraid and protecting her pups.  This can be a very dangerous situation for people that don't know what they are doing.

From locals we had heard that this mother has had pups at least twice and what ends up happening is that most of the pups end up dying.  While nobody can confirm this with any sort of evidence, this is normally what happens with the strays.  If it isn't disease or malnourishment, traffic will get a lot of them as well as poisoning if they become a nuisance.

Now that we and the police have worked together on this one, we can be guaranteed that this mom and her pups will be \

to anyone in the community that might want to do them harm.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kbv.animalwelf/EokdeJBvHnj7WeG1Ap5BhBt8pUhasp2rNu4cw8or4zzCYEgkDTvGnKunFLifakPB5ST.png)
All of them were picked up, sterilized, vaccinated, treated for parasites, and then returned to where we found them. As we walked away mama was already kind of familiar with us, and no longer saw us as a threat. One of pups tried to follow us as we left. Sorry little buddy! We'll be back to check on you I promise.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kbv.animalwelf/23tmWuTdymcrjxyBW6z73cAiAuei1MWiNdSvqjNK5kow9XJqeHsxnWr7jvGywVyQNJdkF.png)
Mama was a bit more expedient in her running away as soon as we got back to the impound yard that was her home. We confirmed that she reunited with her pups, left them some food, and then we departed. We did ask the police to please keep an eye on them and then left them some dog food to feed them with. I like that the community is aware of what we are here for and we are always happy to help in situations like this. If we work together things can be done so much more efficiently! Plus, it never hurts to have buddies that are police, that is always handy.
If you would like to see how you can help out or simply spread the word, please visit our website at

http://krabianimalwelfare.org

![21462758_174743779763179_4154543215066704521_n.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmXHEhXj4e6AzsbAJKsFo8csozuoq1uUcMSdFQTYifzi55/21462758_174743779763179_4154543215066704521_n.jpg)
Krabi Animal Welfare is a charity run entirely by volunteers and are a registered non-profit organization in Thailand and the U.K.. We aim to relieve the pain and suffering of dogs and cats within Krabi Province. เป็นผู้สนับสนุนรายเดือนหรือบริจาคครั้งเดียวได้ที่: http://krabianimalwelfare.org

body.title: WALKING DEAD: THE SILENT DEATH OF YOUNG PEOPLE 💔
body.body:
[
![geraldoswald62-blood-pressure-monitor-1749577_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tobywalter/243M9WGm8RtrSqnuH9x1ne2SNFVm19ZgYVHG8hSqLt3wnK3DpsQQdEjLkjn1BNk8Vdzn2.jpg)
](https://pixabay.com/images/search/health%20is%20wealth%20/)
I took my time to carry out a personal study on why so many young people between the ages of 30 and 45 are dying these days.
From my observations and research, I discovered that many of these deaths are linked to heart attacks, hypertension, kidney failure, liver problems, stress-related illnesses, and other health complications.
Within just two months, I can count about four to five people I personally know within this age range who lost their lives as a result of one or more of these conditions. Honestly, this is very alarming and heartbreaking. 😢
One of them was a very close friend of mine. He called me one day asking for just ₦1000 for support, but unfortunately, I was already tied up with another commitment and could not send it immediately. I planned to send it the next morning.
Sadly, before the next morning came, another friend sent me his obituary picture 

![Screenshot_20260513-054855_WhatsApp.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tobywalter/23zGcWAGvPKZxRr58x4FXpChSXoLSocQvVCanJGahxAijavEbFs7pncTHHXG2TZYQFsFo.jpg)
I was shocked. I felt terrible within me because I kept asking myself: what exactly was he going through at that moment when he called me?
**During our conversation, he said:
\

Those were his last words to me before he passed away. 💔
![IMG-20260417-WA0005.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tobywalter/23t76tfxYfAA7uRVhJxpYrCqYK1jio59zKjWetLcjwbvYKVSBEuByXjvnob3qfsX2WCgm.jpg)

Later, it was reported that he slumped in the bathroom and died. What could have gone wrong? Hypertension? Heart failure? Depression? Stress? Nobody really knows.
The second person was another young man I watched a Manchester United match with just two weeks earlier. According to neighbors, after the match, he still went to another relaxation spot to play pool before heading home.
When he got home, his wife served him food and he sat on the couch to rest. A few minutes later, the wife went into the room to rest too. But when she came back outside after some time, she met him gasping for breath and struggling to breathe.
Before they could rush him to the nearest hospital, it was already too late. He was gone.
Out of the five people I mentioned, at least three reportedly died from hypertension and heart-related complications.
Another young man slumped and died on the football field during a match.
All these situations have kept me thinking deeply: What is really happening? Why are young people dying this way?
Is it because of the hardship in the country and the pressure people face daily? 🤔
Should we blame the government?
Is it the lack of proper medical facilities and healthcare?
Or is it because many people ignore the little warning signs their bodies give them?
Could it also be the kind of food we consume daily — too much processed food, junk food, and unhealthy eating habits?
Or should we talk about drug abuse and the dangerous intake of substances like marijuana, weed, codeine, and other hard drugs?
These are questions that continue to bother my mind because the rate at which young people are dying is becoming frightening.
As for my conclusion:
No matter how little, when someone asks for your help, try your best to assist if you can. You may unknowingly be saving a life at that moment.
Secondly, we must learn to pay attention to our health. Regular medical checkups are important. Many people ignore symptoms until it becomes too late.
Drug abuse also kills silently. The use of hard drugs among young people today is becoming extremely alarming, and this issue must be treated seriously by both society and the government.
To the government, we need a system that truly works — good hospitals, quality healthcare, affordable treatment, and better medical facilities so people will not be afraid or unable to seek medical help.
The government should also provide basic amenities, create job opportunities, and build an environment where citizens can live healthier and less stressful lives.
We must also learn to eat healthy foods instead of constantly consuming junk food. Many people hardly eat fruits anymore. 😢
At the end of the day, health is wealth.
We must all do our best to live healthy lifestyles, both young and old, because life itself is fragile and tomorrow is never promised. 💔
### Thanks for visiting my blog @tobywalter cares ###

# # Proceso de curación en Literatos # En la comunidad de literatura en español, [Literatos](https://hive.blog/trending/hive-179291), hemos puesto todo nuestro empeño en impulsar todas las áreas del arte escrito y hemos venido brindando apoyo a los autores, mediante un proceso de selección del contenido a votar que es manual,llevado a cabo por los integrantes del equipo. El proceso de votación sí se realiza mediante un sistema automatizado, que también deja el comentario en cada publicación apoyada, pero la valoración de las publicaciones responde a la interacción directa. Adicionalmente hemos tomado la iniciativa de hacer esta publicación, una vez a la semana, para contribuir a destacar algunos contenidos que, a nuestro modo de ver, requieren de más difusión, y así brindar un impulso adicional para los autores y sus obras publicadas en **Hive**. title.title: 🎨✏️ Greetings Sketchbook Hive Community | Pencil Character Design ✏️🎨/🎨✏️ Saludos Comunidad Sketchbook de Hive | Diseño de Personaje a Lápiz ✏️🎨
title.body: > Today I want to share a **traditional pencil illustration** created completely by me 🖤✨ This artwork represents the **beauty, confidence, and strength of Black women**, combined with a futuristic and adventurous character design 👑⚡🏍️ From the beginning, my goal was to create a character that looked powerful but also elegant — someone with attitude, style, and personality 💥

></center>

🖊️ **Drawing Process & Professional Techniques:**  
I started with a **basic construction sketch**, using simple geometric forms to organize the anatomy and proportions 📐  
Then I refined the silhouette and worked on the pose to create a dynamic composition connected to the motorcycle 🏍️

✨ **Professional Art Elements Used:**

*   **Gesture drawing** for body movement and posture 💃
    
*   **Line weight variation** to define depth and focal points 🖋️
    
*   **Cross-hatching and graphite shading** for volume and texture 🌑
    
*   Stylized anatomy inspired by **cartoon and comic art** 🎭
    
*   Use of **contrast between dark and light values** to emphasize the character design ⚫⚪
    

💡 **Character Design Details:**  
The outfit and accessories were inspired by futuristic biker aesthetics 🏍️⚡  
The helmet, boots, and gloves help reinforce the adventurous personality of the character, while the facial expression keeps a calm but confident attitude 😎

🌟 **Meaning Behind the Artwork:**  
This drawing is a celebration of feminine power and creativity. I wanted to represent a Black woman as fearless, stylish, and strong the kind of character that immediately catches attention 🔥👑

💬 Let me know what you think!  
  
❤️ Thank you for supporting my art journey!

* * *

Hoy quiero compartir con ustedes una **ilustración tradicional realizada completamente a lápiz** 🖤✨

Este dibujo representa la **belleza, confianza y fuerza de la mujer negra**, combinada con un diseño de personaje futurista y aventurero 👑⚡🏍️

Desde el inicio, mi objetivo fue crear un personaje que transmitiera poder y elegancia al mismo tiempo alguien con actitud, estilo y personalidad 💥

🖊️ **Proceso y Técnicas Profesionales:**  
Comencé con un **boceto estructural básico**, utilizando formas geométricas simples para organizar la anatomía y las proporciones 📐  
Luego refiné la silueta y trabajé la pose para lograr una composición dinámica conectada con la motocicleta 🏍️

✨ **Elementos Artísticos Utilizados:**

*   **Gesture drawing** para el movimiento corporal 💃
    
*   **Variación de grosor de línea** para crear profundidad 🖋️
    
*   **Sombreado en grafito y cross-hatching** para dar volumen y textura 🌑
    
*   Anatomía estilizada inspirada en el **arte cómic y caricatura** 🎭
    
*   Uso de **contraste entre luces y sombras** para destacar el diseño ⚫⚪
    

💡 **Detalles del Diseño:**  
El vestuario y accesorios están inspirados en una estética futurista de motociclista 🏍️⚡  
El casco, las botas y los guantes ayudan a reforzar la personalidad aventurera del personaje, mientras que la expresión facial transmite seguridad y actitud 😎

🌟 **Significado de la Obra:**  
Este dibujo es una celebración del poder femenino y la creatividad. Quise representar a una mujer negra fuerte, elegante y sin miedo un personaje capaz de llamar la atención desde el primer momento 🔥👑

💬 ¡Déjame saber qué opinas!  
  
❤️ Gracias por apoyar mi arte y creatividad
