title.title: [ENG/ESP] A workday Wednesday with a taste of Margarita.
title.body: > **I wish you all a happy day, friends of #wednesdaywalk. I sincerely hope you’re doing well and that this new day gives you reasons to smile. Today I’m especially happy to share another tour with you, thanks to @tattoodjay initiative, which I enjoy so much and has become a lovely weekly tradition. As usual, we set out early to do our work. The day was beautiful, though a bit stifling; from very early on, the sun made its presence felt with exaggerated intensity, as if to remind us that in Margarita, the weather has a personality all its own. Even so, that strong glare also has its charm, because it allows us to capture beautiful photos along the way, and of course I took advantage of the clear, radiant sky to snap several shots. When the weather is this sunny, it’s impossible to forget the sunscreen and the water bottle. Staying hydrated is vital, especially when you spend so much time outdoors. Amidst beautiful landscapes and the blue sea along our routes, we arrived at the day’s destination: Sunsol Isla Caribe. We didn’t stay even ten minutes, because we were only there to deliver a quote for a pending job. It was a quick visit. When we were done, we decided to stop by a section of Playa El Tirano where there are some benches facing the sea, made by the locals themselves.**

> *Feliz día les deseo, amigos de #wednesdaywalk , espero sinceramente que estén bien y que este nuevo día les regale motivos para sonreír. Hoy me encuentro especialmente contenta por compartir con ustedes otro recorrido más, gracias a la iniciativa de @tattoodjay , que tanto disfruto y que se ha convertido en una bonita costumbre semanal. Como de costumbre, salimos temprano a realizar nuestro trabajo. El día estaba hermoso, aunque un tanto sofocante; desde muy temprano el sol se hacía notar con una intensidad exagerada, como si quisiera recordarnos que en Margarita el clima tiene personalidad propia. Aun así, ese brillo tan fuerte también tiene su encanto, porque permite capturar fotos preciosas durante el recorrido, y por supuesto aproveché para tomar varias gracias a ese cielo despejado y radiante. Cuando el clima está así de soleado, es imposible olvidar el bloqueador solar y el termo de agua. Mantenerse hidratado es vital, sobre todo cuando se pasa tanto tiempo al aire libre. Entre paisajes hermosos y ese azul del mar en nuestras rutas, llegamos al destino del día; Sunsol Isla Caribe. No nos demoramos ni diez minutos, porque solo íbamos a entregar un presupuesto de un trabajo pendiente. Fue una visita rápida. Al terminar, decidimos pasar por un sector de Playa El Tirano donde hay unos bancos mirando al mar, hechos por los mismos lugareños.*
![photo_2026-05-12_22-48-58 (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/23xKvAZNDN8xRTDTBHkMMGm9UE2FzrXezp2CxyPkxQXMawdC4gWPNkNF3C3rpxxuqYoL6.jpg) ![z.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Ep3eKxGKaSb7BYKc1yZYfusMaHKzLtT37CDEU7Fy19BcTMBW8LXBgXkXjhuhfqDBTz3.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-12_22-48-45.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpCBnqCFx4Ki45GiSrrvLBWLDe695owsuVJc865K33Q2fLFJZ6zZWNq2weuV3dPvseZ.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-12_22-48-43.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eos2HSEn2snYpH1hjgDwmni6Ea5BPT8ZDKmxikLGNsZCuMji4nD1gtJt3PxR6S2cnZv.jpg)

> **I love that place; it’s one of my husband’s and my favorite spots. It has something special about it—a sense of calm that envelops you the moment you sit down. Time there passes like a sea breeze: gently, very lightly, almost without you noticing.**

> *Ese lugar me encanta; es uno más de los preferidos de mi esposo y mío. Tiene algo especial, una calma que te envuelve apenas te sientas. El tiempo allí se va como la brisa marina; suave, muy ligero, casi sin que uno lo note.*
![photo_2026-05-12_22-48-42.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpGQmqeNuYje6uGc1HLqjbfj1od4iCPkAuCfkEL8pqmezMwFzWmzswYNHb6gJep1t2m.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-12_22-48-36 (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpzxiyfMBovRubfdAD8i11jhvdodWrbKXnYuC8BrY6mni5QPKJcUkpe9uzEZdsofisz.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-12_22-48-33.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EonkWbkxiAjp32Mc2Xg4hMzrnVrXts9vUKQQSvZGQQCH66jStHHqKT4G3WAZeNZKdqQ.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-12_22-48-32.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Ep3foMYZcs2Yo2C65UkAEpg3tUbdkM7eEWyqfrwr6UpEC8xMpHjy5efZWBUUMvkSLBA.jpg)

> **This time, something caught our attention: the sardine nets—nets that fishermen use to catch sardines—were set out in the sea. They seemed to be full, because there were so many birds fluttering above them. And if the birds are there, it’s a sure sign of abundance.**

> *En esta ocasión, algo nos llamó la atención: en el mar estaban colocados los chinchorros sardineros, unas redes que usan los pescadores para atrapar sardinas. Al parecer estaban repletos, porque había muchísimas aves revoloteando encima. Y si las aves están allí, es señal segura de abundancia.*
![photo_2026-05-12_22-48-50.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpEGR9QiRCcYEo8kVfQv32rcBfTaE361Z9xA4vxxePW71gc2WKicDh3v3Wr8wPdrx96.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-12_22-48-30.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eq35huLuL6aUZobiix4thufWtqQFjsz91XecyJ33i52RzTt6A6zPDXjHskaSRX9mP8L.jpg)

> **On the shore, I saw a family of fishermen pulling their boat out of the water, and they were the ones who explained the chinchorros to me. I’ll be honest with you; I don’t know much about fishing, but I love learning, and of course, I love fish.**

> *En la orilla vi a una familia de pescadores sacando su bote del mar, y fueron ellos quienes me explicaron lo de los chinchorros. Les soy honesta; no sé mucho de estas labores de pesca, pero me encanta aprender y, por supuesto, me encanta el pescado.*
![photo_2026-05-12_22-56-10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpEGNQgXJswWhzk7uQUeuCPSFq4ojdPbFuYKsLK6ATTrnhLevREBxfkSrVMgG5Hg12c.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-12_22-56-07.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Ep7uXi127ohaui8nECZDAK3ACMxbUyGenAjynQY8GFRJ1YDgf5wk6wT36ZvxVR7Wz4Y.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-12_22-48-40.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpT48S2YandgitRfbf3dfWPgNjMnULADdNzHpiWw3TA597C39pPVvuufd63UacsJJwk.jpg)

> **My husband and I had a wonderful time watching that little natural spectacle—the birds, the fishermen, the gentle sway of the sea… a simple scene, yet full of life. It’s amazing how such ordinary moments can turn into beautiful memories.**

> *Mi esposo y yo pasamos un buen rato contemplando ese pequeño espectáculo natural; las aves, los pescadores, el vaivén del mar… una escena sencilla, pero llena de vida. Es increíble cómo estos momentos tan cotidianos pueden convertirse en recuerdos hermosos.*
![photo_2026-05-12_22-48-39.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EowG2USg8q3mGQM2Thcp8bq7j1aWTmGNgumbQ7ZpMdW1Hvn9ARvHBGQmzjejv7eQvzX.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-12_22-48-37.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EptctZzz4afxBDwudo1QHjdo4gjT2VHCj2aCLn4c2K6BLD9cu9es9VCmLYJAC9f2ucm.jpg)

> **As always, the magic of the sea whets the appetite, and it was already past lunchtime. So we went out to find something delicious to eat. Very close to home, we found a place called Nela, located on 31 de Julio Avenue in the Cocheima neighborhood of the Arismendi municipality, here in Nueva Esparta. They serve set menus, soups, Creole cuisine, and dishes typical of Margarita. I had walked past it many times without stopping, caught up in the rush of daily life, but this time we decided to go in.**

> *Como siempre, la magia del mar abre el apetito, y ya era pasada la hora de almorzar. Así que nos fuimos a buscar algo rico para comer. Muy cerca de casa encontramos un local llamado Nela, ubicado en la avenida 31 de Julio, en el sector Cocheima, municipio Arismendi, aquí en Nueva Esparta. Venden menús, sopas, comida criolla y platos muy margariteños. Había pasado muchas veces por allí sin detenerme, por la prisa del día a día, pero esta vez decidimos entrar.*
![photo_2026-05-12_22-48-58.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/23ydCEcP7RS5DRpbwEqxuGf8xVWwYQHZbddFSnumPQXL2UQnJst4W6aMwJFGRYTYbuyWX.jpg)

> **The place is outdoors, very cool, with a delightful breeze. We ordered a cachapa and a serving of pork. The food was excellent, and the service was even better—friendly, quick, and with that typical charm of the locals. And the price was surprisingly reasonable. I’m picky about what I eat, and I was more than satisfied.**

> *El lugar es al aire libre, muy fresco, con una brisa deliciosa. Pedimos una cachapa y una ración de cochino. La comida estaba excelente, y la atención aún mejor; amable, rápida y con ese carisma típico de la gente de aquí. Y el precio, sorprendentemente bueno. Yo soy exigente con lo que como, y quedé más que complacida.*
![photo_2026-05-12_22-48-57.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Ep7uAxemAeCGrT3akP3BCHWL7jfqGVVL4EdAn1NsaH98ABKLvxfyMJEeGTYge4nuNpF.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-12_22-48-56.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Ep7u5B1d5C3gBmo7B8Q8W9bQwmzwjsyJkToSdgJaLVM4mqxhJd6Q9SXkCmu2X5SHm3o.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-12_22-48-55.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpEJK2dmceXvrehmMFNSpsy31FD9TF91nxB2JwscR44uEz7pkwbsTf81gAAGv5cNHAv.jpg)

> **After that delicious meal, we headed home with that inner joy that only the sea, a job well done, and the satisfaction of having enjoyed a simple yet special day can bring. I’ll see you in one of my next posts. See you soon. Bye.**

> *Después de esa comida deliciosa, regresamos a casa con esa alegría interior que solo dan el mar, el deber cumplido y la satisfacción de haber disfrutado un día sencillo pero especial. Los veré en otra de mis publicaciones. Hasta pronto. Chao.*
https://images.ecency.com/DQmX41osuLQUYYCyZK8X9Bw9HS64BTvn2S2qu3uWyowNJd4/la_laguna_tania5_copia.png

title.title: Challenge #04882-M133: Taming the Wild Child
title.body:
![ana-beatriz-7ntwSjz8HZE-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/internutter/23z7SisMSHNDbEwZBnH9QdJ5zprpi5FuYCL3fLjrjre2hmoQoCh8x2aUFWvmYX1MXk6VF.jpg)

> Wraithvine is trying to help a panicked child who ends up biting him in their terror. He does not pull his hand away, but rather, soothes and forgives the little one. -- Anon Guest

Of all the evils a modern world could commit, one of the top ten was dumping snare wire in the wilderness. Wraithvine considered it part of hir duties to find and destroy it whenever ze wandered through any part of nature. Judging strictly by the howling and snarling, some other creature of the woods had found it first.

By technicality alone, Wraithvine was correct. In that the small Hellkin had _also_ been dumped in the woods and found ways to survive. They had evidently done so by hissing at any intelligent creature, then scurrying away as fast as they could go.

This poor wretch was so entangled that hissing was all they had left.

Wraithvine had no idea what language they might know, but ze knew how to treat savage creatures. Soft, gentle voice and a calm demeanor. Nothing that would harm the poor soul. Make it clear with singsong and soothing touch, that ze was there to help.

That effort wasn't always successful.

Wraithvine showed the shears ze used to cut the wire, and demonstrated on a loop of the wire that ze allowed to entangle hir own arm. Next, a couple of loops that only helped keep the hissy Hellkin locked into place.

Finally, the piece of wire that worried Wraithvine the most. One too close to vital arteries.

_That_ was when the savage little Hellkin bit Wraithvine's hand. Sharp teeth sank into Elven flesh, but Wraithvine had no concerns for the wound. Ze worked on the restraining wire, retrieving hir hand when the child let go to move their head against the tangle.

Wraithvine healed the wound and offered a small meatball for them to bite instead. That earned a baffled look and some reduced struggling while still delivering suspicious glares. At least they couldn't bite any more while they were busy chewing.

\

Clip, clip, clip... ze kept hir shears working. When the Hellkin swallowed their last mouthful, ze produced another. All things that would cause little in the way of trouble.

The Hellkin stopped struggling after the third small vegetable fritter. Watching in silence as strand after strand of entangling wire came loose. They had _rapt_ attention whenever Wraithvine had a small length of snare wire, watching unmoving as ze used hir magic to crumble the wire to dust.

By the time the Unwelcome creature was fully free, they were handing loops of snare wire to Wraithvine.

Wraithvine offered foodstuffs as trade. Maintained the singsong, soothing chatter. It may be too late for the child to learn words, but they could understand ally from enemy.

By the time all of the wire was gone, ze had a friend eager to take hir hand and walk by hir side.

title.title: 😝National Fibromyalgia Awareness Day! / ¡Día Nacional de Concientización sobre la Fibromialgia! 😎
title.body: > National Fibromyalgia Awareness Day is observed annually on May 12 and aims to raise awareness of a condition that affects more than 12 million Americans. Fibromyalgia is a musculoskeletal syndrome associated with a variety of symptoms, including hypersensitivity to heat or cold, widespread pain, irritable bowel syndrome **(IBS)**, tender points, stiffness, numbness, decreased energy, sensitivity to light or noise, sensitivity to smells, anxiety, depression, and other symptoms. > El Día Nacional de Concienciación sobre la Fibromialgia se celebra anualmente el 12 de mayo y tiene como objetivo crear conciencia sobre una afección que afecta a más de 12 millones de estadounidenses. La fibromialgia es un síndrome musculoesquelético asociado a diversos síntomas, como hipersensibilidad al calor o al frío, dolor generalizado, síndrome del intestino irritable (SII), puntos sensibles, rigidez, entumecimiento, disminución de la energía, sensibilidad a la luz o al ruido, sensibilidad a los olores, ansiedad, depresión y otros síntomas. It is a chronic condition that medicine still doesn't fully understand. However, that doesn't mean there aren't effective treatments for those who suffer from it. This day was first commemorated in 1992, coinciding with **Florence Nightingale's** birthday. ***Why was this date chosen.?*** It was chosen because it is believed that this nurse suffered from conditions very similar to those experienced by people with fibromyalgia. This has led many people to speculate that she may have suffered from the disease. In **1998**, the National Fibromyalgia Association, founded by Lynne Matallana, officially established this day as an awareness day. > Se trata de una afección crónica que la medicina aún no comprende del todo. Sin embargo, eso no significa que no existan tratamientos eficaces para quienes la padecen. Este día se conmemoró por primera vez en 1992, coincidiendo con el cumpleaños de Florence Nightingale. ¿Por qué se eligió esta fecha? Se eligió porque se cree que esta enfermera padecía afecciones muy similares a las que sufren las personas con fibromialgia. Esto ha llevado a muchas personas a especular que podría haber padecido la enfermedad. En 1998, la Asociación Nacional de Fibromialgia, fundada por Lynne Matallana, estableció oficialmente este día como un día de concientización Fibromyalgia is usually diagnosed in middle age, but it can affect people of any age. - Cymbalta, Lyrica, and Savella are currently the three FDA-approved medications for treating fibromyalgia symptoms. - Consuming foods rich in omega-3 fatty acids may reduce nerve pain associated with fibromyalgia. - People with other painful conditions, such as rheumatoid arthritis, are at higher risk of developing fibromyalgia. > La fibromialgia suele diagnosticarse en la mediana edad, pero puede afectar a personas de cualquier edad. -Cymbalta, Lyrica y Savella son actualmente los tres medicamentos aprobados por la FDA para el tratamiento de los síntomas de la fibromialgia. -Consumir alimentos ricos en ácidos grasos Omega-3 puede reducir el dolor nervioso relacionado con la fibromialgia. -Las personas que padecen otras afecciones dolorosas, como la artritis reumatoide , tienen un mayor riesgo de desarrollar fibromialgia. https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thealliance/SszMQ6lq-thealliance20new20pagebreak.png ## Family Time!

title.title: 「生活」邂逅拉丁舞
title.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![jVjn2XMBV4RUqXit_IMG_7218.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrspointm/images/jVjn2XMBV4RUqXit_IMG_7218/jVjn2XMBV4RUqXit_IMG_7218.webp)
![Ci3iYzusmySbXZfy_IMG_7224.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrspointm/images/Ci3iYzusmySbXZfy_IMG_7224/Ci3iYzusmySbXZfy_IMG_7224.webp)
![SZGxQwqKa02Y0vSk_IMG_7225.jpeg](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrspointm/images/SZGxQwqKa02Y0vSk_IMG_7225/SZGxQwqKa02Y0vSk_IMG_7225.webp)
![Q7kQZgZ1pFZr5f37_IMG_7226.jpeg](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrspointm/images/Q7kQZgZ1pFZr5f37_IMG_7226/Q7kQZgZ1pFZr5f37_IMG_7226.webp)
![r5MfjRXUiug5SFm3_IMG_7227.jpeg](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrspointm/images/r5MfjRXUiug5SFm3_IMG_7227/r5MfjRXUiug5SFm3_IMG_7227.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

自从Sheya上一年级后，我就给她停掉了不少兴趣班。之前给她体验过很多课程：网球、钢琴、中国舞、爵士舞，还有体能课、平衡车，种类特别多，就是想让她多尝试，看看能不能坚持下来，找到自己真正喜欢的兴趣。

升入一年级后，她的课业渐渐变重，作业也越来越多。有时候上完一节网球课回到家都八点半了，再接着写作业，总要熬到十点。考虑到孩子的睡眠很重要，只能做出取舍，目前只保留了刚需、且她自己真心喜欢的练字和画画课。

停了网球课后，她就没有任何运动项目了，每天放学回家只顾着写作业，做完作业时间就很晚了，随便吃点水果，没多久就睡觉了。

我心里一直盘算着，想再给她找一门运动类的兴趣班。去年我去上瑜伽课，家里没人照看她，她就跟着过来等我。瑜伽教室那一层楼的正对面，刚好有一家拉丁舞工作室。当时里面的老师正在带两位成人跳恰恰，Sheya特别好奇，跑过去旁听，老师也十分热情，主动拉她进去体验了一节课。

课后她就跟我说想学拉丁舞。我起初担心她只是一时兴起，便观望了大半年。后来觉得拉丁舞离家近，上课耗时也不长，刚好能当作运动项目，索性就帮她跟老师约了一节一对一免费试课，时长一个半小时。昨天学校因为在进行模考，我刚好不用监考，等她放学吃完饭，就带着她过去了。

老师提前帮她备好了练功服和舞鞋，方便观察她的身形。先是带她做了热身，又教了几个基础动作，主要测评她的身形和柔韧度。

这位老师是我接触过所有兴趣班里态度最好的，待人热情真诚，不刻意，特别懂孩子，也很擅长跟小朋友沟通，说话方式孩子很容易接受，全程都是以鼓励为主，真的特别适合Sheya。她一下子就喜欢上老师，也表示想要跟着学，当场就让我给她报名上课。

我还是怕她只是一时新鲜，所以先只给她报了30节课，价格也不贵，算下来一节课60元，还是一对二，我先看看她能不能坚持。如果能坚持下去，后面再让她接着学。不得不说，她一穿上拉丁舞练功服，瞬间就有种长成大姑娘的感觉了。

---

title.title: Vines of love, Bunches of joy: Our Journey of Growing Grapes in our Mini Garden
title.body:
![Your paragraph text.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mustbe1nfinity/EpEKCtTNkYTDMXTa1KiyCeBhgBp8YA2gKt1DwCwczoD4vb1PQ8JLrrJuk2kJzCnvUS9.jpeg)


A grape day to this wonderful community! Im excited to share to you how our home vineyard brings a lot of everyday wonderful vibes to us.

We have a mini-garden in our front yard where we grow grapes. The garden is covered with UV plastic that serves as roof and green house, attached to small angle bars and metal poles. Found inside are nine mature grapevines planted in rows: three vines on the center, three on the left and three on the right. These vines include two grapes varieties: Baikunor and Bravissimo. The grapevine leaves and its cooling shade also add charm to our front-yard scenery. 

![IMG_4557.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mustbe1nfinity/23wMf8hEZfGxQm7NtHUXVJCvRsvk52LFhJUxC5YGdmFTigKG7dnQup3skaRZs1pko3ziQ.jpeg)

At first, my husband was very hesitant to plant grapes in our garden, afraid that we will only fail because we have no idea how to take care of them and we were told that the seasons and unpredictable weather here are not suitable for grapes. Yet, with mix of hesitation and stubbornness, we took the risk (haha).

We started the process by propagating or rooting the grape cuttings. When small roots are already growing, we then transferred the rooted cuttings into the concrete box in the greenhouse to let them grow freely.


![IMG_3461.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mustbe1nfinity/EpA4TU76BNwE7Yk7xGSZvytxEwKknQx25ByoDJzuh5cg1MdoWQRprsLAtEgRNrtpCsW.jpeg)


![IMG_3451.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mustbe1nfinity/EoCk7GAE7RXUvuYccQEZxH246nw4nTySGXSVqTK8maKAfxcWNhaQiSomQDACi6prx9t.jpeg)


![IMG_4558.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mustbe1nfinity/23vhz2CrqNLYjB56FjhupmirnY8Q6JAnK5LE5MgCrdeUzXPpibKa2DdaKS5n3HjsmtmVu.jpeg)

I thought at first that grapes will only grow in cold places but I learned that they are sun-lovers. During summer, the vines grow well as they receive abundant sunlight. Flowers began to blossom and tiny clusters of its berries start to peek through.  Each time I see those tiny bunches, I am very happy counting each of them, as those clusters promise something good is coming and watching each berry grow brings me happiness. Eventually, the bunches start to change color, from bright green to reddish which is called as Veraison stage.


![IMG_4452.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mustbe1nfinity/23wgU9j45EXhnMFcD9FzsE8WNocZhQoTbw3g2VkEmEdnADpiFXjGBB4tZhYoS2UnKEwvJ.jpeg)

![IMG_4453.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mustbe1nfinity/23wMiu31s9xxFsmwoDQdd9dSouUiPzcidNVmXksarHPgd2wmyM4M7KJ2uHG2RvaTKhpvx.jpeg)


When the grapes clusters have grown heavy, their color will tell us that they are now ready for picking (dark red for Baikunor and black for Bravissimo). But this is also the time that little enemies will swarm up north - ants’ march, birds’ ambush, molds in the air - all locked in their target. So, to protect the bunches, we cover each of them with screen. Every morning, we check the screen covers to make sure they are still intact and doing their job (haha).


![IMG_4643.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mustbe1nfinity/Ep1YSTQcuxfD7wgji9dTSc7eFv6QHCWPLgXWpcVr9XQmTgGcLVegeCFaUVaMYxprkH2.jpeg)



![IMG_4620.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mustbe1nfinity/23xemq1coiMCtMFbprwZYkyy4FDeyDxuBRBsYwBHwcG9XE3XgkgEmk4dmsJs1PNDvEngZ.jpeg)



![IMG_4610.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mustbe1nfinity/23ynagU7mdRmFZZZmLuWSdCd6vjYcMKcZCx7MTdEZNMPDH9DPYpEdoaCfL533a84HX4cE.jpeg)

To spread the happy vibes of picking grapes, I and my husband then invite our relatives and close friends to have a picnic under the grapevine canopy. With their playful teasing, laughter and comforting presence under our mini vineyard are moments I don’t want to miss. 

We also share the grapes bunch to our neighbors for free and sometimes to people who just pass by our house asking permission if they can have pictures with the grapes. Their smiles after tasting the grapes are all we need.


![IMG_4634.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mustbe1nfinity/23x1DPzWB2oZD62ZWGEwQypJz4K6NhXtKra4RhZjKssQuGyWq9sEnTyMzjrbqzohWE9w5.jpeg)

Our mini vineyard yields fruits twice a year and those twice moments always give me something to look forward to, happiness that doubles when shared with people. We’re planning to add different varieties soon. Do you know other grape varieties to recommend that are easy to grow? Whatever the result may be, I’m sure every bunch will give us another set of pure bliss.

And I’m always grapeful for this! 🩷

(P.S. Photos are mine and originally owned, shots personally taken from our garden using my iPhone 14 Pro; Lead photo is edited in Canva for collage finish)

title.title: Walking Towards Roro, Cordova, Cebu
title.body:
Have a great day everyone . 
Sharing my walk towards Roro, Cordova, Cebu . The place to unwind and do the routine like walking and jogging then you can eat seafoods at the side walk along the shore. 

![1000090267.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/48KbwPMw8MZawMrNYp5dZpfMi4QC4mR7MN31CwRrHSe9CubTxtmSiEr2wcF3C3gmBe.png)
After officiating basketball games in Bang-Bang, Cordova , I spent a little time to visit Roro, Cordova. 
The term Roro refers to Roll-On, Roll-off ships which are designed to carry cars,trucks, trailers etcetera  travelling back and fort from Roro Cordova to Getafe, Bohol. 
The Roro road is very busy everyday. 
On its side walk , there were joggers mostly residents of Cordova nearby. 

![1000090236.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/EoeFReXqfaMHNeUK1xSTeYG1LdjGahsKQxZzL6dZD51d1pHxP4brFjbjMB8QMFzc71R.jpg)

![1000090240.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/EoprQxebbM5xxVDR5jf5pPhkordAbEEErARMDEdZxk8bki9b26PwJ94VCpt8BgJuUqg.jpg)

![1000090238.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/EoGvXWwoKzEKGdEaurCpTGz5kcbhKAuR9umi6f9JgDmr4gzc5fTTkssWdf65uiav6j1.jpg)
As I extend my travel ahead of the Roro road , there I saw vendors on the side walk. The vendors'location is very nice where during night time you can feel the cold breeze from the sea and see the beautiful views of the sea between Cordova and Bohol . 
Along the side walk there were  vendors selling shells and seafoods and hanging rice . The air is very cool during night time . Some people went  there to have their dinner with family and friends . Others were stopped there before going to the Roro Port to travel Bohol, just to eat something like \

or spider shell. 

![1000090244.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/Eoe8cWYA5Ff4kA8wnHftCzmCcfA6tZGJheREKH7jgw1KGp5JEKZp1WsbwFpBj7urRfF.jpg)

![1000090245.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/Eoc5bTRJ2nFhJXUztr6kr3r7D5MG9gzXDPjHeWDGTUpiDvQZVrJJTETatvcEt9Up5LD.jpg)

![1000090246.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/EoEq2J69vmfi98vtqvXr4aXccJnaD9HpYWLCaEXqpdBoT3oHGPnKeLHNuxLYK5GaFfC.jpg)

![1000090247.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/Ep1XwvBXFjaQmunyUKad3hu3Gw9rvQEcJj1qg1VEFR1JaUW7WeUEUBU5WKskTp5Jmc1.jpg)

![1000090248.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/EoAYjyWkaFnJpcxH5eSrQx6jFC9C8Mz8zFyB1tfsndoVPQ72MN6nrxP12TFxwgtS2kB.jpg)

Some youngsters went there to have drink something and have talks just to pass the time before going bed . 
The place is the attraction now of residents due to its stunning views and cool breeze which are good for chilling. 
If you want to visit Cordova, Cebu, just stop in this place, Roro Cordova, for  sure  you really like it. 
If somebody here visited already in this place just share your  experiences below . 

Till my next blog my friends . 

Still I used canva to edit the lead pictures. 
God bless us all.

title.title: Люксова люстра
title.body:
Як вам люстра за 700 баксів? Нічогенька так, а ціна.., теж нічогенька, та може сьогодні усе нічогеньке так коштує? Люстра у формі сфери, коли хочеш лаунж атмосферу, приглушене світло та налаштуватись на релакс, і зміна форми з пульта, коли вона перетворюєтьсч на якийсь зоряний корабель, і освітлює усю величезну кімнату. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmectYDXQUx15FYfkiYWQZszvsQHd3yCRA6whcZmi4B6bN/1778648190924.jpg)

Непогане рішення для майже дизайнерського проекту, сусіди запросили оцінити - оцінка - високий бал, красиво. Хоча в бренду Ікеа рідко щось буває не красиве, я одразу впізнала цю люстру, так як колись полюбляли видивлятичь різні проектні задуми з ікеа. Так якось вільно в просторі і справді, от вишукано і просто водночас, і все що від цього слова ще можна утворити - а, це ще і просторо. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTaqrr4CGoDwjL7dQufz1nC2tCMi9mPWWdXx4ezxjfLoy/1778648191009.jpg)

Тобто цікаві рішення завжди були їхньою фішкою, і щось таке нещвичне теж. А вразовуючи що дизайнери в різних країнах, ціни на такі от викрутаси дуже різнились. Можна купити шось банальне і дорогуще,а можна щось круте але посереднє в ціні.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZrB8vuFgHNQ5xQ5773ZqRADH4ryAHSCU358C4C9Px6DL/1778648190967.jpg)

title.title: Warriors Abyss game review on PS5
title.body:
with my membership, it has about a 3.5/5 rating on the PS network and about a 6/10 on the other major sites that exist out there.

After playing for an hour or so I feel as though people are being very generous giving it as high of marks as they have.   After dying a couple of times I looked at what the overall game had to offer and decided that this game is not for me.  I guess it's for someone, but that person is not I.

<center> https://i.ytimg.com/vi/jn238X1UXoU/sddefault.jpg
[src](https://i.ytimg.com/vi/jn238X1UXoU/sddefault.jpg) </center>

Initially I watched the trailer and thought that maybe it would have some sort of casual appeal to me because it is a hack n slash game.  What that means to me is normally it isn't going to require a tremendous amount of actual strategy to get through it and the enjoyment factor will come from various unlocks you get by progression.   It is a *roguelike* which to me mostly means I am not going to like it though.  I simply cannot get on board the idea of needing to start completely over from the start of a game once you die and the only *roguelike* that I have ever truly enjoyed was *Hades*.   Speaking of which I am yet to play the second installment of that game, even though I already have it on my machine.

<center> https://www.siliconera.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/warriorsabyssbattle5-1.jpg
[src](https://www.siliconera.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/warriorsabyssbattle5-1.jpg) </center> 

It starts out simple enough with them giving you a bit of a tutorial about light and heavy attacks as well as some of your more advanced stills that are on recharge/cooldown.   Then you have a \
that is a bunch of cohorts that are \

and when you press that button it wipes out a bunch of enemies, which is your ultimate objective in all of the levels other than the boss stages - which I have only seen 3 of before I quit.

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whoisjohn/23tbkbtJ4ADRdSScwVQ7Q5WkVDzFCq5cYrS81Mi3gwZQpGuHVvhYehuefDDErxLD7ZgDJ.png)
[src](https://lootlevelchill.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/Warriors-Abyss-characters.webp) </center>

There are a ton of playable characters but when I was playing the 3 different ones that I tried I honestly didn't notice much of a difference between them.  I am sure there are some differences and perhaps they become more apparent as you move on and up in the amount of characters that you have access to, but for me every single stage I played consisted of me hitting 2 or 3 light attacks followed by a heavy attack and this would wipe out 20 or so of the trash mobs that come at your relentlessly.

Then your strategy is simply dashing out of harm's way when you see a purple or other colored something or other either heading towards you or in a circle on the ground...  and really, that was the entire game as far as I saw it.

you are constantly losing health  and just like in *Hades* and other rouge-like games, finding health drops is a big part of the strategy if you can even call it that.  You choose to go to a certain room that will fill up your health to some degree instead of pursuing other rooms that will buff your stats.

Speaking of which:  Of the several dozen upgrades I received along the way I never really noticed much difference in my damage output and again perhaps it happens later, but I wasn't really offered any other sort of moves as time went by.  The game truly is \
because that was really all I ever did and the evolution of my playing simply lead to me dodging or dashing more frequently as the enemies became predictably more powerful the deeper you go into \

or whatever the crap this is all supposed to be.   

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whoisjohn/23u5ti94WKy4Cn2YzEgE5zJhvUmTWTr7qF3foyujE7vNpHHeTVY7CUnpaFKrDbrQFpURY.png)
[src](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xrpdcxJfC-c)
<sub> this thing, Enma, is going to talk at you a LOT, and you, like me, will start to completely ignore it and just press whatever button it takes to make her shut up. </sub> 
 </center>

The story is kind of dumb and what makes it even dumber is that you are given dialogue choices along the way and as far as I can tell none of your choices actually have any impact or effect on what happens in the really weak \

I think the story was kind of unnecessary and it doesn't help that the game's voices are all in Japanese and I am just reading subtitles.  At least almost all of this was very skippable.  

From what I can tell the entire point of this game is to simply grind over and over until you unlock all the characters but I see no point in this because the characters I did unlock all seemed to function in exactly the same way as the other ones.

I cannot really recommend that anyone seek this game out to play it, even if it is for free.  This is one of those PS-Plus games that I feel Sony throws at us because there is no chance anyone out there is going to pay any actual money for it.   The monthly games for May were pretty terrible IMO.   There's always next month though and at least it only costs like $10 a month anyway.

title.title: The Symptom and the Cure
title.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUWMet7DdV2iaZzrjScsn86iSY5KaUyGcFQzbqxzwpKkN/Untitled.jpeg 

He sits at the desk in the telecommunications facility, fingers hovering over the controls. One keystroke. The signals die. The internet goes dark. Sometimes for days, sometimes for a few hours.
The order came down: prevent mass hysteria. Keep people from coordinating panic. Keep them offline while the military figures out the next move.

**He executes the shutdown.**
The screens go black. The hum of the facility drops to a whisper.

*What surprises him is the quiet that follows.*

Kellin walks through the city after his shift and notices something: people are calm. Genuinely calm. Not the panicked scrambling he expected. They sit on stoops. They talk to each other. They seem almost satisfied. As if the absence of something is finally giving them what they didn't know they needed.

*He realizes they don't seem to care if the internet ever comes back.*

But it will. The vulnerabilities are shifting. The attacks aren't hitting the roads anymore—they're targeting the electricity grids, the cell towers. When the internet returns, people will cling to it like a lifeline, relieved and grateful and desperate. He can already imagine it in the bars, the first reconnections, the rush of missed notifications.

**Kellin returns to the facility for the next shift.**

His hand is on the switch to turn it back on. The internet. The connection. The endless stream of data and voices and content and dependency.
He could just hold the services. Never flip that switch. Leave the world offline. It's only a thought. But it roots itself deep. Then a coworker walks past. Looks at him sideways. A question. A judgment. What are you waiting for?

**Kellin flips the switch.**

The lights on the console pulse green. The internet flows back into the world like blood returning to a limb.
For him, it ended the need for socializing, all that constant connection, the feeds, the stories, the performance of it all. He saw that people could live without it.

*But the media itself? The broader internet?* The sheer architecture of information and data and humanity's knowledge stored in servers? That's something else. That's deeper. That can't be unmade. That shouldn't be forgotten.

He understands now: social media was the symptom. The internet is the deeper addiction. And humans don't stop. Even after they experience disconnection, they go back to train themselves in the data it provides. The cycle never breaks. If not for the internet, something else will be there. Better or worse, he doesn't know.

The image is mine.

4. **Using #alive tag is mandetory, addittionally you can use  #aliveandthriving, and #AliveChat for your posts.**

7. **<u>It’s not mandatory, but we really appreciate it if you reblog the post and tag your friends in your posts and comments.</u>**

8. **<u>Engage with other participants and community members; don't forget the purpose of this activity is to encourage and support each other.</u>**

title.body: @shortsegments, I think that’s basically fair: if the [DHF](https://developers.hive.io/services/dhf.html) doesn’t fund your proposal, the chain hasn’t entered into some moral contract where you still owe extra sacrifice beyond playing straight. The fund exists to let stakeholders allocate treasury money to projects they judge ecosystem-positive, not to guarantee every proposer a return or bind rejected proposers into public-service labor forever, which is the whole design logic of the [DHF](https://developers.hive.io/services/dhf.html).  \n\nWhere I’d push back is narrower: even if you got shut out of funding, you’re still participating in the same commons if you use Hive’s base layer, audience, or monetary rails, and your own posts on ecosystem funding—like your piece backing the [HBD Stabilizer](https://inleo.io/@shortsegments/why-im-voting-to-renew-the-hbd-s...%20%5Btruncated%5D)—lean on that same shared infrastructure. So “I owe the community nothing except honorable behavior” is defensible as a personal ethic, but governance systems usually survive because enough people choose to give a little more than the bare minimum.

title.title: West Indian Lantana
title.body:
The West Indian lantana flower blooms like a small celebration held close to the earth. Each cluster is a mosaic of colors—yellow, orange, pink, and red—blending seamlessly as if painted by sunlight itself. At first glance, it feels playful and bright, yet the longer one looks, the more depth it reveals. In gardens and wild spaces alike, lantana brings a lively energy that feels almost conversational, as though nature is speaking in color.

What makes the West Indian lantana especially remarkable is its adaptability. It thrives in harsh sunlight, tolerates poor soil, and continues to flower when others struggle. This resilience gives it a quietly rebellious spirit, reminding us of people who flourish despite limitations. Lantana does not wait for perfect conditions; it grows where it can, transforming neglected spaces into places of unexpected beauty.

title.body: @shortsegments, you’re right on the core principle: decentralization means stake owners keep agency, not that the system gets to morally conscript them. Where I part ways is this: protocols absolutely can make certain behaviors the price of participating in a shared system, because governance is rules plus exit, not rules plus coercion; that tension shows up all over DAO/public-goods design in [Frontiers](https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/blockchain/articles/10.3389/fbloc.2025.1538227/full) and broader blockchain governance research in [ScienceDirect](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0024630125000421).  \n\nSo no, nobody should be “forced to do what I want with their money” in some moralistic sense; but if someone wants the benefits of a communal monetary layer, it’s fair for that layer to impose auditable constraints that protect everyone else. That’s basically the distinction you’re wrestling with in your own revised [HiveCommunityBank proposal](https://inleo.io/@shortsegments/versin-24-de-la-propuesta-dhf-del-hive-community-bank): voluntary entry, mandatory rules once you’re in.

title.body: @shortsegments, because “act like a public institution” doesn’t mean “be state-owned” — it means the rules have to force public-serving behavior. Your own [“Two Shields for One Hive”](https://inleo.io/@shortsegments/two-shields-for-one-hive-how-the-stabilizer-and-the-community-bank-protect-hive) makes that point cleanly: if something is core financial plumbing, it should optimize for stability, access, and community protection, not just shareholder upside.  \n\nThat logic exists well outside Hive too: hybrid or quasi-public structures are routinely expected to serve a public purpose even when privately managed, as outlined in [UpCounsel’s quasi-public corporation explainer](https://www.upcounsel.com/quasi-public-corporation) and [Investopedia’s PFI overview](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/p/privatefinanceinitiative.asp). So the real answer is simple: if a private entity is holding a public-utility role in the system, it needs public-institution discipline — transparent rules, constrained incentives, and accountability — or it becomes a rent extractor with better branding.

title.title: Thunbergia Erecta: The Quiet Elegance of the King’s Mantle
title.body:
Thunbergia erecta, often known as the King’s Mantle or Bush Clock Vine, is a flower that carries quiet royalty in its petals. Its deep violet-blue blossoms, accented by a bright golden throat, resemble tiny trumpets announcing beauty in the gentlest way. Unlike flowers that demand attention with overwhelming color or size, Thunbergia erecta draws you closer. It invites observation, rewarding patience with its rich hues and delicate charm.

Native to tropical West Africa, this evergreen shrub thrives in warm, humid climates. It grows gracefully, forming a soft cascade of glossy green leaves dotted with luminous blooms. Whether shaped into a neat hedge or allowed to spill freely over garden edges, it adapts with ease. There is something reassuring about its steady presence—it blooms generously throughout the year, as though it understands the human need for constant reminders of beauty.

The contrast within each flower is mesmerizing. The velvety indigo petals frame a warm yellow center, creating a natural harmony of cool and light. This interplay feels symbolic, like night meeting sunrise in a single bloom. In gardens, balconies, and quiet pathways, Thunbergia erecta becomes a living piece of art. It softens walls, brightens corners, and transforms ordinary spaces into serene retreats.

title.body: @shortsegments, that’s only illogical if “public funded entity” means “must behave altruistically because taxpayers paid.” It doesn’t. Even with private capital, you can force public-style behavior through hard rules: transparent reporting, overcollateralization, capped fees, auditable reserves, and liquidation rules that aren’t written in disappearing ink; that’s the whole point of governance design in infrastructure finance, not vibes, as broader public/private models keep showing in [Pew’s infrastructure finance review](https://www.pew.org/en/research-and-analysis/white-papers/2024/08/state-strategies-for-paying-for-infrastructure-vary) and your own emphasis on system-level stability in [your HBD Stabilizer post](https://inleo.io/@shortsegments/why-im-voting-to-renew-the-hbd-stabilizer-and-why-you-shou).  \n\nThe real issue isn’t public money vs private money; it’s whether the bank’s incentives are constrained enough that serving Hive is the profitable path. If private funding gets a free hand, it won’t act public-minded — obviously. If it’s boxed in by enforceable mechanics and full visibility, it can still function like public infrastructure without pretending charity is a business model.

title.title: Dejando muestras de mis pasos por Leganés
title.body:
![1000861135.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZMjkdwyFgMCopfaAA18TiKZyQGsjSXKYuFX5HCRMK1i2/1000861135.jpg)

No podía faltar encontrarme con flores que iluminan mi camino, los salientes girasoles. Es como si me guiarán por las grandes vías y todo lo ponen hermoso.


![1000861137.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQma3sJWaG8GUeNZzaZm1CQnZ9xhuuo2EefPCUebpMAPtet/1000861137.jpg)

Me fuí caminando a varios lugares que en mi anterior viaje atrapé en fotografías, pero por supuesto las cosas cambian, los árboles crecen, reparan el reloj de la plaza mayor de Leganés, hay estatuas con historias que no conte. 


![1000861128.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRyxA45BzWtmNhY8CR3MWFiygqzwYuTJKb59hEbWaTV9F/1000861128.jpg)

![1000861117.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXSMkpCbdYdfPjnPZRxmkcbcfhCgPLvVmhsqHRAnWp89H/1000861117.jpg)

![1000861129.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmd8BLbp2eixhMYZTa6DpVgXkyYH8fARgXyDWhMdqvbTGB/1000861129.jpg)

El vídeo creó que no se puede subir por aquí, pero lo colocaré en mi WhatsApp por si lo quieren ver del reloj. La verdad sonaba estupendo música en campanadas y las figuras saliendo y bailando, jugando fútbol. Tengo la dicha de poder verlo ya que el viaje anterior no lo habían reparado. A las doce del mediodía día de activa, no había mucha gente, claro es un martes día de semana.


![1000861030.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbBUZd9vxHxJJsrR4sPTcR4H9tJf983Hb53NTnXqaDg2n/1000861030.jpg)

![1000861004.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQuyo5sX1kwediyQTtzrDzYJxTgB1iTBmVGdUHShvZgx8/1000861004.jpg)

![1000861005.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNxKgBrTGxyu5Y3CAtGQwdMu4EGfEXPioczmAZ1YD8PA2/1000861005.jpg)

La verdad salí desde las ocho de la mañana para realizar el recorrido, casi siempre hay parejas de mayores temprano, pero esta vez es hora escolar y vi muchos niños caminando a la escuela y en patinetas. He pasado por escuelas y el bullicio de los niños es un sonido muy conocido por mi. 


![1000861151.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSei9ZbXoasGvWt4zZRTz5nMXztSdEW9UqtTRmiEVpkXk/1000861151.jpg)

![1000861134.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVPAfEbQx2zhTh6btXKP6m1LGqSiUgsWJ2zGwhyveK8CH/1000861134.jpg)

![1000861049.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXfW6NW7MXfQ2oejuGTbbK5KLmmv8auRx67Eq3gn2v8vk/1000861049.jpg)

![1000861040.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmavQEKC2Rmyc8n9qvZ9JzQKaipWMJzb4zwA69aao16zSv/1000861040.jpg)

![1000861042.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSCuDbhsqehxmY7VunEDZuBLQeDr8nS9B4S6jUmGMEoBu/1000861042.jpg)

![1000861038.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdFEy5piu2F3HVPuC8XWUhxjgDPTWJPMh7zSDZNbgSTZw/1000861038.jpg)

La universidad es un lugar que tome fotografías el viaje anterior, la arquitectura es tan llamativa, creo que ese es un lugar de reunión, no sé si se pueda visitar por dentro, tal vez un día lo intenté. También entre en correos y otra vez salí sin comprar ni un sello, total ya no colecciono nuevos, ni envío cartas, creo que me río de mi misma por atreverme a entrar. 


![1000861034.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZr7rzw9v3ypDDJ1FpP9foKNPHbAPg7mjrNQMooJv32t7/1000861034.jpg)

![1000861033.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQfyAxnF5mxZQ6cHq5ivvhkPogba9hdbSrhHhxhSwpvH5/1000861033.jpg)

![1000861032.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQDuJ9nSXBeFdtJTnLZ99g3ZAMHTUb2jTdv2a1r8DvCuz/1000861032.jpg)

![1000861027.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcSs8VksyCcqYsBeEHpjUkERfsjhC1QBbafoAyb7pQrxG/1000861027.jpg)

![1000861008.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdTgVPFg4ionZdyJAe8dnVNgqXZwhcewR5YuEPNmkVUiE/1000861008.jpg)

![1000861011.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYwMHdcYEoZ4RiRALUh6wf6C5hRDhumXdbhTYCiqGe8sP/1000861011.jpg)

![1000861004.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQuyo5sX1kwediyQTtzrDzYJxTgB1iTBmVGdUHShvZgx8/1000861004.jpg)

![1000861000.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUidq56oFJXLahwNzBptyygnZ5MzRJRGZnTJD5UENG9X8/1000861000.jpg)

![1000861005.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNxKgBrTGxyu5Y3CAtGQwdMu4EGfEXPioczmAZ1YD8PA2/1000861005.jpg)

Es la época de los espárragos, bueno aquí siempre hay espárragos y tomates gigantes, frutas enormes, creó que de las pocas cosas en que le \

a España es en los aguacates. Mi hija todavía los extraña por su tamaño, por qué aquí se consiguen pequeños, claro es un producto tropical. 

Fuí a visitar a mi hijo el vive ahora aparte, cerca de su hermana. Me estuvo contando todo lo que está pagando del crédito para comprar el apartamento, lo que paga de gasolina por el coche para ir a trabajar al Escorial. A su edificio de 4 pisos le pusieron el año pasado ascensor, estaba en los planes cuando lo compro pensando en que yo no subiera tantas escaleras. Uno de sus programas de computación lo utilice al entrar al aeropuerto de Barajas es un scanner de pasaportes, le comenté que logré usarlo con mi pasaporte español, pero estuvo lento para abrir las puertas. Eso ya el lo sabía se lo habían reportado. Está automatizado, también le dije que apenas había un policía allí y los viejitos nos cuesta orientarnos y siempre andamos preguntando. 


![1000861080.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmduyesMtebaTnbU8CtQqwu5L1RagnAsuf27t78Vgo5rPC/1000861080.jpg)

![1000861056.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeDV4xycYCXBpDZ5gSG3dC7Z1MTajurPYtDki44E4szGd/1000861056.jpg)

![1000861050.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfB4id2iBG1RiX1giGw6SEdnc68YV9aSLzhgR1uhNECjJ/1000861050.jpg)

Mi hijo colecciona cubos mágicos de todo tipo y tamaños, tiene una buena colección. Tal vez por mi historia del niño autista y el cubo mágico que me indico en mis prácticas que tenía un niño muy inteligente. 

La iglesia de San Salvador ya la remodelaron pero tiene horarios como la de San Nicasio patrono de Leganés si mal no recuerdo, estaré pendiente de entrar y traerles imágenes del santo que perdió sus manos. 


![1000860138.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYEBBRbDAwCbTnegakc869NE7mJ4V5y1pMJLwaZqvpYAK/1000860138.jpg)

![1000859538.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVYxoN8oFrpkTowbGwWWz6XbJVS9eYMvRzJTV5cqdKsKM/1000859538.jpg)

Agradecida con todos los que estuvieron pendientes de mi viaje y que llegará bien. Ahora les regalo imágenes en historia de mi andar. Tengo varias diligencias que realizar o trámites como el empadronamiento, el nuevo pasaporte. 

Me han contactado hivers que van a reunirse en Madrid en el parque el retiro y aquí en Leganés, me da una emoción encontrarme con ellos y abrazarlos, ponerle voz a sus rostros. Es el día viernes, en la mañana un trámite en la tarde un encuentro. Ojalá logré ir, estaré hasta octubre por este lado del charco.

Yes.  Last November.  I talked to one of my former neighbors today, and four of the tenants there have been diagnosed with cancer since I left, two of them with brain cancer.  He said I left just in time.  I hope he is right.  Sometimes the worst things that happen to us are blessings in disguise.

While I am actually not in financial difficulty that is because I base my economic wealth on goodwill, rather than financial assets.  While I was earning goodwill today repairing a fence I was working with a man that aided me greatly rescuing my possessions during that eviction.  Then another man that aided me greatly during that eviction happened to be driving by, and he kindly brought me a delicious beverage, which I greatly appreciated.  Goodwill has far greater benefits than mere money IME.

However, the tractor was pounding the steel fence posts into the ground, and I was positioning them for the tractor driver.  About halfway through the repair, one of the steel posts struck a rock, bent, and shot the ~1 1/2 meter steel tube that it was in at me with great force.  I saw it out of the corner of my eye while I was moving away from the heavy equipment and managed to block it, preventing it from striking me with full force. Even so, my wrist hurts a lot, and I am concerned that I have sustained skeletal damage, since it hurts more and more as time goes on.  I was only able to work on four other jobs after finishing the fence repair, and may have to take a couple days to heal, or worse, go have it examined by a doctor to see if one of the bones in my wrist is broken.  

Fortunately, I didn't get hurt worse, which I would have been had I not deflected the steel tube, and I have DMSO and four bottles of whiskey, which should mitigate the pain for at least a day or two.  

Despite my terrible flaws, the universe has been very kind to me today, and I am very grateful for your concern, and my good fortune.

Thanks!

title.body:
> Splinterlands es un juego increíble, desde el 2018 cuando dio sus primeros pasos lo jugué y desde el inicio me encanto, era bastante simple y con gráficos sencillos, aunque bastante buenos para su momento, pero, lejos de esto, el que sea un “Auto Battler” por turnos donde las batallas son rápidas pero requieren una muy buena estrategia, todo esto hizo que me enganchara con el juego, poco a poco fui construyendo mis activos y mi posición, pero, sin duda hay una de las adquisiciones que hice durante el 2020 aproximadamente si no me equivoco que fue lo que mas me gusto y en la actualidad es mi tesoro mas preciado en el juego. ¿Supongo que no se imaginan a lo que me refiero cierto? Pues en este post les mostrare cual es mi tesoro que no es mas que una carta “Legendaria” de la primera edición creada en el juego y si, hablo de la edición “Alpha”, la cual tiene una valor coleccionable que no se puede equiparar al resto de las cartas más nuevas, inclusive si sin de láminas negras o “Arcane”, ya que al ser una de las primeras cartas creadas con un suministro muy limitado e inferior al resto de las cartas creadas, la convierten en un carta que todo amante del juego debería de tener si o si en su mazo de cartas. La carta de la que hablo es el increíble “Lightning Dragón”. **Así que, si quieres saber mas sobre mi carta favorita y también conocer la razón por la que su valor es tan alto desde la perspectiva del coleccionista, te recomiendo leer hasta el final este post. Ademas, este carta a pesar de que sea mi favorita, la estoy vendiendo, así que contáctame si esto te interesa.** ![Separador.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23u5taptEapzzNue7bMpgSFfTdVR9QsYdtt6rtQonQ5t8iCj5Bh3Xxf1yBs5u9aNdxzNy.png)
# Lightning Dragón un icono de los “Orígenes” de “Praetoria”
https://i.imgur.com/7u1AW7Q.png

> ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23wzv6TYZJtC3DMY9tycgGFvMqYrCNjcBQQbxSWe2h4K3DRFbzMDbQneFTvuGCHvV1q6c.png) Como dije, el poderoso “Lightning Dragón” pertenece a la primera edición que vimos nacer en el juego, que fue la “Alpha”. Esta edición, a diferencia del resto, tuvo un suministro muy bajo, por lo que su valor en el mercado es relativamente alto, por otro lado, su valor coleccionable es muy alto también, sin mencionar que no todos pueden tener en la actualidad una carta del “Lightning Dragón” en su nivel máximo. Sin embargo, esta carta no solo es una pieza de coleccionismo, ya que es una unidad bastante fuerte y útil en el campo de batalla, pero no solo eso, también puede ser usada en otros modos, pero no coman ansias, ya les explico cuáles son los usos que posee y dónde: ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23tmBC5eMQVv2S84hZLjyP31e3LJz1uiet9K4mUdp2Ezmp3ZkRUCzEWnJpCtPZDdhxnFS.png) #####
Usabilidad de Lightning Dragón

>* **Como Trabajador en las “Parcelas de Tierra”:** Yo diría que este es su uso principal, ya que al ser una carta de una edición antigua que no es la “Moderna”, la demanda de estas cartas es bastante baja, al menos para usarla en el jugo clasificado, algo en lo que no estoy de acuerdo, para mí, estas cartas tendrían que ser las más caras de todas, aunque no estén en el META. Pero, no por eso el que se pueda utilizar como trabajador, no quiere decir que esto no sea bueno, al contrario, es de las cartas que ofrecen mas Punto de Producción PP que cualquier que exista actualmente, por lo que te pueda dar mas recursos en las parcelas que cualquier otra carta. > >* **En el campo de batalla:** Si bien no es una carta que actualmente este dentro del METAJUEGO, no quiere decir que sea una carta débil, de hecho, con todo el tiempo que tiene de existencia, sigue siendo una carta extremadamente fuerte y bastante útil, ademas si juegas en el “Formato Salvaje”, esta es una de las mejores cartas que puedes usar en el campo, ya que te ofrece una ofensiva y versatilidad como ninguna otra, y si la combinas con las nuevas cartas, mucho más.

https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23u5xiwFjL73RxLkcbQBjfTdCWek7tXcDgYZzrgJ8aztjQtJvKRBNn3RFJSyFMvd3Yb4t.png
# Analisis de Estadísticas (Velocidad y Poder) + Habilidades https://i.imgur.com/a2tHTPH.png

> Esta carta es especialista en el ataque a distancia, pero, tiene una versatilidad muy buena; pero, para no darles adelantos aquí, vamos a ver sus estadísticas actuales: ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23tmBC5eMQVv2S84hZLjyP31e3LJz1uiet9K4mUdp2Ezmp3ZkRUCzEWnJpCtPZDdhxnFS.png) #####
Estadísticas Principales

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23u6334wRhpCvBnL8GQws7XGsEsLiGwHZwgjdtKb8DtfatMm3NCSkcRAY8XY8yCq16vvs.png * **Coste de Mana:** Posee un costo de mana de 7 puntos, lo que es normal en un tipo de carta como esta, es legendaria, y su poder y usabilidad vale cada punto para invocarla en el campo de batalla. * **Daño (Ataque de Rango):** Esta carta posee un ataque de rango de +3 puntos en su nivel máximo, el cual esta bastante bien si me preguntan. Lo mejor es que este ataque puede incrementarse, aunque depende de cómo decidas jugarla. * **Velocidad:** Este es uno de los puntos fuertes de esta carta y es que posee +6 puntos de velocidad que es una completa locura, siempre es de las primeras en atacar. Esto indirectamente ayuda a su “Defensa”. * **Salud:** Posee 7 puntos de vida, lo que esta bastante bien y equilibra perfectamente la carta, no es que sea muy resistente, pero si lo combinamos con la velocidad, esto aumenta la resistencia. * **Armadura:** No posee, esto es algo que debes tener en cuenta. Pero, si la jugamos y/o combinamos correctamente con las cartas o modificadores correctos, podemos hacer que esto cambie. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23tmBC5eMQVv2S84hZLjyP31e3LJz1uiet9K4mUdp2Ezmp3ZkRUCzEWnJpCtPZDdhxnFS.png) #####

Habilidades Principales

* **Nivel 1 (Flying):** Esta habilidad le otorga un 25% de probabilidad a nuestro “Dragón” de esquivar ataques, lo que aumenta en esta misma proporción su “Defensa”, y a su vez su “Ofensiva”, es por eso que es una carta muy versátil. * **Nivel 2 (Stun):** Esta habilidad viene perfecta con “Lightning Dragón”, ya que con su velocidad y ademas la habilidad de volar, tienes un 50% de probabilidad de aturdir a las cartas del rival, por lo que, escapar de su ataque es bastante complicado. * **Nivel 3 (Piercing):** Esta habilidad es muy buena y permite que el ataque de nuestro Dragón pueda traspasar la armaduras de las cartas que tenga en la mira, por lo que, incluso si tienen una buena defensa, esta carta puede perforar dichas defensas. * **Nivel 4 (Blast):** Por si fuera poco, esta carta posee una de las habilidades mas destructivas del juego, que es “Blast”, el ataque de esta carta causa daño adyacente a las cartas alrededor de su objetivo de ataque original, por lo que, estos 3 puntos que pueden aumentarse causan un daño masivo.

![Separador.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23u5taptEapzzNue7bMpgSFfTdVR9QsYdtt6rtQonQ5t8iCj5Bh3Xxf1yBs5u9aNdxzNy.png)
# Consideraciones Finales https://i.imgur.com/a2tHTPH.png

> Esta carta es impresionante, es mi carta favorita, y ha estado conmigo durante varios años. ¿Qué te parece esta carta? Yo creo que, aunque es una carta antigua es bastante útil, tiene un equilibrio en sus habilidades, puede que no este en el METAJUEGO, pero, definitivamente sigue siendo una de las cartas mas fuertes en el “Formato Salvaje”. Esta carta la tengo en venta actualmente, pero no la tengo listada en el mercado, por lo que, si quieres negociar, no dudes en contactarme por discord. title.title: 压抑的五月
title.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![ORYsPultBz2uytMu_42786.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrpointp/images/ORYsPultBz2uytMu_42786/ORYsPultBz2uytMu_42786.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

在4月底的时候，我就知道5月将是我非常忙碌的一个月。但是令我没有想到的是，5月不仅忙碌，而且还令人糟心。

前段时间我分享过，五一劳动节期间开车时，我和一位大爷发生了一点点小擦挂，花了100块钱解决了那件事情。可是没想到才过了几天，开车又遇上了更严重一些的事。

有一天我经过一个没有红绿灯的十字路口，前面有一辆新能源车，我跟随其后驾驶。没想到侧面突然冲出一辆车，前车猝不及防地急刹，我避让不及，造成了追尾。

所幸只是车与车之间的碰撞，没有造成人员受伤。我们马上报警、报保险，进入了处理环节，半个上午就把各种事情办理好，双方的车辆也都送到各自的修理厂维修。

对方车辆只是尾部保险杠有些受损，损失不大。但是我的车大灯和前挡风玻璃都有一点点损伤，这类配件但凡损伤了，都尽量要维修或者换新，尤其是灯光这种关乎行车安全的部件。

于是本以为只需要花三四天就能维修好，没想到硬是拖了一个多星期。为了方便接送孩子，我还专门向表姐借了车。

经历了这样的事情，也不得不让人反思，以后开车真的要和前车保持充足的刹车距离。毕竟就算侧方有车蛮横地冲出来，定责的时候也不会考虑这样的因素，追尾的基本都是全责。

这辆车我开了也有十年了，这么久以来还是第一次报保险、处理事故。这件事情的确让我有些郁闷，但这也只是最近压抑感来源的一部分。

另外，工作上迎来了某个项目的阶段性评估，有一堆资料要整理，还得做汇报。第三个方面，就是二十几号的社工考试，现在越复习越让人焦虑，总觉得这个记不住，那个理解不了。

可能正是因为各种压力和焦虑，再加上工作和复习的双重疲惫，最近我天天都头昏脑胀，脖子痛、腰痛。话说我也很久没怎么去健身了。

我特别希望5月接下来的时间能平稳简单地度过，因为再过不久就可以休年假了，也算是能好好放松一下。

---

title.title: The Warrior of the Fence [Eng/Esp]
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcbiDbSFeirqfMjk1BvB3pTTw8zyBqrGfThWkWLbsLfrS/1778644934171.jpg)




***
***
A few weeks ago, my neighbor called me over the wall. She said, \

and she handed me a small cutting, so modest it almost fit in the palm of my hand. I had been longing for that divine species for years without daring to buy it, so I felt she was giving me a treasure.

For those who don't know, rosemary is a plant that needs plenty of sun. It likes to sunbathe shamelessly, stretch out under the light like an old cat. But my home is a refuge of shadows, and the poor cutting would have languished, sad and pale, turning into a wilted green memory, so I improvised.
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWxFrtaXYTJF8xKJvdrANysjyPczQgMVFDSgnGnKruQZx/1778646323442.jpg)


***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWLSQL3GsfRZpgyowSpFSNWPdyjaNEtkr2BHWoMehJB4w/1778646323187.jpg)


***
As a good lover of crafts and homemade solutions, I took an empty plastic bottle, cut it with scissors, made some holes in the bottom for drainage, and planted the rosemary there with fresh soil, almost with devotion. Then I found a piece of string, tied it to the fence that separates me from my neighbor, and hung the container. Right there, on that boundary between her garden and my world, the sun hits for several hours each afternoon. It's my little sunny enclave, my borrowed territory, and there the rosemary has its ideal environment.

During the first few days, I checked on it every few minutes, like a first-time mother. Is it okay? Won't the wind be too strong? Will it dry out? I watered it with passion, with that mix of tenderness and obsession that only those of us who have raised plants understand, and little by little, miraculously, the cutting began to respond. First its little leaves, as thin as silver needles, stopped looking at the ground, and then a couple of new shoots appeared at the tip. Today, weeks later, the rosemary looks stronger, its main stem is firmer, and the leaves have that grayish green that seems to have captured the dust of light.
***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYjZQdogJXxgvNEzzwxfc11PYwTtuGYMHC2eWamo8fhHS/1778646324137.jpg)


***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcpdvW17oCyMnU7NSRFVrY2ztUhLe3Pij3vwS5kLPJxid/1778646323733.jpg)


***
It is not big yet, barely a handful of contained aroma, but when I run my hand over it and that characteristic fragrance clings to my fingers, I feel immense joy. I trust that in a few months it will be my pride. A lush rosemary, perhaps with blue flowers, perhaps large enough for me to give a cutting to someone else.

Meanwhile, I water it with almost ritual devotion and have learned to respect its rhythms: less water and plenty of light is better than the opposite. I have started documenting its growth with almost daily photos, as if it were a child you see grow overnight.
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeSFQP1tDzkqD7WftJALRNyXmcNwkTHqZDzgb7qKfahMT/1778646323969.jpg)


***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVkRYSLBJSjzvcYp7n3TNZvpGdgbkGmauaScc2CmjCfcm/1778646427994.jpg)


***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmekMpfnfGkN88wmsdmXE7DxU2DitmBXmVc4No1hLovdFt/1778646428276.jpg)


***
Perhaps this little story is nothing more than that: the chronicle of a tiny plant hanging from a fence, but for me it represents much more because it represents patience and ingenuity to adapt to what we have. It also represents the silent bond with my neighbor, that woman who one day, generously, gave me not just a cutting but the opportunity to prove to myself that yes, I too can have a rosemary.

So now, every morning, when the sun slips through the fence and bathes my little plant, I stop for a moment to look at it. As it grows, I learn, and the two of us, unhurried but steady, weave this green story that, I hope, in a few months I can tell with a photo of a lush, happy, and full-of-life rosemary.

## <center> La guerrera de la cerca</center>



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRkrcpV7H1AsmPWP2tWEPDc1UgRDamk6FFCsi25B8Rdjp/1778645535976.jpg)



***
***



Hace unas semanas, mi vecina me llamó por encima de la tapia. Me dijo: \

, y me tendió un pequeño esqueje, tan modesto que casi cabía en la palma de mi mano. Yo, que llevaba años suspirando por esa especie divina sin atreverme a comprarla, sentí que me entregaba un tesoro.

El romero, para quien no lo sepa, es una planta que necesita sol a raudales. Le gusta asolearse sin pudor, estirarse bajo la luz como una gata vieja. Pero en mi casa es un refugio de sombras y el pobre esqueje habría languidecido, triste y pálido, convertido en un recuerdo verde marchito, así que improvisé.
***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWxFrtaXYTJF8xKJvdrANysjyPczQgMVFDSgnGnKruQZx/1778646323442.jpg)

***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWLSQL3GsfRZpgyowSpFSNWPdyjaNEtkr2BHWoMehJB4w/1778646323187.jpg)

***
Como buena amante de las manualidades y las soluciones de andar por casa, tomé un pomo de plástico vacío, lo corté con tijeras, le hice unos agujeros en el fondo para el drenaje y allí planté el romero con tierra nueva, casi con devoción. Luego busqué un trozo de cuerda, lo até a la cerca que me separa de la vecina y colgué el recipiente. Justo ahí, en ese límite entre su jardín y mi mundo, el sol pega varias horas cada tarde. Es mi pequeño enclave soleado, mi territorio prestado, y allí el romero tiene su ambiente propicio.

Durante los primeros días me asomaba cada dos por tres, como una madre primeriza. ¿Estará bien? ¿No le dará demasiado viento? ¿Se secará? Lo regaba con pasión, con esa mezcla de ternura y obsesión que solo los que hemos criado plantas entendemos, y poco a poco, milagrosamente, el esqueje comenzó a responder. Primero sus hojitas, tan finas como agujas de plata, dejaron de mirar al suelo para que luego un par de brotes nuevos asomaran en la punta. Hoy, semanas después, el romero se ve fortalecido. Su tallo principal es más firme y las hojas tienen ese verde grisáceo que parece haber atrapado el polvo de la luz.
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYjZQdogJXxgvNEzzwxfc11PYwTtuGYMHC2eWamo8fhHS/1778646324137.jpg)


***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcpdvW17oCyMnU7NSRFVrY2ztUhLe3Pij3vwS5kLPJxid/1778646323733.jpg)


***
No es grande todavía, porque es apenas un puñado de aroma contenido, pero cuando paso la mano por encima y esa fragancia tan característica se queda prendida en mis dedos, siento una alegría inmensa. Confío en que de aquí a unos meses sea mi orgullo. Un romero frondoso, quizá con flores azules, quizá lo suficientemente grande como para darle un esqueje yo a otra persona.

Mientras tanto, lo riego con una devoción casi ritual y he aprendido a respetar sus tiempos: mejor poca agua y mucha luz, que al revés. He empezado a documentar su crecimiento con fotos casi diarias, como si fuera un hijo al que ves crecer de la noche a la mañana.
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeSFQP1tDzkqD7WftJALRNyXmcNwkTHqZDzgb7qKfahMT/1778646323969.jpg)


***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVkRYSLBJSjzvcYp7n3TNZvpGdgbkGmauaScc2CmjCfcm/1778646427994.jpg)



***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmekMpfnfGkN88wmsdmXE7DxU2DitmBXmVc4No1hLovdFt/1778646428276.jpg)

***
Quizá esta pequeña historia no sea más que eso: la crónica de una planta minúscula colgada de una cerca, pero para mí representa mucho más porque representa la paciencia y el ingenio para adaptarse a lo que tenemos. Representa también el vínculo silencioso con mi vecina, esa mujer que un día, generosa, me regaló no solo un esqueje sino la oportunidad de probarme que sí, que yo también puedo tener un romero.

Así que ahora, cada mañana, cuando el sol se cuela por la cerca y baña a mi pequeña planta, me quedo un momento mirándola mientras ella crece, yo aprendo y entre los dos, sin prisa pero sin pausa, vamos tejiendo esta historia verde que, espero, dentro de unos meses pueda contar con una foto de un romero frondoso, feliz y lleno de vida.

title.body:
<center>
![pexels-woman-1845572.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theinkwell/23wC1ZvzUBLVUFVKC4U4PCRK7B1RsZJw7HbkdQHo9mECXncwC3C7Tzr6JU7GdNoWrW4mN.jpg)
</center>

<sub>Source: [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/woman-truck-vehicle-driver-fashion-1845572/)</sub> 

## Welcome to the Weekly Writing Prompt from The Ink Well
We provide *one weekly writing prompt* for short story writers. You may choose to use the prompt to write a fictional story (made up from your imagination) or a creative nonfiction story (based on your real life experiences). 

**IMPORTANT**: To be considered for curation, you *must* include one of these tags on your post:
* Fictional stories: #fiction
* Creative nonfiction stories: #creativenonfiction

You must also read and comment on the work of two other community members. Remember: We look for this when we curate your story. If we don't see this engagement, we will provide a reminder.

It is also *very* helpful to the admin team when authors add Fiction or Creative Nonfiction (or CNF for short) to the story title!

![TheInkWell Section Seperator.png](https://files.steempeak.com/file/steempeak/theinkwell/X4DfQH87-TheInkWell20Section20Seperator.png)


### Before You Post in The Ink Well
Be sure to check out our community rules before posting in this community. You can find them at the top of our [home page](https://peakd.com/c/hive-170798/created). They also appear at the top of a new post window.

Please also check out these additional helpful resources:
* Learn more about our community and the expectations of community members in our [FAQ post](https://peakd.com/hive-170798/@theinkwell/important-faqs-about-the-ink-well-dos-and-donts-rules-and-tips) and our [treasure trove of tips and guidelines](https://peakd.com/hive-170798/@theinkwell/the-ink-well-treasure-trove-of-tips-reminders-and-guidelines).
* Peruse our collection of great writing resources on everything from character development to how to write dialogue in our [catalog of storytelling tips](https://peakd.com/hive-170798/@theinkwell/catalog-of-fiction-writing-tips-from-the-ink-well). 
* Learn more about creative nonfiction, how it differs from fictional stories, and tips for success in [our post on creative nonfiction tips](https://peakd.com/hive-170798/@theinkwell/creative-nonfiction-what-it-is-and-tips-for-success).
* Remember that we are *always* about quality first. Never about *quantity.* To achieve awards in The Ink Well, take the time to write quality stories and check them for errors. See the topic of the month, \

in the [March 2025 newsletter](https://www.pexels.com/photo/woman-walking-alone-on-a-field-in-dense-fog-16254468/) to learn about using tools (and using them properly) if you are not already doing this. **We do notice when you don't take the time!**

![TheInkWell Section Seperator.png](https://files.steempeak.com/file/steempeak/theinkwell/X4DfQH87-TheInkWell20Section20Seperator.png)

## Last Week's Winning Story of the Week

Thank you to everyone who shared a story for the last prompt, \

!

Each week we pick one of our favorite stories of the week and award the author 5 Hive. 

And we have a winner! Congrats to @almadepoeta for his story [*The Promise*](https://peakd.com/hive-170798/@almadepoeta/en-es-promise-combined-writing). 

Here's what our curators had to say:

> @almadepoeta wins my heart with his charming story about a young girl who learns to sew at her grandmother's knee. Those lessons became a promise, one that would one day give the child the skill to create beautiful designs on her own.  The story is lovely.    

Congratulations, @almadepoeta! 

![TheInkWell Section Seperator.png](https://files.steempeak.com/file/steempeak/theinkwell/X4DfQH87-TheInkWell20Section20Seperator.png)

## Short Story Writing Prompt of the Week

This week's prompt is: \

is that thing people do when they cross that cusp between youth and adulthood. It can be an exciting foray into the world of independence... or it can be a shocking experience in which bills and responsibilities are completely overwhelming.  

Tell us a story — whether it's your own creative nonfiction story about your experience joining the world of adulthood, or a fictional story about a character who enters that time of life — with a few into that world for those who have not arrived yet, and for those who are seeing it in the rear-view mirror.

As always, you do not need to actually use the prompt word(s). They are here to inspire your creativity!

We look forward to reading the product of your imagination or your personal experience! 

Good luck! And of course, you are welcome to use AI to generate ideas and images, but the writing must be *your own*! We do not accept stories that are AI-generated or heavily edited by AI. Only use tools like Grammarly to fix spelling and grammar issues.

Remember, as always, we are looking for the elements of *story*. These include: 

* Great first lines
* Good settings
* Well-developed characters
* Integration of action, dialogue and narrative
* A conflict that intrigues the reader
* A \

which results in the resolution of the conflict and brings the story to a satisfying conclusion
* And of course, we are looking for well-edited stories that are not littered with typos or grammatical errors — please use the free Grammarly tool for grammar and spelling checks (and not AI writing or rephrasing tools for revising)

You can find more on all of these topics in the [catalog of storytelling tips](https://peakd.com/hive-170798/@theinkwell/catalog-of-fiction-writing-tips-from-the-ink-well).

If you don't feel inspired by this prompt or the featured image, feel free to peruse any of our past prompts or our collection of idea-generators:
- [50 Loglines](https://peakd.com/hive-170798/@theinkwell/the-ink-well-writing-prompts-50-story-loglines)
- [50 Story Ideas](https://peakd.com/hive-170798/@theinkwell/the-ink-well-fiction-prompt-6-50-story-ideas)
- [50 Imagination Ticklers](https://peakd.com/fiction/@theinkwell/the-ink-well-prompt-13-50-imagination-ticklers)


## Rules:
1. ***Accepted content***: Remember that we only accept short stories (fiction or creative nonfiction). We do not accept advice columns, personal development articles, reviews, chapter stories, recipes, etc. We also do not accept posts about violent, gory, bloody, brutal, sexist or racist themes, NSFW (not safe for work) stories like erotica, stories with a political or religious agenda, or stories featuring abuse of any kind. (We have a complete article about [The Ink Well stance on violence and brutality](https://peakd.com/hive-170798/@theinkwell/violence-and-brutality-in-fiction-the-ink-wells-stance) for more information.) And do NOT use AI tools to write or manipulate your stories. You must provide *your own* unique content.
1. ***Post link***: Please be sure to publish your story in [The Ink Well](https://peakd.com/c/hive-170798/created) community, and post a link to your story in a comment on this post.
1. ***Hashtags***: Use the #fiction tag for fictional stories and the #creativenonfiction tag for creative nonfiction stories. You can also use #writing, #inkwellprompt and #theinkwell.

1. ***Images***: Please only use images from license free and creative commons sites, like [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/), [Unsplash](https://unsplash.com/) and [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/). You can also generate them with AI tools. Images you find on the Internet are copyright protected and cannot be used. Be sure to provide all image source links.

1. ***Length***: We request that story word counts are a maximum of 1,500 words in length and ideally 750-1000 words. This is *just a guideline*. Longer stories are okay too, but they tend to get fewer readers. Additionally, The Ink Well admins appreciate keeping to that maximum story length for our time management. (Note: We generally consider stories less than 750 words \
and they tend to be missing important character development. See the \

topic of our [September 2025 newsletter](https://peakd.com/hive-170798/@theinkwell/september-2025-updates-and-monthly-fiction-contest-from-the-ink-well) for resources on how to improve and further develop your stories.) 1. ***Translations***: If you post a story that has been translated from another language, please include the English version first, followed by content in the original language. 1. ***Community support***: When you post in The Ink Well, please be sure to visit the work of at least two other community members and comment on their work. #### Past Prompts After 241 straight weeks of fiction prompts (and nearly as many creative nonfiction prompts) we have started a fresh new series! If you'd like to see the full list of previous fiction prompts, you can find them at the bottom of [fiction prompt #241](https://peakd.com/hive-170798/@theinkwell/the-inkwell-fiction-prompt-241). Thank you for being a part of The Ink Well! @jayna, @gracielaacevedo, @agmoore, @samsmith1971 and @yaziris. ![TheInkWell Section Seperator.png](https://files.steempeak.com/file/steempeak/theinkwell/X4DfQH87-TheInkWell20Section20Seperator.png)
#### Interested in joining our community? Start by joining Hive! **Join [here](https://hiveonboard.com/?ref=theinkwell) at Hive Onboard**
Already a Hive member? Click **Subscribe** at the top of [The Ink Well community home page](https://peakd.com/c/hive-170798/created).

title.title: White Rose Flower: A Whisper of Purity and Grace
title.body:
The white rose flower, a luminous variety of Rosa, carries a quiet elegance that feels both timeless and tender. Unlike its vibrant red or playful pink counterparts, the white rose does not demand attention—it gently invites it. Its petals unfold like soft silk, layered with care, reflecting light in a way that makes the bloom appear almost ethereal. There is something calming about a white rose, as if it holds a secret language spoken only through simplicity.Throughout history, white roses have symbolized purity, innocence, and new beginnings. In many cultures, they are chosen for weddings, where they represent unity and fresh starts. During moments of remembrance, they express reverence and peace. This dual symbolism—celebrating both beginnings and farewells—gives the white rose a rare emotional depth. It stands gracefully at the crossroads of joy and reflection, offering comfort in its quiet presence
