title.title: TTT - Sharing Some of My Music
title.body:
<center>
![Zeke.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYTJJZ8n51yuNPWeFSE3gNjn6ko1c9b1bgu21WT6nV445/Zeke.png)
</center>
Back on #TTT to bring you with me on an all new kind of musical adventure!  I usually post #thoughtfuldailypost (@Wesphilbin waves the @thoughtfulposts flag) with my tunes.  This time it is sharing some music made by me with a combination of pent up music, thc and advanced AI tools.

<center>
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXdD8hMvJbpLLzxhRodBLkP7J9urP5Nv3dH3z1P5QWSLz/image.png)
</center>
<center>
![digital anarchy.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVVCp7fNicFENRv4uSgYSKVrxsQzMJvtp1TiS3KXdh8g1/digital%20anarchy.png)
</center>
When a bunch of friends started writing music with AI tools, I was impressed with the quality of the songs and the fun everyone was having.  So, I decided to give it a try and write a song.  Now, I have had the chance to write, record and perform music for the last quarter century.  This makes me possibly one of the biggest music fans you know. So, I have PLENTY of inspiration to draw from my favourite bands, songs that were unwritten in the bands I have played in, books of bad poetry, and a love for learning something new. 

<center>
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXdD8hMvJbpLLzxhRodBLkP7J9urP5Nv3dH3z1P5QWSLz/image.png)
</center>
# Lanfest the Wanfest!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-ivei6rngN0&list=PLMLXXMsKwq1_vAPEXVHvDIwJhhEYuQ1ps&index=28
This was the first song I published.  It is a tribute to all the people I have known over the years and met along the way who convene in the discord community we started to build way before discord was a thing.  The online gamers who have been in it since the 90s and keep showing up decades later to play the latest games together.  The voices in my headset every night I can summon with the old incantation and we adventure together despite the miles.  Our boots echo down the corridors and it is time to frag again. 
<center>https://images.hive.blog/DQmXdD8hMvJbpLLzxhRodBLkP7J9urP5Nv3dH3z1P5QWSLz/image.png
</center>
# The Walls Are Closing In
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EWdPldq8NmA
My second tune is a story about how the walls of the universe are closing in but that is the time time to team up and fight the claustrophobia.  To decide to be uncrushable and use the pressure to press ourselves into diamonds.

<center>https://images.hive.blog/DQmXdD8hMvJbpLLzxhRodBLkP7J9urP5Nv3dH3z1P5QWSLz/image.png
</center>
# Another Kirkland in the Drink!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wI5bEjmGH9k&list=PLMLXXMsKwq1_vAPEXVHvDIwJhhEYuQ1ps&index=25
My next song is a New England hardcore ska song about how much our buddy sucks at golf and so do all his friends.  The inspiration for the title image is from a picture of all of us golfing but we are transported to a Dropkick Murphy's mosh pit with our clubs ready to GO!
 
<center>https://images.hive.blog/DQmXdD8hMvJbpLLzxhRodBLkP7J9urP5Nv3dH3z1P5QWSLz/image.png
</center>
# @evileddy
<center>
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZVSY1fnKdS2PNQ9dQnfQnbya5Y6wrpfRkCYUSWxZTJ28/image.png)
</center>
Having real life friends on the chain along with dozens of virtual ones is pretty special.  He may not get too much time to contribute content but I think he should be sharing some of his best tunes on @3speak.  In the meantime, I should be doing the same and will have him feature my tunes on his channel https://www.youtube.com/@evileddy60 until I can get around to setting myself up.

<center>https://images.hive.blog/DQmXdD8hMvJbpLLzxhRodBLkP7J9urP5Nv3dH3z1P5QWSLz/image.png

title.body: /> အားလုံးပဲ မင်္ဂလာပါဗျ။ Myanmar Hive Community အဖွဲ့သားများ နေကောင်းကျန်းမာပါရဲ့လား။ ကျွန်တော်ကတော့ post မတင်ဖြစ်တာ အတော်လေးကြာခဲ့ပြီးပဲ ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။ ကျောင်းကိစ္စပြီးကတည်းက ခုအချိန်ထိ Hive ပေါ်ကို မရောက်ဖြစ်ခဲ့ပေမယ့်လဲ၊ နေ့တိုင်းကတော့ သတိတရအမြဲရှိနေပါတယ်။ စာရေးမယ်လို့ စဥ်းစားလိုက်တိုင်မှာလဲ စာရေးဖို့ကို အတော်လေး ကြိုးစားနေရတယ်။ အကြောင်းအရာကတော့ ရှိနေပေးမယ့်လဲ မရေးတာကြာနေတော့ တော်တော်လေးပျင်းနေပါတယ်။ ဒါကြောင့် hive ပေါ်မှာ အချိန်တော်တော်ပျောက်နေခဲ့တာပဲ ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။ အမှန်တော့ စာရေးဖို့အတွက်ရော် ပုံဆွဲဖို့အတွက်ရော် ပျင်းနေခဲ့တာပါ ကြားထဲမှာလဲ internet cable ကြိုးလဲပြတ်သွားခဲ့ရတော့ internet line တွေလဲ သုံးလို့ရရုံလောက်ပဲ ရှိနေတဲ့အချိန်နဲ့တိုက်ဆိုင်သွားတာနဲ့ပဲ အပျင်းကြောဆွဲနေခဲ့ပါတယ်။ hive ထဲဝင်လိုက်တိုင် မိတ်ဆွေတွေအများကြီးရဲ့ post တွေကို ဖတ်လိုက်တိုင်းမှာ စာပြန်ရေးချင်တဲ့ စိတ်က ပြန်လည်နိုးထလာခဲ့တော့ တစ်ကြောင်းစ နှစ်ကြောင်းစ ရေးရေးပြီးတိုင် စိတ်ကမပါတော့ပဲ ဖြစ်ဖြစ်နေပါတယ်။ ဒါကြောင့် အချိန်အတော်ကြာ ပျောက်နေခဲ့တာပဲ ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။

/>လူကမအားတာမဟုတ်ဘဲ စာရေးချင်တဲ့စိတ်က ပျောက်နေခဲ့တော့ ညတိုင်းလိုလို Tiktok/Youtube game တွေဆော့နေရင်နဲ့အချိန်ကုန်ဆုံးနေခဲ့တာပဲ ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။ အရင်ကတော့ အလုပ်မလုပ်သေးတော့ စာရေးမှအဆင်ပြေမယ်ဆိုတဲ့ စိတ်ကရှိနေတော့ နေ့စဥ်ရက်ဆက်ဆိုသလို ရေးနေခဲ့တာပဲဖြစ်ပါတယ်။ နောက်တော့ ကျောင်းကိစ္စတွေကလဲ ပြီး လုပ်ငန်ခွင်ထဲပြန်ရောက်ပြန်တော့လဲ လူကသုံးစရာလေးရှိနေပြန်တော့ စာရေးဖို့အတွက် စိတ်ကူးမရခဲ့ပြန်ပါဘူး။ တစ်ရက်လုံးကိုမှ စာရေးဖို့စိတ်ကူးက ရှိနေခဲ့ပေးမယ့်လဲ အကောင်အထည်မဖော်ဖြစ်ခဲ့ဘူး။\n\nစာရေးဖို့ကို စလုံးရေး စ မယ်ကြံလိုက်တိုင်းမှာလဲ စဖို့ကို အတော်လေးကြိုးစားနေရတယ်။ အမှန်တော့ စဖို့လိုအပ်တာကို ကျွန်တော်ကိုယ်၌ကိုက မစနိုင်သေးတာပဲ ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။ အော် အလုပ်တစ်ခု လုပ်ဖို့အတွက် စဖို့ပဲ လိုအပ်တာကို ကိုယ်စိတ်ကိုလဲ တော်တော်လေး ပြင်ဆင်နေခဲ့တာ အချိန်တော်တော်ကြာနေခဲ့တာပဲ ဖြစ်တယ်။ ဒါကြောင့် ခုအချိန်ကစပြီးတော့ စာရေးခြင်းကို ပြန်လည်နိုးထလာနိုင်အောင် စတင်ပြီးတော့ ကြိုးစားရပါဦးမယ်။

title.title: Passing Faith Unto Our Children. My Review
title.body:
https://youtu.be/lmL1m1qely0?si=ZmoLz2JVwJV6D0uR
The words of God is what makes our faith in God strong. The words of God are the sustaining power of our faith in God. If we do not have the Word of God in our hearts, our faith will not be strong. We are believing in God through His words. So to have a strong faith that lasts, we can only depend on God. We should allow the Word of God to be our guide. We should feed on the word of God daily. We should rely on the word of God. We should give ourselves solely unto the Word of God. When we have enough root in the word of God, we will have a lasting faith in God. 

Our children will have to know that same word of God if they must have a strong faith in God. They must be fully submitted to God and His words. We are not going to have faith in God when our minds are filled with other ideologies. When our children only know sciences and philosophy, they cannot stand strong in God. Let them get the knowledge of the Word of God. Let them be settled in the word of God. There is no other way to pass on the faith to our children than to make sure that they are taught in the word of God very well.

title.title: 当然可以！以下是一个关于自然的博客主题建议：\n\n**主题：探索四季的
title.body:
<center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g13c1bb58007d54a68bd2047a1d7dfb77d3ca935d88deafd465546b8dabaf8531fe06e33a08a99feea7192cb0dac8193e8b13c83e6d9993da1e2b03122b205af3_640.jpg)</center>

***

# 探索四季的变迁

自然界的四季变化是一个迷人的主题，它不仅影响着我们的生活方式，也深刻影响着生态系统的运作。本文将带您深入探索春、夏、秋、冬四个季节的独特魅力。

## 春天：复苏与新生

春天是万物复苏的季节，温暖的阳光唤醒了沉睡的土地。花朵竞相绽放，树木重新披上绿装。这个季节象征着希望和新生。

- **自然现象**：冰雪融化，河流复苏。
- **动植物**：鸟儿归来，花朵盛开，昆虫活动。
- **活动推荐**：春游、赏花、植树。

## 夏天：繁荣与活力

夏天是阳光最为强烈的季节，万物生长茂盛，生机勃勃。人们常常选择在这个季节外出游玩，享受大自然的馈赠。

- **自然现象**：高温、阳光明媚、降雨频繁。
- **动植物**：树木繁茂，果实成熟，动物活跃。
- **活动推荐**：海滩度假、露营、野外烧烤。

## 秋天：丰收与沉思

秋天是丰收的季节，农田里的庄稼成熟，果园里的水果挂满枝头。这个季节的色彩斑斓，给人一种宁静和思考的氛围。

- **自然现象**：气温逐渐下降，树叶变色。
- **动植物**：动物为冬季储备食物，鸟类开始迁徙。
- **活动推荐**：收获节、观赏红叶、秋游。

## 冬天：宁静与反思

冬天是一个宁静的季节，白雪覆盖大地，万物似乎都进入了沉睡。这个季节常常给人一种反思和内省的感觉。

- **自然现象**：寒冷、降雪、白天短。
- **动植物**：许多动物冬眠，植物进入休眠状态。
- **活动推荐**：滑雪、冰上活动、温泉度假。

## 总结

四季的变化给我们带来了不同的体验和感受。每个季节都有其独特的美丽和魅力，值得我们去细细品味。无论是春天的生机、夏天的活力、秋天的丰收，还是冬天的宁静，自然的四季都在提醒我们珍惜生活中的每一个瞬间。

---

希望这个关于四季的探索能激发您对自然的热爱与思考！

title.title: 2. 数据类型
title.body:
![类型.jpg](https://img.ilark.io/img/202601/1778645677846-fm8y0.jpg)

- 值类型
值类型传值时，会临时拷贝一份内容出来，而不是拷贝指针，当你修改新的变量时，不会影响原来的变量的值。
  布尔(Booleans)
  整型(Integer)
  地址(Address)
  定长字节数组(fixed byte arrays)
  有理数和整型(Rational and Integer Literals，String literals)
  枚举类型(Enums)
  函数(Function Types)


- 引用类型(Reference Types)
引用即地址传递，复杂类型，占用空间较大。在拷贝时占用空间较大，所以考虑通过引用传递。
  不定长字节数组（bytes）
  字符串（string）
  数组（Array）
  结构体（Struts）

- 两者区别：
如果是值传递，修改新变量时，不会影响原来的变量值，如果是引用传递，那么当你修改新变量时，原来变量的值会跟着变化，这是因为新变量同时指向同一个地址的原因。

title.title: Where All The Games Begin: Second Day of the Youth Camp
title.body:
![Copy of LEAD PHOTO BLOG (4).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/arenaofroses/23xVKAB5JouAhBVGHGkhwNNK2naYmzcFrpLtcvCE7DoetKg4vbbgwLcVuEB9LsQqpDe7S.jpg)
I want to share about the second day of our youth camp, where I was one of the facilitators. 


![photo_6055471887124467709_w.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/arenaofroses/EoiXgtDY78rvepK4xjAauFoPn9ms4Ft5LLvUaCykKy4bgPXjqWhuGALFrBGEy4pMyTn.jpg)
It was a fun and active day, and I was happy to help guide the campers during the activities. Even though being a facilitator came with responsibilities, I still enjoyed spending time with everyone and seeing them have fun.


![695700801_122163994172738768_5289962493117413468_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/arenaofroses/23xATNaAsqgeVqhVXFmLPCB7S4wV1hKLX3xM2ALiP8jwvT5TUsDTj9JEcsrKqeMrrKkhW.jpg)

One of the activities we prepared was the “Amazing Race.” The campers were divided into groups and went to different stations to complete challenges. 
The first station was the \
, where they are blindfolded and they need to follow their leader's voice, next was the \
with a twist, because two people should be in the sack jumping together, next was the \
, where a balloon was in between of the participants and they need to be connected until they finish the race, next was \

, where they need to cook an egg using a bond paper, and more stations I cannot state because there were so many.


![photo_6055471887124467704_w.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/arenaofroses/23vsN1uGABBw9ZkSAV7QKtQ2DH3Sg6ZovKWNXWyUm8uj9xEJ5jac7yumrxWfbH1wPpQGY.jpg)
I was assigned in the Station 3, where the young people needed to cook an egg using a bond paper. As a facilitator, I explained the mechanics, guided the participants, and made sure everything went smoothly. 


![692736338_122163994262738768_9051936152386403376_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/arenaofroses/23uFTQD2QLSBXWwUbNGr5yAAN4iNQBugwpPyajLFc39aWqni4pRt5utm3fXRjLDM2d7Rz.jpg)
It was nice to see the groups working together, helping one another, and enjoying every game. Everyone was excited and full of energy throughout the activity.


![photo_6062057970364780993_w.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/arenaofroses/23yd81k23NmHUyLj9vSHrmdMEktcx9H8ymjtAmUiC7g9BUFLbVPCaxvtFHnuaRKvSbexy.jpg)
After the Amazing Race, we had the Big Volleyball Game. Instead of using a regular volleyball, we used a giant beach ball, which made the game more fun and funny. Everyone was laughing while trying to hit the ball because it was difficult to control. 


![photo_6055471887124467697_w.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/arenaofroses/243BYBN5vFtxCUHQVfnChFg6XUfPsDVdZuF9ZeFnh9PyE8WPfYqmzj6XwT51fvcpZgoAg.jpg)

Some players missed the ball, while others ran around trying to save it from falling. Watching everyone enjoy the game made me happy as a facilitator.


![photo_6055471887124467698_w.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/arenaofroses/243WM9aeiNJFuHeQrZ1bfz6YLPqLVnuJPTGMXXkw7ySi7TrSoAezkMHEDSYL8rYr1iZwp.jpg)

The activities helped the campers build teamwork and friendship. It was also a good experience for me because I learned how to guide and encourage others while making sure everyone felt included.


![photo_6062057970364780995_w.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/arenaofroses/23wqgbJSPMGapWSnXMF1geknSzECbkJ9cWoS4aQPkrG6jWckun5nu3HthkpfBmY1N1DeK.jpg)

The second day of the youth camp was tiring but very enjoyable. I am thankful that I became part of it as one of the facilitators who helped make the activities successful and meaningful for everyone.

This is my blog for today! Thank you for reading<3

P.S. the lead photo is edited using Canva.

Je länger ich aus diesen Institutionen raus bin, desto klarer wird mir, wie sehr das mir und meinen Mitschülern geschadet hat. 

Kritisches Denken bremst Dich in den meisten Systemen eher aus; Konformität scheint das Ziel. 
Das merke ich auch daran, dass sich kaum jemand außerhalb der Schule oder der Uni in irgendetwas selber einfach mal bildet. Und damit meine ich nicht, ein youtube video zu dem Thema durchzuskippen.

Das andere ist, dass niemand in meinem Umkreis wert darauf gelegt hat, mir mal zu erklären, wie wichtig zwischenmenschliche skills sind.Das muss nicht direkt Lutschen sein, aber wenn Du wirklich nur fachlich was drauf hast, aber keiner Dich mag, hast Du verkackt; Im Extremfall brauchst Du teilweise nichts weiter können als beliebt sein.

Das absichtliche Missverstehen und auf Definitionen rumreiten ist absolut eine Taktik der lefties. title.title: Whacky Wednesday - What is Bigo And Reiki? English/French.
title.body: Today I have spent most of my days on Bigo live, I have already done my two hours for today, and I have a shining stars tarot & oracle event on bigo at 6pm, Sydney time, please see the photo. There is currently an auto rebate on today, where you can earn extra beans that count towards your quota. Your quota, is the number you need to make, to earn enough beans to be paid the monthly bonus from the app, this also starts with you needing a bare minimum of 20 hrs total per month, for your first three months, and a 5k bean target. **_So, what is bigo you ask?_** Bigo, to me, is a community & virtual family where you can chill on your own to host, or be in a panel and have a conversation & meet new friends. Being chronically ill, I miss alot of social time not being able to leave the house, so I can only imagine how many other people are in the same situation. If you have a special talent, such as playing an instrument, singing, dancing, crafting, tarot etc, you will also do especially well on bigo. Every Monday, at 12pm Sydney time I run a reiki & tarot gaming channel, where you can have your chance to receive distance reiki (energy healing) or a 1 card traditional tarot reading, moonology energy card, or crystal recommendation card pull. Reiki is also especially good for those who are unwell, or stressed out, as it is also considered a form of mediation, and promotes healing on all 4 levels. I also run a chat panel every Tuesday, Wednesday, Find me on Bigo live: Use my invite code by following this link to join bigo if you haven't already: To become a signed paid host on bigo, join using my invite link & message me through the BIGO live app. **_What is Reiki?_** Reiki works on the basis that your body is made up of seven chakras (energy centres), that start from the top of your head (crown chakra), and end under your belly button (sacrel chakra). Reiki works its best when the receiver is in a relaxed state, and is open to receiving its postive influencial energy, and there feet are either planted firmly on the ground (with no shoes) or laying down on a bed. Reiki is also a form of meditation, that promotes healing on all the four levels: spiritual, emotional, mental & physcial. To best prepare for relaxing reiki: Find a quiet space to sit, or lay down for about 10 minutes at least, with no shoes, if you are sitting, your feet must be firmly placed on the ground, with no shoes (socks are fine), if you are lying down, please also remove your shoes. 1. Take 4 deep breaths by doing the following: 2. Breathe in for the dcount of 4 throuhg your nose 2. Hold your breath for 4 seconds 3. breath out through your mouth for 4 seconds, 4. pause for the count of 4

|![20260511_144210.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/selenediva/Ep3igfYTM3KxXkPBqSg6K12LeK4hqm8a9KnnademRVPDWKzNCXMz5sC8EgQSyzZCzdo.jpg)|![20260511_144204.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/selenediva/Ep3hmZmfxwKrcsHdNfS5X5oj9Uz78NYFLuowiWY3sz5Sy7kYbb1Uy6XH2ZorPovf1vp.jpg)|![20260511_144215.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/selenediva/EoiZ2rx8BVWJW89zzqvkuEWeStg4bQdNdwTskFeYEHcRjAZLDdsZL2nvaprd761Neck.jpg)|
|-|-|-|

|![20260511_150945.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/selenediva/23xVRizVvxjv6DZgyNTHc7d1PXWvfewwpHmh2iThHRXvtRV1APurXnEr5XaBNUBFdMEAs.jpg)|![20260511_151521.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/selenediva/242Y88DYuszfZ5SgGh8xqg5XrhnwVY7gYhwzHGSR6LFSGNkFfPvbJU2ihmxs3kPk9LR3B.jpg)|![20260511_151621.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/selenediva/242YC4iWSHBqKhuZ94q1P1Ez6ww11rBBdSWXbhWj1kxT1UBcGfbQTig9h1jdUjhhMqDqM.jpg)|![20260511_151010.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/selenediva/23ynakLN1PuTCDTpqSYqoFssaNuf4F1TzQAVb4XDvckAfmbV28JfyStE6YwPNm7vrF6Hp.jpg)|

|![20260511_151931.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/selenediva/23wMm2rac651bREmGagTQHrDjGo2M9zHt3L6HvKFT8MD5VwPL9pYjkXiw1GxGSbRVKEX6.jpg)|![20260511_152400.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/selenediva/EpNptFYepHmt8U4wJsuo8inpvESaz8BQMLm8M2WNVSxyKYtm5i6WEhQHxnJky4FNuiJ.jpg)|![20260511_152937.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/selenediva/Ep7vzLNiWc9ZLnzBDacUUfWdRgXvE4TsxJPyApWLNAM6bpUHqV81tTDsLY4jSxHqxUw.jpg)|![20260511_152503.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/selenediva/EpQxCm2pJT5Hh6ymc4PyHvHU4x8pUXzTW2v9UeZFUnpkLv1N86f6aQjpPQDoEsKnqpd.jpg)|

title.title: A Colorful Dance of Change and Resilience
title.body:
The West Indian lantana arrives in the garden like a small celebration. Its clustered blooms, often blending yellow, orange, pink, and red in a single head, feel alive with motion and warmth. Each cluster seems to shift in color as it matures, giving the impression that the flower is constantly transforming. This lively quality makes lantana impossible to ignore, drawing both the eye and the spirit toward its joyful presence.

What sets the West Indian lantana apart is its remarkable resilience. It thrives in heat, poor soil, and bright sun, conditions that challenge many other plants. Rather than retreating, lantana responds with abundance, flowering freely and persistently. This toughness, paired with its cheerful appearance, feels deeply human—an expression of strength that refuses to lose its color even in difficult circumstances.

The flower’s changing hues carry gentle symbolism. As the blossoms age and shift in tone, they reflect the natural process of growth and transformation. Lantana reminds us that change does not diminish beauty; instead, it adds depth and story. Each stage of its bloom holds its own charm, much like the evolving chapters of a life well lived.

body.title: Linda pulsera con cuenta de Cruz y fomi en forma de huellas 🐾[Esp-Eng]
body.body:
> **
ESPAÑOL
** Bendiciones abundantes y eternas para todos los miembros de esta fabulosa comunidad #hivediy. Encantado en saludarles y desearles feliz y Bendito miércoles. Hoy les comparto una hermosa pulsera macramé con hilo cola de ratón, cuenta en forma de cruz y fomi en forma de huellas. Es de mencionar, que esta pulsera es muy fácil de elaborar y en tan sólo pocos minutos ya la tenemos lista para lucir. Sin más tiempo que perder les invito a acompañarme en esta fascinante creación y poner manos al hilo.

> **
ENGLISH
** Abundant and everlasting blessings to all the members of this fabulous #hivediy community. It’s a pleasure to greet you and wish you a happy and blessed Wednesday. Today I’m sharing a beautiful macramé bracelet made with rattail cord, cross-shaped beads, and foam in the shape of footprints. It’s worth mentioning that this bracelet is very easy to make, and in just a few minutes it’s ready to wear. Without further ado, I invite you to join me in this fascinating project and get your hands on the cord. ![1000439968.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/Ep3fHQxyYE51sjPe7zoxwcjcRX983G4wshfrYCVugudixYT3Jybw1vmD9pyXYjvc9sf.jpg) ![separador virgilio 1.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/48fPJW5oSR5NrT5insR3hayLh9ET1ifvCG8zGp4Rfk8EhMtUrcwakXhr5g3cRk6Y8x.gif)
> Los materiales que utilicé para realizar esta hermosa pulsera son los siguientes, a saber: Hilo Tijera Encendedor Cinta métrica

> The materials I used to make this beautiful bracelet are as follows: Thread Scissors Lighter Tape measure ![1000439848.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23uFYHHLeL9d5MHeN9QodAg6WUEU4f9p561TfbUEjDeKSgHMJpjEYHyW3p2NReeNNJVsW.jpg)
> Para comenzar esta hermosa joya iniciamos cortando dos hebras de hilo de 40cm el cuál utilizaremos como base para nuestra pulsera.

> To begin making this beautiful piece of jewelry, start by cutting two 40-centimeter lengths of thread, which we’ll use as the base for our bracelet. ![1000439849.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EowH5jXZueDyTJFHuPMDN7jMAwBGRW3qrUsJQkmWpjm5VXmSsDyDXiSXkDEpjYiL1x7.jpg)
> Luego corté una hebra de hilo chino de 130cm que utilizaremos para realizar el tejido plano.

> Then I cut a 130cm strand of Chinese thread that we will use to make the flat weave. ![1000439854.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/Ep5n7qX7vnMpBw1ecQHmvgFvV5yU5B5UUtdah9p8SJuHUo2FrbiuizAupZNWcasmcG2.jpg) ![separador virgilio.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/48KdAZ2oktyDRja9ez5m3v1qBY6PZfFU8sSGEE17ey9FUfktwmCJiLv2c2YiZggq73.png)
> Después llevamos el hilo base a una tabla a una distancia de 10cm de la punta superior hacia abajo. A partir de esa medida comenzamos a realizar el nudo plano.

> Then we take the base thread to a board at a distance of 10cm from the top end down. From that measurement we start to make the flat knot ![1000439867.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/Ep5mo4WZv3xmcx9TggfdFrQkwb2bPMCmTW29vd4dMES9ddTZdTF24kHFwdm3CjWhQK4.jpg)

> Para comenzar esta pulsera vamos a realizar un nudo plano, comenzamos de la siguiente manera: Primero tomamos el hilo del lado izquierdo y lo pasé por encima del hilo base, formamos una especie de cuatro, luego pasamos el hilo del lado derecho por encima del hilo izquierdo que tenemos en el lado derecho, después lo pasamos por debajo del hilo base y lo sacamos por el interior o argolla del hilo izquierdo como nos lo señala la imagen . Seguidamente con los dedos presionamos para que quede igual de ambos lados. Así comenzamos nuestro tejido

> To start this bracelet we are going to make a flat knot, we start as follows: First we take the thread on the left side and pass it over the base thread, we form a kind of four, then we pass the thread on the right side over the left thread that we have on the right side, then we pass it under the base thread and take it out through the inside or ring of the left thread as shown in the image. Then we press with our fingers so that it is the same on both sides. This is how we start our weaving ![1000439970.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23vi21R67kaMkatjYuJqHimvQKpoardNJRoBUvx6eH4XhBSx6rLSnzCCsj8uom3xrcvZS.jpg)

> Ahora tomé el hilo del lado izquierdo y lo pasé por encima del hilo base, formé una especie de cuatro, luego pasé el hilo del lado derecho por encima del hilo izquierdo que tenemos en el lado derecho, después lo pasé por debajo del hilo base y lo saqué por el interior o argolla del hilo izquierdo como nos lo señala la imagen. Seguidamente con los dedos presioné para que de ambos lados tengan similitud.

> Now I took the thread on the left side and passed it over the base thread, I formed a kind of four, then I passed the thread on the right side over the left thread that we have on the right side, then I passed it under the base thread and took it out through the inside or ring of the left thread as shown in the image. Then I pressed with my fingers so that both sides have similarity. ![1000439971.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23vi21RSc7CBDfHn2Aj3FGY6xDYqggEaJKj1wWVkAYqHKcjYfi8jgqjTvHbtYeZY3v1Ek.jpg)
> Seguí realizando el mismo procedimiento hasta llegar a los 7cm.

> I continued following the same procedure until I reached 7 cm. ![1000439893.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23wX3CLffkheVrNqmyM6wmRTqGF4eV6L2vTZ8re9ZmmPtz1xAwJUvkKAUynwazLKZz33J.jpg) ![separador virgilio 1.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/48fPJW5oSR5NrT5insR3hayLh9ET1ifvCG8zGp4Rfk8EhMtUrcwakXhr5g3cRk6Y8x.gif)
> Luego introduje las cuentas por los hilos base.
> Then I threaded the beads onto the base strings. ![1000439972.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23tvkg7C9V5kMcBsgCtfdxBo2qZisXPes1Uu7uDGiidhX96aQ6ows51Sw9UfqsCPrtxr9.jpg)
> Continúe realizando nudos planos hasta llegar a la medida deseada.

> Continue tying flat knots until you reach the desired length ![1000439912.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23wMaCMKwriszGKspBNmqW9N9cmhktE571s8hX8g2TLR7Qt5x3fSCSwU4btPPWQ52Q2fE.jpg)
> Después de llegar a la medida deseada corté los hilos sobrantes y sellé.

> After reaching the desired size I cut the excess threads and sealed. ![1000439913.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23uFYCp57NLrNKbddt1eqXGQwiqvC1SHWyTvwjxqpGrN8bdzgSp1Lokn3dPAkTWstrdNz.jpg) ![separador virgilio.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/48KdAZ2oktyDRja9ez5m3v1qBY6PZfFU8sSGEE17ey9FUfktwmCJiLv2c2YiZggq73.png)
> Finalmente corté una hebra de hilo de 20cm para realizar un nudo plano para el trancadero de la pulsera.

> Finally, I cut a 20cm strand of thread to make a flat knot for the bracelet's locking ring. ![1000439916.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23wMctVzqkKwp2iMYUgTNypyg7HBuMvRYBvFTKvHx8Ssioq1eqzjyofNhqJQn2UDz719h.jpg)
> Así quedó esta hermosa pulsera

body.title: This is how I celebrated Mother's Day with my family👩‍👧
body.body: > This year’s Mother’s Day was filled with moments that will stay with me forever. Starting very early in the morning, I began receiving messages from the women in my life: sisters, nieces, friends—some are already mothers and others aren’t, but all of them, as daughters themselves, deeply understand what a mother’s love means. Each message contained kind words, memories, sincere affection, and that warmth that makes you start the day with a heart full of love. My daughter also surprised me with a beautiful gift. She gave me several little things I needed, and honestly, they made me so happy because you can tell when a gift is chosen with love and care. Afterward, we went to lunch at our favorite spot: Arte-Sano. And when I say favorite, I mean in every way. We love the atmosphere, the warm service, and, of course, the food that never disappoints. This time we sat on the glass-enclosed terrace surrounded by plants. The afternoon had spectacular light because it was a beautiful day.

> El Día de la Madre este año estuvo lleno de momentos que se quedan guardados en el corazón. Desde muy temprano empecé a recibir mensajes de las mujeres de mi vida: hermanas, sobrinas, amigas, algunas ya son madres y otras no, pero todas, desde su lugar de hijas, entienden profundamente lo que significa el amor de una madre. Cada mensaje tenía palabras bonitas, recuerdos, cariño sincero y esa calidez que hace que uno empiece el día con el corazón apapachado. Mi hija también me sorprendió con un obsequio hermoso. Me regaló varias cositas que necesitaba y que, sinceramente, me hicieron muchísima ilusión porque se nota cuando un regalo está pensado con amor y atención. Después nos fuimos a almorzar a nuestro lugar favorito: Arte-Sano. Y cuando digo favorito, es por todo. Nos encanta el ambiente, la atención tan cálida y, por supuesto, la comida que nunca decepciona. Esta vez nos sentamos en la terraza cerrada con vidrios y rodeada de plantas. La tarde tenía una luz espectacular porque hizo un día precioso. https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23sx9zh86EkkiLKLtSi2PBHC1KVFoXdvczeXaaUxVGrGQEDt4qLKxppjcYjQTNiqLhWr4.png |https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23xp8UEauVrT11Lspn3cMrbXGtuyFxkh1Z4K78z7qsaKVUmZ5rH181n7pXi4duC7Hwmrh.jpg|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23xySdEpGx1Tpp2SLYWxyRXFmrCkYj7qykL9w5QJvZRSXNefEbdibMdz2zapG8CHEj3se.jpg| |--|--| https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23sx9zh86EkkiLKLtSi2PBHC1KVFoXdvczeXaaUxVGrGQEDt4qLKxppjcYjQTNiqLhWr4.png

> We took advantage of that lovely spot to have our little photo shoot while we waited for our food. Amid laughter and lots of posing, we ended up taking tons of cute photos that I know I’ll look back on with a smile. I love capturing those moments because, in the end, memories are what matter most. And well, the food was divine. It was truly delicious. Every dish was spectacular, and I’ll tell you more about everything we ordered later because it deserves its own post. But beyond the food, the best part was sharing the moment. We chatted, laughed a lot, and enjoyed a simple celebration filled with love. I felt so pampered, so loved, and deeply grateful. Sometimes you don’t need big things to feel happy; it’s enough just to be surrounded by the people you love. Today I’m infinitely grateful for the love my family gives me and the good fortune of continuing to make memories together.

> Aprovechamos ese rincón tan bonito para hacer nuestra pequeña sesión de fotos del recuerdo, mientras esperábamos la comida. Entre risas y muchas poses, terminamos tomando muchísimas fotos lindas que sé que luego voy a mirar con una sonrisa. Me encanta guardar esos momentos porque al final son los recuerdos los que más valor tienen. Y bueno, la comida estuvo divina. De verdad comí delicioso. Cada plato estaba espectacular y ya luego les hablaré mejor de todo lo que pedimos porque merece un post aparte. Pero más allá de la comida, lo más bonito fue compartir. Conversamos, nos reímos muchísimo y disfrutamos de una celebración sencilla pero llena de amor. Me sentí muy consentida, muy querida y profundamente agradecida. A veces uno no necesita grandes cosas para sentirse feliz; basta con estar rodeada de las personas que ama. Hoy agradezco infinitamente el amor que mi familia me regala y la fortuna de seguir sumando recuerdos juntos. https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23sx9zh86EkkiLKLtSi2PBHC1KVFoXdvczeXaaUxVGrGQEDt4qLKxppjcYjQTNiqLhWr4.png |https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23yJJuGbM3UqyddmkVdqS9om3vRY2LayXWJ1RcaYf5M5sKw9P5BhruzqsJrJpGpwKucJj.jpg|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23w2kq6WFoYAjZZcxEKnchLxJYM9DRVotwqXXF6N5k2ZfCeRHDLLgAH96sddAamF7LYBo.jpg| |--|--| ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23sx9zh86DUea2FrtyvVo4uvWLcdKMqr59xEguifnQjGVnFVEwaCiaDnEDMspu4BWZceR.png)

body.title: Who Do I Become at Midnight?
body.body:
Midnight is a strange time for me seriously. During the day, I am predictable because I answer messages, laugh at random things online, do what I need to do, and move through life the way everyone expects me to. But at midnight, something changes. It feels like the world finally becomes quiet enough for me to hear myself think, as it the whole world have become mine.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbLFZULX7NsMsv5rHiCLWyyNgxtzLuXq1f8Ld8avSGHps/1000214754.png 

[Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/vectors/landscape-twilight-light-night-1844231/)
Sometimes, I become the most productive version of myself at midnight. It is almost ironic because the entire day could pass with me feeling tired or distracted, but once the clock hits twelve, even if I'm sleeping before, I will wake up and not just my body, my mind suddenly wakes up. Once my mind  is fully awake, I put on my headphones, start playing music, and open a game that somehow makes me feel relaxed instead of distracted. The music fills the silence of my room, and for a while, everything feels peaceful, my thoughts become clearer, my energy returns. It feels like midnight gives me permission to breathe without pressure.


There are nights when I feel unstoppable. I make plans for my future, think about the person I want to become, and convince myself that maybe I still have time to figure everything out. Those are the nights where I feel hopeful. The nights where I feel like I am growing into someone stronger.

But not every midnight feels that way.
Some nights are painfully quiet. The same silence that once felt peaceful suddenly feels heavy. Those are the nights where loneliness sits beside me like an unwanted guest. I could be watching a movie or scrolling through random videos, yet somehow my mind always drifts back to the things I try not to think about during the day, because at midnight, memories become clearer and louder.

I start remembering conversations, people I miss, mistakes I wish I could erase, and moments where I felt misunderstood. It is strange how emotions wait until midnight to become honest. During the day, distractions protect you, but at night, there is nowhere to hide from yourself.

I remember one specific night when I stayed awake until almost three in the morning. I had music playing softly in the background while I played a game I usually enjoyed, but that night, I was not really focused on winning. I was thinking about how fast life changes. How people slowly drift apart without warning. How someone can feel surrounded by others during the day and still feel completely alone at night.

I paused the game and just sat there staring at the screen while the music continued playing. For the first time in a long while, I allowed myself to feel everything instead of ignoring it. The loneliness, the confusion, the pressure, the hope, all of it. Oddly enough, it did not destroy me. It made me feel human.

That is who I become at midnight.
I become honest, not the version of me that smiles automatically or says “I’m fine” without thinking. Midnight strips all of that away. It reveals the quiet parts of me that nobody really sees. The part that dreams deeply, overthinks constantly, misses people silently, and still hopes for better days.

And sometimes, after all the overthinking and emotion, midnight gives me peace. A calm feeling that reminds me I survived another day. The room becomes quiet again, the music slows down, and for a moment, everything feels okay. Maybe that is why I stay awake so often at midnight, Because somewhere between the music, the movies, the games, the loneliness, and the peace, I meet the real version of myself.



**Thanks for checking on my blog and have a wonderful day**

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@leemah1/who-do-i-become-at-midnight-3yp)

body.title: Walls of time
body.body:
Spring in the Nizhny Novgorod Kremlin. The sun floods the brick walls, and it seems that time has stopped here. Walking around the territory, I felt like a part of history. The arches, like portals to the past, beckoned with their mystery. The sky was incredibly blue, with light clouds that added liveliness to the picture. People walking along the path looked so small against the backdrop of the majestic walls. It felt like I had entered another world where peace and tranquility reigned. I love such walks when you can escape from the hustle and bustle and just enjoy the moment.

https://i.ibb.co/99BNXkmn/IMG-20230422-130008.jpg

I love photography. I spend time in nature, walking around the city. And I often take pictures when I see something interesting.

I always edit my pictures (mostly using Lightroom) and love sharing them with the community.

And here you can see some of my works, that you can find in my blog

body.title: Un exquisito almuerzo | A delicious lunch
body.body:
Un saludo afectuoso a todos mis amigos de Foodies Bee Hive. Espero que se encuentren muy bien, en Unión de sus familiares. Hoy les traigo una receta que les va a encantar, porque es fácil y rápida de hacer. En este mundo tan convulsionado de hoy, es necesario vivir la vida con calma. Es por ello, que debemos usar nuestro ingenio para distribuir el tiempo entre el trabajo y las labores del hogar, entre ellas la cocina. El almuerzo que prepare hoy es chuleta ahumada, ensalada de papas y zanahorias aderezadas con mayonesa y mostaza, acompañadas de arroz blanco. Esta ensalada de puede guardar en el refrigerador y el arroz también. Cuando llegamos del trabajo, inmediatamente los sacamos del refrigerador para que esté a temperatura ambiente, y solo ponemos a cocinar la carne. >Warm greetings to all my friends at Foodies Bee Hive. I hope you are all well and enjoying time with your families. Today I’m sharing a recipe you’re going to love, because it’s quick and easy to make. In today’s hectic world, it’s important to take life at a slower pace. That’s why we need to use our ingenuity to balance our time between work and household chores, including cooking. The lunch I’ve prepared today is smoked pork chop, potato and carrot salad dressed with mayonnaise and mustard, served with white rice. You can keep this salad in the fridge, and the rice too. When we get home from work, we simply take them out of the fridge to bring them to room temperature, and just cook the meat. ![IMG-20260512-WA0002.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzmilabracho/EpT8c9ys8JavRrs6HVMzmFWCRuyyztAmbtiSLHDGX1fdnVxiQ5pgdfL2Re9QrXSXpkU.jpg)
**Ingredientes:** - 1 chuleta ahumada - 4 papas - 2 zanahorias - 1 cebolla - 50 gr de cebollín - 50 gr de cilantro - 2 cucharadas de mayonesa - 1 cucharadita de mostaza - 1 cucharada de aceite - Sal al gusto - Arroz
**Ingredients:** - 1 smoked pork chop - 4 potatoes - 2 carrots - 1 onion - 50 g spring onions - 50 g coriander - 2 tablespoons mayonnaise - 1 teaspoon mustard - 1 tablespoon oil - Salt to taste - Rice
![IMG_20260512_142056.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzmilabracho/Ep7v9WbNqZ4CeBVhuyamwwpaeqcQ95sSHTLvm9NCgNGUwp3AbpQAQ8AdVxxscQ9pfXR.jpg) **Preparación:** Se lavan bien las papas y las zanahorias, se pelan y se cortan en trozos pequeños. Se pone a calentar agua con sal, y cuando esté hirviendo se agrega la zanahoria, ya que la zanahoria es más dura que las papas. Cuando la zanahoria ya ha comenzado su cocción, se espera unos minutos para añadir las papas. >**Preparation:** Wash the potatoes and carrots thoroughly, peel them and cut them into small pieces. Bring salted water to the boil, and when it is boiling, add the carrots, as they take longer to cook than the potatoes. Once the carrots have started to cook, wait a few minutes before adding the potatoes. ![IMG_20260512_144509.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzmilabracho/23y8x1i2FTL3DCScMAxFgNS8VZQtPN37pfsvvHHiSKYmRUYkwEG9btwRavpD87SX3eNVn.jpg) ![IMG_20260512_145644.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzmilabracho/23z7DuDa4iBDmSEzYmhx7h3CLp4Fez9qTqGSwondbHBvprntkBhnhWhYLxswmwC5ujppM.jpg) Se deben pinchar las papas y las zanahorias con un tenedor para saber si ya están cocidas. Se ponen a escurrir, mientras se va picando la cebolla, el cebollín y el cilantro, el cual previamente se había dejado en agua con vinagre unos 10 minutos para desinfectarlo. A su vez, se pone a cocinar el arroz y se sofríe la chuleta que preferí cortarla en cuadritos. >Prick the potatoes and carrots with a fork to check if they are cooked. Drain them, whilst chopping the onion, spring onion and coriander, which had previously been left to soak in water and vinegar for about 10 minutes to sanitise it. body.title: Photographing strangers in the park - Monomad Challenge.
body.body:
![cover.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23uQmv55tT5gU2VjXbw3gBan5ke3qSeZvyAd9srS3wC3tbXxprvAL22PpSHG1ghwpLdKT.jpg)
Greetings to all my friends in this beautiful community, today I am back with a new set of photographs that I took in the metropolitan park of my city as part of the content dynamic where I approach strangers and ask them if I can take photographs. On this occasion I want to show you the photos I took of a girl who had a very cool style, I saw her from afar and I thought she looked interesting because it is not common in my city to see people wearing bandanas, she obviously gave me her permission and we took these photos.
Un saludo a todos mis amigos en esta hermosa comunidad, hoy estoy de vuelta con un nuevo set de fotografias que hice en el parque metropolitano de mi ciudad como parte de la dinamica de contenido en donde me acerco a desconocidos y les pregunto si les puedo hacer fotografias. En esta ocasion les quiero mostrar las fotos que le hice a una chica que tenia un estilo muy cool, la vi desde lejos y me pareció que se veia interesante pues no es comun en mi ciudad ver personas utilizando pañoletas, ella obviamente me dió su permiso y hicimos estas fotos:
![IMG_9372.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23y8oLodjae8ZbbUqqNLActt7Q2Vrz6MaxKhrWpBQ7H2jeafZJQWuqigeYp3tuWFzsLUE.jpg)
Immediately I noticed that the girl posed very, very well in front of the camera and that she didn't ask me the typical question of \
, but rather she herself acted naturally, so I asked her if she was a model and her answer was that she was, and that in fact she had seen me pass by with the camera in hand and \

that I take photos of her. That is to say, in fact, she had seen me first and wanted to be photographed.
Inmediatamente noté que la chica posó muy muy bien frente a la camara y que no me hizo la tipica pregunta de ¿pero que hago? si no que ella misma se desenvolvió con naturalidad asi que le pregunté si era modelo y su respuesta fue que si y que de hecho me habia visto pasar con la camara en mano y \

que le hiciera fotos. Osea que de hecho, ella me habia visto a mi primero y queria ser fotografiada. ![IMG_9377.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23yd3ri4dcteD9Qdp5eeQ9UxzGYUWfWY6fjTFvke3vF4KvmvQm4KfAsh5Vh6gscVrhYeQ.jpg) ![IMG_9381.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23y8qa7e6gEhndi26foq8ufQ5CP8Gc1FLvrVgHVsbAAmjQkQLw1hiar1cyYCwCcraQ1tb.jpg)
I suggested that we take some standing photos, I started with a couple of full body photos and then I moved closer.
Le sugerí que hicieramos algunas fotos de pie, empecé por un par de fotos a cuerpo completo y luego me fuí acercando:
![IMG_9393.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23yJEKE5xvojP83DthdhdSCshQTwL3DC4W9d6t82g7ayUtwaXxmBdZ2T3EQkT5iYuqsu9.jpg) ![IMG_9396.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23wC7ZYwNTmMYJhZjZ5WqRQwmDmZw4axJRpxtr9UifFbxRkJ3eVEfmPJa1hBRK6F6sDW1.jpg) ![IMG_9398.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23vsGDbfp939Pq3JaMEZZB7qzV9jUtmZLV6HVPqQGRbTwn5P9auA4vgRX2CbhLJwySvJo.jpg)
And we finished this spontaneous \

with a couple of close-up photos.
Y finalizamos esta \

espontanea con un par de fotos en plano cercano: ![IMG_9388.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23vsC5SaQmmJFBgVdNgwCz9mGFRGAupPADxkK3tz2jb5Qpmuivz1RdApdNZ4tTrsFJxLY.jpg) ![IMG_9384.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23wC1Z2U6gYR3b8q44enRAFwQzghrALdKMw4W2XRWtyvcM1dmgpsKXbNkZX33psDuQBVR.jpg)
I took all the photos with my Canon R8 camera, a 50mm lens at 1.8/f and only natural light. In the end both the girl and I were super happy with the results and I hope you like them as much as we do!!
Todas las fotos las tomé con mi camara Canon R8, un lente 50mm a 1.8/f y solo luz natural. Al final tanto la chica como yo quedamos super contentos con los resultados y espero que a ustedes les gusten tanto como a nosotros!!

body.title: Oklahoma City are overwhelming favorites to win NBA Championship
body.body:
When this tournament began OKC was already the heavy favorites to win it all.   Now that we are approaching the semi-finals, not much has changed about that and normally with NBA you can bet  that the sportsbooks are going to be pretty accurate in an overall sense about who is going to win, especially this late in the game.

Really the only thing that could change any of that would to be if some sort of freak accident were to happen to one of the Thunder starters but let's be honest, it would likely need to be several players getting injured for anyone else to have a chance.  

<center> https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/ace/branded_sport/1200/cpsprodpb/495c/live/539f7e30-33d8-11f1-9f08-d151ff003a20.jpg
[src](https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/ace/branded_sport/1200/cpsprodpb/495c/live/539f7e30-33d8-11f1-9f08-d151ff003a20.jpg) </center> 

When OKC swept Phoenix this wasn't a big surprise.  The number 8 play-in teams are meant to get run over and that is why the brackets are designed that way.  OKC worked hard all season and I guess you could say that they deserve to have a bit of a weaker first round.   They quite handily won all of those games but the sports world was a bit up in the air about whether or not the LA Lakers were going to give them some trouble in the quarterfinals.  

They Lakers didn't put up much resistance as the Thunder went on to win all the games other than game 4 by an average of 20 points or so.  This is a blowout folks.   The 4th game being close is just OKC putting on the brakes because they don't have a sense of urgency.  I always kind of suspect when a team is playing the Lakers that there is probably some sort of back room pressure to draw the series out if possible, sine the LA market will spend untold amounts of money for home game tickets.   

But lets look at the current odds for who is going to win the overall championship.

OKC is -170 to -220 depending on where you look. This is a remarkable favorite numbers to have when there are still at least 8 games remaining for Oklahoma City before it possibly can be over.  

at the moment 63% of all bets are on OKC to win

The Knicks have made a statement in their relative thrashing of Atlanta and sweep of Philadelphia, and the fact that Philly ousted number 2 seed Boston pushed the odds up a bit as far as they are concerned.  They currently sit at +600 to +900 to win.   

Something that really surprised me is that number 1 seed (in the East) Detroit Pistons are the *least favorite* to win the whole thing at this point at a +1800 to +2000 and I think this has a lot to do with the fact that they narrowly avoided elimination at the hands of number 8 ranked Orlando and they are currently struggling with Cleveland even though they went up 2-0 initially.  

I think the Vegas odd-makers are kind of looking at San Antonio as well because they are a mere +320 to win it all.  This is quite surprising because they haven't even won their quaterfinal series which currently sits at 3-2 against the Minnesota Timberwolves.   

<center> https://sportshub.cbsistatic.com/i/r/2026/05/12/bc8548e3-6ced-4e52-bc97-c7ecac8d4086/thumbnail/1200x675/ca0a36b1d8589e485070d17d09dc87a3/nba-playoff-bracket-okc3.png
[src](https://sportshub.cbsistatic.com/i/r/2026/05/12/bc8548e3-6ced-4e52-bc97-c7ecac8d4086/thumbnail/1200x675/ca0a36b1d8589e485070d17d09dc87a3/nba-playoff-bracket-okc3.png) </center> 

Personally, I think it is going to take a miracle, or a string of injuries to OKC for there to be any champion other than them, they are just too good.  I suppose there is always some sort of shock outcome that could occur but when you consider the fact that other than the last two games of the regular season which were meaningless because OKC had already clinched the number 1 spot, they haven't lost a game since March and other than that 1 loss they won the other 15 games in that month.  They haven't lost back-to-back games since February.   

I would prefer that there was a bit more competition but for the most part I would say that this season was kind of wrapped up several months ago.   OKC is just one of those rare teams that is significantly better than anyone else.   While I reckon they could lose a game or two before the end of the tournament, I don't really feel as though there is any realistic chance of them not winning. 

But I'm just one guy that looks at stats.  Things could happen that are really shocking!  

What do you think?

body.title: ‎Who I Become at Midnight
body.body:
‎Hi Hive
‎
‎Here is my own opinion regarding the midnight letters community prompt on who I become at midnight.
‎
‎There is something about midnight that changes me.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmf7fNacq3hpKuExWfBPtKKMSQPMMBM31BrXfBXymGcPdH/file_00000000114c72469d6ae73366ba6181.png 

‎
‎I move like everyone else during the day. I smile when I need to, work when I have to, and pretend that everything is under control like I used to. The noise of life keeps me distracted. Phones ring, people talk, responsibilities pile up, and somehow the daylight gives me enough energy to keep going without thinking too deeply about myself.
‎
‎But things are different at midnight. And I became a owl at midnight.
‎
‎Midnight strips away distractions and leaves me alone with my thoughts. Midnight is the hour when silence becomes more louder than noise. The world slows down, and suddenly I can hear the conversations I have been avoiding within myself. That is when I become someone more honest.
‎
‎I become a dreamer at midnight.
‎
‎I begin to imagining the life I truly want. I think about the goals I have not yet achieved, the risks I am afraid to take, and the person I still hope to become someday. Sometimes I picture success so clearly that it feels almost real. And other nights, I question whether I am doing enough to reach it.
‎
‎I also become vulnerable at midnight.
‎
‎At midnight, memories return without warning. Old mistakes replay in my head. Regrets quietly visit , reminding me of words I should have said, opportunities I missed, and moments I can never bring back. It is strange how the darkness can make emotions feel more heavier than they do during daylight.
‎
‎But midnight is not my enemy despite all that.
‎
‎ I actually think midnight reveals my truest self.
‎
‎Because midnight is the only time when I stop performing for the world. No pretending. No pressure to appear strong. Just me, my thoughts, and my emotions sitting together in silence. That version of me may overthink too much, but he is also honest, reflective, and also full of hope.
‎
‎Sometimes I sit awake wondering if life will finally reward all the effort I keep putting in. And other times, I simply stare into the darkness and remind myself that difficult seasons do not last long.
‎
‎And maybe that's who I really become at midnight, a person caught between fear and hope.
‎
‎A person who is tired, but yet still dreaming.
‎
‎A person who might not yet have  everything figured out, but refuses to give up anyway.
‎
‎Because no matter how heavy the night feels, but deep down I still believe morning will come with another chance to keep fighting for the life I want.
‎
‎**This post was published around 5:0am**
‎
**Image Used Is AI Generated**
‎
‎![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYaWnApEziAtLL5Zwv3ZNbDjRfSfG6h5njgTrpyasnE6y/1775569275821.png)

body.title: Gray Island A good hunting spot in Tibia (Esp/Eng)
body.body: > [Esp] ¡Saludos comunidad! Con las ultimas actualizaciones de Tibia donde agregaron task semanales y diarias, el precio de las creature products se han incrementado, antiguas zonas de caza han vuelto a florecer. Este es el caso de las ciudades más antiguas de Tibia y a la vez más olvidadas en Gray Island Hoy en mis task diarias me toco cazar la criatura Deepling Spellsinger, puedo decir que me fue super bien.

> [Eng] Hello everyone! With the latest Tibia updates, which introduced weekly and daily tasks, the price of creature products has risen, and old hunting grounds have come back to life. This is the case in Tibia’s oldest and, at the same time, most forgotten cities and yet the most overlooked on Gray Island. Today, as part of my daily tasks, I had to hunt the Deepling Spellsinger creature, and I can say it went really well. ---
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23x1YN1cVfkFGFUApsNEqcy14kxB39rxwAvrfhHpVnSeH2hL1EmizukyCqHNz4teH41nn.jpg
![2026-05-04_095355994_Queen of Seireitei_Achievement.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/EoAUVay7TvPm85zLRM1WFdjdLYTm3uUpFLnWzCx5af6gunmLT641RgCwh8RsgJBKc3v.png) ![2026-05-12_152512663_Sanctus Lumin_Hotkey.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23uFPGBEDp9YzYuMLGmWTyneDoomvcNoB4FKpMsTLuS11uYRPtJ1b6DBtuaxzxwAzWArV.png) ![2026-05-12_152556480_Sanctus Lumin_Hotkey.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/EoEpUjtKr4NyxzgARaQP6ADBnhQEGGWvc9C76EdfW9hLjPAcJBBLAQPmNX2T33hrVsA.png)

para entrar en ella hay que hacer ciertas quest, como por ejemplo: Liquid Black Quest, que no es muy difícil de hacer con buen nivel, además de tener el acceso ganarás un outfit de recompensa ente otras cosas. Era una zona de alta demanda, existe una parte que para abrirla hay que hacer puntos de quest, casi nadie los está haciendo, aun así puedes cazar en sus alrededores y va muy bien. Solo me tocaba matar al rededor de 50 criaturas Deepling Spellsinger, sin embargo una buena recolección de productos y armas que sueltan las varias criaturas de allí son muy buenas para recuperar dinero.

> [Eng] This area is known as ‘The Temple of the Deeplings’. To enter it, you need to complete certain quests, such as the Liquid Black Quest, which isn’t too difficult if you’re at a high enough level. As well as gaining access, you’ll receive a reward outfit, among other things. It used to be a highly sought-after area; there is a section that requires quest points to unlock, and hardly anyone is doing them. Even so, you can hunt in the surrounding areas and it works out very well. I only had to kill around 50 Deepling Spellsinger creatures, but the good haul of items and weapons dropped by the various creatures there is excellent for making money.
---
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23x1YN1cVfkFGFUApsNEqcy14kxB39rxwAvrfhHpVnSeH2hL1EmizukyCqHNz4teH41nn.jpg?token=7e431c7db164fa4bff1436ce826f5301151c488c57a5dd67 ![2026-05-12_152537837_Sanctus Lumin_Hotkey.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23u5xfXU9DP1cmhya8PcAaqfHKnF6YjnBeqWhQ6MVzs5Exu9i39rEC587ofQucJ2nWzH8.png) ![2026-05-12_153716070_Sanctus Lumin_Hotkey.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23tbrmVnu4zVWA498k6EPf2W5MYuDFYVYTryEfqnTeeevK2321jq2jGvkafV3cQ3k8pwK.png)

> [Esp] Es fácil perderse en estas zonas asi que sugiero hacer tus marcas, las primeras veces que vine me perdí y tardé horas en encontrar la salida. Esto es por sus infinitos túneles, escaleras, salidas y entradas. También en esta zonas hay tres grandes bosses: Jaul, Obujos, Tanjis que son muy buscados porque podrían soltar ítems muy valiosos, sin embargo requiere de que tengas un nivel superior a 450 para ello.

> [Eng] It’s easy to get lost in these areas, so I suggest you make a note of your route; the first few times I came here, I got lost and it took me hours to find my way out. This is because of the endless tunnels, staircases, exits and entrances. There are also three major bosses Jaul, Obujos, Tanjis in these areas that are highly sought after as they can drop very valuable items; however, you’ll need to be level 450 or above to take them on. ---
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23x1YN1cVfkFGFUApsNEqcy14kxB39rxwAvrfhHpVnSeH2hL1EmizukyCqHNz4teH41nn.jpg?token=7e431c7db164fa4bff1436ce826f5301151c488c57a5dd67 ![2026-05-12_154012277_Sanctus Lumin_Hotkey.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23uQNUERNbSgsMUDnabbLCa3DGe6nMNuEjjs7KnzUdGNrfD6rBKeNXurKJiBXvbhVf64Y.png) ![2026-05-12_154313883_Sanctus Lumin_Hotkey.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23tvVzLFXjWEC8bC3RpLQtehWuTmTwZDCY3ymB785NuEX1TqpQ8yLnogMFn11BG2LyMh4.png)

>

[Esp]

Es raro ver gente en estos lugares cazando, a menos que como yo, estén haciendo task, pero me llevé la sorpresa de encontrar el cuerpo de un jugador que por curioso y quizá con un bajo nivel se atrevió a enfrentarse a muchas criaturas y pues... murió... También puede ser que perdió conexión a internet o la moda nueva \

> [Eng] It’s rare to see people hunting in these places, unless, like me, they’re doing a quest, but I was surprised to come across the body of a player who, out of curiosity and perhaps because they were a low-level character, dared to take on a whole host of creatures and, well… died… It could also be that they lost their internet connection or, as the new trend goes, ‘ran out of power’. ---
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23x1YN1cVfkFGFUApsNEqcy14kxB39rxwAvrfhHpVnSeH2hL1EmizukyCqHNz4teH41nn.jpg?token=7e431c7db164fa4bff1436ce826f5301151c488c57a5dd67 ![2026-05-12_154707544_Sanctus Lumin_Hotkey.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23tbiNC25f6vXZpKwj7SGv21TP83t15W74jM3JbGcHy8MnYCcP22TzHCU17gnsCtXzGpz.png) ![2026-05-12_161219695_Sanctus Lumin_Hotkey.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23tSUETv7z9T8DvuqxLj1rfzdAC5gs8MjFCPyeCCGopr8bjXfCcftTGxscg2v3iCZkAB3.png)

> [Esp] Visualmente me gusta esta zona, aunque cazo más en la zona de Hive en Tibia, ya que el riesgo es mínimo y las ganancias son buenas. Este lugar es atractivo en cuanto a colores pasteles y elementos del mar que me gustan mucho. Las criaturas que enfrenté a pesar de que solo me interesaba Deepling Spellsinger son: Deepling Guard, Deepling Tyrant, Deepling Warrior, Deepling Worker y otras criaturas del mar más pequeñas e inofensivas como el Jellyfish y Shark. Igual es bueno ocupar todas porque todas sueltan items que podemos comercializar. Espero les guste mi recorrido, yo feliz que al fin pude jugar un ratico.

> [Eng] Visually, I like this area, although I do most of my hunting in the Hive area in Tibia, as the risk is minimal and the rewards are good. This place is appealing because of its pastel colours and sea-themed elements, which I really like. The creatures I faced, even though I was only interested in the Deepling Spellsinger, were: Deepling Guard, Deepling Tyrant, Deepling Warrior, Deepling Worker, and other smaller, harmless sea creatures such as the Jellyfish and Shark. It’s still worth taking them all down, as they all drop items we can sell. I hope you like my run; I’m happy I finally got to play for a bit.
---

body.title: Carlsen Back to Playing Classical Chess, Wins TePe Sigeman 2026
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbLc1mWqMee7v15PcVUgUQyZ46N2wMkrFazfufhTVeuf6/image.png)*photo from fide.com*

Magnus Carlsen emerged as the champion of the TePe Sigeman & Co. Chess Tournament 2026 defeating Arjun Erigaisi in an exciting blitz playoff.

Held in Malmo, the 2026 tournament featured a strong eight player round robin field that included world No. 1 Magnus Carlsen, world No. 4 Nodirbek Abdusattorov, world No. 11 Arjun Erigaisi, and world No. 16 Jorden van Foreest. He returned to elite classical play there after reducing his participation in classical events over the past few years. Before Malmo, Carlsen had played very little classical chess, this was one of his rare participation in a traditional round robin event outside Norway since 2023.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZHVSP1DND7kdWvBkmY3VZQqhFM4pLyhqEJRoYJTuxnjg/image.png)

The game we'll see is against teenage American grandmaster Andy Woodward. Magnus had the Black pieces in this game. 


The game started with 1. d4 Nf6 2. c4 g6 3. Nc3 Bg7 4. e4 d6 5. Be2 O-O 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUp1dug7KLKyGKfLb2XxJSR2bSeq5cm8Ceq7XuHU3fFWo/image.png)

The King's Indian Defense, it has a reputation of being an aggressive option for Black. It was very popular in Kasparov's heyday but has fallen out of favor in recent years. Earlier in the tournament, Magnus played the Benoni Defense and now, the KID 6. Be3 a5 7. Nf3 Ng4 8. Bg5 h6 9. Bc1 e5 10. O-O Nf6 11. Be3 Ng4 12. Bc1 Nd7 13. h3 Ngf6 14. Be3 exd4 15. Nxd4 Nc5 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPW8THcVDiXtYUvo4dfAbzjzUSGnUZySz9uvtUVVNsfJZ/image.png)

We reached a position that has been played by Andy before in 2022. In that game, he played Qc2 which I think is better than his choice in this game. 16. f3 Nh5 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWgK7gGaZwbhHu14EHDw4AiGtyaVVjKTURjs1JFwRQVCB/image.png)

The move f3 seriously weakened the dark squares around his King. Magnus will grind this position down and squeeze every advantage to win. 17. Qd2 g5 18. Bd1 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfUkSEZWah8hf79rrxTHEbtk74cHZaFqnuLjT7t6fmnAN/image.png)



A tactical retreat so that one of his Knights can occupy the e2 square and help defend the dark squares. The Bishop can move to c2 and train his sights on Black's Kingside. 18. ...Be6 19. b3 a4 20. Bc2 axb3 21. axb3 Rxa1 22. Rxa1 Be5 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT5zEG4T3MqNpGrQwn266SdhVwZLm2YpVS7pCptRmQbKk/image.png)



The Bishop on e5 reinforces Black's control over the dark squares. 23. Ra7 c6 24. Nce2 Nf4 25. Bf2 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRfQtizYaHfN1ezUjpdLujVCb9RckA7kiNAx89jZVViSE/image.png)




Andy declines the pawn sacrifice. If Bxf4 gxf4 Nxf4 Qg5 wins a piece 25. ...Nxe2+ 26. Nxe2 Qf6 27. Be3 Bxh3 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRzFvB5kMs1jBiDaocxABNCouk3Zbxw3hMnTNb2wPHWmr/image.png)



Magnus stuns the youngster with a piece sacrifice. Accepting it will lead to an attack after Qxf3. So Andy declined the piece sacrifice. 28. b4 Nd7 29. Rxb7 Be6 30. Nd4 Ra8 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcrcYBQ3aBNUEvRBEKTaUqive22WgppkZq8tkbGiSzvjp/image.png)

The Rook joins the attack via the a file, threatening to invade White's first rank. 31. Nxe6 Qxe6 32. Bd3 Ra1+ 33. Kf2 Nf6 34. Ra7 Rh1 35. Ke2 Nh5 36. Qa2 g4 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVbzVksnYGPyCSJoZ4YKTjpq1Az7vBZXQTWjsSvoXFVsK/image.png)


The can opener, g4 will expose White's King. 37. f4 Ra1 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf24pB5zzNMrW2DwWxQgLAEbrHfqDVcJZB8vNPpAWSYfc/image.png)

Magnus can already win the f4 pawn but he wants to distract White's Bishop first. But Andy decided to give up his Queen for two pieces. 38. Qxa1 Bxa1 39. Rxa1 Ng3+ 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRm4nAcD6fVQonSFz7CLjbYXLyFm5MmtHtC93EoQpngHd/image.png)

Black already has a winning position and converted it after a few moves. 40. Kd2 Nxe4+ 41. Kc2 f5 42. b5 cxb5 43. Ra8+ Kg7 44. cxb5 Qd5 45. Rc8 Nf2 46. Rc7+ Kg6 47. Bc4 Qd1+ 48. Kb2 d5 { Black wins. } 0-1

A masterful game by Magnus Carlsen. 

Game link: https://lichess.org/zdLuB9sq#0

Link to Andy's 2022 game: https://lichess.org/qMGsHC2B#27

body.title: The Art of Endurance in Bloom
body.body:
Paperflower, often admired for its vibrant bracts and effortless charm, is a plant that quietly teaches us about resilience. Commonly known as bougainvillea, this flowering climber thrives where many others struggle—under harsh sun, in dry soil, and against unforgiving walls. Its colors, ranging from soft pastels to blazing magentas, feel almost hand-crafted, like delicate sheets of paper shaped by nature’s own hands. Yet beneath that fragile appearance lies a spirit of remarkable strength.

What makes the paperflower truly fascinating is the contrast between illusion and reality. The showy parts we admire are not the true flowers at all, but bracts—leaf-like structures that protect the small, humble blossoms hidden inside. This subtle trick of nature feels deeply human: sometimes the most meaningful parts of life are quietly protected, unseen behind beauty or bravado. The paperflower invites us to look closer, to appreciate what lies beneath the surface.

There is also something poetic about how the paperflower grows—wild, uncontained, and unapologetically bold. It does not conform neatly; instead, it spills, climbs, and stretches toward the light. This untamed growth mirrors the human desire to reach beyond limits, to claim space, and to express oneself fully. The paperflower reminds us that beauty does not have to be delicate or restrained to be meaningful.

body.title: From Planting to Progress: My Onion Farming Journey 🌱🧅
body.body:
Every successful harvest begins with a single step, and for me, this onion journey started with hope, hard work, and determination. Looking at these before and after photos reminds me that farming is truly a process of patience and faith. What begins as tiny seeds in the soil can later become a healthy and productive crop when given proper care.
In the first stage, I prepared the land carefully and planted my onion seeds with great expectation. The weather was hot, and the work was not easy, but I remained focused because farming rewards consistency. Preparing the seedbed involved loosening the soil, removing weeds, and ensuring the land could support healthy germination. Good soil preparation is very important in onion farming because onions need soft, well-drained soil to grow properly.
After planting, the waiting period began. This stage requires patience because the seeds remain hidden under the soil before the first signs of life appear. During this time, I watered the seedbed carefully and monitored moisture levels to avoid drying out the young seeds. I also protected the area from weeds and pests that could damage the seedlings.
A few days later, the transformation started to show. Tiny green onion shoots began emerging from the soil, bringing excitement and motivation. Seeing those young seedlings standing fresh and healthy felt rewarding because it showed that the effort was paying off. The second photo clearly shows the progress from bare soil to a living green nursery full of young onion plants.
Farming teaches us valuable lessons every day. It teaches patience, discipline, and the importance of hard work. Crops do not grow overnight, but with dedication and proper management, progress becomes visible little by little. This onion nursery is still at an early stage, but it already represents growth, hope, and future harvests.
One thing I enjoy most about farming is watching nature respond to care and attention. Healthy seedlings are the foundation of a successful onion harvest. If the nursery stage is managed well, the transplanted onions will have a better chance of producing quality bulbs later in the season.
I am grateful for this progress and motivated to continue caring for the crop until harvest time. To fellow farmers and gardening lovers, never underestimate small beginnings. Every big harvest starts with tiny seeds planted with determination.
The journey continues, and I look forward to sharing more updates as the onions grow stronger each day.

title.body:
> 

![Black Blue Futuristic Cyber Security Presentation.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23uQGVAuoc6VFR8igq65BELHYDpEo5khNnNKvLTn9KbPFxnZpnabc5izL1Koeg3mX7c1e.jpg)

# 🔐 Cyber Security Daily News | 13.05.2026

Codzienny przegląd ciekawszych wiadomości ze świata cyberbezpieczeństwa, do poczytania przy porannej kawie, podzielony na kluczowe kategorie.

![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23tknCkT1U11copjbdW3iXuLr4MmFvLtJYh5VywWc6jj5MWmaAAdEtEUtH2z7Spr53uf9.jpg)

---

## 📰 NEWS

### ***Microsoft Patch Tuesday maj 2026 — 137 podatności, 13 krytycznych, rekordy z powodu AI***

Majowy Patch Tuesday Microsoftu przyniósł łatki dla 137 podatności, w tym 13 ocenionych jako krytyczne — rekordowa pula wynika bezpośrednio z rosnącego zastosowania AI do automatycznego wykrywania błędów w kodzie. Wśród naprawionych luk znalazły się dwa zero-daye aktywnie eksploitowane: podatność w Windows Common Log File System (eskalacja uprawnień) oraz luka w Microsoft DWM Core Library. Krytyczne naprawki objęły m.in. zdalne wykonanie kodu przez Scripting Engine w Edge i Internet Explorerze, luki w usługach Azure oraz błędy RCE w protokole RDP. Administratorzy powinni priorytetowo traktować łatki dla serwerów Windows i systemów z aktywnym RDP — obie zero-daye były już obserwowane w rzeczywistych atakach przed wydaniem poprawek.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/242DCDYs6YyFwQVCpUD4iySrYr77YbfPByQGSoKBisqYVwsFWtuco1oNWkeAHsExePFDZ.png)

*Źródło: [CyberScoop](https://cyberscoop.com/microsoft-patch-tuesday-may-2026/) [EN], [Dark Reading](https://www.darkreading.com/application-security/patch-tuesday-microsoft-zero-day-sight) [EN], [KrebsOnSecurity](https://krebsonsecurity.com/2026/05/patch-tuesday-may-2026-edition/) [EN]*

---

### ***Android zyska \
— Google i Amnesty International wspólnie walczą ze spyware***\n\nCyberScoop opisuje przełomową inicjatywę: Google we współpracy z Amnesty International Tech wbuduje w Androida funkcję \

— pasywne zbieranie zaszyfrowanych logów aktywności systemu, które po złamaniu zabezpieczeń telefonu można przekazać badaczom do analizy bez narażania prywatności użytkownika na co dzień. Projekt jest bezpośrednią odpowiedzią na falę ataków spyware (Pegasus, Predator, BirdCall) — do tej pory udowodnienie infekcji wymagało drogich narzędzi forensycznych. Logi mają być przechowywane lokalnie w formie zaszyfrowanej i dostępne wyłącznie na żądanie właściciela urządzenia. Wdrożenie planowane w kolejnej wersji Androida.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23tSjJL8RSUBzBFdW4Jsht5fuyK6qYqWri2cUs5X2dWFBgZWixTUsfZBofHqSPHsFr9i4.png)

*Źródło: [CyberScoop](https://cyberscoop.com/google-android-intrusion-logging-amnesty-spyware-detection/) [EN]*

---

### ***Ukraina zacieśnia relacje z Palantir — AI dla armii i systemy kontrwywiadowcze***

CyberDefence24 informuje, że ukraińskie ministerstwo obrony podpisało rozszerzone porozumienie z firmą Palantir Technologies, dotyczące głębszej integracji systemów AI w operacjach wojskowych. Platformy Palantir mają wspierać analizę danych wywiadowczych, śledzenie logistyki na polu walki i wykrywanie wrogich sieci agenturalnych. Ukraina stała się de facto globalnym poligonem dla bojowych zastosowań AI — jej doświadczenia kształtują doktryny NATO. Wdrożenie Palantira przez kraj aktywnie walczący jest bezprecedensowe i budzi zarówno entuzjazm (skuteczność operacyjna), jak i pytania etyczne o rolę prywatnych firm w wojnie.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23xoYjcRMYLRu2dNmRUghfY7grNawJVkSQwEt2BNESsJ85CNQbpgCWWPgcG3GtQKDVneG.png)

*Źródło: [CyberDefence24](https://cyberdefence24.pl/armia-i-sluzby/wojna-w-ukrainie/ukraina-zaciesnia-relacje-z-palantirem) [PL]*

---

## 🚨 INCYDENTY

### ***Mini Shai Hulud — podpisane złośliwe paczki npm TanStack i Mistral w ataku supply chain***

BleepingComputer i CyberScoop opisują atak \

: cyberprzestępcy opublikowali złośliwe wersje popularnych pakietów npm — TanStack (framework webowy z milionami pobrań) i Mistral (biblioteka kliencka dla modeli AI) — podpisane ukradzionymi kluczami, co sprawiło, że systemy weryfikacji zaakceptowały je jako autentyczne. Paczki zawierały złośliwy kod eksfiltrujący tokeny uwierzytelniające z CI/CD, zmienne środowiskowe i sekrety cloudowe. Deweloperzy, którzy zaktualizowali zależności w oknie ataku, mogli skompromitować całe pipeline'y produkcyjne. Npm wykrył i usunął złośliwe wersje, lecz okno dystrybucji liczyło kilkadziesiąt minut — wystarczająco dla zautomatyzowanych systemów buildowania.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23tkpDRrxF1moXBCzinLXLNYkFikHHKyW8pquykGsvJCX9Q4VS5hyrsX4QQr4k1jNdyfx.png)

*Źródło: [BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/shai-hulud-attack-ships-signed-malicious-tanstack-mistral-npm-packages/) [EN], [CyberScoop](https://cyberscoop.com/mini-shai-hulud-supply-chain-malware-attack/) [EN]*

---

### ***Skoda — wyciek danych klientów europejskiego sklepu internetowego po cyberataku***

BleepingComputer potwierdza incydent bezpieczeństwa w oficjalnym sklepie internetowym Skody: hakerzy uzyskali dostęp do bazy danych klientów zawierającej imiona, adresy, dane kontaktowe i historię zamówień. Producent samochodów poinformował poszkodowanych i złożył zgłoszenie do odpowiednich organów ochrony danych. Atak na e-commerce branży motoryzacyjnej wpisuje się w trend — dane o zakupach i serwisowaniu pojazdów są cenne dla przestępców zarówno ze względu na docelowy phishing, jak i dane z dokumentów wymaganych przy finansowaniu.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23xA2FT4AoV1igPDnEGCMddgBuYmNTQ1BjQgGiBJrCGg4TjtC6Q46NnKeSoYiaN6Zii1i.png)

*Źródło: [BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/skoda-warns-of-customer-data-breach-after-online-shop-hack/) [EN]*

---

### ***Wielka Brytania ukarała dostawcę wody grzywną £1,3 mln za ujawnienie danych 664 tysięcy klientów***

Brytyjskie ICO (Information Commissioner's Office) nałożyło karę finansową w wysokości 1,3 mln funtów na dostawcę wody South Staffordshire za incydent bezpieczeństwa, w którym dane osobowe 664 tysięcy klientów zostały ujawnione przez luki w systemach IT. Incydent jest szczególnie poważny ze względu na charakter firmy — infrastruktura krytyczna — i sposób przetwarzania danych klientów. Decyzja ICO podkreśla, że obowiązki RODO/UK GDPR dotyczą również firm z sektora użyteczności publicznej, które historycznie były traktowane mniej rygorystycznie w kwestii bezpieczeństwa IT.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/48fNM3jYhkQ8EKVcKi7Hk9y5ij1Brz8e8rtyLT64shQye9sjgKWu2pamqtAZeFz3oW.png)

*Źródło: [BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/uk-fines-water-supplier-13m-for-exposing-data-of-664k-customers/) [EN]*

---

## 💡 CIEKAWOSTKI

### ***LLMJacking 2026 — przestępcy kradną klucze API do prywatnych serwerów AI i odsprzedają dostęp***

Kaspersky opisuje gwałtownie rosnące zjawisko \

: cyberprzestępcy kradną klucze API lub dane logowania do prywatnych instancji dużych modeli językowych (hostowanych przez organizacje na własnej infrastrukturze lub w chmurze) i odsprzedają dostęp innym grupom. Koszty uruchamiania dużych modeli AI są olbrzymie — ukradziony dostęp pozwala konkurencyjnym grupom przestępczym korzystać z mocy obliczeniowej ofiary za darmo do generowania malware, tworzenia phishingowych treści lub łamania captcha. Organizacje korzystające z AI w chmurze powinny monitorować anomalnie wysokie koszty tokenów, rotować klucze API i stosować zasadę minimalnych uprawnień dla każdego modelu.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23yJg65SYJ84a1R6LtdyE4BMg8ZYwNWg8aVFwf7h8EAud7o9BER9etGf6mox2YFxafM12.png)

*Źródło: [Kaspersky Blog](https://www.kaspersky.co.uk/blog/llmjacking-2026-private-ai-server-security/30564/) [EN]*

---

### ***Badanie: Polacy nie dają się nabrać — wyjątkiem są fałszywe e-maile o urlopach i benefitach***

CRN.pl opisuje wyniki badania phishingowego przeprowadzonego na próbie polskich pracowników korporacyjnych: ogólna skuteczność phishingu jest w Polsce niższa niż średnia europejska — Polacy są stosunkowo czujni wobec fałszywych faktur czy powiadomień IT. Jednak jeden typ wiadomości konsekwentnie wyróżnia się wysoką skutecznością: e-maile podszywające się pod wiadomości z działu HR dotyczące urlopów, benefitów i zmian w wynagrodzeniu. Emocjonalne zaangażowanie (urlop, premia) wyłącza czujność nawet u osób, które w innych kontekstach rozpoznają phishing. To ważna wskazówka dla działów bezpieczeństwa organizujących symulacje ataków.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23xxs4N2a4gELPDDgSJXBCYnH9pV6yHH72nRznvqn7yubuLGfnEmUGeBs1VmqRbRYFmGk.png)

*Źródło: [CRN.pl](https://crn.pl/aktualnosci/polacy-nie-daja-sie-latwo-nabrac-wyjatkiem-sa-falszywe-e-maile-o-urlopach/) [PL]*

---

## 🎣 OSZUSTWA, SCAMY, EXPLOITY

### ***Sekurak: InstallFix celuje w użytkowników Claude Code — kampania dystrybuuje RedLine Stealer***

Badacze Trend Micro opisani przez Sekurak wykryli nową kampanię InstallFix wymierzoną bezpośrednio w użytkowników Claude Code — narzędzia do agentowego programowania od Anthropic. Atakujący kupują sponsorowane reklamy w wyszukiwarkach dla zapytań o instalację Claude Code i kierują ofiary do stron z precyzyjnymi instrukcjami \

, nakłaniającymi do uruchomienia polecenia w terminalu. Polecenie pobiera i uruchamia RedLine Stealer — jednego z najpopularniejszych infostealerów kradnącego hasła z przeglądarek, portfele kryptowalutowe i tokeny uwierzytelniające. Kampania jest elementem szerszej fali ataków InstallFix/ClickFix, które w ciągu ostatnich tygodni kolejno celowały w DAEMON Tools, JDownloader, Homebrew i teraz Claude Code. Jedyne bezpieczne źródło Claude Code to oficjalna dokumentacja Anthropic na docs.anthropic.com.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23tcNs1mZELFjgXxmTV3V7x71Ru8uUGZoxm9WYnoywBwHGGDeJv3e2rcfG7BuWDusPUuE.png)

*Źródło: [Sekurak](https://sekurak.pl/kolejna-odslona-installfix-tym-razem-na-celowniku-claude-code/) [PL]*

---

### ***OLX + WhatsApp = wyłudzenie — schemat wciąż aktywny, CERT Orange i CyberDefence24 ostrzegają***

CERT Orange i CyberDefence24 jednocześnie ostrzegają przed wciąż aktywnym schematem wyłudzeń na platformach ogłoszeniowych: rzekomy \
kontaktuje się przez WhatsApp zamiast przez chat OLX, twierdząc, że \

, po czym wysyła link do fałszywej strony płatności podszywającej się pod OLX, DPD lub Allegro. Strona wyłudza dane karty kredytowej lub inicjuje kod BLIK. Schemat nie jest nowy, ale jest stale odnawiany: nowe domeny, nowe szablony SMS, nowe preteksty — i wciąż skuteczny. Bezpieczna zasada: wszelkie transakcje na OLX finalizuj wyłącznie przez wbudowane narzędzia platformy i nigdy nie otwieraj linków przesłanych przez zewnętrzne komunikatory.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23xehXjRMLGXyRbfYUNLynAmcg4pPwEfxBphdtwCwfBbR2Eu6PPbacDtd8Jm2wWzzQFdH.png)

*Źródło: [Dobreprogramy / CERT Orange](https://www.dobreprogramy.pl/cert-orange-uwazaj-na-whatsappa-i-falszywe-linki,7285058217035808a) [PL], [CyberDefence24](https://cyberdefence24.pl/cyberbezpieczenstwo/cyberataki/sprzedajesz-na-olx-uwazaj-na-wiadomosci-od-kupujacych-na-whatsappie) [PL]*

---

### ***CERT Polska: dwa nowe ostrzeżenia — QR kody \
***\n\nCERT Polska wydał jednocześnie dwa nowe alerty. Pierwszy dotyczy phishingu biznesowego: pracownicy firm otrzymują e-maile z tematem \
zawierające kody QR, które po zeskanowaniu proszą o ponowne zalogowanie do firmowych systemów — na fałszywej stronie. Drugi alert dotyczy fałszywych maili sextortion z tematem \

: wiadomości grożą upublicznieniem kompromitujących materiałów i żądają okupu w kryptowalutach. Maile są masowo rozsyłane i nie zawierają żadnych rzeczywistych danych — to czysta socjotechnika oparta na poczuciu winy i strachu. Oba typy wiadomości należy zignorować i zgłosić na incydent.cert.pl.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23tSxMfXasfUVf1g2xRxTMSeoHJ7Dovwjq1oScjXJtzbJSv6yNmvDsUp8Y5C7vrD98HKz.png)

*Źródło: [CERT Polska](https://moje.cert.pl/komunikaty/2026/64/nowe-zasady-w-firmie-oszusci-wykorzystuja-kody-qr/) [PL], [CERT Polska](https://moje.cert.pl/komunikaty/2026/63/wiemy-co-robiles-online-falszywe-maile-o-przejeciu-danych/) [PL]*

---
