title.title: Ways People Accidentally Recreate “Authority” While Claiming To Reject It
title.body:
I am going to deconstruct some common misconceptions and phrases but I need to drill this point into your head or else you won't get it.

# There is not such thing as authority.

Ok???

Gooood.

Keep that lense on for a minute. One day you'll get it and it will hit you so hard and many things will become crystal clear. But until that day comes, just try to keep up for meantime.


![1000029655.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/muhshrooms/23tkk3Xdeqozh4PyXLjYnCbNEb7E5F3C1zKGUpUCnvUrknFLGNRH3DXASBormfTga5dM9.png)


Anyways. Moving on.

Most people who are still under the indoctrinated belief of authority being legitimate and including those at the edge of figuring it out, like the rebels and fresh students of anarchists, still often mistake coercion, social conditioning, and institutional force for something called legitimate authority, but that thing itself does not exist. And it's not, because I say so that it is or that my vocabulary is above average, nor because I a am a smart and an ass sometimes, but because after carefully analysing with logic and rationality and the lack of evidence(non existent), there could be only one conclusion. 

It doesn't exist. Never has and never will. Period. By no stretch of the imagination can it even be close to a possibility that it can. It is simply mathematically impossible as you will soon see for yourself.

Damn, did you hear a broken record on repeat or was it just me?

Hmm. Oh well. Must be that echolalia hitting me again or something.

Now to present to you some breakdowns of some common phrases and some psychology and philosophy to go with it. These are phrases that pretend to acknowledge that authority is fiction but yet still is framed from the premise that it exists. 

### “There’s no authority but you.”

Rather than question the very premise, the foundation, the root of it, it takes \

and simply relocates it to the self. It doesn't bring to the surface that it is not a legitimate phenomenon.

I am not dismissing self governance at all, only differentiating that it is not the same as having the right to rule. 

For example. 

I can rule myself yes. And you can rule yourself. But neither you nor me nor with the consent of someone else to be ruled, have a legitimate ownership over that individual, consent or not. This is because, to rule is to go against the will of the soul. It is anti-life. It deliberately places an natural born being into servitude even if it believes it is free.

The moment we govern another is to go against the soul. And a soul is not meant to be a slave. He is to be a free man or woman just like you and I. So even if we collect a hundred more people or even 100 million or billion people to vote to rule that one man, it does not grant us that right simply because we can govern ourselves. Because to govern ourselves is to be conscious and ethical. It is not the same as \

because nobody has it. Authority and the right to self governance are not the same thing. Authority is a superstition. Held only by the belief in it. And woe is to man for many of us have been dupped into believing it. I and I included.

So I am very aware of what I am saying to you all because I am also attacking and old belief system I once held close.

But maybe it will help you if you equated it to s number. Not 1+1 or 2+2 but zero. 

We each have ZERO (0) authority. 

So, no matter how many zeros we put together and add it, or do rain dances and write magic parchments, the result is the same throughout. Thus all those who still hold on to the belief can't comprehend that they are infact in belief that 0+0=1. How sad indeed.

Next slide please.

## \
my kid or my son and daughters\

body.title: I killed a lot of zombies in Zombie Harbor
body.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1778642878075-e043c681297def53.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=likhon420/cae6ff24)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=likhon420/cae6ff24)


---

Zombie Harbor is a first person ultimate offline zombie survival shooting game.The game us published by Keystorm Holdings Limited.The game features intense action, a collection of various guns, and realistic graphics.There are different types of zombies in the game and there are zombie bosses as well, you have to kill them to complete the mission.

You have to use a lot of intelligence and different skills to win the game because every moment here is very challenging and if you cannot focus on it well then you will lose here.There are many guns in the game and those guns can be updated with money, but it has to be updated with in-game money.The fun thing about the game is that it can be played in two modes: online and offline.

A medium-level device is enough to play the game. There is no need for a very powerful device.The game has been created with 3D graphics, smooth performance, and smooth controls.The game can be a nice game for zombie shooter lovers because this game is very difficult.Because there is a system in the game that zombies will start killing you before you can shoot.

Completing each mission requires quick thinking and precise aim.Killing the zombie boss is even harder than killing the zombies in this game.The game has a multiplayer mood system.If you want, you can play this game with friends in multiplayer mode.If you watch my gameplay, you will understand how difficult and challenging this game is.

But the interesting thing is that due to its offline mode, this game has captured the hearts of many people because there is no obligation to be online all the time. If you are offline, people can spend their free time playing this game and this game is very enjoyable.I play this game almost every day when there is no internet.The game can be played at a maximum of 60 FPS.

However, the game has some bugs and lag issues.But it can be played offline. Overall, I really liked the game.And I did not use any external parts in my gameplay, that is, I did not use any copyrighted parts.

Thanks everyone.Hope I will give you something better in the next.

---

body.title: Tomates confitados | #FoodieMood | Esp-Eng
body.body:
![1000534753.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23wgPq6QRtmbcf9LoDyhqpugx47n4768aiDXUZbHQrafk9tmiNRSpPUTox7Rj1FRgeUXK.jpg)
Recuerdan que les mostré los tomates cherry que coseché en casa, y les dejé la incógnita sobre qué iba a preparar con ellos. También les comenté que obtuve 155 gramos, una cantidad que me pareció ideal para probar el hacer tomates confitados. No los había hecho antes y siempre se me mostraban en Instagram; ya saben cómo el algoritmo va mostrando todo aquello que llega a relacionar con otras publicaciones vistas con anterioridad, por lo cual mis búsquedas culinarias siempre me llevan a nuevas opciones para preparar. Ya había leído que estos tomates confitados resultan tener un gran sabor, sumamente profundo, al prepararse en el horno a baja temperatura por un buen periodo de tiempo. > Remember when I showed you the cherry tomatoes I harvested at home, and left you wondering what I was going to make with them? I also mentioned that I got 155 grams—an amount that seemed perfect for trying my hand at making tomato confit. >I’d never made them before, but I kept seeing them on Instagram; you know how the algorithm shows you everything it associates with posts you’ve viewed previously, so my culinary searches always lead me to new recipes to try. >I’d already read that these tomato confits turn out to have a great, incredibly deep flavor when cooked in the oven at a low temperature for a long time. ![1000534680.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23yTmRJhma5opDhXBf9F8CxDMtyKTFnETtxkg44EuR7MByF2F5X4Hz9NB6VWN2wvD6rjf.jpg) ![1000534681.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23yJNkyX23Pek4EwkwAkydiAmhJ5gSFj6r8vHDuCj6cLNqd7nAxfVEzJ4fRGjMAmogZTW.jpg) Para realizar estos tomates confitados, retiré los restos del cáliz (la parte verde del tope), los lavé muy bien y los corté a la mitad. Los coloqué en un sartén de hierro forjado y sazoné con sal rosada y orégano; también añadí dos dientes de ajo grandes y una buena cantidad de aceite de oliva. >To make these tomato confits, I removed the calyx (the green part at the top), washed them thoroughly, and cut them in half. I placed them in a cast-iron skillet and seasoned them with pink salt and oregano; I also added two large cloves of garlic and a generous amount of olive oil. ![1000534690.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23wWwEjEtphZ2FCjY7j83kGuHiazAm9PJy65XQMj9WLV55Y4MCGxDVvvxnCHXmH2Az3Sk.jpg) Los llevé al horno a 120 grados centígrados durante una hora y media. > I baked them in the oven at 120 degrees Celsius for an hour and a half. ![1000534694.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23y8oeg2LpmDj5Gmp5JNmdE2x9SB7V7XurdwCcQwigmFHwTBW3K6bj5XP1xFK5DMQ5K5u.jpg) Parece increíble el delicioso aroma que desprenden estos tomates confitados; poco a poco se van cociendo y volviéndose más tiernos cada vez. Al finalizar la cocción, los dejé reposar a temperatura ambiente; pasado este tiempo, trituré los ajos que había agregado y luego coloqué todo en un envase de vidrio esterilizado. Guarde en la nevera hasta su consumo. >The delicious aroma coming from these tomato confits is incredible; they cook slowly, becoming more tender with every passing moment. >Once they were done cooking, I let them cool to room temperature; after that, I crushed the garlic I had added and then transferred everything to a sterilized glass jar. I stored it in the refrigerator until ready to eat. ![1000536100.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23wgPhonZfoAhsG614y35nHQN4aqrj51YpCgxUNUg1CqSbcwXXwYyg7sszR95YVCMFhDC.jpg) Con cada día que el confitado reposa en la nevera, mejor sabor tiene. Estos tomates confitados quedan deliciosos con una buena rodaja de pan, queso mozzarella y pesto hecho en casa. ***¡Una combinación de primera!*** > The longer the tomato confit sits in the fridge, the better it tastes. These tomato confits are delicious served with a nice slice of bread, mozzarella cheese, and homemade pesto. > ***A winning combination!***
**I hope you like it!**

body.title: Torta de chocolate, cubierta de chocolate y ralladura de chocolate blanco [ESP/ENG]
body.body: # Torta de chocolate, cubierta de chocolate y ralladura de chocolate blanco [ESP/ENG]\n\n<div class=\

>

Hola amigos del buen comer y del buen paladar que me leen en esta gran comunidad de @hivefood , espero que el domingo pasado día de las  madres, hayan disfrutado cada quien a su manera y dentro de sus posibilidades de este gran día. Bendiciones en abundancia para todas las madres de este grupo que día a día traen a la comunidad sus deliciosas recetas para que nos deleitemos de ellas y podamos ponerlas en práctica. Sean todas bienvenidos a mi blog.


![portada.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23vsQfiwq81iQoMtkCAWSkR2qDhwayWs9cR7rkdwGEBShcgwdie76HyAHtJu4QV9BQDSd.jpg)


Hoy les traigo una receta, sencilla, fácil y rápida de preparar: una deliciosa torta de chocolate tipo Brownie con su cubierta de chocolate y ralladura de chocolate blanco. Decorada con un tanto de Buttercream que tenía en la nevera sabor a maracuyá, me sirvió para decorarla haciéndole tres rosas pequeñas de color amarillo y rosado.

Esta deliciosa y linda torta la hice para la abuela Josefina la popular Pepa que tiene 90 años. 

Hoy solo les voy a nombrar la cantidad de ingredientes que utilicé, debido a que en otro contenido anterior ya les he indicado el paso a paso, solo cambia el tamaño de la torta y la decoración que es este caso, se le agregó chocolate blanco y uno que otros ingredientes que sólo esta receta lo contiene, pero todo el procedimiento es el mismo. Puedes ver el paso a paso [aquí](https://peakd.com/hive-100067/@morepina/brownie-triple-chocolate-a-mi-estilo-espeng-4le)

Ahora solo les indico los ingredientes para una torta de 1300 gramos, utilizando un molde de 20 centímetros para un tiempo de cocción de 2 horas y 15minutos .

# Ingredientes
. 4tazas de harina de trigo leudante
. 3 tazas de azúcar blanca
. 3 huevos
. 1 taza de cacao en polvo 
. 1 taza y media de aceite de maíz o de girasol .
. 1/2 cucharada de bicarbonato
. 1/2 Cucharadita de canela y 1/4 de sal


![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23yJG8G2cL1UJ4RmqqfpCf9qjPxK1zBBTr5JhouvQng14nPYFiH9HbS1MkmZLQUN8xTQV.jpg)

Con estas cantidades logré sacar una torta de 20 centímetros por siete de alto, es una torta relativamente mediana que alcanza para 20 personas, pero la idea era llevarle un pequeño detalle y que es el tipo de torta que a la abuela le encanta.


![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23ywuQsDbUvymMkpQN5REqpw3jA1ZGKENZMFqSfecr6bLvUakpUy9rt8BJzMGJKDQGRjz.jpg)|![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/AKGZfrTY52a4tSFYywHXEwcgz5MJaEu5B3qrUqCL8rQLEXJRD4Jk2qx329oCV88.jpg)|![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23ynUgSArVeaQzqnkGFWRmzNUVDx3kcfRAoDvqs6LhsFjCwqdjRTVJTsJtPj2SsXr3aGy.jpg)
-|-|-

![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wMaeqgKBd5trVZs6qdJX1VV7hQEBUnbSWwWG9vxo2mMQzgR4eXuoju9anixq8EpZwbN.jpg)|![10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23yd8J2Fxi9QpnXTfSHGQDSiv8MkfxF7np1nSyDGcL7v6S4hjmg3BkpLufba2K95eyLYd.jpg)|![11.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23xebDwFxdq7P2m8eE5s6Ad1uen15Rxkox4SwUgkanGp1usTtagWuwbUuPt2iP28AhGHy.jpg)
-|-|-

Les comento que fui a llevársela el domingo muy temprano a las 7:30 de la mañana, todavía estaba dormida, pero necesitaba hacer algunos pendientes como ir a cumplir con la actividad de la pastoral familiar y luego viajar a casa de mi mamá para pasar parte del día de las madres con mi mamá y quedarme unos días más disfrutando con ella .

![16.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23vsQpvnmW1L7xNgVbocGXV4Kw8AwsAcckc7LPik7C5GYgVkREDdnDF8NhfaXRvs5htv7.jpg)

![17.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/243WZtyogpPJ1GptbkT3NmPEJVPk9LbRoFqaFUAgsEWmRjimaHXPQ3ckj5hKnNvLeMrsU.jpg)


![18.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23uQvjasXJ6bBEnN8mvbawqc4E47HwD4WH5zt2a9UVSYHy4ighStrPGWCQqRL6MnBjTgN.jpg)

Esta torta quedó bastante húmeda y deliciosa, tanto el chocolate blanco como el Buttercream de maracuyá le dio ese toque diferente pero súper rico.

Hasta aquí mi contenido, espero sea de su agrado y nos vemos en un próximo post.

Saludos para todos y Dios los bendiga grandemente .

* Fotos tomadas con Iphone 8 plus
* Portada diseñada con Canva
* Texto traducido con Deepl

<div class=\

> # English Version # Chocolate cake, topped with chocolate and white chocolate shavings. Hello, fellow food lovers and connoisseurs who read my posts in this wonderful @hivefood community! I hope that last Sunday, on Mother’s Day, each of you enjoyed this special day in your own way and within your means. Blessings in abundance to all the mothers in this group who, day after day, bring their delicious recipes to the community so we can enjoy them and put them into practice. Welcome, everyone, to my blog. ![portada.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23vsQfiwq81iQoMtkCAWSkR2qDhwayWs9cR7rkdwGEBShcgwdie76HyAHtJu4QV9BQDSd.jpg) Today I’m sharing a recipe that’s simple, easy, and quick to make: a delicious brownie-style chocolate cake with a chocolate glaze and white chocolate shavings. I decorated it with some passion fruit-flavored buttercream I had in the fridge, using it to make three small yellow and pink roses. I made this delicious and beautiful cake for Grandma Josefina, the popular Pepa, who is 90 years old. Today I’m just going to list the ingredients I used, since I’ve already provided the step-by-step instructions in a previous post. The only differences are the size of the cake and the decoration—in this case, I added white chocolate and a few other ingredients unique to this recipe—but the overall process is the same. You can see the step-by-step instructions [here](https://peakd.com/hive-100067/@morepina/brownie-triple-chocolate-a-mi-estilo-espeng-4le) Here are the ingredients for a 1.3-kilogram cake, using a 20-centimeter pan with a baking time of 2 hours and 15 minutes. # Ingredients . 4 cups self-rising flour . 3 cups white sugar . 3 eggs . 1 cup cocoa powder . 1½ cups corn or sunflower oil . ½ tablespoon baking soda . ½ teaspoon cinnamon and ¼ teaspoon salt ![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23yJG8G2cL1UJ4RmqqfpCf9qjPxK1zBBTr5JhouvQng14nPYFiH9HbS1MkmZLQUN8xTQV.jpg) With these quantities, I was able to make a cake that’s 20 centimeters wide and 7 centimeters tall. It’s a relatively medium-sized cake that serves 20 people, but the idea was to bring her a small gift, and this is the kind of cake Grandma loves. ![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23ywuQsDbUvymMkpQN5REqpw3jA1ZGKENZMFqSfecr6bLvUakpUy9rt8BJzMGJKDQGRjz.jpg) |![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/AKGZfrTY52a4tSFYywHXEwcgz5MJaEu5B3qrUqCL8rQLEXJRD4Jk2qx329oCV88.jpg) |![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23ynUgSArVeaQzqnkGFWRmzNUVDx3kcfRAoDvqs6LhsFjCwqdjRTVJTsJtPj2SsXr3aGy.jpg) -|-|- ![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wMaeqgKBd5trVZs6qdJX1VV7hQEBUnbSWwWG9vxo2mMQzgR4eXuoju9anixq8EpZwbN.jpg) |![10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23yd8J2Fxi9QpnXTfSHGQDSiv8MkfxF7np1nSyDGcL7v6S4hjmg3BkpLufba2K95eyLYd.jpg) |![11.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23xebDwFxdq7P2m8eE5s6Ad1uen15Rxkox4SwUgkanGp1usTtagWuwbUuPt2iP28AhGHy.jpg) -|-|- I’ll tell you that I went to pick her up very early on Sunday at 7:30 in the morning; she was still asleep, but I needed to take care of some things, like attending the family ministry activity and then traveling to my mom’s house to spend part of Mother’s Day with her and stay a few more days enjoying her company. ![16.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23vsQpvnmW1L7xNgVbocGXV4Kw8AwsAcckc7LPik7C5GYgVkREDdnDF8NhfaXRvs5htv7.jpg) ![17.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/243WZtyogpPJ1GptbkT3NmPEJVPk9LbRoFqaFUAgsEWmRjimaHXPQ3ckj5hKnNvLeMrsU.jpg) ![18.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23uQvjasXJ6bBEnN8mvbawqc4E47HwD4WH5zt2a9UVSYHy4ighStrPGWCQqRL6MnBjTgN.jpg) This cake turned out quite moist and delicious; both the white chocolate and the passion fruit buttercream gave it that unique yet incredibly rich flavor. That’s all for now—I hope you enjoyed this post, and I’ll see you in the next one. Greetings to everyone, and may God bless you all abundantly. * Photos taken with an iPhone 8 Plus * Cover designed with Canva * Text translated with Deepl Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@morepina/torta-de-chocolate-cubierta-de-chocolate-y-ralladura-de-chocolate-blanco-espeng-kah)

body.body: I've been doing a lot of thinking on and off about the tokenomics of the Hive-Engine token I plan to create. I don't want to rush things. I want to offer value and stability, so it needs to be balanced. I want it to be appealing to as many people as possible, which means the design is something you just don't rush. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb1E21BiVc5ajdxRekMtMsRv1Df6854NpqhqFnjQBQmtT/1778640860306.png) (Created with ChatGPT) This isn't a whitepaper. Not yet. That's coming. This is more just me voicing my thoughts and opinions out loud. It's also an opportunity for those reading this to provide feedback. **Token Supply** My plan is to limit the supply to around 100,000 tokens, of which 70,000 will go up for sale and 30,000 will only be paid out to delegators. This way those who'd rather buy into the project can do so, and those who'd rather use their HP to delegate can also share in the project. **Token Sales** The general idea will be to sell the tokens in tranches that double in price each time a tranche sells out. All HIVE will be powered up to curate the community I plan to build. Once all tokens are gone, then the HP will continue to increase and those who got in early and still kept their stake will watch their payouts continue to increase. It's nothing fancy, but it doesn't need to be since the goal is to reward those who helped me build up the HP of the @nectarbytes account to curate the community I'm going to build. **Comment Incentives** I'm considering taking 50% of all tribal tokens the account receives and selling those for HIVE. The fund from this will then be used to reward commenters in the community with weekly or monthly HSBI raffles. As with everything else, it would start small but continue to grow and eventually give out some nice rewards to those who actively participate. I still have a bit of time before I officially roll out the token and publish the whitepaper, so let me know what you think of the idea. ![1000017156.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulliontools/23uEyyyWCHidcDUBLiCySb4thnoMosshmypAS8GVUkhHC52LCiQqrB6L9Fom29shmtCMN.gif)

body.title: Un retrato para el cumpleaños de un amigo 🎁 🖍️ (creyones óleo pastel y colores) / A portrait for a friend's birthday 🎁 🖍️ (oil pastels creyons and colors)
body.body:
>Saludos hivers. El domingo estuvo de cumpleaños un amigo así que en vista de que él tiene varios años fuera del país, y que obviamente no le puedo entregar un regalo en sus manos, se me ocurrió aprovechar que estoy inspirada haciendo retratos y decidí dibujar uno para él, creo que es un regalo bastante original, los invito a seguir este proceso creativo y así me dicen qué tal me salió jejeje. >Hello hivers! A friend's birthday was on Sunday, and since he's been living abroad for several years and I obviously can't give him a gift in person, I thought I'd take advantage of my current inspiration for portraits and decide to draw one for him. I think it's a pretty original gift, and I invite you to follow along with this creative process and let me know what you think!
🎁🖍️🎁🖍️🎁🖍️🎁🖍️🎁

Elegí tonos azules así que decidí usar una cartulina construcción anaranjada ya que es el color opuesto al azul, este dibujo lo hice con creyones óleo pastel y colores, también usé marcador negro y lápiz. El lápiz blanco es mi favorito para hacer el boceto sobre cartulinas de colores ya que resalta mejor y es más fácil de borrar que el lápiz. Al principio no se parecía en nada a mi amigo 😬😂🤦🏻‍♀️, pero poco a poco fuí corrigiendo los detalles. >I chose shades of blue, so I decided to use orange construction paper since it's the opposite of blue. I made this drawing with oil pastels and colored pencils, and I also used a black marker and pencil. White pencil is my favorite for sketching on colored paper because it stands out better and is easier to erase than regular pencil. At first, it didn't look anything like my friend 😬😂🤦🏻‍♀️, but little by little I corrected the details.
![IMG_20260512_214932.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gatubela/23tvwdMdqDtuwuNHKTcQtHodZxPSdb3VHvrr6zE4pgiTwsrtWrFAisN3UpWz8DbDfwqCc.jpg)
![IMG_20260512_215026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gatubela/23tc9oHK7SqxdEkyBjvUJTjHvAVV9EBWDtURmNcDD8eCLrQcyfTNnGKe1pnw8QyR6CK5y.jpg)
![IMG_20260512_215105.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gatubela/23uFkjCbMPYAVGB4ZjpMV1bbD1hUfcPuUbxq6sSE1Mrqf74Ww2JWYvyr8eAadSLdfB9Bd.jpg)
Dibujar a alguien que conocemos es un poquito más difícil que dibujar a un personaje famoso o a alguien desconocido ya que nuestra percepción de esa persona es más directa, y además, puede decirnos si logramos capturar el parecido o no jajaja 🤷🏻‍♀️. Lo que más me costó fue la nariz, la borré varias veces hasta que finalmente sentí que se parecía. >Drawing someone we know is a little more difficult than drawing a famous person or someone unknown, since our perception of that person is more direct, and they can also tell us if we've captured the likeness or not, hahaha 🤷🏻‍♀️. The hardest part for me was the nose, I erased it several times until I finally felt it looked right.
![IMG_20260512_215135.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gatubela/23viGyVN1sDWvKFbyCATorvLoFJ4ZtHEahRbPDsYcnSEZEEvKU6ckyd3wMmo4HRvqnxwQ.jpg)
![IMG_20260512_215209.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gatubela/23uFkjKpCaSSuKqvFDSDw3XMi7KovBCJbM6gN2XVULUVBPanhTs5SEbFjSTLeFq2ibqNu.jpg)
![IMG_20260512_215227.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gatubela/23uFgivtJwEqNBhDVbcsFKiJDYxTrfw7MVmN5eZH6qSRvHACDxZD6xRjaKzWfZ4f3Es8V.jpg)
![IMG_20260512_215258.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gatubela/23wXJNW3UnpYHcRgM16QoLf5NFqjdtspnvHoLQ4xizVM1mBv1cfxQQkWp1dVhZycEZmGU.jpg)
Como les comenté al principio, en este retrato el protagonista será el color azul, empecé marcando con lápiz blanco las partes más iluminadas, seguidamente con creyones azul celeste el resto del rostro y algunos mechones de cabello, y con azul oscuro las sombras. >As I mentioned at the beginning, in this portrait the protagonist will be the color blue. I started by marking the most illuminated parts with a white pencil, then with light blue crayons the rest of the face and some strands of hair, and with dark blue the shadows.
![IMG_20260512_215325.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gatubela/23tvy7jDGe1GSBzGQ66FvYdVv6P1prqGkT3KNqTLSejYZAaMJJ7L9yfG3VgCouc23iPsG.jpg)

body.title: Starting Out
body.body:
![french-bulldog-g1b481962c_640.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfU5qHFWNrZmbjziEB1RnW6i9TrYy6EvSY3jBbJqYbMFw/french-bulldog-g1b481962c_640.jpg)



Getting off on the wrong foot at my new job has required some correcting the last couple of weeks. I think I've been pretty successful in both displaying my capabilities and marketing myself to my supervisor. They were things I didn't think I'd need to prioritize early but ultimately have turned out to be great moves.

I have a better appreciation for what it means to have a good start. It is not just desired but necessary to set the tone. We see it all the time in sports, where those who get off to a great start often ride on that advantage to eventually win the competition. Real life may be a longer game, but the power of momentum is real.

Starting out badly often means putting in extra work to make up for lost ground, and it is of course as physically demanding as it is mentally demanding. It is also seen a making up for lost time. I certainly would prefer not having to put in extra work for prior results I should have gotten simply because I failed to do so. 

I think I've been able to set the record straight to my Auditees/colleagues that am no pushover, but if I had to do-over, I probably would have started out more aggressive so everyone knows what to expect from day one.

body.title: Zero-waste cooking
body.body: >Les confieso que soy bastante mala picando pollo, las únicas partes que puedo decir que corto bastante bien son las alas y muslos, las pechugas y demás suelo masacrarlas, por eso siempre terminaba guardando partes del pollo que yo creía que ya no servían para nada y las iba a cumulando hasta que recordaba que las tenía ahí y debía botarlas ya que no sabia que hacer con ellas. De un tiempo para acá se me ocurrió darle una segunda oportunidad a aquello que solo aprecian huesos sin provecho alguno y reuní partes de al menos 4 pollos las sancoché y como pude lo esmeche para sacar todo el provecho a la carne, realmente es algo que ayuda a salvar un almuerzo en aquellos días donde ya se está acabando la comida y sabe bastante bien acompañado de salsa y algunos vegetales picados en cuadritos. Y tambien aprovechamos el caldo donde se hierve el pollo ya que lo podemos usar para el arroz y asi le da un sabor diferente. > I have to admit that I’m pretty bad at cutting up chicken; the only parts I can say I cut fairly well are the wings and thighs—I usually end up butchering the breasts and the rest. That’s why I always ended up saving parts of the chicken that I thought were no longer good for anything, and I’d keep piling them up until I remembered I had them there and had to throw them out because I didn’t know what to do with them. Lately, it occurred to me to give a second chance to those parts that are just bones with no real use, so I gathered parts from at least four chickens, boiled them, and shredded the meat as best I could to get the most out of it. It really helps save a meal on those days when food is running low, and it tastes pretty good served with sauce and some diced vegetables. We also make use of the broth the chicken was boiled in, since we can use it for rice, which gives it a different flavor. ![Corazón banner (1).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23uFgAbHNHepcyH3o8wH15M4pR8K7Jsf3tw4TsSj65zyY1UyQpKRK2L9tGpjABj48Qxzb.png)

>Estas son las partes que guardo del pollo (imagen1) muchas de ellas con mucha carne aun pegada al hueso, pero demasiado difícil de filetear para poder usarlas, tambien el cuello tiene bastante carne, aunque es difícil arrancarla. Corto en trozos medianos lo que queda del pollo y lo meto en una olla grande con abundante agua donde comenzara a hervir, después de un rato cocinándose lo saco y dejo enfriar para luego comenzar a esmecharlo, esmechar el pollo es la parte mas tediosa de todas y mas desesperante pero cuando ves todo el pollo que logras sacar vale la pena. > These are the parts of the chicken I save (image 1); many of them still have plenty of meat on the bone, but it’s too tough to fillet to be usable. The neck also has quite a bit of meat, though it’s hard to pull off. I cut what’s left of the chicken into medium-sized pieces and put them in a large pot with plenty of water, where I bring it to a boil. After cooking for a while, I take it out and let it cool before starting to shred it. Shredding the chicken is the most tedious and frustrating part of all, but when you see all the meat you manage to get out, it’s worth it. ![priemr.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23uQvaLkBsqeCD6yETUtmmKc5B3tArCdbsCCZva3vxE6YoJtu9p6X2pb2G4wfHGtR8Rpe.png)

>Luego colocamos un sartén a calentar con un poco de aceite y agregamos onoto para darle color al pollo, lo sofreímos un rato y luego le agregamos tomate, cebolla y ajo picados en pequeños cuadritos, revolvemos y dejamos cocinar por varios minutos, yo suelo colocar un poco de agua para que se cocine aun mejor. > Next, heat a little oil in a skillet and add the annatto seeds to give the chicken some color. Sauté for a few minutes, then add the finely diced tomato, onion, and garlic. Stir and let it cook for several minutes; I usually add a little water to help it cook through better. ![seg.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23tvptQo31gzkwrYbPFEaTxnRi7Giup7DGvLiM6bMFNopdCbFg7LvPb1BDa7nHg4a8tre.png)

>Después de que se cocine por un rato le agregamos pasta de tomate para que quede aun mas espeso y jugoso, esta receta me recuerda muchísimo al guiso para las hallacas en navidad, ah olvide decir que le agregue sal, adobo, salsa inglesa y salsa de ajo jaja- muy importante porque si no, no tendrá sabor… Después que la salsa se reduzca ya podemos sacar del fuego nuestro pollo y servirlo, en este caso yo lo serví con arroz (el cual hice con el agua del caldo de pollo) y plátanos fritos. > After it’s cooked for a while, we add tomato paste to make it even thicker and juicier. This recipe really reminds me of the stew we make for hallacas at Christmas. Oh, I forgot to mention that I added salt, adobo seasoning, Worcestershire sauce, and garlic sauce—haha—which is really important because otherwise, it won’t have any flavor… Once the sauce has reduced, we can take the chicken off the heat and serve it. In this case, I served it with rice (which I made using the chicken broth) and fried plantains. ![terc.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23tSckYEPFsauMQC9WKPmMmaAf4Y9ZcjkEjnWqhsw427yZmXR7MkNC132kk1wJaknR1UL.png)

我一直是想着法，拓展阳坨在其他事情上的其他注意力，减少他在手机上的时间。

我看到李笑来的一个说法，如果确实不可避免的要接触电子产品，最好是给他一台电脑。因为电脑是生产工具，有互动，而不像手机一样，特别是手机上的视频，它会吃掉你的脑子。

是的，给小孩玩手机，等于是让手机吃掉小孩的脑子。

我之前限制阳坨玩手机，他不高兴，闹情绪。我还豆包出了一系列关于“手机如何侵蚀人大脑”的科学研究，放给他听。当时感觉是有点“恐吓”到的意思。不过后面也还是会置之脑后。

在用电脑替代手机转移他注意力上，我自己觉得比较成功的是，他对两个网站还比较有兴趣。一个是PHET，一个免费的教育网站，他很喜欢在上面的去探索科学知识。另外一个就是我玩3D打印带他玩的，tinkerCAD，一个网页端免费建模的程序。

他自己也建模过一些东西，比如陀螺，房子，迷宫，还有些奇怪的东西。我也都给他打印出来，虽然建模的东西不怎么样。也算是他的一个创造。

最近，他玩腻了，好奇心促使他想探索跟多的网站。于是，求我给他弄点其他的网站。

我实在想不出啊啥。

不过突然想到，吃掉脑子。一个游戏突然勾起了我的回忆，就是植物大战僵尸。

这个是我在大学时，特别火的一个游戏，感觉有点策略性。

于是，网上给他找出来了，游戏对小朋友的兴趣是天生的，他玩得不亦乐乎，一开始的几关都比较容易，但是到第7关了，他玩不过来了，然后僵尸占领了房子。

然后，我发现他跑到了房间，不开心的说不玩了。我以为他是害怕失败，还给他“教育”了一番。

后来，我发现，他不是怕失败，而是，最后游戏失败时，弹出来的画面吓到他的。

如果你还有印象，游戏失败是，屏幕会出现一行字“僵尸吃掉了你的脑子”，还带着绿色血淋淋的特效和音效。

我也突然想到，我第一次玩时，也是对我有些冲击，挺吓人的。只是后来玩多了，也就免疫了。

总的来说，也算是一次陪儿子玩游戏的难忘经历。

title.title: My Hive Goals for 2026 Week #19
title.body:
I have decided to start posting a weekly update on my progress toward [my 2026 goals](https://peakd.com/hive-167922/@jfang003/my-hive-goals-for-2026-lma) here on [Hive](https://leofinance.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-what-is-hive). It helps me stay on track, and I can realize if I am behind on a goal at any point in time. It's the fifth month of the year so far, and there is plenty of time left in the year. Also, for everyone's note, the Saturday Savers has ended, but the Slothly Savers Club has started in its place. 

## Progress
![graph.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23wCdNeuv3uZsFtFoNC3wSj3oCQMQU7xQo8KTPdZRtLnKzbH1dCGaERxApZ9xpWYpVRZa.png)
Above are statistics that I have gotten from [HiveStats](https://hivestats.io/). This week is looking a bit worse than last week, and it all adds up over time.

### HP
I earned 118 [HP](https://leofinance.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-hive-power-hp) earned throughout the week. I am checking this through the difference between the two endpoints on the graph on Hivestats. The numbers are looking great this week, and it's only a bit less than last week.

### HBD 

![HBD.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23tkfFks2Kuiqrv8KRg7mz7FJJudQAYq7J7Y3Ygw1XFPsr94mHsFTznBs5FTrgszxVBdr.png)
I earned 0 [HBD](https://leofinance.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-hive-backed-dollar-hbd) this week. With the price of Hive lower, we have hit the debt limit. This means that we will be earning Hive instead of HBD. I won't be able to add to my HBD savings for a while, but the interest will help me towards that goal. When the Hive price is above the debt limit, I'll add to my savings. There isn't much I can do here, but at least that interest will add up. It looks like the APR for HBD savings has dropped to 12%. It was 14% last week, but I kind of expected this to happen.

## Conclusion

![goal progress.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23uFufP6nszMH5SiDtTKYwrcRp1iQN1kB16eMryfzXWAWxVbx3irMMCqTFoYoAHMeDjPZ.png)
My progress is looking decent for now. I need around 2% per week, so this week I met that standard. HBD is officially behind where I need to be now. However, without any HBD being earned, it might not be enough if that doesn't change by the end of the year. Other than that, nothing much has changed, and I am just slowly grinding away at my goals. The HBD goal isn't looking that great as I am behind, and I don't think we will be getting HBD anytime soon with the current Hive price. My HP goal is looking great but my HBD isn't. I am not sure if I want to leave it as is, or change some Hive into HBD later down the year. It's too bad to see the HBD APR drop down, but I kind of expected it given the current debt levels for Hive.

Do you have any goals for 2026? What is the progress towards your own goals? 

Feel free to leave a comment if you read my post. If you have any questions, feel free to ask, and I will do my best to answer.

title.title: [ESP-ING]  My 6th Anniversary at Hive | We're Still Making History
title.body: > Seis años pueden decirse fácilmente pero son años de esfuerzo y dedicación, años de creatividad, de hermanda y de ideas, muchas ideas, recibí mi insignia de 6 años en la Blockchain de Hive gracias a Hivebuzz, quien me recordó que hoy 12 de Mayo era el día de celebrar mi cumpleaños Hivers, que emoción y todavía seguimos contando y haciendo historia y es que Hive para mi es esa ventana perpetua que le dirá a mis generaciones quien era yo, solo eso puedo imaginarlo en mi cabeza.

> ¿Cómo ha sido estos años para mí? puedo decir que han sido los mejores años que he tenido junto a esta plataforma, Ya que en ella siempre encuentro la motivación de escribir y de conocer, ya que puedo leer post de otras personas y cruzar fronteras por medio de ellas, además de hacer amistades que perduran con el tiempo y que aunque no todos los días hablemos sabemos que están allí. Aunque siempre he publicado todos los días nunca me he ganado la insignia de publicación de el año, Así que este año me he propuesto poder alcanzar esa insignia Y es que por ello Lo importante es publicar siempre la misma hora por un año, o en el horario correspondiente, espero de verdad poder alcanzar esa meta en Hive, es una meta nueva para mí.

> Existe mucha gente que se ha ido de Hive y otros que van y vienen, pero yo sigo aquí activa cada día reinventándome, no es fácil muchas veces tener la creatividad para publicar todos los días, sin embargo creo que sí se puede, ya que yo lo he hecho y muchas personas que conozco también lo hacen, porque Hive es una ventana al mundo de cada uno de nosotros sin censuras, para promover cosas buenas. Todavía tenemos mucho que publicar, cada día hay cosas nuevas, manualidades nuevas que hacer pensamientos nuevos y mucha creatividad, aunque algunas veces esa creatividad se vea bloqueada por circunstancias de la vida, porque todos los días no son iguales, sin embargo sé que Hive tiene mucho que ofrecer a cada uno de nosotros, por eso sigo y continúo en esta plataforma que me ha dado tantas alegrías no solamente a mí sino a mi familia.

> Hoy celebró mi sexto año en Hive, esperando muchos años más en esta plataforma, dejando parte de mis vivencias, mis recorridos, mis recetas y parte de toda mi creatividad, Gracias a todas las personas que de una u otra manera me apoyan y me continuan ayudando a llegar hasta aquí todos estos años, son parte de estas alegrías y parte de todo lo que he hecho con cariño en Hive. ***Simplemente gracias 🤗.***

width=472 height=49 border=0>
--- >![ENGLISH] > > Six years may sound simple, but they represent years of hard work and dedication, years of creativity, brotherhood, and ideas—lots of ideas. I received my 6-year badge on the Hive blockchain thanks to Hivebuzz, who reminded me that today, May 12, was the day to celebrate my Hivers birthday. How exciting! And we’re still counting and making history—because for me, Hive is that eternal window that will tell future generations who I was; that’s all I can imagine in my mind. > >

> > >What have these past few years been like for me? I can say they’ve been the best years I’ve had on this platform, because here I always find the motivation to write and learn—I can read other people’s posts and cross borders through them, as well as make friendships that last over time. Even though we don’t talk every day, we know they’re there. > >Although I’ve always posted every day, I’ve never earned the “Post of the Year” badge. So this year, I’ve set out to earn that badge. The key is to post at the same time every day for a year, or at the designated time. I really hope to reach that goal on Hive—it’s a new goal for me. > >

> > >Existe mucha gente que se ha ido de Hive y otros que van y vienen, pero yo sigo aquí activa cada día reinventándome, no es fácil muchas veces tener la creatividad para publicar todos los días, sin embargo creo que sí se puede, ya que yo lo he hecho y muchas personas que conozco también lo hacen, porque Hive es una ventana al mundo de cada uno de nosotros sin censuras, para promover cosas buenas. > >Todavía tenemos mucho que publicar, cada día hay cosas nuevas, manualidades nuevas que hacer pensamientos nuevos y mucha creatividad, aunque algunas veces esa creatividad se vea bloqueada por circunstancias de la vida, porque todos los días no son iguales, sin embargo sé que Hive tiene mucho que ofrecer a cada uno de nosotros, por eso sigo y continúo en esta plataforma que me ha dado tantas alegrías no solamente a mí sino a mi familia. > >

> > >Today marks my sixth year on Hive, and I look forward to many more years on this platform, sharing some of my experiences, my journeys, my recipes, and a part of all my creativity. Thank you to everyone who, in one way or another, has supported me and continued to help me get this far over the years; you are part of these joys and part of everything I’ve lovingly created on Hive. ***Simply thank you 🤗.*** > >

links.title: Beef strips with onions and grated carrots  [Esp-Eng]
links.body:
<center> 

### ❣️_Hola amigos de hive!_❣️ 

>### ❣️_Hello friends of hive!_❣️ 
</center>
<hr>
<div class=\

>
Hoy voy a compartir una receta de tiras de carne de res con cebolla y zanahoria rallada. Es sencilla de hacer; su aroma y sabor son únicos. Lo mejor de todo es que a mi familia le encanta, así que aquí tienes el paso a paso para animarte a probarlo.

> ``` Today I’m going to share a recipe for beef strips with onions and grated carrots. It’s easy to make, and the aroma and flavor are unique. Best of all, my family loves it, so here’s a step-by-step guide to encourage you to give it a try. ```
![Añadir un subtítulo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/23yx66FCyYn5AVyNWyBCr6LVHND5sNHQAF1C3M5B23QymTsZc5WFYoRMhBHj7T74xeUfs.jpg)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/48a5mJrfDHAmwWoz38hgptfiWQnXDZdBjC7FvrycEqcnHCJdmNi4EnNSReLZSLbmQr.png)

> ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/Eokea3Goz1b7eGHnkDFse5jsF9n9HZL7KRhqRfUtsxTkDQfp5KEqMnomo3XFF9JnWC7.png) 300 gr de carne, 02 cebollas, 01 zanahoria. 01 cucharada de ajo en polvo, 01 cucharada de cúrcuma, 01 cucharada de salsa barbecue, 01 cucharada de maicena, 02 cucharadas de agua, sal y pimienta al gusto. ``` 300 g beef, 2 onions, 1 carrot, 1 tablespoon garlic powder, 1 tablespoon turmeric, 1 tablespoon barbecue sauce, 1 tablespoon cornstarch, 2 tablespoons water, salt and pepper to taste. ```
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/48YA3dVucGUQ3j5STqMX3enFGLhvzgymiszf9aqeZzxzyW8oooVgCVPH9wwS7LPMkv.png)

>
Lo primero que hay que hacer es cortar la carne en tiras, enjuagarla, escurrirla y sazonarla con sal, pimienta, ajo en polvo y cúrcuma; déjala marinar durante veinte minutos.

> ``` The first thing to do is cut the meat into strips, rinse it, drain it, and season it with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and turmeric; let it marinate for twenty minutes. ```
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/Ep7sBB5UgAW55Xi6qCY18KyXWNHx9z7jdPRQ4SHcDRYTkHqYoUBrXFJNyGYv2TN1qrA.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/Ep9z8B3UKi5kGETKhmxCfCQJHUCfjV2Ej8xtfpHTRGPwpHE8sycVJViv8FaBCcanKmm.png) -|- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/Ep5oEi2jfcC3avfg5nVgeQ5Q2Nhkr2zZnWgw4PLVby6MDhiLyMREGMBuENfqfk34v9j.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EorzLCECKMJxjHCdHEtJCVwsFUbyv7NKdasntVRxSdfTk9ZfXr7DqxJrJDRU9UVdZ9b.png)

>
A continuación, lava las cebollas y la zanahoria; pélalas, las cebollas córtalas en tiras finas, y ralla la zanahoria.

> ``` Next, wash the onions and the carrot; peel the onions and cut them into thin strips, and grate the carrot. ```
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EpA3QWxvTKkZPtbHyT42xYfr6zHTwEybKpFh1yXQXjw7Zow2SdeGM57BNieuyDjLErj.png)

>
Calienta el aceite en una sartén y, añade las tiras de carne; saltea durante unos minutos hasta que estén tiernas; resérvalas.

> ``` Heat the oil in a skillet, and when it's hot, add the strips of meat; sauté them for a few minutes until tender; set them aside. ```
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EopunmeW3CxTDiLBiT7bQygoa3jq4RGYs4UMabD9dvz9Xr9gupUJa3hjHb8tx4xWzvN.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoCjWxYshZYpP4gUEiMp4uwhoqK42qrNP5MjtAZiprEM7RGmUovWMoWwj5EC7HkCWXT.png) -|-

>
En la misma sartén, calienta un poco de aceite y rehoga las cebollas hasta que estén transparentes; añade las zanahorias y sigue cocinando a fuego lento; a continuación, añade las tiras de carne salteadas.

> ``` In the same skillet, heat some oil and sauté the onions until they’re translucent; add the carrots and continue cooking over low heat; then add the sautéed strips of meat. ```
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/Eoc6ckmDv9b6sco6HWA4wRmirWzaHfPnwoWUmoLDJmaHTvq6EL9hZCuAoJMzVBmsZxW.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EonnxM6Bv94s3NL55msQ8BicFXeSEXpivZTKrXXjhuuoiSdXkQJKobg1eu3remQdTZo.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoAd4Uj8iHFYua2h1ast1kBAUeUpfQ7ZcjRxp6ZtjTjpQYCK7BDz5VUWxPRSzGY3Krr.png) -|-|- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoEsrsyj7JiDphBT2Rr5XS2ovuh59aUTDHvxN86kyCheSqo8M2Lyg6iCYW9z3ctbgeg.png)

>
En un bol, mezcla el agua, la salsa barbacoa y la maicena; añade esta mezcla a la carne, prueba y rectifica de sal y pimienta al gusto, y cocina durante tres minutos más para que la salsa espese y la carne se mantenga jugosa.

> ``` In a bowl, combine the water, barbecue sauce, and cornstarch; stir this mixture into the meat, taste and adjust the salt and pepper as needed, and cook for three more minutes to thicken the sauce and ensure the meat stays juicy. ```
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/Eoc6bgBqDwVvNvSX5qwZ4sMpKzED4n2bYbyLDpHGAmdzshkqpmFnvPHiWDnZyzGRtyy.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/Ep9vJuSFKBpSKn51dPh87KFqrqetcbLUQmuB2AnWgfFQtyBb4GFUJGi9LSD4A3pKqb1.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoAcbCriZdomCa8dbwGTFV31ERsSe5ZPAuTzUj1k33dEYK973P5ULeUXSmkcRdL13ts.png) -|-|- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EpJaxXiyMexDqGJMPMV9fzJovZNHMm7wDjhZSZZc7G6zqy5nKMwxExsdqJw5KAzxQCt.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoAdaYDGB3LCagwjDdfSUSF2xzNEQHKQYXaGKpLjFn9xPHxPbx9qyyvkaW33SGkGgY9.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoCkbLDj8YHuhWb5hfi9tsVUiNZRp6okFDMreNARDVYHt1hsSS7ja3Xb5uM9MzPsswZ.png)

>

links.title: Exquisite toasted bread filled with ham, cheese, tomato and basil (Eng-Esp)
links.body: <center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23x1L8ytiKS9USLs342hfvDEUdRDqfW8u6WB7sUzCe4iWh5AHyjW7VQQuXWvNu8vUde4e.png)</center>\n\n* Good evening, Hivers, welcome back to my blog! Next, I'll explain how to prepare a delicious \

I thought it was great to spread it with pink sauce; the contrast was so appetizing!
This recipe is the ideal option when you don't have time for elaborate recipes... Let's put on our aprons and prepare this delicacy!

>* Buenas noches hivers, bienvenidos de nuevo a mi blog... A continuación, les explico como preparar un delicioso “bocadillo con jamón, queso, tomate y albahaca”, me pareció genial untar con salsa rosada, el contraste quedó MUY apetitoso! 
Está receta es la opción ideal cuando no tienes tiempo de realizar recetas muy elaboradas, pongámonos el delantal para preparar un esta exquisitez!

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/242DT7MZhPcmWvRfyBiiU5MiTRE9B29jcsVEBrWysE4wac2VEr9p4j2qFEJ7vVZnqFfVz.png)</center>

* INGREDIENTS: ham, white cheese, ripe tomatoes, basil leaves, French bread and pink sauce.

>* INGREDIENTES: jamón, queso blanco, tomates maduros, hojas de albahaca, pan francés y salsa rosada.

<center>PREPARATION/PREPARACIÓN</center>

* To make the pink sauce, I combined the mayonnaise, tomato sauce, and a touch of mustard in a bowl... Mix until well combined; if desired, you can add a pinch of pepper.

>* Para realizar la salsa rosada, incorporé en un bowl la mayonesa junto con la salsa de tomate y un toque de mostaza... Mezclamos hasta integrar bien, si lo desean pueden añadir una pizca de pimienta.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23wgW5ZtxNnCXA4NYu1rdRs1jpQXWZLUtc7Abr3M6Q1ycwwNNvGkQ855xDqEtmU37ARnB.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23wCNTS1V63DPvwh3iyjiok5GS7o1wnve8oZf72wadXcCf8eCF4hAZmtrHQEceVN9hiQ8.png)</center>

* Whenever I make this recipe, I love using French bread, but you can use any bread you prefer. Spread it with the reserved pink sauce, then add the cheese slices (white or yellow). Add the ham; I usually buy \

, but this time I decided to use my mom's favorite, which is leg ham.\n\n>* Siempre que realizo esta receta me encanta utilizar pan francés, pero pueden usar el pan de su preferencia... Untamos con la salsa rosada que teníamos reservada, agregamos las lonchas de queso (blanco o amarillo). Añadimos el jamón, siempre suelo comprar \

, pero en esta ocasión decidí usar el favorito de mi mamá que es el jamón de pierna.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23zkzofMCoU1oDZDcDSGyrYRYz4KztCNv1DLibYDBQiLoeE28PDVg7ZevQmCDHUhEGZX3.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23tvyRUHWjhNpwfXPMfAfdTppaTh2u4e5u9nszKnYqZzGUzzBci46AvUpC2MUXk4RpG3h.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23tvyCyayNcD3UivrAYFtVjM4cqM19NEjbkjtLg9oKRcUv34LWkNGZNhRL73dFux8WnxK.png)</center>

* We add the basil leaves; this ingredient will provide a \
flavor... We spread it with a touch of pink sauce.\n\n>* Incorporamos las hojas de albahaca, este ingrediente aportará un sabor \

... Untamos con un toque de salsa rosada.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23xydkAPm2tEjkbLsMMeGxSoMixtSgsZQKz4t4Evfhj37Hz5Y4Fgb2JfXCtMs6xGfcMc1.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23xeoryrfT4yr5Um8WBBaMeQjE3xbZC64nqeAvVJeU4UQDgTCy7FnWaboRxYLhDSNxfsr.png)</center>

* We cook over \
heat in a non-stick pan until golden brown on both sides... Our succulent dish is ready to enjoy!\n\n>* Cocinamos a fuego \

en un sartén antiadherente, hasta que de dore por ambos lados... Nuestro suculento platillo está listo para disfrutar!

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23wqrZ7y8KgXHp2Puz2SXgPE1YDgUkMcxUbfj34sFYkK2qdaK77AavdgREMioJvoVCfXQ.png)</center>

* Friends, here's our exquisite dish, an excellent option to share with your family... A true delicacy!
I hope you enjoyed this easy and simple, yet delicious recipe! Thank you so much for visiting my blog. Enjoy your meal... Hugs!

>* Amigos, a continuación les presento nuestro exquisito platillo, una exclente opción para compartir en familia... Un auténtico manjar!
Espero que hayan disfrutado el proceso de esta receta fácil y sencilla, pero deliciosa!
Muchas gracias por visitar mi blog, me despido deseándoles buen provecho... Un abrazo!

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/242DT7MZhPcmWvRfyBiiU5MiTRE9B29jcsVEBrWysE4wac2VEr9p4j2qFEJ7vVZnqFfVz.png)</center>

Perfect weather to soak up some Pacific Northwest vitamin D, replying to post and comments outside, before today’s hike! 😎 “Silvertop come quick…..”Wayfair” just delivered our laundry cabinet that had a broken part, and it looks like they shipped a complete cabinet kit a second time!”🥰 Rainy day projects my friends, it looks like Silvertop will be busy tomorrow Lol!☺️ “Silvertop now what are we going to do with the first cabinet kit?”🥰 Hmmm….. well the upright supports weren’t broken, just cracked on the inside !🤔 If the first cabinet is still structurally sound, just a cosmetic crack, I might be able to discreetly cover up the crack, and maybe we will end up with a second cabinet!😇 Another project my friends………. Silvertop better get busy!🤣☺️ Till tomorrow Silvertop Mike 😊

links.title: Happy Tuesday! 😎…….My Actifit Report Card: May 12 2026
links.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71778633196.552905) It’s been a lovely Tuesday. The sun was out for the majority of the day and I was headed to ladies Bible study. Upon arriving, one of the gals passed out a blessing bag’ to each of us. A gal she knows does this as a ministry-gifting and blessing ladies with a bag of gifts. This is the third such blessing bags I’ve received and have been blessed in the receiving. Perhaps I’ll do a post on this tomorrow. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71778633433.0559711) We are slowly going through the book of Romans-there’s so much to unpack there, and are heading into chapter 7. It’s very interesting and contemplative. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71778633566.793103) I stopped afterwards to get the clinic mail and run through the local grocer as there are a few things that only they seem to sell. Then onward to home. I spent about 20 minutes out in the garden swing just relaxing and soaking up nature. I’m going to try to do that more often. It is good for the soul! On the apple tree above the swing, there was some plaque like ‘shrooms growing and upon closer inspection, realized it was Turkey Tail growing upside down! Take a look! ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71778633788.5602632) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71778633792.49087) I’ve not seen this view of it before! Enjoy some pictures from our Mother’s Day adventure by the sea! ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71778633845.345432) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71778633850.440261) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71778633853.8866448) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71778633859.868098) On the way to hike ‘up’ out of the park, the third train for the day approached. It was from Canada, heading Canada bound. Two engines graced the front….. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71778633943.334306) ….and one at the end. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71778633958.998666) It was a long and much slower moving train than the earlier ones. I’m thinking it was weighed down a bit and it had fewer engines to help pull/push the load. Tomorrow is my “Monday “. I already know it’s packed, as is the balance of the week. Guess I’d best get my running shoes ready! That’s gonna be it for now. Take care and enjoy the rest of your day wherever you are! 🙏🌏🙏 👣🐑☕️🌞🌻😎👍😊🌙🥱😴 ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71778634233.78283) BSB Romans 6:21-23 What fruit did you reap at that time from the things of which you are now ashamed? The outcome of those things is death. But now that you have been set free from sin and have become slaves to God, the fruit you reap leads to holiness, and the outcome is eternal life. For the wages of sin is death, but the gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.

links.title: Got Lucky to Beat a Captain Frankie on Splinterlands Tourneys!
links.body:
Welcome Splinter-natics and HIVEeees! Hoping you are enjoying your summer getaways and rest for this year fella's! It's 44 degree Celsius heat index here in our country with  a gas price that so high and an unstable supply of electrical power supply. Summer seems not that enjoyable in our area so let me just enjoy what life is offering me right now.


<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/buratus/23u5XKL5QDZ85hmHpw9k6JvgmzHg4LkNGzcD3AzawVLcF7DJs6ZydNm2Whu28SK43mZuz.png)</center>

This time, I will share some battle experience from some tournaments that I joined in splinterlands. If you are not aware yet, tournaments are part of splinterlands game that you have a chance to earn some rewards based on the requirements and sponsor prizes. You just have to join, mostly you will pay some entrance fee which I think are affordable then you have the chance to win prices that are lots of the amount compared to what you paid. Just be aware of what you are joining. 

# A Battle from the Tournament of Modern Bronze #

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/buratus/23t7DhwuuUPcdC5UJS5fpk4S3Fj8Bh8TCtME4WvxtE1ndxSJ48B45UDS4NkZ3t4x8WBsE.png)</center>



Under the sponsorship of SPS DAO, this Modern Bronze tournament is one of the few that I can play with. Mostly of the SPS DAO tournaments are good choice in joining tournaments but its kind of hard. Yeah, there are certain difficulties playing tourneys because it requires a good set of cards that can at least bring you a win and claim a prize. This is a good point of splinterlands game. There are challenge that you should take on and of course, prize comes next. That is also the essence of tournaments so it is still a good experience and fun too. So right now I am against life splinter under the summoning of captain Frankie that is a legendary summoner of the said splinter. Captain Frankie is a good choice for the melee  and range attack monster units that grants them Inspire, True strike and Piercing abilities. That's gonna be painful for sure when it is formed with the right team. Ok for my team, its not that bad I think for I am limiting magic damage formed team in the form of Kylia Silverlief as my Summoner. Anyu Huntswoman and Mantaroth formed my frontal tank and offense for these cards have their abilities a good set for that part. It just sad that they have healing capabilities so they can stay more for long in the battle field. Vengeful Monk, Virid Venomancer, Ghostly Blacksmith and Ruin Keeper will provide my team's offensive capabilities. My opponents team is tough specially the tank Gearnut is present. What is the game changer here is the presence of Anemia in the ruleset. Let's find out how did I push my luck on this battle.


<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/buratus/23tRxjALJcJbfKuMfZLjFTdJLjkJzuwJyxyu9r98BjhgHuoWFWPbcvs6ZxqpWgGgDvwXh.png)</center>
Just in round 1, I almost depleted my cards with those attacks coming from the other said. Mantaroth of my team provide its best abilities that it can offer to keep the balance in the battle. Luckily there are attac misses from my opponent's team that it did put my team into too much pressure that yield to loosing the battle.


<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/buratus/23tGXuxt7JuPrPH6TRLs6B4umfGevK3mWG7oPg3dLukDBko74ypEG7EKLfH5e6oEhQEiC.png)</center>
Round 2 should be where I gain the upperhand. Lossing the frontal support of the range attack dealers is  big blow to my opponents offense. Mantaroth still standing tall in this round of battle. Anemic Ruleset really provided a great help in my team in this battle.


<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/buratus/23tGXuUW1jLPvfgXMkVSF1y1NzSCFGxDgnCtTv9yuKTefZqC7W3aHdvMxArAX56UrBNoQ.png)</center>


Vengeful Monk took the last blow and ended the battle. Its my win with variables.

 
 
<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/buratus/23tbLv9tThtf2i9VMWsY6o9Fzp93LjxY3AmpiX96BvahWLwELQD6f7xeLHvBn46v4vzmJ.png)</center>

Here is my ranking with this  tournament. Not that good but still get me 26.6 sps which is more than enough to cover the const of my entry for this tournament. Congrats to the placers which are renowned player of splinterlands of course. 

- All in all experience in Playing tournament is a bit of a curiosity and a gamble. But at least, you will know your account capabilities. Just be ready if you got beaten right? 



###### You can watch the full battle [HERE](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sm_dVwaKVkRvvWWvMna1wQB?ref=buratus). ######


---
You want to join the game? click it [HERE](https://next.splinterlands.com/register?ref=buratus) for my referral and start your journey!

This is it for this blog. 

Thank you for your time!

links.title: ¿Tarde para empezar?
links.body: > # ¿Tarde para empezar? Esta pregunta, quizás sin imaginarlo, puede tomar forma en la medida que pasan los años y es posible que cueste reconocer el significado de  volver a aprender o emprender nuevas actividades y proyectos. Con estas ideas comienzo esta publicación. En la medida que vamos creciendo, no pensamos que algún día seremos mayores, porque solo vivimos lo que nos toca en nuestra carrera de la vida, ya que era común escuchar que si a los 25 o 30 años no tenías una vivienda propia, entonces ya estabas perdiendo oportunidades, al igual que si no se tienen los hijos antes de los 40, entonces hay que olvidarse de ellos. Y así sucesivamente, como si todo en la vida estuviera planificado. Sin embargo, cuando ya se llega a los 50 y sabemos con claridad quiénes somos, con todas nuestras virtudes y defectos, comenzamos a entender y aceptar que la vida solo es esta que tenemos, que no había nada planificado, que siempre fuimos los protagonistas de nuestras vidas y que así podemos continuar, porque no se trata de volver a empezar, sino de cómo continuar basado en lo auténtico y lo aprendido, lo que solo la experiencia de la vida y los años nos da. Entendemos que muchas cosas con las cuales crecimos no son tan reales como lo pensábamos y que todo tiene sus matices. Además, hoy más que nunca entiendo que los espejismos en la distancia ya se disiparon y solo queda la realidad que vivo todos los días y que, si deseo que algo cambie, entonces todo está al alcance de una decisión que solo dependerá de mí. He podido escuchar a algunas personas decir que cuando llegamos a los 50, ya vamos en declive y no hay más que hacer porque se es viejo, pero estamos en la nueva ola de seres que pensamos que, al ser una persona madura, todo cobra mayor significado y estructura, debido al conocimiento adquirido por años. Todavía quedan algunos años para seguir sonriendo y viviendo con buena vibra. Los invito a compartir sus momentos en Liketu y sus @talentos. Con cariño Angelica7 **English version** # Too Late to Start? This question, perhaps without us realizing it, can take shape as the years go by, and it may become difficult to recognize the meaning of relearning or undertaking new activities and projects. With these thoughts, I begin this post. As we grow older, we don't think about the fact that one day we'll be old, because we only live what we're meant to in our life's journey. It was common to hear that if you didn't own a home by 25 or 30, you were already missing out on opportunities, just as if you didn't have children before 40, you should forget about them. And so on, as if everything in life were predetermined. However, when we reach 50 and know clearly who we are, with all our virtues and flaws, we begin to understand and accept that life is only what it is, that nothing was planned, that we have always been the protagonists of our own lives, and that we can continue in this way. It's not about starting over, but about how to move forward based on what is authentic and what we have learned—the lessons that only life experience and the passing years can provide. We understand that many things we grew up with aren't as real as we thought and that everything has its nuances. Furthermore, today more than ever, I understand that the illusions of the past have faded, and only the reality I live every day remains. And if I want something to change, then everything is within reach of a decision that depends solely on me. I've heard some people say that when we reach 50, we're already in decline and there's nothing more to do because we're old. But we're part of a new wave of people who believe that, as mature individuals, everything takes on greater meaning and structure, thanks to the knowledge acquired over the years. There are still a few years left to keep smiling and living with good vibes. I invite you to reflect and share your moments with Liketu and your @talentos too. Fondly Angelica7

links.title: WednesdayWalk:  A Clinic Laboratory Visit, a walk towards caring for my well being
links.body: Hello @wednesdaywalk Today's walk is very significant for me most especially for my health and well being. I arrived earlier at the clinic to have myself checked up on different vital body parts..

> I've saw already a lot of people inside the clinic. Though I came earlier but my number seems a bit far from my expectations. So I registered my name, the medtech got my body temperature and body weight,and assist me on the other lab test assigned to me.
> Some patients were staying outside to sit down and wait for their number to be called too..
>\nWhat's good if you're seated outside is the overlooking beauty of the plants and garden that surrounds the clinic..\n
> And when it's my turned,I went inside the laboratory to get my complete blood count or cbc

> I can't helped but feel anxious and thoughts started to get in my mind.. Good thing the medtech asked me to relax and be comfortable of the different tests. The Chest X-ray was also done to check if my both lungs have no problem.They perform chest X-ray because of my severe asthma and the other symptoms I felt like having a repeated asthma (cough and wheezing)

>
And Then I proceed to next lab to perform the thyroid test too.
As I lay down on the bed,body positioned still can't helped but feel afraid because it's my first time to have this test.
So when I'm ready, the endocrinologist performed smoothly the test,leaving me so much relax and comfortable of his hands..
And then successfully the ECG was being performed too.

And then when I finished all the tests, I'm being advised to go back at noon to get the result..
And that I'm hoping that all the result be accurate and the doctor can tell me why I repeatedly feel such symptoms..


This would be all for now and see you in my next health update..Bye😍👏👋

links.title: The joys of simple life; enjoying the little things around you.
links.body: />Hello all friends. Happiness originates from within our minds, and it can be created through our thoughts. This isn't an exaggeration. Since living with my family in Malaysia, I've had very little time to go out, and I rarely go anywhere alone—almost never, except for short trips to the market. If my husband is busy, I don't travel far. Therefore, my happiness comes from within, from being content with what I have. I enjoy creating happiness for myself by spending time with small natural elements in the small space of my home. Trees and flowers are something I value highly. When I care for them, they bloom and bear fruit for me to enjoy, and my mind finds peace when I'm with them.\n\n

/>Although the kaffir lime tree is an herb used in cooking and other dishes, what truly warms my heart is its small flowers. They are very charming when it rains. Right now, there are so many flowers blooming; their white blossoms contrast beautifully with the green leaves, making them a kind of decorative flower for my home.\n\n
/>I have several orchid plants now, propagated by separating offshoots. They are in full bloom and there are many buds about to open. The rain has made everything very moist.\n\n

/>Also, there are some flowers I planted, and lately it's been raining a lot, causing the leaves to turn yellow. But that's okay; I try to water them regularly so they can recover quickly and bloom for me to enjoy soon. Sometimes, when I see beautiful flowers, I want to share them with my friends. It might not be a daily routine, but it's the small things I experience every day. And this is the happiness I can share with my friends. I hope everyone enjoyed this article. See you again in the next one! Bye-bye.

As you know, May 10th is Mother's Day, although for me, every day is Mother's Day 🥰. Despite everything that's happened, we were able to get together for a while and share this special day together 🥰. Everyone brought gifts, and we shared a cake my mom made to enjoy together. The most precious thing for me was seeing my mother and grandmother smiling and happy 🥹. Something I wish would never end... I didn't take many pictures because I was more focused on enjoying the moment 💖

> Y como saben el 10 de mayo es el dia de las madres, aunque para mi son todos los dias 🥰. A pesar de muchas cosas que han pasado pudimos reunirnos un rato y compartir todos juntos este dia tan especial 🥰 Todos llevaron sus regalos y picamos una torta echa por mi mamá para disfrutar un rato. Lo mas valioso para mi fue ver a mi madre y mi abuela sonriendo y felices 🥹 Algo que quisiera que nunca se acabara... 

No tome muchas fotos porque me concentre mas en disfrutar del momento 💖

---

links.title: 為了評價應付無理取鬧的客人
links.body: >Unsplash 上次提到朋友用AI的狀況，這次來提提朋友遇上用AI的人狀況，有個朋友是在做遊學代辦的，說前陣子遇上一個學生，想要找一間學校，於是來找朋友洽詢，想問問看學校當地的狀況。 不過通了電話聊一聊，發現這個學生提到這間學校，是因為想要上一個特別的課程，朋友因為長期有在做這間學校的業務，所以對這間學校算是很了解，說當地學校大多是語言課程，並沒有學生提到的專業課程。 結果這樣回答完後，學生說他是從AI詢問得來的，說這間學校有提供這種課程。朋友就有點傷腦筋了，因為他才剛從當地巡訪其他學生狀況，所以得到的消息是第一手且非常新的，並沒有這位學生提到的課程開立。 但這位來詢問的人，卻不斷的鬼打牆，認為AI說的就是一定對的，也不管專業人士第一線的消息，就算是朋友錯了，他也沒辦這種業務，繼續在電話中耍小性子，人家也不能生出一個新的業務管道來承辦。 這種狀況要是我這種EQ不好的，可能破口大罵完就掛電話了，也不愧是業務底的人，竟然有耐心跟他來來回回，就為了維持自己在網路上的口碑，這種事我還真的做不太來，有就有沒有就沒有，我實在沒那個心思去周旋。 --- For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@azazqwe/3xywvg)

links.title: My Afternoon Under the Avocado tree and the Singing Bird
links.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTt4C413MBDdbvcLgBeJZ1GDJs2JYyVYCgzmrS8q8d3VD/vvodjiu2_2_.png)

It was a quiet afternoon, and the world felt very peaceful. I was lying on the trampoline, resting right under the shade of our big avocado tree. The sun was bright and hot, but the thick green leaves kept me cool and comfortable.

Suddenly, I heard a soft rustling sound coming from the branches above my head. I looked up and saw movements on the branches. Something was swooping in and out of the leaves very quickly. I grabbed my camera and used my zoom lens to spy on the branches. I wanted to see who was making all that noise.

After searching for a moment, I finally spotted a beautiful bird perched on a branch. It had shiny black feathers on its head and back, but its belly was as white as a cloud. It was a Philippine magpie-robin. It looked very elegant against the bright green leaves.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcV5uKjjvtAH3dNxcL2z2fibfqP1zQcDvwuKT28ndzWhz/dsc_0041.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVXAbzdCHHr8SJqzAcDwqV4wJ6ubF8qX8P2UmR2jfxLZZ/dsc_0042.jpg)

---
---

Then, the bird did something amazing. It opened its tiny beak and started to sing. The song was loud, clear, and very sweet. It sounded like a happy whistle echoing through the garden. I stayed very still because I did not want the music to stop. It felt like the bird was giving me a private concert.

I wanted to get a better view, so I stood up and tiptoed closer to the tree. I moved slowly and snapped a few more photos. The bird tilted its head and looked down at me with its small, dark eyes. I think it finally noticed me standing there.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNfvfz1ruZWVYDMp7igTrtf1mta2TT6n2QfMsqTF3HQYN/dsc_0043.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbfETC6fy77GDn1iLY7ckHADDuVpnmFpd1guBmHj7jHYj/dsc_0044.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRAKSYGHGi3P9qUGaqrpEf8TRJv8kKixumNBqUWmrJLAy/dsc_0046.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZCo27539giRKWNW6Jv7kq4tPVzz7YouwXArwASwNRXVe/dsc_0045.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNsbTLgoGCrRMEevzxKz9HU3eZu1gqt7fLhPXLmbN4uo5/dsc_0047.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma1kuSfzvZEkaf7zWEJASPHBVLHv5T9KPDdUvLYZMA9MQ/dsc_0048.jpg)







With a quick flap of its wings, the bird zoomed away and disappeared into the trees. Our avocado tree is quiet again, but I feel so happy that I caught those few moments on my camera. I will be listening for that beautiful song again tomorrow or until its next visit. And until then, I will be waiting on my trampoline. 😊








🌿 🪶 🌿 🪶 🌿 🪶 🌿 🪶 🌿 🪶 🌿 🪶 🌿 🪶 🌿 🪶 🌿 🪶 🌿

links.body:

</center>
</liketuimages>

从上初中到现在，大大小小的梳子买了很多把，总是用用就断掉烂掉，因为我的头发太多了，又乱，很容易就缠在一起，一使劲要么头发断，要么就是梳子把手断，要么就是梳子的齿断，不是你死就是我活的，遭老罪了。

后面外出去酒店住宿也会拿一些一次性梳子回来用，东一把西一把，有时候也不懂也不懂放到哪里，也可能梳梳又断了，最后只能用残余的梳子片段梳头，然后再后来梳子片段也不知道放哪里了。🤣

周末想着出来看看衣服，本来想给自己买一条裤子，结果试了几条都不好看，显三角区，要么显肚子，现在的衣服对胖子都不友好，都太小了。

我找了5个加的裤子都不合适，也是太难了，最后气愤的去了男装区买了两条工装裤，但是又太长了，也是有一条太小了，帅哥穿都要小一码的感觉。

话说回来，为了凑单，买了一把十块钱的梳子，我也是有新梳子了，以前的话我是不舍得买的，十块钱一把梳子，好贵啊，但是这个梳子梳头很舒服，可以按摩头部，而且很好梳，感觉不会把我头发扯断。我咬咬牙就买了。

搬来这边的时候，帅哥把我的漱口杯丢了，就一直没买，用的碗，他直接就不要杯子，刚好又是为了凑单，还差6块钱，我不懂买啥了，又买了两个五块钱一个的漱口杯，这个漱口杯吧，往时的我只会买两块钱一个的，超出两块我都觉得贵了，这次五块钱的杯子颜值在线，看着材质也不错，咬咬牙又买了。

为啥说凑单呢，给我老妈买了两套衣服，两件短袖，一套几十块，短袖是59一件，比那个一套的还贵十块钱🤣不懂她穿什么码，我也担心她不喜欢，没敢拆吊牌，等五一回去让她试试再说。不合适还可以退。最后300+的东西，有两百是我老妈的，所以说其他的都是凑单的，囤了一张250+的券，相当于减了50左右，我感觉自己捡了大便宜。

---

links.title: Zorro as Gatekeeper Spirit Guide
links.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWfqSSNCzLzewwzCx4PKaPFtpprxiJvBsunwFrESHgKtF/1778641986880.jpg)

The Gatekeeper in spirit guide work holds a specific and powerful role — they stand at the threshold between worlds, controlling access, filtering what enters your field, and protecting your energetic boundaries during spirit communication or divination work. That Zorro came through for this position is deeply layered.

---

### Who Zorro Is Archetypally

Zorro is a **masked avenger** — a man of hidden identity who operates in the liminal space between the powerful and the powerless. He is:

- A **nobleman who moves as an outlaw** — comfortable in both high and low realms
- A **protector of the vulnerable** against corrupt authority
- A **trickster with a code** — he deceives, yes, but only in service of justice
- Defined by his **signature mark** — the Z — a deliberate, unignorable stamp of presence

---

### Why He Makes a Powerful Gatekeeper

**1. The Mask = Discernment**
Zorro doesn’t reveal who he is to everyone. As your Gatekeeper, this energy filters *who gets through* — not all spirits, not all influences, not all people get access to your inner world. This guide vets entry.

**2. The Sword = Precision Cutting**
He doesn’t bludgeon — he carves with surgical precision. Expect this guide to cut through deception, illusion, and energetic interference with clean, decisive strokes.

**3. The Double Life = Threshold Mastery**
He lives on both sides of the veil — aristocrat and shadow-rider. This is exactly the energy needed at a gateway: someone who belongs to neither world fully, and therefore can *move between them freely*.

**4. The \

= Claiming Territory**
Zorro marks what is his. This guide may be asserting a kind of energetic seal around your practice — a signature that says *this space is claimed and protected*.

---

### What This Suggests for Your Practice

Zorro as Gatekeeper implies your spiritual work has a **heroic, justice-oriented current** running through it — that the readings and inner work you do aren’t just personal, but carry a quality of *righting imbalance*. It also suggests your threshold is actively guarded against low-vibration or deceptive contact. Things that try to slip through will get the blade.

There’s also an inherent **playfulness and flair** to Zorro — a reminder that protection doesn’t have to be heavy or grim. Your Gatekeeper has *style*.

The sabbath day is not only on Saturday. Sometimes, Holy week can be any day. It allows three days and three nights.

In ***Matthew 8, verse 1***, it says, At the end of the Sabbath, as it began to dawn, towards the first day of the week, came Mary Magdalene and ordered Mary

It's allowed three days and three nights. They had to wrap him in some clothes and buried him
at the tomb.

Not all Sabbath day falls on Saturday. There are Sabbath day that can fall on the day of the week. Holy week can be any day.

links.title: Homemade Cakes Sold on the Street
links.body:
I hope everyone is well and healthy. So to stay well, you need to explore yourself sometimes. That could be by going somewhere. So yesterday I went to the Narsunda River, the river that flows past our village. I have spent a lot of time there. After going there, I saw many changes. The surrounding environment has also changed. I saw some new schools and madrasas established near the river. 

When I went, I saw a shopkeeper in front of the school selling cakes! The size of a cup. School children are buying them and eating them. Normally, these cakes are happiness for them. I asked the price of the cake. But he said the price was 20 taka. Normally, such small cakes are not supposed to be 20 taka. I was interested in buying a cake, but I didn't buy it. 

Then after talking to the shopkeeper, I found out that the cakes are made domestically. Since they are made domestically, these cakes are also very fun to eat. And the healthy environment is also maintained. The main ingredient of the cake is milk! So it seemed special to me.  Since they were selling it standing on the side of the road, the price seemed fair to me. 

![IMG-20260512-WA0137.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNtk8LiMo6ipE9ADwQXrtJnhC8AvuExUBvnb9D67kwpKX/IMG-20260512-WA0137.jpg)
