links.title: Toxic people.
links.body: > https://images.pexels.com/photos/7640807/pexels-photo-7640807.jpeg [sourch]( https://www.pexels.com/photo/a-woman-in-black-suit-sitting-at-the-table-7640807/ ) We humans are social creatures, we always like to be together with everyone. So we think about every person in our society and we try to live our lives beautifully by thinking about everything. But in the society for which we sacrifice a lot and the society that we constantly talk about, not every person in that society wants our well-being, in our society there are many people around us who see our beautiful life and see the smile on our face and constantly envy us. How to prevent unrest in our happy world, how to create obstacles in the way of our life's progress, some people in our society constantly think about these and also work accordingly. But these people come in front of us and claim to be our best friends, these people come to us and behave in such a way that they want us very well and associate with us very well, due to which we often do not understand how these people are harming us from being close to us in our lives. There are some people in this society who try to solve our problems in front of us and try to complicate those problems behind us and make arrangements so that we cannot get out of those problems. Some people are so unhappy with our progress that they constantly try to create obstacles to our better life and our success. Many are also seen who are burning with happiness in other people's lives because they do not have happiness in their own lives, and these people, instead of making their own lives beautiful and trying to make their own lives happy, are constantly trying to make trouble in other lives, that is, how to create unrest in other lives and destroy the happy world. Some people are so low-class that they do not even think about how much harm can be done to people by their behavior. Many people try to cause financial damage to break up the family, and many people try to break up the family by telling the husband that the wife's character is bad, and the wife tells the husband that the husband is having an affair somewhere else. Thus, there are some people in our society or around us who do not hesitate to set fire to our happy family or destroy it if they get the opportunity. Most of the people who are constantly trying to destroy the happiness and peace in our family are people close to us. When our close people see that there is no happiness in their family while their relatives or close people have happiness in their family, they cannot tolerate it at all and try to create unrest in the family. Therefore, we have to be constantly aware and try to keep our own family happy. We have to take care that no third person has any influence on our family. Husband and wife should always trust each other without leaving any doubt and try to keep faith in each other. Then we will be much happier in our family and will be able to move forward together. We definitely need to stay far away from these toxic people who are constantly trying to harm us, trying to hinder our progress in life and trying to set fire to our family. So we have to be aware all the time and observe people strictly and then speak our minds or these toxic people will not hesitate to take advantage of our opportunities by listening to our minds. Because these toxic people cannot be good themselves, they cannot tolerate others being good. We have to always identify these toxic bad people in our life and keep our distance from those who give us bad advice and wish us bad. We have to understand ourselves who wants us bad and gives bad advice and who wants us good. It will be good for us to be in touch with only those people who truly love us and wish us well. links.title: Yellow rice with chicken, sausage, and paprika 🫑—that's my lunch today 😋
links.body:
> **
ESPAÑOL
** Tenía un pedacito de pollo en casa, así que, compré unas salchichas, un pimentón y decidí preparar para mi almuerzo un arroz amarillo con estos tres ingredientes, un menú rápido, sencillo, fácil de preparar y muy delicioso; les muestro la preparación

> **
ENGLISH
** I had a small piece of chicken at home, so I bought some sausages and a bell pepper and decided to make yellow rice for lunch using these three ingredients—a quick, simple, easy-to-make, and very delicious meal. Here’s how I made it ![1000882578.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23vi62CdvneNkgtC1EhLJrJWxcgUChMhs8ZbAQLWFAZwKMvSYV4xMgKjaGXCoguaWwimP.jpg)

> **
INGREDIENTES
** arroz blanco, cúrcuma, pollo, salchicha, pimentón, cebollín, ajo, cebolla, adobo, sal, aceite

> **
INGREDIENTS
** white rice, turmeric, chicken, sausage, paprika, chives, garlic, onion, marinade, salt, oil ![1000882303.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/EpA2Z3BZBSNNmeEDExfZu6fwrwLrxv1kreekvyZpT9HkQfHPUnJAUmnMbhUNCJJnkBV.jpg)

> **
PROCEDIMIENTO
** Llevé a sofreír el arroz en aceite caliente, agregué la cúrcuma y el pimentón cortado en tiras, reservé. Por otro lado, preparé un guiso con el pollo y la salchicha sazonado con adobo, salsa de soya, y sal; una vez que el guiso estuvo bastante cocido lo incorporé el arroz, mezcle, agregué la cantidad de agua necesaria y dejé cocinar hasta que hubo secado por completo

> **
PROCEDURE
** I sautéed the rice in hot oil, added the turmeric and the bell pepper cut into strips, then set it aside. Meanwhile, I prepared a stew with the chicken and sausage, seasoned with adobo, soy sauce, and salt; once the stew was nearly done, I added the rice, stirred, added the necessary amount of water, and let it cook until it had completely absorbed the liquid. ![1000882409.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23xyUoZcHTyd1gdZVWLLN11WpcGAe8vC2rN2VxHwPeM5yFUVryvoJ6EBPxweBWBsTRXt1.jpg) ![1000882496.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23wqiZTcy4R7QSkagEELXi6cVjdLHjKP2wXVYWJbXxHRhWcJQGkm7LTdbKUNu2HkSjzJ4.jpg) ![1000882501.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23wWwQq9NzGdsKb3ajUpUGhdc7gXwGFQKR6U4fqyG3V4M43SQpo3SRpbA2NSfAJuAK3L3.jpg) ![1000882506.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23wWw2f15xFvg81wvLDnotyrFKB2KAGpbz3Kd6wuSJgSMVgdnzkLkwHK5QG8hzY7sDcB5.jpg) ![1000882507.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23wgKyVhyk5jBiB1AHADxvpR1KuarLahbQfeKUqUJp6bTdPN4jFPEt5d2w7tnAH2WPC6k.jpg) ![1000882574.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23vsSc7VZ9V3k2qKvg5KjFVE7mUoG6bJYoEFPQ9EXcQDHTYpQodobiaKYn1yxkJevRKD9.jpg) ![1000882574.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23vsSc7VZ9V3k2qKvg5KjFVE7mUoG6bJYoEFPQ9EXcQDHTYpQodobiaKYn1yxkJevRKD9.jpg)

links.body:
> This time I went to the Ciudad Pacífica residential complex in Cali, Colombia. Once there, I headed to Pacific Park, which is located within this modern urban development. It’s quite large—about three hectares—and features a playground with swings, a seesaw, merry-go-rounds, and other recreational equipment.
![1000430040.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmundodeyari/23ywnxeT551AiLvCwZ9M9w7qnM3rC5b2URTKJ43G6eJhJZTPvnCc9DXYo2rQv3eNWVohS.jpg)
![1000430038.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmundodeyari/23uQtoDKwvawtZLYEgVxd6WMq4viTxfbRjv2DiFLeASF852S4UNzowookrJaqtasULYPu.jpg)
![1000430043.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmundodeyari/244Uj7ybc2AjEtdrVJ6Q5U2nayCwLnYkLuvYBRseVs84frch4o57w7qdmSi7YASU2moLE.jpg)
I love this place because it’s outdoors and allows young people to exercise and socialize in a healthy way—activities that have been somewhat lost due to our reliance on technology. Here I saw a basketball court and another area for exercising, including a space set up for riding bicycles. There’s also a designated area for pets.
![1000430044.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmundodeyari/241ZhDB5cGUofi457AqVxEjBze54HXewfoXmTe8cQb78vjRg7cADt664i8vju4y2sZt4T.jpg)
![1000430039.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmundodeyari/23uQtNbj7TTvCKZHFvVmRApKh8A8xChphRXi4xxFzyvdmJxBQQq6csQfhBbJk3ePLyy2f.jpg)
![1000430046.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmundodeyari/23yd5cQPCqzwVxTx5Ax1XRvHrMVd6o7ZRsMxDfkjr7vTGXYibPJudsTDqR8fKAZFfDow3.jpg)
In this park, you’ll find various kiosks selling food, drinks, and snacks to make your visit more enjoyable. Camping is also an option, perfect for families or groups planning to spend many hours here. This large park also hosts events; in fact, when I visited, they were celebrating **Mother’s Day**, which was very touching.
![1000430041.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmundodeyari/23zRy9ux5GE5zNMCUtuXoNkW4xAXRN9CZgmF1Qu3v2d448xkgbwWGnEA2LTuhPiCYUKiW.jpg)
![1000430042.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmundodeyari/245Hf1JFhFEDfYFz2M9g4JUnFEBc3T1DCFyhrLyXoevQCgnFFWmhXVMk1GNx5SjLjWQ9X.jpg)
![1000430045.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmundodeyari/23wgHvsaBL11nEPCJ4UU64SCkBMeE9ZUWCPKh1EsEgqFqvcuRtTnzHMNcxskrotY8cSCf.jpg)
I enjoyed this outing with my family—my husband, my children, and my little grandson—because I got to watch them all play as if they were children again, and that filled me with joy. These moments move me and at the same time make me reflect, especially when observing how each person tends to experience these moments: the children and young athletes are focused on their physical activities, while we adults go for a walk with other priorities in mind. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> En esta ocasión fui a la Urbanización Ciudad Pacífica ubicada en Cali, Colombia, una vez allí me dirigí al parque Pacífico que se encuentra adentro de este moderno complejo urbanístico. Es bastante grande, tiene como unas tres hectáreas aproximadamente, posee una zona de juegos para niños, con columpios, sube y baja, ruedas y otros aparatos recreativos.
![1000430040.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmundodeyari/23ywnxeT551AiLvCwZ9M9w7qnM3rC5b2URTKJ43G6eJhJZTPvnCc9DXYo2rQv3eNWVohS.jpg)

Me encanta este lugar porque es al aire libre y le permite a la juventud hacer ejercicio y compartir sanamente, actividades que se han perdido un poco debido a la dependencia por la tecnología. Acá observé una cancha de baloncesto y otra zona para realizar ejercicios, entre ellos una zona acondicionada para manejar bicicletas. De igual forma, hay un sitio destinado a los animales domésticos.
![1000430044.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmundodeyari/241ZhDB5cGUofi457AqVxEjBze54HXewfoXmTe8cQb78vjRg7cADt664i8vju4y2sZt4T.jpg)

En este parque podemos encontrar diferentes kioskos donde venden comida, bebidas y golosinas, para hacer una experiencia más grata. La opción de hacer camping es posible, adecuada para aquellas familias o grupos que tengan planificado pasar muchas horas en este lugar. En este gran parque también se pueden realizar eventos, de hecho cuando fui estaban celebrando el **Día de las Madres** el cual resultó muy emotivo.
![1000430041.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmundodeyari/23zRy9ux5GE5zNMCUtuXoNkW4xAXRN9CZgmF1Qu3v2d448xkgbwWGnEA2LTuhPiCYUKiW.jpg)

links.body:
###
*A Different Kind of Workout*
Sometimes, exercise and physical activity come through unconventional methods. As you know, my afternoon job as a gym instructor keeps me constantly on the move and always on high alert to stay ahead of the latest training techniques. That’s why I’ve been a bit away from this incredible platform in recent months, as I’ve been immersed in a fast-paced lifestyle where the pace seems to pick up every day. >###
*Un Ejercicio Diferente*
>En ocasiones, el ejercicio y la actividad física se logran a través de métodos poco convencionales. Como ustedes saben, mi trabajo en las tardes como instructor en un gimnasio me mantiene en constante movimiento y siempre con todos los sentidos alertas para mantenerme a la vanguardia de las nuevas técnicas de entrenamiento. Es por ello que los últimos meses he estado un poco alejado de esta increíble plataforma, ya que me encuentro sumergido en un estilo de vida trepidante, en donde el ritmo pareciera acelerarse cada día. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/d6ad8e06-7ba1-49db-9447-b7d224a0e47e.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/e21b5e72-8009-4323-851b-0bdc0f35d251.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/233931a9-6f47-489e-8b0c-e097666b6ed4.jpg) To be honest, I can’t complain because it’s a lifestyle that keeps me constantly on the move, allows me to train my body, and at the same time keeps me up to date on the latest trends. Lately, I’ve also been studying nutrition so I can offer a more comprehensive and effective service, helping my students reach their goals more easily and quickly. But, as I mentioned at the start, progress doesn’t always happen the same way—and that’s how, curiously enough, I managed to hit the 5,000 mark today through sheer determination and hard work. >A decir verdad, no me puedo quejar porque se trata de un estilo de vida que me mantiene en constante movimiento, me permite entrenar mi cuerpo y al mismo tiempo me mantiene actualizado sobre las nuevas tendencias. Últimamente, también he estado haciendo estudios en el área de la nutrición, para así poder brindar un servicio más completo y eficaz, que le permita a mis alumnos avanzar hacia sus metas de manera más fácil y rápida. Pero, como les decía al principio, no siempre los pasos se logran de la misma manera y es así como de manera curiosa hoy logré superar la meta de los cinco mil a punta de coletazos y barridas. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/5a1121ce-f524-4cb5-b238-bd732757f988.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/a79d665a-81b2-4804-a07d-7c8f8d944887.jpg) Since today was my turn to do some maintenance on my entire space—because maintaining quality also means taking good care of the infrastructure around me—it’s essential to keep everything 100% hygienic, sparkling clean, and infused with that touch of love that makes all the difference. This not only helps keep the space tidy but also radiates positive energy to all my students; here, they find a comforting space full of vitality. >Ya que hoy me tocó hacerle mantenimiento a todo mi espacio, ya que para que la calidad se mantenga también hay que darle un cariño a toda la infraestructura que me rodea, es necesario mantener todo 100% higiénico, reluciente y con ese toque de amor que marca la diferencia. Con esto no solo se logra mantener un área pulcra, sino que también le transmite buenas energías a todos mis alumnos; se encuentran en este lugar un área reconfortante y llena de vitalidad. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/2f4c2c83-73ba-452c-a075-5bda4bdf635f.jpg)

links.title: Betrayal / Wednesday / Long Trip
links.body:
![IMG_20260513_101037.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmThGDZ1fzZ89MWmcwLt6ZuHoqzto2ciQKbhFGCgCUCS3B/IMG_20260513_101037.jpg)

### Betrayal
I can see some people I know smiling at me, but I don't know what is going on inside their heads. I'm used to it, and I don't care anymore. Admittedly, I was hurt the first time I heard about someone talking about me behind my back. I am not the only one he is doing that to. That speaks volumes about the kind of person he is.

By now, I have already overcome the pain that I felt. I can still talk to that person, but I don't trust him anymore. I won't tell him any secrets, or even express my opinion about others when he's present. That's the good result of learning about someone's betrayal. You become more protective of yourself.

Of course, the time will come when his actions will come to an end. That is if we, his victims, confront him. It will surely surprise him.

### Wednesday
Even in the early morning, it's already hot. A simple movement can make me sweat. The harsh weather conditions we are having are the effects of human destruction on the environment. Whether they deny it or not, humans contributed to global warming.

### Long Trip
We were ready for the long trip at that time. We used two tricycles and a motorcycle. There were fears, but they calmed down when we reached our destination safely.

links.title: A Look at the Manzanares River (Eng/Esp)
links.body:
> The Manzanares River is the most important freshwater waterway in Sucre State; it is approximately 81 kilometers long, which gives an idea of its magnitude. It originates in the imposing Cerro Turimiquire, flows through the city of Cumana, and empties into the Caribbean Sea via the Gulf of Cariaco.
![1000114753.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23vsScYBFt6Qs2kjyAH8Xz4xrxycmvwDKYYSry2XPa6CKYcqws28nvHvp19v1Ej3LvVD2.jpg)
In the not-too-distant past, its waters were crystal clear along most of its course, but now, as a discharge point for sewage, pollution has wreaked havoc on the stretch that runs through Cumaná. Currently, its flow has decreased because the municipality is dredging it; following a major emergency in which the main transfer line of the system that supplies water to the city collapsed, the decision was made to use water from the Manzanares River, previously treated by water treatment plants.
![1000113765.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/242hWoddYLosK87ieLg1sJBH8o8qM2gVo2jeFumsbHNnq9JSf6inbUcTySRf7vThSiuPW.jpg)
![1000113773.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EowGdCYbDoY2ELjvTkhYgC5Q37fp4qGKN3gTveBQoPYLxcSPty1SdHoM8xyUXt2LoSf.jpg)
Once again, the importance of the Manzanares River to Cumana is evident; this waterway has inspired various artistic expressions such as songs, paintings, poems, and stories. Over the years, it has been a source of both joy and sorrow, which is why—and for many other reasons—it stands as a historical landmark. One of the most iconic songs is “River Manzanares” by José Antonio Lopez, which has become almost an anthem at the local level.
![1000113769.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/Eqd9u6iKv2GmqiqpBfj7cKmYHFjzRrMq2CW7V98ozgyMgCDZkibrLjsVR6zYtArPLhM.jpg)
![1000113766.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpQuuK2NLnE1KbLQV9hD5h6ZUtMGhraZuouYsYK6tvkGLL3Qx8MhZSmzkvHAwPPuZx3.jpg)
Although part of the river is still navigable, pollution levels have contributed to the decline in small boats; at least in Cumana, very few are now seen near the Market and the neighborhoods of La Trinidad and Las Palomas, through which the Manzanares flows until it reaches the river mouth, known as the city’s fishing pier.
![1000113754.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EppLeQCu5ZeMrPosnDekigJZK989HHhd7DKSCrVwsDJSWJAL38SjgvMsrYvW5ZTkrZx.jpg)
![1000113764.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/Ep3errjoo1pZWAUtgxBPvo9p829nE82WA9meVP3Zuqp4aU4tqqoUL4PGsivXj84bE15.jpg)
This river has been a faithful witness to the past and to history; it was vital to the founding of Cumaná because it became the source of fresh water for the first settlers who established themselves in the San Francisco area, next to the Castle and the Basilica of Santa Inés. The old aqueduct was built from the Manzanares River and inaugurated in the early 1800s, serving as one of the foundations for development from the colonial era onward.
![1000113759.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EprTX2f3xrsUZneTTyioykYYW43N9vBTDkM833x8ujo6dPoGFGq2aR1HvmoNXT8Dagm.jpg)
![1000113762.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/Epzy7o8wD89xcB82MjQJ6KJacJS6vGFxreaFwNFUAhSnnobsTiEUT1fgBRHQmEpzFc8.jpg)
The images I’m showing you today are from a walk through the city center, right across the bridge connecting Mariño Street with Ayacucho Square. The river can be seen from various parts of downtown, with Guaiqueri Park, the Gómez Rubio Bridge, the Guzman Blanco Bridge, and Petión Avenue being the best spots to view it as it winds through the city. *** ***
## Versión en Español

>
El Río Manzanares es el caudal de agua dulce más importante del estado Sucre, posee aproximadamente 81 kilómetros de longitud, lo que concede una idea de su magnitud. Nace en el imponente Cerro Turimiquire, atraviesa la ciudad de Cumaná y desemboca en el Mar Caribe a través del Golfo de Cariaco. 


<center>
![1000114753.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23vsScYBFt6Qs2kjyAH8Xz4xrxycmvwDKYYSry2XPa6CKYcqws28nvHvp19v1Ej3LvVD2.jpg)
</center>

En tiempos algo remotos, era cristalino en la mayor parte de su recorrido, pero ahora, al ser desahogo de aguas servidas, la contaminación ha hecho estragos en el tramo que recorre Cumaná. Actualmente su caudal ha descendido debido a que la municipalidad lo está dragando ya que ante una gran contingencia, se derrumbó el eje transvase del sistema que surte de agua a la ciudad, se ha optado por utilizar el agua del Manzanares, previamente tratada por plantas de potabilización.

<center>
![1000113765.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/242hWoddYLosK87ieLg1sJBH8o8qM2gVo2jeFumsbHNnq9JSf6inbUcTySRf7vThSiuPW.jpg)
</center>

<center>
![1000113773.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EowGdCYbDoY2ELjvTkhYgC5Q37fp4qGKN3gTveBQoPYLxcSPty1SdHoM8xyUXt2LoSf.jpg)
</center>

De nuevo se demuestra la importancia del río Manzanares para Cumaná, caudal que ha sido inspiración para diversas manifestaciones artísticas tales como canciones, pinturas, poemas y narraciones. A lo largo de los años ha sido motivo de alegrías y tristezas, por eso y más es un referente histórico. Uno de los temas musicales más emblemáticos es \

de José Antonio López, casi un himno a nivel local.
![1000113769.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/Eqd9u6iKv2GmqiqpBfj7cKmYHFjzRrMq2CW7V98ozgyMgCDZkibrLjsVR6zYtArPLhM.jpg)
![1000113766.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpQuuK2NLnE1KbLQV9hD5h6ZUtMGhraZuouYsYK6tvkGLL3Qx8MhZSmzkvHAwPPuZx3.jpg)
Si bien una parte del río todavía es navegable, el nivel de contaminación ha contribuido a que las pequeñas embarcaciones cada vez sean menos vistas, al menos en Cumaná son muy pocas las que se observan ahora cerca del Mercado y los barrios La Trinidad y Las Palomas, por donde el Manzanares tiene su paso hasta llegar a la Boca del río, conocido como el muelle pesquero de la ciudad.
![1000113754.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EppLeQCu5ZeMrPosnDekigJZK989HHhd7DKSCrVwsDJSWJAL38SjgvMsrYvW5ZTkrZx.jpg)
![1000113764.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/Ep3errjoo1pZWAUtgxBPvo9p829nE82WA9meVP3Zuqp4aU4tqqoUL4PGsivXj84bE15.jpg)
Este río ha sido testigo fiel del pasado y de la historia, fue vital para la fundación de Cumaná porque llegó a ser la fuente de agua dulce para estos primeros pobladores que se instalaron en la zona de San Francisco, al lado del Castillo, y de la Basílica de Santa Inés. El acueducto viejo fue construido a partir del Manzanares e inaugurado a principios de 1800, una de las bases para el desarrollo a partir de la época colonial.
![1000113759.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EprTX2f3xrsUZneTTyioykYYW43N9vBTDkM833x8ujo6dPoGFGq2aR1HvmoNXT8Dagm.jpg)
![1000113762.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/Epzy7o8wD89xcB82MjQJ6KJacJS6vGFxreaFwNFUAhSnnobsTiEUT1fgBRHQmEpzFc8.jpg)
Las imágenes que hoy les muestro son de una caminata por el centro de la ciudad, justo por el puente que comunica la calle Mariño con la Plaza Ayacucho. Desde varios sectores del centro se puede observar el río siendo el parque Guaiqueri, el puente Gómez Rubio, el puente Guzmán Blanco y la avenida Petión los puntos preferidos para contemplarlo en su recorrido por la ciudad.   *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery, edited with Fotocollage. ✓Text translated with DeepL.

links.title: A stroll through the walled city, an open-air art project ENG-ESP]
links.body: >Greetings, dear friends of Worldmappin, and welcome to my blog. Today I’m sharing an extraordinary photo gallery of urban art designed to revitalize the historic district of Cumaná, the capital of Sucre State, Venezuela. In addition to the area’s striking colonial architecture—thanks to its colorful houses, monuments, and narrow, cobblestone streets—to further revitalize the surrounding areas, they have created “Ciudad Mural,” a project that showcases open-air urban art.

>From the moment you begin your stroll through the oldest part of the continent’s first city, you’ll see various artistic scenes in all their splendor. Each one represents the culture, traditions, coastal identity, heritage, nature, and traditional cuisine of the eastern region of Sucre State. The facades of the colonial houses became the perfect canvas for the artistic works of the City of Murals, though it wasn’t just the houses—businesses and even parking lots were also used. As we gather in the plaza where the Minor Basilica of Santa Inés is located, we find a painting honoring the Venezuelan writer and poet born in Manicuare, Cruz Salmerón Acosta.
![1772466310527.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZPTmUASxZNAp8xEEeiSGfknktS24TW9bM51oJxyvaDnA/1772466310527.jpg)
![1772466310468.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmX8WhVae2a8jmoyBkaMRTvTXaLdgDAzvDWQP6Kmv5vujR/1772466310468.jpg)

> In addition to depicting the renowned poet of martyrdom—also known as “The Loner of the Manicuare Summit”—this piece of urban art features a scene typical of the Araya Peninsula, such as the sea, seafood, and pelicans, which are part of the coast’s native wildlife. Cruz Salmerón Acosta is remembered for his poem “Azul,” and the mural features not only the drawing but also the first stanza of the poem, which is worth mentioning:
The blue of that distant peak toward which my thoughts fly under the blue peace of the morning, a color that reveals so much to me! [Source](https://www.poeticous.com/cruz-maria-salmeron-acosta/azul?locale=es)

>Another figure that graces the City of Murals is the portrait of Leonor Guerra, created by the Cuban artist Ivette Dorticós; her signature indicates that this artwork is recent, dating from 2025. One fascinating aspect of this project is that every time you visit the historic district, you discover new works. Leonor de la Guerra was a native of Cumaná remembered for her courage in confronting the Spanish colonial authorities.
![1772466310566.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbvACbKNfsp5niDDZ8zRKYX6YjX5aUY78U7Rmm11hYnXW/1772466310566.jpg)
![1777736257636.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRPZJFRJUmJeqb2GpvqA6B3JDFVWFqGdLNp1t47zNFjBE/1777736257636.jpg)
![1772466310428.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQszvbFShpt11Z8LFAc9HQJoGAzT15ggecTezU72victc/1772466310428.jpg)

>The city of Cumaná is a coastal area famous for its beaches and seafood cuisine; it is considered a land of grace. It is known as the “Firstborn of the American Continent” because it was founded by Spanish colonists, which is why its roots encompass a blend of races, traditions, and cultures. That is why, in the City of Murals, we find works that combine and highlight elements reflecting its indigenous and African roots, seascapes, typical coastal wildlife, folk music traditions, and cuisine, where the main traditional dish is fish.

>The so-called “City of Murals” is beautiful and very colorful, not only because of the colonial-era architecture and facades adorned with street art, but also because of the many flower-filled plants, which attract tourists with their myriad hues. Another facade that represents the region’s identity features a portrait of an indigenous child, paying homage to the ancestral heritage and culture of Sucre State. On another facade, the artwork depicts the characteristic landscape of the coastal area, distinctive cuisine, local fruits, and a figure of a woman posing with a fish atop a two-headed turtle. This symbolizes the statue of the indigenous man, representing the Cumanés people, and at the same time, the warm welcome extended to tourists upon their arrival in the city. This statue was located at a roundabout where Arístides Rojas, Universidad, Arismendi, and Nueva Toledo avenues intersect. Currently, the statue is no longer there; it was moved to the entrance of Cumaná, specifically on Universidad Avenue in the Los Bordones neighborhood.
![1772466310606.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYWi7SZTB9yXvwuVCHiDb7EWX1LEzTFzkMDTduew5MQtA/1772466310606.jpg)
![1777736257560.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQaxjudFmWX2NnLiV4A9sf37ijNr6aCnm4u1rZMugj8aT/1777736257560.jpg)
![1777736257349.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNysGfRcMji32HppcVgxRCTJaF6XcDLaSxshyPKWTFGyV/1777736257349.jpg)
![1777736257688.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSA2nUXxjASfcHMeKnEKyx1MHf6boqEkkMZLoSATc4xR6/1777736257688.jpg)

> The state of Sucre and the people of Cumaná are known for their joy, dancing, and music, which is why many notable figures hail from there, such as Mariano Ribera, Gualberto Ibarreto, and María Rodríguez, known as “La Sirena de Cumaná.” The latter was an important figure in music, well known for her dancing—which is why she was also known as La Mariposa bailadora de Cumaná—and was a Venezuelan singer and cultural figure. On the mural featuring the tribute portrait to the Siren of Cumaná, a few lines from the lyrics of the song “Ay Cumaná” have been inscribed, celebrating the city, its traditions, and the Manzanares River, an important historical landmark. The verse goes like this:
“Ay Cumaná, quien te viera y por tus calles paseara, y a San Francisco yo fuera a misa de madrugada» [Source](https://www.ventevenezuela.org/2022/09/29/ay-cumana-quien-te-viera-por-cristian-silva-potella/)
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQEXznMJApJxc9Hph1nNHP1k9b871Xy21d9NZ8jb54MmJ/image.png) María Rodríguez

> Continuing on the tour, we come across murals adorned with flowers and birds, as well as the Catholic Church of Santa Inés, one of the oldest churches in Cumaná. This is where one of the most beautiful alleys in the historic district begins: El Callejón de La Purpurina. Here, the artist—who signs his work “Tony”—pays tribute to an iconic figure, María Encarnación Maiz, famous for wearing exotic, glittery makeup, hence her nickname, “La Purpurina.”

>In addition to evoking this iconic figure, this alley pays homage to Cumaná’s colonial district, with its design mimicking the facades of the houses, featuring large windows adorned with colorful plants and flowers. One of the things I like most about this alley is the colorful umbrellas hanging from the ceiling; besides being decorative, they shield us from the intense sunlight.
![1765077278373.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmP4cXNgZRgGDVfzoYkDLA849KVqnmZdkJi3ygyXTbNGcr/1765077278373.jpg)
![1765077278393.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPwpjZDf4TJC8ZXiFf7TehnwoWZMMak1ZxLfwfdJQp9Bt/1765077278393.jpg)
![1772466310706.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcSUM856Vsws48ixHMa7ttc9hZGjV6sPoyNAcvLXPx4cL/1772466310706.jpg)
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbKCwGsb5TgNN3ZjdTXxmXagZRtGGpSbB24QZkgZAjjyj/image.png)
![1765077278271.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPdkgdYqQQ6V6ceKDTnkeQBCdG5Mac6q5FXedLMFpotPH/1765077278271.jpg)
![1765077278134.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaZrdnCtm9znBj4Xpqn1ejGPNqNp1nkL3K8ZWmgkeXzXW/1765077278134.jpg)

> A tour of the walled city is fascinating—there’s art everywhere—and this is just a small sample of this open-air art.
[//]:# (!worldmappin 10.46167 lat -64.17443 long Casco Histórico, Cumaná, Sucre, Venezuela d3scr)

>I hope you enjoyed this tour as much as I did. See you next time.
# Thank you for reading
_The photos are originals taken with my Xiaomi Redmi 9 phone. The editions were made with the [GridArt application](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=photoeditor.layout.collagemaker&hl=en_ZA&gl=US)_
![1778624957938.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWC7wXPAXyWfvpprrDuPLxcPSwffN5v2tVry76UWDT4KL/1778624957938.jpg)
#

>Saludos estimados amigos de Worldmappin, bienvenidos a mi blog. Hoy les comparto una extraordinaria galería de fotos del arte urbano que tiene como función revitalizar los espacios del casco histórico de la ciudad de Cumaná, capital del estado Sucre, Venezuela. Además de la vistosa arquitectura colonial de la zona gracias a las coloridas casas, monumentos, calles estrechas y empedradas, para reavivar aún más a las áreas circundantes, han creado a la “Ciudad Mural”, un proyecto que recrea arte urbano a cielo abierto.

>Desde que se inicia el paseo por la zona más antigua de la primogénita del continente, se observan varias escenas artísticas en todo su esplendor. Cada una de ellas representa cultura, tradiciones, identidad costeña, patrimonios, naturaleza y gastronomía oriental típica del estado Sucre. Las fachadas de las casas coloniales se convirtieron en el lienzo perfecto para las obras artísticas de la Ciudad Mural, aunque no solo fueron las casas, también negocios y hasta estacionamientos. Al converger en la plaza donde se encuentra ubicada la Basílica Menor de Santa Inés, encontramos una pintura en honor al escritor y poeta venezolano nacido en Manicuare, Cruz Salmerón Acosta.
![1772466310527.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZPTmUASxZNAp8xEEeiSGfknktS24TW9bM51oJxyvaDnA/1772466310527.jpg)
![1772466310468.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmX8WhVae2a8jmoyBkaMRTvTXaLdgDAzvDWQP6Kmv5vujR/1772466310468.jpg)

>Este arte urbano además de plasmar al conocido poeta del martirio, también llamado El solitario de la cima de Manicuare, muestra una escena propia de la Península de Araya, como el mar, frutos marinos y pelicanos, parte de la fauna propia de la costa. Cruz Salmerón Acosta es recordado por su poema “Azul” y en el mural además del dibujo han plasmado la primera estrofa del poema que vale la pena mencionar:
Azul de aquella cumbre tan lejana hacia la cual mi pensamiento vuela bajo la paz azul de la mañana, ¡color que tantas cosas me revela! [Fuente](https://www.poeticous.com/cruz-maria-salmeron-acosta/azul?locale=es)

>Otro personaje que engalana a la Ciudad Mural es el retrato de Leonor Guerra, cuyo autor fue la artista Cubana, Ivette Dorticós, se puede observar en su firma que este arte es reciente, del año 2025. Algo que resulta fascinante de este proyecto es que siempre que se visita el casco histórico encontramos nuevas obras. Leonor de la Guerra fue una cumanesa recordada por su valentía al enfrentar a la colonia española.
![1772466310566.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbvACbKNfsp5niDDZ8zRKYX6YjX5aUY78U7Rmm11hYnXW/1772466310566.jpg)
![1777736257636.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRPZJFRJUmJeqb2GpvqA6B3JDFVWFqGdLNp1t47zNFjBE/1777736257636.jpg)
![1772466310428.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQszvbFShpt11Z8LFAc9HQJoGAzT15ggecTezU72victc/1772466310428.jpg)
>La ciudad de Cumaná es una zona costera, famosa por sus playas y gastronomía marina, es considerada tierra de gracia. Es conocida como la \

, al ser fundada por la colonia española, motivo por el cual contempla en sus raíces una mezcla de razas, tradiciones y cultura. Es por ello, que en la Ciudad Mural encontramos obras que conjugan y destacan elementos que confieren las raíces indígenas y africanas, paisajes marinos, fauna típica de la zona costera, tradiciones musicales folclóricas y la gastronomía, donde el plato típico principal es el pescado.

>La llamada Ciudad Mural es preciosa, muy colorida, no solo por el diseño propio de la zona colonial y fachadas con arte urbano, hay muchas plantas cargadas de flores, las cuales también atraen a los turísticas con sus múltiples matices de colores. Otra de las fachadas que representan la identidad de la región, es el retrato de un niño indígena en homenaje a la raza y cultura ancestral del estado Sucre. En otra de las fachadas, el arte plasma el paisaje característico de la zona costera, gastronomía distintiva, frutos de la región y una figura de mujer que posa con un pescado sobre una tortuga de dos cabezas, esto simboliza a la estatua del indio, representativo del gentilicio Cumanés y a su vez la cálida bienvenida a los turistas cuando llegan a la ciudad. Esta estatua estuvo ubicada en una redoma donde se interceptan las Avenidas Arístides Rojas, Universidad, Arismendi y Nueva Toledo. Actualmente, la estatua no se encuentra en ese lugar, fue removida a la entrada de Cumaná, específicamente en la Avenida Universidad, Sector los Bordones.
![1772466310606.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYWi7SZTB9yXvwuVCHiDb7EWX1LEzTFzkMDTduew5MQtA/1772466310606.jpg)
![1777736257560.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQaxjudFmWX2NnLiV4A9sf37ijNr6aCnm4u1rZMugj8aT/1777736257560.jpg)
![1777736257349.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNysGfRcMji32HppcVgxRCTJaF6XcDLaSxshyPKWTFGyV/1777736257349.jpg)
![1777736257688.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSA2nUXxjASfcHMeKnEKyx1MHf6boqEkkMZLoSATc4xR6/1777736257688.jpg)

>El estado Sucre y el pueblo cumanés se caracteriza por su alegría, el baile y la música, por lo que destacan muchos personajes ilustres, como Mariano Ribera, Gualberto Ibarreto y María Rodríguez, conocida como La Sirena de Cumaná. Esta última fue una importante figura de la música, muy conocida por sus bailes, motivo por el cual también era conocida como La Mariposa bailadora de Cumaná, fue cantante y cultora venezolana. En el mural donde se encuentra el retrato tributo a la Sirena de Cumaná, han plasmado algunas líneas que forman parte de la letra de la canción “Ay Cumaná”, que enaltecen a la ciudad, las tradiciones y al Río Manzanares, un importante referente histórico. La estrofa dice así:
“Ay Cumaná, quien te viera y por tus calles paseara, y a San Francisco yo fuera a misa de madrugada» [Fuente](https://www.ventevenezuela.org/2022/09/29/ay-cumana-quien-te-viera-por-cristian-silva-potella/)
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQEXznMJApJxc9Hph1nNHP1k9b871Xy21d9NZ8jb54MmJ/image.png) María Rodríguez

>Continuando con el recorrido, encontramos murales cargados de flores, aves y la iglesia católica Santa Inés, uno de los templos más antiguos de Cumaná. Aquí comienza uno de los callejones más hermosos del casco histórico, El callejón de La Purpurina, en este, el autor que ha firmado con el nombre de Tony, le rinde tributo a un personaje icónico, María Encarnación Maiz, famosa por usar maquillajes exóticos y con mucho brillo, de allí su apodo, “La Purpurina”.

>Este callejón además de evocar a este emblemático personaje, rinde homenaje a la zona colonial de Cumaná, simulando en su obra a las fachadas de las casas con su grandes ventanales cargados de plantas y flores coloridas. Uno de los aspectos que más me gusta de este callejón son los paraguas de colores que cuelgan sobre la parte superior del mismo, además de decorativos nos protegen de los intensos rayos solares.
![1765077278373.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmP4cXNgZRgGDVfzoYkDLA849KVqnmZdkJi3ygyXTbNGcr/1765077278373.jpg)
![1765077278393.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPwpjZDf4TJC8ZXiFf7TehnwoWZMMak1ZxLfwfdJQp9Bt/1765077278393.jpg)
![1772466310706.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcSUM856Vsws48ixHMa7ttc9hZGjV6sPoyNAcvLXPx4cL/1772466310706.jpg)
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbKCwGsb5TgNN3ZjdTXxmXagZRtGGpSbB24QZkgZAjjyj/image.png)
![1765077278271.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPdkgdYqQQ6V6ceKDTnkeQBCdG5Mac6q5FXedLMFpotPH/1765077278271.jpg)
![1765077278134.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaZrdnCtm9znBj4Xpqn1ejGPNqNp1nkL3K8ZWmgkeXzXW/1765077278134.jpg)

>El recorrido por la ciudad mural es fascinante, hay arte por todos lados, y es que, esto es solo una muestra de este arte a cielo abierto.
[//]:# (!worldmappin 10.46167 lat -64.17443 long Casco Histórico, Cumaná, Sucre, Venezuela d3scr)

>Espero hayan disfrutado de este recorrido tanto como yo. Hasta la próxima.
# Gracias por leer
_Las fotos son originales, tomadas con mi teléfono Xiaomi Redmi 9. Las ediciones las hice con la aplicación [GridArt](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=photoeditor.layout.collagemaker&hl=en_ZA&gl=US)._

links.title: Hive Fig, Asparagus, and a Slowly Arriving Spring / Hive Figと庭に引っ越したアスパラガス
links.body:
Today was cold and slightly rainy, but the tomato seedlings for the garden I had been growing indoors seemed to be saying, “I cannot grow any more in this tiny pot!” On top of that, I have quite a few plans this week and wasn’t sure when I would be able to visit the garden again, so after checking the long-term weather forecast, I went to plant the tomatoes.

When I arrive at the garden, I always start by walking around to check how the plants are doing. This morning, I discovered that the Hive Fig — which I started growing from seed after tasting delicious figs from @livinguktaiwan 's Airbnb host at Hive Fest 2024 — had finally started putting out leaves! This winter was quite cold, and the very top of the branches was brown and dried out, so I was worried about how it would survive. Seeing the new leaves was such a relief.

![99EB6533-15F3-4FE7-A64B-962738711BE3\_1\_105\_c.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/EopsQQoeXqXV7zBDy7xk9JiWeddXwEiYhQQZzW28rMucthfQKjtDtjx3c6RzoVyL9Kx.jpeg)

Another thing that made me really happy in the quiet morning garden was the asparagus. The asparagus I had transplanted from the balcony to the garden successfully sprouted again. I’m also excited to see whether the crowns I bought from the garden center will start emerging soon as well.

![4B53AC1E-571C-4764-AD5F-8B066E0E7783\_1\_105\_c.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/23xozC7CqGgqVenf2ft9qCY5gRP68suE5wGQU95Sdx9iX9FyJYTxreK3cW6T9tUZv5j1R.jpeg)

This year, winter was cold, and even now in May the spring weather in eastern Germany is still unstable, but perhaps the garden is slowly and steadily becoming more spring-like. 

This year, I’ve started taking panorama photos because I want to document the overall shape of the garden over time.

![DDF40BB6-CB3E-4368-BA50-62BABA1093D9\_1\_201\_a.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/Eos1pFKWHrhPs1bgD5rektCq4EZ6BLgasXNx7ddGSgqwbja5M6UTygUKx5C9eH9ctHo.jpeg)

It still looks a little bare, but next week I’m planning to plant cucurbits and beans, and it should gradually turn into a jungle.

Happy gardening, everyone!

---

今日は寒くて若干雨降りだったのですが、室内で育てていたトマトの苗が「限界！！」と言っているようで、さらに今週はちょいちょい予定が入っていていつ庭に行けるかわからなかったので、長期の天気予報を見て庭にトマトを植えに行ってきました。

庭につくと、まず庭の見回りから始めるのですが、Hive Fig（2024年のHive Festで @livinguktaiwan さんのホストのイチヂクがおいしくて種から育て始めました）から葉っぱが出ている！今年の冬は寒くて枝の一番上が枯れてしまっていたのでどうなることかと思いましたが、新しい葉っぱを見て一安心しました。

![99EB6533-15F3-4FE7-A64B-962738711BE3_1_105_c.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/EopsQQoeXqXV7zBDy7xk9JiWeddXwEiYhQQZzW28rMucthfQKjtDtjx3c6RzoVyL9Kx.jpeg)

もうひとつ、一人朝の庭で大喜びしたのがアスパラガスです。バルコニーから庭に移植したアスパラガスが無事芽を出していました。ガーデンセンターで買った球根からも近々目が出てくるかな？と楽しみです。

![4B53AC1E-571C-4764-AD5F-8B066E0E7783_1_105_c.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/23xozC7CqGgqVenf2ft9qCY5gRP68suE5wGQU95Sdx9iX9FyJYTxreK3cW6T9tUZv5j1R.jpeg)

今年は冬が寒く、5月に入ってもまだ春が不安定なドイツ東部ですが、庭は徐々にゆっくり春になりつつあるのかな。今年は庭の全体像を記録したくて、パノラマ写真を撮るようになりました。

![DDF40BB6-CB3E-4368-BA50-62BABA1093D9_1_201_a.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/Eos1pFKWHrhPs1bgD5rektCq4EZ6BLgasXNx7ddGSgqwbja5M6UTygUKx5C9eH9ctHo.jpeg)

ちょっと殺風景ですが、来週瓜類や豆を植えて、どんどんジャングルになるはずです。

それではみなさん、Happy Gardening！

links.title: Holding on and pushing through. My Actifit Diary: May 12 2026
links.body:
Today was such a busy day that I had to decide between taking a walk and writing a post on my main account. I opted for the walk. It was necessary, and although I have some good ideas for posts, I needed to vent my brain. I spent the morning at Nuevo Sol, translating the quality control training and then working on a manual as to administrative responsibilities. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/539e0d90-1cde-4fe1-a7e1-cf52ef443d36.jpg) On my way back I stopped at the veterinary clinic to see how Nero was doing. Not great. He seems either super exhausted or depressed, doesn’t want to eat, didn’t even turn around when I petted him. But he did wag is tail a little and stretched his legs as if he was comfortable. The doctors are still worried. As am I. But I’ll have to wait a little. The good thing is that I got enough donations from my community to cover most of the bills, which takes the financial pressure out of the picture and lets me focus on what’s best for the little guy. He’s on all kinds of treatments, and hopefully in the next two days we’ll see some progress. It's a tough situation, and seeing Nero like this makes me cry a lot. I was prepared for all the distress from the Lily situation. But Nero eating poison? That was one drop too much. Gates are open, flood it is. ![I took this picture of Nero yesterday. He was just waking up after haven gotten the feeding tube in.](https://usermedia.actifit.io/22c1b911-d1ea-4087-b9e1-af0688feb65a.jpg) I was barely able to eat lunch after coming home when the metalworker and my main baker called me to ask a lot of questions that didn’t really make sense to reply on the phone, so I went over to the bakery, and we figured it all out. New molds for hamburger buns are on the way, so are two experimental containers for the dough to rise. Since it’s low-ish season, we use the time to make experiments and offer new products and/or different sizes, and just try to identify where it makes sense to re-invest the cashflow. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/4076aa56-adcf-4569-a81d-4c87340d99be.jpg) After that, it was already 5pm. So, walk or write? Walk it was. Thinking. Letting nature do its magic. Take a look for pictures, but the light wasn’t really that good, so I’m not that content with them. And then, a 2h meeting with the Nuevo Sol team, discussing how to move forward. There are so many fronts to battle on, and we’re barely making progress one the most important ones. But we’re getting close to passing some milestones. In business, setting the base is not only the most important, but also the most difficult part. As soon that is done, and it’s solid, the building on top of it is a lot easier. So, we have to get through these re-adjustments of basics to have a solid construction of the company. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/df787af7-6ac2-4742-ba91-cab5ca53be6a.jpg) It’s fun to work there. I enjoy it and really hope that my consultation will bear fruits for them. Now it’s time to read to Lily, well, to a message box on whose other side hopefully is Lily listening, and Duolingo, and sleep. Tomorrow is going to be stressful, too. Have a good night and thank you for reading!
_This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@beelshops/actifit-beelshops-20260513t025501556z)_

links.body:

![GridArt_20260512_221841188.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cielitorojo/AKAq8MRGSfiLj5LpDwwLyaTipsKzFNmabxXwskxPP328TWdUfj1B9NMSsrFNSNe.jpg)

Feliz martes para todos mis apreciadísimos hivers lectores espero que hayan tenido un día muy productivo, nuevamente paso por aquí para compartirles un nuevo contenido donde se ponen de manifiesto las demostraciones de cariño a nuestros seres especiales, Alegre celebración familiar en el día de las madres, regalos para las princesas de la casa. El día domingo se celebró a nivel mundial en mi país Venezuela la celebración del día de las madres, por supuesto, en mi familia no pudimos quedarnos atrás, al resumen de mi familia fue llegando al lugar de mis padres para celebrar en unión familiar es importante día como es el honrar a las madres procreadoras de vida de la familia Guevara. Mientras transcurrían las horas y disfrutamos meramente este bonito momento familiar, llegó la hora más esperada, jajaja la de entregar a estas hermosas madres sus respectivos regalos y detalles de amor, les puedo decir mis amores, que el más chiquito de la familia, mi sobrino Dylan estaba muy emocionado por agasajar a su abuela paterna y a su querida mamá, todos los regalos estuvieron muy buenos que ando muy contentas y complacidas por estos obsequios y el gran momento que disfrutamos en unión familiar.
![GridArt_20260512_221406842.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cielitorojo/AKGa6pncMorGq6Tu1xHX85Ky5F5g8PctsuxhrM6SWeBw3LxYVYsPCrkUqZMCUAM.jpg)
![GridArt_20260512_221605304.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cielitorojo/AK6XQ45GrfEqPp9mfEWiyxQr4NidtE2LXGJzxR6QqZUF7SkUbxdQzxQWx4wd3kK.jpg)
Gracias por acompañarme aquí y hasta otra oportunidad. Gracias por leerme y su valioso apoyo. Las fotos son mías @cielitorojo con mi Tecno Spark 10 Pro. Traducido con el traductor Deepl

Of course, my family couldn't miss out. links.title: Entry For Reflection Hunters Contest SMARP
links.body:
May you be filled with all blessings!

The rains this week have caused the roadside ponds to become flooded.
Yesterday, I stopped my motorcycle when I came to a pond on the side of the road in a village I often visit.
Then I took out my phone from my bag, turned on the camera, and planned to take a photo of the reflection of a white heron in the pond.
However, the heron flew away, so I couldn’t get a photo of the heron’s reflection.
I had previously featured the reflection of the trees in this pond in the Reflection Hunters Contest last year.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd6UjM7XNPsai4rYH1vtvDTqjZK8auepxAurCLR9pM7GW/img_20260512_114747.jpg)

The second entry is a pond on the road to a monastery in the forest outside a village I have visited a few times this year.
The pond was filled with water from the rains this week.
The Reflection was visible on the water surface because of the tamarind trees that grew near the pond.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW7LDsWeDg9gmgaFw6BkuLKsgMdhs4wMsUhTzhtDPNRKs/img_20260508_095642.jpg)

Although it is not as clear as the first image, it was chosen as the Contest Photo because it is a new image of a place that has not been featured on Hive Blockchain.

မင်္ဂလာအပေါင်းနှင့်ပြည့်စုံကြပါစေ။

ဒီတစ်ပတ်အတွင်း ရွာသွန်းခဲ့သော မိုးရေများသည် လမ်းဘေးက ရေအိုင်များကို ရေများဝပ်စေခဲ့ပါသည်။
မနေ့က ကျွန်တော် ခဏခဏ သွားရောက်ဖြစ်သော ကျေးရွာတစ်ရွာ၏ လမ်းနဘေးမှ ရေအိုင်တစ်ခု အနားရောက်သောအခါ ဆိုင်ကယ်ကို ရပ်နားဖြစ်ခဲ့သည်။
ပြီးတော့ အိတ်ထဲမှ Phone ကို ယူကာ Camera ဖွင့်ပြီး ရေအိုင်ထဲက ဗျိုင်းဖြူတစ်ကောင်၏ အလင်းပြန်ပုံရိပ်ကို ဓာတ်ပုံရိုက်ယူရန် ကြံစည်ခဲ့သည်။
သို့သော် ဗျိုင်းငှက်က ပျံသန်းသွားသောကြောင့် ဗျိုင်း၏ အလင်းပြန်ပုံရိပ်ကို မရခဲ့ပါ။
ဒီရေအိုင်၌ မြင်တွေ့ရသော သစ်ပင်များ၏ အလင်းပြန်ပုံရိပ်ကို ယခင်နှစ်က Reflection Hunters Contest ၌ ဖော်ပြခဲ့ဖူးပါသည်။

ဒုတိယဖော်ပြသော ပြိုင်ပွဲဝင်ပုံကတော့ ဒီနှစ်မှာ ကျွန်တော် ခဏခဏ သွားရောက်ဖြစ်သော ကျေးရွာတစ်ရွာ၏ အပြင်ဘက် တောထဲ၌ တည်ရှိသော ဘုန်းကြီးကျောင်း အဝင် လမ်းဘေးက ရေအိုင် ဖြစ်ပါသည်။
ရေအိုင်သည် ဒီတစ်ပတ် ရွာသွန်းခဲ့သော မိုးရေများ ပြည့်လာခဲ့ခြင်း ဖြစ်သည်။
ရေအိုင် နဘေး၌ မန်းကျည်းပင်များ ရှိ‌ကြသောကြောင့် ရေမျက်နှာပြင်၌ မြင်တွေ့နေရခြင်း ဖြစ်သည်။

ပထမပုံလောက် မကြည်လင်ပေမယ့် Hive Blockchain ၌ မဖော်ပြဖူးသေးသော နေရာသစ် ပုံသစ် ဖြစ်သောကြောင့် Contest Photo အဖြစ် ရွေးချယ်ပေးခဲ့တာပါ။

links.title: The SoloQ torture is over, now we play 5v5. Annie’s adventure continues.
links.body:
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/syberia/Eo6CEKjGn3QrXex7UxC7z6Xj7YUm7jMUSYaTUx2uZo6eQnuUyUjhPBUCNEABCgyWhVQ.jpg
VERSIÓN EN ESPAÑOL (click aquí)

Buenos días, buenas tardes o buenas noches, damas y caballeros. ¿Cómo están? ¿Cómo se encuentran el día de hoy? Espero que bastante bien. Yo particularmente podría decirse que me encuentro mejor emocionalmente, había tenido una especie de bajón pero ando a por todas, queriendo comerme el mundo, espero que me dure bastante este estado de ánimo. Claramente he estado siguiendo mi aventura jugando Annie pero esta vez se acabó la tortura de andar jugando en SoloQ con otros 4 terroristas que no saben ni tocar el videojuego que están jugando. Estos últimos días ha venido a mi casa mi mejor amigo, que fue quien me dijo que me cambiase a Wild Rift porque él jugaba ese y no Honor of Kings, le hice caso aunque muy reacio a la idea, sería aprender de nuevo un moba pero acepté porque estaba cansado de los trolls, en fin, el caso es que nos enseñó a mi primo y a mí quienes pensábamos que no podíamos jugar a menos que yo subiera a Esmeralda que se pueden abrir los equipos en Clasificatoria para que entre gente random pudiendo jugar en 5v5 y he de decir que nos ha ido bastante bien, además que en estas últimas partidas también se ha sumado mi otro primo, por lo que espero que podamos jugar más juntos para poder subir rápido de rango, al fin y al cabo, todos nos beneficiamos de este truquito. Así que sin más dilación, te hablaré un poco de mis últimas partidas en Wild Rift jugando obviamente con Annie.

Good morning, good afternoon or good evening, ladies and gentlemen. How are you? How are you doing today? I hope quite well. Personally, I could say that I'm feeling better emotionally – I had a bit of a slump, but now I'm raring to go, wanting to take on the world, and I hope this mood lasts me a while. Clearly, I've been continuing my adventure playing Annie, but this time the torture of playing SoloQ with four other terrorists who don't even know how to play the video game they're playing is over. These last few days, my best friend has come to my house – he was the one who told me to switch to Wild Rift because he played that one and not Honor of Kings. I listened to him even though I was very reluctant about the idea; it would mean learning a moba from scratch again, but I accepted because I was tired of the trolls. Anyway, the thing is, he taught my cousin and me – who thought we couldn't play unless I reached Emerald – that you can open up teams in Ranked so that random people can join, allowing us to play 5v5, and I must say it's gone quite well for us. Plus, in these last few matches, my other cousin has also joined in, so I hope we can play together more often to be able to climb rank quickly. After all, we all benefit from this little trick. So without further ado, I'll tell you a bit about my latest matches in Wild Rift, obviously playing Annie.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/syberia/EoASz146AadiRQbDX25Gp4FNsGnoCPrDkmBjvvMKBfyQzcTmANJPUb1S7mhv6f9cJaC.jpg
VERSIÓN EN ESPAÑOL (click aquí)

La primera vez que jugué 5v5 fue con mi primo y mi mejor amigo, entraron dos personas, una jugaba de jungla y la otra de ADC, mi primo que usualmente juega ADC se tuvo que cambiar a Support y con esa nos la arreglamos. He de admitir que estas partidas particularmente me fueron mal en cierta forma porque no podía participar de la mejor manera, se me había olvidado bajarle la resolución al juego y entonces se trababa durante las peleas en equipo, haciendo imposible ejecutar bien mis jugadas. Aún así, jugando de esa forma, la primera partida la ganamos de forma aplastante, la verdad que mi mejor amigo es muy buen top y mi primo hizo un buen trabajo como supp a pesar de no jugar habitualmente ahí. Creo que fue tanta nuestra supremacía que se rindieron, pero en la segunda partida no hubo tanta suerte, el top del equipo contrario andaba imparable y no pudimos hacer nada de nada contra él, quedando todos totalmente anulados, en cambio, la mejor diría que fue la última partida de la noche, donde estuvo muy reñida hasta que el ADC fue tomando varias kills y mataba y mataba, logrando fedearse al final otorgándonos la ventaja suficiente para hacer barón y luego el dragón, culminando la partida de forma magistral. Cabe mencionar que la presión inicial era toda del equipo contrario pero se tuvo un buen mental y todos hicieron lo mejor para remar la partida.

The first time I played 5v5 was with my cousin and my best friend; two people joined, one played jungle and the other ADC. My cousin, who usually plays ADC, had to switch to Support, and we managed with that. I have to admit that these matches went badly for me in a way because I couldn't participate properly – I had forgotten to lower the game's resolution and so it would lag during team fights, making it impossible to execute my plays well. Even so, playing like that, we won the first match in a crushing way. The truth is that my best friend is a very good top laner and my cousin did a good job as support despite not usually playing there. I think our supremacy was such that they surrendered. But in the second match we weren't so lucky: the enemy team's top laner was unstoppable and we couldn't do anything at all against him, leaving us all completely nullified. On the other hand, I'd say the best was the last match of the night, where it was very close until the ADC started getting several kills and kept killing and killing, managing to get fed in the end, giving us enough advantage to take Baron and then the dragon, finishing the match in a masterful way. It's worth mentioning that the initial pressure was all from the enemy team, but we had a good mentality and everyone did their best to turn the match around.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/syberia/EoASxFXyXcA2bVbU9hKoiMy15a8t15wQP5muYJsESK5U3eeZCCytwSqmPiGZrfDmNjU.jpg
VERSIÓN EN ESPAÑOL (click aquí)

La última partida que jugué fue el Día de las Madres (espero que la hayan pasado bien ustedes lectores y sus madrecitas), en el cual mi mejor amigo vino de visita, le dije para jugar y me dijo para que fuese una sola partida porque luego tenía que irse a cocinar, por lo que invité ahora a mis dos primos para que se arme el equipo, esta vez todo estuvo un poco más organizado porque cada quien tenía su rol, solo faltaba el jungla y justo el random lo era, así que todo perfecto. Lo que más puedo destacar de esta partida es que sin dudas quebré a mi contrincante de línea el cual era un Veigar, usualmente me da un fastidio jugar contra ellos pero este simplemente se regalaba todo el tiempo podría decir que fácilmente pude haberlo matado como 4 veces durante el comienzo de la partida, el loco se descuidaba y si le hacía un combo era muerte casi instantánea. El jungla lo hizo bastante bien , resistía bastante, al igual que mi mejor amigo que me salvó varias veces durante la partida con su habilidad, la cual me otorgaba un montón de escudo, el cual yo personalmente no sabía de dónde salía hasta que él me explicó, demasiadas buenas jugadas me marqué y por fin logré conseguir una S, personalmente había pensado que obtendría el MVP por mi comienzo, donde tenía unas 10 kills, muchísimo más que los demás , pero luego nada más contribuí en las batallas de equipo haciendo stun causando que me contaran asistencias cuando en el principio no tenía ni una. Lo único malo de esta partida diría que fue que no pude llegar a ver cómo rompían el nexo pero bueno, sin más nada que decir, me despido por el día de hoy.

The last match I played was on Mother's Day (I hope you readers and your dear mothers had a good time), on which my best friend came to visit. I asked him to play and he told me to make it just one match because he then had to go cook, so I then invited my two cousins to make up the team. This time everything was a bit more organised because everyone had their role; we were only missing the jungler and luckily the random was that, so perfect. What I can highlight most about this match is that without a doubt I broke my lane opponent, who was a Veigar. I usually find it annoying to play against them, but this one simply kept gifting himself all the time – I could say that I could easily have killed him like four times during the early game. The fool would let his guard down and if I did a combo on him it was almost instant death. The jungler did quite well – he was quite durable – as did my best friend, who saved me several times during the match with his ability, which gave me a lot of shield; I personally didn't know where it came from until he explained it to me. I pulled off too many good plays and finally managed to get an S grade. Personally, I had thought I would get MVP for my start, where I had about 10 kills, much more than the others, but afterwards I only contributed in team fights by stunning, causing me to get assists counted when at the beginning I didn't have a single one. The only bad thing about this match, I'd say, was that I couldn't get to see how they broke the nexus, but oh well. Without anything else to say, I'll say goodbye for today.

___
Traducido con DeepSeek / Translated with DeepSeek

links.title: Entre notas y paletas Nuestra sorpresa para las mamis del núcleo.|Between notes and lollipops: Our surprise for the moms in our community.
links.body:
> Hola, amigos, ¿qué tal están? Por aquí estamos a nada de celebrar el Día de la Madre en el núcleo y lo haremos en un espacio súper lindo llamado la Cinemateca. Es un lugar más amplio y con más confort, lo cual nos anima mucho; cada vez que los niños salen de los espacios a los que están acostumbrados, viven una experiencia nueva y le ponen más entusiasmo a las cosas.
Hi, friends, how are you all doing? We’re just about to celebrate Mother’s Day at the center, and we’ll be doing it at a really lovely venue called La Cinemateca. It’s a more spacious and comfortable place, which really excites us; whenever the kids get to go somewhere different from what they’re used to, they have a new experience and get even more excited about things. ​On another note, my colleague and I were thinking about what small gift to give the mothers that wouldn’t be too expensive. Beyond the cost, we wanted the children to have the chance to give their moms a little something. Even though they didn’t do it directly and we covered the cost ourselves, we decided to make some little cards and print them; by the way, they were laser-printed and look spectacular. In addition to that, we bought heart-shaped lollipops. It was a small gesture we liked—something simple that each child could give to their mom, considering we have quite a large number of students. I plan to have the children present this gift at the end of the activity. The process was quite simple: we just used silicone, the cards, and the lollipops. We glued the image directly onto the heart of the lollipop, and the stick makes it easier for the children to hold. Doing something like this is always very rewarding for us, as we do it with love so that our children can feel the joy of giving their moms a gift on concert day.
​Por otra parte, mi compañera y yo estábamos pensando en qué detalle darles a las madres que no fuera tan costoso. Más allá del valor, queríamos que los niños tuvieran el gesto de entregarles algo a sus mamis. Aunque ellos no lo hicieron directamente y el gasto salió de nuestro dinero, decidimos hacer unas tarjetitas e imprimirlas; por cierto, me las imprimieron a láser y se ven espectaculares.
On another note, my colleague and I were thinking about what small gift we could give the mothers that wouldn’t be too expensive. More than the cost, we wanted the children to have the chance to give their moms a little something. Even though the kids didn’t do it themselves and we paid for it out of our own pockets, we decided to make some little cards and print them out; by the way, they were laser-printed and they look amazing.
​Además de eso, compramos una chupeta o paleta en forma de corazón. Fue un pequeño gesto que nos gustó, algo sencillo que cada niño le pudiese entregar a su mami, considerando que tenemos una cantidad de alumnos bastante grande. Tengo pensado que al final de la actividad los niños hagan la entrega de este detalle.
On top of that, we bought some heart-shaped lollipops. It was a small gesture that we really liked—something simple that each child could give to their mom, especially since we have quite a large class. I’m planning to have the children present this little gift at the end of the activity.
​El proceso fue bastante sencillo: solo usamos silicón, las tarjetas y las paletas. Pegamos la imagen directamente en el corazón de la paleta, y el palito nos sirve para que los niños lo puedan agarrar con más facilidad. Siempre tener un gesto así es muy enriquecedor para nosotras, pues lo hacemos con amor para que nuestros niños sientan la alegría de regalarle algo a su mamá el día del concierto.
The process was pretty simple: we just used silicone, the cards, and the popsicle sticks. We glued the image directly onto the center of the popsicle stick, and the stick makes it easier for the kids to hold. Doing something like this is always very rewarding for us, because we do it with love so that our children can feel the joy of giving their moms a gift on concert day.

links.title: New chopping boards [Esp/Eng]
links.body:
> Hello, friends at Hive and Home Solutions, how is everyone? I’m fine, though I’ve been a bit short on time because of work, but I wanted to tell you about a kitchen essential we bought a few days ago at the homeware shop **Mango Bajito**. It’s a set of chopping boards, but they’re very different from the ones you usually find in shops—the thick wooden or plastic ones—because these are very thin and seem to be in fashion, as they were the ones most commonly available.
ESPAÑOL

Hola amigos de Hive y Home Solutions, cómo están todos? Yo bien pero con poco tiempo por el trabajo, pero quería contarles de una compra necesaria para la cocina que hicimos hace unos días en la tienda para el hogar **Mango Bajito**. Es un juego de tablas para cortar, pero unas muy distintas a las que uno generalmente encontraba en las tiendas que son las gruesas de madera o plástico, porque éstas son muy delgadas y parece que están de moda porque era de las que más había.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdca2KwYZUMkW7iSP8NApxTu6xaj9Wcd3S7HGRWEFoWQi/1778640799855.png) https://images.hive.blog/DQmTphUarKuYr5DZnpue1jqNXi6kg3s7koZrrYxYfaQvyGe/18.png My wife had been wanting to buy one of those sets of chopping boards for a while now – the ones that come in a set with several different sizes, so you can use a separate one for each thing and avoid cross-contamination when cooking. Rosa really wanted that, especially as the one we had was getting rather old. Well, friends, it turns out that last week my wife went with her friend @floreudys79 to Mango Bajito, where she saw several models of chopping boards at good prices. Her friend chose exactly the ones she liked, and when she got home she told me she wanted them. So on Saturday we went to buy them because they were a bargain – just $5 for three boards.
ESPAÑOL

Desde hace tiempo que mi esposa quería comprar de estas tablas que vienen como en combo y como vienen varias en diferentes tamaños porque se puede usar una para cada cosa y evitar la contaminación cruzada cuando se cocina y Rosa quería eso, además que la que teníamos ya estaba vieja. Bueno amigos, resulta que la semana pasada mi esposa fue con la amiga @floreudys79 a Mango Bajito y ahí vio varios modelos de tablas para picar, y a buenos precios y su amiga escogió justamente las que le gustaban a ella y cuando llegó a la casa me dijo que las quería y el sábado fuimos a comprarlas porque estaban a buen precio, nada más 5$ y son tres tablas.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXN2bCuxKfg23sm72NsjVM5DXRBVBvKLmgjZbBKLSdLR5/1778640800335.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYJBiLUqJNZrB7yBtjNCV6C8JaaDS1GZ3Q4UGVQsAeXrh/1778640800079.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme4ykkYUAzGBwuYNWX2fdL86ic35Q5EBTYbQ2QkU6TeCy/1778640800583.jpg) https://images.hive.blog/DQmTphUarKuYr5DZnpue1jqNXi6kg3s7koZrrYxYfaQvyGe/18.png The set includes three cutting boards of different sizes in grey, each in a different shade of grey. They’re made from a firm, thin material with a textured surface for a better grip when chopping, and they can be folded, which is handy for transferring what you’ve chopped straight into the frying pan or saucepan. These boards have many good points: firstly, the price, as three boards for $5 is excellent; secondly, as there are three of them, they can be used for different things. We use the large one for meat, the medium one for vegetables and the smallest one for fruit and cold meats; they are easy to wash and dry very quickly. The only thing I don’t like is that the underside isn’t non-slip, but my wife sorted that out by putting a bit of silicone on the corners underneath.
ESPAÑOL

El combo trae tres tablas de tamaños diferentes en color gris, cada una con un tono diferente de gris y es de un material que es firme y delgado con la superficie rugosa para un mejor agarre a la hora de cortar y se puede doblar cosa que es útil para echar lo que se corta directamente a a la sartén u olla. Estas tablas tienen muchas cosas positivas, primeramente el precio porque tres tablas por 5$ está muy bien, en segundo lugar cómo son 3 se pueden usar para distintas cosas. Nosotros dejamos la grande para la carnes, la mediana para vegetales y la más chiquita para frutas y charcutería, se lavan con facilidad y se secan con mucha rapidez. Lo único que no me gusta es que la parte de abajo no es antiresbalanre pero mi esposa lo arregló con un poquito de silicon que le puso por debajo en las esquinas.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNZJM4b3DuF2ZSyQvmGAfymRLsG3pirKPLJyXTtaSndFf/1778640800841.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUkyWkXNY1WefoFyoghZ28DEKRu68fZRikx596V2AxwEo/1778640918600.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNYUEtTu6Jgjk2ap5q6CuRRekf2Q8hUTtDtREY6gcoViV/1778640918847.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSp1jjHXLK1Ksfd277kk9GYkEyJeWdTdBWVe896pPzUos/1778640919045.jpg) https://images.hive.blog/DQmTphUarKuYr5DZnpue1jqNXi6kg3s7koZrrYxYfaQvyGe/18.png Another thing I like is that they have a hole in one corner for hanging them up, and my wife, who’s very creative, took the circular plastic ring that held the boards in the packaging and stuck it to the kitchen splashback using cold silicone—so now the boards are hanging there, ready to hand. Well, friends, that’s all for today. Best wishes, and see you next time.
ESPAÑOL

Otra cosa que me gusta es que traen un hueco en un esquina para colgarlas y mi esposa que es muy creativa agarró el plástico circular que sostenía las tablas en el empaque y lo pegó con silicón frío en el salpicadero de la cocina y ahí están colgadas las tablas a la mano para usarlas. Bueno amigos eso es todo por hoy. Saludos y hasta otro momento.
